﻿Chapter 1381: Chapter 527 Devouring the Beast of the World, Titan Peak_3 Chapter 1381: Chapter 527 Devouring the Beast of the World, Titan Peak_3 “`
Roar!
Suddenly, a brutal roar erupted from the center of the explosion, followed by even more violent fluctuations of strength that spread out layer upon layer in the Void.
Amidst the shattered continental blocks at the center, black and red lightning danced around, echoing with the thunder, while endless golden flames burst forth, enveloping an area of hundreds of kilometers.
At the heart of the sea of fire filled with the destructive power of higher-order laws, an ancient centipede beast, ten thousand meters in length, roared furiously as if it were a black demon dragon cutting through space-time, spiraling around the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Due to the fusion of rule and body, the ancient centipede’s body was incredibly strong; the destructive lightning and thunder that struck it merely blasted small pits into its surface.
Even the golden flames, hot enough to reduce a titan beast to ash in a short period, only caused its body to redden slightly.
This was a creature that had strengthened its giant beast body to the limit.
However, in the clash that happened moments earlier, the smaller Destruction Emperor Dragon exhibited even more terrifying strength, forcefully suppressing it and causing the ancient centipede some apprehension.
Roar!
The ancient centipede beast roared, striking like black lightning from behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, attempting to use its colossal body to wrap around and pulverize the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
But in the instant the ancient centipede pounced, the Destruction Emperor Dragon violently turned its head, with muscles in its arms, wrapped in black and red lightning, swelling, and its double claws opening furiously, the terrifying power causing the space tens of kilometers ahead to distort and collapse.
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon seized the upper body of the ancient centipede with one movement, shattering the void beneath it; when the two giant beasts collided, they unleashed a terrifying shockwave of power.
Roar!
With each claw grasping the sides of the ancient centipede’s neck and upper body, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a fierce roar from its gaping maw, each huge tooth shining with a razor-sharp cold light.
Boom!
Under the terror of its biting force, the ancient centipede’s black shell, hundreds of meters in diameter and over ten meters thick, shattered like a nuclear explosion, releasing terrifying energy and explosive radiance.
The ancient centipede issued a piercing scream; the Destruction Emperor Dragon had bitten a hole two hundred meters deep and over three hundred meters wide into its body, nearly severing it.
At the site of the wound, there was a metallic luster, but not a drop of blood flowed out.
Most importantly, the ancient centipede was terrified to find that, in the moment the black and red giant beast bit down, the soul and rule strength fused with that part of its body had disappeared.
They were gone, as if erased by some terrible power.
This was the tenth deification talent of the Destruction Emperor Dragon: the power of the Dark Realm, which it obtained after reaching grand accomplishment in the laws mystery, absorbing chaos crystal stone energy, and undergoing growth and evolution.
Devouring.
Anything bitten and devoured by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whether it be a titan beast or an ancient beast, would completely lose that part of its body, and even its strong vitality could not restore it.
Because in the soul imprint of the ancient centipede beast, that part of its body did not exist anymore.
This terrifying law mastery made the Destruction Emperor Dragon an absolute terror, a giant beast that devours everything.
And facing this “average” ancient beast from the early stages, the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t even bother to transform into its crimson form, ready to directly devour it.
Roar!
Sensing the intense threat emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the ancient centipede beast instinctively let out a terrified roar and wound its ten thousand meter-long body around the Destruction Emperor Dragon like a giant python.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
On both sides of the ancient centipede, legs hundreds of meters in length and sharp as blades furiously slashed across the black and red scale armor, erupting with terrifying roars and dazzling firelight.
Yet, the ancient centipede’s legs, powerful enough to tear space and slice through all laws, left nothing but white marks on the black and red scales, unable to shake them in the slightest.
Thanks to the tenth deification talent and the tempering of higher-order laws, along with devouring over a dozen metal mine veins of heavy matter, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body had become strong enough to ignore the attacks of ancient beasts.
Roar!
With a forceful burst from its claws and shattering the void beneath its feet, the Destruction Emperor Dragon disregarded the struggles of the other beast and bit once again into the wound on the neck of the ancient centipede.
“`
Boom!
A terrible bite, that directly snapped the ancient centipede’s neck in half, instantly weakened the aura of the once powerful ancient beast.
Lacking rules and with a shattered soul, the beast, now split into two, completely lost its will to resist.
“So, so strong!” the golden-blue giant dragon opened its huge maw, shocked at the sight of the Destruction Emperor Dragon tearing apart the ancient beast and devouring it, bite by bite.
When the Destruction Emperor Dragon killed the Six-tailed White Tiger earlier, it had also shown overwhelming strength.
However, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its Deep Red Form took some time to wear down the ancient beast’s strong vitality and soul will.
Now, with the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s growth nearing Titan Peak and its size becoming increasingly colossal, even the beasts from the ancient early stages were rendered helpless against it.
Such terrifying strength and growth rate left even the oft-shaken golden-blue giant dragon at a loss for words.
However, in contrast to the golden-blue dragon’s shock, the silver giant dragon was excited: “Roar! Tim Abott is invincible, so awesome, roar roar…”.
In the Void filled with wild air currents, a dragon stood tall. The Black-red Colossal Beast over two thousand meters high stood erect, its double claws clutched to the still struggling ancient centipede, voraciously devouring it.
Around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a silver giant dragon, a thousand meters long, let out high-pitched roars of excitement, encircling with joy.
Crackle crackle!!
With the metalized flesh and blood of the ancient beast devoured, an abundance of energy was transformed, and the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon visibly swelled with terrifying power at an alarming rate.
At the same time, within the Destruction Emperor Dragon, strands of Evolution Energy flowed through the Soul Channel, making its way into Jack Clark, far away.
Momentarily, the aura of Jack’s True Demon God Body, that was transforming into Heavenly King, grew even more terrifying, as the scope of the black holes that distorted the surrounding space rapidly expanded, enveloping an area of a hundred and twenty kilometers.
Under the invisible, heavy gravitational field, the mountain ranges that had turned to grey stone across a thousand kilometers suddenly collapsed, booming and billowing smoke and dust.
“What a fearsome human expert!”
Over two thousand kilometers away, feeling the ever more terrifying aura that was nearly on par with a Divine King level, Kordes’s face turned slightly pale.
Disbelief was also evident.
Boom!
In the shaking space-time of the dark space, a Black-red Colossal Beast, four thousand meters long, stood, exuding an incredibly ferocious aura that twisted space-time.
Due to its devouring talent, an ancient beast that was ten thousand meters long and hundreds of meters thick was completely consumed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon in just half a day.
Its size surged from three thousand eight hundred meters to four thousand, its realm reaching Titan Peak, only one step away from the Ancient Level.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon looked into the depths of the pitch-black space, its golden vertical pupils cold, and its ferocious maw slightly opened to emit a deep growl, “Let’s go, continue on the journey.”

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1382: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast Chapter 1382: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast Just when the Destruction Emperor Dragon thought there were many creatures surpassing myths at the other end of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the next million kilometers seemed inconsequential.
It felt as if they had truly arrived in the vastness of outer space, desolate, deadly silent.
Occasionally, dense asteroid belts would appear, or on continental blocks thousands to tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter, there was also not a trace of vitality, no Heavenly Energy.
Such an extreme environment naturally was not suitable for Transcendent Life to inhabit.
And, to maintain their consumption, both the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast relied on flying with their wings, not daring to release their Law Domains, lest they deplete their strength without anywhere to replenish it.
To the left of the Black-red Colossal Beast, which measured four thousand kilometers long with a wingspan exceeding seven thousand kilometers, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, with a body length just over a thousand meters, looked at the surrounding pitch-black Void and felt somewhat bored.
Roar! Thunderflame, do we still need to fly forward, it feels like there’s nothing here, why not change directions?
Within the golden vertical pupils of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the gaze remained calm and imposing. Its massive mouth opened slightly, emitting a deep and sonorous growl, “Continue flying, I want to see just how vast this Chaotic Domain really is.”
“And pay more attention to our surroundings, I have a feeling there might be good things around. The more extreme the place, the higher the chances of precious resources emerging.”
That’s true, if we find a pile of Law-level resources, we will strike it rich. The Single-horned Spawn Roc felt its spirit lifted, and its unique horn emitted invisible waves of light, scanning the surroundings.
Although in the unending Dark Void, if there were any Heaven and Earth Treasures emitting light, they would be discovered first-hand by the Giant Beasts, even if they were thousands to tens of thousands of kilometers away.
However, some Divine Objects might dim themselves or be hidden deep within imperceptible Space Cracks, making them extremely hard to find.
At this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly on the side, “Roar! Tim Abott, even the Great Sethia can find good things.”
You? The huge head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned slightly, looking toward the Silver Giant Dragon flying with its wings outstretched to the right, its gaze calm, brimming with wisdom.
“Roar! Dammit, Tim, is your look mocking the Great Sethia?” the Silver Giant Dragon bellowed furiously.
A sinister smile curled at the corners of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth, “Why would I mock Sethia, when Joe can find resources because he has a treasure hunting talent, what are you relying on?”
The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes shone with pride, “Roar! The Great Sethia relies on luck, of course.”
Instantaneously, the gaze of the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew even more peculiar.
Does this fellow really think all the Divine Fruit, Gold Crystals, and the Scale of Laws from a Titan Beast it picked up on its runaway journey back then was all thanks to good luck?
“Roar! The Great Sethia did not deceive the dragon, my luck has been fantastic since I was young, I always find good things when I go out, don’t believe me, ask Telsafi.”
Saying so, the Silver Giant Dragon looked to the side, where a gold-and-blue Giant Dragon stretched out its elegant double wings, its transparent, crystal-like Dragon Scales radiated a seven-colored glow even in the pitch-black of space, making it appear exceedingly gorgeous and beautiful.
When questioned by the Silver Giant Dragon, the gold-and-blue Giant Dragon pondered for a moment, then elegantly nodded, “Sethia’s luck is indeed good, it did not lie to the dragon.”
“I remember when the Great Torsa had just hatched, probably at the age of one, mom took me to visit Adriana next door.”
“At that time, I was only at sixth level, and while mom was conversing with Adriana, I, feeling bored, flew out of the palace and encountered Sethia, who was planning to sneak out to play.”
“That guy lied to the Great Torsa back then, claiming that Adriana had told it to take me out to play. I didn’t think too much of it, and followed it out of the Icebound Mountain Range.”
“Unexpectedly, as soon as we entered the forest below the mountains, we encountered an Eighth Level Beast in a state of berserk, and in our flight, Sethia led me into an underground crack.”
“Then in the depths of the earth, we found a lot of Dragon Scale Fruit, which could purify the bloodlines of dragons, and after eating them, we both awakened new Advanced Talents.”
“But I heard that, later on, Sethia was confined by Aunt Adriana for a long time.”
The Silver Giant Dragon stamped its feet a bit, “Roar! Damned Torsa, what sneaking out, that time we obviously got lost and accidentally flew out of the mountain range, that’s all.”
The gold-and-blue Giant Dragon looked at it, couldn’t be bothered to care, and continued to growl, “But at that time, I just thought we were lucky, I didn’t take it seriously.”
“After going back, I quickly broke through to Level 7, feeling a bit bored, I flew over to the neighbors to find Sethia, and again met it sneaking out.”
Suddenly, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but pause, it turned out the Silver Giant Dragon’s habit of sneaking out had been there since it was young.
“That time, although Sethia made up another excuse, the Great Torsa immediately knew it was lying, but I didn’t expose it.”
“Then that time, as our pathfinder, Sethia got us lost again.”
“We were supposed to go to a plain outside the mountain range, filled with blooming flowers ‘to see the flowers’, but somehow we inexplicably ended up deep in the forest, and then once again encountered a Level 9 Giant Beast.”
“That Giant Beast resided in Aunt Adriana’s territory and could discern the Monarch’s aura that Sethia carried, but just then the beast had been poisoned and fallen into a berserk state.”
“Then we were chased again, falling into the collapsing remnants of a dangerous relic building, where we found two strands of Pure Law Origin.”
“It was also because of those two strands of Law Origin that both Sethia and I merged with the Innate runes our mother bestowed upon us ahead of time, awakening our Top-tier Talents.”
“At the same time, I also felt something was off, and after several tests, I found that as long as Sethia got lost and ran around, if you follow it, you could find good things.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1383 - 1383 528 The Often Beaten Giant Dragon The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1383: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast – Part 2 Chapter 1383: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast – Part 2 “These resources, though they lay within the domains of my mother and aunt, are of the hidden variety, which normally go undiscovered by beasts.”
“And the biggest haul was nine years ago, when Scythia went running amok and I fell thousands of kilometers deep into an underground crack, where we ‘picked up’ the Earth Heart Cold Marrow Divine Liquid.”
“That’s something even a Level 7 Colossus can absorb, comparable to Law Level resources, capable of enhancing the soul strength of a gigantic beast and strengthening its Soul Source.”
“But because I consumed the Earth Heart Cold Marrow Divine Liquid, both Scythia and I ended up frozen in hibernation underground for nine years.”
Speaking of this, the Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat irritated, “Roar! Damn Telsafi, even though the Great Scythia brought you so many excellent items, you still bully me so often.”
The gold-blue giant dragon couldn’t help but growl softly, “Nonsense, if it weren’t for Scythia, the Great Telsafi wouldn’t have been beaten up so many times when we were that young.”
At this point, even the gold-blue giant dragon was somewhat speechless.
“Scythia’s ‘luck’ is good, alright, but every time we either encounter a rampaging beast or one that’s even stronger, we get beat up before we find anything good.”
“If it weren’t for the defensive runes we had stored in the Reverse Scale Space, we would have been in trouble long ago.”
This… does seem rather tragic. Both the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc had a faint smile in their eyes.
Compared to the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s innate talent for treasure hunting, the Silver Giant Dragon’s luck might be good, finding treasures every time it got lost, but it also came with danger.
However, it seems like the Single-horned Spawn Roc isn’t much better off.
Most of the Heaven and Earth Treasures it discovered were guarded by powerful beasts. Back in the Blue Star Ocean, this guy was either fighting or on his way to recovering from heavy injuries.
Thinking of this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but growl curiously, “Scythia, did you enter the Blue Star World Channel originally just because you got lost?”
The Silver Giant Dragon shook its head and roared, “Roar! No, the Great Scythia’s goal was to enter that Indigenous World, to dominate the world and establish a Beast Empire.”
The gold-blue giant dragon curtly growled with revelation, “Lies, it originally wanted to explore the Misty Area.”
“But while flying, it deviated from the intended direction and ended up near the pathway Barron was guarding. Then, it just went with the flow and entered your world.”
“At that time, not just the Great Telsafi was following it, but also Adriana. Along the way, we lost many good things for it to pick up.”
“Roar! Those Golden Crystal Fruits were also things you dropped along the way?” the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened.
The gold-blue giant dragon rolled its eyes elegantly, “Of course, foolish Scythia. Did you really think the Vast World is littered with Divine Objects? If so, they would have already been devoured by the surrounding giant beasts.”
The Silver Giant Dragon was immediately a bit indignant, “Damn, you actually teamed up to deceive the Great Scythia.”
The gold-blue giant dragon growled lazily, “No, we didn’t deceive you; you’re just too dumb to realize what was obvious.”
Watching the two giant dragons snarling at one another, the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but shake its head.
Alright then, after all that, it turns out that the Silver Giant Dragon ended up in the Blue Star due to getting lost, thereby activating its luck and stumbling upon the Thunderflame Beheamoth at that time.
Including later encounters with Kidora.
At that time, the Thunderflame Beheamoth was hibernating, and the Silver Giant Dragon, along with the Single-horned Tiger Whale and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, rampaged through the surroundings, then came across the more powerful Nine-headed Flood Dragon and all three beasts got beaten up badly.
Looking into the endless pitch-black Void, the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly growled, “Scythia, since your luck is ‘so good,’ why don’t you lead the way? Just fly randomly.”
“Roar! Damn Tim Abott, you think the Great Scythia would get lost?” The Silver Giant Dragon, somewhat angry, then raised its head and roared proudly.
“Tim Abott, aren’t you always flying in that direction, trying to reach the end of the Chaotic Turbulent Region? Today, the Great Scythia will show you all that getting lost is impossible!”
Roar!
With a high-spirited roar, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings vigorously, causing a strong current to blast out, turning into a streak of silver light zooming forward into the distance.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon prepared to speed up and follow, the gold-blue giant dragon growled, “Thunderflame, don’t follow too closely or Scythia won’t get lost.”
Alright then. The Destruction Emperor Dragon paused for a moment, then nodded in agreement.
In the pitch-black Void, the thousand-and-fifty-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon flew rapidly ahead, followed by the even more massive Destruction Emperor Dragon and the two other colossal beasts a few hundred kilometers behind.
Initially, the Silver Giant Dragon’s flight direction was accurate, but as it flew, a meteorite belt composed of countless fragments appeared ahead.
These fragments ranged from just a few tens of meters to dozens of kilometers in size. Seeing this, the Silver Giant Dragon immediately felt a tickle in its throat.
Boom!
A white frosty Dragon Roar spread across the Void, and meteorites over two hundred kilometers away exploded instantaneously, like white fireworks blooming in the Void, resulting in shockwaves that swept across more than a hundred kilometers like white halos.
Boom boom boom!! Excited Dragon Roar emanated from the Silver Giant Dragon as its breath poured out like white laser beams, pulverizing all meteorites within a thousand kilometers.
However, as the Silver Giant Dragon with its two-thousand-meter wingspan swept through the explosion’s epicenter in the gusts of wind and continued its flight, the Destruction Emperor Dragon following behind paused momentarily.
It had noticed that the Silver Giant Dragon seemed to have deviated from its course.
Meanwhile, the Silver Giant Dragon, having a blast up front, looked back and roared, “Roar! Tim Abott, speed up! The Great Scythia is going to accelerate!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1384 - 1384 528 The Often Beaten Giant Dragon The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1384: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast – Part 3 Chapter 1384: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast – Part 3 The Silver Giant Dragon’s double wings burst with power, and in an instant, it transformed into a streak of swift silver light cutting through the darkness.
Following behind the rapidly flying Silver Giant Dragon, the Three-headed Giant Beast pursued at a leisurely pace.
Thanks to the gusts of wind stirred up by the Destruction Emperor Dragon flapping its wings, the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the golden-blue Giant Dragon found it easy to fly by riding the airflow on either side of it.
Amid the raging wind wave, the golden-blue Giant Dragon slightly tilted its body, spread its double wings, and flew a little ahead of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, dipping down to fly side by side under its wings.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon slightly raised its head, looking at the enormous black and red majestic dragon head beside it, and softly roared, “Thunderflame, has Great Scythia flown off course?”
“Hmm, it has deviated from the direction,” nodded the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“As expected.”
A faint smile appeared in the eyes of the golden-blue Giant Dragon, “Great Scythia’s attention is easily distracted. It doesn’t take long into the flight for it to be swayed by external factors.”
“Sometimes it’s the sight of beautiful Unique Beasts that look like butterflies, sometimes a pretty flower, and there was even a time when it started to doze off mid-flight.”
“This guy really doesn’t give a dragon peace of mind. When it was young, every time we went out, we had to keep an eye on it, or it might disappear in the blink of an eye, leaving a dragon searching high and low.”
“By the time I found it, this guy would be gleefully roaring with no concern, thinking I was playing hide and seek with it. It’s such a dumbbell.”
“When this guy first entered your world, I was actually prepared to follow, but Aunt Adriana stopped me.”
“She said that Great Scythia will grow up someday, and we can’t always follow behind and watch over it.” Watching the Silver Giant Dragon happily ‘flying in disarray’ in the distance, the golden-blue Giant Dragon’s gaze was gentle.
“But thankfully, Scythia is lucky to have met you right after it arrived; otherwise, with its nature, it would definitely suffer in your world.”
After a moment of thought, the Destruction Emperor Dragon said, “Actually, Scythia isn’t as foolish as you all think; it’s just a bit… naïve, with a rather simplistic mind.
Although the Silver Giant Dragon usually appears to be adorably clumsy, when it comes to serious matters it remains quite responsible and opinionated; it’s just that these barely noticeable merits are overshadowed by its ‘foolishness’ most of the time.
In the casual conversation between the two Giant Dragons, two days quickly passed, and the Four Great Beasts flew more than three million kilometers in the unblocked Dark Space.
And they had strayed far from the edge of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, not knowing where they had flown to.
Suddenly in the Void, an excited roar of the Silver Giant Dragon echoed, “Roar! Tim Abott, Telsafi, come quickly; Great Scythia has found something good.”
Behind a stretch of fragmented rocks spanning hundreds of kilometers across the Void, the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly looked ahead to a transparent river winding through the Dark Void that was over a hundred kilometers in length.
The transparent river was more than ten kilometers wide, flowing out from an unknown Void and disappearing again through a fracture on the other end. The surrounding dense time forces pervaded the air, distorting space-time.
As the Silver Giant Dragon roared, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast also appeared atop the huge meteorite.
Looking at the region where space-time was twisted, like a physical manifestation of a section of the Time River, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes revealed a hint of surprise; it didn’t expect the Silver Giant Dragon to truly make a discovery.
Although the Time River was mystical, it seemed to be of no use, right?
Instead, it was extremely dangerous. If one carelessly got swept into this segment of the Time River, an ordinary Mythical Giant Beast would instantly be thrown into an unknown space-time, forever lost.
Noticing the puzzlement in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes, the experienced golden-blue Giant Dragon softly roared, “Thunderflame, don’t rush; there must be something good inside, but be careful of the danger too.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly.
Splash! A clear sound of water splashing rose.
Within that clear, transparent river, a silver small fish, about ten meters long, seemingly popped out of nowhere, leapt high, and continued to twist its body in midair, as if trying to leap out of time.
However, the constraints of time were powerful, and after the silver small fish surged hundreds of meters high, it fell back into the river with a splash and disappeared, leaving behind ripples on the water’s surface.
At the instant the silver small fish appeared, the Single-horned Spawn Roc let out an excited cry, and its horn emitted a dazzling light.
Roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, good thing, that fish is a good thing. It’s of Law Level, no, it feels stronger than the Law, very strong.
At that moment, another slightly larger silver small fish leapt high from the river, then fell back with a splash, and promptly the light from the horn on the Single-horned Spawn Roc’s head became even more brilliant.
Clearly, there were not just one of those mystical small fishes in the Time River.
The Silver Giant Dragon raised its head proudly, “Roar! Tim Abott, isn’t Great Scythia amazing?”
“Indeed impressive. Now, you guys back up a bit, and I will catch those fish,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared as it spread its double wings, slowly flying toward the distant Time River.
Seeing this, the other three Giant Beasts retreated a little, excited and anticipating, wondering what benefits eating those small fishes might bring.
Boom! As the Destruction Emperor Dragon approached within a hundred kilometers of that segment of the Time River, it was like entering a heavy mire, as powerful forces of space-time distortion from all directions swept over it.
On the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a layer of invisible, murky power diffused over its black and red scaled armor, forming a Chaotic Force Field capable of dissolving all powers, immovable.
Soon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, carrying the strength of time that could wear down a Titan Beast, arrived above the river.
Even there, the Destruction Emperor Dragon became very cautious, flying at a low altitude of a few thousand meters, to avoid any possible turbulence from the Time River below.

chapters.title: Chapter 1385 - 1385 528 The Often Beaten Giant Dragon The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1385: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast – Part 4 Chapter 1385: Chapter 528: The Often Beaten Giant Dragon, The Awakening of the True Spirit Beast – Part 4 “`
In the patient wait of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, half an hour later, the river surface ten-odd kilometers away exploded with spray, as a silver small fish about fifteen meters long leapt high into the air.
Here it comes. The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes lit up.
Boom!
Amidst the tremors of Time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon instantly appeared over ten kilometers away, as its massive black Dragon Claw descended from the sky and snatched the silver small fish in one grasp.
Compared to the huge claw that stretched out hundreds of meters when all five claws were extended, the fifteen-meter-long silver small fish seemed incredibly tiny in its grip, just as a person would appear holding a small shrimp.
But just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon grasped the small fish and retracted its right claw,
Boom!
The entire Time River suddenly trembled, stirring up waves tens of meters high, and a terrifying heavy force enveloped the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s right claw.
Under the strong pull, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt as if it was holding a Giant Beast that spanned thousands of kilometers, extremely heavy.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a roar as its right arm muscles swelled, and in an instant, a terrifyingly powerful force Burst forth, shattering the surrounding space for thousands of kilometers like broken crystal.
Amidst the violent collision and explosion of power, the Destruction Emperor Dragon soared into the sky, and with an earth-shattering thunderous boom that echoed through the dark space, it burst out of a hundred kilometers in a blink of an eye.
In the instant the Destruction Emperor Dragon escaped the area shrouded by the Power of Time, a strong struggling force transmitted from its hand.
The silver small fish more than ten meters long emitted a dazzling light, its body swelled, and thick silver scale armor grew all over its body, with Sharp Horns emerging on its head.
However, before the silver small fish could complete its Transformation, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes with golden vertical pupils grew cold, and it stuffed the ‘small fish’—which had already ballooned to over a hundred meters long—into its mouth.
Boom!
The instant the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed the fish, an endless torrent of wild energy exploded within, creating rings of silver halos that swept across its entire body.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the Power of Time contained within, the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon swelled rapidly, its muscles bulged, and its scales stretched; it grew over forty meters in just a moment, and its Aura became more terrifying.
After reaching the Titan Peak at four thousand meters, every additional meter that the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew required energy dozens of times more than when it was at two thousand meters.
One can only imagine how staggering the energy contained in that silver small fish must have been.
Moreover, the Destruction Emperor Dragon keenly felt that after eating the silver small fish, its bloodline became more ancient, as if undergoing a sort of ancestral retrospection.
However, as a being of the Heavenly Tier, the Destruction Emperor Dragon itself was an ‘Ancestor,’ the source of the current bloodline form, so there was no change in its appearance.
But this effect was extremely precious to the Silver Giant Dragon and others, especially the Purple little dragon sleeping on its head.
If its bloodline could regress to the level of its mother’s, the power of Creation within its body would become even more formidable.
Huff!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon breathed out hot air from its nose and its eyes revealed a rare hint of excitement, “Great Sethia, prepare the Spatial Channel. As soon as I catch the fish, you guys eat it immediately.”
“Roar! No problem, Tim Abott,” the Silver Giant Dragon hundreds of kilometers away also nodded excitedly.
They naturally saw the changes in the Destruction Emperor Dragon as well—not only had its size increased by dozens of meters, but even the breath of its bloodline had become more ancient.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc fluttered its wings excitedly.
Roar roar roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, I want two, I’m taking one back for my wife.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded, “No problem, as long as there are enough fish.”
For these subordinates like the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it was quite generous, of course, provided that it had enough to eat itself.
As the Power of Time trembled, the Destruction Emperor Dragon soon arrived over the Time River again, quietly overlooking the flowing river below, waiting.
Whether it was because catching that fish earlier caused too much commotion, or the fish had moved away, it took about two hours this time for a small fish thirteen meters long to appear in the distance.
Boom! Just as the small fish leapt out of the water, a Dragon Claw entwined with black lightning descended from the sky.
The black lightning was the Destruction Law, transformed after the Strength Talent had been enhanced to the level of Deification, encapsulating the pure characteristic of destruction. Even the pervasive force of Time was crushed by it.
“`
Just like before, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon grabbed the fish and tried to retract its claw, the entire river erupted once again.
Boom!
With a terrifying burst of physical strength, the Destruction Emperor Dragon forcibly broke free from the scope of the temporal cage, and the silver small fish in its grasp mutated once again.
Bang!
In an instant, the Destruction Emperor Dragon swelled to 200 meters in size, its form no longer resembled that of a fish, resembling instead a silver-golden Giant Beast whose upper body disappeared, devoured in one bite.
With its upper half gone, the aura of the silver-golden Giant Beast in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s claw weakened, giving off a sense of incompleteness; it also ceased struggling and expanding.
Whirr! Space distorted in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, forming a silver Hollow, and on the other side was the Silver Giant Dragon.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s size increased explosively once again and it charged into the sky above the river of time, the Silver Giant Dragon, holding the remainder of the silver-golden Giant Beast’s corpse, tossed it to the golden-blue Giant Dragon.
“Telsafi, you eat this one.”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon expressed some surprise, “Great Scythia, you’re not eating?”
The Silver Giant Dragon lifted its head proudly, “Roar! The Great Scythia is the Dragon Palace Dragon King; it’s only fair to distribute evenly, so I’ve decided to eat last.”
Fine then. The golden-blue Giant Dragon nodded, not standing on ceremony.
In order not to waste a single bit of ‘flesh and blood residue,’ the golden-blue Giant Dragon grabbed the colossal silver-golden Giant Beast’s corpse and stuffed it directly into its mouth, swallowing it whole.
Boom! The blood within the golden-blue Giant Dragon boiled instantly, even igniting.
Roar!!
Under the torrent of violent and Overbearing power, the golden-blue Giant Dragon screamed in agony, its double wings furiously spread, emitting a dazzling seven-colored glow, lighting up thousands of kilometers just like a sun.
These silver small fishes may not look large, but the energy contained within them is such that it can cause the current Destruction Emperor Dragon to surge by tens of meters in height, incredibly thick and dense, almost equivalent to half an Ancient Beast.
Such immense energy would normally be too much to bear for a Mid-Mythical Stage golden-blue Giant Dragon, causing it to explode instantly.
But whenever the Giant Beast’s body of the golden-blue Giant Dragon was about to explode, a sweep of Time Power would pass over it, causing its bloodline to return to an older state, and its condition would return to its original state.
Then, it would let out agonizing screams once more.
“Roar! Poor Telsafi.”
Watching the pitiful state of the golden-blue Giant Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon felt somewhat relieved that it cleverly let this unpleasant creature, which often bullied it, test the waters first.
However… the effect was indeed very strong.
At this moment, as the bloodline devolved, the form of the golden-blue Giant Dragon also changed once again, the aura on its body even more ancient, which made the Silver Giant Dragon feel slightly uncomfortable.
So, it might be a bit tragic, but the meat had to be eaten regardless.
While the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc watched the golden-blue Giant Dragon scream in agony, they waited, and half an hour later, another silver small fish leaped out of the river.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s giant claw reached out, catching the fourteen-meter-long silver small fish with a swift eruption of power, breaking free from the range of time.
Bang!
As the third silver small fish emitted silver light and ballooned to over two hundred meters, its body sprouting pure golden scales and robust claws, the Destruction Emperor Dragon took another bite.
Crackle Crackle!!
By devouring half a silver small fish and with the consequent surge of energy, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body swelled to four thousand one hundred meters, its presence more terrifying than before, and the ancient aura enveloping it grew denser.
“Roar! Joe, this one’s yours.”
The Silver Giant Dragon opened a Spatial Channel, took the half of the Golden Beast’s corpse, and tossed it to the eagerly waiting Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Meanwhile, as the Destruction Emperor Dragon re-entered the sky above the time river, ready to keep catching silver small fishes in a bid to undergo a breakthrough to the Ancient level.
In the depths of the upper reaches of that time river, a pair of large silver vertical pupils slowly opened.
In that moment, an overpowering aura that transcended the ancients and emitted fearsome Time Power filled the space, the intangible pressure causing the temporal tributary to shake violently.

chapters.title: Chapter 1386 - 1386 529 Transcending the World Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1386: Chapter 529: Transcending the World, Emperor Dragon Heavily Injured Chapter 1386: Chapter 529: Transcending the World, Emperor Dragon Heavily Injured The ancient True Spirit Beast had already fused with its own rules, obtaining recognition from the mythical world, and through the evolution of those rules, it had become the basis for the operation of a certain realm of Heaven and Earth.
In the upper reaches of an unknown tributary of the space-time continuum, the river trembled, water splashed explosively, and an impossibly colossal beast emerged, with just one of its heads spanning tens of thousands of meters.
This beast’s head resembled an Eastern Divine Dragon, covered in gold and silver dragon scales, with a pair of thick dragon horns branching out from its head and extending backward for ten thousand meters, and its dense silver mane danced without any wind.
In those slowly opening huge silver vertical pupils, countless scenes flashed every moment: flourishing civilizations, shattered firmaments, and the deadly silence of the cosmic void.
Those eyes seemed to reflect the beginning and the end of a world, mystical beyond compare, each breath they took stirred the whole river of time, terrifying to the utmost.
The True Spirit Beast slightly lifted its head to look downstream, its gaze traveling through distant space-time to land on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, emitting a deep, resonant sound from its nostrils that shook this segment of space-time.
“Ancient… no, that beast’s realm is merely at the Titan Peak!”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, with a body length of four thousand one hundred meters, had already far surpassed the standard three thousand meters of a regular Titan Peak Beast by a large margin.
This standard was a foundational rule of the mythical world, as well as a shackle on the gene limits of Giant Beast Type Creatures, and only beings like Dragon Pythons and those who had broken through those genetic limits could transcend it.
And while that black-red colossal beast bore some resemblance to it in its head, its robust body bore no relation to Eastern Divine Dragons, and it was also quite different from Western-style dragons.
Moreover, the blood aura entwined around the black-red beast was terrifyingly strong, even giving it the feeling that it had encountered a lifeform of the same tier.
Emperor-level bloodline, and at least at the high-order Monarch or above! At this thought, a look of surprise flashed across the eyes of the Time True Spirit Beast.
To Giant Beast creatures, bloodline represents potential; only those whose bloodline has reached the King level have a chance of breaking through to become a Mythical Giant Beast.
To break through the Titan Level, bloodlines must be purified to the Monarch level, possessing at least one top-tier talent and birthing a Higher-order Law level inherent ability.
To break through to the Ancient Level, one needs a high-order Monarch bloodline and mastery over two superior Higher-order Laws, to support and nurture the strength of the rules.
As for True Spirit Beasts above the Ancient Level, their bloodline tier must reach the Emperor level, otherwise the weak strength of the rules will be unable to break through the natural moat of the mythical world.
Of course, for Giant Beast creatures, bloodline isn’t everything; as strength increases and growth occurs, the bloodline of Giant Beast creatures will evolve and level up time and time again.
Much like human cultivators, who can comprehend multiple laws to construct their own path and elevate the level of life.
This was also the reason for the True Spirit Beast’s surprise, sensing an Emperor-level, or even a high-order Emperor’s bloodline in a Titan Level Beast.
While a high bloodline level does not equate to strength, the bloodline levels of powerful beasts are indeed high.
This meant that this little Titan Peak fellow before it could, if it did not die prematurely, smoothly grow to the strength level it possessed now.
While the True Spirit Beast’s thoughts lightly processed this information, half an hour had passed, and a silver small fish leaped high from the transparent river beneath the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
A dragon claw entwined with black and red lightning seized the small fish, and in an instant, the entire length of the river of time shook, unleashing a terrifying force capable of submerging a regular Ancient Beast.
But “this bit” of time-space suppressive force was directly shattered by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, who in the blink of an eye, burst out more than a hundred kilometers, appearing within the range swathed by the force of time.
Roar!
Seemingly preempting its own demise, the silver small fish, sixteen meters long, let out a deep roar, its body aglow with silver light, its form swelling… Bang!
Just as horns like a dragon’s were emerging on the head of the small fish and its body expanded to over two hundred meters, resembling a white True Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon bit down, devouring its upper body.
“Roar! Tim Abott, It’s the Great Sethia’s turn.”
Hundreds of kilometers away, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, opening a Spatial Channel and snatching the half of the silver ‘small fish’ tossed over by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
There was no choice, their strength was too weak to digest the entire silver small fish; consuming the entire Giant Beast Body would result in an explosion.
Also, without the Destruction Emperor Dragon eating half, they couldn’t suppress the silver Divine Fish that lost the bind of time.
Roar! As it devoured the white dragon fish in one gulp, the Silver Giant Dragon’s bloodline boiled, and its black ice crystal Destruction storm and Space Law all went berserk.
Boom, boom, boom!
Endless cold air burst from the body of the Silver Giant Dragon, freezing over a hundred kilometers, and then shattered under the black raging wind, become intermixed with distorted space, forming an Area of Destruction.
Far away, after eating the silver small fish, the Single-horned Spawn Roc had disappeared, creating around it a Black Hole that covered a range of a hundred kilometers.
Compared to them, the transition of the gold and blue Giant Dragon during its Evolution was more glamorous and dazzling.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had no time to pay attention to these details, having returned to its position above that section of the river of time, ready to seize the opportunity to catch more silverfish.
As time passed, the unease in its heart grew stronger, presumably being targeted by some terrifying creature.
It well remembered the Silver Giant Dragon’s mix of good and bad luck; every time it ‘chanced upon’ something good, it would encounter a powerful beast and get beaten up.

chapters.title: Chapter 1387 - 1387 529 Transcend the World Emperor Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1387: Chapter 529: Transcend the World, Emperor Dragon Severely Injured_2 Chapter 1387: Chapter 529: Transcend the World, Emperor Dragon Severely Injured_2 Under normal conditions, the Destruction Emperor Dragon should have taken the win and decisively left.
But it couldn’t help itself, these time-born silverfish were too precious, so precious that even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t bear to part with them, and decided to snatch another for the Purple little dragon before leaving.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon extended its senses to the maximum, guarding against a possible sneak attack, and watching the river surface, that distant True Spirit Beast was also slowly contemplating.
“Just now, it seemed that traces of five Higher-order Laws appeared on that little fellow.”
“The black and red lightning filled with a Destructive Aura, the murky force field on its body that abolished Time Power, as well as the speed that crossed space-time in an instant and Devouring.”
As this slow-thinking True Spirit Beast pondered, another hour passed in the blink of an eye, and another silver small fish leapt from that segment of the Time River.
The silverfish that jumped out this time was the largest, measuring nineteen meters, like a streak of silver light that shot up a kilometer high in the blink of an eye.
In the view of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the silverfish had only jumped one kilometer, but in the eyes of the silver small fish, it had broken through more than a dozen layers of distorted space-time in one breath.
However, upon reaching this point, even the powerful silverfish was somewhat exhausted, with the invisible pulling strength behind it growing stronger and stronger.
No, I must get out, I must transcend, I must reign supreme over all things in heaven and earth. A firm and powerful Will burst forth in the eyes of the silver small fish.
Bang bang bang! With its body madly twisting, a powerful strength erupted from within the silver small fish, momentarily halting its descent.
But just as the struggling silver small fish sought to break free from the river’s constraints and ‘transcend’ the ‘world’, it felt a vast shadow looming overhead.
A Black-red Colossal Beast of unimaginable size appeared, its massive body stretching across spaces and times like the sun, cold golden vertical pupils staring down at it.
Then before the silverfish could react, a huge claw wrapped in black and red lightning descended from the sky, crushing layers of space-time as it enveloped it.
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon caught the over ten-meter-long silverfish with its right claw, the muscles swelling, and the strength of its entire body Bursting to shatter the space-time constraints, instantly turning into a dark shadow that appeared beyond the limits of time.
I’m out! Feeling the transcendent suppression force crumble on its body, the silverfish caught in the Black-red Dragon Claw revealed ecstatic joy, never expecting that in the end it would be that horrendous beast that helped it.
But it was not yet safe. From the monstrous beast that obscured space-time, it felt a strong malice and knew it had to flee at once.
With that thought, the silverfish immediately ignited the Origin within its body, which had been suppressed by the Space-Time Detachment Power, and in a moment, boundless strength erupted, inflating its size.
Suddenly, the feeling of the powerful strength that it had once prided itself on for bursting a world re-emerged, and under the invincible power bursting forth, even the Horrific Creature’s claw was forced open a bit by it.
Just when the silverfish thought it could show its full form and break free from the terrifying claw’s suppression with a surge of power, a sinister maw large enough to devour the sky enveloped the Firmament.
No! I am the Overlord of the Great Wilderness World, I am the Supreme Beast about to transcend the cosmos and space-time, how could I die here!!
That’s wrong, all transcendence of the Endless World is a deception; there is no transcendence.
We are all bred lives, food for the Horrific Creatures that linger outside the Endless World; the moment we surpass the world we will be eaten.
In that instant, countless thoughts flashed through the mind of the silverfish, followed by endless despair.
Bang!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon devoured over three hundred meters of the upper body of the Giant Beast covered in golden-red scale armor, and in an instant, the previously struggling lower half stiffened.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was devouring half of the silverfish’s body and the energy within it exploded, causing its size to increase visibly to the naked eye, that Giant Beast stationed upstream in time also realized what was happening.
“Wait a second, what am I thinking about, these little creatures have already stolen several Time Fish from me.”
In an instant, the entire tributary of the Time River shook violently, including the section where the Destruction Emperor Dragon caught its fish, which roared madly as the True Spirit Beast rose to its feet.
Boom!
A water wave tens of thousands of meters high rose from the space-time river behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and amid the spray, a true Heavenly Dragon Claw, enveloping layered spaces, reached out.
The moment that Dragon Claw appeared, a Terrifying Aura that surmounted Heaven and Earth descended as if coming from the past, crushing the Void to smithereens with just a wisp of its presence.
The cosmos trembled, and the Rules roared.
Roar!
At the moment when the Dragon Claw above time made its appearance, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a roar, and blood red lightning burst forth from its body, emitting a dazzling red glow.
Amidst the endless red light, a Deep red Destruction Beast measuring eleven thousand meters in length appeared, its body wrapped in hundred-meter-thick Blood Red Lightning, emanating an Aura of calamity that could destroy an entire world.
Behind that Deep red Destruction Beast, phantoms of world destruction emerged, standing as if outside the universe itself, a Beast of world-ending might, immensely terrifying.
With its realm growth reaching the Titan Peak and its size surpassing that of ordinary ancient beings, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had even more terrifying power amplification upon entering its Deep Red Form.
And from the descent of the golden and silver Dragon Claw through space-time to the outburst of the Destruction Emperor Dragon into its Deep Red Form, it all happened in an instant.
Roar! In the face of that terrible True Spirit’s strike, the Deep red Destruction Beast roared fiercely, rose to its feet, and the moment it tucked away the half silverfish corpse into its Reverse Scale, it stomped with both feet.
Boom!
With the Deep red Destruction Beast at the center, a thousand-kilometer range of the Void exploded, forming layers of black shockwaves that toppled the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast hundreds of kilometers away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1388 - 1388 529 Transcend the World Emperor Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1388: Chapter 529: Transcend the World, Emperor Dragon Severely Injured_3 Chapter 1388: Chapter 529: Transcend the World, Emperor Dragon Severely Injured_3 At the same time, all the strength within the Deep Red Destruction Beast converged and rose from its legs and tail, pivoting at the waist along its spine, gathering at its double claws.
At this moment, the Deep Red Destruction Beast resembled a Martial Arts Grandmaster among humans, its arms’ muscles swelling to twice their size, with boundless strength bursting forth as its double claws seemed to support the sky.
Beneath the dazzling red glow of the double claws, everything was annihilated, space-time dissolved, and rules shattered as they intersected with the previous terrifying Dragon Claw, bringing Heaven and Earth to a sudden stillness in an instant.
Boom!
The entire Chaotic Turbulent Region shook thunderously, and the Void exploded instantly, forming an ever-expanding black hole that devoured all in its path as the laws of Heaven and Earth collapsed and order was destroyed.
And in the instant when the black hole rapidly expanded to several thousand kilometers, a beam of red light shot out like a laser, appearing tens of thousands of kilometers away in an instant.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Not until that red light flew tens of thousands of kilometers and stopped, having shattered a continental block with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, did this dark space fill with the dense rumble of explosions.
Those were the innumerable meteoric materials shattered in an instant by the blow that sent the Destruction Emperor Dragon flying, where the terrifying kinetic energy and shock released were like Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs with the explosive yield of hundreds of millions, illuminating tens of thousands of kilometers with their dazzling light.
The Void Continent that the Destruction Emperor Dragon finally collided with exploded like a planet, with countless hot materials and energy flowing forward in streams, forming a fan-shaped radiation zone that covered tens of thousands of kilometers.
Meanwhile, under the destructive shock of that devastating blow, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Three-headed Giant Beast, already blown away two thousand kilometers, were too late to react and once again swept away by the impact stretching for tens of thousands of kilometers.
In the midst of the terrible explosion, the flow of time slowly vanished.
Meanwhile, upstream of that tributary, was a terrifying beast that revealed only half its body and yet was a million meters long, also showing a hint of surprise in its eyes.
Because the claw strike just now, which contained a ‘tiny bit’ of its strength, was actually momentarily blocked by that little guy.
“Is this little guy the offspring of that Primordial Beast, and its parents must be no ordinary Primordial Beasts either, or else it would be impossible to possess such strength at the Titan Realm,” it wondered in amazement.
In awe, the dreadful Gold and Silver Giant Beast slowly sank back into the river of time, ready to continue its slumber.
Because it had recognized the extraordinary nature of the Destruction Emperor Dragon at first glance, possibly the descendant of two powerful Primordial Beasts, this True Spirit Beast did not mind the theft of the fish.
As a True Spirit-level giant that has lived for who knows how many tens of thousands of years, these creatures are filled with more wisdom than most lifeforms.
Apart from those naturally ferocious and bloodthirsty creatures and those that strive over ‘interests’, many prefer to ‘harmoniously’ rest in hibernation, cultivate, and make themselves stronger.
However, although the Destruction Emperor Dragon had a ‘significant’ background, this Giant Beast did not plan on gifting it two more Time Fish.
These small fishes were created from its manipulation of the rule of time, evolving various Illusory Worlds, gathering auras of powerful life from countless space-times, and refining their bloodlines.
Every silverfish that could leap out of the river surface contained a thread of the weak force of Creation’s Mystery, which could make it more ancient.
Although a single silverfish was of minimal enhancement to its True Spirit level, as long as they kept coming, its strength would continue to grow.
……
The scorching magma spread over a Void range of more than a hundred thousand kilometers, burning fiercely, its firelight illuminating the surroundings.
In front of the blazing Magma Fire Sea, the red glow, like blood seeping into space, rendered everything a foreboding crimson.
Amidst the brilliant red light, the 6,000-meter-tall Deep Red Destruction Beast stood tall, its whole body resembling shattered porcelain that had been pieced back together, covered in massive cracks.
Glowing with a blood-red light, these cracks were visible to the naked eye, healing rapidly under the terrifying vitality of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“That Giant Beast just now was so strong!” Shock and seriousness lingered in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s golden-red enormous eyes.
Even after fully unleashing its power in its Crimson Form, it had been sent flying by a mere slap from the dreadful Giant Beast, causing the convergence of the ten Higher-order Laws within it, the Crimson Destruction Rule, to shatter.
Such a frightful power was beyond its expectations.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had originally estimated that the Silver Giant Dragon’s discovery of the river of time and those silver small fishes might attract an ancient late-stage or peak Giant Beast to attack.
After all, the strength of the Silver Giant Dragon was only at the Mid-Mythical Stage, so attracting a peak ancient Giant Beast was already an overestimation, which would have left it with almost no chance of survival.
A peak ancient Giant Beast, while not a match for the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s current strength, would feasibly be able to retreat unscathed relying on its formidable defense.
But unexpectedly, it attracted a True Spirit-level Giant Beast, and not just an ordinary one.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon felt that had its own strength not been sufficient and its body not robust enough, that single slap might have burst it apart, costing it a life.
And that had all been without the Giant Beast showing any intent to kill.
Sensing the now vanished ominous presence, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt a chill, vowing not to take such risks in the future.
If that True Spirit Giant Beast had harbored any killing intent, it might have had a slight chance to severely injure and escape by relying on the Mystery of the Speed Law, but the Silver Giant Dragon and the others would have definitively met their end.
Pensive, the cracks on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body had healed, and the bloodied lightning coiling around it vanished as its body rapidly shrank.

chapters.title: Chapter 1389 - 1389 529 Transcend the World Emperor Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1389: Chapter 529: Transcend the World, Emperor Dragon Severely Injured_4 Chapter 1389: Chapter 529: Transcend the World, Emperor Dragon Severely Injured_4 The Destruction Emperor Dragon soon recovered to its normal state of over 4,100 meters, though its aura was a bit weak.
Huff!
With a breath, the Destruction Emperor Dragon exuded a scorching wave of air from its nostrils, its double wings unfurled, and it turned into a streak of black light that pierced through the Void, flying towards the location of the Three-headed Giant Beast that had been flung away.
It quickly found the Silver Giant Dragon over 80,000 kilometers away.
However, the Silver Giant Dragon was in a sorry state at that moment; its double wings had been broken under the residual power of that strike, most of its scales were shattered, and one of its front claws was broken.
Moreover, because of the residual aura of the True Spirit Beast’s Rule, these wounds could not heal, even though there was the power of the silverfish within its body evolving its bloodline.
Seeing the huge Black-red Colossal Beast flying towards it through the darkness, the Silver Giant Dragon bared its teeth and let out a weak roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, the Great Scythia is in so much pain.”
It was the first time the Destruction Emperor Dragon had seen the Silver Giant Dragon so wretched. It could only roar softly in comfort, “It’s fine, it will be better soon.”
As it spoke, its massive right claw reached out, gently placing the Silver Giant Dragon on its back’s side. The power from its Law Domains enveloped it, dispelling the residual Rule aura from its body.
“Scythia, rest for a while, we will go find Telsafi and the others.”
Lying on the left side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s back, the Silver Giant Dragon immediately felt an intense sense of safety, then roared fiercely, “Roar! Damn it, that creature dared to attack the Great Scythia and Tim Abott.”
“Next time we meet it, Tim, you have to beat it fiercely for revenge.”
Although the Silver Giant Dragon was angered and in pain, due to its reverence for the terrifying strength possessed by that Giant Beast, it dared only speak of beating it up as a form of venting.
As for the possibility of not being able to defeat it, the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t consider that at all.
With the growing speed and terrifying talent of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon believed it wouldn’t take long before it became even stronger. If it could block the opponent’s claw once, next time, it could thrash it.
Soon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon flew another 50,000 kilometers and found the Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon amidst the ruins of an exploded meteor.
However, the state of the Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon was a bit better than that of the Silver Giant Dragon; although its double wings were broken and many scales were shattered, its front claws were not broken.
Seeing the Black-red Colossal Beast carrying the Silver Giant Dragon flying over, the Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon let out a strained roar, “Thunderflame, you’ve arrived, Great Torsa knew you were alright.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head, “It’s a good thing that True Spirit Beast didn’t have the intent to kill, otherwise it’s hard to say.” It then gently placed the Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon onto its back’s right side.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon flew in another direction with two heavily injured Giant Dragons on its back, searching for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Silver Giant Dragon lying on its back showed a spirit of defiance.
“Roar! Torsa, why do your injuries look lighter than the Great Scythia’s?”
Bearing the acute pain, the Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon maintained an elegant posture as it lay on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, lazily roaring, “Because you, Scythia, are too silly.”
“Roar! You despicable Torsa, you actually call the Great Scythia silly again, the Great Scythia is going to…”
Thump!
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon was about to get up and fight, a massive force pressed its head against the thick Black-red Scaled Armor, and it let out a muffled wuu wuu wuu roar.
“Stop it, if you want to fight, wait until your injuries are healed.”
“Also, although your bodies were ‘broken’, there is also a bit of a benefit— the power of the small fishes can optimize your bloodline on a deeper level, fortifying the body of a Giant Dragon.”
In the midst of the roar, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly released the Dragon Claw pressing down on the Silver Giant Dragon’s head.
Looking at the Silver Giant Dragon that had been agitated and then forcefully suppressed, the Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon lay indolently, not continuing to taunt—it no longer felt a sense of accomplishment from bullying this dummy.
It was then that the Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon’s eyes showed a hint of surprise.
Because it sensed keenly that after it lay on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, under the influence of the invisible life aura emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its bloodline became more active.
Even excluding the Power of Ancient Times contained by the silverfish, its bloodline was slowly evolving on its own under the influence of the life aura from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Gold-and-Blue Giant Dragon slightly lifted its head to look in the direction above the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
No wonder little Emma Abott spends all day lying on Thunderflame to sleep.
[There’s still a 1,000-word conclusion being revised, please wait for twenty minutes.]
