﻿Chapter 1390: Chapter 530: Crossing the Edge of Chaos, Breakthrough of the Ancient Beast Chapter 1390: Chapter 530: Crossing the Edge of Chaos, Breakthrough of the Ancient Beast In the pitch-dark silence of the Void, a Black-red Colossal Beast with a body length of over 4,150 meters and wingspan exceeding 8,000 meters was flying at a high speed.
Upon the durable metal blade-edge-like wings of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, golden flames were burning. Every feathered edge had an air pore, blasting out scorching air currents like engines.
From afar, it looked like a pair of magnificent golden wings were tearing through space, emitting a dazzling radiance that was incredibly spectacular.
With each Evolution, the form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon grew increasingly distinct from the Eastern Divine Dragon and the Western Divine Dragon, becoming a completely new mythic species.
As long as the Destruction Emperor Dragon reached the True Spirit Level later on and the rules were recognized by the mythical world, its very life form would become a part of the revolving Heaven and Earth.
By then, under the influence of the rules, many powerful life forms that were compatible would instinctively evolve toward the form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Just like most serpent-like creatures and centipedes with elongated attributes evolving into flood dragons during their evolution, and simian creatures evolving into mythical beings like Irvin Watkins.
At this moment, two Giant Dragons with surface injuries already healed were lying on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with their tail tips being bitten by the burly Single-horned Spawn Roc, trailing along in a procession.
Although their injuries seemed to have healed, the two Giant Dragons showed no intention of flying on their own, lazily sprawling on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Stimulated by the invisible life aura emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, their bloodlines became more active, with a faster Purifying speed.
And it wasn’t just the two Giant Dragons—even the Single-horned Spawn Roc got smart for once, stubbornly biting the thigh of the Destruction Emperor Dragon with the excuse that its bloodline was still undergoing Transformation and needed to ‘hug.’
At that moment, it nearly disgusted the Destruction Emperor Dragon enough to give it a claw.
Ultimately, considering that the fellow was about to enter a semi-Hibernation state unable to fly during its bloodline evolution, the Destruction Emperor Dragon reluctantly agreed to let it bite the tail.
As for the Purple little dragon, after eating the Chaos Crystal Stones and silver small fishes, its size skyrocketed directly from 12 meters to 20 meters, and at that time, a Purple Divine Dragon Shadow over 500 meters long appeared behind it.
In reality, the Purple Divine Dragon Shadow measuring over 600 meters long was the true form of the Purple little dragon.
Being an Innate Divine Holy with a life level at Monarch, upon birth, the Purple little dragon already reached the quasi-mythical level, and that was with its Innate deficiency which caused only a false impression of a pseudo-Monarch level aura during hatching.
Otherwise, as a descendant of Primordial Beasts, under normal conditions, it should have hatched as a Mythical Giant Beast.
During this time following the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon consumed a large amount of Divine Objects above God-level, and with the nourishment from the aura of a Heavenly Tier Giant Beast, it entered Hibernation and stepped into the realm of Myth.
Continuing on without any discoveries or unexpected occurrences and with the Destruction Emperor Dragon maintaining a hundred times the speed of sound as its usual pace, they swiftly traversed more than five million kilometers.
As over a day passed by, the bodies of the two Giant Dragons together with the Single-horned Spawn Roc visibly swelled at a visible rate, inflating to over 1,200 meters and stepping into the late Mythical period.
The silverfish contained not only a strand of the Rules of Creation, which could Purify bloodlines and render life more ancient but also harbored terrifying energy.
Even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon consumed half of them, it still caused a significant rise in the power of the three Giant Beasts.
Moreover, due to the bloodline purification, during this period of growth through Hibernation, they conveniently absorbed the energy from various Top-level Divine Items, Law Level Divine Artifacts, and the Chaos Crystal Core they had Devoured recently.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon estimated that once they completely digested this harvest and with its help, their bloodlines had a high probability of awakening a third Top Tier Talent.
Especially since their bloodlines had already been substantially upgraded previously.
On the third day of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s solitary flight, covering almost ten million kilometers and passing through some ‘ordinary’ forbidden areas in the dark space, an endless white flame territory blocked their way ahead.
These white flames were terrifying, the scorching high temperatures burnt through space itself, forming some kind of fearsome semi-liquid transparent material, into which Mythical Giant Beasts would enter and be directly burnt to ashes.
However, this level of ‘power’ was still unable to stop the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s advance, and its humongous body turned directly into a black and gold streak of light as it charged in.
Boom Boom Boom!
Flying at a hundred times the speed of sound, the white flames from all directions furiously wrapped around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, forming a solid mass that collided with the golden flames circling its body, causing a terrifying energy impact.
The powerful Destructive Aura instantly awoke the Silver Giant Dragon and the three-headed Giant Beast.
The Silver Giant Dragon, a bit bewildered, looked around and then roared, “Roar! Tim Abott, have we not reached the edge of the Chaotic Turbulent Region yet?”
The black mane on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon danced wildly in the swift flight, and with a cold gaze focused ahead, it growled in response, “Not yet, but I feel we should be close.”
Boom!
In the midst of the low roaring exchange between the two Giant Beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt lighter—it had already penetrated the region of white celestial fire.
Simultaneously, ahead of them was no longer the black void of space but a winding dark gold mountain range stretching thousands of kilometers, the broadest part being over a thousand kilometers.
And beyond that mountain range lay a vast plain covered with shrubs over ten to a hundred meters tall and weed stalks around fifteen meters high, extending all the way to the horizon.
On that plain over tens of thousands of kilometers, countless Alien Beast Groups of enormous size lived; in the sky, every now and then, a blue bird with wings spanning hundreds of meters, resembling a phoenix, would fly past.
Suddenly, all four Great Beasts felt a rush of wild and primitive aura hit their faces.
Upon witnessing the pitch-black void of dead space for so long, the rich life aura outside excited the Silver Giant Dragon, loudly exclaiming, “Roar! Tim Abott, we’re out, we’ve crossed the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1391 - 1391 530 Crossing the Edge of Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1391: Chapter 530: Crossing the Edge of Chaos, Breakthrough of the Ancient Beast_2 Chapter 1391: Chapter 530: Crossing the Edge of Chaos, Breakthrough of the Ancient Beast_2 “`
“Yes, we’ve finally made it through,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon said with a sigh.
Because the passage under the seabed of the Blue Star World that connected to the mythical world was ‘too small’, accommodating only Mythical-level beings, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could only support the Frontline Battlefield by flying over from this side.
If it weren’t for the two-in-one sense of unity between Jack Clark and the Emperor Dragon that allowed for positioning, the Beast Empire’s support plan would simply be unachievable.
As for the Space-Time Summoning Technique, the method of summoning the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon suited only as a trump card.
Every time the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon descended, Jack Clark would become a ‘power bank’ to maintain the reverse consumption of space-time by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, unable to participate in the battle, effectively losing a significant unit of strength.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon was slightly nostalgic, the golden-blue Giant Dragon had already let out a lofty Dragon Roar, eagerly soaring into the sky and flying beyond the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
“Scythia, I saw a beautiful sea of flowers at the foot of that mountain range, let’s hurry over and take a look,” it said.
The Silver Giant Dragon hurried to catch up, “Roar! Wait for me, Telsafi, the Great Scythia wants to breathe out the dragon breath first, I want to blast all those flowers to smithereens.”
The words of the two dragons made the corner of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitch.
How did these two dragons develop such destructive characters? Shouldn’t they stand aside and quietly appreciate the beauty of a picturesque sea of flowers?
As the two dragons flew out, the Destruction Emperor Dragon pondered softly.
From the information currently available, the Chaotic Turbulent Region seems to be an irregular elongated ellipse, with its middle being divided by a space-time destructive fault stretching for hundreds of millions of kilometers.
The end that borders the territory of the Blue-White Giant Dragon is roughly over four million kilometers deep, where the Heavenly Energy is rich and violent, sprinkled with countless Heaven and Earth Treasures and perilous forbidden areas.
The other end, which is more than ten million kilometers wide, has a harsh environment like the silent and dark outer space, bordered by a tens-of-thousands-of-kilometers-long Heavenly Fire forbidden area.
Only Titan Beasts could cross that scorching heat unharmed, but even if they enter, it’s just a pitch-black space with no Heavenly Energy, no resources.
Therefore, even after the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its companions traveled over ten million kilometers, they only encountered one Ancient Beast and occasionally, a True Spirit Level horror creature.
So this side could basically be given up, no need to waste time searching for powerful beasts that may not exist.
When the time comes, they just need to sweep across the region on the edge of the Chaos Sea, subjugate all Mythical Giant Beasts, Titan Beasts, and Ancient Beasts, and then they can launch the expedition.
Thoughtfully, with the Single-horned Spawn Roc hanging from its tail, the Destruction Emperor Dragon quickly flew out of the invisible barrier at the edge of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Boom!
With its power already reaching Ancient Level, the arrival of the black-red Colossal Beast made the whole world tremble instantly, as endless Heavenly Energy howled forth.
Even the laws of this world seemed to rise and fall with the breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, forming colorful ribbons of gold, black, blue, and purple, encircling an area for thousands of kilometers.
At the same time, with the suppression of the violent chaotic magnetic field of the Chaotic Turbulent Region gone, some power emerged from the depths of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and a strong wave of drowsiness surged up.
It was about to breakthrough.
Due to its Evolution Talent, the Destruction Emperor Dragon naturally transitions to the next realm as soon as it reaches the peak level and accumulates enough energy, without facing any bottlenecks.
However, the mountain range beneath it consists of some kind of Transcendent heavy metal veins, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon did not feel any threatening aura in the vicinity, making it a suitable location for Hibernation and breakthrough.
With this in mind, the Destruction Emperor Dragon ceased to hesitate, retracted its wings, and landed on a dark golden mountain peak that was over ten thousand meters tall.
Boom!
The Giant Beast, stretching over four thousand meters long, almost a quarter the height of the mountain peak, landed, and the whole mountain range shook thunderously. The peak, sturdier than alloy, crumbled instantly, sending up billows of smoke and dust.
An Invisible Power erupted at the same time, flinging away the Single-horned Spawn Roc still biting the tail of the Destruction Emperor Dragon. The immense force smashed the Spawn Roc against a mountain peak thousand of meters high, collapsing it.
Amid the clouds of smoke and waves of dust, the black-red Colossal Beast slowly turned its head and let out a deep and dignified roar, “Joe, I’m about to enter hibernation for a breakthrough, you and Scythia keep an eye on our surroundings.”
“`
Boom! Rocks exploded into countless fragments as the Single-horned Spawn Roc excitedly took flight.
Roar! Thunderflame, you’re finally about to become an Ancient Beast, no problem, we’ll definitely keep an eye on the surroundings, anyone who dares to approach within tens of thousands of miles will be devoured whole.
As a lieutenant for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the better off the Destruction Emperor Dragon is, the better their lives are.
Especially since the boss is so loyal and never mistreats his underlings; ever since the Single-horned Spawn Roc started following the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it has enjoyed the good life of eating once every three days.
Glancing at the two Giant Dragons joyfully bombing the flower sea below the mountain range, the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook his head and without any further attempt to suppress the drowsiness within him, slowly lay down.
Boom! In an instant, an Invisible Power swept across the entire mountain range, centered on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, covering tens of thousands of kilometers.
The bands of light encircling the Destruction Emperor Dragon burst forth with even greater Radiance, dissipated, and transformed into countless Law Chains, integrating into this World, as an authoritative Dragon Roar echoed through the Void.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Under the force of that breakthrough, the mountain ranges around the Destruction Emperor Dragon began to move, rocks seemingly turned to liquid slowly covered him, forming a small hill over 20,000 meters high and stretching for over ten kilometers.
At the same time, a mountain range thousands of kilometers long also rumbled as its bedrock shifted and deformed, resembling an enormous beast thousands of kilometers long that breathed in and out slowly.
Such a massive change immediately caught the attention of the two Giant Dragons, who looked up toward the dark gold mountain range that trembled.
“Roar! Great Sethia, Tim Abott is breaking through, he’s about to reach the Ancient Level,” the Silver Giant Dragon said with some excitement.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon nodded slowly and hummed quietly, watching calmly as the heavy metal mountain range naturally evolved and adapted to the Heaven and Earth.
This is the power of an Ancient-level Giant Beast – they stand above the Heavenly Earth Laws, with all things resonating with them, and their environment changing to accommodate them.
As for the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s terrifying growth rate, going from a Titan to an Ancient-level Giant Beast in such a short period, even the golden-blue Giant Dragon was no longer surprised.
There was no helping it, they’ve become completely desensitized.
…
In the Eternal Divine Domain, Number Seventeen Plane.
In the center of the dark golden domain that enveloped an area of over four thousand kilometers, nearly swallowing half of the Mixed Copper Mountain Range, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, within them a massive world spun gently.
Feeling the slumbering intention from his other half, Jack Clark, whose True Demon God Body now stood over eight hundred meters tall, slowly spoke with a layered voice emanating from three faces.
“So the other side is finally going to make a breakthrough too, huh?”
Once the Destruction Emperor Dragon breaks through to the Ancient Level, its combat power will soar to new heights.
Ten fully-developed Higher-order Laws giving birth to Rules, coupled with the unleashed potential of the Heavenly Tier bloodline, will make its power unimaginably terrifying.
At the same time, he was only one step away from completing his Transformation.
With this thought, Jack Clark slowly closed his eyes. An aura of extreme terror, as heavy as a Neutron Star, spread out, causing the very Plane to tremble invisibly.
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon had a higher realm and was about to break through to the Ancient level, at this point, Jack Clark’s combat power was even more terrifying under the same tier.
The fearsome flesh of the Beast with no upper limit on strengthening, five Higher-order Laws from the Human Race cultivator, one Supreme Law, and four Great Divine Powers that would evolve into concepts at their peak – Jack Clark was an absolute monster.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was breaking through and Jack Clark was undergoing the final Transformation, a million kilometers away from the Eternal Domain, three armies spanned thousands of kilometers from the three great Purgatory Empires were marching in an imposing manner, their Invisible demon gas almost turning the whole world dark.
“Are we certain that the girl appeared in Number Ten Plane?”
In a palace where demon gas billowed, the Left Demon looked ahead coldly. Suspended before him was a twisted black mirror, within which a member of the Heavenly Feather Clan with Silver Light Wings bowed respectfully.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1392: Chapter 531: The Beginning of the End, Sun and Moon Shine Together Chapter 1392: Chapter 531: The Beginning of the End, Sun and Moon Shine Together “`
“Yes, Prince Cortes, that girl from the Human Race received some news half an hour ago and has already entered the Number Ten Plane.”
In the half-empty palace where demon gas rolled, a broken black mirror floated, and within its twisted image appeared a silver-winged figure from a different race kneeling on one knee.
Seated high above on the throne, the Left Demon, his face covered in dark gold scales, nodded slowly with a cold and indifferent gaze, “You have done your task well, you may leave.”
“Yes, Your Highness,” the silver-winged being was somewhat excited.
Watching the twisted mirror in the half-empty space slowly fade away, the Left Demon leaned back, resting his right elbow on the arm of the throne and cupping his chin, his eyes narrowing slightly.
The Number Ten Plane is currently in a ‘neutral’ state, eroded by the Power of the Abyss unleashed by the Purgatory Demon God, and is no longer under the control of those Divine Kings.
This is also true for Planes Number Twelve, Thirteen, and five others, which have become battlefields of frontline conflict.
While the armies of the three major empires are stationed at the edge of the crack in Plane Number Twelve, ready to strike at any moment like Thunder, that girl suddenly appeared on the Number Ten Plane.
“Thinking to lure me in there for a final battle, huh?” The Left Demon’s gaze turned frosty, immediately suspecting the work of the undetectable Jonathan Walker.
At this thought, the Left Demon stood up slowly, a horrifying aura of darkness spreading from his body, causing the entire Number Nine Plane to tremble momentarily.
Above the Firmament, a dark Demon Cloud covered the sky, changing the winds and clouds, while the invisible pressure made every demon king and Great Demon King look up with solemn expressions.
“How powerful. With just two Sun Wheels absent, the strength of the prince from the Demon King Empire is almost on par with that of a Demon God, and he hasn’t yet taken the final step.”
“The Demon King Empire is about to produce another God-level Demon.”
“It is Prince Cortes. After this period of Closed-door Cultivation, His Highness’s strength has surged, and perhaps, with the upcoming battle to annihilate the Heavenly Feather Clan, he might directly step into the realm of Demon Gods.”
Under the overwhelming Demon Power that blotted out the sky, the faces of those demon kings and Great Demon Kings showed expressions of solemnity, excitement, wariness, and awe.
Meanwhile, an even more terrifying aura appeared, forming a massive face thousands of meters large above the towering Dark Demon Palace, as the Will of the Great Demon King Tyris descended.
The Will of Tyris shook Heaven and Earth, and his grand voice echoed in the Demon Palace, “Cortes, you contacted me so suddenly, do you have a new plan?”
“Yes, Your Majesty.”
The emergence of the Left Demon’s pressure wasn’t to show off to those Purgatory True Demons, instead he replied respectfully, “I am preparing to enter the Number Ten Plane next and fight another version of myself.”
“The Number Ten Plane, it seems that your other self has made an appearance.”
“Though it is in a neutral state, it still lies within the Territory of the Heavenly Feather Clan, and with the support of the Human Experts’ army, you’re worried about an ambush on the other side.”
The Left Demon replied calmly, “It’s more likely that an ambush is certain, and even though I don’t know what trump cards the other me has, I am confident that he can’t defeat me.”
“Yet at our level, defeating the other party and killing them are two separate concepts—I am not sure I can hold him back, and he feels the same about me.”
“Therefore, those Human Experts are very likely to intervene, and the Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan might lurk nearby as well.”
“Given the chance, those Heavenly Feather Divine Kings would certainly love to remove a formidable enemy possessing the strength of a Demon God before the outbreak of a great war.”
“Therefore, I feel we should focus our main objective on those Heavenly Feather Divine Kings; as for the other me, there’s no rush–time is on my side.”
As he spoke, a terrifying darkness began to churn in the eyes of the Left Demon.
A ‘ferocious’ smile appeared on the face of Tyris, “I am very much looking forward to the moment you break through to Demon God during the annihilation of the Heavenly Feather Clan, Cortes.”
“However, at present, all of us at the Demon God Level are locked in a stalemate, and it will take some time to infiltrate quietly.”
The Left Demon nodded, “Then I’ll wait for two more days before entering the Number Ten Plane. By then, the armies of the three empires should also be nearing the frontline, so I can set things up in advance.”
“Very good,” said Tyris as his Will departed, leaving only the boundless Dark Demon Cloud rolling above the Firmament.
……
The Number Ten Plane is a vast continent stretching over fifty thousand kilometers in diameter and shaped like an irregular semi-circle.
This world is shrouded in Cloud Mist; sharp mountain peaks towering thousands to tens of thousands of meters stand erect without connecting mountain ranges, and sparse vegetation gives an impression of desolate and treacherous terrain.
At this moment, the Heavenly Feather soldiers stationed in Number Ten Plane were orderly evacuating, taking flight toward the horizon aboard warships, vanishing into golden ripples.
At the summit of a lone lofty mountain peak, Jane Aiken, with four swords on her back and wearing Crystal Red Battle Armor, looked up quietly as those golden War Fortresses disappeared into the distant sky.
The raging wind howled, blowing her black hair into disarray, with an intense sense of solitude emanating from her body.
At this moment, she was the only ‘person’ left in this Plane, surrounded by tens of thousands of mountain peaks between heaven and earth, but devoid of any signs of life.
Time passed unknowingly when, atop another mountain peak across the sea of clouds, a figure appeared soundlessly, his gaze complicated as he watched the girl’s silhouette from behind.
After a long while, Jonathan Walker sighed, “This might be the tipping point for the ultimate battle between two civilizations. Once he appears, you should leave here first.”
Jane Aiken responded coldly, “No need, I want to witness his death with my own eyes. It was my mother’s last wish, even though he didn’t die by my hand.”
“It’s a pity that I am too weak now. Otherwise…” Jane Aiken turned slightly, her eyes sweeping over Jonathan Walker, her gaze piercingly cold.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1393 - 1393 531 Beginning of the End Sun and Moon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1393: Chapter 531 Beginning of the End, Sun and Moon Shine Together_2 Chapter 1393: Chapter 531 Beginning of the End, Sun and Moon Shine Together_2 From that indifferent gaze, Jonathan Walker felt a piercingly sharp Sword Intent, and his own look became even more complex.
In the end, Jonathan Walker nodded slightly, said nothing more, and vanished once again. This scene caused True Martial Heavenly King and others outside the plane to tense up slightly.
For Jonathan Walker’s appearance and disappearance left not a single trace, the space showing no sign of disturbance, as if he had never existed at all.
Not to mention any fluctuation of the law’s energy.
This genius, who had dazzled an era, despite having silently split into three for many years, still possessed strength surpassing that of countless senior cultivators.
Now, outside of the Number Ten Plane, space-time distorted, and the Golden Divine Tree, towering tens of thousands of kilometers high, shone even more brilliantly, radiating endless golden light.
In that sea of gold were not only True Martial Heavenly King and his companions, but behind them a vast Human Expedition Legion, and an even greater number of elite members of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
At this time, these warriors of the Heavenly Feather Clan, with wings of gold, silver, and white light upon their backs, were spread out into legions, each numbering in the tens of thousands, centered around golden battleships and golden fortresses.
Each legion was overseen by one or more Mythical-level Powerhouses, these divine beings emanating dazzling halos of light that resonated with the armies and fortresses below.
Above the golden sea, apart from the Mythological Legion below, there stood twenty-two majestic and splendid divine temples covering hundreds of kilometers.
These palatial structures were all carved with the Eternal Divine Tree’s patterns and housed thousands, even tens of thousands, of figures with two pairs of light wings, stationed at various points in the temple.
These “people,” different from the typical Heavenly Feather Clan, were very similar in form but lacked physical bodies; yet they all radiated high-order or even quasi-mythical aura, with a few even at the Mythical-level.
These temples, like even more vast War Fortresses, had each of their spires glowing with halos, sacred and formidable.
Simultaneously, each temple represented a Divine King of Heavenly King Level.
Compared to the Human Race’s slightly more than ten Heavenly King Level powerhouses, the Heavenly Feather Clan had a greater number of Main God-level individuals, although all of these Main Gods seemed to be in a weakened state.
Nine of them had just been resurrected from the trunk of the Eternal Divine Tree, preparing to burn their last bit of strength.
And because they were enveloped in the golden light of the Eternal Divine Tree, the Demon Gods standing outside the Eternal Domain could not perceive nor see this force.
Within the Eternal Domain, four Heavenly Feather Divine Kings radiating Supreme Level aura stood firm, still confronting the nine Demon Gods outside the domain, and everything appeared to be quite normal.
Time passed, and two days quickly slipped by without a sound.
Under the silver moonlight, the Number Ten Plane became even more desolate and silent. On the mountain peak, the black-haired girl bearing four swords stood motionless, as if she were a breathtaking painting etched between heaven and earth.
Suddenly, Jane Aiken looked up toward the sea of clouds in front of her, where space silently shattered and tore, forming a crack several thousand kilometers long.
From within the fissure stepped out a Purgatory Evil Demon clad in dark red armor, standing five meters tall, with horns on its head and a pair of black bat wings and a sharp tail behind it.
The moment this Purgatory Evil Demon appeared, a Terrifying Aura spread, darkening the entire plane in an instant, as though a layer of black veil had been draped over it.
Immediately the world became oppressively gloomy, as the pervasive shadow within drove away the moonlight, swallowing everything.
But then, high in the Firmament, a golden Great Sun a hundred kilometers in diameter emerged, casting dazzling Radiance, like golden swords rending the darkness.
Soon the sky was clear again, bright as day under the golden sun’s glow.
However, the land below was now submerged in Dark Demon Air, with only mountain peaks visible, surrounded by rolling black waves like an ocean.
“I thought you might not dare to enter.”
A calm voice sounded, Jonathan Walker appeared under the golden sun, bearing the Great Sun on his back, his gaze calm as he looked down at the churning sea of darkness below.
There, Left Demon also slightly raised his head, his gaze coldly fixed on Jonathan Walker.
Both emanating a chilling murderous intent at this moment, each wanting to slay the other, even though they were originally one person, one soul self-cleft into two separate beings.
This was the drawback of the ancient secret skill that Jonathan Walker once practiced.
Although after killing the other, they would fuse and absorb everything from one another, reintegrating into a whole, the dominant consciousness would be of the last victor.
The other two personalities would completely vanish, leaving behind only some memories and experiences of cultivation insights.
Left Demon slowly spoke, “I thought you had something to rely on, daring to lure me here actively, but I didn’t expect your realm to have only reached the late period of Heavenly King.”
“It seems that my choice back then was correct; the Purgatory bloodline is stronger than that of the human body.”
As he spoke, an overbearing will surged from Left Demon’s body, his entire being emitting a dazzling black-gold radiance, turning half the sky into darkness.
Boom!
From within the black-gold light, an indescribable, terrifying aura burst forth; the force was so strong that space itself was compressed into substance, forming layer upon layer of transparent shockwaves erupting in all directions.
A Purgatory Demon King, a thousand meters tall with three heads and ten arms, covered in black-gold scale armor, appeared in the black-gold light, with wings that blotted out the sky, surrounded by black and red ribbons of light, his demon power vast and majestic.
In the true form of Left Demon’s hands, he held a black-gold battle halberd over two thousand meters in length, entwined with Dragon Scale Patterns, but the weapon’s front was a single-edged Devouring Overlord Halberd.
Besides the arms holding the halberd, two of the remaining eight arms were jointly supporting a black stone tower, while the six other arms each grasped a hundred-meter-long black flag.
And beneath his feet, the Dark Demon Air dissipated, revealing another scene.
It was a special abyss engulfing the earth, with dark red lightning streaking through the dark red world. Wherever these lightnings passed, mountains and Earth silently crumbled into annihilation.
“Today is the day I become whole again and step into the ranks of the Demon Gods,” said Left Demon, raising a long roar. His halberd shone bright as a ten-thousand-meter halberd light entwined with countless dark red lightnings shot up into the sky.
Under the black halberd light, blessed by the abyss and even more solid than the space outside in the mythical world, backed by the Eternal Divine Tree, space immediately shattered into pieces.
Like a black tide bursting skyward, releasing a terrifying aura that could destroy heaven and Earth, it enveloped thousands of kilometers, swallowing everything in its path.
Above the Firmament, Jonathan Walker watched with cold eyes, the Great Sun behind him radiating endlessly, emitting boundless radiance and high temperatures, just like a true Great Sun, suddenly descending.
Boom!
The falling Golden Great Sun spun wildly at a speed of tens of thousands of turns per second, grinding a thousand kilometers of space into dust, while the invisible force of distortion and destruction enveloped a ten thousand kilometer range.

Below, already fused with the abyss body of ten thousand meters, the Left Demon with overwhelming Demon Power held his halberd across the sky, his entire being resembling a terrifying Demon God forged from Black Gold.
Boom!
The Purgatory Great Demon King, standing atop the abyss, shattered the Void and appeared above the Firmament in an instant, stirring up a sky-full of dark tides that devoured the land and sky. The forefront of the tides wielded a Tyrant Halberd tens of thousands of meters long.
Bang bang bang!!
Under the unrivaled domination of the Devouring Heaven Overlord Halberd, round after round of Golden Suns with a diameter of a hundred kilometers, rapidly spinning and distorting space-time, burst apart, their momentum rainbow-like, unstoppable.
The exploded suns formed golden rings that swept across more than ten thousand kilometers, causing the entire Number Ten Plane to shake wildly, with earth-shattering roars echoing incessantly.
In the dazzling explosion, Jonathan Walker danced wildly with his long hair, his body cloaked in a layer of jade-green battle armor, his surroundings roiling with chaotic currents.
Looking at the Black Overlord Halberd coming at him, shattering space-time and bursting ten Great Suns, Jonathan Walker calmly extended his right hand and spoke softly, “Yin, Yang, turn.”
Boom! A terrifying Power of Will burst forth from Jonathan Walker, enveloping the entire world.
The powerful Will, almost comparable to a Rule, coalesced into ten silver moons that spun slightly, and in an instant, the Plane reversed Yin and Yang, the explosive radiance of the Golden Suns around him suddenly paused.
In the astonished gaze of those above the rank of myth of the Heavenly Feather Clan outside the Plane, at this moment, time stood still and then flowed backward. In an instant, the shattered explosive radiance of the golden, scorching energy suddenly converged, reforming ten Great Suns.
The ten Great Suns surrounded the Left Demon, who had manifested a ten-thousand-meter True Body, hanging over the abyssal sea that submerged Heaven and Earth, releasing an even more dazzling light in the instant of reversal.
Boom boom boom!! Beneath the explosion of the ten Great Suns, the entire Number Ten Plane shook wildly, the explosive light akin to an expanding golden sphere that swept across Heaven and Earth.
Under the power capable of destroying Heaven and Earth, the dark abyss devouring the Earth was torn apart, forming a massive hollow over ten thousand kilometers wide, with thousands to tens of thousands meters high mountain peaks collapsing in all directions.
“Is this your confidence? Unfortunately, it’s too weak.”
In the center of the explosion spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, all things melted under the intense force, even the rules of Heaven and Earth disintegrating under that extreme heat and destructive power.
But amidst the violent energy chaos, a Black Gold figure tens of thousands of meters tall stood firm, wielding a War Halberd, his three heads and ten arms emanating an extremely tyrannical dark aura.
At this moment, apart from some shattered scales on Left Demon, his aura seemed even more overbearing. That strike, which nearly shattered the land of the Number Ten Plane, had hardly injured him at all.
Boom! The Black-gold Battle Halberd, vast as a mountain range, pierced through Heaven and Earth, with countless dark red lightnings from the abyss twisting around it, shattering the world’s phenomena above the Firmament.
Under the powerful force, time stood still, and in just an instant, it was upon Jonathan Walker.
At the same time, behind the Left Demon, the double-armed held Black Stone Tower also shook thunderously. The nine levels of stone eyes, carved on the tower’s surface, suddenly opened, revealing eerie black pupils.
Under the gaze of those eyes, akin to the abyss of Hell, an immensely heavy force traversed space-time and descended, sealing the layers of space-time surrounding Jonathan Walker.
This strike was unavoidable, inescapable.
Boom!
Under the dominion of that towering Overlord Halberd, Jonathan Walker was obliterated on the spot. The terrifying force even pulverized the time and space of a thousand miles, annihilating them with unrivaled domination.
After obliterating Jonathan Walker, the concentrated force continued unabated, cleaving a ten thousand kilometers long Black Crack across the Firmament of the Number Ten Plane, as if parting the world down the middle.
Looking at the Black Gold Great Demon King who stood above the Firmament, overlooking all directions, in the golden interlayer world outside the Plane, all the Heavenly Feather Divine Kings became sharp-eyed.
In the Radiant Divine Temple, Deya said gravely, “This Marshal of the Purgatory Empire, after having disappeared for a while, though he has not broken through the Divine King Level, his strength now is no less than a Divine King.”
Previously, before absorbing the Sacred Body and entering Closed-door Cultivation, even though the Left Demon’s combat power was overwhelming, he could only briefly clash with a Divine King for a few dozen exchanges and then retreat fully.
But the battle power he now displayed had entirely reached that of a Divine King, even stronger than some of those who had just broken through to the Ancient Realm.
Suddenly, in every Divine Temple, powerful Divine Soul Intent permeated, and the voices of the Heavenly Feather Divine Kings were heard.
“This Purgatory Evil Demon must die; otherwise, if a great war breaks out and no ‘Person’ can restrain him, it will become very difficult to handle.”
“It seems that the hidden strong man of the Human Race is very powerful, but it appears he is no match for him. To kill this Purgatory Commander, it seems we will need to make a move.”
“When the time comes, it will be best for you three, Falcola, to join forces and find an opportunity to restrain him, and then the Lord of Holy Light, wielding the Primordial Light, should make a move, and there might be hope.”
In this moment, more than twenty Heavenly Feather Divine Kings made their decision, their eyes coldly watching the dark gold Demon King whose Demon Power overwhelmed the Plane.
The three individuals entrusted with this mission, Falcola, were among the strongest Divine Kings revived this time, all three at the peak of Divine King cultivation.
Though their presence was strong, seated high in the Divine Temples with a grand and holy aura, they somehow gave the impression of a flickering candle in the wind.
The one whom the Heavenly Feather Divine Kings called the Lord of Holy Light also had the peak aura of a Divine King but exuded an immensely majestic air, as though he was a Divine King himself.

Standing behind the Main God, who was clad in a golden divine robe with four pairs of white light wings and shrouded in white radiance, was Anstice, also of the Realm of the Lord God.
“Your strength is as I expected, indeed very strong.”
A calm voice rose between heaven and earth, where golden light appeared out of nowhere in the chaotic Void currents shattered by a strike from Left Demon, forming a huge golden eye.
Dressed in a cyan jade War Halberd, Jonathan Walker appeared from nothingness within the eye, his aura still at its peak.
Watching this scene, Left Demon’s eyes were ice cold without a hint of surprise; if his human True Body were so easily obliterated, that would have been troubling.
Compared to Purgatory True Demons, who solidify their True Bodies through their bloodlines, humans have always had an advantage in comprehending the Laws of Heaven and Earth.
And as the genius who had astounded an era more than a decade ago, Jonathan Walker’s talent for comprehension was naturally even more terrifying, whether regarding the Laws or the realm of thought unique to humans.
That scene where ten suns hung in the sky, the sun and moon shined together with Yin-Yang rotating, was the result of Jonathan Walker fusing the terrifying sun and moon realm of thought with Higher-order Extreme Yang and Extreme Yin Laws.
Without any superfluous words, there was only an instant standoff, and then Left Demon burst forth with demon gas, and the Stone Towers he held, each with a black eye, opened once again.
This time, under the reflection of the enormous golden eye’s phantom with a diameter of ten thousand meters, dark gaze-like substance sprang up from all directions, centering around Jonathan Walker.
These gazes interwove and converged, forming a phantom of a Black Tower tens of thousands of meters high, nonexistent in essence, sealing layers of Space Interlayers and cracks.
Boom!
The moment the Stone Tower locked the space-time, the Purgatory Great Demon King, whose stature reached ten thousand meters, let out a roar. The Tyrant Halberd erupted with black radiance, unleashing a flood of crimson red lightning that submerged both heaven and earth.
This terrifying display of crimson lightning swept across all of creation below the heavens, reducing everything to ash, shattering Laws.
However, this move was already useless against Jonathan Walker, who, in the very instant those black eyes once again sealed him, manifested another round of sun and moon behind him.
With a diameter of one hundred kilometers, radiating blistering heat, the golden Great Sun and the cold and remote moon swiftly spun at a rate of one million rotations per second, like two colliding stars.
Under the terrible Distortion force, space exploded, space-time twisted, and even the phantom of the Black Stone Tower emerging under the reflection of the golden eye collapsed with a bang.
At the moment the abyssal Black Tower was torn asunder, the Tyrant Halberd that demolished everything appeared in front of Jonathan Walker, met by the sun and the moon spinning in opposite directions and violently merging into one.
In the instant that Jonathan Walker’s Supreme Will merged the two Higher-order Laws into one, manifesting the sun and moon as one, a turbid star emerged, filled with the Terrifying Power of Destructive Rules on par with the Supreme Level.
Boom!
An explosion even more terrifying than the previous strike erupted, causing the whole Plane to shake violently beyond its limits, emitting sounds of impending collapse.
Golden chains of order emerged on the edge of the Plane, forming the phantom of a giant Golden Divine Tree, forcibly suppressing the impact threatening to shatter the Plane.
“Kill!”
A resounding shout exploded between heaven and earth within the trembling Plane, as ten Great Suns appeared once more, emanating dazzling radiance that suddenly merged into a more terrifying crimson red sun.
The Left Demon, holding the War Halberd, likewise let out a heaven-shaking roar, scattering Halberd Skill beams that reached a hundred thousand meters long. With the support of the Abyss beneath his feet, each strike carried Terrifying Power.
An even more astounding battle broke out in an instant, causing the Plane to shake even more violently. The sheer force of their power made it nearly impossible for anyone to discern their figures.
Their speed transcended the perception of time itself, exchanging tens of thousands of blows in the blink of an eye, their Terrifying Power threatening to collapse the very order of the Plane’s Laws.
In Jonathan Walker’s ‘hands,’ the power of the sun and moon evolved to the extreme, with moonlight flashing in an instant and appearing a thousand miles away, its speed surpassing that of time itself.
When the ten Great Suns stretched across the sky, they scorched the heavens and boiled the seas, dissolving countless strands of Dark Demon Air, melting the Earth, and slowly turning the entire Plane into a fiery Hell.
Especially when the sun and moon shined together, they could even reverse space-time.
This Terrifying Power capable of reversing space-time in an instant was even more dreadful than the rules mastered by many ordinary ancient-level beings, allowing Jonathan Walker to dodge lethal attacks every time.
Moreover, with the ten suns hanging in the sky, and the reversed integration of the sun and moon forming the Destructive Great Sun, he, in the late period of the Heavenly King realm, displayed combat strength comparable to the ordinary Supreme.
But as strong as Jonathan Walker was, Left Demon, manifesting his True Body as the Purgatory Great Demon King, was even more terrifying. With the Abyss beneath his feet and wielding the War Halberd, he swept through all directions.
No matter how powerful the fallen Great Sun was, they were all shattered by the heavy and Overbearing Tyrant Halberd, everything was torn apart.
Even if the sun and moon merged, transforming into the Chaos Destructive Great Sun, they were still destroyed, with the Power of the Abyss invisibly entwined around the War Halberd shaking the entire Plane.
This scene made even True Martial Heavenly King and others look grave.
This ‘genius’ who had betrayed the Federation and joined the Purgatory Empire through demonization had some terrifying combat power, and his stance of Unrivaled Domination subconsciously reminded them of Jack Clark.
Both wielded a War Halberd, and both exhibited equally formidable and terrifying strength, pushing through in all directions.
However, as earth-shattering as their battle was, the expressions of True Martial Heavenly King and the others grew increasingly grave, for Jonathan Walker was actually at a disadvantage the entire time.
Both men had extremely exaggerated talent and ability to fight across realms, but there was a small gap in cultivation levels, and this ‘small difference’ was being magnified infinitely during the battle.

﻿Chapter 1396: Chapter 532 Who Killed Her, The True Awakening of the Demon King_3 Chapter 1396: Chapter 532 Who Killed Her, The True Awakening of the Demon King_3 The peak-level Left Demon of the Great Demon King had nearly completely refined and fused the Black Gold spine that served as the carrier for his Avatar, condensing the power of the Abyss bloodline and the golden eye to form the body of a Demon God.
At this moment, setting aside his cross-realm combat capabilities, Left Demon, with his cultivation realm alone, could already be considered a half-celebrated Demon God, having acquired the body of a Demon God.
Therefore, Jonathan Walker’s attacks could not even shake Left Demon. The apparent destructive power of the sun and moon seemed terrifying, but in fact, he had been suppressed from the start of the battle.
However, despite the suppression, Jonathan Walker’s eyes seemed to possess the ability to discern the secrets of heaven and foretell the future, as he deftly avoided the heavy War Halberds that Left Demon slashed through space-time to deliver at critical moments.
As such, the battle was incredibly thrilling, causing onlookers such as the Heavenly Feather Gods, Main Gods, and the Mysterious Martial Sky King to watch intently, their expressions solemn as they pondered continuously.
They were contemplating how they would cope with the terrifyingly powerful Left Demon if they were in that situation.
Most of them concluded that they would flee; even Mythical-level Powerhouses would have their True Bodies shattered and Divine Souls heavily injured under that terrifying halberd in one strike, with three strikes enough to erase them completely.
Ordinary Main Gods facing Left Demon at this moment would just endure a few more halberd strikes before their true bodies would be shattered, their Origins eroded, and they would fall.
Even the three resurrected Peak Main Gods doubted they could withstand a single attack from that fearsome Great Demon King on their own, given the terrifying power that contained the essence of the Dark Abyss.
“No, how is that Human girl still there!?”
Suddenly, one of the stronger members of the Heavenly Feather Clan noticed that, amidst the tens of thousands of kilometers of Earth shattered into fragments, with magma flowing and flames burning in the Doomsday World, the Human girl was still there.
The girl with four swords on her back was surrounded by a powerful strength, blocking the waves of battle residue that continually erupted between heaven and earth, her long hair wildly dancing in the wind, her expression indifferent.
The golden light around the True Martial Heavenly King gathered to form the figure of Bordea, who asked in perplexity, “True Martial brother, how is that genius of your Human Race still down there?”
Bordea had a deep impression of Jane Aiken, who had previously exhibited astonishing talent no less than the youngest geniuses of the Divine Phoenix Lineage.
Previously, when the Humans sought their alliance to ambush the notorious Purgatory Marshal Cortes, they only mentioned they had a way to lure him out.
But now, with the battle imminent, the chances of success for an ambush relying solely on the forces of the Human Race were not high—cooperation from a Heavenly Feather Divine King-level existence was necessary to make a move.
Moreover, this battle could potentially be the turning point of the final showdown.
Watching the girl with black hair whipping in the raging wind, the True Martial Heavenly King sighed slowly, “She didn’t leave; she’s preparing to use herself as bait to pin that Great Demon King in place.”
“As long as she is there, the Great Demon King will not leave until the outcome of today’s battle is decided, even if there’s a risk of perishing later on.”
“This…” Bordea’s eyes showed astonishment, at a loss as to the relationship between the Human girl and the Purgatory Marshal.
The True Martial Heavenly King did not hide anything and said gravely, “This Great Demon King, known as Cortes, is actually a traitor from our Human Race.”
“True Martial brother, you must be joking. Cortes is actually a traitor of your Human Race?” Even Bordea seemed a bit dazed at this revelation, soon showing a look of astonishment.
Whether it was that Human Expert who wielded the sun and moon with a cultivation resembling a Divine King despite being a late-period Main God, or that terrifyingly powerful Great Demon King, their strength was exceedingly exaggerated.
Add to that the Divine Martial Throne who was in Closed-door Cultivation on the 17th Plane, each of them was a monster that could dominate an era, and yet the Human Race had produced so many of them!!
That’s not right.
The Great Demon King had previously mentioned that today it would achieve its unification; moreover, there seemed to be a faintly similar soul breath in the two battling strong men.
Thinking of this, Bordea took a deep breath, somewhat in disbelief, “True Martial brother, don’t tell me the Human Experts fighting below and that Great Demon King are essentially the same person!”
The True Martial Heavenly King sighed, “They are indeed the same person, named Jonathan Walker, once a genius who dominated an era in our tribe.”
“Then some things happened; he cut himself into three parts, and one of his True Bodies chose to betray the Human Race and demonize, joining the Purgatory Empire.”
“The relationship between Jane Aiken and them is a bit complicated, or maybe she is the key to killing that Great Demon King today.”
Just then, two terrifying auras burst forth within the Plane.
Above the Firmament, a huge golden eye emerged, its gaze cold and devoid of any emotional fluctuation, reflecting on Heaven and Earth as if it were the Eye of Heavenly Path looking down upon all beings.
Meanwhile, below, at the feet of Left Demon who stood above the Abyss surrounded by innumerable dark red lightning, another golden eye emerged.
Unlike the Eye of the Firmament, irradiating Sacred Breath, the golden eye from the depth of the Abyss felt unbelievably terrifying, filled with endless darkness.
Boom! The light from both eyes intensified as if connecting to some Supreme Power, Divine Might descended, and under the clash of Terrifying Power, the entire Plane shattered with a thunderous roar.
Dark cracks spread in all directions like a spider web, encompassing tens of thousands of kilometers, blanketing almost half of the entire Plane.
If it were not for the Eternal Divine Tree suppressing it, this strike would have sufficed to completely destroy that Plane World, its might was so terrifying that even the Demon Gods and Divine Kings at the edges of the Eternal Domain paused momentarily.
On the Domain’s edge, a Demon God shrouded in Dark Demon Air spoke up in a grand voice, “As expected of Tyris, the talents you uncover from different races always have incredibly high potential.”
