﻿Chapter 1398: Chapter 533: The Might of the Great Demon King, Jack Clark’s Arrival Chapter 1398: Chapter 533: The Might of the Great Demon King, Jack Clark’s Arrival The sudden intervention of the Heavenly Feather Clan caught Jack Clark, the True Martial Heavenly King, and his companions off guard.
The initial agreement between the two parties was that they would control Cortes (Left Demon) while Jonathan Walker was casting the Summoning Secret Skill, and it was at that instant that the True Martial Heavenly King would strike to Suppress him.
As for them, they were to prevent the possible intervention of the Purgatory Demon Gods and the high probability of a full-scale war breaking out.
Boom!
The Number Ten Plane, frozen in time and space, shattered its sky, forming a hollow thousands of kilometers in size, from which endless White Light poured down through the Hollow, brimming with the essence of Holy Light.
From afar, it looked like a beam of light thousands of kilometers thick descended from the sky, intending to purify the world below shrouded in the darkness of the Abyss.
Especially within that pillar of heavenly-reaching white light, a pure white Radiance that resembled a long spear circulated, exuding the ancient Aura of the first ray of Primordial Light.
The moment that Primordial Light appeared, the Demon Gods observing from outside the Eternal Domain all felt a strong sense of danger.
The Lord of Holy Light is the innate life born from the Pool of Light with the power of the Eternal Divine Tree, fused with the Rule Origin of the Divine King of Light, the strongest of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
This ray of Primordial Light is its accompanying artifact, containing the strength of the first light created by the domain of the Eternal Divine Tree, tantamount to a half-step World-class weapon.
The Lord of Holy Light, wielding the Primordial Spear and like the True Martial Heavenly King, possessed the combat ability to Reverse Defeat ordinary Demon Gods, making it the strongest beneath the Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Over the years, on the battlefields between the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Purgatory Empire, it was basically this entity that blocked the terrifyingly powerful Left Demon.
However, just as the entire Plane was being sacrificed by the three Peak Main Gods and the utmost powerful forces they had Summoned were sealing it, and the Lord of Holy Light was fully invoking the Primordial Light to purify the Left Demon, a Terrifying Power descended.
Boom!
The entire Plane shook violently, as a pair of immense, endless claws covered in black scales reached into the Plane, eclipsing half of the sky.
With just the appearance of the claws, the Demonic Aura they emitted effortlessly shattered the force that froze time and space, generating rings of black shock waves that trembled throughout space and time.
Spitting Essence Blood from their mouths, the three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, burning both soul and True Body, saw their vast shadows of light directly shattered by the Trembling Aura.
“Great Demon God Tyris!”
At the edge of the tattered Hollow in the Firmament, the Lord of Holy Light, clutching the Primordial Spear, displayed a trace of astonishment in its eyes, and the originally descending Spear of Light paused in its hand.
Nobody expected that Great Demon God Tyris, the mightiest being among the three Purgatory Empires, would take direct action at the first sign of an ambush on the Left Demon.
Shouldn’t an entity of this caliber only appear at the very last moment?
Boom!
The demon claws grasping either side of the Plane’s sky tore apart fiercely, and in an instant, the Plane’s sky was split in two by a terrifying force, creating a pitch-black crack tens of thousands of kilometers long.
Outside the crack, a terrifying figure stood tall; towering over hundreds of thousands of meters high, surrounded by endless Dark Demon Air, these formed a number of Distorted Worlds.
These worlds were unmistakably the nine Planes already controlled and corrupted by the Purgatory Empire, and as the Great Demon King manipulated the Abyssal Power, their respective space-times were merging.
Most crucially, throughout these nine Planes were distributed Main Battle Legions of True Demons, Vassal Demonized Alien Legions; the sheer number of them, at a rough glance, was at least over two hundred million.
More than two hundred million High-Ranking Powerhouses possessing at least Five Demonic Marks, and countless others with Eight Path Demon Marks and Nine Demonic Marks, along with Giant Demonized Beasts and Flying Giant Beasts circling overhead, the Aura was terrifying.
What caused the Heavenly Feather Clan and people like True Martial Heavenly King to be earnest was the presence of demon king castles floating above these legions, surrounded by swirling Dark Demon Air, covering the sky.
At this moment, above those demon king castles, the Demon Kings had revealed their True Forms, towering hundreds to thousands of kilometers tall, with the shapes of Three-headed Six-armed and Three-headed Eight-armed Demon Kings.
The number was close to two hundred.
Among them, there were over one hundred and fifty Demon Kings and thirty-seven Great Demon Kings, with a quarter of them being at the peak of their realms as Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings.
In this moment, the formidable high-end combat power displayed by the three major empires had slightly shocked all of the experts from the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Human Race.
Although it was known that over the last few centuries, the three Purgatory Empires had been continuously ‘training troops,’ using their numerical advantage to grind down the Heavenly Feather Strongmen with Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings taking turns in battle.
But they had not expected that after years of attrition against the Heavenly Feather Clan, there remained so many mythical-level strongmen.
Especially when the three empires had initiated the War of Extermination, there were still some Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings left behind to guard the empire.
As that terrifying figure tore through the Number Ten Plane, initiated the Abyssal Descent, and forcibly merged the Nine Great Dark Planes, around the edge of the Eternal Divine Domain, four Heavenly Feather Divine Kings maintained their standoff with nine Demon Gods.
Behind them, with twelve white wings spread wide, radiating endless white light, a figure resembling a Creation Angel spoke slowly, and an ancient, majestic voice echoed throughout space-time.
“So it’s the True Demon God Body of Tyris. It seems you can no longer restrain yourselves and are ready to fight our clan with all your might.”
“I wonder though, are you prepared for the fall of several Demon Gods?”
Outside the Domain, sitting high upon the ancient throne, Tyris was shrouded in darkness, only a pair of dark red eyes emerged, his voice echoing, deep and sonorous.
“Pitiful Metastat, once I decide to obliterate your Heavenly Feather Clan, no Demonic Energy can defy my Will.”
As he spoke, Tyris slowly stood up from the ancient throne, and in an instant, a pressure powerful enough to shake the entire Eternal Domain erupted, imperceptibly superior even to the Demon Gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1399 - 1399 533 The Might of the Great Demon King
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1399: Chapter 533: The Might of the Great Demon King, Jack Clark’s Arrival_2 Chapter 1399: Chapter 533: The Might of the Great Demon King, Jack Clark’s Arrival_2 “`
Boom, boom, boom!!
“`
“`
Around Tyris, the Void shattered, space-time trembled, creating layers of twisted, dark Abyss illusions; or rather, those were no illusions at all, but Abysses surrounding him on all sides.
“`
“`
The instant Tyris rose to his feet, terrifying auras also burst forth from the eight Demon Gods encircling the boundary realm, each revealing their Demon God True Bodies that towered ten thousand meters high.
“`
“`
Among them, the two from the ancient late stage had the most dreadful presence, with three heads and sixteen arms, surrounded by endless Dark Demon Air, akin to World-Destroying Demon Kings descending from the depths of the Abyss.
“`
“`
Most importantly, in their hands were a pitch-black magic spear and a blood-dripping war spear, emanating a terrifying fluctuation that seemed to destroy the world and suppress the Heavenly Earth Rules.
“`
“`
World-class weapons.
“`
“`
The moment it was decided to fully unleash the War of Extermination, both sides dispensed with any superfluous words.
“`
“`
One could only see Tyris, from outside the boundary realm, reaching out slightly with his hand, and immediately the Golden Divine Realm in front of him began to shake violently, with strands of pure gold Rules of Power emerging, interweaving into a thick Gold Wall Realm.
“`
“`
Boom! Under the overwhelming power, that Gold Wall Realm collapsed, forming a gigantic palm imprint with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers and depths of thousands of kilometers.
“`
“`
The formidable power crushed space-time and shattered the silhouette of the Divine King of Light.
“`
“`
Such was the might of the Great Demon Kings from the three mighty Purgatory Empires, completely on a different level from other Demon Gods. No one could withstand their might when they made their move.
“`
“`
As the silhouette of the Divine King of Light was shattered, it disintegrated into countless points of light and vanished.
“`
“`
Hum!
“`
“`
At the heart of the Eternal Divine Domain, the Golden Divine Tree, standing hundreds of thousands of kilometers tall, surged with radiance, sending out rings of brilliant light waves that enveloped the entire boundary realm and all planes.
“`
“`
Simultaneously, endless White Light converged atop the tree canopy, forming a white light circle with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers, akin to the Wheel of Creation.
“`
“`
Within the Light of Creation, a figure appearing ten thousand kilometers tall with fourteen white wings of light behind it, slowly emerged.
“`
“`
At once, an aura belonging to the True Spirit Level, embodying the notion of immortality, soared into the sky, spanning ages and instilling a primal fear and reverence in all life.
“`
“`
And all of this happened in the blink of an eye from when the Lord of Holy Light took action to this moment.
“`
“`
At this instant, countless faces of the Heavenly Feather Clan turned to look up towards the center of the Eternal Divine Domain with fervent adoration, kneeling in worship to that supreme existence.
“`
“`
“It’s the great Divine Master of Light.”
“`
“`
“The God Lord has stepped into that eternal, ultimate realm.”
“`
“`
“Our Heavenly Feather Clan is saved, haha…”
“`
“`
“Damn you, True Demons from Purgatory, today is your end…”
“`
“`
While the Heavenly Feather soldiers were hysterically excited, those Heavenly Feather Gods, Main Gods, True Martial Heavenly Kings, and others softly bowed in respect to that magnificent figure.
“`
“`
Only the strong men above Mythical level knew that the Divine King of Light hadn’t actually broken through to the ancient True Spirit Level, but had merely merged temporarily with the Eternal Divine Tree, stepping into the realm of Ancient Gods.
“`
“`
“Ancestors, the Divine King of Light of our Heavenly Feather Clan has become an Ancestor.”
“`
“`
While the Heavenly Feather soldiers were hysterically excited, the Purgatory True Demons standing behind the Abyss Demon God Body of Tyris all revealed horror in their eyes.
“`
“`
Panicking, they looked uneasily at the figure emitting endless White Light, illuminating the nineteen planes, the whole Eternal Divine Domain, and even the surrounding mythical world.
“`
“`
The information inherited through their bloodline told these Purgatory True Demons that they were witnessing the power of an Ancestor surpassing Demon Gods, a terrifying existence that had become part of the rules, immortality and ancient eternity.
“`
“`
Even Jack Clark from the seventeenth plane was startled awake by this ancient and powerful True Spirit Aura.
“`
“`
At the heart of a tens of thousands of kilometers wide Black Gold radiance, Jack Clark slowly opened his three pairs of eyes, with a world slowly rotating in each. He slightly lifted his head to look beyond the plane.
“`
“`
“This power, the Divine King of Light has made a breakthrough! No, that doesn’t seem like a truly True Spirit Level existence?” Jack mused, a hint of confusion in his eyes.
“`
“`
As someone who had encountered True Spirit Beasts (Emperor Dragons), Jack immediately sensed something amiss with the vast and majestic figure of the Divine King of Light.
“`
“`
“The War of Extermination has begun, has it?” Jack thought, deep in contemplation.
“`
“`
For the strongest Divine King of the Heavenly Feather to reveal such a form clearly indicated a crisis of potential extinction. Wasn’t it said that they could still hold out for two more Sun Wheels?
“`
“`
Due to his closed-door cultivation, Jack was unaware that the decisive battle that had erupted prematurely was all because of him.
“`
“`
Just as all ‘people’s’ gazes were fixed on that grandiose figure of the Creation Angel, the enormous light circle above the Divine King of Light exploded with a bang, forming a surging white tide that flooded the entire Eternal Divine Domain.
“`
“`
In an instant, space-time distorted, and the cosmos inverted, the nineteen planes surrounding the Eternal Divine Tree disappeared, merging into a ‘world’ huge and boundless, with a diameter of over two million kilometers.
“`
“`
At the center of this vast world’s Earth, the Golden Divine Tree towering hundreds of thousands of kilometers stood breathtakingly tall, with streams of tangible gold and white Rules of Power circling around it.
“`
“`
Many areas along the edges of the world were corroded by Dark Demon Air, looking like massive patches of ominous mold spreading an ominous presence.
“`
“`
This was the true form of the Eternal Divine Domain.
“`
“`
With the merging of the nineteen planes, the hundreds of millions of Purgatory Demon Race, Demonized Alien Race, over a hundred Demon Kings, and dozens of Great Demon Kings, previously spread across nine layers of the corrupted planes, found themselves scattered.
“`
“`
At once, these Purgatory Evil Demons, in groups ranging from thousands to mere hundreds, were stunned as they looked around, their faces showing solemnity and shock.
“`
“`
In a world with a diameter of over two million kilometers, the dispersal of hundreds of millions of the Purgatory Demon Race made little difference, akin to a small river entering a vast ocean, hardly noticeable.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1400 - 1400 533 The Might of the Great Demon King
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1400: Chapter 533: The Might of the Great Demon King, Jack Clark’s Arrival_3 Chapter 1400: Chapter 533: The Might of the Great Demon King, Jack Clark’s Arrival_3 Similarly, over twenty million soldiers of the Heavenly Feather Legion, along with more than seventy Heavenly Feather mythicals and twenty-three Main God-level powerhouses, were scattered in all directions by that rule power.
Unlike the Purgatory Demon Race, the Heavenly Feather clan’s legions were organized in units of one hundred thousand, revolving around those mythicals and the Main God palaces formed scattered legions in all directions.
Including the thirteen sky-based battleships of the Human Race, the one million unmanned War Pattern Legion, and the True Martial Heavenly King and others, also ended up together, appearing above an endless sea of trees.
Such might made Mysterious Martial Heavenly King take a deep breath, “So strong, is this the power of a Civilization Emperor? With a wave of his hand, heaven and earth are inverted, rules are reshaped.”
Supporting the black Divine Stele, True Martial Heavenly King nodded gravely, “Indeed very strong.”
Before everyone could recover from their shock, suddenly, in the distance, several bursts of terrifying power that shook space-time exploded, causing the entire Eternal Divine Domain to tremble under the burst of power from the seven demon gods.
In the center of the Eternal Divine Domain, beneath the Golden Divine Tree that stood tens of thousands of kilometers high, roots that stretched tens to hundreds of thousands of kilometers lay across the earth, resembling golden divine dragons.
Surrounding these roots were powerful golden and white rules, twisting heaven and earth, sealing off an area of several hundred thousand kilometers, enveloping the seven demon gods including Tyris.
Merging with the Eternal Divine Tree elevated the Divine King of Light’s power to an indescribable level, monopolizing the seven demon gods.
“Kill! Exterminate those ugly monsters.”
“Do not spare any from the Purgatory Demon Race.”
“Charge, for the great Divine Master of Light…”
As the war of the demon gods erupted instantaneously, the whole Eternal Divine Domain also fell into chaos, each Heavenly Feather Legion swooping towards the nearby Purgatory Demon Race.
At the moment of the plane convergence, the Divine King of Light consciously scattered some dispersed, lesser demon kings around the Heavenly Feather Clan’s legions.
Including within a three thousand kilometer range of the Human Race’s legions, about two hundred thousand Purgatory Main Battle Corps, four demon kings, and one Great Demon King were also dispersed.
Boom! The True Martial Heavenly King’s hand on the black stele shook, his figure swelling to ten thousand meters tall as he rose into the sky with the stele: “I will go and suppress that Great Demon King.”
“Mysterious Martial, Denny Kaye, you each take on those two demon kings, make it a quick battle, and Morning King, you hold off the remaining two demon kings.”
“No problem.”
“Leave it to us.”
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
In an instant, Mysterious Martial Heavenly King, Denny Kaye, including Morning King, five kings in total, all revealed their Mythical True Bodies and pounced towards the distant four demon kings.
At the same time, the War Pattern Legion split into ten, with units of one hundred thousand boarding the now fully charged sky-based battleships flying towards those Purgatory True Demons.
An instant later, a one-sided slaughter broke out in this world.
Because the Divine King of Light had intervened, the numerical advantage of the Purgatory Tribe was erased, and for a short period, the Heavenly Feather Clan actually held the advantage.
But both the True Martial Heavenly King and those Heavenly Feather Main Gods knew that this advantage was only temporary.
The millions of kilometers of the Divine Realm were vast, but aside from the tens of thousands of kilometers in the central region’s demon god battlefield, this distance could not stop those stronger than mythicals.
While they were slaughtering the scattered Purgatory Legions, they might also encounter a peak Great Demon King at any time and be completely annihilated.
Roar!
The ferocious roar echoed between heaven and earth as the black-red colored mech, standing over six hundred meters tall atop the Number One sky-based battleship, roared skyward, exuding an extremely vicious and terrifying aura.
As the blue-white radiance lit up in Number One’s eyes, two light beams shot out explosively, instantly traversing hundreds of kilometers, and struck the Purgatory Legion relying on the mountain range to form a demon array.
Boom! A dazzling blue-white mushroom cloud rose solemnly from the earth, enveloping an area of tens of kilometers.
Under the terrifying strength of the Heavenly King Level, the earth within a few hundred kilometers collapsed, mountain ranges exploded, and tens of thousands from the Purgatory True Demon Legion were directly eradicated by this strike.
This is the power of the Heavenly King Level without any mutual restraint, slaughtering these transcendent lives as simply as crushing ants.
…
Not far from the dark golden light circle with a diameter of over eight thousand kilometers, almost covering more than half of the Mixed Copper Mountain Range, there stood a Great Demon King in high altitude, emanating a late-stage Titan aura, with a grave expression looking ahead.
In that massive dark golden light sphere, it vaguely felt a hidden and terrifying aura, incredibly heavy.
“Does the Divine King Senior of the Heavenly Feather Clan esteem me so highly that they actually sent a Great Demon King directly to me?”
As a deep voice resonated between heaven and earth, Jack Clark, who had been preparing to continue stabilizing his realm in the center of the Dark Star Domian, slowly stood up.
The earth within ten thousand kilometers trembled with a roar as if unable to bear his presence.
Two days ago, Jack had already completed his breakthrough, but instead of emerging, he continued to solidify his cultivation, devouring the heavy metal elements from the Mixed Copper Mountain Range to strengthen his True Body.
Whoosh!
The dark golden light sphere enveloping thousands of kilometers kept shrinking, fading away, revealing the mountains beneath that had turned to ash-gray, and the figure standing above on the vast pit that spanned hundreds of kilometers.
After the breakthrough into the Heavenly King Realm, Jack’s True Body soared to a kilometer in height, still with three faces and eight arms, his body covered with black-red armor interlaced with blue patterns.
Behind him, his hair, three hundred meters long and black and white like flames dancing in the air, a golden light wheel with a diameter of three hundred meters slowly spun, reflecting a world filled with Black Wind and thunder.
What astonished the Great Demon King the most was the aura of strength emanating from Jack, who was merely standing there. Just the invisible magnetic field radiating from him caused the Heavenly Earth Laws within a thousand kilometers to collapse.
And due to being overly ‘heavy’, the space within a few hundred kilometers around him was distorted into a transparent vortex with him at the center.
Run, run!!
Facing Jack, who was emanating an early Heavenly King Realm breath, the first thought that came to the Great Demon King, who was at a late-stage level, was to flee.
This ‘person’ is terrifying, immensely terrifying.
Boom! With the powerful eruption of the Dark Demon Air, thousands of kilometers of the sky were covered in rolling dark clouds, forming a section of the Dark Demon Realm.
At the center of the darkness, a Great Demon King standing fifteen hundred meters tall, with three heads and eight arms, was engulfed in fierce burning Black Flames, its aura swelling several times.
Faced with that intense threat of death, the Great Demon King instantly ignited its origin, transforming into a black streak of light penetrating heaven and earth, and instantly appearing hundreds of kilometers away.
But at that moment, a pitch-black, heavy War Halberd
Thud! Exceeding consciousness

chapters.title: Chapter 1401 - 1401 534 Half-step Supreme the Power of Rule
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1401: Chapter 534: Half-step Supreme, the Power of Rule Chapter 1401: Chapter 534: Half-step Supreme, the Power of Rule Boom!
With the fall of the Great Demon King and the dissipation of the law power he controlled, a dazzling blood-colored moon emerged high in the sky, only to plummet down afterward.
Below the Blood Moon, in the center of a black hole filled with violent chaotic streams, stood Jack Clark, one thousand meters tall, holding a halberd in one hand.
Behind him, his six arms supported a golden-white Great Sun, held a purple Thunder Spear, and nine overlapping layers of golden gates and black chains, a grey wheel, and a black stone gate.
With a golden World Halo spinning behind him, he looked like a supreme deity at the pinnacle of the firmament, emanating an aura that made the entire world tremble.
At that moment, Jack was quietly sensing the changes in power from his previous strike when he called up the attribute page with a thought.
Although the battle of civilizations had already erupted, before setting off to slay the mighties of the Purgatory Empire, he needed to carefully examine the detailed changes brought by this breakthrough.
Realm: Early-stage Heavenly King [Level: Eleven]
Heavenly Dragon Physique: 92 → 115 (17 points from feedback enhancement of the Emperor Dragon Form, 6 points from heavy metal element strengthening)
Heavenly Dragon Strength: 97 → 119
Heavenly Dragon Agility: 65 → 79
Divine Soul Spirit: 71 → 85
True Body of the Fighting Demon God: [After absorbing a top-tier ore vein’s heavy metal element matter, it transformed into an innate Demon God’s body as heavy as a celestial body.
Top-tier Divine Power: Vacuum Destruction, Absolute Force Field, Cross-World Divine Walk.
Common Divine Powers: Hidden Deity’s Eye, Peeping Void Eye.
Demon God Combat Techniques: World-Destroying Great Sun, Thunder God’s Spear, Wheel of Death, Soul Judgement
Special Power: Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate [Behind the gate lies a World-Destroying Dragon, ready to shatter the Heavenly Gate and enter the Fighting Demon God, Destruction Emperor Dragon Form]
Note: The ordinary human form can only exert 60% of the strength; only when the eight-arm form is manifested can all the divine powers be fully unleashed.]
Deification Talent: Soul Split, Void Double Pupils
Law Power: Supreme Strength [1%, a rudimentary rule nurtured with Law of Strength at its core, blending Void, Death, Soul, Flames, and Thunder—five higher-order laws.
Under the influence of Law Power, the inner Divine Strength is enhanced fifteen times on its base, exerting a greater suppression over the laws of heaven and earth.
Strength Amplification: Under the Supreme Strength Rules, all the original law powers are enhanced by fifteen times.
Note: Current rule origin is scant, please use with caution, as it may affect the fusion progress of the six major laws and the tempering progress of the Heavenly King True Body.]
Cultivation Method: Illusion Meditation Scripture [Sixth level 73%]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark [Limit Break]
Superior Divine Power: Time Reincarnation [+9, 5 in the Mid-Mythical Stage, 4 in the Late Mythical Stage]
Special Marks: Ancient Duel Mark, Hell’s Eye
Real World: Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder [Medium-sized world, true range of 5900 kilometers, abilities: Absolute Domain, World Wall]
Equipment: Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Heavy Halberd [Further strengthened by melting a large amount of heavy metal element matter and containing Opening the Heavens trait]
Demon God Heavy Star Battle Armor [Melted heavy metal element matter and Heavenly Tier Colossus Essence Blood, battle armor of law level merged with the body]
Attribute Points: 10,494
Soul Points: 3,570
Avatar Body: Sombre.Heaven.Destruction Emperor Dragon
Level: Titan Peak [Body length of 4235 meters, status: in Hibernation to break through to the Ancient Level]
Law: Strength.Destruction…
Evolution Value: 1,480,737/2,000,000 [Next evolution, Peak of the Ancient]
Jack’s gaze swept over all the changes in his attributes, finally resting on the Supreme Strength Law Power.
This breakthrough into the Heavenly King realm, due to the previous completion of the pathway’s melding process, had already allowed Jack’s understanding to reach the peak of the Heavenly King’s domain, so the overall changes weren’t very significant.
In terms of the true body, there was only an enhancement on the original basis, with only the change in law power being significant, as it had nurtured a nascent rule power with the Law of Strength at its core.
Next, Jack only needed to speed up the fusion of laws and temper his Heavenly King True Body. Once his true body is fully developed and the nascent rules fully evolved within, he will be able to break through to the Supreme Level.
This was the reward for all the effort he had put in earlier to recast the Demon God’s body.
The path from Heavenly King to Supreme was straightforward; he wouldn’t need to exhaust his mind to fully comprehend and perfect the laws and would soon be able to cross the path that Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others had spent decades laboring over.
The difference between laws and rules is that laws represent some natural force of heaven and earth, such as raging wind or flames.
Rules, on the other hand, involve a more conceptual, authoritarian force; a strong man who controls rules needs only a thought to forcibly reverse the positions of earth and sky.
The sky becomes a heavy solid from nothingness, and the earth floats above the firmament, light and insubstantial.
Of course, to achieve this requires an unspeakably terrifying might, practically redefining the foundations of the cosmos, akin to the act of Opening Heaven and Earth.
“`
So, in a sense, Jack Clark, who had already mastered the rudimentary power of rules, was no different from Left Demon, the Demon King at the peak who touched upon the rules.
The difference was that other Heavenly Kings and Demon Kings reached the pinnacle of their realms, rebuilding their paths before they could touch and nurture the rules.
Jack Clark, however, had completed this step as soon as he broke through to the Heavenly King realm, and during the breakthrough, he devoured and refined a copper mountain range, further enhancing his physical strength and the might of his weapons and Dark Red Armor.
Boom boom boom!!
As Jack Clark contemplated the changes from this breakthrough, the aura of various Demon Kings erupted within millions of kilometers in the Eternal Divine Domain, sending up dark demon clouds that shot into the sky.
One of the Demon Kings, at the peak of the Titan realm, distorted space at a terrifying speed and lunged toward the Heavenly Feather Legion tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Half an hour later, the thick dark demon air permeated the shattered heaven and earth, and the corpses of the large Silver Wing tribe littered the ground, all torn apart by some sharp force into hundreds or thousands of pieces.
Since they were not completely blown apart, these corpses spewed large quantities of blood, forming meandering blood rivers on the ground.
In the sky, that Demon King held the bodies of two Heavenly Feather Mythical Strong in his eight arms, each wrapped with black lightning, suppressing and grinding away the divine soul sources.
Meanwhile, another peak Demon King stood erect more than a hundred thousand kilometers from the Human Race.
This two-thousand-meter-tall Demon King with three heads and ten arms was covered in a set of thick Dark Red Armor, with blood-colored flames burning ferociously around him, spreading over a thousand kilometers.
The terrifying blood-colored flames distorted heaven and earth, turning the area into a dark red abyssal region, horrifying to behold.
At this moment, the peak Demon King’s gaze was icy as he looked in the direction of the Human Race, faintly sensing a hint of danger from there.
Cooper licked his lips with his three heads, his eyes revealing a ferocious cruelty, “To feel even a slight threat from you, it seems you are not weak and are worthy of dying by my hand.”
Boom!
In an instant, the peak Demon King surged with a sky full of blood-colored flames and flew rapidly towards the Human Race, blinking a thousand kilometers away.
Quickly, the peak Demon King appeared a thousand kilometers away from the Human Race legion, his expression slightly solemn as he looked forward.
There, the ground had shattered, forming a huge crater spanning two thousand kilometers, with massive cracks spreading all around like a shattered spiderweb covering ten thousand kilometers.
At the center of the crater stood an imposing black stone stele, beneath which a Demon King was suppressed.
However, at this moment the Demon King’s aura was weak, its true body nearly transparent from the eroding power of the stone stele, hanging by a thread before complete collapse.
The True Martial Heavenly King standing on the True Martial Stone Tablet looked up at the horizon ablaze with blood-colored flames and slowly spoke, “Another Demon King has come, has it.”
…
After spending a minute to review the changes in data, Jack Clark slowly exhaled, then put away the attribute page, his eyes revealing a pair of black gold vertical pupils.
Because he was ‘plane,’ Jack Clark’s terrifying vision spanned tens of thousands of kilometers, taking in the battles erupting in several areas.
One of the Demon Kings, three Demon Kings, and the army of more than a hundred thousand Purgatory True Demons caught his attention.
It would be you guys.
Swoosh!
Jack Clark’s figure flashed, turning into a black streak cutting through the sky, and with a few flickers, he appeared over four thousand kilometers away.
Under the Bound Crossing Divine Ability, Jack Clark’s speed had become terrifyingly fast, directly distorting space and blinking, covering tens of thousands of kilometers in a few breaths.
His speed was so fast that it far surpassed the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s flight at more than two hundred times the speed of sound in normal conditions.
Giant Beast Type Creatures with their massive size, unless they have a speed-related talent or the ability of speed-related laws, their large size will have a significant impact on their movement and soul.
After all, a colossus over a kilometer long is too heavy, and even though the Law Domains offset some of their own weight, they are still affected by gravity, a fundamental rule.
Facing the chaotic battlefield of the Civilization Battlefield, although his strength surged after his breakthrough, Jack Clark did not seek out Demon God Level beings to test himself but intended to keep a low profile.
His main targets were those Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings.
Compared to exchanging blows with hard-to-kill Demon Gods, it was more profitable to overpower and slaughter these Demon Kings.
If he could wipe out the Demon Kings or even the Great Demon Kings of the three major empires, even if the Heavenly Feather Clan perished in this battle, the pressure on the Human Race would be greatly reduced afterward.
If the war ended and he managed to return to the Human Race earlier, there was even a chance to take advantage of the timing and destroy the Mokeya and Dark Purgatory Empires.
Swoosh!
Jack Clark stopped in his tracks, appearing silently tens of thousands of meters in the air, his cold gaze falling on the battlefield below that spread over a thousand kilometers.
At that moment, the Demon King was clashing with another Heavenly Main God, and that Heavenly Main God was an acquaintance of Jack Clark, Bordea.
As a Main God in his late period, he was not at a disadvantage against a Demon King in his mid-period and three Demon Kings surrounding him, even suppressing them.
Hum!
Then, the arm holding the Purple Thunderclap Spear among Jack Clark’s six arms suddenly lifted high, emitting a dazzling light.
The invisible aura of destruction immediately alarmed the tens of thousands of Purgatory True Demons and Heavenly Feather soldiers below, causing a panic of dread, and they looked up instinctively.
This included the Demon King and the three Demon Kings who were engaged with Bordea.
Boom! A dazzling column of purple lightning fell from the sky, reaching from heaven to earth and illuminating the world with its light.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1402 - 1402 535 The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1402: Chapter 535: The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet, Gathering from All Directions Chapter 1402: Chapter 535: The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet, Gathering from All Directions Demon God Battle Skill, Thunder God’s Spear.
It appeared to be just a war spear condensed from the Power of Thunder, yet its might was incredibly terrifying. It was formed by the compression of Jack Clark’s internal twenty percent Origin of Purple Heaven Thunder combined with his divine power.
Upon release, it could burst forth with tenfold might and the ultimate destructive characteristic. Its sharp edge and power had surpassed the Heavenly King Level, rivaling the Supreme.
And with the speed of the Thunder Law that not even the Great Demon King could evade in time, the domain of Demon King Gilber, which engulfed tens of kilometers around him, shattered instantly under the column of purple light piercing through heaven and earth.
“Block it for me!”
The true body of the Great Demon King, towering at one thousand one hundred meters with three heads and eight arms, completely covered in dark red armor, roared towards the sky while rising with a spear in his arms, his body ablaze with roaring Black Flames.
Facing that sudden terrifying strike, Gilber instantly ignited fifty percent of his origin within his body, and his aura surged tenfold.
At the same time, the six arms behind him furiously extended, the demon patterns engraved on the arms releasing scarlet radiance as they ignited the origin, causing the six arms to explode into a sky full of blood mist.
Roar roar roar! The six exploding arms transformed into blood dragons, each thousands of meters long, their powerful aura wrapping around the black war halberd.
Boom!
Gilber’s aura surged once again, and this spear touched upon the pinnacle of the Great Demon King’s might. It was his most dazzling strike ever, only to be submerged by the column of Thunder Light.
Bang!
Under the destructive and fiery sharpness of the lightning, the blood dragons disintegrated, the war spear shattered, followed by the explosion of Gilber’s Great Demon King’s true body.
How is this possible!
At the instant his true body burst, still remotely sensing that early stage aura of the Great Demon King from the firmament above, Gilber’s divine soul let out an incredulous scream under the wash of the thunder column.
Boom! The thunder column that destroyed Gilber’s true body continued unabated, striking the earth below like a burst of fireworks, crackling and releasing countless bolts of lightning.
Those purple bolts of lightning meandered along the earth and sky, spreading out in all directions like a rapidly expanding spherical shock wave, resembling a three-dimensional net of lightning in an instant.
Passed over by these bolts of higher-order lightning, Purgatory True Demons turned instantly to ashes, not even having time to react.
However, not all Purgatory True Demons were annihilated.
Under the explosion of purple lightning, the three demon kings, who were not the primary targets, merely spat blood, their surroundings’ domains of Dark Laws and Abyssal Law crumbled.
“The enemy is too strong, flee!”
The three demon kings reacted immediately, their expressions greatly altered. Their bodies burned with dark red flames, transforming into three black fiery streams scattering into the sky.
The fact that Demon King Gilber’s true body was shattered by one strike and that his divine soul was becoming weaker under the scourge of the thunder column indicated just how terrifying the attacker was—beyond their ability to defend against.
“Stay behind.”
A deep and indifferent voice echoed between heaven and earth.
Above the heads of the demon kings, who had scattered hundreds of kilometers apart in an instant, space fractured, and down bore three thousand-meter-long Black Gold War Halberd’s radiance, collapsing the Void as they descended.
Upon each of those halberds, which seemed to appear instantly, were entwined black Soul Chains and gray currents, emitting a terrifying aura of despair for them.
“Your souls! Death!”
“No!”
Boom boom boom! The three demon kings’ true bodies exploded, and the space for hundreds of kilometers around them crumbled under that overbearing halberd.
And in the instant that the true bodies of the three demon kings were blown apart, Black Gold Halberd Radiance also exploded, releasing countless sharp lights that shredded their divine souls.
Most importantly, this halberd contained the force of higher-order laws.
Under the suppression of Soul Chains and the definition of the Death Law, the demon kings’ vigorous vitality and powerful divine souls were eroded bit by bit by Laws’ Origin.
In the face of absolute strength and realm suppression, the demon kings and Great Demon Kings, reputed to be undying and indestructible, could not withstand even one move from Jack Clark now.
They were slain with a single strike.
When the lightning in heaven and earth had dissipated, and the phantom of the Great Demon King’s Divine Soul faded within the column of lightning, four blood moons of varying sizes emerged in the intersection of heaven and earth and then slowly fell.
“Those Purgatory Demon Kings, they’re dead!!”
Both in the sky and on the ground, tens of thousands of elite soldiers of the Heavenly Feather Clan, along with Bordea, who had fought three demon kings and one Great Demon King with all his might, watched the falling blood moons above, somewhat dazed.
As the Main God, Bordea was momentarily stunned but quickly regained his composure, looking up into the high altitude tens of thousands of meters above, then exclaimed in shock.
“Divine Martial Throne, it’s you!”
Jack Clark, with his three faces and eight arms, looked down faintly at Bordea below, slightly parted his lips, and a deep, resonant voice echoed between the heaven and earth.
“Lord Bordea, long time no see.”
“Divine Martial Throne, you’ve broken through to the Realm of the Main God,” said Bordea as he took a deep breath to suppress the shock in his heart.
Although aware that Jack Clark’s terrifying combat power would reach an extremely exaggerated level once he broke through to the Main God-level, this was all too horrifying.
How strong are the Mythical-level demon kings? Certainly strong.
For those Heavenly Feather soldiers in the Transcendence Realm, they are unstoppable, and even for Bordea, who was in the late period of the Main God level, killing one demon king would require a bit of time.
The trickiest part was that demon kings were difficult to kill; it required the consumption of the Laws’ Origin to wear down the opponent’s Divine Soul Intent and the Origin of Vitality.
And that bit of time would be enough for nearby demon kings and Great Demon Kings to come to the aid. Hence, throughout the hundreds of years of warfare, the three major empires had not lost more than sixty demon kings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1403 - 1403 535 The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1403: Chapter 535: The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet, Gathering from All Directions_2 Chapter 1403: Chapter 535: The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet, Gathering from All Directions_2 Not to mention the even harder to kill Great Demon King.
However, now was not the time to chat, so Jack Clark gave Boris a slight nod, “The current chaos works to our advantage. There’s no time to lose, we’ll talk later.”
After speaking, golden flames erupted beneath Jack’s feet like a lotus, and in an instant, he disappeared, leaving behind trails of black marks in the air that had yet to dissipate after the Purple Heaven Thunder flashed by.
As Jack vanished, the invisible, oppressive weight that had been suffocating the atmosphere also dissipated, and tens of thousands of elite Heavenly Feather soldiers unconsciously breathed a sigh of relief.
Atop a collapsed mountain peak, a Heavenly Feather strongman emanating the aura of the Ninth Heavens exclaimed in shock, “That Human Race’s Divine Martial Throne, no, he should now be called the Divine Martial Sky King, is incredibly powerful.”
“He truly deserves to be the one who slew seventeen demon kings and two Great Demon Kings in the previous battle.”
As the strongman marveled, a young man with a luxurious crown and a golden feather pattern between his brows chuckled bitterly, “Uncle Tassu, you can’t even begin to imagine how exaggerated this Divine Martial Sky King is.”
Augubas exclaimed in awe, “You all can’t imagine, this Divine Martial Sky King only took a little over a dozen Sun Wheels to advance from Transcendent First Tier to Main God-level cultivation.”
“Over a dozen Sun Wheels!?”
The thousands of high-ranking Heavenly Feather powerhouses around him all widened their eyes in disbelief. That’s ridiculous, advancing from Transcendent First Tier to Main God-level in just over a dozen Sun Wheels, slaughtering Great Demon Kings like slaughtering dogs.
As these individuals stood shocked, the majestic voice of Boris rang throughout the universe.
“All ‘Persons’ assemble, march toward the southeast with the Divine Temple as our center.”
“Yes.”
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!!
One after another, figures with wings of light fluttered toward the Main God Palace, gathering into a legion of over a hundred thousand, flying off into the distance. Meanwhile, the legend of Jack Clark slowly began to spread within the Heavenly Feather Legion.
The most monstrous Unparalleled Genius of the Human Race, who advanced from Transcendent First Tier to Main God-level in just twelve Sun Wheels.
It is said that he once slain several Purgatory Demon Kings during his early Ninth Tier and, immediately after breaking through to the Legendary Realm, stormed into the rear of the Purgatory Empire and slaughtered more than a dozen Great Demon Kings.
Moreover, he had emerged unscathed from the siege of two Demon Gods, with a combat strength defying the heavens.
This man had a talent unparalleled throughout history, with none to follow after him. It was rumored that the Divine King of Light intended to forge a marital alliance with the Human Race, matchmaking him with Princess Anstice…
…
Bang!
Under a hand covered in black scales, the head of a Heavenly Feather woman with two pairs of white wings exploded, her corpse falling to the ground, spurting out hot silver blood.
By now, the corpses of the Heavenly Feather Clan had piled up into small hills, with tens of thousands of bodies, the flowing silver and gold blood nearly converging into small rivers, emitting a strong scent of blood.
All these Heavenly Feather Clan members had their heads crushed by a powerful force, a terrifying sight.
Atop the mountain of corpses stood a throne, hundreds of meters tall, wrought from unknown black metal and adorned with various ornate patterns.
Seated on the throne was a towering and muscular Purgatory Great Demon King, who in his normal form stood a hundred meters tall.
This Great Demon King exuded a terrifying presence, covered in black-red scaled armor, with three pairs of red demon horns on his head, and a face that showed a faint disappointment.
“These Heavenly Feather Clansmen are all thick-headed. Is kneeling before this king’s throne really so difficult?”
As he spoke, the Great Demon King looked up slightly to the front, where four Purgatory True Demons, each exuding the aura of Nine Demonic Marks, stood respectfully, holding two Heavenly Feather women soldiers in silver armor.
The Great Demon King reached out, and one of the 2-meter tall, beautiful Heavenly Feather women screamed as she was grasped in his hand.
In comparison to the enormous hand of the Great Demon King, the 2-meter tall Heavenly Feather woman was like a little mouse, not to mention the difference in power between the two.
However, the Great Demon King didn’t kill her but said in an unusually gentle voice, “Don’t be afraid, I will not kill you. I am Prince Hamdanman of the Belvetan Empire.”
“Now, you have a tremendous opportunity. If you willingly submit and become a flute-playing maiden under my throne, I will bestow upon you the Blood of Demon God to transform your bloodline.”
“Then, you will not only avoid extinction with the Heavenly Feather Clan, but you will also become a powerful Purgatory True Demon.”
“How does that sound? Isn’t the future bright?”
The Heavenly Feather woman held in his hand glared with intense hatred, “Despicable Purgatory Evil Demon, thinking to make us, the proud members of the Heavenly Feather Clan, submit is a pipe dream.”
“Not even you, a Great Demon King, nor even the Imperial Demon God himself, could make me, Kavadola, submit and become a flute-playing maiden.”
As she spoke, disgust filled the eyes of the woman and she glanced down at the base of the Great Demon King.
“You refuse to submit?” Hamdanman sighed with a hint of pity, and then his thumb flicked slightly.
Bang! In an instant, the head of the Heavenly Feather woman in his palm exploded.
After casually discarding the Heavenly Feather clan’s corpse on the ground, Hamdanman looked toward the last Heavenly Feather woman and asked in a gentle voice, “Then, are you willing to become a flute-playing maiden beneath my throne?”
The captive Heavenly Feather woman shouted angrily, “Despicable Purgatory Evil Demon, you will not disgrace us. Even if you kill all the ‘Persons’, no one will submit to you.”
“One day, the great Divine Master of Light will slay you demons and avenge us.”
The towering Great Demon King sighed softly, “Is that so, what a shame.”
Bang!
In an instant, the head of the last Heavenly Feather Clan member exploded, splattering countless droplets of blood on the Purgatory True Demons on either side, staining half of their bodies silver in a gory spectacle.

﻿Chapter 1404: Chapter 535: The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet, Convergence from Eight Directions_3 Chapter 1404: Chapter 535: The Flute-Playing Maiden at His Feet, Convergence from Eight Directions_3 “After slaughtering all the members of the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan, Prince Hamdanman sat on his throne with some annoyance, ‘Are these guys idiots, or have they all gone completely mad? Don’t they know that it’s better to live a bad life than have a good death?'”
“Alive, there is hope, but dead, there’s nothing left.”
“Even if they desire revenge and wish to annihilate all the Purgatory True Demons, they must first survive.”
As he said this, the Great Demon King shook his head as if lamenting his subordinates’ inability to understand.
All of a sudden, the thousands of Purgatory True Demons, who were standing respectfully around the throne, revealed wry smiles on their faces.
Hey, great Prince Hamdanman, aren’t you the beloved prince of the Belvetan Empire? Don’t you think there was something off about what you just said?
Just then, a Mythical Breath appeared in the sky, followed by the rolling Dark Demon Cloud, quickly appearing overhead.
Immediately afterward, a Purgatory Demon King over 500 meters tall descended from the sky, looking at Prince Hamdanman high upon his throne and bowing respectfully.
“Greetings, Lord Hamdanman.”
After some thought, Hamdanman said, “You are…the demon king from the Freymand Empire—Gulaire, if I recall correctly. I have some impression of you.”
“Yes, Prince Hamdanman, I am here by His Majesty’s orders to gather two Main Battle Legions and two Vassal Legions in the vicinity.”
“Never expected to meet Your Highness here. Following the orders of the higher-ups, I and the four legions will all be following your lead from now on.”
“Very well, move to the back,” Hamdanman said with a casual nod of his head.
At the foot of the mountain behind him, hundreds of thousands of the Purgatory Legion had already gathered, while a demon king stood quietly behind the throne, watching Gulaire.
Although the shattering of the nineteenth planar Boundary caught Tyris and the other Demon Gods by surprise, they reacted immediately.
Leveraging Abyssal rules already corroded by almost half from between heaven and earth, they sent orders to all demon kings to gather their legions to avoid being defeated one by one.
At the same time, it was ordered to move closer to the Demon King Marshals nearby and encircle the Heavenly Feather Clan’s army, allowing them no respite.
As the demon king had just finished regrouping and Hamdanman, who sat high on his throne, appeared lazily contemplative, considering whether to lead a group away to capture some women from the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Buzz!
A vibration emanated from Hamdanman’s chest, where a 1-meter diameter black mirror set into the armor trembled; then, a cold and authoritative voice rang out from within.
“Hamdanman, 370,000 kilometers to your left, Rayne and the others have encountered a Human Expedition Legion and are engaged in battle. You must go to their aid immediately.”
“Be cautious. That Human Legion is very strong. Just half an hour ago, Modimus and four Demon Kings fell there.”
Immediately, a serious look crossed Hamdanman’s face, and he sat up straight, “Modimus has actually fallen, there must be ‘Demon God’ powerhouses in the Human Legion!”
Modimus was a Great Demon King of the Belvetan Empire, in the mid-period of his strength, together with four Demon Kings.
To eliminate them quickly without allowing them any chance to inflict heavy injuries in a last stand and escape, was a challenge even for Hamdanman.
The mirror on Hamdanman’s chest vibrated again, “There are no Demon God Level Powerhouses, but there is a human among that legion who is very strong, no less strong than you.”
“A powerhouse comparable to an Extreme Realm Expert at the peak of being a Great Demon King!” A strong Battle Intent appeared in Hamdanman’s eyes.
Hamdanman had heard upon arriving at the frontline that this Heavenly Feather battlefield had seen an unexpected twist: a Human Race from a distant area of civilization sent a Legion to aid.
And the so-called Extreme Realm Expert at the peak of being a Great Demon King referred to those at the pinnacle of the Great Demon King realm, but with the fighting power comparable to the early stages of a Demon God.
“Be careful. That human is not weak. After you arrive, try to entangle him. I have already notified Cortes (Left Demon), Patreles, and others to assemble.”
“A mere human dares meddle in the Civilization War between my empire and the Heavenly Feather tribe, seeking death.”
“Not only must we annihilate the Heavenly Feather Clan this time, but we will also not let a single one from that Human Legion escape, to let them understand the consequences of incurring our wrath.”
As the cold voice faded away and the Will of the Demon God that had descended left, the black demon mirror slowly settled down.
Hamdanman looked toward the left and pondered for a moment. Then he said indifferently, “The whole army, march at full speed and go to the aid of Rayne and the others.”
“Yes.”
Thousands of Purgatory True Demons bowed respectfully around them, followed by two hundred-meter-tall teams of War Demons emerging, each holding a sign hundreds of meters high.
Written on them in Infernal script were the eight words, “By Prince’s wish, all beings make way.”
Next, four colossal Black Trolls, each eight hundred meters tall, slowly stepped forward, reaching their arms down into the underground to grasp the thick mountain pillars as their Power Explosion erupted.
Boom! The earth shattered and a massive palanquin, over a thousand meters long and five hundred meters wide with a throne in the middle where Hamdanman sat, emerged.
As the four mountainous black trolls lifted the throne, two teams of beautiful Purgatory True Demon beauties flew out from the procession behind and sprinkled white petals ahead.
Shortly thereafter, the majestic booming of DJ music shook the air, as two Purgatory True Demons carrying gigantic “speakers” tens of meters tall appeared on either side of the throne.
At the front of the procession, a shrill voice from a Purgatory True Demon called out, “The Prince surveys the heavens, all beings kneel—lift the palanquin!”
Instantly, the earth trembled and mountains quaked as the four massive trolls shouldered the throne and took large strides forward, each step causing an uproar as if mountains and seas were shaking.
In the forefront, War Demons held banners, ‘Goddesses’ scattered flowers on both sides, accompanied by the thunderous sounds of the DJ’s music vibrating heaven and earth; the lengthy following procession was a sight of grandeur and splendor.
This scene made the two Demon Kings’ eyes pop with astonishment.
Noticing the surprise on the faces of the two Demon Kings, Hamdanman revealed a faintly smug expression, “What do you think, isn’t my traveling entourage impressive?”
One of the Demon Kings hesitated, “This… Your Highness, your entourage is indeed unexpected.”
Hamdanman said proudly, “The soul of this entourage is those two speakers; they are artifacts that came from the Human Race.”
“Some time ago, the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire sent messengers to request an audience with His Majesty and also brought me some gifts, among which were these.”
“According to those messengers from the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, the Human Race, though not very powerful, has an extremely flourishing civilization, which has piqued my interest.”
“Therefore, I’ve been considering suggesting to His Majesty after annihilating the Heavenly Feather Clan that we join the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire’s expedition to conquer this civilization.”
“I did not expect that before we could even get there, those humans would actually come knocking on our door.”
“What a pity that this time it was one of their Human Experts and not the Human Expedition Legion; otherwise, we might have been able to take some human women as wind instrument maidens for beneath my throne.”
Upon hearing this, the corner of the Demon King’s eye twitched, unsure why the Imperial Prince was so fixated on wind instrument maidens.
Meanwhile, in a distant direction, a titanic figure clad in dark gold scale armor stood ten thousand meters tall, with a black-haired girl shouldering four swords on his shoulder.
