﻿Chapter 1405: Chapter 536: Jack Clark Returns, Mysterious Martial Giant Beast Chapter 1405: Chapter 536: Jack Clark Returns, Mysterious Martial Giant Beast Above the altitude of one hundred thousand meters, thirteen sky-based battleships, each more than ten kilometers in length, were aligned horizontally, their three main cannons and forty-nine secondary cannons all radiating intense heat.
On the decks and inside the battleships, numerous staff members and engineering mechas were busy at work, loading ammunition and replacing energy crystal blocks, preparing for the next great battle.
Below, within a thousand-kilometer radius, the Earth was shattered, mountain peaks collapsed, and the land was strewn with the massive corpses of demonized beasts and remnants of the Purgatory Demon Race, as well as densely packed explosion craters.
Amidst these corpses of the Purgatory Demon Race were scattered fragments of unmanned close-combat mechas, the scene was extremely tragic.
True Martial Heavenly King stood above, feet hovering in the void, hands supporting a black True Martial stele, an imposing expression on his face, radiating an aura capable of suppressing the heavens.
Yet, when looking at the soldiers down below who were cleaning the battlefield and gathering usable resources, a hint of deep contemplation appeared in the eyes of True Martial Heavenly King.
At this moment, two powerful auras swiftly approached from afar. Soon, the figures of Mysterious Martial Sky King and Sky King Denny Kaye appeared, having pursued two heavily injured demon kings attempting to flee.
Both bore somber expressions. Mysterious Martial Sky King spoke in a grave voice, “Although those Demon Gods are currently entangled by the Divine King of Light, they must have other means to control the overall situation.”
“In just a short while, those scattered members of the Purgatory Demon Race have regrouped into large army formations. If this continues, it will be very disadvantageous for us.”
True Martial Heavenly King nodded seriously, “The situation here has already collapsed, we must retreat immediately.”
Originally, according to the initial plan and relying on the remaining nine planes, the deployment of war bases was such that, even with the combined efforts of the Human Race and Heavenly Feather Clan, there was still a chance for battle.
Under the ‘map’ constraints of those planes, the numerical advantage of the Purgatory Family could not be maximized.
Therefore, even if the Heavenly Feather Clan could not change the outcome of annihilation, they could still inflict significant damage on the three major empires, at least annihilating tens of millions of elites and a large number of demon kings.
But now, with the overlap of planes expanding into a vast world over two million kilometers in diameter, this had inadvertently aided the three major empires.
A divine realm range of over two million kilometers is almost larger than the sun itself, equivalent to more than ten thousand times the area of Blue Star—note, this refers to area, not volume.
Such a vast area and range, after a brief period of chaos, with those demon kings and Great Demon Kings starting to gather the Purgatory Legion, the situation suddenly became severe.
For example, the scale of the Purgatory Legion encountered by the human side just now reached nearly two million in number, commanded by one Great Demon King and three demon kings.
Despite the overwhelming strength of superior forces, especially with Number One dominating the battlefield and slaughtering, it only took a little over an hour to end the battle, annihilating all the Purgatory demons.
But by the same token, if the Human Race were surrounded by more Purgatory Legions and True Martial Heavenly King was restrained by a Demon God Level Powerhouse, the humans would face the same fate.
“Notify everyone, once all the wounded are treated, we will depart immediately, and start the retreat according to the coordinates given by the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
As True Martial Heavenly King issued the order, the atmosphere on the battlefield became tense all at once, figures flashed across the ground and then flew towards the battleships above.
At that moment, a bolt of lightning streaked across the low sky, and Damon Lopes appeared in front of a black-red colored mech hovering over seven hundred meters high, shouting, “Junior Louise, we’ve received orders from above to prepare for retreat.”
Click!!
Number One slowly raised its head, its eyes emitting a blue-white radiance, calmly observing Damon Lopes, making him feel somewhat uneasy, as if he were being targeted by a natural predator.
Fortunately, at this time, Number One was not in a rampage state, maintaining regular combat status. After a pause, it slightly nodded.
Just then, another powerful aura quickly approached, and even from a distance of over ten thousand kilometers, the invisible and heavy oppressive force surprised even True Martial Heavenly King.
However, the aura was very familiar to everyone, especially Number One on the ground, who abruptly looked up.
With Divine Powers that could traverse over a thousand kilometers in a single step, Jack Clark soon appeared on the horizon, a kilometer-tall figure surrounded by golden flames and purple thunder light.
With three heads and eight arms, brandishing an overbearing black-gold battle halberd, with a golden World Halo slowly rotating behind him, he resembled an ancient War God descending from the past.
Suddenly, countless super soldiers on the battleships revealed looks of surprise.
“It’s the Divine King Throne!”
“No, that’s not right, he should now be called the Divine Martial Sky King. General Jack has already broken through to Heavenly King.”
“Divine Martial Heavenly King has returned.”
The return of Jack invigorated everyone’s spirits. Before breaking through to Heavenly King, his strength already effortlessly overpowered Great Demon Kings and unquestionably slaughtered Mythical Demon Kings like slaughtering dogs.
Now, having broken through to Heavenly King, with his consistently exaggerated combat power, he was surely capable of directly confronting Demon Gods.
Furthermore, together with the True Martial Heavenly King who held the True Martial Divine Tablet, the Human Race Expeditionary Army possessed two Supreme combat forces. They would not even fear an ambush by an army led by a Demon God.
Of course, this was on the premise that they were facing only one Demon God.
“A Heavenly King, huh.” As they watched Jack approach through the air, True Martial Heavenly King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and Mysterious Martial Sky King all showed expressions of relief and pride.
Ever since Jack swept through the Southern Battlefield and joined the plan to encircle the Evil God Clone, the three of them had taken note of this genius of the new generation.
However, at that time, only Denny Kaye and Mysterious Martial Sky King had met Jack in advance, due to Mathilda Ward’s period of hibernation and a prior return to Blue Star.
What made the three even more gratified was that Jack’s talent was not only stronger than that of Jonathan Walker from years past, but he also possessed more loyalty, proceeding honorably and domineeringly throughout his journey.
“Cough! Seniors, could you please not look at me with that expression?” Jack arrived, stepping through the air, and coughed dryly, his skin crawling under the gaze of True Martial Heavenly King and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 1406 - 1406 536 Jack Clark Returns Mysterious
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1406: Chapter 536 Jack Clark Returns, Mysterious Martial Giant Beast_2 Chapter 1406: Chapter 536 Jack Clark Returns, Mysterious Martial Giant Beast_2 The Mysterious Martial Sky King appeared beside Jack Clark, slapping his shoulder robustly as he burst into laughter, “Hahaha… well done, you’ve broken through to the Heavenly King realm so smoothly.”
At this moment, the Mysterious Martial Sky King was in his ordinary human form. Standing at 1.9 meters tall next to the kilometer-high Jack Clark, he looked almost like an ant in comparison, which created a somewhat comical scene.
The True Martial Heavenly King said solemnly, “Jack, your return is timely, as the situation has changed. We are preparing to head to the evacuation point next. We can talk about anything else on the way.”
“Okay,” Jack nodded.
Soon, the thirteen sky-based battleships formed three rows, left and right, with the leading No. 5 flagship at the forefront, flying toward the evacuation point over eighty thousand kilometers away.
However, because the fleet might encounter the Purgatory Legion at any time, they did not enter a state of over-limit flight but instead traveled at a maximum of fifteen times the speed of sound.
This was a downside of moving with a large force: while there was strength in numbers, it also meant limited mobility.
Even for Mythical Kings, Heavenly Kings, and even the Supreme Level powerhouse True Martial Heavenly King, these Transcendent soldiers weren’t of much use anymore.
If all of them died, it wouldn’t affect the True Martial Heavenly Kings much.
But since this legion had followed them on the expedition, they had a responsibility for the lives of these men, striving to bring them back alive.
This was the duty of a general.
Jack shared this sentiment, so after slaying nine demon kings and two Great Demon Kings, he gave up on the idea of continuing the slaughter and chose to reunite with the main force.
Aboard the fleet, led by the True Martial Heavenly King and including Jack and the Morning King among other king-level powers, they held a temporary meeting to prepare for all possible upcoming scenarios.
They also learned of the events that had taken place in the Number Ten Plane.
Jane Aiken baited the Left Demon into a trap, and Jonathan Walker emerged to battle it. Both sides unleashed a strength comparable to that of an ordinary Demon God.
Yet, the subsequent developments took Jack by surprise,
particularly the death of Jane Aiken’s mother, which seemed to be surrounded by other hidden matters.
After the meeting concluded, Jack went to the left-leading No. 1 Battlefleet. Just as he regained his human form and appeared on the deck, the soldiers on guard saluted excitedly.
“Your Highness, the throne,” they greeted.
Although the power gap between a king-level and a Heavenly King was a Major Realm, within the Federation, the title for both was the same, “Your Highness, the throne,” rather than “Main God” of the Heavenly Feather Clan or “Purgatory Prince.”
“No need to be formal,” Jack nodded slightly, then in an instant, flashed onto the shoulder of No. 1 machine, several kilometers away.
The giant head of No. 1 machine turned slightly to look at Jack, and Freya’s voice came through with a hint of a smile, “Congratulations on the breakthrough, Heavenly King.”
“It was alright,” Jack smiled.
Throughout his journey until now, it was only in front of friends like Freya that Jack could feel a bit more relaxed.
“By the way, Freya, where is Damon?” Jack probed the No. 1 Battleship and was surprised not to sense Damon’s presence.
Freya’s voice emerged from within No. 1 machine, “We encountered a Purgatory Legion in a previous plane convergence, which led to a major battle. Damon was the quickest to charge in.”
“Then he came across a particularly strong True Demon Noble whose realm had reached the Nine-fold Peak. Although Damon eventually killed the opponent, he was gravely injured, even to the core, and is now recuperating on the No. 7 Battleship.”
“That’s pretty bad,” Jack was taken aback.
With Damon’s strength and the speed of his Thunder Rule, as long as he was cautious, he should have been able to dominate the front lines without encountering a powerful demon king.
But unexpectedly, he ended up heavily injured as soon as the major battle erupted.
Shaking his head at the thought, Jack’s gaze suddenly hardened.
At that moment, the fleet entered a region where the Earth was charred and the sky darkened, with a faint Dark Demon Air permeating and obscuring the silver moonlight.
This was a plane region contaminated by the Purgatory Empire. Upon entering, Jack felt as if there was a gaze ‘watching them’ somewhere in the depths.
Hum!
Black Gold vertical pupils emerged in Jack’s eyes, sweeping a terrifying gaze across all directions. He immediately spotted the Purgatory Legion waiting in formation thirty thousand kilometers ahead.
The number of Purgatory Legion exceeded three million, with rolling demon gas blotting out the sky.
The leading Great Demon King, enveloped by black Dark Demon Air with three heads and ten arms and towering two thousand meters tall, even made Jack feel a hint of danger.
Additionally, another Purgatory Legion exceeding two million in numbers was rapidly approaching from the fleet’s left side, over fifty thousand kilometers away, with its Dark Demon Air enveloping thousands of kilometers.
Beyond that, a Terrifying Aura was fast approaching from the rear right of the fleet.
The World-Destroying Demon King with its ten-thousand-meter tall Black Gold body, and its invisible Killing Intent, almost turned heaven and earth a dark red. Wherever it passed, mountains crumbled and the Earth cracked, creating a startling momentum.
“Stop!”
Right as Jack sensed something was wrong, the True Martial Heavenly King’s voice also suddenly rang out, indicating that not just Jack, but they too had powerful sensing methods.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! Jack, the True Martial Heavenly King, the Mysterious Martial Sky King, and Sky King Denny Kaye appeared above the fleet.
The True Martial Heavenly King’s expression was stern, “We’ve been targeted. Three Purgatory Legions are converging on us from three directions. We must break through quickly.”
“Otherwise, once entangled, it would draw in even more legions and demon kings, Great Demon Kings.”
Jack looked towards the rear right, his gaze on the towering World-Destroying Demon King, and said slowly, “True Martial Senior, leave the Left Demon to me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1407 - 1407 536 Jack Clark Returns Mysterious
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1407: Chapter 536 Jack Clark Returns, Mysterious Martial Giant Beast_3 Chapter 1407: Chapter 536 Jack Clark Returns, Mysterious Martial Giant Beast_3 Jack Clark always had an odd feeling about ‘Jonathan Walker’.
When he first exchanged for the Dragon Elephant Overbearing Body Method and heard about the legend of his one year in the Ninth Heavens, Jack inexplicably felt that a battle between them was fated.
That is also why, when Jane Aiken had approached him earlier to reveal past secrets, he didn’t reject her offer to help.
Just because he missed the battle between Jonathan’s human form and his Purgatory Demon form due to his closed-door breakthrough, Jack hadn’t expected to encounter him here again.
Truthfully, Jack only believed a fraction of what Jonathan and Jane had said.
But as the Emperor Dragon Giant Beast began its breakthrough from ancient times and his true body advanced to the Heavenly King stage, all of that didn’t matter to Jack—who was set on shattering any of Jonathan’s plans.
However, to Jack’s request, the True Martial Heavenly King shook his head, “The matter with Left Demon is for me to handle; the situation is a bit complicated there, and I have some issues to confirm with him when the opportunity arises.”
“Jack, I’ll leave that army on the left to you. Don’t hold back, crush them with full strength, then join with Mysterious Martial and the others to tear through the army at the front,” the True Martial Heavenly King said before pausing, “Also, be cautious of Jonathan Walker lurking in the shadows, he is too secretive to be trusted.”
“…I understand,” Jack paused.
“Begin the attack!”
Boom!
With a long howl from the True Martial Heavenly King, an immense power comparable to the Supreme burst out, radiating terrifying aura, with black divine light shining as he transformed into a colossal figure towering ten thousand meters high, ascending into the sky.
In his true form, the True Martial Stone Tablet in the True Martial Heavenly King’s hand also grew massively, becoming an eternal stele spanning the heaven and earth, hurtling towards Left Demon who appeared twenty thousand kilometers away.
The terrifying power caused space-time to shatter, creating a vast black hole, its power far surpassing that of an ordinary Demon God.
“The fleet, full speed ahead; war pattern legion, deploy,” commanded the Mysterious Martial Sky King in sync with the True Martial Heavenly King’s move, unleashing an aura as heavy as the vast earth.
Roar!
An ancient and desolate roar echoed through heaven and earth as a Mysterious Martial the size of several kilometers, resembling an actual being, materialized in the void with substantial Mysterious Yellow aire recycling around it, forming a semblance of a great land.
Boom!
The world shuddered instantly as the invisible yellow light permeated, making the space around the fleet turn dense.
Simultaneously, countless war patterns on the surfaces of thirteen battleships lit up, coupled with unmanned mechs on the deck already in place, emitting circles of purple halos that fused together.
Soon, a purple halo with a thousand kilometers in diameter appeared, augmenting the gigantic Mysterious Martial.
The Mysterious Martial, which seemed as if it had descended from ancient times, roared once more, its body swelled to ten thousand meters in size with its aura becoming utterly terrifying.
Under the augmentation of the Sky Base Fleet and the million-strong war pattern legion, the late-stage Heavenly King Mysterious Martial’s presence surged dramatically, almost crossing the limits of a Heavenly King.
And this was precisely why Jack and the Federation had placed such importance on the propagation of war patterns back then.
Witnessing this scene, Sky King Denny Kaye smiled lightly, “So, Jack, do you now understand why his title is Mysterious Martial? His true martial arts phantom is that of a turtle.”
“Indeed, that’s rather unexpected,” Jack nodded.
“I’ll set off as well; be careful on your end. Those Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings are not like ordinary Great Demon Kings—they wield Pseudo-World Level weapons and are very powerful.”
As he spoke, a black halo emerged behind Sky King Denny Kaye, resembling a pathway that linked to a nether world, where over a hundred one-kilometer-tall ferocious mechs faintly appeared.
War patterns covered these mechs as well, but they were somewhat different from those Jack had provided to the Federation, seeming even more bizarre and cold, as if fused with something else.
Perhaps, after acquiring the war patterns, Sky King Denny Kaye had remade these mechs, incorporating the war patterns into them.
“Senior Kaye, take care as well,” said Jack as he glanced at the Mysterious Martial ‘Giant Beast’ in the sky, then with a flash, he appeared a thousand kilometers away.
Boom!
Jack unleashed an earth-shaking heavy aura, with streaks of purple lightning erupting and golden flames burning, forming a golden sea of fire over thousands of kilometers wide.
The blazing sea of fire, like a round sun, shone brilliantly, illuminating the heavens and the earth, and also vaporizing the surrounding dark mists.
In the center of the sea of fire, Jack’s form rapidly expanded, once again displaying his three-faced, eight-armed True Demon God Body, with the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd that was two thousand meters long appearing in his hands.
Boom!
The void quaked at that instant, the space around him collapsed under pressure, as if what Jack held was not a two-kilometer-long halberd, but a compressed mountain range stretching for thousands of miles.
But, as Jack crossed over thirty thousand kilometers and drew near the rolling Dark Demon Clouds racing towards him, even he couldn’t help but pause.
The team holding up the plaques signifying the prince’s arrival that made all living beings move aside, the witches scattering white petals across the sky on both sides, and those carrying the
meter-tall black ferocious mechs.
War patterns were also spread across these mechs, just like the ones on the mechs provided to the Federation, only these patterns were more eerie and cold, seemingly infused with something else.
Or perhaps, after the propagation of the war patterns, Sky King Denny Kaye had reforged these mechs, adding the war patterns to them.
“Senior Kaye, take care as well,” Jack said, looking up at the Mysterious Martial ‘Giant Beast’ looming in the sky before suddenly appearing a thousand kilometers away.
Boom!
Jack’s presence burst forth, shaking heaven and earth, with lines of purple lightning sparking and golden flames blazing, creating a golden sea of fire that enveloped thousands of kilometers.
The fiery sea, like a bright sun, emitted blinding radiance that lit up the world, also turning the enveloping dark mist into vapor.
In the center of the sea of fire, Jack’s figure swelled rapidly, again displaying his three-faced, eight-armed True Demon God Body, with his two-kilometer-long Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd appearing in his hands.
Boom!
In an instant, the void thundered down, and the surrounding space burst under the pressure as if what Jack was holding wasn’t a two-kilometer-long War Halberd but a mountain range stretched for miles on end.
Yet, as Jack crossed over thirty thousand kilometers to approach the swiftly incoming rolling Dark Demon Clouds, even he could not avoid a pause.
Witnessing the procession bearing plaques that signify the prince’s arrival and compel all beings to make way, witches in flight scattering white petals across the heavens, accompanied by those carrying

chapters.title: Chapter 1408 - 1408 537 Dark Star Apocalypse Form
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1408: Chapter 537 Dark Star Apocalypse Form, Reincarnation Combined into One Invincible Chapter 1408: Chapter 537 Dark Star Apocalypse Form, Reincarnation Combined into One Invincible “Human, I shall kill you.”
Jack Clark’s sudden move caught Hamdanman off guard.
As a Great Demon King who yearned for the flourishing civilization of humans, upon seeing Jack Clark from afar, Hamdanman initially didn’t have a strong intent to kill; instead, he was preparing to exchange pleasantries.
Of course, it was mainly to discuss his Honor Guard.
Little did he expect that Jack Clark would dare to make a move against the two million-plus Purgatory Legion and the six gathered demon kings, including two Great Demon Kings.
Boom!
In the instant that a heaven-shattering and earth-obliterating War Halberd blow turned the Honor Guard into a blood fog, a pitch-black radiance burst out like a black hole, expanding rapidly into an abyssal dark world.
Within that endless darkness of the abyss world, a massive yet somewhat broken Black Battle Axe emerged from the abyss, ‘slowly’ meeting the War Halberd that streaked across the sky.
“Be careful, all legions raise the Demon Pillars and defend with full strength.”
Witnessing the War Halberd whose mere invisible aura from hundreds of kilometers away sent shivers down its spine, along with the Black Battle Axe that soared into the sky, the face of the Great Demon King leading the legion changed drastically.
In that moment, not only that Great Demon King, but also the two million Purgatory True Demons and the demonized alien race all felt a profound fear that penetrated their hearts emanating from that heaven and earth-destroying War Halberd.
Boom!
The War Halberd, entwined with a wisp of Supreme Rule, clashed with the Black Battle Axe, causing a ten-thousand-kilometer expanse of heaven and earth to shake violently, and all ‘persons’ recoiled.
Immediately after, space shattered like glass, all things ceased to exist, and a pure destructive black shockwave exploded in all directions, spreading out.
The Purgatory Legion, a thousand kilometers away, bore the brunt of it.
Over two million members of the Purgatory Demon Race were divided into more than thirty legions, each ‘person’s strength unified under a high-order True Demon to form a Demon Pillar several hundred meters thick.
These Demon God Pillars were one of the core strengths of The Purgatory Family, derived from inherited Secret Skills with various Terrifying Powers.
For example, ripping open space to transport demon kings or forming legion Combat Techniques, concentrating all demons’ strength for attack, Defense, long-range bombardment, and so on.
At that time, more than thirty legion Demon God Pillars united, and under the control of the Great Demon King, they unleashed Terrifying Power, forming a sky-covering, ten-thousand-meter-thick demon gas shield in front.
Thud, thud, thud!!
Under the aftermath of the clash between two beings comparable to Demon Gods, the Demon God Pillars shattered, the thick dark shield instantly exploded, and tens of thousands of Purgatory True Demons dissipated.
As if those Purgatory True Demons had never existed at all.
However, thanks to the resistance of those Demon God Pillars and the buffering of the dark shield, the shockwave dissipated only after scattering the collected dark demon air of the Purgatory Great Formation.
The mere aftermath of their encounter was so terrifying that the Great Demon King and several demon kings all showed horror on their faces as they looked into the distance.
There, atop a thousand-kilometer-wide crater, stood a Great Demon King towering over three thousand meters tall, with three heads and twelve arms, his body covered in thick black-red armor.
Hamdanman’s True Body of the Great Demon King, unlike other Great Demon Kings’ lean figures, was somewhat corpulent, resembling a sphere over three thousand meters wide and high.
At that moment, in Hamdanman’s bulkiest arms, he held a ten-thousand-meter-long Black Battle Axe, firmly blocking the War Halberd above, while dark abyssal waves churned around him, emanating a terrifying aura.
Boom!
Chains of the abyss wrapped around Hamdanman, and in an instant, his demonic aura surged, with his arms releasing Double Arm Burst strength that shattered the world, breaking the Black-gold shadow of the War Halberd.
Amid the wild blast of explosive air currents, Hamdanman held a Black Battle Axe that had shrunk to over three thousand meters, gazing solemnly into the distance.
There stood Jack Clark, his Halberd in hand amidst a golden sea of fire, confronting Hamdanman over two thousand kilometers apart, their auras clashing and shaking the Void.
The power displayed by both Jack Clark and Hamdanman in that strike was terrifying, exceeding the limits of the Great Demon King’s realm.
But Hamdanman, as a peak Great Demon King with immense combat strength and wielding a Pseudo-World Level Weapon, his combat power reaching Demon God Level was to be expected.
Yet the realm breath emanating from Jack Clark was only at the beginning of the ‘Great Demon King,’ and his combat strength was so terrifying that it was unbelievable to the demons.
Especially that nascent Supreme Rule, which shocked Hamdanman, unable to believe that any being could congeal a Rule at the beginning stage of the Great Demon King’s realm.
While Hamdanman was shocked, Jack Clark was also slightly surprised, his gaze falling on the Black Broken Battle Axe in its hands.
That Axe was strong, possessing not only terrifying strength and edge but also robustness like a real world, instantly devouring most of the attacking strength at the moment of interaction.
Jack Clark spoke slowly, his deep and resonant voice echoing between heaven and earth, “You are strong; you are worthy to know my name. Remember, the one who will kill you today is Darren Callum of the Human Race.”
Hamdanman, holding his axe, with his demon power surging to the skies, simultaneous cold chuckles came from its three heads, “Human Darren Callum! I will remember you.”
“But to kill me, that level of strength is not enough.”
The true combat strength of both of them was at the initial stage of the Demon God Level, and in such a scenario, although Jack Clark might be a bit stronger, at most, he could only suppress Hamdanman.
When strength reaches the God-level, one can touch upon Rules and solidify worlds, and slight differences in strength would entail a war of attrition, possibly lasting through dozens of sunrises and sunsets, if neither yielded.
As for defeating or injuring, it was quite challenging under the terrifying Vitality of a Demon God Level being, let alone slaying—this was the confidence behind Hamdanman’s immediate suppression.

chapters.title: Chapter 1409 - 1409 537 Dark Star Apocalypse Form
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1409: Chapter 537 Dark Star Apocalypse Form, Reincarnation Combined into One Invincible_2 Chapter 1409: Chapter 537 Dark Star Apocalypse Form, Reincarnation Combined into One Invincible_2 But, just when Hamdanman, who was holding a black battle axe and had nearly burst out with his full strength, thought that this was all of Jack Clark’s power.
Hum!
Behind Jack Clark, a thousand meters long, translucent small river slowly emerged, upon which nine figures wearing black imperial robes and donning twenty-four All-Heaven Emperor Crowns manifested.
These figures were each at the Mid-Mythical Stage or the late period, but the intangible oppressive aura they emitted changed the color of Hamdanman and the other demon kings.
“Time-Type Divine Power!”
“Nine avatars, how is that possible!”
“I know who he is now, it’s that human who killed Buddy and the others!”
“Run!” At this moment, all the demon kings’ complexions hugely changed, remembering the legend that had spread among the Frontline Battlefield armies.
The legend of someone at the Mythical Stage suppressing seventeen demon kings, including two late-period Great Demon Kings, and who had single-handedly decimated millions from the Purgatory Legion.
But it was already too late, as Jack Clark had already burst out with his ‘full’ strength, preparing for a quick battle and quick decision; there was no way he would let them escape.
Boom! Nine Time Clones appeared in all directions of the Purgatory Legion, each revealing their true forms, towering five hundred meters tall and wielding the phantoms of black-gold Eight Desolations War Halberds.
Seven of the Time Clones each targeted a fleeing Great Demon King and the six demon kings, while the remaining two pounced towards the more than one million soldiers of the Purgatory Legion.
Boom Boom!!
Two golden Great Suns, each several kilometers in diameter, set in the west, descending upon the Purgatory Legion’s battle formation like crystal energy hydrogen bombs of over a hundred megatons, releasing dazzling light and forming two massive mushroom clouds.
Bang Bang Bang!! In just an instant, the true bodies of six demon kings were shattered, and that Great Demon King, like a black meteor, was hammered into the ground by a three-thousand-meter-long War Halberd.
Boom!
Within a few hundred kilometers, the earth cracked, countless dirt and stones rose like a tsunami, forming a ring-shaped shockwave that swept over a thousand kilometers.
While unleashing the Time Reincarnation Divine Power, Jack Clark’s figure flashed, crossing a vast distance in one step to appear above Hamdanman, behind whom a golden gate emerged.
Crackle Crackle!!
On that ten-thousand-meter-high golden gate, cracks began to appear, and thick, heavy dark golden radiance seeped out of those cracks, emitting an aura that made Hamdanman’s heart palpitate.
Not good, it wasn’t his full strength just now.
“Kill!” Shocked, Hamdanman roared, a column of blood-colored flames soared skyward from his body, and his aura skyrocketed in an instant.
Facing what he knew was about to be a massive release of ‘big moves’ from Jack Clark, Hamdanman decisively chose to burn two-tenths of his origin, causing the aura and the radiance from the black battle axe in his hand to intensify tremendously.
Boom!
A ten-thousand-meter-long shadow of a black battle axe surged into the sky, its invisible sharpness cutting even the Heavenly Earth Law, ripping through space and creating a continuously spreading, over a hundred-thousand-meters-long, black curtain in front of Jack Clark.
Just then, the golden gate behind Jack Clark also exploded, with the dark golden dragon-shaped chains wrapped around it shattering, causing the whole world to shake once more.
Endless dark golden Qi Blood gushed out from behind the door, poured into Jack Clark like a river flowing in reverse, causing his body to swell to two thousand meters, his entire being emitting dazzling dark golden light.
In an instant, an immensely heavy power filled Heaven and Earth, the space around making booming explosive sounds as if large areas were shattering like mirrors.
At the same time, a ten-thousand-meter-long dark golden War Halberd descended from the heavens, shattering space and time with unrivaled domination.
Boom! Hamdanman, burning his origin and drawing upon the power of the Abyss World, wielded his Pseudo-World Level weapon, the battle axe, to which the dark curtain was directly obliterated.
The dark golden War Halberd, undeterred, descended like a sacred mountain range ten thousand kilometers long, carrying an indescribable colossal force as it landed on the black battle axe.
Boom! The Void under Hamdanman’s feet shattered, the whole demon with the descending War Halberd smashed onto the Earth instantly.
Under the terrifying force, the Earth cracked, cleaving open a chasm over ten thousand kilometers long and unfathomably deep, rending Heaven and Earth, mountains and everything else in the ripping force into oblivion.
If this strike were to land on the weaker spatial carrying capacity of Blue Star, it would have been enough to shatter the planet.
Nine-layered Heavenly Gate.
Forged from the fusion of Dark Star Runes, Nine Dragon Runes, Heavenly Gate Runes, and the Demon God’s Body, it’s a sealing technique of special prowess condensed from Jack Clark’s lifetime of Martial Arts essence.
Behind the Heavenly Gate, sealed lies a dragon of apocalypse imbued with the strength of Heavenly Tier Emperor Dragon Essence Blood. Breaking through the First Layer Heavenly Gate and breaking free from a dragon patterned chain increases strength, defense, and attack power twofold, with each layer compounding on the previous one.
Although Jack Clark’s strength had only doubled at this time, the all-around doubling resulted in him striking Hamdanman with his halberd, plunging him more than two thousand kilometers deep into the earth.
This was Jack Clark merged with the power of the Dark Star, whose formidable true body, in harmony with the supreme Law of Strength and divine power, rendered his strength unbearably overbearing and terrifying.
“This king does not accept this!”
Boom! Accompanied by an angry roar, the shattered abyss below exploded, the earth collapsed, forming a deep pit over a thousand kilometers in diameter.
From the bottom of the pit surged endless Dark Demon Air, thick like liquid, its invisible presence deeply corrupted the surroundings with its dark, malevolent power.
From the surging dark abyss at the bottom of the pit, an even more colossal figure slowly emerged.
By this time, Hamdanman had undergone another transformation, his two heads and ten arms had vanished, leaving behind blood-dripping holes on his shoulders and back, and the remaining head still had remnants of flesh and blood dripping from its mouth.
Beyond that, his size had ballooned to over five thousand meters. His massive body, like an overinflated balloon, had shattered his armor, exposing the stretched skin and scale armor beneath.
The Black Broken Battle Axe in its hand was now stained red with dark red blood, emitting a thick and glaring blood light, casting a real and intact world beneath its illumination.
Only that world was somewhat broken, with dark, cracked grounds devoid of any signs of life, filled with endless Dark Demon Air.
Standing atop the dark abyss, Hamdanman, at the peak of his Limit Breakthrough, exuded demon power that roared to the heavens. Looking up at Jack Clark in the sky, he bellowed: “This king refuses to believe that you can kill me today.”
“Whether you believe it or not isn’t important, what’s important is that you’re about to die.”
Jack Clark, as if cast from dark gold, looked indifferently with his kilometer-long black hair wildly dancing behind him, supported by the rotating World Halo that made for a somewhat terrifying sight.
As Jack Clark’s voice fell, nine avatars wearing black imperial robes appeared behind him, having already slain the Demon King’s True Form in its early stage, along with six demon kings.
As for the more than a million soldiers of the Purgatory Legion, they had already been slaughtered.
Unchallenged by an equal force, the million-plus True Demons of Purgatory stood no chance against two time true bodies matching the power of a Demon King in his late stage.
Without wasting words, the moment the nine time true bodies appeared, silver runes shaped like wings emerged at the corners of Jack Clark’s forehead.
These silver divine runes spread continuously, infiltrating and unfurling behind him, covering the nine time true bodies and forming a set of silver light wings spanning ten thousand meters behind Jack Clark.
Those nine true bodies, like nine nodes, were inlaid on the silver wings, which then abruptly closed together enclosing Jack Clark like a silver river linked from front to back.
In an instant, infinite silver radiance erupted, and from that dazzling figure as the epicenter, streaks of silver cracks spread in all directions.
In Hamdanman’s eyes and perception, the world at that moment became exceedingly slow, solidified, and came to a halt.
Under the union of the nine past time true bodies’ strength, Jack Clark’s power reached a terrifying level in that instant.
This power didn’t simply refer to accumulation of energy but meant that under the force of time, his laws, talents, divine powers, and even his true body had briefly reached a certain point in the future.
It was an advanced convergence of certain powers, breaking the world’s limits.
Splat!!
As Jack Clark swept his now nearly radiant silver war halberd below, the void collapsed, and the surrounding Abyss World that enveloped Hamdanman instantly burst.
Following that, even Hamdanman’s true body, which was comparable to an ordinary Demon God at the peak of its Limit Breakthrough, was crushed by that future dominating power, dispersing into black dust like crumbling sand.
In that moment, Jack Clark was akin to a Demon God wielding the power of Great Destruction, ruling over the life and death of all things.
The invisible, terrifying power that naturally emanated from him made the nine demon gods and five Divine Kings of Heavenly Feather from the Eternal Divine Domain in the great battle take note involuntarily with astonishment in their eyes.
Was this force really from a ‘person’ at the early stage of being a Great Demon King (Main God)?
The Great Demon King Tyris slightly turned its head, its terrifying gaze spanning a million kilometers to land on Jack Clark, murmuring softly, “This human must die.”
In this moment, even Tyris, who ‘favored’ unmatched monsters of different races, felt a strong threat from this human.

chapters.title: Chapter 1410 - 1410 538 Overwhelmingly Dominant Pushing All
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1410: Chapter 538: Overwhelmingly Dominant, Pushing All Directions Chapter 1410: Chapter 538: Overwhelmingly Dominant, Pushing All Directions As Hamdanman’s true body turned to black dust and dissipated, obliterated by the terrifying authority contained in the Time Reincarnation, a blood-red and blinding Blood Moon emerged high in the sky.
This Blood Moon was dozens of times larger than those demon kings and appeared like a real celestial body thousands of kilometers above, then began to fall slowly.
Instantly, the rich Law Power between heaven and earth dissipated and surged in all directions.
Such spectacles of life beyond the myth falling were formed when the laws they possessed at death dissipated and intersected with heaven and earth, which was akin to an alternative return to the natural world.
Just then, around Jack Clark, wing-like silver rivers sprang cracks, and with a snap, they burst into a sky full of silver specks and faded away.
That single strike had instantly exhausted the Time Reincarnation power contained in the Divine Power.
Hu!
Jack Clark slowly exhaled, and as the silver halo faded, the silver wing mark on his brow grew dim, and his hair also returned to black.
Consuming nine Time Marks to slay a half-step into Demon God Level entity, whose real combat strength was comparable to an ordinary ancient early stage Demon God, was actually quite a bargain.
After all, these Mythical Realm marks would have been consumed sooner or later; keeping them any longer would be a waste of the “Skill position.”
With Jack’s current strength, his ordinary human form was almost comparable to the peak of a Heavenly King, and the manifested Eight-armed True Demon God Body form could break free from shackles and step into the Supreme Level of the ancient times.
Of course, this step was just equivalent to an ordinary ancient early stage Demon God.
Though every entity capable of becoming Demon God Level boasted a stunning and unmatched talent, among cultivators and Giant Beasts, there still remained a gap in talent.
For instance, entities like the Time Dragon that master the Supreme Law, could, once entering the Ancient Level, clash with mid-period ancient beings under the Time Rule.
Therefore, for Jack now, the Time True Body he had earlier condensed had become somewhat superfluous, better off being consumed and then re-condensing new Time Marks.
In the future, each additional Time Clone condensed would be equivalent to another ordinary ancient early stage Demon God’s combat strength.
Condensing nine would be like having nine more early-stage Demon Gods—just thinking about it felt terrifying.
Of course, that was only wishful thinking.
The stronger the original body, the greater the consumption of the Power of Time needed to condense a Time True Body; now, the power needed to condense one mark was almost equivalent to the total of the previous nine.
This was a fundamental rule of the mythical world and even the endless space-time that even top-tier Divine Powers could not break completely.
With the battle over, it was time to clean up the battlefield.
With his three-faced six-armed form towering over two thousand meters tall, Jack Clark, like a majestic mountain peak, looked down below.
There, in a dark pit over a thousand kilometers in diameter where Hamdanman fell, the broken Black Battle Axe, now restored to a kilometer in size, sank amidst rolling Dark Demon Air.
For this Pseudo-World Level Weapon forged from rules, Jack naturally would not let it slip away; he teleported into the dark pit hundreds of kilometers below.
From behind Jack, a gigantic arm reached out and grasped the handle of the Battle Axe.
Boom!
The moment Jack grasped the Black Battle Axe, his form involuntarily sank, as though what he was holding was not an axe, but a world in free fall, extremely heavy.
In addition, a powerful repelling force filled with madness, slaughter, and darkness repelled Jack.
“Seeking death!”
Jack’s gaze turned cold, and an empty and boundless eye appeared on his brow. In an instant, a void black slash blade struck towards the Black Battle Axe.
Boom! The broken Black Battle Axe trembled violently, several more minute fractures appeared on the wheel-shaped blade, looking even more damaged and dim.
As the Blade of Void-Cutting Rune upgraded to the Peeping Void Eye Divine Power, the characteristic of annihilating void became even more potent, and just one strike obliterated Hamdanman’s mark within the axe.
Immediately, the repulsion from the axe disappeared, but it was still immensely heavy.
After all, it was a weapon that contained its own ‘world,’ capable of mobilizing the World’s Power; its level was even higher than Jack’s Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd.
World-class weapons are a special category, characterized by melting one-sided worlds, heavens and earth, into formidable weapons with a Second Layer Rule enhancement.
Similar to avatars, even for the same Demon God, the difference between possessing a World-class weapon and not is significant.
However, this Black Broken Battle Axe was just a Pseudo-World Level weapon, far from the level of the World-class demonic weapons held by the three Lords of the Purgatory Empire.
Even so, it was precious. For example, Jack could choose to melt it into the Opening Heavens Halberd to further enhance the war halberd’s power.
Or he could choose to smash it into the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, but he’d consider how to make that choice after the battle ended, as the war isn’t over yet.
With this in mind, Jack looked up towards the horizon.
The True Martial Heavenly King and Left Demon were battling fiercely tens of kilometers away, with every motion they made sending shockwaves that disturbed a hundred thousand kilometers of heaven and earth.
In another direction, thirty thousand kilometers away, the Mysterious Martial Sky King led the Sky Base Fleet, clashing with another Purgatory Legion, tearing the heavens apart and splitting the earth.
After a brief pause, Jack, holding both the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd and the Black Battle Axe, flew towards the Sky Base Fleet.
As for True Martial Heavenly King, the matter with Jonathan Walker seemed to have some complexities; that Left Demon may not necessarily be the enemy, otherwise, Jane Aiken wouldn’t side with him.
…
Boom, Boom, Boom!!!
In the heart of the Eternal Divine Domain, merged with the Eternal Divine Tree and having entered the ‘Ancient God’ realm, the Divine King of Light alone fought against seven Demon Gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1411 - 1411 538 Crushing the Old and Decayed
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1411: Chapter 538 Crushing the Old and Decayed, Sweeping All Directions_2 Chapter 1411: Chapter 538 Crushing the Old and Decayed, Sweeping All Directions_2 “`
The horrifying war caused space-time to tremble within an area spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers, as golden roots stretching tens to hundreds of thousands of kilometers traversed Heaven and Earth, blasting demon gods away.
Facing the True Spirit Level divine tree roots, only the lords of the three major empires wielding world weapons could contend with them, to some extent.
Among them, the most formidable was Tyris, with his Abyss Demon God True Body, standing tens of thousands of meters tall, confronting the Eternal Divine Tree head-on, fearless even as the head and arms of his Abyss True Body were obliterated time and again.
Another Great Demon God held a terrifying Dark Demon Blade, emanating a terrifying demonic aura, capable of severing some of the slightly thinner roots of the Eternal Divine Tree.
Boom!
Golden roots tens of thousands of kilometers long swept across, tearing vast areas of the Void asunder. Tyris’s Abyss True Body was directly blasted deep into the Void.
But quickly, Tyris, with half of his shattered True Body already recovered, returned from the endless darkness, wielding a Dark Demon Blade wrapped in the Abyss, and said in an indifferent voice,
“Metastat, give up. The moment you chose to merge with this divine tree, your Heavenly Feather clan lost all hope.”
“Originally, I thought you’d give up on the divine tree and lead a part of your elite kin to withdraw. With you, an Extreme Realm Divine King, anchoring them, the Heavenly Feather clan still had a glimmer of hope to rise again.”
“But to my surprise, you made such a foolish choice, to merge with this divine tree.” At this point, disappointment unexpectedly tinged Tyris’s voice.
His adversary of hundreds of years had, in the end, chosen such a foolish path, inevitably leaving the demon somewhat disheartened.
Above the divine tree’s canopy, the towering phantom of the Divine King of Light, thousands of miles high, slowly spoke with an aged voice that echoed through space and time, “Foolish, perhaps it is to you.”
“I was born in this world and witnessed the Heavenly Feather tribe’s rise from an ordinary race to a mythical civilization. To me, this place is everything.”
“To one like me, who has existed for tens of thousands of years, whose consciousness has traversed the river of time for hundreds of thousands of years, it’s not a bad end to be annihilated alongside my homeland today.”
“But before that happens, are you ready to perish?”
Boom!
In an instant, pairs of light wings shone heavily behind the Divine King of Light, unleashing a dazzling white light that brightened the entire world, and under its overwhelming spread, countless dark demon gases dissolved away.
Watching this scene, Tyris and other demons did not stop it, even pausing the condensation of their Abyssal rule, allowing the Divine King of Light to consume the Rule Origin and amplify his domain fully.
Looking down from high altitude, one could see the Eternal Divine Domain, as large as the sun, split into three, each becoming its own battlefield.
There, the Human Race army, over twenty million of the Heavenly Feather Legion, and more than two hundred million of the Purgatory Legion were mostly located in the north of the Divine Domain, engaged in a ferociously brutal strife.
Among them, a few Heavenly Feather Legions led by the Heavenly Feather Main Gods, numbering in the millions, were surrounded from all directions by the incessant Purgatory Demon Race, doomed to inevitable collapse.
Even the shining white light bathing the entire Divine Domain could hardly change their fate.
However, the most frenzied battlefield was at the southern edge of the Divine Domain, where four Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather were jointly attempting to slaughter two Purgatory Demon Gods, causing chaos as if the sky were falling and the earth splitting.
Both sides had entered a state of bursting their Rule Origin, with terrifying attacks laying waste to an area spanning millions of kilometers.
The most relentless among them was a Divine King with ten silver light wings, surrounded by eight rotating Halo, who, even burning his Divine Soul, clung tenaciously to a Demon God.
But all these were far away from the Human Race.
“Right-wing fleet, be advised, strong life signs at coordinates to the left at 168, energy converging on the twelve main cannons, prepare for simultaneous firing to destroy it,”
“Calling for small Crystal Energy Nuclear Bomb carpet bombing, target direction 1779 high ground at approximately seven hundred and fifty kilometers, obliterate that legion of Demonized Beasts.”
“Requesting air support, the number of Flying Giant Beasts and sky-and-space alien corps is too much, and our air dominance is under threat…”
On a boundless plain with only some hills rolling, a Human Race army of a million centered on thirteen battleships in the air formed a triangular sky-and-space warfare system.
On the ground’s outskirts were massive close-combat Mechas, teaming up with High-level cultivators to forcibly encounter the Purgatory Demon Race’s ground troops.
Aboard the sky-based battleships, missile launchers, rune rocket launchers, and large-caliber siege artillery positions covered every inch of the deck, pouring out fire in a frenzy.
On the ship decks, unmanned fighters and Energy Bombers took off every moment, coordinating with the main and secondary cannons on both sides of the battleships, to obliterate and suppress the flying Purgatory Legions.
Additionally, the purple War Pattern rings enveloping a thousand kilometers magnified all attributes fully, bolstering their Defense, allowing the Human Race army to withstand the onslaught of more than three million of the Purgatory Legions.
And a thousand kilometers above the battlefield, where space was shattered, the Mysterious Martial Giant Beast roared at the Firmament, clashing with a Great Demon King who emitted terrifying might.
Elsewhere, Denny Kaye was suppressing a mid period Titan Great Demon King, their forms transforming into blinding streaks of black and purple light, with formidable Law Radiance shaking Heaven and Earth.
And a towering eight-hundred-meter-tall Black-Red Colored Mech was being suppressed by four demon kings and a Great Demon King, unable to step onto the front lines to slaughter the Purgatory Legions.
This was the normal rhythm of a great war between civilized races.
King against king, general against general, Mythical Powerhouses restraining counterparts of equal strength, with ordinary Transcendent Corps forming battle arrays to boost the Mythical Strongmen.
Especially for the demon kings, the Great Demon Kings, and even the Demon Gods, those legions of the Purgatory were extensions of their strength, manifestations of their Rule Will.
“`

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1412: Chapter 538: Overwhelmingly Dominant, Pushing All Directions_3 Chapter 1412: Chapter 538: Overwhelmingly Dominant, Pushing All Directions_3 Under the same-source power physique, the more Purgatory True Demons and demonized aliens there are, the stronger the power of the Abyssal and Dark Laws they wield becomes.
This is also why the Divine King of Light did not dare to lose too many Purgatory True Demons in the southern regions of the Divine Realm.
However, once the balance of high-end strength is broken in such a war, what awaits those Transcendent Corps will be slaughter, like the more than two million Purgatory Legion previously wiped out by Jack Clark.
Roar!
The Number One roared violently from the Earth, its eyes shooting out blue and white light beams like laser blasts, sweeping across Heaven and Earth, shattering space wherever it passed.
“Demon Banner of the Masses, all things return to ruin.”
The Great Demon King, towering a kilometer high with eight arms raging, held four dark banners each over a thousand meters long, their powerful demon patterns shimmering, forming chains of rune sequences.
At the same time, four Demon Kings within a 300-kilometer radius also held two Dark Demon Flags each. The twelve banners echoed each other, forming a Demon Array that enveloped an area of five hundred kilometers.
Within the Demon Array, endless dark demon air churned, creating layer upon layer of Void Demon Walls under the Rune Sequence Chains, suppressing the Number One.
Even though the blue and white light beam shot out by the Number One was terrifyingly powerful, capable of blasting away an ordinary Great Demon King with a single hit, it dispersed after shattering more than a hundred layers of the Demon Wall.
Roar! Faced with an enemy that dared not confront it head-on, but instead jointly restrained it with a space Demon Array, the Number One was extremely enraged, constantly issuing fierce roars.
Inside the Number One, the screens in the cockpit flashed with red light continuously.
“Alert, the Soul Sync Rate has exceeded one hundred, Number One is emitting a strong desire to fight and slaughter instinctively, do you choose to enter Rampage Mode?”
“Alert, entering Rampage Mode will cause double erosion to mental consciousness and body, leading to assimilation, please choose carefully.”
Looking at the urgent flashing red lights on the big screen, as well as the savage instinct transmitted from the Number One, Freya Louise’s gaze was very calm, but this time she chose no!
Roar!
Immediately, the Number One issued an even more cruel roar, as waves of more intense assimilation impacts rushed toward Freya, seeking to gain self-control authority.
Whether it was the battle in the sky or the great war on the ground, both sides were waiting.
The strong warriors of the Purgatory Demon Race, especially those above the Demon Kings, knew that two Great Demon Kings from the Extreme Realm were leading legions to reinforce them; the arrival of just one would be enough to wipe out the Human Race’s expeditionary force.
The Human side was also waiting, waiting for either Jack Clark or the True Martial Heavenly King to finish their battles.
As the Federation’s strongest person after the Supreme, the True Martial Heavenly King possessed unparalleled strength, capable of even clashing with and injuring Demon Gods from the Ancient Middle Stage.
Not to mention Jack Clark—when in the Legendary Realm, he could retreat unscathed under the siege of Demon Gods, and after breaking through to Heavenly King, he would undoubtedly be even more terrifying.
Thus, everyone was full of confidence in them.
Boom!
The Firmament collapsed, forming a black crack over a hundred kilometers long. From within the crack, a figure shrouded in dark gold light and towering two thousand meters tall tore through space to arrive.
With three faces and eight arms, holding a black-gold battle halberd and a black battle axe, his black hair flowing wildly against the backdrop of the golden World Halo made him appear inexplicably terrifying.
The moment Jack Clark appeared, a vast and heavy oppressive force descended, causing the Heavenly Energy within thousands of kilometers to solidify, and everyone felt a sudden weight upon them.
“It’s the Divine Martial Throne!”
“Hahaha… those damn Purgatory Demons are finished.”
“Kill them!”
“Fire all ammunition, don’t worry about the consumption.”
The arrival of Jack Clark energized everyone, even the Number One trapped below by the space Demon Array, which roared instinctively with a tinge of joy.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King, transformed into a ten-thousand-meter giant beast, laughed loudly: “Hahaha… It’s just like you to take out that guy so quickly.” In the midst of laughter, the Mysterious Martial Sky King fiercely collided with a Great Demon King.
Boom!
The sturdy bulk of the Mysterious Martial’s back slammed against the giant dark red warhammer, instantly shattering the space for a thousand kilometers, breaking through layer upon layer of the Void.
The powerful shockwaves of the battle swept thousands of kilometers but were weakened layer by layer by the purple Halos and the sky-covering Dark Demon Clouds as they moved towards the Earth below.
In the center of the raging explosion, the Mysterious Martial Sky King roared, “Jack Clark, I’ll hold this guy off; you go help Denny Kaye and the others.”
“Alright.”
Jack Clark gave the still enduring Mysterious Martial Sky King a glance and, with a thunderous plummet, appeared above the space Demon Clan that had trapped the Number One, overlooking the standing Dark Banners below.
Immediately, the Great Demon Kings commanding the battle’s faces changed drastically.
Boom!
The mile-long Black Broken Battle Axe shone brightly, its sharp rending characteristic causing the Space-Time to be cleaved, forming a dark crack hundreds of kilometers long.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
With that terrifying strike, all the Dark Banners shattered, space collapsed, and under the Overbearing Unrivaled Power, four Demon Kings and one Great Demon King all spat blood.
Roar!
The freed Number One let out a violent roar, the ground beneath it shattered, and its figure instantly appeared in front of a Demon King over two hundred kilometers away, reaching out with both hands.
Under the forceful strength, the Demon King’s true body, over five hundred meters tall, along with the surrounding space, suddenly solidified and shrunk as if flattened into a two-dimensional scroll.
But in the eyes of that suffocated Demon King, the shape of the Number One was growing continuously, becoming ten thousand meters tall in a blink, seeming like a monstrous beast capable of devouring the sky and land.
“Casadila, save me!” the Demon King screamed in terror.

﻿Chapter 1413: Chapter 538: Overwhelmingly Dominant, Pushing All Directions_4 Chapter 1413: Chapter 538: Overwhelmingly Dominant, Pushing All Directions_4 “`
However, at this moment, the Great Demon King named Casadila was already struggling to protect himself. As the Demon Array collapsed and he was blasted away, he transformed into a black firelight and flew toward the sky.
Including the other Three Demon Kings, they all frantically fled the moment Jack Clark appeared, without a single thought of looking back.
That suddenly appeared human was too terrifying; just the invisible aura he emitted caused their instincts to palpitate and their souls to tremble, feeling as if they were facing the esteemed Demon God himself.
“Do you think you can escape?” a low, indifferent voice echoed in the ears of those Demon Kings and the Great Demon King.
Only to see Jack Clark’s figure slightly move, a terrifying power that could shake the world burst forth from within his body, as his arm gripping the Golden-White Great Sun reached towards Casadila.
Distorting space, the already eight hundred kilometers distant Casadila had a bright glow above his head, and a Golden-White star ten kilometers in diameter appeared, shining with blinding radiance.
Boom!
The Demon God Battle Skill, World-Destroying Great Sun, exploded like a real star expanding rapidly at the instant of explosion, unleashing endless searing energy to destroy everything in its vicinity.
The Dark World surrounding the directly impacted Casadila instantly shattered, followed by the True Body of the Great Demon King, which vaporized under the expanding Golden-White sun.
The terrifying strike annihilated everything within a thousand kilometers, and the energy released formed rings of scorching flames, sweeping across thousands of kilometers, dispersing the dark clouds that blotted out the sky.
However, because the epicenter of the explosion was already over a thousand kilometers away from the main battlefield, the rising wave of scorching air, though imposing, affected few ordinary ‘people’.
As he blasted apart the Great Demon King, Jack Clark’s other arm, gripping the Thunder God’s War Spear, exploded with lightning, and a purple thunder light snaked through heaven and earth.
Boom! Four hundred kilometers away, a Demon King trying to escape into Space Cracks, had its True Body shattered.
At the same time, Jack’s figure flashed, stepping through space to another direction, his unarmed hand forming a seal, gathering an indescribable force.
Suddenly, madness and despair appeared on the faces of the two Demon Kings below.
Under the Overbearing Power that seemed like the Milky Way pouring down, space collapsed as if tangible, forming a black fist imprint a hundred kilometers in size, with detailed fingerprints visible upon it.
Under the Unrivaled Domination, the True Bodies of the two Demon Kings shattered instantly, and the fist imprint, undiminished, crashed down onto the Earth.
Boom!
The terrifying power caused the land to sink, creating a huge pit hundreds of kilometers wide. Subsequently, the energy spread and burst forth, and the surrounding dirt and rocks erupted like tsunamis in all directions, with a thunderous and earth-shattering force.
“Freya, the rest is up to you.”
In his tranquil voice, Jack Clark had already disappeared from view.
From the moment Jack appeared to the annihilation of the True Forms of one Great Demon King and three Demon Kings with heavy injuries, everything had happened in an instant, so quickly that everyone hadn’t yet had the chance to react.
Roar!
Number One roared, biting off half the body of the Demon King in its grasp. Dark-red blood sprayed, staining its entire body red, followed by another swift devouring.
Instantly, a Blood Moon slowly emerged in the sky, signifying the complete downfall of that Demon King.
Under the Blood Moon overhead, Number One, standing tall upon the Earth, drenched in fresh blood, looked particularly ferocious, its eyes emitting a blue-white light as it gazed into the distance.
There, amidst the shattered Void from the Purple Heaven Thunder, the Demon King whose True Form was reconstituting was bound by strands of purple thunder light, suppressed and unable to move.
“No, don’t, don’t eat me!” The Demon King shouted in horror as it saw the Black-Red Colored Mech approaching with large strides.
As a Mythical-level Powerhouse, it did not fear death through battle against its foes, but the prospect of being torn apart and devoured alive by an unknown creature was somewhat unbearable.
Not just this Demon King, but the two Demon Kings who had been obliterated by the fist imprint now lay at the bottom of the enormous pit, weak and breathing faintly as they looked up at the sky with despair in their eyes.
A strong will converged upon them, forming an invisible fist imprint, and the Law of Strength emanating from it suppressed their internal dark forces.
“`
Including that Great Demon King, whose true body had been reshaped by consuming its origin after vaporizing, was sealed by the scorching golden-white flames, forming a fireball thousands of kilometers in diameter that burned in the sky.
“Senior Kaye, be careful.”
Above the firmament more than three thousand kilometers away, the moment Jack Clark’s voice sounded, a dark gold war halberd thousands of kilometers in length smashed through the void, descending from the heavens.
Under the terrifying and overbearing power, the rules of this world all collapsed thunderously. The Sky King Denny Kaye, who was in the midst of exchanging blows with a Titan mid-period Great Demon King, had their expressions change immediately.
“Damn it, Kid Jack Clark, I’m still here,” Denny Kaye exclaimed, and immediately, a dazzling purple radiance burst forth from his body, transforming into a gigantic purple lotus of the twelfth rank.
Boom! The Purple Lotus Platform exploded.
[Wait a moment, there are still a few hundred words, hehe, ending today with a 7K chapter]
At the same time, Jack Clark’s figure flashed, stepping through space to appear in another direction. Behind him, one arm that wasn’t holding a weapon was forming seals, gathering an indescribable strength.
Immediately, the two Demon Kings below revealed expressions of madness and despair.
Like the mighty river of the heavens inverted, under the overbearing strength, space itself seemed to collapse into substance, forming a black fist imprint a hundred kilometers across, with the whorl patterns of the fingers clearly visible.
Under the Unrivaled Domineering Power, the true bodies of those two Demon Kings shattered in an instant, then the fist imprint continued its unstoppable descent to the ground.
Boom!
Under the terrifying power, the Earth sank, forming a gigantic pit hundreds of kilometers wide. Following that, the force spread and burst out, with the surrounding dirt and rocks erupting like a tsunami in all directions, with a momentum that shook the heavens and the Earth.
“Freya Louise, I leave the rest to you.”
Within that faint voice, Jack Clark had already vanished from sight.
From Jack Clark’s appearance to a Great Demon King, to the three Demon Kings being blasted to heavy injuries happened in the blink of an eye, with a speed so fast that everyone else hadn’t even reacted yet.
Roar!
Number One roared, biting off half of the Demon King’s true body it held in its grasp in one bite, dark-red blood spraying and dying its entire body red, and then it devoured the rest in another bite.
Suddenly a Blood Moon slowly emerged in the sky, symbolizing the complete fall of that Demon King.
Under the illumination of the Blood Moon above, Number One, standing tall upon the Earth, drenched in blood, appeared incredibly ferocious, its eyes emanating blue-white light as it gazed into the distance.

As a Mythical-level Powerhouse, it did not fear death in battle against an enemy, but the prospect of being torn apart and devoured alive by an unknown monster was something it found hard to accept.
And it was not just this Demon King; the two that had been blasted by the fist imprint also lay in the massive crater, with weak auras, gazing up at the sky in despair.
A powerful will converged above them, forming a transparent fist imprint. The invisible Law of Strength radiated out, suppressing the dark forces within their bodies.

﻿Chapter 1414: Chapter 539 Chapter 1414: Chapter 539 “`
As Jack Clark’s battle came to an end, tens of kilometers away, the epic battle between Left Demon and the True Martial Heavenly King also shook heaven and earth.
The True Demon God Body, reaching tens of kilometers in height and clad in Black Gold battle armor, wielded the Devouring Overlord Halberd with every move shattering the Void, its imposing presence earth-shattering.
Around the towering mountain-like figure of Left Demon, millions from the Purgatory Legion and four demon kings spread out over tens of kilometers, swarming like ants.
Empowered by the Demon Array formed by these Purgatory Legions, the Dark Demon Air around Left Demon roiled, its aura swelling several times, strong enough to clash directly with the True Martial Divine Tablet.
Each time the black stele descended, compressing space-time, and collided with the mountain-spanning Tyrant Halberd, the Destructive Shockwave turned tens of thousands of Purgatory True Demons into a blood mist.
After just a brief clash, more than a million from the Purgatory Legion had suffered heavy casualties, and the four demon kings were heavily injured, spewing blood, their real bodies cracked.
“Traitor, today I will definitely suppress you,” the True Martial Heavenly King roared angrily, eyes blazing with intense golden light, raising the tens of kilometers high black stele and smashing it down once again.
Boom!
The black stele, bearing the inheritance power of a civilization, descended and obliterated thousands of kilometers of space in an instant, forming cascading Destructive Shockwaves that erupted all around.
Before the invisible might even descended, the Demonized Alien Race near Left Demon, standing at the edge of the Demon Array, exploded into a blood mist with loud bangs.
“I am myself; where is the betrayal?” the Left Demon growled, holding the halberd in both arms, conjuring a sky full of dark red lightning that surged upward, striking beneath the black stele.
Boom!
As the Human Race’s inherited rules collided with the Power of the Abyss, the entire Heaven and Earth trembled madly, with countless dark red lightnings mingling with black light waves spreading across the sky.
Under the powerful backlash, tens of thousands of Demonized Alien Race screamed in agony, exploding into Blood Demons, and the two demon kings anchoring the Demon Array’s enhancement also burst open.
Looking at the terrifying figure in the distance, one of the demon kings at Mythical Peak spoke with gravity, “Lord Cortes, the enemy is too strong, we’re struggling to hold on.”
Left Demon’s gaze was cold, his voice like thunder filling Heaven and Earth, “Even if you can’t hold on, you must. Today, we must eradicate this Human Expedition Legion.”
“However, rest assured, Prince Hamdanman from the Belvetan Empire and Prince Priest from the Freymand Empire are currently encircling the Human Race’s army.”
“Just hold on a little longer, once they arrive, we can capture this Human Expert.”
The words of Left Demon lifted the spirits of the following Purgatory True Demons, including the four demon kings whose foundations were damaged.
Suddenly, the fierce battle erupted once again.
The True Martial Heavenly King, whose cultivation was already half a step into the Supreme Level and who had touched the Heavenly Earth Law, was tens of kilometers tall, garbed in golden armor, resembling a majestic middle-aged man.
With the black stele in his left hand and the Golden War Sword in his right, countless silhouettes stood firm behind him, like celestial soldiers, somewhat resembling the mythical legend of the True Martial Emperor.
Or rather, when the True Martial Heavenly King initially condensed his True Form, he had referenced the True Martial Emperor, emanating an unsurpassed and immense aura.
But as the more than a million Purgatory True Demons perished, and including the four demon kings who were churned to pieces by the terrifying Golden War Sword, the so-called reinforcements still had not arrived.
Boom!
The tens of kilometers high black stele fell from the sky, compressing space-time and crashed onto the Devouring Overlord Halberd, pressing Left Demon down, causing the Void under his feet to collapse, his figure sinking.
In the midst of the raging Destructive Impact, the True Martial Heavenly King looked solemn as he glanced at the girl carrying four swords on her shoulder near Left Demon and suddenly asked in a low voice.
“How did you know the Eye of Eternity was with the Divine Gods Alliance?”
The eyes of Left Demon flickered with dark red lightning, his voice deep, “Tyris told me, said the Divine Gods Alliance had the Eye of Eternity.”
The True Martial Heavenly King frowned, “Tyris, it’s in the distant Heavenly Feather battlefield, how would it know about the Divine Gods Alliance’s existence, including the Eye of Eternity?”
Tens of years ago, Jonathan Walker, who had made a breakthrough to Heavenly King deep within the mythical world, suddenly returned and claimed he had obtained an ancient Secret Skill. If he could refine the Eye of Eternity, he would possess the strength to clash with the Demon God.
That ancient relic was with the Divine Gods Alliance, in the hands of the strongest Divine King, Tarodel.
Because of the trust in Jonathan Walker, the First Councilor, Adam Garcetti, personally intervened and entered the Divine Gods Alliance for negotiations, eventually bringing out the Eye of Eternity.
But what no one expected was Jonathan Walker’s subsequent betrayal, which shook the Human Race.
Boom! As they engaged once more, the Golden War Sword clashed with the Tyrant Halberd, his arms holding the Stone Tower blocked the horrible rule power of the True Martial Stone Tablet smashing the Void, the Heavenly Earth Law shaken within a radius of tens of kilometers.
In the center of the violent turbulence, Left Demon said in a deep voice, “Tyris has always been mysterious, unlike the other Purgatory Demon Gods. It’s not only terrifyingly strong but also knows many secrets.”
“Years ago, when I was exploring the depths of the Azure Mysterious Ruin, I obtained the Green Jade Heart and the Corpse Slayer Secret Method that could be carried in a human body. That’s when I encountered Tyris’s Abyss Demon God Avatar.”
“It was cultivating deep within the ruins and seemed surprised that I could practice the Corpse Slayer Secret Method. It told me to reach grand accomplishment with this Secret Skill, one must split themselves into three.”
“Moreover, it didn’t ask to subdue me at the time. Instead, it took me to the Purgatory Ancestral Court for a visit, where I met the Hibernating Purgatory ancestor…”
Left Demon paused, for it was precisely because of this reason that he had chosen ‘betrayal’ back then.
The Purgatory ancestor was too terrifying, its strength beyond the imagination of the Human Race, its mere aura distorting space-time and evolving a real abyss.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1415 - 1415 539
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1415: Chapter 539 Chapter 1415: Chapter 539 In front of that ancient Purgatory ancestor, what human race Heavenly Kings, what Supremes, even including the powerful Great Demon King Tyris, were not worth one blow.
“That avatar of the Great Demon King has actually appeared deep within the Azure Mysterious Ruin.” The True Martial Heavenly King’s doubts suddenly multiplied.
The Azure Mysterious Ruin was an ancient relic located to the west of the Divine Gods Alliance, deeper into the mythical world, more than five million kilometers away from the Human Territory.
This relic was shrouded in mystery, its existence counted in tens of thousands of years, with space-time distortions within its vast territory, visited by some of the human race king-level figures and Heavenly Kings.
For instance, War King Elmore Hall had once conducted closed-door cultivation within that relic, obtaining some sort of inheritance, which allowed him, at the Mythical Peak realm, to fiercely confront the Great Demon King.
Even the core of Number One, the incomplete heart of an ancient creature, came from the Azure Mysterious Ruin.
Under normal conditions, it was plausible for Tyris’s avatar, who was battling the Heavenly Feather Clan, to appear there, as they were diagonal from each other at a distance of about eight million kilometers.
But the True Martial Heavenly King always felt something was off and said gravely, “After you split into three back then, how long did it take you to reconstruct your true body?”
Left Demon replied in a deep voice, “I took three months to reconstruct my true body and stabilized my Legendary Realm cultivation in one year.”
“Only three months? Left God didn’t appear in the Divine Gods Alliance area until three years later, founding the Holy Light God Sect. Jonathan Walker only revealed his tracks five years later.”
“What was he doing during those five years?” The looks on the faces of the True Martial Heavenly King and Left Demon grew more profound.
Through the confrontation between the two ‘persons’, the events of the past not only failed to become clearer but seemed even more chaotic.
Suddenly, a Terrifying Killing Intent spread from Left Demon, his eyes turned blood red, and he uttered each word deliberately, “Don’t tell me, he was the one who damaged Runa’s foundation.”
Left Demon’s ‘he’ referred to Jonathan Walker in human form. Hearing this, before the True Martial Heavenly King could speak, Jane Aiken suddenly spoke up from atop his broad shoulders, like mountain ridges.
“If it was him, why didn’t he kill me when I encountered him on the Southern Battlefield?”
Ilisa Zabel, who appeared in the Southern Battlefield, seemed very aloof. After giving Jane Aiken guidance on the aspects of cultivation comprehension, her approach to Jack Clark was quite casual as well.
If he had been the one to harm Jane Aiken’s mother’s foundation, leading to her early death and the killing of his teacher and father-in-law, he should have been ruthless to his kin.
Jane Aiken’s words made the True Martial Heavenly King and Left Demon furrow their brows once again.
They said it as such, but since there was no issue, why was Jonathan Walker so eager to ‘kill’ Left Demon?
Just then, a formidable Demon God’s Will swept across the Firmament, causing Left Demon’s gaze to turn icy as a dark and fierce Power Explosion erupted within him.
Boom!
An endless darkness soared into the sky, covering Heaven and Earth, turning ten thousand kilometers around it into Abyssal Hell. The Earth shattered, and countless scorching hell magma surged to the sky.
At the same time, above the Firmament, a vast Abyssal Claw descended slowly, sealing off space-time.
“Where are you going!”
The True Martial Heavenly King roared with strength so terrifying that everything around him distorted and deformed, his might even more fearsome than that of an Ancient Middle Stage Demon God.
Boom! With one strike of the True Martial Divine Tablet, the sky-darkening demon claw shattered, and the Abyss World that enveloped ten thousand kilometers also exploded thunderously.
Within the chaos of the collapsing Abyss, the True Martial Heavenly King stood tall, bedecked in golden battle armor, resting his hand upon the Divine Stele with a ‘gloomy’ expression, because Left Demon had already fled.
“Hmph! Consider yourself lucky to have fled quickly today.”
The True Martial Heavenly King snorted coldly, then turned into a beam of golden light flying toward the direction of the Sky Base Fleet, the invisible aura emanating from his body constantly shaking Heaven and Earth.
By the time the True Martial Heavenly King returned, the cleanup of the battlefield here had already been roughly completed.
