Jack Clark, who had reverted to his human form, stood aloft over the battleship, his black hair dancing wildly behind him, talking with the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and others.
Seeing the True Martial Heavenly King appear out of the distorted space as if from nowhere, Jack Clark asked, “True Martial Senior, how did it go over there?”
“He escaped.”
“The situation with Jonathan Walker is a bit complex. I don’t feel I can fully trust him right now; we need to discuss the details when we get back,” the True Martial Heavenly King said with gravity.
That complicated, huh. Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
But no matter how complicated it was, if they were enemies, then they would just annihilate them all the next time they encountered them.
“By the way, Senior, hasn’t Student Aiken come back?” At that moment, Jack Clark suddenly remembered, as he thought he saw Jane Aiken standing on Left Demon’s shoulders earlier on.
“No, she left with Left Demon. She probably wants to investigate the past events herself,” the True Martial Heavenly King replied.
Jack Clark nodded.
The ‘world’ was erupting with major battles everywhere, and the situation was urgent, so as soon as the True Martial Heavenly King returned, the fleet set off once again.
Their destination was over eighty thousand kilometers away at the evacuation coordinates on the border of the Eternal Divine Domain.
However, even at the sky-based battleship’s regular tenfold the speed of sound, accelerating to thirtyfold with engines at full operating capacity, it would take at least one day to reach over eighty thousand kilometers away.
“Jack, you and I are the strongest here. I will expand the True Martial Domain to hasten the fleet’s journey at full strength,” the True Martial Heavenly King said solemnly. “You will take care of security at the front, while Mysterious Martial and Denny Kaye will look after the rear.”
“No problem, Senior,” Jack Clark replied solemnly.
Reaching the True Martial Heavenly King’s realm, where the rules are perfected, a One-side World had already been cultivated within his body to nurture rules, and those heavenly soldiers’ shadows during the battle were the projection of his world.
However, his world was different from the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane opened by Jack Clark; it lay between illusion and reality, the manifestation of his ‘path’, incapable of housing others.

chapters.title: Chapter 1416 - 1416 539_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1416: Chapter 539_3 Chapter 1416: Chapter 539_3 Even the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane that Jack Clark belonged to would result in death for any life below the level of myth if they entered due to the overly violent nature of the fundamental elements of lightning, fire, and wind that filled it.
And as the Plane expanded, under the weight of nurturing embryonic Rule Power, the encompassing strength of the four basic elements would become even more terrifying.
Boom!
Centered around the True Martial Heavenly King, a circle of golden light burst forth, distorting the space it passed over and forming a membrane of light that enveloped an area hundreds of kilometers wide.
Surrounded by the ‘World’s Power’, the flight speed of the thirteen sky-based battleships surged, accelerating infinitely as if space had lost all restraints, growing faster and faster.
Soon, the battleships’ flight speed surpassed a hundred times the speed of sound, transforming into a rhomboid streak of golden light that spanned Heaven and Earth.
As a result, the strength of the True Martial Heavenly King was rapidly depleting at an alarming rate.
It seemed that because the three Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings leading their armies had all been repelled by the Human Race, the fleet didn’t encounter any more powerful ambushes on their path.
The occasional Demon King or Great Demon King they did come across would flee far away before Jack Clark and his companions even made a move.
Number One sky-based battleship.
Upon the deck, after devouring the souls and flesh of over two million members of the Purgatory Demon Race, along with four Demon Kings and two Great Demon Kings, Number One’s usual form had swelled to over eight hundred meters. It was surrounded by a dense aura of blood light, its presence terrifying.
Underneath that fierce, natural-enemy aura, not only the Transcendence Realm cultivators, even the Mythical Kings like the Morning King felt uncomfortable and dared not approach.
However, while others feared, Jack Clark did not care.
Amidst the thick blood mist, Jack Clark stood on Number One’s shoulder, tapped on its cold armor, and curiously asked, “Freya Louise, how many Great Demon Kings does this guy need to eat before it can recover to the Supreme Realm?”
Hum! Number One tilted its head slightly downward, its eyes glowing with blue and white radiance as it looked towards Jack Clark, with Freya Louise’s somewhat blurry voice emanating from within.
“It feels like it would have to devour the souls and flesh of another hundred million from the Purgatory Demon Race, or the souls and flesh energy of twenty Great Demon Kings, to recover to Supreme status,” she said.
“A hundred million from the Purgatory Demon Race, twenty Great Demon Kings!” Jack Clark exclaimed in surprise at those words.
Twenty Great Demon Kings were equivalent to twenty Titan Beasts, and if you combined all the Great Demon Kings currently at war with the Human Race from the two Purgatory Empires, they might total that number.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon, having almost traversed the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region, had only encountered just over a dozen Titan Beasts, which gives some idea of how rare such beings are.
Except in this dangerous battlefield where civilizations clash, it was virtually unheard of for Great Demon Kings to appear in groups.
Suddenly, Jack Clark said, “What about a Demon God?”
“A Demon God, Jack Clark, you want to help me catch a Demon God to eat?” Freya Louise’s voice came through from within Number One, sounding somewhat shocked.
At the same time, the blue and white radiance in Number One’s eyes intensified, hinting at an innate excitement that began to vibrate, causing the surrounding blood mist to tremble.
“If it could devour one Demon God, absorbing its Rule Origin, Number One’s strength should be able to reach the pinnacle of Heavenly King level, and devouring two could potentially bring it to the Supreme level.”
Freya Louise’s tone turned excited.
“Cough! Don’t get too worked up, I was just asking,” Jack Clark coughed dryly, not daring to guarantee he could capture even one Demon God.
Suppressing and sealing a Demon God was more difficult than killing one; it required an overwhelming and comprehensive superiority, otherwise the Demon God would tear the Void and escape at the slightest mistake.
Like when Jack Clark was besieged by the three Demon Gods sent by Diorus but still managed to use a forbidden weapon to tear through the Void and escape into the chaos of Space-Time.
Demon God-level beings have even more varied and stronger means of ensuring their survival.
Otherwise, Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan would have long been hunted down to extinction.
Including that Extreme Realm Great Demon King, Jack Clark briefly merged with Time Reincarnation, annihilating it with a single strike but unable to seal it to feed to Number One.
Though he might not be able to catch a Demon God for Number One to eat just yet, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised by Number One’s capability of ‘transformation’ of energy.
It seems that eating just two Demon Gods would allow it to reach Supreme Level, akin to a Titan Level Destruction Emperor Dragon consuming two Ancient Beasts and breaking through to become ancient.
Of course, there are significant differences between them.
For example, an Ancient Emperor Dragon could only consume ‘flesh and blood’ for transformation, incapable of refining souls, and for Number One, it wasn’t growth but a recovery of ‘injuries’.
“There’s likely another big battle coming. Continue your digestion process; I also need to make some preparations,” Jack Clark said.
After giving Freya Louise a nod, he flew down from Number One’s shoulder and landed on the battleship’s deck.
In front of the battleship, a black broken battle axe a thousand meters long lay across the deck, but rather than lying flat, it floated about ten meters in ‘low altitude’.
Around the battle axe, purple lightning jumped about, supporting it, because if it truly fell onto the battleship, the sky-based battleship would immediately shatter.
After all, this was a weapon that contained a fragment of a world.
Standing before the battle axe that was akin to a small mountain range, Jack Clark pondered whether to fuse this weapon with the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd or feed it to the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane.
But after only a short contemplation, Jack Clark had made his decision.
The formidable Eight Desolate Battle Halberd could immediately enhance his own power, whereas if the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane ‘devoured’ it, the expansion of the Plane and the elevation of the Supreme Law would be slower.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s four-meter-long black-gold battle halberd appeared in his hands, causing space around him to suddenly sink, invisible razor edges tearing open black cracks in the air.
At the same time, a row of transparent text appeared in front of Jack Clark.
“Do you wish to expend ten thousand Points Attribute to smelt the current weapon and enhance the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1417 - 1417 539_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1417: Chapter 539_4 Chapter 1417: Chapter 539_4 Since he enhanced the Eight Desolate Halberd to legendary level, Jack Clark had not used the weapon enhancement feature again.
And at his current level of cultivation, many secrets no longer needed to be concealed, such as his ability to quickly “refine” weapons, melting down his own weapon.
“Melt down.”
As Jack confirmed, the remaining attribute points on the transparent page instantly dropped from 10494 to 494, while a surge of violent enhancement energy appeared out of nowhere in his body.
Boom!
The moment Jack’s hands emitted a white radiance like flames, enveloping both the Eight Desolate War Halberd and the Black Battle Axe, the Black Broken Battle Axe struggled fiercely.
Within the Battle Axe, an energy burst forth, comparable to a Heavenly King’s, forming rings of black shock waves that shattered space, trying to break free from the white flame.
This white flame was not only the energy burn of attribute points but also contained the spirit qi of Jack himself.
Jack simply pushed down with his palm, and a formidable strength suppressed the Black Battle Axe, the invisible aftermath not even affecting the swiftly flying battleship.
The commotion on Jack’s side immediately drew the attention of Freya Louise, other cultivators, and the patrolling fleet’s Morning King and others.
With the discernment of Morning King and others, they realized right away that Jack was refining that demonic weapon.
But be it Morning King or Mysterious Martial Sky King, they didn’t think too much, assuming Jack was simply refining it to make it easier to put away.
Under normal conditions, even True Martial Heavenly King would need a year or two to refine a Pseudo-World Level demonic weapon.
Furthermore, because of attribute mismatches, the weapon couldn’t unleash its full power after being refined, and it could even slightly impact the user’s own path.
As the Human Race fleet quickly flew toward the evacuation point, in the outskirts of the Eternal Divine Domain, surrounded by a Golden Crystal Wall, golden rings rippled across the sky, launching one warship after another.
At this moment, about three million elite members of the Heavenly Feather Clan gathered here, along with over forty Mythical Powerhouses, and eleven figures emanating the aura of Main Gods.
Among them was Bordea, who had previously encountered Jack Clark.
With the power of the Eternal Divine Tree’s rules, Bordea reached here even faster.
However, both Bordea and Anstice, who had clashed with two late-period Great Demon Kings using early stage Main God realm strength, looked rather somber.
Among these elite members of the Heavenly Feather Clan, an intense atmosphere of sorrow pervaded.
At that moment, a woman with two pairs of white light wings on her back, exuding the aura of a peak Ninth Tier, rose into the sky, her expression sorrowful, as she came before Anstice and the others.
“Princess Anstice, and all the esteemed lords, do we still have hope now that we are leaving?”
Upon hearing this, countless members of the Heavenly Feather Clan looked up, anxiously turning their gazes towards these mighty Main Gods, hope flickering in their eyes.
Anstice nodded calmly, “Yes, we are simply evacuating ahead of time. After we leave, the God Lords will follow.”
“The Eternal Divine Tree on the Human Race’s side has successfully taken root, and under the collision of forces between the Human Race World and the Mythical World, it’s growing rapidly.”
“Once we get there, we just need to recuperate for a while, and we will quickly regain our vitality.” Anstice’s words brightened the eyes of the Heavenly Feather Clan members.
However, what these people didn’t know was that there wouldn’t be any big group following them; the more than ten million who were fighting the Purgatory Demon Race had all been abandoned.
The majority of those left behind from the Heavenly Feather Clan were the ‘old, weak, sick, and disabled,’ including twelve Main Gods and more than thirty resurrected Mythical beings.
As for the Divine Kings, likely only three would be able to leave in the end.
At this moment, Bordea spoke in a grave tone, “You have also witnessed the strength of the Human Race, with their base we can boost our combined strength. Even if the Demon Clan catches up to us, they won’t be able to do anything.”
Indeed, the members of the Human Race were powerful; many of the Heavenly Feather Clan members who had witnessed Jack Clark’s display of Divine Might nodded subconsciously.
Just a single legion from the Human Race’s reinforcements, boasting the strength of two beings on par with Divine Kings and only tens of thousands of Transcendent cultivators, were able to command an army of a million special forces in battle.
Especially that Human Expert named Jack Clark, who was freakishly strong; slaughtering demon kings and the Great Demon King as if he were slaying dogs, unstoppable by anyone.
From this, one could see the might of the Human Race, presumably not weaker than the Heavenly Feather Clan’s peak civilization.
“Alright, everyone rest while you can. We might face a pursuit battle next.”
“Yes.”
While those elite Heavenly Feather members sat cross-legged to recover, the standing Heavenly Feather Gods and Main Gods watched ahead with solemn eyes, their gaze penetrating the thick Gold Wall Realm.
Outside the Boundary Wall, four Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, regardless of the cost, were fiercely battling two Demon Gods, seemingly having the upper hand but accumulating heavier injuries themselves.
They could only watch, for a battlefield of Divine Kings wasn’t something they could interfere with.
“The Human Race army is here.”
[There are a few hundred words left to conclude, please wait half an hour for the update]

chapters.title: Chapter 1418 - 1418 540 The Nine Layers Annihilation Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1418: Chapter 540: The Nine Layers Annihilation Dragon, Slaying the Demon God Chapter 1418: Chapter 540: The Nine Layers Annihilation Dragon, Slaying the Demon God “`
Within the golden crystal wall, thousands of golden battleships of varying sizes flew in the sky, each at least a kilometer in length, crowded with dense ranks of elite warriors from the Heavenly Feather Clan.
On the edge of the Heavenly Feather Legion were more than a dozen black battleships, each stretching over ten kilometers in length.
At that moment, above ten thousand meters in the sky, the Main Gods of the Heavenly Feather Clan looked down, their gazes falling upon the Number One battleship located tens of kilometers away.
There, purple lightning leapt and intertwined with golden-white flames, forming a kilometer-wide sphere of light that isolated the inside from the outer world.
Although the view inside was unclear because of the barrier created by their Laws World, Boris and other Main Gods faintly sensed an obscure, terrifying aura emanating from within.
This aura was powerful, resembling a million-year-old volcano on the verge of eruption, harboring earth-shattering destructive energy.
However, previously their attention had been solely on the True Martial Heavenly King and the Mysterious Martial Sky King, so they had not noticed it.
The towering black-red colored mech behind the light globe also caught the attention of many Main Gods, particularly the red Killing Intent surrounding Number One, which carried within it the resentments of several Great Demon Kings.
This Human Clan Biological Mecha had killed Great Demon Kings, and not just one.
As those Heavenly Feather Main Gods were surprised by the remnants of resentment on Number One, the Great Sun True Flame and Purple Heaven Thunder that formed the Law World suddenly contracted, revealing Jack Clark’s figure.
Hum! A ring of black radiance exploded from the center where Jack was standing, causing the whole world to shake slightly, and a dark golden transparent giant star emerged behind him.
The moment the giant star shadow, a thousand kilometers in diameter, appeared, a crushing presence that seemed to collapse Heaven and Earth spread out.
Boom!
Beneath the dark golden shadow of the giant star, all the battleships and warships were jolted violently, sinking tens of kilometers, with the cultivators and members of the Heavenly Feather Clan on board all turning pale.
Fortunately, the oppressive aura disappeared as quickly as it came, but even so, over a million ‘people’ were left pale-faced, sprawled on the decks, powerless.
“A Pseudo-World Level Weapon!” Anstice and others gazed upon the weapon in Jack’s hand, feeling the heavy World’s Power emanating from it, somewhat surprised.
For someone just in the early period of being a Main God to have crafted a Pseudo-World Level weapon, this Human Clan Genius wasn’t only frightening in combat strength and astounding in cultivation speed but was also skilled in weapon forging.
Not just Anstice and others were taken aback at that moment, but so were the Mysterious Martial Sky King and others, somewhat astonished.
No, wasn’t it said that transforming a basic demonic weapon would take at least several years? How had it been just a few hours since Jack Clark had refined the Battle Axe?
And it was even fused with his original War Halberd.
While everyone was in shock, Jack Clark also slightly lowered his head to inspect the weapon he had reforged in his hand.
After the fusion with the black Battle Axe, the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd underwent significant changes, its usual length of four meters grew to 4.5 meters, and its appearance becames more ferocious.
Originally, the halberd shaft with Black Gold Dragon Scale Patterns turned into layers resembling black armor, wrapped with parched and burning Earth patterns.
The halberd’s head, as dark as ink, radiated an extremely sharp edge, while the side blades designed for cleaving became thicker, resembling elongated axe blades.
At the same time, on the War Halberd, a row of transparent text only visible to Jack appeared.
Weapon: Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd[Pseudo-World Level, a powerful weapon forged from a small world, possessing the four major attributes of heavy weight, solidity, sharpness, and Opening the Heavens.
Regular functions: Evil-Repelling Demon Light, size can be altered at will
World Heavy Pressure: The original ability to infinitely increase weight combined with a small world, bestowing extreme heaviness to itself, creating an oppressive field with ultimate density and weight, bursting everything within.
Note: When an enemy’s pure strength is weaker than that of the wielder, a ‘world collision’ knock-back effect will occur.]
After the fusion with the black broken Battle Axe, the change in the ‘attribute’ of the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd was simple, merely gaining further enhancements based on its original foundation.
For example, the original properties of weight and solidity, as well as its ability to infinitely increase in weight under the domain and World’s Power to form a heavy-field, were all enhanced.
Of course, both the previous ‘infinite’ weight increase and the current World Heavy Pressure ability of the Eight Desolates Halberd had a limit.
Otherwise, if there really were no limit and it continued to infinitely increase in weight, the Eight Desolates War Halberd would have long turned into black hole material.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King still seemed somewhat incredulous: “Jack Clark, you’ve forged that dark Battle Axe you seized with your War Halberd!”
Coming back to his senses, Jack gave a slight nod: “Yes, that axe would have been useless for me to keep, so it’s better to refine it to strengthen my weapon.”
“You really are a monster.”
The three Heavenly Kings exclaimed.
As they spoke, Jack’s figure flashed instantly before everyone, holding a halberd, his black hair stirring without wind, his handsome features peerless, looking like a True God that had descended from ancient times.
“Bordea, Anstice, and all of you, greetings.”
“The Divine Martial Throne is too polite.”
After some brief exchanges among the crowd, Bordea explained their evacuation plan to Jack in simple terms.
This included abandoning over ten million elite main forces, more than thirty ‘old and weakened, ice-encased’ mythical beings, nine Main Gods, and two mythical beings and a Peak Divine King who were not planning to leave.
Even someone like Jack was shaken by the resolute decision of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Looking at Anstice, Jack spoke with some gravity: “In doing so, wouldn’t your clan be severely weakened? And by abandoning so many of your people at once, aren’t you concerned about the opinions of other ‘people’?”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1419 - 1419 540 The Nine Layers Annihilation Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1419: Chapter 540: The Nine Layers Annihilation Dragon, Slaying the Demon God_2 Chapter 1419: Chapter 540: The Nine Layers Annihilation Dragon, Slaying the Demon God_2 Speaking of this, Jack Clark looked toward the several million elite soldiers in the distance.
“Today, the higher-ups are willing to abandon more than ten million people to retreat. Tomorrow, they could abandon them again due to other threats. Under normal conditions, this would absolutely lead to the dissolution of military morale and the collapse of the tribe.”
“By then, even if we establish a firm footing in the Human Territory, the combat power of this remnant of the Heavenly Feather civilization may plummet, and many traitors may even emerge.”
“Like the Human Race now, the unity in the face of external threats is entirely due to the Federation’s collective resolve, from king-level strong men to ordinary Transcendent soldiers—all are equally valued.”
So, it wasn’t just Jack Clark with this concern. True Martial Heavenly King and the others actually shared it as well.
“Rest assured, the situation you worry about will not occur within our Heavenly Feather tribe,” Anstice explained softly.
“Our Heavenly Feather tribe is one with the divine tree. Each member, upon making a breakthrough to the Seventh Tier, Ninth Tier, Myth, and even Main God-level, will return once to the divine tree.”
“Each time we briefly merge with the divine tree, the Life Mark we leave within it is optimized once again.”
“Should we fall one day, die, the divine tree will use our left behind Life Mark to re-cultivate a new body on the existing foundation.”
“Therefore, for us, death is only a cycle. As long as the divine tree exists, we have hope of Resurrection.”
“…!!” This time, whether it was Jack Clark or True Martial Heavenly King or Mysterious Martial Sky King, all were somewhat shaken.
That Golden Divine Tree, with a ‘body’ at the True Spirit Level, actually possesses such a perverse ability, akin to an infinite save point.
But just as his face revealed surprise, Jack Clark reacted, “No, if the Eternal Divine Tree is really so powerful, how could your Heavenly Feather tribe fail to overcome the Purgatory Empire?”
“Of course, it’s not that simple,” Anstice said with a wry smile. “The cost of this kind of resurrection is huge, not only requiring a tremendous amount of Life Energy but also the resurrected ‘Person’ only maintains basic information.”
“As for the past cultivation, cultivation experience, memory, all are gone. To say it’s resurrection, it’s actually like completely becoming another ‘Person’.”
“Only Main God-level strong men can retain some of their cultivation and memories. The stronger they are, the more they retain. For instance, if I were to die, my resurrection should grant me the strength of the early Myth stage.”
“Therefore, the divine tree prioritizes cultivating strong men above the Myth level. However, this kind of resurrection consumes too much. Over hundreds of years, the divine tree has only re-cultivated just over twenty Myths (Main Gods) and two Main Gods (Divine Kings).”
“As for those ordinary tribe members, their Life Marks are still frozen. Only when one day there are no threats from the Outer World and Life Energy is abundant will they have the chance to be reborn.”
So that’s how it is. Jack Clark and the others nodded, feeling slightly relieved but also a touch of regret.
The resurrection ability of the Eternal Divine Tree is too perverse, like a save point in a game. Once strength Breakthroughs are made, it’s possible to update the Life Mark, and upon death, one can be reborn according to the Life Mark.
However, the cost of rebirth is too great, losing all cultivation and memories. It’s better to say it’s ‘resurrection’ than to say they have entirely become another person.
But even so, this function is immensely important for a civilization, equivalent to optimizing the racial gene pool time and again, making overall improvements.
If humanity also possessed this ability, with the Human Race’s talent and development speed, it’s possible that one day everyone could achieve ‘God-level’ talent and become a divine race!
Hiss! Thinking this, Jack Clark and True Martial Heavenly King looked at each other.
The Eternal Tree Sapling in the Human Territory must be safeguarded; it is the key to humanity’s quicker rise in the mythical world. After addressing the crisis of the Purgatory Demon Race, opportunities to negotiate and study this should be sought.
In the midst of their conversation, distant golden ripples flickered, as an army composed of dozens of warships entered the scene.
At the same time, Jack Clark and the others noticed that the Golden Crystal Wall of the Eternal Domain became even more solidified, like an impenetrable shell intent on sealing everything inside.
At this moment, whether it was the Divine King of Light or those Demon Gods, all were buying time.
Unaware of the annihilation plan, Demon Gods like Tyris aimed to drain more of the Rule Origin of the Eternal Divine Tree, while the Divine King of Light was waiting for the crystal wall to strengthen to a limit.
Otherwise, with the strength of Demon God Level powerhouses, even if the Divine Realm were to collapse and explode, they would have the means to tear open the Void and escape at the first moment.
In the silence of all the ‘People’ waiting, a terrifying Power Explosion suddenly emerged from beyond the crystal wall.
Boom!
The True Demon God Body, which had been suppressed and battered by three Divine Kings, suddenly self-destructed. The self-destruction of an Ancient Middle Stage Demon God caused devastation within tens of thousands of kilometers, with the terrible Rule Burst tearing through the Eternal Divine Domain itself, shaking its foundational rules and causing the entire domain to wobble.
Under the powerful shock, the corner of the battlefield enveloped by the Divine Realm’s central rules also began to show gaps.
On the edge of the battle with the Divine King of Light, a Demon God from the ancient early stage paused in its gaze and turned toward a terrifying Demon God wielding a World-class weapon.
“Emperor Carotis, Bogtes and the others can no longer hold on. I wish to go and support them,” said the terrifying Demon God, over twenty thousand meters in height with three heads and more than thirty arms, looking back with an icy gaze then nodding slightly.
“Go then.”
“Yes.”
The Demon God bowed respectfully, then with a boom, shattered the golden cracks behind it and burst through the boundaries sealed by the power of the Eternal Divine Tree’s rules.
As for the departure of that Demon God, aside from the Divine King of Light furrowing his brow, the six Demon Gods including Tyris paid it no heed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1420 - 1420 540 Nine Layers Annihilating World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1420: Chapter 540: Nine Layers Annihilating World Dragon, Slaying the Demon God_3 Chapter 1420: Chapter 540: Nine Layers Annihilating World Dragon, Slaying the Demon God_3 Although the Demon God was already incomparably powerful, the strength of the ancient early stage was indeed not of much use here.
Instead of this, it would be better to go out and join forces to hold back those Heavenly Feather Divine Kings. Once they have dealt with the Divine King of Light, we can go and suppress those Divine Kings one by one.
Among the three great Purgatory Empires, apart from the Great Demon King Tyris, the realms of the other two Demon Gods in the Demon King Dark Sky Empire are also in the ancient late stage and middle stage, with the strongest strength.
Next is the Belvetan Empire, where the realm of the Lord of the Empire is at the ancient late stage, wielding a World-class weapon that reaches the peak of a Demon God, with two Demon Gods at the Ancient Middle Stage under his command.
And the Demon God of the ancient early stage that appeared just now comes from the Freymand Empire, whose Lord of the Empire is also at the ancient late stage, wielding a World-class weapon.
The Demon God whose True Body Rule had just exploded belongs to the Belvetan Empire and, along with another ancient middle-stage Demon God from the Freymand Empire, was besieged by four Divine Kings.
At the same time, the figure of the Demon God who self-destructed his rule True Body in the Divine King Battlefield began to condense again, only his aura was extremely weak, dropping directly to the mid-stage of a Demon God.
Unlike the demon king and Great Demon King, whose true bodies can be reformed only by consuming their origin after shattering, the Rule True Body of a Demon God is very important, being an integration of rules and “world.”
Once the True Demon God Body is blown apart, it is almost equivalent to foundational damage and requires countless resources and time to re-condense again.
“Not good!”
Watching the Demon God, who surged out of the core Divine Realm and rushed towards the Divine King Battlefield surrounded by endless Dark Demon Air, the faces of Anstice and others inside the Golden Wall changed drastically.
In a four-against-two situation, it took so long for the four Divine Kings to heavily injure one Demon God, and there was hope of slaying it.
But once another Demon God were to join, the combination of three Demon Gods would be enough to withstand the attack of the Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, managing to hold out until other Demon Gods could free up their hands.
“True Martial Senior, you go to help Divine King Salie and the others; I’ll handle that Demon God.”
“No problem, be careful as well.”
But in just an instant, Jack Clark and True Martial Heavenly King burst out with an earth-shattering aura and, without a second thought, prepared to take action.
“Open the Boundary Wall!”
Bordea and several Main Gods also reacted immediately, opening a crack in this Crystal Wall Small World with the origin force of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Boom! Boom!
The moment he stepped out of the Golden Wall, the form of True Martial Heavenly King surged violently, transforming into the ten-thousand-meter-tall True Martial Emperor clad in golden armor, with a black stele in hand, plunging towards the Divine King Battlefield.
And Jack Clark also revealed a thousand-meter-tall True Body, covering over a thousand kilometers with each step, charging towards the Purgatory Demon God that was twisting space and speeding along.
Seeing Jack Clark, who dared to face a Demon God at the early stage of a Main God, Anstice and other Heavenly Feather Main Gods, as well as the forty Mythical Powerhouses behind them, were all shocked.
Divine radiance burst from Anstice, who turned back to look at those Main Gods and Mythicals, “My Lords, the Divine Martial Throne of the Human Race dares to face a Demon God to aid our clan; shall we just stand by and watch?”
“Indeed, it’s our Heavenly Feather Clan that is the protagonist of this great battle. How can we shrink back today?”
At this moment, influenced by Jack Clark, all Heavenly Feather Main Gods and God-level strong men revealed intense Battle Intent in their eyes, throwing all plans out of their minds.
Including the millions of elite Heavenly Feather Clan members who looked towards those battleships spanning the Void and the figure rushing towards the Demon God outside the crack, they all filled with respect.
“We cultivators, why should we fear a fight.”
“Please lead us, my Lords, to battle against the Purgatory Demon Race once again, not retreating even in death.”
At that moment, millions of cries echoed throughout the entire Crystal Wall Small World, with powerful Battle Intent soaring into the skies, and everyone’s blood began to boil.
But just then, Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, Morning King, and others hurriedly spoke up to stop Anstice and the rest.
“My Lords, calm yourselves; our strength is ‘too weak’ to step into a battlefield of Demon God level would not only be no help to them but would be a hindrance instead.”
Anstice’s expression turned serious: “Of course, we are aware of our disparity with a Demon God, but the nobility’s Divine Martial Throne…”
“Jack Clark is different. After his breakthrough to Heavenly King, his strength has already surpassed his current realm, and it’s no problem for him to block a ‘regular’ Demon God.”
Just then, Jack Clark, who was already ten thousand kilometers away, had an immense golden gate emerge behind him, with dark gold dragon-shaped chains wrapped around it breaking apart continuously.
Boom!
The Heavenly Gate shattered, and endless dark golden Qi Blood gushed out, flooding into Jack Clark’s body, instantly enlarging his form to two thousand meters, with his whole body radiating dazzling dark golden light.
In an instant, a supremely heavy strength filled Heaven and Earth, and the whole world seemed to shake, with the surrounding space constantly bursting and shattering.
The unrestrained release of that terrifying aura shocked Anstice and the other Heavenly Feather Main Gods.
Dark Star Emperor Dragon Apocalypse Form.
Jack Clark had previously only opened the first Heavenly Gate, easily overpowering the initially evenly matched Great Demon King Hamdanman.
And just then, another golden gate appeared behind Jack Clark, with two vibrating dark gold dragon patterned chains, as if some terrifying entity were about to emerge from behind it.
Boom! As the gate shattered, a dark gold dragon-shaped shadow roared out from behind the door, its Dragon Roar filled with a dreadful oppressive force echoing across the entire Eternal World.
In an instant, Jack Clark’s aura surged again, with his form expanding once more; his True Body reached two thousand five hundred meters tall, with his whole person emitting a blinding dark golden radiance.
The body of the Apocalypse Dragon from behind the second Heavenly Gate, Jack Clark’s foundational strength and Defense, was enhanced by four times across the board.

chapters.title: Chapter 1421 - 1421 540 Nine Layers Annihilating World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1421: Chapter 540: Nine Layers Annihilating World Dragon, Slaying the Demon God_4 Chapter 1421: Chapter 540: Nine Layers Annihilating World Dragon, Slaying the Demon God_4 “`
The invisible but heavy aura emanated with such intensity that even the void cracked and creaked, unable to bear the weight.
But even this was not enough!
As Jack rushed toward the Demon God tens of thousands of kilometers away, he let out a long howl, and behind him, layers of Heavenly Gates appeared one after another, each more majestic than the last, towering behind him.
The beings that could become Imperial Demon Gods were indeed terrifyingly powerful; even if they couldn’t fight across levels, their strength was rare among those in the same realm, and they were not something that the Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings could compare with.
Moreover, the Great Demon Kings from the three major empires possessed Pseudo-World Level Weapons, and naturally, so did this Demon God.
With the enhancement of a Pseudo-World Level Weapon, they at least possessed the combat power of a Mid-period Demon God. Therefore, Jack dared not take any chances and immediately prepared to enter his strongest form.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
As the layers of Heavenly Gates shattered, dragon shadows containing the power of the Dark Star Apocalypse Dragon roared forth from within, pouring into Jack’s body.
In an instant, Jack’s aura surged limitlessly, and his True Demon God Body rapidly expanded, transforming into a terrifying figure tens of thousands of meters tall.
He maintained a form with three heads and eight arms, his body covered in nearly luminous dark golden battle armor. His hair, which extended for thousands of kilometers, was ablaze with dark golden flames, making his entire being seem composed of radiance.
The blinding brightness almost rendered this world purple-gold in color, while a vast and profound aura filled the Heaven and Earth, imparting a sense of overwhelming solidity.
Such an appalling aura surprised even the four Divine Kings and two Demon Gods, as well as the True Martial Heavenly King who were truly battling in the distance.
Anstice, Bordea, and the other Heavenly Feather Main Gods, along with Denny Kaye, Mysterious Martial Sky King, and others also widened their eyes in disbelief.
To think that someone with early Heavenly King realm strength could rival that of an early-stage Demon God was one thing, but now there was also such a terrifying ‘Secret Skill’ for an outburst of power.
In this moment, the magnitude of Jack’s might gave them the impression that he could slay a Demon God, as if this wasn’t the strength that someone who had just made a breakthrough to the Heavenly King realm should possess.
At this instant, Denny Kaye and the others began to doubt themselves for the first time, wondering if they were truly worthy of being called Heavenly Kings.
How could there be such a vast difference between individuals who were all Heavenly Kings?
Boom!
Wrapped in dark golden ‘Rule’ ribbons of light, Jack moved, and the world shook ceaselessly with him. With just one step, he crossed tens of thousands of kilometers, and in a few flashes, he appeared outside the range of the million kilometers of that Demon God.
Watching the encroaching abyssal darkness of the Dark World from afar, Jack’s hand magnified in synchrony; the dark golden War Halberd, spanning over twenty thousand meters, blazed with intensified radiance.
Thud!
A Halberd Skill of hundred thousand meters spanned the sky, darkening all else. In that moment, the entire world was left with only that dazzling War Halberd.
Under the force of the terrifying power, space shattered extensively, exploding into nothingness and forming violent gales, creating an extensive Dark Passage over ten thousand kilometers long, plummeting towards that Demon God.
Due to the overwhelming power, time itself seemed to lose meaning, and in almost an instant, the strike appeared above the Demon God’s head.
“Human, courting death!”
Ecosela roared furiously, his True Demon God Body, towering tens of thousands of meters high, erupting with endless black light, forming Abyss Rule Chains wrapped around his warhammer in his hands.
Simultaneously, his twelve arms flared angrily, with countless demon patterns ablaze in red light, reaching out towards the sprawling Abyss World in all directions with a fierce claw.
The several thousand kilometers wide Abyss World trembled thunderously, revealing four immense abyssal phantoms tens of thousands of meters tall, each exuding a majestic presence.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
The four abyssal phantoms roared as they, along with Ecosela’s attack, met the War Halberd descending from the sky.
Facing Jack, who began his offensive with grand attacks and emitted a terrifying aura, the Purgatory Demon God did not dare underestimate him and also unleashed his bloodline Divine Power, the Abyss Dark Demons, at the first opportunity.
These were phantoms formed by the combination of his bloodline Divine Power and Abyssal rule, each capable of unleashing an attack comparable to an early-stage Demon God.
Though they would vanish after one strike and consume a great amount of bloodline energy, their power was truly daunting.
But just as the massive, mountain-sized Dark Battle Hammer, along with the four Abyss Dark Demons, clashed with the dark golden War Halberd, Ecosela’s eyes bulged with rage.
He felt an indescribable oppressive force exploding forth.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Under the terror of such force, space-time collapsed, everything exploded, and the Abyss Dark Demons shattered. Following that, the Rule Chains wrapped around the Dark Battle Hammer also disintegrated instantly.
Boom!
The overbearing force caused the thousands of kilometers wide Abyss World to explode, and Ecosela himself turned into a black light plunging from the sky, crashing heavily onto Earth tens of thousands of kilometers below.
In a flash, the Earth within a range of tens of thousands of kilometers fractured, with countless pieces of dirt and stone mixed with black light soaring to the heavens, resembling tsunamis hundreds of thousands of meters high, scattered to all directions.
The release of such terrifying energy caused cracks to spread outward in all directions, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, with a fearsome momentum.
Moreover, the force of this strike created a Vacuum pathway in the sky, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers in length and hundreds in width, an awe-inspiring sight.
This was the terror of a five-hundredfold increase in fundamental strength resulting from the shattering of the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gates.
In the midst of the violent waves of destruction, Jack’s feet stood upon the collapsing void, and with Speed Divine Power, he exploded at almost a thousand times the speed of sound instantaneously.
Roar!
From within the thousands of kilometers deep Earth, Ecosela, with his arms’ flesh and blood blown apart, howled to the sky, his eyes revealing a vicious and brutal glint as he saw Jack descending from above.
Bang! Bang!
Ecosela’s weapon-wielding arms exploded, forming a blood mist mixed with the power of rules, enveloping the Dark Battle Hammer, which instantly surged with a blood light.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1422 - 1422 540 The Nine Layers Dragon of World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1422: Chapter 540: The Nine Layers Dragon of World Annihilation, Slaying the Demon God_5 Chapter 1422: Chapter 540: The Nine Layers Dragon of World Annihilation, Slaying the Demon God_5 Beneath the illumination of the Dark Red Glow, it seemed as if a world emerged from the depths of the Earth.
Roar!
Ecosela roared once more, reaching out with two pairs of undamaged arms from behind and seizing the blood-ritual enhanced Dark Battle Hammer, instantly sinking in form.
Even that Demon God struggled somewhat to wield the Dark Battle Hammer, now fully activated and brimming with the World’s Power.
But its power was equally terrifying.
Below the Earth, a dark red ‘planet’ with a diameter of thousands of kilometers surged skywards, its fearsome power compressing space into transparent layers upon layers.
From a distance, it looked like a satellite plummeting to Earth at astonishing speed, with rings of spatial waves surrounding it as shockwaves.
Above the Firmament, a near-ray of Dark Golden Halberd Radiance descended from the heavens, delivering a heaven-shattering, earth-annihilating blow upon the dark red planet.
In an instant, Heaven and Earth fell silent, then the dark red planet shattered, followed by another pained roar from Ecosela.
Boom!
Terrifying Power burst in all directions, twisting space-time, devastating Earth, melting countless dirt and rock into magma that erupted thousands of kilometers.
This scene left the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Freya Louise inside Number One, and others utterly shocked.
In this moment, the strength displayed by Jack Clark nearly matched that of the seasoned Supreme Experts like the Sky-based God King. Such power was more than enough to be a pillar of a civilization.
And Jack had achieved all this in just over a year.
As the saying goes, ‘strike while the enemy is sick, and take their life,’ naturally, there would be no turn-based combat at this point where it was my halberd strike in exchange for your hammer blow.
The instant another strike suppressed Ecosela, Jack had already charged into the depths of the Earth.
Instantly, an even more terrifying battle erupted, with the force of the powerful strength causing the ground within tens of thousands of kilometers to shake like the sea’s surface.
In his Dark Star Emperor Dragon Apocalypse Form, Jack Clark, like a true Great Demon King, was unstoppable. The Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd, now at a Pseudo-World Level, was incredibly heavy.
Within the terrifying force of gravity, all was shattered, whether it be the power from the Abyss World or the Dark Rules—everything was blown apart.
Moreover, with the effect that[when the enemy’s pure strength was weaker than that of the wielder, a world-colliding blast would occur], Demon God Ecosela was nearly powerless to fight back.
In the blink of an eye, the Earth within tens of thousands of kilometers crumbled, countless dirt and rocks mingled with dark light soaring skyward, like tsunamis tens of thousands of meters high, being flung in all directions.
Under the release of terrifying energy, cracks spread in all directions, covering tens of thousands of kilometers, the momentum horrifying.
And the force of this strike, at the moment of its Burst, even created a Vacuum pathway in the sky tens of thousands of kilometers long and hundreds of kilometers wide, an astonishing sight.
This was the terror of the base forces amplifying by over five hundred times, following the shattering of the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate.
Amid the raging destructive waves, Jack Clark, with Void Annihilation beneath his feet, exploded at nearly a thousand times the speed of sound under Speed Divine Power.
Roar!
Thousands of kilometers deep within the Earth, Ecosela, with arms torn and flesh and blood blasted, looked up to the descending Jack, his eyes revealing a brutal, savage light.
Bang bang!
Ecosela’s weapon-wielding arms exploded, forming a Rule-powered blood fog that enveloped the Dark Battle Hammer, causing it to flare up with increased blood light instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1423 - 1423 541 Eternity Exile Destruction Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1423: Chapter 541: Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath Chapter 1423: Chapter 541: Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath As Jack Clark’s Void Double Pupils opened, the Void power burst forth from him, distorting space-time and enveloping the entire underground in pitch-black Void.
In the dark Void, a massive Black Gold vertical pupil emerged, resembling the ‘Heavenly Dao’ that ruled over the Void, its gaze cold and icy.
Under the gaze of the Void Double Pupils, amplified sixteenfold in might by the Void Rules, space-time came to a halt, transforming into an invisible force that pinned Ecosela in the Void.
At that time, in the midst of the Black Gold vertical pupils, a grey gate moved open, from which endless streams of grey Death Power surged forth.
Washed by the Origin of the Death Law, the remnants of Ecosela’s true body burst into a mist of blood, with the vitality within furiously draining away.
Even its Rule Origin-Tempered Divine Soul, which felt as tangible as reality, weakened at a terrifying rate, growing faint and translucent.
“How could I possibly die here?” Under that unprecedented intensity of the aura of death, the Divine Soul of Ecosela let out an angry roar.
Then, madness apparent in its eyes, Ecosela chanted and screamed, “I am willing to sacrifice everything to plummet into the Abyss, to embrace the darkness.”
“I am willing to become an Abyss Demon God, to devour all for the Supreme Abyssal Will, descend now, great and Supreme Dark World of the Abyss…”
Boom!
The Void World that had been generated by Jack Clark’s application of the Void Law shook, half of it shattering, as endless Dark Red Glow infiltrated, turning it into a terrifying Abyss.
The True Abyssal Descent.
This Abyss World was not one like those condensed by Tyris, Left Demon, and other demons; it was a real Supreme Abyss, just as terrifying as the Supreme Hell that Jack Clark controlled.
Under normal circumstances, as agents of the Abyssal Power, certain Purgatory True Demons of outstanding talent among The Purgatory Family could gain the right to pull on the Abyss.
Some strong demon kings, Great Demon Kings, and Demon Gods also qualified to draw upon the Power of the Abyss.
But becoming an agent of the Supreme Plane and pulling on the Supreme power is not without cost, much like the saying, “When you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss gazes also into you.”
These demon kings, once they become too entangled with the Abyss, will eventually be devoured by it.
Hence, in the later stages, even Great Demon Kings, and especially Demon Gods, begin to break away from the Abyss, and the Abyss Rules and Abyss Worlds they condense are exclusively their own.
For example, cultivators of the Human Race, though they cultivate using the Heavenly Energy of the mythical world, the Laws World they condense after reaching the Heavenly King Realm, and the Rules World that materializes upon breaking through to the Supreme, belong exclusively to them, not to the mythical world.
Although after forsaking the pull of Supreme Plane Power, the might of the Abyssal Rules they control may be somewhat weaker, they also possess relative ‘freedom.’
After all, those who can become Demon God Level beings are all individuals with monstrous talent and unparalleled pride, unwilling to bow to others.
But now, faced with the threat of death, this Demon God chose to give up ‘freedom,’ willingly sacrificing everything to the Abyss, to become a true Abyss Demon God.
“The Supreme Abyss, eh!”
A deep voice echoed through the Void, and as it did, the Hell’s Eye in the middle of Jack Clark’s left demon king facade slowly opened, and instantly, an equally terrifying power descended.
Above the Void, a blood-red crack tore open, spewing endless blood light that drowned everything, turning the pitch-black Void into a scarlet red.
Within the blood light that reeked of slaughter, there was a faint suggestion of a Supreme World descending, augmenting Jack Clark’s aura, which soared once again.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The clash between the two Supreme Plane powers caused the Void World, generated by the Void Law, to instantly shatter, as the entire thousand-kilometer deep underground went into a frenzy of shaking, with space-time itself distorting.
Above the shattered thousand-kilometer stretch of earth, the sky for tens of thousands of kilometers was covered by the Black Red Abyss and the Blood Red Hell.
This astonishing sight once again shocked Anstice and other Heavenly Feather Strongmen who were watching, astonished at the seemingly endless depths of his hidden strength.
Bordea looked towards the Mysterious Martial Sky King and expressed his astonishment, “I never imagined that a noble from the God-level throne could actually pull down the power of the Supreme Hell!”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King smiled faintly, “As a genius, Jack Clark’s fortune has always been good.”
“However, while the power of the Supreme Plane is strong, it also has some risks. If possible, try not to use it. When you have a chance, remember to remind the Divine Martial Throne,” Bordea cautioned.
As an ancient civilization, the Heavenly Feather Clan once had geniuses who became apostles of the Hell Plane, so they were not unfamiliar with the power of Supreme Hell.
While this Supreme power is indeed strong, almost like possessing an additional Higher-order Law Power later on, its downsides are also quite apparent.
The Heavenly Feather genius disappeared one day after reaching the peak of the Main God realm, leaving no trace.
And in the ‘records’ of the Eternal Divine Tree, his state was shown as neither alive nor dead, an unusual status that made it impossible to ‘resurrect’ him using the Life Mark.
It was as if he was confined and controlled by some powerful force.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King solemnly nodded, “Thank you for the reminder, Brother Bordea.”
As the Mysterious Martial Sky King and others solemnly ‘watched’ the battle, far below the nearly ten thousand kilometer deep earth, Jack Clark’s body suddenly became heavy.
Within the endless Dark Red Abyssal World, a colossal, planet-sized terrifying phantom slowly surfaced. It was the Supreme Will that the Demon God Ecosela had summoned through his sacrifice.
This mere apparition, as it began to appear, made all six of Jack Clark’s eyes reveal a solemn color.
This terrifying phantom was strong, its true body’s strength even surpassing that of ancient True Spirits. Just a whiff of descending Will was enough to make him feel an overwhelming urge to resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 1424 - 1424 541 Eternity Exile Destruction Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1424: Chapter 541 Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath_2 Chapter 1424: Chapter 541 Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath_2 But what did that matter, today no ‘person’ could stop him from slaying a Demon God.
“Scram for me!”
Jack Clark let out a long howl, as the pupils of his black-gold vertical eyes behind him dilated, the Void Power contained within the double pupils was drained in an instant.
Boom!
Under the gaze of the black-gold double pupils, half of the Abyss World that enveloped the world shattered, forming an endlessly deep, black and purple crack extending tens of thousands of kilometers.
The strongest power of the Void Death Pupil, Dimensional Exile.
It ripped open a gap that spanned the endless Void, banishing the enemy to an unknown dimension, never to return.
In truth, this move was somewhat superfluous, as any enemy not a match for Jack Clark would generally be overpowered and slain by him, making it unnecessary, while those stronger than him couldn’t be swallowed by the dimensional cracks.
Like the battle against Diorus and other Demon Gods when he was at the Legendary Realm.
Even if Jack used up all his Void Power and exerted his exiling force to tear dimensional cracks, they would just be shattered by the formidable true body of Diorus and the others.
But at this moment, what Jack faced was just a terrifying presence manifesting as a will, a body of nothingness wielding the power of the Abyss.
Boom!
The black and purple dimensional crack emitted a strong suction, enshrouding that towering shadow, and the pulling force from the infinite depths caused the will to let out an angry roar.
Surrounding it, endless demon gas converged, forming hundreds of dark red Abyssal Demon Pillars, reaching the heavens and drilling into the ground. Amidst constant collapse and reformation, they blocked the devouring pull of the dimension.
This will was trying to fill up the dimensional crack with Abyssal demonic aura.
“Get inside.”
The origin of the Void Law within Jack’s body burned, turning into raging Black Flames that poured into his black-gold vertical pupils, and under his gaze in an instant, space and time around that shadow crumbled.
Boom!
Having burned the origin of a Higher-order Law, with his increased strength and simultaneously enhanced talent, the might of the Void Annihilation reached a terrifying level.
Even that will filling Abyss World, along with the surrounding tens of thousands of kilometers of space, crumbled together.
Accompanied by a cry of outraged roar, that immortal will was devoured by the black and purple dimensional crack in an instant.
Suddenly, the Divine Soul of Ecosela, spiked in the Void, showed despair and fierce unwillingness in its eyes. It never imagined that one day it would fall at the hands of a ‘Great Demon King’ from an alien race who was only at the initial stage.
As the origin of the Death Law flooded, Ecosela’s Divine Soul became increasingly weaker, and its dissipating true body flesh and blood continuously turned into black powder and vanished.
Moreover, buried tens of thousands of kilometers deep into the Earth, surrounded by the oppressive force field of the distorted space, the two Demon Gods fighting with the True Martial Heavenly King and the others, as well as the six Demon Gods at the center of the Eternal Divine Domain battlefield, noticed nothing.
They could only sense that within this Supreme Abyss, Supreme Hell, forces were colliding unceasingly.
In the center of the crumbling area spanning over ten thousand kilometers, the ground collapsed, forming a pit over two thousand kilometers in diameter. From deep within the pit, dazzling light and powerful energy burst forth.
In order to slay the Demon God, Jack Clark nearly used all possible methods at his disposal, including seizing the perfect moment and location.
Compared to the Destruction Emperor Dragon crushing and tearing apart the Ancient Beast, Jack’s difficulty in slaying a Demon God was greater, as these Demon Gods had more ways to preserve their lives, along with the aid of comrades.
About an hour later.
Boom! The Abyss Plane above the Firmament suddenly collapsed, while the Supreme Hell erupted in a surge of blood light, the endless red light spilling over and engulfing the disintegrating Abyss.
At the same time, above the crumbling Abyss World, a dazzling Blood Moon emerged, slowly descending afterward.
This Blood Moon shadow was enormous, almost surpassing a thousand kilometers in diameter, its light nearly illuminated the entire Eternal World.
Instantly, all the Purgatory True Demons, the Vassal Races, Demon Kings, and Great Demon Kings throughout the Divine Realm, including the eight Demon Gods, all turned their gaze toward the Blood Moon.
Shock, terror, and disbelief filled the eyes of every Demon Eye.
The decisive battle had been raging, and the Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan had not died yet, but instead, one of their Demon Gods had fallen first.
This very moment, including Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, Freya Louise, and Damon Lopes, who was gravely injured lying in the battleship, were all astounded as they looked beyond the golden cracks.
They stared at where the Blood Moon had appeared.
Damon Lopes, pale-faced, couldn’t believe what he saw outside the window, nearly falling off the bed in his excitement, his lips trembling and words becoming incoherent.
“I, I can’t believe it, damn it, damn!” He laughed loudly, unable to hold back and turned into a bolt of Purple Thunder Light, flying out of the battleship, shouting loudly.
“Brothers, did you see that? My brother Callum, the Divine Martial Throne, has slain a Demon God, a Demon God indeed!”
At this moment, not just Damon Lopes, but all the cultivators aboard the thirteen battleships were trembling, their expressions excited and faces flushed with emotion.
Since the Human Race and The Purgatory Family started warring, both Supreme Level and Demon God Level powerhouses had been fighting for decades with mutual injuries, but never had a Demon God or Supreme fallen.
Unexpectedly, the first to slay a Demon God was not the strongest of the Human Race, the First Councilor, but Jack Clark.
“Divine Martial Throne is mighty.”
“Throne’s Divine Might, invincible!!”
Countless cultivators couldn’t help but cheer loudly.
The Human Race cried out in excitement, while the ‘people’ of the Heavenly Feather Clan were dumbfounded with shock. To reverse-defeat a Demon God at the realm of the Main God, these humans were just too horrifying!
“Amazing, so powerful!” Anstice stared at the distant Blood Moon, her flawless beauty showing uncontrollable shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 1425 - 1425 541 Eternity Exile Destruction Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1425: Chapter 541: Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath_3 Chapter 1425: Chapter 541: Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath_3 At this moment, it was Freya Louise within the Number One who remained calm, her gaze cold and distant as if she stood apart from the world, silently watching the great battle beyond the crystal wall’s cracks.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark and True Martial Heavenly King battled the Demon God, another Heavenly Feather Mythical Strong led an army through a portal.
By this time, almost everyone on the evacuation list had arrived.
…
Deep within the Earth, towering a hundred thousand meters high with three faces and six arms, Jack Clark stood holding a halberd, surrounded by dark golden light that formed dragon shadows, emanating a terrifying aura that could collapse heaven and earth.
To the left of Jack’s forehead, streams of World Origin flowed out from the blood-red eye of Hell.
One of the benefits of being a Hell Messenger was that after slaughtering the spokespeople of a Supreme Plane and devouring the power they invoked from that plane, a vast amount of Origin would reciprocate back.
Beyond that, Jack could keenly sense that the power of the Hell’s force he wielded had further enhanced, far stronger than the Higher-order Law on one side.
“35 streams of World Origin.” As Hell’s Eye ceased to surge with energy, Jack mused before looking down.
Within the hot bed of magma, a black warhammer was sinking and floating, the weapon of that Demon God, its level slightly higher than the black broken Battle Axe Jack had obtained.
Thump!
When Jack grabbed the black warhammer, a rebounding force burst forth, the invisible impact causing the surrounding scorching material to explode violently.
Yet, this power was directly suppressed by Jack.
Right away, Jack wielding a dark golden War Halberd tens of thousands of meters long, one arm held the now thousand meter long ‘small’ warhammer as he soared into the sky.
As Jack departed, the rule’s power that had been pressing down from his body ceased, causing the hollow extending kilometres down into the Earth to collapse instantly, with endless scorching material refilling the void.
As a beam of dark golden light, Jack burst from the ground, appearing above the vast sky, and instantly the surrounding air vibrated, forming rings of white air currents a thousand kilometers in diameter spreading outwards.
“That human.”
Witnessing Jack holding the battlefield of eternal darkness, the lords of the Purgatory Empire, including Tyris, all had icy gazes.
On a distant battlefield tens of thousands of kilometers away, the faces of the two Demon Gods, who were besieged by four Divine Kings and True Martial Heavenly King, changed dramatically.
Because Jack, with his earth-shaking momentum and terrifying speed, was hurtling towards them.
A Demon God, already wounded and being besieged by a Golden Winged Divine King and True Martial Heavenly King, displayed a look of determination, his arms behind him holding a glowing blue pearl brightly shining.
“Careful!”
The faces of True Martial Heavenly King and the Divine King who were besieging changed slightly.
The pearl in the hands of the Demon God came from a powerful race that had been eradicated by their empire, a Race Background Weapon that had been cultivated for thousands of years by that race.
Now with all its energy triggered, it formed circles of blue Rune Sequence Chains, radiating terrifying energy fluctuations.
Boom!
A blue Great Sun, a thousand kilometers in diameter, appeared between heaven and earth, unleashing endless destructive blue radiance, enveloping an area over ten thousand kilometers.
Under that apocalyptic blast, True Martial Heavenly King stood before a giant black stele tens of thousands of meters tall, which blocked the explosive impact capable of obliterating everything.
Another Divine King sprouted ten pairs of golden light wings, with rule’s power diffusing all around, solidifying into innumerable Divine Texts, indestructible.
As the Demon God self-destructed a piece of intrinsic forbidden weapon, an already heavily injured Demon God swiftly retreated in another direction.
Under the Dark Rules distorting space, the Demon God vanished tens of thousands of kilometers away in just a few blinks, leaving behind only a long howl lingering in the air.
“Bogtes, they outnumber and overpower us, I can’t aid you anymore.”
“Skadia!”
Seeing the escaping Demon God having fled tens of thousands of kilometers, the one named Bogtes whose true form had already been shattered roared in shock and fury.
“Bogtes, you’re not getting away today.”
Divine King Salie, whose true form stood over ten thousand meters tall, roared angrily, her ten pairs of Silver Light Wings erupting with light, silver flames burning fiercely as if ten silver blades were slashing through the void.
At the same time, the other two Divine Kings made a bold move.
One, with four pairs of golden light wings and an ancient early-stage realm, had over three thousand golden Divine Texts coalescing around him, forming a golden barrier that enveloped Bogtes.
The other, with five pairs of white light wings, condensed the light from Rule Chains in his hands, forming spears that pierced through the void and pinned Bogtes in place.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the united strike of the three Divine Kings, Bogtes’ true form exploded again, scattering flesh and blood across the void.
“Now’s the time, help me trap it.”
Divine King Salie shouted, her eyes filled with intense killing intent, the other two Divine Kings striking again; their rule’s force condensing into two vast figures a hundred thousand meters tall.
As those two sacred angelic visages clasped their hands together, the space around the area where Bogtes’ exploded true form lingered became frozen in time, forming a transparent diamond-shaped white-golden Crystal.
From behind Divine King Salie, flames burning on her Silver Wings furiously poured down into the crystal.
Within the time-sealed diamond-shaped transparent crystal, Bogtes’ Divine Soul attempted to erupt with powerful strength, struggling to break free but unable to escape the suppression of the three Divine Kings working together.
As the silver flames burned, its Aura grew weaker and weaker, letting out screams, “Emperor Carotis, save me!”
Boom!
On the Eternal Center Battlefield, the towering Divine Soul of a Demon God with three heads and thirty-two arms repelled the Golden Tree Root with a single strike, suddenly turning back, its gaze terrifying as it looked in this direction.

chapters.title: Chapter 1426 - 1426 541 Eternity Exile Destruction Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1426: Chapter 541 Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath_4 Chapter 1426: Chapter 541 Eternity Exile, Destruction Emperor Dragon Breath_4 “Skadia, you dare to flee the battle?”
The demon god, already twenty thousand kilometers away, stood tall above the Firmament with a calm expression and said indifferently, “Carotis, it’s not that I don’t want to abandon Bogtes; it’s just that the adversary is too strong.”
“Any later, even I would have perished there.”
Although Carotis was more powerful, this demon god was not under its command and was not very frightened by its anger.
At that moment, Tyris, who held the dark demon blade and had cut off a golden tree root, spoke indifferently, “Enough, Carotis. Once we deal with Metastat, not one of those divine kings or humans will escape.”
Compared to losing one or two demon gods, it was naturally more important to exhaust Metastat and obtain the Origin of the Eternal Divine Tree.
Hum!
At that moment, the entire Eternal Divine Domain began to vibrate slightly, and a thick layer of pure golden crystal wall emerged at the edge of the divine realm, exuding a sense of immovability and indestructibility.
As the crystal wall of the entire divine domain manifested, a long and profound horn sounded within the small world of the golden wall.
The small world also began to shake and collapse, and at the other end of the Golden Wall World, a crack channel leading directly to the outside mythical world appeared.
At the moment of the crack’s appearance, an old voice sounded in the ears of Anstice and others.
“Go.”
“God Lord!”
The eyes of these elite Heavenly Feather warriors revealed intense reluctance, and a sad atmosphere spread between heaven and earth.
However, those main gods of the Heavenly Feather tribe knew that time was pressing, and Bordea said with a solemn expression, “Mysterious Martial Tortoise, there’s no time to delay; let’s go, you all first.”
“All warships turn around, follow behind the allies’ fleet and retreat!”
The Mysterious Martial Heavenly King said with a solemn expression, “All engines full power, drive, go!”
Boom! The human race’s sky-based battleship roared into action, with sixteen engines at its tail spewing hot radiance, charging into the crystal wall channel with streaks of light trailing behind.
As the evacuation began within the Golden Wall Inner World.
Divine King Salie, with silver light wings aflame, eroding the residue of Bogtes the demon god, also looked calmly at the remaining three divine kings, True Martial Heavenly King, and the approaching Jack Clark.
“Gentlemen, you should leave as well.”
The divine king with ten white light wings behind him hesitated, “Brother Salie.”
Divine King Salie said calmly, “My Divine Soul is damaged, and my rules are shattered; even if I leave with you, I would fall into eternal hibernation.”
“Rather than that, it’s better to stay and give Metastat a hand. Each additional demon god we can keep back is a win for us.”
At that moment, the entire Eternal World began to shake, and the golden Boundary Wall emitted an ominous blood-colored light, with a terrifying Destructive Aura spreading out.
Looking at the world that had turned red, Divine King Salie said calmly, “Go. With the assistance of the Human Race and our allies, there is still hope for our Heavenly Feather Clan to rise again.”
The three divine kings sighed, saluted Divine King Salie lightly, and then looked towards the True Martial Heavenly King and the terrifyingly auraed Jack Clark.
“We are grateful for your assistance this time, and we hope to aid each other in the future to together withstand the coming Purgatory Demon calamity.”
The True Martial Heavenly King nodded solemnly, “Naturally.”
“Go!”
The conversations among the divine kings all happened in an instant; they did not hesitate after speaking, each distorting space and flying towards the distant Golden Wall small world.
Before leaving, Jack Clark looked regretfully at the fleeing demon god.
It’s a pity; that guy fled too fast. Otherwise, with him, the True Martial Heavenly King, and the three divine kings who could free their hands joining forces, that guy wouldn’t have escaped.
Bang! Above the sky, a piece of the crystal wall shattered, forming a deep red hollow. Outside the hollow was not the Void but a world filled with endless ominous red light.
Boom!
A red column of light hundreds of kilometers thick pierced through heaven and earth, and at the moment it struck, mountain ranges collapsed, and tens of thousands from the Purgatory Legion and a demon king were instantly eradicated.
Then came the second, the third, one after another, red beams of various thicknesses fell, and the entire world was thrown into a frenzied turmoil.
Destruction began.
Witnessing this scene, even Tyris couldn’t help but roar, “Deep Red Destruction, Metastat, you actually sacrificed the Eternal Divine Realm to the deep red plane.”
The other six Demon Gods also showed slight changes in their expressions.
Atop the golden divine tree, which towered tens of thousands of kilometers high, a figure shone with holy radiance, their gaze indifferent.
“You have always sought to annihilate my Heavenly Feather Clan, today I shall grant your wish, let us be buried here together with my tribe.”
Boom! The entire Golden Divine Tree shuddered, its surface coated with flames that burned fiercely, and in an instant, an even more terrifying destructive aura enveloped the entire Divine Realm.
The Earth collapsed, the firmament shattered, and the whole world seemed to be slowly devoured by a massive blood-colored maw.
Just then, the silently observing lord of the three major empires roared, “Metastat, do you really think we have no way to deal with you?”
Boom!
In an instant, the Demon God roaring with a Demon God Pillar in its grasp, tens of thousands of meters long and inscribed with countless Purgatory True Demon patterns, exploded with a terrifying power of heavenly rules.
“The Deep Red Destruction has only just begun, there’s still a chance, Tyris, Carotis and I will hold it off, you burst forth with your full strength to tear apart the Divine Realm.”
“Make your move.”
Carotis held back no longer, black and red rule chains intertwined as they shot into the sky from his body, forming a terrifying abyssal world behind him.
At the same time, the other three Demon Gods also burst forth with all their might, throwing themselves towards the Eternal Divine Tree.
In the instant the five Demon Gods unleashed their full strength, the cold-faced Tyris turned his gaze upon Jack Clark and the others who were about to flee into the Golden Wall World and were at the edge of the Rift Channel.
“Today, you all shall die.”
With a terrifying roar, the presence of Tyris’s True Demon God Body, tens of thousands of meters tall, pierced through the cloud sky, causing the entire Eternal World to tremble slightly.
At the same time, the Abyss Demon God, engaged in a mad struggle with the Eternal Divine Tree, let out an earth-shattering roar, turning and pouncing towards Tyris.
Boom!
As the two figures merged in an instant, space-time burst, Heaven and Earth quaked, and Tyris’s form swelled as he unleashed a terrifying pressure that suppressed the rules of heaven and earth.

The terrifying power neared that of a Demi-True Spirit.
Just then, Jack Clark, who was about to retreat and stood at the edge of the crack, summoned the space-time channel, and the hibernating Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly lifted its head and dealt a heavy injury to Tyris with a blast of mixed breath.
