chapters.title: Chapter 1427 - 1427 542 The Breath of the Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1427: Chapter 542 The Breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, The Return Ends Chapter 1427: Chapter 542 The Breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, The Return Ends As Jack Clark’s palm runes glowed during the summoning, one of the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, who was retreating, unfolded his five pairs of golden light wings and let out a long howl.
“We can’t let it break through, otherwise God Lord won’t be able to complete the Eternal Seal!”
Boom!
The aura of the ancient late stage burst forth from that Divine King’s body, as a pair of metal-cast, hundred-thousand-meter-spanning golden wings unfurled to his sides.
Around those wings, a line of the Divine Phoenix Lineage’s race background weapons, golden rune sequence chains wrapped around, emitting terrifying rule fluctuations.
The power of a tribe’s chief wielding an intrinsic weapon of their own race was more than ten times stronger than the race background weapon snatched by the Purgatory Demon God.
In the hands of that Divine King, the dual golden blades merged into one, transforming into a golden spiral light beam that shot out, radiating a sharpness to the extreme.
Because of the terrifying power contained within, space-time began to distort at the front section of the thousand-meter wide golden spiral, creating a backward-spinning impact.
By now, the fissure in the crystal barrier of the Eternal World had expanded to over twenty thousand meters under the power of the Dark demon blade. A ferocious roar echoed through space-time.
“Scram!”
Boom! With an unrivaled domineering slash, the golden spiral was shorn apart. Two golden radiance shot backwards, reforming into golden wings.
However, at this time those race background weapons’ glow was dimmed, with a large gash on both sides, almost being slashed in two.
As that Divine King’s strike was blocked, monstrous power converged inside the other two Divine Kings, including the True Martial Heavenly King, who were preparing to make their move.
Especially the True Martial Heavenly King, who held in his hands a black stele engraved with ‘True Martial,’ the phrase representing the talent of the Human Race, was now emitting terror-inducing fluctuations.
At this moment, everyone knew they had to stop that Demon God.
By then, Tyris had arrived near the fluctuating rift, his massive true body surrounded by three terrifying rune sequence chains, the demon power he exuded shaking heaven and earth.
Even separated by a world, and thousands of kilometers apart, the pressure made numerous elites of the Heavenly Feather Clan and human cultivators struggle to breathe, shaking their legs and paling their faces.
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s voice emerged: “Seniors, let me block it.”
As the Divine King attacked, beneath his feet, a ten-kilometer-wide gloomy blue altar had unfolded, and above his head, a huge distorted vortex appeared.
As Jack Clark’s strength increased, and was pushed to the limit enhancement, the power of the Space-Time Altar mark, now a talent rune, also surged exponentially.
At this moment, even the invisible waves emitted were causing the surrounding space-time to crisscross, forming another layer of a space-time anomaly.
Within that twisted space-time anomaly, a miles-long chain of dark gold mountain ranges sprawled, surrounded by powerful forces that obliterated all things, forming a black void spanning over ten thousand kilometers in diameter.
From afar, it resembled a miles-long Giant Beast lying in wait, its might terrifying to behold.
And most importantly, that terrifying ‘Giant Beast’ was slowly lifting its head, looking in this direction, and its opened maw shone with a predominance of black-red radiance.
Currently, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was in hibernation, progressing toward ancient breakthroughs, and naturally, Jack Clark wouldn’t forcibly awaken it unless necessary.
Otherwise, it would interrupt the Giant Beast’s advancement, not only causing problems with its evolution to an ancient creature, but it would also affect the nurturing core of the ten Higher-order Laws within its body.
But letting out a single breath was not an issue.
Boom!
From the maw of the dark gold ‘Giant Beast’, a kilometer-thick black-red light beam gushed out, the destructive power it emitted causing the very fabric of heaven and earth to tremble violently, fundamental rules shattering.
Such daunting might instantly awoke the slumbering, guardian Silver Giant Dragon, the golden blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc thousands of kilometers away.
As the three Giant Beasts woke with shock and confusion in their eyes, that fearsome breath shot through heaven and earth, vanishing into the twisted blue vortex in an instant.
At the same time, above the altar where Jack Clark stood, the space-time summon channel trembled wildly, the black-red light pillar bursting out, surrounded by spirals of black, red, blue, and golden energies.
The light pillar contained such extreme destructive power that it set everyone’s heart racing, ‘people’ and Divine Kings included.
From the deployment of Jack Clark’s Space-Time Altar to the attack’s execution, everything happened within an instant. The Breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon dominated space-time, and the blast flowed like a torrent into the fissure in the crystal barrier.
“Today, no one can thwart me.”
Boom!
An even more terrifying aura burst forth from Tyris, wielding the Dark demon blade, confronting the expanding breath that now filled the fissure with a slash.
Boom! In an instant, everyone felt the whole world shake, as blinding black-red radiance exploded between heaven and earth.
Instantly, everyone became deaf, unable to hear a sound, and their eyes were blinded by the intense light, seeing only whiteness, unable to see or hear.
After an unknown amount of time, people only felt the warships under them and the sky-based battleships trembling wildly, while the area where the True Martial Heavenly King and others were caused a horrifying rumble.
In the midst of the fearsome blast, Jack Clark and the others saw the terrifying breath strike directly hitting Tyris and blasting him tens of thousands of kilometers away.
At the same time, the surrounding crystal barrier, now a golden-red color, was healing at a terrifying speed, until only a roar imbued with a terrifying intent to kill echoed between heaven and earth.
“Human, I will kill you,”
With the crystal barrier completely healed, Tyris’s presence vanished, leaving only a golden-red Sky Curtain stretching across the front.
That Sky Curtain was in fact the manifestation of the Eternal Divine Domain in the mythical world, its edges now transforming into multi-faceted crystal barriers, rapidly being painted red.

﻿Chapter 1428: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_2 Chapter 1428: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_2 “`
Boom! Just as the entire Eternal World Crystal Wall was completely stained red in an instant, space-time trembled, and the whole Eternal Divine Domain soared ‘up’ into the air.
At that seemingly unreachable apex which vanished into the Void with a speed both seemingly slow and astonishingly fast.
From afar, it looked like a colossal red maw in the Void had opened, devouring the two million plus kilometers in diameter of the Eternal Divine Domain in a single gulp.
Such a majestic sight shocked even Jack Clark and the True Martial Heavenly King.
Not to mention Damon Lopes and the other cultivators, as well as the members of the Heavenly Feather Clan, all of whom watched the scene with their mouths agape.
Two million kilometers, nearly a third larger than the sun in the Solar System where Blue Star resided, was now being devoured by an unknown and terrifying ‘Giant Beast’.
Suddenly, all the members of the Heavenly Feather Clan, including the Mythical Powerhouses and the Main Gods, all knelt on one knee, and the three Divine Kings as well, solemnly saluted the world that was being devoured.
Then Mysterious Martial Sky King suddenly asked excitedly, “Bordea, is it possible that your noble’s Eternal Annihilation can prevent those Demon Gods from escaping?”
Instantly, Jack Clark and the True Martial Heavenly King turned their heads to look as well, their gazes flickering.
If such a terrifying move could bury all the Demon Gods of the three Purgatory Empires, as well as all the demon kings and great demon kings including the millions of elite troops, the pressure on the Human Race would be greatly reduced afterwards.
They could even launch a counterattack upon their return and directly destroy and annihilate the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire and the Grita War Demon Empire.
With the three current supreme powers of the Human Race, comparable to Demon Gods like Jack Clark and the True Martial Heavenly King, and the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, who also possessed the strength of Divine Kings, along with the Lord of Holy Light.
In terms of overall high-end combat power, they had already overwhelmingly suppressed the two Purgatory Empires.
The four Demon Gods of the two Purgatory Empires, plus a possible one or two Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings, were no match for the current Human Alliance.
The only concern was the Purgatory Family and the other civilization engaged in battle with the three major empires.
The Human side did not know much about that situation, whether they were still evenly matched with the three major empires or, like the Heavenly Feather Clan, were on the brink of extinction.
In response to Mysterious Martial Sky King’s question, Bordea gave a wry smile.
Before Bordea could speak, the Ancient God King who had taken action earlier sighed, “It’s difficult; the depth of the Purgatory Family’s roots is far greater than we could have imagined.”
“This time, Metastat merged with the Eternal Mother Tree, seeming to wield Divine Might that reached the realm of legendary Ancient Gods, able to take on seven, but that’s just the surface.”
“Neither Metastat nor the Eternal Mother Tree are at their peak.”
“Metastat has even cut out a piece of Rule Origin in preparation for their upcoming resurrection, while the Mother Tree had long since stripped away its heartwood.”
“Moreover, for the sake of sealing all the elites of the three major empires and preventing those Demon Gods from escaping, the Mother Tree used the remaining Rule Origin to solidify the crystal wall.”
“Therefore, even if Metastat and the Mother Tree burn together, under the joint hands of Tyris and the other two Lords of the Empires, at most, they could only kill one more Demon God.”
“As for the life and death of the other Demon Gods and the great demon kings, it depends on the might of the legendary Deep Red World that has destroyed countless worlds.”
“It’s possible that all the elites of the three major empires will be annihilated, leaving only the Lords of the Empires to escape back, or it’s possible that half of the elite forces of the three major empires will be unharmed.”
“But either way, those Demon Gods will be trapped in the Deep Red World for a short time and unable to return.”
“I see.”
The True Martial Heavenly King and people like Jack Clark nodded thoughtfully.
It was clear that the Heavenly Feather Clan had left themselves a way out with such a decisive sacrifice, whether it was that Peak Divine King or the Eternal Divine Tree.
And this was also the surprising factor for Tyris and the other War Demons.
Their goal in this civilizational battle was to kill most of the elites of the Heavenly Feather Clan, including Mythical, Main Gods, and Divine Kings, but not Metastat.
As an existence at the zenith of Divine Kings, the strength of this civilization’s leader was unfathomable—not even Tyris, who considered himself invincible in the Demon God Realm, was assured of stopping it.
Therefore, it never occurred to them that this Divine King would prepare for mutual destruction.
Even less so did they expect that it would use more than ten million Heavenly Feather elites as bait, dispersing the armies of the three major empires in all directions to restrain them, and sacrificing the entire Eternal Divine Domain together in death.
“Be careful!”
With the Eternal Divine Domain slowly ‘ascending,’ the surrounding space-time began to shake, shatter, and stirred up powerful Void tides roaring in.
Seeing this, the three Divine Kings and Jack Clark and the True Martial Heavenly King simultaneously made a move, tearing apart this space and lifting all the warships and fleets, shooting them quickly towards the distance.
After flying out more than three hundred thousand kilometers in almost a single breath, ‘everyone’ stopped and looked back.
The vast and boundless Eternal Divine Domain had already detached itself from the ‘Earth’, slowly rising from the Void below, while half of it had already been devoured by the Deep Red World above.
With a sigh, Jack Clark exhaled deeply, and behind him emerged several damaged golden Heavenly Gates as the dark gold radiance around him began to dim.
As the form of Dark Star Apocalypse receded, Jack Clark’s stature shrunk rapidly, and his aura weakened more and more.
Soon, he shrank to the normal True Body form of a thousand meters, then continued to diminish, his aura contained until he returned to an ordinary humanoid form.
Instantly, Jack Clark felt a strong sense of weakness inside him, and he breathed slightly heavily.
The Dark Star Apocalypse Form of the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate is powerful, but because this strength is too strong, it places a great deal of pressure on the True Body when it bursts forth.

﻿Chapter 1429: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_3 Chapter 1429: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_3 And this power is primarily derived from the Burst of Heavenly Tier Divine Dragon Bloodline, the Azure Dragon Nine Turns, so it can only be used as a trump card at critical moments, unable to be a normal state for combat.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t be a Burst form but regular strength.
Just looking at the somewhat weakened black-haired young man in the sky, even the Main Gods and Divine Kings, whose true forms stand thousands, even tens of thousands of meters tall, dare not gaze at him lightly.
After all, this is the existence that has single-handedly slain a Demon God.
Not to mention the terrifying strike he summoned earlier, which even repelled Tyris, that Great Demon God, let alone everyone present daring to confront its dreadful might head-on.
At this thought, the True Martial Heavenly King suddenly realized something, surprised and in disbelief, “Jack Clark, that attack you summoned earlier, was it from that Giant Beast called Thunderflame!?”
Jack Clark smiled slightly and nodded, “Yes, that strike earlier was indeed sought from ‘Thunderflame’s’ assistance.”
Hiss!
The True Martial Heavenly King instantly sucked in a breath of cold air, his surprised expression causing Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and the Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan to pause in astonishment all the same.
Mysterious Martial Sky King was somewhat puzzled, “True Martial, haven’t you adapted to Jack Clark’s exaggerated feats yet?”
After all, this Jack Clark, even in the early stages of Heavenly King Realm, had already slain a Demon God, along with his exaggerated record of achievements along the way, such as retreating unscathed from a direct clash with a Demon God while still in the Legendary Realm.
Therefore, although that strike just now was horrifying, Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others were merely slightly shocked and then paid it no further mind.
The True Martial Heavenly King smiled bitterly, “It’s not Jack Clark’s ‘strength’ that surprises me, but rather that strike itself.”
“You all have been ‘traveling’ outside during this period, so you’re not very familiar with this aspect; you don’t realize how terrifying that Giant Beast just now really is.”
Under the gaze of Mysterious Martial Sky King and those Divine Kings and Main Gods, the True Martial Heavenly King exclaimed, “That Giant Beast known as Thunderflame also comes from our Human Race’s Blue Star World.”
“If Jack Clark is considered a once-in-an-era genius that dominates across our species, then that Thunderflame Giant Beast is the unparalleled genius of the Blue Star’s Mutated Creatures.”
“According to the current known records, about ten Sun Wheels ago, when that Giant Beast was only Level 4, it encountered Jack Clark, who was then merely at the Third Layer Heaven, by the seaside and formed a contract between man and beast.”
“Afterward, in just a few months, a mere few Sun Wheels, it grew from Level 4 to Level 9, battling Mythical Giant Beasts.”
“Later, as Jack Clark broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven and entered the mythical world, that Giant Beast also left Blue Star, breaking through to the Legendary Realm not long after.”
“Calculating the time, it’s only been about five Sun Wheels since that Thunderflame Giant Beast entered the mythical world.”
“And just now, if I sensed correctly, that Giant Beast is already making a breakthrough to the Ancient Level, and its combat power is even more terrifying—just a single Breath was enough to repel that Great Demon King, Tyris, who wields a World-class weapon.”
“How can it be possible, five Sun Wheels!!”
This time, it was the Divine Kings and Main Gods of the Heavenly Feather Clan that were staring, agape and unable to believe, looking towards Jack Clark.
As allies, they had some understanding of the Human Race’s body types and knew that the so-called Third Layer Heaven corresponded to their tribe’s Level 3 during their juvenility.
That includes Giant Beasts; Level 9 is Ninth Tier.
As for Jack Clark, the monster that broke through to the Heavenly King Realm in just twelve Sun Wheels, they already found him exaggerated enough, only to discover there was an even more fearsome Giant Beast.
In just five Sun Wheels, it went from the initial Legendary Realm to breaking through to the Ancient Level.
And that exaggerated combat power was no less than that of this monstrous prodigy of the Human Race, capable of repelling a peak Demon God like Tyris, who held a World-class weapon, with just a single Breath as it was still breaking through.
Damn, is that Blue Star World really that exaggerated!? Aside from one monstrous freak, there’s even a more terrifying Giant Beast creature.
Anstice’s body radiated less Divine Light as she shrank from over a thousand meters in her Main God true form to the size of a normal human. Her immaculately beautiful face showed astonishment as she looked towards Jack Clark.
“King Clark, I’m a bit curious about your Blue Star World. I wonder if I could visit it sometime?”
Hearing this, Bordea also seemed interested, “Me too, I’m also curious. I wonder what kind of beautiful and mysterious world it must be to nurture such a strong civilization of the Human Race.”
Seeing this, the late-stage Ancient Divine King couldn’t help but clear his throat.
“If King Clark doesn’t mind, perhaps we could all pay a visit sometime?”
Jack Clark smiled lightly, “Everyone, there’s no need to be so formal. Our two races are now allies, and visiting Blue Star is a small matter that can be arranged at any time.”
Seeing this, the True Martial Heavenly King and others also smiled and said nothing.
As the pillar of civilization, such matters could already be decided by Jack Clark at will.
It just so happened that they had considered exchanges between the two races, such as sending students to each other’s realms, and they were also interested in the body types of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
If the True Martial body type could integrate some of the ‘strength’ of the Heavenly Feather civilization, maybe the whole Federation could take another step forward.
In the distance, the Eternal Divine Domain was already half-devoured, its location having turned into a Dark Void, filled with the chaotic flows of a raging Void Storm.
Under normal conditions, the Eternal Divine Domain always exists within the interstitial layer of space-time of the mythical world, with only parts of it projecting out and linking with the mythical world.
Only now, being devoured by the Deep Red World, could Jack Clark and the others see the full expanse of this world that, in essence, had already stepped into the True Spirit Level.
At this moment, everyone solemnly watched the sky, awaiting the final outcome.
Although the Eternal Burial sounded very powerful, until this world was completely devoured, Jack Clark and the others dared not let their guard down.

chapters.title: Chapter 1430 - 1430 542 Destruction Emperor Dragons Breath
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1430: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_4 Chapter 1430: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_4 If the situation where Tyris tears through the crystal wall and breaks out happens again, it would also be good to join forces to resist it.
As Jack Clark and the others awaited the final outcome, at the other edge of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Silver Giant Dragon and its kin also looked at the now tranquil dark gold mountain ranges with some confusion.
“Roar! Telsafi, why did Tim Abott suddenly wake up and spit water into the sky continuously?”
The gold and blue Giant Dragon stood up slightly, fixed its gaze on the mountain ranges standing in the Dark Void of the sky, and pondered, “Just now, Thunderflame must have gone to help that human.”
“Help a human?”
At first, the Silver Giant Dragon was taken aback, then it quickly realized what was implied and roared angrily, “Are you saying that despicable human has summoned Tim Abott again?”
“Yes, it must be him,” the gold and blue Giant Dragon nodded.
Because they were over ten thousand kilometers away and the area was distorted by space-time, they did not see the summoning vortex that flashed by, with a diameter of only a few kilometers.
However, the gold and blue Giant Dragon was all too familiar with the sight of the Destructive Breath shooting up into the sky and disappearing after tens of kilometers.
It was clearly that human summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon for help again.
“Roar! The detestable human, he actually disturbed Tim Abott while it was breaking through its ancient hibernation, that is unforgivable.”
“Do not let the Great Sethia see him, otherwise it must scold him to death,” the Silver Giant Dragon fumed, its double wings flaring in anger.
Due to the ‘vast knowledge’ passed down in their family, the Silver Giant Dragons also knew that hibernation was crucial when the Giant Beasts breakthrough to the ancient level.
For instance, its mother had to hibernate to advance to the ancient level, and would not easily wake up until then, and must not be disturbed; that’s why it could sneak out.
The Silver Giant Dragon, though very angry, was merely barking threats.
There was no helping it, that human was too terrifying, a monster just like Tim Abott, one who advanced from level eight to the late period of mythical level in a short period, with even more frightening strength.
When the Spatial Channel opened earlier, just the aura that leaked through the channel made them all shiver with fear.
“No worries, just now Thunderflame briefly woke up and spat out a Breath, it won’t have much influence.”
“Continue sleeping (cultivating), strive to breakthrough to the Mythical Peak before Thunderflame wakes up, and complete the bloodline Transformation,” suggested the gold and blue Giant Dragon as it lay back down.
Unlike the Silver Giant Dragon which lay curled up casually on the ground, the gold and blue Giant Dragon’s sleeping posture, even when lying down, was very elegant.
Its colossal body, stretching 1,300 meters in length, lay straight, wings folded, legs curled forward, with the massive head resting on its double claws, basking in the silver moonlight, resembling a colorful mountain range.
Seeing the gold and blue Giant Dragon fall asleep again, the Silver Giant Dragon thought for a moment and then laid down its head to sleep as well.
Following the Destruction Emperor Dragon through the Chaotic Turbulent Region, they had consumed a lot of good things, particularly the recent Time Fish and Chaos Crystal Core.
Under the energy of these high-level Law Divine Artifacts, their bloodlines were undergoing astonishing Transformation and Evolution.
The gold and blue Giant Dragon could acutely sense that within the deep recesses of the Giant Beast Body, a powerful strength was being born, the third Top Tier Talent.
As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it slept enshrouded in an almost tangible Cloud Mist thousands of kilometers away, its massive body flickering in and out of visibility, like the legendary ancient Spawn Roc.
While the Silver Giant Dragons fell back into slumber, Jack Clark and his group, after waiting for almost half a day, showed grave expressions on their faces.
Right below the Eternal Divine Domain, which was already mostly devoured, threads of Abyss Demonic Aura coiled like chains from the deep abyss.
One end of these chains was opposite the Eternal Divine Domain, on uninhabited lands that had been completely claimed by the Abyss.
Across a million-kilometer stretch of land that had been demonized by the three major empires, innumerable Dark Demon Air and smoke poured out from the cracked Earth underground, continuously converging.
These Dark Demon Air strands functioned like tentacles of some rule, connecting the three Lords of the Purgatory Empire, wrapping underneath the Eternal Divine Domain.
Even after the Eternal Divine Domain was completely swallowed and disappeared into the vast depths of the Dark Void tens of thousands of kilometers above, those dark chains still reached in and disappeared.
Clearly, these were the fallback plans of those Purgatory Demon Gods.
This Dark Demon Air was the extension of their rule power. As long as the demonic aura continued, they could find their way back from the Deep Red World.
Of course, that was assuming they didn’t encounter the terrifying beings within the Deep Red World or fall into the cataclysmic explosion as the Eternal World descended into the Deep Red World.
Sigh! All three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings exhaled, their expressions solemn.
“This must be the reason those few Demon Gods did not flee. Their target is our clan’s ‘Destructive Power, as well as the divine tree’s husk and Origin,” one said.
“Even if they have to be buried along with the Divine Realm in the Deep Red World, they do not wish to give up.”
This time, the Heavenly Feather Clan had calculated against the three major empires, intending to obliterate them, but the empires had their own goals and contingencies as well.
Thus, at the critical moment, it was only Tyris’ tentacle, and the other two Lords of the empire entangled with the Divine King of Light, preventing him from ‘escaping’.
Otherwise, if those Demon Gods fled at the first chance, the Divine King of Light too could have commandeered the divine tree to leave, leaving behind the Eternal Divine Domain and the Demon Race Legion to be devoured.
“Is there a way to go over there and destroy those Abyss Demonic Air chains?” the Mysterious Martial Sky King asked gravely.
The True Martial Heavenly King shook his head, “Difficult.”
“Because of the destruction of the Eternal Divine Domain’s foundational rules, the region, although appearing dark and calm, is actually littered with terrifying Space-Time Storms.”
“Even if we venture in recklessly, we’d run into trouble. That place has already become a new forbidden area.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1431 - 1431 542 Destruction Emperor Dragons Breath
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1431: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_5 Chapter 1431: Chapter 542: Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath, The Return Ends_5 “However, with this forbidden area acting as a barrier, Demon Gods like Tyris would need to take a detour to attack the Human Race even if they manage to escape later, having to cross from the Purgatory Family’s side.”
Well, this outcome isn’t too bad. Jack Clark nodded his head upon hearing this.
“Let’s go, it’s time to return.”
The True Martial Heavenly King held the stele in his hand and spoke in a deep voice, “Take advantage of the fact that Diorus and the others haven’t reacted yet, gather all forces, and push the battlefield into the homeland of the Purgatory Demon Race.”
“It would be best to annihilate the two empires of the Mokaya Dark Demon in one fell swoop.”
That Golden Winged Divine King also revealed a cold light in his eyes, a terrifying murderous intent surfacing: “Indeed, the Purgatory Demon Gods over there would never expect us to appear.”
Bordea said fiercely, “All those of the Purgatory Demon Race deserve to die; when the time comes, we’ll exterminate every last one of them.”
The other Heavenly Feather Strongmen also all showed intense murderous intent.
The obliteration of the Heavenly Feather Clan’s land left these ‘People’ with some sadness and unwillingness. But even with unwillingness, facing an overwhelming situation was futile if they couldn’t win the fight.
However, the strength of the three major empires on this side was strong, while the strengths of the two Purgatory Empires on the side of the Human Race were average at best.
This time, they would start with the Purgatory Empires over there, exterminating them to avenge the more than ten million tribespeople they had lost this time and the billions who had died over the centuries.
“Let’s go!”
Boom!
Following the order of the True Martial Heavenly King, led by thirteen sky-based battleships of the Human Race, hundreds of Golden Battleships followed behind, forming a fleet thousands of kilometers long that majestically headed towards the Human Race’s territory.
On the Number One Battleship, Jack Clark stood with his hands behind his back on the shoulder of Number One, gazing back at the Dark Void above the Firmament, and at those black chains that spanned heaven and earth, his gaze profound.
This expedition was not long, but the experiences made his blood boil.
A Civilization Great War larger than the Frontline Battlefield of the Human Race, where countless Extraordinary Creatures fought, Mythical-level, Titan Level, and Ancient Level strong men appeared in groups.
Especially that Great Demon King with terrifying strength, Jack Clark felt him to be unfathomable.
And there was Jonathan Walker who had mysteriously disappeared, full of many secrets. His betrayal from those years ago was definitely not as simple as it seemed on the surface, and it appeared there were other issues as well.
While Jack Clark was lost in thought, a girl within Number One was also quietly watching him.
That youth standing with his hands behind his back was tall and straight, like a sovereign holding up the heavens, his handsome face and black hair wildly fluttering in the wind, looking utterly dashing.
Yet as she watched him, a touch of heartache showed in Freya Louise’s clear sky-like eyes.
Others only saw Jack Clark’s heaven-defying talent, envied his achievements, and were shocked by his terrifying combat power, but no one paid attention to the hardships and dangers behind his successes.
From the time Jack set forth on his path of cultivation, he was almost constantly fighting and battling; a slight misstep would mean no burial for his corpse.
In the Second Layer Heaven, he went to foreign battlefields and fought with Evil God Sect Cultists, directly faced Evil God Soul Splits in the Sixth Layer Heaven, fighting across two Major Realms.
Later it became even more exaggerated; Freya heard from Gabriella that when Jack was in the Seventh Layer Heaven on the Heritage of Ruins Continent, he had slaughtered at least a hundred thousand Void Creatures.
These creatures were at least at the Fifth Layer Heaven, with many strong ones at the Seventh or Eight Layer.
Not to mention later, facing Demon Gods directly at the rear of the Purgatory Empire with his Legendary Realm.
To have reached this point, Jack went through too much, making his ‘good friends’ proud, yet also filled with heartache.

chapters.title: Chapter 1432 - 1432 543 Refining the Rule Envoy of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1432: Chapter 543 Refining the Rule, Envoy of the Empire Chapter 1432: Chapter 543 Refining the Rule, Envoy of the Empire A pseudo-world level weapon suppressed in the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, five pieces of Space Equipment snatched from demon lords, and one from a Great Demon King.
However, I currently don’t have any Attribute Points, so I am unable to enhance the Eight Desolate War Halberd a second time.
As for the contents of that Space Equipment, there’s too little of use to me right now, just two pieces of Law Level minerals that can be absorbed.
Standing on the shoulder of Number One, Jack Clark was evaluating his gains from the battle, which seemed only average after calculations.
Of course, this ‘average’ is relative to him, given that the Dark Battle Hammer alone is worth a fortune.
Weapons containing the power of rules like this require massive amounts of top-tier resources and Heaven and Earth Treasures to forge, as well as sufficient strength to craft, which is why usually only Supreme Experts possess them.
Currently in the entire Human Federation, aside from the three Supreme Experts, only that Heavenly King Powerhouse who has mastered the Supreme Law and is known as Mad Wheeler possesses such a weapon.
As for the True Martial Heavenly King, the weaponry system of the True Martial Divine Tablet he controls is different, and its power is already comparable to that of a world-class weapon in terms of level.
This is also why he, with his peak Heavenly King prowess, is able to stand against and even suppress Demon Gods from the Ancient Middle Stage.
Of course, saying that only a Supreme Level existence has them does not mean all Supreme members of the Human Race use pseudo-world level weapons.
For example, as far as Jack is aware, the weapon that the First Councilor obtained from the relics of the Void Continent, which came together with an ancient Inheritance, is terrifyingly powerful.
But no one knows exactly how strong it is.
The most impressive battle feat is that before the True Martial Heavenly King rose to prominence, the First Councilor faced off alone on the frontline against two Demon Gods and one Extreme Realm Great Demon King, undefeated.
Add to that, the Sky-based God King and the Primordial True King safeguarding the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, who held off the fierce first onslaught of the Purgatory Empire twenty years ago.
That began the ensuing decades-long war of attrition.
Although Adam Garcetti is very strong, it seems his power is related to the ‘Human Race’ and he cannot easily leave the domain of the humans, so he can only maintain an undefeated situation.
Moreover, his strength fluctuates at times, occasionally giving the impression of being ‘weak’ and having difficulty even against a single Demon God from the Ancient Middle Stage.
But if two Demon Gods were to team up against him, his power would surge rapidly.
Therefore, even within the Human Race, the power of the First Councilor remains a mystery, also making the Demon Gods of the Purgatory Empire clueless.
In recent years, he alone has been overseeing the Sky Curtain Battlefield.
On the other hand, the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield is always guarded by two Supreme Experts year-round, among which the True Martial Heavenly King and the Primordial True King occasionally rotate with the Outer Development Department.
“Next, I’ll wait for the Giant Beast to awaken, return to collect the Life Crystals gathered by Horned Lady and the others, and then enhance the Eight Desolate War Halberd once more.”
“After that, I’ll focus on the quick breakthrough to Supreme Level.”
“I have already completed the True Body recasting, with the five Higher-order Laws Worlds converging with the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, using the Law of Strength as the core to form the embryonic rule.”
“So, I’ve skipped the early and mid stages of becoming a Heavenly King, I just need to continue expanding the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, perfect the rules, and temper my True Body with the power of rules.”
“When the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane expands to ten thousand kilometers and the rules are complete, that will be the moment I make my breakthrough to Supreme Level…”
As Jack Clark stood with his hands clasped behind him on the shoulder of Number One, contemplating his next main direction in cultivation, space distorted in front of him, and the True Martial Heavenly King appeared out of nowhere.
Whir! Number One’s eyes lit up as it sensed the approach of a powerful being.
But immediately under Freya Louise’s control, the light in Number One’s eyes dimmed again, and the powerful force awakening within quickly subsided into silence, standing still.
Had Number One’s instinct recovered to this extent, it felt as if consciousness would emerge autonomously at any moment.
Watching this scene, the True Martial Heavenly King looked somewhat solemn, “Freya, how do you feel now? Is the spiritual pollution from the ancient revival strong?”
A calm voice from within Number One responded, “It’s okay.”
“Good enough,” the True Martial Heavenly King slowly nodded.
Number One is special. After the failure of the Sky-based God King and the Primordial True Martial, it has become the last resort for the Human Race to resist the Second Mythical Impact.
In this period, Number One’s growth has been rapid, even surpassing expectations due to Jack’s help.
That’s good for the Federation, increasing the chances for the Blue Star World, but it might not be the case for Freya.
The rapid growth of Number One leads to an ancient revival.
As an entity that has touched upon ‘Eternal and Undying’, that ancient creature may have fallen tens of thousands of years ago but has not completely died.
The laws of such a powerful life have merged into the mythical world’s Heaven and Earth, influencing countless worlds.
Thus, even if the True Body collapses and the soul erodes, it is essentially still not destroyed, because some fragmented soul will remains in the rules merged into the mythical world.
As the broken heart within Number One mends and its vessel gains strength, the power within instinctively resonates with the rules of that ancient creature.
In such a case, those fragmented souls will be awakened and gathered together.
When enough of those faint, shattered soul powers amalgamate, it will be the moment that ancient creature’s consciousness returns and revives anew.
This revival is irreversible.
For life at this level, even a thread of nearly indetectable soul force holds tremendous and terrifying amounts of information, far beyond a Transcendent Life’s capacity to resist.
This is why the first generation driver of Number One was assimilated and polluted.
Because the initial research on Number One was insufficient, that tragedy happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1433 - 1433 543 Refining the Rule Envoy of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1433: Chapter 543 Refining the Rule, Envoy of the Empire_2 Chapter 1433: Chapter 543 Refining the Rule, Envoy of the Empire_2 Freya Louise’s path was to use the Primitive Secret Techniques to reflect her heart towards the heavens, aligning her special mental state with the Primitive Azure Sky recorded in the ancient texts.
She used the Primitive Azure Sky as a vessel to carry the fragmented soul of a resurrected ancient creature, peeling away the will and information contained within those threads of soul.
In the end, she would merge only with the purest essence of the soul.
Moreover, with Number One’s power gained from devouring countless living beings, including demon kings and the Great Demon Kings’ flesh and souls to nourish her, Freya’s strength soared rapidly, like a rocket taking off.
However, this was an untrodden path; nobody knew whether, in the end, it would be Freya replacing the ancient creature or the ancient creature’s revived soul assimilating her.
True Martial Heavenly King looked solemnly at Jack Clark, “Jack Clark, with the Heavenly Feather battlefield conflict over, I plan to return to the Federation ahead of time to prepare for the counter-offensive.”
“You will be in charge here. However, you don’t need to worry about the minor details; Mysterious Martial and the others will coordinate with the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
“No problem,” Jack Clark nodded.
Regarding the alliance between the two tribes and the counter-offensive against the two great Purgatory Empires, Jack and the True Martial Heavenly King had already secretly discussed the matter while waiting for the Eternal Divine Domain to be devoured.
Then everyone agreed that this opportunity should not be missed.
Although they were all aware that time was of the essence, the Heavenly Feather Clan’s sky-based battleships lacked an overdrive mode, and the Federation fleet could not abandon their allies to flee first. So, they had to return at the highest speed possible.
Afterwards, the True Martial Heavenly King and Jack Clark continued to discuss some matters before departing.
With the departure of the True Martial Heavenly King, Jack Clark became the highest person in charge of the Expeditionary Army.
But since it was a return journey with no conflict at hand, Jack Clark settled himself on the shoulder of Number One, with a black Emperor Seal appearing in his hand.
Within the black Emperor Seal, a miniature galaxy was calmly chosen, sending out invisible fluctuations that even made Number One beneath him tremble slightly.
This was the Emperor Inheritance that Jack had obtained after following the Emperor’s path in the Void Relic Continent, a complete and untapped Primordial Rule.
This was key to Jack’s breakthrough to the Civilization Emperor stage.
However, because he had been too weak before, there had been no chance for him to refine it until now, having reached the standard of a ‘Heavenly King.’ But Jack had no experience in how to refine this rule.
Jack Clark’s Divine Soul Intent entered the Emperor Seal, and his consciousness shook violently in an instant, his aura becoming obscure and indistinct, his presence growing weaker and weaker, disappearing.
If it weren’t for the fact that he was sitting on Number One’s shoulder, Freya would have thought he had left.
Inside Number One, Freya stood in the Void, her gaze indifferent, like a detached deity devoid of any sentiment.
More and more dark golden patterns appeared on her body, as if embodying profound, arcane truths of heaven and earth. The God Machine Armaments almost completely transformed into dark golden scale armor.
As the assimilation deepened, the ancient aura wrapping around Freya became increasingly evident.
As the Expeditionary Army hastened back at full speed, the aftershocks of Jack’s deep foray into the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire endured.
Under the bright moonlight, an island several kilometers in diameter, resembling an inverted warship, flew swiftly through the air. It was surrounded by the pervasive Dark Demon Air, exuding a staunch aura.
Above the island, two Purgatory True Demons, exuding the peak of Nine Demonic Marks, stood tall, their formidable presence causing Heaven and Earth’s energy to oscillate within hundreds of kilometers.
One of the Purgatory True Demons, Gulden, with two pairs of branching horns, said gravely, “Brooks, it’s said that the Mountain Giant appeared at the edge of Talos Demon King’s territory.”
“Now Talos Demon King has led the army in pursuit. Do you think we should rush over now or take it a bit slower?”
Brooks pondered for a moment, “That Mountain Giant is very strong. After devouring all life in five territories that lost their Demon King’s suppression, it has entered the Legendary Realm.”
“Moreover, the data suggests that this Demon is dangerous, having awakened a powerful force that even makes Talos Demon King hesitate to act rashly.”
“Of course, this siege mission was decreed by Lady Tarolia herself, and no one in the Demon City can disobey. But we can afford to be slightly slower.”
“With our current strength, as long as we’re careful, we have the means to protect ourselves even against Mythical-level Demons.”
“I understand, Brooks,” the horned True Demon’s eyes showed understanding, “This time we’ll enter the scene quietly; don’t go for the shooting, take the credit if there’s a chance, and let those other guys go to their deaths if not.”
“Good to know.” Brooks revealed a faint smile.
This foray into the Demon Clan’s territory had indeed been very fruitful. Under the repeated refinement and enhancement of his Purgatory Bloodline, his strength had reached the quasi-mythical level.
Moreover, because he had awakened a potent Purgatory Divine Power, he no longer feared even the early-stage Mythical demon kings.
This rate of strength increase was much faster than staying in Human Territory. With a suitable opportunity, he believed he would soon break through to become a Demon King.
For someone in their twenties to become a Mythical Powerhouse, aside from that monstrous figure, none of the younger generation should be faster than him.
Following coordinates, Brooks and his comrade, already on the edge of the empire, quickly crossed more than 200,000 kilometers using the Demon Island to reach the Lost Soul Mountain Range.
As they approached, terrifying roars and powerful energy fluctuations could be heard from afar.
The fierce battle below caused mountain peaks to collapse, hundred kilometers of Earth to shatter, countless Sky-touching Trees to snap, burn, and raise searing winds and raging currents.
Thousands of kilometers away, tens of thousands of Purgatory True Demons, comprising the Main Battle Legions, surrounded and worked with a Mid-Mythical Stage Demon King to combat a terrifying giant.

chapters.title: Chapter 1434 - 1434 543 Refining Rules an Envoy from the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1434: Chapter 543: Refining Rules, an Envoy from the Empire_3 Chapter 1434: Chapter 543: Refining Rules, an Envoy from the Empire_3 The giant’s aura was only at the early stages of Myth, but his massive body towered at a kilometer high, even larger than the Demon King’s body in its True Form, filled with an overwhelming sense of oppression.
The giant’s entire body was covered in greyish-gold rocks, shining with a metallic luster, and with his double shoulders ‘muscles’ bursting out, his head almost seemed to connect directly with his neck.
In his hand, he held a 1,500-meter-long greyish-gold Battle Axe, surrounded by a terrifying fog of blood, much like Punishing Heaven, the War God of Mythical Legend.
The strength of this giant was also terrifyingly formidable. With unmatched power, he was able to clash head-on with the Demon King without falling behind.
Every time the giant swung his colossal axe, the sharpness it emitted would cause a slight change in the Demon King’s expression, making him hesitant to meet the blow directly.
Boom!
The horrific Battle Axe struck the ground, causing the Earth to instantly crack and create a chasm over five hundred kilometers long, its powerful tearing force shattering thousands of Purgatory True Demons along its path.
As the giant swung his axe down, his figure paused momentarily, and that’s when a few surrounding Purgatory True Demon strong men’s eyes lit up with opportunity.
Among them, two pinnacle Nine Demonic Marks Purgatory True Demons shouted, “Bardoro, let’s attack its right leg joint together, break one leg first.”
“Kill!”
The two quasi-mythical level Purgatory True Demons cried out, turning into a streak of black light appearing behind the Mountain Giant, their hands holding a Dark Demon Spear and a slash blade, light swallowing and spitting.
Just as the two powerful beings from Purgatory were about to strike, the Demon King’s expression changed slightly, “Careful, move.”
But before the two Purgatory True Demons could react, two massive forces, each with a hundred-meter diameter, descended from the sky, centered on them.
Thump, thump!!
In a twenty-kilometer radius of pressurized Law Domains, under the gravity field of a hundred meters compressed and condensed, the two quasi-mythical Purgatory True Demons exploded into a mist of blood in an instant.
The horrific force continued unabated, carrying the blood mist as it slammed into the ground, creating two pits thousands of meters deep and a hundred meters in diameter.
The rocks at the bottom of the pits were almost compressed into solid steel, with a greyish-gold metallic appearance.
This scene caused those surrounding Purgatory Nobles, including the Demon King and those who had just arrived, like Brooks and the Horned Split True Demon, to focus sharply.
Roar!
Suddenly, the Mountain Giant let out a brutal roar, its massive body turning abruptly and crushing the Earth, rushing into the forest at the rear with astonishing speed.
Seeing this, the Demon King did not attempt to obstruct, but instead stood solidly in the air, his expression solemn.
After a long while, this Demon King suddenly turned to those surrounding Purgatory Nobles, including Brooks and others just arriving, and said in a cold voice.
“Popokosa, when you return, report to Lord Tarolia that the Mountain Giant that attacked has been repelled by me, the king, and has fled the empire’s territory.”
“Yes, Demon King,” the commander of the Purgatory Legion responded respectfully, bowing his head.
After speaking, the Demon King no longer paid attention to those other True Demons around, leading his army to retreat back to their territory, leaving more than twenty Purgatory True Demons looking at each other.
These True Demons at the late stages and the peak of Nine Demonic Marks weren’t even worthy of a direct greeting from that Demon King.
For Mythical-level Powerhouses, everything below Myth is insignificant; without becoming a Myth or breaking through as a Demon King, they remained subordinate to the Demon King.
This fact was also very clear to those True Demons, so none dared to harbor any discontent.
Including the Horned Split True Demon, they once again admired Brooks’s wisdom; the Mountain Giant indeed possessed the strength to kill them in an instant.
However, as Brooks looked in the direction in which the Mountain Giant had vanished, he couldn’t shake the feeling like the sun was setting over West Mountain.
This was the mighty Purgatory Empire, home to two Purgatory Demon Gods, nine Great Demon Kings, and nearly forty Demon Kings in residence.
And yet, they were unable to handle this Mountain Giant that had recently broken through to Myth, which was almost inconceivable, yet a fact.
With most of the Demon Kings, Great Demon Kings, and Demon Gods of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire at the frontline, only thirteen Demon Kings and four Great Demon Kings remained in the rear.
After Jack Clark swept through the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, seven of the defending Demon Kings had died, along with one Great Demon King, and the peak Great Demon King, Tarolia, had been ‘injured.’
Including one returning Demon God who was seriously injured, they were now all in deep retreat within the empire, recuperating.
With reinforcements still being called to the frontline for the upcoming War of Extermination against the Human Race, this resulted in vulnerability at the empire’s rear.
Faced with the Mythical Mountain Giant harassing the empire’s borders, they were momentarily at a loss, with several Demon Kings’ efforts achieving only temporary deterrence.
This Mountain Giant, seemingly mindless and crazy, also behaved quite smartly, specifically targeting territories unguarded by Demon Kings.
Perhaps this was an opportunity, another raid on the rear might completely disrupt the rear of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.
While Brooks was contemplating whether to send this news back, the Horned Split True Demon’s communication demonic weapon suddenly began to pulsate.
Then the True Demon spoke surprisedly, “Brooks, Jaya Demon King has issued an order canceling the mission to snipe the Mountain Giant.”
“The order is for us to immediately head to the Southern Region Demon Domain to assemble, welcoming The Imperial Emissary as the empire’s new generation genius.”
“The Imperial Emissary?” Brooks paused.
The excited Split True Demon said, “Yes, The Imperial Emissary. It’s said that Emperor Diorus and the Ancestral Demon God have set out together to call upon an emissary from an even more powerful empire.”
Immediately, Brooks’s expression grew grave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1435 - 1435 544 The Collapse of Civilization The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1435: Chapter 544: The Collapse of Civilization, The Awakening of the Destruction Emperor Dragon Chapter 1435: Chapter 544: The Collapse of Civilization, The Awakening of the Destruction Emperor Dragon In the place where the demon domain had once been destroyed, the torn and shattered land had been repaired, becoming flat once more, and a new, massive city had been erected.
Surrounded by dark demon air, the towering Purgatory City was lively under the bright moonlight, with many Purgatory True Demons coming and going in the streets.
Many ‘children’ who were as tall as 2 meters held various ferocious demonized unique beasts on leashes, and Giant Beasts with Dragon Bloodlines flew across the sky pulling carts, surrounded by strong men.
This bustling scene made it impossible to believe that the place had almost been completely destroyed in the past.
At this moment, outside the 3-kilometer-high city wall of the demon domain, more than a thousand enormous figures stood proudly in the air, surrounded by rolling demon gas, emanating astonishing auras.
These Purgatory True Demons, led by Tarolia who sat on the throne ‘recovering from injuries’, solemnly looked forward.
Behind Tarolia sat a Great Demon King, followed by four Demon Kings, and then Purgatory Nobles like Brooks who had rushed back.
Blending into the crowd of demons, Brooks, who was at the peak of the Nine Demonic Marks, seemed somewhat inconspicuous.
At that moment, an excited Horned Split True Demon beside him said, “Brooks, do you think Lord Barus will promote our ranks when we return to the frontline after this audience is over?”
Brooks slowly nodded: “He should, given that our return to the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire is for ‘further study’.”
“Besides, with our strength now on par with ordinary Demon Kings, the Assassination Department, besides a few Demon Kings, considers us the strongest.”
“That would be great,” said the Horned Split True Demon, looking forward to returning to show off his power: “When we get back, I hope I can lead an assassination branch. I want to kill a few Human Clan Geniuses to establish our power.”
As the Horned Split True Demon spoke about killing a few Human Clan Geniuses, the look in Brooks’ eyes became a bit strange.
However, the True Demon did not notice this subtle change in Brooks’ gaze.
Just then, a Demon God Level pressure appeared in the sky, and instantly the whole world darkened, as the moonlight above the firmament was obscured by the rolling Dark Demon Air.
Within the boundless Dark Demon Air, several enormous figures appeared intermittently visible.
As the rolling Dark Demon Cloud appeared above the demon domain, all the Purgatory True Demons, with Tarolia at the forefront, bowed respectfully: “We greet Your Majesty and the Demon Gods.”
Seated on an ancient creature’s skull throne, Diorus looked down upon those figures below him and slightly turned his head to look at one of the fiercely featured Demon Gods beside him.
“Stephenl, ahead is my demon palace. Let’s go inside and then discuss,” said Diorus.
The Demon God known as Stephenl, typically one hundred meters tall and covered in black scale armor, had a deep and terrifying aura. Unlike other True Demons, it bore only a pair of huge curved demon horns on its head.
After scanning the Purgatory True Demons below that had come to greet them, the Demon God nodded slightly.
Despite what legends might suggest, Diorus’ empire was far from insignificant; with most of the empire’s forces pressed on the frontline, those left in the rear were not weak either.
In the demon domain divided into northern and southern sections, just one central region of the demon domain was guarded by a peak Great Demon King, with several Demon Kings assisting with state affairs.
Among those elite younger generations, several peak Nine Demonic Marks True Demons also appeared very young based on the life traces they carried.
In the towering palace, Dark Demon Air twisted around the ground, and black stone pillars a hundred meters in diameter soared, disappearing into the distorted dark red world thousands of meters away.
Because the palace was so immense, the thousands of Purgatory True Demons standing apart below were virtually invisible.
On the steps of the palace, four Demon Gods sat high on their thrones, with space distortion and Dark Demon Air around them obscuring their forms, with only their terrifying demonic godly aura spreading.
In front of these Demon Gods, only Tarolia had the privilege to sit, but even then, he could only sit on a lower throne.
Diorus looked down slightly and said in a deep voice to Tarolia below, “Tarolia, how goes the task I assigned you?”
“Your Majesty,” replied Tarolia, who rumor has it had been in closed-door cultivation. He respectfully said, “This subordinate has used a Secret Skill to alter his life aura and infiltrated the Human Race’s rear, making some astonishing discoveries.”
Under the gaze of the four Demon Gods, Tarolia said somewhat soberly, “I have found that the Divine Gods Alliance seems to have fully sided with the Human Race.”
“Many of our Demon Kings, the Assassination Department, and the Intelligence Department, as well as some demonized different races developed by us, have been almost completely uprooted.”
“Furthermore, through the Intelligence Department’s communication amulet, I have reestablished contact with some human traitors,” he continued.
“It was revealed that Darren Callum had already returned to the Human Race ten Star Hours ago and seemed unfazed in strength, exuding a strong aura.”
“Darren Callum is still alive and his strength hasn’t fallen!” Diorus’s expression suddenly became grave.
At that time, Jack Clark’s life origin was nearly exhausted and he had encountered an attack by a Titan Level Time Being in the midst of the Space-Time Chaos, being swept into a Space-Time Storm.
For a ‘Person’ at the Legendary Realm, to have not died was one thing, but to have recovered so quickly and returned to the Human Race was another.
Not just Diorus, Levides, the Demon God from the ancestral grounds, also became somber, his voice cold and deep.
“That human was sealed by me using the power of four Ancient Ancestors; his Summoning Secret Skill, his Inner World, the Power of Supreme Hell, and his connection to the Human Race’s luck were all cut off,” said Levides.
“With his strength, even if he was fortunate enough to survive, he should still be in a state of heavy injury,” he added.
Nodding gravely, Tarolia replied, “That’s what surprised me as well, clearly Darren Callum is more of a monster than we had estimated.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1436 - 1436 544 Civilization Perish Destruction

﻿Chapter 1436: Chapter 544 Civilization Perish, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_2 Chapter 1436: Chapter 544 Civilization Perish, Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_2 “Including luck.”
“Besides, I’ve also obtained information that the Heavenly Feather Clan had also appeared behind the Human Race’s lines.”
Suddenly, Diorus himself was somewhat astonished, “The Heavenly Feather Clan, the civilization that is at war with the Demon King Empire?”
“Yes, Your Majesty.”
Tarolia added, “Not only did messengers from the Heavenly Feather Clan appear behind the Human Race’s lines, but the Human Race also sent an expeditionary team to the Heavenly Feather battlefield.”
“However, the human that was turned by us does not have a high enough status to know the strength and specific personnel of that expeditionary legion.”
Immediately, cold smiles appeared on the faces of the two unfamiliar Demon Gods.
The Demon God named Stephenl said indifferently, “A mere ordinary civilization’s small tribe that even you, Diorus, cannot stop, dares to provoke Tyris. It’s simply seeking death.”
The Ancestral Demon God Levides also nodded in agreement, “Indeed seeking death. As far as I know, Tyris has already launched a final annihilation war against the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
“Given the Heavenly Feather Clan’s strength, depleted over hundreds of years, even with the addition of the Human’s expeditionary legion, they will be crushed to dust.”
A wave of Invisible Power then enshrouded the four Demon Gods and Tarolia, after which Diorus slowly began to speak, “It seems we need to reevaluate the current strength of the Human Race.”
“With the addition of the Divine Gods Alliance, the Human Race’s rear is secured, and they can engage our clan in full force.”
“On the frontal battlefield, as far as is currently known, the Human Race boasts three Demon God Level Powerhouses and one True Martial Heavenly King with the power of a Demon God, as well as Darren Callum, who can Summon that Giant Beast.”
“Although Darren’s Summoning Secret Skill was sealed by a strand of power from the Ancestor, since the Aura remains undamaged, there may be a problem with that Seal, which we must consider.”
“Also adding the possibility of the Divine Gods Alliance’s Divine Kings taking action, the high-end Demon God Level strength of the Human Race has reached six.”
At this point, the expressions of several Demon Gods became grave.
Six Demon God Level Powerhouses are already very formidable and, in terms of numbers, they are comparable to the current strongest among the eight Great Demon King Empires of the Purgatory Empire, the Saint Demon Anke Empire.
The Saint Demon Anke Empire only has four Demon God Level Powerhouses, in addition to two Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings wielding Pseudo-World Level Weapons with the fighting power of ordinary Demon Gods.
Of course, they are only comparable in number; the strength of the Human Race is far inferior.
Alone, the Lord of the Empire of the Saint Demon Anke Empire, renowned alongside Tyris and counted among the Great Demon King of the Purgatory Empire’s Carthius, could crush the entire Human Race.
In the Purgatory Family, this Great Demon King holds even greater prestige than Tyris and is the idol of many demon kings and Great Demon Kings.
Including the Demon God that was heavily injured by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, even the Demon Dragon Carthius is a ‘fan’, and out of sheer admiration, Carthius even altered its name to be nearly identical to that Great Demon King.
Diorus spoke in a low voice, “We thought that with your support, Stephenl, we would be enough to annihilate the Human Race, but it seems it’s still not a sure thing.”
“At the lower end, the Purgatory Legion, as well as demon kings and Great Demon Kings, we have the strength to crush them, but we don’t have a significant advantage at the Demon God Level.”
With the Demon Dragon Carthius currently recovering from heavy injuries in closed-door Cultivation, its empire only has one Demon God Level powerhouse. Including the two Demon Gods here to support, and the Ancestral Demon God, there are four in total.
Meanwhile, the Grita War Demon Empire has one Extreme Realm Great Demon King in addition to its two Demon Gods, which is equivalent to three Demon God Level Powerhouses in total, making seven altogether.
Although this number offers a slight advantage over the Human Race, overall, it is not enough to overwhelm them, especially since they lack an ancient late-stage Lord of the Empire wielding a World-class weapon.
And in the final battle, what decides the outcome of the battlefield are only the existences at the Demon God Level.
As for those Transcendent Corps, demon kings, and Great Demon Kings, who fight and die on the battlefields and seem so important, by that point, they will be inconsequential.
Without a same-level powerhouse to restrain them, except for a joint force of more than a dozen Great Demon Kings, it is simply impossible to stop a single regular Demon God from slaughtering those lower beings.
The Demon God named Stephenl slowly said, “The Immortal Spirit Clan has already been vanquished, and Your Majesty, they are currently assimilating the gains to breakthrough to higher levels.”
“Next, according to the Ancestor’s Will, our empires will focus on eastward expansion, and thus, this Human civilization must be erased.”
“Diorus, you continue to mobilize all forces, gathering at the frontline, preparing for the final battle.”
“As for the problem of Demon God Level Powerhouses, although Your Majesties cannot be disturbed, the other Demon Gods should be able to spare some of their demonic hands.”
“It’s just that by doing so, you Diorus, will need to give up a part…”
Because of the Rule Power, Brooks, who was below, couldn’t hear the conversations of those higher-up Demon Gods and could only see Tarolia nodding respectfully from time to time.
About an hour later, the meeting ended, and all the Purgatory True Demons orderly exited the Demon Palace.
Upon returning to the Floating Demon Island hovering outside the Demon Domain, Brooks was just about to dismiss the Horned Split True Demon when it excitedly said,
“Brooks, I actually saw the figures of the Demon Gods, as many as four of them.”
“Those Great Demon Gods were so majestic, so powerful, that just feeling their nearly imperceptible Supreme Demon Power made me wet.”
Even Brooks was taken aback for a moment, “Wet! Gulden, aren’t you ‘male’?”
“Who said I was ‘male’?” the Horned Split True Demon looked at him curiously.
Damn!
Looking at the robust, fierce, and terrifying figure of the Purgatory True Demon before him, and considering its increasingly enthusiastic behavior lately, Brooks instinctively took a step back.

﻿Chapter 1437: Chapter 544: Civilization Destroyed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_3 Chapter 1437: Chapter 544: Civilization Destroyed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_3 “Cough! Gulden, I just had some insights under the oppressive presence of those Demon Gods, and I’m preparing to return to cultivation, so I’m off first.”
Speaking, Brooks didn’t wait for the Horned True Demon to speak and turned into a residual shadow that disappeared in an instant.
Soon, on his way back to the Human Race, the True Martial Heavenly King stopped in his tracks, his eyes fixed on the text that had emerged on the True Martial Stone Tablet.
“Ancestral Demon God, and two Demon Gods from another Purgatory Empire!”
No wonder the True Martial Heavenly King looked so solemn.
Currently, The Purgatory Family is known to have Eight Great Empires, aside from the two weakest empires that are in conflict with the Human Race and six other empires with greater strength.
Moreover, the elite of the three empires led by Tyris had just been buried in the Deep Red World by the Heavenly Feather Clan, so it definitely wasn’t them.
It means the outcome from another Civilization Battlefield had been decided, Purgatory Empire had won, and that civilization known as Immortal Spirit, just like the Heavenly Feather Clan, had been annihilated.
This was not good news.
Just as the True Martial Heavenly King received the latest information and sped back to the Human Race with a serious expression, changes also emerged on the other end of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In the Dark Void that spanned over ten thousand kilometers in range, resembling a Giant Beast, a dark golden mountain range as long as thousands of kilometers suddenly started to tremble.
From within the range, a terrifying and indescribable Aura began to awaken.
At the same time, brilliant Law Radiance started to sparkle on the surface of the dark golden mountain range, with black lightning over ten meters thick intertwining over it, extending for tens of thousands of meters, and red lightning like blood shattered the Void.
Moreover, golden flames, fiery hot, also erupted endlessly from within the dark golden mountain range, burning fiercely and turning tens of thousands of kilometers around it into a fiery sea.
At the crest of the mountain, even more were blue-purple thunders that looked like Thunder Dragons leaping, and purple circles representing the Corrosion Law spreading in all directions.
Simultaneously, golden, dark black, and dark golden Law patterns began to emerge on the surface of the mountain range, gradually forming a layer of thick scale armor material.
Furthermore, a strong and vigorous Aura of life gushed from inside out of the mountain range, as if the entire range had come to life.
Ten Higher-order Law Powers manifested, turning into solid Rune Sequence Chains that encircled the dark golden mountain range, constantly entangling and weaving a kind of great strength.
The terrifying Aura caused the surroundings of the hundred thousand kilometers range to shake, and countless creatures and Unique Beasts, Giant Beasts, all looked towards it in terror, limbs weakening and lying on the ground.
Even because the power was too dreadful, the Space-Time around the Destruction Emperor Dragon was twisted, forming a long river that howled and encircled it.
The sudden turn of events woke the Silver Giant Dragon that had just gone back to sleep for two days, startling it from the ground, surprised at the now chaotically colorful region in the distance.
“Roar! What’s happening to Tim Abott?”
Also awakened, the golden blue Giant Dragon raised its head, its eyes in shock as it looked into the distance, unbelieving, “Thunderflame, it looks like it’s awakening.”
“But how is that possible? Shouldn’t a Giant Beast creature require a long hibernation to complete the rule incubation and Transformation of the Giant Beast Body when breaking through the ancient times?”
Under normal conditions, a Titan Peak Beast breaking through the ancient times usually required several Sun Wheels, or even dozens of Sun Wheels, of sleep.
For instance, Great Sethia’s mother had slept for almost six Sun Wheels before getting through the initial phase, and till now, she’s still in hibernation on the Icebound Mountain Range, transforming.
Compared to the shock of the golden blue Giant Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon looked at it curiously, “Roar! You fool Torsa, have you forgotten that Tim Abott is a ‘genius’?”
“With Tim Abott’s talent, it’s normal for him to breakthrough quickly, especially since he didn’t sleep much when he broke through the Legendary Realm and the Titan Realm before.”
“…Alright, I almost forgot,” the golden blue Giant Dragon suddenly nodded, remembering now in its shock, having forgotten that the Destruction Emperor Dragon is an abnormality.
“Roar! Go Tim Abott, Great Sethia is to dominate the Vast World.”
“Roar Roar!! Great Sethia will let blood flow like rivers, charge ahead…”
The Silver Giant Dragon was very excited, with no traces of sleepiness with the resurrection of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its double wings flapped, and its body, now grown to over thirteen hundred meters, soared into the sky.
Boom! Like a beam of silver light, the Silver Giant Dragon collided into the Single-horned Spawn Roc a thousand kilometers away.
Under the impact of the great strength, the hundred kilometers of Cloud Mist swirling around the Single-horned Spawn Roc instantly dissipated, and the enormous body, like a mountain peak, crashed onto the Earth.
Within the explosion that caused mountains to collapse and the ground to split, the body of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which appeared larger than the Silver Giant Dragon, soared into the sky, looking somewhat wronged at the Silver Giant Dragon.
Roar! Sesi, why did you hit me?
The Silver Giant Dragon was very excited, exhaling White mist from its nostrils that froze Space, “Roar! Jerry Jones, Tim Abott is awakening, he is about to break through the ancient times.”
Yes, I know that Thunderflame is about to awaken and break through, but what’s the point of you hitting me?
Looking at the excitedly circling Silver Giant Dragon in the air, the Single-horned Spawn Roc was confused and speechless, finding it quite ordinary for Thunderflame to breakthrough.
Under the gaze of the three eyes, that force being slowly woven by ten Laws within the sea of chaotically colorful in the distance became more and more terrifying.
The invisible Law Radiance that spread almost lit up this piece of Space-Time, magnificent and splendid beyond words.
The Law formed by the congregation of ten Higher-order Laws, and aside from the Deep Red Strength that came from the Deep Red World, the other nine Higher-order Laws were all from God Transformation Level talent metamorphosis.
Each was stronger than the average Higher-order Law.
Such a dreadful power fusion forming the Law, just the thought of it shows how terrifying it was, to the extent that in the ‘history’ of the mythical world, such horrific strength had never appeared.
