﻿Chapter 1438: Chapter 544: Civilization Destroyed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_4 Chapter 1438: Chapter 544: Civilization Destroyed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon Awakens_4 Mastering ten Higher-order Laws and achieving perfection in ancient breakthroughs, such talent and soul-bearing capacity simply cannot be possessed by a Titan Level Giant Beast.
Or rather, it is impossible for True Spirit Level Giant Beasts to comprehend and bear ten Higher-order Laws.
Roar! A majestic, utterly ferocious roar resounded through Heaven and Earth from the Chaotic Seven-Colored Ocean.
Immediately following was an even more terrifying aura that burst forth. The Silver Giant Dragon that was excitedly circling in the sky with a loud bang plummeted from the heavens, crashing heavily onto the ground.
Boom! Hundreds of kilometers of Earth shattered, countless broken stones soared into the sky, and then, having ascended merely tens of meters, were suppressed by the Invisible Power pervading between heaven and earth.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc, too, was firmly pressed to the ground.
In front of that awakening Horrific Creature, not a single being was qualified to fly in the sky; all could only lie prostrate on the ground and look up.
Instead, it was the golden-blue Giant Dragon which, since it was already lying down, only needed to collapse the mountain peak underneath itself under the Rule pressure and did not have to fall a second time.
At that moment, a long breath sounded between heaven and earth, each inhale and exhale echoing the entire world, and this change continued for half an hour.
Boom! In the Chaotic Seven-Colored Ocean, that terrifying aura surged violently once again.
Roar!
The Chaotic Seven-Colored Ocean trembled, and in its roar, a several-hundred-kilometers vast dark-gold mountain range rose up, its appearance fierce, its shape exactly like that of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
With two pairs of sharp and branching dragon horns on its head, covered in dark-gold fine scales, extending backward are sharp horns like a mane and on both sides, three pairs of feather horns resembling coral.
And between the crevices of the scale armor on its head and neck, some dragon’s mane, like rays of light, were slowly growing.
The dark-gold mountain range had come to life! It had taken the form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, or rather, under the power of the Rule, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had fused with the thousands-of-kilometers-long mountain range.
After a slow glance at the Silver Giant Dragon and the others, the massive dark-gold ‘Giant Dragon’ slowly receded back into the Chaotic Seven-Colored Ocean.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon continued its Transformation, even more magnificent phenomena occurred between heaven and earth.
Crack! The sound of shattering glass suddenly erupted above the Chaotic Seven-Colored Ocean’s Firmament, several tens of thousands of kilometers high, the sky collapsed.
There, the space shattered like physical matter, turning into transparent fragments scattered about, forming a dark Hollow with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, inside which golden lightning danced.
In an instant, an oppressive aura descended that made the Silver Giant Dragon and the others tremble, like the cold, indifferent gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Path looking down from on high.
Especially those dancing golden thunders, invisibly emanating a Destructive Aura that frightened all living beings.
Under the pressure of the Heavenly Dao, the entire world trembled, the Earth undulating like waves, mixed with white shockwaves that emanated in all directions, enveloping a million kilometers.
The sudden upheaval startled the Three-headed Giant Beasts, and the Silver Giant Dragon, pressed heavily to the ground, struggled to raise its head, glaring fiercely at the Hollow flashing with golden lightning above.
“Roar! Damn it, are you the one trying to stop Tim Abott’s breakthrough, you guy in the sky?”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon was somewhat speechless, struggling to say, “…Scythia, that is the strength of Thunderflame’s breakthrough being too powerful, which has triggered the resonance of the Heavenly Earth Rules. It has no consciousness.”
“Moreover, it represents the Will of the Vast World’s operating Rules; don’t shout recklessly.”
In the end, the golden-blue Giant Dragon still gave a warning, not wanting this fool to be struck dead by a bolt of golden thunder.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon shrank back its neck, alright, that being is not to be provoked, inviolable, unless one day the Destruction Emperor Dragon becomes strong enough to shatter the Vast World.
Just then, the dark Hollow above the Firmament burst into dazzling light, and from the heavens descended a heaven-penetrating, earth-shattering, thousand-kilometers-thick Golden Thunderclap Pillar.
In that moment, the sky shattered, the Earth collapsed, and the entire world seemed to be compressed by that horrific pillar of light, forming a black ringed golden pathway.
Facing an attack that could destroy an ordinary world, the Chaotic Seven-Colored Ocean trembled, and a dark golden Dragon Claw hundreds of kilometers wide shot up into the sky.
Intertwined with murky power, the claw emanated a terrifying aura that suppressed space-time and obliterated all things.
Boom!
In an instant, the golden light pillar enveloped the Dragon Claw and burst into the Chao Sea, followed by endless golden lightning exploding, covering tens of thousands of kilometers.
The power, frenzied to the extreme, shook the Seven-Colored Ocean that harbored the Supreme Rule.
Suddenly a tiny golden lightning bolt leaped into existence, snaking for ten thousand kilometers and struck the Silver Giant Dragon at a speed beyond the comprehension of consciousness, like a trace of golden light.
Roar! A dismal shriek resounded immediately.
Under that golden lightning, the laws and bloodline Gifted Power within the Silver Giant Dragon collapsed instantly, and chunks of semi-transparent Silver Scale Armor shattered.
Its tail was electrocuted to stand on end, its limbs stretched out trembling, and its entire body visibly blackened at a speed visible to the naked eye.
“Scythia, are you alright?” the gold and blue Giant Dragon roared with effort.
However, at that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon did not respond to it. Only after trembling for more than ten minutes did it belch out a puff of black smoke and weakly growled, “Roar! No, no problem, I won’t die.”
The gold and blue Giant Dragon sighed in relief, then a hint of schadenfreude appeared in its eyes, “Told you not to blabber, now you know what pain feels like.”
Not far away, the Single-horned Spawn Roc also lay prone on the ground, tucking its wings in.
Luckily, it had hesitated a moment earlier and hadn’t joined Scythia in shouting.
[A few hundred words to conclude, the Giant Beast awakens.]
At this time, the Chaotic Seven-Colored Ocean also gradually changed, numerous Law Radiance interwove, forming a Chaos Halo spanning thousands of kilometers.
Or perhaps that was the Rule of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, slowly revolving, exuding a terrifying and heavy aura.

﻿Chapter 1439: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race Chapter 1439: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race Amid the chaotic currents of destruction, a gilt-red creature, towering like a mountain range, stood with an aura of ancient and powerful gravity, so overwhelming that Heaven and Earth seemed barely able to bear it.
Under the strike of the Heavenly Punishment Golden Sword, the mountain-like body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which originally spanned over five thousand kilometers, had vanished, leaving only a mere twenty-plus kilometers.
By leveraging the Power of Heaven and Earth for Tempering, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had completely finished the final step of Rule body casting, retracing its bloodline to ascend into the Ancient Level.
At this moment, the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was covered in gilt-red Scale armor, shimmering like red-hot forged steel, ablaze with gilt-red flames capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
This flame-like strength was terrifying; the surrounding space melted away layer by layer like glass, revealing the darkest depths of the Dark Void where ferocious shadows began to emerge.
But simply looking at the figure wreathed in gilt-red flames, all the Void Creatures showed a look of awe, not daring to approach.
Even a Void creature, tens of thousands of meters long and exuding an aura of the Ancient Level from the depths of the dark void, revealed a hint of dread in its brutal, cruel eyes before slowly fading away.
At this instant, time and space warped around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, who seemed to stand at the boundary between reality and illusion, suppressing the dark abyss, exuding sanctity and majesty.
Watching the enormous shadow disappear into the depths of the void, a flicker of regret passed through the icy Golden vertical pupils of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
If that ancient Void monster had come forth, it would have provided a perfect opportunity to test the strength after the breakthrough. Unfortunately, the creature had withstood the temptation from the Material World.
In regret, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s intent moved, and at once the gilt-red flames shrouding its body retracted, and its immense form rapidly shrank, soon transforming into a Giant Beast that was six thousand kilometers long.
And this was the normal state of the Destruction Emperor Dragon after breaking through to the Ancient level, the previous form having been its Deep Red Gigantification Form.
After the breakthrough to the Ancient level, the ten Deification talents forged into rules, hence the ability of the Deep Red Form is now limited to the advantages of a burst in foundational strength and Defense after Gigantification.
With a life stage Transformation after the breakthrough to the Ancient level, both the appearance and form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon underwent significant changes.
The black-red scales across its body turned to Black Gold, with a metallic sheen on the surface, each scale featuring three pronounced spines, making them appear both thick and ferocious.
The three rows of Dorsal Fins, standing tall like mountain peaks on its back, stretched from the nape to the tail, with black gold Mane intermixed between the fins.
The wings on either side, composed of bone and scale, were sharp at the edges. The appendages resembled a series of Black Gold sharp blades with golden membranes extending behind them.
They were like a pair of semi-energized light wings, sprawling over a ten-thousand-meter radius, exuding an oppressive feeling.
The Tail of the Ancient Form remained as half of its body, appearing long and agile while also conveying a sense of danger.
The body had become even more muscular; its hind legs were arched and bulging, with an impression of Power Explosion under the covers of the scale armor. Its double claws appeared more robust and elongated, and the claws themselves became even more brutish and sharp.
The most noticeable change was to the neck. The original Destruction Emperor Dragon resembled a hybrid of Western and Eastern dragons.
It had the long tail and head of an Eastern dragon, as well as the robust body of a Western dragon, but now the neck of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was a bit shorter, appearing more muscular.
Of course, this muscular quality was not the short and stubby kind one sees with Godzilla, but slightly longer, creating an appearance that was more balanced and flexible.
Besides, the broad and ferocious dragon head maintained its imposing dignity. The original alignment of the two pairs of dragon horns on the head had also shifted.
The Black Gold dragon horns, reminiscent of those of a deer located at the front, were accompanied by another pair of Spiral Dragon Horns, twice as long, emerging slightly askew and extending backward.
With the mane on the head waving like Black Gold flames in a nonexistent breeze, it was as if it wore an Imperial Crown upon it.
Additionally, the three pairs of Crystal Red feather horns symbolically on either side of the head had been slightly repositioned, tipped backward, and ablaze with Golden flames, resembling a pair of wings.
This added a touch of grandeur to the already majestic, sacred, and ferocious Destruction Emperor Dragon.
At this moment, traces of Eastern and Western Divine Dragons on the Destruction Emperor Dragon were faint, transforming into a completely distinct ancient creature, representing another evolutionary path.
Yet these were but external and physical changes. The most significant of this breakthrough was the Transformation in the life stage and the power.
Aboard the sky-based battleship, Number One, Jack Clark, who had been in Closed-door Cultivation for two days, slowly opened his eyes. An attribute page appeared in his and the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s line of sight.
Avatar Body: Azure Heaven Dragon
Level: Early Ancient Stage [Body length 6,100 meters, possessing ten Deification talents, self-evolved into a ‘Boundary,’ a Heavenly Tier Colossus]
Bloodline: Heavenly Tier Emperor Dragon [Monarch Dragon Might spreads, all life with a bloodline lower than Heavenly Tier will be suppressed, suppression effect depends on the other party’s strength and bloodline level.]
Heaven’s Gift: Can consume bloodline power to grant a bloodline upgrade and Evolution to Giant Beasts below Monarch level once.]
Rule: Chaos Doomsday [Supreme Level, contains the traits of ten Superior talent rules in the power of chaos, with a penchant for the Mystery of Laws towards extinction and destruction.]
Supreme Power: Increases the capability of all Laws Mysteries by forty times.
Final Destruction: In the face of the Supreme Chaos power of destruction, all Heavenly Earth Law and ordinary Rule forces will disintegrate, irresistible.
Doomsday Descent: Consumes Rule Origin to enter Chaos Form, heralding Doomsday. If one chooses to induce the Deep Red World to descend, a further increase in power is possible.
Note: Currently just broken through to the Ancient Realm, Rule Origin is insufficient; overconsumption will damage the foundation, affecting growth speed.

﻿Chapter 1440: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_2 Chapter 1440: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_2 “`
Tip 1: The power of the Deep Red World contains the will of the Deep Red Heavenly Path Beast; please use it cautiously, as integrating too much during battle may risk life traces being eroded.
Tip 2: As a Heavenly Tier life, you are immune to a certain level of Heavenly Dao will erosion.]
Talent Mystery: Chaos Dominant Body [An advancement of the original Strength Talent. Crafted from the origin of destruction, the body is extremely robust, with overbearing strength capable of annihilating everything.]
Vajra Immortal [An advancement of the original Defensive Talent. Tempered by the origin of gold, muscles, bones, and scale armor all attain properties of immortality, indestructible, and even if vanquished, they will not decay for eternity.]
Instantaneous Divine Shift [An advancement of the original Speed Talent. Innately attuned with space and extended by the power of the rules, it ignores all obstacles for instant movement.]
Undying Power [An advancement of the original Life Talent. The body contains the pinnacle of life’s vitality; any severe wound can be healed instantly by consuming life force, without exhausting the origin.
At the same time, by consuming a large amount of the life origin, Rebirth Blood containing the Soul Source imprint is condensed. In the instant when the flesh perishes and is annihilated, one can be revived, with a limit of two drops.]
Doomsday Great Sun [An advancement of the original Flame Talent. The palm-sized Great Sun incinerates everything and can merge with the Rule Domain to release all fire origin instantly, forming the Doomsday Great Sun, obliterating everything.]
Thunderbolt Tyrant [An advancement of the original Thunder Talent. Control the thunderstorm magnetic field and harness the Heaven and Earth’s thunder magnetic powers that are several times the domain of the rules, mastering wind and thunder.
Tyrant Halo envelops all the Power of Thunder between heaven and earth, compressing it within the body, transforming into the tyrant of thunder, with the power to destroy heaven and earth, and reshape the cosmos.]
Crimson Destruction [An advancement of the original Gigantification Talent. Upon entering Giantification form, all powers and defenses are amplified by thirty times, while agility and speed drop significantly.
Tip: It can be stacked with other talent abilities.]
Chaotic Force Field [An advancement of the original Dark Force Talent. The body’s surface contains a layer of force field that is immune to all kinds of power, including the damage from rules, decreasing in sequence if the intensity of attacks exceeds the limit of endurance.]
Corrosion of Everything [An advancement of the original Toxin Talent. All powers within the body, including claws, now contain potent toxins that corrode any substance and energy they contact, dissolving life.]
Dark Realm Swallowing [An advancement of the original Dark Star Talent. The origin of the heavy star forms a devouring space within the body that can refine all matter and energy.]
Evolution value: 1551471/2000000
Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a deep breath as his gaze swept over the breakthrough changes on the attribute page, revealing a look of surprise and shock in his eyes.
The power of the Heavenly Tier bloodline goes without saying; it only further strengthened the dragon’s might and the original bloodline stimulation abilities, becoming akin to a bestowed blessing.
It can directly cause the bloodlines of lives below the level of Monarchs to evolve; this kind of enhancement has an amazing effect on Ancient Level Giant Beasts.
Each Ancient Level Giant Beast has mastered two to three Top Tier Talents, and their bloodline level has reached the high-order Monarch or even the peak, just one step away from stepping into the Emperor level.
But this step is incredibly difficult, blocking a large number of Ancient Beasts. This is also why many Giant Beasts at the peak of ancient times fail to breakthrough and ultimately petrify.
The bloodline ability of the Destruction Emperor Dragon can directly make these Monarch Ancient Beasts, who are just one step away, step directly into the Emperor level in terms of life hierarchy.
Of course, such a level of enhancement would probably consume the Destruction Emperor Dragon immensely, but it doesn’t matter to it.
Previously, Jack was thinking about how to get the Blue-White Giant Dragon, Time Dragon, and Dust Serpent to join his expedition.
After all, they are all Dragon Kings, and it’s fine to collectively attack two or three Ancient Beast Empires, but it would be rather difficult to inexplicably follow the Destruction Emperor Dragon into a Civilization Great War.
That could involve dozens of Ancient Level combatants, and they might even face the dangerous battlefield of True Spirit Level Purgatory ancestors.
Moreover, as the Purgatory Family is billions of miles away from the Dragon Palace, separated by countless dangerous forbidden zones, and there is no conflict of interest between the two, they are entirely unrelated.
However, this bloodline ability has now solved the problem.
By using the improvement of bloodlines as a condition, these Ancient Giant Beasts would follow it to partake in the Civilization Great War, even at the risk of falling – these beasts would not refuse.
In addition to bloodline abilities, the rules condensed in this breakthrough are powerful, directly reaching the Supreme Level.
Just as laws vary in strength, the powers of the rules differ among each other, like the common rules that are consolidated around Higher-order Laws like Earth, water, and fire.
The common Rule power provides an increase of about tenfold for all talents.
Though only tenfold, this increase is on the basis of talents that could already unleash ten to dozens of times more power. Multiply that fearfully with the Laws Mystery, and the result is a terrifying enhancement.
This is the terrifying reason why ancient creatures can affect tens of thousands of kilometers with their power: this exaggerated enhancement of Rule power is something even Titan Level beasts cannot withstand.
As for powerful Rules, they require one Supreme Law and two Higher-order Laws as the foundation. When breaking through to the Ancient level, powerful rules are condensed.
The base amplification for all Talent Mysteries reaches twentyfold.
Thus, the strong are always stronger. Even when both parties are Ancient Beasts, Purgatory Demon Gods, members of the Human Race, or Divine Kings, there can still be a massive gap in their strengths.
Of course, this level of Rule power can increase with strength by comprehending more compatible laws and merging them to make one’s Rule even stronger.
Alternatively, one could refine a World-class weapon by reforging rules of a whole world, or additionally condense an Abyss Demon God True Body like Tyris did.
At the Ancient Level, there are even more aspects involved in battle power.
Weapons, the Divine Secret Skills that one cultivates, the level of the involved rules, enlightenment, and so on.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1441 - 1441 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon Immortal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1441: Chapter 545: Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_3 Chapter 1441: Chapter 545: Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_3 And as soon as the Destruction Emperor Dragon had a breakthrough, the rules it condensed reached the Supreme level, which was the endpoint of cultivation on the path of rules for ancient creatures with matchless talent.
Yet, this was merely the starting point for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose strength and bloodline evolution would grow increasingly powerful as its Law Power underwent further refinement and perfection.
Similarly terrifying was the Supreme Power Rule that Jack Clark had condensed.
At the beginning, when it had just begun to take shape, the basic amplification reached fifteen times. It likely would not be weaker than the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Chaos Doomsday once he broke through to the Ancient Level.
Repressing the shock in his heart, Jack Clark’s gaze fell upon the talents below.
All the Law Powers, after being forged into rules, did not mean that these powers had disappeared; these laws still existed and formed the basis of the ‘world’ trait of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body.
With this breakthrough, these talent abilities also became much stronger.
The most terrifying was the Fusion Traits of the Ancient Beasts, which allowed the talent abilities that could only be used one at a time before ancient times to be freely combined under the power of the rules.
For instance, the Chaotic Overlord Heaven and Vajra Immortal along with the Chaotic Force Field on the side of its body, when stacked with basic rule amplification, would turn the Giant Beast Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon into something unimaginably horrific.
Its strength would grow stronger, its Defense utterly impregnable, bolstered further by the mystique of speed.
If it were to enter its Gigantification form and gain further amplification, the Destruction Emperor Dragon would become invincible in close combat, capable of withstanding the True Spirits.
Similarly, the Doomsday Great Sun, Thunderbolt Tyrant, and Corrosion of Everything on the energy side could also be combined, forming an extremely terrifying Death Domain under a fortyfold basic Rule amplification.
Ordinary Ancient-level Giant Beasts wouldn’t even get close to the Destruction Emperor Dragon before being dissolved into nothingness by the destructive power that covered tens of thousands of kilometers.
Beings below the level of the ancients could be directly disregarded, and the Destruction Emperor Dragon could simply unleash the Destruction Domain to destroy the fundamental rules of a One-side World, causing the world to collapse.
Indeed, just one ‘Person’ could obliterate a world, which was the origin of its Doomsday title.
It could be said that with its breakthrough to the Ancient Level, the ten Deification Talents of the Destruction Emperor Dragon fully demonstrated their superiority, which was the terrifying ruling power that Heavenly Tier beings ought to possess.
While Jack Clark’s consciousness merged as one, feeling the changes from this breakthrough of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
In another place far away, more than a hundred million kilometers from the Human Race Territorial Area, cities floated in the sky, heading in the direction of the Human Race.
The smallest of these Floating Cities had a diameter of over a hundred kilometers, shielded by a blue glimmer, with buildings beneath that resembled those of ancient human times, albeit far grander and full of ancient charm.
Among these Floating Cities, beings somewhat resembling humans of different races moved about.
The men of these races stood around 2 meters tall, and the women were somewhat shorter, most of them garbed in white, blue, or green silk garments reminiscent of ancient times.
The major difference between them and humans was in their ears: the men had silver metallic wing-like adornments at their ears, exuding an air of magnificence and dignity.
The women, on the other hand, had small white wing-like adornments, conferring an ethereal, light, and beautiful elegance.
At that moment, in the leading Floating City with a diameter surpassing a thousand kilometers, a towering observatory that reached ten thousand meters stood proudly, with bands of green luminescence rotating around it, imparting an air of utmost sanctity.
At the top of this observatory, the Nether Heavenly King of the Human Race stood calm, alongside a middle-aged ‘Person’ in a golden robe, peering down ahead.
Suddenly, the handsome middle-aged man sighed, “Our clan has stood between heaven and earth for tens of thousands of years; I never imagined that one day we would face the annihilation of our lands and have to flee to other domains.”
The Nether Heavenly King sighed, “This is the cruelty of the Vast World; whether it’s Brother Russ of the Immortal Spirit Clan or our Human Race, we’re but ordinary members in the mythical world.”
“In this universe where countless powerful lives and civilizations coexist, being weak is the original sin.”
“Even if your clan hadn’t encountered The Purgatory Family, another powerful race would have emerged, and the same fate of annihilation would have been unavoidable.”
“That’s why we need to band together even more, bringing together our strength to face threats from all directions.”
“It’s not only about dealing with the current threat from Purgatory; we must also work together and integrate the strengths of our clans, complementing each other’s weaknesses, to make ourselves even stronger.”
“Besides the Nobles, our Human Race has already formed an alliance with the Divine Gods Alliance and the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
“With the combined strength of our four clans, plus the unique narrow battlefield environment where my clan is situated, we should be able to withstand a joint offensive even from the eight great empires of The Purgatory Family.”
The Nether Heavenly King spoke confidently, his influential tone uplifting the spirits of the middle-aged man next to him.
When sending messengers to make contact with the Heavenly Feather Clan, the Human Race naturally wouldn’t miss out on another powerful civilization that had been engaged in hundreds to thousands of years of warfare with Purgatory civilization.
Only, this civilization was even further away; by the time the Mysterious Martial Sky King and his party brought the messengers of the Heavenly Feather Clan back and forth, he had just arrived.
Moreover, the predicament of the Immortal Spirit Clan was even more severe than that of the Heavenly Feather Clan, having nearly reached the brink of extinction, and they had prepared to abandon their homelands and delve deeper into the mythical world.
The environment surrounding the Immortal Spirit Clan was also highly dangerous, with forbidding areas where Heavenly Kings—and even Supreme Experts—could perish, littered in all directions. It was akin to a much larger death ground.
This was the reason why the Nether Heavenly King had travelled such a long distance.
If not for proceeding along the edge of the Purgatory Empire, he might well have perished along the way.
The arrival of the Nether Heavenly King brought surprise to the Immortal Spirit Clan, and after learning about the ‘Outer World’ and that two other civilizations were at war with The Purgatory Family, they were filled with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 1442 - 1442 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon Immortal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1442: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_4 Chapter 1442: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_4 Especially since the Human Race and the Heavenly Feather Clan have already “allied”.
Although at this time, the Nether Heavenly King had no idea that the Human Race had formed an alliance with the Heavenly Feather Clan and had sent the Expeditionary Army back and forth to carry out their mission.
But no matter, trick them into coming back first, take whatever strength can be gathered, since there is anyway no way out for them.
Under the Nether Heavenly King’s artful “persuasion”, the Immortal Spirit Clan, driven to desperation, abandoned their ancestral world, leaving a part of their forces behind to cover their retreat.
The rest, led by several Immortal Spirit Kings, detonated their Race Background Weapon to temporarily form a pathway, crossing several horrific forbidden areas to make their escape.
However, because they were unfamiliar with the route, this remnant of the Immortal Spirit Clan moved slowly, only able to rely on the Moonstone in the hands of the Nether Heavenly King to locate the direction of the Human Race.
……
On the edge of Chaos, a Black Gold Ancient Beast over six thousand meters in length slowly emerged, each step shaking the Earth and Heaven around it.
The invisible aura it emitted drew in the Heavenly Energy from within tens of thousands of kilometers, creating rings of white energy tides that surged in all directions, a truly magnificent sight.
The Silver Giant Dragon lying on the ground, most of its scale armor still charred black, let out an excited roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, you have become so fierce!”
The gigantic head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, stirring up rolling waves of air, followed by a deep and resounding voice.
“Not bad, this breakthrough felt good.”
The Silver Giant Dragon struggled to stand up, its excitement spreading its double wings wide and its Dragon Claw lightly tapping the Earth, “Roar! Tim Abott, we can now dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region, right?”
Feeling the Silver Giant Dragon’s ever-casual attitude, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s lips curled slightly, revealing a ferocious smile.
“Of course, now, I am invincible.”
After the breakthrough into ancient times, the Destruction Emperor Dragon might not yet be among the top-tier forces in the mythical world, but it was confident in its invincibility within the limited scope of the Chaotic Turbulent Region—even if there were True Spirit Level Ancient Beasts lurking.
Of course, this excluded the Time True Spirit Beast that had already disappeared.
The Silver Giant Dragon became even more excited at this, its wings flapping to shake off loose black fragments, as its massive form soared into the sky, circling the Destruction Emperor Dragon with thrill.
At that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its head to look at the gold and blue Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc not far away (thousands of kilometers away), and let out a low, space-time-shaking roar.
“Joe, Telsafi, there’s no need to hold back. No matter to what realm my strength breaks through, we will still be ‘friends’, teammates.”
Compared to the carefree Silver Giant Dragon, facing the breakthrough to ancient times and the actual strength even entering the True Spirit of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, both the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the gold and blue Giant Dragon felt an instinctive fear.
Especially the subtle but terrifying pressure of the bloodline emanating from its body.
Such a huge gap that even before the Destruction Emperor Dragon got close, their bodies and souls emitted instincts of reverence, submission, and fear.
Even the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which had been following the Destruction Emperor Dragon from the beginning, could not avoid this.
Just as the two beasts were feeling somewhat restrained, a childish, milky voice suddenly emerged from the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Yi ya yi ya!! Eat, May needs to eat more, so delicious, so fragrant.
Atop the huge dragon head, a twenty-meter-long Purple little dragon lay curled up with its eyes closed, its body exuding faint waves of Creation, absorbing the rich Aura of Life emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
This dense Aura of Life almost materialized, forming strands of golden-red breath that swirled around, devoured by the Purple little dragon.
The sight made the gold and blue Giant Dragon’s eyes widen in amazement.
That was the pure Aura of Life from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and it had condensed into a tangible form—an Aura of Life so potent that a single strand was comparable to a Law Level Bloodline Divine Object.
But only that little one could ‘eat’ like that, the gold and blue Giant Dragon’s eyes showed envy.
Such a power to condense the tangible from the void Aura of Life was incredibly formidable, not to mention that the Destruction Emperor Dragon let the Purple little dragon absorb it freely without resisting.
This devouring was in fact akin to absorbing the Vitality of the Destruction Emperor Dragon itself.
As the gold and blue Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc gradually adjusted their emotions and began to rise from the ground, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, noticing the excited circling Silver Giant Dragon, suddenly let out a low growl.
“Let’s go, I have broken through ancient times and it’s time to return.”
“Once we’re back, we will gather all forces to unite all Mythical-level Ancient Beasts of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, and then I will launch an expedition.”
“An expedition, Tim Abott, who are you going to fight?” asked the Silver Giant Dragon, taken aback.
In the curious gaze of the three beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon coldly growled, “A powerful force that wields the strength of twenty ancient beings—I will slaughter them all.”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon roared in response.
“Roar! That despicable force dared to provoke Tim Abott, they’re seeking death—slay them all, for the Great Sethia to flow with rivers of blood.”
Regaining his senses, the Single-horned Spawn Roc also vigorously flapped his wings.
Roar roar roar!! Those guys truly deserve death, daring to provoke Thunderflame. When the time comes, we must kill and plunder all that they have.
In contrast to the two beasts who adored the Destruction Emperor Dragon blindly, the gold and blue Giant Dragon breathed a sigh of relief, “Twenty ancient beasts should not be a problem.”
With the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s peerless within the same rank, battle power spanning boundaries, fighting even twenty ancient lives was not impossible.
Currently, aside from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Dragon Palace held other ancient-level forces namely Jormungand the Dust Serpent, the Batfish Beast Alius, and Lord of the Earth Kutadire.

chapters.title: Chapter 1443 - 1443 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon Immortal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1443: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_5 Chapter 1443: Chapter 545 Ancient Emperor Dragon, Immortal Spirit Remnant Race_5 There was also the King of Blade Edge, Toriad, whose combat power was comparable to an ordinary ancient creature, bringing the number of ancient-level powers in the Dragon Palace to five.
In addition to her, the mother of Scythia, Adriana, should have also achieved a breakthrough to ancient times. Considering Scythia’s relationship, it should be no problem to bring her into the fray.
Then there was her mother in the late stage of the Titan growth, who could be persuaded to join the Dragon Palace when the time comes.
Calculating, the golden-blue giant dragon revealed a look of shock in its eyes as it hadn’t expected the strength of the Dragon Palace Empire to have expanded to this extent so stealthily.
Who could have predicted that just a few Sun Wheels ago, the Dragon Palace was merely a small force with only a few members, and the strongest, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, had just made a breakthrough into the Legendary Realm.
In the midst of the golden-blue giant dragon’s shock, a circle of golden-red lightwaves exploded centering around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, distorting space and enveloping it along with the Silver Giant Dragon and the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Under the force of rules, several Giant Beasts transformed into a beam of light in an instant and disappeared into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, crossing hundreds of thousands of miles in the blink of an eye to appear amidst an immense fiery sea.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon departed, the terrifying pressure that engulfed this World also vanished, and the countless Unique Beasts within a million-mile radius all breathed a sigh of relief.
In fact, most Unique Beasts below Level 9 of the mythic realm didn’t understand what they were afraid of.
They only knew that they suddenly felt weak all over, unable to stand, and instinctively lowered their heads in worship toward a certain direction.
Half a day after the Destruction Emperor Dragon departed, the space where it broke through crumbled, the rules were in chaos, and the air was still filled with its Destructive Aura, forming a Dark Forbidden Zone tens of thousands of miles wide.
At this moment, in the center of the forbidden area, through the fragile Space Cracks, wisps of Black Power began to emerge out of thin air.
This Black Power was different from the Abyss Demonic Aura; it didn’t bear an intense evil and darkness. Instead, it was filled with chaos, pollution, distortion, and madness.
After passing through the deep Void cracks, these wisps of Black Power spread cautiously in all directions like delicate tentacles, seemingly sensing something.
As the aura of Void permeated and spread, it soon covered thousands of miles, and the perception of invisible and powerful ancient creatures swept across a region spanning hundreds of thousands of miles.
Without any powerful life aura or energy fluctuations, that terrifying creature had already left.
Suddenly, within the depths of the Void behind the cracks, a massive creature slowly breathed a sigh of relief.
Even so, this enormous creature did not come out directly but continued to hibernate, continuously transmitting Void strength containing rules.
As the Black Power continued to surge forth, the forbidden area soon became engulfed with a thick, mad Void strength.
Only then, in the center of the forbidden area, did the crack which had been shattered by the base rules of the Supreme strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and which led directly to the depths of the Void, suddenly began to tremble violently.
Boom! A black tentacle, tens of thousands of meters long and covered with white bone spurs, tore through the pathway and emerged into the Material World.
Following closely, another immense claw as large as mountain ranges reached out from the depths of the Void, entwined with black Void Rules. With a tremendous burst of strength, it tore fiercely.
Rip!!
The space sounded like torn fabric, shattering layer by layer as a pitch-black crack thousands of miles long was torn open, leading straight into the dark depths.
Standing behind the crack was a creature over thirty thousand meters long, covered in black scale armor with an upper body resembling a Violent Dragon and two pairs of giant claws like a mantis.
Its lower half was bent at four feet, with a long tail, and eight ten-thousand meter long tentacles on its back. The creature, covered in sharp bone spurs all over its body, roared silently, its four pairs of greedy eyes fixed on the opposite Material World.
Boom!
As this terrifying creature of the Void entered the crack, this World began to shake violently, with waves of strong rejection force descending upon it.
For the Material World, the twisted and strange Void Creatures were like ‘cancer,’ similar to dark matter, rejected by the fundamental rules of the Primary Material World.
The stronger the Void Creature, the more intense this rejection force becomes, making it very difficult for them to enter the Primary Material World, even with cracks that penetrate deep into the Void.
This was especially true under the incredibly powerful foundation rules of the mythical world.
However, because of the reason for the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s breakthrough, the foundational rules here were chaotic and collapsed, and the rejection force was significantly weakened.
Boom!
In the trembling Space Cracks, the Void Creature forcefully descended, instantly unleashing endless amounts of Dark Void power in all directions, engulfing Heaven and Earth as it blotted out the sky.
Roar!
Surrounded by the dark aura of the Void, the Ancient Monster couldn’t help but let out a ferocious and violent roar, its cold, cruel eyes excitedly surveying its surroundings.
It, the powerful Lord of Void, Dlair, had arrived so easily in the Primary Material World.
Next, as long as it contaminated enough life, polluted this World, and even this world, the power it would gain would soon allow it to become the master of the Void.
To contaminate millions of creatures and devour the World’s Power of the corrupted worlds is the instinct of these twisted Void Creatures, or rather, their source of power.
Just as the Ancient Monster was about to take action in its excitement, suddenly a deep and authoritative voice resounded above the Firmament.
“I thought you could resist the temptation of the Primary Material World.”
Above tens of thousands of miles and still enveloped in the pressure of the Heavenly Dao within the Area of Destruction, the figure of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, bathed in Black Gold, slowly emerged.
“I thought you could resist the temptation of the Primary Material World.”
Above tens of thousands of miles and still enveloped in the pressure of the Heavenly Dao within the Area of Destruction, the figure of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, bathed in Black Gold, slowly emerged.

chapters.title: Chapter 1444 - 1444 546 Doomsday Great Sun Open Heaven and
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1444: Chapter 546: Doomsday Great Sun, Open Heaven and Earth Chapter 1444: Chapter 546: Doomsday Great Sun, Open Heaven and Earth At the very moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon appeared, the ancient aura that reigned supreme over all living beings filled this world, suppressing the rules of Heaven and Earth.
Especially the Terrifying Aura of the Ancient Heavenly Dragon, which made even the Void Creature known as Dlair, though it was also of the Ancient Level, feel its legs soften a bit.
This kind of suppression that stemmed from the hierarchy of life didn’t just come from the body and bloodline, but even seeped into the soul.
However, the eyes of this Ancient Monster soon revealed madness and ferocity.
For it, Dlair, the Void King, and calamity of the twisted world, to feel fear towards an Ancient Beast of the Material World was unthinkable, unforgivable.
Roar!
Under the sway of its brutal and angry emotions, Dlair broke through the suppression of its bloodline, and then a Terrifying Aura comparable to the ancient late-stage burst forth.
Boom!
Endless torrents of dark energy surged skyward, forming hordes of Void Creatures ranging from kilometers to tens of kilometers and even tens of thousands of kilometers in size, roaring to the heavens.
These creatures, condensed from the power of the void, seemed tangible in their thousands, each exuding the Aura and Will of Titan Level and Mythical Level beings.
The most powerful among these Void Creatures even emitted an Aura typical of the Ancient Early Stage, creating a vast sea of monsters.
The moment these monsters, formed from the unwilling and resentful souls taken by Dlair, appeared, the Ancient Monster’s Aura surged multiple times over.
This ability was somewhat similar to Jack Clark’s Doomsday Blood Sea Hell, with all the resentment, unwillingness, hate, and Killing Intent of his slain enemies intertwining with each other and falling into Hell upon their deaths.
Under the power of Doomsday Hell, these resentments would condense into blood shadows like vengeful spirits, amplifying the power of his domain.
However, with the enhancement of the Void Rules, Dlair’s Void Contamination Domain offered even stronger amplification.”
And all of this happened in an instant.
Just as Dlair summoned an endless army of Void Creatures, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was releasing the Single-Horned Spawn Roc, its right claw slashing across space, tearing a Black Crack in it.
Whoosh! Under the force of Invisible Power, the Single-Horned Spawn Roc and the two Giant Dragons instantly passed through the spatial cracks and appeared over thirty thousand kilometers away.
Only then did the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body start to emit streaks of purple Thunder Light that exploded outwards, forming a Thunder Ring several kilometers wide that continued to expand tens of thousands of kilometers.
Boom! In an instant, for tens of thousands of kilometers around, the Heaven and Earth raged with endless lightning, creating a terrifying storm of thunder and magnetic fields.
At the center of the storm, the Destruction Emperor Dragon glowed radiantly, its feet surrounded by ten Thunder Rings ranging from ten to tens of kilometers in diameter, flashing like the Thundering Tyrant who commanded all the Thunder Rules.
And the moment the thunder-magnetic domain was unleashed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon glowed even more brilliantly, as endless golden flames erupted, forming a vast Sun with a diameter of thousands of kilometers.
Surrounding the Great Sun were circles of purple corrosion light, merging with the flames and thunder to create a terrifying domain capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
At the heart of the burning Sun stood a gold-red Giant Beast over twenty thousand meters in length, emitting a Terrifying Aura that even the rules trembled before.
Facing this ‘very strong’ Ancient Late Stage Monster, the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t take it lightly and immediately entered its Monstrous World-Destroying Form.
Of course, it wasn’t careless, but this Void Creature hadn’t yet earned the right for it to go into a Limit Breakthrough.
In its Titan Level, the Deep Red Form was the trump card of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, something it used as a last resort when fighting across levels, usually reluctant to use it to avoid excessive consumption.
But after the breakthrough to the Ancient Level, the Monstrous Form had become a normal Talent Ability.
Watching the two Ancient Beings tens of thousands of kilometers apart, covered by the domains of Void and Apocalypse, the Silver Giant Dragon, with its wings flapping wildly, roared with excitement.
“Roar! Tim Abbott is invincible! Kill that guy!”
Influenced by the Silver Giant Dragon and feeling the two earth-shattering Terrifying Auras in the sky, the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon started to feel its tail go weak as its eyes reddened with excitement.
“Kill, tear that Void Creature in half, the great Telsafi loves watching the Beasts being torn apart by you.”
Roar! These two Giant Dragons were too ferocious.
The Single-Horned Spawn Roc shrank its sturdy neck instinctively moving away from the two excited Giant Dragons, fearing they might get together and beat it in their agitation.
After all, Scythia had just recklessly knocked it down from the sky in its excitement.
If not for its thick scale armor and robust body, a normal blow from the Silver Giant Dragon’s horns would have severely injured a typical Mythical Giant Beast.
Roar!
Feeling the Terrifying Aura above the Firmament, the Ancient Monster let out another ferocious roar, its blood-red eyes and countless tentacles sweeping across Heaven and Earth as it took the offensive.
Roar! Roar! Roar!
The monsters bound by the Void Rules roared as they followed the lead of the Black Python in the Ancient Early Stage, soaring to the skies and triggering a Tsunami-like tide of darkness towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
While countless Void Creatures obscured the sun, the Ancient Monster abruptly turned and charged towards the depths of the spatial cracks behind it.
The Giant Beast from the Primary Material World was too terrifying, with only the Realm of the Ancient Early Stage, yet its current display was completely dominant compared to the ancient ones.
It was unwinnable, death would follow.
Just entering a normal Apocalypse Form, the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon alone was enough to completely rid the Ancient Monster of its Battle Intent.
All the brutality and killing intent that had risen from anger vanished entirely.
But just as it wanted to leave, would the Destruction Emperor Dragon that had set its sights on it possibly let it go?

chapters.title: Chapter 1445 - 1445 546 Doomsday Great Sun Open Heaven and
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1445: Chapter 546: Doomsday Great Sun, Open Heaven and Earth_2 Chapter 1445: Chapter 546: Doomsday Great Sun, Open Heaven and Earth_2 Roar! The ferocious and majestic Dragon Roar echoed through Heaven and Earth as a resplendence surged above the Firmament.
Infinite golden flames burst forth and spread, fusing with Thunder and the Corrosion Rule, transforming into a World-Destroying Great Sun with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers.
Golden, purple, and blue halos encircled the Great Sun.
Such a terrifying Aura made the Ancient Monster, which had just turned around, freeze in terror and instinctively look up.
Above the Firmament, that sun emitting endless light suddenly sank, descending with a seeming slowness but an actual speed beyond description.
As the horrifying strength pressed down, the surrounding Space-Time twisted, and everything in its path, whether matter, energy, or the foundational space of this World, was collapsing.
In an instant, the Doomsday Great Sun appeared above the sky-obscuring Black Tsunami.
Without sound or disturbance, under the scorching light, those Void Creatures silently dissipated, including the Ancient Monster of the early period which had no chance to resist.
Under the terrifying strength, the domains constructed by Void Rules also broke apart incessantly, exposing the horrified gaze of the Ancient Monster below.
I’m going to die, I’m going to die, I’m going to die!!
Watching the World-Destroying Great Sun, whose mere force was causing its Void domain to collape, Dlair’s brain frantically signalled impending death.
Roar!
Dlair went completely mad; under the threat of death, it burned all its Rule Origins in an instant, including its True Body and soul.
Boom!
Billowing Black Flames erupted from Dlair’s body, with its aura soaring more than twenty times, and its form swelling to over fifty thousand meters, covered in vicious bone spurs.
At the same time, at Dlair’s center, a pitch-black, devilish Void Rule strength burst forth, rendering everything around it into absolute darkness.
Space, matter, even time itself turned into Void under Dlair’s frenzied eruption, polluting and twisting everything.
And behind Dlair, within the Dark Void, a shadow standing ten thousand miles tall, formed entirely by Void Rules and its own Talent Ability, slowly rose.
Beholding the World-Destroying Great Sun falling from the sky, Dlair, briefly one with the Rules, let out a ferocious roar, with tentacles spanning Heaven and Earth from behind it, rolling towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
At the same time, two pairs of mantis claws also slashed out instantaneously, with their keen edges severing Space-Time, forming four intersecting Black Cracks that extended unceasingly.
At this moment, Dlair felt itself immensely powerful.
Having burned everything, its strength reached a realm once unimaginable, on the cusp of the powers of a True Spirit with its incarnation as Rule.
In the nearly frozen time, the World-Destroying Great Sun instantly engulfed the monster turned into Void Rules.
Boom! An indescribably powerful force erupted instantaneously, bringing down the heavens and sinking the earth.
From a high altitude, the dark area formed by the breakthrough of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, including the Void domain, collapsed in an instant, melting away under the endlessly bursting golden-red light.
The surrounding Earth melted layer by layer into scorching matter, flung in all directions in a ring shape, with Scorching Magma shooting tens of thousands of kilometers into the sky.
Thirty thousand kilometers away from the battlefield, the Silver Giant Dragon and others hadn’t yet reacted when they were overwhelmed by the dazzling, scorching, golden-red impact and were blown away with it.
Roar! The Silver Giant Dragon let out a panicked roar, striving to flap its wings to maintain balance.
Around the Silver Giant Dragon, a Destruction Ice Crystal Storm domain swirled, shaking madly as it was compressed from a hundred kilometers to just a few meters in radius by that scorching impact.
While the Three-headed Giant Beast was thrown over a hundred thousand kilometers away by the blast’s shockwave, the Space-Time at the center of the explosion collapsed, and the Doomsday Great Sun, releasing devastating power, raged wildly.
At the heart of the scorching sun, almost transformed into golden-red light, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a brutal roar.
On its double claws, entwined with golden-red lightning, a terrifying strength capable of crushing the heavens pressed the charred body of the Ancient Monster firmly to the ‘ground’.
Between the two Ancient Beasts, the Dark Void Rules crumbled under the golden-red lightning, unable to withstand a single blow.
Moreover, with flames from all directions of the Doomsday Great Sun scorching and burning, the Ancient Monster’s entwined dark powers kept dissipating.
Roar roar roar!!
With its head pressed to the ‘ground’ and the Void crushed underneath, Dlair let out a mad roar, but was utterly unable to shake the terrifying Dragon Claw above it.
As for the tentacles, two pairs of mantis claws, and the tail on Dlair’s back, each time they barely grew back they were severed again by the continuously flashing blades within the flames.
The Annihilating Tail Blade, almost merged with the Doomsday Great Sun, was like an exceedingly sharp bolt of lightning.
Under the ensnaring Doomsday Rule of Chaos, the golden-red Tail Blade instantly Annihilated the Void Rules with unparalleled sharpness, invincible and irresistible.
Although Dlair was of higher realm, having reached the ancient late stage, it was virtually powerless against the Destruction Emperor Dragon of the ancient early stage.
Even though Dlair’s Void Rules were nearing grand accomplishment with formidable might, they crumbled upon contact with the Doomsday destructive powers.
Not to mention the Giant Beast Body’s strength, Dlair was overwhelmed in every aspect.
If not for Rule-based Creatures’ horrific Vitality, the Undying characteristic, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon would need some time to erode it away, otherwise Dlair would have been instantly slain.
This was the Supreme Domination of the Destruction Emperor Dragon among its peers, absolutely invincible.
Half an hour later, the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly roared, and its double claws wrapped in golden-red lightning swelled with muscles, instantly releasing an unstoppable Burst of strength.
Dlair let out a miserable scream; under the Limit Breakthrough, its more than fifty thousand meters long body was torn in half by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.

﻿Chapter 1446: Chapter 546: Doomsday Great Sun, Open Heaven and Earth_3 Chapter 1446: Chapter 546: Doomsday Great Sun, Open Heaven and Earth_3 In the burning tri-colored flames, the aura of Dlair, torn by the rule body, grew weaker and weaker, until soon the last remnants of its soul will had dissipated.
At the center of the scorching Doomsday Great Sun, a golden-red Giant Beast, over twenty thousand meters long, suddenly lifted its head while grasping a charred giant corpse.
Roar!
A ferocious roar filled with utmost hostility resounded through Heaven and Earth, shaking the fabric of space-time. Under the influence of Dragon Might, every creature within a million kilometers trembled and bowed in worship.
After releasing a wave of its inner desire for slaughter and brutality, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly exhaled a hot breath and, with a thought, began to retract its power.
As a result, the surrounding Doomsday Great Sun collapsed, with the golden flames, Thunder, and Corrosion Law separating and transforming into streams of light that disappeared inside the Emperor Dragon’s body.
Unlike the past, where unleashing the Great Sun Eruption would create a compressed fireball that would explode upon encountering an enemy, the Doomsday Great Sun talent of merging three rule factors truly formed a Destruction Sun.
As long as the Destruction Emperor Dragon wished, it could hang continuously in the Firmament, scorching the skies and boiling the seas.
Yet, this Ancient Monster didn’t have the privilege to witness this scene.
With the disappearance of the Doomsday Great Sun, the region where the Destruction Emperor Dragon resided became an Area of Destruction with a diameter of fifty thousand kilometers where space continually shattered and restored itself.
In this area, the Earth vanished into nothingness, forming a Hollow big enough to contain several Blue Stars.
At the core of this pit, the Earth shattered in all directions, riddled with cracks, forming layer upon layer of radiating waves that extended over hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
It wasn’t until the Silver Giant Dragons sensed the end of the great battle and approached the dark area, somewhat bedraggled, flapping their wings.
There, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had reverted to its normal size of six thousand one hundred meters and was devouring a Black Mountain Range with each bite creating a massive void.
Under the prey of that mouth full of sharp, giant teeth, the charred scale armor, tough flesh and blood, and bones of the Ancient Monster were directly crushed and disappeared.
Moreover, under the talent ability of Dark Realm Swallowing, the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t need to chew and could swallow directly.
This brutal scene made the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the others feel a chill rise from their tails.
Too terrifying for beasts.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon fed on the Ancient Monster, it quickly metabolized the ‘flesh and blood’ in its world-like stomach, likened to a doomsday furnace, at an astonishing rate.
In an instant, energy levels exciting even to the Destruction Emperor Dragon exploded within its body.
Boom!
Endless biological energy containing rule factors burst forth, prompting the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s cells to divide frantically, bones to grow, and muscles to form.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the bountiful energy, the Emperor Dragon’s newly advanced Giant Beast Body swelled at a visible rate, its scales pried open by the expanding ‘muscles’ and making a cracking noise.
“How could this be, Thunder was already an Ancient Giant Beast!” This vision left the golden-blue Giant Dragon deeply shaken, almost beyond belief.
It hadn’t anticipated that the terrifying growth trait of the Destruction Emperor Dragon would still be present after it became an ancient life form.
Or rather, after advancing to the Ancient Level, the Evolution speed of the Destruction Emperor Dragon became even more terrifying.
In the past, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could only rely on biological energy derived from the flesh of Mythical Giant Beasts, Titan Beasts, and a few Ancient Beasts that hadn’t fully transitioned into rule bodies, to grow rapidly.
Now, with its strengthened capabilities and a talent for darkness, the devouring ability of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was enhanced again, no longer restricted to beast flesh alone.
Whether it was those heavy matter metal veins, Mythical-level resource materials, or the fully rule-integrated bodies of the Ancient Beasts, it could devour them all.
The golden-blue Giant Dragon could envision that the growth speed of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was about to accelerate even further.
Perhaps it wouldn’t be long before the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire would see the rise of a True Spirit-level Giant Beast, truly capable of dominating the Vast World, considering the terrifying strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
While the golden-blue Giant Dragon was shocked at the further grotesque nature of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, within the returning Human Race’s Expeditionary Army, countless individuals were also staring ahead with either astonishment or excitement.
The Expeditionary Army had already stopped for half a day without advancing because a distorted Black Hole loomed before the fleet.
At the center of the Black Hole, a thousand seven hundred meters tall, stood a Demon God with three faces and eight arms, its Aura heavy and Overbearing, compressing the surrounding space into constant collapse.
Occasionally, a tiny strand of golden-red lightning would jump along Jack Clark’s body, exploding and sending forth a Destructive Aura that made even Sky King Denny Kaye and others break out in a cold sweat from afar.
And it wasn’t just Sky King Denny Kaye and the others, including the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, who looked exceedingly grave.
From the occasional golden-red lightning that leaped, they sensed a potent danger, a Terrifying Power that could harm them.
What was even more unbelievable for them was that such a slight flicker of lightning could hurt beings like them.
However, in contrast to the shock and surprise of these Heavenly Kings, Divine Kings, and Main Gods, the cultivators aboard the sky-based battleships of the Human Race were greatly excited, discussing fervently.
On the deck, a middle-aged man spoke with some expectation, “He’s already reached one thousand seven hundred meters, do you think Divine Martial Emperor could breakthrough to the mid period of Heavenly King in one go this time?”
A young man in Red Battle Armor shook his head, “Probably not.”
“Have you noticed? Compared to half a day ago, the golden-red lightning leaping around the Divine Martial Throne is becoming less frequent, and the corresponding Aura growth is slowing down.”
