﻿Chapter 1448: Chapter 547: The Human Race Trembles, Pinning Hopes Chapter 1448: Chapter 547: The Human Race Trembles, Pinning Hopes Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In the pitch-black space where energy and matter were scarce, Black Gold light pierced through the Void, occasionally flashing tens of thousands of kilometers like a curvature spaceship.
In this space, where the straight line exceeded tens of millions of kilometers and only some meteorites were drifting, only occasionally the fireworks from explosions brought a touch of light and brightness.
Those were the continental blocks of meteorites destroyed by the breath of the Destruction Emperor Dragon as it passed by, with diameters ranging from thousands to tens of thousands of kilometers.
After its breakthrough to the Ancient stage, the dragon’s strength allowed it to forcibly control the space around it, suppress the rules of Heaven and Earth, and perform space jumps.
Therefore, it only took the Destruction Emperor Dragon a few hours to cross tens of millions of kilometers and approach the area where the Time River had appeared.
However, aside from the tens of thousands of kilometers of violent Space Turbulence, the Time River had already disappeared.
In the pitch-black Void, the Destruction Emperor Dragon spread its double wings as its pupil-shaped eyes, as if forged from gold, looked on coldly, tinged with a hint of regret, “It’s gone?”
The Time True Spirit Beast it encountered back then had given it an overwhelming sense of oppression, so strong that the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt utterly powerless against it.
But as it had now made its breakthrough to the Ancient level, the dragon was confident that even if it couldn’t defeat the Time True Spirit Beast, it could still retreat unscathed under the rule of speed.
And as for the opponent’s Time Rule, the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t care at all; its defense that negated all rules was not just for show.
The Area of Destruction divided the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region, spanning hundreds of millions of kilometers, with a gray airflow spreading throughout, and at its edges, gigantic Batfish Beasts roamed.
They opened their flat and large mouths wide, filtering energy materials from the Destruction airflow, and the ‘exhaust’ filtered out behind them, forming a strong Kinetic Energy.
The largest among them was Alius, an Ancient Middle Stage Giant Beast, with its massive body over sixty thousand meters long, resembling a mountain range, its thick blackish-grey scale armor like the furrows of the Earth bunched up.
Just then, the Ancient Batfin suddenly turned its head, towards the edge of the gray airflow area, where space distorted, and a terrifying Black Gold Giant Beast appeared silently.
In an instant, an indescribable oppressive force spread, causing all the Batfish Beasts to instinctively shudder.
That included Alius, whose massive eyes revealed horror and a touch of disbelief, “King, have you ascended to an Ancient life form!?”
No wonder this Ancient Beast was so shocked; it clearly remembered that just half a Sun Wheel ago, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon passed through this area, it was merely at the peak of the Titan Level.
Even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon was on the verge of a breakthrough back then, it shouldn’t have been so fast!
You have to understand that when it broke through to the Ancient level, it hibernated for more than ten Sun Wheels to complete the Tempering Transformation of the Giant Beast Body, so the Destruction Emperor Dragon should also rest for a few Sun Wheels, right?
As the Ancient Batfin Beast was still in shock, the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slowly, its ferocious mouth slightly opened, emitting a deep roar, “Yes, I have broken through to the Ancient level.”
“…Worthy of being a king, so powerful.” Saying that, the Ancient Batfin Beast bowed its head, showing utmost respect.
Previously, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had yet to break through, and its Deep Red Destruction Form was already intimidating enough for the Ancient Batfin Beast to feel that it couldn’t win, opting to join the Dragon Palace and follow its lead.
Now that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had become an Ancient Beast, one could only imagine how terrifying its strength was.
It’s likely that the Destruction Emperor Dragon wouldn’t need to enter its Gigantification Destruction Form to defeat it; the Ancient Batfin was very aware of this fact.
All those Batfish Beasts became even more respectful of the Destruction Emperor Dragon now that it had reached the Ancient Level.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “Alius, I have now broken through to Ancient, and I will next consolidate all forces and unite the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
“Later, you will lead your subordinates to follow me to the Dragon Palace.”
“Yes, great king.” Feeling the barely perceptible terrifying pressure emitting from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Ancient Batfin Beast nodded respectfully.
If the Destruction Emperor Dragon had not achieved its breakthrough to the Ancient level and had ordered it to lead its subordinates to leave the Area of Destruction, it would have certainly refused.
The Area of Destruction filled with the flow of Destruction was not only their ‘home’, but also their sanctuary.
In front of those erosive Destruction airflows which wear down everything, even the Ancient Giants could only defend themselves for a short time before their combat power would degrade significantly due to the continuous loss of strength.
Not to mention those creatures below Ancient level, they wouldn’t dare come close recklessly.
But faced with the Destruction Emperor Dragon that had broken through to the Ancient level, the Ancient Batfin had not the slightest urge to resist, only instinctual obedience and awe.
Boom!
The massive body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon plunged into the Destruction Forbidden Zone, and in an instant, gray airflows from all directions surged over, erupting in a roar like mountains and seas shaking.
This Destruction Forbidden Zone that isolated Space-Time also spanned tens of millions of kilometers, and waiting for those Batfish Giants meant the Destruction Emperor Dragon had to slow down.
Even with the Batfish Giants flying at full speed, it was estimated that it would take two to three days to cross the Forbidden Zone.
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon was now ‘invincible’, conquering all the Mythical level and above beasts in a short amount of time to unify the Chaotic Turbulent Region still required its subordinates’ help.
Only with enough hands could they spread out and sweep through all directions simultaneously.
In this case, the eight Titan Level beasts, comparable to Heavenly Kings, were naturally the best henchmen; each could lead a mighty army on their own.
……
In the Human Race Territorial Area, behind the Outer Development Department, where the 30th Army Group was stationed, a powerful aura suddenly descended.
Soon after, higher-ups above the Human King level received the message to convene a meeting.
Before long, a multitude of wills descended in the Void Space, forming projections upon the throne including the First Councilor and the three Supreme Experts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1449 - 1449 547 Human Race Shakes Pinning Hopes_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1449: Chapter 547 Human Race Shakes, Pinning Hopes_2 Chapter 1449: Chapter 547 Human Race Shakes, Pinning Hopes_2 By the time thirty-one king-level experts and six Heavenly Kings of the mythical world had gathered and taken their seats in the first row, the True Martial Heavenly King, supporting a black stele, said solemnly,
“Ladies and gentlemen, four days ago, the Heavenly Feather Clan clashed with the Purgatory Empire in a decisive battle and has been annihilated.”
At once, Gentry Gail below was astonished, “The Heavenly Feather Clan has been annihilated? How could this happen so quickly? Wasn’t the plan to delay them for two or three Sun Wheels?”
The other monarchs and Heavenly Kings were also surprised by this outcome.
The True Martial Heavenly King managed a wry smile, “There was an unexpected turn of events. When we arrived at the Heavenly Feather Clan, the three major empires were launching a fierce attack, and one of the Divine Kings had been heavily injured and lost the ability to fight.”
“Given the critical situation, we intervened in the battlefield immediately.”
“Originally, our plan was for the Expeditionary Army to expose half of its strength, to help the Heavenly Feather Clan withstand that assault by the Purgatory Family.”
“Who would have thought Jack Clark would strike, killing seventeen demon kings, including two late-period Great Demon Kings within a short time, sending shockwaves across the entire battlefield?”
Hiss! In an instant, all the monarchs present inhaled sharply, as looks of disbelief appeared on each of their faces.
Even the usually serious and composed Leo Hart couldn’t help exclaiming, “This kid is too freakish!”
Sky Knife King Sheehan Wade grimaced, “It’s more than freakish. We’ve fought against the Purgatory Empire for so many years and combined we haven’t killed as many demon kings as he did this time.”
Compared to other monarchs, Leon Hart, and Shepherd Army Sheehan Wade felt the impact more deeply.
A few months ago, when Jack entered the mythical world, he was only at Eight Layer Heaven, and facing the siege of two demon kings, he still needed their help to stand against and suppress them.
Now just a few months have passed, and this kid has grown to the point where he could slaughter mythical powerhouses as if slaughtering chickens.
Watching those shocked faces, a hint of a smile passed in the eyes of the True Martial Heavenly King. His expression then turned even more solemn, “Because of our appearance, the three major empires felt threatened, thus accelerating the decisive battle.”
“In this battle, over ten million Transcendent elite soldiers of the Heavenly Feather Clan perished, including twelve Main God-level experts, more than thirty Mythical Powerhouses, and two Divine Kings.”
“This includes the Divine King of Light at his Peak of the Ancient, who had the strongest fighting capability, and the Eternal Divine Tree’s mother tree.”
At once, everyone, including the Gabriel King was profoundly solemn. The casualties were too severe; the number of elite fighters lost was nearly equal to that of the entire Human Race.
The True Martial Heavenly King’s voice was low as he continued.
“Currently, there are only over four million elite soldiers of the Heavenly Feather Clan left, three Divine Kings, twelve Main God-level experts, and forty-five Mythical Powerhouses who managed to retreat while being covered.”
“Furthermore, all of these experts above the Legendary Realm are injured, with significant Origin energy depleted.”
The Golden Dragon Heavenly King sighed deeply, feeling somewhat relieved, “Fortunately, our Human Race first faced the two weakest empires of Purgatory; otherwise, it’s unimaginable.”
“Indeed,” Gentry Gail said, with a sense of shared grief.
If the Human Race had faced these three Purgatory Empires from the start, they might have been annihilated long ago.
Three powerful beings holding World-class weapons and having the strength of peak Demon Gods, not to mention their numbers were several times that of the Human Race—who could stand against them?
Just then, the True Martial Heavenly King’s tone changed, “However, although the Heavenly Feather Clan suffered heavy losses, the three great Purgatory Empires also suffered.”
“The Divine King of Light, Metastat, burned his True Body and merged his strength with the Eternal Divine Tree to momentarily step into the Monarch level, fighting against seven by himself and suppressing seven Demon Gods.”
“The remaining four Heavenly Feather Divine Kings ganged up on two Demon Gods, killing one and heavily injuring another.”
“And in the end, they sacrificed the entire Eternal Divine Domain, pulling all the elite forces of the three Purgatory Empires, including their demon kings, Great Demon Kings, and the Demon Gods into the Deep Red World.”
“At present, all the forces of the three empires are trapped in the Deep Red World, and even if they are not dead, they won’t be able to return for a short time.”
The sudden turn of information left all the monarchs once again stunned, then they looked at the True Martial Heavenly King with speechless gazes.
Gentry Gail was at a loss for words, “Damn, you scared me. It turns out that although the Heavenly Feather Clan’s main forces were mostly wiped out, the three empires also suffered a great deal.”
The other Heavenly Kings were a bit speechless, then smiles appeared on their faces; the ‘heavy blow’ to the three empires had eased their concerns, lightening their spirits significantly.
As their minds relaxed, the Golden Dragon Heavenly King even flipped the middle finger, “I didn’t expect you, True Martial, with your thick brows and big eyes, to have learned to play tricks on people.”
“Right, such important information, and you didn’t reveal it all at once, making us go through such shock and alarm,” another added.
The True Martial Heavenly King smiled slightly, “Isn’t it because the atmosphere of the meeting was a bit tense? So, I decided to let everyone relax a bit first, and by the way, to tell you another more astonishing piece of news.”
From the main seat, which had been silent, the rotating Rubik’s Cube conveyed the aged voice of the Sky-based God King, “If True Martial says it’s astonishing, it must be important. I have a feeling it has something to do with that little fellow, Jack Clark.”
At that, the Sky-based God King paused for a moment, “…Don’t tell me, he killed a Demon God?”
“…To think that you, Sky-based, would guess that,” the True Martial Heavenly King said, a bit surprised. He had been ready to drop that news on them like a bomb.
Leo Hart was astounded, “True Martial, are you sure you’re not joking?”
“Do you think I would joke about such a thing?”
The entire council then fell into silence. Apart from those ranked Supreme, their faces showed shock, surprise, and terror.
A small smile curled at the corners of the True Martial Heavenly King’s lips; he was very pleased with the effect.
In fact, under normal conditions, with the composure of the True Martial Heavenly King, he wouldn’t play such games or take interest in them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1450 - 1450 547 Human Race Shakes Pinning Hopes_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1450: Chapter 547 Human Race Shakes, Pinning Hopes_3 Chapter 1450: Chapter 547 Human Race Shakes, Pinning Hopes_3 But there was no helping it—who could blame him for being shocked? If he didn’t shake these fellows up with such news, wouldn’t he seem somewhat embarrassed?
After everyone had calmed down a bit, the True Martial Heavenly King finally spoke up, “Before the outbreak of the great war, Jack Clark had a breakthrough into the Heavenly King Realm, and his strength was comparable to the Supreme.”
“In the final moments of the decisive battle, he entered some kind of limit breakthrough state and single-handedly slew an ancient early stage Demon God.”
“Besides, according to what he said afterwards, he probably killed about ten demon kings, two Great Demon Kings, and one Extreme Realm Great Demon King during the decisive battle.”
“Damn!” A king-level figure from the Berlin Empire couldn’t help but let out a swear word.
At this moment, Gentry Gail burst into laughter, “…Impressive. He truly deserves to be a one-of-a-kind genius of our Human Race, slaying a Demon God to raise the flag just after stepping into the Heavenly King Realm.”
“If this news were to be released, it would definitely greatly boost the morale of our Human Race.”
Gabriel also nodded in agreement, “Indeed, Jack Clark’s combat power has always been exaggerated. When he was at the Legendary Realm, it was like killing chickens for him to slay Great Demon Kings of a Major Realm higher.”
“Now that he has broken through to Heavenly King, killing a Demon God seems quite normal.”
Normal? More like a ghost of normal.
The other king-level figures shook their heads and then smiled as well, their spirits lifted, because this meant that another Supreme Level strength had been added to the Human Race.
By calculation, the Human Race’s high-end combat strength was already capable of directly confronting and even overpowering the two great Purgatory Empires.
However, just when everyone was starting to feel somewhat relieved, the True Martial Heavenly King spoke again, “Jack Clark will be leading the remnants of the Heavenly Feather Clan back in half a month.”
“By then, with the addition of the three Divine Kings and twelve Main Gods of the Heavenly Feather Clan, plus the three Main Gods of the Divine Gods Alliance and the God King Tarodel, our alliance’s strength will be enough to completely overpower the two opposing empires.”
“This is also the reason I rushed back here early, but…”
At this point, the True Martial Heavenly King paused, then continued with a grave tone, “On my way back, I received a message from a sleeper agent within the Purgatory Empire.”
“Two days ago, envoys from another Purgatory Empire appeared in the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, and they were two Demon Gods.”
Sitting at the main seat, Adam Garcetti, who had been watching quietly, suddenly sat up straight, his expression solemn, “Those two Demon Gods are from a Purgatory Empire engaged in battle with another civilization?”
Though it was a question, Adam Garcetti’s tone was already certain, his mind immediately going to their origin.
The True Martial Heavenly King nodded seriously, “Right, the elites of the three major empires have fallen in the Deep Red World, so these envoys could only come from another civilization battlefield’s Purgatory Empire.”
“Does that mean the war over there has also ended?” the Primordial True King asked in a deep voice.
The other kings also thought of this, and the mood that had relaxed a bit due to Jack Clark’s breakthrough and the fall of the three major empires suddenly became heavy again.
Even these Mythical Powerhouses were somewhat overwhelmed by today’s news, which had seen many ups and downs.
At this time, the First Councilor Adam Garcetti slowly spoke up, “Everyone need not worry too much, compared to more than twenty years ago, our situation has already greatly improved.”
“We managed to bear such great pressure back then, let alone now.”
“Moreover, even though the war over there has ended, it doesn’t mean we will face the pressure of five Purgatory Empires. Some of these empires are even enemies amongst themselves.”
“Therefore, even if the three major empires free up their forces, it’s likely that only one of them will participate in our war against the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.”
“Furthermore, the three major empires obliterated the Immortal Spirit Clan to consolidate their racial intrinsic strength, so they will need some time to digest this.”
“And that time is our opportunity.”
As he spoke, Adam Garcetti’s gaze turned cold, “We must seize this time difference, gather all our forces, and in one battle, overthrow the two great empires of the Mokaya Dark Demon.”
True Martial Heavenly King nodded gravely, “Correct, this is also the reason I’ve convened the council of kings.”
“Before the Purgatory Family gathers all its forces, we’ll launch a preemptive War of Extermination, slaying Diorus and other Demon Gods as well as imperial forces, and push the frontline forward by two million kilometers.”
“By then, relying on the geographical restrictions of the expansively forbidden area, even if the remaining six Purgatory Empires join forces, we will still have room to maneuver.”
The area surrounding the Human Race is a massive gourd-shaped forbidden area; the Human Race occupies a territory spanning over twenty-thousand kilometers which lies at the mouth of the gourd, beside which is the Divine Gods Alliance.”
The larger belly area of the gourd behind it is occupied by the two Purgatory Empires, serving as the rear for their frontline battlefield bases.”
This region is not only riddled with various hazardous areas internally, but it is also surrounded by Death Forbidden Areas that even Demon Gods do not dare to casually enter, forming a huge ring.
This is also the reason why the Human Race has been able to hold out for so long.
If it weren’t for being blocked by forbidden areas on three sides, and the Purgatory Empire could only open up the Heavenly Abyss and the Sky Curtain Battlefield, the Human Race, even if capable of holding out, would not have it so easy.
Currently, the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield is cut off by the tail of that horrific creature that fell from the sky, leaving only the Sky Curtain Battlefield as a passage.”
If the Human Race can gather all its forces and obliterate the elite forces of the two empires in one battle, pushing the battlefield to the very end of the gourd-shaped forbidden area to hold it, we will secure a greater strategic depth on the battlefield.”
By then, relying on those dangerous forbidden areas to build war bases and establish prohibitions, as long as we’re not afraid to die, even when facing double the strength of the Demon God-level forces, we can hold out for a while.”
At that time, as long as Jack Clark can quickly make a breakthrough to Supreme, there is still hope for the Human Alliance.”
At this moment, even Supreme Experts like Adam Garcetti couldn’t help but place their last hopes on Jack Clark. There was no helping it; this youngster’s performance was just too exaggerated.”
Whether it’s his combat strength crossing a Major Realm, or the speed of his cultivation getting faster after breaking through to the Mythical Level.”
“Notify Blue Star, all Sky-based doomsday satellites and Sky-Base Deathline Satellites to enter revival mode, ready to strike across boundaries at any time.”
“Also, from the Blue Star and post-Mythical logistical bases, open all the warehouses, produce Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs, Crystal Energy Four Phase Bombs, Large Yield Intercontinental Missiles, and so on.”
“This includes the newly successfully tested Gravity Collapse Bomb, and all the experimental Anti-Matter Annihilation Rune Weapons are to be activated…”
Soon, as commands were issued one after another, the entire Human Alliance was set thunderously in motion.
All factories, whether military or material factories, operated at full capacity, producing supplies needed for the upcoming War of Extermination.
These supplies were not just weapons, ammunition, and energy bombers, but also restorative resources, emergency medical drugs, and more.
Simultaneously, after the meeting ended, the Primordial True King immediately entered into consultations with the Divine Gods Alliance about the war. This time, the Divine Gods Alliance could not remain on the sidelines.
Now, all that awaited was the return of Jack Clark and his company, marking the time for the ultimate battle.
And such a war, just the mobilization of supplies and preparations, required ten to fifteen days, much like the great battle that took place at the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield back then.
The suddenly tense atmosphere set the whole Human Race subtly quivering.
However, the information was kept classified, only known to those above the level of kings, so many mistook it for intensifying pressures at the Sky Curtain frontline battlefields.
Including the Purgatory Empire’s spies hidden within the alliance, who only transmitted ‘routine information’ that the Human Race was amassing vast resources in preparation for the next frontline battle.”
Across the Sky Curtain Battlefield.
In the dark world tens of thousands of kilometers away, Demon King Belidier’s gaze was indifferent, quietly observing the direction of the Human Base, fixing on the Sky-based God King who was positioned tens of thousands of kilometers away on the battlefield.
“Keep struggling, for when the reinforcements from that side arrive, it will be the time of your Human Race’s downfall.”

﻿Chapter 1451: Chapter 548: The Ancient Legion, The Return of the Giant Beast Chapter 1451: Chapter 548: The Ancient Legion, The Return of the Giant Beast As the Human Federation prepared for the counterattack, the Expeditionary Army was also flying at full speed.
On sky-based battleship No. 1, Jack Clark sat cross-legged at the edge of the deck, watching the incandescent shockwaves stirred up by the battleship traveling at thirty times the speed of sound, and he sighed lightly.
“Too slow.”
For ordinary cultivators, moving at thirty times the speed of sound was very fast, covering ten kilometers in a blink of an eye, whereas even the most advanced Supersonic Missiles were only a few times the speed of sound.
But for a strong man like Jack Clark, it was too slow, feeling like a turtle’s jog.
Just then, a red light appeared ahead, followed by the sound of the fleet’s intelligent control system in Jack Clark’s ear.
“Report, under Divine Martial Emperor, an unknown intense energy fluctuation has been detected on the predetermined route ahead, potentially a mobile danger zone with a fire attribute, high threat level.”
“Activate the energy shield, charge through directly, and be on the lookout for possible unknown creature attacks.”
“Yes.”
Under Jack Clark’s command, led by thirteen sky-based battleships, the fleet that stretched thousands of kilometers quickly approached the red zone and charged into it.
Boom!
The moment the fleet charged in, a fierce energy shockwave struck the battleship’s energy shield, emitting a roar like mountains and seas shaking.
This was a fiery domain of unknown extent, where the earth burned and a certain overbearing heat pervaded between heaven and earth.
These ‘flames’ mistakenly ignited everything, the air, the energy drifting between heaven and earth, and even the battleship’s shields.
However, this combustion was not rapid and was still within the capacity of the battleship’s power reactor, but the danger of this forbidden area came not only from the environment.
Hum!
The main cannon of sky-based battleship No. 1 suddenly lit up, and immediately, a red Light Beam hundreds of meters thick pierced through heaven and earth, landing over a thousand kilometers away.
There, a swath of red mist burned high in the sky.
Roar!
The moment the main cannon’s Light Beam appeared, the cloud of mist exploded, transforming into a flame creature with wings spanning a thousand meters, roaring ferociously and resounding through heaven and earth.
But in an instant, the quasi-mythical flame creature burst into explosion, annihilated by a main cannon shot comparable to a Mythical Attack.
However, this shot from sky-based battleship No. 1 seemed to have disturbed something; a Flame Mountain Range thousands of kilometers away suddenly shook violently, and magma spewed forth.
In an instant, a Terrifying Aura spread, and the creatures beneath the mountain ranges began to awaken, causing the temperature of this World to start climbing frantically.
Or rather, the mountain range itself was a creature.
Woo!
A long, desolate ancient roar echoed between heaven and earth, numerous rocks on the mountain range’s surface shattered, and an ancient creature stretching hundreds of kilometers slowly stood upright.
Instantly, Jack Clark’s expression became solemn, “To encounter an ancient creature here.”
Compared to the ancient creature that once pursued the Destruction Emperor Dragon, this ancient creature was more petrified, its body already turned to rock over a stretch of a hundred kilometers.
But this also indicated that the ancient creature was even stronger.
As a being that had once reached the Peak of the Ancient, it possessed fully developed rule powers and its rock-hard skin had been greatly fortified by the dissipated Rule Origin.
Of course, with Jack Clark’s strength, even if he couldn’t kill it, he could leave at any time, but those subordinates and the Heavenly Feather Clan battleships…
Boom! A tremendously heavy Aura of rules emanated from Jack Clark, like a black hole, distorting the Heavenly Earth Laws in his surroundings.
Behind him, a nearly two-thousand-meters-tall Illusion of a Three-faced, Eight-armed Demon God appeared, each of the eight arms holding a halberd, cradling the Great Sun and Heavenly Gate, and wielding the Emperor Seal.
Especially the Soul Emperor Seal held by the True Body projection, which also emitted an Origin Aura of Opening the Heavens.
Together with the Pseudo-World Level fluctuation of the Heaven-opening Halberd, this powerful Aura made the ancient creature pause, and its flame-wreathed head slowly turned to look over.
Although the petrified creature’s consciousness was confused, the instinct of an Ancient Beast remained.
As the ancient creature hesitated slightly, the space above the following Heavenly Feather fleet lit up as three colossal Illusions emerged, radiating Gold, Silver, and White Divine Light, overshadowing the sun and sky.
The mighty Divine King pressure shook the entire World crazily, and even the ancient creature instinctively showed fear in its eyes due to Jack Clark’s terrifying Aura that resembled a black hole.
Under the deterrence of four Divine King level pressures, the ancient creature ultimately did not attack and stood thousands of kilometers away, silently watching the fleet fly past.
Likewise, Jack Clark and his allies also had no interest in this ancient creature.
Teaming up to slay it would bring no benefits but would rather waste time and energy, and should any of the Divine Kings suffer even a slight injury, it would be an even greater loss.
It was only after the fleet passed ten thousand kilometers and finally left the fiery Hell that Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others, who were also flying in the air on guard, relaxed slightly.
“That creature’s oppressive feeling was strong.”
Sky King Denny Kaye said slowly, “After all, it is a creature that once touched the edge of Monarch status; being stronger is normal.”
“It’s just unexpected that such an ancient creature would appear on this route. Fortunately, we didn’t encounter it on our first visit to the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
This is the danger of the mythical world, where hazards could be encountered at any time.
This danger could originate from some powerful ancient beings, moving forbidden areas filled with peril, or perhaps some form of suddenly erupting destructive power.
Compared to Jack Clark’s slow progress, with the Destruction Emperor Dragon clearing the way, the return trip was even faster, taking only two days to exit the Area of Destruction.
Woo!
Following behind the nearly seven-thousand-meter-long Destruction Emperor Dragon, one Batfish Beast after another, with bodies tens of thousands of meters long, burst out of the Area of Destruction, emitting long and melodic calls.

﻿Chapter 1452: Chapter 548: Ancient Legion, The Return of the Giant Beast_2 Chapter 1452: Chapter 548: Ancient Legion, The Return of the Giant Beast_2 Particularly, the Ancient Batfish following behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, when it spread its double wings, cast large patches of shadow under the sunlight.
At this time, the dark night of the mythical world receded, and the Golden Sun slowly rose, signaling the passing of another Sun Wheel.
At this moment, the Mythical Giant Beast Ancient Batfish glanced at the two Giant Dragons hibernating on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and curiously growled, “King, the bloodlines of Scythia seem to be evolving?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly, a deep hum emanating from its breath: “Mhm, after we ventured into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, we consumed a creature containing the power of time that can Purify Bloodlines.”
Suddenly, envy appeared in the eyes of the Mythical Giant Beast Ancient Batfish. If it had known, it would have followed them then.
Evolution of bloodline, ah… At its current realm, every slight upgrade of its bloodline was extremely difficult; it had been many years since it had felt any growth in strength.
At this time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly: “Alius, I am going to speed up now. There are no chaotic streams here affecting us; take them and keep up.”
“As you command, King.”
Boom!
In an instant, the double wings of the Destruction Emperor Dragon radiated brightly, emitting dazzling golden light, and its massive body turned into a ray of light and disappeared under the dim Firmament.
Simultaneously, a Gray Light Burst erupted from the body of the Ancient Batfish, and rules spread, forming a huge, murky world that enveloped its subordinates like an even larger shadowy figure of a Batfish.
Under the Burst of speed from the two Ancient Beasts, many dangerous forbidden areas were directly shattered, quickly crossing millions of kilometers.
At this place, the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly stopped, hovering over a rotting swamp, its intimidating maw slightly opening, and an authoritative and profound Dragon Roar vibrated Heaven and Earth.
The horror of the sound waves shattered the layers of the Void, revealing a Black World deep within the Space Interlayer.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon appeared, the Black Mountain Range at the center of that world trembled, and a Kirin Beast of the same size as the Ancient Batfish stood up.
Besides, on the edge of the mountain ranges, a black ‘miniature’ Giant Beast over a thousand meters long was also disturbed.
Roar!
The Black Colossus standing over twenty kilometers at shoulder height roared towards the sky, its gaze turning outward to the world, then it paused, “King, you have broken through to ancient times!”
“Hmm, I have broken through to ancient times, and judging by your appearance, you have also completed the final step, good,” the King beyond the world nodded in satisfaction.
This Black Colossus was very powerful; even the Lord had to enter the Crimson Form and Limit Breakthrough to subdue it after a ‘half day’ of fighting.
Moreover, this Ancient Beast named Kutadire, not only had it reached the realm of the Ancient Middle Stage, but it was also just a step away from completing the refinement of this world.
It was equivalent to a Demon God wielding a World-class weapon, its strength far superior to that of its peers, including the Dust Serpent.
“I have now broken through to ancient times, and next, I am preparing to dominate the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region. Kutadire, you have broken through at just the right time, come, join me in returning to the Dragon Palace.”
“Dominate the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region?” Upon hearing this, the Kirin Beast’s eyes revealed excitement and a bloodthirsty savagery.
Just right, the greatly empowered beast was also looking for something to do.
Squatting in this world for a thousand years, passing each Sun Wheel in dull refinement and hibernation, it had long felt thoroughly bored and wanted to indulge in a wild slaughter.
“Please wait, King.”
Roar!
A powerful and profound strength Burst forth from within the Kirin Beast, and instantly, the vast world trembled, Black Gold rules covering Heaven and Earth.
Under the gaze of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the world gradually became transparent, collapsing and compressing, until it eventually vanished inside the Kirin Beast.
At once, the aura around the Kirin Beast became even more terrifying, with the surrounding Space-Time twisting and breaking apart.
The terrifying aura made even the Ancient Batfish solemnly hum low: “So strong, King, is it also one of the Dragon Kings of our Dragon Palace?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slowly: “Yes, Kutadire is also one of the Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace, titled the Lord of the Earth.”
At this time, the Kirin Beast, now over fifty kilometers in length and resembling a Black Mountain Range, also emerged from the depths of space, descending into the mythical world.
Instantly, an aura as terrifying as the ancient late stage spread out. The Earth below sank silently, forming a depression several thousand kilometers deep, with an imposing and frightening presence.
“Kutadire, let me introduce you, this is one of the twelve Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace, Alius, the King of the Sky.”
“King of the Sky of the Dragon Palace.”
The Kirin Beast looked at the Ancient Batfish, even more massive in size, and roared like thunder: “Greetings, Alius, I am Lord of the Earth.”
The Ancient Batfish hummed enthusiastically: “Greetings, Kutadire. From today onward, we are brothers of the same empire. We’ll share good things to eat and fights to join together.”
This big, dark fellow seems very fierce. Best to foster a good relationship now, in case it needs to ask for its help against some formidable creatures in the future.
Unaware of what the Ancient Batfish was thinking, the Kirin Beast growled in response.
“Of course.”
While the three terrifyingly powerful Ancient Beasts ‘talked,’ the Mythical Giant Beasts following the Kirin Beast watched with fervent and excited eyes.
The Dragon Palace Empire was too strong, indeed, as the great Thunderflame Dragon King had said, filled with countless powerful beasts.
Not to mention the colossal Dragon King among them, the strength of those Giant Beasts following it was also formidable, all at the Titan Growth Level and so massive in size.
After the two Dragon Kings finished their greetings, the Destruction Emperor Dragon finally spoke: “Let’s go, we continue our journey.”

﻿Chapter 1453: Chapter 548: Ancient Legion, The Return of the Giant Beast_3 Chapter 1453: Chapter 548: Ancient Legion, The Return of the Giant Beast_3 “Yes, my king.”
Although it had integrated the other world and its strength had become even stronger, the black Kirin Beast still behaved very respectfully in the presence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
After all, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had been able to suppress it before its breakthrough in ancient times, let alone now.
Upon approaching closely (a mere hundred kilometers away), the invisible Dragon Might emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon sent shivers down its spine, as if a single act of defiance would lead to its being devoured whole.
“Let’s go.”
With a roar that shook the world, the Destruction Emperor Dragon took the lead and burst forth at lightning speed, its enormous body causing a horrific rumble during its rapid flight, creating shockwaves that stretched for thousands of kilometers and exploded everything in their path.
Following behind the nearly seven-thousand-meter-long Destruction Emperor Dragon was the black Kirin Beast, over fifty thousand meters in size, and the Ancient Batfin, even larger at over sixty thousand meters.
Add to that the eight Titan Beasts and one Mythical Giant Beast, it was a formidable procession.
Under the leadership of the three Ancient Beasts, there was virtually no creature in the Chaotic Turbulent Region that dared to provoke them; barreling straight through, they reached a patch of the Void in less than half a day.
Unlike the Dark Space opposite the Chaotic Turbulent Region, this Void was a zone of nothingness formed by the collapse of space and the dispersal of rules.
Deep within this Void lay a hazy sphere of light, nestled in the depths of the Void and the surface space.
A massive continental block floated within the sphere of light.
Compared to the complete world where the black Kirin Beast resided, the sphere of light housing the Dust Serpent was a stable World Fragment, albeit much smaller in size.
In the middle of that continental block, a gray-white Python more than five thousand meters long coiled atop a mountain peak, its eyes closed in hibernation, breathing in and out gray-white mist.
This mist merged into the space, spreading throughout heaven and earth with the Spatial Fluctuations, inhaling and exhaling to refine this world.
As the Dust Serpent was hibernating and cultivating, suddenly, a Terrifying Aura descended, accompanied by a majestic and authoritative growl.
“Jormungand, it’s time to wake up.”
The gray-white Python was immediately startled awake, lifting its head swiftly, its gaze crossing the Boundary Wall of the world, and landing on the seven-thousand-meter-long Black Gold beast in the Void.
It then saw the other two, even larger, Ancient Beasts.
“My king! You’ve returned, you…”
Before the Ancient Giant Python could finish speaking, the Destruction Emperor Dragon confidently said, “Indeed, I have made a breakthrough beyond ancient times. By my side are the Earth Dragon King Kutadire from the Dragon Palace, and Alius, King of the Sky.”
“This is Jormungand, the World Serpent, one of the twelve Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace.”
Looking at the gray-white Python that was comparatively ‘smaller’, the Ancient Batfin subconsciously growled low, “The World Serpent, so small…?”
Compared to the terror-inducing black Kirin Beast, the early ancient Gray Python indeed seemed rather ordinary.
With a length of just over five thousand meters, it wasn’t even a tenth of the length of the Ancient Batfin Beast, not to mention the inherently long and slender body of snake-like creatures.
In comparison, the size of the Ancient Batfin Beast was nearly hundreds of times larger than that of the gray-white Python.
The enormous discrepancy in size and the ‘dominance’ of the grown realm were reasons behind the Ancient Batfin Beast’s subconscious attitude of contempt.
The Gray Python keenly sensed this and its gaze turned cold in an instant.
Boom!
In an instant, a terrifying aura burst forth from the gray-white python, and the entire World Fragment shook violently. Then, a python hundreds of thousands of kilometers long, encircling the world, emerged.
Roar!
In the Void, the Giant Python coiling around the world slowly bowed its head, quietly observing the ‘Little One’ before it. Its gray vertical pupils were icy, devoid of any emotion.
“Still small?”
Feeling the powerful oppressive force emanating from the Dust Serpent, astonishment appeared in the eyes of the Ancient Batfin: “So this is your true form? Indeed, it is powerful. I apologize for what I said earlier.”
Unlike other Ancient Beasts that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had encountered, the most striking impression the Ancient Batfin left was its ability to recognize the situation.
Indeed, without waiting for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to speak, the tension between the two dissipated when the Ancient Batfin showed subservience, and at this moment, the nearby black Kirin Beast also looked somewhat envious.
“Dragon King of the World-Coiling Serpent, your Gigantification Talent is so strong.”
The praises from the two Ancient Beasts made the gray-white python blush a little: “… Not at all, my ability is far inferior compared to the King’s Destruction Form.”
As it spoke, the Giant Python that encircled the world rapidly shrank, its aura plummeting back to normal, and soon, a python over thirteen thousand meters long appeared in the Void.
It was clear that the words of the Ancient Batfin Beast had some impact on the gray-white python. Although it had ceased its world-coiling state, it still maintained a length of over ten thousand meters.
This form of the gray-white python was actually its true appearance.
At that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly: “Jormungand, I am preparing to unite all forces to unify the Chaotic Turbulent Region. Can you move in your current state?”
“To unify the Chaotic Turbulent Region, no problem. King, I am still slightly short of fully assimilating this World Fragment, but I can first swallow it into my body.”
“Then let’s do it.” The corners of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled slightly, revealing a ferocious smile.
Boom!
Under the watchful eyes of the beasts, the virtual image of the python, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers, reemerged in the Void. With its gaping maw, it spewed endless white mist that engulfed the World Fragment.
Devouring the heavens and the earth, the petrified world slowly shrank and was finally swallowed by the gray-white python.
“Let’s go. It’s time to head back.”
With that, the Destruction Emperor Dragon led the way, flying towards the Dragon Palace located more than two million kilometers away, followed by three colossally sized Ancient Beasts.
By this time, only the King of Blade Edge, at the Titan Peak realm and possessing ancient-level battle power, had not yet returned to the fold.
However, that beast was somewhat special; unlike the gray-white pythons that had fixed lairs, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t know where it had wandered off to.
Next, without any accidents, as the four Ancient Beasts cleared the way, annihilating gods and Buddhas alike, they quickly reached the boundless, Violent Ocean.
They had arrived at the Chaos Turbulent Sea.
Boom, boom, boom!!
As the four colossal Ancient Beasts entered the sea area, the laws between heaven and earth trembled instantaneously. The ocean surged, spawning tsunamis thousands of meters high.
This fearsome aura, even from thousands of kilometers away, caused the magnificent beasts within the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace to look up in horror.

﻿Chapter 1454: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting Chapter 1454: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting “`
When towering beasts surfaced above the sea, a terrifying ancient pressure instantly suffused heaven and earth, causing countless Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts to tremble.
Surfacing on the sea was a Kelterta, over a hundred meters long, who once ushered a Little Tiger Whale into the Longa Tribe. It looked up, excitement on its face.
“Yes, yes! The great King of Thunderflame, the Lord of the Dragon Palace, has returned.”
When the Destruction Emperor Dragon left, its body was only about nineteen hundred meters long, and its Full-body Scales Armor was black and red. It also looked very different from now.
But the three pairs of feather horns on either side of its ferocious dragon head were too distinctive to be mistaken.
Behind this Longa, a dozen Eighth Level Beasts, ranging from seventy to a hundred meters in length, floated in the sea water, looking up in horror.
After hearing Kelterta’s words, these Giant Beasts patrolling the sea area all heaved a sigh of relief, followed by excitement.
One of them, resembling a shark and covered in blue bones, roared with excitement: “Is this our Dragon Palace’s legendary King of Thunderflame? So strong, so big.”
Another swordfish Giant Beast trembled its double fins: “Yes, it’s so big!!”
A black Giant Squid Monster with twelve tentacles convulsed all over, its eyes turning white: “The king is super, super big!”
A thousand kilometers above, surrounded by thunderstorms, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitched as its golden vertical pupils glanced at the turbulent sea below before continuing to fly.
Soon, towering ice mountains appeared before the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eyes, forming the Ice Crystal Dragon Palace, including the thousands of kilometers high and kilometers wide Dragon Palace Gate.
While the palace was awe-inspiring and magnificent to the Flame Tiger Whale and its kin, it appeared almost miniature in front of Giant Beasts like the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Not to mention the Ancient Batfin, stretching sixty thousand meters long; even the smallest Destruction Emperor Dragon was larger than that gate, such is the world of Giant Beasts.
Some grow into colossi of tens to hundreds of thousands of kilometers, suspended in the outer reaches of the sky, looking down upon all life, while the smallest are mere tens or hundreds of meters long, insignificant as dust.
At the moment, on the Ice Crystal steps of the Dragon Palace Gate, standing at the forefront was the Longa King, two thousand meters long and a thousand meters tall when standing upright, followed by an array of Mythical Giant Beasts.
The Kamaitachi burning with red flames, the Mythical Longa, the Dragon Horse Beast, and the surrounding Candle Dragon twisting space and time with its presence.
Beneath them were the Level 9 Peak, Quasi-Mythical Realm Nine-Headed Ghidorah, Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Late Stage 9 Female Tiger Whale, and Blue Giant Crab.
As time went on, these members who joined at the creation of the Dragon Palace, despite being carried along by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, began to slowly fall behind, let alone keep up with the empire’s expansion rate.
Yet at this moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt somewhat peeved. Its gaze fell on those towering ice mountains carved with lifelike bas-reliefs.
The writhing Candle Dragon, the Dragon Turtle with a neck several times its body length, and Ghidorah with nine dragon heads sprawling in all directions like a chrysanthemum.
Most notably, the first of these ice mountains featured the Destruction Emperor Dragon, rising erect in battle, majestically tearing apart a black smoke Titan Beast.
Moreover, the statue was so well carved that the depicted Destruction Emperor Dragon, with its head raised in a roar and wings furiously outstretched, radiated an intensely fearsome aura, almost like it could captivate one’s soul just from the likeness.
Had it been just that, the Destruction Emperor Dragon wouldn’t have felt peeved.
However, the Blue Giant Crab, in an attempt to accentuate the masculinity of the Destruction Emperor Dragon or for some other reason, added an ice pillar shooting up beneath it.
From a distance, it looked as if there were something quite unsightly protruding underneath.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon contemplated whether to squash the Blue Giant Crab with a single claw, Nine-Headed Ghidorah began rolling on the ground in laughter.
Roar, roar, roar!! So strong, Abbott is invincible.
Roar, roar, roar!! Abbott has even broken through to ancient times, such a terrifying aura.
Roar, roar, roar!! Worthy of Abbott, you’ve grown so big.
Roar! Damn it, don’t pull me, I want to go to the front.
Roar, roar!! Everyone shut up, let me speak.
Ghidorah’s nine heads, each with a will of its own, grew even stronger. Each head wanted to control the body, causing it to sway chaotically from their conflicting commands.
Meanwhile, the nine heads tugged in different directions, looking surprisingly similar to the chrysanthemum-like sculpture…
This spectacle made many Giant Beasts twitch at the corners of their mouths, unsure of what to say.
At this time, the six-armed Longa King, with a serpentine lower body stretching over a thousand meters and an upper body resembling a beautiful woman covered in Golden Dragon Scales, slightly bowed.
“Welcome back, great king.”
Looking down at the distinctly beautiful King Ja amid a host of ferocious behemoths, the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly, “It’s been a while, Alicia. Your strength has also improved quite a bit. Good.”
By this time, the aura of the Longa King was fluctuating, nearly double the strength it was before.
It was evident that in the period since, she must have discovered some fine treasures while clearing the surrounding sea area.
At that moment, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle stuck its head out, roaring excitedly, “Roar! Thunderflame, you’ve finally come back. Did you bring me anything good?”
Even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon had grown very strong, it didn’t exert the same Heavenly Tier bloodline pressure it exuded right after its breakthrough. Thus, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle didn’t feel particularly constrained.
After all, it had been following the Destruction Emperor Dragon since it was ‘small.’
From high above, the massive Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded, “Yes, I’ll give you some later.” It had intentionally kept some of the Chaos Crystal Cores it found earlier.
Hearing this, all nine of Ghidorah’s heads brightened up, and for once, they roared in unison amidst the chaos, “Roar, roar, roar!! Abbott, do I have some too?”

﻿Chapter 1455: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting_2 Chapter 1455: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting_2 “Yes.”
Immediately, Kamaitachi and other Mythical Giant Beasts couldn’t help but reveal envy in their eyes, but they were not the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle or the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and dared not be so ‘presumptuous’ in front of the ancient Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“Alright, we’ll talk about these matters later. Let me introduce them to you,” said the Destruction Emperor Dragon as it extended its right claw towards the black Kirin Beast that was over fifty thousand meters long.
“These are three new Dragon Kings who have joined the Dragon Palace: Lord of the Earth, Kutadi, King of the Sky, Alius, and Jormungand, the Serpent Encircling the World.”
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon spoke, it introduced several more giant beasts below: “This is one of the Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace, Titan Longa King, Alicia.”
“That one is the Nine-Headed Dragon King, Kidora, as well as the King of Earth Destruction, Domination, and the King of Day and Night Spacetime, Candle Dragon.”
No sooner had the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished than the black Kirin Beast and the Gray-White Python were stunned, finding it hard to believe as they looked down at the two giant beasts below that appeared small and weak, with one being only three hundred meters in size.
Unlike the Ancient Batfin, they had not seen Sesi and others; after being subdued by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, they only knew that the Dragon Palace had several Dragon Kings but were unaware of the varying strengths of these Dragon Kings.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, sensing what they were thinking, growled low.
“Although Domination and Kidora are only quasi-mythical level, as one of the initial members of the Dragon Palace Empire, they have made outstanding contributions to the empire.”
“Including Great Sethia on my back, Telsafi and the clasped Joe all have the title of Dragon King, and may enter the Dragon King Hall to discuss matters.”
So that’s how it was. The black Kirin Beast and the Dust Serpent nodded slowly.
But just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles only then noticed the two Giant Dragons on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the captured Joe Spawn Roc.
There was no helping it; with the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s size having increased severalfold and its ancient aura, plus the presence of those three ancient beasts, each larger than the last, the impact was just too great.
Even the Female Tiger Whale realized suddenly.
Roar!! King, what happened to Joe?
“They’re fine, just undergoing bloodline Evolution after consuming some resources and are now in hibernation,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon said, its gaze falling on the narrow empire gates.
“Alright, I will first expand the empire gates, then we can hold a meeting to discuss our next actions.”
“Great Sethia, Telsafi, wake up.” In a deep rumble, a powerful force swept over the Silver Giant Dragon and the gold blue Giant Dragon on its back.
In an instant, the two dragons that had been asleep the whole way blearily opened their eyes, looking around.
“Roar! Have we returned home already?” The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes cleared, and then with a flap of its double wings, it soared into the sky, transforming into a silver streak of light that landed on the Ice Crystal Platform.
Boom!
In a radius of tens of thousands of meters, the Law Power-infused Ice Crystals collapsed, countless hard Ice Crystals pitter-pattered on the Giant Beasts around.
The Silver Giant Dragon, with a length of one thousand four hundred meters, spread its double wings and stood in front of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, which was only three hundred meters long, and roared boastfully, “Roar! Domination, Kidora, Great Sethia has broken through to the Mythical Peak.”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle nodded, “We know you’ve reached the Mythical Peak and that your bloodline is still Evolving.”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s tone was very calm, without a hint of jealousy; of course, that was just on the surface, inside the creature was enviously wishing to roll around.
It was just one step away, just one step.
If it had joined the Destruction Emperor Dragon in entering the mythical world at the time, by now it would have certainly broken through to Myth and, like Great Sethia and the Single-horned Spawn Roc, become a Mythical Peak Giant Beast.
Wuu wuu!! So envious.
Aha! While the Silver Giant Dragon boasted to its ‘little friends’ below, the gold blue Giant Dragon yawned, then with a lazy gaze, it flew up.
As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc, it had been tossed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon as soon as the two dragons awoke, like a massive cannonball falling from a thousand kilometers up until now, finally crashing into the sea.
Bang! The sea surface erupted over a radius of a hundred kilometers, countless amounts of sea water shot up to the sky, reaching tens of thousands of meters high before thundering back down, like the celestial river reversing course.
Beneath the turbulent sea, the Single-horned Spawn Roc flew up bewilderedly, unsure of what had happened.
Meanwhile, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already arrived above the Rift World, its body covered in golden red lightning crackling, emitting a terrifying Doomsday Destructive Aura.
Boom boom boom!! The lightning infused with the Doomsday Rule crackled and shattered the Void, like a dazzling net enveloping the entire World Crystal Wall of the Rift World.
The terrifying Aura that radiated invisibly, even with the Destruction Emperor Dragon in control, shook the entire small world so violently.
As for the Ancient Giant Clams, the Longa Tribe, and the Mermaids farming Ice fish inside the small world’s ocean, all watched in horror at the sky above, trembling under that Destructive Aura.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon, standing atop the world, howled skyward, its double claws wrapped in the Doomsday Rule slamming down hard.
Boom!
The entire Rift World sank with a thunderous crash; in a flash, the Void shattered, the sea surface exploded over a range of tens of thousands of kilometers, as if a moon-sized celestial body had plummeted.
As the Small World Barrier collided with the space of the mythical world, tens of thousands of kilometers of Heaven and Earth shook violently, and the sea surface rose in a tsunami that obscured the sky and destroyed everything.
Under the assault of the powerful Rule, the dark clouds in the Firmament above dissipated instantly, forming an expanding, thick ring of clouds as Heavenly Energy surged wildly.
Time passed, and when the chaotic forces of Heaven and Earth finally calmed down, the place where the Rift World once was had completely changed.

﻿Chapter 1456: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting_3 Chapter 1456: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting_3 “`
The sea surface gained an inner sea that spanned over seven thousand kilometers in diameter.
Compared to the wild sea waves around, the azure sea water within the inner sea was clear and calm, home to many ‘gigantic’ ancient clams.
These clam species were several, or even ten times larger than other marine life of the same level.
The largest among the ancient giant clams stretched over seven thousand meters long and over four thousand meters high, resembling a small mountain range, and had once quite surprised the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
However, currently in the presence of the Titan Realm batfish beasts, which were twelve to twenty thousand meters in length, those ancient clam creatures seemed not as exaggerated anymore.
The azure world of the inner sea was surrounded by water, with a continent spanning over two thousand kilometers in the middle.
Near the seaside, the edge mountain ranges stood towering, forming a semi-circular high platform that was eight hundred kilometers in diameter and three hundred kilometers high.
Atop the high platform lay a silver giant dragon, stretching one thousand four hundred meters long, with a solemn gaze looking down from above, exuding the majesty of the Big Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire.
About ten kilometers away from the silver giant dragon, on the left, was an even more colossal black gold beast, with a length of seven thousand meters and a shoulder height over two thousand meters, its presence invisibly emanating a terrifying oppression.
Ten kilometers to the left of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a gold-blue dragon sat with its hind legs curled and foreclaws stretched out straight, emanating an air of elegance and solemnity.
Continuing alongside the gold-blue dragon to the left was an ancient batfish beast that measured over sixty thousand meters in length, followed by the Titan Longa King, itself almost two thousand seven hundred meters.
Further along, there were the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Red Candle Dragon Giant Beast.
To the right of the silver giant dragon, thirty kilometers away, there was a giant kirin beast as vast as the mountain ranges, and a Dust Serpent that was over ten thousand meters long.
Beyond the Dust Serpent, there were the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah and the Dragon Turtle Domination.
Eleven Dragon Kings sat in a ring, while on the second layer platform a hundred kilometers below, there were the Titan Batfish Giant Beasts, the Legendary Realm Kamaitachi, the Dragon Horse Beasts, and other such creatures.
They made up the second tier.
On the last layer of the platform were members of the Dragon Palace’s third tier, including the Female Tiger Whale and the Blue Giant Crab, floating in their respective places.
However, relative to those Dragon Kings at the top and the Titan and Mythical Giant Beasts on the second layer, the number of members in the Dragon Palace’s third tier seemed pitifully few.
Even when including a few like the Flame Tiger Whale and the Black Small Tiger Whale, still busy with tasks outside, there weren’t many generals in the third tier.
At the very bottom of the Dragon King’s council platform, tens of thousands of Longa Alien Tribe members and thousands of Giant Beasts of level 7 or higher excitedly floated on the sea surface, their gazes filled with reverence, excitement, and shock, as they looked towards the sky.
Among these Giant Beasts, some marine life had been recruited by the Longa King during his sweeps of the surrounding areas after the departure of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Indeed, the empire of the Dragon Palace, with its numerous Titan Giant Beasts and Mythical Creatures, was overwhelmingly powerful. It even boasted four sovereigns of ancient-level Giant Beasts that dominated their own worlds.
Under the gaze of the excited and eager subordinates, the Giant Beasts of the three layers on the Dragon King’s council platform also turned their attention to the black gold beast at the center, including the silver giant dragon.
Although all situated on the same platform, signifying equal status, all the ‘Dragon Kings’ knew who the real ruler of the empire was.
At that moment, with the surroundings shrouded in clouds and mist, and the presence of mythical beings such as numerous dragons, Longas, black Kirins, red Divine Dragons, and other gigantic creatures, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt a surge of emotion.
By now, the overall strength of the Dragon Palace Empire was hardly inferior to that of the Human Race.
In terms of peak power, it had even surpassed the Human Federation. However, the empire’s mid- to low-end strength was still far behind that of the Human Federation.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly began to speak, “Today marks the first Dragon King meeting held by the Dragon Palace, primarily to discuss the matter of subduing the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
“Before we begin, however, there’s something I must attend to.” the Destruction Emperor Dragon said as he turned to look at the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast. His neck shimmered under the Reverse Scale, and six gray crystals, each over ten meters across, appeared.
Within the crystals, gray turbid energy material flowed, emanating special fluctuations that instantly made countless Giant Beasts below gasp, their eyes ablaze with desire.
Even the Titan-level Longa King eyed those gray crystals with heated desire, breathing rapidly.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled, “These Crystal Cores have a somewhat special origin. They are Law Level Divine Artifacts that can purify and elevate bloodlines. Take them.”
With this, four Chaotic Crystals separated and flew towards the Titan Longa King, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast.
It went without saying that the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and others would receive a share of good things from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, while the Titan Longa King received some for his merits in defending the empire.
However, due to their comparatively weaker strength, the portions for the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon were smaller, only half the size of what the silver giant dragon and others consumed.
The remaining two fragments of the Chaos Crystal Core were divided into eight pieces, two of which, the largest five-meter diameter pieces, spun in space distortion and flew towards the Female Tiger Whale and the Blue Giant Crab, respectively.
“You two are relatively weak; too large a piece would be indigestible for you.”
Still, even such a share excited the Female Tiger Whale, who emphatically said, “Thank you, my king.”
The Blue Giant Crab, even more thrilled, blew out a big stream of bubbles, its eight legs collapsing as it lay prostrate, rubbing continuously and speaking words that made the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s scalp tingle.
Gurgle, gurgle!! “Thank you for your grace, king. Invincible, amazing, you are like the red divine tree that holds up the world in the hearts of your subjects, your greatness is beyond description.”
The red divine tree that holds up the world, beyond description! Initially, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mind raced to the ice sculpture underneath the statue, something that seemed to prop up the sky.
“`

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1457: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting_4 Chapter 1457: Chapter 549: Bloodline Enhancement, The First Dragon King Meeting_4 Dammit, so this is how it’s done.
Luckily, those statues had already shattered the world’s rift boundary walls and partially merged into the mythical world beforehand, destroying them in the process.
Phew! The Destruction Emperor Dragon took a deep breath, and instantly, a raging wind blew across the sky, suppressing the thought of crushing the Blue Giant Crab. With a single thought, it separated the remaining five shards.
Three Chaos Crystal Core shards flew in front of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which looked on vacantly as the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly.
“These three pieces belong to Tiger One and Tiger Two. Hand them over to them when they return.” The Destruction Emperor Dragon already knew that the Flame Tiger Whale had returned.
It was also somewhat surprised by the transformation of the creatures invading the Blue Star World into flame creatures after being slain.
Then, it sent the remaining three smaller crystal shards flying towards the Kamaitachi Beast, the Mythical Longa, and the Dragon Horse Beast, causing all three giant beasts to become excited.
“Thank you, king.”
“Thank you, great king!”
Since these mythical giant beasts were the enforcers of the Dragon Palace, it would not do to favor some and neglect others. However, these Chaos Crystal Cores were merely the appetizer; the main event was yet to come.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze landed on the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, and it growled slowly: “In this breakthrough of mine, I have mastered a talent ability that can evolve your bloodlines.”
“Now, swallow these crystal cores, and I will help you trigger your bloodlines, stepping fully into the Legendary Realm and pushing your bloodline level to the high-order monarch tier.”
No sooner had the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking than all the giant beasts suddenly looked up and turned their heads, their eyes filled with disbelief.
A talent ability to forcibly upgrade bloodline levels, how is that possible!!
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s four legs trembled with excitement.
Roar! Thunderflame, I want it, I want to break through to the mythical, I want to evolve. Afraid that the Destruction Emperor Dragon might be joking, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle swallowed the crystal core in front of it in one gulp.
Meanwhile, the nine dragon heads of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon went crazy, and its tail whipped about like a helicopter’s rotor blade, emitting chaotic roars.
Roar roar roar!! Evolution, super evolution, Tim Abott, hurry up and do it to me.
Damn, what are you all babbling about?
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle’s case was one thing, but Ghidorah’s words nearly choked the Destruction Emperor Dragon, who, in the past, could blame it for using expressions like ‘awesome’ and ‘incredible.’
It hadn’t expected that these casual phrase would be remembered by these creatures, with them shouting ‘incredible’ and ‘awesome’ all day long.
This time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could guarantee that it definitely never said those words.
Phew!
Taking another deep breath, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with slightly elevated blood pressure, extended its right claw in front of giant beasts such as the Dust Serpent and gently pressed it toward the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that had swallowed the crystal core.
On the surface of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Dragon Claw, mysterious golden-cyan patterns emerged, exuding an incredibly profound aura that seemed to represent some ultimate truth.
Boom!
In an instant, an invisible force made Heaven and Earth shake. Around the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, space shattered for several kilometers, forming a projection of an illusory world.
This was a world bubble created by the Destruction Emperor Dragon using absolute strength to slice through space.
From a distance, it looked as though the Destruction Emperor Dragon was holding a world in its claw, with rings of air blasts spreading in all directions, stirring up a gale.
Before the astonished eyes of the Giant Silver Dragon and the other giant beasts, the golden-cyan patterns on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s right claw came to life, slowly merging into the illusory world and enveloping the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
When all the bloodline patterns had left the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s right claw, the world bubble covered in golden-cyan designs vibrated violently.
Inside the world bubble, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle howled to the sky, emitting a painful cry as an extremely ferocious aura exploded from it, piercing the clouds.
The magnificent bloodline aura stirred up clouds and created a huge inverted vortex hundreds of kilometers in size. Under the influence of the bloodline, a huge dark red Dragon Turtle shadow, a hundred kilometers in diameter, faintly appeared in the sky.
This Dragon Turtle, different from the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, was covered with red spikes, looking even more fierce and fierce.
And what shocked all the giant beasts was the rapidly ascending bloodline on the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, becoming more ancient and powerful, and even its body began to change.
In the midst of the scorching gaze of all the giant beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already extended its left claw, mysterious gold-cyan patterns also emerging on it.
Boom!
The space around the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, which had swallowed the Chaos Crystal Core, shattered and exploded, transforming under the powerful rule of force into a temporary spatial world bubble.
Roar! Roar! Roar! In the instant the gold-cyan bloodline patterns enveloped the ‘world’, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon also emitted a painful roar as an aura of ferocity burst from its body.
In an instant, the sky above the Nine-headed Flood Dragon’s heads cracked, the earth trembled, and countless blood-colored flames appeared out of nowhere, burning fiercely.
In that sea of blood-colored flames, a shadow as massive as a range of mountains appeared, with ten dragon heads standing tall like columns, radiating an endless and violent bloodthirsty aura.
“The bloodline has truly begun evolving!” The Ancient Batfin Beast was somewhat shocked but also excited and agitated, its gaze burning as it looked towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Silver Giant Dragon rushed over, hugging one of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s thighs and roared excitedly, “Roar! Tim Abott, Great Sethia must evolve and become stronger too.”
On the other side, the gold-blue Giant Dragon, though a bit more reserved, also flashed into existence before the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its gold-blue gem-like vertical pupils staring intently at it.
Watching this scene, the Ancient Batfin spread its double wings, stirring a gigantic wave of wind and roaring excitedly, “King, us too, we too must purify our bloodlines.”
“And me, I too, Great King.”
At this moment, the dignity of an ancient beast and the solemnity of a Titan beast were all thrown aside.
The three Ancient Beasts, including the beautiful and dignified Longa King, also flickered with eager desire in their eyes, staring at the imposing and authoritative Black Gold Giant Beast.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon extended its right claw, dragging the Silver Giant Dragon off its leg, and lowly growled with a hint of speechlessness, “The evolution of your bloodlines must wait.”
“Although this talent is very strong, it also greatly consumes the power of my bloodline.”
Hearing this, the beasts noticed that the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had suddenly weakened a lot, as if it had suffered heavy injuries.
This time, the weakness of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not feigned, as the ability to enhance bloodlines indeed consumed a lot of energy, and even it was somewhat taken aback.
Just strengthening the quasi-mythical level Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and Nine-headed Flood Dragon had depleted one-tenth of its bloodline power.
Moreover, this consumption was similar to damage to the Rule Origin and needed time to recover slowly; otherwise, forced use could even affect its Heavenly Tier bloodline.
However, the effect was quite satisfactory, meeting its expectations.
Feeling the burning gazes of the surrounding beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded in satisfaction.
This ability to elevate the level of a bloodline is actually not 100% successful, otherwise, any ancient beast at the peak of their realm could enhance their bloodline and suddenly mass-produce Monarch level bloodlines.
Whether it’s cultivation or growth, the difficulty increases towards the later stages, and so does the bloodline ability of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Hence, to ensure success in one go, the Destruction Emperor Dragon not only selected the two quasi-mythical behemoths with the highest success rates but also fed them Chaos Crystal Cores.
Glancing at the two Giant Beasts who had fallen into hibernation for bloodline evolution, the Destruction Emperor Dragon then roared slowly.
“Although enhancing bloodlines consumes a lot from me, as the Lord of the Dragon King Hall, I have always been clear about rewards and punishments and have never been stingy with those who have made outstanding contributions to the empire.”
Even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t spell it out, all the giant beasts understood its meaning.
The simple explanation was that they could enhance their bloodlines, but they had to work for it; if they did well, it would help strengthen their bloodlines, and none of the giant beasts had objections to this.
After all, there must be a return for the effort put in.
“Alright, let’s now officially begin the empire’s first Dragon King Conference.”
“Next, the empire will advance in four directions, led by me and Jormungand among four Ancient Beasts, spreading out to progress.”
“All Mythical-level and above creatures willing to join the empire can be conferred the title of Cavalry General; Titan Level can become Great Generals, and Ancient Level can be titled Dragon Kings.”
“Within one Sun Wheel, I want the empire’s influence to spread throughout the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region; those who do not submit will be suppressed…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1458 - 1458 550 Meeting Your Mother The Bewildered
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1458: Chapter 550 Meeting Your Mother, The Bewildered Blue-White Giant Dragon Chapter 1458: Chapter 550 Meeting Your Mother, The Bewildered Blue-White Giant Dragon Above the sea surface, a solemn and authoritative voice reverberated between heaven and earth. Tens of thousands of Longa Alien Tribe members and Marine Giant Beasts, along with Mythical Giant Beasts, listened respectfully.
Though it was called a Dragon King meeting, in fact, only the Destruction Emperor Dragon spoke, and the other Dragon Kings merely nodded in grave agreement.
The content of the meeting included not just the overall strategic goals for battle, but also the assignment of personnel and tasks.
When the four Ancient Beasts took the lead, each one was followed by two Titan Batfish Beasts, one or two Mythical Giant Beasts, and over a thousand Level 9 Giant Beasts.
The purpose of these Level 9 Giant Beasts was to disperse and brazenly emit their auras, luring out the reclusive Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts from secret realms and forbidden areas.
To those beings above the mythical, the idea of a mere Ninth Level Extraordinary Creature daring to release its aura in provocation was simply suicidal.
Then, in a rage, they would descend and tear those Level 9 Giant Beasts to shreds and burst them.
As for traps, the concept never occurred to those highly intelligent but “less experienced” Giant Beasts that these Extraordinary Creatures could be bait.
They were not like information explosion-era humans, but rather hermits who had stayed indoors for hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of years.
Minutes later, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked around at the Dragon King Beasts and growled softly, “My speech is finished. Does anyone have anything to add?”
“Roar! Nothing to add, Great Sethia’s blood shall fill the rivers. Tim Abott, shall we depart now?” The Silver Giant Dragon was already restless with anticipation.
It had waited for this day for so long, finally about to dominate the Chaotic Turbulent Region completely.
Looking at the impatient Silver Giant Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon paused, then shook its head, “No, not yet. You and I, along with others, still have another matter to attend to.”
“What matter?”
“Go find your mother.”
Roar roar roar!!
Halved in the Chaos Sea, the Inner Sea World trembled as Ancient Batfin, Ancient Kirin, and the Ancient Giant Python, the Three-headed Giant Beast, roared forth.
Trailing behind the massive, sky-obscuring Three Ancient Beasts were the Titan Longa King, Batfish Beasts, and an army of Mythical-level Candle Dragons, Kamaitachi, and a multitude of Ninth Level Giant Beasts.
As they flew out of the Inner Sea World, powerful rules spread out from the core of the Three Ancient Beasts and diffused in all directions.
In an instant, the sky and earth changed color, and giant shadows of the three enormous beasts appeared faintly, tens of thousands of kilometers above, gazing down in all directions.
At the same time, another direction saw the Destruction Emperor Dragon also setting off with two Giant Dragons, transforming into a golden red light that pierced through the Chaos Turbulent Sea and flew toward the Outer World.
