The ocean where the Destruction Emperor Dragon resided was only a little more than ten thousand kilometers from the edge of the Chaotic Domain.
If not for the spatial chaos in the Chaotic Domain, filled with dangerous space-time rifts, it could have simply twisted space and leaped out with one jump.
But even so, it took only a few minutes.
Boom!
The moment the Three-headed Giant Beast surged out of the dark heavens and earth of the Chaotic Domain, they felt a lightness on their bodies as the gravity a hundred times heavier than the outside world vanished.
The whole world also became sunny and bright.
In the firmament above, the Golden Sun hung while the earth was green with vegetation and giant Unique Beasts roamed leisurely amidst the grasslands, towering over tens of meters high, exuding vitality.
This scene was completely a different world from the oppressive, dim, and chaotic domains.
Released from the influence of the Chaotic Domain, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt its mood inexplicably soften; the icy, violent killing intent in its eyes was also considerably diluted.
“Roar! Great Sethia has returned.” The Silver Giant Dragon roared joyfully, flapping its wings as it soared and danced in the sky, as happy as a child.
The gold-blue Giant Dragon flying beside the Destruction Emperor Dragon showed a hint of disdain in its eyes.
“This fool, the air is just a bit fresher between heaven and earth, what’s there to be so excited about?”
“Roar! Telsafi, let’s race to see who reaches my home first,” said the Silver Giant Dragon and before the gold-blue Giant Dragon could respond, dazzling silver light erupted from it.
Wrapped in the laws of space, the Silver Giant Dragon instantly turned into a streak of silver light and disappeared into the horizon, leaving behind a pathway extending to the end of the world through the clouds.
“Damn it, Sethia, you didn’t even say start!”
The gold-blue Giant Dragon roared and burst into a seven-colored glow, sprouting even larger Seven-color Dragon Wings, and shot out with powerful beams of energy light.
From the Chaotic Domain to Sethia’s “home,” there was a straight distance of a little more than two hundred thousand kilometers.
Under the full-strength burst of speed from a Mythical Peak Giant Dragon, it took less than half an hour to enter the territory of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, startling numerous Giant Beasts.
Before those tribes and Giant Beasts could react, the two streaks of light exuding a Mythical Aura had already vanished.
However, as the two Giant Dragons flew over a black mountain range, the sleeping Black Colossus Barron suddenly looked up, bewildered, at the sky.
“That aura that just passed by, it felt like Sethia, but how is that possible…?”
As for the darling daughter of the Blue-White Giant Dragon family, the Barron Beast was naturally familiar, having closely watched and protected it when Sethia first entered that Indigenous World.
So there was no mistaking the feel; the Mythical Peak Giant Dragon aura that just passed was indeed Sethia.
There was another familiar Mythical Dragon aura, seeming to belong to the neighboring Titan Dragon family’s daughter, who grew up playing with Sethia. That Giant Dragon.
Wait, weren’t they following that terrifying Thunderflame Behemoth into the Chaotic Domain before?
At this realization, the Barron Beast became somewhat puzzled: “Could it be that I’ve slept for dozens of Sun Wheels? Otherwise, how could it be that upon opening my eyes, Sethia has already broken through to the Mythical Peak?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1459 - 1459 550 Meeting Your Mother The Bewildered
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1459: Chapter 550 Meeting Your Mother, The Bewildered Blue-White Giant Dragon_2 Chapter 1459: Chapter 550 Meeting Your Mother, The Bewildered Blue-White Giant Dragon_2 As the Balon Beast was bewildered, in the heart of its territory, the Icebound Mountain Range, a blue-white Giant Dragon, having reached a length of five thousand kilometers, also suddenly raised its head, somewhat bewildered as it looked towards the sky.
“Scythia, and Telsafi—how have they returned, and what is this Mythical Peak aura…?”
If the blue-white Giant Dragon remembered correctly, those few little ones had only entered the Chaotic Turbulent Region two or three Sun Wheels ago, and by that time Scythia and Telsafi had just reached the quasi-mythical level.
Now… wait, behind them.
Boom!
The blue-white Giant Dragon suddenly stood up, the white chill that froze space-time emanating from its body, and wherever it passed, space crackled with a thin layer of ice encapsulating it.
Even the entire Icebound Mountain Range trembled under the strength of the blue-white Giant Dragon, as if an Ice Crystal Giant Dragon had been awakened, with a powerful ice-cold storm howling between heaven and earth.
The blue-white Giant Dragon looked towards the horizon with a solemn expression; it felt a terrifying ancient oppressive force coming from behind Scythia and the others.
That creature was very strong, immensely powerful, so much so that even from that distance it gave the dragon an instinctive urge to turn and flee.
Had it not been for the aura of excitement and joy emanating from Scythia and the others, the blue-white Giant Dragon might have almost thought they were being chased.
Under the intense scrutiny of the blue-white Giant Dragon, two rays of light emerged at the end of the sky, followed by the familiar roar of the Silver Giant Dragon that resounded through heaven and earth.
“Roar! Telsafi, it’s the Great Scythia who is faster; you’ve lost today.”
“That’s not necessarily true.”
“The thought of defeating the Great Scythia is impossible.” Within the roar, the aura of both Giant Dragons surged several times, actually igniting their Origins in a Burst.
In the end, Bursting with such speed, the two Giant Dragons turned into silver and seven-colored light and crashed onto the mountain peak.
Boom!
In an instant, mountains crumbled and the peak, which contained a faint Rule of icy power, collapsed thunderously, ice and rock shooting into the sky, forming two massive mushroom clouds like nuclear explosions.
This scene made even the blue-white Giant Dragon involuntarily close its eyes, but then it suddenly opened them again.
Cloud Mist in the sky suddenly dispersed, revealing an even more massive Black Gold Ancient Beast that appeared nonchalantly, and in an instant, an Overbearing aura filled with Destructive Aura spread throughout.
Boom! The entire world trembled as if two colossal creatures had collided.
Centred around the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the blue-white Giant Dragon, thousands of kilometers apart, transparent cracks spread in all directions, dividing heaven and earth in two.
One half was filled with white icy breath, freezing space-time, with space itself covered in a layer of ‘thin ice’.
The other half of the world turned into Chaos, filled with endless Doomsday and destructive breath, ending all things.
This was the phenomenon manifested between the Rule domains of the two Ancient Beasts. As soon as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s realm of thought moved, retracting its Aura to signify no harm, the phenomenon disappeared.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon opened its mouth slightly, and a deep, mellow voice sounded, “It’s been a long time, Princess Adriana.”
The attitude of the Destruction Emperor Dragon caused the blue-white Giant Dragon to pause, and with that somewhat familiar tone, the dragon’s eyes widened, disbelieving as it looked at the feather horns on either side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head.
“You are… that little one called Brock Abbott?!”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly nodded: “It’s me, thanks to the gift from Princess Adriana back then, which allowed me to increase my strength before heading to the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
“How is that possible?!” Even the blue-white Giant Dragon was completely bewildered this time.
Its daughter had, in just two or three Sun Wheels, broken through from quasi-mythical to the Mythical Peak. That was shocking enough, but that little one had only been at the early stage of Myth when they left, the early stage of Myth!
And now, in just two or three Sun Wheels, the other had already become an Ancient Beast.
Moreover, that powerful Rule oppression from just now, barely touched, nearly caused its own Rule Domain to collapse. It was imaginable how terrifying the combat strength was.
The most unacceptable thing for the blue-white Giant Dragon was that it had cultivated (hibernated) for so many years, went through so many dangers and battles, and only then made a breakthrough to the ancient level.
As for that little one, it vividly remembered it was only one year old, with a single Sun Wheel of life.
This shock surpassed even when the blue-white Giant Dragon first learned the Destruction Emperor Dragon had reached Myth in one year, completely shattering its mindset and beliefs, and striking its core principles with a powerful impact.
Just then, amid the collapsing ice mountains in the distance, the Silver Giant Dragon crawled out from beneath.
Looking at the colossal dragon standing atop the distant ice mountain, the Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly: “Roar! Mother, the Great Scythia has now grown to the Mythical Peak. Impressive, right?”
“And you’d never guess, my Dragon Palace Empire is so powerful now that even you, Mother, breaking through to the ancient level, are no match for the Great Scythia anymore.”
“Scythia, you seem to have forgotten that the Dragon Palace Empire is an empire, and you are you.”
From a distance, another ice mountain shattered, and a gold-blue Giant Dragon also climbed out from below, its double wings shaking slightly as its body shook off the ice flakes.
The words of the two Giant Dragons brought back the attention of the blue-white Giant Dragon, pressing down the shock in its heart, and it slowly growled: “Unexpectedly, Tim Abott, you’ve already made a breakthrough to the ancient level.”
“…Is this the terror of being Myth at one year old?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon humbly said, “Not at all, Your Highness is too kind. I was able to grow so fast mainly because there are plenty of resources in the Chaotic Domain.”
To this blue-white Giant Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon still held considerable respect.
Not only because the other party had given it many good things in the past but also because despite the huge ‘strength’ gap between them back then, the other party still had such a friendly and gentle attitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 1460 - 1460 550 Going to See Your Mom The Bewildered
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1460: Chapter 550: Going to See Your Mom, The Bewildered Blue-White Giant Dragon _3 Chapter 1460: Chapter 550: Going to See Your Mom, The Bewildered Blue-White Giant Dragon _3 “`
At that time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had just broken through to the Legendary Realm, and the Blue-White Giant Dragon was already half a step into ancient times.
The gap was like when the Destruction Emperor Dragon had broken through to the Titan Realm and was facing a Level 9 Giant Beast—under such circumstances, the attitude of the Blue-White Giant Dragon was even more valuable.
Of course, here we speak of realms, not combat power.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon shook its head slightly, “The gap in talent cannot be compensated by willingness alone.”
If it were only a matter of having enough resources to crazily elevate one’s growth realm and strength, it would not have left the Chaotic Turbulent Region to establish its own territory on the outside.
After a brief exchange of pleasantries, the Destruction Emperor Dragon got straight to the point and courteously said, “Princess Adriana, we have returned this time with the intention of inviting you to join the Dragon Palace Empire.”
“Dragon Palace.” The Blue-White Giant Dragon paused for a moment.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded, “Yes, currently in the Dragon Palace Empire, there are eleven Dragon Kings, of which, aside from myself, there are three Ancient-level Giant Beasts holding the fort.”
“Should you agree to join, you would become the twelfth Dragon King, with the right to participate in the Dragon King Hall’s deliberations. Your status within the empire would be equal to mine.”
Saying this, concerned that the Blue-White Giant Dragon might be worried about Scythia’s status, the Destruction Emperor Dragon added another sentence.
“As for Scythia, its status as Big Dragon King is honorary in nature; Princess Adriana, you need not concern yourself with that.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon let out a low growl, “The status of Scythia has never been a concern of mine, and as for joining the Dragon Palace Empire, there’s no rush.”
“May I ask what purpose you had in mind when you established this empire?”
Before the Destruction Emperor Dragon could respond, the Silver Giant Dragon roared proudly, “Roar! Mother, you fool, the purpose of establishing an empire is, of course, to dominate the Vast World and let blood flow like rivers.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon glanced at its foolish offspring and, too lazy to speak, quietly watched the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled softly, “It’s simple, the initial purpose of establishing this empire was to watch and help each other out, to gather more strength to survive in this dangerous world.”
“It was the same when I first met Scythia, as it is now.”
“Princess Adriana, you must surely understand that even though we are called Ancient Beasts, in this boundless and vast Vast World, we are still as insignificant as ants.”
“This can be seen from those ancient creatures that, after failing to make a breakthrough, chose petrification and hibernation.”
“To become creatures at the Peak of the Ancient, they, in terms of talent and opportunity, are no less than ‘us’, yet most ultimately still fail.”
“From this, it can be seen how difficult the path to True Spirit is, and the realms above True Spirit are even more insurmountable.”
“If we wish to continue on, we need to constantly gather all strength, occupy more foundations, resources, and push all our talents, abilities, bloodlines, and conditions to their peaks.”
“Including the potential dangers from True Spirit Level beings in the future, we can also gather the empire’s forces to crush them.”
“Even a being as powerful as a True Spirit, when faced with an empire’s ten or eight ferocious Ancient Beasts, would not dare to recklessly challenge its edge.”
“You are quite right,” the Blue-White Giant Dragon nodded slowly.
Although it was accustomed to being solitary, it could not deny the truth in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s words – banding together is indeed safer than fighting alone.
However, as a Giant Beast, it yearned for the freedom and unbounded state of being.
Under normal conditions, Mythical-level and above creatures seldom wish to follow other Giant Beasts unless the latter’s realm and combat power are a Major Realm higher.
However… The Blue-White Giant Dragon glanced at the Silver Giant Dragon and nodded slowly, “Since that is the case, then I shall join the Dragon Palace and become a Dragon King.”
…The Destruction Emperor Dragon paused.
It had just finished its rational explanation and was preparing to use the advantages of bloodline Evolution to entice, not expecting that the other would agree to join the Dragon Palace before it even finished speaking.
In fact, the mere combat power of an Ancient early stage creature wouldn’t have concerned the Destruction Emperor Dragon so much.
What it truly valued was that once the Blue-White Giant Dragon joined, another Giant Beast would certainly join as well – the Time Dragon Kulapavida, effectively getting a two-for-one deal.
Just then, the Silver Giant Dragon roared in surprise, “Roar! Mother, how could you agree so readily? You should have refused.”
“Why should I refuse?” The Blue-White Giant Dragon looked at the Silver Giant Dragon somewhat strangely.
“Roar! Because it’s you,” the Silver Giant Dragon thought for a moment.
In the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon, its mother was always domineering and calm, like an Ice Queen sitting loftily aloof, coldly surveying everything around her.
Earlier, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon spoke of inviting its mother to join the Dragon Palace, the Silver Giant Dragon shook its head, thinking it unlikely.
Given its mother’s personality, and what must have been the strength of an Ancient breakthrough, under normal circumstances, it would not be possible to join the Dragon Palace unless it used its ultimate move.
At this point, the Blue-White Giant Dragon glanced at the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon and suddenly spoke, “Since the creed of the Dragon Palace is to assist each other and gather strength to survive in this dangerous world, surely you would not mind the addition of another Titan Dragon, would you?”
“…Of course not,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze shifted subtly: “Is Princess Adriana referring to Torsafi’s mother?”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon nodded slowly, “Correct, Caotena is also not weak in strength; her growth realm is approaching Titan Peak, and her combat power is even stronger than her realm.”
“Even if you hadn’t mentioned it, I would subsequently have gone to invite Princess Caotena, and considering the relationship between Your Highness and Torsafi, I would also grant the position of Dragon King.”
By now, the title of Dragon King had become almost a wholesale offer from the mouth of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Anyway, it’s a matter of herding one sheep or two, and having another Titan Peak level combat creature can help contain the awakening of a Great Demon King in the future.
“Let’s go then, we shall find Caotena,” the Blue-White Giant Dragon said decisively.
Meanwhile, the Destruction Emperor Dragon followed the Blue-White Giant Dragon and its Silver offspring as they flew toward the neighboring territory.
In another timespan within a crevice, an immense White Giant Dragon watched in a daze as its daughter and wife followed the other creature away.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1461 - 1461 551 The Fall of Eternity Civilization
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1461: Chapter 551: The Fall of Eternity, Civilization Fragments Chapter 1461: Chapter 551: The Fall of Eternity, Civilization Fragments The vast Earth spread out below, with mountain ranges extending far and wide, covered with sky-touching trees whose lush branches intertwined to blot out the sunlight, occasionally revealing the enormous silhouettes of passing creatures.
Above the high altitude, dense Heavenly Energy gathered into white mist, slowly drifting with the breeze, appearing very leisurely.
On the plains at the edge of the mountain ranges, a huge city of different races had been established, inhabited by many beings over five meters tall with massive blue snail shells on their backs.
Howl!
Accompanied by a majestic and profound Dragon Roar, the clouds above shattered to reveal two Giant Dragons with wingspans exceeding two thousand meters, promptly startling countless different races below.
“Don’t panic, it’s Prince Telsafi.”
“And Princess Scythia is there too.”
“The princes have returned.”
“All hail the Great Prince Telsafi…” After a brief moment of alarm, the High Priest of the different races below recognized the gold-blue Giant Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon.
The entire city’s inhabitants looked up to the sky, their expressions filled with fervor as they continuously greeted the two immense and majestic dragons.
As for the sudden expansion of the Giant Dragons’ colossal size by several times, these vassal different races gave it no second thought, nor did they find it suspicious.
To them, the larger the body of the revered Divine Children of the Dragon, the more normal it was.
Howl! Howl! Howl!! The Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon circled in the sky, roaring with authority, clearly enjoying the respectful worship from the different races below.
“Telsafi, haven’t you come to see your mother?”
A deep roar slowly spread between heaven and earth, and then all the different races felt the day darken suddenly as an even larger figure appeared in the Firmament.
A Black Gold bodied beast nearly seven thousand meters long sprawled across the sky like a mountain range, its wings unfurled and extending over ten thousand meters with light emitted from their edges, casting enormous shadows in the sunlight.
What was most striking was the terrifying pressure radiating from the beast, overpowering the rules of this World.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
In an instant, over a million entities within the vast city fell like wheat to a scythe, all stunned into unconsciousness, unable to withstand the horrifying fluctuations of Qi Blood.
This was still the case with the Destruction Emperor Dragon having reined in its ancient aura.
Meanwhile, not far from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a Blue-White Giant Dragon with a length of over five thousand meters floated with its wings spread, surrounded by an extreme chill, calmly observing the scene below.
Facing the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s puzzlement, the gold-blue Giant Dragon below looked up, letting out a soft roar: “Thunderflame, my mother is here, but you have to call her.”
As the gold-blue Giant Dragon said this, its Spiral Dragon Horns lit up, and at the same time, in the City Center, a kilometer-tall, Dragon statue several kilometers long trembled.
This was a statue formed from a stone resembling White Jade, suffused with dense faith power. Triggered by the gold-blue Giant Dragon, it now emitted a White Light.
Hum!
This faith power bathed heaven and earth in white, and with the distortion of space, a faint shadow of a world emerged. Instantly, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon could not help but show surprise.
This world, cleverly hidden in the deep crevices of space, had evaded detection due to the faith power covering the statue.
“Telsafi, you’ve returned so soon?”
With a surprised low roar, the shadow of the world transformed, and the phantom of a Giant Dragon over two thousand nine-hundred meters long, covered in Crystal Red Scale Armor, emerged.
Separated by a One-side World, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon’s gaze first fell upon the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a look of astonishment in its eyes.
What ancient Beast was this stranger, so powerful that it made her feel an irresistibly oppressive sensation through the Boundary Wall?
And why was Adriana here too?
Noticing the Crystal Red Giant Dragon’s wary gaze, the Blue-White Giant Dragon let out a low roar before the Destruction Emperor Dragon could speak: “Caotena, there’s no need to worry.”
“This is Thunderflame, the Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire, and also a good friend to Scythia and Telsafi.”
“The Dragon Palace, I know of it. It seems to be the power that Scythia established in that Indigenous World, even involving Telsafi in the venture to the Chaotic Turbulent Region…”
With that, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon paused, suddenly realizing something, as its gaze shifted to the now Mythical Peak Silver Giant Dragon and the gold-blue Giant Dragon, its eyes widening in shock.
“Impossible, you two little ones only left two Sun Wheels ago, right? How have you reached the Mythical Peak already?”
The Silver Giant Dragon lifted its head in pride: “Howl! Aunt Caotena, the Great Scythia is a genius, so it’s normal for her to grow faster.”
Normal my foot, do I not know you? The Crystal Red Giant Dragon held back the urge to roll its eyes.
At this moment, the gold-blue Giant Dragon roared softly, explaining: “Mother, didn’t we go to the Chaotic Turbulent Region? We found a lot of Law-level resources there, which is why our strength increased so quickly.”
“We’ve come this time to invite you to join the Dragon Palace Empire.”
“Although the Dragon Palace was established by Scythia, it has grown rapidly under Thunderflame’s leadership. There are now twelve Dragon Kings, five of whom are Ancient-level Giant Beasts.”
“Including Aunt Adriana, who has also joined the Dragon Palace, becoming one of the Dragon Kings. Telsafi and I are also Dragon Kings.”
“Moreover, Thunderflame comes from that Indigenous World Scythia first entered, simply possessing even higher talent than Scythia.”
“When Thunderflame met Scythia, she was only Level 7, but in just nine Sun Wheels, Thunderflame has grown to be an Ancient Beast, invincible in power.”
“With Thunderflame’s talent, under her leadership the Dragon Palace Empire is certain to grow stronger and stronger…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1462 - 1462 551 The Fall of Eternity Civilization
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1462: Chapter 551: The Fall of Eternity, Civilization Fragments_2 Chapter 1462: Chapter 551: The Fall of Eternity, Civilization Fragments_2 To prevent her mother from misjudging the situation and missing some “opportunities,” the golden-blue dragon clearly and simply spelled out what it understood.
Yet, as the golden-blue dragon revealed more, the crystal-red dragon’s mouth gaped wider and wider, even suspecting whether it was experiencing an illusion.
The Beast Empire, which the child next door playfully established, had, within just a few Sun Wheels’ time, suddenly grown into a colossal force boasting five Ancient Beasts.
With five Ancient-level Giant Beasts, this power was enough to sweep across the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region and dominate this vast world.
And there was Thunderflame, the indigenous Giant Beast, who in just a few Sun Wheels had evolved from a common Level 7 Extraordinary Creature to an Ancient Beast!?
Even though the one speaking was its daughter, and Adriana was by its side, it felt this was impossible, all fake, how could it be!!
It clearly remembered that it had taken years for it to advance from a Level 9 dragon to a Mythical Giant Beast.
Not to mention, breaking through to a Titan from a Mythical Giant Beast, not only took it more than a hundred years, but also involved countless dangers, and had it not joined forces with Adriana, it would have perished in the Chaotic Turbulent Region long ago.
While the golden-blue dragon’s mother was gaping in shock at the existence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, in the original site of the Eternal Divine Domain, an anomaly emerged.
In the world center where the heavens and earth were bathed in a red glow, the once lush Golden Divine Tree had withered, with falling leaves and broken branches remaining only as a trunk.
The Golden Tree Trunk, tens of thousands of kilometers long, floated like a massive continent within the Void, its radiance dimmed.
Amid the collapsing Void currents around, six Demon Gods exuding a terrifying aura stood tall, their surroundings roiled with Dark Demon Air, an awe-inspiring presence.
As for the Divine King of Light, he had “fallen.”
Even with a cultivation at the peak of the ancient times, forcibly integrating the body to reach the True Spirit Level of the Eternal Divine Tree, not even the Divine King of Light could tolerate and control the power of the divine tree, ultimately leading to the collapse of his True Body.
Though the fight successfully exhausted the Divine King of Light to death and wiped out the Heavenly Feather Clan, Tyris and the other Demon Gods appeared rather troubled.
This battle resulted in the fall of three Demon Gods, and each surviving Demon God sustained heavy injuries from the Divine King of Light’s counterattack and suffered damage to their rules, including the Lords of the three major empires who faced the Divine King head-on.
Especially Tyris, the strongest combatant who faced the most direct engagement, had his True Body of the other Abyss Demon God blown apart by the Divine King of Light, his Aura nearly plummeting to the late period of a Demon God, suffering tremendous losses.
Standing over the Abyss World with his True Body stretching up to a hundred thousand meters and wielding the Dark demon blade, Tyris’s gaze was icy as it settled on the hundred thousand kilometer-long Golden Tree Trunk, his voice deep.
“This Eternal Tree Trunk, I claim half,” said Tyris.
After Tyris spoke, the other two Lords of the empires simply fell into a slight silence, offering no objection.
Seeing this, the remaining three Demon Gods, belonging to the other two empires, although slightly dissenting, remained silent out of fear of Tyris’s Demon Power.
Boom!
Under the dark slash that nearly split the world in two, the golden trunk floating in the Void vibrated, the rules clashing and producing terrifying energy halos.
The Golden Divine Tree Trunk was so formidable that even in its “death,” Tyris could only make a slash tens of thousands of kilometers long and over three thousand kilometers deep with his strength.
Boom, boom, boom!!
After three overbearing slashes, the golden tree trunk finally burst apart with a thunderous crash, splitting in two amidst a fearsome explosion, numerous shards breaking off at the fracture and detonating.
It was like a skyful of golden fragments sprinkling in all directions.
Suddenly, various Great Demon Kings and demon kings in the distance lit up with bright eyes and burning gazes.
Including the Left Demon, whose True Body was as high as ten thousand meters, who also burst into action, sweeping the Devouring Heaven Overlord Halberd across the Void and lunging at the largest piece of the ‘tree trunk,’ several thousand kilometers in diameter.
Apart from the Left Demon, another Demon God radiating a terrifying aura also lunged for that piece of golden shard.
“Cortes, I had my eye on this shard first,” a cold voice proclaimed as the distant six-armed, three-headed Great Demon God bellowed, the blood light surging on its dark red warhammer, smashing the Void towards the Left Demon.
The Left Demon, standing at ten thousand meters and covered in black gold battle armor, grew colder in his gaze, “Seeking death, Telus.”
Boom!
Beneath the overbearingly tyrannical Overlord Halberd, the dark red warhammer, which was also a Pseudo-World Level weapon, shook violently, and the bloody light of the surrounding rules shattered.
Under the strike comparable to that of a Demon God, the Void within a ten thousand kilometer range collapsed, Law Chains whirled, forming ripples of black and crimson light waves that spread in all directions.
The Extreme Realm Great Demon King was directly blasted tens of thousands of kilometers away by a halberd, his face looking rather unsightly.
“Telus, do you need my help?” Nearby in the Void, a figure exuding the aura of an Extreme Realm Great Demon King appeared.
This demon king differed from the typical demon with a skull for a head; even though he also had three heads and twelve arms, all three of his heads resembled black python’s, exuding a chilling malevolence.
“Hmph! I am not interested.”
The Great Demon King holding the dark crimson warhammer glanced at the other with disdain, then with a cold snort, flew towards a much smaller golden tree shard.
“Scram! This fragment is mine.”
Boom!
Under the dark crimson warhammer, another Great Demon King who was about to grasp the golden tree trunk fragment let out an angry roar, and then, spewing blood, was blasted away.
At this moment, around those tree trunk fragments, around the six great Demon Gods, this part of the Void descended into complete chaos.
And Left Demon, amidst the greedy gazes of those great demon kings, slowly stowed the massive golden tree trunk fragment away, carrying the deterrence of a strike that repelled an Extreme Realm Great Demon King.
As the Abyss ‘world’ unfolded slowly and swallowed the golden tree trunk fragment, Left Demon breathed a sigh of relief.
On Left Demon’s broad, mountainous shoulders, the girl carrying four swords looked at those scrambling for the tree trunk fragments, at the demon kings and Great Demon Kings, somewhat puzzled.
“What use is this thing?”
“These are Civilization Fragments.”
Left Demon’s voice was deep and robust, touched with a hint of gentleness, “That Eternal Divine Tree bore the entirety of the Heavenly Feather Clan—their tribal world, faith, rules, and even that elusive luck.”
“And the Purgatory Family, wielding the power of the Abyss, can smelt these Civilization Fragments, absorbing and transforming the inherent strength within them, to bolster their own power.”
“This is also why the Purgatory Family constantly wages wars and obliterates other civilizations.”
“Rather than arduously cultivating a little bit at a time, drawing in Dark Demon Air to pollute Heaven and Earth, slaughtering other lives for sacrifices, or even plundering the intrinsic power of civilizations, yields faster strength growth.”
“Or perhaps, slaughter is the ‘path’ of the Purgatory Family.”
As Left Demon explained to Jane Aiken, two Lords of the Empire in the distance also cleaved the remaining half of the tree trunk, ‘deliberately’ shattering those golden fragments once again, stirring the demon kings into a frenzy.
The Civilization War had been fought to this point, and it was finally time to reap the rewards.
Boom! Just at that moment, the world, already steeped in a red glow, began to shake wildly, the already fractured Earth continuing to collapse, the cracked Firmament shattering.
As the Eternal Tree Trunk was destroyed, the Eternal Divine Domain also lost its last support and began to plummet rapidly.
Roar! An utterly ferocious roar exploded, and then, above the cracked crimson sky, an immense claw reached in.
Boom! Under that terrifying claw, the sky completely collapsed, creating a Hollow with a diameter of over one hundred thousand kilometers.
On the other side of the Hollow, the head of a vast, ominous Giant Beast appeared, its covetous gaze fixed on those demon kings, the Purgatory Legion, and the three broken sections of the golden tree trunk below.
And with the emergence of that Deep Red Giant Beast, in an instant, an almost True Spirit level Terrifying Aura descended, causing the faces of all Purgatory True Demons to drastically change.
Including Demon Gods like Tyris.
“Before it even crashes, it has already attracted a Deep Red Destruction Beast.” Tyris’s expression turned somewhat ugly, “I will hold it off when it comes, while you lead them in retreat.”
Boom!
Innumerable Abyss Demonic Aura gushed forth from Tyris, transforming half of the world into a dark Abyss, his Demon Blade glowing brightly with five wailing shadowy figures appearing on the blade.
Each of these shadows exuded the aura of a late-stage Demon God or even that of a peak Demon God.
They were Alien Lords who had fallen to Tyris’s Demon Blade.
As the rules once mastered by these Alien Lords were ignited, Tyris’s originally weakened aura soared, imbued with the Demon Power to Destroy Heaven and Earth, lunging towards the Deep Red Giant Beast.

chapters.title: Chapter 1463 - 1463 552 The Terrifying Deep Red World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1463: Chapter 552: The Terrifying Deep Red World, Civilization Guardian Chapter 1463: Chapter 552: The Terrifying Deep Red World, Civilization Guardian In the Deep Red World filled with crimson light, a dazzling Light sphere descended from the sky, casting a huge, boundless tree-like shadow upon the Earth.
Boom! This time it was a real star explosion.
In an instant, the Eternal Divine Domain, spanning over two million kilometers in diameter, collided and released energy that instantly destroyed everything in its surroundings, emitting infinite light and energy.
Yet, despite such terrifying impact and explosion, the ground of the Deep Red World, akin to red rock, remained incredibly solid, merely cracking to form vast fissures that spread across millions of kilometers.
Even from deep within the Earth, a fearsome roar could faintly be heard as the hard red rocky ground, like a living entity, began to heal its cracks that stretched for tens and even hundreds of millions of kilometers.
It was as if it wasn’t the ground at all, but rather the surface of an unimaginably terrifying Giant Beast.
Roar!
At the center of the world-shattering devastation, a behemoth tens of thousands of meters long, shaped like a four-armed Burst Ape but covered in Red Scale Armor and sharp spikes, roared furiously.
Wrapped around the Giant Beast was the crushing power of the deep red forces, drawing forth the red light between heaven and earth to create a colossal shadow of the Burst Ape that stood a million meters tall, its claws widely outstretched, wielding a fragment of the red world as it smashed down.
Such immense strength made the already chaotic epicenter of the explosion even more frantic, its formidable might almost comparable to that of a True Spirit.
“Away!”
The majestic roar of Tyris, engulfed in demonic might, echoed as the Demon Blade in his hand, entwined with the phantoms of five Alien Lords, surged, becoming a black blade light that connected heaven and Earth.
Boom!
The world-breaking power enveloping the claws of the Deep Red Burst Ape was shattered by the terrifying blade light, which even carved a massive gash on its body, cutting through rules with unstoppable sharpness.
Roar! The Deep Red Giant Beast let out a ferocious bellow, retreating several steps while the ground below vibrated and the rocks split.
Such terrifying might was befitting of the strongest among the three major empires, the titled Abyssal Great Demon God; but the extreme cost of wielding such power also took its toll on Tyris.
On the Demon Blade in Tyris’s grasp, the phantoms of the five Alien Lords screeched in agony as they wound their way up his arm, penetrating deep into his bones.
The pain caused even Tyris’s face to show a hint of suffering.
Roar! In that moment, the Deep Red Giant Beast roared again, invoking the destructive forces of the world and descending upon Tyris, reigniting the fierce battle.
As Tyris fought fiercely, inflicting heavy losses on the enemy but hurting himself in the process, two titanic Abyss Demon Gods stood between heaven and earth in the distance.
With world-class weapons pushed to their limits in their hands, they transformed into an immense Dark Demon Dragon and a spiky monster shadow, each enveloping tens of thousands of kilometers.
Under the protection of two Lords of the Empire, most of the force from the cataclysmic collapse of the Eternal World was intercepted, allowing the majority of the Purgatory Legion and demon kings to survive.
As for the unlucky few (tens of millions) of the Purgatory Legion, some demon kings, and Great Demon Kings, they were directly obliterated in the colossal explosion.
Yet, just as those Purgatory True Demons were grateful for not perishing in the explosion, suddenly, another terrifying roar erupted between heaven and earth.
In the distance of the world suffused with crimson light, an even larger, vague silhouette emerged, radiating an aura truly belonging to the True Spirit Level.
At that moment, another terrifying figure appeared.
Instantly, all the Demon Gods turned pale.
“The explosion of the Divine Realm was too loud; let’s split up and leave.”
Boom, boom, boom!!
The remaining five Demon Gods struck at once, unleashing their Abyssal Rule Domains or Dark Domains, sweeping up countless Purgatory Legions and shooting out in all directions.
Even Left Demon abruptly retracted his True Demon God Body, transforming into an ordinary form of a three-thousand-meter-tall True Body of the Great Demon King, ripping through space with Jane Aiken, vanishing in an instant.
And the direction he fled was entirely opposite that of the other Demon Gods.
As the Purgatory Demon Gods divvied up the remains of the Eternal Divine Tree, far away in the direction of the Human Race, outside the Logistics City behind Channel One, the towering, ten-thousand-meter Golden Divine Tree suddenly trembled under the sunlight.
Hum!
The Divine Tree, as if forged from pure gold, shone brilliantly, with mysterious white patterns emerging on each Golden Leaf and appearing to float in reality.
When countless White Rule Runes encircled to form a huge halo, the light suddenly retracted and disappeared.
At the same time, the entire divine tree shook even more violently; rich light surged from within its trunk, penetrated the bark, and shone resplendently, forming a series of golden halos encircling the surroundings.
The sudden change immediately alerted the cultivators of the Human Race, including the king-level guardians of the pathway.
As everyone watched in astonishment, the Golden Divine Tree trembled, its branches and trunk growing visibly to the naked eye, expanding quickly to reach beyond the clouds at thirty thousand meters.
Meanwhile, its roots tore through the Earth; some spread along surface cracks for tens of kilometers to Channel One, then probed into the surrounding void.
Boom, boom, boom!! Channel One shook violently, its silver vortex spinning faster and faster, even beginning to expand.
At the same time, everyone felt the pathway become more stable.
As the cultivators in the Logistics City were all stupefied by the sudden turn of events, a powerful will arrived silently, appearing within the crown of the now light-swathed divine tree.
That will took the form of Adam Garcetti, his black-and-white hair moving without wind, gazing ahead.
There stood a vague, translucent white figure with fourteen white light wings emerging from its back and a white halo overhead, reminiscent of the legendary Creation Angel.
Adam Garcetti spoke slowly, “Should I address you as Divine King or as Civilization Guardian?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1464 - 1464 552 The Terrifying Deep Red World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1464: Chapter 552: The Terrifying Deep Red World, Civilization Guardian_2 Chapter 1464: Chapter 552: The Terrifying Deep Red World, Civilization Guardian_2 The white phantom slowly shook its head, “I am merely a strand of will that has awakened in advance, unable to protect civilization nor continue leading our people to pioneer.”
“My existence is only to witness, and to awaken ‘it’ at the appropriate time.”
“Unable to discern whether it’s protection or pioneering, it seems your condition is not very good,” Adam Garcetti sighed lightly, then his figure vanished.
No one noticed Adam Garcetti’s arrival and departure, nor did they know of it, as everyone’s attention was on the Eternal Divine Tree that kept growing.
Under everyone’s gaze, the golden divine tree almost swelled to a height of one hundred thousand meters—equivalent to a hundred kilometers—before it slowly came to a halt, standing on Earth like majestic mountains.
The spreading canopy covered more than two hundred kilometers, obscuring the sky and sun, and it even shaded half of the No.1 Channel Logistics Base.
Meanwhile, under the convergence of the young Eternal Divine Tree, the concentration of Heavenly Energy within the range of the canopy grew increasingly dense, eventually even turning into tangible dew that fell.
In addition, cultivators were shocked to discover that under the illumination of the golden light from the divine tree, their previously solid cultivation bottlenecks seemed to loosen slightly.
……
“By the way, Princess Caotena, did you choose your Dragon King title yourself, or shall I come up with one for you?”
At high altitude, five massive Giant Beasts were flying together, among which the Destruction Emperor Dragon was the largest in size, followed by the Blue-White Giant Dragon and the Crystal Red Giant Dragon.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, they were like little brothers trailing behind the three-headed beasts.
Moreover, since both of their mothers were present, even the rebellious Silver Giant Dragon acted more ‘obediently,’ refraining from causing mayhem along the way.
After understanding the situation in the Dragon Palace Empire, and with his daughter and friends joining in, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon only hesitated slightly before accepting the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s invitation.
Now, the five Giant Beasts were on their way back, preparing to enter the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In response to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s question, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon thought for a moment and then growled lowly, “My Dragon King title shall be Ruler of the Mountain Ranges.”
The Crystal Red Giant Dragon mastered the rules of Petrification, Earth Law, and several other talents; these abilities fused together to control the power of the Earth and mountain ranges, including gravity.
Within its domain, where it had already refined the Power of Heaven and Earth, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon in the late-stage Titan Realm almost reached the limit of Titan Peak in terms of combat strength.
Very strong.
Of course, this strength was relative to other Giant Beasts, but for the current Destruction Emperor Dragon, it was merely a bite’s worth of challenge.
At this moment, from afar, the Blue-White Giant Dragon with its double wings spread and surrounded by white frost mist also issued a low Dragon Roar, “My title will be Ice-encrusted Destroy Dragon King.
No sooner had the Blue-White Giant Dragon finished speaking than the Silver Giant Dragon roared with pride, “Roar! Mother, your title is too simple. It doesn’t have the grandeur of Great Sethia’s title.”
“Also, Aunt Caotena, your title isn’t as catchy as Telsafi’s Crystal Dragon King.”
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon couldn’t help but roll its eyes, “Sethia, don’t give me random names. My title is clearly King of Ice Crystal Elements.”
Boom, boom, boom!!
As the Giant Dragons ‘chatted’ among themselves, one charged into the dark and chaotic domain of the sky. Suddenly, gravity a hundred times stronger than that of the Outer World enveloped the five Giant Beasts.
However, this change in gravity was outright ignored by the beasts, and soon they entered the range of the Chaos Sea, arriving above the Inner Sea World.
Overlooking the Inner Sea World, where numerous giant ancient clams unfurled, the Destruction Emperor Dragon came to a halt, “This is where the Empire’s temporary Headquarters is located, the abode of the Dragon Palace.”
“However, Alius and the others have all set out, on an expedition to the Chaotic Domain. Princess Adriana, do you plan to oversee the Dragon Palace or choose a direction to advance?”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon and the Crystal Red Giant Dragon exchanged a glance, then roared lowly, “Since we have joined the empire, as Dragon Kings, we have a responsibility to contribute to the empire’s growth.”
With that, the Blue-White Giant Dragon looked towards the Silver Giant Dragon.
The Silver Giant Dragon recoiled, “Roar! The great Sethia and Tim Abbott are in one team, so I won’t join forces with you and Aunt Caotena.”
“I… will also go with Thunderflame,” said the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, shifting towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon as it faced the Crystal Red Giant Dragon’s gaze.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon and the Crystal Red Giant Dragon looked at each other again, both slightly shaking their heads, “Fine, you young dragons have more in common. You’ll be better off together.”
Roar, roar! The two massive dragons let out commanding roars, declaring their presence to the different races below, and then flew off into the depths of the chaotic domain.
They did not carry with them a Level 9 Giant Beast Bait, as per the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s words, because the Crystal Red Giant Dragon had particularly sharp ‘senses’ and possessed a certain talent for detection.
However, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon wasn’t detecting Heaven and Earth Treasures but powerful creatures in the vicinity.
After the two Giant Dragons vanished into the horizon, the Silver Giant Dragon finally breathed a sigh of relief, “Roar! Damn it, with my mother here, the great Sethia always feels devoid of any Dragon King majesty.”
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon looked at him curiously, “Sethia, when have you ever possessed that quality?”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon roared fiercely, “Roar! Torsa, what are you implying? Are you suggesting another showdown with the great Sethia?”
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon held its head high, proudly roaring, “I fear no one.”
The two Giant Dragons flew on either side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the atmosphere between them growing tense as if they were about to fight, but the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but shake his head.
“Enough, stop quarreling, we have important business to attend to.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1465 - 1465 552 The Terrifying Deep Red World
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1465: Chapter 552 The Terrifying Deep Red World, Civilization Guardian_3 Chapter 1465: Chapter 552 The Terrifying Deep Red World, Civilization Guardian_3 Speaking, the Destruction Emperor Dragon extended its massive claws, grasping the necks and shoulders of two giant dragons, one with each claw. With a gentle effort, its figure sank slightly.
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon descended from the sky, holding the two giant dragons as it pierced through the Boundary Wall and entered the Inner Sea World, where a mighty army of thousands of Giant Beasts was respectfully waiting.
Looking at the Black Gold Giant Beast whose wings covered the sky and whose body became increasingly huge and fierce, the Black Tiger Whale on the sea surface had grown to over two hundred and ten meters, reaching Mid Level 9, and it excitedly approached.
Roar! Uncle, uncle, you’re back.
Behind the Black Tiger Whale, a Female Little Tiger Whale that had grown into an Eighth Level Beast respectfully cried out.
Roar! Greetings to the great king.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly, gazing down at the Black Tiger Whale, which seemed like a tiny thing, and let out a low growl, “Tiger Three, how is the collection of Life Crystals?”
When the Destruction Emperor Dragon had entered the depths of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, it had given orders for the whales to continue collecting Life Crystals.
However, when it returned, the Black Tiger Whale, who was mainly responsible for this task, was not present, so it had simply sent a ‘Person’ to issue the summoning command.
The Little Black Tiger Whale nodded, letting out roars: In this time, I have led them and collected many crystals, all stored with Miss Keller.
Roar! Miss Keller, bring over the storage bag.
Roar! Yes, leader.
Compared to other Extraordinary Giant Beasts that trembled and dared not move under the majesty of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the two Tiger Whales behaved quite normally and relaxed.
The oppression of the Monarch level or Heavenly Tier bloodline was something they had long grown accustomed to.
Similar to before, a ‘backpack’ containing Space Power hung on the Dorsal Fin of the Female Little Tiger Whale, but this time the backpack had turned white in color.
Clearly, as its strength improved, the equipment of the Female Little Tiger Whale was also being updated.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s realm of thought moved, a wisp of strength entwined the backpack and lifted it, meanwhile casually asking, “By the way, Tiger Three, where are Tiger One and Tiger Two?”
Roar! Boss One and Boss Two, those two dummies, I don’t know where they ran off to.
Alright then.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded its head, the consciousness entering the stomach sac of the white unknown creature, and instantly a small mountain pile of High-level Life Crystals came into view.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled into a vicious smile, “Well done, Little Three, later go to the Red Tassel Divine Tree and claim three red Divine Fruits.”
Then the Destruction Emperor Dragon added another sentence: “By the way, your dad brought back some good things for you this time, remember to ask him for it.”
Roar! Thank you, uncle. The Little Black Tiger Whale became excited all at once.
The Red Tassel Divine Tree, the pillar of this small world, condensed Top-grade Divine Fruits that could enhance the strength of even Mythical Giant Beasts, let alone a Level 9 Giant Beast like itself.
Only before, there weren’t many Divine Fruits condensed, and there were not enough for the Silver Giant Dragon and the others to share.
However, the Black Tiger Whale, having received a reward, did not leave immediately, but flattered by wagging its tail.
Roar! Uncle, uncle, my subordinates have also worked hard; otherwise, I could not have collected so many crystals in such a short time.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly: “The empire is never stingy in rewarding those who have made contributions; this king will certainly not forget them.”
“Later, Tiger Three, go to Domination… no, Domination is in hibernation for a breakthrough. Just go to the warehouse and collect the resources yourself, each reward a normal top-tier resource.”
“For those who perform exceptionally, give each one a normal Divine Object, and make a judgment yourself about their contribution.”
At present, countless resources are piled up like mountains in the Dragon Palace Warehouse; these were collected by the Female Tiger Whale and those Level 9 Giant Beasts following the departure of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
These top-tier resources and ordinary Divine Objects no longer have much effect on those left behind, including the Titan Dragon King Ja and the Candle Dragon Giant Beast.
As for the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, they had long developed resistance and couldn’t digest much, so the rest were all piled up in the warehouse.
Roar roar roar! Now hurry up and thank Uncle.
Roar roar!! Thank you, Great King.
Whine! Many thanks for the great king’s gracious gift.
Suddenly, thousands of Eighth Level Beasts excitedly roared, looking up at the sky with awe and great admiration for the Black Tiger Whale.
Their boss was too impressive, daring to haggle with the powerful and terrifying King of the Dragon Palace and even obtaining so many rewards for them.
By the time the Black Tiger Whale, leading the Giant Beast legions, was swimming majestically towards the enormous Ancient Giant Clam in the distance, the normally quiet Silver Giant Dragon showed some surprise.
“Roar! The Great Scythia has noticed that Tiger Three seems to be getting smarter, even knowing how to buy the loyalty of beasts.”
“Eh! Scythia, you actually noticed this.”
“Roar! Despicable Telsafi, what do you mean by that?”
“Nothing much, just that you seem to have become a bit smarter.”
“Damn it, are you saying the Great Scythia was a fool before?”
“You could think of it that way.”
Suddenly, the two Giant Dragons started quarreling again, which made the Destruction Emperor Dragon just shake its head, too lazy to mind them anymore, and cast its gaze onto a small white bag floating before it.
Hum!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s head sprouted three pairs of feather horns which lit up, with silver spatial runes appearing on them as golden flames burned and seeped into space.
Meanwhile, seated cross-legged on Battleship One on the way back, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, then his figure silently vanished.
When he reappeared, he was thousands of kilometers away from the fleet.
Standing atop a towering ten-thousand-meter mountain peak, Jack Clark’s right arm lit up with golden red space runes, forming coordinates to provide positioning for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom! Space rippled and distorted, and a silver vortex a hundred meters in diameter appeared in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
With the breakthrough into ancient times, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s control over space had become even more powerful, and the Spatial Channels it opened no longer needed to be fixed above its head.
Pop! A bolt of Blue Thunder leapt forth, and the white backpack turned to ash, revealing tens of thousands of Level 4 or higher Life Crystals.
As those Life Crystals entered one after another, passing through the Spatial Channel, the Reverse Scale under the neck of the Destruction Emperor Dragon flickered slightly, revealing three Chaos Crystal Cores, each over ten meters in diameter.
These Crystal Cores were not Life Crystals; they contained Chaotic matter that could elevate the bloodlines of all life and Strengthen Constitution.
This also applies to humans, so it should be effective for Jack Clark’s original body as well, although the extent of the effect would only be known after use.

chapters.title: Chapter 1466 - 1466 553 Million Attributes Chaos Traits
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1466: Chapter 553: Million Attributes, Chaos Traits Chapter 1466: Chapter 553: Million Attributes, Chaos Traits Only after the three Chaotic Crystals had passed through the Spatial Channel did the silver radiance on the feather horns flanking the Destruction Emperor Dragon begin to fade, eventually closing the pathway.
At the same time, the distorted space surrounding them dissolved the domain of rules, thus the two feuding Giant Dragons did not witness the moment when those Life Crystals had been removed.
Although with increased strength, the Destruction Emperor Dragon no longer needed to hide many secrets, such as previously fooling the Purple little dragon by claiming that the spatial transmission pathway was for sacrifices.
However, Life Crystals were a bit tricky, and it was still necessary to conceal their handling.
After all, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had once told the Silver Giant Dragon and others that it could convert the energy of Life Crystals into “enlightenment,” which was why it possessed so many and such powerful talents.
It was then that the Silver Giant Dragon nudged its head forward, seemingly impatient: “Roar! Tim, can we depart now?”
The massive and ferocious head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly, exhaling a muted, deep growl: “Let’s go, the sooner we unite the Chaotic Domain, the sooner we can embark on our expedition.”
“Roar! Let’s set off, Great Sethia is to be crowned as the Chaos Overlord.” The Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, spreading its silver-scaled wings wide, whipping up violent wind waves as it surged forward.
Compared to the energetic Silver Giant Dragon, the gold-blue Giant Dragon was much more ‘gentle,’ stretching its wings with elegance and following behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon as it soared into the sky.
Beneath them, countless Longa Tribe members and beasts watched with reverent gazes as the three immense beasts quickly disappeared into the dim horizon.
The vast Chaotic Turbulent Region was bisected by a Destruction Forbidden Zone that stretched for hundreds of millions of kilometers, while on the opposing side lay a dark expanse of space wider than ten million kilometers.
The area where the Destruction Emperor Dragon resided was estimated to be over four million kilometers wide, and its full extent was still unclear.
Furthermore, scattered with various space-time faults, collapsing space regions, and dangerous zones, even five Ancient Beasts leading the charge would need some time to sweep through it all.
The territory carved out by the Destruction Emperor Dragon required the five Ancient Beasts to advance side by side over a distance of more than eighty thousand kilometers.
Mythical-level and Titan-level Giant Beasts were all to be suppressed, and if an Ancient-level Giant Beast was encountered, the Dragon King’s Mandate was used to notify the Destruction Emperor Dragon immediately.
After increasing in strength, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had reforged the tokens in the hands of these Dragon Kings with the power of rules, adding features such as communication and stronger positioning.
As a result, it could arrive on the battlefield instantly and either suppress or devour the Ancient Beast.
Battles between Ancient Beasts of the same level would be hard-fought and could last for several Sun Wheels unless one possessed overwhelming combat strength like the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Even when an Ancient late-stage Beast fought an Ancient early-stage Beast, it was difficult to prevent the latter from escaping unless it was ambushed.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon began to push across the Chaotic Turbulent Region, Jack Clark, on the other hand, was smiling at the sight of more than ten thousand Life Crystals floating in mid-air.
Although after his breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, Attribute points could no longer directly enhance his realm and level, they remained very important to Jack.
Whether it be weapon fortification, which saved him a substantial amount of tempering time, or burning them to enter the epiphany state to speed up cultivation, these functions were still strong.
Moreover, Jack felt there were many areas where the function of Attribute points could still be developed.
For example, helping the Human Race’s three Supreme Experts to strengthen their weapons, or upgrading the Federation’s intrinsic weapons like the Sky-based doomsday satellite and Deathline satellite.
The fortification brought about by Attribute points was nonsensical; as long as there were enough materials, the level could be raised through melting and refinement.
If the three Supreme Experts, including the True Martial Heavenly King and his True Martial Divine Tablet were strengthened, their combat power would naturally increase and become even more formidable.
Now, Jack no longer needed to hide many of his secrets, such as his terrifying talent to temper weapons in a short time and forge other weapons.
Of course, no longer hiding didn’t mean Jack would reveal everything; he would use the excuse of an awakening talent ability.
It was Jack’s way of repaying them for their help when he first broke through to the Eight Layer Heaven and entered the mythical world as the three Supreme Experts all took action, slashing with the power of rules to craft forbidden weapons for him.
Out of the four forbidden weapons, besides the Rebirth Crystal which became redundant due to Jack’s rapid rise in strength, the others had all played their significant roles.
In fact, Jack could also help enhance the weapons of those Mythical Kings and Heavenly Kings in the future, leading to a significant increase in the overall combat power of the high-end forces of the Human Race.
Of course, this was all just wishful thinking.
If he really did fortify all of the weapons, the consumption of Life Crystals would be colossal to the point of giving Jack a headache, something the Human Race could not afford.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon would not be able to collect so many Life Crystals within a year or two.
After the Black Tiger Whale and others had slaughtered a large number of Unique Beasts in the Chaos Turbulent Sea, they barely managed to gather over ten thousand Level 4 or higher Life Crystals.
This was because the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region had no ordinary Unique Beasts, and only a few Transcendent Beasts lived in the Chaos Sea. Even so, there were very few fish in the sea.
Moreover, unlike Blue Star, the Unique Beasts in the mythical world were born as Extraordinary Creatures with stable genes, only forming Life Crystals at the pinnacle of their species.
For instance, if the evolutionary cap for a fish species of Unique Beast was Level 5, it would not produce a Life Crystal within at Level 4 Peak as it had not reached its limit, and did not need a Life Crystal to ignite Evolution.
This was the largest difference between the lifespan of beings from the mythical world and those from the Blue Star World.

chapters.title: Chapter 1467 - 1467 553 Million Attributes Chaos Traits_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1467: Chapter 553: Million Attributes, Chaos Traits_2 Chapter 1467: Chapter 553: Million Attributes, Chaos Traits_2 Under the collision of the powers from two worlds, all life forms in the Blue Star World became unstable—highly prone to mutation, awakening, and stepping onto the path of transcendence.
And it wasn’t just the Blue Star, all worlds devoured by the mythical world, their living beings would initially undergo an unstable process of mutation.
“You have transformed a high-purity energy crystal into 73 attribute points.”
“You have transformed a high-purity energy crystal into 138 attribute points…”
Surrounded by dense life crystals, Jack Clark spent over half an hour to finally transform all the Life Crystals into attribute points.
Instantly, on the transparent page, the attribute points turned into 1,075,238.
A million attribute points; even Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
Unfortunately, after his talent and the abilities of the Destruction Emperor Dragon reached the Deification Level, they could no longer be strengthened; otherwise, these attribute points would be enough to pile up a terrifying ability.
In contemplation, Jack Clark’s gaze fell upon the ‘huge’ Chaos Crystal Core floating in front of him.
Fourteen meters in diameter, the multi-faceted elliptical gray crystal seemed tiny as a grain of sand in front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon; however, to a human, it was akin to a small building.
Feeling the chaos substance flowing inside the Chaos Crystal Core, and the devouring instinct emanating from all his cells, Jack Clark couldn’t help but extend his right hand and gently touch it.
Boom!
The entire gray crystal vibrated thunderously, the overbearing energy of the chaos substance rushing into his body through his palm, wildly scourging and destroying everything in its path.
Yet, this force of Chaos that made the Silver Giant Dragon and other Mythical Giant Beasts scream in agony as their flesh and blood shattered, couldn’t shake Jack Clark’s true body in the slightest.
Jack Clark’s true body strength now was comparable to that of an ordinary Ancient Beast, unmatched in might.
In Jack Clark’s perception, as the chaos substance entered his body, all his cells and flesh and blood began to undergo a kind of transformation, giving him a sense of completion.
“Completion, huh,” Jack Clark mused.
So this was why the Chaos Crystal Core could purify the bloodline of Giant Beasts—the substances containing chaos could make the essence of Mythical Creatures become more complete.
In just over ten minutes, the Chaos Crystal Core, more than ten meters in diameter, turned to dust and dissipated, with all the energy and chaos substance it contained absorbed by Jack Clark.
This transformation did not significantly elevate his life level, but it was very important to Jack Clark.
It endowed his top-tier Innate Gods and Demons’ true body with characteristics of a Chaos Living Being, making it more complete, and even seemed to deepen his innate connection with Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
Suddenly, a terrifying aura burst forth from Jack Clark; his black hair danced wildly, a golden World Halo appeared behind him, slowly rotating and emitting an infinite radiance, which overshadowed the sun in the sky.
With the help of that Chaos Crystal Core, and just short of a bit previously, his realm smoothly advanced to the mid period of the Heavenly King, with an even more terrifying aura.
Jack Clark sighed lightly, “The mid period of the Heavenly King, it’s a pity that the requirement to break through to Supreme is having complete rules; it will take some more time.”
Amidst his musings, Jack Clark turned his head slightly to look behind him, his gaze resting on the slowly rotating World Halo and the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane beyond it.
At the center of the main continent on the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, the diameter had already expanded to over 7,000 kilometers.
Above the firmament, where Black Wind howled and purple lightning roared, a Golden-White Great Sun spanned, radiating boundless and intense radiance.
Most importantly, around the Golden-White Great Sun, those ripples of transparency that enveloped everything emitted a terrifying aura that seemed to suppress all heavens and shatter space-time.
A nascent Supreme Rule of Strength.
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, “The growth of the plane and the speed of rule evolution seem a bit slow; it looks like I need to find a way to slay one or two Ancient Beasts.”
As the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane finished digesting the Titan Giants, the essence of an Ancient Beast skeleton, the expansion speed suddenly plummeted, becoming exceedingly slow.
The growth of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane was intertwined with the evolution of the Supreme Rule, even relating to his breakthrough to the Supreme Level or stepping into a higher tier.
This plane opened by Jack Clark always had a subtle existence; just supporting and nurturing the Law of Strength, the World’s Power added some enhancement to Defense.
But once Jack Clark breaks through to the Supreme, this plane will unveil its true might.
A real and complete Inner World Plane over 10,000 kilometers in diameter is what those Demon Gods and Divine Kings eternally pursue, symbolizing a Monarch’s potential.
A perfected and actualized rule world, eventually merging with the body, becoming the rule itself, is the direction of cultivation after reaching Supreme.
Since Jack Clark opened the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane himself, his will was the Heavenly Dao, making the integration of the Inner World and the rules with his True Body far less difficult compared to other Demon Gods.
“Therefore, I should slay at least two more Ancient Beasts,” he thought.
In a moment of quiet contemplation, Jack Clark’s silhouette silently vanished, chasing after the fleet that had already flown tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Jack Clark, unlike those Demon Gods who had cultivated for many years, had little time, especially for an Inner World like the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, which required time to gradually accumulate and evolve.
Therefore, he had to exchange sufficient resources.
But the act of slaying Ancient Beasts and using their skeletons as nourishment was a bit of a grand gesture.
…
In a vast circular conference room, Jack Clark sat in the chief seat. Opposite him was the Mysterious Martial Sky King, and to his left and right were Sky King Denny Kaye and King Cyril, with his head of silver hair.
Noticing Jack Clark, whose aura seemed a bit unsettled and somewhat concealing the ‘sky,’ the Mysterious Martial Sky King exclaimed, “Jack Clark, has your realm broken through to the mid period of the Heavenly King?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1468 - 1468 553 Million Attributes Chaos Traits_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1468: Chapter 553: Million Attributes, Chaos Traits_3 Chapter 1468: Chapter 553: Million Attributes, Chaos Traits_3 Jack Clark smiled and nodded, “Yes, I had a sudden inspiration just now, so I temporarily left to find a place for my breakthrough.”
He is simply a monster. Both Sky King Denny Kaye and King Cyril showed a touch of shock on their faces.
How long since Jack Clark’s last breakthrough to Heavenly King? Ten days or fifteen days?
Sky King Denny Kaye felt somewhat emotional, “As time passes, new talents emerge, eh, Mr. Winston, Cyril, don’t you feel like being slapped dead on the beach?”
King Cyril smiled bitterly, “It’s more than being slapped to death, it’s more like being so shocked that I want to find a hole to bury myself in.”
“And you’re still better off, you’re already strong men of the late period of Heavenly Kings, while someone from a generation later like myself has cultivated for so many years, only recently breaking through to the late period of king-level.”
“Compared to Jack Clark’s speed, it’s downright embarrassing.”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King burst into laughter, “Haha… I’m not too bothered, aside from being a bit surprised, I don’t have many other feelings, because I never compare myself to others.”
As opposed to Sky King Denny Kaye and Golden Sword King Cyril, who displayed astonishing talent from the beginning, the Mysterious Martial Sky King belonged to those who achieved success later in life.
Only breaking through to Seventh Layer Heaven in his twenties, he never compared himself with others, always aiming to surpass his own self from yesterday.
Being praised so directly, even Jack Clark felt a bit embarrassed and couldn’t help but cough dryly, “You overpraise me, seniors; I am just a little faster.”
His modesty made the two Sky Kings reluctant to speak.
You call that just a little faster?
At that moment, Jack Clark changed the topic to the main issue, “I’ve called the three seniors here because there are some things that I would like to give to you.”
As he spoke, the space in front of Jack Clark distorted, and two 3 meter and one 1-meter diameter gray stones appeared, the faint Chaos fluctuations causing an instinctive restlessness in the three of them.
“While I was breaking through earlier, the Aura I released caused a space to collapse, revealing the ruins.”
“These Crystals are what I found inside, containing traces of Chaotic substance, which can enhance a cultivator’s True Body Strength and talent.”
After confirming the effect of the Chaos Crystal Cores, Jack Clark had crushed the remaining two pieces into variously sized fragments to give to these ‘acquaintances’.
However, looking at the floating gray Crystals in front of them, the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and Golden Sword King Cyril all remained motionless, instead turning their gaze towards Jack Clark.
“I didn’t expect them to be resources containing Chaotic substances; no wonder our bodies reacted so vigorously.”
Then the Mysterious Martial Sky King solemnly shook his head, “Jack Clark, we can’t accept these; you would benefit more from absorbing them than we old folks.”
“Indeed,” the two Sky Kings nodded slightly.
Jack Clark smiled faintly, “Please don’t be modest, seniors; I’ve already assimilated a larger Chaos Crystal Core previously and have developed resistance to it.”
Jack Clark was indeed not being modest.
The most important feature of these Chaos Crystal Cores is to bestow a sliver of Chaotic attribute to life, making it more complete and in greater harmony with Heaven and Earth, thereby enhancing its potential.
The small amount of energy they contained and the ability to strengthen physique and purify a little bloodline were actually not the main points.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with its ability to evolve, saw a dramatic decrease in the effect after absorbing the first core, and those that followed yielded only energy.
Therefore, it was better to give them to these ‘acquaintances’ to improve their strength.
The more than ten remaining fragments of Chaos Crystal Cores in Jack Clark’s hands already had intended recipients: the three Supreme ones, Glenn Clark, Freya Louise, Marcellus Larry, and others.

chapters.title: Chapter 1469 - 1469 554 Second Enhancement Ancient Blade
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1469: Chapter 554 Second Enhancement, Ancient Blade Edge Chapter 1469: Chapter 554 Second Enhancement, Ancient Blade Edge After giving three Chaos Crystal Core fragments to Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others, Jack Clark’s figure appeared on the Number Thirteen sky-based battleship.
In the medical and living area in the middle of the battleship, the Special Forces Soldiers standing guard in the corridor immediately stood at attention when they saw the black-haired young man appear out of thin air, “Divine Martial Emperor, we salute you.”
“No need to be so formal.”
Jack Clark nodded and looked towards the ward.
Through the glass, he could see Damon Lopes busy on the hospital bed, holding a mobile phone, with his fingers creating a blur as he rapidly chatted away.
In Jack’s ‘view,’ however, the guy was not just chatting with a beauty but simultaneously with more than thirty girls, constantly swapping between chat windows on his phone.
Only when a beauty sent him her glamour photos would he pause for a moment.
The guy’s hobbies hadn’t changed. Jack shook his head and then knocked on the door.
“Jack, Divine Martial Emperor, why are you here?” Damon Lopes was surprised, then subconsciously closed the chat app and put his mobile phone into the Storage Space before sitting up.
Jack smiled slightly, “I’ve come to bring you something and to check on your condition.”
“I’m okay, can’t die just yet,” Damon Lopes said somewhat embarrassedly.
Compared to Jack, who had dominated one side on his expedition, he, a genius from the same period, nearly got beaten to death, and even his Soul Source suffered some damage.
Otherwise, as a Ninth Heaven top-level powerhouse, how could he possibly be lying in a hospital bed?
As he spoke, Jack turned his hand, and a gray crystal the size of a fist appeared.
There was no helping it, Damon Lopes was too weak, a bit more and he would have died.
“Although it is a bit painful to refine this thing, the substance it contains can further enhance your Thunder Talent; consider it a gift for your ‘illness’.”
“Otherwise, even if you break through to the Legendary Realm later on, you will be only a bit stronger than the average Mythical powerhouse, not enough to show off.”
“Hehe… we’re all brothers, I won’t stand on ceremony then,” Damon said, decisively taking the gray crystal.
With Jack’s current level of cultivation, anything he gave out definitely wouldn’t be ‘cheap,’ and Damon was no fool to offer insincere pleasantries.
Damon’s attitude made Jack smile, then he patted his shoulder, “Being sick, you should watch less ‘erotic films,’ it’s not good for your health.”
“No, I never watch erotic films, I just chat with them…” But before Damon could finish, Jack had already disappeared.
Then, not long after, a scream rang out in the medical area.
“Weren’t you saying it would only be a little painful…”
…
On the Number One sky-based battleship, on the front deck, a Black-Red Colored Mech, over eight hundred meters tall, stood quietly, enveloped by a faint blood-colored mist and a Terrifying Aura.
As it grew, the ‘Mecha’ aura of Number One was getting fainter, and its life characteristics were strengthening.
Now, many who saw Number One’s first impression was that of a gigantic creature clad in battle armor, no longer a cold machine.
As soon as Jack appeared out of nowhere, the originally tranquil Number One shuddered violently, ready to awaken the Terrifying Power within it as it sensed a strong threat.
But then the eyes that lit up on Number One dimmed down again, as it recognized the person who had arrived.
The guy who had fed it a lot of demon kings and Great Demon Kings.
Jack looked indifferently at Number One and then said in a gentle voice, “Freya, can you come out?”
“I can, give me a moment.” As she spoke, the crystal on the chest of Number One lit up, emitting a blue and white light beam, and Freya Louise slowly flew out from inside of it.
At this time, the black-haired girl was wearing golden-white battle armor, but whether it was the energy-based God Machine Armament or the dark golden patterns spreading over the backs of her hands and face, they were all visible.
Beyond that, Freya’s Aura had reached the peak of the Ninth Heavens, showing signs of breaking through to the king-level Boundary.
Moreover, the ancient Aura wrapped around her was becoming more evident; her gaze was cold and indifferent, as if she was standing in another world, quietly observing this one, filled with a sense of detachment.
But when her gaze fell on Jack, her eyes flickered slightly, becoming more lively, regaining some of the warmth characteristic of a person.
Seeing the refined girl before him, Jack’s gaze became focused, “There are no issues with your current state, right?”
The girl replied softly, “It’s still within control, I’m in a synchronized fusion state with Number One right now, so my Aura is slowly changing to match it.”
Beyond that, Freya had merged a strand of a resurgent ancient creature’s soul in the Primitive Azure Sky, extracting the information contained within that soul fragment.
As she fused with more and more ancient creature souls, Freya’s life form and level were undergoing a certain Transformation.
