Although Freya was still full of confidence, Jack felt her condition was somewhat dangerous.
After all, those almost eternal ancient creatures, if their revival power could be stolen so easily, wouldn’t have much ‘prestige,’ even if Freya possessed the Primitive Azure Sky.
Still, this was Freya’s path; when she chose to go to Mist River City to study, she had prepared for it.
So even though Jack had some concerns, he said nothing else and took out a handful of gray sand: “This substance contains special material. After refining it, you should be able to stabilize your realm and strengthen your True Body.”
Unlike the Chaos Crystal Core given to Damon, the crystal Jack gave to Freya was crushed by him, using the power of rules to remove the Furious Power contained within.
Therefore, even though the amount of ‘refinement’ was several times that of Damon, she would be fine, and the pain of rebirth would also be much less.

chapters.title: Chapter 1470 - 1470 554 Second Enhancement Ancient Blade
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1470: Chapter 554 Second Enhancement, Ancient Blade Edge_2 Chapter 1470: Chapter 554 Second Enhancement, Ancient Blade Edge_2 Just as Jack Clark brought out the Chaos Crystal Core, it seemed as if the Number One, sensing the chaos matter contained within, vibrated slightly as it emitted a blue-white radiance from its eyes.
It was unclear whether it was wary of Jack Clark or under Freya Louise’s control, but the Number One’s instinct did not attempt to seize the core.
Looking at the grey crystal sand imbued with dense energy before her, the girl’s lips suddenly curved upward, “Jack Clark, does this count as the first gift you’ve given me?”
Jack Clark paused, then smiled, “…Yes, I suppose it does. You’ve given me portraits before, and the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd. It’s only natural for me to return the favor.”
“Indeed,” said Freya Louise as she gently scooped up the grey crystal sand and placed it into her Storage Space.
After chatting for a while longer, Freya Louise once again flew into Number One along the Light Beam. Seeing this, Jack Clark also prepared to begin his cultivation practice.
Boom! Not far from Number One, space above Jack Clark trembled and shattered, forming a crack that spanned thousands of kilometers.
The powerful fluctuations of energy shook the void, creating shockwave after shockwave that exploded into the abyss, from which a black-colored warhammer in normal shape, but more than a thousand meters in length, descended slowly.
Immediately, centered on the first sky-based battleship, the eight surrounding sky-based warships sank abruptly, followed by the flashing of blinding red alert lights.
Merely the invisible and heavy aura almost caused these sky-based warships to disintegrate, showing the might of a Pseudo-World Level Weapon used by Demon God Level Powerhouses.
Compared to the Extreme Realm Great Demon King who was slain by Jack Clark’s hand, this Demon God Weapon was evidently of a higher level, even though both were Pseudo-World Level.
The sudden abnormality caught the attention of many. Numerous High-Ranking Powerhouses took to the sky, looking from high altitude towards the source.
When they recognized the black-haired young man standing with his hands behind his back beneath the black warhammer, they heaved a sigh of relief, “It’s Divine Martial Emperor, that gave me quite a scare.”
“It appears the Emperor is attempting to refine that powerful weapon.”
“Seems like it.”
Among the cultivators in the distance, curious about this side, and looking toward the black warhammer descending slowly from the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, Jack Clark’s eyes also revealed a row of transparent text.
“The Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd has been upgraded to a Pseudo-World Level Weapon. To merge with other Pseudo-World Level Weapons, 100,000 Attribute points are required. Proceed with fusion?”
“It actually requires 100,000 Attribute points this time,” Jack Clark said, somewhat surprised but then reasoned that it seemed quite normal after all.
Pseudo-World Level Weapons also belonged to the world-class category, containing within them a broken fragment of a world and incomplete rules. The fusion of two different ‘worlds’ was akin to the collision of two worlds.
Naturally, the difficulty was greater.
“Spend 100,000 Attribute points to infuse this Dark Battlefield into the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd.”
Boom! The moment Jack Clark spoke, an explosive surge of enhancement strength erupted within him.
This majestic enhancement strength turned into white flames, fiercely burning, traveling down his hands to engulf both the four-meter-long Black Gold battle halberd and the thousand-meter-long Black Warhammer in a conflagration.
And the instant this enhancement strength enveloped both weapons, the Eight Desolate War Halberd and the Dark Battle Hammer emitted terrifying fluctuations of energy.
The powerful ripples of rules even alarmed the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Powerhouses following behind.
Three Divine Kings and more than a dozen Main Gods soared into the sky, unfurling the wings of light on their backs and looking toward the human fleet, their gazes immediately settling on Jack Clark.
Then on the Dark Battle Hammer and War Halberd enshrouded by white flames.
Anstice, puzzled, “What is he doing?”
Bordea hesitated, “It seems like he’s refining that Pseudo-World Level Weapon.”
“I know, but does he not realize that each Pseudo-World Level Weapon exists independently and can’t possibly be fused and refined?”
“… Well, the Divine Martial Emperor probably doesn’t know that,” Bordea responded uncertainly.
At this moment, not only the Heavenly Feather Clan but also others such as Sky King Denny Kaye, who had not yet had the chance to refine the Chaos Crystal Core, were somewhat astonished. They had figured out what Jack Clark was attempting to do.
Golden Sword King Cyril said gravely, “Should we intervene?”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King shook his head slightly, “No need. Since Jack Clark dares to do this, he must have some confidence. Don’t forget his talent for weapon forging.”
“Even if he fails, it’s just the loss of an unusable Abyssal Weapon, nothing of consequence.”
Recalling the scene where Jack Clark had merged the War Halberd with the Battle Axe in just a few hours, elevating it to a World-class weapon, Golden Sword King Cyril nodded thoughtfully.
Boom!
Just then, a more astonishing force exploded on Number One sky-based battleship. Under the mighty force, the Heaven and Earth weather changed dramatically, showing various omens.
Above the Firmament, the vague shadows of two worlds appeared, slowly drawing closer amidst the burning white flames.
While Jack Clark was fusing the weapons, darkness descended ahead, and a vast dark area stretching across Heaven and Earth appeared in front, causing the fleet to slow its advance.
At the same time, smiles appeared on many faces.
Passing through this forbidden area meant they were only over five hundred thousand kilometers from Human Territory.
“Report, we have reached the Fault region. Proceed with space-time jump?”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King spoke somberly, “Halt advance. Wait for the Divine Martial Throne to finish refining before entering the spatial fault. Also, notify the Heavenly Feather Allies of this situation.”
“Yes.”
The human race’s fleet had used a space-time fault jump to traverse over three million kilometers to appear on this side, saving a significant amount of time.
However, such a journey through space-time faults required that objects and energy maintain a stable state, so they had to wait until Jack Clark finished refining his weapon before proceeding.

chapters.title: Chapter 1471 - 1471 554 Second Enhancement Ancient Blade
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1471: Chapter 554: Second Enhancement, Ancient Blade Edge_3 Chapter 1471: Chapter 554: Second Enhancement, Ancient Blade Edge_3 While Jack Clark was strengthening the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd for the second time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had once again delved deeper into the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
In the dimly lit world, blue tornadoes, towering and penetrating the earth, shattered the land, and their movement even tore space apart, creating black cracks.
At the edge of the hurricane forbidden area, a Giant Beast over nineteen hundred meters long, covered entirely in Blue Scales Armor, stood tall like a griffin but even more ferocious, sweeping up the raging winds.
Facing this Titan Beast was an even larger beast, like a mountain range clad in Black Gold, with double wings spread wide enough to blot out the sun, emitting an ancient aura that seemed to crush heaven and earth.
Behind this enormous and ferocious Black Gold creature, two Silver and Gold-Blue Giant Dragons, each over fourteen hundred meters long, roared.
And yet, even faced with the Ancient-Level Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Blue Scaled Griffin Beast showed no signs of retreating; instead, it roared furiously, appearing extremely ferocious.
Looking at the fiercely imposing Titan Beast, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly spoke with a deep and majestic roar that echoed between heaven and earth, “Submit, or die?”
Mad fury filled the eyes of the Griffin Beast as it let out a violent roar, “Roar! Begone, this, my territory.”
Seeing this, the Silver Giant Dragon shook its head, “Roar!… Tim Abott, here’s another fool.”
Due to the chaotic rules of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, many Giant Beasts that stayed here for too long had their consciousness affected, becoming more bloodthirsty and savage, with confused minds.
Only a few places where the Heavenly Energy was ‘calm’ or similar to a small world were able to avoid interference.
This kind of Giant Beast was nothing new to the Silver Giant Dragon; they had encountered many as they traversed the Chaotic Turbulent Region in the past.
“If it’s already foolish, then kill it.”
In a deep roar, terrifying Qi Blood surged through the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its body radiating a Terrifying Aura that made this World tremble, as it stomped down hard.
Boom!
Space shattered like glass under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s foot. Its massive body Burst forth with unrivaled speed, instantly covering a thousand kilometers to appear in front of the Griffin Beast.
At the same time, a giant claw, wrapped in black lightning, fell from the sky, its terrible strength instantly shaking heaven and earth and creating layers of spatial tidal explosions.
Under the pressure of indescribable Overbearing Power, the seventeen tornadoes, each a thousand meters thick and reaching heaven from earth, that surrounded the Griffin Beast instantly dissipated.
As for the Griffin Beast itself, it only had time to let out a wail before its head exploded instantly, its hot blood spurting from its neck like a waterfall, gushing hot blood everywhere.
However, under normal conditions, Titan-Level Beasts had incredibly strong vitality, and even if their heads and hearts exploded, they could recover in an extremely short time by consuming their Origin.
But the Destruction Emperor Dragon certainly didn’t allow it the chance. The moment it crushed the beast’s head with one claw, it reached out with its left claw, grabbed the beast’s body, and pressed down fiercely.
Boom!
The Earth within thousands of kilometers fractured and exploded, the powerful shockwave shattering all nearby tornadoes with Unrivaled Domination.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon stood roaring, holding the half-shattered body of the Griffin Beast in its claw. Black lightning arced between its claws, and its fearsome maw bit down.
Thump! Under the terrifying bite, the Giant Beast’s scale armor shattered, its skin tore, and its body was severly in two, its struggling breath weakening immediately.
Under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Devouring Talent, this bite not only devoured the flesh and blood but also a part of the Titan Beast’s soul and the Laws’ Origin.
With a Griffin Beast corpse in each claw, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly turned its head, with bits of meat and blood hanging from its mouth, and let out a low growl, “Let’s go, we continue further in.”
“Roar! Tim Abott, remember to leave a Mythical-level Giant Beast for Great Sethia next time. Great Sethia also wants rivers of blood.”
“We’ll see when the time comes,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t directly agree.
For the dragon now, Mythical-level beasts were simply one bite each. Rather than hand them over to Sethia for a drawn-out battle, it might as well eat them on the spot and continue its advance.
With the Titan Griffin corpse in its grasp, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body surged upward, shattering the blue tornadoes between heaven and earth as it rose.
Following the pathway opened by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Silver and Gold-Blue Giant Dragons easily passed through the hurricane zone.
By this time, the Titan Griffin corpses held by the Destruction Emperor Dragon had disappeared, eaten outright, lengthening the Emperor Dragon’s body by a meter—a meager gain.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon rampaged far and wide, over twenty million kilometers away, a Giant Beast over five thousand meters long, covered in black scales and bone spurs, stood tall, radiating an Ancient-Level pressure.
Around this Ancient Beast, more than thirty creatures, ranging from several hundred to a thousand meters long, lay coiled, all exuding Mythical-level aura, and even two exuding the aura of Titans.
However, the gaze in these Giant Beasts’ eyes seemed vacant, Hollow, as if they were being ‘controlled’ by a ‘Person.’
Roar!
Suddenly, the Ancient Beast bellowed in anger, swinging its Blade Edge-like arms, and under its Terrifying Power, two Mythical Giant Beasts that couldn’t dodge in time were cleaved to pieces.
The formidable power did not lessen, leaving behind two dark cracks more than a thousand kilometers long on the ground, causing the Earth to shake.
The Ancient Beast’s eyes were filled with violence and murderous intent as it mumbled incoherently, “It’s no use; I still can’t shake off the control; that Soul Power is too strong.”
After a while, the raging Ancient Beast gradually calmed down, and cold and slightly rueful light shone from its purple eyes.
“It’s time to find it.”
In a muffled, low roar, the King of Blade Edge, having retaken control of an Ancient Beast’s body, turned and led the Mythical Beast Army toward the direction of Dragon Palace.

﻿Chapter 1472: Chapter 555: Return to the Federation from the Eight Desolations Blood Prison Chapter 1472: Chapter 555: Return to the Federation from the Eight Desolations Blood Prison “`
Roar!
The ferocious Giant Beast’s roar shook Heaven and Earth.
Under the Dark Heavens and Earth, countless Giant Beasts as numerous as locusts flew in the sky, with the smallest one being a hundred meters long, and the largest resembling a mountain peak.
These Giant Beasts were covered with black scale armor, their arms like a pair of slash blades vibrating at the edge tens of thousands of times per second, emitting an incredibly sharp aura.
Furthermore, when these Giant Beasts gathered together, the vibrating waves from those blades resonated, creating a humming roar that shattered the rules pervading Heaven and Earth.
Even space became unstable under the resonance, displaying numerous cracks.
“Roar! These Giant Beasts are so annoying, Tim Abott, kill them all.” Under the sound of the vibrating waves, the Silver Giant Dragon roared uncomfortably and disgustedly.
The Gold and Blue Giant Dragon on the other side growled lowly, “It would be a pity to kill them. This group of Giant Beasts has a collective ability. If subdued, they could form an elite Giant Beast legion.”
Hearing this, the Black Gold Giant Beast in the middle, even more massive in size, slowly nodded, its golden vertical pupils, like amber, coldly fixed on the leading Giant Beast whose body length was over two thousand eight hundred meters.
From this late-period Titan Beast, the Destruction Emperor Dragon sensed an incredibly sharp edge, with those surrounding strands of black radiance appearing like the embodiment of ‘sharpness.’
Plus, aided by the resonance of the surrounding Giant Beast legions, all starting at level eight, even facing its ancient early-stage self, the leading Beast chose not to flee.
But with just this level of strength, it didn’t have the qualifications to fly before it.
Boom!
Golden-red lightning leapt across the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and in an instant, an aura that crushed the Void and the heavens erupted, shaking space-time.
The terrifying oppression of the Heavenly Tier bloodline caused the Heavenly Earth Law to collapse, rules trembled, and mixed with the power of Doomsday, it formed rings of golden-red radiance sweeping across Heaven and Earth.
Bang, bang, bang!!
In an instant, all Mythical-level Giant Beasts in front stumbled, stunned by the shock and falling from the sky.
Roar!! The two thousand-meter-long Mythical Black Armored Giant Beasts, along with that Titan Level Beast, all let out cries of terror as the domains around them roared and crumbled.
In an instant, the three Giant Beasts dropped like meteors from the sky, their bodies radiating black light as they smashed into the Earth.
Boom!
An area over a thousand kilometers across fractured, and the dazzling explosion rose like a mushroom cloud from a nuclear explosion, with countless dirt and rocks thrown in all directions, including those Transcendent Black Armored Beasts.
In two large pits, each tens of kilometers in diameter, the two Mythical-level Black Armored Beasts lay on the ground, their bodies limp and unable to move, a fear originating from their souls spreading through them.
In comparison to the two Mythical Beasts, the Black-armored Beast King of the late Titan period was slightly better off, barely managing to stand.
On this Titan Beast, golden-red radiance suffused, like a veil, bearing the weight of the world, heavily suppressing it, allowing only roars of fury to be heard.
At that moment, a huge Black Gold claw appeared soundlessly above its head and pressed down fiercely.
Boom!
An even more terrifying explosion burst open, rending heaven and Earth, with space itself shattered by the Titan Black Armored Giant Beast’s skull, forming an impact crater hundreds of kilometers in diameter.
Amid the wild waves of energy, the seven-thousand-meter-long Destruction Emperor Dragon stood behind the Black Armored Titan Beast, its right claw suppressing it underground, its ferocious mouth slightly open.
“I am the Lord of the Palace of the Dragon King Hall of the Dragon Palace Empire, the King of Thunderflame. Now you have two choices, submit or die.”
“I submit, I submit!”
Feeling the cold and terrifying killing intent behind it, along with the intense scent of death, the late-period Titan Black Armored Giant Beast hastily growled, fearing the terrifying Giant Beast might bite down in the next moment.
Seeing this, the Silver Giant Dragon felt somewhat regretful, “Roar! What a pity. This guy’s consciousness hasn’t fallen into chaos. The Great Sethia was still hoping for a bloodbath.”
The standard for the Dragon Palace Empire to subdue Giant Beasts now was that they must be of Mythical level or above, and their consciousness must maintain a certain independence and clarity.
As for those with a violent and chaotic consciousness, even if forcefully subdued and suppressed by absolute strength, it was impossible to ensure they would obey orders during the upcoming great battles.
Seeing that the Titan Beast was willing to submit, the Doomsday Rule pervading the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body slowly receded, and the terrifying oppression that collapsed everything disappeared from heaven and Earth.
Even the Dragon Claw pressing on the Titan Black Armored Beast’s head slowly loosened.
Immediately, the Beast that had just walked the line back from death felt weak at the knees and almost collapsed, taking a moment to catch its breath before standing straight again.
At this time, the scale armor on the Titan Beast’s head was shattered, its bones collapsed, revealing the muscle underneath gleaming with a black edge – it had come close to being crushed to death by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
With the lifting of regulatory suppression, the injuries on the Giant Beast’s head were rapidly healing.
At that moment, the two Giant Dragons flew over as well, landing on either side of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, eyeing the ferocious Black Armored Beast with curiosity.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon began to speak in a deep and resonant voice, “This is the Imperial Dragon King, the King of Storm and Frost, Sethia, and this one is the King of Ice Crystal Elements, Telsafi.”
The Imperial Dragon King! The Titan Black Armored Beast’s eyes showed astonishment; it looked somewhat dumbfounded at the Silver Giant Dragon, which, at one thousand four hundred meters long, was much smaller than itself.
To the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the confused expression of the Titan Beast was very satisfying.
By this point, the title of the Imperial Dragon King held by the Silver Giant Dragon was, in effect, expendable. However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had a sense of wicked amusement and felt that keeping the title was more fun.
Every time those Titan Beasts, Ancient Beasts, heard that a Mythical Giant Beast was the Imperial Dragon King, the bewildered expressions on their faces were quite entertaining.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1473 - 1473 555 Return to the Federation from the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1473: Chapter 555: Return to the Federation from the Eight Desolations Blood Prison_2 Chapter 1473: Chapter 555: Return to the Federation from the Eight Desolations Blood Prison_2 As for whether these Dragon Kings and their subordinate Giant Beasts would be disobedient, the Destruction Emperor Dragon did not care.
With its suppression, even if they were not convinced, they would have to hold it in.
Gazing at the Giant Beast standing before it, over eight hundred meters tall at the shoulder, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled softly, “Your strength is not bad, I just used a little bit of force, and yet I didn’t crush your head.”
The Titan Giant Beast paused at these words, then respectfully said, “…Thank you for your mercy, king.”
“From now on, you are the Black Armored General of the empire, continue to command these tribemates of yours; this is your token of identity.”
Within the deep, thick voice, a red token akin to jade emerged slowly, its diameter tens of meters, floating in front of the Titan Black Armored Giant Beast.
This so-called token of identity was made from the bark of the red divine tree and contained the Rule Aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon after it was tempered.
“The empire is currently expanding, with five Ancient Level Dragon Kings leading the Giant Beast legions to sweep through all directions.”
“Next, you will take your subordinates above Level 9 to these coordinates to rally, using the general’s token to identify unfamiliar Mythical-level Giant Beasts.”
“Yes, my king,” said the Titan Black Armored Giant Beast, his heart chilling at the mention of the empire’s five Ancient Level Dragon Kings.
After subduing a legion of Giant Beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the others departed again, their enormous figures quickly vanishing into the dim sky.
The Chaotic Turbulent Region was vast, terrifyingly so when measured in square kilometers, hence the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s expedition plan only required Giant Beasts above Level 9.
Those Giant Beast creatures that were to be reclaimed would be sent in advance to gather at the edge of the Chaos Sea.
When they returned, it would be time for the expedition against The Purgatory Family.
Otherwise, taking along those subdued Giant Beasts would slow down the speed, and not taking them to have them wait in place would waste a lot of time when summoning them later.
To prevent these Giant Beasts from ‘getting lost’, the tokens crafted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon included mapping capabilities.
The tokens outlined the routes they had traversed, which areas were dangerous forbidden areas that Mythical Giant Beasts could not pass, where space was fractured, and where those below Ancient Levels needed to detour, among other things.
To unify the entire Chaotic Domain and gather all the Mythical-level Giant Beasts was not merely talk; it actually involved a great deal of troublesome and complex affairs.
If the Destruction Emperor Dragon hadn’t been well-prepared and had fully considered everything, allowing Scythia to proceed with a few Ancient Beasts, it would have taken years to accomplish without a few years’ time.
While the Beast Empire was frenziedly expanding, the enhancement of Jack Clark’s weapons was also coming to an end.
Above the Sky Ocean, fleets of ships were levitating.
At the forefront, above the leading sky-based battleship, a towering white flame was burning, and within it, a black-gold battle halberd over three thousand meters in length, large as a mountain range, was suspended.
Surrounding the halberd was a vortex of crimson blood light, forming a transparent and colossal red world projection that resembled a devilish face, radiating intense blood light and a terrifying killing intent.
This blood-colored devilish face world was the ‘world’ of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
The world of a world-class weapon, unlike the Real Plane of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder that Jack Clark had opened up within his body, was not a physical reality but an existence between the illusory and the real.
Or perhaps, it was a sort of Rule power with the world feature, born of the weapon’s innate attribute.
And that massive devilish face was surely in line with the traits of the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd and similar to the initial killing technique of the Eight Desolations Halberd method, the Ghost Wailing Divine Howl.
Watching the world projection that was growing clearer by the moment, on the Golden Battleship, a main god of the Heavenly Feather Clan took a deep breath, somewhat shocked, “The level of that weapon is now infinitely close to a complete world-class.”
Anstice also nodded slowly, “His talent for weapon forging is as unparalleled as his cultivation talent; throughout the ages, there’s no parallel. Provided he does not fall, he is guaranteed to achieve the status of an Ancient God (Civilization Emperor).”
“I also have this sense,” Bordea nodded with deep feeling.
The first time it met Jack Clark, he had just joined the Expeditionary Army and his cultivation was ‘merely’ at the Mythical Peak; his weapon was also just a legendary weapon used by Mythical-level Powerhouses.
Yet before a day had even passed, he not only broke through to the mid period of a Main God but also forged a world-class weapon fitting for a Main God’s realm, one that was his own.
With such terrifying talent, it was hard to imagine that he came from an ordinary civilization.
Behind them, a Heavenly Feather Divine King with ten golden light wings spoke slowly, “Although our clan’s homeland has been destroyed, the seedling of the Eternal Divine Tree has been planted, and there is hope.”
“And choosing to ally with the Human Race was an incredibly correct decision.”
“As long as the threat of the Purgatory Demon disaster can be overcome, with the fortune of the Human Race, our clan might even produce an Ancient God and have the hope of becoming the overlord of a civilization.”
At once, the surrounding Heavenly Feather Mythical Powerhouses and Main God Powerhouses were invigorated, their eyes filled with hopeful radiance.
Meanwhile, inside Number One, the last traces of grey crystal sand around Freya Louise vanished, indicating that she had completed the refining of those Chaos Crystal Cores, her aura more powerful than ever.
At this moment, apart from the spreading dark gold patterns on Freya Louise’s body, there were also some grey divine patterns exuding a mysterious and subtle aura.
Freya Louise quietly watched the outside, her gaze falling on that perfect and handsome face illuminated by the white flame and whispered softly, “After I return, I won’t be able to fight by your side anymore.”
By then, Freya Louise’s cultivation had reached the limit of the Ninth Heaven Peak, only one step away from breaking through to Mythical, and this step was very important to her and Number One.
This step would need to be taken in the Blue Star World, and she would not appear on the battlefield ever again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1474 - 1474 555 Return to the Federation from the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1474: Chapter 555: Return to the Federation from the Eight Desolations Blood Prison_3 Chapter 1474: Chapter 555: Return to the Federation from the Eight Desolations Blood Prison_3 Because her goal, her mission, was never about resisting the invasion of the Purgatory Demon Race, but rather the shock of the Secondary Mythical World.
Boom!
The blood light on the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd surged violently, and the white flame of strengthened energy burnt even more fiercely as the demon god’s ghastly face suddenly collapsed, transforming into a stream of blood light that merged into the halberd.
In an instant, the white flames vanished, and the halberd rapidly shrank, eventually becoming a ‘normal’ weapon four point six meters in length and gently landed in Jack Clark’s hands.
Even Jack Clark felt a weight in his hands in that moment, as if he was holding an entire world.
At the same time, a row of transparent text appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes.
Weapon: Eight Desolates Opening the Heavens Boundary Halberd[Level: Pseudo-World Level+2, a powerful weapon containing nearly complete rules, condensing the Eight Desolations Blood Prison World.
Top-tier features: Heavy, solid, sharp, Opening the Heavens.
Common function: Slayer Demon Blood Light, size at will.
Light of the Blood Prison: With the force of incomplete rules entwined, all attacks gain a significant enhancement on their original basis.
World Heavy Pressure: An extreme heavy density and weight compose a pressure field that crushes everything.
Hint: Reforge another pseudo-world-level weapon, and this weapon will reach world-class, containing a complete force of rules.]
This enhancement significantly strengthened the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd in all aspects, including the amplification of that incomplete rule force.
Furthermore, it only needed to be reforged, or rather devoured, another pseudo-world-level weapon for the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd to reach a world-class level.
Such a ‘weapon forging’ speed, if revealed, would certainly make countless Demon Gods and Divine Kings green with envy.
In the Purgatory Empire, only the lords of the Six Great Empires possess world-class weapons. Other demon god weapons are merely pseudo-world-level, roughly equal to the weapons of the Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings.
And not every Demon God possesses a pseudo-world-level weapon; forging one requires an immense quantity of resources.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
Figures flickered around Jack Clark, including two Heavenly Kings and five king-level members of the Human Race, as well as three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan and those Main Gods, Mythical Powerhouses.
At once, Law Radiance shone brilliantly around Jack Clark, nearly forming a multicolored ocean that made the cultivators aboard the Number One sky-based battleship struggle for breath.
And that was while these powerhouses were still restraining their auras.
The Golden Winged Divine King smiled and said, “Congratulations to the Divine Martial Emperor, your weapon has achieved grand accomplishment.”
Jack Clark returned the smile with an apologetic expression, “I’m sorry for the delay. My realm breakthrough and subsequent weapon refinement took some time, making all of you wait.”
“Ha ha ha ha… Such trivial matters are not worth mentioning. Of course, it is more important for the Divine Martial Emperor to improve your strength.”
“I had no idea that the Divine Martial Emperor’s talent in weapon refining was so formidable, actually capable of fusing the weapon of the Purgatory Great Demon King with your own.”
“Not at all, actually my weapon refining talent is average. The main reason I could reforge this pseudo-world-level weapon lies in a certain weapon refining talent of mine.”
“And this weapon forging ability also consumes a lot, depleting Origin, even I cannot use it lightly.” As he spoke, the aura around Jack Clark ‘diminished.’
“So that’s how it is!”
Yet even then, these powerhouses still marveled at the power of this ability as they gathered around Jack Clark, offering their congratulations.
Standing at the pinnacle, surrounded by powerful allies.
This scene was admired and envied by many cultivators aboard the fleet, including Damon Lopes, Gabriella, Joshua Welan, and other geniuses. This was the aspiration of a truly great man.
“All personnel be advised, the fleet is about to enter a space-time fault and jump.”
Wuuu! Accompanied by the prolonged and deep sound of a horn, the Human Race’s sky-based battleship took the lead as the kilometer-long fleet began to orderly enter the space-time fault.
Under the powerful influence of time distortion, Jack Clark and the others on the battleship felt a strong sense of weightlessness. In a blink, they appeared on the opposite side of the forbidden area.
On this side, the golden sunlight was radiant, and below was an endless prairie, breezes blowing gently, filled with the fresh scent of grass and wood.
But after waiting for a while, all of the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Golden Battleships also completed the jump, and a dense array of warships hovered in the air, casting vast shadows.
Looking at this scene, Jack Clark couldn’t help but show a touch of emotion in his eyes, finally about to ‘arrive home.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1475 - 1475 556 All the Buddies are Here Before the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1475: Chapter 556: All the Buddies are Here, Before the Decisive Battle Chapter 1475: Chapter 556: All the Buddies are Here, Before the Decisive Battle Human Federation Outer Development Department, thirty-one miles outside the corps base.
On the edge of a forbidden area filled with white lightning, a red battleship nearly fifteen kilometers long, far larger than the average sky-based battleship, hovered in high altitude.
At this moment, on the deck of the battleship, which was akin to an island, many human cultivators curiously looked ahead.
Among these human cultivators, many were acquaintances of Jack Clark.
Eddy Keller, who had already made a breakthrough into the mid-term of Ninth Heaven, Beast King Baldro of the early term of the Ninth Heaven from Berlin, the former third-grade senior sister who had graduated, Betty Leinster.
Aside from them, there were also Denny Rhodes, Jasper Forbes, and other Southern Battlefield geniuses who had entered the Ruins Continent and gained a little something.
Half a year had passed, and these people had basically all made breakthroughs to the Seventh Heaven, with a few even reaching the late stage of Seventh Heaven, becoming the Human Race’s rising stars.
This included many other geniuses from various empires who had entered the Ruins Continent.
Apart from these graduated geniuses, the group also included Justin Welan and sisters Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis.
More than two months had passed, and the three of them, who had already been advancing quickly in their cultivation due to obtaining the Heritage of Ruins, had also broken through to the early Seventh Heaven with the additional resources provided by Jack Clark.
This rate of cultivation was among the top hundred of the new generation of the Human Federation, including Innate Awakened Ones.
Of course, this didn’t count special personnel like Jack Clark, Freya Louise, and Jane Aiken.
Justin Welan squatted down on the deck, bored: “Class Leader, why hasn’t that alien envoy team arrived yet, weren’t they supposed to come today?”
“If I’d known it would be this boring, I wouldn’t have come.”
Dressed in Red Battle Armor, with red hair tied behind her head, Crystal Lewis leaned against the ship’s railing and said indifferently, “Stop complaining. You got to come up here because I asked someone for help.”
“This time, welcoming the alien team is led by the True Martial Heavenly King and the Primordial True King. Just think about how grand the scene is, it’s possibly a once-in-a-lifetime event.”
“Later, when you go back and boast to Zac Maben and the others, you can say that as a member of the human young generation’s talent group, you’ve had contact with the alien delegation.”
“Plus, the mythical world is riddled with dangers, so a delay of a day or two is normal.”
This time, facing the remnants of the Heavenly Feather Clan, the Human Federation took it very seriously since that included three Divine Kings, over a dozen Main Gods, and more than forty Mythical-level powers.
Just the high-end strength alone was on par with the current Human Race.
Not to mention nearly five million elites above the Fifth Layer Heaven, which was even more than the current number of advanced cultivators of the Human Race, and it would require technological advantages to match them.
Therefore, the reception was led by the Primordial True King and the True King Heavenly King. As for Adam Garcetti, the First Councilor, and the Sky-based God King, they had to suppress the Sky Curtain Battlefield and couldn’t be moved lightly.
To show importance and bulk up the numbers, the Primordial True King summoned some of the elite and young talents from around the Outer Development Department, including the now-grown Baldro and others.
As for Justin Welan, he nearly missed the excitement because he arrived a little later.
As Justin Welan and others were waiting boredly on the battleship, the Primordial True King, who looked like a small old man, and True Martial stood in another space interlayer above the ship.
With a heavy tone, the Primordial True King said, “The Divine Gods Alliance has replied that it will take a few more days for their personnel to mobilize.”
“To prevent the news of the Heavenly Feather Clan’s arrival from leaking, we might need to have them stay here for a few days, but I’m not sure if that will cause discontent on their side.”
“After all, they’ve come from far away, bringing all their remaining strength to form an alliance with us, but we’ve temporarily shut them out upon their arrival…”
The True Martial Heavenly King, holding the black stele, shook his head: “It shouldn’t be a problem, I’ve met with the Divine Kings and Main Gods from the Heavenly Feather Clan, none of them are narrow-minded.”
“For them at this point, if there’s a chance to wipe out two Purgatory Empires in one battle, let alone waiting here for a few days, waiting for a few years wouldn’t be an issue.”
The Primordial True Martial nodded slowly: “That would be for the best.”
Then, after a brief silence between them, the eyes of the Primordial True King suddenly brightened, the world around them vibrating slightly.
With a smile appearing on his aged face, the Primordial True King said, “I have completed the control over the law of this world. From now on, if a ‘Person’ sets foot within range, he will be detected by me.”
“It’s a relief,” said the True Martial Heavenly King with a smile on his face.
There have always been traitors within the human inner circle. Thus, before launching a war of extermination, the news of the Heavenly Feather Clan’s arrival must be sealed off to prevent leaks.
As a result, for thousands of kilometers around this center, the Rule of the Primordial True Martial has isolated and sealed the area.
Even those with Predictive Ability, Reflecting the Other World, and special predictive divine powers can’t sense the situation here, including the hidden traitors.
Moreover, the people who have come along on the battleship for the reception had all been checked by both the Primordial True King and the True Martial Heavenly King, including background checks, analysis of recent traces of movement, and so on.
Essentially, these individuals are of upstanding generations for three generations back and are unlikely to be traitors.
And even so, in the next few days, the members aboard this battleship won’t be able to leave until the great war begins.
At the top level of the central bridge, the tall figure of Eddy Keller, still dressed in white, stood with his hands behind his back, looking down from above. His long, deliberately uncut black hair danced in the wind, giving him a dashing appearance.
As Justin Welan came over out of boredom, he looked up and shouted, “Hey, old Eddy, stop showing off. Come down and shoot the breeze, will you?”
Even though he was two realms behind in strength, Welan had become familiar with Eddy Keller, who liked to act tough, because they had spent time together at the base in the pathway.

chapters.title: Chapter 1476 - 1476 556 All the Little Friends are Here
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1476: Chapter 556: All the Little Friends are Here, Before the Final Battle_2 Chapter 1476: Chapter 556: All the Little Friends are Here, Before the Final Battle_2 On the bridge of the battleship, Eddy Keller’s mouth twitched, “What showoff, I’m clearly overlooking the forbidden area, constantly observing the situation of the delegation.”
Roar!
The white light on Eddy Keller’s body sparkled as he transformed into a white Divine Dragon more than two hundred meters in length and flew down from the top of the thousand-meter-high bridge.
Many who recognized him couldn’t help but shake their heads.
This guy, even descending a floor, still has to show off.
However, just as Eddy Keller landed, without waiting for him to speak, the forbidden area suddenly trembled, and countless white lightnings furiously struck in one direction.
Boom! In the midst of the dazzling explosion of white lightning, a Mysterious Martial Phantom that blocked out the sun and sky descended, suppressing heaven and earth.
Beneath the robust aura of the Yellow Earth, countless lightnings dissipated, creating a stable area spanning hundreds of kilometers, while a black crack hundreds of thousands of meters long emerged behind it.
From within the pitch-black crack, a colossal sky-based battleship appeared, followed by a second and third one…
“They’re back.”
“The Expeditionary Army has returned.”
“Look, that’s the main force of the Heavenly Feather Clan, so many of them.”
Amidst the excited and eager gazes of many, thirteen sky-based battleships flew out of the forbidden area, followed by a dense array of Golden Battleships and millions of Heavenly Feather tribespeople.
Whir!
The human’s red battleships moved suddenly, and a melodious and profound horn sound rose slowly, welcoming them.
At the same time, strong auras emerged high above, as the Primordial True King and the True Martial Heavenly King appeared, followed by the Shepherd Army and several Mythical Kings.
These powerhouses were draped in Law Radiance, their figures majestic, and their powerful auras filled heaven and earth, treading the Void as they moved forward.
Wherever they passed, a multicolored path formed under their feet, and golden petals floated down from the sky, creating a grand scene.
This solemn imagery made Jack Clark, who was standing with his hands behind his back at the forefront of the fleet, pause; by now, the multicolored path had extended to the front of the first sky-based battleship.
The Primordial True King revealed a smile on his face, his gaze tenderly sweeping over Jack Clark and the others, then over all the cultivators on the battleships, his voice resonant and powerful enveloping the entire Sky Base Fleet.
“Ladies and gentlemen, welcome home. You’ve all worked hard.”
Immediately, the cultivators were all emotionally stirred, their gazes resolute as they shouted, “It’s not hard; this is our duty. Everything is for the rise of the Human Race.”
Their resolute voices and fervent will infected those on the approaching red battleships like Justin Welan and others, making their blood boil.
They couldn’t wait to rush to the Frontline Battlefield and fight the vicious Purgatory True Demons for three hundred rounds.
Crystal Lewis and the others felt the same way.
Just as the red battleships approached the fleet and Justin Welan and other high-level cultivators could clearly see the scene on the opposite fleet, they all paused.
Because they saw the Third Councilor, the Primordial True King, patting Jack Clark’s shoulder affectionately, smiling and speaking to him.
“Damn, that’s Jack, my brother Jack is actually over there!”
Jack Clark had disappeared under the encirclement of the Purgatory Demon Gods and had now returned unexpectedly, then joined the Expeditionary Army; aside from a few at the Federal Top Level, not many knew about it.
And much less would ‘ordinary people’ like Justin Welan.
Eddy Keller also came back to his senses, slapping Justin Welan’s shoulder hard, “I should have thought of it earlier, with Jack Clark’s strength, his disappearance for so long surely meant he went out.”
Hiss! “Damn, Eddy, go easy,” Justin Welan gasped, clutching his half-shoulder that had been numbed from the slap.
This guy must be taking revenge for the times he told him not to show off. But today, with my brother returning safely, I’m not going to fuss with you about it.
With that thought, Justin Welan grew excited, “Haha… Jack, I’m here!” He said, his face full of excitement as he prepared to run over.
Bang!
Eddy Keller grabbed Justin Welan’s shoulder in one hand, reminding him, “Justin Welan, I advise you it’s best not to publicly display a very close relationship with Jack Clark.”
“…I almost forgot about that.” Justin Welan stopped in his tracks.
Jack Clark’s fame was soaring, not just within the Human Federation, but the Purgatory Demon Race hated him to the degree that they would be thrilled to see him dead.
But Jack Clark was too strong, and the Demon Gods could do nothing against him, leading the Assassination Department of the Purgatory Empire to target those around him instead.
If they couldn’t kill him, slaying some of his relatives and friends could still give them satisfaction.
And if that enraged Jack Clark and caused him to lose his cool and venture deep into the Purgatory Empire again, the next time he wouldn’t get away so easily.
However, at the moment, the Evil God Sect Cultists on Blue Star were almost wiped out, those remaining hid deep and dared not show their faces, let alone access any information about Jack Clark.
As such, Diorus and other Demon Gods still lacked clear information about Jack Clark’s close relations and friends.
No targeted assassinations had yet been carried out.
Thus, if Justin Welan were to boldly declare his close relationship as good brothers with Jack Clark, once this news reached the Purgatory Empire, he would be met with frenzied assassination attempts.
“What a pity, such a good opportunity to show off,” said Justin Welan, looking regretfully at the black-haired young man who was now the center of attention.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Powerful auras burst forth from the distant Golden Battlefield Fleet where golden, white, and silvery Divine Lights soared into the sky, forming sacred columns of light piercing through the clouds.
In an instant, over forty Mythical Auras, more than a dozen Main Gods, and three Divine Kings exerted their overwhelming presence, making everyone’s legs go weak and their faces filled with shock.
“So many Mythical Powerhouses.”
“Those figures with three pairs of light wings behind them, enveloped by Laws Worlds, are all Heavenly King Level powerhouses!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1477 - 1477 556 All the Buddies Are Here Before the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1477: Chapter 556: All the Buddies Are Here, Before the Final Battle_3 Chapter 1477: Chapter 556: All the Buddies Are Here, Before the Final Battle_3 “My Clear Spirit True Eye hurts, don’t look at those three figures that resemble the sun; they are Supreme beings and will be harmed by the light of the Rule!”
“Three Supremes, the Heavenly Feather Clan is so powerful…”
Aboard the red battleship, all the cultivators were looking at the dazzling figures in shock, never having imagined that the Heavenly Feather Clan would dispatch so many strongmen.
Have they emptied their nest!?
While many squinted at the sky, those Heavenly Feather strongmen one by one landed on the number one sky-based battleship.
The Primordial True King showed a smile, “My friends, it has been a hard journey; welcome to your new home.”
“Normally today, all the Supremes of our Human Race should have come to welcome our allies, but due to the urgent needs at the frontline, where there is a need for people to stand guard, I am the only one who has come.”
The Golden Winged Divine King solemnly said, “Your Excellency Primordial, you are too polite, a fallen clan is not worth such grand ceremony, in the future our clan will need more support from the nobles.”
“Hahaha… Divine King, you speak too seriously, you have not failed but merely strategically relocated to a new stronghold under the threat of the Purgatory Empire.”
“Moving forward, I am confident and believe that together, our two clans can create an even more glorious civilization alliance.”
“We, of course, also have great faith in the strength of your noble clan.”
With a smile on his face, the Golden Winged Divine King said, “Your noble Divine Martial Emperor’s talent covers the world, presumably the other outstanding talents are also numerous.”
Laughing heartily, the Primordial True King said, “That is indeed the case, our clan’s young generation has seen a great surge of geniuses in recent years.” He continued humbly.
“But Jack Clark is different; he is the exception. In our Human Race, we have only one such unparalleled genius.”
Being praised so frankly to his face, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but shake his head modestly, “You both flatter me, in truth, I’m just a bit quicker at cultivation than others.”
However, Jack Clark’s modesty was too much for the Mysterious Martial Sky King to bear as he looked on, “Jack, there’s no need to be humble, we all know how great your talent is.”
Watching those towering figures in the sky, radiating dazzling halos, even in the presence of Supreme Experts and Alien Divine Kings, Crystal Lewis found herself somewhat in a trance.
Crystal Lewis suddenly sighed, “Miss Karen, the gap between him and us is getting larger.”
Gazing at the figure surrounded by halos of light, Mandy Lewis wore a gentle smile and said softly, “Sister, haven’t you realized this long ago?”
With a complex look in her eyes, Crystal Lewis said, “I did realize it, but it still feels a bit hard to accept.”
In a gentle voice, Mandy Lewis replied, “Sister, everyone’s physique is different, there’s no need to compare ourselves to him; in fact, our cultivation realm has already been advancing quite rapidly.”
“Father once said, cultivation is not a matter of overnight success but a long marathon. As long as we keep improving, we have hope to reach the pinnacle.”
“One day, we’ll catch up with them.”
“Miss Karen, do you actually believe the pep talk Dad gave us?” Crystal Lewis looked at Mandy Lewis in surprise.
Under normal conditions, this would actually make a lot of sense. Life is not a sprint but a long marathon. The starting line is important, but as long as we persist, we will eventually reach the finish line.
Because everyone dies.
But the problem is this is the Transcendent Era, where everyone’s running speed and distance to the finish line are completely different.
Mandy Lewis sighed, “Sister, can’t you just enjoy chatting anymore? What can we do if we don’t believe? Do we just sit in despair and watch?”
“That’s true.”
Crystal Lewis nodded, “Let’s keep trying. Even if we can’t catch up to that guy, we can’t let Freya Louise get too far ahead. I heard she already made a breakthrough to Eight Layer Heaven.”
At this moment, it wasn’t only the Lewis sisters who felt the gap; Betty Leinster, Jasper Forbes, and other seniors who had once been in contact with Jack Clark also felt a sense of poignancy.
As for shock, they no longer felt it.
After all, Jack Clark had previously shaken the entire Human Race by facing the Demon God and emerging unscathed.
At this time, the pleasantries in the sky had ended, and suddenly the space fractured, and all the king-level strong men from both tribes, including Jack Clark, disappeared from view.
At the same time, everyone below received a notification.
The strong men of the two tribes were to hold a high-level meeting, and the task of the others was to act as hosts, receiving the distant allies from the Heavenly Feather Clan.
In a dark void space, a number of strong men sat high upon massive thrones, arranged into three tiers based on their strength.
On towering stone thrones that reached ten thousand meters, Jack Clark manifested a three-faced, eight-armed, three-thousand-meter-high True Demon God Body, seated in line with the True Martial Heavenly King and the Primordial Heavenly King, who manifested ten-thousand-meter True Bodies.
Opposite them were three Divine Kings from the Heavenly Feather Clan, also manifesting their Divine King True Bodies, surrounded by dazzling Divine Light, which made them appear sacred and magnificent.
Behind each side stood rows of thrones, three thousand and one thousand meters tall, with powerful Law Radiance swirling around, shaking the entire space continuously.
In the solemn atmosphere, the Primordial True King spoke gravely, “You are all aware of the situation of our clan facing the two Purgatory Empires, I trust.”
The Golden Winged Divine King opposite him nodded slightly, “Indeed, Divine Martial Emperor has already fully detailed it with us.”
“Our clan is up against the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire and the Grita War Demon Empire, each with two Demon Gods presiding over them. The Lords of the Empires have realms around the mid-period of Demon Gods.”
“Among them, Diorus, the Lord of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, controls two Rules, one of which involves time and allows him to summon a True Body from the past or future, regardless of the expenses.”
“Together with his higher-end Pseudo-World Level Weapon, his strength is formidable.”
“The other empire’s Lord, Belidier, is stronger than the average Demon God of the same realm, with a combat power roughly around the late period of Demon Gods.”
“In addition, the Grita War Demon Empire also has an Extreme Realm Great Demon King, whose combat power is comparable to an early-stage Demon God—his strength is not to be underestimated.”
“In the past, due to a lack of high-end combat power, including a lack of Heavenly King Level and King Level numbers, our Human Federation has always been suppressed by the two empires.”
“But now that you have arrived, along with Jack Clark’s growth to a level comparable to the Supreme, our clan sees the opportunity to crush the two empires head-on.”
“Even before your arrival, our clan had already begun full mobilization, with all intrinsic qualities activated, aiming for a battle that could severely damage or even obliterate the two empires.”
“And for added security, we have communicated with another ally, the Divine Gods Alliance, and they will also send a portion of their forces.”
“However, their preparations require more time; they estimate another five days, which is about five star hours.”
“To prevent the messengers of the Purgatory Empire who are implanted within our clan from discovering your arrival, we would need to trouble everyone to stay here for five days.”
“Moreover, the welcome ceremony planned for the nobles will also have to wait until after this battle is over. We hope for your understanding.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1478 - 1478 557 The Fifth Pillar of the Human Race
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1478: Chapter 557: The Fifth Pillar of the Human Race, Ancient Secrets Chapter 1478: Chapter 557: The Fifth Pillar of the Human Race, Ancient Secrets The overall direction of the Civilization War was set.
The Primordial True King, Jack Clark, True Martial Heavenly King, and the top strong men of the Heavenly Feather Clan began to discuss the details, making adjustments according to the current layout of the Human Race.
In fact, the Human Race think tank already had a detailed layout, including the activation of intrinsic weapons like the sky-based doomsday satellite.
However, some of this information would definitely need to be shared with allies and their opinions sought. Both sides needed to consult again to show respect for the alliance.
After all, this was a war that gambled the fate and luck of the entire race, not child’s play.
In the negotiations and adjustments, specific targets were clarified, such as the two Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan joining forces to contain Diorus and the Two Demon Gods.
The remaining Human Race’s three Supreme Experts, Jack Clark, and the True King Heavenly King, along with a Divine King from the Divine Gods Alliance and a Heavenly Feather Divine King, represented seven Supreme Level powers set to confront the two Demon Gods from the Grita War Demon Empire.
Plus, the three unknown Demon Gods mentioned in the intelligence reports.
Four against four, three against one, assassinate one of them.
As for the Extreme Realm Great Demon King, he was to be cornered by the Lord of Holy Light from the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Human Race’s Mad Wheeler who had returned with the mastery of the Supreme Law.
Besides these, out of the seventeen known Demon Kings from the two Purgatory Empires, excluding the one Jack had slain, there were still sixteen.
Originally, there were almost eighty Demon King Level Strong men, but in the battles Jack was indirectly and directly involved in, more than a dozen had fallen from the two empires.
In the battle against the Evil God Clone, due to Jack’s “outstanding” performance, three Demon Kings had fallen from the Purgatory Empire. In the subsequent battle when Jack entered the mythical world, another two were killed.
Combined with the Demon Kings Jack directly suppressed on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield and indirectly helped Number One to devour, there were four or five. Additionally, there were seven more that Jack had slain deep within the Purgatory Empire.
All things considered, because of Jack, the two empires had lost over a dozen Demon Kings, which fueled their hatred.
This attrition also meant that in the first wave of the extinction war launched by the two empires, the casualties among the Human King Level strong men were not as severe.
Add to that previous casualties, and it is estimated that the two empires could muster upwards of sixty Demon Kings when fully mobilized.
The Human Race currently had forty-one it could mobilize, the Heavenly Feather Clan brought thirty-nine from their retreat, and the Divine Gods Alliance indicated that they could gather twenty.
In total, the number of King Level strong men has reached one hundred and one.
As for the Heavenly King Level strong men, there were nine stationed within the human inner circle, ten from the Heavenly Feather Clan, one whose Origin was heavily damaged requiring recovery, and two Main Gods from the Divine Gods Alliance.
With the advantage in numbers for both Mythical-level and Heavenly King Level strong men, where some could engage in one-on-one containment, the other strong men teamed up in groups of three to assassinate the specifically targeted Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings.
After all, harming his ten fingers is not as effective as cutting off one.
Such tactics of outnumbering and continuously bleeding and assassinating the enemy are what the Purgatory Empire excels at.
Previously, they relied on these tactics to assassinate over a dozen Human kings over twenty years while only losing a few Demon Kings.
And this was the case even under the watch of the three Supreme Experts and within the confined battlefield.
However, warfare is more than just a comparison of numbers; victory depends on individual and environmental factors as well as external ones. Furthermore, the Human Race was not aware of how many trump cards the two empires held.
So even now, with an apparent overwhelming advantage, they remained extremely cautious.
Several hours later, the holographic projection of the battlefield model slowly vanished. The Primordial True King looked towards the strong men of the Heavenly Feather Clan, “Gentlemen, are there any objections?”
The Golden Winged Divine King shook his head slowly, “The nobles’ plan is very thorough; we currently have no additions.”
“The only objection is that we believe the task of containing the Demon Gods named Diorus and Carthius should be the responsibility of one of the nobles’ Supreme Experts and the Divine King from the Divine Gods Alliance,” he said.
“Leave the task of assassinating the Demon Gods to us.”
Another Divine King of the Light Wing nodded slowly, his eyes revealing a terrifying murderous intent, “Yes, the dangerous task of assassinating Demon Gods is more suited for the three of us.”
Centuries of slaughter and bloodshed had filled the strong men of the Heavenly Feather Clan with hatred towards the Purgatory Demon Race.
They wouldn’t miss any opportunity to kill all Purgatory True Demons; even if it meant heavy injury, they would not pass up the chance to slay a Purgatory Demon God.
On the other hand, knowing that the Divine Gods Alliance had not directly waged war with the Purgatory Empire, and that some Demon Kings had even joined them internally, there was a certain reservation regarding that Divine King’s willingness to fight.
This doubt wasn’t about their stance, but rather whether they possessed the determination to kill the enemy Demon Gods regardless of the threat they might face to themselves.
With the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Divine Kings eager to join the most dangerous assassination missions against the Demon Gods, the Primordial True King would naturally not object.
“Agreed.”
The resolution of the final issue also marked the end of the meeting.
Law Radiance scattered in all directions, followed by hundreds of Golden Battleships gently shaking and then dispersing across thousands of kilometers, some hovering at a low altitude to establish temporary bases.
The thirteen sky-based battleships of the Expeditionary Army also received the command to station in place.
After leaving the meeting space, the Primordial True King summoned Jack Clark to the command center of the red sky-based battleship, with the True Martial Heavenly King joining them as well.
In the spacious and simple meeting room, the three of them sat at separate corners of a circular desk.
Regarding the youthful face across from him, the Primordial True King revealed a gentle smile, “Your performance on the Expedition Battlefield this time, has taken us all by surprise.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1479 - 1479 557 The Fifth Pillar of the Human Race
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1479: Chapter 557 The Fifth Pillar of the Human Race, Ancient Secrets_2 Chapter 1479: Chapter 557 The Fifth Pillar of the Human Race, Ancient Secrets_2 Jack Clark knew he was referring to the matter of slaying the Demon God, and he shook his head slightly, “Actually, luck played a part in that encounter. If the Demon God I had faced had been from the Ancient Middle Stage, I definitely wouldn’t have been able to slay it.”
Among only the Primordial True King and the True King Heavenly King, who were his own people, Jack Clark did not display modesty.
The reason he could slay that Demon God indeed had a great deal to do with luck, as he had the advantages of the right time, place, and harmony with people.
“Harmony with people” naturally meant that his opponent was just in the ancient early stage realm, and Jack Clark overwhelmingly outmatched him in overall strength, while “advantage of place” was the shielding provided by the tens of kilometers deep Earth below.
As for the “right time,” there was no need to mention it, as the six Ancient Middle, late period, and even peak-stage Demon Gods were restrained by the Divine King of Light.
Otherwise, even if one of the Demon Gods had intervened to support, creating a slight opportunity for that Demon God, Jack Clark would have been unable to slay it, and at best could have inflicted a heavy injury.
The Primordial True King smiled faintly, “Many times, luck is also a part of strength. The fact that you could slay that Demon God shows that your strength is already not inferior to this old man’s.”
“Now your true strength has securely entered the Supreme Level, signifying that our Human Race has gained another pillar of support,” said the Primordial True King his expression turning solemn.
“Next, I will open the Civilization Inheritance access for you, and connect you to the core of the Human Race’s Void Secret Sea.”
“Civilization Inheritance access?” Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a questioning look.
The True Martial Heavenly King beside him smiled faintly, “Don’t be anxious, you’ll find out soon enough.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly.
The Primordial True King across from him had his hands flickering with black radiance, which converged between his hands, forming a black rune resembling an ouroboros.
And as that rune surfaced, Jack Clark felt a powerful force of the Void emanating from it.
Bang!
The ouroboros rune collapsed, turning into streams of Rune Sequence Chains that revolved and orbited in the air above the circular table, slowly forming a pitch-black interface.
Opposite the interface was a connection to a world of pitch-black nothingness where a towering white jade palace floated, encircled by an enormous black ouroboros serpent tens of kilometers long.
On the main door of the Great Hall of the palace, the words ‘Void Sea Divine Palace’ hung, inscribed in the large characters of an Ancient Civilization.
At that moment, the aged voice of the Primordial True King rose again, chanting slowly in the language of the Ancient Civilization.
“I, as a Civilization Guardian, holding the rank of the Third Guardian, with the witness of the Fourth Guardian present, hereby grant the current Human Expert the access to inheritance.”
The voice of the Primordial True King pierced through the pitch-black interface, echoing in that world of nothingness.
At the same time, a black rune also emerged in the hands of the True King Heavenly King, but unlike the ouroboros, it bore some resemblance to the wolf dragon from Mythical Legends.
Roar! Just as that black rune solidified, a majestic and tyrannical roar thundered through the world of nothingness.
In that instant, the Void Sea Divine Palace trembled slightly, and the surrounding ouroboros serpent raised its head abruptly, letting out a roar as its immense crimson eyes turned to look at Jack Clark.
As the terrifying Giant Beast’s gaze landed on Jack Clark, the force of a Distortion in Space-Time descended, attempting to pull him in.
Just as Jack Clark subconsciously thought of bursting forth with his strength, the True Martial Heavenly King reminded him, “Jack, don’t resist.”
Alright then.
Jack, whose Eye of the Soul did not sense danger deep within, nodded and vanished under that force, reappearing within the towering Divine Palace.
Unlike the exterior, which appeared to be ten kilometers high and spanning tens of kilometers, the interior of the temple was boundless and vast, with jade pillars like mountains soaring into the clouds, disappearing into the depths of the Void.
More than a hundred jade thrones floated on either side of the temple, corresponding to the numbers one hundred and eight, thirty-six, and above the main seats, there were seven imperial thrones shrouded in darkness, appearing ethereal.
Crack! Before Jack Clark could take a closer look at his surroundings, a gigantic black Eye of Void slowly emerged in the Void, its gaze revealing the illusion of rotating gears.
Looking down at Jack Clark’s tiny figure below, a voice as cold as machinery sounded from the gigantic eye.
“The Civilization power verification will now begin; please do not resist.”
Hum! From within that eye, a trace of dim black light shot out, encircling Jack Clark like a phantom gear, an invisible wave sweeping across his entire body.
“Verifier’s current cultivation level, the eleventh tier mid period, body has begun forming rudimentary rules, rule strength… Supreme Level!”
“Beep beep! Verifier’s body shows fluctuations of Top-tier Divine Power, with his True Body harboring Qi Blood of a twelfth-tier life form, and fluctuations of a Monarch weapon detected.”
“Comprehensive strength, twelfth tier; strength meets the foundational requirements. Next, we will begin soul verification!”
Hum!
The color of the gears orbiting around Jack changed from black to gold, emitting a faint glow as they swept over his entire body once more, penetrating deep within him.
However, when that force touched Jack Clark’s soul, intending to delve deeper, a powerful rebound shattered the golden wave.
In an instant, the Eye of Void trembled, emitting an urgent voice: “The verifier’s Soul Strength is extremely high, unable to precisely detect.”
“Soul Strength exceeds standard requirements, unable to precisely detect…”
It seemed Jack’s soul was too powerful, exceeding the detection limit of the Eye of Void. After almost several minutes of chaos, the Eye of Void calmed down again.
But when that Eye of Void looked at Jack again, there was a subtle change in its gaze, still emitting a mechanical, cold voice.
“Next, we will verify the verifier’s age. Please do not resist; I am simply a rule operating according to a predetermined procedure, without malice or self-aware thought.”
As it spoke, the gears in the Eye of Void became white, and a white gear phantom enveloped Jack Clark, spinning and emitting waves of Mysterious energy.

“Verification passed, verifier’s Life Wheel scale seventeen, age seventeen years old… seventeen years old!” In an instant, the Eye of Void’s Radiance flared up, flashing a trace of shock and disbelief.
Boom!
The Eye of Void burst open, transforming into strands of Black Power twisting in the air, converging and gradually forming a black rune infused with the strength of rules.
At the same time, a majestic voice rose in the Void.
“The inheritor meets the requirements. You are now granted the privilege to enter and exit the Secret Sea, and to unlock the Void, to light a beacon for the Human Race, so that civilization may endure for eternity.”
As that majestic voice sounded, the black rune finished condensing, resembling a Responsive dragon with double wings emerging from its back, as if from a Mythical Legend.
Jack Clark looked calmly at the black rune slowly falling into his hand.
There was no sudden increase in cultivation level, nor any enhancement by rules. Silently, the rune merged into his hand, and instantly Jack Clark felt a connection with a certain part of the Void.
At the same time, a surge of information about the inheritor flooded into his mind.
The Void Secret Sea belonged to a Monarch called “Void” among the Seven Great Emperors of the Ancient Civilization.
This Monarch had mastered the Void Rules and was so powerful that he could freely travel between the Void and the Material World, essentially becoming a different kind of Void Creature.
Feeling the ubiquitous nature of the Void, and facing the critical crisis of spiritual energy depletion on Blue Star, the Monarch had the idea of opening a new Boundary, of “Ascend as a Clan.”
Only this Ascension was not about becoming immortals, but about transforming all humans into Void Creatures.
Becoming powerful beings capable of walking between reality and the Void.
This idea was opposed by some monarchs and kings of the time, but it was also supported by others as one of the salvation plans of the time.
However, soon after Monarch “Void” had just opened an initial Chaotic Domain, another Monarch wandering through Space-Time accidentally connected to a chaotic domain.
That domain was a time-space Distortion, linked to many worlds around a powerful and mysterious corner of the world.
Not long after the Monarch began his exploration, the Human Race decided on an expedition plan to plunder the World Origin of other worlds to rejuvenate Blue Star, but they also prepared for failure.
Therefore, when gathering all high-end forces and armies, they also left a backup plan, the Void Relic Continent and the Inheritance path above it.
The Void Continent was scattered with legacies of King-level War Generals, while the Inheritance path was distributed with a portion of powerful War Generals, Monarchs, and one Emperor Inheritance.
This included the Void Secret Sea.
The Void Secret Sea was the ‘Inheritance’ second to the Emperor Inheritance on the Inheritance path, containing weapons once used by War Generals and Monarchs under Monarch “Void”.
The person who inherited the Void Secret Sea in those days was the First Councilor, Adam Garcetti.
And then, it was no more…
The actual treasure of the Void Secret Sea was the weapons left by some Monarch Experts and War General Experts, all of them had long been divided up by the Human Experts.
Among them, Adam Garcetti, Henry Garcetti, and Primordial True King each took a weapon left by a Monarch, which was one of the reasons they suppressed the Dark Age in a short time after emerging from the Ruins Continent.
It was also the confidence they had to later confront Demon Gods head-on.
Otherwise, how could the Human Race have possibly withstood the two great Purgatory Empires for so long with just decades of accumulation?
