chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1481: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The Arrival of the Emperor Dragon’s True Body Chapter 1481: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The Arrival of the Emperor Dragon’s True Body “A damaged ancient divine weapon, containing incomplete Rule War Patterns, can consume 500,000 Attribute points to melt Rule Level materials that fit and refurbish the war patterns, enhancing its level.”
“If appropriate materials are not available, it can be enhanced by consuming two million Attribute points.”
Staring at the transparent text that appeared before him, even Jack Clark was somewhat taken aback—two million Attribute points.
Is this a robbery?
Judging by the oppressive force emanating from this damaged ancient divine weapon, Jack sensed that it was of a similar level to his Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd; both were just one step away from reaching the world level.
Of course, their refinement routes were different, and once upgraded, it should be called a complete ancient divine weapon.
Yet to enhance this damaged divine weapon when adequate refining materials were available would require 500,000 Attribute points, and without materials, it would need two million.
In fact, judging purely on the value of Attribute points, two million equates to about 2.3 million Contribution Points, which, when converted to merit, is not yet eighty thousand.
That amount of merit wasn’t even as high as the value Jack had reaped when he first swept through the Evil God Alliance.
But the problem is Life Crystals are priceless in the Federation; even the Life Crystals Jack had accumulated over such a long time didn’t seem to add up to three million Attribute points.
Besides, the Federation’s yearly production of Life Crystals isn’t much, of which those low-level Life Crystals bred within Blue Star are all allocated to nurture the freshmen of Martial Arts High Schools.
But now, it seemed the freshmen would have to endure some hardship.
Gripping the weighty ancient divine weapon, Jack slowly spoke, “Primordial Senior, your weapon is powerful, but it appears that its Rule War Patterns are incomplete.”
The Primordial True King nodded, “Indeed, this ancient divine weapon had already dimmed and become damaged due to the passage of time when I came into possession of it.”
“Aside from my Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth, the Sky-reaching War Soldiers of the Heavenly Base also fall short by one step, while only Adam Garcetti’s Yin-Yang Divine Wheel qualifies as a complete ancient weapon.”
“However, the consumption of using Adam Garcetti’s Yin-Yang Divine Wheel is too great, so it cannot be used lightly.”
At this point, the Primordial True Martial expressed some regret, “Regrettably, Rule Level materials are rare, not to mention suitable for an already forged ancient divine weapon.”
“Over all these years, I’ve only collected one piece of Rule Level Dark Realm Cloud Mine, but I’m still missing one Sky-reaching Tree Heart.”
Saying that, the Primordial True King brought out a black crystal stone, more than 2 meters in diameter, heavy and dark. As soon as this stone appeared, it distorted everything around it like a black hole.
Even light was devoured, forming around it a complete, slowly rotating chain of twisted black Rune Sequence Chains.
“Detected a material compatible for melting the weapon, can consume 800,000 Attribute points to enhance this ancient divine weapon.”
800,000 Attribute points.
Seeing the transparent text in front of him, Jack showed a hint of a smile on his face, “With this piece of Dark Realm Cloud Mine, I am confident I can help you reforge this weapon, Senior.”
“It’s possible even with insufficient materials!?” The Primordial True King paused.
Jack nodded, “Under normal conditions, it definitely wouldn’t be possible, but haven’t I said? My weapon refining talent can, to a certain extent, defy fundamental rules.”
True Martial Heavenly King spoke gravely, “Jack Clark, I entrust this matter to you.”
If the Primordial True King’s divine weapon is repaired, his strength could at least increase by a minor realm, reaching from the Ancient Middle Stage to the Ancient Late Stage, adding another advantage for the upcoming great battle.
“Rest assured, both of you, Seniors,” Jack replied solemnly with a nod.
Whether it was to repay the Primordial True King for the weapon he had previously refined for him, or for blocking the Purgatory Demon God’s Curse’s forbidden weapon for him later, or for the greater good, he would lend a hand.
Holding the Black Wolf Tooth Stick in his hands, Jack saw the space around him twist, and in the blink of an eye, he appeared on a mountain peak a thousand kilometers away from the temporary base.
And the moment Jack appeared, the Wolf Tooth Staff, now unrestrained by the will of the Primordial True King, burst forth with a series of sharp blackthorn radiance.
The blackthorn light, as sharp as wolf teeth, pierced through the space, creating huge Hollows everywhere, and the mountain peak, over 7,000 meters tall, collapsed with a thunderous rumble.
This was the might of an ancient divine weapon, even though it was impaired.
When a few strands of the black light fell onto Jack, they could not shake him in the slightest; instead, they were blocked by an invisible force field around his body, erupting with rings of Energy Halos.
With both hands holding the Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth and the cloud stone, Jack’s realm of thought moved, and the voice of his Divine Soul resonated within his mind: “Consume 800,000 Attribute points, enhance this divine weapon.”
Boom!
In an instant, Heaven and Earth trembled, and white flames surged up around Jack, enveloping the damaged ancient divine weapon and the black ore.
Under the enhancement’s power, the formidable divine weapon and black ore vibrated, their internal strengths spreading and coalescing into densely packed and complex Rune Illusions.
The melting of the divine weapon even generated waves of black Radiance, spreading outward in all directions like the tide, where the Heavenly Earth Law roiled, giving rise to multicolored auroras.
Such a stunning display of power immediately drew the attention of the strong men back at the base, including those of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Whoosh! Multiple figures rocketed up from the warships and battleships and looked toward the center of the Seven-Colored Glow in the distance, where a huge black vortex loomed.
At the center of the vortex, Jack sat cross-legged, as if standing at the center of the world, with flames burning around him, encompassing the crystal and the Wolf Tooth Staff in front of him.
At that moment, Jack’s hair fluttered wildly behind him, his aura immense.
Not far away, the Primordial True King and True Martial Heavenly King stood firm on either side, backing him, especially the Primordial True King, whose expression was filled with excitement and agitation.
A complete ancient divine weapon, with it, any average Ancient Middle Stage Demon God would have to flee on sight, or risk being severely beaten.

﻿Chapter 1482: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The Arrival of the Emperor Dragon’s True Body_2 Chapter 1482: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The Arrival of the Emperor Dragon’s True Body_2 In the Heavenly Feather Clan, a Divine King with five pairs of golden light wings stretched out behind him stood in the high sky, his expression one of shock, “Is that Human Clan’s Divine Martial Sky King melting a pseudo-world-level weapon again?”
With five pairs of white light wings spreading out behind him and emitting the aura of an Ancient Middle Stage Divine King, Segovia nodded solemnly, “It’s not just a pseudo-world-level; that weapon seems to be advancing.”
“Advancing, forging a world-class weapon, how is that possible!!” Another Divine King, with four pairs of golden light wings and at the ancient early stage realm, was stunned.
Weapons of this level, even the Purgatory Empire they had been fighting for hundreds of years only had three emperors who possessed them.
Aside from the Divine King of Light, their Heavenly Feather Clan only had Divine King Tolstoy who controlled a world-class weapon, which had been the main force to resist the emperors of Purgatory in the past.
And that Human Clan Genius at the mid period of becoming a Main God, had already astounded everyone by melting two pseudo-world-level weapons in succession previously, yet it wasn’t his limit.
Main God Bordea of the Heavenly Feather Clan was even more shocked, watching the splendid scene in the distance, “The strength of that Human Clan genius seems unfathomable.”
As he spoke, Bordea glanced at the blonde girl nearby with a calm expression and white light wings spread out behind her, a touch of regret showing in his eyes.
Because, given the talent and strength Jack Clark had displayed now, the likelihood that his initial suggestion of an alliance through marriage between the two clans had diminished greatly.
While those of the Heavenly Feather Alien Clan were surprised and shocked, the Mysterious Martial Sky King and Sky King Denny Kaye from the Human Race side were somewhat astonished looking at the distant scene.
As for the cultivators below the myth, they couldn’t see the scene deep within the seven-colored radiance at a distance of thousands of kilometers.
But the spectacle was so startling, and the tumultuous Heavenly Earth Law made breathing difficult for countless individuals.
At the edge of the ship, under the illumination of the seven-colored glow, Justin Welan was somewhat curious, “What is Jack doing over there? It’s such a huge commotion.”
Eddy Keller asked, somewhat puzzled, “How do you know it’s King Jack?”
Justin replied with certainty, “It’s simple. As long as Jack is there, nobody else can show off in front of him, so the person making such a big scene this time must be him.”
“…Indeed, it seems you’re right,” Eddy Keller realized, nodding.
Recalling since meeting Jack Clark, it indeed seemed like no one could surpass him—like when he slaughtered countless Void Creatures on the Ruins Continent, with nightly battle achievements that stunned everyone.
There was also the opening of the Road to Becoming a God, where he was the first to go up, crossing the Path of the Gods in one step.
Including the time he was the first among his peers to break through to the Eight Layer Heaven, just as he was about to stride forward proudly, Jack followed suit breaking through, his formation of the Fourfold Illusionary World shook the kings.
Not to mention when they met again after entering the mythical world.
Thinking of this, Eddy Keller seemed contemplative, it seems in the future if I want to show off and act divinely in front of others, I need to find an opportunity when he’s not around.
This time, the forging of the divine weapon for the Primordial True King took even longer, nearly half a day passed before the Dark Realm Cloud Stone, now half-illusory, completed merging.
Simultaneously, the increasingly ferocious Black Wolf Tooth Stick, wrapped in some white mysterious patterns that wound and spread like vines wrapping around a tree trunk.
But once the white patterns completed nine loops, a fragmented sky pattern appeared on the Wolf Tooth Staff, and in an instant, a terrifying aura of destruction spread between heaven and earth.
Hum, hum, hum! The Black Wolf Tooth Staff flared with radiance, vibrating continuously, and faintly, a thunderous sound of the world shattering resounded from within.
As the white flame engulfing the Black Wolf Tooth Staff extinguished, in an instant, the staff’s light surged, transforming into a black radiance that shot into the sky, expanding massively in size.
Soon, a Wolf Tooth Staff spanning over thirty thousand meters lay across the Firmament, akin to a mountain range, with terrifying power swirling around it, shattering space.
At the very moment the Ancient Divine Weapon was born, heaven and earth changed color, endless dark clouds materialized from nowhere, spanning thousands of kilometers, with golden lightning dazzling within the thick clouds.
Boom!
Thunderous, earth-shattering lightning resounded, illuminating the whole world with a golden glow, as a bolt that tore through the clouds gathered into form.
Under the golden lightning, space crumbled layer by layer, and the invisible Destructive Aura, even at a distance of over a thousand kilometers, turned the faces of all cultivators below the myth pale.
Roar! Just as the golden lightning was about to strike the Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth Staff, a ferocious and brutal roar echoed through heaven and earth.
Beneath the lightning, an Eight-armed Explosion Ape, tens of thousands of meters in height and covered in black scales, appeared with its eyes furiously wide, roaring as it stretched out both arms to grasp the Black Wolf Tooth Staff.
Boom!
The moment it grasped the Ancient Divine Weapon, the Primordial True King’s aura skyrocketed, countless white patterns traveling up the staff to his entire body.
Even his body swelled again, muscles expanded, morphing into an Unmatched Explosion Ape over fifteen thousand meters tall, swinging the Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth Staff to sweep heaven and earth.
At the same time, the golden lightning descended from the sky.
Boom! A dazzling light exploded, as if a second Golden Sun had appeared between heaven and earth, the invisible viral Rule light rings even shook heaven and earth.
Beneath the terrifying impact, Earth collapsed and the Firmament cracked, and over a thousand kilometers away, the Mysterious Martial Sky King and others rapidly changed color.
“Be careful.”
“Join forces to block it.”
Including the Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, and several Main Gods took action, pooling Heavenly Energy to form a Sky Curtain stretching across hundreds of kilometers.
Boom, boom, boom!!
As the Rule impact swept through heaven and earth, a deafening roar akin to the Mountains and Seas shaking ensued, and the pervasive oppressive force even caused the legs of Justin Welan and others to weaken.
Too, too powerful.
Is this the strength of Supreme Experts? Just the aftermath of a collision with heaven and earth, spanning over a thousand kilometers and even after being blocked by the concerted efforts of kings, it is so terrifying.

﻿Chapter 1483: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The True Body of the Emperor Dragon Descends_3 Chapter 1483: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The True Body of the Emperor Dragon Descends_3 “`
The impact that shook Heaven and Earth lasted for about ten minutes before finally subsiding, causing Crystal Lewis and the others to breathe a sigh of relief.
By this time, the golden radiance that had illuminated Heaven and Earth in the distance had vanished, leaving only rampant torrents spreading outwards, mountain ranges collapsing, the Earth shattering, and a cloudless hollow spanning thousands of kilometers appeared in the sky.
Meanwhile, the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King and the others, as well as those Heavenly Feather Divine Kings and Main Gods, had disappeared from sight, reappearing a thousand kilometers away, looking up at the sky in astonishment.
There towered the Eight-Armed Explosion Ape, standing over ten thousand meters tall, wielding a massive, ferocious Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth Stick, with space around it fragmented like shattered mirrors, in a state of irregular breakage.
At this moment, the Primordial True King’s aura was overwhelming, filled with the utmost aura of destruction, as if an ancient Demon God had descended from the past.
An ancient Divine Weapon in perfect condition augmented the strength of the Primordial True King’s ancient Explosive Ape True Body to its limits.
However, even though the Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth had become a complete ancient Divine Weapon, it still fell short of the might of the Dark Demon Blade in Tyris’s hands.
Ancient Divine Weapons are not World-class weapons; their War Patterns serve to amplify and augment the user’s Rule power, not to provide an additional rule.
Of course, what’s most crucial is that its level is not as high as Tyris’s Dark Demon Blade, which has been refined by Tyris to a terrifying degree.
Huh!
The Primordial True King let out a long breath, shrank in size, and in a blink, appeared in front of Jack Clark.
The Primordial True King’s aged face was flushed with excitement as he looked at Jack Clark, “The complete Heaven-breaking Fang is very powerful, Jack Clark, I thank you for this time.”
A smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face, “Senior need not be polite, this is what I should do.”
“Jack Clark, my Heaven-breaking Fang has now become a complete Divine Weapon. As for the Sky-based God King…” At this point, unsure if Jack Clark could still offer help, the Primordial True King paused.
Looking at the somewhat excited Primordial True King, Jack Clark gave a wry smile, “Primordial Senior, I temporarily can’t help with repairing the Sky-based God King’s Divine Weapon.”
Jack Clark explained, “When I use my talent to melt and forge weapons, what’s actually consumed and burned is Life Energy.”
“Of course, it’s not my Life Origin that’s burning, but the Life Crystal energy I’ve refined and stored over time.”
“Just now, in helping you forge the weapon, I’ve exhausted the accumulation from this period. If I were to repair the Sky-based God King’s Divine Weapon, I would need sufficient Life Crystals.”
That’s simple enough.
Compared to the strength enhancement of a Supreme Expert, Life Crystals are trivial.
The True Martial Heavenly King immediately asked, “Jack Clark, how many Life Crystals are approximately needed to repair the Sky-based God King’s Divine Weapon?”
“The amount needed depends on the completeness of the Sky-based Senior’s Divine Weapon and whether there are Rule-Level materials.”
After a moment’s thought, Jack Clark said, “If there aren’t any Rule-Level materials that match, it’s estimated that about six hundred thousand Level 1 or an equivalent amount of energy from Life Crystals will be required.”
Six hundred thousand Level 1 Crystals could be converted to more than two and a half million, up to three million Attribute points.
Afterwards, strengthening and repairing the Sky-based God King’s Divine Weapon would leave several hundred thousand points to replace what was used this time.
Although enhancing the weapons of Supreme Experts is equivalent to raising the overall strength of the Human Race, he also needs Attribute points to speed up cultivation and to prepare for the next upgrade of the Eight Desolate War Halberd.
The next time another great battle occurs and a Demon God or Extreme Realm Great Demon King is slain, taking their Pseudo-World Level weapons will allow the Eight Desolate War Halberd to be enhanced to World-class.
“Six hundred thousand Level 1 life crystal energy, huh.”
The Primordial True King mused, “The Sky-based God King has been sitting at the Frontline Battlefield all these years, without the time to delve into the mythical world, so he certainly doesn’t have materials for repair.”
“However, the upcoming battle is of great importance; naturally, it would be better if his strength could be further advanced.”
“I will immediately inform Blue Star to mobilize all the Life Crystals from my Inner World, and from now on, all crystal outputs will be provided to you.”
Jack Clark’s talent ability is too powerful.
If enough forging materials and Life Crystals are available, enhancing the weapons of the Human Race’s Heavenly King Powerhouses will lift our upper-level fighting forces by a notch.
As for enhancing the weapons of all kings and Heavenly Kings, it’s a bit unrealistic, for lack of sufficient Life Crystals.
Furthermore, it’s clear that Jack Clark is also in need of such resources, and he must also keep some for his own use.
At this moment, the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Divine King Powerhouses flew over, their eyes burning with eagerness as they looked at the huge Wolf Tooth Staff in the hand of the Primordial True King, especially the powerful pressure emanating from it.
Following him, sporting five pairs of Golden Light Wings and the powerful aura of Rule Radiance forming a Golden Divine Wheel behind his head, the Divine King Tolstoy from the Heavenly Feather Clan, in the ancient late-stage realm, smiled and said,
“I didn’t expect that, under the Divine Martial Emperor, your skills in weapon forging are so remarkable, even capable of helping others forge Rule-Level weapons!”
Jokingly, Jack Clark modestly said, “It was nothing, Divine King Tolstoy has praised too much; helping Primordial Senior repair the Divine Weapon also involved some luck.”
“You’re being modest, Divine Martial Emperor.”
The three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings obviously didn’t believe it was just luck for Jack Clark this time. The Divine King Segovia, bearing white light wings, hesitated for a moment before asking,
“Divine Martial Emperor, my Sparkling Heaven Shining World Spear is also close to World-level, and it is currently at Pseudo-World Level. I wonder if I could trouble you to help in its refinement?”
Suddenly another Divine King also seemed interested.
Jack Clark pondered, “Our two races are allies bound by mutual dependence. Of course, I would be willing to help the esteemed ones, but…”
“But what?” Hearing Jack Clark was willing to help, Segovia could barely wait.
“`

﻿Chapter 1484: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The Arrival of the Emperor Dragon’s True Body_4 Chapter 1484: Chapter 558: The Ancient Divine Weapon, The Arrival of the Emperor Dragon’s True Body_4 Jack Clark spoke, “The materials required for upgrading weapons must be prepared by yourselves, and forging consumes a lot of energy, so I will need enough Life Crystals to replenish it.”
“Life Crystals?” The three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings were puzzled.
“Yes, Life Crystals. The reason I can rapidly melt and strengthen weapons mainly depends on my Gifted Power. The Weapon Refining Secret Methods are only auxiliary.”
“The pure Vitality contained in the Life Crystals can supplement my consumption and serve as the fuel to activate my Gifted Power,” Jack Clark explained again.
“I see,” said the three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, nodding as a hint of understanding appeared on the face of Bordea not far away.
No wonder Jack Clark initially wanted Life Crystals.
But this issue now seemed simpler. The Divine Martial Emperor named Heavenly King Segovia inquired, “May I know how many Life Crystals Divine Martial Emperor requires?”
Jack Clark smiled, “For a Senior Pseudo-World Level weapon, given sufficient materials, at least one hundred and twenty Level 9 Life Crystals are needed.”
“If there are no Level 9 Life Crystals, Level 7 or Level 8 will do as well. What I need is enough Life Energy to burn; the level is not very important.”
“If the materials are insufficient, I can even reverse the fundamental rules to compensate forcibly, but then at least double the Life Crystal energy would be needed.”
A Level 9 Life Crystal, when converted, provides between ten thousand and fifteen thousand Attribute Points. With the materials for a Senior Pseudo-World Level weapon, the requirement for strengthening should be around five hundred thousand Attribute Points.
In other words, to strengthen an ordinary World-class weapon, Jack Clark’s service fee would be around one million Attribute Points.
“Only one hundred and twenty Level 9 Life Crystals!” The three Divine Kings were startled, then their faces showed smiles.
The difficulty of creating a World-class weapon lies not only in the vast amount of resources and materials but also in the profound Weapon Refining cultivation close to the Dao, and the extensive time required; otherwise, weapons of this level would be commonplace.
To the Divine Kings, quasi-mythical beasts were no different from ants—easily suppressed with just a thought. The slightly troublesome part was finding and collecting Life Crystals.
But that would just be a waste of a little time.
As long as they defeat the two from the Purgatory Empire and get a period of respite afterward, with their strength, half a year’s foray into the mythical world will be enough to gather what’s required.
Most importantly, one hundred and twenty quasi-mythical beasts are still not as valuable as one Titan beast, not to mention a World-class weapon that can enhance Divine King Level power.
Such a deal is too good to pass up.
However, due to insufficient materials and a lack of Life Crystals, the matter of weapon forging had to be put on hold for now.
This also meant the Divine Weapon issue for the Sky-based God King would have to wait.
Soon, an order was relayed from the Outer Development Department to the Blue Star World.
At South Sky Martial Arts School, Head Instructor Laurant Harris looked at the newly issued notice with some confusion: “What’s going on? Why are all the Life Crystals allocated for the fourth quarter suddenly being called back?”
The teacher talking to Laurant Harris was also surprised: “All the Life Crystals are being called back; why is that?”
Laurant Harris scrutinized the information popping up on his smart wristwatch, deep in thought: “It seems it’s needed in the mythical world.”
“And the document mentions that from now on, all Life Crystals will not be allocated anymore; all produced by Blue Star will be supplied there.”
“This… What about the early bodily strength improvements for the freshmen and sophomores?” the other teacher asked tentatively.
Each year, Life Crystals produced by the numerous breeding farms, including those raised on the Southern Battlefield and other Unique Beasts, had specific purposes.
Combined with the Body Casting Skill and other Cultivation Methods, they can rapidly help freshmen and sophomores from Second Grade surpass the First and Second Layer Heaven and make an early breakthrough to Triplex.
Regarding this issue, Laurant Harris could only shake his head: “The higher-ups must have considered this aspect, but still, they issued this order, obviously implying that the other matter is more significant.”
“Besides, we still have the Ancient Body Refining Techniques. The publicly available Basic Body Refining Techniques can already make up for this issue.”
“Plus, I’ve noticed recently that some freshmen suited for Body Refinement progress even faster when they abandon the True Martial and focus solely on Body refining techniques in the early stages.”
…
In dim Heaven and Earth, a Black Gold Giant Beast over seven thousand one hundred meters tall stood defiantly, its body crackling with golden-red lightning that emitted an aura of Terrifying Destruction.
It was then that the Destruction Emperor Dragon, gripping in its right claw, a Titan Beast’s corpse torn in half and stretching over two thousand meters in length.
Not far away, a Silver Giant Dragon and a golden-blue Giant Dragon roared as they fought against a Mythical Giant Beast, which looked like a giant statue ablaze with flames.
In the face of two Mythical Peak beast opponents, the late-period mythical beasts posed no threat, their scale armor shattered and flesh and blood flying.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon brought the Titan Beast’s corpse to its maw, its fearsome jaws snapped shut, crushing the scale armor and resonating with the bone-shattering explosion of energies comparable to a nuclear detonation.
With its massive size coupled with the Dark Realm Swallowing ability, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s eating speed was even faster; it devoured half of the Giant Beast’s corpse within just a few bites.
It didn’t take long for the late-period Titan Beast to be consumed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon in a savage display.
As for the energy contribution of this massive Titan Beast, over two thousand seven hundred meters in length, it only caused the Destruction Emperor Dragon to grow about ten meters longer.
There was just too significant a gap in energy levels between them.
After roughly ten minutes, the two Giant Dragons finally dealt with their opponents.
“Roar! Tim Abott, this one’s for you,” the Silver Giant Dragon, its body half-drenched in blood, flapped its double wings as it carried over the corpse of a thousand-meter-long Giant Beast, letting out an excited roar.

In a deep roar, Destruction Emperor Dragon extended his huge right claw and took the Giant Beast corpse, then devoured it within three crunches and rumbles.
At this time, the gold and blue Giant Dragon also flew back, its tone equally excited, “Thunderflame, there’s another one here.”
“Hmm.”
The enormous Black Gold Giant Beast nodded, grabbing the half-destroyed body of the Giant Beast corpse and ate it like a snack in just two bites.
However, to the current Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Mythical Giant Beasts were indeed no different from snacks, growing by only a meter after consuming two huge bodies.
Once Destruction Emperor Dragon had finished eating, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t wait to urge, “Roar! Tim Abott, let’s continue on our way. The Great Sethia feels full of strength right now.”
A strong desire to destroy was apparent in the eyes of the gold and blue Giant Dragon nearby.
In the past few days, following the Destruction Emperor Dragon into the Chaotic Turbulent Region, they had encountered over ten Mythical Giant Beasts and three Titans. All of them, except for that Black Armored Giant Beast, were maddened with chaotic consciousness.
Those Giant Beasts that refused to submit, with no value in being tamed, were directly killed by them.
Serveral of the Mythical Giant Beasts were jointly handled by the two Giant Dragons, and after striking them down, they would bring the corpses to the Destruction Emperor Dragon as a snack.
The continuous battles also completely unleashed the innate bloodthirsty and destructive nature of the two Giant Dragons.
But just as the two Giant Dragons were seeing red, the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly growled, “You should rest and recover from the battle you just went through.”
“Besides, I have something that requires me to leave for two or three days.”
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re leaving, where are you going?” The two Giant Dragons immediately froze.
The corners of Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth turned up slightly, revealing a fierce grin, “Naturally, I’m going to check on ‘Jack Clark’.”
With that, a blue radiance shone beneath Destruction Emperor Dragon’s feet, a gloomy blue altar encompassing tens of kilometers slowly emerged, as if descending from another space-time.
In an instant, a terrifying power of space-time distortion burst forth, and Destruction Emperor Dragon vanished in the dazzling blue radiance.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon became angry and roared out in fury, “Roar! Damn it, that human must have come across an enemy he can’t beat again, and asked Tim Abott for help.”
As the Silver Giant Dragon raged like thunder, the gold and blue Giant Dragon lazily growled, “Alright, stop yelling, Sethia. Anyway, you can’t beat that human.”
With that, the gold and blue Giant Dragon’s gaze fixed on the spot where Destruction Emperor Dragon had disappeared, eyes revealing amazement.
Although it wasn’t the first time he had seen it, he was still somewhat surprised every time. He wondered what kind of Secret Skill it was that could summon the Destruction Emperor Dragon across space-time.
And after a period of space-time reversal summoning, Destruction Emperor Dragon would silently return.
Moreover, Thunderflame seemed to completely trust that human, being so easily summoned every time without worrying about any traps on the other side.

﻿Chapter 1486: Chapter 559: Demon God Avatar, A Battle on the Verge of Eruption Chapter 1486: Chapter 559: Demon God Avatar, A Battle on the Verge of Eruption Over the Demon Domain, the sky was obscured by roiling dark demonic aura, within which loomed five towering silhouettes exuding an aura as terrifying as that of gods or demons.
The beings that the five Demon Gods were there to greet were even more fearsome.
Wherever they passed, Heaven and Earth were stained with a black and red blood light, resembling the infernal abyss that swallowed the world, radiating endless darkness and a sinister omen.
Above the Firmament, the image of the Supreme Abyss World emerged, exuding a terrifying pressure that made even the Demon Gods show a wary expression.
Within the dark demonic aura, the Dark Demon Dragon Carthius was somewhat solemn, “Is this the strength of the strongest under the Lord of the Saint Demon Anke Empire, how strong!”
After over half a ‘month’ of closed-door cultivation, Carthius had recovered most of his injuries by exhausting the accumulation of years and could now exert eighty percent of his strength.
Under normal conditions, he would definitely wait until he recovered to his peak before emerging from seclusion.
However, Diorus and other Demon Gods were feeling the threat from the Human Race growing increasingly severe, and under the initiative of Levides from the Ancestral Court, two Imperial Demon Gods had been invited as reinforcements.
This time, even if they couldn’t completely destroy the Human Race, they aimed to heavily injure its vital energy, to prepare for the subsequent war of annihilation.
As that Demon God with a sky-reaching blood light approached, Levides from the Ancestral Court showed a smile, “Sigitico, you have finally arrived.”
“Some matters cropped up on the way, so I was delayed.”
The deep and cold voice rolled with blood light as a ferocious Demon God clad in thick blood-colored battle armor appeared, standing over three hundred meters tall in its normal state.
Like other Purgatory True Demons, this Demon God’s body was also covered in red scale armor; however, it grew a pair of spiral dragon horns on its demon-like head, adding to its domineering appearance.
The more than two hundred meters long blood-colored hair at its back moved without wind, resembling burning red flames, surrounded by thick bands of blood light, and it exuded a terrifying aura.
It was still that towering Demon Palace, but this time only six Demon Gods sat high upon their thrones.
From the Bloody Throne, a Demon God who seemed to emerge from the Blood Sea Hell turned to look at Diorus and said in a deep voice, “I have understood the situation here. That human truly cannot be allowed to continue unchecked.”
“But for so long, you still haven’t drawn the power of the dark abyss over here, which is also the reason for your failure.”
Upon hearing this Diorus shook his head, “We are different from you; after the breakthrough to Demon God, we did not merge with the abyss. Naturally, the rate at which we corrupt the world is much slower.”
“Moreover, Belidier and I only established our empire a little over a hundred years ago; the Heavenly Earth Law within the empire’s territory has not yet completed the demonization.”
Facing this issue, the few Demon Gods present could only shake their heads upon hearing this.
Since the Purgatory Demon Race didn’t have any natural enemies nearby, Diorus and the other three founding Demon Gods of the empire rapidly expanded their territory, distributed lands, and soon occupied a vast area.
But when the Purgatory Demon Race took over a territory, it wasn’t just about drawing a circle around it; they also had to transform (pollute) the area, turning it into an environment suitable for their subsistence.
Moreover, the range shrouded and polluted by the Abyssal Demonic Aura is actually a different sort of larger world domain that can enhance the strength of the Purgatory True Demons while suppressing enemies.
Especially for a Demon God who is the lord of an empire, they wield even greater Demon Power within their empire’s domain, having boundless strength.
Of course, this is under the precondition that the empire has been completely engulfed in darkness, where the power of the abyss has become the supreme force of this world, and the empire’s ruler has condensed the Abyssal rule.
Glossing over the issue, the Blood-colored Demon God said coldly, “Speak of the current situation.”
Diorus spoke in a grave tone: “All forces of the two great empires have been mobilized and are stationed a million kilometers to the rear of the Frontline Battlefield, ready to enter the battlefield at any moment.”
“The only concern now is that we cannot form overwhelming strength in the clash of top-tier Demon God Level powers, so no offensive has been launched.”
“The Human Race’s side is a bit complicated; the vast area they occupy is a terrifying forbidden area, with only a narrow strip suitable for the army to enter.”
“And the actual territory held by the Human Race isn’t even as large as that of one demon king’s land and is estimated to be only one-fifth.”
“With such a small territory, under the Human Race’s use of the forbidden area as a defensive stronghold, we are unable to break through; but at the same time, they have no depth in the battlefield and nowhere to retreat.”
“Even if we cannot completely annihilate the Human Race in this battle, as long as we breach their base in the Vast World, they will lose their foothold.”
The main objectives of this battle are crystal clear to Diorus and the other Demon Gods.
In the absence of absolute dominance in Demon God Level combat power, the hope of annihilating the Human Race in one battle is slim, as doing so would cost them the lives of at least a few Demon Gods.
But obviously, no one wishes to be that unlucky one.
After all, even with their exceptional talents and many years of cultivation, they have gone through countless life-and-death battles to reach the stage of Demon God.
Seeing that Diorus and the others were prepared, the Blood-colored Demon God said coldly, “Then let’s prepare to take action. Just in time, my collection shelf lacks the head of a Human Race Demon God.”
At that moment, Stephenl, who had arrived earlier, slowly said, “We still need to wait a moment, as I have informed the Great Demon King sent from the empire, but the demon king’s subordinates have not yet arrived.”
The Blood-colored Demon God looked at Stephenl with some surprise, “Your Alecasa Empire suffered heavy losses in the deadly battle against the Immortal Spirit Clan, and you still have the spare forces to send reinforcements?”
Stephenl spoke in a deep voice, “It’s manageable.”
Is that so? The Blood-colored Demon God’s gaze swept over the others present, thoughtful, obviously aware there was some deal among them that it did not know about.

﻿Chapter 1487: Chapter 559: The Demon God Avatar, An Imminent Great Battle_2 Chapter 1487: Chapter 559: The Demon God Avatar, An Imminent Great Battle_2 “`
…
“That presence, so strong!”
At the temporary base, many powerhouses gazed towards the distorted dark area at the end of the sky, their faces showing a solemn expression, including the Sky-based God Kings.
However, no one went to investigate that terrifying aura thousands of kilometers away, because Jack Clark had already said that he would be cultivating there over the next few days.
But clearly, that was just an excuse to appease everyone; that terrifying aura that made even the Divine Kings tremble at such a distance couldn’t possibly be Jack Clark.
In the Black Hole Zone where space itself was slightly distorted, a Black Gold Giant Beast over seven thousand meters long stood erect, its mountain-like Dorsal Fin imparting a sense of oppression.
Seated in a cross-legged position on the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark, with his frail aura yet inexplicably strong presence, let his black hair fly wildly, a silver light flickering at his brow.
Around Jack Clark, strands of pure Time Power circulated, forming a transparent Time Stream that meandered for kilometers.
Within the transparent stream, a vague phantom was gradually condensing, albeit slowly due to the scant amount of Time Power.
At this moment, the Purple little dragon approached, its large eyes twinkling.
Ee-ya ee-ya! Brother, your life essence is very weak, do you want Miss Joseline to spit some saliva?
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, his voice weak, “Wait a little longer; I haven’t reached the ultimate limit of my True Body, the erosion of time is not enough yet.”
“And, that’s not saliva, that’s your Creation Power.”
Saliva somehow sounds strange.
Ee-ya ee-ya! Alright then.
The Purple little dragon nodded, its body like that of a dragon made from Purple Crystal, coiling in the air with its double claws supporting its chin, appearing both adorable and mystical.
Since Jack Clark summoned the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s True Body, half an hour had passed, and his internal “energy” had almost completely depleted due to continuous consumption.
But because it hadn’t exceeded the limit yet, the erosion of Time Power was not very intense; the amount of Time Power present was barely enough to trigger the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power.
As for condensing a complete True Body of Time, that was still a far cry.
With the increase in Jack Clark’s strength, the amount of Time Power required to condense a Time True Body also demanded higher standards because once it successfully condensed, it would be equivalent to having an additional Demon God Level combat power.
As time went on, Jack Clark’s internal “energy” quickly ran out, his formerly robust and erect True Body now looked like mere skin and bones, his hair withered.
At this stage, Jack Clark had almost reached his limit, and he suddenly opened his eyes, letting out a long howl, “It’s still not enough, burn for me.”
Boom!
A terrifying Power Explosion erupted within Jack Clark’s body, his aura surging as an infinite Life Origin burned, his body visibly plumping and recovering at an observable pace.
This scene closely resembled the time he ventured deep into the rear of the Purgatory Empire and summoned the Destruction Emperor Dragon to confront two Purgatory Demon Gods.
And as Jack Clark once again burned his Life Origin, defying the Space-Time Summoning Rule to forcefully halt the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the infiltration of Time Power on his body surged by more than ten times.
Instantly, the rune on his brow, resembling wings, shined radiantly as the Time Stream behind him roiled, the vague transparent phantom rapidly solidifying.
When the Life Origin began to burn, Jack Clark’s eyes opened once more.
“Miss Joseline, now’s the time, just a little bit; as long as you can barely keep my Life Origin from declining.”
This time was different from the last; there was no need to feign weakness to deceive the Purgatory Demon Gods, so Jack Clark asked Purple little dragon to cooperate with him to exploit a bug in time.
Ee-ya ee-ya! No problem, brother.
Hearing that it could finally be of use, the Purple little dragon became spirited and excitedly approached, its dragon-head mouth slightly open as huge as a sedan.
Roar! In a low Dragon Roar, the Purple little dragon exhaled a purifying stream of Creation Power from its mouth, merging into Jack Clark’s body like a fine thread.
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s entire being surged with renewed power, every drained cell bursting with vitality.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon consumed, the Purple little dragon supplemented, and Jack Clark, like a conversion station, crazily absorbed the skyrocketing Power of Time curse.
Perhaps even the ancient Monarch who mastered the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power could not have imagined someone could condense the Time True Body so rapidly in this way.
Under such circumstances, as long as Jack Clark had time, he could quickly condense the Nine Time True Body again, his one person being equivalent to the power of ten Demon Gods.
But there is a pre-condition: that the Purple little dragon’s Creation origin is plentiful enough.
As Jack Clark’s True Body of Time condensed swiftly, time passed, and the Life Crystals initially allocated within Blue Star began to regather from various places.
However, once the tally was complete, there was a shortfall. The new semester had long passed, and most of the Life Crystals had been exchanged and used by the students.
What was gathered back from the warehouse amounted to more than three hundred thousand Level 1, over forty thousand Level 2, and several thousand Level 3 Life Crystals.
Together, these Life Crystals could be considered roughly equivalent to five hundred thousand Level 1 Life Crystals after conversion.
For this reason, in the mythical world, the mighty army bases and logistical bases were also restless, with many High-Ranking Powerhouses venturing into the surrounding mountain ranges to hunt Giant Beasts.
Including two other directions of the Outer Development Department, the bases overseen by two Monarchs both took action to hunt Giant Beasts, striving to collect the remaining one hundred thousand Level 1 Life Crystals within three days.
Because there was also the need to reserve time for Jack Clark to help the Sky-based God King repair his Divine Weapon.
In reality, the shortfall of these Life Crystals could be filled with the killing of three quasi-mythical behemoths.
Unfortunately, due to the Human Race’s encirclement and hunting over the years, Giant Beasts near the territory have become scarce; the intelligent quasi-mythical behemoths are either dead or have long since fled.

﻿Chapter 1488: Chapter 559: The Demon God Avatar, An Imminent Great Battle_3 Chapter 1488: Chapter 559: The Demon God Avatar, An Imminent Great Battle_3 Meanwhile, in the central region of the Divine Gods Alliance, Sky Warships blotted out the sun as Giant Beasts soared overhead, and dozens of Alien Corps on the Earth were mobilizing.
Among these Alien Corps, a multitude of mountainous Giant Beasts were mixed in, and from time to time, an aura stronger than mythical passed through the ranks.
Above the Firmament, boundless golden radiance spread far and wide, and a towering silhouette stood in the depths, like a Supreme Deity ruling over all living beings from on high.
Standing with hands behind his back among the Alliance Army was Jewell True Immortal, positioned on a magnificent Jade Stone Spaceship, watching the rapidly marching armies below with a touch of wistfulness.
“Originally, according to the secret agreement with King Tarodel, the Divine Gods Alliance was to act as the Human Race’s rear guard and also as one of the retreat routes in case of defeat,” he thought.
“But I never imagined that one day, the Human Race would be able to gather the strength to launch a counteroffensive against the Purgatory Empire.”
Another Human Mythical King smiled, “This day truly took everyone by surprise, but it also proves that the fortune of the Human Race is at its peak.”
“This battle will definitely break through the two great empires, lengthening the depth of the war to come, and securing more time for development.”
“Victory belongs to the Human Race!”
The Divine Gods Alliance’s army marched swiftly, and since it wasn’t too far from the Outer Development Department of the Human Race, it only took two days to reach where the 30th Army Group was stationed.
There, the immense Silver Glow Divine Tree stood tall, emitting halos of light that sealed the entrances to the forbidden areas on both sides.
Atop the Silver Divine Tree, the Primordial True King, who had been waiting there, stood with his feet on the Void and a Black Wolf Tooth Stick radiating an astonishing aura slung over his shoulder.
Boom!
Space shattered, and the Primordial True King appeared high above, thousands of miles in the sky, looking at the figure in the golden sea and smiling, “Tarodel, you have arrived.”
In the midst of the Golden Cloud Sea, a youth with silver hair and a third eye on his forehead sat high on the divine throne.
When Primordial True King greeted him, this youth, who suppressed one side of the Divine Gods Alliance, nodded slightly, his expression indifferent, “As agreed, I will act to suppress the opposing two powerful Demon Kings.”
“As for how many ‘Persons’ from the opposite side can be left after this battle, that will depend on the strength of your Human Race and the Heavenly Feather Clan,” he said.
The Primordial True King nodded with a smile, “Of course.”
Yet the Primordial True King didn’t mind Tarodel’s attitude.
As an entity that had lived for untold years and had already reached the Peak of the Ancient, King Tarodel’s strength was unfathomable, and even the joint effort of the three Supreme Experts of the Human Race seemed inadequate against him.
Although Tarodel’s strength would be diminished after leaving the Divine Realm, the Primordial True King, who had only recently made a breakthrough to the Ancient Middle Stage and was just barely stabilizing his realm, still didn’t dare to take him lightly.
Even with a complete Ancient Divine Weapon in hand.
There was no helping it, the other’s strength was too great.
Boom!
As the light from the Silver Divine Tree shone brilliantly, the forbidden area entrances on both sides shook as if by an earthquake, and the mountain ranges trembled, slowly splitting open to reveal a huge pathway.
Under the lead of the Primordial True King, the Alien Corps quickly traversed the outpost of the Outer Development Department’s army, officially entering the hinterland of the Human Territory.
However, after entering the Human Territory, the Alien Corps didn’t proceed directly to the Sky Curtain Battlefield; instead, under the guidance of the Primordial True King, they took a slight detour.
In just half a day, the army approached the temporary base of the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Sky Base Fleet.
Before the two forces even got close, the strong men on both sides had already detected each other, and instantly more than a dozen terrifying Auras burst forth above the Heavenly Feather Clan, as beams of Radiance shot up into the sky.
Above the Firmament, a boundless golden sea undulated, its intangible aura pressing down on the Heavenly Earth Law, colliding with three vast breaths that approached head-on.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
With the collision of the pressures exerted by four Supreme Experts of the Ancient Level, the whole world shook violently, the Void trembled, and Heaven and Earth thundered.
At that moment, everyone felt their brains quake, with only the earth-shattering booms echoing in their ears, the entire world submerged in a blend of golden and white Divine Light.
No one knew how much time passed, then between heaven and earth, all was silent.
Above ten thousand kilometers, the three-eyed young man still sat solemnly on the Divine Throne, calmly observing the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan opposite him, especially Tarodel with his unfolded Golden Light Wings.
“Worthy indeed of a civilization that has battled the mighty Purgatory Empire for centuries, the strength is astonishing.”
Tarodel’s expression was grave as he slowly spoke, “Your strength has also surprised me; such power, I have only encountered in the presence of the Divine Master of Light.”
With that, a faint smile appeared on both parties’ faces.
From this brief encounter, whether it was King Tarodel or Tarodel, each gained a bit of understanding of the other.
Very strong!

﻿Chapter 1489: Chapter 561: Demon God Standoff, That Human Must Die Chapter 1489: Chapter 561: Demon God Standoff, That Human Must Die The narrow Sky Curtain Battlefield space trembled as powerful forces swept through Heaven and Earth.
Two original bodies of the Demon Gods, together with a continental block over ten thousand kilometers in diameter, were launched into the air, and with rolling airwaves and earth-shattering roars, they thunderously fell.
“Brace for impact.”
“Hold it back.”
Nine Great Demon Kings, more than forty Demon Kings, and nearly ten million troops from the Purgatory Legion unleashed their power in an explosive burst, transforming into towering pillars of black Demon Gods that shot up into the sky.
These legions, dispersed in all directions, merged all their strength into the Earth, mountains, and various spatial rule domains in the sky under the command of the Great Demon Kings, and in an instant two Demon Gods’ auras surged wildly.
Whether it was the Human Race’s Frontline Battlefield base or this battlefield of the Purgatory Empire, both were eroded by the Supreme-level rules of both sides, and various powerful Demon Arrays and Rune Arrays were laid out.
Or rather, the actual control of the rear areas of both parties is the domain of the world that they have already refined.
This is also the reason why the two Demon Gods could jointly withstand the continuous attacks of seven Supreme Experts, even if people like Adam Garcetti couldn’t inflict heavy injuries on the two Demon Gods or annihilate all the Purgatory Legions immediately.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The launched continental block smashed fiercely onto the Earth, and instantly, within tens of thousands of kilometers, the ground cracked, shaking the Heaven and Earth and triggering a rolling surge of demonic gas and a nuclear explosion’s radiant impact.
Mountain ranges on the continental block swayed, and the Earth fractured but, under the suppression of towering pillars of Dark Demons and chains of rule, it did not collapse.
Above the trembling Earth, two weakened Demon Gods, Belidier, stood firm, looking grimly at the entrance to the forbidden area that stretched over twenty thousand kilometers away.
Meanwhile, behind them, the surrounding air was saturated with blood light, and six Demon God figures emerged, instantly causing eight Demon Gods’ rule auras to converge, and the already shaking Earth sank fiercely.
At the same time, at the entrance to the forbidden area, which was thousands of kilometers away, seven figures emanating Supreme auras stood tall, their gazes cold as they looked over here.
Diorus spoke in a deep voice, “I didn’t expect the Divine Gods Alliance, which has always been cowering in a corner, and the Heavenly Feather Clan, which should have been annihilated by Tyris and the others, to appear.”
“Very well, since you have shown up here today, then join the Human Race in being buried together.”
Walking upon Yin and Yang, surrounded by black and white rule light, Adam Garcetti said calmly, “Diorus, you don’t actually believe you have a chance to win today, do you?”
Diorus’s gaze was cold, “That remains to be seen.”
At this moment, in terms of high-end Demon God-level power, the Purgatory Empire appeared to have an advantage, having one more “person”, and one of the Demon Gods’ strength surpassed all the other Demon Gods.
Therefore, even with the appearance of the Peak Divine King from the Divine Gods Alliance, Diorus was not overly apprehensive.
Boom!
Just then, a pressure as strong as a Demon God rose to the sky, and the True Martial Heavenly King, holding a black stele, stepped through the shattered Void to appear.
Suddenly, with eight opposed to eight, they stood confronting each other high in the sky, unlike the previous head-on conflict.
And this world, enveloped by sixteen powerful rule auras, was shaken by enormous pressures colliding, dividing Heaven and Earth into two.
On one side, Dark Demon Air rolled and formed into heavy dark clouds, shrouding tens of thousands of kilometers with eight terrifying figures standing within.
Among them were the Lord of the Empire from the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, Diorus, and the Demon Gods Carthius, all of whom had ancient mid-stage cultivation.
The two Demon Gods who suffered heavy injuries earlier were the Lord of the Empire from Grita War Demon Empire, Belidier, and Demon God Rudeus.
In addition, there was a Demon God from the Purgatory Ancestral Court, Levides, who once sealed Jack Clark with the power of four ancient ancestors and cut off his human Luck.
The other two Demon Gods were from the Alecasa Empire, one of whom, named Stephenl, was in the ancient mid-stage and had astonishing hidden energy fluctuations within.
The other named Adibadan, was in the ancient early stage but due to possessing a Pseudo-World Level weapon, his combat prowess was comparable to a mid-stage Demon God’s.
The remaining Demon God with the most terrifying aura was from the Saint Demon Anke Empire, the first War Demon under the most powerful Great Demon King, Sigitico.
On the side of the Human Race, the sky was filled with a variety of colors, permeated with divine charm.
Three Supreme Experts stood tall, the Sky-based God King appeared like a God from legends, with twelve pairs of metallic wings stretching behind him, radiating a Sacred Breath.
The Primordial True King was like an eight-armed Furious Ape, holding an Ancient Divine Weapon of terrifying power.
And there was the True Martial Heavenly King, whose mere presence was even stronger than a normal Demon God, along with three Heavenly Feather Clan God Kings and Tarodel, the Divine King sitting high on the Golden Divine Throne.
Boom!
Suddenly, space started shaking violently, and as sixteen rule auras interwove and collided, the collapsing space above them was descended upon by a force.
Emerging from a shattered Spatial Channel that resembled a Black Hole, Jack Clark appeared with his black hair draped over his shoulders, instantly filling the space with a heavy and Overbearing strength.
Although his Realm aura was only at the mid-level of a Heavenly King, the intangible pressure radiating from him was no less than that of an average Demon God.
Seeing the arrival of Jack Clark, True Martial Heavenly King, Primordial True King, and others all revealed a smile, including those three Heavenly Feather God Kings.
After all, Clark had, in a short period, single-handedly vanquished a Demon God.
Jack Clark glanced at the powerful figures showing their True Bodies, a smile spreading across his face, “Gentlemen, I’m not too late, am I?”
Adam Garcetti said with a slight smile, “You’ve arrived just in time.”
“Human Race, Darren Callum!” Seeing the terrifying aura of Jack Clark, Diorus, Carthius, and the Ancestral Court Demon God all wore a serious expression.
Previously, Clark had escaped their pursuit, and even managed to remove the Ancient Ancestor’s Seal by some means, but what was up with the pressure comparable to a Demon God’s at this moment?

﻿Chapter 1490: Chapter 561: Demon God Standoff, That Human Must Die_2 Chapter 1490: Chapter 561: Demon God Standoff, That Human Must Die_2 The Great Demon King, at the mid-realm level, actually made them all feel a veiled threat.
Within the dark clouds roiling with dark demon air, Diorus looked toward the towering figure shrouded in blood light and said gravely, “Sigitico, and the rest of you, this human must not be left alive.”
“His talent is horrifying. We must find a way to kill him today, even if it means we cannot severely damage the Human Race or even if I risk a heavy injury.”
“Is this human that important?” a demon god shrouded in blood light frowned, and two other demon gods from another empire were also somewhat astonished.
That human’s talent appeared to be strong, his oppressive power at the mid-realm level of the Great Demon King was comparable to an early period Demon God, but do you really have to be so exaggerated, Diorus?
Noticing the doubt on the faces of the three demon gods, the Demon Dragon Carthius gave a bitter smile, “My three comrades, never underestimate this human. His talent is truly frightening and grotesque.”
“Just over one Sun Wheel ago, his realm was only at the late myth period, and he ventured alone deep into our empire, within one Star Hour (one day) he killed seven demon kings, including one Great Demon King.”
“Later, under the combined forces of Diorus and myself, he summoned a very strong Giant Beast, which even inflicted a heavy injury on me.”
“And after being supported by Levides wielding the strength of four ancestors, who sealed off three known powerful abilities and cut off Race Luck, he still managed to escape.”
“Now, in just over a single Sun Wheel, he has not only broken the seal of the four ancestors’ power, but his cultivation has already stepped into the mid-realm level of the Great Demon King.”
“As for his strength…” Carthius paused here.
At that moment, including Sigitico, all three demon gods turned solemn and serious, and when they looked at the young black-haired human again, their eyes were filled with a horrifying intent to kill.
This human’s talent was indeed terrifying. Whether it was his exaggerated battle prowess or his fearsome cultivation speed, both were somewhat beyond their common sense.
This kind of exceptional genius from a different races civilization must die.
As a race with rich experience in annihilating other civilizations, these Purgatory Demon Gods were very familiar with the situation where a monster arises to save a dying race from destruction.
But those so-called monsters would always be discovered by the Purgatory Empire at the earliest opportunity and then crushed with the might of a thunderbolt.
Otherwise, once such geniuses, who garnered the luck of a civilization, grew up, even the Purgatory Family would have a headache, because such ‘persons’ are hard to kill.
Turning bad luck into good fortune, and gaining benefits from disasters—that describes these kinds of individuals.
Of course, hard to kill doesn’t mean unkillable; it just means countless deaths may occur or even drag down one or two demon gods in their fall.
Thinking this, Sigitico’s face turned somewhat ugly, “Diorus, knowing that this human had monstrous talent, how did you all allow him to grow to such a state?”
“Or are you always so incompetent in your tasks, having fought for hundreds of Sun Wheels, not only failing to destroy this ordinary civilization but also allowing the enemy to grow stronger?”
Toward the end, Sigitico’s tone had almost become a rebuke, his voice icy cold.
There was no helping it; the strength the Human Race displayed this time even made a demon god like Sigitico, who came from the strongest empire, feel somewhat troubled.
The equivalent of the battle power of nine Demon Gods—such a vast amount of high-end strength even surpassed that of his own empire.
Especially that Divine King named Tarodel—if he had been standing in the Divine Realm, even the Lord of the Saint Demon Anke Empire would find it difficult to defeat him.
This was a force that could be compared to an alliance of the top powers of three Purgatory Empires, and they had grown to this stage in just over twenty Sun Wheels.
And this growth occurred step by step under the siege of two Purgatory Empires, which was the reason for Sigitico’s ugly expression.
Utterly useless.
Faced with Sigitico’s inquiring tone, Diorus looked somewhat unsightly, considering he was the lord of an empire.
However, as Sigitico was a very strong ally they had specially invited for support, Diorus couldn’t really blow up in anger.
As Diorus looked troubled, the Demon Dragon Carthius gave a bitter smile, “Sigitico, this is not our fault. The main issue is that this human’s talent is too exaggerated.”
“Over the years, we have been suppressing their growth using the standard Civilization Battlefield model, including assassinating Federal Genius and upcoming talents of the Human Federation.”
“But this human is different. From the moment he came into recognition in his Inner World and entered the vast expanse of time, it only took a few Sun Wheels.”
“By the time we paid attention to him, he had already entered the frontline battlefield at the realm of the Nine Demonic Marks, and in that battle, he killed many demon kings.”
“At the time, despite our injuries, we tried to Suppress him with our hands, but we were blocked by other Human Supreme Experts and the crafting of forbidden weapons.”
“After that battle, Diorus immediately asked Belidier on this battlefield to craft the Cursed demon artifact and initiate a curse by tracing causality.”
“But that attempt to directly invoke a causality curse and kill, also allowed the opponent to escape.”
“By the time this human appeared again, in less than two Sun Wheels, he already dared to kill his way into the heart of my empire…” Carthius paused here.
What happened subsequently was already known to the three Demon Gods of Sigitico.
This human was indeed hard to kill, and his growth rate was terrifyingly fast; he had grown to his current state in just a few Sun Wheels.
“…This human must die,”
Sigitico said gravely, “It’s just that he has grown strong now, and it’s somewhat difficult to kill him, especially with so many Human Experts protecting him.”
“Prepare for a war of attrition first, and look for an opportunity. When the time comes…” said the eight Demon Gods as the Rule drifted around them.
And as those Demon Gods opposite were discussing something, Jack Clark also subtly felt a strong malice.
“Want to kill me, huh.” Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly.
What’s going on?
In terms of high-end power, the alliance even had one more than the opponent.
But both sides showed gravity and astonishment, both somewhat surprised by the opponent’s Demon God Level Powerhouses.
According to the Purgatory Empire’s estimate, counting the Divine King that the Divine Gods Alliance might send, the Human Race’s strongest level should be around six.
And two of them had only stepped into the Supreme Level in strength, their realm still being that of a Heavenly King.
However, it was unexpected that there were actually three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, making Diorus and the other Demon Gods who wished to crush the Human Race in one battle feel somewhat grave.
At the same time, the Human side was equally serious, as the number of Purgatory Demon Gods was two more than they had estimated.
Consequently, the plan to entangle their counterparts and then unite the remaining three Supreme forces to kill a Demon God also failed.
Fortunately, they gathered their power immediately, catching the opponent off guard and taking possession of the entrance to the forbidden area.

﻿Chapter 1491: Chapter 562 Decisive Battle Erupts, I Will Slaughter the Demon God Chapter 1491: Chapter 562 Decisive Battle Erupts, I Will Slaughter the Demon God “Miss Joseline, how long will it take for you to recover the Origin you expended this time?”
In the Chaotic Turbulent Region, as Jack Clark leapt across several space folds to descend upon the Frontline Battlefield, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, returning to the Chaotic Turbulent Region under the force of space-time distortion, lifted its head slightly.
Above its head, the Purple little dragon that had become skinny and even more slender over the past three days lay exhausted, yawning weakly.
Yiyiyaya!! Miss Joseline is very hungry, going to sleep for a long time this time.
This time, Jack Clark had formed a Time True Body with Demon God Level combat power, nearly draining the Purple little dragon dry.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Hard work, Miss Joseline, if we come across anything good beyond Law Level, I’ll let you eat it first to nourish your body.”
Yiyayaya!! Really, brother? Hearing that there was good food, the Purple little dragon’s eyes, which were just about to close for sleep, suddenly brightened.
“Really.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, of course, wouldn’t deceive this little one. The Purple little dragon was crucial for the later formation of nine Demon God Level Time True Bodies, and even nine True Spirit Level combat power Time True Bodies.
After the great battle of The Purgatory Family concludes, and Jack Clark’s cultivation breaks through to Supreme, with combat power comparable to that of a Monarch, he can slowly refine the Time True Bodies without external pressure.
By then, as long as the Purple little dragon’s Origin is sufficient, Jack Clark will need only a month to form the Nine Great True Bodies, effectively becoming equivalent to ten Civilization Emperors.
The thought alone is terrifying.
Boom!
A mountain peak in the distance suddenly collapsed as the Silver Giant Dragon that had been bored asleep for a few days shot up into the sky, its colossal body, reaching the Mythical Peak at 1,400 meters, stirring up a tumult that shook mountains and seas.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re back.”
“Mhm, back.” The Black Gold Giant Beast, resembling a ferocious mountain peak, nodded slowly, its black mane floating like flames.
At this moment, a seven-colored radiance flashed through the sky, and a large golden-blue Giant Dragon flew over elegantly, its curious gaze falling on the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“Thunderflame, are our enemies so troublesome this time? Have you been fighting this long?”
“Roar! Nearly forgot about that. Tim Abott, was that human’s enemy really powerful? Did you kill it?” The Silver Giant Dragon also remembered.
The time the Destruction Emperor Dragon was summoned this round was far longer than before; previously, its longest absence was only a Star Moment (half an hour).
Thus, both Giant Dragons subconsciously assumed that the enemy Jack Clark encountered was very strong since even the Destruction Emperor Dragon had to battle for three Star Hours (three days).
Confronted with the curious gazes of both Giant Dragons, the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head slightly, its breaths emitting a muffled growl: “No fight, this trip was just to discuss some matters.”
“Discuss matters?” Both Giant Dragons were baffled.
Ha ha, brother’s secret is only known to the great Miss Joseline. Atop the head of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon looked proudly at the Silver Giant Dragon and closed its eyes to fall into a deep sleep.
Without waiting for the two Giant Dragons to ask further, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a deep roar: “We still have to stay here a bit longer; there’s a great battle on the other side waiting for me to join.”
The Civilization War between the human race and the Purgatory Empire was just a prelude.
The real crisis lies with that hibernating Purgatory ancestor and the main forces of the other six Purgatory Empires, including Tyris fallen in the Deep Red World.
These pose the real threat.
The Great Demon King Tyris could, in collaboration with two Lords of the Empire and three Demon Gods, even withstand the Divine King of Light who temporarily possesses True Spirit Combat Power.
Plus, another Great Demon King, as famous as Tyris and even more renowned, along with two other Lords of the Empire, also wield True Spirit Level power and should not be underestimated.
Although the True Bodies can be summoned to the battlefield, they can only act as an initial surprise force, as the enemy will quickly discover the weakness of the Space-Time Summoning Technique.
And that is its lack of endurance.
Thus, if the Destruction Emperor Dragon gets entangled or even suppressed by that terrifyingly powerful Purgatory ancestor True Spirit, it wouldn’t be long before Jack Clark would be exhausted to death.
So, once the battle is over, the Destruction Emperor Dragon needs to quickly return to the Chaotic Domain and then lead the Giant Beast legions to support the human frontline.
Upon the Giant Beast True Body’s arrival at the battlefield, it can sustain itself indefinitely.
And with the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s defense, even if the Purgatory ancestor’s strength is greater than an average True Spirit, it is confident it can trade blows and heavily injure the opponent, relying on two drops of Rebirth Blood.
…
Standing upon the Firmament, absorbing the Chaos Crystal Core to heal his injuries and even coming a step closer to the Ninth Heaven Peak, Damon Lopes stood at a high altitude.
Surrounded by streaks of purple-black lightning, the Law Aura he emitted triggered natural thunderbolts within hundreds of kilometers, resembling the deities of Myth who wield Thunder.
Gazing into the horizon at the rolling Dark Demon Cloud and the boundless demon shadows within, Damon Lopes declared proudly, “Eddy Keller, just watch. This battle will be dominated by me, Daoist Master.”
In this moment, Damon Lopes was spirited and full of intense aura, causing Eddy Keller, also flying in the sky, to twitch at the corner of his mouth.
It used to be him who would force the show in front of Damon Lopes, an Innate Awakened One. Little did he expect that in just a few months, Damon Lopes would surpass him and could soon break through to the Legendary Realm. The Thunderbolt Power he wielded was even more potent than the Innate True Thunder of the past, filled with a terrifying aura of destruction.
Eddy Keller said languidly, “Don’t boast, Damon Lopes. You’re not even a Mythical King yet, and you think you can dominate the battlefield? That’s probably wishful thinking.”
“The only ones who can dominate the battlefield this time are those Supreme Experts above us, such as the Divine Martial Sky King Jack Clark!!”
