﻿Chapter 1492: Chapter 562: The Final Battle Erupts, I Will Slay the Demon God_2 Chapter 1492: Chapter 562: The Final Battle Erupts, I Will Slay the Demon God_2 “`
As they spoke, both instinctively looked up at the sky, but aside from the thick clouds and blue sunlight, they could see nothing.
The ground structure of the mythical world is special; the higher one goes, the stronger the gravity rules suppress the beings, and the spatial layers also change.
Therefore, as Jack Clark and the other seventeen Supreme Experts, Divine Kings, and Demon Gods confronted each other in the turbulent region above ten thousand kilometers, the overwhelming Law Power spread out, but Damon Lopes and the others actually felt little.
However, also due to the hindrance of space and distance, those with strength below that of a mythical being couldn’t see the scenes above the Firmament.
“Justin Welan.”
“I’m here, Captain.”
“Come with me, our squad’s mission is to hold position A105, located in the rear of the battlefield, to protect the Hellfire missile launch site.”
“Mandy Lewis, Crystal Lewis.”
“Senior Sister.”
“Our team’s task is to snipe any Purgatory Demon Race elites that might infiltrate and destroy important launch sites like the Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs in the rear. Let’s go.”
“Yes.”
Under the special care of the Purple Heaven Heavenly King, who presided over this army war, classmates on good terms with Jack Clark were directly assigned to the rear, avoiding immediate contact with danger.
A thousand kilometers above the ground, dozens of Heavenly Kings, Main Gods, and Great Demon Kings also spread out across the front lines, confronting each other from thousands of kilometers away.
Around Gabriel King, Purple Heaven Heavenly King, Overlord Dragon Heavenly King, and other powerhouses, worlds of Law revolved, and the intangible Law Power mingled with the Yin-Yang rules that pervaded heaven and earth.
Connected above to the Supreme Rule, and below to those Mythical Kings’ Law Power, it spread in all directions forming a colossal rule network, covering the entrance to the forbidden area one or two thousand kilometers vertically.
Beyond the entrance to the forbidden area was the boundless, tumultuous Abyss Demonic Aura that swallowed the sky and earth, exuding dense darkness, omen, and evil Aura.
If one were to look at this moment with a deeper layer of rule’s eyes, one would see the two confronting civilizations like two huge unknown creatures, baring their teeth and claws in constant collision.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The collision of the two civilizations’ forces caused constant explosions and expansions in the depths of space, a fearsome spectacle.
This moment, Gabriel King, including subordinates like Leo Hart and Gentry Gail, as well as the forty or so Heavenly Feather Deities, all wore solemn expressions.
Everyone had a feeling that today’s battle would be extremely brutal.
But just for today’s battle, in the past, under the mutual restraint between Demon Gods and Supreme beings, as one of the protagonists, the Transcendent Corps, Mythical Kings, and even Heavenly Kings would become supporting roles.
Because those who would decide the outcome, and even influence the battlefield, were tens of thousands of kilometers above, where behind Jack Clark, with his black hair flying, he gazed at the Twisted Space-Time of the Abyss World in the distance and suddenly transmitted his Divine Soul’s voice.
“Dear Seniors, try to delay your intervention as long as possible; I need some time to recover ‘injuries’.”
“Jack Clark, are you injured?” The Primordial True King and others were slightly taken aback.
In their perception, Jack Clark’s Aura was as Overbearing and strong as a Divine King at that moment and from inside out, he radiated a vigorous vitality, which did not seem like he was injured at all.
Jack Clark said calmly, “During my earlier Closed-door Cultivation, I injured my Life Origin, but thankfully, it’s not very serious – I just need half a day to recover.”
At this time, Jack Clark was indeed not speaking; within the depths of his body, strands of substantial golden life Radiance flickered, mending some cracks deep within his True Body.
Although there was the replenishment from the Purple little dragon’s Creation Origin, Jack Clark still had to maintain a Limit Breakthrough state, burning his Life Origin, to exploit a BUG.
Such an injury rooted in his ‘foundation’, even with Jack Clark’s formidable strength, required some time to heal.
This was still when the ‘injury’ was very ‘light’ — the appearance of robust Vitality was just a residual illusion from the little dragon’s energy.
If his True Body’s energy ran out and his Life Origin depleted, forcibly Summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon would directly enter a state of burning his Origin.
Without the help of the Purple little dragon by then, it could get very tricky, such as his cultivation would come to a standstill before his foundation recovered.
No one expected that Jack Clark had an injured Origin. Adam Garcetti said slowly, “In that case, after the big battle breaks out later, we will deal with those Demon Gods; you just focus on suppressing those Great Demon Kings, Jack Clark.”
“`
At the moment, Demon God Level Powerhouses on their side had a numerical advantage. Given that Jack Clark was injured and not suitable for joining the battle of Demon Gods, it would be better to go and kill the enemy’s middle and high-end strength.
However, Jack Clark shook his head slightly at this suggestion.
“Killing a few more Great Demon Kings won’t be of much help to the current situation the alliance is facing. We must kill several more Demon Gods, or even annihilate all of these Demon Gods.”
Jack Clark’s words left the others stunned.
But before they could speak up, Jack Clark suddenly announced with bombastic resolve, “Senior Adam Garcetti, when the time comes, you all must fight with all your might to entangle these Demon Gods, even if it means burning your Origin, you must not let them escape.”
“I want to try and see if I can annihilate them all, or at least leave half of them.”
Even Adam Garcetti could not help being astonished at this moment, his expression turning solemn, “…Jack Clark, are you sure you’re not joking?”
Leaving at least half…! Those were Demon Gods who mastered unique laws, not Mythical Kings.
Such existences, not to mention their power to destroy Heaven and Earth, possessed incredibly terrifying vitality alone. Their souls and laws’ True Bodies had fused, already containing certain undying and immortal characteristics.
Moreover, with their powerful Secret Skills and Divine Power, unless four or five strong men of the same rank joined hands, it would be extremely difficult to capture a fleeing Demon God, to say nothing of killing at least four Demon Gods.
Because if a single Demon God falls, the rest will be mentally shaken. It is inevitable that they will flee at the first opportunity.
Even the Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan, who had witnessed Jack Clark slay Demon Gods, could not help but frown, feeling that Jack Clark might be getting carried away after having killed an ancient early stage Demon God.
There was also a flicker of doubt in the eyes of the Divine King Tarodel. This absolute genius of the Human Race seemed to slightly underestimate the Demon Gods.
“I am certainly not joking.”
In front of the eight Divine Kings, whose True Bodies of laws spanned ten thousand, even more than ten thousand meters, Jack Clark, still in human form, seemed as small as an ant, yet his aura was no less imposing.
Jack Clark said slowly, “By my own strength, naturally, I cannot accomplish this. However, a ‘Person’ will take action in due time.”
Suddenly, the reaction came from the Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan. The Golden Winged Divine King instinctively said, “You mean that Giant Beast that repelled Tyris with one strike!”
“Exactly, I plan to Summon its True Body to descend at that time,” Jack Clark nodded slightly.
At this moment, the three Divine Kings all recalled that terrifying Breath that pierced through Heaven and Earth, repelling Tyris who wielded the dark demon blade.
Adam Garcetti, along with the Primordial True Kings, also realized this because the True Martial Heavenly King had returned earlier and mentioned the horrendous Thunderflame Beheamoth’s Breath.
Seeing this, Tarodel’s gaze shifted slightly, thinking back to the strong threat he had sensed coming from the depths of the dark area when they reconvened with the Heavenly Feather Clan.
The Light Wing Divine King Segovia radiated a terrifying murderous intent, “This time, even if we exhaust all our strength, we will find a way to leave behind a Purgatory Demon God.”
“Four of them, there is indeed hope,” the Primordial True King slowly nodded in agreement.
If they were to add the combat strength of the Thunderflame Beheamoth, which could rival a Great Demon King and perhaps was even slightly stronger, they might truly be able to suppress several Demon Gods today.
However, this meant they would need to reconvene and formulate a new plan.
Like who would hold off the strongest Demon Gods including Diorus and how to create opportunities for Jack Clark to swiftly eliminate the slightly weaker Demon Gods.
Meanwhile, as the Human Race was discussing how to surround and kill the Demon Gods, Diorus and the other Demon Gods were also making preparations to surround and kill Jack Clark.
These Demon Gods possessed powerful weapons from different races, one of which was a Race Background Weapon called “Creation Extending Heaven-Sealing”, capable of briefly sealing a Demon God’s laws.
In addition, there was a forbidden weapon capable of shaking the Divine Soul of a Demon God Level Powerhouse, the Abyss Bone Demon Horn, and others.
But once the great battle of Demon Gods broke out, they would all have opponents, necessitating some covert preparations to launch a deadly strike against that human genius.
As both sides made their calculations, time rapidly slipped away, and soon half a day had passed.
Suddenly, Diorus roared.
“Kill!”
Boom! In an instant, a catastrophic battle that could Destroy Heaven and Earth erupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 1493 - 1493 563 The Defeated Jack Clark Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1493: Chapter 563: The Defeated Jack Clark, Emperor Dragon Roars Chapter 1493: Chapter 563: The Defeated Jack Clark, Emperor Dragon Roars High above the firmament, at the height of ten thousand kilometers, a Demon God level battle suddenly erupted, shocking the various Heavenly Kings, Great Demon Kings, and king-level demon kings who were ready for combat below.
“Kill!”
Boom!
Endless Black Flames surged from Diorus, who was at the Ancient Middle Stage realm, rising to the sky as if the flames could burn the seas and cook the heavens, resembling a colossal, boundless black lotus.
The dense power of time and age permeated the center of the Lotus Stand, mysteriously connecting the past and future, forming a winding transparent river extending toward the future.
Boom! In an instant, a Terrifying Aura descended, and atop the transparent river of time, a Demon God appeared, strikingly similar to ‘Diorus’.
However, this Demon God who descended from the future wielded an Aura several times stronger than Diorus, with Black Flames burning underfoot, shattering the Void with a terrifying momentum.
This was Diorus’s bloodline Divine Power, which allowed him to summon a past or future self by sacrificing the strength of his bloodline as a burnt offering.
In an instant, the high-end Demon God level battlefield, already balanced at eight against nine, became nine against nine.
Two identical Demon Gods stood above the sky, surrounded by boundless Black Flames, exuding a Terrifying Power capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
“Adam Garcetti, today shall be the day your Human Race is annihilated.”
The two Dioruses roared, shattering the Void. Behind them, Hell Rule Flames burned as they lunged at the First Councilor Adam Garcetti and the Second Councilor, the Sky-based God King.
In their hands, they each held a magic spear entwined with nine dragons, with rules coiling around it, forming nine Dark Demon Dragons, each fifty thousand meters long, shrouding Heaven and Earth.
“To think a True Body would dare to come here, seeking death.” Adam Garcetti’s gaze turned cold as a black and white Divine Wheel emerged behind him, brilliantly illuminating.
Under the reflection of the Ancient Divine Weapon, the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel, the entire world was segregated by the Rule of power into realms of Yin and Yang, leaving only the huge Divine Wheel descending from the sky.
And there stood Adam Garcetti above, with one foot in Yin and the other in Yang, wielding the power of life and death.
This was the true strength of the First Councilor Adam Garcetti, a Divine Wheel exuding a powerful Aura of Yin-Yang Rules, and he himself mastered a high-level Rule of Life and Death.
Bang bang bang! Underneath the world-dividing Yin-Yang Divine Wheel, the nine Dark Demon Dragons kept collapsing and exploding, emitting furious roars.
Boom!
The Golden-White Divine Wheel, crushing the Demon Dragon, did not lose momentum and in an instant struck down on the Dark Nine Dragons magic spear, resulting in an earth-shattering rumble as though two worlds had collided.
As the two Terrifying Powers intersected, a ring of black gold radiance exploded, sweeping thousands of kilometers at the speed of light, tearing apart the Heavenly Earth Laws as it passed, obliterating all things.
In the center of the explosion, Diorus let out a muffled grunt, feeling a Rule power grinding Yin and Yang and the alternating forces of life and death washing over him, causing even his towering form to sink and the scale armor on his arms to crack apart.
Even though they were both at the Ancient Middle Stage realm, Diorus found himself at a disadvantage against Adam Garcetti straight away.
As the strongest of the Human Race, it used to take two Demon Gods to contend with Adam Garcetti, and Diorus also needed to summon a past or future True Body to do so.
This was also the reason Adam Garcetti had earlier declared it was seeking death, even with a high-level Pseudo-World Level Weapon in hand.
At the same time, facing ‘Future Diorus,’ the Sky-based God King spread the twelve pairs of wings on his back, emitting an immeasurable radiance and forming a heavenly kingdom world around him.
“It seems I have been underestimated.”
In contemplation, a figure hundreds of kilometers tall ‘slowly’ rose behind the Sky-based God King, grasping all the radiance of the heavenly kingdom world with one palm down.
Instantly, hymns of light and devotion resounded through the Void, as if from numerous worlds, countless dimensions, living beings were praising the supreme light.
Bang!
The Seal of God met with a dark red deep world of the Abyss, and the entirety of the sky shook violently, sending countless shattered spatial fragments flying in all directions, generating a spatial storm sweeping across ten thousand kilometers.
However, as this destructive shockwave spread downward, it was continuously weakened by the invisible Rule powers between heaven and earth, dissipating into nothingness after spreading a thousand kilometers.
Even so, the terrifying power undulations that diffused invisibly still caused the various Heavenly Kings and demon kings below to be utterly astounded.
This clash was an evenly matched confrontation.
While Diorus made his move, the other seven Demon Gods also daringly attacked.
Carthius, who manifested a Darkness Demon Dragon true form of ten thousand meters and roared like an Ancient Beast, lunged at the Primordial True King wielding a massive Wolf Tooth Staff.
Under the formidable true form, space shattered in layers, creating concentric rings of black Destructive Shockwaves sweeping through Heaven and Earth.
Roar!
The Primordial True King, in the form of an Eight-armed Furious Ape, let out an inhuman roar, four arms raised high while the other four formed rune seals: “Carthius, do you think I’m still the same as before?”
Among the Three Great Speakers, the strength of the Primordial True King was the weakest, having only broken through to the Ancient Middle Stage not long ago.
In the past, while defending the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield with the Sky-based God King, he had fought with Carthius many times, with neither gaining an upper hand over the other.
But today was different, for he, the Primordial True King, possessed a complete Ancient Divine Weapon.
Boom!
Beneath the heaven-shattering Wolf Tooth Staff, the world around the already wounded Dark Demon Dragon shattered, its right claw was directly severed by the impact, causing it to let out a scream.
One of the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, the strongest among them, Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy, pounced on the heavily injured Belidier, who wielded a Pseudo-World Level Weapon.
And below, powered by the combined strength of countless Purgatory True Demons, demon kings, and Great Demon Kings, Belidier’s Aura soared by several times.
The other Divine King of the Ancient Early Stage from the Heavenly Feather Clan, Tristique, faced an equally wounded opponent, Rudeus, who wielded an ancient saber—a Race Background Weapon of different races.

chapters.title: Chapter 1494 - 1494 563 The Defeated Jack Clark Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1494: Chapter 563: The Defeated Jack Clark, Emperor Dragon Roars_2 Chapter 1494: Chapter 563: The Defeated Jack Clark, Emperor Dragon Roars_2 The Ancestral Demon God Levides appeared before the Light Wing Divine King Segovia, behind it a towering gate that reached into the clouds, entwined with the wailing silhouettes of numerous different races, stood tall and firm.
The True King Heavenly King, with a black stele in hand, faced Stephenl from the Alecasa Empire.
“You dare to approach me, do you not fear death?” seated high upon the Golden Divine Seat, Tarodel glanced indifferently at the ancient late-stage demon god in the distance.
Surrounded by terrifying blood light that distorted space-time, forming an Abyss Blood Hellish World in a radius of a thousand kilometers, Sigitico spoke slowly, his voice deep, “A piece of trash that only dares to hide in the Divine Realm, quite the big talker!”
In contrast to other Demon Gods’ true bodies with three heads and twelve arms or eighteen arms, Sigitico’s demon god true body stood over eighteen thousand meters tall and had a comparatively ‘normal’ form with just one head and two arms.
Covered in thick blood scale armor, his arm and leg joints and both shoulders boasted sharp backward-pointing spurs, while a row of bone spurs extended from his back all the way to the tip of his tail, which resembled a dragon’s.
Additionally, his skull was covered in blood bone armor, his sharp and straight spiral dragon horns, and his blood-red hair danced wildly like flames, making him appear very fierce.
And the aura he exuded was even more terrifying. Without even making a move, the invisible and dangerous aura he emitted caused the surrounding battling demons and divine kings to subconsciously keep their distance.
“Trash… It’s the first time in many years that anyone has dared to say that word in front of me.” In the faint voice, the silver-haired young man, with a third eye on his forehead, slowly stood up from the Golden Divine Seat.
Instantly, a pressure that made heaven and earth tremble spread out, boundless golden light painted the heaven and earth, laws, rules, energy, matter—all turned into gold.
Including the Abyss Blood Hell that covered a radius of a thousand kilometers around Sigitico, which also got slowly eroded by that overwhelmingly overbearing golden rule and turned into gold.
Sigitico’s gaze sharpened.
What kind of rule power is this, so overbearing that it can even forcefully render my fully matured Abyss Blood Hell rule? The strength of this person is indeed unfathomable.
In solemnity, Sigitico’s robust arms became covered in blood dragon scales, and in the blink of an eye, they transformed into a pair of two thousand meter long sabers engraved with countless mysterious blood demon patterns.
Roar!
At the very moment when those gigantic sabers appeared, an extremely fierce roar sounded, and suddenly a real Abyss Blood Sea Hell descended.
As a top-tier demon that has vanquished and destroyed the civilizations of various different races, Sigitico naturally would not underestimate any opponent.
Standing tall in the golden world, the three-eyed young man looked on with an indifferent gaze, “You melded a genuine Abyss, just one step from ascending, have you? This is the confidence that made you dare to challenge me.”
“But this alone is not enough.”
Boom! The sky fell and the earth sank as a huge boundless golden palm descended from the heavens, covering the sky and the sun. Beneath this palm, the void collapsed and the ages trembled.
Even the rules of heaven and earth were suppressed by the force contained in this palm, utterly overbearing.
The dreadful might caused demon gods like Diorus, who were thousands of kilometers away and battling with Adam Garcetti, to feel some palpitations.
Including the Sky-based God King, Primordial True King, and others witnessing Tarodel’s move for the first time were also somewhat surprised by the strength of this ancient divine king who hadn’t made a move in so many years.
Roar!
Facing this palm that suppressed the heavens, the Abyss Blood Hell’s blood light surged, and two saber lights like blood dragons soared into the sky, emanating a fiercely sharp aura and ferocious Dragon Might.
Boom!
The two saber lights, each one hundred thousand meters long, crossed and slashed at the descending golden palm, exploding into a tangible rumble and resonance.
Between the saber light and golden palm, rings of dazzling radiance continuously exploded outward, the saber light constantly shattered, but the golden palm developed cracks as well.
Roar!
With a bellow, Sigitico’s body emitted terrifying blood light as his arms, transformed into gargantuan Dragon Slaying Blades, burst with power in a thunderous blast that shattered the golden palm.
The exploding rule power formed rings of golden halos that shined and shook tens of thousands of kilometers of heaven and earth with an awe-inspiring sound.
In the midst of the golden light that filled the sky, Sigitico, wrapped in blood light, let out another fierce roar and lunged toward Tarodel, who was holding a golden divine temple in his hands.
Infinitely, the battle between the two highest realm ‘strong men’ erupted.
At the same time as the battle broke out, Jack Clark was also approached by a demon god, one from the Alecasa Empire named Adibadan.
Ancient late stage against ancient late stage, ancient mid stage against ancient mid stage, but this demon god of the ancient early stage challenged Jack Clark, a Heavenly King in the mid stage whose oppressive power was comparable to that of an ordinary demon.
It seemed that in this battle, the demons were acting very normally, king against king, general against general, rather than the tactics of undermatched against superior, or superior against average.
But just as this demon god, seasoned by battles from the Immortal Spirit Battlefield, appeared a thousand kilometers away from Jack Clark, an icy voice, like that of a venomous snake, rang out between heaven and earth.
“Human, go to hell.”
Boom!
Behind this demon god, each of the fourteen arms held five forbidden weapons, all from the intrinsic weapons of different races, which exploded, instantly flooding the world with terrifying radiance.
It was as if a treasure, golden as jade, burst into flames, sending out transparent, jade-colored ripples that vibrated through space-time and enveloped Jack Clark.
Under the terrifying power of sealing the heavens and locking the earth, all the strength within Jack Clark’s body condensed in an instant, as if it was wiped away from existence, unable to be mobilized.
Whether it was the rudimentary Supreme Rule or the Power of Divine Power, including the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill, its might was even greater than the Heritage Token originally obtained by Jack Clark.
Beyond that, the moment another black, bony horn-like forbidden weapon self-destructed, the shadow of a demon skull that could swallow heaven and earth emerged, emitting a silent roar.
Boom!
Under the soul-impacting howl capable of shaking a demon god, Jack Clark’s Divine Soul, which had already merged with his True Body, shimmered, unable to control and mobilize the power within his body.
And still, it wasn’t over; centered around Jack Clark, within a hundred-kilometer radius, the space solidified out of nowhere under the cutting of countless green rule chains, forming an incredibly solid cube.
And there Jack Clark was, like an insect trapped in amber, together with that space, solidified by the self-destruction of the intrinsic weapons of other races.
At the same time, a ring of distorted, black and transparent shockwaves swept across heaven and earth, casting shadows on the seven demon gods of Diorus, who suddenly turned around.
Boom boom boom!! Eight demon gods from the Ancient Middle Stage and Late Stage unleashed a Full-Force Strike that destroyed heaven and earth, their terrifying power crossing space-time to envelop Jack Clark from all directions.
Meanwhile, Sigitico, who was in combat with Tarodel, vanished under the influence of a time-distorting power and appeared not far from Jack Clark.
And Adibadan, who self-destructed three forbidden weapons comparable to Pseudo-World Level weapons and two intrinsic weapons of different races, appeared in front of Tarodel.
All this happened in the blink of an eye.
Sealing all powers with a secret skill, cutting and solidifying space, shaking the Divine Soul, casting the shadows of seven demon gods to strike with full force.
Even the dreadful Sigitir from the ancient late stage, whose true target was actually Jack Clark in the mid-period of the Heavenly King, only pretended to battle Tarodel.
Nobody imagined the demon gods’ murderous intent towards Jack Clark could be so intense that they would self-destruct their forbidden weapons and burn their intrinsic weapons for a fatal blow at him first.
“Diorus, you’re seeking death.”
In an instant, Adam Garcetti and others went mad, their terrifying rule light bursting forth, striking the momentarily paused demon gods of Diorus that were reflected in the shadows, causing them to spit blood.
But it was all too late.
Boom! Blood-red blade lights that severed the world crossed paths, and with the collective strike of the seven demon gods, the solidified space surrounding Jack Clark shattered and exploded.
Even the firmament above was instantly pierced with a hole about four thousand kilometers in diameter, filled with an indescribable Destructive Aura.
An immensely powerful force pierced heaven and earth, creating a black and red beam, entwined with the eight rules and about a thousand kilometers thick, which descended from the sky and fell in the middle of the two battlefields.
In that moment, the sky crumbled and the earth split, the land within ten thousand kilometers shattered.
Boom boom boom!!
Countless bits of dirt and rubble rose up into the sky under the rapidly expanding Destructive Glow, flung thousands of kilometers high, surrounded by rings of billowing smoke and dust, a sight that was both shocking and earth-shattering.
The destructive explosion’s impact caused all the king-level and demon kings to change their expressions dramatically, with Gabriel and others having their Laws World shine even brighter.
“Be careful.”
“We can’t block it, pay attention to protecting the rear Main Battle Legions…”
The horrific strike surprised everyone, including a ‘Jack Clark’ more than twenty thousand kilometers away, whose gaze was grave as he watched his temporal True Body being obliterated by the assault.
“Good thing, I was on guard after sensing danger through the Heart’s Eye.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark’s gaze fell on Sigitico, who had a surge of Blue Radiance on the back of his left hand.
Roar! In an instant, a roar filled with terrifying majesty echoed through heaven and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1495 - 1495 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1495: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God Chapter 1495: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God Roar! The terrifying dragon roar echoed between heaven and earth.
More than 20,000 kilometers away from the battlefield of the demon gods, an aura that made even Tarodel, the Divine King, and Sigitico, the Demon God, feel threatened descended.
On a summoning altar that was spread out over an area of a hundred kilometers, blue radiance flickered and space twisted.
The sudden turn of events startled all the supreme divine kings of the Human Alliance and even the Purgatory Demon Gods, who fiercely pulled back from their opponents and turned their heads towards that direction.
There, a giant beast had already stood up from the gloomy blue summoning formation.
Its immense body undulated like mountain ranges, with black gold peaks standing erect upon its back, and thick scale armor studded with raised scale horns covered its body—resembling, yet not resembling a dragon, it was imposing and ferocious.
This giant beast was clearly only a little over 7,000 meters long, not even as large as a common demon god’s true body.
But the instant the likes of the Golden Winged Divine King saw it, it was as if they glimpsed the boundless firmament—vast, majestic, with an aura filling heaven and earth, blocking out the sun.
Such a dreadful power made all the demon gods subconsciously show fear in their eyes.
Diorus, Carthius, and the Ancestral Demon God Levides’ complexions drastically changed as they sensed the ancient aura emanating from the black gold giant and couldn’t believe it.
“It’s that human’s summoned giant beast, but how is this possible…!?”
In front of a Sun Wheel, when Jack Clark launched an attack on the rear of the Purgatory Empire, he had summoned this giant beast, which heavily injured the Demon God Carthius while Diorus was restrained by the Time Dragon.
And at that time, the realm of the giant beast was only at the early Titan phase.
Now, just one Sun Wheel later, this giant beast with its heaven-defying combat power had already become a creature of the Ancient Level, and its aura was even more terrifying and powerful.
Furthermore, the sight of Jack Clark, with his black hair dancing wildly, standing at the edge of the Time-Space Summoning Altar beside the giant beast, also left those demon gods dumbfounded.
Because just now, hadn’t Jack Clark been obliterated by the premeditated strike from their joint effort, along with the self-destruction of five forbidden weapons? Hadn’t both his true body and divine soul been destroyed?
And even the breath of life had disappeared.
That unmistakable sensation of the rules of the true body dissipating, and the divine soul shattering, couldn’t be faked, so how had he reappeared?
While those demon gods were shocked and amazed, Adam Garcetti and the others were also somewhat astonished, but at the same time, a great weight lifted from their hearts.
There was no helping it; Jack Clark’s ‘demise’ had not only deceived those demon gods, but Adam Garcetti and company also had not discerned the truth and thought that a true accident had transpired.
While everyone was still in shock, a serpentine, transparent small river emerged behind Jack Clark.
Above the small river, another ‘Jack Clark’ slowly materialized from nothing.
However, compared to the imposing manner of the earlier convergence, the aura of the Time True Body was very weak, giving off a feeling of being damaged and incomplete.
Yet even in such a state, it caused Diorus and other demon gods to be startled once more, and the Demon Dragon Carthius roared in anger, “Time-Type Divine Power, it’s somewhat similar to Diorus summoning past and future true bodies.”
“No wonder, the one we obliterated just now was Darren Callum’s Time True Body, not his main body!”
Earlier, when Jack Clark sensed the intense malevolence in the demon gods’ gaze and the warning of danger from the Heart’s Eye, he distorted the space around him with the power of rules, shielding the line of sight and switching places with the Time True Body.
As for the Time True Body being destroyed, and the breath of the soul vanishing, it was irrelevant.
As long as the Time Mark remained, Jack Clark could use the Power of Time to re-condense it.
However, the joint strike of the eight demon gods, coupled with the explosive power of five great forbidden weapons, was terrifyingly mighty, and the Time Mark was damaged.
Though the Time True Body had re-condensed, its aura had plummeted from mid-period Heavenly King to Mythical Peak.
But it was enough. With the combat power of Jack Clark at the Mythical Peak boosted by the burst of the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate, he could barely engage an early-phase demon god.
From when those demon gods sensed the arrival of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to when Jack Clark showed the river of the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power to re-condense his damaged body, all happened within an extremely short time.
So quickly that those demon gods simply had no time to prevent it.
Roar!
The summoned Destruction Emperor Dragon roared to the heavens, its body radiating red brilliance, and under the Crimson Rule, its body inflated rapidly, transforming in the blink of an eye into a Red Beast over 20,000 meters long.
Instantly the already terrifying aura, comparable to the Peak of the Ancient, became even more frightening, almost reaching the Ancient Limit, pressing down so heavily that the entire world momentarily darkened.
Even Sigitico’s face changed color, for such formidable power had only been sensed from two Great Demon Kings.
But that was not enough.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body burst forth with a pitch-black power like flames, igniting into a fierce blaze.
Under the annihilating Black Flames, where all things disintegrated and heavenly earth rules crumbled, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s size surged once more, reaching 30,000 meters as its muscles swelled, bulging the scale armor.
It resembled a world-devouring beast in ferocious armor.
Upon its massive body, crimson lightning crackled, and Black Flames raged, emanating an aura that made all ‘persons’ tremble in fear, towering above both Divine Kings and Demon Gods.
Amidst the terrifying power, everything within hundreds of thousands of kilometers shook, all life lost its color, and it seemed as if the universe itself was returning to Chaos—a horrifying and awe-striking scene.
And the end was not yet in sight, for as Diorus and the other demon gods hadn’t even recovered from their stupor, a Deep Red World descended behind the final form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
In an instant, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s body blazed with endless red light, its aura surged another notch, and sharp bone spurs grew from all its joints, wrapped in blood-red light, utterly ferocious.

chapters.title: Chapter 1496 - 1496 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1496: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_2 Chapter 1496: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_2 In that instant, an aura that could annihilate everything and lead the world into doomsday spread out.
Even in the Void, mysterious whispers of unknown languages with words like ‘Doomsday,’ ‘Destruction,’ and ‘Extermination of All Beings’ faintly resounded.
Within hundreds of thousands of kilometers, no matter if they were the Great Demon Kings, demon kings, or those Purgatory True Demons and vassal alien races, including the Human Race’s allied army, all trembled under this aura.
At the rear of the Human Race army, Mandy Lewis lifted her head with a terrified look, staring at the sky filled with an endless Dark Red Glow, her voice quivering, “Sis, what is this power? It’s terrifying.”
“I, I don’t know.” Crystal Lewis’s face was ashen, her legs trembling under the oppressive and heart-palpitating invisible force.
Damon Lopes, who stood high in the sky and whose strength had already been comparable to that of a Mythical King, stood firmly on Earth, struggling to keep his stance and not fall to the ground.
He was the genius who had just declared he would dominate the battlefield; how could he sit down?
At the very least, he couldn’t sit down in front of Eddy Keller, who was already sprawled on the ground.
At this moment, aside from those Demon Gods who mastered the rules and Heavenly Kings who had independent Laws Worlds condensed within them, no other figure could be seen in the sky.
This included the over one hundred million soldiers of the Purgatory Legion and the Flying Demonized Giant Beasts that blotted out the sun.
In front of a True Spirit level existence, creatures below the Titan Level had no right to fly, and even people like Gabriel could barely manage to stay aloft.
The aura of Chaos and Doomsday was simply too terrifying; even from tens of thousands of kilometers away, the invisible pressure emitted made it difficult for Heavenly Kings to resist.
While those below were shocked and clueless, Heavenly Feather and the other Divine Kings above the Firmament at tens of thousands of kilometers were even more horrified.
“True Spirit!”
“How is that possible?”
Even Adam Garcetti and others were shocked by the strength of the Thunderflame Beheamoth at this moment.
Including the True Martial Heavenly King, who had witnessed that Breath from back then.
They had never imagined that the Thunderflame Mutant Beast, which had left Blue Star just half a year ago, had not only become an Ancient Beast but had also broken through its limits to reach the Civilization Emperor Level.
As for Diorus and other Demon Gods, their faces were extremely grave and filled with horror, and the thought of retreating emerged in their minds at the first moment.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon entered its most powerful form, Jack Clark let out a long howl that resounded through Heaven and Earth, “Seniors, ten minutes, hold them at full strength.”
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark’s voice fell, the terrifying beast that represented Chaos and Doomsday shattered the Void beneath its feet with one step, smashing through space to appear ten thousand kilometers away.
With another stride, its massive body once again crossed ten thousand kilometers, appearing atop Sigitico, who stood at the center of the raging tempest.
“We can’t let them escape.”
The instant the Destruction Emperor Dragon made its move, the three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, who harbored intense hatred for the Purgatory True Demons, also reacted instantly, burning their Origin.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings radiated dazzling gold and White Light and pounced toward the Demon God Belidier, Rudeus, and the Ancestral Demon God Levides.
The arrival of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, along with its terrifying Doomsday form, gave them hope of annihilating all the Demon Gods.
They also recalled what Jack Clark had said earlier, “I want to try and see if I can kill them all, or at least leave half alive.”
Although they had agreed on the surface, they had felt the hope was slim, after all, they were facing eight Demon Gods. But now…
“Today, all of you will die,” bellowed the Light Wing Divine King Segovia, furious.
The Speaker Adam Garcetti had the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel blazing behind him, his hand wielding life and death as he howled, “Heavenly base, Primordial, entangle them and buy time for Jack Clark.”
“Hahahaha… Don’t worry, not one of them will get away today,” laughed the Primordial True King, resembling an eight-armed Furious Ape. His Rule Origin erupted, wielding a thirty-thousand-meter-long Wolf Tooth Staff that shattered the Void, lunging at the fleeing Demon Dragon Carthius.
Adam Garcetti and others aimed to Suppress and detain those Demon Gods while the Demon Gods themselves realized over the first few moments.
“We can’t get entangled, retreat, all demons retreat,” Diorus roared in shock and anger, his voice echoing across tens of thousands of kilometers, not only alerting the other Demon Gods but also the legions below.
That terrifying Giant Beast was unstoppable and had to be fled from, or else all Demon Gods would fall today.
“The thought of leaving us behind is impossible.”
Under the threat of a True Spirit level Giant Beast, all Demon Gods chose to burn their Origin in the first moments, with some opting to clash directly with Adam Garcetti and others, while some even detonated their demon arms outright.
Boom, boom, boom!!
It was difficult to intercept Demon God level beings wanting to escape, especially those who disregarded their injuries, thus within mere breaths, the battlefield spread over a hundred thousand kilometers.
Divine Kings and Demon Gods enveloped in rule forces clashed fiercely, shaking space-time and turning the energy of Heaven and Earth within a hundred thousand kilometers into a violent tempest.
Occasionally, a streak of Radiance descended from the sky, landing on Earth and in an instant, destroying everything, tearing open a ten-thousand-kilometer-long Abyssal crack.
But not all Demon Gods managed to escape.
Tarodel, who was previously walking casually, subdued the shock in his eyes and turned to an ancestral Demon God from the ancient early stage thousands of kilometers away, his gaze suddenly turning cold.
“You have courage, daring to face me directly,” Tarodel’s rumbling voice said as his third eye in the brow emanated a dazzling golden light.
In an instant, above Adibadan’s head, a golden Great Sun with a diameter of a thousand kilometers emerged, resembling a golden eye, casting a soul-petrifying terrifying light.

chapters.title: Chapter 1497 - 1497 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1497: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_3 Chapter 1497: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_3 Boom!
The self-destruct forbidden weapon detonated, and the surrounding Rule Domain of Adibadan—whose true body had already shattered halfway—collapsed, spurting blood, with his formidable body riddled with huge cracks.
Merely under the gaze of golden eyes, Adibadan was directly suppressed by the Divine King Tarodel, who was not even in his peak state.
Under the invincible power of the Divine Power infused in the golden pupils, Adibadan turned into a burning black meteorite falling from the sky.
Boom!
The land shattered for thousands of kilometers around, a vast nuclear explosion light burgeoned, and within the blast radius, a dozen Purgatory Legions were instantly wiped out.
In the moment those Demon Gods fled, Sigitico also let out a roar, watching the terrifying Giant Beast pounce toward it, with seventy-two red Demon God Pillars rising from the surrounding Abyssal Blood Prison.
These Bloody Prison Demon Pillars reached from Heaven to Earth, each one wrapped in countless corpses of different races and Dragon-type Giant Beasts, with their blood flowing down—a horrifying sight.
With the power of the seventy-two Demon God Pillars, Sigitico’s aura surged, and the Pseudo-World Level weapons in his hands—Dragon Slaying Double Blades—dripped with blood, emitting a dazzling blood light, resonating with the Abyssal Blood Prison.
Boom!
Two terrifying blade lights, each a hundred thousand meters long and entwined with the Sea of Blood from the Abyss, fell, cleaving through the Void, with the edge and aura that seemed to rival the peak of ancient times.
“Scram!”
A deep and powerful roar echoed through Heaven and Earth as black flames blazed into being, with Dragon Claws enshrouded in golden-red lightning descending like a world of Crimson Chaos.
In an instant, the blade light transformed by the Dragon Slaying Double Blades shattered, followed by the world of Blood Prison that had descended from the Abyss, also trembling violently, emitting endless blood light and bursting continuously.
In front of that Overbearing and Doomsday power of Chaos, everything was irresistible, unable to withstand.
Boom!
Sigitico, who stood at the center of the Abyssal Blood Prison, let out a scream. His formidable body was torn to pieces in an instant, directly blasted apart by the strike of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
But as a Demon God at the ancient late stage realm, Sigitico had experienced countless battles over the years, and his combat experience was incredibly rich.
At the moment his true body was shattered, a massive arm thousands of kilometers long, covered in torn flesh and blood, released a terrifying amount of energy near the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
His nearly grandly accomplished Rule True Body Origin exploded with incredibly terrifying power; even the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was blasted, faltering before vanishing from sight.
The explosion of a mere arm of an ancient late-stage Demon God released energy and destructive power of the rules nearly equivalent to a Full-Force Strike of Sigitir.
Such force, striking the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, did nothing but make its scales shine brighter, it couldn’t shake its invincible Defense.
But in the moment the Doomsday Emperor Dragon hesitated, Sigitir had already reassembled his true body, including the self-destructed left arm, which regenerated from flesh and blood.
It was just that Sigitir’s aura had fallen by twenty percent.
The complete reconstruction of what was like a One-side World, with his true body shattered, in addition to the self-destruction of his arm which contained the Rule Origin and Divine Soul Intent, meant he was now heavily injured.
However, at this moment, Sigitir’s aura suddenly soared as bright blood-colored flames erupted from his body, ascending into the sky and forming tangible red Rule Sequences.
Under the intense threat of Death, Sigitir instantly burned fifty percent of his Rule Origin, including the strength of his Demon God bloodline, his aura exploding more than tenfold.
His already towering true body of more than ten thousand meters inflated even further, transforming into a terrifying Blood-colored Demon God over twenty thousand meters tall.
An almost peak ancient stage Terrifying Aura filled Heaven and Earth; the deep crimson Sea of Blood even tinged half of the sky red, saturated with the thick scent of blood and a desperate sense of Death.
“Come again.”
Sigitico, standing in the Sea of Blood from the Abyss, roared, and his hands wielding Dragon Slaying Double Blades were further entwined with red Rule Sequences, instantly turning into two streaks of red lightning appearing before the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
The terrifying blade light split the world into three, creating two lengthy space-time faults running for thousands of kilometers, with Heavenly Earth Law and all things severed by this slash.
The terrifying blade light struck upon the kilometer-thick layer of Black Flames, unleashing a dreadful energy explosion.
In the dazzling glow of the black and red explosion, the two streaks of red blade light continuously tore through everything, even slashing apart streaks of leaping golden-red lightning and resulting in intense explosions.
As the forces of the rules annihilated each other, by the time the two red blades reached in front of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, the unleashed power had been reduced to a third.
Boom!
The blades exploded, and the burst of force spread like a red Great Sun, blanketing thousands of kilometers, with a series of black Halos encircling the surroundings.
The released sharp blade light cut through everything, turning into red rays that shredded all within tens of thousands of kilometers, whether it was space or the Void.
With space shattered, the explosion’s epicenter riddled with black cracks, stood Sigitico, towering over twenty thousand meters tall, radiating a tide of Abyssal blood light.
Before him rose a massive and ferocious Red Beast Dragon, its golden-red vertical pupils coldly gazing at him, and the Dragon Slaying Man standing on its shoulder.
The giant Dragon Slaying Blade, now thousands of meters long and wrapped in red Rule Sequences, was covered with cracks; the rich blood flowing from within these fissures dropped, disappearing into spatial cracks below.
Seeing this, Sigitico’s eyes showed deep Despair.
Having burned his Origin and bloodline, summoned Abyssal Power to amplify his peak strike, not only had he failed to make the terrifying Giant Beast step back, but he hadn’t even managed to create a single crack in its scales.
Moreover, because the gathered force was too strong, his Pseudo-World Level Weapon, cultivated for thousands of years, had also sustained damage.

chapters.title: Chapter 1498 - 1498 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1498: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_4 Chapter 1498: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_4 Such a terrifying defense, how can one even fight…
“Too weak, is this the so-called power of the Demon God?”
Boom!
The true body of Sigitico exploded under a claw enveloped in the burning Doomsday flames, forming a black hole that extended deep into the Void within a thousand-kilometer radius instantly.
No sooner had the black hole piercing into the depths of the Void appeared than nearby Void Creatures swarmed towards it.
But before they could get close, they were obliterated by the gold and red lightning that leapt around the edge of the Hollow, turning to black ash and dissipating.
“I refuse to accept this!”
Suddenly, a crazed roar echoed from the depths of the black hole, immediately followed by an even brighter blood light.
It was indeed Sigitico’s pair of Dragon Slaying Giant Blades, with even more cracks rapidly forming all over the blades, emitting energy fluctuations capable of destroying Heaven and Earth.
Boom, Boom!!
The Pseudo-World Level Weapon, being only one step away from World-class, self-destructed, unleashing destruction like a supernova explosion.
In the blink of an eye, two giant blood-colored suns appeared in the Firmament, expanding endlessly, crushing and destroying everything in their path.
Even the figure of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon paused momentarily, as it was pushed back a step by the torrential chaotic energy of infinite destruction, hearing nothing but the roaring destruction and seeing red gleams in both ears and eyes.
As the Dragon Slaying Double Blades self-destructed, a streak of blood light shot into the sky with indescribable speed, instantly crossing thousands of kilometers.
With another flash, it had already appeared more than ten thousand kilometers away.
Boom!
The Red Beast, engulfed in Black Flames, ‘slowly’ stepped out of the periphery of the blood suns that had swelled to three thousand kilometers in diameter, with gold and red lightning flashing all over its formidable figure.
Watching Sigitico already having escaped over thirty thousand kilometers away, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon unfurled its wings furiously, sending billowing Black Flames that obscured the sky.
Boom!
In front of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, in its Apocalypse Form, space shattered like fragile paper, distorted and, in an instant, appeared over ten thousand kilometers away.
“No!”
Having burned his Origin to escape a hundred thousand kilometers, Sigitico suddenly looked back, witnessing an enlarging red Dragon Claw in the sky, and let out a roar of despair.
Boom! Sigitico, like a meteor with a diameter of over twenty kilometers, shot through the sky in a dazzling red light and crashed onto the Earth below, ten thousand kilometers away.
The land trembled within tens of thousands of kilometers, surging like Tsunamis.
At the center of the explosion, endless red radiance shot up to the sky, golden red lightning swept across Heaven and Earth, mixed with countless stones defying gravity and Scorching Magma erupting.
In the shattered Earth’s core, thousands of kilometers deep, Sigitico’s internal power exploded, struggling madly, but unable to dislodge the imposing dragon foot crushing him.
This time, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon didn’t blast Sigitico’s true body but instead gathered its Doomsday power to Suppress him.
Endless Black Flames burned on the body of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, erupting, mixed with gold and red lightning, frantically scouring the true body of the Demon God it Suppressed below, eroding the Divine Soul.
This was the terrifying power of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon in its strongest form.
In front of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, even Sigitico’s force, which nearly reached the Ancient Limit and comparable to those Lords of great empires, was still no match.
Although the power of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was only comparable to the True Spirit Initial Stage, it showed unspeakable Absolute Domination under the full-scale suppression.
As the Doomsday Emperor Dragon demonstrated its power to Destroy the World and effortlessly Suppressed Sigitir, the energy in Jack Clark’s body drained like a torrential flood.
Calculating in his mind how to erode one Demon God and the remaining time to support the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Jack’s gaze turned cold, “No, at this rate, I can’t kill many Demon Gods.”
Boom, Boom!!
Both Jack’s real body and the Time True Body surged with Aura, their figures expanding, transforming respectively into a three-faced, eight-armed Demon God of three thousand meters and one thousand meters in height.
And behind the two Jacks, the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate emerged, with the dragon-patterned chains shattering.
Boom, Boom, Boom!!
As each layer of the Heavenly Gate crumbled, dragons infused with the power of the Dark Star Apocalypse Dragon roared out, pouring into Jack and the Time True Body.
The Aura of Jack surged limitlessly, his Demon God True Body swelling rapidly, transforming into an enormous figure tens of thousands of meters tall and another six thousand meters tall.
His entire body covered in luminescent Black Gold battle armor, with thousands of meters of hair burning with Black Gold flames, he looked like a being composed of light.
The dazzling light almost painted this world in purple-gold, permeating the vast, profound Aura filled the Heaven and Earth, exuding an overbearing presence that seemed to support Heaven and Earth.
Jack, having entered the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, let out a long howl, crossing over eighty thousand kilometers amid the trembling world, appearing behind the Original True King and the Demon Dragon Carthius.
“Primordial Senior, let’s Suppress it together.”
Jack, in the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, roared, and the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd in his hands, more than twenty thousand meters long, blazed with radiance, transforming into a Black Gold Halberd Radiance a hundred thousand meters long, slashing towards Carthius.
At the same time, the other Time True Body, with its Black Gold vertical pupils appearing, caused the world to darken instantly, turning a ten thousand-kilometer area into an absolute dark area.
Void Descent.
“Hahaha… Well done, Jack,” laughed the Primordial True King, flames of Black Flames burning on his body as well, boosting his strength even further.
Roar!
Behind the Primordial True King, a Furious Ape ghostly figure, tens of thousands of meters tall, emerged, letting out a supremely ferocious roar.
The enormous Furious Ape ghost grabbed into the Void, drawing in a force from an unknown Void, turning into eight pale lights that, together with the Furious Ape, surged towards the distant True King.

﻿Chapter 1499: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_5 Chapter 1499: Chapter 564 Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Devouring Demon God_5 Boom!
The aura of destruction emanating from the Primordial True King became even more terrifying, with a dreadful white light that could shatter everything entwined around the Wolf Tooth Staff in his hand.
“Roar!
“It’s impossible for me to fall here today.” The Demon Dragon, with a length of ten thousand meters and a black western form, let out a roar of terror. The dark rules around it burst forth and expanded, forming a dark world that enshrouded a thousand kilometers.
Deep within the darkness, a colossal dragon head emerged, soaring into the sky, to meet the heaven-destroying radiance of the Opening the Heavens Halberd Skill and the shattering Wolf Tooth Staff.
Boom!
Under the oppressively dominating power imbued with the essence of Opening the Heavens, the head of the abyssal dragon shattered, and the dark world surrounding the Dark Demon Dragon Carthius violently exploded as well.
Roar!
Carthius let out a scream, both claws fractured, both arms blown apart, with their flesh and blood exploding; nearly half of his Rule True Body was destroyed by the combined strike of the two.
At the same time, a formidable power that could shatter the void burst forth.
Under the Time True Body’s talent for the explosion of Void Devouring, expending all of its Void Energy in an instant, the formidable body of the Dark Demon Dragon was further torn apart, its wounds worsening.
However, the power of the Time True Body was still too weak. Had Jack been at his full strength, he could have entirely shattered the dragon in one hit.
Even so, under the combined strike of the three, the Dark Demon Dragon Carthius was severely injured, its massive body plummeting from the sky and viciously smashing onto the earth.
At the moment when Jack and the Primordial True King joined forces and suppressed Carthius, a lamentable scream pierced through heaven and earth from afar, with an invisible despair that startled all the Demon Gods, who looked towards the sky.
On the blood-lit earth, the vast True Body of Sigitico was torn in two by the beast.
Furthermore, under the suppression of the terrifying Black Flames and golden-red lightning, Sigitico was unable to regenerate his body or escape as he could in the past.
But that wasn’t even what shocked the Demon Gods.
Sigitico, being of ancient late stage strength, with a rich source of rules, would ordinarily require even a True Spirit Level existence some time to gradually wear him down and kill him.
But then, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon opened its jaws wide, with red-hot light radiating from its gaping mouth, and bit down in a single chomp.
Boom! Beneath the sharp teeth, half of Sigitico’s shoulder vanished instantly.
This disappearance was not merely the True Body being devoured; it included that part of the Divine Soul Intent too, which vanished without a trace, as if Sigitico never had a left shoulder.
This was exactly what filled all the Demon Gods with terror.
This fearsome beast possessed a Devouring talent, capable of devouring everything, including rules and even the True Bodies of the Demon Gods.
Roar!
The beast, radiating red light and cloaked in Black Flames, let out a piercing roar to the heavens as it frenziedly began to devour the colossal True Demon God Body of Sigitico.
“That beast has a Devouring Talent, run!”
“Sigitico is beyond saving, let’s flee.”
“There is still hope, that beast is so powerful; the human surely won’t last long.”
Remembering the time unit of ten minutes mentioned earlier by Jack for the Human Federation, hope flickered in the eyes of all the Demon Gods, who then erupted with even greater urgency.
Boom! Fifteen thousand kilometers away, Diorus roared, repelling Adam Garcetti, while another future True Body of Diorus exploded half of its True Body.
The intense explosion pushed back the Sky-based God King, allowing this Divine God True Body to escape using the power of time…
[A few hundred words to modify and finish, it’s already twelve o’clock, update first, brothers wait ten minutes and refresh]
The Ancestral Demon God Levides pulled out an object to fend off the escape, entangling in the process.
In the end, the Destruction Emperor Dragon pounced on Belidier, sending it into despair. With the Sky-based God King losing its opponent, it dove towards another Demon God, Rudeus, who also burst forth crazily, running into the distance.
Above the earth, mountains, and rivers, each base that had been laid out earlier erupted, forming powerful rule forces to block.
While the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already suppressed Belidier, it continued to explode his True Body, preparing to suppress and devour him.
