chapters.title: Chapter 1500 - 1500 565 Horizontally Pushing Five Million
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1500: Chapter 565: Horizontally Pushing Five Million Kilometers, Chapter 1500: Chapter 565: Horizontally Pushing Five Million Kilometers, The power in the form of black flames burned invisibly, obliterating everything, burning a chaotic black hole with a diameter of thousands of kilometers in the shattered Earth.
In the center of the black hole, the Deep Red Giant Beast, now over 32,000 meters long and even more massive and ferocious, stood tall, emitting a terrifying aura that struck fear into all living creatures.
After devouring a Demon God of the ancient late stage realm, ‘biological energy’ was converted, causing the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s size to surge by over two thousand meters.
However, due to being in the gigantified deep red state combined with the doomsday form, the actual growth was only a few hundred meters.
Furthermore, as the Evolution Energy from the growth of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon nurtured him, even Jack Clark, tens of thousands of kilometers away and in the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, felt a surge in his aura.
Although that bit of Evolution Energy didn’t provide much of a boost to Jack at that moment, it replenished a portion of his already greatly depleted energy.
Hiss! A breath as hot as a heatwave was exhaled, and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon slowly turned its head, its eyes filled with gold and crimson lightning, coldly observing its surroundings.
Because it pursued the Demon God Sigitico, flying over a hundred thousand kilometers to the left, the farthest Demon God was now over four hundred thousand kilometers away.
Even the Doomsday Emperor Dragon could only vaguely sense the strong Rule Level energy fluctuations from such a distance.
The nearest battlefield, on the other hand, was over a hundred and thirty thousand kilometers away to the southeast.
There the Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy manifested his Divine King form, with the forces of rules spreading around him, merging with ten Divine Texts to form ten world projections, destroying heaven and earth.
Enveloped by the elemental worlds containing wind, thunder, Earth, fire, light, darkness, water, ice, magma, and the stars, even the Demon God Belidier, who burned his Origin, was suppressed and could not escape.
In a fierce battle between two Demon Gods at full strength, the area tens of thousands of kilometers around them shattered, with mountain ranges collapsing as if it were the apocalypse.
Even two regular forbidden areas filled with extreme and dangerous forces were flattened, with shocking momentum.
“Four more minutes, that’s enough,” said the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, which had calculated the time and roared its resolve, its massive body streaking across the sky like a black and crimson light, crossing over a hundred thousand kilometers in just over a minute.
Just as the Doomsday Emperor Dragon neared the battlefield, sensing an aura as if chaos had descended, destroying everything, the Demon God Belidier suppressed by Divine King Tolstoy’s showed terror in his eyes.
In front of this terrifying beast whose strength had entered the True Spirit level, Sigitico was destroyed in just a few strikes and devoured and fallen in an extremely short amount of time, let alone him.
“Get out of my way,” Belidier bellowed, erupting with a violence that reached the extreme.
Boom!
Belidier self-destructed his Rule True Body, instantly shattering the heaven and Earth within ten thousand kilometers, causing chaos to surge and a destructive force to form a massive black sun.
Around the apocalyptic black sun, Heavenly Energy formed circles of dark red energy halos, spreading out for tens of thousands of kilometers, with an imposing presence.
Even Tolstoy’s ten elemental worlds shattered under the explosion, the golden Rule Domain’s radiance around his True Body trembling.
Under the powerful force, even Tolstoy felt a disturbance in his strength and turned into a ray of golden light, flying out more than ten thousand kilometers.
During the moment the terrifying explosion sent Tolstoy flying, more than fifty thousand kilometers away, a Demon God Pillar standing on the mountain range and towering into the clouds shone brightly.
Etched with a massive Eye of Void on the Demon God Pillar, a black light burst into the sky under its guidance, pouring into the Void.
An invisible force, following certain coordinates and breaking through countless space-time restrictions, shot into the depths of the black sun, where a phantom vanished immediately following the traction.
Roar! A ferocious and majestic roar shook space and time.
In an instant, the sky darkened as a red Tail Blade, burning with black flames and wrapped in gold and crimson lightning, tore through the Void and descended, its sharp edge splitting the world in two, creating a dark crack spanning ten thousand kilometers.
Under the edge imbued with doomsday and destructive power, the force of countless space-times were severed, and a figure split in half fell from the sky.
Boom, boom!!
The impact of the Demon God’s true body shattered the Earth, collapsed the mountain ranges, and a tsunami of destructive shock swept through thousands of kilometers.
Roar!
The ferocious and majestic roar sounded again as a pair of dragon claws, burning with black flames, descended from the sky, bringing with them a world of chaos that landed on the two halves of Belidier’s true body.
Boom! The earth within a radius of more than twenty thousand kilometers surged like waves, and countless mountain peaks collapsed.
Under the power of doomsday chaos, the Abyssal rules swirling around Belidier’s body continuously broke apart, utterly unstoppable and beyond resistance, as the Doomsday Emperor Dragon suppressed and grasped him in its claws.
As the ferocious maw drew closer, the upper half of Belidier let out a piercing scream, “Diorus, save me!”
But at this moment, Diorus had already fled more than five hundred thousand kilometers away, without daring to look back, let alone hearing Belidier’s plea for help.
As for the other Demon Gods, the situation was quite similar; even if they heard, they dared not turn back.
In the face of a beast whose strength and Defense were invincible, having entered the True Spirit Level and possessing a Devouring Talent that could rapidly dissolve and erode the Demon Gods, who would dare to stop?
Boom!
Under the ferocious maw of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the True Demon God Body of Belidier, spanning ten thousand meters, was like a roasted suckling pig, its three heads directly bitten off in one bite.
Hiss! Witnessing the crimson beast of destruction that devoured the demon god, the distant Heavenly Feather Divine King, Tolstoy, revealed a trace of wariness in his eyes.
This Giant Beast was too terrifying to provoke.
As a Divine King, Tolstoy did not fear death, but he also did not want to be eaten bit by bit by other beasts as if he were a snack one day.
At the same time, Tolstoy was somewhat excited; he hadn’t expected that the Human Race would have True Spirit Level combat power on their side.
This Giant Beast had reached the True Spirit Level, just like the main body of the Heavenly Feather Clan, but unlike the Eternal Divine Tree, which was only considered half a True Spirit, it was an existence with the power of a true, eternal True Spirit.
Although it had only reached True Spirit Level during a Limit Breakthrough, it could still crush all creatures below the True Spirit Level, including those Great Demon Kings.
As long as that Primordial Ancestor of the Purgatory Demon Clan that was said to be in hibernation did not emerge, no demon was a match for this Giant Beast; it could suppress everything.
Under the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s massive devouring, it took just over two minutes to chew and swallow Belidier indiscriminately, and its size swelled by another kilometer, becoming even more massive.
The black flames burning on its body grew even more intense, and the aura of destruction and doomsday spread throughout heaven and earth surged.
But with the enhancement of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s strength came an explosive increase in Jack Clark’s pressure.
At the very moment the Doomsday Emperor Dragon devoured Belidier, the aura on Jack Clark, who had been working with the Primordial True King to suppress the Demon Dragon Carthius, weakened.
Roar! Realizing the opportunity, the badly damaged Demon Dragon Carthius with its wings torn off, had a black crystal inside its body explode.
Boom!
Instantly, Carthius’s aura temporarily surged tenfold. Countless fleshly tentacles grew over its body, and its severed left claw swelled immensely, smashing the immensely heavy Eight Desolate Battle Halberd off of it.
At the same time, its tail, ablaze with black and crimson Blood Flames, emitted blinding light, piercing the Void and entangling the Primordial True King along with the Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth Stick.
Boom!
The Demon Dragon’s tail and the latter half of its true body exploded instantly, unleashing a terrifying power that could destroy heaven and earth.
The star-shaking explosion was like an invisible expanding supernova, even splattering blood from the Primordial True King, shattering his four arms, and driving his massive body into retreat.
At the forefront of the impact, the surrounding Boundary Wall around Jack Clark shook, forming rings of pure gold diamond-shaped halos, and his ears were filled with earth-shattering roars.
His somewhat weaker Time True Body was directly blown away, half of its true body shattered.
Roar!
Having self-destructed half of its Rule True Body and blown away Jack Clark and the Primordial True King, the Demon Dragon Carthius roared and charged ahead, plunging into the Dark Rift along with the Abyss.
Compared to the transcendentally powerful Giant Beast Emperor Dragon, which had stepped into the Ancient Realm, Jack Clark’s original strength was still one Major Realm inferior.
In the face of an ancient middle-stage Demon God burning its Origin, combined with the self-destruction of its true body, even Jack Clark and the Primordial True King could not retain it.
This was the difficulty in killing a Demon God Level being, including the supreme powers of the Human Race or even the Heavenly Feather Divine King; if they desperately wanted to escape, it was very hard to retain them even with the cooperation of one or two peers from the same rank.
“Carthius, you won’t be able to escape today.”
Boom!
Rising ten thousand meters and radiating dazzling dark golden light, Jack Clark burst out from the center of the explosion, shaking space-time with the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd in his hand, causing the Void to collapse.
At the same time, the Time True Body appeared directly in front of Carthius with its aura increased tenfold as it burned all its Origin, and behind it emerged the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane—seeming as if it had descended from the future, like a continent nearly ten thousand kilometers in diameter entwined with Supreme Rule Power, crashing down onto Carthius.
Boom! Carthius’s true body sank, and its surrounding domain of Dark Rules vibrated, forming rings of dazzling halos.
The powerful gravity further collapsed the Void, pressing Carthius down.
Boom!
The black-gold battle halberd pierced heaven and earth, shredding the domain of Dark Rules and spearing through Carthius’s abdomen, nailing it firmly onto the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane continent.
The halberd, too, was wrapped with pure and transparent Rule Power, suppressing Carthius, grinding away its Origin Rule and Divine Soul Intent.
But with Jack Clark’s strength, it was difficult to eradicate Carthius quickly.
Previously, it had taken Jack Clark nearly half an hour to kill an ancient early-stage Demon God during his full strength explosion, not to mention the stronger Carthius.
But it did not matter; he only needed to suppress Carthius for one minute.
Roar!
[One more chapter to go]

chapters.title: Chapter 1501 - 1501 566 Ancient Rules The Massacre Begins
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1501: Chapter 566: Ancient Rules, The Massacre Begins Chapter 1501: Chapter 566: Ancient Rules, The Massacre Begins Far above the Firmament, the red sun shone with dazzling light, and these red sunbeams folded space, crossing infinite distances to envelop the entire mythical world.
Under the cover of these red rays, all creatures, including cultivators, instinctively felt irritable and anxious.
Even a strong man like Jack Clark felt somehow restless under the red sunlight, and the urge for slaughter in his heart grew stronger.
Phew! Jack slowly exhaled, suppressing the restlessness within his heart.
At this moment, Jack had already exited his Dark Star Apocalypse Form, and he was unable to maintain his True Demon God Body due to extreme weakness, standing pale-faced at high altitude.
Fortunately, although not a drop remained within, ‘flight’ is an innate ability of Innate Gods and Demons, just like fish swimming in water without the need to expend energy.
At that moment, Jack’s view darkened, and the head of a giant Black Violent Ape, as large as a mountain peak, came closer with the breathing of raging wind, his voice booming like thunder.
“Jack, how are you doing?”
Jack took a deep breath: “I’m fine, Senior. Just that maintaining the Summoning Secret Skill is a bit consuming. I won’t be able to join the demon god-level battles that follow.”
The Black Violent Ape’s face revealed a ferocious grin: “As long as you’re fine. Leave the upcoming battle to us.”
Even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon had come and consecutively slain three Demon Gods, it didn’t mean this great battle had ended.
The remaining five Demon Gods, exploding various secret skills and partially self-destructing their True Bodies and forbidden weapons, were already seriously injured, and the Human Race naturally wanted to pursue the victory.
Even if they could not slay another, they aimed to aggravate their injuries or even damage their foundations.
Beyond that, the Great Demon Kings, demon kings, and Purgatory Legions that had converged for this apocalyptic battle could not be let off. They would slay as many as possible.
This battle must severely damage the two great Purgatory Empires, and even break into the Demon Clan’s Territory to destroy both empires, securing more time for the Human Alliance.
After exchanging greetings, the eight-armed ape, towering more than ten thousand meters high, casually chose a direction and stepped on the Void to leave, pursuing the remaining five Demon Gods.
Watching the Primordial True King depart, Jack stood thousands of kilometers in the high altitude, and a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils slowly emerged in his eyes, surveying all directions.
Under the terrifying vision of the Void Death Pupil, every scene within tens of thousands of kilometers, except for some Space Distortion in forbidden areas, appeared before Jack’s eyes.
The battlefield was now utterly chaotic, mixed like a pot of porridge.
The Terrifying Aura unleashed during the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s arrival, coupled with Diorus’s battlefield-wide retreat order, made all demon kings choose to withdraw at the first opportunity.
Similarly, with the numerical advantage, the kings, Main Gods, and king-level fighters of the Human Alliance naturally wouldn’t let them escape.
Thus, as the demon god-level great battles spread ever wider, the demon king battles at ‘Low altitude’ also raged in every direction.
And the spread-out Purgatory Legions, spanning over thirty thousand kilometers laterally and tens of thousands of kilometers deep at the frontline, were somewhat bewildered and at a loss.
Then, chaos ensued.
Some Purgatory Legions chose to retreat immediately, riding Demonized Beasts or flying castles, pulling rolling Demon Clouds as they fled, or using the Demon Clan’s power to tear temporary Spatial Channels for jumping.
Some Legions, having not ‘received orders,’ resisted based on bases established within dangerous forbidden areas.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Tens of thousands of kilometers away from the original standoff between both races, a Purgatory Main Battle Corps, consisting of over eighty thousand members, along with five Vassal Race Legions, were engaged in combat with the Human Race Legions.
Tangled in Demon Arrays and black Thunder, and led by several Nine Demonic Marks true demons, they formed cascades of Thunder waterfalls that held the Human Race at bay.
Hovering in midair, Eddy Keller looked solemn as he shouted towards the mountain ranges engulfed in black Thunder, stretching for thousands of kilometers: “All legions attend, in five minutes, a Sky Base Apocalypse strike will descend.”
“Immediately withdraw five hundred kilometers from the current battlefield, block the exits and don’t let those Purgatory True Demons escape.”
Hum!
In Outer Space, beyond Blue Star, a colossal Sky Base Satellite had unfolded like a spider, its mirrors covering a hundred-kilometer radius and accumulating searing Stellar Energy in a charging state.
Following the command, the colossal gun barrel emitted a terrifying Radiance, and a golden light beam one kilometer in diameter pierced through the atmosphere, ‘slowly’ descending.
That dazzling light was immediately spotted by many on Blue Star.
South Sect City.
Glenn Clark and Teresa Wilson, who were shopping on the street, also abruptly looked up to see the golden column of light, surrounded by rings of white waves, vanish in the north.
Teresa tensed up a bit: “It seems like a Federation Apocalyptic Weapon. They say it’s only activated when the Frontline Battlefield is in crisis. Nothing’s gone wrong there, right?”
Glenn calmly replied: “Don’t worry, May. It should be fine.”
“If the situation there was indeed dangerous enough to threaten Blue Star, the official mood wouldn’t be this relaxed and peaceful, and the higher-ups would have started fleeing already.”
Next to him, the voluptuous Nora Martinez nodded: “Glenn’s right. If there were really a problem, someone would have come to take Glenn and Aunt Zhang away by now.”
“That makes sense,” May said with a smile on her face.
The graceful and beautiful Melinda chuckled: “May, don’t think too much about it. No matter what the situation is over there, it’s too distant for us.”
“Rather than worry about what’s happening in the mythical world, we should look forward to tomorrow’s provincial top sixteen tournaments and see if Glenn can qualify for the national competition.”
At that, May’s face was filled with confidence: “With Glenn’s strength, there’s definitely no problem, right Glenn?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1502 - 1502 566 Ancient Rule The Slaughter Begins_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1502: Chapter 566: Ancient Rule, The Slaughter Begins_2 Chapter 1502: Chapter 566: Ancient Rule, The Slaughter Begins_2 “`
Faced with the expectant gazes of three beautiful girls, Glenn Clark showed a honest smile on his face.
“Hmm, no problem, but my goal isn’t just a spot in the national competition; I also aim to take the top spot in all seven southern provinces,” Glenn said, exuding an aura of matchless confidence and an overbearing composure.
During Jack’s absence, Glenn had encountered some opportunities. Along with the reward for ranking first in the Second Grade of the Mist River City selection competition, his cultivation had broken through to the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven.
With his innate talents for Tyrant Body and Gigantification, paired with the terrifying strength of his flesh after cultivating the Dark Star Battle Body, Glenn was confident he could suppress any opponent below the Seventh Layer Heaven.
But just then, Outer Space suddenly emitted radiance once more, and two golden light beams, each a kilometer in diameter, appeared back to back and then vanished towards the north.
The invisible, terrifying energy spread by those beams shook the entire Blue Star.
Especially for the high-level cultivators, who sensed a terrorizing force within the golden beams that could destroy planets, knowing that even the slightest deviation could pierce through the world.
And just as the light of the two Sky-based doomsday satellites disappeared, the space in outer space darkened. A pitch-black beam shot through Heaven and Earth, silently disappearing deep within the Berlin Empire.
In the mythical world, above the city of Channel 3, the pitch-black beam passed through the passage and vanished into the skyline, reappearing at another entrance to the forbidden area, more than forty thousand kilometers away.
There, a Mythical King, clad in a silver robe, stood tall, with the surrounding space spinning, forming a massive vortex passage several tens of kilometers in diameter.
Witnessing the pitch-black line of death that pierced Heaven and Earth, the king took a deep breath, and all the power of the Space Law inside him erupted, forming silver Law Chains that encircled the vortex.
Boom!
The black line of death plunged into the pathway and reemerged over fifty thousand kilometers away where Gabriel King and Purple Heaven Heavenly King cooperated to battle a Great Demon King.
With their combined strength, they could suppress a demon king of their tier, but it was somewhat difficult to kill it in its desperate state.
“What is this!”
The Great Demon King, pressed down by the white light prison, suddenly looked up, horrified at the black beam cutting through Heaven and Earth, sensing an intense danger emanating from it.
“Purple Heaven, suppress it,” Gabriel bellowed, a phantom with three pairs of white wings appearing behind him, his entire being radiating bright White Light, like the Primordial Light.
Under the penetrating brilliance, the Great Demon King, towering more than two thousand meters tall, paused in its steps.
At the same time, a terrifying roar of thunder emanated from Purple Heaven Heavenly King, transforming into a miles-long Purple Thunder Dragon. The dragon exploded in an instant, turning into a dense web of purple electricity that engulfed the demon king.
Just as the two Heavenly Kings unleashed their suppressive force on the demon king, the kilometer-wide black beam pierced through everything at terrifying speed, shooting from top to bottom through the demon king’s body.
“No!” With a tragic scream, the demon king’s True Body stiffened, its True Body, tempered by the laws, disintegrated into black ashes under the scouring of the black beam.
After eradicating the demon king with a single hit, the black beam slanted down onto the Earth, leaving an unknown depth of a Hollow before disappearing.
Such Terrifying Power made both Purple Heaven Heavenly King and Gabriel King feel a bit apprehensive, even though they were well aware of the might of the doomsday satellite.
Gabriel sighed lightly, “Every time I see the power of these ancient relics, I feel so insignificant and marvel at the vastness of the mythical world.”
Purple Heaven Heavenly King also sighed softly, “Indeed, even though we are already very powerful among the federation’s Heavenly Kings, we are still nothing in front of those ancient beings.”
“`
“For example, the death satellite is so powerful that it can easily annihilate us by just activating the power within the remains of an ancient being’s skeleton,”
Reflecting upon this, the two Heavenly Kings looked around the chaotic battlefield before flying towards the area in the sky where powerful energy was vaguely erupting.
Jack also saw the scene of the black beam killing the Great Demon King, his eyes revealing a faint solemnity, “Such a strong aura of death, no wonder it’s called the death satellite.”
One of the foundations of the Human Race, the death satellite, has a core that is an ancient creature’s skeleton discovered in a relic.
After tens of thousands of years had passed, hardly any energy remained within the skeleton, but it was still incredibly solid, inscribed with mysterious rule patterns.
These rule patterns were potent, related to the laws of death, and even the Sky-based God Kings were wary of just a few of these patterns.
The Federation researched around this ancient skeleton for over a decade and finally deduced a method to use Stellar Energy as the reactor, carving runes to convert energy to trigger the power of these laws.
This is the death satellite, which after testing its formidable power once, became one of the cards the alliance kept up its sleeve against the Purgatory Great Demon King.
Although the power of the death line is formidable, its weakness is also quite evident; it’s straightforward and can be easily detected and evaded in advance, so the Human Race didn’t activate it unless absolutely necessary.
With a hint of emotion, Jack’s gaze became sharp as he had regained a bit of ‘strength’ after this brief rest.
Adam Garcetti and the others were chasing after Diorus and the other Demon Gods, having already flown far into the distance; the closest demonic battlefield to him was over sixty thousand kilometers away.
But his help wasn’t needed there; the Great Sun, akin to golden eyes, shook Heaven and Earth, with the violent wave of Heavenly Energy reaching over ten thousand kilometers.
The demon god from the ancient early stage, known as Adibadan, was already suppressed on the Earth by Tarodel.
The massive True Demon God Body let out angry roars but was bound to the Earth by golden chains of Law, forming ancient arrays that ringed around it.
Facing the unfathomably powerful Tarodel, this injured demon god had no capability of fighting back.
If no other demon gods intervene to save it, it will meet its end as its True Body gradually erodes, eventually leading to the dispersal of its Divine Soul and the dissipation of its will.
Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly, “This Divine King is very strong.”
Although he had once killed an ancient early-stage Demon God, that was after using all his methods and trump cards to erupt with power, whereas Tarodel did it effortlessly, marking a significant difference.
After taking a deep look at the giant golden sun stretched across Carney Turner, Jack, gripping the War Halberd, turned into a ray of Radiance and flew toward the sky amidst his wildly fluttering black hair.
“Next, it will be a river of blood.”
Although he had only recovered a ‘bit’ of strength, there was no difficulty in slaying those Demon Kings or Great Demon Kings, including those armies.
Once the high-end powers in a Civilization War lose their constraints, without peers to restrain them, it will be a catastrophe for those Transcendent Corps.
Boom!
A Thunder bolt from the Firmament descended from the sky, collapsing a small mountain range, and in the depths of the explosion-ravaged Earth, Damon Lopes spat out blood.
In the sky above, the demon gas billowed as a demon king with three heads and eight arms looked down from above, his gaze cold, “A mere Transcendent human dares to challenge this king, seeking death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1503 - 1503 567 Suppressing All Directions
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1503: Chapter 567: Suppressing All Directions, Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox Chapter 1503: Chapter 567: Suppressing All Directions, Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox Stretching over a thousand kilometers, a small mountain range covered in red trees collapsed across a range of hundreds of kilometers under the impact of Damon Lopes, lifting billowing smoke and dust.
“Cough, cough!! Damn it, as expected of the Demon Clan, so insidious.”
Damon Lopes wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, looking somewhat somberly at the demon king shrouded in dark demon air above, feeling he had been a bit careless.
Or rather, he had hit a snag this time.
Under normal conditions, with his Nine-fold Peak cultivation, mastering two types of Innate Thunder Power and starting to refine the Supreme Thunder Law, he should have been able to suppress an early Myth demon king.
Even a Mid-Myth demon king could face him head-on.
But he hadn’t expected that this demon king, who turned to flee at the first sign of the great war erupting, would be so terrible in strength—feeling even a late-Myth king might not be a match for him.
This was also what left Damon Lopes speechless.
At that time, seeing how sneaky this demon king was, he assumed the opponent wasn’t very strong and decisively left the army to pursue and ‘hunt down’ the demon king, wanting to shock everyone in the Federation by Reverse Defeating a demon king.
And then, there was no “after that.”
After flying tens of thousands of kilometers back and forth and failing to shake off Damon Lopes, who had turned into lightning, the demon king suddenly turned around and in just a few moves, shattered his Innate Thunder Power, heavily injuring him.
High above in the sky, hundreds of kilometers up, the three-headed, eight-armed demon king looked down coldly, “Merely a Transcendent human daring to challenge me, utterly ignorant of life and death.”
“Since you’re courting death, I will grant it to you.”
Whoosh! Damon Lopes turned into a lightning bolt and appeared above the smoke and dust, sneering, “With Daoist Master’s speed like mine, you think you can kill me? Dream on!”
However, although Damon Lopes was unwilling to concede defeat, the moment he finished his tough talk, he was already preparing to escape.
If he couldn’t win, he would leave this demon king to others.
Just then, a silent figure holding a halberd appeared above the two of them, followed by a terrifying power descending.
Boom! From the firmament above, a ten-thousand-meter-long Black Gold Halberd Radiance fell from the sky, entwined with grey Death Law Chains.
In an instant, a terrifying aura of death spread, enveloping heaven and earth.
Roar!
Under the dominating will that pervaded heaven and earth, the demon king Haks knew he couldn’t escape or hide, and the three heads couldn’t help but howl to the sky.
Intense Black Flames surged from Haks’s body, and the Dark Demon Air that filled the surroundings stirred violently under the eight arms stirring heaven and earth, forming a pair of gigantic demon claws that shot towards the sky.
Enwrapped with purple patterns, the claws seemed like terrifying demons from the depths of Abyssal Hell, and the power they emitted made the world tremble.
It was a force that should not exist in the Material World—evil, powerful, filled with endless dark and malevolent intent.
But… Boom!
Under the Divine Power Vacuum Destruction condensed halberd skill, the Abyssal Demon Claws instantly shattered, followed by the Laws World around Haks and the Demon King’s True Body.
After blasting away Haks’s True Body with one strike, the Halberd Skill continued unstoppable, slashing down to Earth from the sky.
Boom!
A range of hundreds of kilometers of Earth shattered, with countless magma rocks shooting into the sky, and the Destructive Impact wave that it raised destroyed mountain peaks and snapped trees, sweeping over thousands of kilometers.
At the center of the explosion, energy converged again, but the Demon King Haks, with his True Body in ruins, let out a scream of despair.
A phantom Black Gold Halberd Radiance pierced through its True Body, nailing it to the Earth, with the Death Law embedded within it continuously eroding its vitality.
Such was the strength of this force of death that it spread over hundreds of kilometers, creating an area of ‘ordinary’ death-filled forbidden zone.
As Jack Clark casually suppressed a demon king with a single strike, miles away from the collapsed mountain peak that exploded, the repercussion of the blast sent Damon Lopes soaring.
Turning into a bolt of lightning, Damon Lopes arrived in front of Jack Clark, a touch envious, “Your strength is too formidable now; slaying these demon kings feels as easy as slaughtering chickens.”
“Not bad,” replied Jack Clark with a smile, “How about it, still alive, aren’t you?”
Damon Lopes said nonchalantly, “No big deal, it’s just that my Thunder Prison True Body was shattered, reaching the foundation. With some time, I can recover.”
“In a civilized war battleground, try not to engage enemies who are beyond the limits of your strength; otherwise, a slight inattention could lead to your downfall,” Jack Clark reminded.
This was also a close call for Damon Lopes, for if Jack Clark hadn’t seen the situation from tens of thousands of kilometers away and specifically flown over, Damon Lopes might have died or at the very least been skinned alive.
But it seems this guy really does have some bad luck, getting heavily injured in every major battle.
Hearing this, Damon Lopes smiled sheepishly, somewhat embarrassed.
In fact, Damon Lopes tended to be very cautious in his actions, which was evident from the mission to protect Mathilda Ward where he was cooperative and did not like taking risks.
But influenced by Jack Clark’s record of repeatedly crushing higher realm enemies with a lower cultivation, Damon Lopes, also a ‘peerless’ genius, couldn’t help being affected.
He always felt those higher-realm enemies were just so-so, and he wanted to slay one to prove himself.
Then, after several consecutive failures and getting heavily injured each time, it was nothing short of tears when spoken of.
While the two were talking, the energy between heaven and earth suddenly fluctuated. Not far away, a Blood Moon slowly emerged beneath the crossing Heavenly Earth Laws and then fell.
Watching this scene, Jack Clark and Damon Lopes exchanged glances, nodded solemnly, and then turned into two rays of light, disappearing in different directions.
The geographic environment of the Human Race was quite special, surrounded by forbidden zones, forming a shape like a gourd.
The Sky Curtain Battlefield, which had previously faced off against the Purgatory Empire, and the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, were the upper parts of the gourd. Crossing the Frontline Battlefield, the region controlled by the Purgatory Empire, one would find a much larger mapped area.

chapters.title: Chapter 1504 - 1504 567 Suppressing the Eight Directions
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1504: Chapter 567: Suppressing the Eight Directions, Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox_2 Chapter 1504: Chapter 567: Suppressing the Eight Directions, Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox_2 This place stretches horizontally over a million kilometers and has a depth of over two hundred kilometers on both sides, surrounded by the forbidden areas of space-time faults, resembling the belly of a gourd.
Facing the direction of the Purgatory Empire, the entrance that’s over four hundred thousand kilometers wide is like the gourd’s buttocks, and just beyond lies the territory of the two great Purgatory Empires after another three million kilometers.
But at this moment, this ring-shaped world, occupied by the Purgatory Empire for decades, is witnessing epic battles everywhere, with the sky and the Earth occasionally lit by the dazzling glow of nuclear explosions.
All the demon kings, Great Demon Kings, and those legions that retreated using the Demon Array are frantically rushing toward the gourd-shaped region.
Added to the subsequent pursuit of the Human Alliance experts, the battlefront is stretched even longer.
Two thousand kilometers high in the Firmament, Gentry Gail, who is a kilometer tall and has eight white tails, is radiating sharp white light, engaged in a fierce battle with a Great Demon King.
“Gentry Gail, have you gone mad?” Barus, with three heads and eight arms, covered in purple armor and with eighteen Demon Horns on his crown, bellowed in anger.
Barus swung his eight arms, stirring up space, and gathered the power of a Dark World to descend.
Boom!
Under the terrifying power, Gentry Gail, who had briefly attained Heavenly King-level strength by merging with a Giant Beast, shook and turned into a ray of White Light that fell from the sky, collapsing a mountain range.
A long roar burst through the raging explosion, “Barus, you can’t escape today, stay for me.”
Whoosh! The smoke and dust below dispersed, revealing a somewhat weakened Gentry Gail soaring into the sky, lunging once more at Barus who attempted to flee.
Watching Gentry Gail, who was burning his Origin without regard for the loss, and trying to entangle him, Barus’s eyes flickered with intense intent to kill, “Gentry Gail, since you wish to die, this king will fulfill your wish.”
Barus knew he couldn’t continue to be entangled with this human king-level expert, otherwise it wouldn’t be long before other Human Experts came to support, and by then he would not be able to escape.
“Go to hell.”
Barus let out a ferocious bellow, his Aura surging nearly tenfold in an instant, and dazzling purple demon light Burst from within him, his form swelling as he entered a Bloodline Awakening state.
In an instant, endless purple light colored the surroundings, like a ribbon of purple light.
As the custodian of the Purgatory Empire’s Assassination Department at the early stage of the Great Demon King Realm, Barus’s strength was actually very formidable, now with the bloodline transformation awakening, his Aura was extremely terrifying.
Boom!
Barus held a purple war spear, and with a slight movement of his form, the entire world seemed to tremble, and his powerful strike shattered space, raising up a tide to Destroy Heaven and Earth, rolling towards Gentry Gail.
Gentry Gail took a deep breath, his expression serious, “Eight-tails, it’s time to fight with all we’ve got.”
Boom!
Eight tails behind Gentry Gail glowed brilliantly, like the full spread of a peacock’s tail, with the tips reaching into the Void, and in the blink of an eye, a white vixen shadow tens of thousands of meters tall emerged.
Just as the Nine-tailed White Fox shadow appeared, an Aura as formidable as Barus’s descended.
“Heavenly Fox in chaos, kill!”
Boom!
Dazzling purple and white light exploded in the air, as if a small world had burst open, releasing power that caused the laws of this World to become chaotic, with a raging wind howling.
Amidst the violent energy waves, a sharply Auraed white world revolved around Gentry Gail, constantly colliding with Barus’s purple Dark World.
Behind him, nine white tails encircled him, with one slowly materializing from its ethereal state, its Aura vast.
Watching this scene, Barus’s gaze turned icy, because Gentry Gail was actually trying to use the pressure to break through the limits of life and death and step into the Great Demon King Realm.
This method of seeking a breakthrough in the midst of battle was completely suicidal, and only a fool would give him the chance to make a breakthrough.
Of course, Barus was no different, and besides the arms wielding the purple war spear, six demon arms each appeared with two crescent bone-pieces and four black sharp spikes.
All at once, a strong sense of danger enveloped Gentry Gail.
“Eight-tails, if not now, then when should we fight for our lives?” Gentry Gail’s hair danced wildly, and in this moment, his Spirit Qi and all his strength became one, reaching an unprecedented peak.
Besides, there was a strength in his body that burst out, like that of a Giant Beast yet not a Giant Beast.
Boom! The Void collapsed, and tails thousands, even tens of thousands of meters long emerged from the Void, like sharp swords and agile pythons.
These tails, which were between the ethereal and the real, penetrated Heaven and Earth, engulfing Barus in an instant, forming a massive sphere that contracted and compressed.
At the same time, the giant image of the Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox emerged once again, letting out a silent roar, pouncing towards Gentry Gail with the wildly dancing tails behind him.
In an instant, Gentry Gail’s Aura surged again, and the tails that extended from the Void in all directions shook like pythons, exerting a terrifying strangling power that shattered space.
But at that moment, the white tails in front burst apart, and infinite purple light illuminated the World, piercing through everything.
Within the purple light, crescent bone-pieces emerged, with black demon patterns twinkling, and under the ghastly white light, the Earth and Heaven congealed; then four black sharp spikes silently pierced through the Void.
Pffft, pffft, pffft!!
Gentry Gail’s limbs were pierced by the black spikes, nailed in the Void, and at the same time, a purple war spear shattered everything, piercing his chest like lightning.
Boom!
The heavily injured Gentry Gail spat blood, once again falling from the sky like a streak of light, crashing heavily upon the Earth, resulting in an instant Earth-shattering impact.
At the center of the collapsing Earth, where magma flowed, Gentry Gail, with limbs pierced by demonic weapons and a massive Hollow in his chest, stood weakly but with a wild laugh on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1505 - 1505 567 Suppressing All Directions
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1505: Chapter 567: Suppressing All Directions, Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox_3 Chapter 1505: Chapter 567: Suppressing All Directions, Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox_3 He succeeded.
At this moment, deep within Gentry Gail’s body, two powerful auras were spreading and resurrecting, evolving toward the Heaven King Realm and the Titan Giant Beast.
Watching this scene, Barus’s gaze turned icy, “Gentry Gail, aren’t you celebrating too early?”
“Even if you completely step into the Great Demon King Realm by borrowing the power of life and death today, what awaits you is still death.”
In a deep voice, a terrifying radiance gathered on the magic spear in Barus’s hand.
Although Gentry Gail had broken through the shackles, the two ‘persons’ had been fighting all the way until now, and with the recent strike, he had been severely injured.
At this moment, the origin within Gentry Gail’s body was exhausted. Although he had made a breakthrough and was reshaping the True Body of a Heavenly King, he only needed some time to recover. Barus, however, would not give him that chance.
“It’s a pity, but you won’t be able to kill me today,” Gentry Gail said with a faint smile on his face.
As a king who had come from the Dark Ages and established a country, Gentry Gail had long seen through life and death. His only pursuit in life was to break through to the Heavenly King Realm.
As a Veteran King, Gentry Gail had reached the pinnacle of kings for many years, but he was unable to make a breakthrough either due to insufficient talent or a lack of intrinsic strength.
Gentry Gail had resigned himself to the fact that if he could not make it in forty years, he would try in four hundred years. He refused to believe that he couldn’t break that barrier.
But the rise of Jack Clark during this period, with his terrifying cultivation speed and against-the-heaven combat strength, had directly stimulated Gentry Gail, filling him with passion once again.
That youngster Jack Clark managed to break through to the Heavenly King within just over a year. Although Gentry Gail admitted his talent was inferior, he refused to believe he couldn’t break that shackles.
Now it seemed that he, Gentry Gail, was indeed a genius. A Heavenly King was just that, and now he was one as well.
Noticing the smile on Gentry Gail’s face, Barus felt an inexplicable unease.
At that moment, the voice of Jack Clark echoed between heaven and earth, “Senior Gail, may I intervene now?” Instantly, Barus’s face drastically changed.
“This is bad.”
Boom!
The void above Barus shattered, and a Black Gold battle halberd, tens of kilometers long, stretched across the void and fell, bringing with it an indescribable force.
“Darren Callum, how are you here?” Barus cried out in shock and anger. All the strength within his body burst out in an Instantaneous Explosion, emitting a dazzling purple radiance.
This mighty force compressed the space into a transparent substance, forming a Purple Crystal Wall tens of kilometers in diameter with an unbreakable solidity.
Thump!
With the Divine Power of Vacuum Destruction imbued, the heavy and overbearing halberd strike instantly shattered Barus’s Laws World. Then the force burst forth violently, sending out overlapping shockwaves that swept across thousands of kilometers.
Under the unrivaled overbearing strength, Barus, the Great Demon King, who could only be suppressed on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield when Jack Clark combined his soul breath with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, exploded on the spot.
However, as a Great Demon King, Barus had stronger and more varied methods of self-preservation.
At the moment when the True Body of the Great Demon King was blown apart, over a hundred streaks of blood light flashed through the dispersing blood mist and remnants and flew in all directions, reappearing over three thousand kilometers away.
Seeing this, Gentry Gail was startled, “Jack Clark, don’t let Barus escape. Its identity is very important.”
“Don’t worry, Senior. It can’t escape,” Jack Clark said, standing with a halberd in hand atop the shattered space interlayer, with his black hair wildly blowing in the wind.
Watching the blood lights that used a technique similar to the Blood Shadow Escape Method flee, endless purple lightning burst forth from Jack Clark’s body, expanding rapidly like a Thunder Great Sun.
Based on the fundamental physical rules, aside from light itself, the speed of thunder and lightning is the fastest.
Boom, boom, boom! The terrifying Purple Heaven Thunder crushed the space, spreading in all directions like a sprawling purple spiderweb thousands of kilometers long.
Under the aura of the Supreme Law contained in the Purple Thunder Light, each and every blood light shattered and was obliterated, emitting screams one after another.
In the blink of an eye, the hundred blood lights that had flown thousands of kilometers were all extinguished, and at the same moment, Jack Clark’s gaze turned cold as a pair of golden vertical pupils appeared in his eyes.
“Barus, meeting again, why are you in such a hurry to leave?” A deep voice rang out as Jack Clark’s War Halberd in his hand emitted a dazzling radiance and suddenly disappeared.
Boom! Over two thousand kilometers away in space, an explosion occurred. A broken figure, pierced by the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, fell from the sky, landing on a mountain range.
In an instant, the sky collapsed and the earth caved in, sending dazzling purple-red light erupting over the land, forming a mushroom cloud with a diameter of a hundred kilometers that slowly rose, obliterating heaven and earth.
At the bottom of a pit dug hundreds of kilometers into the earth, Barus was nailed into the void by the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd.
Under the force of the Supreme Rules entwining the halberd, the true body of Barus dissipated at an alarming rate, his eyes revealing intense despair and unwillingness.
If only it had known how terrifying this human genius truly was, on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, it would have risked heavy injury to its foundation just to find a way to kill this human at all costs.
Instead of just going through the motions.
No, had it known the human’s talent was this terrifying, on his first entry into the Vast World, it wouldn’t have been just two Demon Kings from Deviana acting, but the entire Assassination Department descending with all its Demon Kings.
Unfortunately, it’s too late to say any of this now.
“I refuse to accept this…” Eyes filled with strong reluctance, Barus, under the grinding power of the rules contained in the Eight Desolate War Halberd, soon utterly perished.
Although his strength was above all other Great Demon Kings, to swiftly slay this Great Demon King, Jack Clark had directly exhausted the nascent Rule power that had just recovered within his body.
Immediately above the firmament, a more crimson Blood Moon appeared. It slowly descended, watched by the desperate gazes of various Purgatory True Demons.
Another Great Demon King had fallen.
“Barus is finally dead.” Watching the celestial phenomenon of the Great Demon King’s demise, Gentry Gail felt somewhat dazed.
Barus’s strength wasn’t the strongest among the Great Demon Kings, but he was very famous within the Human Federation. Over the years, many descendants of kings and Human Clan Geniuses died at the hands of the Assassination Department led by it.
Moreover, this fellow was very cunning and cautious; aside from that big battle on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield some time ago, he almost never appeared on the frontal battlefield.
Amidst her musings, Gentry Gail’s figure slightly flickered, transforming into a white nine-tailed Giant Fox, alongside a silver-haired youth, that was over one hundred meters in length.
At this moment, both the Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox and Gentry Gail exuded an aura that was very weak, but oddly gave off the impression of being powerful and complete, like an independent world unto themselves.
At this time, Jack Clark also slowly descended, a smile appearing on his face, “Senior Gentry, congratulations on you and the Eight-tails breaking through to the Heavenly King Realm together.”
Speaking of this, Gentry Gail couldn’t help but smile, “That’s all thanks to you, Jack Clark. Had you not been supporting from the shadows, I wouldn’t have dared to make a full effort.”
“My arrival was only to relieve the Senior’s concerns. The breakthrough was still achieved through your own efforts.”
“Senior, your realm is not yet stable, it would be best to find a place to recuperate and recover first. Leave the matters that follow to us.”
“Hmm.” Gentry Gail did not stand on ceremony.
After exchanging greetings, Jack Clark’s figure flickered slightly, and with one step, he appeared at the ends of the sky, arriving tens of thousands of kilometers away in a few breaths, thanks to the power of his Divine Powers.
As he watched Jack Clark’s figure disappear, Gentry Gail slowly exhaled and sighed lightly, “The younger generation is to be feared indeed.”
Beside Gentry Gail, a Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox emanating a faint aura of the Titan beasts shook its head, “Not just to be feared, he’s outright terrifying.”
“Terrifying, that’s one way to put it.” Gentry Gail nodded with a laugh.
Because of Gwen Gail and Hannah Gail, Gentry Gail had paid attention to Jack Clark quite early on, and so she was even more amazed by his current achievements.
Who could have imagined that the youth, who only a year ago needed to fight a tough battle against an Evil God Soul Split, would have already become a peer of the Demon Gods in strength?
Such a frightful speed of cultivation, despite having shocked many times already, still made veterans like Gentry Gail feel bewildered.
It couldn’t be helped; it was too exaggerated, breaking all known understandings.
At the same time, kings like Gentry Gail, as well as the three Supreme Experts, were relieved that Jack Clark had ‘correct principles’. Unlike Jonathan Walker, who was a talented fiend but chose betrayal.
Otherwise…” At this thought, Gentry Gail involuntarily shuddered.

﻿Chapter 1506: Chapter 568 Supreme Sword Intent, The Great Battle Ends Chapter 1506: Chapter 568 Supreme Sword Intent, The Great Battle Ends “`
In a primordial forest composed of colossal trees hundreds to thousands of kilometers tall, two faint shadows flitted between the dim branches like lightning.
Suddenly, those two shadows halted and looked up toward the sky on the left.
There, a black-gold battle halberd tens of kilometers long pierced the clouds, wrapped in chains of golden flames that radiated a world-destroying aura.
The target of the halberd was a mountain range below, shrouded in dark demon air and stretching for thousands of kilometers.
Around the mountain ranges, raging winds howled, forming massive black tornadoes that reached the skies, amidst which dense, red lightning exploded, emitting a dangerous aura that even mythical powerhouses would find unsettling.
At this moment, leveraging the forbidden area of dark clouds and thunder, three Purgatory Legions were stationed at the entrance, battling against two Heavenly Feather Legions.
Golden battleships in the sky fired dazzling giant arrows, shaking the dark curtain of the Purgatory Legion incessantly.
Beneath them, at low altitude and on the Earth, hundreds of thousands of Heavenly Feather Clan soldiers, resplendent with golden and silver light wings, fought fearlessly against the demonized alien race and True Demons.
Meanwhile, a demon king and a Heavenly Feather deity stood opposed in the air, their gazes coldly locked on each other.
But the sounds of slaughter on the ground suddenly ceased; all True Demons and Heavenly Feather Legions looked up in shock to see the halberd skill descending from the heavens—seemingly slow yet in reality too fast for the mind to react.
Boom!
The black-gold Halberd Skill instantly destroyed the Demon King’s True Form, and then, without losing momentum, it pierced through the thunder and landed diagonally over two hundred kilometers behind the Purgatory Legion.
Boom! Blinding golden flames erupted, followed by earth-shattering roars.
The immense strength spread like a fan in front of it, destroying the entire mountain ranges with endless golden flames, turning everything into erupting magma.
The golden ring of fire released at the moment the Halberd Skill hit the ground melted everything within a thousand-kilometer radius.
Including the True Demon Nobles who couldn’t react in time, burned to ash by the high-temperature flames.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The searing explosions swept across heaven and earth, whipped up winds and dust that blew countless Heavenly Feather soldiers away, including the Heavenly Feather deity who had been confronting the demon king in the sky.
This was still Jack Clark controlling the direction of the Power Explosion from his halberd; otherwise, the fate of the Heavenly Feather Clan would not have been as simple as being blown away by the residual blast.
But no one knew this.
The Heavenly Feather Alien Clan members, thrown a thousand kilometers away, could only catch a fleeting glimpse of a towering figure holding a halberd in the sky.
Not until the terrifying aura that was almost imperceptible in the firmament vanished, did Brooks, a Horned Split True Demon thousands of kilometers away, slowly ease his breath.
After calming his mind a little, the Horned Split True Demon couldn’t help but exclaim in shock, “Brooks, the strength of that human just now was terrifying. It feels even stronger than the Great Demon King!”
Gazing down at the sea of magma fire where the mountain ranges and forbidden area had vanished, Brooks nodded gravely, “Indeed, it is very strong. To destroy an ordinary forbidden area with one strike—this is a power that only a Demon God possesses.”
Such power that could alter landscapes and the natural environment had exceeded the understanding of the two True Demons.
Hiss! The power of a Demon God.
The Horned Split True Demon drew a cold breath, “No wonder Great Demon King Barus suddenly fell earlier. He must have encountered this human powerhouse.”
“It must have been him.”
Recalling the blood moon that shone in the sky before and the aura of Great Demon King Barus which dissipated after the moon’s fall, Brooks slowly nodded his head.
“How can the Human Race have so many Demon God Level Powerhouses!” The Horned Split True Demon’s voice was a bit hoarse.
As a True Demon Noble who had chosen demonization, Gulden was initially thrilled and excited because, in his heart, The Purgatory Family was invincible.
Over the years, following the armies of the Purgatory Empire, he participated in several wars that obliterated normal alien civilizations.
The Purgatory Legion was nearly unstoppable wherever it went, and no civilization could hold back their advance, including many giant beasts entrenched in forbidden areas.
Thus, like countless demonized alien races, Gulden was filled with fanaticism and faith in the Purgatory Demon Clan.
But one battle had shattered the illusions in his heart.
This time, two empires convened all of their elites, amassing an army of hundreds of millions, with dozens of demon kings and demon kings manifesting in full force, and eight Demon Gods descending.
Yet to their surprise, the strength of the Human Alliance was even more terrifying; the Demon Gods started falling almost immediately in the battle that erupted quickly, leading to consecutive defeats.
This directly led to a complete loss of Battle Intent in the Purgatory Legion, and with the hidden mythical powerhouses of the Human Race emerging—outnumbering even the demon kings and Great Demon Kings of the Purgatory Empire—the battle below had not yet erupted before the Purgatory Legion was already in disarray, fleeing in all directions under the pursuit of the Human Alliance Army.
Including Brooks, who was stationed with the Assassination Department on the outskirts of the battlefield, they, too, chose to scatter and flee at the first opportunity.
This left Gulden, who had just become the Lord of the Intelligence Department branch hall, somewhat unprepared to adapt, shattering his long-held invincible vision of the Purgatory Demon Clan and casting a shadow over his future.
Seeing the Horned Split True Demon suddenly feeling downhearted and losing confidence, Brooks offered reassurance.
“Don’t lose heart, Gulden. Although the number of Supreme Experts from the Human Race exceeded our expectations and caught us off guard this time, our The Purgatory Family is much stronger than the Human Race.”
“Don’t forget, it’s only our two empires that are currently at war with the Human Race.”
“Compared to our empires, the Demon Clan has six even more powerful empires, with more demon kings, Great Demon Kings, and Demon Gods.”
