chapters.title: Chapter 1507 - 1507 568 Supreme Sword Intent The Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1507: Chapter 568 Supreme Sword Intent, The Great Battle Ends_2 Chapter 1507: Chapter 568 Supreme Sword Intent, The Great Battle Ends_2 “There’s also the legendary ancestor who has been hibernating for thousands of years, whose strength is earth-shattering and immensely powerful.”
The encouragement from Brooks invigorated the spirit of the Horned Split True Demon.
Seeing this, Brooks continued gravely, “Next, we need to leave here quickly and return to the empire.”
“Right now, the human experts’ attention is on pursuing our demon king, the Great Demon King, so they’re less likely to notice us.”
“But once the great battle ends, the humans will definitely sweep through the newly occupied territory, and all the hidden True Demons will be cleansed.”
The Horned Split True Demon solemnly nodded, “Brooks, you’re right. We must escape back to the rear of the empire as soon as possible.” Saying this, he prepared to set off.
But just then, Gulden sensed something and turned his head in astonishment to look at his companion, “Brooks, your aura… are you about to make a breakthrough to Demon King?”
Speaking of this, Brooks showed a faint smile on his face.
“I tried to temper that drop of Demonic God’s Essence Blood earlier. Probably because I have the talent for blood control, the fusion doesn’t seem to be difficult.”
Immediately, the Horned Split True Demon showed envy on his face, “It’s a pity, I’m not good with bloodline and life-based talents, so there’s not much hope for me to temper that drop of Blood of Demon God.”
The two True Demons had stumbled upon two drops (the size of water tanks) of demon god blood that had fallen from the sky while they were sneaking away.
Although it wasn’t Demonic God’s Essence Blood, as blood that contained the aura of rules and the strength of the True Demon God Body, it would still be a great boon to the two True Demons of shared origin as long as they could temper it.
For example, Brooks, who was at the peak of Nine Demonic Marks and half a step into Demon King, had originally estimated that it would take him several more months to break through.
This time, with the help of the dark power contained in the demon god blood, he completed the tempering of the Demon King’s True Form. Now he just needed to do some closed-door cultivation to step into the Demon King level.”
“It’s okay, Gulden.”
“I’m somewhat familiar with biology and gene evolution. When we go back, I’ll help you research your body, and I should be able to help you temper the Demonic God’s blood.”
“Really, Brooks?” The Horned Split True Demon’s face lit up with surprise.
Brooks’s gaze flickered for a moment, and a fierce smile appeared on his face, “Of course, we are good brothers, helping you is the same as helping myself.”
“Once you break through to Demon King, if we join forces, we might be able to take control of the Assassination Department and become important figures in both empires.”
“Of course, that’s assuming the empire isn’t obliterated by the human race this time.”
……
Above the firmament where space had shattered, Jack Clark slowly retracted the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
In the sky, the corpse of the Great Demon King, which was split into dozens of pieces, floated amidst golden flames and wrapped in jumping purple lightning.
Besides that, there was also a Golden Dragon soul phantom pressing down on it, eroding the remaining Divine Soul Intent and Origin of the Great Demon King.
In the distance, a Golden Dragon more than two thousand meters long coiled around, emitting a strong Heavenly King level aura, its breath chaotic and heavy.
Turning to that Golden Dragon, Jack Clark slowly said, “Overlord Dragon Senior, I’ll leave the rest up to you.”
The Overlord Dragon Heavenly King nodded, “Jack, be careful too. These demon kings are treacherous and vicious; I almost fell for this guy’s trick earlier.”
After a greeting, Jack’s figure soared into the sky to an altitude of ten thousand kilometers, with Black Gold vertical pupils in his eyes emerging as he surveyed the surroundings.
At this moment, a red sun spanned the sky, and the entire heaven and earth were tainted by red sunlight, with clouds swirling as if hell had descended, exuding an intense sinister aura.
This scene was somewhat similar to when the Blood Moon descended at night, except one during the day and one during the dark night, containing very different powers.
For instance, the light of the Blood Moon incited bloodlust, ferocity, and an overwhelming desire for slaughter and destruction in all living beings.
The sunlight from the red sun hanging in the sky, however, only made people feel irritable and more restless. Considering this, Jack’s gaze flickered slightly.
The ‘red’ powers he had known so far included Supreme Hell and the Deep Red World…
After contemplating for a moment, Jack snapped back to reality; now wasn’t the time to think about these things. Sensing that he had regained two-tenths of his strength, his eyes narrowed slightly.
“It’s time to catch up and check it out.”
Half a day had passed since the Destruction Emperor Dragon had returned. Employing the Bound Crossing Divine Ability, Jack had crossed more than two million kilometers.
Along the way, he had slain seven Demon Kings and two Great Demon Kings, and incidentally slaughtered more than twenty Purgatory Legions and Vassal Alien Races.
There was no helping it; the battlefield, which was a half-circle extending over a million kilometers in length and two million kilometers at its widest, was too large, and Jack had not even covered one percent of it as he flew.
Moreover, the energy fluctuations of those Demon King level battles were so ‘weak’ that Jack couldn’t sense them beyond ten thousand kilometers and could only search for them using the Void Death Pupil.
Currently, the human side had the numerical advantage in high-end power. It was fine to leave those Demon Kings to them; there was no need for him to waste any more time here.
Compared to this place, the battlefield where Adam Garcetti was fighting was more critical.
With his current restored strength, entering the Dark Star Apocalypse Form should enable him to contain a Demon God.
As for summoning the Destruction Emperor Dragon again later to burst into the rear of the Purgatory Empire and explode those Demon Gods, Jack had only thought about it before deciding to give up.
Because just as he was about to try using the Space-Time Summoning Technique, he felt as if his body was overburdened, on the verge of shattering at any moment.
For the past three days, drawing on the Creation power of the Purple little dragon, he had been burning his Life Origin, and his body had been shattered and restored time and again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1508 - 1508 568 Supreme Sword Intent The Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1508: Chapter 568 Supreme Sword Intent, The Great Battle Ends_3 Chapter 1508: Chapter 568 Supreme Sword Intent, The Great Battle Ends_3 He had reached a physical limit where, without the help of the Creation power from the purple little dragon, even his Life Origin would shatter upon breaking through.
If Jack Clark survived, his cultivation would still be severely regressed, losing his foundation.
This was why he did not burn his Vitality to forcibly maintain the stay of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and continue to slay one or two more Demon Gods.
Clearly, his previous action to exploit the BUG seemed to perfectly solve the erosion by the Power of Time, but that didn’t mean there were no problems at all.
The Space-Time Summoning Technique involved time, space, and even reversed causality, so some ‘injuries’ were invisible.
Whoosh! Jack Clark’s figure flashed, turning into a golden red light that shot into the sky, speeding towards the rear of the Purgatory Empire like a beam of rainbow light.
…
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
High in the sky, three terrifying figures collided and entangled, bursting forth with power on par with Demon Gods.
Among the three figures, one was the Purgatory Great Demon King with three heads and twelve arms, wielding a double-edged slash blade, surrounded by a domain of dark crimson Abyssal World exuding a terrifying Aura.
Its opponent was none other than the Lord of Holy Light, with white wings spread behind, emanating the peak Aura of the Main God.
Under the first glimmer of Heavenly Radiance, the Demonic Qi dissipated, and beams of Light Spears, each thousands of meters long, pierced through the Abyss World, releasing blinding brilliance.
Joining forces with the Lord of Holy Light was a Human Expert Jack Clark had never seen before, who appeared to be a man in his thirties, with a wild and unrestrained look.
Most importantly, an Aura of the Supreme Law emanated from this young man, along with an extremely sharp, heaven-piercing, terrifying Sword Intent.
This Human Heavenly King had merged the Supreme Law into his Sword Intent, transforming it into a horizon-spanning silver sword light of tens of thousands of feet, sweeping across everything.
Under the majestic and overbearing sword light, the Abyss World shattered, and even the Abyssal Rule controlled by the Great Demon King Georgi was severed, leaving silver scars of light lingering between heaven and earth.
Boom!
The three strong men withstood a direct hit, and with the cooperation of the Lord of Holy Light, the Great Demon King Georgi spat blood, nearly sliced in half at the shoulder by the slanting silver sword light.
“Mad Wheeler, do not push this king too far, or we all meet our end today,” the Great Demon King Georgi roared.
Boom!!
A terrifying Power Explosion erupted within Georgi’s body, his entire figure wrapped in dark crimson blood runes, with a black orb supported by a pair of demonic arms behind him emitting dazzling Radiance.
The powerful energy fluctuation caught the Lord of Holy Light off guard, instinctively wanting to push away.
“Meet our end together? Over your dead body,” came a cold, long howl echoing through Heaven and Earth, as the silver sword light flared up, splitting into nine, dropping like nine hanging galaxies, each slice filled with razor-sharp Aura, aiming for Georgi.
Seeing the dazzling sword light tearing through the Abyss Domain, a fierce look flashed in Georgi’s eyes: “Then let’s die together.”
Boom!
Georgi’s arms exploded, turning into countless droplets of blood that flowed into the black orb, which at that instant blasted open, bringing forth an even more terrifying and evil Abyssal Descent.
Infinite billowing Black Demonic Qi engulfed Heaven and Earth, forming layers upon layers of sky-obscuring gates that looked like the heads of malevolent spirits, sealing off the sky and trapping everything beneath them.
As the gates of the Abyssal Demons descended, enclosing everything, the Lord of Holy Light, Georgi, and Mad Wheeler, along with this piece of the world, continuously fell into the depths of the Abyss.
This was the true Supreme Abyss, not the hollow Abyss projection summoned by Demon Kings; it was filled with endless darkness and malevolence.
Suddenly, the Lord of Holy Light’s face turned grave.
Boom!
The white wings on the back of the Lord of Holy Light flared angrily, emitting blinding Radiance, dissolving the incoming Abyssal Demonic Qi, frantically resisting the Devouring power from below.
The Dark Abyss differed from the Deep Red World—it was a twisted, dark, infinitely deep place of terror where once entered, there was no escape.
This included even the Extreme Realm Great Demon King Georgi himself.
But at that moment, those nine silver sword lights suddenly merged into one, and an exceedingly radiant sword light appeared in the Abyss, piercing through Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
Under the brilliance of the Supreme Sword Light, the black world that enveloped a range of three thousand kilometers shattered, and along with it, the layers of Abyssal Devil’s Gate and Georgi’s true body were also slashed into pieces.
In the wake of that piercing silver sword light, the darkness dissipated, and once again red sunlight spilled down.
Huff, huff!! So strong!
The Lord of Holy Light, having escaped from the grasp of the Abyss’ devouring force, caught his breath, looking at the sword light that stood between heaven and earth and the silhouette within the sword light with some shock.
The Lord of Holy Light was not only shocked by the endless emergence of strong men of the Human Race.
It had not expected that, aside from Jack Clark with his heaven-defying talent and combat strength, and the True Martial Heavenly King who was at the pinnacle of the Heavenly King realm and could stand up to a Demon God, there were still other fighters who could break through their limits.
This person, known as Mad Wheeler and also at the pinnacle of the Heavenly King realm, was stronger than it and even some of the Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings.
Just then, as the sky fell and the earth collapsed, a black-gold battle halberd descended from the sky. With its edge trembling, the very heavens and earth shook along with it, exuding a terrifying aura that suppressed Heaven and Earth.
And the target of this black-gold battle halberd was none other than the Great Demon King Georgi, who had just reconstructed his true body in the distance.
Boom!
Under that unrivaled domination of the battle halberd strike, Georgi let out a miserable scream as his true body exploded once again, and along with him, a range of thousands of kilometers was blown apart into chaos with a single hit.
Such overbearing power caused even Mad Wheeler to focus his gaze, turning his attention towards the horizon.
There, a young man with black hair cascading over his shoulders held a halberd and gave a slight nod towards the two men before turning into a golden-red light and vanishing into the horizon.
Watching that figure disappear, a smile broke across Mad Wheeler’s rugged face, “So strong, is that the strength of the everlasting number one talent spoken of by Teacher Adam Garcetti?”
After casually aiding the Lord of Holy Light and the others in wounding that Great Demon King, Jack Clark quickly flew out of the forbidden area.
Following the lingering wisps of Rule Power throughout Heaven and Earth, he hurriedly flew towards the direction of the Purgatory Empire.
Along the way, one could see the earth below breaking apart, rivers and mountains collapsing; the fierce Rule Power was stirring the Heavenly Energy into a frenzy, creating numerous hazardous zones.
However, those few Demon Gods were quick to escape, and more than two hours later, following the pervasive Rule Aura between Heaven and Earth, Jack Clark flew another three million kilometers.
In the distance, countless tendrils of Black Demonic Qi were rolling between heaven and earth, forming a towering Dark Sky Curtain that submerged everything.
Inside the surging Black Demonic Qi, five powerful figures stood proudly, their terrifying auras stirring the darkness and forming five monstrous demon shadows behind them, each standing a hundred thousand meters tall.
Aside from Diorus and Rudeus who had fled, and the Ancestral Demon God Levides from the Alecasa Empire and Stephenl, there was another Demon God.
And no matter whether it was Diorus or the other three Demon Gods, though they appeared weak and severely injured, they inexplicably exuded a very powerful aura.
Standing in the boundless darkness, they were receiving some sort of more formidable Dark Rule empowerment, confronting Adam Garcetti and the other powerhouses outside the Dark Sky Curtain.
Outside the Dark Sky Curtain, Adam Garcetti stood with Yin and Yang underfoot, surrounded by the Sky-based God King, Primordial True King, True Martial Heavenly King, and three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings.
As for the strongest Divine King Tarodel, since he didn’t want to overtax his Origin, he was gradually eroding that Demon God bit by bit using the power of the rules.
Jacks Clark’s figure appeared in front of Adam Garcetti and the others, instantly boosting the spirits of all the powerhouses present, including the three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, as smiles appeared on their faces.
“Jack Clark, you’re here.”
With a serious tone, Jack Clark said, “Seniors, how is the situation?”
Adam Garcetti replied gravely, “It’s a bit troublesome. We didn’t expect that in their empire, there would indeed be an Ancestral Demon God presiding, completing the territorial demonization.”
“This Black Demonic Qi is different from the Abyssal Demonic Aura they usually harness. It comes from that hibernating ancestor.”
“Or maybe this Black Demonic Qi, including that part of the world, is actually part of that ‘true body’ of the Purgatory ancestor, extending its rule power.”
“And whether it’s Diorus or the other True Demons, their bloodlines and powers, they all inherit from that Ancestral Demon. Therefore, upon entering the demon domain, their strength will greatly increase.”
Up to this point, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but sharpen his gaze.
He knew that today’s battle had reached this point, and it was almost time to end it.
[There are still 300 words left to wrap up the update, just to keep up with the daily release. Refresh the page after ten minutes, brothers.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1509 - 1509 569 The Space-Time Rift Ancient Fierce
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1509: Chapter 569: The Space-Time Rift, Ancient Fierce Ape Chapter 1509: Chapter 569: The Space-Time Rift, Ancient Fierce Ape The Purgatory ancestor was indeed very powerful!
On the return journey, after distancing himself from the dark demon realm that blotted out the sky, Jack Clark, transformed into a streak of golden red radiance, showed a grave expression on his face.
During the three-day confrontation, the Supreme of the Human Race and those Demon Gods appeared calm on the surface, but in reality, there had been some skirmishes, including Jack Clark.
However, his target was the all-devouring dark demon air.
The dark demon air, different from the demon air of Demon Gods like Diorus, harbored the characteristic to demonize everything. The laws of Heaven and Earth and all living things were contaminated and became a part of that ancient creature.
Such overbearing strength was far above the rules grasped by lifeforms of ancient level.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which could be compared to a True Spirit after a limit breakthrough, was no match for the ancient ancestor, since the Destruction Emperor Dragon only broke through its limits due to an exceedingly terrifying foundation and was comparable to an initial stage True Spirit creature, but not a real True Spirit Beast.
And the gap between ancient creatures and True Spirit Creatures was even broader than that between a Heavenly King and the Supreme.
The power of rules belonging to the ancient life was born within their own ‘world’ and needed continuous improvement and growth.
Whereas True Spirit creatures were already fused with the rules, controlling rules recognized by the mythical world, able to change the fundamental laws of a realm and suppress everything.
Within the realm governed by these power of rules, True Spirit creatures possessed absolute authority and unparalleled strength.
And the strength of this Purgatory ancestor, as it expanded its Purgatory Empire, drew upon demon air to pollute Heaven and Earth over a range of billions of kilometers, and its strength was horrifying beyond description.
Although he had not had direct contact with this Purgatory ancestor, Jack Clark estimated that the adversary’s realm was at least in the late stage of True Spirit.
And that was merely realm; no one knew if the true combat strength might be even stronger.
This Purgatory True Demon had been alive for countless tens of thousands of years, and the Secret Skills and Divine Powers it had honed over the long years, as well as the weapons it had forged, had already reached the pinnacle of perfection.
Moreover, a creature that had grown to this realm was also not lacking in combat experience and wisdom.
Jack Clark felt that the Destruction Emperor Dragon needed to grow to the ancient late stage before it could clash head-on with this ancient Purgatory True Demon, and to ensure victory, it had to breakthrough to the peak of the ancient stage or even become a True Spirit Beast.
Therefore, in the battle that was about to begin, Jack Clark’s goal was merely to leave behind half of those Demon Gods.
As for completely annihilating all eight Demon Gods, that was nearly impossible. These Demon Gods were all strong and had numerous methods; even when Adam Garcetti and others joined forces, they could not stop them if the Demon Gods truly intended to flee.
Of course, if Jack Clark had not exhausted the Creation origin of the purple little dragon earlier, and could maintain the existence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon for three days in a limit-burning state, the state of Doomsday was estimated to last about two hours or so.
Giving two hours to a True Spirit level combatant, even if the eight Demon Gods scattered and fled, Jack Clark was confident that he could slaughter most of them and destroy all living forces of the two great empires.
Jack Clark had considered this issue, but in the end, he chose to abandon it.
A True Spirit Initial Stage Summoned Giant Beast that could only exist for ten minutes, and one that could last two to three hours, presented two entirely different levels of threat to The Purgatory Family.
For the former, the Purgatory Empire only needed to dispatch one Great Demon King, who together with two ancient late-stage Lords of the Empire, could contend head-on.
As long as they were careful not to suffer heavy injuries from the beast’s Burst, they could just wait about ten minutes for Jack Clark’s strength to run out. Any human at the mid-period Heavenly King could easily kill him then.
Therefore, the fall of four Demon Gods in this battle would definitely shake The Purgatory Family to its core, yet it was not enough to forcibly awaken that Purgatory ancestor.
However, if all eight Demon Gods perished and the two great empires were destroyed in this battle, under severe danger, there would definitely be Demon Gods sacrificed to awaken the ancient creature.
By then, unless Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon achieved Deification and merged beforehand, fully advancing into the True Spirit level, there would be no hope of resisting; otherwise, the fate waiting for the Human Race would be nothing but annihilation.
Still, there was another problem—if the Destruction Emperor Dragon summoned through the Space-Time Summoning Technique merged with the Giant Beast Body, would there be issues after Jack Clark, the bearer of the Space-Time Altar, disappeared?
In such a case, the mainly higher realm of the Giant Beast Body would prevail, but at the same time, Jack Clark, the carrier of the Space-Time Altar, would vanish too.
Would the Giant Beast that descended against space-time also disappear, returning to the Chaotic Turbulent Region under the influence of the Distortion of space-time?
By the time the Deified Giant Beast traveled through the Chaotic Domain and over vast distances to reach the battlefield, the Human Race might have already vanished at the hands of the awakening Purgatory ancestor.
Hence, the current outcome was just right for the Human Race.
Almost halving the elite Purgatory Legions of the two great empires, the demon king and the Great Demon Kings also suffered heavy losses, and one Demon God from each side perished.
Including the Demon Gods that came to aid, two were also slain.
The strength displayed served as a deterrent, while also not driving the Purgatory Demon Race into madness.
Two Great Demon Kings, four ancient late-stage Lords of the Empire, along with over a dozen other Demon Gods’ combat power and multitudes of Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings—the combined strength was still above that of the Human Race.
As long as they gathered all their strength subsequently and prepared for it, they could obliterate the Human Race in one battle.
It’s just that this gathering of all forces would take some time, given that the three major empires on Tyris’s side were still trapped in the Deep Red World.
And this difference in time was crucial for the Human Federation, or for Jack Clark.
Before the next decisive battle erupted, he or the Destruction Emperor Dragon had to grow strong enough to clash with, or even slay, the Purgatory ancestor.
Of course, although Jack Clark considered many factors before the great battle, there were also miscalculations.
For instance, depleting the purple little dragon’s Creation origin to maintain the Destruction Emperor Dragon—capitalizing on the Time Power gained by the time BUG—resulted in only one Time Mark being formed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1510 - 1510 569 The Space-Time Rift Ancient Fierce
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1510: Chapter 569: The Space-Time Rift, Ancient Fierce Ape_2 Chapter 1510: Chapter 569: The Space-Time Rift, Ancient Fierce Ape_2 Originally, Jack Clark had estimated that creating a Time Mark as a Heavenly King would cost more than ten times that of someone at the Mythical Peak Realm.
Three days would be enough to condense three Time Marks, increasing his combat power by three Demon God Level figures from the Ancient Middle Stage.
But who would have thought that after reaching the mid period of the Heavenly King Realm, the cost to form a single Time Mark would actually skyrocket to more than fifty times, causing even Jack Clark to feel somewhat of a headache.
If it weren’t for the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill, and he had to capture the Power of Time using Time Reincarnation Mystic Power regularly, Jack estimated it would take ten years to form one Mark.
It was that exaggerated.
Of course, this pace was slow for Jack, but for other Heavenly Kings or Great Demon Kings, it was ridiculously fast.
Ten years in the Blue Star World is equivalent to just over three years in the mythical world, which for a Great Demon King, would simply pass by during a period of hibernation or closed-door cultivation.
Mere decade-long seclusions could condense avatars with combat power equal to nine of their peers, which was simply defying the heavens.
Besides the miscalculation in condensing Time Marks, there was something else Jack Clark hadn’t anticipated: those Demon Gods would disregard everything and launch a desperate, coordinated assassination attempt on him the moment the battle began.
Among the eight Demon Gods, Diorus, Belidier, and Stephenl each had the combat power of the Peak of the Ancient stage.
In addition, Sigitico, whose combat power surged to the Peak of the Ancient stage in an Instantaneous Explosion, three Demon Gods with Ancient Middle Stage strength, two forbidden weapons and three others that detonated from different races with Intrinsic Strength.
Such a terrifying strike, which would have heavily injured or even brought a Sky-based God King to the brink of death, let alone Jack Clark, who was a cultivator in the mid period of the Heavenly King Realm.
Even in a state of Limit Breakthrough, Jack’s combat power was at the very top within the Ancient Middle Stage, but under normal conditions, he had only just barely stepped into the early stage of the Demon God.
Including his Defense.
Therefore, even looking back now, Jack still felt somewhat fortunate.
Although his Heart’s Eye had sensed strong malice from the gazes of those Demon Gods and an intense danger implicitly, it couldn’t predict exactly what that danger was.
Out of caution, Jack subtly switched places with his Time True Body.
And to avoid exposure, at that moment Jack deployed the world power of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, covering a hundred-kilometer radius, so subtly that not even Adam Garcetti and others noticed.
If it weren’t for the Time True Body blocking that strike, under the conditions where all Mystic Powers, Laws, and Talents were sealed, even if he didn’t die, he would have suffered terrifying heavy injuries.
For instance, his Divine Soul might have been shattered by a strike from the peak power of a Demon God, causing severe damage to the Soul Source.
Even if the little Purple Dragon still had the Creation Origin, it wouldn’t be able to heal such spiritual injuries, and the consequences would be stagnation or even a significant drop in cultivation level.
After all, the little Purple Dragon’s power was still too weak, having only grown to the Mythical Level, with a Law Level Creation Power.
Jack sighed lightly, “Indeed, one should never underestimate any ‘Person’, especially those who can reach the level of a Demon God.”
While Jack Clark was analyzing the gains and losses of this great battle, the Chaotic Turbulent Region was erupting with Ancient Level fighting.
Roar!
Under the dim Firmament, a Dust Serpent as long as fifteen thousand meters roared furiously, locked in a crazed battle with a Giant Beast that stood seven thousand meters tall, with its whole body covered in white scale armor and fur—the Furious Ape.
Or rather, being crushed.
The Ancient Fierce Ape had limbs glowing red, surrounded by a crimson Radiance that enveloped a thousand-kilometer radius. Every movement it made contained the Terrifying Power to shatter space-time.
In front of the mountainous body of the Ancient-level Irvin Watkins Beast, the Dust Serpent, long and slender at fifteen thousand meters in length, seemed somewhat slim.
Each head-on collision sent it flying, causing the Void to explode and the Earth to collapse.
Roar!
The Dust Serpent, sent flying once more, let out an angry roar; its body suddenly shining with an intense gray-white Radiance. Under the powerful petrification light, everything, including space itself, became petrified.
Even the crimson domain of the Ancient Irvin Watkins started to Crackle Crackle, turning into solid gray rock.
From afar, it looked like a satellite with a diameter of more than a thousand kilometers had appeared amidst the shattered Void, emitting an invisible rule power that distorted everything around it, instilling terror.
But just then, the stone satellite shook violently, its surface showing cracks, with endless, fierce and murderous crimson Radiance leaking from those cracks.
Boom!
The stone satellite exploded, the seven-thousand-meter-tall Fierce Ape roaring skyward, its boundless red Radiance shooting into the sky, like a supreme Ferocious Beast descending from the Ancients.
But just as the enraged Ancient Irvin Watkins was ready to catch and tear apart the detestable Gray Python, Heaven and Earth suddenly darkened.
Suddenly, a vast gray world emerged above the Firmament, like a continental block with a diameter of ten to twenty thousand kilometers.
Surrounding the continent, the ghostly figure of a Python, tens of thousands of kilometers in length, coiled, its enormous head bowed slightly, its massive gray vertical pupil coldly observing everything below.
Boom!
The Python coiled around the world opened its massive maw and in an instant, the world shook and darkness fell. A devouring power enveloped the Ancient Irvin Watkins.
Under that world-devouring force, the Ancient Irvin Watkins’ red Rule Domain shook and gradually succumbed to the darkness.
Roar!
Within the red Radiance and sensing the danger, the Ancient Irvin Watkins let out a shocked and angry roar. Its eyes glowed red, and an even more Terrifying Power began to revive within its body.
With the Essence of War and Calamity exploding from within the Ancient Irvin Watkins, blood dyed all of its full-body scales and fur a deep red.
Its immense strength resonated with a rule between heaven and earth, forming an image of a tens of thousands of meters tall Blood-colored Fierce Ape behind it.

﻿Chapter 1511: Chapter 569 Space-Time Rift, Ancient Fierce Ape_3 Chapter 1511: Chapter 569 Space-Time Rift, Ancient Fierce Ape_3 “`
Boom!
Just at the moment the shadow of the Blood-colored Fierce Ape appeared, an even more ferocious and terrifying killing intent surged to the heavens, as its body swelled infinitely under the dazzling crimson light.
Blood-red light swirled around its arms as they reached into the dark void above.
Roar!
In the midst of the Blood-colored Fierce Ape’s raging roars, its arms experienced a Power Explosion, emitting blindingly bright red light, gradually tearing apart the enveloping darkness.
Boom!
The Nine Heavens shook, darkness collapsed, and the mighty collision of Divine Powers caused a collapse of space within a range of tens of thousands of kilometers. The Earth shattered, and the impact that could Destroy Heaven and Earth swept across an area of tens of thousands of kilometers.
Roar! Be careful.
Roar! Run quickly.
Over ten thousand kilometers away, the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Kamaitachi Beast, which had been following the Dust Serpent, let out terrified roars as their internal power Burst forth, forming Law Domains around them.
Boom, boom, boom!
Beneath the impact that could Destroy Heaven and Earth, the two Mythical Peak Beasts were sent flying by the spatial tide, their Law Domains around them constantly trembling, shrinking.
Not knowing how far they had flown, when the raging impact weakened, the Single-horned Spawn Roc struggled to flap its double wings and halt its momentum.
Looking up, it saw that far in the Firmament above, the Gray Python that encircled the world had half of its mouth shattered; its breath was weak from the backlash of its shattered Divine Power.
At the same time, beneath the curled python that encircled the world, an endless crimson light lit up the Heaven and Earth, like a red Great Sun.
At the center of the dazzling red light, the Blood-colored Fierce Ape, standing over seven thousand meters tall, was surrounded by a terrifying aura of killing intent, looking extremely ferocious.
The Blood-colored Fierce Ape’s arms and shoulders were covered in wounds, fresh blood dripping from them, blending into the surrounding crimson blood, instantly making the red light more dazzling, the aura more ferocious.
Even the Single-horned Spawn Roc could tell that the Dust Serpent was at a disadvantage and was no match for the Blood-colored Fierce Ape.
Moreover, from the endless killing intent in the Blood-colored Fierce Ape’s red eyes, the Single-horned Spawn Roc saw the madness and ferocity; this beast was not of the same kind as them.
Roar! Jormungand cannot win, it’s a thorny issue, we must call for help.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc’s mouth opened, spewing out a Black Gold scale armor with a diameter of a hundred meters and a thickness of over twenty meters, while the blue light intensified on the single horn on its head.
Boom! A pure Laws’ Origin power exploded from the blue single horn, turning into a light beam ten meters thick and fiercely striking the Black Gold scale armor.
Hum!
The Black Gold scale armor vibrated, its surface entwined with gold-red lightning patterns lighting up one by one, the shimmers forming the shadow of a giant beast that resembled but was not a dragon.
As the gold-red lightning zigzagged, a powerful Will traversed the coordinates across spacetime, suddenly animating the giant shadow.
In an instant, a Terrifying Aura spread, shaking the entire Heaven and Earth.
Over twenty thousand kilometers away, the two ancient beasts that were about to continue battling suddenly paused, turning their heads to look.
A thousand kilometers from the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the previously steadied Kamaitachi Beast bowed its head respectfully under this Aura, “Roar! Greetings, great king.”
Under the gaze of the golden-red Giant Beast shadow, the Single-horned Spawn Roc cried out excitedly.
Roar! Thunderflame, hurry up and come help, we’ve encountered a very powerful big guy, Jormungand cannot win.
“Have you encountered an Ancient Beast?” the deep voice thundered through Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
The Black Gold scale armor vibrated again, activating a force of rules from within, forming golden-red Rune Sequence Chains intermixed with some silver spatial runes.
These golden-red Rune Sequence Chains revolved around the Black Gold scale armor as the center, forming a massive vortex.
Meanwhile, over a million kilometers away, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its massive head flanked by three pairs of red wings, also burned with flames, countless silver spatial runes flickering.
The skyward-rising golden flames melted spacetime, echoing with the coordinates and rule forces of the other, gradually forming a massive Spatial Channel.
After evolving to an ancient level, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s control over space became even stronger, and even without the talent for space, it could interfere with the Supreme Rule.
Additionally, having studied the Innate Space Rune in the past and built Spatial Channels, it had a profound understanding and mastery of space.
Thus, before setting out, it condensed four enhanced Dragon King Scales, the Reverse Scale King Orders, which contained not only a strand of its rule power but also spatial coordinates inscribed based on the Space-Time Altar.
Using the rule power and spatial coordinates within the King Orders, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could instantly tear open a Spatial Channel and descend upon the Giant Dragon across millions of kilometers.
As for any further distance, it was temporarily beyond its power boundary.
The four Reverse Scale King Orders were given to the Silver Giant Dragon, the gold-blue Giant Dragon, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon.
The main purpose was to provide a safeguard in case the Silver Giant Dragon and it were separated and encountered insurmountable dangers, as well as for the safety of the Single-horned Spawn Roc and others following the two Ancient Beasts.
Roar! Just as the Single-horned Spawn Roc activated the Reverse Scale King Order and tore open the Spatial Channel to call for help, the distant Blood-colored Fierce Ape also reacted immediately.
Boom! A red Breath emanated from the Blood-colored Fierce Ape’s mouth, traversing Heaven and Earth, radiating energy fluctuations and bright light that could Destroy Heaven and Earth.
“Roar! Have you forgotten about me?”
Just as the red Breath beam traversed ten thousand miles, the high sky trembled, and a python’s tail thousands of kilometers in length descended from the heavens.
The overcast tail of the Gray Python, transparent like a shadow, emanated formless strength that caused the Heavenly Earth Law to collapse and all things to be annihilated.

The immense tail of the Giant Serpent shattered the red Breath and fiercely landed on the raging Red Beast, causing the earth-shattering roar to explode once again.
The terrifying power released by the clash of the two Giant Beasts reached a tearing point, forming a colossal crack tens of thousands of kilometers long.
In the apocalyptic explosion, the phantom of the python stretching tens of thousands of kilometers disintegrated, and the body of the Blood-colored fierce ape was blasted thousands of kilometers away by the powerful rebound.
In the instant that the Dust Serpent blocked the way, a pair of Black Gold claws wrapped in golden-red lightning appeared in the vortex in front of the Single-horned Spawn Roc and tore fiercely at the whirlpool.
Boom! The originally stable Spatial Channel instantly collapsed, forming a black Space Crack over a thousand kilometers in length.
Within the crazily shaking Black Cracks, a Black Gold Beast stretching over seven thousand meters forced its way through, with two Giant Dragons over a thousand meters in length still hanging from its tail.
The moment the Black Gold Beast appeared, this world shook even more violently, the Earth quaked like a Tsunami, and an aura making even the Heavenly Earth Law tremble descended.
Watching the arrival of the Black Gold Beast, the Single-horned Spawn Roc cried out excitedly.
Roar! Thunder Dragon, you’ve arrived. That creature is too despicable, it actually wanted to destroy the pathway and prevent your arrival, and we must punish it severely later.

The immense Gray Python in the sky also lowered its head, emitting excited growls, the sound causing the entire heaven and earth to roar, “Roar! Thunderflame, you’ve come.”
Seeing this scene, even the eyes of the Blood-colored fierce ape, filled with Killing Intent and violence, showed a hint of wariness.
From the Black Gold Beast, it sensed a presence as vast as the ocean, very strong.
At that moment, the silver dragon head behind the Black Gold Beast poked out excitedly and roared, “Tim Abott, that creature actually beat Jormungand to such a state, it even lost its tail,it’s unforgivable.”
“Roar! It’s unforgivable, let’s finish it off and eat it, the Great Sethia loves to see rivers of blood,” it bellowed.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly to the Single-horned Spawn Roc and turned its gaze to the Blood-colored fierce ape over twenty thousand kilometers away, slowly opening its terrifying maw and making a deep, resonant sound.
“Torn apart, eaten yet?”
In its low growl, an Invisible Power emanated from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, shaking off the silver Giant Dragon and the golden-blue Giant Dragon clinging to its tail, and it took great strides forward.
Its heavy footsteps shattered the Void, and at the same time, red light began to shimmer on the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which rapidly expanded.
Boom!
In the eyes of all the Giant Beasts filled with excitement, astonishment, and shock, a Deep Red Giant Beast over twenty thousand meters in length appeared, wrapped in golden-red lightning emitting a huge and supreme Destructive Aura.
Watching as the Crimson Giant Beast, turning the entire world red and shattering the Void with steps of thousands of kilometers, pounced, the Red Raging Ape let out a terrified roar.
The terrifying Killing Intent within the Red Raging Ape erupted once again, like blood gushing out, dyeing its Full-body Scales Armor and fur an even deeper scarlet.
Behind it, a blood-colored ape phantasm tens of thousands of meters tall, a powerful manifestation of some Rule between heaven and earth, emerged more clearly than ever.
Roar! The two ferocious blood-colored apes roared, like the ultimate calamity attracting a catastrophe incarnated as crimson light, confronting the Crimson Giant Beast.
Boom! Under the double claws wrapped in golden-red lightning, the blood-colored ape phantom towering tens of thousands of meters high, capable of smashing a One-side World, collapsed, followed by the blood-colored fierce ape itself.
Roar! Under the tremendous Red Beast Claw, the crimson Rule Domain unfolded around the Blood-colored fierce ape collapsed, and its entire head was seized by a claw and brutally slammed into the ground, letting out a scream.
Boom! Within a ten-thousand-kilometer range, the Earth shattered.
An indescribable force tore great cracks across the land, countless red lights burst forth from underground, blending with the fiery magma and rock and dirt soaring into the sky, flung thousands of kilometers away.
Boom! A red light shot out from the center of the explosion, collapsing mountain ranges in its path and forming a Destruction Tunnel tens of thousands of kilometers long and a thousand kilometers wide.
Finally, after bringing down a mountain peak a hundred thousand meters high, the light stopped and released a dazzling mushroom cloud.
Roar!
In the midst of the earth-shaking, violent roar, a figure ablaze with flames emerged from the explosion, a Deep Red Giant Beast over ten thousand meters tall slowly walked out.
Meanwhile, over 30,000 kilometers away, a collapsing mountain range exploded, revealing the massive body of the Blood-colored fierce ape, half-battered and broken.

In the instant the Dust Serpent was blocking, a pair of Black Gold claws wrapped in golden-red lightning appeared in front of the vortex where the Single-horned Spawn Roc was, and tore through the vortex with a fierce rip.

Watching this scene, even the eyes of the Blood-colored fierce ape, filled with Killing Intent and fury, showed a hint of dread.
From that Black Gold Giant Beast, it felt a boundless and powerful strength, very strong.
Just then, a silver dragon head emerged from behind the Black Gold Giant Beast, roaring excitedly, “Tim Abott, that guy actually beat Jormungand so badly that its tail is gone. Unforgivable.”
“Roar! Unforgivable, let’s kill it and eat it. The Great Sethia loves to see rivers of blood.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly nodded to the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the others before turning its gaze to the Blood-colored fierce ape at a distance of over 20,000 kilometers away, its ferocious maw slowly opening to emit a deep, resonant voice.
“Tear apart, have you eaten?”
In a low roar, an Invisible Power emanated from the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, shaking off the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold and Blue Giant Dragon that were clinging to its tail, and it took big strides forward.
Heavy footsteps crushed the Void, while red glimmers began to shine on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its body rapidly expanding in size.
Boom!
In the eyes of all the excited, thrilled, and shocked Giant Beasts, a Crimson Giant Beast, twenty thousand meters long, appeared, wrapped in golden-red lightning and emanating a grand, supreme Destructive Aura.
Seeing that Crimson Giant Beast, which dyed the whole world red, stepping through the Void, with each step covering thousands of kilometers, the Red Raging Ape let out a roar of terror.
The fearsome Killing Intent inside the Red Raging Ape burst forth again, like blood erupting, making its Full-body Scales Armor and fur even more blood-red.
Behind it, a violent shadow of the Blood-colored fierce ape, tens of thousands of meters tall, and wrought from some powerful Rule between heaven and earth, emerged once more, and this time it was even clearer.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1513: Chapter 570 Celestial Calculation ‘God’, Entire Family Supports Chapter 1513: Chapter 570 Celestial Calculation ‘God’, Entire Family Supports Amid the enveloping gold and crimson lightning, the Ancient Nick Westmore was devoured completely, and the Crimson Giant Beast, reaching over twenty-five thousand meters in size, roared up to the heavens.
Roar!
The terror of its sound waves shattered space, forming atmospheric rings that exploded outward in all directions, with raging winds howling like thunder.
Contained within the roar was a bloodline pressure that enveloped an area of over a hundred and fifty thousand kilometers, so oppressive that even the Dust Serpent, another Ancient Level being, couldn’t help but lower its head instinctively.
As for the Single-horned Spawn Roc and the Kamaitachi Beast—other Mythical Lives—they too felt the pressure akin to heavenly might and sank down, crouching on the ground with tails trembling.
Including the two dragons that landed on the shattered Earth, roaring excitedly like little fan girls, they looked on in excitement at the august and fierce Giant Beast in the distance.
After venting the fury in his heart for a while, the Destruction Emperor Dragon willed himself out of his Gigantification State, his red glow receding and his size shrinking.
Soon, a vast Giant Beast, with a length of eight thousand seven hundred and twenty meters, half of which was its tail, appeared in the Void.
Relative to the True Body refined by Law Level rules, it was the biological energy contained within the Ancient Beast that was far greater, allowing the Destruction Emperor Dragon to grow by nearly eight hundred meters.
For the Destruction Emperor Dragon at its current size, an eight-hundred-meter increase in length required an amount of biological energy nearly equivalent to that needed at the breakthrough to the Ancient Level when it had grown by over a thousand meters.
This was precisely why, after suppressing the Ancient fierce ape, the Destruction Emperor Dragon did not attempt to subdue it but instead chose to directly tear and devour it.
There was just no helping it; the Qi Blood emanating from the Ancient fierce ape was too abundant, nearly on par with an Ancient Late Stage Giant Beast.
Additionally, considering it didn’t seem too intelligent, it seemed best to just eat it and boost his own power.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon estimated that after consuming three more Ancient Beasts or equivalent energy materials, its length could reach ten thousand meters, breaking through to the Ancient Middle Stage Growth Level.
After reaching the Ancient Level, each Giant Beast’s body size and limits vary. For example, the Batfish Beast’s standard for breaking through to the Ancient Level would likely be thirty thousand meters.
And once a Giant Beast grows to the True Spirit Level, due to various Gigantification Talents and rule transformations, the disparity in body sizes among Giant Beasts will become even more exaggerated.
Feeling the even stronger power within his body, the Destruction Emperor Dragon lifted his head and saw a mammoth python’s phantasmal shadow intertwined with the world above, and he let out a low growl.
“Jormungand, what gains have you come across on this path up to now?”
The Ancient Giant Python came to its senses and transformed into a ten-thousand-meter size as it hissed in response, “I and Jerry Jones came across four Mythical Giant Beasts and one Titan Beast.”
“Among them, only one Mythical Beast and that Titan were willing to submit and join the Dragon Palace. The other two Mythical Beasts with savage consciousnesses were devoured by me.”
“Besides that, Jerry Jones also discovered some resources, among which there were five of Law Level; I’ve collected them all.”
Saying this, the Ancient Giant Python unleashed a Space Tear, and more than twenty Heaven and Earth Treasures of various sizes, emitting intense energy fluctuations and brilliant radiance, flew out.
Hu! With the raging wind heaving, all the Heaven and Earth Treasures were sucked into the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s maw. Instantly, a mix of stronger and weaker energies exploded within its body.
Crackle Crackle!!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s figure visibly swelled and enlarged at a speed noticeable to the naked eye, growing by another eleven meters to reach a length of eight thousand seven hundred and thirty meters or so.
“Good haul. Next, let’s move parallel to each other, fifty thousand kilometers apart, and sweep through the entire Chaotic Domain sooner.”
The Chaotic Turbulent Region, littered with Heaven and Earth Treasures and inhabited by countless powerful Giant Beasts, lies secluded and thus serves as a perfect nursery for the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s development.
Once it dominates the Chaotic Domain after sweeping away everything, it will be time for it to ’emerge from the mountains.’
As for the promise to the Purple little dragon about eating more good stuff to bulk up, nothing compares to the Life Energy emanating from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The naturally dispersing waves of Life Energy are collected by the Purple little dragon’s Creations Field, turning them into life energy befitting the Heavenly Tier Colossus, purifying its bloodline each time it absorbs a bit.
Roar roar roar!!
Under the leadership of the two Ancient Beasts, the Silver Giant Dragon and other Giant Beasts let out excited roars, swiftly stirring up massive air waves that vanished into the depths of the Chaotic Domain.
……
“Jack Clark, your aura…?”
High above the Firmament, space distorted by tens of thousands of kilometers, three Divine Kings of Heavenly Feather, including Adam Garcetti and True Martial Heavenly King, turned around in astonishment to look at the black-haired young man treading the Void.
For just then, Jack Clark, who had seemed somewhat weak before, suddenly vibrated with energy, his body faintly emitting an even more formidable strength.
Jack Clark smiled faintly, “Just now, as I was reflecting on the gains and losses of this battle, I had an insight, and my realm improved a bit, which in turn promoted the progress of my True Body’s Law Level Tempering.”
You must be a monster. The crowd paused.
To improve your strength on the way back is freakish, especially since your realm has reached the Heavenly King, and your combat power is comparable to the Supreme Level.
The Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy exclaimed in admiration, “The talent of the Divine Martial Sky King… is impressive.”
“It’s nothing, Divine King Tolstoy flatters me,” Jack Clark demurred politely.
By then, everyone had traversed over three million kilometers and returned to the ‘entrance’ to the forbidden area, stretching over three hundred thousand kilometers. The space between heaven and earth was permeated with Dark Demon Air, snaking across the land like black pythons.
This area had been the base of the Purgatory Empire for several decades. Although they hadn’t utterly corrupted the land with demon gas to pollute it completely, it nonetheless demonized some of the mountains and rivers.
This corruption by Demon Air from the Purgatory Demon God extended its power to form pathways, facilitating easier communication and interaction within the Purgatory Empire.

chapters.title: Chapter 1514 - 1514 570 Celestial Calculations God Whole
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1514: Chapter 570 Celestial Calculations ‘God’, Whole Family Support_2 Chapter 1514: Chapter 570 Celestial Calculations ‘God’, Whole Family Support_2 In addition, there are many other functions, such as intensifying the might of the Void Demon Eye Array.
The Void Demon Eyes and the Blood Sacrifice Array is The Purgatory Family’s most commonly used long-distance teleportation formation, comprised of spatial coordinates and the Blood Sacrifice Demon God Pillar.
It was the Void Blood Sacrifice that sent two demon kings to encircle and kill Jack Clark behind the outer expansion department’s rear through the battlefield of the Human Race.
Under the influence of the demon gas pathway linked by the Demon God’s rule power, the Void Demon Eye Array could even teleport demon kings distances of tens to hundreds of millions of kilometers at a time.
Therefore, within the half-day duration of the intense outbreak of the great demon war, many resolute demon kings and Great Demon Kings desperately broke free from the entanglement of Human Experts and escaped through the Void Demon Eye Array.
As for those demon kings who were slower to flee, after Jack Clark had slain a portion of them, the rest were besieged by more king-level and Heavenly King combatants.
A few days have passed since then, and most of those due to perish have already fallen.
This was also the reason why no Supreme Experts returned to crush and slaughter those demon kings after several days of standoff at the fringes of the Purgatory Empire, for those who could escape had already fled.
“Let’s head back to the frontline first, we’ll deal with these Dark Restrictions one by one later,” he said, and once again the group transformed into streaks of Radiance and vanished.
After entering the forbidden area, Jack Clark and the others occasionally saw Human Experts encircling and killing Purgatory True Demons, or witnessed sporadic battles of small-scale armies clashing.
Occasionally, Human Kings would take action, leading armies to slaughter those Purgatory True Demons and vassal alien corps without a demon king to preside over them, resulting in rivers of blood.
After crossing more than two million kilometers, Jack Clark and the others finally returned to the temporary base of the Human Alliance.
The temporary base was supported by several sky-based battleships suspended in the air, surrounded by dozens of Golden Battleships, and composed of three Sky Beasts from the Divine Gods Alliance.
As a series of mighty auras and towering figures returned, the entire Human Base started to seethe with excitement.
Witnessing the dazzling figures descending from the Firmament above, many cultivators couldn’t help but shout excitedly.
“Speaker and the others have returned.”
“The Speaker hasn’t lost anyone, and the Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan is also with them; we’ve won, and it’s a great victory this time.”
“Long live the Federation!”
“For the alliance…”
At the same time, the already returned Gabriel King, Overlord Dragon King, along with two Main Gods from the Divine Gods Alliance, and five Main Gods from the Heavenly Feather Clan, came out to welcome them.
As for others, they were still ‘fighting’ outside.
Amid the brilliant golden light, the silhouette of Divine King Tarodel slowly emerged, and instantly an utmost and great aura filled Heaven and Earth.
Behind Tarodel, there was also an enormous Demon God’s head, unmistakably the one it had suppressed — though it had now been ground away.
Tarodel spoke with a deep voice, “Gentlemen, we’ve returned. How is the situation over there?”
“On the Grita War Demon Empire’s side, an Ancestral Demon God Priest is presiding, and demonization of Heaven and Earth has been completed,” Adam Garcetti said gravely.
“Unlike Diorus, who got distracted by delving into Time Power and neglected his empire’s domain, Belidier’s actions are more in line with the standard of a Purgatory Demon God.”
“Although they have not steamrolled the rear of the two empires, the gains from this battle have exceeded our expectations,” Adam continued.
While Adam Garcetti conversed with Tarodel, Jack Clark squinted slightly at the sight of Tarodel’s figure, which glowed like a golden Radiance, and the Demon God’s head behind him.
This Divine King from the Divine Gods Alliance is very mysterious, and also very strong, and his attitude makes it somewhat difficult for Jack Clark to grasp.
In this great war, Tarodel suppressed an Ancestral Demon from the ancient early stage and was injured, his achievements only ranked below ‘Jack Clark’, who had slain three Demon Gods.
However, the attitude he displayed during the fight seemed a bit ‘half-hearted’ as if his participation was merely symbolic from the start.
This was in stark contrast to the Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, who have completely bound their fate with the Human Race, fighting fearlessly and even fiercely unleashing their Origin to clash with Demon Gods in battle.
However, the federation’s documents had mentioned that this Divine King only has a standard alliance with the Human Race.
As the King of a tribe who has lived for countless years, it’s normal for Tarodel to have his own thoughts and goals; it’s enough that he stands together with the Human Race in the grand scheme of things.
After all, he is an existence that stands at the peak of the ancient.
At this moment, Tarodel shifted his tone and looked towards the black-haired young man with his hands clasped behind his back, “Speaking of achievements, Divine Martial Sky King’s performance has indeed shocked us.”
“Being able to slay four Demon Gods, it can almost be said that it’s all thanks to Divine Martial Sky King.”
Jack Clark faintly smiled, “Divine King Tarodel is too laudatory. The one who slew those Demon Gods was Thunderflame Aro; it has nothing to do with me. I’m merely a summoning intermediary.”
“Moreover, the cost of Summoning Thunderflame Aro is too great. Even I can only maintain it for a few minutes before exhausting my strength.”
“Only a few minutes? What a pity,” Tarodel showed a look of regret on his face, seemingly lamenting that Jack Clark could only maintain an ‘invincible’ state for a few minutes.
Jack Clark just smiled in response.
Afterward, everyone exchanged a few more pleasantries and then agreed to meet again in five days, before dispersing to their respective recovery areas for closed-door cultivation.
This battle seemed to have Jack Clark as the sole figure in the limelight, but Adam Garcetti and others also consumed a great deal of energy. When those Demon Gods burned their Origin in desperation, they too chose to burn their own Origin.
However, it was due to their decisive actions that even though they fought with all their might, they only managed to inflict heavier injuries on those Demon Gods, not capturing any.
Time swiftly passed by unnoticed, and during this period, many kings and Heavenly Kings returned one after another, including the armies of the Alliance Three Tribes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1515 - 1515 570 Celestial Calculations God Whole
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1515: Chapter 570 Celestial Calculations ‘God’, Whole Family Support_3 Chapter 1515: Chapter 570 Celestial Calculations ‘God’, Whole Family Support_3 In addition to that, at the entrance to the rear of the forbidden area, a vast number of transport fighter aircraft and Flying Giant Beasts flew out, carrying a large amount of personnel and supplies.
Five days later.
Above the cloud-covered Firmament, a hundred towering kilometer-high steles stood erect, atop which were seated the will projections of ninety-seven Mythical-level Powerhouses.
In front of the more than ninety king-level figures on both sides, twenty thrones, each three kilometers high, stood in a ring, upon which were seated people such as Gabriel and the Heavenly Feather Main Gods.
In addition to them, there were two Divine Gods Alliance Main God-level Powerhouses.
In front of the thrones occupied by Main God-level Powerhouses, two majestic thrones that soared five kilometers high stood prominently, upon which were seated the Lord of Holy Light and that wildly spirited young man.
At this time, all the Heavenly Kings and king-level figures turned their gazes towards the very front, where nine towering ten-kilometer-high thrones stood.
Atop them respectively sat the three Supreme beings of the Human Race, three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, the Divine Gods Alliance Divine King Tarodel, True Martial Heavenly King with his hand on a black stele, and Jack Clark.
Out of the nine, Jack Clark had the lowest realm, only at mid-period Heavenly King level, but when everyone’s gaze fell upon the black-haired young man, they were filled with expressions of astonishment and admiration.
After this battle, no one dared to underestimate this young man who was still one month shy of eighteen.
At the main seat, Adam Garcetti slowly spoke, “Today is the first Throne Conference of the three-power alliance, mainly to discuss how to deal with the counterattack from the Purgatory Empire.”
“Before that, let’s first sum up the losses and gains of both sides in this battle.”
Having said that, Adam Garcetti turned his head to look at a figure shrouded in White Light, “Gabriel King, please.”
Responsible for logistics and command, Gabriel nodded slightly, “Speaker, you are too polite. Two days ago, the army-level battle within the forbidden area had already completely ended.”
“Currently, there are still tens of millions of Purgatory True Demons and Demonized Alien Races scattered in small squads hiding deep in the forbidden area, which will require some time to be completely exterminated.”
“The battle lasted for nine days, and we have recorded and confirmed the slaying of four Demon Gods, seven Great Demon Kings, twenty-nine demon kings, and over one hundred and thirty million elite corps.”
“The remaining demon kings and Great Demon Kings escaped through the Void Demon Eyes scattered across various Demon Clan bases and reversed Blood Sacrifice Arrays that tore through the Void, making it impossible to pursue.”
“From our side, one king-level of the Human Race, two Gods of the Heavenly Feather Clan have fallen in the counterattack of the Purgatory Demon Kings, with fifteen suffering heavy injuries.”
“Two Heavenly King Level Powerhouses sustained heavy injuries, six Main Gods sustained heavy injuries and will need a long time to recover while we also captured a large amount of Space Equipment.”
“Because of the constraints of time, these Space Equipment have not yet been fully accounted for…”
After about ten or more minutes, Gabriel reported in detail all the information, giving all king-level figures a more direct understanding of the brutality of the battle.
Despite having the advantage in all respects, three Mythical-level Powerhouses still fell, not to mention those Transcendent Corps beneath Mythical level, which also suffered significant damage during the frenzied counterattack of the Purgatory Legion.
However, compared to the spoils of war, these losses were relatively minor.
At that moment, Adam Garcetti spoke again, “Now, we face three matters.”
“First, to eradicate the power of the Demon God rules that pervade this World, completely survey the vast forbidden area to preempt any contingencies left by Diorus and the like.”
“At the same time, we shall join forces to lay down stronger rules at the entrance of the forbidden area to prevent Demon God Level Powerhouses from infiltrating and launching surprise attacks, also leaving Will Projections to stand guard and alert.”
“Secondly, to construct a main battle base within the forbidden area, centered around the heavenly foundation, covering a vertical length of over two million kilometers, and a horizontal span of over one million kilometers.”
“Third, to fully support Jack Clark’s cultivation, enabling him to make an early breakthrough to the Supreme Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1516 - 1516 571 World-renowned Dark Matter Particles
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1516: Chapter 571: World-renowned, Dark Matter Particles Chapter 1516: Chapter 571: World-renowned, Dark Matter Particles Blue Star, South City.
With silver hair draped over her shoulders and a pair of small horns on her head, Mathilda Ward pushed open the villa’s gate, walked in with Glenn Clark and Teresa Wilson, and introduced,
“Tiger, this is the official residence arranged for you.”
“As the venue for the national competition, South City provides a detached villa for the top ten geniuses from each province, facilitating dedicated cultivation.”
Glenn Clark showed a naive smile, “Sister Ilisa, thank you for the trouble, you’re so busy and still personally accompanying us over.”
Mathilda Ward smiled slightly, “It’s okay, Jack and I are good friends, and as his brother, don’t worry about such small matters.”
After that, Mathilda Ward explained some things to pay attention to before she left.
Only after Mathilda Ward had gone did Teresa Wilson, with a pink backpack on her back, stick out her tongue and say, “I always thought Sister Ilisa was pretty on television, but I didn’t expect her to have such a strong presence.”
“When she was here just now, I felt like the air around me solidified and I couldn’t breathe, so scary,” the girl added, patting her chest.
Glenn Clark nodded, “Normal, after all Sister Ilisa is a Nine-fold Peak strong man, and it’s said that she’s about to step into God-level. Such powerful beings, even if they constrain their aura, cannot be directly faced by ordinary people.”
“However, once you achieve a breakthrough to the Second Layer in your body refining technique, and truly step into the Transcendent, you’ll feel much better.”
“Mm, I will work hard at cultivation, Jim,” Teresa Wilson nodded earnestly.
As a ‘ninth-grade’ student, Teresa Wilson wasn’t supposed to start cultivating until next year, but with Jack Clark making the body refining techniques available, the Federation had lowered the cultivation requirement to junior high school.
Once one’s body refining technique reached the Second Layer, one could choose to switch to cultivating True Martial or continue along the path of body refinement.
As classmates of the technique creator’s brother, and with Glenn Clark’s help as well as family support, Teresa Wilson and Melinda saw rapid progress in their cultivation.
Teresa Wilson, having made the most progress, had achieved a breakthrough to the First Layer Middle Stage after a month and a half of cultivation, equivalent to a First Layer Heaven cultivator.
Glenn Clark and she wandered about the villa’s living room, then Teresa Wilson casually turned on the television.
“I’m the host Nina. We will now interrupt our regular programming to bring you an important news update.”
“Ten days ago, on the Frontline Battlefield of the mythical world, the Federation and the Purgatory Demon Race erupted into a Civilization-level war, culminating in an unprecedented large-scale battle.”
“In this battle, both sides deployed over a hundred of king-level and demon king warriors, and dozens of Heavenly Kings and Great Demon Kings, along with support from the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Divine Gods Alliance.”
“Championed by our own strong men, countless cultivators bravely fought the enemy, and the eight-day-long battle ended with our victory.”
“We slew four Demon Gods, seven Great Demon Kings, and twenty-nine demon kings of the enemy, decimating countless elite armies, and advancing the frontline by 2.15 million kilometers.”
“Such an unprecedented victory solidifies the Human Race as the Overlord in the territories surrounding the mythical world.”
“And Jack Clark, our Nation’s number one genius, endowed with unparalleled and unmatched talent, now titled the Heavenly King Divine Martial, distinguished himself in this battle by single-handedly slaying three Demon Gods.”
“Demon Gods, the strongest beings of the Purgatory Demon Race, each wield the power to rule and possess the strength to Destroy Heaven and Earth; even a planet’s explosion would at most cause them light injury.”
“One can only imagine how powerful the Divine Martial Heavenly King is to have such a battle record, a monumental achievement that dwarfs any in history, truly making him the backbone of our race. This announcement is declared worldwide…”
Watching the news broadcast and the various edited videos of the battlefield on television, Teresa Wilson’s mouth hung open in disbelief.
They knew Jack Clark was very strong, but wasn’t he just at the Legendary Realm before? How did he suddenly become a Heavenly King?
And he even killed three Demon Gods who wouldn’t die even if a planet exploded!!
Glenn Clark was just as excited, unable to help but shout enthusiastically, “May, my brother is too awesome, he’s now capable of slaying even Demon Gods.”
“Those are beings as powerful as the Supreme Experts of our alliance.”
At this moment, not only in South City’s television station but also across the globe in the three major empires, as well as numerous small and medium countries’ televisions and official websites, they were broadcasting the news of the major victory at the frontline.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s name once again echoed throughout the world.
Even though the previous battle in South City had already shaken the world when the new king Jack Clark suppressed the Alien Myth with a simple wave of his hand, the significance of this occasion was different.
And for those who knew Jack Clark, the news was even more shocking.
At the top of the South’s Number One Building, Mathilda Ward stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, gazing down at the bustling city below with a touch of emotion.
“Aunt Boyce, did you ever imagine that the elegant youth would grow to become as dazzling as the Great Sun in just over half a year?”
Crystal Boyce, standing behind her, responded with a wry smile, “Who could have thought?”
Reflecting back on their first encounter with the calm and composed youth, Crystal Boyce’s initial feeling was that he was no ordinary person, but she only recognized him as having boundless potential.
She never imagined things like him breaking through into the Legendary Realm or becoming a Heavenly King and even killing Demon Gods in just a few months.
After all, back then, Jack Clark was only at the early stages of the Sixth Heaven, not even considered high-order, and their paths would never have crossed if not for the Evil God Clone not daring to appear for fear of strong guards.
“Hahaha… Fantastic, Jack Clark, you’re so powerful. As his classmate and best friend, I share in his glory,” Crystal Boyce laughed joyfully, holding her mobile phone in the street.
Zac Maben was also invigorated, “Truly amazing. Now the videos saved on my phone are even more valuable.”
“What videos?” asked Marcus Lindsay from the side, pausing as he was eating something.

chapters.title: Chapter 1517 - 1517 571 World-renowned Dark Matter
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1517: Chapter 571: World-renowned, Dark Matter Particles_2 Chapter 1517: Chapter 571: World-renowned, Dark Matter Particles_2 Zac Maben said proudly, “Of course, it’s the video of Jack Clark dominating all Martial School cultivators on the Southern Battlefield.”
“Back then, Justin Welan told me to record it, to play at our wedding in the future. You guys made fun of us, but now you see our foresight, don’t you?”
“It’s the grand emergence of a great pioneer of the Human Race, the legend under the Divine Martial Emperor, who single-handedly pressured the entire generation of Southern Youth.”
“Since then, Jack Clark has skyrocketed, becoming more and more exaggerated, so this video has great historical significance.”
“Damn, make me a copy,” Marcus Lindsay said abruptly as he dropped his barbecue.
Zac Maben decisively refused: “Scram, I’m going to pass this video down as a family heirloom.”
“With Jack’s talent, he will surely become an existence beyond our imagination, maybe even living eternal for tens of millions of years.”
“This video can prove my relationship with the elder of Human Race, the great Divine Martial Emperor, the utmost Supreme Eternal Emperor. Then, who would dare to bully my descendants?”
In his excitement, Zac Maben had already started dreaming about the future, even bestowing Jack Clark with a long string of honorifics.
The White Veil nearby said sourly, “If you won’t give it, then forget it. I remember that rascal Justin Welan recorded it too. We’ll just get it from him later.”
“Besides, Zac Maben, you only have a video. Marcus Lindsay, that guy, has hit the jackpot.”
At this point, envy shone in White Veil’s eyes: “Marcus Lindsay’s sister is so close with Tiger; if she marries Glenn Clark, she’ll become Jack Clark’s family.”
“Damn, that’s true, Marcus, you’ve really struck it rich,” Zac Maben suddenly felt that the video in his hand wasn’t so appealing anymore.
While countless people in the Blue Star World were shaken and exhilarated by the news of the frontline’s great victory.
After the meeting, Jack Clark and Adam Garcetti appeared silently inside the flagship’s bridge, surrounded by a space distortion.
A large map projection was spinning slowly between them, representing the base of the forbidden area they had just conquered, but currently, the map was blurred with only an outline visible.
Adam Garcetti said slowly, “The God Defense System, also known as the Doomsday Plan, was established ten years ago, known only by me, by Sky-based God King, and by Primordial.”
“The threat from the Purgatory Demon Race was becoming increasingly severe at the time, and sometimes, even we couldn’t see any hope, so we made several preparations.”
“For instance, if we were ultimately defeated, and the Human Race faced the brink of extinction, we would initiate the Doomsday Plan to perish together.”
“The Doomsday Plan specifically consists of two major parts, the astrocomputers together with twenty-eight bases of destruction.”
“The astrocomputers are structured around the Sky-based God King at the core, with the power of rules infused into wireless information, breaking through the interference of Heavenly Energy to cover Human Territory, including the surrounding area of 200,000 kilometers.”
“Each base of destruction uses Doomsday Nuclear Weapons crafted from dark matter. Each one’s firepower is tens of thousands of times more powerful than a billion-ton equivalent Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb.”
“Most importantly, the instant the Doomsday Nuclear Weapons burst, they will release terrifying dark matter energy that can dissolve the foundational rules of a realm.”
“According to the astrocomputer’s calculations, deploying twenty-eight Doomsday Nuclear Weapons in the positions of the stars and detonating them simultaneously, the force generated could completely destroy the rules within a realm.”
“At that moment, with space-time shattered and Heaven and Earth crumbling, not even Demon Gods could withstand it, enough to drag all our enemies down with us.”
Jack Clark was somewhat surprised: “So dark matter actually exists.”
In past scientific theories, dark matter had always been speculative, an invisible substance in the universe, also a fundamental component of its makeup.
But even after walking the path of cultivation and later developing the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, comprehending the birth and destruction of worlds, Jack Clark had never discovered the existence of dark matter.
Adam Garcetti explained, “Dark matter is one of the greatest discoveries in the technological realm since the dawn of the Transcendent Era, originating from our Blue Star universe, and so far, it has only been found in our world.”
“Although we’ve mainly focused on the Cultivation System over the years, our technological research hasn’t fallen behind, making astonishing progress.”
“Fifteen years ago, Heavenly King Kras constructed a giant collider acceleration ring thousands of kilometers long in space far from Blue Star and conducted an experiment.”
“Under the enhancement of Heavenly King Kras’s Primordial rules, the speed of the material particles inside the acceleration ring reached a terrifying level, and at last, they collided.”
“And dark matter particles resulted from that experiment.”
“Afterward, headed by Heavenly King Kras, the research team developed a method to utilize dark matter particles, combining them with Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs to form a more intricate fission formula.”
“However, dark matter energy is highly dangerous, a double-edged sword; using it could lead to unforeseen risks.”
Pausing for a moment, Adam Garcetti, speaking as if from a Rubik’s Cube, let out a bitter laugh from within the Sky-based God King, “We tested the Doomsday Nuclear Weapons once, and afterwards, we never activated them again, sealing them as a last-resort option for mutual destruction.”
“During the experiment in deep space, tens of thousands of kilometers away from the Moon, the explosive force not only destroyed everything nearby but also contaminated the far side of the Moon.”
“In that area, under the influence of dark matter energy, filled with twisted and bizarre forces, even we dare not tread lightly.”
“The Space Forbidden Area Regulation,” Jack Clark paused, recalling a piece of core information he had read.
Adam Garcetti nodded, “Correct, following that incident, we issued the Space Regulation, forbidding all countries and strong cultivators from exploring beyond the Moon’s distance.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1518 - 1518 571 Renowned Worldwide Dark Matter
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1518: Chapter 571: Renowned Worldwide, Dark Matter Particles_3 Chapter 1518: Chapter 571: Renowned Worldwide, Dark Matter Particles_3 “The main purpose is to prevent any Ninth Tier cultivators who are unaware, or medium level countries’ exploration satellites from entering even the polluted areas, and bringing back those strange powers.”
“I see,” Jack Clark nodded thoughtfully.
With Jack Clark’s current level of authority, he had the right to view all classified information within the Federation, equal to that of Adam Garcetti and others.
But due to time constraints, he hadn’t had the time to look at most of it, and when he occasionally perused the internal Federation documents, he only picked some that interested him.
