Adam Garcetti continued, “Although we’ve won a great victory this time, the threat of the Purgatory ancestors has always been there. No one is currently capable of resisting that ancient Monarch-level existence.”
“Therefore, we are preparing to initiate the backup Doomsday plan, which is now renamed the God Defense System.”
“Before you and the Thunderflame Beheamoth have grown strong enough to contend with that Ancestor, if the Purgatory Ancestor wakes up prematurely, we are ready to destroy the forbidden area.”
“At that time, the collapse of the world’s foundational rules it initiates will be sufficient to turn that area into a terrifying zone that even Monarchs dare not enter, buying us time.”
“Although by doing this, we would lose all our territory, and the Human Race would be forced to retreat back to Blue Star, it doesn’t matter because we could turn to develop the Deep Sea Tunnel.”
“Of course, that’s provided that the Second Mythical Impact hasn’t erupted by then.”
As the spine of the Human Race, figures like Adam Garcetti weren’t blinded by the recent victories; instead, they remained calm as ever, preparing for all possible outcomes.
This time, they told Jack Clark so much because they needed his help in repairing the Sky-based God King’s Divine Weapon.
Only with the complete Ancient Divine Weapon, combined with the strength of the Sky-based God King, could they cover over a million kilometers with wireless information under the influence of Heavenly Energy, ready to detonate all Doomsday Nuclear Weapons simultaneously when necessary.
“Jack Clark, there are three hundred and forty thousand Level 1 Life Crystals here, including tens of thousands of Level 2 and Level 3, as well as some Level 7 and Level 8 crystals.”
“Converted, it’s roughly equivalent to six hundred and fifty thousand Level 1 crystals. Should that be enough to repair the Sky-based God King’s Divine Weapon?”
Looking at the tens of thousands of White Crystals floating in the air, a smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face: “That’s enough, Senior.”
Equivalent to over six hundred thousand Level 1 life crystals, that would be enough to convert nearly three million Attribute points. Deducting the estimated two million for the Sky-based God King’s repair, there would be about one million left over.
He just happened to have acquired a Pseudo-World Level Weapon, and the remaining Attribute points would enhance his Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, elevating his weapon to a true World-class level.
Once Jack Clark confirmed his answer, Adam Garcetti showed a smile: “In that case, I’ll leave it to you.”
Jack Clark responded solemnly, “There’s no need for formality, Seniors. This is what I ought to do. Everything is for the everlasting existence of our Human Race.”
“However, before that, I need a bit of time to absorb these life crystals, converting them into Talent Energy, so I can then help Senior Sky-based with the repair of the Divine Weapon.”
Although Jack Clark no longer hid his ability to enhance equipment, he was still careful about the things that needed attention.
The two Supreme Experts, catching the implications in Jack Clark’s words, didn’t think too much and simply nodded with a smile before disappearing, leaving Jack Clark alone with the hundreds of thousands of life crystals.
“Looks like I’m going to be busy now,” Jack Clark said with a smile on his face.
“You’ve converted a life crystal and gained 4 Attribute points.”
“You’ve converted a life crystal and gained 5 Attribute points…”
Since Jack Clark needed to physically touch each of the hundreds of thousands of life crystals to convert them, the entire process would take some time.
And as Jack Clark dealt with this welcome problem, in a certain area of the Deep Red World filled with crimson radiance, the earth shattered, littered with countless broken corpses of creatures.
At the center of these corpses, the weakest of which emanated Ninth Tier energy, stood Jane Aiken in somewhat damaged battle armor, breathing slightly heavily.
Around the black-haired girl, extremely sharp Sword Intent swirled, forming tangible sword lights covering a ten-kilometer radius, the aura inching past the limits of the Nine Layers of Heaven, on the verge of a breakthrough into the Legendary Realm at any moment.
Behind Jane Aiken, the earth was enveloped in endless Dark Demon Air, resembling a tremendous black cocoon with a diameter of a hundred kilometers as if something was gestating within.
Such a colossal black ‘object’ stood out starkly in a world where everything else was crimson, therefore attracting many mundane monsters of the Deep Red World.
“So you’ve been hiding here to breakthrough into a Demon God.” As an indifferent voice sounded, a figure appeared in the distance — it was Jonathan Walker, who had vanished after the battle with Heavenly Feather.
At this moment, Jonathan Walker’s gaze was icy, showing none of the warmth it once held when turned towards Jane Aiken.

chapters.title: Chapter 1519 - 1519 572 Im Not Human — Jonathan Walkers
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1519: Chapter 572: I’m Not Human — Jonathan Walker’s Death Chapter 1519: Chapter 572: I’m Not Human — Jonathan Walker’s Death In a world filled with red radiance, Jane Aiken’s eyes revealed a cautious wariness.
At this moment, Jonathan Walker seemed like a stranger, so unfamiliar that Jane felt as though he had become a different person.
With black hair cascading over his shoulders and a handsome, dashing appearance, Jonathan stood with his hands clasped behind his back and said indifferently, “Step aside, in my presence your strength is no different from that of an ant.”
Four sharp Sword Intents burst forth from Jane’s body, stirring the red clouds above, and in her eyes, a sword world emerged, resonating with the surrounding sword lights.
“You are not Jonathan Walker, who are you?”
“I, of course, am myself.”
Faced with Jane’s questioning, Jonathan didn’t give a straight answer. Instead, he turned his gaze towards the Demon God’s egg behind her.
Boom! Heaven and earth shook as scorching Will and Laws combined to form a golden Great Sun with a hundred-kilometer diameter behind Jonathan.
Then came the second round, the third round… in the blink of an eye, ten suns spanned across the sky, emitting endless light and heat, scorching the heavens, boiling the seas, and obliterating all things.
Under the intense power, the Earth around them collapsed and melted, forming a thousand-kilometer pit, and the pervasive red light between heaven and earth was driven away, creating rings of golden halos.
Faced with power comparable to that of a Demon God level, Jane’s figure sank.
Jane’s surrounding Will and Laws merged and formed a Sword World that also vibrated wildly. Then, with a thunderous crash, she, along with the ten-kilometer radius of Earth, suddenly plunged a kilometer into the ground.
This was the gap of absolute strength.
Even though Jane had already stepped half a foot into the Legendary Realm and her combat power was astonishing, she could not even make a move in front of the power emanated by Jonathan.
Jonathan, with an indifferent look in his eyes, extended his right hand slowly towards her as an invisible strand of realm of thought and Rule suppressed Jane.
A pure golden light gathered at the tip of his index finger, emitting waves of terrifying energy capable of instantly erasing all life below the Legendary Realm.
Jonathan Walker was about to kill her!
Faced with the intense threat of death, not a hint of fear appeared in Jane’s eyes, which were sharply determined, severing the cosmos, as she said word by word.
“You are not Jonathan Walker, who in the world are you?”
“Want to know very much, do you?”
Jonathan’s gaze was ice-cold and indifferent, his eyes brimming with non-human intuition, as he said lightly, “I have said, I am myself, and there has never been a ‘Person’ named Jonathan Walker in this world.”
“The so-called Jonathan Walker was merely a consciousness that shouldn’t exist, an identity born from my temporary hibernation as I became part of the human race.”
…This revelation left Jane Aiken momentarily stunned.
She had many speculations in her heart, such as Jonathan being split into different personalities due to his Cultivation Methods, or experiencing spiritual problems, leading to instability.
But she never considered that Jonathan Walker didn’t exist at all.
That genius of the Human Race who had dazzled an era was actually the reincarnation of the Will of some unknown, powerful being.
Jane’s long hair danced wildly behind her, her eyes filled with murderous intent, her voice deep, “In that case, my mother’s injury, and my grandfather’s disappearance, all your doing.”
At this moment, many past confusions seemed to make sense.
Why after severing their divisions, Left Demon and the others quickly stabilized their True Bodies, while Jonathan underwent closed-door Cultivation for many years, disappearing without any contact or explanation to the Federation.
Because he never underwent closed-door Cultivation at all.
But simultaneously, some new puzzles rose in Jane’s heart, like the ‘Jonathan Walker’ who appeared on the Southern Battlefield. The demeanor and aura he had back then could not have been faked.
However, at this time, Jonathan had no interest in explaining. The light gathered on his finger shone as he said, “It’s time to end everything.”
Biu!
The golden light beam pierced through everything, crossing over a hundred kilometers in an instant and appearing in front of Jane’s eyes, leaving behind a tiny, pitch-black pathway.
Under the terrifying power, the Sword World gathered around Jane was instantly penetrated, and the speed of the beam of light was even beyond the realm of time.
Boom! Just then, four Sword Intents burst forth from Jane, turning into red, black, cyan, and gray beams of sword light that reached the Cloud Sky and pierced the Earth, merging into one.
Under the force of the sword light capable of Slaying Gods and Demons, which contained extreme sharpness, the Heavenly Earth Laws were severed, and it struck the golden light beam in an instant.
Thump! The sword light dispersed under the golden light beam.
The gap between the two’s realms was too vast.
Even though Jane’s sword, powered by the union of four Lawful Sword Intents, was so mighty that it even touched the late period of the Legendary Realm. Against a casual strike from Jonathan, it was still no match.
“Away!”
Just as Jane was about to be erased, Jonathan suddenly let out an angry roar, and the chaotic aura on his body caused heaven and earth to quake.
The golden light beam that would’ve penetrated Jane’s head dissipated the instant it touched her forehead, leaving only a red burn mark.
All this happened in the blink of an eye.
The sudden turn of events left Jane, who thought she couldn’t escape, slightly stunned.
At the same time, on Jonathan’s face in the distance, a look of surprise emerged, “Even though the consciousness has been devoured by me, it still retains the instinctive protective response for his daughter, huh?”
Saying this, a struggle appeared in Jonathan’s left eye while his right eye remained cold and unfeeling.
“Useless, my Will is eternal and indestructible. How can you resist, you who hasn’t even reached the twelfth tier, and whose consciousness hasn’t been Tempered by Rule.”
“It was you, you killed her.”
Boom!
A ferocious and mad roar echoed between heaven and earth, and suddenly, the egg of the Demon God exploded, releasing an indescribable Terrifying Power. Everything in the vicinity was crushed to nothingness.
From within the darkness that obscured the sky, the Purgatory Demon God appeared, standing a towering ten thousand meters tall, with three heads and eleven arms, his body covered in Black Gold scale armor, and with double wings unfurled, his Demon Power overwhelming.

chapters.title: Chapter 1520 - 1520 572 Im Not Human — Jonathan Walkers
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1520: Chapter 572: I’m Not Human — Jonathan Walker’s Death_2 Chapter 1520: Chapter 572: I’m Not Human — Jonathan Walker’s Death_2 “`
Witnessing the Left Demon emerging from its chrysalis, along with his even stronger yet somewhat hollow aura, Jonathan Walker was astonished.
“You actually haven’t made a breakthrough, no, you actually forced an end to the evolution of the rules, abandoning the breakthrough – have you gone mad!”
The Left Demon delved into the Deep Red World and chose this ‘safe’ place to attempt breaking through to Demon God, which was true; otherwise, he could not have fooled him.
But unexpectedly, this individual actually gave up the breakthrough to Demon God, terminated the Divine Soul Intent that had already begun merging with the Laws World, and dissipated the rules that had started to take shape.
This was an irreversible process, and what awaited the Left Demon next was the collapse of the Laws World, a heavy injury to the Divine Soul, and a downfall in cultivation.
With three ferocious heads roaring, its voice like thunder, the Left Demon declared, “As long as I can avenge her, I am willing to forego becoming a Demon God forever.”
Boom! A Black Overlord Halberd, tens of thousands of meters long, shattered space-time, ripping open a dark abyss in the Deep Red World.
At the same time, in his eight demonic arms, each held a black banner that surged in radiance, turning into all-encompassing banner shadows that scattered in all directions.
Boom! Boom! Boom!! The instant the eight banners touched ground, it was as if they connected to an abyss, with endless Dark Demon Air spurting out, forming chain after chain of sequence links.
Within merely an instant, the scene before their eyes changed, and they found themselves in another world.
“Sealing-type Pseudo-World Level Weapon!” Jonathan Walker cried out, as ten rounds of the Great Sun behind him emitted blinding radiance, crashing across the firmament towards the Left Demon.
Bang! Bang! Bang!!
The Black Overlord Halberd, infused with terrifying power and unrivaled domination, shattered round after round of the Great Sun beneath it, grinding everything into chaos.
“Yin-Yang alternation, all things return to the void!” Jonathan Walker, clad in a cyan jade-colored battle suit, bellowed.
Boom!
An even more vast and terrifying will erupted from Jonathan Walker, distorting Heaven and Earth, with day and night alternating in a firmament filled with Dark Demon Air, forming a Yin-Yang Fish pattern.
Under the rotation of Yin-Yang, a great destruction capable of eroding all things descended, and the entire world creaked as if it could not bear the strain.
At this moment, Jonathan Walker seemed like the supreme overlord who commanded the sun and the moon’s Yin-Yang, his might terrifyingly greater than during his battle with the Heavenly Feather Clan, increased by more than a dozen times.
Under the oppressive will that wielded the sun and the moon’s Yin-Yang, the towering figure of the Demon God staggered, its arms wielding the halberd roared in defiance, its halberd skill soaring to the skies.
Boom! The Yin-Yang grinding wheel enveloping the world trembled.
At that moment, ten rounds of the Great Sun and ten moons emerged on the Yin-Yang grinding wheel, their dazzling light distorting space-time, instantly increasing the grinding wheel’s power once more.
Or more precisely, this was his true strength—the force that claimed to be the Eternally Unfading Will.
Boom! Under the weight of terrifying power, the Left Demon’s form sank once again.
“Out of my way!”
The towering Demon God roared as a section of its pitch-black spine surfaced, spraying out a surge of purple-black substance that dyed the Left Demon the same color.
Crackle! Crackle!!
The Left Demon’s stature swelled once more, its muscles bulging, and sharp bone spurs grew out from its head, back, and shoulders, exuding a savage ancient aura.
Boom! Under the terrifying power, the Yin-Yang grinding wheel shattered, the Great Suns fell, and the moons exploded.
The wild strike shook the entire world into a frenzied tremor, and eight black banners emerged at the ends of the Heaven and Earth, even showing signs of cracks.
Standing amid rolling demon gas, with a ferocious and lofty figure, the Left Demon roared like an ancient Demon God’s descent, its eyes fierce, “What are you waiting for, our path was wrong, wrong.”
“Kill it, avenge her.”
The roar infused with ancient power echoed between Heaven and Earth, shaking the soul, and Jonathan Walker, previously expressionless, showed a look of struggle on his face as his aura became chaotic again.
“That’s right, fight for control of the body, kill.” the Left Demon roared as it charged at Jonathan Walker like a Demon God bent on destruction.
“`
In an instant, a fierce battle erupted.
Within the world suffused with red light, Jane Aiken watched the eight Black Demon Flags that spanned the heavens and the earth, enveloping a range of a thousand miles, with a grave expression.
Their crazily distorting and vibrating forms seemed as if they would burst open at any moment.
Once the All-Heaven Demon Flag’s coverage vanished, the powerful fluctuations of battle could attract the terrifying Deep Red Giant Beast at any time.
However, as the Left Demon’s trump card, a weapon not even used during the Heavenly Feather Clan’s War of Extermination—the power of the eight All-Heaven Demon Flags that sealed was beyond doubt.
Even though two beings more powerful than the average Demon Lord were fighting within, the flags were still barely holding on without bursting.
But watching the Demon Flag continuously distort and expand, Jane Aiken, who normally remained calm no matter what enemy or danger she faced, showed a rare trace of worry on her face.
Jane Aiken whispered, “You must win.”
After spending time with Left Demon, battling alongside him, and venturing deeper into the Deep Red World under his protection, Jane Aiken gradually came to recognize this ‘Jonathan Walker’ even more.
Especially after confirming that her mother’s death had nothing to do with Left Demon, her already minimal resentment and repulsion grew even weaker.
What followed was a long wait.
Half a day passed without attracting any powerful Deep Red Giant Beasts, whether due to good luck or because Left Demon had already ‘seen’ the surroundings when choosing this location.
Then, the eight All-Heaven Demon Flags shook violently, and the banner that depicted a one-side world burst with a bang, turning into a sky full of black fragments.
Boom!
An endless Dark Demon Air spread in all directions, colliding with the pervasive red glow between heaven and earth and creating an ear-splitting roar, like the tide of a mountains and seas shaking tsunami.
Out of the tumbling demon gas, a figure exuding a Terrifying Aura slowly emerged.
The Left Demon’s current state was extremely ragged—two of his three heads were forcefully ripped apart, creating enormous bloody wounds on his shoulders, exposing the black bones.
The eight demonic arms that wielded the All-Heaven Demon Flag were all blown to pieces, with only tiny remnants of bone left under the armpits, and wounds full of black gold blood droplets were dripping from the flesh and blood obliterated areas.
In addition, half of his True Body was torn apart, exposing wriggling organs, his eyes shattered, and half of his skull split, presenting a horrifying scene.
Under normal conditions, a half-step Demon Lord like Left Demon could use his Eternally Unfading Will to regenerate limbs and heal severe wounds by consuming Vitality.
But at that moment, Left Demon was so weakened he could barely stand, the insides of his body felt empty without a trace of life force, and the bloodline and origin of laws within him were gradually dissipating—an aftermath of the repercussions of a failed breakthrough.
Clearly, although Left Demon succeeded in killing Jonathan Walker, he paid a heavy price for it.
Boom! Left Demon, having emerged from the collapsed ‘world,’ crashed down, shattering the ground, with smoke and dust billowing.
Jane Aiken turned into a sword light, appearing before the Left Demon, who had resumed his five-meter Purgatory True Demon form, “…Can you hold on?”
“Let’s go, we can’t stay here long.”
Left Demon struggled to his feet, his voice weak, “The Dark Demon Air that just erupted will attract Deep Red Giant Beasts, or possibly a Demon King in the vicinity.”
“Take this, it can shield our auras…”
Whoosh! A black light flashed, and Jane Aiken with Left Demon disappeared into the depths of the Deep Red World.
At the moment the two left, a terrifying roar came from afar, followed by the manifestation of a huge shadow within the red glow at the edge of the sky.
And in a place tens of thousands of miles away, an Extreme Realm Great Demon King stood with his aura concealed as well, gazing in the direction of the shattered Demon Flag.
“Such pure and powerful darkness, the fluctuations of the rules have even reached here; could it be that one of the Demon Gods met with misfortune!?”
As he spoke, this Great Demon King’s eyes revealed a serious look. After a brief hesitation, he ultimately abandoned the idea of scavenging and vanished following a certain summoning.
The call from the darkness grew weaker, and if he did not leave soon, he would forever fall into the Deep Red World.

chapters.title: Chapter 1521 - 1521 573 God Mecha Summoning the Demon Gods
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1521: Chapter 573: God Mecha, Summoning the Demon Gods Chapter 1521: Chapter 573: God Mecha, Summoning the Demon Gods The entrance to the forbidden area of the original Frontline Battlefield, transport warships fill the sky, slowly descending as countless cultivators unload shipping containers weighing hundreds to thousands of tons.
With a roar, thousands of Green-backed Oxen Beasts, each hundreds of meters long and over two hundred meters tall, bellow as they haul million-ton cargoes towards certain no-fly zones.
The war had ended, and the front-line base, having completed repairs, became busier than ever.
The Federation, from those logistics cities at the rear, mobilized more than five million people to ardently construct the new front line.
Even Seven Layer Heaven Cultivators like Justin Welan engaged in hard labor obediently.
The most staggering sight, however, was that of Mythical Kings lifting mountains and filling seas, raising a ‘City Wall’ circumventing thousands of kilometers across the Earth.
Kings mastering Gold Attributes and Solidifying laws took action, transforming the material, with Heavenly Kings later inscribing runes to form grand arrays, shrouded by Supreme Rules.
Such bases are akin to War Fortresses, similar to the Purgatory Demon Domain; when controlled by Supreme Experts, they can unleash even more terrifying power.
It doubled as the foundation for the upcoming God Defense System.
Above the sky spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, Jack Clark stood on the Void, gazing towards a golden Rubik’s Cube with a diameter of 3 meters, and beyond it, the Mecha standing tall at ten thousand meters.
The Mecha, primarily white with gold trim, exuded majesty, especially with the twelve pairs of white metal wings that unfolded majestically from its back.
Further adorned by a slowly rotating white halo behind the Mecha’s head, a sense of divinity and grandeur enveloped the area.
The Golden Rubik’s Cube slowly rotated, emitting the aged voice of the Sky-based God King, “The initial Sky-reaching War Triumph was actually a puppet battle armor.”
“When I acquired the War Triumph, my cultivation was merely at the Ninth Heaven Peak, allowing only preliminary refinement and use as Kinetic Energy armor.”
“To suppress those awakened during the Dark Age, I began to experiment with installing weapon systems, information systems, and power systems, resulting in the prototype for the first generation of Mecha.”
“Later, as I broke through to the Legendary Realm and Heavenly King Realm, I continued researching and perfecting the path of Mecha Mechanical Ascension.”
“Transcendent Mecha is the external expression of the cultivator’s Laws World; at my breakthrough to the Supreme Level, the laws I mastered, my True Body, and Laws World merged, becoming God’s Armament.”
“This path’s advantage lies in the reinforcement of all technological firepower weapons, possessing an impenetrable defense, along with stronger kinetic energy and endurance.”
“For example, the Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs I launched from the God World have a thousand times the power of conventional ones, alongside auxiliary functions like information transmission and scientific calculations.”
“One could say that a God Mecha is a collective of a civilization’s technological prowess.”
“Even if the Blue Star shattered and exploded, killing most people and severing the line of civilization, as long as the God Mecha remains, civilization can be quickly rebuilt, even developing faster.”
“At the same time, my vulnerability is quite apparent; the God Mecha does not have the Demon God’s undying trait and would require much more time to repair if damaged.”
“Besides, if the Myriad Magic Cube, which is the core of my Divine Soul Intent and also the control core of the God Mecha, were to shatter, I would likewise perish.”
“Therefore, for this Mecha upgrade, I hope to prioritize defense and solidity; everything else is secondary.”
“To ensure there are no mishaps during the upcoming Tempering, my soul, and consciousness housed in the Myriad Magic Cube will temporarily separate and enter a backup body.”
“I understand, Senior,” Jack Clark nodded slowly, his gaze falling upon the transparent page before him.
Attribute points: 2,975,200
Adding the remnants of his original attribute points, the haul from converting Life Crystals this time nearly breached three million.
As the Myriad Magic Cube turned into a streak of golden light piercing the Heavens and Earth, merging with the twenty-kilometer white sky-based battleship below, Jack Clark also appeared on the mountain-like shoulder of the Mecha.
Pressing his right hand against the cold armor of the Mecha, a string of transparent text instantly appeared before him.
“Ancient Divine Weapon, incomplete, integrating half-rule true body with science, can consume two million attribute points for enhancement, completing core Rule War Patterns and leveling up.”
“Consume two million attribute points for enhancement.”
Boom!
The two million attribute points transformed into a force that exploded within Jack Clark like a nuclear blast, turning into boundless energy spurting forth.
The energy was so immense that the surrounding Space-Time distorted at that very moment.
Centered around Jack Clark’s hand, white flames engulfed the entire God Mecha, and the Mecha roared vibrantly, its surface rule lines radiating blinding light.
Under the blaze of the white flames, these rule chains melted and decomposed in the inferno, becoming countless runes that filled the air.
The armor of the Mecha also gradually became transparent, revealing the cold, metallic world between reality and illusion within its depths.
As it was a weapon “belonging to another,” Jack Clark needed not concentrate fully, nor integrate his Divine Soul Intent for increased compatibility.
Thus, while the enhancement set on the correct path and began the Tempering of the Mecha true body and the development of Rule War Patterns, Jack Clark also turned his attention to the smart wristwatch, accessing the logistics statistics.
Rows upon rows of names and data surfaced before his eyes.
Because the Purgatory Empire’s Demon God Level Power was thoroughly suppressed early on, leading to a rapid defeat, countless resource caches were left behind, un-transported, un-destroyed.
Beyond that, there were also Space Equipments acquired from some Purgatory True Demons, part of the Demon Kings, and Great Demon Kings, containing even more resources.
While it was true that past the Heavenly King Realm, few things could directly enhance cultivation, that didn’t mean none existed.
Otherwise, so many Titan Beasts and Ancient Beasts wouldn’t lurk in the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Moreover, Jack Clark’s realm had long reached the pinnacle of Heavenly King, only lacking sufficient Tempering of the true body and the completion of the Inner World’s Wind, Thunder, Earth, and Fire Planes not keeping pace.
“Exclude all resources ineffective against Heavenly King Realm cultivators.”
“Filter out Heaven and Earth Treasures that can temper the true body and hasten the transformation of the Inner World.”
At Jack Clark’s command, countless items disappeared from the projected page, ultimately leaving thirty-seven types, their abundant number making even him slightly startled.
“Demon Cloud Yama Soul Vine, containing Yama Soul energy that can significantly enhance the Tempering process of the Heavenly King’s True Body, acquired from Demon King’s Space Equipment.”
“Heavenly Crystal Dragon Blood Flower, a special resource with Dragon Bloodline power that, when absorbed by cultivators with dragon bloodlines, can greatly improve the evolution speed of the True Body, bestowed by Mad Wheeler Heavenly King.”
“Solid Stone Breath Soil, a special resource of the Earth category that can accelerate the evolution of the Inner World’s Earth and enhance its foundational solidity, originating from Phantom Serpent Main God.”
“Illusion Annual Crystal…”
Jack Clark’s gaze swept over these Heaven and Earth Treasures, especially their origins listed later on.
Only a small portion of these resources were confiscated; the majority came from those kings and Heavenly King powerhouses, as well as gifts from the Heavenly Feather Clan and even the Divine Gods Alliance.
Adam Garcetti’s whole clan supporting Jack Clark’s cultivation wasn’t a joke.
After seeing Jack’s terrifying combat strength, his rapid cultivation progress, and his summoning of an Ancient Beast with True Spirit-Level strength, he was now regarded as the hope to overcome the Purgatory Demon Race.
Add to that, in the estimation of Adam Garcetti and others, within at most three Sun Wheels, the Purgatory Demon Race was expected to regroup and attack with greater strength.
Under these circumstances, resources unfit for immediate use or unsuitable for absorption and Tempering by these powerhouses, as well as resources to strengthen their world, were all offered to Jack.
Thinking this, Jack Clark didn’t hesitate to activate his smart wristwatch, which immediately produced an electronic sound.
“These resources are of the Law Level and require first-sequence clearance for access.”
“Respected Divine Martial Emperor, your clearance meets the requirements. Within one hour, Gabriel King will personally deliver these resources to you.”
Jack took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
After helping the Sky-based God King reinforce the Mecha, he planned to go into closed-door cultivation himself, focusing entirely on cultivating and addressing any weaknesses in his practice.
…
“The Human Race has become a grave threat to our clan, one that must be treated with utmost seriousness,” said one of the powerhouses.
“Especially that Human Race monster named Darren Callum, as well as the Giant Beast he summoned. Their cultivation growth rates are frighteningly rapid.”
“Moreover, once Darren Callum and the Giant Beast reach the realms of Great Demon King and Demon God Level, they both possess the terrifying strength to surpass a Major Realm.”
“If this continues, I fear Darren Callum will enter the Demon God Level within a few Sun Wheels, and the Giant Beast will become even more powerful.”
“By then, even if our ancestors awaken, they may be powerless against them.”
“Moreover, the eastward expansion is the will of our ancestors. I suggest, in the name of our ancestral court, we notify the other six great empires to gather all the empire lords to discuss this matter.”
In the imposing and strict Demon Palace of the Purgatory Empire, five Demon Gods seated on their thrones.
After a few days of brief recuperation from the injuries suffered in the desperate outburst of the previous battle, the auras of Diorus and other Demon Gods recuperated somewhat.
At this moment, they convened in the Grita War Demon Empire’s Demon Palace to deliberate on the unexpected rise of the Human Race and the alliance of its three major forces.
Meanwhile, a Demon God Priest named Constantin was holding a black Magic Crystal, slowly levitating it in his hand.
After Diorus had spoken, without expressing any opinion, the towering figure of the Demon God Priest slightly bowed his head, looking at the demon king standing respectfully below, and slowly said.
“Why is there so little information about that Giant Beast within this Magic Crystal?”
In the midst of the hall, Brooks, who had just broken through to demon king, replied respectfully: “Your Majesty, that summoned Giant Beast is very mysterious, and the Intelligence Department does not have much data on it.”
“There are only records of it being summoned by Darren three times to join in battles. As for the background of this Giant Beast, and why Darren can summon it, no one knows.”
“Furthermore, because Darren’s strength has increased too rapidly, plans revolving around his assassination have not been implemented. Even demon kings planned to strike against him, including the Lord Barus, are now no match for him.”
“Including intelligence gathering, plans to identify relatives or infiltrate the Blue Star World for assassination were not yet devised before the battle broke out.”
Brooks showed a ‘bitter smile’ on his face as if to indicate that the Assassination Department was not at fault for these issues.
It was not that the Assassination Department was ineffective, rather that the enemy’s growth was simply too fast. So fast that complete intelligence hadn’t been gathered before the empire was nearly destroyed by the opponent.
Constantin, the Demon God, slowly spoke out, “The vast world is boundless and spacious, and the exceptional geniuses of the dazzling era keep emerging in quick succession, such as Darren Callum of the Human Race.”
“The power the Human Race has shown indeed poses a serious threat to our clan.”
“Earlier, I have inquired about the Demon King Empire’s situation through the Sacrificial Demon Altar, confirming the complete destruction of Heavenly Feather Clan’s domain and Tyris’s great victory.”
“But for now, Tyris and the elite forces of the three great empires are trapped in the Deep Red World, and the command to gather all empire lords cannot be delivered.”
Continuing, Constantin turned his gaze toward the Demon God Stephenl: “Besides, The Lord of Alecasa Empire bears ‘personal’ enmity towards Tyris…”
“The Kasa True Demon tribe of Alecasa Empire, before they were demonized and joined our clan, their race’s civilization was nearly exterminated by Tyris.”
“Moreover, there has been long-standing animosity and hostility between the Saint Demon Anke Empire and the Freymand Empire for a thousand years.”
“Although Sigitico has perished, even if I issue a demon order from the Ancestral Court and summon the lords of the six great empires, it would still be impossible to get them to agree to act together.”
At this point, even Constantin felt somewhat troubled by the situation.
The Demonization rules of the Purgatory Demon Race have allowed Purgatory to grow continuously, never to be exterminated, regardless of how formidable the enemy, including the destruction of empires.
Yet, during the hibernation of the Purgatory ancestors, the empires formed by the different demonized alien races were filled with contradictions and hatred, unable to unify.
Otherwise, the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Immortal Spirit Clan would have been long annihilated by the joint forces of the Purgatory Empire.
Diorus suddenly said:
“There’s another point to wrap up; I’m feeling a bit stuck today.”
“Including intelligence gathering, plans to identify relatives or infiltrate the Blue Star World for assassination were not yet devised before the battle broke out.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1522 - 1522 574 World Star Core
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1522: Chapter 574: World Star Core Chapter 1522: Chapter 574: World Star Core The Great Hall towered majestically, with black demon air rolling inside; pillars as thick as a kilometer and as tall as Heaven’s Columns stood erect, piercing into the clouds and disappearing into the swirling vortex.
In this abyss that resembled Dark Hell, Brooks stood respectfully below, awaiting the ‘next instructions’ from the demon gods.
However, as the five demon gods communicated, the invisible rule spread, stirring space-time, so Brooks did not know what they were talking about.
Half an hour later, the five demon gods finished discussing matters of the Primordial Origin.
Diorus slightly lowered his head, his indifferent gaze falling on Brooks, his voice distant: “Brooks, from now on you are in charge of taking over the crippled Assassination Department. Gather some of the elite True Demons for reorganization.”
“The Assassination Department will henceforth be transformed into the Intelligence Department. Find a way to deeply infiltrate the human inner circle and obtain important information.”
“Especially concerning Darren Callum, including his family and friends—the more details, the better. In addition, the movements of the Heavenly Feather Clan as well.”
“This time, I allow you to use resources from the two great imperial treasuries. You do not need approval for anything below Law Level; Law Level and above must be approved by Tarolia.”
The great war had not only cost the life of Barus, the Intelligence Department’s director, but also two demon kings had fallen, with several others escaping back with heavy injuries to their Origins, and the elite of the departments were devastated.
At this time, the recently advanced Brooks became the only usable demon king, entrusted with a significant task by Diorus.
For this rookie who had participated in ‘intensive training,’ Diorus had a bit of an impression—good talent, and more prudent and capable in handling matters than the other demon kings.
And to incite rebellion among human traitors would require a large amount of resource enticement.
“Thank you, Your Majesty, I will do my utmost to complete the task and thoroughly investigate all the information on that human,” Brooks said, his expression solemn and respectful.
“You may leave.”
“Yes.”
Brooks respectfully bowed, then slowly withdrew from the Demon God Palace.
As he stepped out of the oppressive Dark Demon Palace and stood on the steps, Brooks looked down at the bustling demon domain city below with a smile curling at the corner of his mouth.
Just then, the Demon Palace trembled, and three black Light Beams shot up into the sky, emanating the might of demon gods and vanishing in three different directions in the sky.
Witnessing this scene, Brooks’s gaze flickered slightly; some demon gods had departed.
Inside the Demon God Palace, facing the demon god Rudeus, Diorus suddenly spoke: “What do you think? Will this call from Constantin to the ancestry site summon a response from the Ancestor”
Shrouded in the darkness, Rudeus’s voice was deep and cold: “I do not know, the Ancestor has been in Hibernation for so many years, only the ancestral rites could make contact.”
“As for how much the Ancestor’s injuries have healed and when he will fully awaken, the responses from the ancestral site have always been ambiguous over the years.”
“Including the last brief awakening of the Ancestor who issued the order to expand eastward that was also conveyed through Constantin’s rites. As for…” Rudeus paused here.
At the same time, Diorus did not speak to continue, and the Demon Palace fell into silence.
……
Above the entrance of the forbidden area, as the white flames gradually extinguished, there appeared a Mecha standing 15,000 kilometers tall, with twelve pairs of wings unfurling behind it.
As it became a complete Ancient Divine Weapon, the God Mecha’s invisible energy fluctuations grew more terrifying, and its entire armor was covered with golden rule patterns, mystical and sacred.
Between the twelve pairs of outstretched wings, substantial white ribbons of light circulated, and their Radiance turned the surrounding space into a metallic world.
This gigantic metallic world, like a continental block over ten thousand kilometers in diameter, spanned above the forbidden area.
The complete arrival of the Inner World caused even the invisible fluctuations of power to burst space and explode the atmosphere, forming concentric rings of red waves spreading in all directions.
Such a grand display of might instantly shocked countless cultivators into awe.
But in the eyes of those Mythical Kings and Heavenly Kings, envy and excitement shone through.
With the promotion of the Sky-based God King’s Divine Weapon, the three strongest beings of the Human Race now each possessed a complete Ancient Divine Weapon, their strength soaring, each on par with those who held World-class weapons and were at the Ancient Middle Stage of the empire’s ruler.
For demon gods like Carthius, who were in the Ancient Middle Stage, they were no longer a match for the Primordial True Kings.
The God Mecha, radiating holy light, projected the voice of the Sky-based God King through the spinning Golden Rubik’s Cube on its shoulder: “You worked hard, Jack Clark.”
Jack’s face broke into a smile: “You’re too kind, Senior; this is what I should do. Please give it a try and see how powerful it is now.”
“Very well,” the Sky-based God King also felt a wave of excitement, and the Golden Rubik’s Cube melted into a beam of light and merged with the Mecha.
Boom!
The previously still Mecha vibrated, and terrifying waves of rule strength emanated from within. The white circle above grew intensely bright, piercing the Void, and faintly, hymns seemed to resonate throughout Heaven and Earth.
Amid the hymns, full of holiness and devotion, sounding like the choral voices of countless people, the God Mecha began to transform.
The twelve pairs of wings on its back continuously stretched and elevated, while its internal framework refined, and soon a structure resembling a ‘Person,’ yet not a ‘Person,’ akin to a cosmic base, emerged.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh! Four beams of white Light Beam infused with rule strength shot out from the God Mecha’s chest, passing through Heaven and Earth, covering four battleships below, spanning twenty kilometers each, colored red, white, black, and purple respectively.
Boom boom boom! The four massive sky-based battleships shook and, to the astonishment of many, ascended into the sky.
The four sky-based battleships transformed continuously, and by the time they rose to tens of thousands of kilometers above, they had become four components resembling limbs, crackle crackle, merging with the God Mecha.

chapters.title: Chapter 1523 - 1523 574 World Star Core_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1523: Chapter 574 World Star Core_2 Chapter 1523: Chapter 574 World Star Core_2 Suddenly, a platinum celestial body with a diameter of a hundred kilometers appeared.
Hum! Inside the core of the God Mecha, an even more powerful law force burst forth, transforming into white radiance that assimilated the four Sky Base parts.
At the same time, an intense signal pulse fluctuation, like gamma rays, shot out in all directions, instantly piercing through one hundred thousand kilometers, two hundred thousand kilometers, five hundred thousand kilometers…
In the mythical world, human electronic technology was severely suppressed.
The electromagnetic waves of wireless communication were interfered with by the violent Heavenly Energy, and precise electronic components were eroded, shortening their lifespan.
However, the pulse signal emitted by the God Base at this moment, containing intangible law power, ignored all obstacles and enveloped an area of over two million kilometers around the forbidden battlefield.
Suddenly, the signals at the various small bases being established around the scattered battlefield lit up fiercely.
Even Jack Clark couldn’t help but be somewhat surprised.
It was not just the establishment of communication within a range of more than two million kilometers; as those pulse signals spread, it also represented the extension of the Sky-based God King’s power.
The law force covering an area of more than two million kilometers was terrifying to think about, on par with the Divine King of Light merged with the Eternal Divine Tree, whose power encompassed the Divine Realm.
Of course, just the expanse of the diffusion of rules did not mean that the Sky-based God King’s strength was comparable to that of a half-step True Spirit.
However, the Sky-based God King took no further action here, unlike the Primordial True King who had wielded the complete Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth Stick with Divine Might that shattered the Firmament.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s wristwatch lit up slightly, and Gabriel’s voice came through: “Jack Clark, I’ve gathered all the resources you asked for. Are you coming down to get them now?”
Gabriel, with her Heavenly King strength, could not come higher than ten thousand kilometers, so she could only have Jack Clark come down to retrieve them.
“Thank you for the trouble, Senior. I will come down right now.” As Jack said so, the space around him distorted, and his figure disappeared in an instant.
As Jack left, an icy electronic voice also came from inside the God Mecha.
“Zzz!! The God Defense system begins to establish.”
“Planning coordinates.”
“Calculating the Doomsday base point…”
Gabriel King stood in the Void, surrounded by white orbs of light, each sealed with a Heaven and Earth Treasure using the power of laws.
The largest was a blue crystal stone the size of a small hill, emitting rich spatial fluctuations, and there were also tank-sized vials of golden blood, shining like miniature suns with dazzling radiance.
Seeing the black-haired young man appear suddenly, Gabriel smiled and said, “Here you are, Jack Clark, hurry up and take these things away. If it were any later, I might not be able to resist the temptation.”
This time, all the Heavenly Kings and even Divine Kings among the alliance’s three major forces brought out all the resources they had that could be useful to a Heavenly King Powerhouse.
Many of these treasures even made Gabriel feel envious; if she refined them all, they would be enough to boost her cultivation from mid-period Heavenly King to peak level.
“Senior is joking,” Jack laughed, not taking the comment to heart.
After saying hello, Gabriel left immediately, as she had many other things to attend to, while Jack looked at the Heaven and Earth Treasures floating before him, his face showing anticipation.
After helping to strengthen the Ancient Divine Weapon for the Sky-based God King, it was his turn next.
He just didn’t know if these resources would be enough for him to break through to the peak of Heavenly King, as his foundation was too solid, and his requirements naturally higher.
Whoosh!
Golden flames erupted around Jack, sweeping up those Heaven and Earth Treasures that couldn’t be stored in spatial equipment, and they disappeared into a beam of golden light.
The Black Wind howled, blue Thunder flickered, and on the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, roots imbued with the World’s Power and blue crystal stones fell from the sky.
No sooner had these treasures appeared than they were shattered by Thunder, causing the entire Plane to tremble.
Meanwhile outside, Jack, seated on the mountain peak, opened his mouth wide, emitting a strong suction force, and swallowed the sun-like golden Dragon Blood in one gulp.
Boom! The Overbearing and scorching Dragon Bloodline power exploded but could not shake Jack’s formidable True Body in the slightest; instead, it was devoured by an even more Overbearing force.
While Jack found a secluded place for Closed-door Cultivation, others were also busy.
True Martial Heavenly King looked at the content emerging on the True Martial Stone Tablet and pondered: “The three Demon Gods have left, each in a different direction; are they going for reinforcements?”
At the same time, Adam Garcetti and other Supreme Experts also dispersed in all directions, driving away the remnants of Diorus’s law power.
In the Blue Star World, Simon Empire.
In the huge underground research base, the hot magma churned, and massive pipes sprawled through the Magma Fire Sea like circuits.
On the shores of the Magma Fire Sea, countless mechanical devices flickered with lights as numerous people busied themselves.
“Report, under the transformation of the Earth’s Core Power and Cold Star Marrow Fluid, the Super God Energy inside Number One has stabilized and is about to reach the target point.”
“The Soul Synchronization Rate between the pilot and Number One has surpassed five hundred percent and is approaching the critical point for releasing the Primordial Form.”
“The current mental state of the pilot is stable, no signs of contamination observed, meeting the preliminary fusion requirements.”
“Constrained Armor part one has been loaded.”
In the searing Magma Fire Sea, the thousand-meter tall Number One submerged most of its body, only its head and half of its shoulders visible, quietly emanating a bluish-white light.
Behind Number One, there stood an even bigger Black-Red Colored Mech, like an enlarged version of Number One, but empty inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 1524 - 1524 574 World Star Core_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1524: Chapter 574: World Star Core_3 Chapter 1524: Chapter 574: World Star Core_3 And with Number One as the center, within a diameter of three thousand meters it was bone-chillingly cold, flowing with icy blue liquid, emanating an aura that seemed to freeze everything.
Looking at the silent Number One, Elvis Louise’s expression was grave, “Freya Louise, how do you feel?”
From within Number One, Freya Louise’s calm, or rather, indifferent voice sounded, devoid of any emotional fluctuations, “Wait a bit longer, I haven’t sensed the opportunity for a breakthrough yet.”
Elvis Louise nodded slowly, “Continue to maintain energy transformation, maximum power to stimulate the icy strength within the Cold Star Dragon Pearl, suppress the biological activity of Number One.”
“At the same time, notify the higher-ups to check those circuit pipeline connections; when the time comes, I want to mobilize all the nuclear power plants on the entire planet.”
“Yes, Doctor Louise.”
……
Roar! Strange Giant Beast, this is my territory, get out.
Black reef rocks stood tall amidst the Magma Fire Sea burning with flames, with Magma Fire Dragons resembling Western Dragons, hundreds and thousands of meters in length, coiling and circling about.
There were tens of thousands of these Magma Fire Dragons, the weakest emitting Level 9 auras, over thirty of Mythical level, and seven Titan Level Magma Giant Dragons spanning over two thousand to three thousand meters in length.
At this moment, all of these Magma Giant Dragons were roaring in unison, their flame-engulfed eyes filled with brutality and majesty.
Above this sky akin to a Magma Purgatory, a massive crack was torn open.
Beyond the crack, a Black Gold Giant Beast that was nine thousand and one hundred meters in length stood firm, its golden vertical pupils coldly observing the roaring Magma Giant Dragons below.
Beside the Destruction Emperor Dragon, there were two Giant Dragons flying, one Silver and one Gold Blue, both around one thousand four hundred meters in length.
The Silver Giant Dragon looked somewhat excited, “Roar! Tim Abbott, such a powerful aura of flame rules. The fellow inside is also an Ancient Dragon-type Giant Beast. Shall we fight it before inviting it to join the Dragon Palace?”
This was the second Ancient Dragon-type Giant Beast the Silver Giant Dragon had seen, naturally feeling a sense of kinship.
If this Ancient Giant Beast could join the Dragon Palace, the empire would have two Ancient Giant Dragons.
“I want to eat it.” In a low growl, two black ten-character runes appeared in the golden vertical pupils of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its terrifying gaze penetrating layers of magma and falling onto a location deep within the world.
Endless dark gold magma rolled there, and an Ancient Crimson Magma Giant Dragon with nine dragon heads, stretching to twelve thousand meters in length, was coiled up.
Between the claws of this Ancient Crimson Magma Giant Dragon, it was holding a kilometer in diameter ‘Sun’, completely black in color with a surface full of fiery hot cracks that spewed black and red hot substances.
The fire, heat, energy, and even the black reef rock material of the entire Magma World originated from that Sun.
And on top of that black and red Sun, the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt an extremely heavy aura, its waves causing every cell in its body to instinctively surge with the impulse to devour.
That was a very high-level Heaven and Earth Treasure, or rather, the Star Core of the original Great Era of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
If it could devour that Star Core, including this Magma World and the Nine-heads Ancient Magma Giant Dragon of the ancient late stage, the strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon would at least break through to the Ancient Middle Stage.
And an instinct deep within it told the dragon that devouring that Star Core could even cause its already Heavenly Tier bloodline to undergo a certain evolution.
Thinking of this, a dazzling red light burst from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Roar!
The entire Magma World shook violently, the black cracks suddenly torn apart to a million meters in length, and a nearly thirty thousand meters long Crimson Giant Beast descended.

chapters.title: Chapter 1525 - 1525 575 I Am the Catastrophe the Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1525: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast Chapter 1525: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast The arrival of the Deep Red Emperor Dragon caused the entire Lava World to shake and roar in an instant.
The red light that dyed the sky was the extension of its power, filling Heaven and Earth, like a huge, boundless red monster brimming with a sense of oppression.
Roar!
The countless Magma Giant Dragons squatting below roared, magma exploded, and a scorching tsunami that blocked out the sun rushed towards the invading Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
Although there was a huge difference in size and strength level between the two sides, these Magma Giant Dragons were all fearless to the point of recklessness.
These Giant Dragons were the rule power of an Ancient Beast deep within the magma, merged and altered with the scorching magma, akin to life yet not life, similar to subordinates.
Bang bang bang!!
Each Magma Giant Dragon, measuring hundred to two hundred meters, had just reached the sky, still thousands of kilometers away from the Deep Red Emperor Dragon, when they were crushed by the red light that permeated Heaven and Earth.
In an instant, nuclear explosion glows sparkled in the air, and heaven-wide magma flames sprayed all over.
Roar!
Over thirty Mythical Magma Giant Dragons roared, the surrounding Magma Domain boiled, and a scathing Magma Dragon Breath shot out from their mouths, forming dozens of flame pillars that penetrated Heaven and Earth.
But at that moment, streaks of golden red thunder flashed within the pervasive red light, shattering the breaths and eliciting mournful cries from the Mythical Magma Giant Dragons.
Boom boom boom!!
More than thirty Mythical Lava Giant Dragons exploded, their terrifying clamor akin to tens of billions of Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs detonating, shaking the entire world wildly.
The scorching impact shattered the sun-blocking Lava Tsunami, sweeping across thousands of kilometers, destroying space, and the earth-shaking rumbles echoed endlessly.
Facing the Deep Red Form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, these creatures didn’t even qualify to come close.
Roar roar!!
Seven Titan Dragons over two thousand meters long let out ferocious roars, their Dragon Wings dripping with magma flared angrily, and in an instant, the entire Magma Fire Sea erupted.
Boom boom boom!!
Vortexes appeared in the Fire Sea, forming columns of Magma Fire thousands of meters thick that surged skyward, and under the converged power of the seven Titan Dragons, formed a Magma Fire Sphere a thousand kilometers in diameter.
From a distance, it was like the Nine-Headed Titan Dragons were propelling a Flame Satellite into the sky.
With the power of the seven Titan Beasts pooled together, the scorching Fire Satellite contained terrifying energy; wherever it went, space was compressed into substance, creating a red tide that spread out.
Roar!
The Deep Red Emperor Dragon roared, its gaze icy, turning into a golden red light at an indescribable speed, descending from the sky and directly striking the world-destroying Lava Satellite.
Boom!
The heart of the Lava Satellite collapsed suddenly and then exploded into fragments under the horrific force, endless streams of scorching magma erupting in all directions, as if a planet had exploded.
In the Destructive Impact, the seven Titan Dragons roared, but before they could react, the scorching magma dispersed and a Dragon Claw wrapped in golden red lightning burst down, obliterating everything in its path.
Bang bang bang!!
Golden red lightning flashed, and the bodies of four Titan Dragons exploded on one side in an instant, becoming streams of scorching magma erupting under that Unrivaled Domineering Power.
The remaining three Titan Dragons had no time to react when the space in front of them suddenly shattered, sliced open by a red Tail Blade over ten thousand meters long.
Under that writhing darkness tearing through the Sky Curtain, the three Titan Dragons were split in two, and then an even more ferocious power erupted, their true bodies exploding under the onslaught of golden red lightning.
These dragons, born of the synergy between the rules’ power and the magma, were incomplete beasts without the strong Vitality of mythical creatures, essentially representing death upon being blown apart.
And all of this happened in the blink of an eye.
Only then did the Nine-Headed Magma Giant Dragon, slumbering deep within the Lava World, suddenly raise its head, its nine ferocious dragon heads issuing roars of shock and rage, its colossal body suddenly standing up.
Boom!
The Magma Fire Sea spanning tens of kilometers trembled, and the middle thousand-kilometer area suddenly bulged, as if some terrifying creature was awakening beneath it, simultaneously heating up the entire world even more.
Flames burned between heaven and earth, the air scorched.
The scorching magma rose tens of kilometers before erupting, with an over twelve thousand meters long, massive-bodied Ancient Lava Giant Dragon appearing amidst the scorching magma explosions.
The Ancient Lava Giant Dragon was covered with dark red scale armor, with scorching golden magma flowing between the scales, emanating a horrific high temperature that seemed to melt space itself.
On the nine heads of the Giant Dragon were two pairs of ferocious dragon horns, with one pair spiral-shaped and straight, the other pair thick and curved like a bull’s.
And unlike the Silver Giant Dragons, this Ancient Lava Giant Dragon was also donned in a set of black armor.
Although the armor was somewhat rudimentary, looking like a patchwork of equipment, it still covered its entire body, including its claws and tail, appearing incredibly might and domineering amid the burning flames.
Gazing at the monstrous behemoth standing tall in the Firmament, surrounded by endless red light, the nine dragon heads of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon let out a threatening and ferocious roar.
“Roar roar roar!! I am the Master of Disasters, the great Disaster Tyria, the Dragon Monarch who embodies strength and courage.”
“Stranger Giant Dragon, not only have you invaded the great territory of the Master of Disasters, you have also slain all the Magma Giant Dragons charged with guarding this world, challenging my majesty.”
“However, if you realize your mistake and say ‘You are the embodiment of courage and strength’ ‘You are the valiant Dragon Monarch’ ten times,
‘Your radiance will shine upon the world for eternity, worshipped and passed down by billions of Giant Dragons’, extolling the greatness of Disaster Tyria, then I might consider forgiving you.”
…
Looking down at the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon proudly standing on the Magma Fire Sea, its nine heads held high in self-importance, even the Deep Red Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but pause for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1526 - 1526 575 I Am the Catastrophe the Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1526: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_2 Chapter 1526: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_2 “`
No, do you not understand the situation?
At this moment, the Deep red emperor dragon inexplicably felt like it had encountered an idiot child, and its murderous intent to tear and suppress the other to death slowed down.
Watching the two ancient giant beasts suddenly stopping, above the Firmament, the Silver Giant Dragon peeked its head through the shattered edge of the crack, also looking puzzled.
“Roar! Tim Abott, is there something wrong with this guy’s head?”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon elegantly poked its head through as well, growling lowly, “Clearly, this one’s a fool, just as stupid as Sethia.”
“Despicable Telsafi, how dare you insult the great Sethia! When have you ever seen the great Sethia let an enemy praise him for his bravery and beauty in the midst of battle?”
Facing the outraged Silver Giant Dragon, the golden-blue Giant Dragon thought for a moment and nodded in apology, “…Sorry, Sethia, I did speak wrongly.”
“Although you are usually foolish, your control of the situation during battle is still quite impressive.”
Seeing the golden-blue Giant Dragon rarely admitting its mistake, the Silver Giant Dragon proudly raised its head: “Roar! Of course, the Great Sethia is much smarter than it.”
Then the Silver Giant Dragon looked down excitedly and roared, “Roar! Tim Abott, can we not eat this guy? He’s so stupid, what if eating him affects your intelligence?”
The Silver Giant Dragon was originally interested in this ancient lava Giant Dragon and wanted the Destruction Emperor Dragon to subdue it into joining the empire.
Now, seeing just how foolish this being was, it was even less keen on its death—after all, with this lava Giant Dragon by its side, it wouldn’t be the dumbest among the dragon kings.
Under the constant ‘idiot’ and ‘fool’ brainwashing by the golden-blue Giant Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon subconsciously developed the false impression that it was very foolish itself.
Because they had nearly refined this lava world, the conversation between the two Giant Dragons was clearly heard by the Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon, which caused its mouth to twitch.
Is it foolish?
How could that be? The great Disaster Tyria was intelligent; everything it did was an act to ease the tension between both sides.
This huge Red Beast, although only at the ancient early stage of growth, was extraordinarily terrifying.
Merely standing above the Firmament, the strength it naturally emitted was suppressing its Lava World flames that spread between heaven and earth, making it nearly impossible to breathe.
Beyond that, the Dragon Bloodline that was nearly Monarch level was sending waves of compulsion to submit and revere.
The bloodline of this Red Beast had reached Monarch level, a Horrific Creature with the potential to become a True Spirit. Even in its ancient late stage, it had no confidence in defeating it.
In such circumstances, peace was naturally preferable; everyone could step back and give each other an out.
Presumably, this unfamiliar dragon species didn’t want to fight a battle where victory wasn’t assured, especially since this was its Territory.
Standing in the Lava World it had already refined, its strength would increase several times, reaching the Peak of the Ancient.
And with nine heads, each containing different Talent Abilities, its strength was nearly invincible among its peers.
Just as the Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon’s eyes flickered, assuming that the invading Destruction Emperor Dragon would take a step back for an armistice, the large Deep Red Giant Beast slowly growled,
“Have you got it wrong? You are the one who should be apologizing to me.”
“I was merely passing by this place, glanced at this world, and your dragon subordinates dared to roar at me, telling this king to scram.”
“A mere group of dragons with Myth and Titan strength actually dared to roar at an Ancient Giant Dragon, completely challenging my dignity as an ancient creature.”
This… The Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon was stunned.
No, wasn’t it you who first tore the Boundary Wall of this world, prompting my subordinates to roar a warning?
While the Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon was bewildered, the Deep red emperor dragon continued to growl lowly: “Seeing as your attitude is not bad, if you offer that World Star Core as an apology, I might consider letting bygones be bygones.”
The moment the Deep red emperor dragon mentioned the World Star Core, the eyes of the Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon sharply steeled over, and the flames on its body Burst out completely.
Boom!
The whole world shook amidst the infinite eruption of golden flames, and chains of red Flame Rule appeared between heaven and earth, exuding terrifying pressure.
The Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon glared deathly at the Deep red emperor dragon, its gaze suddenly turning cold as all nine of its heads let out a vicious roar,
“Roar! You invader, so your target is my Star Core; you’re seeking death.”
Boom!
The Scorching Magma of the entire world erupted violently, rising to the sky and transforming into a Lava Giant Dragon head with a diameter of over a thousand kilometers, devouring towards the Deep red emperor dragon.
Meanwhile, hundreds of meters-thick chains of Flame Rule pierced the Void, ignoring the gold-red lightning domain, locking the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s double claws and body.
At the same time, strands of red flame chains shot through the Firmament, spreading out in all directions to cover ten thousand kilometers.
Instantly, the immense gravity of the entire Lava World descended, pressing down on the Deep red emperor dragon so heavily that it sank, and the red radiance permeating the space around it suddenly contracted to within a thousand kilometers.
Roar! Under the oppression of the Rule, the Deep red emperor dragon bellowed as it stood up, its arms swelling as if mountains were rising, and in an instant a power capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth exploded from within its body.
Thud, thud, thud!
The Rule Chains wrapped around the body of the Deep red emperor dragon shattered, and immediately the tri-row of mountainous Dorsal Fins on its back blazed brightly, stretching from the tail to the back.
Hum!
The Radiance from the mouth of the Deep red emperor dragon surged greatly, and a kilometer-thick beam of crimson Radiance shot forth, emanating an energy fluctuation capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1527 - 1527 575 I Am the Catastrophe the Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1527: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_3 Chapter 1527: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_3 “””
As the breath, resembling blood flames, spewed out, it expanded rapidly by absorbing Heavenly Energy from within a range of tens of thousands of kilometers, defying the rule suppression of the Scorching Magma Dragon.
In just the blink of an eye, the dragon head with a thousand kilometers in diameter collided with the blood-red waterfall breath that swollen to hundreds of kilometers thick.
Boom!
Under the torrential pour of the red breath, the magma dragon head exploded violently, creating rings of dazzling red light that spread out in all directions, rushing tens of thousands of kilometers away.
The destructive red breath, undiminished, continued to collide and finally turned into a light beam a thousand kilometers thick, plunging into the magma ocean and submerging both the ancient magma giant and the dragon.
Boom! At this moment, the sky shook, the oceans roared, and the entire world trembled wildly.
In the depths of the magma ocean, a dazzling red light sphere expanded rapidly, the surrounding scorching magma erupted skyward, and flung in all directions, reaching thousands of kilometers high.
At this moment, within a range of tens of thousands of kilometers across the world, molten lava rain poured down, accompanied by howling winds and billowing black smoke, as if Doomsday had descended.
Or perhaps this world was Hell itself, a lava hell.
However, this world was even more solid and vast than the Kirin Beast’s Black Mountain World and the Dust Serpent’s gray Earth World.
Even the breath of the Deep Red Emperor Dragon didn’t penetrate it, but merely shattered the Void, leaving behind immense cracks on the crimson boundary wall deep within the world.
Roars! Ferocious roars echoed between heaven and earth.
The entire world shook even more violently, and from the eight directions of the world burning with magma, eight massive dragon heads made of scorching magma rose up, their mouths flickering with dazzling light.
Boom boom boom!
Instantly, eight breaths of golden, silver, purple, and blue, each tens of kilometers thick and radiating scorching radiance, pierced through heaven and earth.
With the entire world’s strength mobilized in support, each breath emitted the terrifying energy fluctuations of the peak of ancient times, annihilating space wherever it passed and forming nine dark pathways.
And just as the eight dragon heads roared and their breaths exploded, time seemed to come to a standstill around the Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
In its conscious perception, time around it slowed down drastically. The eight breaths, infused with destructive power, folded space and submerged it instantly.
Dazzling seven-colored radiance erupted between heaven and earth, like a rapidly expanding seven-colored star, its terrifying energy causing space and time around it to distort and collapse.
When the seven-colored light sphere expanded to three thousand kilometers, the energy within, twisted and collapsing, reached its limit.
Boom! The energy, ferocious to the extreme, exploded, fracturing space and forming layer upon layer of dark tides that swept across heaven and earth, almost reducing the entire lava world to chaos.
This fearsome strike, with its intangible energy fluctuations, caused even the Silver Giant Dragon and Golden-Blue Giant Dragon outside the world to become apprehensive, instinctively recoiling their heads from the cracks.
“Roar! Telsafi, this dumb dragon is so strong!” the Silver Giant Dragon growled low.
The Golden-Blue Giant Dragon nodded gravely, “It’s not just very strong, it’s frighteningly strong. This ancient beast is even more powerful than Aunt Adriana and Kutadire.”
This ancient Lava Giant Dragon could be said to be the strongest being they’d encountered, aside from the creature that resided in the river of time.
Its terrifying strength was even sufficient to face off against the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its Deep Red Form.
But that was merely facing off; the two giant dragons were confident in the Destruction Emperor Dragon, including its current submersion in the eight terrifying breaths, believing it would be unharmed.
As beasts that had followed the Destruction Emperor Dragon all the way, they were all too familiar with its might.
That was an invincibility in every aspect, whether it was strength or Defense, there was not a single giant in its class that could match it, let alone break through its defenses.
At this time, the explosive light in the Lava World gradually faded, and violent energy roared between heaven and earth.
Within the explosion zone of the dragon breath, space across a range of ten thousand kilometers resembled a shattered mirror, riddled with massive Black Cracks, with the central area as dark and turbid as the primordial chaos.
At that moment, at the heart of the explosion filled with destructive currents, a red Giant Beast rose, standing fifteen thousand meters tall, its scale armor gleaming, surrounded by dancing golden-red lightning, emitting an indescribable aura of destruction and oppression.
“Roar! How is this possible!”
Thousands of kilometers below the great land, within the red-glowing magma Hollow, the ancient Lava Giant Dragon roared, all nine of its red eyes revealing shock and disbelief.
Under its talent ability’s lock-on, with Origin energy erupting and integrating the strength of the Lava World, a combined blow from eight breaths could obliterate an entire side of the world.
Yet, the red beast emerged unscathed, its terrifying defense more dreadful than the blood-breath strike that had wounded it earlier.
Now, the ancient Lava Giant Dragon appeared somewhat disheveled, with many areas of its scale armor broken, golden flames burning over its wounds, repelling fine strands of golden-red lightning.
The Deep red emperor dragon slowly lowered its head, its golden vertical pupils cold, and its fearsome maw slightly open, emitting a world-shaking, resonant growl.
“Warm-up is over, now, embrace destruction.”
With a growl, an aura burst forth from the Deep Red Emperor Dragon that struck fear into all living beings, as if a fierce presence from the untamed wilds of ancient times had descended, shaking the stars as it soared to the sky.
Boom!
Under the black flame-like energy eruption, the Deep Red Emperor Dragon’s body expanded once more, swelling to thirty-five thousand meters, its muscles explosively enlarging the scale armor, like a Destroy the world beast clad in a fierce armor.
“””

chapters.title: Chapter 1528 - 1528 575 I Am the Catastrophe the Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1528: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_4 Chapter 1528: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_4 Under the power of destruction, the entire Lava World was shaking, all colors faded, the rules of Heaven and Earth collapsed, and the whole world plunged into chaos.
Amid the spreading circles of black radiance, the red flame rule chains that threaded through Heaven and Earth disintegrated, and the burning magma was extinguished.
In the Void, whispers of “Doomsday,” “Destruction,” and “Supreme Destruction” resounded mysteriously, exuding an ominous, apocalyptic aura of the end times.
Crackle Crackle!! Even the deep recesses of the Void faintly conveyed the sounds of the world’s boundary walls shattering, unable to grow any longer.
At that moment, whether it was the ancient Lava Giants or the Silver and Gold-Blue Giants outside the world, all were silenced, awestruck by the Destroy the World Beast standing tall amidst chaos and darkness.
But, in contrast to the trembling ancient Lava Giants, the Silver and Gold-Blue Giants who witnessed the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s final form were excited and thrilled.
“Roar, roar! Tim Abbott is so strong, so powerful, Telsafi,” exclaimed the Silver Giant Dragon.
Heated breaths erupted from the Silver Giant Dragon’s nostrils as it fixed its gaze on the mighty silhouette of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, its instincts causing its legs to tremble and its tail to stand straight up rigidly.
“Is this the true power after Thunderflame’s breakthrough? So strong, too strong!!”
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon was no different, its claws frantically scratching at the space below, its gaze fiery as it watched the Giant Beast burning with Black Flames.
Too strong, too strong! Ah, how could there be such powerful dragon-type giants in the world.
The two excited giants outside the world, with their tails rigid and swaying madly back and forth, watched as the Doomsday Emperor Dragon suddenly moved.
Boom!
With that terrifying might, time itself seemed to shake with the movement of the Destroy the World Beast, the ancient Lava Giant cowering even more.
“I submit, I submit…”
Just as the ancient Lava Dragon raised its nine dragon heads and prepared to cry out its surrender, a dragon claw ablaze with Black Flames had already descended from the sky.
Boom!
Beneath one claw, all things perished, the domain of rules around the ancient Lava Dragon shattered, five heads exploded, and half of its true body was torn asunder as a massive silhouette was slammed deep into the Void.
“I ackn…”
The remaining four dragon heads of the ancient Lava Giant roared furiously, but before they could speak, a Tail Blade wrapped in Black Flames swept across silently.
Under the power of Doomsday and Destruction, the four heads of the ancient Lava Giant were instantly turned to ash.
Roar!
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon roared as it grasped the shoulders where the ancient Lava Giant’s head had shattered; its sharp Dragon Claws ripped through the thick scale armor, penetrating flesh and bone.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Within the body of the ancient Lava Giant, where golden blood at temperatures of millions of Celsius flowed, fiercely burning the invading claws, they could not shake them in the slightest.
“I am Doomsday!” the Doomsday Emperor Dragon bellowed to the sky, its strength bursting forth from its claws.
Under that terrifying power, the ancient Lava Giant inside cried out in agony; its thick and solid scale armor shattered, and its dark-golden muscles tore apart, booming like a nuclear explosion.
Boom!
Under that Unrivaled Domineering Power, the ancient grand-stage Lava Giant was directly torn asunder by the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, its scorching blood sprayed, dying half of its body golden.
Vicious, ferocious.
However, after tearing apart the ancient Lava Giant, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon halted its advance, not opening its maw wide to devour as it had done in the past.
Bang!!
Releasing the claws, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon casually dropped the two halves of the body, stretching over ten kilometers long, and walked off into the distance, leaving vibrations in the Void with its heavy steps.
Where it passed, the space crushed out of existence, and the rocks formed from extinguished magma disintegrated into nothing.
Deep within the Lava World’s Void, the World Star Core, a kilometer in diameter and covered with cracks from which scorching magma oozed, rotated slowly.
When the Doomsday Emperor Dragon approached the black Star Core, a profoundly heavy aura pressed forward.
Unlike the Star Core fragment that Jack Clark initially refined, this was a complete core, the Star Core of a Great World, containing astonishing energy.
Most importantly, the World Origin remaining within the Star Core emanated complete Rule Charm; devouring and refining it would not only significantly enhance the Doomsday Emperor Dragon but also improve its bloodline to a certain extent.
That’s because each Ancient Beast’s body was unparalleled in strength, embodying World Features.
Unlike the worlds nurtured and borne by the rules within the bodies of Demon Gods and Divine Kings, alternately vague and real, the Ancient Beasts’ bodies were the “world.”
In essence, these Ancient Beasts bypassed the step where divine kings and demon gods, upon reaching the pinnacle of their realms, had to unite with their Inner Worlds.
This exceptional condition allowed beast-life to reach the critical point of the Ancient Realm much faster.
Boom!
The claws, burning with Black Flames, grabbed the Star Core, and immediately the Doomsday Emperor Dragon felt a weight in its grasp, its massive body shrouded by some unfathomable heavy force.
