Under the overwhelming pressure, even the current strength of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon struggled to lift it, let alone carry it away.
This Star Core seemed eternally fixed here, at this spot, within this Void, rotating slowly at a predetermined speed, ceaselessly releasing scorching magma and energy.
So heavy!
No wonder this Star Core has remained here for so many years without being refined or devoured by that ancient Lava Giant.
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon took a deep breath, and its ferocious maw lined with giant fangs slowly opened, while in its stomach, a space capable of devouring and refining everything exploded with Space Power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1529 - 1529 575 I Am the Catastrophe the Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1529: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_5 Chapter 1529: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_5 “`
Boom!
Under the eruption of the Dark Realm’s Devouring Talent Ability, the space within a hundred-kilometer radius in front of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon vanished, as if erased by some terrifying power, forming an utterly black hollow.
The World Star Core also disappeared along with it.
And the moment the Doomsday Emperor Dragon devoured that expanse of space along with the World Star Core, an endless burst of scorching energy erupted from its stomach.
Boom!
Under the tsunami of energy, every cell in the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s body exuded greed, frantically devouring and absorbing those energies.
Crackle Crackle!! The muscles of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon swelled, its scale armor bulged out, and its bones grew at a visible speed.
But at the same time, a force like a black hole tearing space-time, accompanied by the refining of the Star Core, instantly enveloped the entire body of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
This gravitational pull was tens of thousands of times stronger than before. Even in its Doomsday form, the Emperor Dragon’s muscles were straining, tearing apart bit by bit.
Its bones emitted a fragile, squeaking noise, and the surface scales collapsed from time to time, forming pits tens or hundreds of meters in diameter, spewing even more vigorous Black Flames.
On the shattered land covered in Doomsday, the flesh of the split ancient Lava Giant Dragon writhed, reconnected, and the flesh where its nine necks had been obliterated and annihilated began to regenerate.
Soon, nine terrifying dragon heads had grown back.
Whew, Whew!! That was a close call.
The true body battered, its scale armor shattered, the ancient Lava Giant Dragon gasped heavily, and with a somewhat palpitating heart, its gaze turned to the depths of the Void, to the Red Beast enshrouded in Black Flames.
At this moment, any normal giant beast could tell there was something abnormal about the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, whose body was alternately swelling and collapsing.
However, the ancient Lava Giant Dragon had no intention of making a move, as all nine newly regrown heads were filled with reverence in their eyes.
In the short battle just now, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s overwhelming power had completely terrified the ancient Lava Giant Dragon. That despair was something it did not want to experience a second time.
Moreover, it had the premonition that if the other had truly wanted to kill it, it would have already fallen.
Roar!
Suddenly, the giant beast in the depths of the Void let out a roar that reached the heavens, and a more terrifying aura burst from its body, with black light emerging among the leaping golden-red flashes of lightning on its surface.
Those black bolts of lightning were incredibly terrifying, distorting everything, and even the faint light between heaven and earth was drawn towards it.
At this moment, the aura of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon became even more dreadful, as if some horrifying power inside it was awakening, and its body swelled rapidly at an even faster rate.
Thirty-six thousand kilometers, thirty-seven thousand kilometers…
And as the Doomsday Emperor Dragon devoured the World Star Core of the Chaotic Turbulent Region’s Great Era, growing rapidly, streams of pure and powerful Evolution Energy passed through the Soul Channel and appeared within Jack Clark’s body.
At the summit of a remote small mountain range, having devoured all cultivation resources and in closed-door cultivation for two days, Jack Clark suddenly exuded a grandiose and overbearing aura that pierced the Cloud Sky.
Boom! Heaven and Earth darkened, and the energy within a ten-thousand kilometer radius went berserk, swarming towards Jack Clark.
Because the energy gathering was so immense, it formed a funnel vortex with a diameter of a hundred kilometers in the Firmament, endlessly pouring into Jack Clark.
At this moment, Jack Clark was like a black hole devouring everything, his aura of just having made a breakthrough to the mid period of Heavenly King continued to surge, gradually approaching the late Period of Heavenly King.
Behind him, an illusion of a demon god, ten thousand meters tall and with eight arms on three sides, emerged, surrounded by golden flames and encircled by purple lightning.
The demon god held a War Halberd, and its six arms each clutched a Great Sun, Heavenly Gate, and Thunder Spear; beneath its feet lay a vast Plane filled with Black Wind and Blue Thunder.
Such a might instantly alarmed the Human Base three thousand kilometers away.
Even though they were thousands of kilometers apart when high-level cultivators like Damon Lopes and Gabriella looked up, they could vaguely make out the towering illusion with eight arms stepping on the plane.
The invisible pressure that permeated was comparable to a Demon God, with its presence filling Heaven and Earth, majestic and grandiose.
“Divine Martial Emperor has made another breakthrough!”
“Too strong, indeed he’s the greatest genius of our Human Race for all of time.”
“Hahaha… Previously, Divine Martial Emperor could slay three Demon Gods, and now his cultivation has improved again. Isn’t killing those Demon Gods like slaughtering chickens?”
“What, that figure is Divine Martial Emperor!?”
“Of course, the Demon God Form with three sides and eight arms is unique to the Divine Martial Emperor. I was fortunate to see it from afar during the previous Civilization Great War.”
Gazing at the towering figure touching the sky, millions of Human Race cultivators on the frontline all boiled with excitement.
Including those ‘newcomers’ supported by the Logistics City upon hearing that Jack Clark had made another breakthrough, their expressions were also excited and exhilarated.
As the backbone of the Human Race, the stronger Jack Clark’s strength was, the stronger the Human Race became. Under his protection, they also felt safer.
“Does his cultivation have no bottleneck?”
While countless people were cheering, Eddy Keller, dressed in white attire atop a towering building thousands of kilometers high, looked on with complex emotions, his shock mixed with envy and other sentiments.
As a High-level cultivator, Eddy Keller was well aware that the more advanced the cultivation, the slower the progress. For instance, he’d been stuck in the Ninth Heavens for a long time and had only reached the mid period of the Ninth Heavens.
Yet this monster, Jack Clark, since his breakthrough to Heavenly King, didn’t seem to slow down his cultivation speed. On the contrary, it appeared to be even faster.
And at this moment, it was not just Eddy Keller and those former geniuses who felt this way. The gaze of other king-level and Heavenly King Powerhouses standing high above was also complicated.
Amazement, envy, melancholy, and more emotions abounded.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1530: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_6 Chapter 1530: Chapter 575: I Am the Catastrophe, the Primordial Beast_6 As simple as drinking water, with his cultivation soaring rapidly, Jack Clark made these old fellows, who had been stuck in the King Realm for ten or even twenty or thirty years, feel as if they were practicing in vain.
Just then, an untimely voice rang out. Gentry Gail laughed carelessly, “Luckily, I made a breakthrough to Heavenly King with the help of this great war, otherwise I would definitely be frustrated and spitting blood this time.”
Not far away, Knife King Joel Moore, who was standing on the Void, said irritably, “Get lost. If it weren’t for Jack backing you up, would you have dared to unleash a limit burst without any restraint?”
Gentry Gail didn’t take it to heart and proudly said, “But it’s true that I made it to Heavenly King.”
“And it’s not just me. Eight-tails, no, it should be called Nine-tails now, also made a breakthrough with me to the Titan Level, hahaha…”
Watching Gentry Gail laughing carelessly there, the surrounding veteran Kings like Leo Hart took deep breaths to suppress the urge to beat him up.
How hateful this guy was, it was just a breakthrough to Heavenly King Realm.
Gradually, though, many people’s expressions became grave again as they looked at the Demon God Illusion in the sky, which had become much clearer, and the surging aura had started to slow down.
Gabriel spoke with a heavy tone, “It’s not enough. Those resources have only promoted his cultivation to the late stage of Heavenly King, advancing him only two steps further within that stage and still some distance from the peak of the Heavenly King.”
Purple Heaven Heavenly King shook his head and sighed, “This outcome was expected; there’s nothing we can do. Jack’s foundation is just too solid.”
“Just breaking through to the late stage of Heavenly King, the commotion is comparable to when the First Councilor made his breakthrough to Supreme. One can only imagine the depth of his foundation.”
“Under such circumstances, the resources required for rapid promotion of cultivation are naturally dozens or hundreds of times what we need.”
However, while saying this, these Heavenly King Powerhouses were still somewhat disappointed.
After all, almost all available resources had been mobilized this time to help Jack Clark make the breakthrough. If he could have pushed through to the peak of Heavenly King, his combat power would be no less than Adam Garcetti’s.
Then the time they could summon that Thunderflame Behemoth for would be even longer.
But what they didn’t know was that without the feedback from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, those resources would have been just enough for Jack to barely make it to the late stage of Heavenly King.
Underneath the Demon God Illusion surrounded by golden flames and Thunder, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, within which a world seemed to crumble, be destroyed, and then be reborn.
Jack remarked with a slight sense of emotion, “The closer I get to my limit, the harder it is to temper the True Body.”
The requirement for advancing from the late stage of Heavenly King to the peak was for the Law World within the body to nurture a nascent form of the Rule, drawing the power of the Rule to continually temper the True Body and the Divine Soul.
Because the True Body and Divine Soul of Heavenly Kings are too weak to withstand the power of the Rule.
During this tempering process, the cultivator’s True Body will transition from ethereal to substantial (from the Rule True Body to a stronger rule body), and both their flesh and blood genes and Soul Will will be branded by the power of Rule.
Given Jack’s True Body, far stronger than those of his peers, the quantity of Rule power needed for his tempering was naturally much greater.
This was in addition to the nascent Rule of Supreme power nurtured by the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, and also a nascent Rule with the notion of Primordial Genesis from the Soul Emperor Seal world.
Given the current progress, Jack felt that under normal conditions, it would take him another half a month to break through to the peak of Heavenly King.
Moreover, during this expansion, the diameter of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder world had already reached more than eight thousand kilometers, and there was still a part of the world’s energy unabsorbed.
Expected to be fully ‘digested’, it could reach more than nine thousand kilometers, just short of the ten thousand kilometer limit to contain a complete Rule.
“Half a month, I should still make it in time,” Jack murmured.
According to the current situation, a major battle between the Human Race and the Purgatory True Demon within a short term, meaning within a Sun Wheel, was unlikely to break out.
Especially since four Demon Gods had fallen on the side of the Purgatory Empire this time.
Given the strength the Human Race has currently exhibited, under conditions of uncertainty, deities such as Diorus would definitely not dare to rashly provoke a war.
But at the same time, it also suggests that the next great war will be even more brutal, and even that Ancestor might awaken.
Just as Jack Clark stood under the shadow of the Demon God Illusion, contemplatively pondering the situation, the space in front of him distorted, and the figure of Adam Garcetti appeared silently.
“Senior Adam,” Jack looked up, somewhat surprised at the middle-aged man with half black and half white hair.
Adam’s voice was gentle, “Jack, how does it feel to have made your breakthrough?”
Jack thought for a moment, “It feels good, but the overall increase in strength isn’t that significant.”
His realm had long been comparable to the peak of Heavenly King, having nurtured a nascent rule, so the process from the early to late stage of Heavenly King was only about the transformation and tempering of his True Body and Divine Soul.
After reaching the late period of Heavenly King, his comprehensive strength increased somewhat, but the overall increase was not very significant.
“I feel the same way.”
Adam slowly nodded, “In your current state, your strength will only see a substantial increase once you reach the peak of Heavenly King and then breakthrough to Supreme.”
“But your foundation is too deep, and you essentially already compare to an Ancient Middle Stage Demon God; if you want to quickly improve your cultivation…”
Adam paused there.
Looking at the young man with black hair, whose radiance made him look like an ancient deity descending, a trace of resignation slowly emerged in Adam’s eyes, as if he was giving up on something important.
“I have a way to rapidly advance your cultivation to the peak of Heavenly King, or even further.”
Looking at Adam who suddenly spoke, Jack paused, somewhat surprised, “Senior, you have Primordial-level resources in your possession!?”
With his current cultivation, only Divine Objects that were at the Rule Level or had reached the Primordial Level could propel his cultivation to leap to the peak of Heavenly King.
And it had to be of the cultivation type, not the material type.
All they could see was Adam stretching out his hand and slightly waving it, instantly a circle of gray-green life and death Rule light spread, enveloping an area of tens of kilometers.
After shielding the surroundings to ensure no ‘Person’ could overhear, Adam slowly nodded, “Correct, I have Primordial Level resources in my possession, a wisp of Primordial Origin.”
“A wisp of Primordial Origin!” Even Jack couldn’t help but be somewhat shocked at this moment.
He couldn’t understand how Adam had Primordial Origin in his hands, and why hadn’t he used that Origin himself?
If Adam had chosen to refine that Origin, with his talent, he might have already broken through to the ancient late stage or even reached the peak, his strength comparable to great beings like Tyris.
Looking at the somewhat shocked Jack, Adam slightly smiled bitterly, “It’s a wisp, not an entirety.”
“If it were an entire Primordial Origin, I would have already refined it to break through my cultivation, there would have been no need to wait till now, struggling to contend with Diorus and the other Purgatory Demon Gods.”
“I was originally planning to keep that wisp of Primordial Origin, waiting until my cultivation reached the Peak of the Ancient, and then to break through to the Emperor Realm using that Origin all at once.”
“But with the current situation, there is no need to hold on to it anymore.”
“Compared to me, your talent is higher, and using that wisp of Primordial Origin to break through the peak of Heavenly King, or even to Supreme, sooner would be of greater help to the Human Federation.”
“As for the source of that wisp of Origin, it’s quite simple, it comes from a forbidden area where our Human Race resides.”
“It was once the place where a Primordial Beast fell.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1531 - 1531 576
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1531: Chapter 576 Chapter 1531: Chapter 576 Chapter 576: Return to Blue Star, Final Darkness Devouring
Fifty years ago, when Heaven and Earth mutated, Adam Garcetti was among the first batch of Innate Awakened Ones, with formidable strength.
Also, because of his distinguished origins, he was directly appointed as the person in charge of the Transcendental Special Duties Department of the Eastern Summer Empire, responsible for subjugating those awakened ones with extraordinary abilities among the populace.
Afterward, when the relics of the Void Continent made their appearance, he was among the first to enter and obtained the Void Inheritance, second only to the Emperor Inheritance.
Upon exiting, he quickly made a breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, holding the Ancient Divine Weapon, the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel, and suppressed the era with absolute power to establish the Human Federation, ending the Dark Age.
He was also the first person to lead an exploration into the mythical world.
Back then, the entrances of the three world passageways were not as safe as they are now, filled with Giant Beasts, dangerous environments, and some low-level different races that live off blood and raw flesh.
It was also due to exploring the relics of the mythical world that Adam Garcetti’s strength leaped forward again, swiftly breaking through to become Heavenly King, and then the first Supreme Expert of the Human Race.
Clearly, Adam Garcetti was the Child of Destiny of Blue Star, or rather, the first great fortune-bearer of Blue Star’s first generation.
Jack Clark could not help feeling emotional as brief information about Adam Garcetti surfaced in his mind, and he was also somewhat surprised that the forbidden area where the Human Race resided once saw the fall of a Primordial Beast.
But on second thought, it seemed indeed plausible.
The entire territory of the Human Race is enveloped by terrifying forbidden areas, many of which are so dangerous that not even Demon God Level beings dare to easily set foot in.
The few tens of thousands of kilometers actually controlled by the Human Race, and the more than two million kilometers currently occupied, are just a part of this forbidden area.
That Primordial Beast had fallen who knows how many years ago, and its ‘world’, as the True Body of a Primordial Beast, had long since dispersed and merged into the mythical world.
The trace of Primordial Origin that Adam Garcetti acquired was the only proof of that Primordial Beast’s existence.
Or rather, what Adam Garcetti obtained back then was more than just a trace; otherwise, it couldn’t explain the gap in strength between him, the Primordial True King, and the Sky-based God King compared to cultivators of the same generation.
Three Supreme Realm experts all reached the Ancient Middle Stage, but below these three, the current closest to the Supreme, True Martial Heavenly King, is still at the peak of Heavenly King.
Not to mention the other king-level individuals and Heavenly Kings.
Base.
At the canteen for High-level cultivators, after Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis finished ordering their food, they sat at the table waiting for it to be served. Meanwhile, not far away, Jack Clark and Justin Welan walked over.
“It’s the Divine Martial Emperor.”
“Why is the Divine Martial Emperor here?”
Jack Clark’s appearance caused a stir in the restaurant, with all cultivators looking excitedly at the black-haired, shoulder-length youth whose demeanor was supremely dignified.
At Jack Clark’s level and status, no one cared anymore about his tall and straight stature or his almost perfectly handsome features.
Even the Lewis sisters were somewhat surprised by Jack Clark’s appearance.
Under everyone’s gaze, Jack Clark came in front of where Crystal Lewis and her sister were sitting, causing both girls to become somewhat tongue-tied, “Jack… Divine Martial…”
Just as the two girls were nervous and subconsciously wanted to address him with the honorific “Divine Martial Emperor,” Jack Clark smiled slightly, “Class Leader, Mandy Lewis, no need to be so formal. Just call me Jack Clark.”
Justin Welan beside him also smiled, “Haha… Class Leader, aren’t you exaggerating? Jack won’t mind these things.”
“But I didn’t expect that you, who’s always so overbearing, Class Leader, would also have a moment of constraint. You couldn’t even speak clearly just now,” said Justin Welan as he laughed even more cheerfully.
He remembered when he first entered the Martial Arts School, he was taught a lesson by Crystal Lewis several times for ‘talking behind her back’ due to her cold and overbearing character.
Mandy Lewis shook her head and said softly, “We are not afraid; it’s just that Jack’s presence is too overwhelming. Even when he conceals his aura, it instinctively commands awe.”
Jack Clark laughed and demurred, “Mandy Lewis is being too extravagant with her praise. What overwhelming presence? It’s just a psychological effect, that’s all.”
Of course, this was just a polite statement. As an innate god-demon whose strength was comparable to that of Supreme Experts, Jack Clark’s level of life had long transcended that of myriad living beings.
Therefore, even if he held his aura back, the invisible suppression of his life’s hierarchy would still create a pervasive pressure in his surroundings.
Jack Clark and Justin Welan then sat opposite the Lewis sisters and directly stated their purpose, “Class Leader, Mandy Lewis, my reason for coming is to ask if you want to return to Blue Star.”
“Return to Blue Star?” The Lewis sisters were taken aback.
Jack Clark nodded, “Yes, there won’t be any major wars happening here in the short term, so I’m planning to return for a visit.”
“Currently, the Blue Star World is hosting the Global Martial Arts Competition, and all younger generation of cultivators can participate. The top ten contestants globally will each receive a reward.”
“This reward, as far as I know, is special resources that can allow High-level cultivators to upgrade an entire Major Realm.”
“For example, if you, Class Leader, and Mr. Willard can make it to the top ten globally, you could directly break through from the mid-stage of the seventh realm to the Mid-eighth level.”
Following nearly ten consecutive days of battle, as well as the painstaking cultivation and resource allocation after the victory, the strength of Crystal Lewis and her companions had advanced.
And upon hearing that the competition in Blue Star World actually offered resources to directly elevate one’s Major Realm, both sisters’ eyes lit up.
Then Jack Clark continued, “And it’s not just the final match rewards. In the national level competitions, it is said that the rewards for the top ten include resources to enhance one’s cultivation level and break through bottlenecks.”
“Although it can only elevate cultivators below the Eight Layer Heaven by one minor realm, or help those in the Late Sixth Heavenly Stage break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, it’s perfectly suitable for you two.”
“If you both can make it into the top ten nationally, and then into the global top ten, with your talents and inheritance, you will soon become Ninth Heaven Experts.”

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1532: Chapter 576 Chapter 1532: Chapter 576 Just as Jack Clark finished speaking, Justin Welan chuckled and said, “Class Leader, I’ve already decided to go back with Jack. This time, my goal is to be the global champion.”
Crystal Lewis’s eyebrows shot up, “Justin Welan, are you sure you can take first place?”
“Of course, I’ve calculated it carefully.”
Justin Welan said proudly, “Currently, in the three grades of the Martial Arts Schools from the three major empires, among the younger generation, there are only a few who are stronger than us.”
“There’s Damon Lopes, who is also a senior and entered the mythical world same as us, as well as Carol Koch, and Gabriella who pilots Mechas.”
“But Damon Lopes and Gabriella both have already made a breakthrough to the Nine Layers. The former is even about to step into the Legendary Realm and definitely won’t be returning.”
“As for Carol Koch, thanks to Jack’s previous help, I’ve left her behind by a small cultivation realm, so she’s not a concern.”
“Therefore, as long as I go back, the global championship title is mine for the taking.”
Justin Welan had some impression of those monster geniuses from the Federation’s younger generation who had entered the Void Continent half a year ago.
Back then, people like Jack Clark, Damon Lopes, Eddy Keller, and Balderas took the lead with their cultivation realms reaching the Seventh Layer.
But the latter had already graduated, becoming top strong men.
As for Jack Clark, he had ascended and would not participate in a kids’ cup competition.
Thinking of this made Justin Welan somewhat excited, “Jack is the first genius of the Human Race in the eternal existence, and me being his brother, getting the title of the number one young person globally doesn’t seem excessive, does it?”
At this moment, Crystal Lewis spoke slowly, “Whether it’s excessive or not, but Justin Welan, it seems you have forgotten about us.”
Mandy Lewis nodded with interest, “Indeed, we’re also a bit interested in that title of number one young individual of the generation.”
Suddenly, Justin Welan’s smile stiffened, and he thought to himself that it was over; he almost forgot about them. If he had known, he wouldn’t have let Jack come to them.
With the same cultivation realm, the Lewis sisters who obtained the inheritance of the Empress of Mysterious Flame were actually very strong, only overshadowed by the radiance of Jack Clark, which is why no one noticed.
While the four were talking, an invisible power spread around them, shielding their conversation, yet it still couldn’t block the curious gazes of the other people in the restaurant.
“Who are those three? They seem to know the Divine Martial Emperor,” someone said enviously.
“From how they talk, they seem to be very close friends,” another person commented.
“They look very young to be here on the Frontline Battlefield at this time. They must be at least high-order in strength, it seems they are also the geniuses of the younger generation.”
At that moment, in a corner of the restaurant, a rough-looking young man exclaimed, “Actually, those three are classmates with the Emperor.”
“What?”
“Classmates!”
Hiss! A collective gasp rang out around them, and when looked back at Justin Welan and the others, their eyes were filled with surprise, shock, and even more envy.
What was shocking was that they were only seventeen years old, and their cultivation had reached the high-order realm. What was enviable was the relationship they had with the Divine Martial Emperor.
Being classmates…
With this relationship, as long as the Divine Martial Emperor exists eternally, not only they but also their descendants would benefit in some way.
Jack Clark naturally heard the low voices around him, but he didn’t care about the exposure of Justin Welan and the others’ ‘identities’.
He had a personal reason for ‘calling’ the three of them back. The next great war would be even more brutal and extremely dangerous, so he wanted to find a reason to take the three of them back, to avoid the coming decisive battle.
The Lewis sisters and others, unlike Damon Lopes and Eddy Keller, had not yet grown strong; their Seventh Layer cultivation was still a bit weak.
Just as Jack Clark was preparing to take Crystal Lewis and the others back to Blue Star World, in the Purgatory Empire, within a castle swirling with Dark Demon Air, two Demon Kings sat facing each other.
One of them, Gulden, with Horns-Split and fresh breakthrough into the demon king realm, said excitedly, “Brooks, I made a significant discovery while sorting through old materials from the Assassination Department.”
“And it has something to do with that terrifying Darren Callum of the Human Race.”
Brooks’s gaze sharpened, “Related to Darren Callum, the Human Race? What discovery?”
The Horned-Split Demon King said excitedly, “Half a Sun Wheel ago, True Demon Perdo, who is in charge of the Human Race affairs on Blue Star, sent back a message with news of Darren Callum’s kin.”
“But before it could upload the message, its superior, who was in charge, fell in the last great battle, and the message was lost there.”
“After I found this message, I took some time to verify the Demon Pattern Bands and reestablished contact with Perdo, who was in hiding behind the Human Race’s Outer Development Department.”
“According to it, it had always been in contact with cultists of the Evil God Sect who were hiding within the Inner World of Blue Star.”
“Although the contact has been intermittent during this time, it has still obtained some useful information, including details about Callum’s kins that they hold dear.”
“You wouldn’t guess, but Darren Callum’s mother turned out to be an ordinary human, weaker than even a juvenile Demon Bug with a single Demon Mark.”
“Besides, he also has a brother named Glenn Clark, who is only at the level of Five Demonic Marks, currently competing in something called the Martial Arts Tournament.”
“It’s hard to imagine that with a mother who is just an ordinary human and a brother whose power is equivalent to Five Demonic Marks, Darren Callum himself could be so terrifyingly powerful,” the Horned-Split Demon King marveled.
“Brooks, do you think we should immediately report this information to them, or should we secretly try to infiltrate the Blue Star World and assassinate Darren Callum’s relatives?” As he spoke, excitement flickered in the eyes of the Horned-Split Demon King.
If he could stealthily kill the relatives of Darren Callum, he would become renowned in a single battle and emerge as the most dazzling demon king among the Purgatory Demon Race.

﻿Chapter 1534: Chapter 577: Hibernation Breakthrough, Chapter 1534: Chapter 577: Hibernation Breakthrough, “`
Watching the twelve thousand-kilometer-long figure before him, resembling a searing, congealed nine-headed giant dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a world-shaking, deep roar.
“Welcome to the Dragon Palace Empire, from now on, you are the fourteenth Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, King of Lava Hell.”
Despite being swiftly suppressed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, this ancient lava giant dragon possessed terrifying strength as it was an entity from the ancient late stage that had refined an entire Magma World.
Its nine dragon heads held nine talents, one of which affected the perception of consciousness and even gave the Emperor Dragon in its Crimson Form the illusion of time coming to a standstill.
Therefore, the Destruction Emperor Dragon directly entered its Doomsday Form to overpower and beat it with absolute strength.
Otherwise, relying solely on the strength of the Crimson Form at the extreme boundaries of the ancient realm, even if it could suppress the lava giant dragon, it would have taken a while and consumed a bit of time.
The Black Gold Giant Beast roared lowly, “Let’s go, Disaster Tyria; follow behind me from now on, and together we will conquer the remaining areas of the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
According to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s estimation, they should have already swept through a large area of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, with only about two million kilometers left to fully level it.
The nine dragon heads of the ancient lava giant dragon roared, as flames ignited on its body again: “Roar! From now on, let me become your claw, my King, clearing all obstacles ahead.”
“Under the great leadership of you, my King, the prestige of the empire shall echo throughout the Vast World, making billions of living beings tremble.”
“And your glory shall shine through the ages, an eternal existence.”
Looking at the nine heads that were full of fervor, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was noncommittal, “Spare me the flattery; it sounds empty and false.”
“Roar! Yes, Great King of Thunderflame.”
That said, although this fellow’s flattery was a bit stiff, it was far better than those like the Blue Giant Crab who only knew how to yell about being ‘awesome’ and ‘incredible.’
However, before departing, the ancient lava giant dragon needed to first ‘Devour’ the Magma World.
In the turbulence of the ripped world’s pathway, the eleven thousand kilometers long Black Gold Giant Beast slowly emerged, its heavy footsteps shattering the Earth and rocking Heaven and Earth.
And in the instant that the Destruction Emperor Dragon emerged, a heavy gravitational force spread out, covering hundreds of kilometers. Countless fragments of rock suspended in orbit around him as the center.
Within this range, the rules of Heaven and Earth collapsed, gravity vanished, and the scene was shocking, even as the Destruction Emperor Dragon consciously restrained its power.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you are too powerful, especially when you tore apart that grand True Body, even the Great Sethia shivered all over.”
“Too bloody, too violent, roar roar!!” Amidst roars, the Silver Giant Dragon shattered floating meteors, circling around the Destruction Emperor Dragon and letting out high and excited Dragon Roars.
As opposed to the excited Silver Giant Dragon, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon was much more graceful, standing there quietly, watching the imposing Black Gold Giant Dragon before it with a somewhat fiery gaze.
The eleven thousand-kilometer-long Destruction Emperor Dragon, when standing on its four claws, reached nearly four thousand meters in shoulder height, and its tail, over five thousand meters long, spanned the Void like a ferocious mountain range.
In front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon at this time, the one thousand four hundred meters long Gold-Blue Giant Dragon and Silver Giant Dragon, standing at a shoulder height of over six hundred meters, were akin to a small child.
Boom!
At that moment, the Magma World, half enmeshed in the depths of the Void, shook; the previous extinguished Black Volcanic Rock crumbled, and endless magma erupted from the belly of the Earth.
In just the blink of an eye, the entire world was again overrun with flames and magma; endless flames gathered between heaven and earth, forming an immense, boundless, nine-headed giant dragon.
Roar roar roar!!
With each roar and Dragon Roar by the ancient lava giant dragon, the whole world violently shook. It gradually became illusory under the heaven-reaching, earth-piercing chains of fire rule.
When the Magma World disappeared, the massive silhouette of the nine-headed giant dragon emerged in the raging Void.
Suddenly, a fearsome pressure from the ancient late stage spread out, making the Silver and Gold-Blue Giant Dragons sink in their forms, ready to erupt with internal power in resistance.
But at that moment, an invisible force of rule expanded, blocking the scorching pressure that filled heaven and earth.
The robust Dragon Claw of the ancient lava giant dragon took a step, with molten, golden magma flowing and melting everything, forming a fiery pathway in the Void.
No sooner had the ancient lava giant dragon stepped forward than its massive body cast a vast ‘shadow,’ as the nine flame-ignited dragon heads turned towards the Silver Giant Dragon.
“Roar! Insignificant dragon-type giant beasts, before you stands the fourteenth Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire, the great Disaster Tyria. Bow down and pay homage.”
In front of the ancient late stage lava giant dragon, the two peak mythical realm dragons were as insignificant as infants.
In the world of giant beasts, strength is always the supreme law, so it barely gave them a second thought.
However, due to the tone of ‘conversation’ from the Silver Giant Dragon earlier and the way it seemed very ‘familiar’ with the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the ancient lava giant dragon took the initiative to introduce itself.
And from the perspective of the lava giant dragon, its own act of introducing its identity and status, allowing the other to pay homage, was already giving them a lot of face.
But to the lava giant dragon’s surprise, just as it finished speaking, that smaller Silver Giant Dragon raised its head and roared.
“Roar! Before you is the first Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire, also the Big Dragon King, the King of Storm and Frost, Sethia.”
… The nine dragon heads of the lava giant dragon all paused, wondering if they had heard wrong.
At this moment, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon also came forward, uttering a soft growl: “And me, the seventh Dragon King of the Dragon Palace Empire, the King of Ice Crystal Elements, Telsafi.”

﻿Chapter 1535: Chapter 577 Hibernation Breakthrough, _2 Chapter 1535: Chapter 577 Hibernation Breakthrough, _2 Roar! It indeed hadn’t misunderstood, these two Mythical-level weak Giant Dragons were actually Dragon Kings of the Dragon Palace Empire.
Especially that Silver Giant Dragon, who even held the title of Big Dragon King, a position even loftier than the King of Thunderflame — how was this possible? What was the situation??
At this moment, the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon was utterly disconcerted, with all nine dragon heads agape, eyes filled with disbelief.
Witnessing the petrified state of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon revealed a hint of amusement in their eyes, knowing well that this Ancient Giant Dragon would be shocked upon hearing their Titles.
At that point, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, “Scythia is the pioneer of the empire; it was at level eight, while I was at Level 7 when we joined forces to establish the Dragon Palace together.”
“Therefore, its title as Big Dragon King is unshakable.”
“Moreover, besides Scythia, among the fourteen esteemed Dragon Kings of the empire, several are only of Mythical-level; they are among the original elders of the empire who have made outstanding contributions.”
“Within the empire, Dragon King is a symbol of status, not merely a representation of strength; besides Disaster Tyria and myself, there are four other Ancient-level Giant Beasts among the Dragon Kings.”
“The empire’s structure is centered around the Dragon King Hall; every Dragon King has the right to discuss matters and participate in the decisions regarding all affairs of the empire.”
“Apart from being the King of Thunderflame Dragon King of the empire, I also serve as the first Lord of the Dragon King Hall, possessing the decisive and veto power over all matters of the empire.”
Considering the complexity of the Dragon Palace’s structure for Giant Beasts, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had to explain it once to this newly joined Dragon King of the empire.
Awareness dawned upon the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon, “Roar! I thought so. With your strength, what beast could possibly outrank you within the empire?”
At the same time, it began to grasp a rough understanding of the situation within the Dragon Palace Empire and its own position.
In addition to it and the King of Thunderflame, there were six Ancient Level Giant Beasts among the fourteen Dragon Kings; below them were some Titan Level Dragon Kings and Mythical Level Dragon Kings.
While the Silver Giant Dragon’s title of Big Dragon King was merely honorary, the actual control of the empire rested with the King of Thunderflame, followed by these Ancient Dragon Kings, and then the ordinary Dragon Kings.
Also, this titleholder named Scythia seemed a bit lacking in talent.
At the time of the establishment of the Dragon Palace Empire with the King of Thunderflame, one was Level 8, and the other was Level 7, with Scythia having a Growth Level one rank higher than the King of Thunderflame.
And now, while the Great King of Thunderflame had become an Ancient Middle Stage Beast, this one was merely at the Mythical Peak.
So disappointing. The Ancient Lava Giant Dragon shook its heads subtly, its nine dragon heads looking at the Silver Giant Dragon with a faint sense of sentiment.
The Silver Giant Dragon instantly became furious, releasing a breath of icy aura from its nostrils.
“Roar! Despicable creature, Disaster Tyria, what sort of look is that? Are you thinking that the Great Scythia is too weak, now only at the Legendary Realm?”
The Ancient Lava Giant Dragon was startled; this Silver Giant Dragon had such sharp perception it guessed the thoughts of the Great Disaster Tyria.
Suppressing its surprise, the Lava Giant Dragon’s nine heads shook in unison to deny it.
“Roar! How could that be possible, Scythia? To become a Big Dragon King of the empire, your talent must naturally be strong; otherwise, the Great King of Thunderflame would not have allied with you back then.”
The Silver Giant Dragon snorted, its naive clear eyes revealing a wise glow, “Don’t try to deceive me. The Great Scythia has seen that kind of look from Telsafi many times.”
“And what about ‘back then’? It’s only been eight Sun Wheels since Tim Abott and I established the Dragon Palace.”
“Eight Sun Wheels, and the Great Scythia has grown from a Level 8 Beast to the peak of the Legendary Realm; this speed is already quite astonishing.”
“Roar! Eight Sun Wheels, how is that possible!!”
The shocked roar of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon reverberated; its nine pairs of eyes widened, almost jumping out of their sockets from the shock.
Eight Sun Wheels, from a Transcendent Giant Beast to the Ancient Middle Stage — is this not some kind of joke? Or perhaps the decision has been made that the Great Disaster Tyria is easy to fool?
“Roar! Don’t look so astonished; it makes you seem inexperienced. Also, do you still think the Great Scythia lacks talent?”
The constant astonishment of this terrifying Ancient Late Stage Beast pleased the Silver Giant Dragon.
That’ll teach you for daring to look down on the Great Scythia.
Just as the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon was too stunned to know what to say, the Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, “Disaster Tyria, there’s no need to be so astounded; I just happen to grow at a faster rate, that’s all.”
…Is it just a faster growth rate? Watching the Black Gold Giant Dragon with an air of nonchalance, the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon couldn’t help but scoff internally.
For its part, evolving from a Transcendence Realm Flame Giant Dragon to the current Ancient Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon Realm had taken how much time?
Over five thousand years, or was it more than eight thousand years?
Since it had spent most of its time in hibernation, the Lava Giant Dragon was also unclear about how many years it had been cultivating; anyway, it only knew it was a very long time.
That was also why it was shocked and incredulous.
Compared to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which had grown to Ancient-level in just a few Sun Wheels, its own prideful talent suddenly seemed lacking by the farthest reaches of sky and earth.
But after the shock subsided, the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon’s eyes glowed with fervor, revealing a look of deep veneration.
“Roar! Worthy of being the great and supreme Master of Thunderflame, my admiration for you burns hotter than the Tsunami of magma seas.”
“Under your valiant leadership, the Dragon Palace Empire will surely hang high above the Firmament, becoming the Eternity shining Great Sun amongst the stars, illuminating the whole world.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1536 - 1536 577 Hibernation Breakthrough _3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1536: Chapter 577 Hibernation Breakthrough, _3 Chapter 1536: Chapter 577 Hibernation Breakthrough, _3 “To become the Imperial Dragon King has been the greatest honor of my life, please allow me to…”
Looking at the Lava Giant Dragon, which showed no sign of stopping its ceaseless chatter, the Destruction Emperor Dragon interrupted with a headache, “Enough already, stop sucking up and go take care of business.”
The Ancient Lava Giant Dragon stood erect, its nine dragon heads held high, “Yes, my revered and great Master of Thunderflame, your command is the beacon in my heart, guiding the way forward.”
This scene left both the Silver Giant Dragon and the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon somewhat baffled.
They had never seen an Ancient Beast act so ‘subservient’ and so adept at flattery—you are a ruler who dominated an entire world, after all.
An Ancient late-stage dragon’s presence in the vast world was an undeniably formidable existence.
Think about the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon’s mother, at the realm of Titan in the late period, and even the Silver Giant Dragon’s mother who had been at Titan Peak, ruling over a territory spanning two to three hundred thousand kilometers.
In that domain, they were the supreme Dragon Gods, majestic and overbearing.
Forget it, incomprehensible. The two dragons shook their heads.
At that moment the Silver Giant Dragon let out a low growl: “Roar! Tim Abott, the great Scythia wants to sleep.”
“I feel so sleepy as well,” the Golden-Blue Giant Dragon growled in agreement.
As they spoke, an irresistible aura of breakthrough enveloped them, drawing wild Heavenly Energy from their surroundings, with black storms howling and Ice Crystals spreading.
Having reached the Mythical Peak for so long, the two dragons were finally ready to make their breakthrough.
But clearly, this was not a place for hibernation, so the two dragons, under the astonished gaze of the Ancient Lava Giant Beast, flew onto the broad back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Separated by three rows of mountainous Dorsal Fins, they each found a comfortable spot near the wings and soon closed their eyes, falling asleep.
Huu huu!! The Silver Giant Dragon’s body exuded a thick, white coldness that quickly transformed into a huge dragon-shaped Ice sculpture.
The Golden-Blue Giant Dragon, on the other hand, radiated a Seven-Colored Glow, gradually forming a colorful amber jewel, pregnant with an astonishing energy fluctuation.
The size of the two dragons had no effect on the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
After waiting a moment for the dragons’ bloodlines to begin their transformation and enter deep sleep, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low growl: “Let’s go, Disaster Tyria.”
With that, its massive body thunderously soared into the sky, heading deeper into the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Wherever the colossal form passed, everything shattered, and all was distorted, forming a gravitational collapse zone hundreds of kilometers in diameter—a terrifying spectacle.
Following behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon cast its eyes upon the two slumbering dragons, and soon its expression cleared in realization.
It had almost forgotten those two dragons were mothers.
No wonder the Great Master of Thunderflame let them lie on its back.
Feeling like it had discovered a blindspot, the Lava Giant Dragon was excited but also warned itself to be kinder to the two seemingly fragile dragons in the future.
While the Lava Giant Dragon was lost in ‘wishful thinking’, the two Ancient Beasts had already flown tens of thousands of kilometers, one leading and one following.
As they passed, their terrifying aura swept through Heaven and Earth, unrestrainedly radiating deterrence to countless lives—ordinary forbidden areas were either bypassed or destroyed outright.
When the two beasts had flown more than eight hundred thousand kilometers, an Ice-encrusted Forbidden Zone appeared before them.
Here, a gloomy blue coldness filled the space between heaven and earth, nearly freezing the space solid, leaving ordinary Mythical Giant Beasts to fall and shatter upon arrival.
Deep within this range of Icebound Mountain Range, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, a subtle ancient aura flashed by fleetingly.
Without waiting for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to speak, the following Ancient Lava Giant Beast roared furiously.
“Roar! You audacious unknown behemoth, how dare you not show yourself at the arrival of the great King of Thunderflame, and the illustrious lord Disaster Tyria.”
“Your concealment is an insult to the grandeur of the King of Thunderflame and me, a challenge to our dominion.”
With that, the Ancient Lava Giant Beast looked towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon: “Great king, please allow me to punish this ancient beast harshly and make it kneel before you to admit its wrongdoing.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon paused for a moment, then let out a deep growl: “…Go ahead, if this beast refuses to submit, bring me its corpse.”
“Yes, great king.”
Given the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s blessing, the Ancient Lava Giant Beast roared excitedly, its wings dripping with golden magma flaring, transforming into a dazzling firelight that shot into the sky.
“Roar! Face the fury of the mighty lord Disaster Tyria, you despicable lowly beast.”
The nine dragon heads roared unreservedly, causing the entire Ice-encrusted Forbidden Zone to tremble under the terrifying sound waves, their formidable presence echoing endlessly.
Boom!
Above the Ancient Lava Giant Beast, a Magma World ablaze with flames emerged, forcibly descending and colliding with the space of the mythical world, resulting in a horrific vibration.
As the Magma World impacted, the dim Firmament shattered thunderously, and huge Black Cracks appeared, followed by boundless Scorching Magma.
Boom boom boom!!
In that moment, the sky was flooded with pouring magma like a galaxy, with Mountains and Seas shaking eruptions descending from above, engulfing the entire Icebound Mountain Range in a earth-shattering roar.
The scorching lava collided with the Ice Crystals that had been frozen for ten thousand years, causing intense explosions as the extreme heat and extreme cold clashed.
In addition, red Rule Chains shuttled through Heaven and Earth, sealing all directions and enveloping an area of tens of thousands of kilometers, preventing the beast from escaping.
In the blink of an eye, the whole world turned into a sea of fire, Heaven and Earth were dramatically transformed—such was the power of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon, changing the world with a simple gesture.

﻿Chapter 1537: Chapter 577: Breakthrough in Hibernation, _4 Chapter 1537: Chapter 577: Breakthrough in Hibernation, _4 If such a scene were to occur on Blue Star, the entire world would instantly turn into a lava hell, eradicating all life.
This is why the Destruction Emperor Dragon named it the King of Disasters, for a nine-headed giant dragon that masters the rules of both flames and magma is essentially a cataclysm.
Roar!
From beneath the ice layer engulfed by magma, a deep and prolonged roar echoed.
Boom!
Amidst the scorching magma sea, ice mountains rose, their invisible gloomy blue extreme cold power colliding with the magma, emitting thunderous and violent explosions.
Simultaneously, a beast over five thousand meters long, covered with several hundred meters of thick white ice crystals, emerged, radiating faint ripples of rule power.
This was a Titan Peak, half-step into the Ancient Realm, a colossal beast resembling a white tiger with ice crystal wings, its appearance ferocious.
Roar!
Gazing at the nine-headed lava giant dragon above the firmament exuding terrifying pressure, the Ice Tiger Beast let out a savage roar, its icy, ferocious gaze emanating from its crystal-like white eyes.
At the same time, the rule power entwining its body surged, resonating with a certain power between heaven and earth, instantly shaking the entire world.
Boom!!
Beneath the feet of the Ice Tiger Beast, the ground collapsed, forming a hollow a thousand kilometers in diameter, with endless torrents of gloomy blue chill erupting like the tide, instantly freezing the boiling magma below.
Even the surrounding space-time came to a standstill under that terrifying chill, forming an absolute zero domain.
Standing amidst the rolling gloomy blue chill, the Ice Tiger Beast’s aura surged like a true Ancient Beast, with a vague shadow of a Frozen World emerging behind it.
Above the firmament, the nine dragon heads of the lava giant beast revealed intense killing intent, “Roar! Seeing the great King of Disasters, you do not bow in submission but dare to provoke, seeking death.”
This was its first battle since joining Dragon Palace, actually being provoked by a half-step into the Ancient Realm beast before the King of Thunderflame.
Unforgivable, it must be torn apart.
Roar! The earth-shaking roar turned the nine-headed dragon into a beam of light that plunged into the Magma World. In an instant, heaven and earth trembled, a vast and boundless lava giant dragon emerged.
The sky-covering dragon head of the lava giant dragon slowly lowered, mouth gaping, collecting golden light within, emitting an energy fluctuation capable of destroying heaven and earth.
Boom!
In an instant, a golden magma fire pillar three thousand kilometers in diameter erupted from the mouth of the immense lava dragon head, like a divine punishment light column capable of destroying heaven and earth.
Under the might of this powerful strike, the void collapsed extensively, shaking the cosmos.
The energy gathered was so terrifying that gold and red order chains formed around the magma fire pillar, creating a vision of collapsing worlds.
Roar!
Facing that heaven-destroying strike, the Ice Tiger Beast let out a furious roar, unleashing all the rule power within its body, drawing upon the unknown powerful force beneath it.
Instantly, glowing gloomy blue radiance flourished, and the almost liquefied gloomy blue power erupted within that frozen hollow, like the Rule Origin of Ice freezing space-time.
Under such fearsome power, thousands of kilometers of the world solidified, forming layers upon layers of gloomy blue ice, resembling a four-winged white tiger roaring skywards.
At that moment, the golden magma fire pillar struck the gloomy blue ice layer, instantly illuminating the world with blinding radiance, like the explosion of a star.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Under the inexhaustible onslaught of the golden magma fire pillar, the crystal layers shattered, penetrating heaven and earth with unstoppable force, engulfing the deep Ice Tiger Beast.
Roar! Suddenly, a scream echoed from the midst of the lava fire pillar.
This Ice Tiger Beast had refined some ancient force beneath the Earth and thought itself on par with Ancient Beasts, believing it could defy the majesty of the Lava Giant Dragon and compete against it.
But it had no idea how vast the gap was between the early ancient stage and the peak of ancient power.
Especially under the fury of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon, directly invoking the World’s Power of the Lava World, the strength of the strike unfolded from the Rule Origin was profound.
Boom!
Magma Fire Pillars pierced through the Ice Layer, engulfing the Ice Tiger Beast before continuing unabated into the depths of the Earth, striking that ancient force beneath thousands of kilometers.
In an instant, the sky crumbled, and the land shattered within tens of thousands of kilometers; explosions erupted, with hot magma and Ice Crystals spewing from the vast cracks.
The scorching Destructive Shockwave swept across Heaven and Earth, and massive chunks of Ice Layer as big as mountain peaks flew towards the Destruct Emperor Dragon, but they were crushed by an invisible force before they could get close.
Under the cold gaze of the Destruct Emperor Dragon standing tall in the Void, the fierce explosions continued for more than ten minutes before the Magma Fire Pillar that pierced Heaven and Earth finally began to die down.
By then, the entire Ice-encrusted Forbidden Zone had vanished, with a crater over seven thousand kilometers in diameter at the center, and the land for tens of thousands of kilometers around shattered, covered with web-like cracks.
Hot magma flowed within the cracks like rivers, occasionally erupting with Fire Pillars that collapsed space itself.
Even the pervasive flames and magma’s Rule strength were so intense that they formed dozens of dragon-shaped Lava Giant Beasts, exuding Level 9 and Mythical Auras, roaring between heaven and earth.
“Roar! Great Dragon of Disasters, you are the source of all strength in this world.”
“Praise the great Lava Giant Dragon, your eternal Radiance shines upon Heaven and Earth; your existence is the hope of billions of lives.”
“Oh great Lord of Disasters, we are your most devoted servants, please accept the worship of your humble servants… ”
These Magma Giant Dragons, following their instincts, circled above the towering nine-headed Lava Giant Dragon in the Firmament, chanting their Dragon Roars in unison.
This scene appeared sacred and monumental, as if the Lava Giant Beast was the true Dragon of Creation, bringing hope to all beings in this Lava Hell.
The Lava Giant Dragon being orbited stood proudly with its nine heads, seemingly enjoying the adoration immensely.
But the Destruct Emperor Dragon twitched at the corner of its mouth, finally understanding why this Lava Giant Dragon was so adept at flattery.
It was uncertain whether there was an issue with the Rules it mastered or some other reason, but its Rule strength resonated with magma matter, giving rise to these synergetic Magma Giant Dragons.
These Magma Giant Dragons, with a hint of intelligence but mostly following instincts, would naturally worship it because they were born from its strength.
Day after day, surrounded by these praises, the thought processes of this Ancient Lava Giant Dragon diverged from those of ordinary Ancient Beasts.
For example, it was more ‘intelligent,’ knew the times, and enjoyed being flattered by ‘persons.’
Fortunately, this Lava Giant Dragon knew who the boss here was. So, after basking in the adulation for more than ten minutes, it flapped its wings and plunged into the depths of the Earth.
Soon after, the Lava Giant Dragon arrived before the Destruct Emperor Dragon, surrounded by several dozen Magma Giant Dragons, clasping the tattered body of the Ice Tiger Beast in its claws, all nine heads respectfully growling.
“Great king, this offender of your majesty has been slain by me. From now on, this place is the territory of the Dragon Palace Empire.”
“Well done.”
The Destruct Emperor Dragon nodded slowly, its colossal Dragon Claw grabbing the corpse of the Ice Tiger Beast and crunching it up in a few bites.
Before long, the two Giant Beasts disappeared into the far reaches of the sky.
And at that moment, Jack’s ride, the No.1 Cloud Sky Fighter Jet, slowly landed outside the world passageway of the first world.
“We pay our respects to the Divine Martial Emperor.”
As the cabin door of the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet opened, Jack, with a group of people following, slowly descended under the excited gaze of the soldiers guarding the entrance to the pathway.
Aside from the Lewis sisters, Crystal and Mandy, and Justin Welan, there was also a ravishing blonde girl with three pairs of white light wings.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1538: Chapter 578 Unseen, Unheard, Descending Upon the South Chapter 1538: Chapter 578 Unseen, Unheard, Descending Upon the South “Divine Martial Emperor, these are the two Dimension Binding Divine Jades prepared for you,”
As Jack Clark and his group approached, a Ninth Heaven Expert responsible for the day-to-day supervision of the passageway came over and respectfully handed over a black wooden box.
“Thank you,” Jack Clark nodded slightly as he accepted the box.
The strongest of the three major world passageways in the Blue Star World is Channel One, but it can only accommodate up to Heavenly King peak experts. The several passageways in the deep sea can only fit Mythical Creatures.
Currently, although Jack Clark’s realm is only at the late period of Heavenly King, his essence has already become comparable to a Demon God’s.
Hence, he needs such Divine Objects that can form a ‘Boundary’ on their own to bind the Rule powers within his body, otherwise, it could trigger passageway disturbances or even collapse.
Of course, such a thing can only be used by the life forms from the Blue Star World.
If the Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings were to try and descend forcibly by relying on a similar Divine Object, they would be suppressed by Blue Star’s rules in an instant, while for demon gods accessing it is simply impossible.
Because there are no sufficiently stable world passageways.
This is also why Adam Garcetti placed that strand of Primordial Origin in the Blue Star World, mainly to avoid it being snatched by even stronger beings.
If the news of his possession of a strand of Primordial Origin gets out, the two Great Demon Kings of the Purgatory Empire, and even the Divine Gods Alliance’s King Tarodel might not resist the temptation to make their move.
After all, that is a Creation-Level Divine Object that could help them breakthrough to Ancestor or Ancient God.
Hiss!
Just as Jack Clark and the others were about to enter the passageway, a silver vortex over a thousand meters high suddenly trembled. Following that, a long whistle sounded.
Boom! The vortex trembled as a blue train roared out with a thunderous rumble, stirring up a raging wind and advancing mightily ahead.
Immediately, Justin Welan said with a grin, “It’s a transportation train; looks like some newcomers have entered the mythical world.”
Suddenly, Crystal Lewis remarked thoughtfully, “I remember more than half a year ago, Jack, you entered the mythical world on this train. In the blink of an eye, you have become a Heavenly King.”
“Yeah, time flies,” Jack Clark also nodded with a hint of sentimentality.
“Let’s go, back to our world. I’m aiming for the Global Martial Arts Competition; Grandpa Walton, here I come.” Justin Welan was a bit excited as he was the first to rush into the pathway, followed by the Lewis sisters, Mandy and Crystal.
Then came Anstice, who had been curiously looking around all the while. As the blonde girl just entered the silver vortex, the entire passageway began to shake violently.
The radiant silver brilliance permeated the space, forming ripples that spread over a dozen kilometers in a massive show of force.
“Hiss! That beauty from a different race is so powerful!” Suddenly, the surrounding cultivators all gasped in amazement.
They hadn’t expected the breathtakingly beautiful girl from a different race to be so strong. Judging by the force of the passageway’s tremor, she was already comparable to the old guard experts like the Mysterious Martial Sky King.
At this point, Jack Clark opened the wooden box to reveal two fist-sized silver jades, like star sapphires, with a blue star sapphire spinning slowly inside, emitting a hazy radiance.
Crack!
Jack Clark crushed one of the Dimension Binding Divine Jades in his hand, and instantly a blue, transparent energy enveloped him, forming a thin membrane separating him from the outside world.
Feeling the strong Barrier Wall outside his body, Jack Clark’s figure flashed as he dashed into the vortex.
…
In South City, the temperature in January had dropped below zero; the snowflakes fell thickly, blanketing the city in white. Under such weather conditions, nearly all flights were canceled, causing many to be delayed.
But as many stranded passengers waited helplessly in the airport, someone in the waiting area suddenly paused and pointed outside, “Didn’t they say all flights were canceled? Why is there a convoy going out there to pick someone up?”
This immediately caused a stir in the waiting room.
Many people looked outside to see a lineup of over a dozen luxurious black sedans and business cars driving into the airport.
An Invisible Power spread out from the convoy, lifting the ten or so centimeters of snow ahead of it, clearing a straight and clean path.
“…With such heavy snow, under normal conditions, planes definitely cannot land. It seems that some high-profile individual has arrived.”
“This kind of grandeur, could it be the Descendant of the King?”
“Damn it, those with power can do whatever they want. We’re stuck here unable to travel, and they can just send a Transcendent to clear the snow and land.”
As many people in the waiting room grumbled, the distant convoy stopped, and car doors opened. First, a line of bodyguards in black suits disembarked.
Then a few military generals appeared, their expressions solemn. Lastly was a woman with a gentle demeanor and a noble aura, her silver hair cascading over her shoulders and dragon horns atop her head.
Even though the woman’s features were unclear, her distinctive silver hair and dragon horns were recognized by onlookers immediately.
“It’s General Mathilda Ward.”
“To have General Mathilda Ward personally welcoming them, this visitor must be more significant than merely a Descendant of the King. Could it be the son of a Heavenly King?”
“Big news indeed.”
Many people grew excited, whipping out their mobile phones to take pictures through the glass, and some even started posting on social media.
As a former big star and then revealed as the Princess of the Heavenly King, Mathilda Ward, who now also holds the rank of a Ninth Heaven Expert and Major General, doesn’t normally greet guests herself. The national presidents often do not have the privilege to be welcomed by her, which indicates the person arriving this time is at least someone with a status not inferior to hers.
But it is uncertain which Heavenly King’s Descendant or empire prince it could be.
While many awaited with expectation, the snow in the skies above suddenly halted.
Then the dense grey clouds parted abruptly, creating a vast hollow with a diameter of dozens of kilometers. Above the kilometer-thick clouds, dazzling sunlight formed a pillar of light falling from the sky.
In the golden sunlight, a sinister black and red fighter aircraft appeared, with its two engines underneath emitting fiery light, descending slowly.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1539: Chapter 578 Unseen, Unheard, Descend on the South_2 Chapter 1539: Chapter 578 Unseen, Unheard, Descend on the South_2 And the most conspicuous was the insignia on the side of the fighter aircraft. Inside the waiting room, a middle-aged man who recognized the insignia exclaimed in surprise, “It’s a Throne Fighter, a king-level figure has come to South City.”
“So it is.”
“Turns out it’s the arrival of a king-level figure, no wonder Mathilda Ward and those generals are personally coming to receive.”
People suddenly realized, then some felt disappointed, thinking it was some other high-profile person, only to find out it was the arrival of a king-level figure after all.
Although for these ordinary people or ordinary cultivators, a king-level figure is high above, akin to deities, at the same time it also lacked topicality, with no places for gossip.
Actually, with Jack Clark’s current identity, his official vehicle should have long been upgraded to a Sky Base Battleship of fortress level.
In the Federation, Mythical Kings, Heavenly Kings, and Supreme Experts all have official vehicles that match their status, such as the Throne Fighter for kings, the atmospheric battleships for Heavenly Kings, and the Sky Base Battleships for Supremes.
It’s just that Jack’s strength increased too quickly, and the official administration simply couldn’t keep up with upgrading his vehicle.
Whoosh whoosh! The landing fighter aircraft blew out hot air waves, sweeping away and melting all the snow on the runway, before finally touching down on the airport with a slight tremble.
The aircraft’s hatch on the belly slowly opened, revealing Jack Clark, Anstice, and the Lewis sisters and Justin Welan standing behind.
Mathilda Ward’s face broke into a smile, “Jack Clark, you’re back.”
Jack gave a slight smile, “I had some matters to take care of, so I have come back for a bit. Sister Ilisa, you seem even more beautiful after not seeing you for a while.”
“Is that so.” Jack’s casual compliment made Mathilda’s smile even more radiant.
However, it was obviously not the place to chat about those things, so Mathilda looked at the three people behind Jack, “Justin, hello, and these two must be Crystal and Mandy Lewis?”
Because previously, Justin Welan and Glenn Clark had come to South City to watch the Violent Dragon Alien Tribe, so Mathilda recognized him.
As for the Lewis sisters, although she had not met them, Mathilda had discreetly learned about the ‘friends’ who were close to Jack, so naturally, she would not ignore them.
“Hehe… Miss Ward, hello, hello,” said Justin, nodding with a cheerful laugh.
The Lewis sisters didn’t feel constrained; instead, their eyes lit up with excitement, “General Ward, hello, you look even more beautiful in person than on TV.”
As seventeen-year-old girls, both sisters used to enjoy listening to Mathilda’s songs.
And after emerging from the Southern Battlefield, having heard about her daring exploits as the Daughter of the Mysterious Martial Sky King in luring the Evil God Sect Cultists, their admiration for her increased even more.
After a brief greeting, Mathilda’s gaze moved to the blonde girl with three pairs of wings stretching out behind her and white halos above her head. Her eyes shimmered with amazement.
So beautiful!
Mathilda inwardly marveled, then composed herself with solemnity, “Greetings, Princess Anstice. I am Mathilda Ward, the person in charge of South City, and I welcome you to Blue Star as our guest.”
Anstice spoke slowly, with a slightly stiff command of the Federation language, “Miss Ward, hello. My apologies for the intrusion.”
“Your Highness is too polite. As the first ally of different races to visit Blue Star, we, the Human Race, naturally want to do our duty as hosts to the fullest,” responded Mathilda earnestly.
“I will personally take charge of all your travels here, Your Highness. Please feel free to make any requests at any time…”
While Mathilda was formally receiving Anstice, behind her a female host was already excitedly holding a microphone, speaking into the video camera.
“Hello, everyone, I am Nina, a host at the South City Television Station.”
“Today marks a historic moment. I am at the airport, accompanying General Ward to receive the first visitor from a different species to our world.”
“That sacred figure with the gorgeous wings and a sparkling white halo behind them belongs to the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
“This is an ancient mythic race whose overall appearance is similar to ours, with the only difference being the wings on their back.”
“As I understand it, the Heavenly Feather Clan has three types of wings: white, silver, and gold, with the number of wings relating to their strength.”
“For example, the Heavenly Feather being behind me with three pairs of white wings might look young and beautiful, but they’re actually a strong figure not less powerful than our Human Race’s Heavenly King.”
This emergency news, being an official live broadcast, was seen by many people as soon as it aired, all captivated by the figure with blonde hair.
“Damn, what am I seeing, an angel?”
“Wow! That Heavenly Feather is so beautiful, even prettier than Ilisa.”
“Shut it, my Ilisa is the most beautiful, no arguments admitted.”
“Mom, come quickly, there’s an angel.”
“I declare, from now onward, my goddess will be this Heavenly Feather beauty, no one dare compete with me.”
“Don’t go spouting comments willy-nilly, didn’t you hear what the host just said? That angel is a strong man comparable to the Heavenly King; be careful they might pinch you dead through the internet cable…”
The entire official live broadcast room of South City went absolutely wild, with a barrage of comments flying across the screen.
For these ordinary people, Anstice seemed like a true Seraph descending upon them, her perfect and holy Figure instantly creating a massive emotional shock.
Including Zac, White Veil, and Marcus, who were earlier alerted by the official announcement that something momentous was happening and were tuned in, were wide-eyed.
But their attention was soon drawn to Mathilda, as well as Justin, Crystal, and Mandy beside her, “Weren’t the Lewis girls supposed to be in the mythical world? How come they suddenly returned?”
“Damn, damn, why is Justin there too?”
