﻿Chapter 1540: Chapter 578 Unseen, Unheard, Descending upon the South_3 Chapter 1540: Chapter 578 Unseen, Unheard, Descending upon the South_3 “Damn, Justin Welan is really living it up this time; he gets to be so close to two super goddesses. No, wait, there are also the equally beautiful Lewis sisters over there.”
At this moment, envy was naked in the eyes of the three, wishing they could pull the grinning Justin Welan out of the computer and beat him up.
Mathilda Ward’s beauty is universally acknowledged and, since becoming a Half-Dragon Human, her looks and aura have become absolutely breathtaking, and Anstice needs no mention.
Members of the Heavenly Feather Clan are naturally striking, but as a Main God-level strong man, her appearance, enhanced through repeated strength breakthroughs and genetic optimizations, is close to perfection.
And that’s just the exterior, not to mention the dignified and sacred aura of a Main God-level presence.
However, whether it’s the three in front of the computer or the journalists on-site, everyone only noticed Justin Welan’s group, completely overlooking Jack Clark as if he didn’t exist.
Even the video cameras failed to capture any footage of him.
Underneath the Cloud Sky Fighter Jet, after Mathilda Ward and Anstice had finished their official interaction, Jack Clark spoke up, “Sister Ilisa, I’ll have to trouble you with the reception of Anstice.”
Then Jack Clark looked towards Justin Welan and the others, “Mr. Willard, Class Leader, as ‘geniuses’ returning from the frontline, you can skip the preliminary rounds and go straight to the national competition.”
“I’ve asked before coming back; Zac Maben and the others have also qualified for nationals and are currently in the South. Sister Ilisa will find someone to take you there.”
Justin Welan said subconsciously, “Jack, aren’t you coming with us?” Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis turned their heads to look at him too.
Jack Clark shook his head slightly, “Didn’t I say I had other matters to attend to when I came back? If I find the time later, I’ll come to watch your competition.”
“By the way, Jim has also qualified for the nationals. Remember to go easy on him when you encounter him.”
“Damn, Glenn Clark made it to the nationals too?”
Justin Welan was a bit surprised, recalling that when he entered the mythical world more than two months ago, that guy was only at the Second Layer Heaven… don’t tell me that kid has reached the Fifth Layer Heaven now?
Thinking of Glenn Clark’s terrifying cultivation speed, and his exaggerated luck, Justin Welan suddenly felt that it wasn’t impossible for Glenn to have broken through to the Fifth Layer Heaven in just over two months.
Especially since he had a brother with even more terrifying talent, and most importantly, the resource support given by Jack Clark.
Before leaving, Jack Clark apologetically looked at the blonde girl, “Lady Anstice, I’m sorry that I cannot personally show you around our human world this time.”
Anstice shook her head slightly, “Divine Martial Emperor, your matters are of greater importance. I was just simply curious about your world and came for a casual visit.”
Jack Clark had already given Anstice a heads-up before her visit, so she wasn’t overly concerned.
To the people standing not far away, the occasional behavior of people like Mathilda Ward, who seemed to be speaking into thin air, seemed a bit strange.
With the reputation of a ‘well-known’ global figure, Jack Clark, intending to keep a low profile on this return, was enshrouded in a layer of space-distorting Rule strength.
Apart from Mathilda Ward, who was allowed to ‘see’ him, no one could see him, including optical instruments like video cameras.
Whoosh!
Under the watchful eyes of the crowd, the black and red warplane kicked up an airwave as it slowly ascended, and the moment it reached a hundred meters high, it surged into the sky with a piercing boom.
Boom! Under Supersonic Speed, the warplane ripped through the sky, and in the blink of an eye, it disappeared into the horizon, leaving behind a long pathway tearing through the clouds.
Because of Anstice’s arrival, and to demonstrate respect for her, the Cloud Sky fighter jet landed conspicuously at the airport.
Otherwise, with Jack Clark’s character, he would have casually found a place to drop off Justin Welan and the others long ago.
Traveling at more than ten times the speed of sound, the Cloud Sky soon arrived over the capital of the Eastern Summer Empire, hovering above a massive Military Base.
Waiting there, formerly in charge of Channel One, was Marcellus Larry standing in the Void, expecting him.
Seeing Jack Clark flying out of the warplane, Marcellus Larry said solemnly, “Jack Clark, you’re here.”
“Next, I’ll trouble you, Senior Larry, to open it up.”
“,”Come with me.”
Seeing Jack Clark flying out of the warplane, Marcellus Larry said solemnly, “Jack Clark, you’re here.”
“Next, I’ll trouble you, Senior Larry, to open it up.”
“,”Come with me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1541 - 1541 579 Refining the Primordial Origin The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1541: Chapter 579: Refining the Primordial Origin, The Protagonist’s Script Chapter 1541: Chapter 579: Refining the Primordial Origin, The Protagonist’s Script Deep within the Capital Military Base, space was sliced by formidable strength, forming a white crystal ten thousand meters in shape and size.
Within that materialized space crystal surface, a purple radiance a few meters in length and as thin as an arm slowly circulated, exuding a mysterious aura of the original source of all things at the beginning of creation.
Outside the space, at the very instant Jack Clark saw that streak of purple light, the Supreme Power Rules inside his body and the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal deep within his soul vibrated faintly.
Jack Clark slowly said, “Is this the Primordial Origin?”
Marcellus Larry nodded, “This strand of origin is the hope for the birth of a Monarch for our Human Race. To prevent the news from leaking and being snatched by different races, Mr. Garcetti sealed it within Blue Star.”
“This crystal faceted space is actually a broken world-class weapon from a relic.”
“Although it lacks offensive power, once deployed, it can form a ‘world’ of incredible solidity and stability, sealing and isolating everything. Even a Heavenly King would not be able to break through the crystal barrier.”
“Now Mr. Garcetti is entrusting it to you, clearly believing that your chances of making a breakthrough are even greater than his,” Marcellus Larry said with a mix of emotion and excitement.
When Jack Clark obtained the Emperor Inheritance on the Road to Becoming a God, Marcellus Larry was shocked by his unparalleled talent.
Later, when Jack Clark made a breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven and opened up four Illusory Worlds of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, Marcellus Larry affirmed that he was the hope of the Human Race, promptly seeking Adam Garcetti and others to craft a forbidden weapon for him.
Even so, Marcellus Larry never imagined that Jack Clark’s growth would be so rapid.
In a few months, he had broken through to the late stage of Heavenly King, even slaying several Demon Gods, pushing across the battlefield for more than two million kilometers, and decimating most of the forces of two great empires in a single battle.
Considering this, Marcellus Larry suggested, “Jack, given your current level of cultivation, once you breakthrough, the impact will be extremely massive, and the Blue Star World actually cannot bear it.”
“Therefore, I suggest that you first assimilate the origin within, allowing your accumulation to reach its limit. It will be better to enter the mythical world for a breakthrough then.”
“Mhm, that’s what I was planning,” Jack Clark nodded.
Last time he broke through to the late period of a Heavenly King, he almost devoured most of the Heavenly Energy within a ten thousand-kilometer radius in one breath, condensing an even stronger True Demon God Body.
If he were to make a breakthrough in Blue Star, with the density of Heavenly Energy merely a fraction of that in the mythical world, he might completely drain it.
At that time, the cultivation environment that various empires had accumulated and cultivated for decades would be destroyed, turning into a barren desert of cultivation in the short term.
Hum! As the white bead in Marcellus Larry’s hand emitted circles of radiance, the crystal faceted space, independent of the world, also vibrated.
On the crystal barrier facing the two men, an opening with a diameter of 2 meters slowly formed.
Suppressing his excitement, Marcellus Larry said expectantly, “Go ahead, Jack Clark, and begin your legend.”
He was eager to see just how astonishing a transformation Jack Clark would undergo after merging with that strand of the Primordial Origin, already monstrously talented and on a par with a Demon God in strength.
Would he transcend to join the Supreme, or become a being of even higher order?
Whichever it was, it indicated that he was officially stepping onto the stage of the mythical world, and as a Supreme Expert who mastered the rules, even among some of the legendary major races in the mythical world, he would be a core force.
Jack Clark looked back at Marcellus Larry and nodded at him slowly, then stepped into the crystal faceted world in a flash.
The moment Jack Clark entered, he felt as if he had come to another world, a narrow and barren dark void devoid of everything.
At the same time, the White Crystal opening in the Dark Void behind him silently healed and disappeared.
But all of that was irrelevant now, as the moment Jack Clark entered, his entire attention fell on the purple radiance circulating in the void.
Within every cell of his body, and even deep within his soul, he felt an overwhelming urge.
It was the instinctive desire from his genes and life itself, striving for perfection, evolution to a higher order, urging him to devour and absorb that origin.
Jack Clark took a deep breath, and with his whole being, he lunged toward the purple light band.
At the instant Jack Clark touched the Primordial Origin, the purple light band burst radiantly, infusing into his body as endless purple radiance.
Boom!
In an instant, Jack Clark’s consciousness thundered, and under the force of an indescribably mighty power, he exploded completely, turning into a sky of purple-golden blood mist.
Under the force of the beginning of all things, the origin of everything, his formidable True Body was of no use, or rather, it had no resistance whatsoever.
It disintegrated at the genetic level in the first moment, enveloped in the most fundamental cellular form across a thousand kilometers.
In this state, Jack Clark didn’t feel pain, his consciousness clear, as if elevated like the Heavenly Dao, quietly watching the newly formed world below.
As an Innate God Demon who had reached the late stage of Heavenly King, Jack Clark’s cells had long departed from the conventional protein structure and were more like tangible forms of energy combined with runes.
These runes, merged with countless cells, were the foundation of all his powers.
Supreme Power Rules, five Higher-order Laws, six Great Divine Powers, Ancient Duel Mark, Eye of Prison, Azure Dragon Bloodline, and talents such as the Void Death Pupil and Soul Split.
Even the Demon God Heavy Star Battle Armor and the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd, which had already been refined and integrated into his True Demon God Body, appeared in phantom forms.
Boom!
Just then, a purple lightning bolt emerged within the purple-gold blood mist, much like the first ray of light at the dawn of creation exploding and thundering through the ages.
This bolt of lightning was like the beginning of everything; each cell released astonishing energy, twinkling like stars, with runes within the cell nucleus shining brightly.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1542: Chapter 579 Refining the Primordial Origin, Protagonist Script_2 Chapter 1542: Chapter 579 Refining the Primordial Origin, Protagonist Script_2 At this moment, the entire universe seemed to come to life, slowly beginning to rotate. Some cells, following a certain pattern, began to autonomously converge, their internal runes merging and evolving.
Gradually, within that purple-gold ‘world,’ a majestic and towering figure of a deity’s phantom slowly emerged.
Around that hibernating deity, countless runes orbited and wove together, forming an immeasurable rune sequence chain that emitted a brilliant divine light.
This scene, watched from outside the ‘world,’ left Marcellus Larry utterly shocked, “He’s not just experiencing a sudden increase in cultivation level, he’s restructuring his God and Demon True Body!?”
Marcellus Larry had once seen Adam Garcetti absorb the primordial origin.
When Adam Garcetti obtained the primordial origin deep within the Stone Statue Ruins, his cultivation level was only in the latter stages of the mythic realm. Unaware of the origin’s value, he directly absorbed a strand of it.
At that time, Adam Garcetti’s cultivation had surged, breaking through to the mid-period of the Heavenly King level and his true body had also undergone a transformation, his aura becoming even more elusive and noble.
However, the changes that had occurred to Adam Garcetti were tremendous but still within the realms of normal understanding.
Whereas Jack Clark was now returning to the elemental state of the True Demon God Body, reorganizing life, and it was unknown what kind of transformation he would undergo.
Because Jack Clark’s transformation took place in another ‘world’ underground, no one in the outside world perceived it, nor did anyone know about it, except for Marcellus Larry, who quietly stood guard outside.
South City, night.
On the edge of the bustling night market, a popular roadside barbecue stand was bustling with Glenn Clark, Justin Welan, Zac Maben, White Veil, and Marcus Lindsay enjoying their meal and drink lively together.
All five of them were tall and burly, especially Glenn Clark, who resembled a smaller giant as he sank his teeth into a spicy grilled chicken leg, his face glistening with grease.
At this moment, Marcus Lindsay lifted up a large bunch of beer, “Tiger, come on, let’s take one down.”
“Alright, Big Bro Marcus,” Glenn Clark replied without hesitation, grabbing his cup.
After all, Marcus Lindsay was his elder cousin, and Glenn had to give due respect.
Marcus Lindsay finished his drink in one gulp, putting down the mug with a satisfied expression on his face, “Drinking chilled beer in heavy snow is just bliss, too bad Jack Clark isn’t here, or it would be even livelier.”
Then, changing his tone, Marcus Lindsay curiously asked, “Speaking of which, Mr. Willard, what brought you guys back all of a sudden? Has the war with the Purgatory Demon Race on the frontline ended?”
“We’re far from it, the war is nowhere near over.”
Justin Welan finished a skewer of meat in two bites and wiped his mouth, “Though we’ve won a great victory this time, we’re still a long way from total victory.”
“It’s said that there are even more powerful beings behind the Purgatory Demon Race and in time, a more vicious war could break out, even greater than the last one.”
Justin became excited while speaking, “You guys haven’t been on the frontline and so you have no idea how outrageous it was.”
“Giant Beasts covered the mountains, and Purgatory True Demons, equivalent to the Seventh and Eighth Layer Heavens, numbered in the millions; the whole view was lit up by the explosions of Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs.”
“Even at times, it felt like the whole world was shaking, the Earth undulated like tsunamis, and mountain peaks thousands of meters tall collapsed en masse.”
“If you weren’t careful, the residual waves from king-level and demon king clashes above your head would sweep by, and all you’d hear is the thunderous booming that shakes your brain.”
“Occasionally, a main cannon shot from a sky-based battleship passed by and a mountain range would vanish.”
“Especially our Federation’s sky-based Apocalyptic Weapons, their power is so exaggerated that with each strike, a piece of the continent would be destroyed, as if the surface was being cleansed.”
Zac Maben’s eyes bulged in astonishment, “Damn, the Frontline Battlefield is that exaggerated? How did you survive with your level of strength?”
Instantly, Justin Welan looked annoyed, “Hey, what do you mean, Mr. Lewis, you looking down on me as a Seventh-level high-order powerhouse?”
White Veil from across the table promptly flipped him off, “Dayum, we all know you’re at the Seventh Layer, you don’t need to keep reminding us.”
“But Mr. Lewis has a point. You said the hills were full of Seventh and Eighth Layer True Demons by the millions, and there must be tens of thousands of Nine Layer True Demons, how did you not get blown up in that scenario?”
Justin Welan boasted, “That question is simple. Our Human Race is nothing like those backward Purgatory Demons. Don’t forget, we’re a civilized society.”
“On the battlefield, our frontlines consist mainly of War Pattern mecha troops and saturation bombing with large caliber artillery and missiles, so the casualties among cultivators are actually not as high as imagined.”
“Plus, this Civilization War has seen countless Heavenly Feather Clan and Divine Gods Alliance different races’ corps joining in, and many tough armies were handed over to them.”
“Moreover, I am a Federal Genius, and people like us are generally assigned to relatively safe tasks when we go to battle; we don’t go deep into the fight.”
Then, coming back to his senses, Marcus Lindsay said sarcastically, “Cut it out, so you were just hanging around the edges of the battlefield, making soy sauce.”
Justin Welan’s eyes bulged, somewhat annoyed, “What do you mean ‘making soy sauce,’ Grandpa Walton here killed more than a dozen Purgatory True Demons and several hundred Demonized Aliens.”
“Besides, I’ve even withstood a level eight Demonized Giant Beast’s assault head-on, allowing it to roar and attack in fury without breaking my defense.”
As he spoke, pride washed over Justin Welan’s face again, that punchable smug look irritating Zac, White Veil, and Marcus profoundly.
Damn it, the guy’s cultivation level was just a little higher than theirs, advancing into the mythical world ahead of them. What’s the big deal? If he has the guts, he should compare himself to Jack Clark.
Then, Glenn Clark, who had just gobbled up three plates of barbecue, holding a skewer, curiously asked, “Big Brother Justin, those demon kings and Great Demon Kings, are they powerful?”
“And the Demon Gods, I heard my brother killed three during this Civilization War.”

﻿Chapter 1543: Chapter 579 Refining Primordial Origin, Main Character Script_3 Chapter 1543: Chapter 579 Refining Primordial Origin, Main Character Script_3 “`
…Ahem.
Facing this question, Justin Welan coughed dryly, “Of course those demon kings and great demon kings are powerful, but those strong men’s battlefields are all in the heavens.”
“And with the radiance of the rules shimmering and spreading for ten, even tens of kilometers, the roiling dark demon air surrounding the demon kings obscures the sky, so you basically can’t see anything.”
“As for the true demons and divine kings who grasp the rules, they stand above the firmament tens of thousands of kilometers high, bursting the void with a flick of their hand, even shaking space-time.”
“Battles of such level can destroy everything within tens of thousands of kilometers with their remnants, and even if one saw it, they would not live to tell the tale.”
“Hahaha… Mr. Willard, after all your explanations, it turns out you didn’t see anything,” the three of them laughed suddenly, this guy was just showing off in front of them, making it sound so amazing, but actually on the frontline he was just an insignificant little shrimp.
However, as they laughed, their faces filled with melancholy, because they were not even as much as little shrimps.
Marcus Lindsay sighed, “Ah, when will we be able to break through to the Seventh Layer Heaven and enter the mythical world, I really want to witness the grandeur of the racial battles.”
Zac Maben also sighed, “Yeah, it’s so boring staying in the Blue Star World every day.”
Glenn Clark gobbled down a roast sucking pig in two bites, nodding excitedly, “Me too, I really want to go to the frontline battlefield and hack at those Purgatory True Demons to let them know Big Tiger’s prowess.”
“My brother hacks true demons; I’ll go hack the great demon kings.”
Justin Welan chuckled, “With your talent, Glenn, practice for another year and maybe you really will hack at a great demon king. By the way, Glenn, what realm are you at now in your cultivation?”
It was then that Justin Welan remembered, earlier Jack Clark had mentioned that Glenn Clark also took part in the national competition.
Scratching the back of his head, Glenn Clark looked a bit embarrassed, “Me? I’ve only reached the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven in my cultivation; I haven’t even broken through to the Sixth Layer yet.”
Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven, that’s good. Justin Welan felt a sigh of relief in his heart.
In the past, reaching the peak of the Fifth Layer Heaven would have been among the very top few characters in the Southern Region of Eastern Summer, and among the geniuses in third grade.
But times have changed. With the Federation’s resource allocation and the spread of ancient body refining techniques, many individuals in third grade have already broken through the Sixth Layer Heaven.
Even a few geniuses like Gabriella and Eddy Keller have already broken through to the Seventh Layer, like Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, among others.
Consequently, the realm of the peak of Fifth Layer Heaven could only be considered as average in the national competition’s selection, not that incredible.
“Wait a minute, Glenn, how did you cultivate so quickly?” Justin Welan suddenly realized something and his eyes widened.
“Two months ago, when I entered the mythical world, weren’t you just breaking through to the Second Layer Heaven?”
The initial stage of Fifth Layer and the peak of Fifth Layer are entirely different concepts, just one step away from entering the Sixth Layer. And Glenn has been cultivating for less than three months?
Even for geniuses who reach Foundation Establishment in a day and directly enter the Second Layer Heaven, this is a bit unbelievable, isn’t it?
Marcus Lindsay spoke with a ghostly tone, “Don’t ask anymore, Mr. Willard. Glenn here is even more of a monster than Jack Clark. You have no idea how exaggerated his cultivation speed and luck are.”
“He was only in the late stage of the Third Layer Heaven when he participated in the Mist River City selection competition. Then, thanks to the rewards from the competition, he directly broke through to the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“That’s not all. Listen to this: before preparing for the provincial level competition, Glenn went fishing at the sea entrance.”
“He didn’t catch any high-level Mutated Fish that time, but he found a top-tier resource ‘Dragon Ball’ on the beach, containing pure Dragon Power.”
“With the lifelong essence of even the weakest Dragon Variant Beast of Level 7, Glenn’s cultivation soared directly to the peak of the Fourth Layer Heaven.”
“Add to that his Innate Hegemon and Giantification Talent, his battle prowess can even compete with those of the Sixth Layer. Not even the three of us are a match for him, and he easily claimed first place in the provincial competition.”
“The first place in the provincial competition is rewarded with a Soul Crystal, a top-tier special resource that can greatly strengthen the soul.”
“With a significant enhancement to his soul, plus the resources Jack gave to Glenn, a few days pass and the guy breaks through to the Fifth Layer Heaven and reaches the mid-stage immediately.”
“That’s not all, do you know what happened the day before yesterday?” At this point, Marcus Lindsay, Zac Maben, and White Veil all showed intense envy on their faces.
Justin Welan hesitated, “Don’t tell me, a God-level resource fell from the sky, and Glenn’s cultivation surged from the mid-stage of the Fifth Layer Heaven straight to the peak?”
At this, Marcus Lindsay and the others paused, “How do you know?”
“Damn, did a God-level resource really fall from the sky?” Justin Welan was stunned and looked towards the bulky youth who was wolfing down meat.
A bit embarrassed, Glenn Clark admitted, “It wasn’t that exaggerated. At that time, May, Melinda, and the others were barbecuing in the courtyard of the villa when a space crack appeared in the sky.”
“Intense energy fluctuations and roars could be heard coming from that crack as if two mighty Giant Beasts were battling on the other side. Then a drop of golden blood containing dense energy flew out.”
“That drop of golden blood was nearly the size of a water tank. Afraid it might cause problems, I asked Sister Ilisa to check it out, and after ensuring there were no issues, I absorbed and refined it.”
Zac Maben added solemnly from the side, “Then, his cultivation broke through to the peak of Fifth Layer Heaven.”
“With his Innate Awakening Tyrant Body, plus the body refining technique given by Jack, and his Giantification Burst Talent, he was strong enough to crush all Sixth Heaven cultivators.”
“Even those cultivators who could fight across realms if they were geniuses.”
White Veil then chimed in, “And the most important thing is that the national competition starts in three days, and due to the large number of participants, it’s expected to last a week.”

﻿Chapter 1544: Chapter 579 Refining Primordial Origin, Main Character Script_4 Chapter 1544: Chapter 579 Refining Primordial Origin, Main Character Script_4 “For such a long time, with Brother Glenn Clark’s freakish luck, he might stumble upon some Heaven and Earth Treasure and have a breakthrough to the Sixth Layer.”
“By then, even you, Mr. Willard, might not be able to beat him.”
“…Damn it.” Justin Welan was dumbstruck; he felt it wasn’t just possible, but a certainty.
Damn it, why does it seem like the entire Human Race’s luck has converged on the Clark family?
It was already crazy enough that they produced a one-of-a-kind monster who reached the Ninth Heavens within a year, broke through to the late period of the Heavenly King’s realm within months, and whose combat strength overwhelmingly dominated an era; now there was also an equally abnormal Glenn Clark.
In terms of achievements, Glenn Clark may not compare to Jack Clark, but damn it, his luck is even more exaggerated.
At least since they had known Jack Clark, even after his breakthrough to the Eight Layer Heaven and entry into the mythical world, they had never seen him pick up any Heaven and Earth Treasure falling from the sky.
But what about Glenn Clark? He’s been cultivating for just over three months, and damn it, if he’s not picking up Heaven and Earth Treasures, he’s digesting them.
Plus, after participating in the national competition and the official resources that came with it, there’s also a brother standing at the pinnacle of the Federation supporting him.
At this moment, even Justin Welan couldn’t help feeling envious and jealous, “Damn, Glenn, tell us honestly, did you peek at the protagonist’s script in your last life?”
Glenn Clark, with a simple touch to the back of his head, said, “Mr. Willard and the rest of you are exaggerating, I’ve just been a bit luckier lately.”
Although everything that happened recently was somewhat mysterious, Glenn Clark was actually very sober, not getting carried away by his terrifying luck.
After all, just a year ago, he was still ‘starving’ every day, and his brother was even so malnourished that his waist wasn’t as thick as his arms.
And while Justin Welan and several others were overpowering Glenn Clark with alcohol out of jealousy, another place was also discussing him.
The mythical world.
Behind the Purgatory Empire, eighteen thick, kilometer-high Demon God Pillars stood like towering mountains, their tops disappearing into the swirling Dark Demon Air.
At that moment, atop the Demon God Pillars adorned with demon patterns, two figures over ten meters tall with robust frames, covered in black and red sinister armor, stood quietly.
They were surrounded by terrifying Killing Intent, like two heartless Slaughter Machines emitting an edge so dangerous that even Brooks felt threatened.
Seated high on a throne made from the skull of an ancient creature, Devil God Emperor Eros looked on coldly: “Brooks, are you sure there are no problems with this plan?”
Brooks, looking solemn, bowed respectfully: “According to the current intelligence, Blue Star’s interior is empty, with only two Legendary Realm kings guarding the north and south.”
“Although ‘Person’ has not tested them, it’s estimated that the highest level of protection around Glenn Clark and his family does not exceed Nine Demonic Marks, which is the Nine Layers.”
“After all, the status of a Mythical King within the Human Race is very high, and even with Darren Callum’s current standing, he cannot have a king provide one-on-one protection for his family.”
“Moreover, the Human Race doesn’t have that many ‘hands’ to spare, to the extent of having a Mythical King protect two ordinary people, especially when the rear of the Blue Star World is stable.”
“The previous major sweeps organized by the Human Race have almost cleaned out the Evil God Sect Cultists nurtured by Demon King Barus.”
“With the removal of the Demon God Sect, and the stability of the Outer Development Department in the human rear, they believe we no longer have a way to use the occasional World Rifts to infiltrate Blue Star.”
“Therefore, the protection of the Blue Star World, especially Darren Callum’s relatives, will further be neglected, which is our opportunity.”
“As long as Your Majesties’ two Demon God Puppets can successfully infiltrate Blue Star, even those two kings can be suppressed, let alone some mere Transcendent guards.”
“Once we execute Glenn Clark and capture Doris Clark, it will definitely throw Darren Callum into chaos and make him hold back for fear of harming the captives.”
“And to ensure that nothing goes wrong this time, I sent a Demon God Puppet equal to nine Demonic Marks to Blue Star, and I personally visited the rear of the Human Race’s Outer Development Department.”
“The branch that was established there still exists, and the Void Demon Eye Array continues to function, along with two remnants of ordinary True Demons from the Intelligence Department.”
“There has been a slight World Rift permanently fixed there, which is in communication with several Giant God Sect Apostles lurking within Blue Star.”
“I inspected that rift, and although it’s very slight, it is indeed stable. Using a realm-breaking forbidden weapon is enough to temporarily tear open a pathway.”
“At the same time, I personally verified the information provided by those Giant God Sect Apostles to further confirm the target’s current status.”
“For example, Darren Callum’s brother, Glenn Clark, is currently located in Eastern Summer Empire’s South City, attending a Martial Arts national tournament hosted by the Human Race.”
“The person in charge of that city is a Ninth Heaven Cultivator named Mathilda Ward, and yes, that woman happens to be the daughter of the Mysterious Martial Heavenly King.”
“Initially, when Kautorus and the others split their souls to infiltrate Blue Star, it was to assassinate her, but ultimately they failed due to Darren Callum’s intervention.”
“This time, a Demon God Puppet containing two strands of His Majesty’s soul will enter Blue Star. There will be professionals to guide it to South City and Mist River City.”
“Moreover, the identity of the Demon God Puppet is legal and compliant, so as long as the forces belonging to His Majesty are not exposed, they will certainly not attract the attention of Federation strong men.”
“When the time comes, as long as we find the right opportunity, we can kill Glenn Clark in an instant and abduct Doris Clark.”
As he looked at Brooks, who had thoroughly investigated everything and made proper arrangements, Diorus slowly nodded, a look of satisfaction flashing in his eyes.
Compared to Barus, a fool who was negligent in his duties and always met with unexpected outcomes when executing plans, Brooks was much more reliable.
Diorus nodded slowly, “Very well, if this mission is successful, I will surely grant a generous reward.”
Excitement appeared on Brooks’s face, “Many thanks, Your Majesty. Actually, this is all part of my duty, but there might be a bit of trouble with another matter.”
“What is it?” Diorus was in a good mood at the moment, so he didn’t mind that Brooks hadn’t explained everything in one go.
Brooks gave a wry smile, “It’s about those Giant God Sect Apostles. They contacted us regardless of the risk of exposure, agreeing to help assassinate Darren Callum’s family, in exchange for rescuing their god.”
“Their god.”
Brooks bowed respectfully, “Yes, their god named Grayson, was one of our clan’s allies in the Divine Gods Alliance in ancient times.”
“After Darren Callum’s breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, he stormed into the Divine Gods Alliance, sweeping through the Demon God Sect, and destroyed the entire Evil God Alliance, including the Demon God Sect.”
“However, Grayson of the Giant God Sect managed to evade that disaster because he was not in the Divine Realm.”
“Now, Grayson is trapped in an ancient relic, unable to break free, and so he hopes that our clan’s strong men can rescue him, as compensation for helping our clan assassinate Darren Callum’s family.”
“I even sense that those Giant God Sect Apostles on Blue Star World may have been guided by Grayson himself, which is why they took the initiative to contact us.”
“After Darren Callum’s breakthrough to the Legendary Realm, he stormed into the Divine Gods Alliance, sweeping through the Demon God Sect, and destroyed the entire Evil God Alliance, including the Demon God Sect.”
“However, Grayson of the Giant God Sect managed to evade that disaster because he was not in the Divine Realm.”
“Now, Grayson is trapped in an ancient relic, unable to break free, and so he hopes that our clan’s strong men can rescue him, as compensation for helping our clan assassinate Darren Callum’s family.”
“I even sense that those Giant God Sect Apostles on Blue Star World may have been guided by Grayson himself, which is why they took the initiative to contact us.”

﻿Chapter 1545: Chapter 580: Starting from Primitive Man, The Grand Competition Begins Chapter 1545: Chapter 580: Starting from Primitive Man, The Grand Competition Begins At the frontline battlefield of the forbidden zone, Adam Garcetti’s gaze turned toward the direction of the distant Purgatory Empire.
“Originally, I thought that several demon kings would sever a strand of their soul origin and infiltrate Blue Star, but unexpectedly, it brought out Diorus, this big fish.”
“Two souls intertwined with a thread of divine soul origin, if we can seal one, it will be a lethal weapon to use against Diorus.”
Unlike demon kings, demon gods won’t weaken due to severing two strands of their soul origin, nor will they suffer heavy injuries should the divine soul origin within those two demon god puppets be extinguished.
But the value of those two strands of soul origin far exceeds that of several demon kings.
As a demon god who controls the power of the bloodline of time, Diorus is not only powerful, comparable to the ancient late stage, but also very difficult to kill.
For instance, when faced with mortal danger, Diorus could rip through the void to enter a time rift, burning the power of his bloodline to escape to another time period.
In such cases, unless a being with the power of time takes action and pursues across time, it would be impossible for Adam Garcetti and others, who cannot pinpoint the rift’s location, to do anything to him.
Even the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t prioritize killing Diorus first, considering this point.
But if we can seal one of his strands of soul origin this time, it won’t matter which time period he flees to; we could locate and pursue him through the divine soul origin.
By Adam Garcetti’s side, the True Martial Heavenly King, holding a black stele, also slightly smiled, “This time was an accident, after all, no one thought that the little guy had already mixed in with the demon kings.”
“Not only that, but the little guy also gained the trust of demon gods like Diorus, taking control of the reorganized Intelligence Department.”
“With him there facilitating things this time, we’ve been able to obtain many pieces of information one step ahead, including this time. But how do we seal those two puppets next?”
“Reactions of demon god-level entities are swift; we need to act with lightning speed to stand a chance of success, otherwise, it will definitely choose to self-destruct immediately.”
Adam Garcetti slowly said, “Currently, the strongest person on Blue Star is Jack Clark, but he has other matters, and it’s not certain whether he’ll encounter those two puppets.”
“To be on the safe side, it’s better to have Mysterious Martial and Denny Kaye return for a visit, otherwise, if something were to happen to Jack Clark’s mother or brother, it would be hard to explain to him.”
……
Watching the two pillars of light disappear deep into the void, Diorus slowly nodded.
There were no accidents with the transmission, and guided by the coordinates of the Void Demon Eye, the two demon god puppets had crossed millions of kilometers and precisely arrived.
As the blood-colored pillars of light slowly faded away, a Mythical Giant Beast, a kilometer long and with its flesh and soul drained, turned into black ash and dissipated beneath the Demon God Pillar.
Miles away to the east of the Outer Development Department’s 30th Army Group base, past where the Black Forbidden Zone collapsed, more than ten thousand kilometers to the side.
In the depths of a gorge underground, shrouded in black mist, two beams of blood light descended from heaven and earth, landing on an altar stained with the blood of countless Unique Beasts.
Below the altar, two Seven Demonic Marks True Demons with weak auras knelt excitedly on the ground.
“Greetings to the Imperial Emissary.”
The two demon god puppets, more ferocious-looking than true demons, nodded slightly, and one puppet, with eyes flickering with a dark red glow, spoke in a hoarse voice.
“Lead us to the crack.”
“Yes, Emissary of the Empire.”
The two Purgatory True Demons, unaware of the true identities of the puppets before them, assumed they were just powerful True Demons sent by the empire, and respectfully stood up to lead the way.
Passing through the moist and dark hallway, the four True Demons quickly reached a spacious cave where, half a meter above the ground, a crack over a meter in length and more than ten centimeters wide floated.
The rich Heavenly Energy followed through the crack toward the barren ‘world’ on the other side, creating raging winds that occasionally swept up fragments of rock.
But as soon as these hard fragments entered the crack, they silently shattered into dozens of pieces, immediately turning into ash and disappearing, pulverized by the spatial storms in the passageway.
One True Demon hesitated, “My lord, according to the agreement, the cultists of the Giant God Sect are already waiting on the other side, but this crack is too narrow to pass through…”
The Demon God Puppet, with a hoarse voice, slowly spoke, “No matter.”
As it said this, an alien forbidden weapon that was more than five meters long and resembled both a flying shuttle and a broken blade appeared in the hands of the puppet refined from a demonized alien race.
Hum!
The numerous runes infused with a breath of world-breaking energy lit up on the broken blade. Then, a force that shook heaven and earth gathered, its intensity far exceeding the Transcendent Level.
Boom!
A black blade light that cut through space-time rushed into the crack. Under its tremendous force, the World Rift vibrated but didn’t collapse or shatter, instead, it continued to tear apart under the moon-like black blade light.
Gradually, a passage, about ten meters long and more than five meters wide, surrounded by black runes appeared, and on the other side, one could faintly see the dry earth and low vegetation.
After that slash, the black broken blade became even more damaged, appearing as if it might break after no more than one additional use.
“The passage will only last for a moment, go.”
Zoom, zoom!!
The two demon god puppets, possessing self-awareness and intelligence but fundamentally under the control of Diorus’s strand of divine soul origin, didn’t hesitate and transformed into two black streaks of light, rushing into the pathway.
Blue Star World.
In the desolate and barren prairies of the Northern Continent, inside a cave, three primitives with dark skin and colorful patterns painted on their bodies held wooden spears, their expressions excited.
In front of them stood two towering figures nearly ten meters tall, with fierce and terrifying forms.
The three primitives spoke with respect, “We greet the two True Demons, congratulations on your arrival in the Blue Star World.”
Looking at the three primitives, who didn’t even have two pieces of clothing, merely wrapping something around their buttocks, the two Demon God Puppets fell into slight silence. Then, a cold and deep voice echoed in the cave.
“What are our identities, and how do we go to Eastern Summer to approach the target?”
The chief primitive respectfully said, “My lords, we have already planned everything. Your identities are the brave warriors of our Katavarabura Tribe.”
“Several months ago, our tribe discovered a gem mine that caught the attention of a jewelry company from the Eastern Summer Empire, providing them with raw ore.”
“With the help of the jewelry company from the Eastern Summer Empire, our tribe bought a large amount of modern civilization’s goods, such as televisions, satellite mobile phones, and we even built a base station.”
“As the first and second warriors of our Katavarabura Tribe, you are naturally strong and worship strength.”
“Recently, you have watched a lot of cultivator videos online and have developed a longing for True Martial, always wanting to go to Eastern Summer to seek a master and learn.”
“Especially now, with the global martial arts competitions being held by various countries and the three major empires, it has excited you even more, eager to go watch the events on site.”
“In three days, people from the Heaven Treasure Company, as is customary, will come to collect the raw ore.”
“I have already spoken to the person in charge of the Heaven Treasure Company’s local branch and paid for your travel expenses to take you with them on an international flight to Eastern Summer…”
The primitives went on to go over all the details and things to be aware of.
For instance, before exiting the cave, the two Demon God Puppets needed to change their shape to look more like the primitives.
Otherwise, once they left the cave, they would immediately be locked onto by the high-definition imaging satellites that spanned space. Besides that, they had to pay attention to language, speaking habits, eye contact, and so on.
After the chief primitive finished explaining all the matters, the two Demon God Puppets fell silent again.
They were mighty peak Nine Demonic Marks powerhouses, commanders of legions that led millions, and their first task upon arriving in this barren world was to pose as primitives?
More than ten minutes later, three primitives walked out slowly from the ancestral cave.
Two of the primitives had transformed to appear even more robust, their skin darkened and their nostrils widened, resembling unevolved great apes, filled with intimidating power.
When the three primitives returned to the tribe at the base of the mountain, many women wearing loose patterned shirts and dreadlocks in their hair lit up at the sight.
One of the women, who weighed over 200 kilograms, came forward with shining eyes, gazing at the two primitive warriors: “Wow.”
She even turned a full circle before them to show off her strong and fecund figure, as a strong scent of sweat permeated the air.
The primitive shaman, with a stern expression, scolded, “Lulala, get lost. Taru and the others have just completed their meditation, and their strength has increased. They need time to rest.”
Seeing the significantly bulkier physiques of the two warriors, the surrounding tribe members became excited, chattering away non-stop.
With the shaman’s strict order, the portly woman could only walk away disappointed.
Huff, huff! The two primitive warriors exhaled heavily through their nostrils, suppressing the urge to eradicate all the unsightly humans.
Meanwhile, as the two Demon God Puppets who had attempted to assassinate Glenn Clark and Doris Clark were still getting accustomed to primitive life,
Deep under a military base outside the Capital City of Eastern Summer, Marcellus Larry sat cross-legged, focusing intently on what was in front of him.
In the Crystal Faceted World, the expanse of purple-golden blood fog that had spread across a thousand kilometers had vanished, turning into a greyish glowing orb that resembled a world.
The majestic figure lying in the middle of the orb became more distinct, looking like an ancient demon with eight arms, whose every breath caused the entire world to quake with overwhelming force.
Surrounding this demon figure, countless Rune Sequence Chains had also disappeared, forming a dazzling and mysterious cluster of stars, with innumerable twinkling lights within.
As Marcellus Larry watched this scene, his anticipation grew.
At the same time, deep within the land of the Simon Empire, where the molten lava churned, the center was shrouded in cold mists, sealing the enormous Number One.
“Report, General Freya Louise and Number One’s Soul Sync Rate have dropped to 150%.”
“But the Mental Fluctuation compatibility has reached 98%, and the life magnetic field synchronization is at 99%, almost as if united.”
Elvis Louise, who hadn’t slept in over ten days, fixed his gaze and his breathing quickened: “It’s close, just a bit more. Keep monitoring closely.”
“Yes.”
As time slipped by unnoticed, three days quickly passed.
When an airplane took off to transport raw gemstones and some special medicinal herbs of the North State, the opening ceremony for the national Martial Arts competition in South City was also gradually unfolding.
“Dear audience, hello and welcome to the live broadcast of the first national Martial Arts competition. I am your host, Nina.”
“Today’s opening ceremony will be presided over by General Mathilda Ward and Her Highness Anstice from the Heavenly Feather Clan…”

﻿Chapter 1546: Chapter 581: Primordial God Demon, Six Domains of the Human Race in Ancient Times Chapter 1546: Chapter 581: Primordial God Demon, Six Domains of the Human Race in Ancient Times The national competitions of the three major empires were broadcast live, with high-ranking powerhouses stepping into the void at the opening ceremony, causing anomalies between Heaven and Earth, with thunder flashing and the Great Sun crossing the sky.
Such a grand spectacle naturally attracted countless viewers.
Among them were two men on a transport plane heading toward the border city of the Eastern Summer Empire, both wearing black suits, their rugged faces resembling gorillas, with dark skin.
Airplanes now are different from the past; mobile phones no longer need to be switched to airplane mode.
However, the gaze of the two dark-skinned men was not on the opening ceremony but on the blonde girl on the tribune, her head crowned with a halo, and behind her, three pairs of white light wings.
“Heavenly Feather Main God!”
The burly man with three dreadlocks in his hair condensed his gaze and whispered, “What’s going on? Wasn’t it said that there were only two Mythical Kings on the Blue Star?”
The backward nature of the North State Tribe and the international disconnection meant they hadn’t seen the city news from South City three days ago.
The other dark-skinned man spoke in a deep voice, “Something unexpected must have happened; let’s look it up.”
Quickly, the two men found the report about Heavenly Feather Main God Anstice’s visit three days ago using the network, and immediately, their expressions turned solemn.
Having a powerhouse comparable to a Great Demon King watching the competition increased the difficulty of their assassination plan against Glenn Clark.
As a Main God, just a thought from Anstice would allow her Divine Soul Thought to cover thousands of kilometers, with her Law Power and figure instantly arriving upon extension.
Therefore, if they chose to continue with the assassination of Glenn Clark, they would only get one chance to make their move.
And once they took action, whether successful or not, they would not be able to escape.
As the two burly men hesitated, a touch of black light flashed in the depths of their eyes, and the man with three dreadlocks slowly said.
“After getting off the plane, I’ll make an excuse to visit the ‘Divine Martial Sky King’s’ alma mater and take a high-speed train to Mist River City.”
“You continue with the original plan and take another vehicle to South City to watch the national Martial Arts competition. We’ll contact each other using a code and strike at the same time.”
The other dark-skinned man nodded slightly.
Meanwhile, in the largest stadium in South City, while the lively opening ceremony was underway, two breathtakingly beautiful figures on the rostrum were conversing in low voices.
“Your Excellency Anstice, the youth sitting in the first row of the Martial Arts Arena, with three girls standing behind him, is Glenn Clark, the brother of Jack Clark.”
The blonde girl, akin to a seraph, turned her gaze toward Glenn Clark. Her eyes immediately revealed surprise because, in her perception, Glenn Clark’s aura was only at the Fifth Tier.
That level of strength was not even as strong as an ordinary soldier of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
“The brother of the Divine Martial Emperor, how come he’s so weak?”
Ilisa Ward smiled slightly, “Our Human Race is different from the Nobles; most of us are not Transcendent Life Forms, and in the past, we could only begin cultivation after sixteen.”
“Despite Glenn Clark’s strength being only at the Fifth Layer Heaven, considering that he has been cultivating for just over three months, it is like he has become a Fifth Tier Transcendent in just three Great Sun cycles from an ordinary life.”
“This cultivation speed is even faster than Jack Clark’s in the past. I remember it took Jack Clark over five months to reach the Fifth Layer Heaven.”
Anstice paused, “…I almost forgot, the Nobles have only recently integrated into the Vast World.”
Thinking of Jack Clark’s achievement of becoming a Main God-level entity in a little over ten Sun Wheel cycles, with combat prowess comparable to a Divine King, Anstice showed a shocked expression on her face.
“Does this mean that the Divine Martial Emperor’s brother has an even higher talent than he does?”
“We can’t say that,” Ilisa Ward shook her head slightly, “When Jack Clark began his cultivation, he had no resources to help him, and was physically weak with mediocre family conditions; his starting point was very poor.”
“Whereas Glenn Clark started his cultivation when Jack Clark had already become a Mythical King of our clan, and the difference in status, identity, and resource allocation is like day and night.”
Anstice pondered and nodded her head.
With Jack Clark’s current achievements and talent, he could be said to be unrivaled throughout the ages, even regarded by many as not inferior to those seven Civilization Emperors of Ancient Civilizations who had broken free from their shackles.
Therefore, while Glenn Clark’s talent seems exaggerated, in the eyes of all kings and Heavenly Kings, he still ranks below Jack Clark by one level.
Of course, although Glenn Clark is a bit behind Jack Clark, his talent is actually quite terrifying, having been listed as one of the inheritors of Human Race civilization.
Especially his astonishing luck, which even made Marcellus Larry see shadows of Adam Garcetti in him.
Even Adam Garcetti’s luck wasn’t as good as his; ever since Glenn Clark started cultivating, it was either Divine Objects falling from the sky or resources delivered from the sea. Even walking down the road, he could find good things.
It was as if all the Luck of the Human Race had converged on him.
As the casual conversation ended, Ilisa Ward’s expression suddenly became stern, and she seriously said, “They over there probably don’t know they have been exposed, and even with you here, they will probably take action.”
“At that time, I will need your help to intervene.”
Anstice nodded, “Don’t worry, Miss Ward. The Divine Martial Emperor once helped my clan, so morally and reasonably, I will not stand idly by.”
The news about the Demon God Puppets’ attack had already been relayed back to Blue Star.
But to avoid startling the snake, the Federation remained inactive as if they were unaware of their presence, continuing with their usual activities while waiting for the Mysterious Martial Sky King and others to return.
Sealing the Soul Source of Diorus was actually very difficult.
After all, Mythical Kings and Demon Kings occasionally have whimsical premonitions about potential dangers in the dark, let alone an existence of Diorus’s caliber.
Even though that strand of his Divine Soul Source was in hibernation inside the puppet’s body, if a strong threat was nearby, there would still be a presentiment.

﻿Chapter 1547: Chapter 581: Primordial God Demon, Six Domains of the Human Race in Ancient Times_2 Chapter 1547: Chapter 581: Primordial God Demon, Six Domains of the Human Race in Ancient Times_2 This is also the reason why Demon God Level existences are difficult to be ambushed; every time a Civilization Great War erupts, Demon God Level powerhouses face each other head-on.
Jack Clark, too, would sense something through his profoundly mysterious Heart’s Eye immediately if someone wished to ambush him.
Therefore, the return of the Mysterious Martial Sky King and others was merely a precaution; they would not take action proactively.
They were waiting for Jack Clark, who, as a master of Time-Type Divine Power, and also possessing the Divine Power to erase his own existence, was actually a significant restraint to Diorus.
At this moment, the opening ceremony below came to an end, and the hostess, a beauty, stepped onto the massive Martial Arts Arena, her voice filled with excitement, “The first National Martial Arts Competition will now officially begin.”
“This competition is divided into two rounds, the first round being a draw for matchups, where each person must fight three matches. Winners gain a point, losers lose a point, to determine the top thirty-two of the nation.”
“The second round will be knockout matches, one-on-one to decide the top sixteen, eight, four, and finally the championship match. We now begin the draw.”
As the hostess announced, countless names flashed across the big screen, finally showing two rows of Red Large Characters.
South Sky Martial Height’s Marcus Lindsay, Secret Martial Arts Institute’s Zhang Tianyi.
And just as the national competition began, in the Crystal Faceted World beneath the Capital City base, a wide expanse of a planar continent phantom, measuring ten thousand kilometers, was suspended in mid-air.
Within the plane, black Tornadoes reached from Earth to Heaven, shattering everything, and bolts of lightning, thick as tens of meters, exploded throughout Heaven and Earth like the ferocious roars of Thunder Dragons, their might terrifying.
Above this world of hurricane and thunder, a Golden-White Great Sun hung in the sky, scattering endless light and heat, dispelling the darkness.
At the center of this plane stood an enormous, towering, and intact Black Stone Gate, invisibly radiating a heavy aura that suppressed Heaven and Earth.
Atop the Gateway to Heaven that suppressed Heaven and Earth, sat a Demon God, thousands of meters tall, with three faces and ten arms.
The Demon God’s arms were positioned in front of his body, one hand pointing to the sky and the other to the ground, as he slowly opened his eyes, his gaze indifferent, cold, devoid of any emotional ripple.
Behind him, the eight arms still held the Golden-White Great Sun, the purple lightning spear, and the nine-layered Golden Door wrapped in black Dragon Patterns, just as before.
There were also black chains that reached into the Void, and a Grey Wheel manifesting the rules of Death.
However, where there was once an arm supporting the pitch-black door, it was now holding a Seal with a black base edged with some purple-golden patterns.
Inside the Seal, a hazy white orb slowly rotated, faintly radiating a terrifying power in hibernation, exuding a mysterious aura of primordial creation.
The remaining two arms were raised upwards, gently cradling the spinning Golden-White light wheel.
At this moment, the Golden-White light wheel appeared like a transparent, ‘blank’ world, seemingly empty, yet emitting an overwhelming and heavy sensation to those who beheld it.
After ‘four days,’ Jack Clark had completed his Transformation. He felt incredibly powerful, yet at the same time somewhat weak.
The strength came from the fusion of all his powers with a strand of Primordial Origin, culminating in an advancement.
Whether it was his True Demon God Body or his mastery of the Rule, including the Supreme Power Rules, as well as the primordial Rule still in embryo form within the Soul Emperor Seal.
At this point, Jack Clark’s realm in all aspects had reached the Heavenly King Limit, and he could take that step toward Transformation at any moment.
But the Crystal Faceted World contained not a trace of energy, and thus, after his breakthrough, Jack Clark lacked sufficient Heavenly Energy to consolidate, resulting in a realm achieved but internally empty.
To put it simply, he had gone from a one-thousand-meter glass bottle to a ten-thousand-meter alloy bottle, but the water inside remained the same.
This was even after Jack Clark, as an Innate Demon God, had continuously drawn energy from the Chaos Void to replenish himself over the past few days.
Moreover, Jack Clark had awoken forcibly this time.
Under normal conditions, he would need to hibernate in the Crystal Faceted World for several months or even a year or two, waiting to draw enough energy for the supreme breakthrough from the Chaos Void before awakening.
“I’m so hungry,” Jack Clark swallowed, feeling as if he could devour an Ancient Beast whole if it were placed in front of him right now.
Suppressing the intense hunger emanating from within, Jack Clark moved his thought, summoned the attribute page, and prepared to carefully examine the changes from this breakthrough.
But just at that moment, the grey mark on Jack Clark’s arm trembled slightly.
Immediately after, the surrounding Space-Time began to Distort, and from the depths of endless time and space, a strong pulling force was faintly transmitted — the Summoning of the Ancient Dueling Arena.
“`
When Jack Clark made his breakthrough as a Mythical King and returned to preside over the Eastern Region of Blue Star, he had once been pulled by a Time Silver Butterfly into an unknown space-time, arriving at an Arena.
It was a mysterious and special relic, enveloped by ancient rule forces. Whenever two duelers of the same realm were chosen, the rules would start to operate.
The only way for the duelers in the Arena to leave was to slay their opponent, and the rewards were astonishingly generous.
Powerful forbidden weapons of the rules, bloodline strength, and unmatched physical power—Jack’s rewards from that time included body reinforcement and a substantial amount of World Origin.
Thus, after a brief pause, Jack allowed that force to envelop him, and he disappeared without a trace.
At this instant, space-time came to a halt, and everything solidified.
Under the cover of that force, Jack felt himself continuously sinking, and, after an unknown amount of time, the frantic retreating myriad colors of light around him vanished.
Boom!
Jack, in a normal human form, descended from the sky. In an instant, the solid grey rocks in a kilometer radius shattered, lifting billowing smoke and dust that scattered in all directions with crackling sounds.
Standing amidst the rolling smoke and dust, Jack looked around with a calm expression.
It was still the same rough Arena made of giant rocks, now even larger, measuring ten thousand kilometers in length and width.
The surrounding mountain walls towered into the clouds, reaching a height of a thousand kilometers, with the mottled bloodstains on the edge exuding an even more terrifying aura.
Meanwhile, around the vast Arena, thousands of stone statues of various shapes, towering tens to hundreds of thousands of meters high, stood in the audience seats, emitting a subtle and terrifying aura that surpassed the ancients.
As Jack surveyed his surroundings, suddenly a cold, proud voice with a hint of surprise spoke up from behind, “This time, my opponent turns out to be a human.”
“Your presence here means your talent is not weak. I wonder from which domain of the Six Domains of Human you hail, from which royal family?”
Suppressing the intense hunger surging within him, Jack’s thoughts moved, summoning the attribute page, ready to meticulously examine the various changes of this breakthrough.
But just then, the grey mark on Jack’s arm began to tremble slightly.
Immediately after, the surrounding space-time started to distort, and from the depths of the infinite space-time, a powerful pulling force emerged, the summoning of the Ancient Dueling Arena.
When Jack Clark made his breakthrough as a Mythical King and returned to preside over the Eastern Region of Blue Star, he had once been pulled by a Time Silver Butterfly into an unknown space-time, arriving at an Arena.
It was a mysterious and special relic, enveloped by ancient rule forces. Whenever two duelers of the same realm were chosen, the rules would start to operate.
The only way for the duelers in the Arena to leave was to slay their opponent, and the rewards were astonishingly generous.
Powerful forbidden weapons of the rules, bloodline strength, and unmatched physical power—Jack’s rewards from that time included body reinforcement and a substantial amount of World Origin.
Thus, after a brief pause, Jack allowed that force to envelop him, and he disappeared without a trace.
At this instant, space-time came to a halt, and everything solidified.
Under the cover of that force, Jack felt himself continuously sinking, and, after an unknown amount of time, the frantic retreating myriad colors of light around him vanished.
Boom!
Jack, in a normal human form, descended from the sky. In an instant, the solid grey rocks in a kilometer radius shattered, lifting billowing smoke and dust that scattered in all directions with crackling sounds.
Standing amidst the rolling smoke and dust, Jack looked around with a calm expression.
It was still the same rough Arena made of giant rocks, now even larger, measuring ten thousand kilometers in length and width.
The surrounding mountain walls towered into the clouds, reaching a height of a thousand kilometers, with the mottled bloodstains on the edge exuding an even more terrifying aura.
Meanwhile, around the vast Arena, thousands of stone statues of various shapes, towering tens to hundreds of thousands of meters high, stood in the audience seats, emitting a subtle and terrifying aura that surpassed the ancients.
As Jack surveyed his surroundings, suddenly a cold, proud voice with a hint of surprise spoke up from behind, “This time, my opponent turns out to be a human.”
“Your presence here means your talent is not weak. I wonder from which domain of the Six Domains of Human you hail, from which royal family?”
“`

﻿Chapter 1548: Chapter 582 Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God Chapter 1548: Chapter 582 Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God “`
Every ‘Person’ who comes to the Ancient Dueling Arena is an unparalleled genius within their own tribe, an invincible existence among their peers, possessing the strength to cross major realms in battle.
Moreover, once the rules of the Ancient Dueling Arena are in motion, only one individual can survive.
Therefore, the moment Jack Clark and the Golden Dragon Man announced their ‘true names’, they fiercely began to attack.
Boom!
Endless golden light burst forth from within the Golden Dragon Man’s body. Amidst the dazzling radiance, his figure swelled enormously, revealing the true form of a divine being tens of thousands of meters tall, with the head of a dragon, the body of a man, and four arms.
In his true form, the Golden Dragon Man’s entire suit of battle armor turned purple-gold, covered with mysterious rule inscriptions, forming nine solid halos of light, emanating a sense of solidity and heaviness.
In his hands, he held a ferocious long spear over twenty thousand meters long, wrapped in purple dragon patterns, with an invisible sharp edge circulating around its tip, emitting a pressure comparable to the Heaven-breaking Wolf Tooth Staff.
This was a complete Ancient-Level Divine Weapon.
Meanwhile, in one of the arms behind him, he held a golden divine seal a few hundred meters in diameter, where the dazzling golden light flickered, forming the phantom of a Divine Mountain.
The might of Nashigyas, now revealing his true form, was immensely terrifying. Endless Divine Light radiated from the Golden Dragon Man as the center, enveloping half of the Ancient Dueling Arena.
Under that intense, overbearing golden radiance, even the Heavenly Earth Law and the fabric of space itself were dyed gold, forming an absolute Rule Domain unique to him.
Roar!
Behind Nashigyas, pure golden strength converged, faintly forming a shadow of a divine dragon tens of thousands of meters long, as if forged from gold, with three heads.
Under the dragon’s roar that pierced through vast space-time, Nashigyas’s aura spiked once again, radiating a terrifying pressure that seemed capable of collapsing the Void and shaking the starry skies.
While Nashigyas displayed the true form of a Heavenly God, the world around Jack Clark was also submerged in dazzling golden-white light.
In the midst of the light stood an immeasurable, three-faced, ten-armed Demon God, seeming to cross dimensions, arriving with a black-gold battle halberd even more rough and domineering in his grasp.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark manifested his true form, the golden-white light of the Supreme Power Rules burst forth from him as the center. Wherever it went, space exploded and time and space shook and distorted.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The endlessly expanding golden-white light waves instantly collided with the Golden Divine Domain, and in the instant the two rule powers intersected, it was like two worlds crashing into each other, creating an earth-shattering rumble.
Standing at the center of the Golden Divine Domain, Nashigyas’s gaze became slightly grave, and his voice boomed, shaking Heaven and Earth, “Such an overbearing rule power – it seems that the True Emperor bloodline you inherited has reverted to its ancestral strength.”
“But no matter which Divine Realm you come from, or which direct descendant of the True Emperor you are, today you will be suppressed by the great Eternal Golden Divine Tribe.”
Boom!
Above the firmament, golden light trembled, as streaks of golden spear shadows, each tens of thousands of meters long, pierced through heaven and earth, raining down towards Jack Clark like a starry waterfall.
These spear shadows, seemingly forged from gold, were incredibly powerful. Below their tips, space shattered layer by layer like a mirror, forming golden meteors that tore through the void.
“Get lost!”
With a mighty roar, Jack Clark swept the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd wrapped in the power of Supreme Power Rules, forming an invisible force that became a towering, world-penetrating golden-white halberd radiance.
Compared to when he had just made his breakthrough into the Heavenly King Realm and was forming the rudimentary rules, Jack Clark could now freely command the might of the Supreme Power rules.
Bang, bang, bang!!
Under the stirring of the sky-high, tens of thousands of meters long golden-white halberd radiance, the myriad golden spear shadows exploded, annihilating the void within thousands of kilometers, forming a colossal vortex of dark destruction.
Just as the world-piercing halberd radiance shattered the void, both Rule Domains vibrated, and two streaks of golden light had already burst out.
In that terrifying speed, time itself seemed to pause, leaving only the four-armed dragon man radiating endless golden light, and the ten-armed Demon God with the halberd splitting the heavens.
Wrapped in golden-white rules, the battle halberd shattered space-time and crossed with the Golden Long Spear laden with the Intention of Slaying God.
Boom!
In that instant, an indescribable force erupted, emitting a blinding radiance. Under the extreme ferocity of the force, both the laws of Heaven and Earth and the fabric of space itself instantly collapsed.
From afar, it looked as if a rapidly expanding black hole had emerged, with a center that radiated dazzling golden light.
At the same time, a terrifying reverberation of power erupted. Nashigyas, holding the God-slaying long spear, felt his arms tremble and his figure sink, as the land beneath him collapsed for thousands of kilometers.
Boom! Countless gray rocks around Nashigyas shot up into the sky, as smoke and dust billowed.
It was only because the space of the Ancient Dueling Arena was solid, tens of times more so than the outside world, and also due to the suppression from the Golden Rule Domain that the shockwaves of this attack did not obliterate tens of thousands of kilometers.
Nashigyas’s face changed slightly, “Such strong power!”
But that was not enough. Just then, the unflinching Jack Clark’s arms swelled as he released an even more overbearing and powerful burst of strength.
Boom!
With a forceful push of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, the ground under Nashigyas’s feet crumbled once again, the golden-themed space around them shattered, revealing massive cracks.
His strength hadn’t reached its limit!? Disbelief filled Nashigyas’s eyes.
As a member of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, they were known for their formidable true forms, and every ‘person’ of the Eternal Divine Clan had a physique comparable to that of the same-tiered Giant Beasts upon breaking through into the Legendary Realm.
And as an unparalleled genius who had awakened the bloodline of a Heavenly God, although only half a step into the Divine King Realm, his pure physical strength was comparable to a mid-stage Giant Beast from ancient times, infinitely strong, capable of shaking the starry heavens.
Yet now, manifesting his true form as a Heavenly God, he was being suppressed by a member of the Human Race who excelled in the rule of law, even in terms of true form strength.
“`

﻿Chapter 1549: Chapter 582 Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God_2 Chapter 1549: Chapter 582 Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God_2 “`
“Impossible!”
Nashigyas roared, his body emitting a dazzling golden radiance, and the three golden Divine Dragon shadows circling behind him let out a dragon’s roar before suddenly charging into his body.
Boom! Nashigyas’s muscles swelled to double their size, resembling a super strongman, and the strength within his body exploded nearly tenfold in an instant.
Under the overwhelming strength, even Jack Clark, holding the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, was repelled, and he took a step back involuntarily, his heavy footsteps stirring up a tsunami-like surge of the air.
“Human, come again.” Nashigyas, with his strength bursting, bellowed as the Golden Divine Spear in his hand swept through heaven and earth, transforming into a sky filled with spear shadows lunging at Jack Clark.
Under the mighty force, all things perished, like a thick sheet of the destructive world pressing down on Jack Clark.
What welcomed this world-ending strike was the Black-gold battle halberd, enshrouded in darkness and entwined by Golden-White rules, falling with a speed surpassing that of time itself.
Boom, boom, boom!!
At a terrifying speed, the two exchanged tens of thousands of blows in an instant, each containing the power to horizontally push through a boundary, shaking space-time, nearly blowing up the entire Ancient Dueling Arena.
If not for the strong ancient rules surrounding it, even the Dueling Ground itself might have been sent flying by the two combatants.
And even with the ancient rules as a barrier, some remnants of the shockwaves still pierced through the Dueling Ground, hitting the petrified statues in the audience seats, causing tiny cracks to emerge on two of the statues that stood tens of thousands of meters tall.
Roar, roar!!
The moment those cracks appeared, a vague roar echoed from within the statues, followed by a terrifying aura that seemed to awaken something dreadful.
But just then, atop the empty main seat of the Dueling Ground, a force endowed with a supreme aura descended.
Boom!
The two shaking statues solidified, and the visible cracks on their surfaces vanished as quickly as they had appeared, while the two battling sources of radiance in the Dueling Ground abruptly separated.
“Human, take this strike, the Golden Light Wheel, from me.”
Along with a long howl, a light wheel with a diameter of a thousand kilometers rose from the Golden Divine Domain, like a Divine Wheel tearing apart heaven and earth to annihilate everything.
Under that invisibly sharp aura, the Golden-White radiance that shrouded half of the firmament was silently torn apart, spreading into a pitch-black abyss.
At this moment, Jack Clark, standing with the halberd, let the Golden-White Light sphere in one of his eight hands blaze with brilliance.
With Jack Clark’s realm reaching the limit of a Heavenly King and the rules becoming complete, his once Demon God Battle Skill of Divine Power also fully materialized into an accompanying ‘artifact.’
Now, as the World-Destroying Great Sun unfolded, it was like a sun with a diameter of three thousand kilometers, churning with endless liquid Golden-White flames within, radiating a terrifying heat capable of scorching heaven and boiling seas, bringing about destruction of heaven and earth.
But the power of the Golden Light Wheel, infused with the strength of Heavenly God’s bloodline and Divine Power, was terrifying; its sharpness cut through everything, including rules.
The moment they made contact, the scorching corona surrounding the World-Destroying Great Sun, including the liquefied Golden-White flames, was silently slashed open by the rule-level sharp edge.
Seeing this scene, a hint of satisfaction flashed in Nashigyas’s eyes.
The power of Divine Power from his Eternal Divine Clan was the strongest force in the Vast World, supreme among the billions of living beings, and power beyond measure, crushing all heavenly and earthly paths.
But at that moment, the World-Destroying Great Sun emitted an even more dazzling light and even more terrifying power.
Boom!
An unending tide of Golden-White light erupted, shaking the entire Ancient Dueling Arena with the power of the sun’s nuclear explosion, a force that melted everything filling the heaven and earth.
The destructive power engulfed the rules of heaven and earth, shattering the Golden Divine Domain and engulfing Nashigyas, together with the purple-gold halo around him, emitting a roar loud enough to split the ears.
That was the might of the World-Destroying Great Sun, a strike capable of obliterating worlds.
Had this strike landed on Blue Star, it would have been enough to blow up the entire planet, the might of which was terrifying to the extreme.
Just then, above the raging and wild flames, a Grey Millstone appeared, spanning heaven and earth, slowly revolving and causing distortion in heaven, earth, and death, enveloping Nashigyas.
Splat!!
Under the illumination of the Gray Light, black smoke seeped from the gaps in Nashigyas’s battle armor near his neck, the radiant golden skin became dull, and an air of corruption and death emerged.
And that force of death, spreading along his decaying skin, crept into his body, withering his pure gold blood, the muscles shining like gold, giving off a putrid smell.
The Death Grindstone, becoming an accompanying artifact, was almost like the true embodiment of death’s force, its might terrifying, disregarding Defense.
But just then, the boundless Vitality within Nashigyas’s body erupted, frantically repairing the already rotting flesh and skin.
Suddenly, the spread of death momentarily halted.
Though the burgeoning Life Origin had staved off the corrosion of death, the intense pain of the decaying flesh still enraged Nashigyas.
“Witness me destroying your Divine Power of death with the Eternal Divine Punishment!”
Nashigyas roared, emitting endless golden light from his body, mysterious patterns appearing on his cheeks and forehead, resonating with a distant power in space-time.
Instantly, endless golden light pierced through space-time, forming a pure golden door in the far reaches of the Firmament.
Hum!
As the door to the Golden Heavenly Kingdom slowly opened, the Void filled with the whispers of billions of Living Beings, as if praising the supreme power about to descend.
In the midst of the song of the multitude, a golden long sword, stretching ten thousand miles long, appeared, passing through the golden door and slowly falling; everything it passed was crushed by the sword light’s golden power.
“`
