﻿Chapter 1550: Chapter 582: Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God_3 Chapter 1550: Chapter 582: Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God_3 At this moment, heaven and earth fell silent, leaving only the Golden Divine Sword, which seemed like a punishment from the highest deity, falling onto the Death Grindstone with a speed surpassing that of time itself.
Boom! The Death Grindstone suddenly sunk, followed by huge cracks appearing on its surface, making a crackle crackle sound.
Bang! After a brief pause, the Death Grindstone exploded along with the Eternal Divine Sword, turning into rolling grey shockwaves that swept across heaven and earth.
The raging power of death and the Eternal Golden Rule permeated between heaven and earth, accompanied by Nashigyas’s roar, “Darren Callum, take another strike from me, the Collapse of All Worlds.”
Roar roar roar!! The entire world shook in an instant, as majestic, eternal, and sacred Dragon Roars echoed through heaven and earth.
Behind Nashigyas, a shadow of a three-headed Golden Divine Dragon that blocked out the sun and sky slowly materialized, with twelve Boundary Phantoms appearing around the three rising dragon heads.
These worlds were like golden bubbles, existing in different spaces and times.
Roar! Amidst the raging tempest, a Demon God with thirty arms roared furiously, with the Purple Thunder Spear in the hands of the Demon God arms shining even more brightly.
Suddenly, a purple Thunder Spear made of pure light that stretched for tens of thousands of meters pierced through heaven and earth, aiming at the falling stars.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the terrifying force of the twelve Golden Worlds shattering, the entire Ancient Dueling Ground turned upside down. The Thunder God’s Spear was destroyed in an instant, engulfing Jack Clark.
The terrible explosion shook the cosmos, turning the Dueling Ground into Chaos, where heaven and earth were indistinguishable, and the Void was in disarray with space and time trembling.
After about ten minutes, the shadow of the three-headed Golden Divine Dragon that covered the sky finally faded slowly.
As the light from the explosion gradually dimmed, a murky Void filled with violent eddies appeared, as well as the shadow of the Demon God that stood in the Dark Void.
“How is this possible!” Horror reappeared in Nashigyas’s eyes.
Under its full-force Divine Power attack, Jack Clark was unharmed, with layers of diamond-shaped halos surrounding him, radiating an aura of indestructibility and unshakeability.
This was the might of the top-tier Secret Skill, the Absolute Force Field.
It possessed a terrifying Defense that ignored all physical layers, energy aspects, and illusions. Only an attack ten times stronger than the body’s limit could break through it.
In the instant of Nashigyas’s distraction, Jack Clark disappeared silently, appearing before it at a speed undetectable even by consciousness.
Boom! The War Halberd, wrapped in black chains, shattered the Void, and the invisible converged strength made Nashigyas’s heart tremble.
But just as it was about to defend itself, the black chains wrapped around the halberd suddenly exploded, turning into a black Radiance that swept through heaven and earth, scouring the soul.
The power of Soul Judgement ignored all defenses, rushing into Nashigyas’s body.
Under the horrific soul attack, even Nashigyas’s consciousness thundered and shook, followed by a majestic Dragon Roar exploding within its body.
Boom!
Under the power that contained a terrifying soul oppression, the black waves engulfing Nashigyas dispersed.
As a supreme genius of a powerful race, Nashigyas was armed to the teeth with no weaknesses, including a soul that had cultivated a powerful bloodline Defense Secret Skill.
But at the moment when its consciousness was shaken by the soul attack, the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd containing terrifying strength had already fallen.
Boom!
Under the Overbearing and terrifying strike, Nashigyas shot out and turned into a golden light that flew backwards for thousands of kilometers, slamming hard into the sturdy walls of the Dueling Ground.
With the strong impact of the force, a thousand kilometers of the stone wall collapsed, and huge web-like cracks spread in all directions.
The terrifying aftershock even caused the entire Dueling Ground to jolt violently, with colossal stone statues in the rear seating area shaking, and surrounding shockwaves whistling with a threatening force.
Bang!
The rubble engulfing Nashigyas exploded, and amidst the rising smoke and dust, Nashigyas, with his collapsed battle armor and body covered in cracks, slowly walked out.
Looking at the far-away figure holding a halberd, whose presence was like a god and a demon, Nashigyas, somewhat disheveled, regarded him with an icy gaze fraught with seriousness.
This human’s strength was terrifying, with a True Body power that was overwhelmingly strong, defense that was terrifying, and continuous emergence of Divine Powers and mysteries, almost suppressing Nashigyas at every aspect, even as a member of the Eternal Golden Divine Clan.
Including that Overbearing Rule power, which was no less than its own Eternal Divine Strength.
Such talent and exaggerated fighting power were rare even in the Eternal Divine Clan.
With that thought, Nashigyas couldn’t help but take a deep breath, his eyes sharp as he slowly spoke, with a deep, humming voice echoing between heaven and earth.
“Human, your strength is immense; even I underestimated you. Next, I will let you witness the true power of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe.”
“Is that so,” Jack Clark said placidly, noncommittal.
Having roughly assessed the strength of this formidable being from a different race during their ‘brief’ exchange, he was now confident that he could suppress this member of the Golden Divine Tribe.
As for the so-called true power of the Golden Divine Tribe, it mattered not, for he had not yet unleashed his full strength, not even close to his Limit Breakthrough.
Just then, an indescribable mighty Power Explosion erupted from within Nashigyas, as if a supreme deity were awakening, and the whole person turned into pure gold.
“I, as a descendant of the Seventh Eternal Heavenly God, hereby declare in the name of the Eternal Divine Clan: I’m willing to become an extension of the Golden Power and obtain Eternal protection.”
“I am willing to carry the will of the immortal Golden Rule and become the earthly incarnation of the great and supreme Heavenly God.”
“I am willing…”
As Nashigyas intoned the ancient bloodline oath of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, the power of his bloodline boiled, and a Supreme strength from above the nine heavens was drawn forth.

﻿Chapter 1551: Chapter 582: Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God_4 Chapter 1551: Chapter 582: Dark Star Apocalypse, Eternal Heavenly God_4 In the distant firmament of the mythical world, a star suddenly twinkled, emitting a radiance that pierced through the endless past and future, forming a golden light beam that descended.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Under that golden light beam, layer upon layer of the Void shattered like glass, penetrating heaven and earth, with the phantom images of surrounding mountains and rivers emerging as if a supreme world was descending.
Crackle Crackle!!
With the endless golden radiance flowing in, Nashigyas’s body swelled monstrously. His scale armor bulged, covered with golden bone spurs, his four arms sharp as dragon claws, his legs sturdy.
In the blink of an eye, a ferocious Golden Dragon Man, towering over four thousand meters tall and with a length reaching over twenty thousand meters, appeared, enshrouded in golden mist.
Roar!
The fierce and ferocious Golden Dragon Man roared to the skies, its body exuding an extremely fierce aura of predation from the primordial wilderness, piercing through the clouds.
At this moment, Nashigyas’s true strength had almost increased a hundredfold, breaking through the shackles with pure strength and stepping into the ancient late stage, shaking the entire heaven and earth with his terrifying power.
As Nashigyas burned his bloodline strength, entering the Heavenly God form, behind Jack Clark, likewise, Nine-Layered golden gates emerged.
In the ‘hollow’ state inside his body, Jack actually didn’t want to enter the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, because it would place an even greater burden on his already ‘weakened’ true body.
But facing Nashigyas, who was also a monstrous and heaven-defying being, he could no longer hold back.
Boom!
The Nine-Layered golden gates, entwined with dragon-patterned chains, shattered layer by layer as boundless dark golden Qi Blood surged out, pouring into Jack’s body.
Simultaneously, the terrifying and majestic Dragon Roar echoed throughout the world. In an instant, a terrifyingly powerful force erupted, causing the Ancient Dueling Arena itself to shake.
The healing space around was completely blasted open by that exponentially growing aura, extinguishing like an ever-expanding black hole devouring thousands of kilometers.
At the center of the black hole, a figure towering twenty thousand meters tall emerged, with three faces and ten arms, covered in armor transformed from dark golden light, with long hair at the back like burning dark golden flames.
As the almost luminous figure descended, an immensely vast and profound aura filled heaven and earth, as if an original primordial deity had arrived.
Such terrifying might shocked Nashigyas, who had increased his strength a hundredfold in his Heavenly God form, then it turned to anger.
“How could this be?!”
“Offspring of a mere Human True Emperor’s bloodline, how can you be so powerful? Impossible!!”
Compared to Nashigyas, who drew upon his bloodline to summon the power of Primeval Heavenly Gods and transform, Jack’s aura in his Dark Star Apocalypse Form was even more formidable.
It also infuriated Nashigyas even more.
From Jack, Nashigyas felt a strong threat—a force more powerful than the bloodline of Heavenly Gods, severely endangering the position of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe.
This force was not to be allowed to exist.
Boom!
Intense murderous intent erupted from Nashigyas, like a Golden Divine Dragon bent on destroying heaven and earth, lunging towards Jack, the Eternal God-killing Spear in his hand shining brightly.
At the same time, the Golden Divine Seal he had been holding behind him also emitted dazzling light, with tangible golden Rule chains soaring into the sky.
Suddenly, atop that ghostly golden world, a massive mountain range as towering as Mount Sumeru appeared.
Instantly, a world-limit-breaking gravity descended, a terrifying force crushing the void and the heavens, overshadowing Jack.
“Begone!”
In his Apocalypse Form, Jack roared, his eight arms supporting the heavens; the golden-white Divine Wheel in his hands shone brightly, forming a light circle with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers.
Boom!
Under the boost of Supreme Rule Force, the collision of the golden-white light circle with the world-evolving Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder made the pressing golden mountain range tremble violently.
Under the clash of two supreme forces, huge cracks began to appear on the surface of the golden mountain range.
Meanwhile, Jack Clark had already stepped out amidst the shaking of heaven and earth, his terrifying true body bursting forth with a sky-obscuring, destructive aura in front of Nashigyas.
Boom!
Below the Eight Desolate War Halberd, shimmering like a purple-gold radiance, space-time shattered, the world plunged into darkness, leaving only the apocalyptic halberd skill demolishing heaven and earth.
Under that horrifying power, the entire space of the Ancient Dueling Arena exploded, generating a violent chaos airflow that swept across the heavens and earth.
“In this world, only we, the Golden Divine Tribe, are eternally invincible,”
Nashigyas let out an angry roar, his eyes blood red, like a Golden Divine Dragon soaring into the sky, clutching a brilliant Divine Weapon as he faced that world-destroying strike.
Under the space-shattering purple-gold War Halberd, all things perished.
Even the God-killing Spear, an Ancient Divine Weapon of immense sharpness and indestructibility, crumbled piece by piece under the horrified gaze of Nashigyas.
Boom!
The Divine Weapon shattered, followed by Nashigyas’ arms also exploding under that unrivaled domineering power, flesh and blood flying, bones breaking.
At this moment, Nashigyas felt that he wasn’t facing a deity, but rather a dark celestial body crushing all the heavens and worlds.
Under the terrifying power, Nashigyas spat blood, the void beneath him collapsed, and he was directly blasted into the deep void by that strike, creating a vast hollow.
Roar!
Jack Clark, like a god or devil, let out an inhuman roar. He blasted through layer after layer of deep space with a boom and lunged at Nashigyas, who was drenched in golden blood.
An even more ferocious battle erupted in the depths of the void in an instant.
Or it should not be called a battle, but pure oppression. Jack Clark, burning the origin of rules, had almost reached his peak state, akin to a strong man who had just stepped into the Supreme Realm.
Under these circumstances, with the power boost of the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, amplified by the shattering of the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate and increased by hundreds of times, his fighting strength was unspeakably terrifying.
Even though Nashigyas also burned his bloodline power and entered the form of a Heavenly God, he was still rubbed into the ground by Jack Clark, powerless to fight back.

﻿Chapter 1552: Chapter 583: The First Person of the Human Race, Two Major Supreme Rules Chapter 1552: Chapter 583: The First Person of the Human Race, Two Major Supreme Rules As Jack Clark held the corpse of Nashigyas and looked up at the firmament, the entire ancient dueling arena suddenly shook, celebrating the magnificent duel that had just taken place.
Immediately, an invisible rule power spread out. All the statues in the audience seats vibrated intensely, and terrifying auras interwove above the dueling ground.
At the same time, the rules of the dueling ground descended, enveloping the corpse of Nashigyas in Jack’s hands.
Whoosh!
The body of Nashigyas, still tough and strong even after death, suddenly disintegrated, turning into a sky full of blood mist that spread out and vanished.
This included Nashigyas’s battle armor, which was comparable to ancient divine weapons, the fragments of the shattered Eternal God-killing Spear scattered in the Void, and the broken golden seal that Jack held in his hand.
All of them continuously broke apart under that power and were ‘devoured’ by the ancient dueling arena.
This scene made Jack frown, as all of these were his spoils of combat, especially the somewhat damaged battle armor and the golden seal riddled with cracks.
However, the power that operated the ancient dueling arena was so strong that even Jack couldn’t detect it, let alone contend against it.
Therefore, he could only suppress the impulse in his heart to intercept and quietly watched as everything belonging to Nashigyas faded into nothingness.
At the same time, Jack’s thoughts moved, and he exited the Dark Star Form. His entire aura plummeted, his body shrank, and in the blink of an eye, he returned to his normal human form.
Feeling an even stronger sensation of hunger within him, Jack slowly exhaled.
At that moment, a fog of blood spread across heaven and earth. Under that rule power, it shook violently and transformed into hundreds of red and white rays of light that pierced through heaven and earth, fiercely merging into Jack’s body.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Jack’s aura skyrocketed in an instant. His body, previously hollow, rapidly brimmed with a formidable sensation as the strength of his mighty physique soared at an astonishing rate.
Beyond that, following his breakthrough in realm, the two rules that had been slightly trembling due to the lack of absorption of Heavenly Energy and insufficient condensation of origin now vibrated faintly.
Crackle, crackle!!
The space around Jack that had been sealing the cracks started to tremble again, splitting open into numerous black cracks that spread out like a spider web for hundreds of kilometers in all directions.
From afar, it appeared as though a distortion of space, a black hole, had formed in that area, infused with an invisible and terrifying extreme force.
When all the red and white rays of light disappeared and his aura had surged by more than a dozen times, reaching the limit of the Heavenly King, Jack’s face showed a satisfied smile.
This visit to the ancient dueling ground was quite rewarding.
The reward from slaying Nashigyas allowed him to skip the process of absorbing a massive amount of Heavenly Energy to replenish his true body and refining the power of heaven and earth from the mythical world to transform into origin.
Furthermore, the base strength of his physique also surged by roughly twice, becoming even more fearsome.
It seemed that the random rewards of the ancient dueling arena were adjusted based on the victor’s current needs. As Jack pondered this, the space-time around him began to distort.
Boom!
Under that rule power, Jack was directly thrown into a space-time storm. Surrounded by flickering multicolored lights, he rapidly approached a certain set of coordinates.
It felt like an eternity and yet a mere instant passed before Jack found himself back in the crystal faceted world filled with pitch-black nothingness.
At the same time, outside of the crystal faceted world, Marcellus Larry, saw that time had resumed its flow, Jack had never left.
Because the moment of his departure and return were the same instant.
Nobody knew that Jack had left and slain a proud warrior of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, even though his foe had invoked the Primordial Bloodline.
Feeling the urge to break through stirring within him, Jack gradually closed his eyes, and when he reopened them, his gaze had regained its calmness. His eyes fell on the transparent page before him.
This time, there was ‘no one’ to disturb him from viewing the changes brought by his breakthrough.
Jack’s gaze moved past the boundary that had reached the Heavenly King Extreme Realm and settled on the attribute of physique and strength that had surged from 158, 167 to→199.
It seemed that the limit of his physique in the Heavenly King Realm was 199 points, equivalent to the combined compression of 199 Heavenly Dragons, which couldn’t be broken through, even with the reward from the dueling ground earlier.
Including the faint Evolution Energy that seemed to come from across the Soul Channel.
Although it still melted into his flesh and blood, the overall strength did not improve a bit, as if it had reached a kind of shackles, or rather, the current gene limit.
“It looks like my strength and physique will need to break through to the Supreme Level in order to continue improving,” Jack mused, his eyes falling on the note underneath about the True Demon God Body.
Primordial Demon God True Body: [Juvenile form. Under the supplement of the Primordial Origin, the True Body which was once at the peak of the Innate Demon God evolved and transformed, ascending to the Primordial Demon God from the beginning of heaven and earth.
Primordial life exerts absolute dominion over the Heavenly Earth Law, innately aligning with the rule, passively influencing the rules within the body to evolve towards a more perfect and powerful direction.
Note: The process of Primordial influence on rule evolution will continue to consume a certain amount of Rule Origin.]
Beyond the evolution of the True Demon God Body, there were not many changes in divine powers and talents, which remained Top-tier Divine Powers and Senior Divine Powers.
Apart from that, it was the Demon God Battle Skill that had undergone significant changes.
Primordial Demon God Innate Divine Weapon: World-Destroying Great Sun [The Law Power materialized from the liquefied Great Sun Heaven-Scorching Golden Flame, which can release a hundredfold power when unleashed instantly.]
The World-Destroying Great Sun, transformed into an innate divine weapon, increased its amplification from the previous several dozen times to a hundred times.
Of course, this hundredfold refers to the power unleashed by Jack using the Heaven Burning Sun Flame, not a hundred times his overall composite strength – that would be too exaggerated.

chapters.title: Chapter 1553 - 1553 583 The First Among the Human Race The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1553: Chapter 583: The First Among the Human Race, The Two Supreme Rules_2 Chapter 1553: Chapter 583: The First Among the Human Race, The Two Supreme Rules_2 But even so, it was exceedingly exaggerated, considering Jack Clark, who had reached the Heavenly King Extreme Realm, now possessed strength far surpassing that of when he had just made a breakthrough in the early stage of Heavenly King.
In such a case, the bursting amplification of the Demon God Soldiers naturally became even more exaggerated.
Including the Thunder God’s Spear, the Death Grindstone, and the Soul Lock, which had also evolved into accompanying weapons, their might were further strengthened on the original basis.
Special Seal Weapon: Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate [Behind the gate, nine Dark Star Dragons are sealed, containing endless Qi Blood that can crush the Heavenly Gate and enter the Apocalypse Form at any moment.
With each shattered layer of the Heavenly Gate, the base strength and Defense of the True Demon God Body doubles, adding up successively.
Hint one: The Qi Blood sealed in the Heavenly Gate originates from the True Demon God Body. Under the vigorous and fiery Vitality, the Qi Blood that overflows every moment is sealed by the Heavenly Gate, compressed and accumulated.
Thus every Burst of the shattered Heavenly Gate requires a certain time to recover and to form the Dark Gold Dragon Patterned Lock Chain again.
Hint two: It can continue to absorb heavy matter elements, construct and condense the tenth Heavenly Gate, obtaining an even stronger Instantaneous Explosion]
Upon seeing the second hint about the tenth Heavenly Gate, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but widen his eyes in astonishment, his face revealing a trace of shock.
This mystery, forged from the Dark Star Rune, the Nine Dragon Rune, the Heavenly Gate Rune, and his own Demon God’s Body, using the essence of his lifetime Martial Arts pursuit, was already very exaggerated.
An Instantaneous Explosion of more than five hundred times the base strength of the body allowed him to possess a strength capable of smashing and overwhelming all, invincible within his rank, even within the Ancient Realm.
He hadn’t expected that under the influence of the Primordial Force, the upper limit of this mystery would rise once again.
Although he still had the Nine Layers of Heavenly Gates, if he were to successfully condense the Tenth Heavenly Gate, the Burst strength, with ‘one more time’ amplification, would reach an even more terrifying degree.
This amplification was even tantamount to mastering an additional Supreme Rule.
Whew! Jack Clark slowly exhaled, suppressing the excitement in his heart as his gaze fell upon the changes in the rules below.
Power of Rule: Supreme Power[A complete Supreme Level Rule, containing purity to the extreme Overbearing strength, indestructible, bulldozing everything.
Under the influence of the Power of Rule, the Divine Strength in the body increases twenty times on the original basis, having a more powerful suppression over the Heavenly Earth Laws.
Strength Amplification: Under the Supreme Power Rules, all mysteries and attack might increase thirty times.
Law of Strength: The ultimate Rule possesses the absolute property of one strength shattering ten thousand laws, breaking everything tangible and intangible between heaven and earth.
Supreme Descent: Consuming the Rule Origin, allowing the power of the Law of Strength to surpass its limits, smashing the world, and can be stacked with the Dark Star Apocalypse Form to achieve an even more powerful Burst.]
Primordial Genesis Rule[A complete Supreme Level Rule, the originally blank proto-rule, under the Doomsday Rule of Chaos, opened heaven and earth, giving birth to the opposite force of Primordial Creation.
Currently, this rule is united with the Soul Emperor Seal, and is in a semi-fused state with the Divine Soul. The Soul Source is slowly undergoing Transformation under the influence of the Primordial Creation force.
Hint: This state is exceedingly special, one in ten thousand. It is of great help to the subsequent advancement to the Primordial, so please try not to interrupt.
Hint: Because the Primordial Creation force cannot be mobilized and is fused with the Divine Soul, some of the might data is unclear]
These are the greatest Transformations from the current breakthrough. The Law of Strength, after integrating the strength of five Higher-order Laws, has metamorphosed into a Supreme Rule, as Jack Clark anticipated.
However, even though they are both Supreme Level Rules, it is slightly inferior to the Doomsday Destruction of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
This can be seen from one having a thirty-fold base increase and the other a forty-fold base increase.
Even so, it still propelled Jack Clark’s strength over most Demon Gods.
Especially since he mastered six Divine Powers, among them Time Reincarnation, which is Supreme Level, the Top-tier open shattering and Absolute Force Field, as well as the four accompanying weapons and the Seal mystery.
Jack Clark estimates that his current Normal Battle Strength should be around the mid period of Demon Gods, approaching the late period of Demon Gods. Once he breaks through to a Supreme Level Normal Battle Strength, it would step into the late period of Demon Gods.
And that is as a Lord of the Empire with a World-class weapon from the ancient late stage.
If he were to shatter the Nine Layers of Heavenly Gate and enter the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, burn the Rule Origin, his strength should be no weaker than that of great Demon Kings like Tyris at the Ancient Limit.
“It’s a pity, now the amplification of the Dark Star Apocalypse Form is only on the base strength and base Defense of the Demon God’s Body; if the might of the rules could also be amplified by more than five hundred times, it would be enough to step into the True Spirit Level.”
Thinking this, Jack Clark felt somewhat regretful.
After stepping into the ancient level realm, the current limit of the human true body is still slightly behind that of the giant beast true body.
Unless the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate transforms into the Tenfold Heavenly Gate, then at that time, Jack Clark could also burst out with battle strength that rivals the True Spirit Level at the ancient early stage realm.
Alternatively, if he reconsolidates the Time Mark and merges with reincarnation, he could enter the True Spirit Level, or even stronger.
Unfortunately, all of these require time.
With a sense of regret, Jack Clark glanced at the other data that hadn’t changed much and then slowly stood up, a heavy and vast aura spreading from his body.
Under the terrifying pressure, in an instant, the entire crystal faceted world’s void began to shake.
Crack!
Without waiting for Marcellus Larry to open the ‘door’ of the crystal faceted world, a crack appeared on the crystal face, and then it shattered thunderously under Jack Clark’s palm.
Of course, Jack Clark did not completely destroy the crystal faceted world; he only tore a hole a few meters in size on the crystal barrier and slowly stepped out.
Suddenly, Marcellus Larry felt darkness before his eyes, and in his vision, the entire world seemed to contain only the silhouette of the black-haired, broad-shouldered youth.
Despite being only around 1.8 meters tall, he now appeared incredibly towering, filling heaven and earth, his unconsciously emitted oppressive might making Marcellus Larry’s soul tremble.
Suppressing the panic instinctual to his soul, Marcellus Larry spoke with a voice tinged with excitement and agitation, “So strong, Jack Clark, it looks like you’ve gained a lot from this time.”
Jack Clark showed a faint smile on his face and retracted the leaking strand of aura, speaking in a gentle and polite tone.
“The gains are indeed significant, I have now reached the Heavenly King Limit, and I can step beyond at any moment, breaking through to the Supreme.”
“…Really?” Although he had anticipated it, Marcellus Larry’s voice still trembled when he heard Jack Clark confirm it.
Because it was too exaggerated.
Today is January 10th, 2057, looking back at Jack Clark’s cultivation journey from the beginning, it has all added up to roughly one year and four months.
A year and four months, from an ordinary person cultivating to the verge of breaking through to the Supreme level.
Such a terrifying cultivation speed is dreamlike to even think about, and that’s before considering his exaggerated combat strength after reaching his current realm.
Before Jack Clark appeared, it was unthinkable for Marcellus Larry and other king-level figures that someone’s talent could reach such a terrifying extent.
“Hahahaha… Congratulations, Jack Clark, from you, I see a future full of hope for the Human Race,” overcome with excitement, Marcellus Larry laughed loudly, vigorously patting Jack Clark’s shoulder.
As for the gap in strength between them, the differences in status and all that was completely disregarded by him in that moment.
Looking at Marcellus Larry who was emotional and with eyes slightly reddened, Jack Clark just smiled slightly, allowing him to vent the suddenly erupting emotions in his heart.
From Marcellus Larry, Jack Clark sensed a pressure that had been held back for countless years, a fear and trepidation that was slowly dissipating.
Marcellus Larry, having been a peak strong man of the Human Race for decades and seated in the Blue Star World for many years, appeared to hold a high position, but the pressure accumulated in his heart was actually immense.
This pressure came from the vast, mysterious mythical world, from the terrifyingly powerful Purgatory Demon Race that could overturn humans if they so much as got serious.
But just like he said, from the now grown Jack Clark, he saw the future of the Human Race.
Jack Clark’s current strength had already surpassed Adam Garcetti, making him the number one strong man of the Human Race at this moment, but for his talent, this was just the beginning.
Possibly within a few years, the Human Race might witness the rise of a Civilization Emperor, or even an existence beyond kings, who would dominate an era and suppress the ages.
As for the danger of the Purgatory Demon Race, as long as Jack Clark was alive, nothing would be a problem.
As long as he exists, the Human Race survives.
Possibly within a few years, the Human Race might witness the rise of a Civilization Emperor, or even an existence beyond kings, who would dominate an era and suppress the ages.
As for the danger of the Purgatory Demon Race, as long as Jack Clark was alive, nothing would be a problem.
As long as he exists, the Human Race survives.

chapters.title: Chapter 1554 - 1554 584 Darren Callum of the Human Race Ten
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1554: Chapter 584: Darren Callum of the Human Race, Ten Thousand Years in a Hurry Chapter 1554: Chapter 584: Darren Callum of the Human Race, Ten Thousand Years in a Hurry As Jack Clark left the Ancient Dueling Arena, in a gorgeous Great Hall bathed in golden light far beyond in distant space-time, the air suddenly vibrated.
“Nashigyas has fallen.”
With a rumbling and deep voice that exploded, a beam of golden Radiance burst and disappeared into the depths of the Void.
Boom! Suddenly, the entire Great Hall shook, and endless golden light converged in the air, forming a dazzling set of Golden Dragon Eyes that radiated invisible True Spirit Level pressure.
The pure golden Dragon Eyes, filled with terrifying majesty, settled on the golden figure sitting cross-legged on the intricate altar.
“Taino, how could Nashigyas fall so suddenly? It presided over the Golden Ancient City, which is under the rule of Tugulas the Ancient God.”
The gold-clad deity of massive build sitting on the altar grimaced, “The death of Nashigyas is somewhat special; even Tugulas the Ancient God is likely unaware of its demise.”
As they spoke, ‘the two’ glanced to the left, where a plaque, as if forged from gold, had shattered, the image of Nashigyas upon it dimmed.
The deity on the altar spoke gravely, “Just before Nashigyas fell, the radiance of the great Seventh Eternal Heavenly God briefly shimmered.”
“And before we could light the life-mark to trace the cause, the great Seventh Eternal Heavenly God decreed that we investigate a person of the Human Race named Darren Callum.”
“Darren Callum, Human Race.” The Golden Dragon Eyes flashed with terrifying Radiance.
As the formidable presence uttered the three syllables of Darren’s name, a black gate within the depths of the eyes slowly opened, a terrible power piercing through the Void, following a predestined sense to observe.
Then… they saw nothing, as if this ‘Person’ did not exist in the world at all.
There was a pause in the gaze of the Golden Dragon Eyes, and the terrible will vibrated through the Great Hall, “Taino, are you certain that’s the human’s name? Why do I see nothing.”
“There must have been human experts acting to shield all information about that person, which is why your Eyes of Cause and Effect, Goulds the Ancient God, could not spy upon them,” spoke the deity on the altar with gravity.
“Moreover, the place where Nashigyas fell is the Ancient Dueling Ground.”
“Goulds the Ancient God, as you know, that place is most mysterious, where Duelers of the same realm must combat, with the victor living and the vanquished dying.”
“With Nashigyas’s talent, even among our Golden Divine Tribe’s current generation, it ranked within the top ten, possessing the makings of an Overlord.”
“Under the power of a Heavenly God, Nashigyas could even, at the peak realm of the Main God, clash with a Divine King of the ancient late stage without falling behind.”
“To still defeat and slay it under such circumstances, that human named Darren Callum must be unimaginably terrifying.”
“Such a being, who possesses the potential of an Overlord and a glimmer of hope as a Heavenly God, holds a lofty status among humans, and it is expected for even mightier beings to conceal information about them, just like Nashigyas.”
“If you had guessed this point, why didn’t you remind me earlier?” The gaze of the Golden Dragon Eyes grew cold.
“I hadn’t completed my sentiment when you, Goulds the Ancient God, already acted. How could I have offered a reminder?” the deity on the altar said with a wry smile.
“Are you saying that I wrongly accused you?”
“There lies my fault, and I fully grasp your feelings, Goulds the Ancient God, given that Nashigyas was your lineage’s most hopeful to step into the Ancient God Realm.”
After speaking, there was a slight silence between the two parties.
During this time, the terrible will within the Golden Dragon Eyes stirred, “I had once warned Nashigyas, that the Ancient Duel Mark was more harmful than beneficial to it.”
“With its talent and our clan’s resources, the feedback from each duel victory was, in essence, optional for it.”
“Regrettably, it ignored my counsel and treated the Ancient Dueling Arena as a Martial Arts Arena where it could compete with geniuses of other peak civilizations to refine itself and reach higher heights.”
“Past victories in dueling have blinded it, preventing it from seeing that in the Vast World, even the radiance of an Eternal Heavenly God cannot shine forever.”
After speaking, the Golden Dragon Eyes looked toward the deity sitting on the altar and spoke with an indifferent voice, “Tell me, did the great Seventh Eternal Heavenly God issue any other decrees?”
“The great Seventh Eternal Heavenly God merely informed me of Nashigyas’s fall, but no additional Decrees were given.”
“To inform you, Goulds the Ancient God, at the earliest moment was my initiative,” the deity sitting on the altar pronounced slowly.
“As one of the peak civilizations, our clan keeps watch over other peak civilizations and powerful races at our level, including the Human Race, which has risen in the last thirty thousand years.”
“However, having scoured information on the Human Race, no intelligence indicated the existence of a Monarch-level monster named Darren Callum with the potential of an Overlord.”
“Clearly, this person named Darren Callum is an unprecedented monster hidden among the human populace, cultivated with all their might by some domain to be the next Monarch.”
“Such a pride of a level civilization could not remain in obscurity.”
“Hence, I wish to formally declare this astonishing battle to the world and legitimize this human Overlord with the brilliant fall of our tribe’s prodigy.”
“After all, the clash between the two was fair and square, with no intervention from Monarch-level beings of the Human Race; Nashigyas’s defeat at the same realm indicates its insufficient strength.”
“Therefore, while we lament Nashigyas’s death, it will not affect the diplomatic relations between our clan and the Human Race; our clan will maintain the stance of non-interference,” concluded the deity.
“And as one of Nashigyas’s Ancient God lineage, it is most appropriate for you, Goulds the Ancient God, to address this affair.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1555 - 1555 584 Darren Callum of the Human Race Ten
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1555: Chapter 584: Darren Callum of the Human Race, Ten Thousand Years in a Hurry_2 Chapter 1555: Chapter 584: Darren Callum of the Human Race, Ten Thousand Years in a Hurry_2 Looking at the Golden Divine Tribe member seated on the altar, a cold smile emerged in the Golden Dragon Eyes, “Only you, Taino, would dare to convene a council and announce the death of my young son to the surrounding civilizations.”
Feeling the faint killing intent emanating from the Golden Dragon Eyes, the member of the Golden Divine Tribe on the altar spoke calmly, “Everything is for the glory of the mighty Golden Eternal Divine Tribe.”
“Of course, if you, the Ancient God Goulds, are unwilling to speak, I can ask the Ancient God Tugulas to do it instead.”
A frigid voice resonated throughout the Great Hall as the Golden Dragon Eyes turned into a sky full of golden light and dispersed.
Soon, information about a prodigy from the Human Race with unparalleled talent named Darren Callum, who possessed the True Emperor’s Qualification, spread throughout the periphery of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe.
This individual was at the twelfth tier of the Human Race, a peak, corresponding to the peak realm of the main gods of the Golden Divine Tribe, and had slain a member of the Golden Eternal Divine Clan of the same realm in the Ancient Dueling Arena.
Especially since this member of the Golden Divine Tribe had awakened the Heavenly God bloodline, their peak combat strength could transcend a Major Realm, comparable to a Divine King from the ancient late stage.
Such an exaggerated ability to fight across realms caused an immediate stir amongst the surrounding ordinary civilizations, including two peak civilizations that were hostile to the Human Race.
And this news also reached one of the Six Domains of Human, located at the fringe—the Flame Wheel Divine Domain—at the earliest opportunity.
“Darren Callum? Does our Human Race have such a prodigy?”
Amid the starry sky, ripples gently spread across the silver lake, and seated in a pavilion beside the lake was a black-haired woman in white and gold regal divine garb.
At this moment, her stunningly beautiful face was slightly furrowed, and her eyes, as dazzling as stars, reflected deep contemplation.
In the center of her forehead was a mark as mysterious as the Great Sun, radiating a faint halo, adding a divine and majestic aura to her.
Beneath the pavilion, a young man with a solemn expression and a scar on his face respectfully lowered his head and reported.
“Lord of the Palace, I have checked. This person should not be from our Flame Wheel Dynasty, and even his name is a forgery, likely a Divine Child from some other Imperial Dynasty or empire.”
“Then why have you come to me, Arthur?”
The scar-faced young man replied respectfully, “I have other matters to report to you, my Lord. The information about Darren Callum was just in passing.”
“As I came here, I encountered the Lord of the Imperial Dynasty’s Heaven Observation Hall. Since our own Heaven Observation Hall has information from all directions, he asked us to help look into this person’s background.”
“The Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall, the eighth prince, what is his interest in this?” inquired the woman with the Great Sun mark on her forehead, her brows furrowing again.
The scar-faced young man shook his head, “I do not know.”
“If that’s the case, then we don’t need to bother with it.”
“Yes,” said the scar-faced young man, bowing respectfully before continuing, “My Lord, the reason for my visit is to report news regarding the Vice Hall Master.”
“Sherry, has she found Brother Clark?” The woman with the Great Sun mark instantly straightened up, a subtle, terrifying aura flashing across her.
The scar-faced young man gave a bitter smile, “No, the Vice Hall Master only said that she sensed fluctuations from a Heritage Token she gave out thousands of years ago.”
“The core rule power within that Heritage Token can only be activated by someone from the Human Race.”
“But the location is unimaginably far from the Divine Realm, surrounded only by some ordinary civilizations, and the strongest one, a dark civilization, is not very powerful either.”
“Most importantly, that region shouldn’t have any ‘Person’ there, so the activation of the Heritage Token is unusual. She’s preparing to check it out.”
At this point, the scar-faced young man hesitated, “As for the news about Teacher Clark, my Lord, you and the Vice Hall Master have been searching for over ten thousand years.”
“But there has been no trace of him in the Six Great Divine Domains, not even a hint of his existence, perhaps…”
Boom!
A terrifying aura that collapsed the Void burst forth from the woman, shaking Heaven and Earth, distorting space-time, and interrupting what the scar-faced young man was about to say.
Standing amidst the radiant Divine Light of the Great Sun, the woman who presided over it spoke slowly.
“Although there has been no trace of Brother Clark in the Six Domains for ten thousand years, I believe he must still be somewhere.”
“At the time of his departure, there were powerful forces of time around him, distorting space-time. Perhaps he’s fallen into another time period.”
“Of course, there’s also the possibility that Brother Clark is like us, lost descendants from ancient times, and his departure was merely a return to his world.”
“Given Brother Clark’s remarkable talent, in ten thousand years, he may already have become one of the Primordial Stars…” As she spoke, the woman slightly lifted her gaze towards the distant stars above.
Unfortunately, she was still far from the Primordial Realm; otherwise, she would have truly wished to go and see for herself.
More than ten thousand years had passed, and she wondered what Brother Clark had become, as the woman’s mind once again conjured the image of the black-haired figure, like a Heavenly God descending.
She was Sara Williams, whom Clark had encountered in a Lost World when he was swept into a Space-Time Storm and fell into the past.
At that time, the Lost World was embroiled in Doomsday; the Human Race struggled to survive against endless hordes of Mutant monsters and Mutated Beasts, civilization was regressing, on the brink of extinction.
When Clark arrived, though his visit was brief, he left a deep impression on the first person he met, Sara and her sisters.
And before Clark departed, he also gave hope to the humans of that world, such as a modified and more powerful Ancient Techniques pointing directly at the Legendary Realm.
In addition to these, he left behind an altar with coordinates capable of contacting Ancient Civilizations, which he did not take with him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1556 - 1556 584 Human Race Darren Callum Ten
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1556: Chapter 584: Human Race Darren Callum, Ten Thousand Years Hastily Pass By_3 Chapter 1556: Chapter 584: Human Race Darren Callum, Ten Thousand Years Hastily Pass By_3 “`
And tore open a pathway into the mythical world.
With the inheritance of the Great Sun Cultivation Methods given by Jack Clark, the sisters Sherry and Sara Williams, already geniuses, broke through to the Ninth Tier in the Dharma Ending Age remarkably fast.
Then, entering the mythical world, they achieved a Mythical-level breakthrough and led the remnants of the Human Race in their quest to follow ancient traces, spending over a decade to reach this place.
By this time, Sara Williams had already reached the realm of a Heavenly King and was considered a formidable force among the rising ancients of the Human Race.
However, when they excitedly arrived in the ancient Human Territory, they discovered that among the Six Domains of Human, there was no ‘War General’ or anyone stronger by the name of Jack Clark.
In fact, there was no such person at all.
A millennia had passed since the world of ten thousand years ago, and Sara Williams’s cultivation had grown even stronger; she had become one of the Lords ruling over the Flame Wheel Divine Domain Dynasty.
Including those who had received Jack Clark’s inheritance, as long as they were alive, had become very powerful after a millennium.
Take the young man named Arthur with a scar on his face standing in front of us; back in the experimental relic, he was just a youth, following behind Sherry Williams.
Over the millennia, the sisters Sherry and Sara Williams had continuously searched for traces of ‘Jack Clark’.
This obsession was something many found incomprehensible, including Arthur and others. In their view, Jack Clark might have perished in the vast stretch of time.
Otherwise, with the strength and talent he displayed back then, his name would have shaken Heaven and Earth long ago in a span of ten thousand years.
…
“Roasted sweet potatoes, roasted sweet potatoes, cooked slowly with coal, absolutely no trace of boiling; don’t believe it? Buy one to see.”
“Buy one and you won’t be disappointed, buy one and you won’t be cheated…”
In Mist River City, not far from the Clark family house, on the roadside, a roasted sweet potato stall blares out the sales pitch over and over through a speaker.
In front of the roasted sweet potato stall, where a large and rough-looking Violent Dragon King, Kavadola, was sitting on a small stool, yawning due to boredom as there was little business at around five in the afternoon.
Just then, a black-haired young man appeared silently at the street corner, walking towards the stall with a calm and unhurried demeanor.
Some pedestrians on the Pedestrian Walkway passed by from time to time, but they seemed not to notice the young man with a dignified countenance and a noble aura.
Even the Violent Dragon King Kavadola only ‘saw’ him when the young man reached his front, causing his face to change drastically as he suddenly stood up excitedly.
“King, you’ve returned,” Kavadola exclaimed.
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “How’s everything been recently? No issues, I hope?”
Knowing what he was asking about, Kavadola replied respectfully, “No abnormalities, very safe, including those around the king currently under my surveillance.”
“Alright, that’s good.”
Aside from preventing attacks from different races and the Evil God Sect Cultists, Kavadola’s existence was also to monitor any possible ‘traitors’.
At that moment, Jack Clark casually said, “By the way, there might be an enemy coming to Mist River City later, targeting my mother. Keep an eye out.”
Just after breaking through, Marcellus Larry told Jack Clark about the Demon God Puppets, including the fact that two of them had taken a high-speed train in the morning.
Therefore, Jack Clark directly distorted space and returned to Mist River City.
As for his brother Glenn Clark, Jack Clark did not pay much mind. With Mathilda Ward and Anstice present, and knowing about the enemy, if anything were to happen, that would be a joke.
After all, two entities merely at the Nine Demonic Marks Realm, at most bursting with the power of a Mythical King, could be suppressed with the flick of a wrist.
After a brief exchange, Jack Clark took a step and vanished at the end of the street in the blink of an eye, leaving behind the solemn-faced Violent Dragon King.
At that moment, Kavadola was somewhat excited.
Finally, an enemy had set their sights on the king’s family. It, the great Violent Dragon King Kavadola, would finally have its day of glory.
No one knew how long it had waited for this day; it was not easy, and to show appreciation, it must smash the upcoming foe into mincemeat with a single blow.
Since it wasn’t yet time to prepare dinner, outside the Clark family courtyard, by the roadside, Doris Clark was chatting with two middle-aged women from the neighborhood.
Due to Jack Clark’s influence, the houses near his home had become the most expensive ‘property’ in Mist River City, with prices per square meter reaching the staggering sum of a million.
And still, they were without buyers even at such prices.
The current street, apart from the early homes covertly acquired by the officials to protect Jack Clark’s family, consisted of courtyards snapped up by some quick-reacting tycoons for exorbitant amounts, while no other homeowners had sold their properties.
Even though some of these people earned only a few thousand or ten to twenty thousand a month, they resisted the temptation of selling for tens or even hundreds of millions.
After all, this was the home of the First Genius of the Human Race, under the Heavenly Martial Divine Emperor’s protection. As long as their descendants could have even the slightest connection with him, it meant endless wealth and honor.
“Jenny, did you watch your son Glenn’s match this morning?” one asked.
Doris Clark chuckled and nodded, “I did, it went well. Tiger’s first opponent wasn’t very strong, so he managed to win fortunately.”
Instantly, one of the elegant middle-aged women shook her head, “Jenny, you’re too modest. Your son Glenn’s opponent was the number one genius of Northern Shepherd Province; winning was no small feat, not just luck.”
“Yes, that young man Glenn is really impressive. One punch and the whole Martial Arts Arena was blown to smithereens. He truly deserves to be an advanced cultivator.”
“Oh, you’re exaggerating,” Doris Clark quickly played it down.
As Doris Clark was modestly brushing off her neighbors’ compliments, a smile tugging at the corner of her eyes, Jack Clark turned the corner and called out from a distance.
“Mom.”
“Jack,” seeing her suddenly returning son, Doris Clark first froze, then a radiant smile spread across her face.
The two middle-aged women became slightly nervous, watching the approaching young man with his warm smile, feeling constrained and in awe.
“Divine, Divine Martial Emperor.”
“Heavenly Martial Divine King?”
Facing the two somewhat ‘unfamiliar’ middle-aged women, Jack Clark nodded with a smile, “Ladies, no need to be so formal.”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1557 - 1557 585 Suppressing with a Backhand Freya
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1557: Chapter 585: Suppressing with a Backhand, Freya Louise’s Breakthrough Chapter 1557: Chapter 585: Suppressing with a Backhand, Freya Louise’s Breakthrough Gwen Gail and Marcus Lindsay’s mom were just a small interlude, although it was somewhat unexpected for Jack Clark.
As Jack Clark suddenly returned, the two middle-aged women greeted him nervously and then took the excuse of going back to cook dinner to leave.
Walking into the courtyard, Jack casually asked, “Mom, wasn’t Tiger going to South City to participate in the national competition? Didn’t you go to cheer him on?”
“No time.”
Doris Clark shook her head: “Metal Company has been very busy recently, with the workshops below running three shifts non-stop for twenty-four hours. I have to help down there.”
The metal refining company she worked for was a semi-state-owned enterprise, primarily producing and refining special steel materials used to build the shells of inscription missiles.
Following two intense battles and the upcoming Civilization War, departments across the Blue Star were frantically producing supplies.
As the deputy general manager of the company, Doris Clark didn’t feel it was appropriate to ask for leave and be absent.
Especially as Jack’s status became increasingly higher, she felt even more the need to be mindful of her image, at least not to let Jack down, so she still went to work as normal every day.
Of course, her nine-to-four job was still under the condition of the Metal Company chairman repeatedly requesting her to finish work early.
As Jack was about to follow Doris into the living room, his steps suddenly hesitated, and he turned to look in the direction of Mist River City’s train station.
“So eager to come to your death.”
Within the train that had just arrived at the station, amidst the surging crowd exiting the doors, a 2-meter-tall man in a black suit with dark skin from the Northern Continent stood out conspicuously.
His rugged looks were indeed reminiscent of an unevolved gorilla.
But in the current Transcendent Era, there were all kinds of people, including human-beast hybrids, so the people around him simply took a curious glance and then paid no more attention.
Meanwhile, the man posing as an original inhabitant who came to admire South Sky Martial Arts School spread out a map of Mist River City in his hand, glancing at the marked route to South Sky Martial Arts School, and muttered to himself.
“It’s a bit late today; I should find a hotel to stay and go admire the great school that rose under the Divine Martial Emperor tomorrow.”
Under the watchful eyes of the train station guards, the muscular dark-skinned man walked out of the station and naturally followed the map towards a hotel.
However, as he walked, his figure suddenly stiffened, and the space-time around him came to a standstill.
A dark chain appeared slowly in the Firmament above, blocking out the sun.
The invisible Aura of the terrifying power of the Soul Law swept over the city, visible only to those above higher order cultivation. The stronger one was, the greater the suppression they received.
For example, the Violent Dragon King Kavadola, who was prepared to make a show, was now petrified on the side of the street, looking up in horror.
Gazing at the black Soul Chains weaving through the Void, even a mere direct glance caused soul searing pain. A direct confrontation could instantly grind a soul to dust and obliteration.
Roar!
A roar encompassing terrifying majesty echoed through the Void; the black chains that shrouded Mist River City plummeted from the sky like a black Demon Dragon, piercing right through the dark-skinned strong man.
A the moment when the Demon God Puppet, infused with a strand of Diorus’s Divine Soul, had no chance to resist, it was turned to ash under the Soul Chains’ penetration.
At the same time, a transparent phantom figure, horrific in appearance and reaching a hundred meters tall, was constricted and sealed within the Void by the Soul Chains.
“Diorus, your attempt today to enter Blue Star and assassinate my relatives, I will find time to deal with you later,” said Jack, whose figure slowly emerged.
“Darren Callum, how could you be on Blue Star!?” Seeing the slowly emerging figure of Jack, the sealed soul phantom showed surprise and astonishment.
Wasn’t it said that the Blue Star was lacking in powerful individuals of the Human Race? Suddenly, a Heavenly Feather Main God emerged, and now the very target Darren Callum too.
At this point, even Diorus couldn’t help but doubt whether he had picked the wrong day to venture out.
Why did it feel like everything went wrong the moment he arrived?
Or could it be that those Giant God Sect Apostles were compromised? Had they already clandestinely allied with the Human Race, and this assassination was merely a trap, a conspiracy to ambush him?
Boom!
Jack didn’t bother with words, and with a slight press of his palm, space-time shook, sealing together that strand of Diorus’s soul along with the space, compressing it into a palm-sized transparent crystal.
Within the crystal, the transparent phantom figure of the Purgatory Demon God looked as though encapsulated in amber.
Just as Jack acted in an instant, suppressing the Demon God Puppet with the overwhelming force, in South City, outside the competitors’ residential area, another dark-skinned strong man’s expression changed drastically.
“Something’s gone wrong over there.”
Sensing the sudden loss of connection with the side of Mist River City, the dark-skinned strong man burst out with terrifying Power.
Boom!
In the center of the lakeside park with few evening pedestrians, endless Dark Demon Air erupted, and with a terrifying force, the pavilion was shattered instantly, and the whole lake was lifted into the air.
The strength of the Demon God Puppet, equivalent to the Ninth Heaven Peak in its dormant state, exploded with a terrifying force that instantly changed the color of Heaven and Earth.
But just as the rolling Dark Demon Air spread, like a devouring behemoth about to instantly engulf the nearby residential area and assault Glenn Clark,
“The situation has changed, take action.”
A roar containing the pressure of a Heavenly King blasted through the high altitude, darkness enveloped the world, and a massive earthy-yellow palm descended from the sky, suppressing Heaven and Earth.
Before the terrifying palm landed, the entire park sank with a loud crash, abruptly collapsing hundreds of meters, forming a crater spanning several kilometers across in the shape of a palm.
Within the crater where the True Body of the Demon God Puppet appeared, it was pressed into the Earth, looking up in shock and anger at the Mysterious Martial Sky King in the sky: “Mysterious Martial, you’re actually on Blue Star?”
Due to the seal over Mist River City, the Demon God Puppet was still unaware of Jack Clark’s presence.
Mysterious Martial Sky King’s gaze was cold, as he slowly said, “If you can sneak in, why can’t I return, and moreover, Diorus, do you think your information is accurate?”
Immediately, the Demon God Puppet’s expression changed slightly, but before it could speak, the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s face revealed a cold smile.
“Did you never consider why those Giant God Sect Apostles knew so much, including the specific location of Jack Clark’s family members?”
The words of the Mysterious Martial Sky King were almost akin to telling Diorus outright that those Evil God Sect Cultists were problematic and were pawns of the human race.
And the moment his voice fell, a colossal and boundless Mysterious Martial Phantom emerged behind him, aiming to suppress the Demon God Puppet and seal the Soul Source within it.
“Despicable humans!”
Boom! The Demon God Puppet roared as a terrifying power erupted from within, and an instant burst of Demon God Level pressure made the entire Heaven and Earth shake.
Seeing there was no chance to kill Glenn Clark, this Demon God Puppet, under the control of Diorus’s Will, decisively self-destructed, resembling an exploding black sun.
However, in front of the Mysterious Martial Sky King, the self-explosion that could have destroyed the entire South City and eradicated millions was suppressed just as it began to detonate.
From a distance, it appeared like a shrinking black Light Sphere containing terrifying energy, eventually leaving behind a crater three kilometers in diameter.
In the neighboring villa area, Justin Welan, Glenn Clark, and others looked up in astonishment, setting their eyes on the imposing silhouette of the Mysterious Martial Sky King radiating terrifying pressure.
“What happened?”
This time the Demon God Puppet’s infiltration and assassination attempt on the Blue Star World had not even begun before it was suppressed, appearing somewhat theatrical.
But for many, it was a disaster of epic proportions. A Transcendent Special Forces team from the Northern Continent stormed into a tribe, suppressing the sacrifices without delay.
Meanwhile, in the mythical world, the Purgatory Empire, Diorus, who was sitting in the endless darkness recovering from his injuries, suddenly opened his eyes, his voice low and icy cold.
“Humans, you all deserve to die.”
The moment the puppet in South City self-destructed, a strand of information crossed an infinite distance back, sensed by Diorus of the same origin.
And the content darkened his face, for this plan to deal with Jack Clark was actually a human conspiracy.
The few Evil God Sect Cultists in the Blue Star World had betrayed, coordinating with the human higher-ups to pass on false information and set up a trap to lure and kill them.
As for the so-called pleas for help from the Evil God Grayson, they were obviously fake.
“I’ve been negligent,” Diorus’s expression turned ugly, filled with regret.
It should have been more cautious, even if dispatching two Demon Kings to infiltrate the Blue Star with their Seal strength would have been better than fabricating a Demon God Puppet.
In truth, the simple loss of the two Demon God Puppets, including the loss of two strands of Soul Source, was not a big deal; he could recover it with a Rule Level Divine Object.
But what made Diorus’s face ugly was that he only sensed the dissipation of one strand of the Soul Source; the other had gone missing.
Even it could not sense the specifics, only aware that it was ‘still there’—the implication was self-evident.
…
After dinner, Jack Clark looked at Doris Clark who was cleaning up and said, “Mom, I have something to do and need to go to Simon for a while. I probably won’t come back tonight.”
Beyond assimilating and absorbing that Primordial Origin, Jack Clark also planned to go and see Freya Louise.
When he broke through and emerged earlier, he had inquired online through Roger Intelligence and learned that Freya Louise was on the verge of a breakthrough into the Legendary Realm and was beginning to merge with Number One.
If it weren’t for wanting to avoid any accidents here, he would have gone to Simon right then.
Doris Clark paused for a moment, then smiled and replied, “You’re so busy, which is good. Be safe on your way, Jack.”
“Yeah, I know, Mom. I’m leaving now.” Jack Clark nodded his head.
After bidding Doris Clark farewell, Jack Clark walked out of the courtyard and then disappeared without a trace.
Simon Empire, First Research Institute Base.
At this time, the surface of the entire base was covered with scores of thick cables, tens of meters in diameter, linked by enormous power converters and running deep underground.
Among these large machines, many researchers in white clothing were bustling about.
“Connection to Belo Nuclear Power Station Complete, power storage in progress.”
“There are severe fluctuations in the peak energy flow from Berlin’s Stuart Nuclear Power Station. Please notify them to stabilize power transmission, or disconnect if it cannot be stabilized.”
“Connection to Five Canyons Nuclear Power Station successful, power transmission beginning…”
And around the research institute, numerous Mechas standing tens of meters tall were on guard.
Especially one gigantic Mecha standing over two hundred meters tall, painted completely black, radiating a Mythical Breath, watched over the scene with a stern demeanor.
Just then, the space in front of the Mythical Mecha folded, and black-haired Jack Clark appeared out of nowhere.
Immediately, the Mythical Mecha paused and then respectfully said, “Divine Martial Emperor, you have arrived.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “Lord Tarip, what is the situation below?”
“Currently, Major General Louise’s soul fluctuation and life magnetic field have reached a 100% synchronization rate with Number One. Once all the nuclear power stations in the western hemisphere of Blue Star are connected, we can begin,” was the response.

chapters.title: Chapter 1558 - 1558 586 Freya Louises Breakthrough Eternitys
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1558: Chapter 586: Freya Louise’s Breakthrough, Eternity’s Exile Chapter 1558: Chapter 586: Freya Louise’s Breakthrough, Eternity’s Exile “Nuclear power station electricity for half a week, huh.” Looking down at the cables stretching out for hundreds of kilometers and disappearing into the horizon, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly.
The breakthrough for Freya Louise differed greatly from when he first broke through to king-level.
In the research of Elvis Louise combined with orbital computations, the moment she makes her breakthrough and fusion occurs, the originally incomplete ‘heart’ within Number One’s body will also be stimulated, completing itself amidst the intersection of Heaven and Earth within the Legendary Realm.
At that time, the originally bearable mental impact will surge tens or hundreds of times, and the power imprint from the ancient creature will become even more terrifying.
If Freya Louise cannot withstand it, she will be assimilated immediately, and the ancient creature will also be resurrected.
Nuclear power is used as a countermeasure, offsetting the Super God Energy within Number One’s body with the material energy from Blue Star World, the universe where Blue Star resides.
The research into transcendence and technology up to today has led Elvis Louise and others to realize the difference between Blue Star World and the mythical world.
This difference stems from the fundamental universal laws.
In the universe where Blue Star resides, the energy from nuclear fusion comes from the structural changes of atoms, instantly releasing billions of times the destructive energy.
However, in the mythical world, the principle of ‘nuclear fusion’ does not exist, and many fundamental elements are also different.
Therefore, those nuclear and hydrogen bombs need to be infused with Crystal Energy, simulating a material similar to cover hydrogen and tritium, to undergo fission and release greater power.
“I’m going down to take a look.”
After exchanging greetings with the Mythical King guarding above, Jack Clark arrived at the central door of the research center below, where the silver door tens of meters high began to glow faintly.
“Mental fluctuation verification passed.”
“Pupil lightwave scanning complete.”
“Identity verification passed, authority level matched, welcome, Divine Martial Emperor.” The electronic voice was cold as the door, ten meters thick and split into five layers, slowly slid open.
After Jack Clark entered the elevator descending deep underground, the door closed layer by layer, snapping shut with a click.
“Underground elevator will now commence. Some weightlessness will follow, passengers are advised not to panic.”
Whoosh!
The elevator Jack Clark was in plummeted at a terrifying speed, reaching nearly two thousand kilometers per second. Even with gravity field constraints, there was a strong sensation of weightlessness.
Of course, this bit of weightlessness would only affect the average cultivator.
With Jack Clark’s current strength, he could twist space and teleport wherever he wished across the globe with just a thought. However, there were still some places that were restricted.
For example, the underground base where Freya Louise currently was enveloped by a powerful spatial constraint magnetic field. Even Jack Clark couldn’t teleport inside without forcefully tearing the space magnetic field.
Plummeting almost thirty kilometers straight down, going through the thickness of the Earth’s crust, the elevator began to slow to a stop.
Puft!
The moment the elevator doors opened, a scorching wave of air surged in, evaporating all the moisture in the elevator’s interior air and distorting the view.
Endless fiery magma came into Jack’s view, along with the busy researchers on the shore and the thick electric cables.
“Jack… Divine Martial Emperor.”
At the control station, Elvis Louise in his heat-resistant suit was taken aback to see Jack Clark arriving. He subconsciously wanted to call out his name, but it turned into an honorific at the tip of his tongue.
“Uncle Elvis, you don’t need to mind me, just proceed as planned,” Jack Clark nodded slightly to Elvis Louise, then looked ahead.
There, at the magma’s scorching center, flowed a gloomy blue liquid that spread an invisible coldness, freezing everything.
Jack’s arrival excited Elvis Louise. With him at the helm, he had the power to suppress any anomalies that might occur during Freya Louise’s breakthrough.
Taking up the walkie-talkie, Elvis said in a heavy tone, “Let’s check all the current data again.”
“Reporting, nuclear power has completed charging, ready to be connected at any time.”
“Reporting, the biological fluctuations of Number One have completely subsided, and the subconscious instincts are deeply locked.”
“Reporting…”
As each piece of data reached an ideal state, Elvis Louise’s expression grew more serious, his gaze fixed on the giant mecha within the blue liquid.
Whoosh!
Elvis Louise suddenly exhaled slowly, then his eyes sharpened, “Let’s start. Open all nuclear power switches, pump it into Number One with full force.”
“First electric isolation valve successfully opened.”
“Second electric isolation valve begins disengaging…”
Hum!
As the giant circular electron switches opened one by one, nuclear power began to converge and transmit, causing the dozens of meters-thick black cables to tremble.
More than ninety large semi-nuclear fusion power stations, over eight hundred reactors, the electrical energy released at every moment was terrifying.
Such fearsome electrical energy poured into the body, and even Number One’s body itself crackled with flashes of lightning several meters thick, trembling.
Meanwhile, as the boundless nuclear power and the Super God Energy inside began to neutralize, the lights of the western hemisphere plunged into darkness due to the energy shift, causing massive blackouts.
And as the endless nuclear power and Super God Energy began to neutralize in the body of Number One, the girl wearing semi-transparent platinum divine mech armored battle armor slowly opened her eyes within.
“Is it time for the breakthrough?”
As she softly muttered to herself, Freya Louise, who had already reached the limit of Ninth Heavens and was ready to take the final step, no longer suppressed her realm.
In an instant, a power burst within Freya Louise, similar to a law yet different, and a terrifying aura shot through Cloud Sky.
Boom!
The sea of fire hundreds of kilometers in diameter raged as magma fire pillars erupted and collided with the cavern ceiling ten thousand meters high. In an instant, the entire world shook.

chapters.title: Chapter 1559 - 1559 586 Freya Louises Breakthrough Eternity
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1559: Chapter 586: Freya Louise’s Breakthrough, Eternity Exile_2 Chapter 1559: Chapter 586: Freya Louise’s Breakthrough, Eternity Exile_2 Endless, scorching magma converged at the roof of the cavern, forming a dark red vortex of flames, as if heralding doomsday.
“It’s starting.”
“Finally, it’s time to fuse with Number One.”
The trembling underground, all the researchers watched the data before them tensely, their eyes filled with anticipation and excitement.
This was the moment they had all been working towards for so many years.
In the midst of that sea of fire that could boil oceans, the silhouette of a mech that towered into the firmament and tread upon the earth slowly emerged, bearing some resemblance to Number One.
Only, this mech was white with golden edges, grand in appearance, and though it was called a mech, it resembled a Valkyrie clad in battle armor.
Above the head of the mech’s silhouette, a black-red circle with nine rings rotated slowly, seemingly connected to some horrific world, sacred and majestic yet somewhat fierce.
Roar! As Freya Louise’s aura made a breakthrough and met with the resonating Heaven and Earth, manifesting the vision of her “Rule,” a terrifying roar came from the distant space-time.
Boom!
In an instant, space-time trembled, the Void twisted, and a horrific force burst through the boundary wall between the mythical world and the Blue Star universe, attempting a forceful descent.
That force, spanning ancient times, descended from the distant past, forming an immense and boundless vague silhouette in the Void.
The moment the terrifying silhouette appeared from the past, Number One suddenly looked up, its eyes emitting a fearsome blue-white light.
Roar!
Number One roared to the sky, and in an instant, energy fluctuations comparable to those of a Heavenly King-level burst forth from within, the super god energy instantly suppressing the neutralized nuclear energy at its core.
Over eight hundred reactors released terrifying amounts of electrical energy every second, but still, they could not suppress Number One, which was comparable to a Heavenly King.
Just as Number One was about to resist and shake off the giant cables plugged into its back, another command that made it give up resistance came from deep within its soul.
Suddenly, Number One hesitated.
Meanwhile, in front of the colossal silhouette attempting to cross boundaries and descend, a projection of an empty, azure “world” slowly unfolded, emanating an aura of vast, supreme authority.
Seeing the sudden appearance of that azure world, Jack Clark thoughtfully mused, “That primitive azure sky, could it be the Firmament reflected in Freya Louise’s heart.”
With Jack’s insight, he immediately recognized that the azure world was not a breakthrough vision but a projection from a corner of a special world.
No sooner had the silhouette that had revived from the distant past appeared, it vanished into the Azure Sky World.
Devoid of the terrifying silhouette’s resonance, the struggle within Number One weakened, and under the control of Freya’s will, the strength that erupted within began to subside slowly.
With no further interference, the majestic silhouette of the mech standing from heaven to earth, absorbing the endless power of the magma flames, became increasingly clear.
Simultaneously, around the perimeter of the hundreds of kilometers wide Lava Lake, as the scorching energy was devoured, its edges solidified and cooled at a visible rate to the naked eye.
At this rate, Freya was projected to complete her breakthrough in no more than an hour, becoming the second person of the younger generation to achieve the status of a Mythical King.
However, compared to the terrifying commotion of Jack’s initial breakthrough to king-level, Freya’s seemed quite ‘ordinary.'”
Elvis Louise said gravely, “Divine Martial Emperor, the next moment is the most critical.”
“This time, Miss Flora has chosen to make her breakthrough on Blue Star to absorb the ‘energy’ of the Blue Star World and form a Mythical True Body unlike that of a normal king-level being.”
“This True Body contains traces of the power of our universe, which can weaken the mark of ancient creatures within Number One when fused.”
“Furthermore, if the fusion is successful this time, with three strands of the ancient creature’s soul already fused, Miss Flora will roughly become the true Number One.”
“Her path forward will be to control the further revival of Number One, absorbing more traces of ancient creatures’ power from the river of time.”
“The more traces she absorbs, the more complete Number One becomes and the stronger its power.”
“Then, we wait for the Second Mythical Impact when the collision of two universes will completely tear apart the Solar System we inhabit, and that moment will be when we stand our ground.”
The plan sounded complete, with every step under the control of Elvis and his team.
But including himself, they all knew this was just wishful thinking, for this time they were scheming against an ancient existence that had not yet fully fallen.
Such a level of power, the essence of existence, is beyond their imagination.
Jack Clark slowly nodded, understanding his meaning, “Don’t worry, Uncle Freya, there won’t be any accidents with Freya Louise’s breakthrough this time.”
The one who was just half a step away from reaching the Supreme strength was confident that unless that ancient creature itself descended, he could suppress any unexpected challenge.
Hoo hoo!!
As the massive Mecha phantom behind Number One grew clearer, the entire Lava Lake had almost cooled, turning into black volcanic rock.
And it wasn’t just the surface, virtually down to a thousand kilometers underground, the magma gushing out through the mantle cracks had all cooled.
At that moment, the aura of Mythical Transformation on the Valkyrie Mecha, which looked almost tangible, grew even stronger.
Boom!
With a sudden move, the colossal Mecha apparition dashed toward Number One and the standing, even larger Black-Red Colored Mech with the momentum of a mountains-and-seas shaking gust.
Hmm!
The True Body of Freya Louise’s Mecha spread out, dissolving into countless white laws and patterns that merged with the Mecha carrier, instantly lighting up the eyes of the massive Mecha.
Crack!!
The chest and limbs of the Mecha cracked open, revealing its hollow insides, and it dashed towards Number One, shattering the blue hard ice covering its body.
Without any accidents, the Black-Red Armor that stood over three thousand meters tall merged seamlessly with Number One, fitting like the right piece of clothing.
During the moment of integration with the Rule True Body, Freya Louise achieved perfection, her life and soul transforming into a Mythical Life.
Boom!
A resonance with Heaven and Earth, the formless aura of transformation shrouded Number One, and instantly, a heartbeat thunderous like the burst of spring thunder exploded deep within Number One.
In the past, this remnant heart that served as Number One’s biological core had been in a state of quiescence.
Now with the heart’s pulsation, an aura that caused everyone to palpitate spread out, accompanied by a fearsome force of absorption, devouring all surrounding energy.
At this time, the only energy beneath the ground was linked to the nuclear power on Number One’s back, together with the Mythical True Body merged into the exoskeleton, all were devoured.
The energy supply from over eight hundred reactors, coupled with the absorption and fusion of Freya Louise undergoing Mythical Transformation, slowly brightened the remains of the heart.
That ancient aura immediately grew stronger.
Within the dark golden radiance, numerous flesh buds began to grow at the edge of the incomplete heart, unleashing an even more powerful vitality.
Roar! Number One howled to the sky, its eyes releasing a terrifying blue-white light, its body swelling in size.
In the blink of an eye, Number One grew to three thousand meters and continued to grow, stretching the Black-Red Armor on its body to the point of creaking and even deforming.
When the muscles’ swelling strength passed a certain limit, the armor on Number One’s shoulders burst open, revealing the dark gold skin underneath.
Then came the arms, and the constricting armor on the thighs began to give way bit by bit.
Roar!
A terrifying blood-red light enveloped Number One, as it let out an even more ferocious roar, looking fiercely over at Elvis Louise and others in the distance.
