The intangible aura of Horrific Creatures instinctively struck fear into the researchers, a primal terror of facing a natural predator, causing their legs to buckle, and they sat down on the ground.
However, when Number One’s gaze landed on Jack Clark, the eyes filled with madness and cruelty paused.
But at that moment, Jack wasn’t paying attention to it; instead, he looked up at the hollow space above the cavern – as Number One ‘reawakened,’ another colossal phantom twisted through the Void, making a spacetime descent.
And at that moment, Freya Louise was in a special state.
In Jack’s perception, she had disappeared, merged with Number One in some form, her consciousness in a state of Chaos, unable to guide the massive phantom back to the Primitive Azure Sky.
Is this the so-called accident, Jack thought, glancing at the King-level Mecha that appeared behind him.
If he hadn’t returned this time, it would have been the King named Tarip who would have intervened, barring the ancient Will crossing barriers, yearning to return.
“The imprint of Eternal and Undying, I wonder if you can come back once you’ve been exiled,” Jack spoke slowly, his eyes revealing a pair of sky-covering Black Gold vertical pupils.

chapters.title: Chapter 1560 - 1560 587 The Giant Beast Unites The Demon God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1560: Chapter 587: The Giant Beast Unites, The Demon God Returns Chapter 1560: Chapter 587: The Giant Beast Unites, The Demon God Returns For an ancient will that had dissolved into the river of time, immune to vanishment even after tens of thousands of years, powers like the Death Grindstone and the Soul Judgement were relatively restraining.
However, for the sake of safety, Jack Clark still chose exile.
Boom!
Under the terror of his will’s power, the fabric of space-time began to tremble. The force of the Void unfolded, turning the entire underground into a pitch-black nothingness, depriving everyone of all senses and consciousness.
In the darkness, a pair of black gold vertical pupils slowly emerged, shattering the void wherever they gazed.
Boom!
In front of the colossal phantom that descended twisting through space-time, a boundlessly deep purple crack was torn open, emitting a terrifying suction force that enveloped it.
A roar, filled with rage and horror, pierced through space-time, shaking everyone’s spirit.
This wisp of ancient will, triggered by the heart of Number One, was incredibly strong – almost three times that which Freya Louise had sealed in the Primitive Azure Sky.
With the roar, a terrifying force erupted from the ancient phantom’s body, emitting dark gold radiance, rippling out from its center like circles upon circles of waves.
Boom!
The entire space-time folded and twisted under those dark gold ripples, unleashing waves upon waves of storms that tried to destroy the dimensional cracks, with a momentum that shook Heaven and Earth.
But the nearly boundless purple crack, which seemed to tear through the void and stretched over tens of thousands of meters, was equally formidable and remained unwavering under the assault of the space-time storm.
It was as though the crack didn’t exist in essence, still radiating a terrifying devouring gravitational force that shrouded the ancient phantom.
Roar!
Under the illumination of the purple glow, the ancient phantom, composed of mere Soul Will, was gradually drawn into the crack. In the end, only a roar of anger echoed through the void.
As Jack Clark consolidated the True Demon God Body, a God Transformation Level talent ability, the might of the Void Death Pupil also surged drastically.
Furthermore, having once slain countless Void Creatures and enhanced by the power of the sixteenfold Void Rules in the Ruins Continent, the power of the Pupil reached a terrifying level.
With all of the Void power expended in a single strike, even that strand of soul will, eternal and undying, was still exiled.
And this dimension was not part of the current universe, nor the depths of the mythical world’s world, but another dimensional space-time.
This ability, which was somewhat weak in the past, has grown progressively stronger along with Jack Clark’s own strength. It can eternally exile many creatures that cannot be obliterated for the time being, suppressing them deep within another dimension.
As the ancient phantom vanished, the space-time anomaly that twisted both realms slowly dissipated along with the darkness, and everyone’s senses and consciousness were restored.
Cooling down to normal, in the center of the land where black magma stone pillars stood, Number One’s figure had swelled to over four thousand meters.
The black-red armor that bound it was stretched wide open, its form towering and ferocious, seemingly inhuman, with a single horn on its head pointing obliquely to the Firmament, shrouded in red mist.
Beneath the stretched armor of Number One, the skin that was revealed was no longer dark golden, but golden-white, just like human skin.
Simultaneously, in its hand, there appeared a double-edged long spear that was over four thousand meters long, with sharp blades at both ends and a handle in the middle, the color of golden-white.
Mysterious patterns wound around the long spear, subtly emanating the terrifying intent of death and certain kill.
Looking at the Mecha Valkyrie standing tall at the center of the Earth, covered in black-red ferocious armor, Elvis Louise’s voice trembled, “Did it… succeed?”
Beside her, Jack Clark, with his long black hair over his shoulders, nodded slightly, “It should have succeeded.”
As he spoke, the terrifying and majestic black gold vertical pupils in his eyes slowly faded.
This breakthrough to Myth by Freya was threatened most by those returning undying wills, which contained information that could be deemed terrifying even as a mere strand.
These bits of information might embody some understanding or memories of that being, or the negative forces carried through wandering in space-time.
Under the onslaught of endless information, Freya’s spirit and consciousness would be instantly contaminated, her soul and body both assimilating as a part of that ancient being.
“So powerful, is this his strength?” Behind Jack Clark, a Mecha that stood over two hundred meters tall revealed a look of shock.
Compared to the researchers and Elvis Louise, who saw and sensed nothing under the shroud of the void, Tarip felt a close brush with death.
At that moment, the terror that filled the void was such that even the aftermath nearly shattered his Divine Soul.
It was terrifying, truly befitting the being that could slay even a Demon God, Tarip marveled in his heart.
And as Jack Clark oversaw Freya’s breakthrough until its complete success,
In the chaotic Chaotic Turbulent Region of the mythical world far away, a black gold Giant Beast, stretching over eleven thousand five hundred meters, stood towering like a mountain range, facing forward.
There, space shattered, the Earth collapsed, forming a stormy fault zone thousands of kilometers wide filled with Space Cracks.
Behind the fault lay a vibrant world, with mountain ranges meandering, mist swirling, and gigantic shadows flickering through forests of towering ancient trees.
Next to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, an even larger primordial Lava Giant Dragon with nine dragon heads roared, “Roar! Great king, surely this must be the edge of the Chaotic Domain, right?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slightly. With a mere movement of its colossal head, it set off waves that caused mountains and seas to shake, followed by a low roar that vibrated Heaven and Earth.
“Mmh, we have reached the edge of the Chaotic Domain.”
“Let’s go back, it’s time.”
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly turned around, its heavy footsteps caused space to shatter, unleashing a shockwave similar to a nuclear explosion, sweeping the surroundings for hundreds of kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1561 - 1561 587 The Giant Beast Unifies The Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1561: Chapter 587 The Giant Beast Unifies, The Demon God Returns_2 Chapter 1561: Chapter 587 The Giant Beast Unifies, The Demon God Returns_2 “`
By the time they reached this point, they had virtually swept through the Chaotic Domain.
This vast region, equivalent to hundreds of millions of times the size of Blue Star, fell under the dominion of the Dragon Palace Empire, where all mythical-level creatures either submitted or were suppressed.
This included various different races’ civilizations.
In addition, as they journeyed through, the Destruction Emperor Dragon consumed a great deal of resources, and its size swelled by several hundred meters from the time it devoured the World Star Core.
However, compared to its current colossal size, an increase of several hundred meters wasn’t very noticeable.
At the same time, on the back of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the silver and gold-blue Giant Dragons had grown another three hundred meters in just a few days without anyone noticing.
Besides, there were some changes in the shapes, and their auras grew even stronger, surrounded by solidified Destruction Ice Crystal Storms and the Roar of Seven Colored Elements.
Meanwhile, tens of thousands of kilometers away, a black and gray Giant Beast with wings spread, measuring over sixty thousand meters in length, stood in the Firmament, surrounded by terrifying gray currents that destroyed everything in their path.
A thousand kilometers below the Ancient Batfin, across mountain ranges that spanned tens of thousands of kilometers crumbled, strewn with countless centaur-like Giant Beast corpses, their blood flowing and staining the Earth red.
Three Batfish Beasts, each about twenty thousand meters in length, were locked in fierce combat with a rampaging Titan Giant Beast.
Each clash of the three massive Beasts, with their Law Domains swirling around them, caused ear-splitting roars and dazzling flashes of energy.
At that moment, within the scale armor crevices at the neck of a Batfish Beast, a token several meters in size vibrated slightly.
Woo! The Ancient Batfin issued a long, siren-like wail.
“Keldo, take that unwilling one down in two strikes. Thunderflame has reached the end of the Chaotic Domain, summoning us back to the Dragon Palace for a gathering,”
“Woo! Yes, my great king.”
In an instant, the three Batfish Beasts below roared, an even more terrifying power erupted within them, stirring up rolling gray waves that surged directly towards the Titan Giant Beast, ignoring its attacks.
On the Earth below, the Black Mountain Range, which stretched over thirty thousand meters in length and rose up twenty thousand meters high, trembled violently as a Kirin-like ferocious head roared, “Kutedora, Boldis, it’s time to return.”
In the distance, a black Kirin Beast measuring fourteen hundred meters in length and two Titan Batfish Beasts responded with a melodious long cry.
As the order from the Destruction Emperor Dragon spread, all Ancient Beasts received the command to return, bellowing out as they summoned their subordinates to begin the return journey.
Meanwhile, in the underground research facility, waiting for Freya Louise’s breakthrough to finish, Jack Clark’s wrist suddenly flashed, emitting a cold electronic voice.
“Incoming communication request from Sky King Denny Kaye, would you like to connect?”
Sky King Denny Kaye, Jack Clark paused for a moment, then chose to accept.
Suddenly, Sky King Denny Kaye’s voice transmitted from the smart wristwatch, “Jack Clark, while interrogating those Evil God Sect Cultists, I discovered traces of the Giant God Grayson. Do you want to come over and have a look?”
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, “Giant God Grayson, wait a moment.”
Saying this, Jack Clark turned to Elvis Louise, “Elvis, if there’s an issue with the Federation, I’ll check it out. If Freya needs any help later on, remind her to find me.”
After saying his goodbyes, Jack Clark didn’t wait for Elvis Louise to speak, his figure vanished in a flash as he entered the elevator.
As the heavy doors of the distant elevator slowly closed, Elvis Louise’s eyes were filled with reflection.
Who would have thought that just a few months earlier, that youth who had seen off Freya Louise had just broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, and then in the blink of an eye, he became the world-renowned Divine Martial Heavenly King.
Such a monster, indescribable.
In the Eastern Summer Empire, where Mathilda Ward once lay in hibernation, in the spacious white laboratory, a stiff figure from Northern Continent lay on the operating table.
Dressed in a white lab coat, Sky King Denny Kaye held out a hand, and a pale black Light sphere floated above it, with fragments of a soul hovering inside.
Gazing at Jack Clark appearing through the twisted space, Sky King Denny Kaye smiled slightly, “Here you are, Jack Clark.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly and asked directly, “Senior, the message sent from earlier mentioned Giant God Grayson was trapped in some relic. Have you found his location?”
Sky King Denny Kaye nodded, “I roughly know where he’s trapped.”
“This cultist of the Giant God Sect, though not powerful, held a faith in Grayson so devout he could call upon him from the shadows.”
“And when Grayson’s partial will descended along the cultist’s prayers and issued commands, the overpowering strength left some traces.”
Sky King Denny Kaye smiled slightly, “Grayson could never have imagined that I can lock onto his rough whereabouts relying on these residual traces in the cultist’s soul fragments.”
Jack Clark expressed his admiration, “Senior, your accomplishments in the Soul Law are admirable.”
Though Sky King Denny Kaye made it sound easy, as someone who had also delved into the Soul Law, Jack Clark knew all too well the extent of the difficulty, some of which even surpassed the scope of the soul.
Sky King Denny Kaye shook his head and laughed, “Your admiration is unnecessary. Actually, it’s more of Grayson’s bad luck. The main reason I know his location is that I had visited that relic myself.”
“But because I lacked a critical token at the time, I could only wander around the outskirts. I couldn’t enter the interior.”
“On this occasion, I’m seeking you out because I remember that it was you who killed Blood God Acunus, right? Did you get a special stone slab from him by any chance?”
“Stone slab, I do seem to recall such an item.” Jack Clark thought for a moment, then projected his consciousness into his Storage Bracelet and quickly found the fragment of the stone slab tucked away in a corner.
Looking at the grey stone slab appearing in Jack Clark’s hand, and the somewhat cryptic engraved designs on it, Sky King Denny Kaye nodded.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1562 - 1562 587 Giant Beast Unification The Return
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1562: Chapter 587: Giant Beast Unification, The Return of the Demon God_3 Chapter 1562: Chapter 587: Giant Beast Unification, The Return of the Demon God_3 “It’s this one, the Blood God Akunus really also had a piece.”
After that, Sky King Denny Kaye explained, “Last year’s suppression of Koroya was a large-scale sweep against the Evil God Sect, where we captured two high priests from the Blood God Sect and the Giant God Sect.”
“During the soul search, I saw fragmented memories from their soul shards of following Grayson and Akunus exploring that memory.”
“Combining the information of Grayson being trapped in the relic with the clues I have, I deduced that another stone slab is in Akunus’s possession.”
“Currently, Grayson has entered that relic, and having gained the opportunity, has already made a breakthrough to the Heavenly King realm, so I am preparing to go and deal with him.”
As he said this, the gaze of Sky King Denny Kaye suddenly turned cold, “Over the years, many geniuses from our Federation who entered the mythical world have died from the assassinations of the Evil God Sect.”
“These guys, once part of the Human Race, know us better and are full of hatred towards the Federation, leaving a tail is always a problem.”
“The impending war with the Purgatory Demon Race is coming, and this guy truly can’t be left alone. However, Senior Kaye, I’ll be the one to go.”
Jack Clark said slowly, “I once said that the next time I meet Grayson, I’ll slay him.”
When Jack first emerged from the Black Forbidden Zone after his breakthrough to the Ninth Heavens, he encountered Eddy Keller and a few others being pursued by the Giant God Sect Cultist, and after intervening to save them, he encountered Grayson spying on them.
At that time, Jack, with his Void Double Pupils, exchanged blows with Grayson through the void, ‘undecided’, but also said he would slay him.
Moreover, his realm had now reached the limit of the Heavenly King, and he was on the verge of stepping into the Supreme. It was perfect timing to make a breakthrough upon returning to the mythical world, and then it would be about time to launch a counteroffensive against the Purgatory Empire.
Although wary of that hibernating Ancestor of the Purgatory tribe, being wary didn’t mean he was afraid to act.
First, taking advantage of the Ancestor’s hibernation and the fact that the other Imperial Demon Gods hadn’t gathered, he planned to slay a few Demon Gods and Great Demon Kings, weakening the high-end strength of the Demon Clan of Purgatory.
“You wish to go… very well,” Sky King Denny Kaye thought for a bit and eventually did not refuse.
With Jack Clark’s current strength, suppressing the freshly advanced Heavenly King Grayson would indeed be effortless, and it would also fully unveil Jack Clark’s entanglements with the Evil God Sect.
Was it fate? Jack’s nature was the bane of both Akunus and Grayson’s existence, having participated in the suppression war against Koroya from a young age.
Afterwards, he swept through the Southern Battlefield, repelling the invasion of the Evil God Sect Cultists, including the subsequent incident with the Evil God Clone.
Upon entering the mythical world, he happened upon and suppressed the heavily injured and fallen Akunus, breaking through to king-level by destroying the Evil God Alliance.
Now, only the Giant God Grayson remained. Taking him down would nearly settle all accounts with Jack Clark.
…
The location of the Heavenly Feather Battlefield.
Across from the forbidden area where space-time had shattered, forming millions of kilometers, endlessly rolling Dark Demon Air pooled into chains piercing the Void.
At this moment, under those massive pillars of Dark Demon Air, tens of thousands of meters wide, stood the Ancestral Demon God Levides, whose True Body towered ten thousand meters tall, radiating a heavy aura of suppression.
Surrounding Levides amid the swirling Dark Demon Air, a Titan mid-period Great Demon King and three demon kings stood respectfully.
Then Levides spoke slowly, “How long has it been since Tyris and the others fell into the Deep Red World?”
The Great Demon King replied respectfully, “Imperial Demon God Levides, it’s been almost a Sun Wheel since they fell into the Deep Red World, and there’s been no sign of their return yet.”
“No, they are on their way back,” Levides said, his eyes lifting slightly to look at those Dark Demon Air pillars probing into the Void, his expression calm.
At this moment, within the Will of the Dark Demon Air infused with Levides’s perception, terrifying Auras from the distant end were rapidly returning.
As for the Great Demon King and the three Demon Kings, their strength was too weak, so they couldn’t feel it yet.
Without waiting long, just as the Great Demon King was startled by the words, suddenly the Dark Demon Air of this world began to tremble, and the invisible strength permeating within the demon gas started to grow stronger.
“It’s His Majesty, it’s His Majesty’s Aura of strength,” the Great Demon King and the three Demon Kings got excited at once.
As the rulers of this world, the Will of Tyris constituted the operational rules of this realm, and all the tumbling Dark Demon Air was, in fact, a part of him.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Columns of Dark Demon Air that linked to the depths of the Void shook and quivered violently; the oppressive might filling the heavens and earth grew increasingly terrifying, and there was not just one source of it.
Roar!
The brutal roar echoed throughout Heaven and Earth, and in the depths of the twisted Void, a Demon God figure tens of thousands of meters tall slowly emerged, emitting an invisible terror nearly reaching the peak of ancient times.
Behind this Demon God, endless Crimson Radiance tumbled, forming a dark red cloud layer upon which millions of Purgatory Elite Legions stood, their demon gas soaring to the sky.
Among these Purgatory Legions, there were also more than twenty demon kings and several Great Demon Kings.
Beneath Levides’s feet, a demon king spoke excitedly, “It’s the Imperial Demon God of the Belvetan Empire. Their Majesties, they are all safe, they’ve returned.”
Following the emergence of the Lord of the Belvetan Empire, not far behind it, the figure of another Demon God appeared, then a second, and a third…
In the Rule Domains behind these Demon Gods, there were varying numbers of Purgatory Legions or one or two demon kings.
But when the last figure, towering a hundred thousand meters and emitting a horror almost reaching that of a True Spirit, appeared, even Levides could not help but tense and feel envious.
“Tyris, has it already refined the Intrinsic strength of the Heavenly Feather Clan?”
The Purgatory Empire was expanding its territory frantically, attacking civilizations of different races to plunder everything they had, to meld into itself and increase its cultivation more quickly.
As an existence already at the pinnacle of Demon Gods, the gains from Tyris’s recent eradication of the Heavenly Feather Clan and the refining of a great clan’s civilization were quite significant.
Just the invisible pressure emanating at that moment was enough to make Levides’s heart race with fear; it was too powerful.
He felt that at this moment, Tyris had reached the limit of a Demon God and was only a step away from crossing over to enter the Ancestor Realm, becoming the second Ancestor of the Purgatory Demon Race.
But that step was difficult, or rather, hopeless, for the Purgatory Family already had one Ancestor.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
With the return of seven Demon Gods, along with hundreds of millions from the Purgatory Legions and a multitude of demon kings and Great Demon Kings, this world began to shake wildly, filled with the terrifying pressure of the Demon Gods.
Among the seven Demon Gods, Tyris and the other two imperial Lords had already recovered from their injuries, and even their Auras had become stronger.
The remaining four Demon Gods also had injuries that had healed, except for one that was somewhat unfamiliar, emitting an Aura from the early days of ancient times.
In the recent great war, three Demon Kings of the Purgatory Empire had fallen, one slain by Jack Clark and another ground to oblivion by Divine King Salie.
After that, the Divine King of Light was only able to kill one Demon King despite the joint resistance of Tyris and others.
Taking advantage of this war of annihilation, an Extreme Realm Great Demon King from the Purgatory Demon Clan achieved a breakthrough and stepped into the rank of a Demon God.
If one adds the Left Demon who had ventured deep into the Deep Red World, it should amount to two Demon Gods.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1563: Chapter 588: Breakthrough to the Supreme, Deep in the Universe Chapter 1563: Chapter 588: Breakthrough to the Supreme, Deep in the Universe Just as Ancestral Demon God Levides spoke about the Primordial Origin, six unstoppable demonic pressures erupted violently, shrouding the entire sky with a terrifying demonic aura.
As for the newly ascended demon god, he still didn’t understand what the Primordial Origin signified.
Surrounded by endless Dark Red Glow, Tyris distorted space-time into Abyssal Hell, and said in a deep voice while looking at Levides.
“Levides, do you realize what you are talking about?”
In front of Tyris, whose true body stretched a hundred thousand meters, Levides, only ten thousand meters tall, was like an infant, his head barely able to lift under the crushing pressure of the rules.
Levides slowly said, “Of course, how could I jest about such news?”
“Several Sun Wheels ago, you all must have seen the fallen Primordial Star too, crashing right into the middle of the battlefield where the Diorus Empire and the Human Race were fighting.”
“Moreover, the world rules of that Primordial Beast dissipated rapidly, and a light of disintegration appeared just two Sun Wheels earlier, which even Belidier and the others witnessed.”
“Judging by this rate of disintegration, it won’t take many or maybe just a dozen more Sun Wheels for a pathway to emerge into that Primordial World.”
“With so little time, Tyris, how much Primordial Origin do you think will remain? Five strands, or maybe a dozen?”
By the time Levides had finished speaking, all of the demon gods’ eyes had reddened, especially Tyris, whose eyes flickered with a terrifying light.
With his current realm, just one strand of Primordial Origin would enable him to instantly step into True Spirit Ancestor Level, touching the undying boundary.
But without such a Divine Object as the Primordial Origin, he might be stuck at this realm for thousands or even tens of thousands of years.
It wasn’t a matter of insufficient talent; it was because within The Purgatory Family, there could only be one True Spirit Level, one True Spirit Level bloodline source.
Suppressing the boiling blood within him, Tyris said with an icy gaze, “You showing up here, and revealing the Primordial news to us, seems to indicate that the situation over there is quite dire.”
Tyris was naturally not foolish; if Levides and the other demon gods were willing to share this information, they undoubtedly had ulterior motives.
Levides let out a wry smile, “Not only is the situation over there bleak, but it is so severe that four demon gods have fallen in the previous battle.”
“Including Sigitico of the Saint Demon Anke Empire, who fell half a Sun Wheel ago.”
Suddenly, all seven demon gods showed looks of astonishment and shock, and the Lord of the Freymand Empire, Carotis, was particularly stunned.
“How could this be? Sigitico is at the ancient late stage, and his demonic weapon was almost world-class, with a strength comparable to the Peak of the Ancient.”
“If Sigitico truly wished to escape, it would be difficult for even Tyris to slay him, not to mention the insignificant Human Race. Could it be that a True Spirit Level being intervened?”
Carotis’s shock was understandable, as Sigitico’s power was no less than those of the Lords of the Empires. Even if weaker, the difference was negligible.
If the Human Race could slay Sigitico, did that not mean they could also slay him?
“True Spirit Level, roughly so,” Levides said, still somewhat scared when recalling the fearful Giant Beast and the power that crushed and exploded everything.
Tyris’s gaze sharpened, “The Human Race actually has a True Spirit?”
Levides explained, “Not a true True Spirit creature, but a giant beast temporarily Summoned by a human expert, with a level only of the ancient Giant Beast.”
“However, that beast is terrifyingly powerful, its strength instantly bursting through the Ancient Limit and becoming comparable to a True Spirit when entering a form filled with destructive powers.”
“If not for the imbalance caused by the appearance of that summoned beast, we could have inflicted heavy damage on the Human Alliance in that battle, if not defeat them.”
“Unfortunately, the appearance of that beast broke the balance and immediately Suppressed Sigitico…”
With the demon gods’ expressions growing serious, Levides thoroughly introduced the current state of the Human Alliance, including the Heavenly Feather Clan, the Divine Gods Alliance, and other information.
After Levides had finished speaking, Carotis and the other demon gods fell into silence.
Unbeknownst to them, a powerful alliance force had already risen in the east, and after absorbing the remnants of the Heavenly Feather Clan, the number of demon gods within their realm had reached seven.
In addition, there were four experts with complete Demon God Level strength.
Two of them were comparable to Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings, and the other two, known as True Martial and Divine Martial Heavenly Kings, were even comparable to the Lords of ordinary empires.
Adding that terrifying Giant Beast, only if the Purgatory Family assembled all their strength and the Eight Great Empires joined hands would they be assured of crushing this force.
Tyris said gravely, “It seems it’s not just us, you must have also sought out Carthius.”
Although it was a question, Tyris’s tone was one of certainty.
Levides nodded, “At present, the overall power of the Human Alliance is too strong, especially that beast with True Spirit level strength.”
“After calculating, only you and Carthius will be able to contain that giant beast head-on, and by working together, you can suppress it, dragging out the half Star Moment limit of its summoning.”
“Once that beast is gone, the remaining human experts and the remnants of the Heavenly Feather Clan will stand no chance.”
“However, for greater security, we shall not act unless it’s necessary, and if we do, we must strike with the force of Thunder, annihilating this alliance in one fell swoop.”
“Otherwise, if we allow time to drag on, unforeseen problems may arise.”
A murderous intent surfaced in Tyris’s eyes, “The so-called unforeseen problems surely refer to that human named Darren Callum, indeed a threat.”
