chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1564: Chapter 588: Breakthrough to the Supreme, Deep in the Universe_2 Chapter 1564: Chapter 588: Breakthrough to the Supreme, Deep in the Universe_2 Tyris had not expected that in just one Sun Wheel period, the human who killed Ecosela and Summoned a Breath to prevent it from tearing apart the Eternal Divine Domain had grown even stronger.
So strong, they could directly suppress Carthius, a Demon Dragon from the Ancient Middle Stage.
Whether as a vessel for Summoning the Giant Beast or because of the terrifying strength enhancement speed and exaggerated combat power, this human had to die.
Otherwise, given another two Sun Wheel periods, Tyris felt that the human might not even need to Summon a Giant Beast; they could directly face and clash with it.
Tyris turned around, looking towards Carotis and the other Demon Gods, with a voice cold and deep, “This matter is no longer just about Diorus and the others, but now concerns the safety of Our Purgatory Family.”
“You understand what I mean, don’t you?”
Carotis nodded slowly, “Of course I understand, before the obliteration of the Human Race, I shall temporarily put aside my grievances with the Sagundo Empire.”
Among the eight great empires of purgatory, the Freymand Empire and the Sagundo Empire had a deadly enmity, and the Alecasa Empire also had friction with the Belvetan Empire.
In addition, Belidier, which had already fallen, and another Demon God, were also enemies.
If not for the pressure from Tyris and another Great Demon King from above, the Purgatory Family would have already exploded into war internally, let alone divide to expedite other civilizations.
Of course, the main reason Carotis put aside ‘hatred’ was certainly not because of the so-called big picture.
For them, it didn’t matter even if the entire Purgatory Demon Race perished, as long as they survived. The real reason it was willing to join forces was the Primordial Origin.
If it could obtain a piece of Origin, it could use the power of the Primordial to reshape its soul and True Body, and break the shackles of the Purgatory Bloodline.
“Inform everyone, the mighty army will set out immediately, targeting the eastern battlefield.”
“Levides, has Carthius gone over there yet?”
“I am not clear about the situation over there as of now. It was Stephenl who went back to inform them, and the distance is also farther than from where you are at,” said Levides.
…
Blue Star
At the entrance of Channel One, Marcellus Larry and Jack Clark stood side by side on the base building’s rooftop, overlooking the front.
In front of the rotating silver vortex, a black train thousands of meters long was slowly driving into it. The train had no carriages, but was bare, dragging objects resembling intercontinental missiles.
Each missile-like object was five hundred meters long with a diameter of over forty meters, and its surface was covered with Seal-like Runes Arrays.
In Jack Clark’s perception, the interiors of these giant missiles were like a Black Hole, invisibly permeating some form of terrifying energy.
Marcellus Larry said with emotion, “This is the first batch of Doomsday nuclear bombs, freshly assembled. Normally, that Dark Matter is stored in Outer Space.”
“This material is very special. If it leaks on Blue Star, it would instantly cause a disaster, even damaging the current ecological environment.”
Jack Clark said with some regret, “It’s a pity I don’t have time now, otherwise I really want to go deep into space to see how that Heavenly King captures these dark particles.”
He was indeed curious about the existence of Dark Matter, including the space of this universe.
Back when Blue Star was not connected to the mythical world, it contained abundant Heavenly Energy and gave rise to a Great Era of cultivation, and there existed seven Civilization Emperors.
From this, one could see the uniqueness of the Solar System and even this universe.
In the mythical world, a territory occupied by a single Titan Beast spans tens of thousands of kilometers, an area dozens of times bigger than Blue Star, and the territories of the Ancient Beasts are even larger.
It is only with a much broader territory that ‘energy’ could be sufficient to support their continued growth.
Yet the Ancient Beasts were only equivalent to some of the mighty Monarchs of the Ancient Civilization, not to mention the Civilization Emperors comparable to True Spirits, and yet, how could little Blue Star support that?
Unfortunately, there was too much happening at the moment, leaving no time to study the Solar System, including what was beyond it, and whether there was similar life in the neighboring Star Systems.
As a Primordial Demon God, even without energy supplements from the universe, Jack Clark could traverse the stars.
With space Distortion and leaping, even the Solar System with its diameter of over a hundred billion kilometers, marked at its limit by Neptune, could not contain him, though it would take some time.
Watching the black train pass through the pathway, Jack Clark bid farewell, “Senior Marcellus, I’m also preparing to head over. Please take care of this side.”
Marcellus Larry gave a slight smile. “Don’t worry, Jack Clark, I’m always keeping an eye on your brother, and that girl Ilisa has been constantly watching over your family too.”
Jack Clark smiled and nodded. “Thank you, Senior, for your trouble. I came back in such a hurry this time that I didn’t even have time to invite Sister Ilisa for a meal.”
Indeed, Jack Clark’s return was very rushed. He hadn’t even visited Glenn Clark but had simply made a round trip to Mist River City before attending to Freya Louise’s breakthrough into the Legendary Realm.
And his return to the mythical world this time, dealing with Grayson was merely on the way; his true purpose was to make a breakthrough to Supreme.
After greeting Marcellus, Jack stood before Channel One, but as he was about to enter the pathway, he stopped in his tracks and looked back.
Gazing at the fog wall in the distance that shrouded the sky, separating the Inner World from the surface of Blue Star, Jack fell into silence for a moment.
Once he left, he might not be able to return for a long time.
Bang! The Dimension Binding Divine Jade in Jack’s hand shattered, and in an instant, a transparent blue energy enveloped him, isolating him from the outer world.
Unlike his previous entrance, the moment the transparent blue energy covered Jack, it suddenly began to vibrate violently, constantly changing shape and expanding.
Fortunately, since Jack had not yet achieved the ‘breakthrough to Supreme,’ the Dimension Binding Divine Jade could barely handle it.
“That was close, it didn’t break,” Jack exhaled softly and then transformed into a beam of blue light rushing into the world passageway.
Boom!
The silver vortex shook violently, sending out rings of brilliant silver light waves in all directions, almost rendering half of the sky silver with their terrifying might.
“Greetings to the Divine Martial Emperor.”
As the black-haired young man emerged from the silver vortex, all the cultivators guarding the pathway bowed their heads respectfully.
Jack nodded slightly. “No need for formalities,” he said. And with a flash, he disappeared from sight.
Meanwhile, the Golden Divine Tree, rooted firmly in the Earth and now soaring over thirty thousand meters high, suddenly trembled slightly, sprinkling the sky with a multitude of golden spots of light.
The Eternal Tree Sapling opened a pair of dazzling white eyes, gazing in the direction where Jack had disappeared.
“Primordial…” The eyes stared towards the direction where Jack had vanished for a long while before slowly closing again, as the will of the Divine King of Light sank back into hibernation.
In just a few breaths, Jack had crossed the Outer Development Department of the Human Race without stopping, continuing at a terrifying speed deeper into the mythical world.
After flying for almost a quarter of a million kilometers in one go, Jack finally slowed down, looking at the endless plains below and said slowly, “This distance should be sufficient.”
This time, he planned to keep his breakthrough to Supreme a secret.
After all, once he achieved such a position, it would certainly send shockwaves throughout the entire Human Race and also come to the attention of the Purgatory Demon Race.
At that point, apart from further provoking the Purgatory Demon Race and allowing them to prepare, there would be no benefit; it was better to make a low-profile breakthrough to facilitate subsequent actions.
Actually, Jack had always felt that he had the potential to be an assassin.
His Hidden Deity power, once advanced to Divine Power, could perfectly conceal his aura and power fluctuations. In addition, it allowed him to briefly vanish into the Void, erasing any sense of his own existence.
It would truly be a waste not to become an assassin with such ability.
For now, a grand battle between the Human Race and the Purgatory Demon Race couldn’t erupt just yet, and he couldn’t afford to waste this time.
Once the Destruction Emperor Dragon returned, it would lead the Ancient Beasts on an expedition here. Meanwhile, Jack also planned to infiltrate the rear of the Purgatory Demon Race again and assassinate a few Demon Gods.
And he might as well visit the ancestral court where the Purgatory ancestors slumbered to gather some ‘intelligence.’
Whoosh! Jack took a deep breath, no longer suppressing the realm within his body.
Boom!
A terrifying aura burst forth from Jack, his entire being radiating an intensely dazzling golden-white light. In an instant, tens of thousands of kilometers vibrated.
The fundamental rules of this world were shaken apart, Heavenly Energy went into chaos, as if a boundless Giant Beast had been let loose.
Above ten thousand kilometers, endless dark clouds gathered out of nowhere, forming a sky-obscuring vortex. The opening in the center of the vortex seemed like a giant eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1565 - 1565 589 Gathering of the Giant Beasts Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1565: Chapter 589: Gathering of the Giant Beasts, Dragon of Ancient Times Chapter 1565: Chapter 589: Gathering of the Giant Beasts, Dragon of Ancient Times Boom!
Within the hollow that resembled the Eye of the Heavenly Path, pure and majestic energy, like the pillar of heaven, poured down into the golden-white radiance below, which continued to expand.
In an instant, the golden-white halo, which had already expanded to over 3,000 kilometers, shone even more brilliantly, expanding at an even faster speed.
When a cultivator breaks through to the Supreme level, in addition to consuming vast amounts of Heavenly Energy and the World’s Power to condense their True Body, it also signifies a transformation in the level of life itself.
Just like the Destruction Emperor Dragon that earlier broke through to become an Ancient Beast.
Except Jack Clark wasn’t a beast, and didn’t need to hibernate for so long.
The location Jack Clark chose for his breakthrough was far from the Outer Development Department and also far from the Divine Gods Alliance’s territory, hence no one knew that a Supreme Expert was breaking through more than 200,000 kilometers away.
As Jack Clark quietly underwent his transformation, events that were meant to happen continued to unfold.
In the forbidden area battlefield, known as Adam Garcetti, the Primordial True King and the three Divine Kings of Heavenly Feather finally expelled the remnants of the Purgatory Demon God’s strength and started to erode Heaven and Earth with their own rules to set restrictions.
At the same time, the entire Federation’s resources were mobilized; strategic supplies were produced frantically as countless mines in the mythical world worked overtime day and night to collect resources.
The Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Roar roar roar!!
In the raging winds that lifted tsunamis a kilometer high on the edge of the Chaos Turbulent Sea, huge beasts of enormous size stood tall, occasionally letting out low roars and growls.
Some of these beasts were over a thousand meters long, some stood as tall as mountain peaks reaching thousands of meters into the sky, while others with double wings spread wide, casting shadows that darkened the sky, their surrounding Law Domains exuding an imposing aura.
At this moment, these beasts clearly divided into three camps.
One consisted of beasts dwelling in the ocean, led by the Mythical-level Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, and other Giant Beasts like the Female Tiger Whale, who made up a mighty army.
Another was led by a beast over five thousand meters in length, covered in black scale armor and bone spurs, followed by a group of more than thirty beasts emanating the aura of Mythical Creatures and even Titans.
These beasts followed behind the Blade Giant Beast like a military, with an air of stern discipline.
Apart from these two groups, more than thirty other Mythical Giant Beasts and a few Titans stood like isolated creatures, each occupying a mountain peak over a range of a thousand kilometers.
Among these beasts, some were surrounded by Eighth Level and Ninth Level Beasts, all of whom looked around at the other giant beasts with a vigilant and defensive gaze.
In the thundering ocean, a Late Stage 9 Black Tiger Whale excitedly frolicked, emitting excited cries: Roar roar roar!! So many Giant Beasts, their auras are all so powerful.
Roar!! Miss Keller, do you see? Our Dragon Palace is now so strong.
Above the sea, a hundred-meter-long Female ‘Little’ Tiger Whale, exuding the aura of the peak of eighth level, let out an adorable cry, looking up at the Black Tiger Whale with worshipful eyes.
Roar!! I see it, leader, so many Mythical Giant Beasts.
Roar roar roar!! But they joined the empire too late and are just ordinary members of the empire. Your status, Great General, is still above theirs.
Moreover, with your talent, Miss Keller believes it won’t be long before you become a Mythical-level Giant Beast.
At the cry of the Female Little Tiger Whale, the Black Tiger Whale became even more excited, a sight that greatly displeased the two Flame Tiger Whales flying in the sky.
That cheeky third brother, always bringing that Female Tiger Whale behind him, getting her to constantly butter him up.
On the ocean surface, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon, no, it should now be called Kidora, gazed at the surroundings with excitement and some nervousness.
“Domination, I feel like we can’t quite control the situation, what should we do?”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, coiled in the water like a dark brown mountain peak, growled softly: “Roar! Don’t be nervous, Kidora; even if you are, it won’t make a difference. Only Thunderflame can suppress this scene.”
“But rest assured, although we have just broken through to Mythical, the status of the Dragon King is enough to prevent any beast from provoking us.”
Saying this, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle glanced warily at the Blade Giant Beast standing in the distance.
Among all the beasts present, that one was the strongest, its aura nearly rivalling those of the few strongest Ancient Dragon Kings, in addition to the army of Mythical Creatures it commanded.
Not far behind the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, a three-hundred-meter-long Blue Giant Crab, exuding an aura of Level 9 Peak, clutched its pincers nervously, bubbles spewing from its mouth.
Blub blub!! Horned Lady, the empire has suddenly added so many Mythical Giant Beasts. Do you think any beast will try to take my job as the gatekeeper?
Floating quietly in the air, the female Tiger Whale with clear signs of Batfish lineage looked down at the Giant Crab and let out a calm, low hum: “Don’t worry, Crab General, no beast can take that position away from you.”
“The king is very nostalgic. As long as your loyalty remains unchanged, then even those Titan beasts need not concern you.”
“Of course, while you need not concern yourself with them, it doesn’t mean you can be arrogant. You must still show respect for those above the level of Mythical, respecting their strength.”
Blub blub. The Blue Giant Crab nodded with its eyes; as for its head and body, which were one solid piece, it could not nod even if it wanted to.
Roar!
At this moment, a melodious Dragon Roar exploded in the distance, and in the dim sky, a fifteen-hundred-meter-long Red Beast appeared, causing many of the Titans present to look up abruptly.
Around this Dragon-like beast, time distorted and seasons shifted, emitting an aura faintly menacing even to them.
Behind the Candle Dragon in the Firmament, a vast shadow was cast, where an Ancient Beast, thirty thousand meters long and resembling a Black Mountain Range, stood tall.
Around this Black Kirin–shaped giant, two twenty-thousand-meter Batfish Beasts flanked it, accompanied by two Mythical Giant Beasts, their formless oppression causing the Heaven and Earth to tremble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1566 - 1566 589 Gathering of the Giant Beasts Dragon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1566: Chapter 589: Gathering of the Giant Beasts, Dragon of Ancient Times_2 Chapter 1566: Chapter 589: Gathering of the Giant Beasts, Dragon of Ancient Times_2 All the Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts sprawling on the Earth sank their bodies down.
The Blade Giant Beast, Thor, also subconsciously let out a low roar, its strength from the ancient early stages Bursting forth and colliding with the all-encompassing Aura that was surging over.
Boom!
As the auras of the two Ancient Beasts clashed, the sky trembled, creating rings of white waves that exploded in all directions, and the Earth cracked continuously.
Looking at the ferocious behemoth with its four claws sunk a kilometer into the Earth, the Black Kirin Beast slowly growled, “So you are the King of Blade Edge, Thor, eh? I’ve heard about you from Thunderflame.”
With an icy gaze, the Black Kirin Beast swept over all the Giant Beasts gathered on the Earth and spoke with a voice like thunder, “I am the Lord of the Earth, one of the Imperial Dragon Kings.”
“Roar! We greet the Earth Dragon King.”
In the face of this terrifying Ancient Beast, all the Giant Beasts that were subdued by other Ancient Beasts and summoned here bowed their heads respectfully.
It was the same with the Female Tiger Whales gathered on the sea surface and the Blue Giant Crabs too, which, having experienced the first Dragon King meeting, dared not show any negligence.
However, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon only nodded slightly.
As Dragon Kings, though their current realm was inferior to that of the Black Kirin Beast, they could not appear weak in terms of aura, even if their limbs and tails under the sea were trembling.
The return of the first Ancient Dragon King, whose Invisible Power emitted a suppressing Terrifying Aura, quieted what was once a somewhat restless scene.
Just then, the entire sky suddenly trembled, followed by a long, whistle-like roar—the return of the Ancient Batfish measuring over sixty thousand meters.
Accompanied by Titan Level Batfish Beasts, the sweeping Invisible Power carrying the Aura of Chaos made all the Giant Beasts’ legs go weak once again.
“It’s the Sky Dragon King.”
“We greet the Sky Dragon King.”
Tens of thousands of the Longa Alien Tribe on the sea surface shouted respectfully, along with a dozen Mythical Giant Beasts and a Titan Beast, all subdued by the Ancient Batfin.
Looking at the colossal figure dominating the Firmament, these Giant Beasts felt as if they had found their mainstay.
Gazing down upon those minuscule figures, the Ancient Batfin merely nodded slightly at the Kirin Beast a few hundred kilometers away, and then circled quietly above the Firmament, waiting.
Similarly, the Black Kirin Beast had no intention of making small talk, standing proud and aloof.
At this moment, they showed their true nature as Ancient Beasts—indifferent, proud, looking down upon all living beings, disregarding any creatures with a lower realm than themselves.
Even when facing Giant Beasts of the same level, due to unfamiliarity, there was no desire to converse.
And had it not been for the presence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to suppress them, these Ancient Beasts would not likely have gathered unless it was for battle or ‘communication’ among the same kind.
In the silent wait, an Ancient Aura quickly approached from afar, turning half the sky grey-white under its Invisible Power.
Roar!
With a hiss that sounded both dragon and python-like, a Gray Python over ten thousand meters long descended, trailed by endless grey strength that coalesced to form the shadow of a Giant Python wrapping around the world.
Boom! Instantly, all the Giant Beasts felt heavier, and the Earth beneath their feet crumbled under that Ancient Aura.
On the Seaside, eight Mythical Giant Beasts and two Titan Beasts instantly growled respectfully, “We greet the Serpent that Enwraps the World, the great Jormungand Dragon King.”
The Gray Python nodded slightly at the few beasts it had subdued and then turned to the Ancient Batfin, “Roar! Alius, have you reached the end yet?”
The massive Ancient Batfin shook its head slightly, “Not yet, it feels a little short, then we received Thunderflame’s summoning.”
The Black Kirin Beast growled, “I have seen the end of the Chaotic Domain, but I did not traverse it, for it is cut off by a strong spacetime rift.”
“That’s good, it seems none of us have completed the journey,” the Gray Python nodded with satisfaction.
However, the three Ancient Beasts only exchanged a few words before falling silent, separated by hundreds of kilometers.
And as they returned one by one, the various Mythical Beasts scattered in every direction below stirred slightly, and then a portion of the Beasts suddenly moved to gather beneath the three Ancient Beasts.
Observing this, the three Ancient Beasts did not intervene, for these Beasts were ones they subdued along the way.
At this moment, the Black Tiger Whale at the Seaside suddenly called out: Yiyiying! Mom, I think I see Dad over there, slacking on the back of the Giant Batfin, sleeping.
Immediately, the Flame Tiger Whale in the sky also recognized this, looking towards the Gray Python’s rear where two Titan Batfin Beasts glided with spread wings.
Atop a Giant Beast, with a body stretching over nineteen thousand meters, there rested a Single-horned Spawn Roc in hibernation.
Tiger One’s eyes suddenly bulged, and furious flames burned: “Roar! Dad is actually lying on another Giant Beast. Mom, should we help teach it a harsh lesson?”
Roar! Roar! “Yes, unforgivable.” Tiger Two also nodded excitedly.
At last, they found an opportunity to challenge their father’s position.
As the three ‘little’ Tiger Whales got excessively excited, the Female Tiger Whale’s eyes remained calm, and she murmured softly, “Stop it, Joe is just in hibernation for a breakthrough.”
“Besides, Joe is about to become a Titan Level Giant Beast. Are you sure you can challenge him?”
Titan!
The Three-headed Small Tiger Whale realized this and instinctively shrank their tails, almost forgetting that their dad’s growth rate was increasing rapidly. It seemed they still needed to lie low for a while.
A tinge of regret flashed in the eyes of the Black Tiger Whale.
After a while, another Giant Beast returned, not the Ancient Dragon King, but the Titan Longa King Alicia.
Compared to the imposingness of the three ancient Giant Beasts, the aura of the returning Titan Longa King was far less intense. Upon her return, she simply nodded slightly and then retreated to her ocean camp.
Roar! Roar!
Two earth-shattering Dragon Roars exploded, followed by an icy chill that enveloped everything, ushering in a sweeping, icy blue aura.
Amidst the freezing gale appeared a Giant Dragon with wings spanning five thousand meters, its body covered in blue-white scale armor. Encircled by several earth-piercing tornadoes, it appeared like a Dragon harboring a destruction storm and frost, one capable of ending all existence.
At the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s side was a slightly smaller Crystal Red Giant Dragon, emanating an aura of peak Titan strength as it circled around.
The appearance of the Blue-White Giant Dragon caused many Giant Beasts to pause, including the three-headed Ancient Giant Beast, known as the Dust Serpent.
The mother of Scythia had joined the Dragon Palace while all the Giant Beasts had already embarked on their campaign to the Chaotic Turbulent Region, so the Destruction Emperor Dragon had no chance to introduce herself to all the Giant Beasts.
However, sensing the faint aura of the Dragon King’s Mandate emanating from the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the three-headed beasts did not display any hostility.
Nor did they greet it proactively, merely watching with a cold and aloof gaze. This was further emphasized by the surrounding invisible swirl of Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts beneath them.
In comparison, the two Giant Dragons beside the Blue-White Giant Dragon seemed a bit slender.
Even less imposing than the Blade Edge Beast King, standing proudly on the Earth, surrounded by about twenty Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts.
At the moment when the two Giant Dragons seemed somewhat overwhelmed in aura, giving off a sense of being ‘suppressed’ by the powers of the various Giant Beasts, suddenly, Heaven and Earth shook, and Space-Time distorted, resulting in transparent ripples.
Roar! A terrifying and majestic Dragon Roar echoed, and boundless silver brilliance emerged from the twisting Void.
Under the dazzling radiance, all the Giant Beasts felt an illusion of time and space intertwining and years fleeting by, including the three-headed Ancient Beasts and the King of Blade Edge, who all looked up solemnly.
Within the silver light, a five-thousand-meter-long Giant Dragon surfaced, its body covered in pure white scale armor. Rich Time Power loomed around it, as if it had descended from the past and appeared beside the Blue-White Giant Dragon.
Suddenly, two ancient Giant Dragons appeared, and one of them wielded the Time Rule, causing even the three-headed Ancient Beasts known as the Dust Serpent to growl involuntarily.
“Time Rule!”
“Which Dragon King is this?” As they faced the emergence of the Time Dragon, the eyes of the three older Ancient Beasts showed traces of apprehension.
At this sight, Kulapavida lifted his head slightly with prideful aura but was somewhat cautious in the glance he gave the Blue-White Giant Dragon.
Fortunately, the Blue-White Giant Dragon merely glanced coldly at the Time Dragon and chose not to strike.
The Time Dragon heaved a sigh of relief and displayed a humanized apologetic smile: “Roar! Adriana, congratulations on your breakthrough to the Ancient Realm.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon, however, continued to look at it coldly, showing no intention of responding.
Under the gaze of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the Time Dragon gave an awkward smile, retracting its neck slightly and avoiding looking directly at the Crystal Red Giant Dragon by its side.
Fortunately, before the Time Dragon could feel too awkward, the entire Earth suddenly trembled, and the ground shook violently within tens of thousands of kilometers.
It was as if an indescribably enormous creature was slowly approaching.
At the same time, a terrifying aura that struck fear into all the Giant Beasts spread, and under the dreadful pressure of bloodline authority, including the Time Dragon, all the Giant Beasts instinctively lay down on the ground.
In the presence of the approaching terrifying behemoth, no Giant Beast was worthy of standing aloft in the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 1567 - 1567 590 The Ancient King Campaign Against
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1567: Chapter 590: The Ancient King, Campaign Against Purgatory Demon Chapter 1567: Chapter 590: The Ancient King, Campaign Against Purgatory Demon Under the pressure that collapsed the Void, the ferocious behemoth with a body length of over ten thousand meters slowly appeared, its legs as stout as mountain pillars shook Heaven and Earth with each step it took.
Its massive body was like a mountain range of Black Gold, with the mane running along its tail from the dorsal fin resembling a forest of trees, and three rows of dorsal fins piercing through the clouds like mountain peaks.
The beast’s ferocious head was crowned with black dragon mane that burnt like flames, and its two pairs of sharp, bifurcated dragon horns stood fiercely, surrounded by scale horns that rose up like a solemn crown.
On either side, three pairs of crystal red feather horns glowed with a brilliant golden-white halo, adding an inexplicably sacred aura beneath them.
Compared to the rule true bodies of demons and Divine Kings, creatures like Giant Beasts that stepped into ancient times might not differ much in size upon reaching the ancient late stage, but their might was even more terrifying, filled with an oppressive force of enormity.
For instance, the Destruction Emperor Dragon at this moment, with every movement, compressed the surrounding space until it burst, creating rings of explosive shockwaves that spread in all directions, covering a thousand kilometers.
Only amidst the howling gales, the scene of two dragons wrapped in ice crystals and surrounded by colorful crystals taking a nap on the back of Destruction Emperor Dragon somewhat disrupted the atmosphere.
Upon the return of Destruction Emperor Dragon, the sea surface exploded, as the Blue Giant Crab excitedly blew bubbles and waved its pincers.
Behind the Blue Giant Crab, more than three thousand Level 7 and Level 8, and a few Level 9 red, blue, multicolored Giant Crabs waved their pincers in unison, continuously blowing bubbles and shouting in unison.
“We pay our respects to the Great Master of Thunderflame.”
“We welcome the return of the Great Dragon Palace King.”
The sudden performance by the Blue Giant Crab not only made the Destruction Emperor Dragon halt in its tracks, but the Female Tiger Whales and creatures of the Deep Sea Dragon Palace were also somewhat stunned.
The Black Tiger Whale glared, surprised: “Roar! What’s going on, Crab General? That stone sculpture of a brain of yours actually thought to prepare this?”
From afar, Kidora, the Nine-headed Dragon, also churned through a tsunami, causing the sea water to explode in chaotic roars: “Roar! Crab General, this move of yours is awesome.”
The sudden display of such a grand honor guard by the Crab General indeed surprised and astonished all the Giant Beasts.
After all, the world of Giant Beasts was ‘simple’, even when creatures like the Single-horned Spawn Roc flattered in the past, it was quite subtle, let alone organizing a guard of honor.
Moreover, this army behaved normally, without the usual bombastic, awesome, or weak-kneed stunts.
Watching all Giant Beasts reacting with shock, the Blue Giant Crab rotated its pincers and made a “yeah” gesture of thanks to the Mermaid sisters who had shown half their bodies above the sea surface.
Also, the Blue Giant Crab’s honor guard disrupted the somber atmosphere that had pervaded between heaven and earth.
Destruction Emperor Dragon too, moved by thought, slowly retracted the bloodline pressure that could be exerted externally, immediately relieving all the Giant Beasts who took a long breath of relief.
And it wasn’t until then that all the Giant Beasts noticed another even more massive and dark-red nine-headed giant dragon behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
What was most important was that the behemoth, the Ancient Middle Stage nine-headed Lava Giant Dragon, radiated an extremely dangerous aura.
So strong! Including the Time Dragon, all five Ancient Beasts narrowed their eyes. Then, the large Black Kirin Beast bowed respectfully, letting out a low growl.
“We congratulate the king for uniting the Chaotic Domain and becoming the Overlord of this Heaven and Earth.”
The Ancient Batfin also let out a long call: “It is not in vain that we call you King, breaking through to the Ancient Middle Stage so quickly, the mere formless aura you just released made my wings weaken.”
The Gray Python coiled like a mountain and hissed slightly: “Indeed, the aura released by Thunderflame just now was too terrifying, I nearly entered my Void-surrounded form to resist.”
Immediately, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and other Giant Beasts were once again bewildered.
Hang on, all of you are mighty Ancient Beasts, there’s no need to flatter like us, surely you should maintain some dignity, right?
And what should we say after you’ve said it all?
The enormous maw of Destruction Emperor Dragon widened slightly, and slowly, a thunderous roar echoed through Heaven and Earth: “Indeed, it is a cause for celebration. From now on, the Dragon Palace shall be the sole ruler of this vast realm spanning billions of kilometers.”
“And this glory belongs not just to the Dragon Kings, but to all members of the empire’s Giant Beasts.”
All at once, the blood of all Giant Beasts boiled, particularly those of the Longa Alien Tribe and Marine Giant Beasts on the shore, who were ‘more familiar’ with Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“Roar! The empire is invincible, the great Thunderflame Dragon King is awesome.”
“Invincible, awesome!”
“Praise the Supreme King of Thunderflame, praise the Great Scythia Dragon King.”
“Right, also Scythia, without it, there wouldn’t be today’s Dragon Palace.”
As the Giant Beasts’ domains spread and rules burst forth, causing the ocean to boil over and the sea to overturn, it took more than ten minutes to calm down a little.
At this time, Destruction Emperor Dragon turned to the Ancient Beasts like the Ancient Batfin and growled slowly.
“Up next, let me introduce everyone. Behind me is Disaster Tyria, the fourteenth Dragon King newly joined to the empire, the Lava Hell King.”
Upon Destruction Emperor Dragon’s words, the Ancient Beast with golden magma flowing over its body stepped forward, and space exploded beneath its feet as waves of scorching heat erupted.
The Lava Giant Dragon turned its nine heads to all directions and nodded slightly to the six Ancient-level Giant Beasts including the King of Blade Edge: “Roar! Greetings, everyone. I am the master of lava, the eternal and resplendent Lord Disaster Tyria.”
The Black Kirin roared lowly: “Greetings, Disaster Tyria. I am Kutadire, the Lord of the Earth Dragon King.”
“I am Alius, the King of the Sky.”
“Jormungand, the world-encompassing Serpent Dragon King.”
“And I am the King of Destruction Ice Crystal, Adriana.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1568 - 1568 590 The King of Ancient Times Campaign
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1568: Chapter 590 The King of Ancient Times, Campaign Against Purgatory_2 Chapter 1568: Chapter 590 The King of Ancient Times, Campaign Against Purgatory_2 Facing this Ancient Beast from the ancient late stage, the strongest giant beast in the empire besides the Destruction Emperor Dragon, all other ancient beasts behaved quite politely.
At that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked toward the seaside, its voice deep and resonant.
“Disaster Tyria, the Dragon Turtle coiled up in the sea over there is Domination, the King of Earth Destruction. The one with nine dragon heads like you is the Nine-Headed Dragon King Kidora.”
“And over there, coiling on the mountain peak, with the surroundings alternating between day and night, is the Candle Dragon, the King of Day and Night Spacetime…”
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon introduced each giant beast by name and title, not only did Disaster Tyria look towards them, but so did the other Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts, slightly astonished.
Yet, Disaster Tyria had long been aware that some of the empire’s Dragon Kings were not very powerful. Therefore, its nine dragon heads turned towards the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Crystal Red Giant Dragon, including all the Giant Beasts, with Titan Dragon King Longa among them.
On those nine ferocious dragon faces, burning with molten lava, a humanized smile emerged as they roared warmly, “Roar! Greetings, fellow Dragon Kings.”
“Today, we meet for the first time, and from now on, we are all one dragon. If there is anything you need help with, feel free to seek out Disaster Tyria.”
“I believe under the leadership of the King of Thunderflame, whose prominence rivals the highest of stars, the empire will grow even stronger and dominate even larger and richer lands.”
“When that time comes, we must work together to assist the great King of Thunderflame in governing this vast empire and with utmost dedication, contribute our strength to the empire.”
The scene fell quiet for a moment, as none of the giant beasts expected this fearsome molten giant to be so… eloquent.
At the same time, weaker Dragon Kings like the Candle Dragon and the Crystal Red Giant Dragon felt spirited and moved, relishing the feeling of not being overlooked.
In the wake of this emotion, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle looked towards the Nine-Head Dragon Kidora, its expression somewhat vexed.
Damn it, Kidora’s in trouble now, these new Dragon Kings are not only more powerful, but they seem to be better at flattery too. What do we do?
Kidora’s nine dragon heads nodded slightly, silently conveying a message: this is indeed a problem; it seems we need to brush up on our skills.
After a brief introduction among the Dragon Kings, the Destruction Emperor Dragon looked towards the Time Dragon, standing in front of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, and the Crystal Red Giant Dragon.
With the keen perception of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it immediately sensed a subtle atmosphere amongst the three giants and couldn’t help but have the corners of its mouth curve up slightly.
Fortunately, although the gaze of the Blue-White Giant Dragon was cold, it made no extra ‘moves’.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled low, “Prince Kulapavida, it’s been a long time. Congratulations on entering the Ancient Realm and becoming one of the rare Ancient Giant Dragons who masters the Time Rule.”
The Giant Dragon, covered in semi-transparent white scale armor, replied with a low growl: “Relative to me, King Thunderflame, your growth rate is even more astounding.”
Just one Sun Wheel ago, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon activated the heart scale of the Time Dragon, aiding its return from its past spacetime position, this beast was merely at the Titan Realm.
Now, in what seemed like a mere nap to it, this fearsomely powerful beast had grown to the Ancient Middle Stage, a rate of growth that shattered the Time Dragon’s comprehension.
It even defied the rules of biological growth.
The Time Dragon had a premonition that this beast called Thunder had a great secret, perhaps a Primordial life not completely fallen and revived.
As for Eternity, that unreachable realm, the Time Dragon didn’t dare to think about it.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had no idea what the Time Dragon was thinking at that moment when it growled softly, “Prince Kulapavida, you have now become an Ancient being. Do you have any interest in joining the Dragon Palace?”
“This empire was established by me and Scythia, your daughter. She is currently in Hibernation, breaking through into the Titan Realm.”
“Besides, Princess Adriana is also one of the Imperial Dragon Kings, along with Princess Caotena and Telsafi.”
“If you join the empire as a Dragon King, our strength would be greatly bolstered. Furthermore, should Scythia encounter any danger in the future, you could also lend a hand. What do you think?”
“I will join,” the Time Dragon growled back, its response assertive and straightforward.
If its daughter and wife were Dragon Kings of this empire and it did not join, it would certainly face exclusion. This could lead to familial discord, among other more serious issues.
Still, the Time Dragon could not forget the sight of the Blue-White Giant Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon following this great beast away.
The corners of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth lifted in a faint, ferocious smile.
“Welcome Prince Kulapavida to the Dragon Palace. From this moment on, you are the fifteenth Dragon King of the Dragon Palace, titled the King of Time.”
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s voice fell, a terrifying Power Explosion burst forth from it, engulfing thousands of kilometers around it.
In an instant, Heaven and Earth shook, the Earth cracked and countless dark-brown rocks thunderously rose to the sky, stirring up billowing smoke and dust, and forming a ring-shaped Mountain Range spanning a thousand kilometers.
The Black Mountain Ranges were steep and towering, and atop their ridges were scattered fifteen platforms, each thousands of meters high, enshrouded in Cloud Mist with giant beasts standing majestically.
This included the slumbering Silver Giant Dragon, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, and the Single-horned Spawn Roc.
In the center of the fifteen Dragon King Mountain Pillars, situated on a hundred kilometers wide staircase slanting into the sea, stood twenty-one Titan Level Giant Beasts and over sixty Mythical Giant Beasts, arrayed according to their strength.
The strongest among them, the Black Blade Giant Beast, stood at the top of the staircase, its body emanating an Ancient Aura, stronger than many Dragon Kings.

chapters.title: Chapter 1569 - 1569 590 The King of Ancient Times Campaign
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1569: Chapter 590 The King of Ancient Times, Campaign Against Purgatory_3 Chapter 1569: Chapter 590 The King of Ancient Times, Campaign Against Purgatory_3 However, on either side of the Blade Giant Beast, atop the Dragon King Mountain Pillars, stood an imposing Black Gold Giant Beast exerting pressure on Heaven and Earth and a Silver Giant Dragon, coiled and in hibernation.
In front of the terrifying aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it dared not show the slightest offense.
Compared to other Giant Beasts that had joined the empire, the Blade Giant Beast, or rather the Purple Eye Giant Beast within it, was the only creature that had been subjected to restriction.
This clearly showed how much the Destruction Emperor Dragon ‘valued’ it.
Beyond that, under the ring-shaped mountain ranges, in the seas below, millions from the Longa Alien Tribe floated, and tens of thousands of high-rank Behemoths tumbled, including Level 9 Peak creatures like the Female Tiger Whale and the Blue Giant Crab.
There were also the Mermaids led by sisters Rain Lawson and Ning Lawson, and Ancient Shell Creatures whose half-open shells jutted out of the sea surface, ranging in diameter from hundreds to thousands of kilometers.
At this moment, the Aura of the rules between Heaven and Earth intertwined, the Radiance of Law trembled, and the pervasive, formless aura even triggered phenomena in the world, creating resplendent rainbow lights stretching tens of thousands of miles.
A spectacle so awe-inspiring and grand made the newly joined Giant Beasts of the empire overwhelmingly excited.
Above the clouds tinted by the rainbow lights, the over ten thousand meters long Black Gold Giant Beast stood tall, looking at the Dragon King Behemoths on both sides and letting out a low roar.
“Currently, we have completed sweeping the Chaotic Turbulent Region. Next, we shall convene the second Dragon King meeting to discuss the expedition I mentioned before,” it continued with a low growl.
Speaking, the Destruction Emperor Dragon went on, “I come from a world called Blue Star, a world where, aside from us Mutated Beasts, there is a civilization known as the Human Race.”
“I have had dealings with a new generation genius of the Human Race and signed a Summoning Contract for mutual assistance, and there has been communication over time.”
“Currently, there are several pathways between the Blue Star World and the Vast World, and in the direction the Human Race entered, there is a different race called the Purgatory Demon Race.”
“That race is cruel and brutal, leaving all Living Beings polluted and demonized in their wake, including all things in Heaven and Earth.”
“Right now, the Human Race is at war with the Purgatory Demon Race and is slightly at a disadvantage. Therefore, I plan to lead the mighty army of the empire across the Chaotic Domain to aid them.”
“Since this expedition is a private matter of mine, all of you may choose to join or not, and I shall give ample rewards to the Dragon Kings who join the expedition.”
“As long as you can slay at least one Demon God of the Ancient Realm, I will assist in activating your bloodline.”
Boom, Boom, Boom! Hardly had the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking when Jormungand, the Black Kirin Beast, and the Three-headed Gray Python couldn’t help but quake with excitement.
The Black Kirin Beast could not restrain a low roar, “Roar! Thunderflame, is this true?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared back, “Of course, my promises are as good as gold; once given, they are never retracted.”
Seeing this, the Three-headed Ancient Beast looked toward the edge of the Dragon King Mountain Pillars, where two pillars, each tens of thousands of meters in diameter, housed respectively a Deep Sea Dragon Turtle five hundred meters long and a Nine-headed Flood Dragon over seven hundred meters long.
The Three-headed Giant Beast naturally did not forget that, during the campaign against the Chaotic Domain, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had helped them by purifying their bloodline, which allowed the two Level 9 Peak Behemoths to enter hibernation early.
Now that more than half a Sun Wheel had passed, the two Behemoths had awakened as Mythical Giant Beasts.
Most importantly, they perceived that the bloodlines of these King-level Peak giants had smoothly advanced to Monarch, possessing the potential to become Ancient Beasts.
In fact, the Ancient Beasts had been observing the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon ever since they returned from the campaign.
Seeing the excited Ancient Beasts, the Lava Giant Dragon’s nine heads curiously roared lowly, “Roar! Jormungand, why are you so excited?”
“Could it be that the Monarch’s help with bloodline activation can directly advance our species to the Emperor level?”
The bloodline layers of each Ancient Beast had reached Monarch, and they were among the high-level and even peak within the Monarchs due to strength enhancement and bloodline purification.
Seeing this, the Blue-White Giant Dragon and the Time Dragon, who had not witnessed the hibernation of the two Behemoths, also looked on, equally puzzled.
The Gray Python hissed slowly, “During the campaign in the Chaotic Domain, Thunderflame mentioned its breakthrough to the Ancient Realm, awakening a new talent capable of purifying other Behemoths’ bloodlines.”
“At that time, Thunderflame conducted a test on Domination and Kidora, who were at the Peak King bloodline level. As for the result…”
The Gray Python paused there, but the other Behemoths’ eyes widened, incredulous, looking towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Including the Blade Edge Beast King beneath the Dragon King Mountain Pillar, whose ferocious look became fiery, its gaze filled with shock as it looked towards the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon.
A Giant Beast’s bloodline was directly related to its strength; the stronger the beast, the stronger the bloodline, and vice versa.
It was easy to see how important the bloodline was to them.
At this moment, even the Time Dragon and the Blue-White Giant Dragon were a little excited.
The Time Dragon could not help but roar lowly, “Thunderflame, are you certain that all we need to do is slay one Purgatory Demon God to receive your help in advancing our bloodline?”
“Indeed,” confirmed the Destruction Emperor Dragon with a slow nod.
Of course, it had only promised to assist in bloodline activation once. Whether they could advance further and break through to the Emperor level was not its concern.
After all, the successful advancement of the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle was related to their ‘weakness’ in strength.
As for the Time Dragon and other Behemoths like the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon, whose bloodline level was already high, nearing Emperor, there was no guarantee as to how much advancement the Destruction Emperor Dragon could ensure.
Nevertheless, the five Ancient Dragon Kings abruptly stood, roaring, “Roar! What’s there to say? Set off, Thunderflame, and let us slay the Purgatory Demon Race.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1570 - 1570 590 The King of Ancient Times Campaign
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1570: Chapter 590 The King of Ancient Times, Campaign Against Purgatory_4 Chapter 1570: Chapter 590 The King of Ancient Times, Campaign Against Purgatory_4 Apart from the Time Dragon, none of these Giant Beasts had encountered the Purgatory Demon Race before, and they had no idea the strength of that different race or how powerful the Demon Gods were.
But it didn’t matter, for the temptation to break through their bloodline shackles was too great, and they would dare to charge forward even if it meant facing a True Spirit Beast ahead.
After all, with the Destruction Emperor Dragon at the front, they only needed to swarm and attack.
And at this moment, not just the Ancient Beasts, but also the Longa King of the Titan Realm and the Crystal Red Giant Dragon were tempted, their gazes fervently fixed on the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon was very pleased with this outcome.
Although it had stepped into the True Spirit Level and could sweep away all the Demon Gods below it, what if it were tied down by a being of the same realm?
Like that Purgatory ancestor?
At such times, these Ancient Beasts represented a force that could not be ignored.
Among the six Ancient Dragon Kings, aside from the Blue-White Giant Dragon who had just broken through to the Ancient Realm, each one’s combat strength was in the Ancient Middle Stage, Ancient Late Stage, or even stronger.
Especially the Ancient Lava Giant Beast, whose combat power was on par with the Peak of the Ancient, no less than those mighty Lords of the Empire.
Together with the Demon God Level Powerhouses from the Human Alliance and the soon-to-be Supreme Realm-breaker, Jack Clark, the combined strength of both sides was now very close.
Thinking this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Before we depart, there are some arrangements to be explained. The lowest requirement for this expedition is the Mythical-level.”
“In this expedition, no matter who you are, as long as you make a contribution, I will grant rewards,” said the Destruction Emperor Dragon, looking down at the King of Blade Edge.
“For instance, Toriad, if you can slay a Demon God of the same realm, not only will I help you activate your bloodline, but you will also be promoted from the First War General to a Dragon King.”
“A Demon God,” the black ferocious behemoth slowly growled, its eyes revealing a terrifying intent to kill.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon then turned its gaze to Longa, the Titan Dragon King, “For this expedition, after our departure, our power here will be empty, to prevent any accidents, we need to leave a Dragon King to Suppress this place, you all…”
Before the Destruction Emperor Dragon could finish speaking, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared, “Roar! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, I’m not staying behind, I want to join the battle too!”
“Roar, roar, roar!! And Kidora, I have become super strong now; I want to defeat ten of them,” the Nine-headed Flood Dragon also swiftly roared, afraid of being left behind.
And not just them, even the hibernating Silver Giant Dragon forced its eyes open and growled, “And the Great Scythia, let blood flow into rivers, flow into rivers…”
Uh… Alright then.
In the end, all the Ancient Beasts joined the expedition, while Longa, the Titan Dragon King, stayed behind, commanding the Dragon Palace.
Deep Sea Dragon Turtles and others were also adamant about joining, and with the Destruction Emperor Dragon there, what was there to fear?
Roar, roar, roar!!
The Giant Beast legions set out gloriously, on an expedition to Purgatory.
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not in a hurry, since the final decisive battle between the Human Race and the Purgatory Demon Race was not going to erupt so soon, and furthermore, it needed to eat and grow stronger along the way.
It hoped to break through to the Ancient Late Stage before reaching the battlefield, so that even if it couldn’t defeat that Purgatory ancestor, it could still ensure its full retreat.
Meanwhile, once Jack Clark ended his closed-door cultivation, it would coordinate with Adam Garcetti and others about the support for the Giant Beast expedition, and be mentally prepared.
As for teleportation, it is indeed possible to twist and tear space for jumps at the Ancient Level Rule derivative, but only for tens to hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Longer distances require precise coordinates.
Unfortunately, the mythical world is not only vast and boundless, but it is also filled with forbidden areas where Heavenly Earth Rules have collapsed, and reckless spatial jumps are simply suicidal.
An incautious move, and you could be pulled into a deep Spatial Storm or unknown space-time.
By then, even Ancient Beasts could be torn to pieces, their Divine Souls and fragments of their True Bodies scattered, ultimately grinding away and falling.
