chapters.title: Chapter 1571 - 1571 591 Freya Louise who flies towards the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1571: Chapter 591: Freya Louise, who flies towards the sun, attacks Jack Clark Chapter 1571: Chapter 591: Freya Louise, who flies towards the sun, attacks Jack Clark Aside from Jack Clark who was in closed-door cultivation, for the moment, no ‘Person’ knew of the Destruction Emperor Dragon leading the Giant Beast Legions on an expedition to Purgatory to support the Human Race,
In the depths of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, nearly a hundred giant beasts of enormous size were flying at high speeds, waves of rule pressure and fluctuations of law intersecting between Heaven and Earth, their invisible aura shaking the world.
At the forefront of the army, eight giant beasts, exuding an Aura of Ancient Level, flew at the very front, led by a black gold Giant Beast with its double wings unfurled.
At that moment, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly turned its head, looking towards the Time Dragon next to it, which was covered in white scale armor and had double wings shining with silver luminescence, and let out a low growl.
“Kulapavida, the Dragon King, having had contact with the Purgatory Demon Race, do you know how far their territory is from this side of the Chaotic Turbulent Region?”
Because the Destruction Emperor Dragon had once forcibly collided with two Demon Gods, including Diorus, it had encountered Kulapavida and thus did not need other interfaces.
And since this fellow appeared on the side of the Purgatory Demon Race, it obviously also had crossed the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
As a Titan Level Giant Beast of the Time species, it had stronger life-saving methods than many other Ancient Beasts, able to escape by hiding in a Time Rift when in danger.
The Time Dragon growled softly, “Very far. According to our current speed, it will take about five Star Hours (approximately five days) to pass through the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
“And after crossing the Chaotic Domain, even if we fly straight ahead, the remaining distance would take about one Sun Wheel.”
“However, in the Vast World filled with dangers, even as Ancient Beasts, we still need to be cautious when crossing the two Great Forbidden Zones in between, the Sunset Black Sea and the Chaotic Starry Sky.”
“If we choose to go around, the time is expected to extend to one and a half Sun Wheels, and this is under the condition that we don’t encounter any True Spirit Level Horrific Life.”
When speaking of True Spirit Level life, a solemn expression appeared in the eyes of the Time Dragon, as if it had once been chased by a True Spirit Beast while ‘wandering’ outside.
“Almost two Sun Wheels’ worth of journey,” mused the Destruction Emperor Dragon with a nod, which was almost in line with its own estimation.
Earlier, when passing through the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Destruction Emperor Dragon used the sensing of its soul coordinates to make a vague estimation of the distance between the body of the Giant Beast and the human form.
The conclusion was that it was very far away, estimated to be hundreds of millions of kilometers.
Of course, that was the time it would take for the Expeditionary Army at their movement speed. For a pure Ancient Giant Beast, especially Dragon-type Giant Beasts, the journey could take just over ten days.
Now, with the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Chaos Doomsday Rule spreading, enveloping an area of more than a thousand kilometers, the Legion’s normal flight speed was around 300 times the speed of sound.
And along the way, they charged through obstacles recklessly, so the Forbidden Areas were burst open by a few Ancient Beasts that took action, rampant and unrestrained.
Watching the Destruction Emperor Dragon deep in thought, and along with the Silver Giant Dragon and the golden-blue Giant Dragon on its back, the Time Dragon’s gaze briefly paused before it made a suggestion.
“Thunderflame, if you think we’re too slow, we can join forces and tear through space in segments to make the jump.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon came back to its senses and shook its head slightly, “No need, let’s proceed at this speed for now.”
“The dangers of this expedition are not only on the Purgatory Battlefield, but also on the way there. Since they have followed me on this campaign, I am responsible for their safety.”
For Ancient Beasts that have mastered Rule Level strength, many dangers on a journey spanning hundreds of millions of kilometers can be withstood, but not so for Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts.
In the Vast World, being a myth is only the beginning, and any mishap could lead to their downfall.
This accident might come from the environmental conditions of a Forbidden Zone, other more powerful Giant Beasts, or the sudden appearance of Catastrophes.
As for the Time Dragon’s proposal for segmented jumps, it meant the other Ancient Beasts would move at a faster speed, positioning millions to tens of millions of kilometers ahead, and jointly rip open a large Spatial Channel.
The Purgatory Demon Race was able to tear through the Void and transport over millions of kilometers, and naturally, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and other Ancient Beasts had similar methods.
However, under normal conditions, Ancient Beasts could only randomly teleport tens to hundreds of thousands of kilometers, and for greater distances, they needed precise coordinates.
Although one could tear through space and jump without coordinates, if one was not careful, one might end up in the depths of Space Cracks, swept into Space-Time.
Then, even an Ancient Beast could be torn to pieces, its Divine Soul and True Body fragments scattered all over, ultimately perishing.
There’s no helping it; the mythical world is not only vast and boundless but also filled with various Forbidden Zones where Heavenly Earth Rules have collapsed; mindlessly space jumping is just seeking death.
But the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not in a particular hurry, as the final battle between the Human Race and the Purgatory Demon Race wasn’t going to erupt for the time being.
Taking advantage of this time, it planned to find more things to eat on the way, hoping to grow into the ancient late stage by the time it reached the battlefield.
By then, once it entered the Doomsday form, its strength should be above the mid-stage of True Spirit, at which point, if facing the Purgatory ancestor, it could retreat safely even if not victorious.
And if it really came down to needing fusion, the body of the Ancient Stage Giant Beast and the Early Ancient Stage human form merged for a moment; all talents, rules, Divine Powers could probably reach Primordial Level after Deification.
Such strength would be enough to Suppress everything.
As for the issue of separating after the fusion, it was pinning its hopes on the Purple little dragon.
The current Purple little dragon was already a Giant Beast of the Early Myth level, its Creation talent evolving into the Law of Creation, but it was still a bit short of the Creation origin needed to separate the human form from the Giant Beast body.
Therefore, in the time remaining on the road, one needed to find a way to boost the strength of this little fellow to the Titan Level.
A perfect Law of Creation, coupled with the little fellow’s self-sacrificial Burst, the Origin it spewed out should allow Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon to separate again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1572 - 1572 591 Freya Louise Flying Towards the Sun
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1572: Chapter 591: Freya Louise Flying Towards the Sun, Launches a Surprise Attack on Jack Clark_2 Chapter 1572: Chapter 591: Freya Louise Flying Towards the Sun, Launches a Surprise Attack on Jack Clark_2 If that still doesn’t work, consume the “Primordial Origin” and upgrade the Purple little dragon to the Ancient Level.
Deification of this Talent Ability is Jack Clark’s greatest trump card for his future breakthrough into the Eternal Realm, so even with the Purple little dragon, he would not fuse with it unless it was absolutely necessary.
Therefore, on the Human Race’s side, they must try to delay the outbreak of the final battle as much as possible.
Or rather, try not to provoke those Purgatory Demon Gods, to avoid a situation where a Demon God, in desperation, sacrifices itself to forcefully awaken the Purgatory Ancestor.
For the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the advantage lies with it.
If the time can be extended by one or two Sun Wheels, so it can develop further, then the Human Race will surely win this battle.
After carefully calculating the combat power of both sides and any possible accidents, the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared and took the lead in charging into the Space Cracks forbidden area ahead.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Nearly a hundred massive Giant Beasts followed, pouring into the forbidden area, stirring up earth-shaking roars and explosions as they disappeared from sight.
…
Blue Star, the Simon Empire.
Deep beneath the research facility, in the center of a cooled Lava Lake, Number One, with most of its body buried in Black Volcanic Rock, had dim eyes and not a trace of energy fluctuation.
But no change was the best news for Elvis Louise and the others.
Suddenly, an exclamatory cry rang out.
“Report, intense Soul Fluctuations are detected within Number One, the frequencies are complex, we can no longer distinguish which frequency belongs to Young general Louise and Number One.”
“Alert, Soul Fluctuations in Number One have exceeded five hundred percent, six hundred… and it’s still crazily rising.”
As the piercing alarm sounded and red lights flashed, the previously silent Number One suddenly began to tremble, its eyes once again emitting a terrifying blue-white Radiance.
However, unlike before, there was now a hint of agility in Number One’s raging gaze, as if a person who was originally ‘dimwitted’ had been endowed with a soul.
Boom!
The arms of Number One vibrated, and under the Power Explosion, the Earth within a hundred kilometers range shattered, with countless Black Volcanic Rocks soaring into the sky.
The violence of the Power Explosion was so great that the entire underground shook, with cooling magma pillars collapsing and thundering noise deafening.
Amidst the billowing smoke and dust, the nearly four thousand meters tall Number One, with its Black-Red Armor expanded as if wearing heavy battle armor, stepped heavily, slowly approaching the ‘shore’.
Even though Number One had contained its power, the movement of its tremendous body still stirred up a raging wind, blowing so strongly that Elvis Louise could hardly keep his eyes open.
But as he looked up at the colossal Mecha before him, Elvis Louise felt an intense surge of excitement, his eyes slightly red and his voice trembling, “Do you see it, Moon? Can you see it?”
“Miss Flora has successfully merged with Number One, we’ve done it, our initial efforts were not in vain, we have the ability to save the world.”
While Elvis Louise was excited, the elevator behind him suddenly opened, and Emma Louise, who had been far away in Eastern Summer, walked out slowly.
Standing on the command platform hundreds of meters high, Emma Louise raised her head to look at Number One, now in Black-Red Armor, its skin turned Golden-White and body more slender and ferocious, feeling somewhat bewildered.
She hadn’t expected the fusion of Freya Louise with Number One to be so ‘easily’ successful.
They had envisaged various accidents, difficulties, and even prepared numerous emergency measures to interrupt the fusion, none of which were needed.
Emma Louise said softly, “Miss Flora, how do you feel now?”
The colossal Biological Mecha vibrated slightly, and from within came Freya Louise’s cold voice, devoid of any emotional fluctuation, “I feel very good right now, including Number One.”
“At the moment, Number One’s heart has been repaired, and flesh and blood have begun to spontaneously generate around it, starting to replace the biological body originally in Number One.”
“As the ‘bodies’ of those ancient beings start to reform, more Remnant Souls will begin to return and reconstitute.”
“Next, I need to maintain the Primitive state for a long time, with my spirit merging as one with the Azure Sky, to bear the vast, inexhaustible torrent of information.”
“Maintaining the Primitive state for such a long time!” Emma Louise frowned.
With the help of the Primitive Secret Technique, Freya Louise’s soul merged with that special Azure Sky World, becoming for a short time a part akin to a section of the ‘Heavenly Dao.’
But this method was not without cost.
In maintaining the state of the Heavenly Dao for a long time, she might avoid the danger of being drowned by ancient creature soul information, but she might also fall into the Primitive Azure Sky World and become completely assimilated and dissipated.
As a ‘Myth’ realm human, how could she possibly resist an entire Great World?
In the past, she only entered briefly, reflecting her spirit like connecting locally, so the impact was not too great, and she could exit at any time separated by an entire world.
However, if she were to maintain it for a long time, her consciousness might forever fall there, all being assimilated and dissipated.
This move was essentially like using another powerful force to destroy a weaker force, using the Primitive Azure Sky World to counterbalance the return of the fragmented souls of ancient lives.
Within Number One, Freya Louise’s voice remained cold and calm, “This is an inevitable price. I once promised her that I would uphold the world.”
“Now that we are infinitely close to success, no matter the cost, I will not stop.”
There has never been a perfect situation in the world, stealing the power of an ancient being, how could there not be risks?
At those words, Elvis Louise and Emma Louise fell silent, no longer saying anything, as their family, and the entire research facility bore too much.
Freya Louise’s grandfather died twenty years ago because of research into the Sky Support Project, and Elvis Louise’s wife also passed away early due to the erosion of power by Number One.

chapters.title: Chapter 1573 - 1573 591 Freya Louise Flying Towards the Sun
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1573: Chapter 591: Freya Louise Flying Towards the Sun, Launches a Surprise Attack on Jack Clark_3 Chapter 1573: Chapter 591: Freya Louise Flying Towards the Sun, Launches a Surprise Attack on Jack Clark_3 Over the years, Emma Louise, though far in Eastern Summer, has also been involved in the research.
More than a decade ago, Freya’s older sister, as the first generation driver being cultivated, was assimilated during the rampage of Number One due to insufficient data.
At the same time, Emma’s fiancé died during the space-time havoc caused by Number One’s rampage. It could be said that their family had given almost everything for this plan.
Looking at the two people who remained silent for a long time, Freya said in a calm and icy voice, “I now need more Blue Star World energy to maintain the growth of flesh and blood within Number One.”
“According to the current growth rate of the flesh surrounding the heart, it will take at least a hundred years to complete the entire biological body replacement after calculation.”
“More energy?” Emma’s gaze fell on the nuclear plugs on Number One’s back, her expression grave.
Since the integration of Freya with Number One, the nuclear power stations on half of the planet had been in operation non-stop, and it was surprising that even with all the electrical power being transmitted, it would still take a century.
Not to mention, after the completion of the ancient being’s body replacement, further revival would require hundreds or even thousands of times more energy.
Elvis Louise slowly said, “There isn’t enough energy on Blue Star for Number One’s rebirth. To make it regenerate quickly, we can only look to the heavens.”
Emma was startled. “The sun? Isn’t that too risky? Isn’t our next plan to let Number One sink into the core of Blue Star?”
Elvis shook his head. “The core’s energy might not be sufficient, and if Number One devours too much thermal energy, it could greatly destabilize the core.”
“If the core’s balance is disrupted, unless all the Supreme Experts return to suppress it forcibly, the continental blocks would definitely be torn apart by the planet’s violently moving energy.”
“By then, the Doomsday might arrive before the Second Mythical Impact even erupts.”
Emma’s brows furrowed slightly. “Of course I know that, but the sun’s surface temperature seems to be only several thousand Celsius. The trouble is the tearing forces surrounding it.”
“So I think Miss Flora can first enter the core, absorb energy to increase Number One’s strength, and consider entering the sun afterward.”
The sun, as a gigantic celestial body with a diameter of over a million kilometers, is constantly burning and undergoing nuclear fusion, emitting intense light and energy.
And such a massive body, with the terrifying aggregation of matter, also has a gravitation field so immense when it rotates.
Once a Mythical King, driven by curiosity about the sun, took two months to cross over a hundred million kilometers to approach the sun, only to forcibly stop upon nearing the corona.
In the past, with Blue Star’s technology, the corona was observed to be the outermost layer of the sun’s atmosphere, with a thickness of millions of kilometers and temperatures reaching one million Celsius.
But in that Mythical King’s perception, the corona was actually a terrifying zone where space had been completely shattered.
Under the terrible gravity emitted by the rotating sun, the space in that region was completely broken, filled with forces that could instantly destroy the true body of a Mythical King.
However, because outer space is pitch-black and distant, past physicists simply couldn’t observe it.
“There’s no time left.”
Elvis slowly shook his head. “The global spatial fragmentation ahead has already indicated that the Second Impact could erupt at any moment, so we need to accelerate the plan.”
“Moreover, I’ve calculated the strength of Number One after the preliminary integration. With a body stronger than that of an ordinary Heavenly King, it’s more than capable of withstanding the tearing in the sun’s corona.”
“By harnessing the infinite nuclear thermal energy inside the sun, Number One could quickly complete the body replacement.”
“And most importantly, according to my continuous calculations, the core of our fragmented world lies not within Blue Star, but within the sun.”
“What, in the sun?” Emma was once again astonished.
Elvis nodded affirmatively. “Yes, within the sun, and deep within at that. This is the conclusion I’ve drawn based on the Primordial True King’s previous failure to bear the burden.”
“This issue has been discussed with the Primordial True King. The ‘center’ deep within Blue Star is merely an illusion, just a ‘Hollow’ once pierced by a locational force.”
From inside Number One, Freya’s cold voice transmitted, “If that’s the case, then let’s go directly to the sun.”
A few minutes later, the surface of the base’s layers of heavy armor slowly cracked open, forming a black tunnel hundreds of meters in diameter.
Hum!
The bottom of the tunnel faintly shimmered with light, followed by a huge Black-Red Colored Mech soaring into the sky, its engine spraying out fiery radiance like a shooting star.
Under the anxious gaze of many, the gigantic mech quickly breached the atmosphere and surged into the vastness of space at an astonishing speed, accelerating as it went.
In the blink of an eye, a new streak of radiance appeared in the vacuum of space, headed towards the sun.
In the base’s data research, it would take only a few days for that streak of light to land on the sun.
Meanwhile, over 200,000 kilometers away from the Human Race’s Outer Development Department, the range of the Heavenly Earth Law disturbance had already reached 30,000 kilometers, with endless Heavenly Energy converging towards the collapsing funnel in the center.
Below the funnel, the Golden-White Light sphere had expanded to over five thousand kilometers, its intangible pressure becoming more horrifying.
Such vast majesty, especially the chaos caused by the disintegration of Heavenly Earth Laws resulting in thunderous explosions, hurricanes, tornadoes, and collapsing mountain ranges, made the tens of thousands of kilometers around it seem like Doomsday.
Countless Unique Beasts, Giant Beasts, and beings of different races instinctively fled in all directions, forming waves upon waves of beast tides spreading tens of thousands of kilometers.
By this time, three days had passed since Jack Clark’s Closed-door Cultivation.
In the center of that light, which devoured the heavens like a Black Hole, apart from that vague, imposing figure, there was also a Black-Gold battle halberd engulfed in white flames.
Knowing that this Closed-door Cultivation would take a long time, Jack conveniently used five hundred thousand attribute points to fuse the Pseudo-World Level Weapon he obtained from the recent battle into the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
This Pseudo-World Level weapon came from the Supreme Heavenly King Mad Wheeler, and had been with Jack for several days.
But since he had been busy rushing back to Blue Star, absorbing and refining the Primordial Origin to make a breakthrough to the Supreme level, he hadn’t had the time to strengthen the Eight Desolate War Halberd.

chapters.title: Chapter 1574 - 1574 592 Breakthrough to Supreme
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1574: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial Chapter 1574: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, another two days had gone by, with that beam of light in space now nearing the sun.
In the mythical world, more than thirty million kilometers from the battlefield of the Human Race’s forbidden area, endless crimson demon gas was rolling above the Firmament.
Below, over a range of tens of thousands of kilometers, the Earth had collapsed, and the Void had shattered, forming a pitch-black Hollow with a diameter comparable to Jupiter, bottomless and vast.
At the center of the Hollow, a group of palaces composed of thousands of towering Demon Palaces was suspended, stretching for tens of thousands of kilometers, surrounded by rolling demon gas that filled the air with oppression.
Within the demon gas that surrounded the area like dark clouds, two giant shadows, each tens of thousands of meters in length, could be vaguely seen moving. They exuded an aura as mighty as that from the Peak of the Ancient, guarding the Demon Palaces.
Boom!
The sky trembled, and the crimson clouds above the Firmament rolled violently, torn apart by a powerful force, forming cracks that extended for a thousand kilometers.
Behind the crimson fissure, a towering figure slowly emerged, standing three hundred thousand meters tall, with three faces and eighteen arms, its powerful Demon Power shaking space and time as it diffused invisibly.
Behind this imposing figure, a dark crimson Abyss World appeared, with dozens of crimson Rule Chains reaching out from the Void, piercing through a figure that stood thirty thousand meters tall.
The figure pierced by the Rule Chains was robust, covered with red fur, with backward-bending legs, and a broad back towering like crimson mountain peaks, resembling a giant turtle shell.
But at this moment, the strong man’s aura was weak, his body was damaged, covered with large wounds.
And these wounds, continually emitting black smoke under the suppression of the Abyssal Power, sizzled, showing a color of pain on his face.
Boom!
The Ancestral Palace below trembled, and a black pillar of light surged into the sky, forming a vast shadow tens of thousands of meters tall under the skies darkened by the crimson clouds.
Constantin’s will, in the form of a shadow, looked up at the terrifyingly mighty Tyris and his pupils shrank, revealing a hint of wariness, “Tyris, long time no see.”
Towering above the dark crimson Firmament, Tyris slightly lowered his three ferocious heads and spoke in a deep voice, “Indeed, it has been several centuries since we last met, Constantin.”
“After hundreds of years, I wonder how the Ancestor’s injuries have healed?”
Constantin replied slowly, “The Ancestor’s injuries? They’ve healed quite well. His will awoke once before and conveyed to me the order to expand east.”
“Only at that time you were tied up with the Heavenly Feather Clan, and so was the Saint Demon Anke Empire, so we only informed Diorus and the others.”
Watching the Demon God Priest below with a calm expression, Tyris swept his gaze over the vast and stern palace complex and fell silent for a moment before speaking again in a deep voice.
“I just returned from the Deep Red World and encountered Levides waiting for me, asking me to come to the Ancestral Palace to discuss the matter of the eastern Human Alliance.”
Seeing Tyris shift the topic, Constantin’s expression also grew grave: “That Human Race is different from any civilization we’ve encountered over the years; it’s somewhat troublesome.”
“Not only do they grow rapidly, but they also connect with other civilizations, and suddenly their power swelled several times over, and now they’re putting pressure on Diorus and the others.”
“Right now, this alliance composed of three major forces is outwardly led by that veteran Divine King from the Divine Gods Alliance. With combat power at the Peak of the Ancient, even you, Tyris, might not be his match.”
“Besides, there’s the Heavenly Feather Divine King, Tolstoy, who once battled with you, and the mysterious First Councilor of the Human Race, Adam Garcetti, both with combat power at the ancient late stage.”
“Add to that the Summoned Giant Beast that wields True Spirit Combat Power, and we’d need to mobilize all of The Purgatory Family’s strength to suppress them.”
“To avoid unwanted complications, I’ve already prepared to commence the prayer ritual to call upon our Ancestor to return ahead of schedule.”
Jack Clark’s horrifying cultivation speed and the existence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon brought an unprecedented sense of threat to the Demon God Priest, fearing that even Tyris and Carthius working together wouldn’t be safe.
Therefore, it had sent messengers to the Six Great Empires and immediately prepared to awaken the Purgatory ancestors early, hoping to crush the Human Race with overwhelming force in its cradle.
As for first gathering the forces of the Six Great Empires for a decisive battle with the Human Race and then performing a sacrificial ritual to awaken the Purgatory ancestors if unsuccessful, it had never considered that at all.
As a Demon God that had existed for thousands or even tens of thousands of years, it was not foolish enough to give the Human Race any more time to develop.
Especially since that Human Clan Genius was climbing one rung of the Sun Wheel at a time, the Demon God feared that even if the Ancestor was awakened, it might not be able to suppress the Human Race if they delayed any longer.
Tyris slightly bowed his head, the three demon-like faces emitting a terrifying glare, staring intently at Constantin below for a long while before slowly speaking.
“After many years, you have become more cautious, Constantin. This approach is indeed more prudent.”
“However, for us, only that temporarily existing Summoned Giant Beast is a bit of a problem; the rest are not worth mentioning.”
“Take for instance that Divine King of the Divine Gods Alliance; our battlefield with the Human Race is far from the territories of the Divine Gods Alliance, so it would be considered profound if his strength could maintain the Peak of the Ancient.”
“Therefore, we only need to limit Darren Callum’s Summoning methods, and we can suppress this alliance without needing the Ancestor to awaken.”
“I am well aware of this issue,” Constantin shook his head slightly.
“Levides has already carried four strands of the Ancestor’s power to support Diorus, sealing the Summoning Secret Skill of the Legendary Realm Darren and cutting off the Human Race’s Luck.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1575 - 1575 592 Breakthrough to Supreme
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1575: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial_2 Chapter 1575: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial_2 “`
“But even in such a situation, Darren Callum was not left behind; he not only escaped but also reappeared in Human Territory a few Star Hours later.”
“That would be fine, but the Seal on his Summoning Secret Skill and the strength of the Ancestor’s coordinates from the Supreme Plane were also worn away,” said Constantin, his eyes revealing an extraordinarily grave look.
“The terror of this human has exceeded our imagination, not just in his talent, but also in the luck that he carries. This is also why I am preparing to awaken our Ancestor ahead of schedule.”
While the other Demon Gods were mainly focused on the Summoned Giant Beast during the previous battle where four Sovereign Demon Gods fell, Constantin gathered all the information related to Jack Clark.
He carefully studied the central figure who caused their defeat in that battle.
From the initial infiltration of a demon king’s soul into Blue Star, to the first encounter with Darren Callum, and later the descent through the Void Demon Eye to attempt assassination,
including the slaying of a demon king in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, resisting the attack of a Demon God, and the battle that devastated the Demon God Alliance after breaking through to the Legendary Realm.
The more Constantin studied Jack Clark’s growth trajectory, the more alarmed he became.
The geniuses of other civilizations typically show their monstrous talents from the beginning, quickly rising to power, but after breaking through to the Legendary Realm, their strength increase slows down, with most eventually stopping at the Titan Realm.
Only a few of the most monstrous ‘Person’ can step into the Ancients and become beings who wield the rules.
But this human was completely the opposite. According to the information obtained from Blue Star, his performance was quite ordinary in the early stages of transcendence, and then he slowly began to shine.
Once he became a high-order Extraordinary Creature, his strength began to expand at a terrifying speed, and this speed still did not decrease even after stepping into the Legendary Realm. On the contrary, it became even faster.
In almost the time it took them to rest for just a moment, he grew from an ordinary creature of an Indigenous World to a strong man capable of slaying a Demon God.
This growth speed that defies rules and the exaggerated strength almost made Constantin believe that the other party was a Primordial being reborn.
And this was not impossible, as the territory of the Human Race had once seen the fall of a Primordial Creature.
A Primordial Creature is close to Eternity, inherently immortal and undying. Even if its true form dissipates and its Divine Soul Intent extinguishes, it may not completely perish.
According to the records, the Human Race has only been part of the Vast World for around twenty years (equivalent to fifty years on Blue Star).
If the undying essence of Primordial Origin had entered the Blue Star World through the world passageways during this time to reincarnate and revive, it would coincide with this human’s age.
This would also explain why the human initially had ordinary talent, but his strength and talent became increasingly terrifying as he grew stronger.
Because as the reincarnated life grew and its strength increased, the dispersed power of that Primordial Life in the river of time and between heaven and earth would feel the pull and return.
This speculation caused Constantin to break out in a cold sweat.
Because if this conjecture were true, then when that human steps into the Ancient Level realm next, not only will his growth not slow down, but it will accelerate even further.
He might reach the True Spirit stage in just a few Sun Wheels.
And once the other side breaks through to True Spirit, even if he’s at the initial stage, the revived Purgatory ancestor may not necessarily be a match.
Of course, Tyris was unaware of Constantin’s speculation. Looking at the towering figure of the Demon God, Tyris spoke in a deep voice, “The previous failure was due to your underestimation.”
“Although the strength of an Ancestor is powerful and can command rules at will, even the weakest strength can be worn away by the Rule Origin—it’s just a matter of how much it costs.”
“Therefore, this time, my method to deal with Darren Callum is not to Seal, but to completely destroy his Summoning Secret Skill.”
“Destroy his Summoning Secret Skill,” Constantin’s eyes narrowed slightly.
Tyris nodded slowly, “I have witnessed the scene of that human Summoning the Giant Beast, although at the time it was just a Breath.”
“During his Summoning, there will always be a blue altar formed under his feet. Although I do not know the specifics of the altar’s operation, it must involve elements of time and space.”
As a being that had reached the limit of the ancient peak, Tyris had seen a lot and had involvement or knowledge of all kinds of Secret Skills and Divine Powers.
“Thus, we only need to erase the time or space structure of the Summoning Altar, and the altar will collapse, naturally making it impossible to Summon the Giant Beast again.”
“Although this method is not a permanent solution, Darren Callum can still re-cultivate the Secret Skill and re-form the Summoning Altar.”
“But under normal conditions, it would take decades or even centuries to re-cultivate the altar to the stage where it can Summon the Giant Beast again, and even for someone with his talent, it would take several Sun Wheels.”
“But do you think we will give him that much time?” Tyris’s eyes revealed an extremely cold murderous intent as he spoke.
Due to that human’s interference earlier, the Divine King of Light was able to complete the Deep Red Destruction, causing significant losses to Tyris, who in the end only acquired part of the Eternal Divine Tree’s trunk.
And it was a trunk without the heartwood.
Such a huge loss nearly wasted hundreds of years of his efforts, naturally filling Tyris with killing intent towards Jack Clark.
Otherwise, had he been able to assimilate the Eternal Divine Domain and monopolize the complete ‘corpse’ of the Eternal Divine Tree, he might have even had a chance to break the Bloodline Shackles.
What was most important to all the Lords of the Empire was that they did not wish for the Purgatory Ancestor to awaken.
Looking up at the formidable figure in the Firmament, Constantin fell silent for a moment, then slowly said, “Since you, Tyris, already have a plan, why come here?”
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1576 - 1576 592 Breakthrough to Supreme
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1576: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial_3 Chapter 1576: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial_3 Tyris spoke in a deep voice, “Because I need you, Constantin, or rather, I need the Ancestor’s strength to find Darren Callum, and to drag him and the Alien Divine King behind me into the Supreme Abyss.”
“The Kumodo Clan, wasn’t this civilization destroyed by you, Tyris, over seven hundred years ago?” Constantin furrowed his brows.
“Moreover, to achieve this, it requires the consumption of a True Demon’s Scale left by the Ancestors to pinpoint Darren Callum’s true name.”
“Additionally, to open the true Supreme Abyss and to send him and this Alien Divine King across space-time to the Supreme Plane, it requires the consumption of one of the Ancestor’s Origins.”
“This will delay the time of the Ancestor’s return.”
Tyris indifferently said, “Your concerns are completely unnecessary.”
“As long as that Summoned Giant Beast is dealt with—without it, the Human Race is no match before me and Carthius—there will be no need to awaken the Ancestors.”
“I can sense that the wounds to the Ancestor’s Origin from those days have not fully healed; awakening them prematurely could cause foundational damage and lose the opportunity to strike for the position of a True Demon.”
“By that time, Constantin, do you think you can withstand the Ancestor’s divine fury?”
Tyris’s words made Constantin’s expression tighten slightly.
At that moment, Tyris continued, “This Kumodo possesses the power to erase space and conceptually remove all surrounding space of any meaning.”
“This is also why I did not annihilate it, but instead suppressed it within the Abyssal Hell.”
“Over the years, I have been researching how to integrate this power into my Demon God bloodline, and after several hundred years, I have already made some gains.”
“It will also serve as my weapon against Darren Callum this time.”
“This Alien Divine King has already had its will shattered by me and is controlled by a Demon Soul I implanted within it, burning its soul and True Body’s Origin, its strength will reach the ancient late stage.”
“Add in the Intrinsic Weapon of the Heavenly Feather civilization that I provided, after destroying the Summoning Altar, we might even severely injure Darren Callum in the process.”
“When Carthius and the others arrive and the Purgatory Army converges, we will be ready to launch the genocidal war against the Human Race, deciding the outcome in a single battle.”
Tyris indifferently said, “So, what will it be, Constantin? Are you prepared to endure the Ancestor’s fury as they devour you upon awakening, or will you try my plan?”
Uncertainty flashed in Constantin’s eyes as he calculated the success rate of Tyris’s plan.
In the previous battle, Human Race’s Darren Callum displayed strength on the battlefield that not only involved Summoning that Giant Beast but also showed power comparable to the Ancient Middle Stage, approaching the late stage.
And this Demonized Alien Divine King’s strength had reached the ancient late stage, even a notch stronger than Darren Callum’s.
Plus, the Intrinsic Weapon of the Heavenly Feather civilization that was obliterated by Tyris’s empire over a thousand years ago, when burning everything to Burst, approached its pinnacle strength.
And then there was the power that could erase space…
“Let’s try it,” Constantin eventually agreed.
Although as a Purgatory Demon God Priest, all of its being was dedicated to The Purgatory Family, as a Demon God that had lived nearly ten thousand years, naturally, it did not wish to die if it could be Undying.
If it failed, at most, the Ancestor’s recovery time would be delayed by half a Sun Wheel.
But if successful, there would be no need to forcibly awaken the Purgatory ancestors, avoiding the Ancestor’s wrath.
Watching this scene unfold, all three of Tyris’s fierce faces showed satisfaction.
But just as Tyris’s massive form began to move thunderously towards the Ancestral Demon God’s abode, an endless dark radiance erupted from Constantin.
Boom! The collision of two mighty Rule powers made the whole world shake.
Constantin slowly said, “Tyris, it seems you have forgotten that aside from the Ancestral Demon God, no Imperial Demon Gods are allowed into the Ancestral abode by decree.”
Simultaneously, the sprawling palace complex below also trembled, and a Terrifying Power began to awaken deep within, resonating with Constantin.
Roar! Roar!!
The area around the Demon Palace roiled with Dark Demon Air as two huge shadows of Dark Giant Beasts emerged, their icy gazes fixed upon the Demon God’s form above the Firmament.
As Tyris faced the opposing Demon God Priest and the two guardian Giant Beasts preventing his entry to the Ancestral abode, an even more frightening Aura spread from him, making the entire sky tremble under his Demon Power.
That dreadful Aura even exceeded the limits of a Demon God.
However, after a brief standoff, Tyris gradually reined in his power and said in a deep voice, “Having battled the Heavenly Feather Clan for hundreds of years, I’d almost forgotten about this.”
“If that’s the case, I’ll leave it to you.” Speaking, Tyris formed a clasp behind his back with both hands.
Boom!
The dark red Abyss World shuddered, and along with it, the suppressed Alien Divine King shrank, finally condensing into a dark red Light Sphere a kilometer in diameter, grasped in Tyris’s hand.
As Constantin watched the tangible miniaturized world above, a flash of astonishment crossed his eyes.
Relative to the Great Demon King of centuries past, Tyris, having assimilated the Heavenly Feather civilization’s Intrinsic strength, had become even stronger.
And at the moment when his arms cradled the dark red world, Constantin’s expression dramatically changed.
Boom!
Constantin’s form plummeted thunderously, and the space beneath his feet exploded like a meteor descending into the Ancestral abode, collapsing a Demon Palace tens of thousands of meters tall beneath him.
The Earth shook violently, smoke and dust billowed.
From within the tumult of smoke and dust, Constantin strained to support the dark red world and slowly said, “Perdas, entertain Tyris for me outside; I’m going in.”
Roar! Roar!!
The two colossal Dark Giant Beasts let out deep roars, their massive bodies rolling in the Dark Demon Air, faintly conveying their defensive posture.

chapters.title: Chapter 1577 - 1577 592 Breakthrough to Supreme
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1577: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial_4 Chapter 1577: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Reincarnation of the Primordial_4 Above the firmament, Tyris watched Constantin’s figure disappear with a detached and icy gaze.
Passing through palace after palace, barriers after barriers, Constantin came to the depths of the palace complex.
Under the dark shadow of the Dark Demon Air that blotted out the sun and sky, stood a stone statue a hundred thousand meters tall, with the entrance to a collapsing altar at its feet.
Carrying the Dark Red Illusory World, Constantin approached the entrance to the altar with a solemn expression.
Hum!
The moment Constantin approached, the giant stone statue’s eyes lit up, a wave of light swept over Constantin’s body, including the fluctuations of his Divine Soul.
After confirming Constantin’s identity, the statue’s eyes dimmed once more, and the terrifying strength within fell back into hibernation.
However, upon reaching the entrance, Constantin did not enter the altar, but instead slowly closed his eyes, and a complex Black Gold rune emerged on his forehead.
Boom! Driven by the power of that sacrificial rune, Constantin’s consciousness shook, and with a loud bang, he arrived in an immensely vast Dark Starry Sky.
In the depths of the starry sky lay an enormously vast figure, its body covered with pitch-black scales, surrounded by the horror of Dark Rules that tainted and corroded everything.
At this moment, on the head of this vast figure, there was a crack extending from the top of the head to the jaw.
Besides this, in the middle of the enormous body, on the restored scales and battle armor, there was still a trace of a tiny crack, as if it had once nearly been cleaved in two by an unknown force.
But, with thousands of years passing, the injuries of this terrifying being had almost fully healed, with only ‘a bit’ remaining.
Looking at the figure that spread across the starry sky, blotting out the sun, the manifestation of Constantin’s will was filled with fervor as he knelt down respectfully and spoke with devotion.
“Great ancestor of purgatory, your humble servant, Constantin, presents himself before you.”
“I come before you this time with a matter of great importance, to borrow one of your true scales to invoke the descent of your supreme presence…”
Constantin’s willful voice was imbued with a certain sacrificial power, spreading across the entire Dark Starry Sky, echoing, hoping to elicit a response from that great existence.
But after a long while, the entire Dark Starry Sky remained silent, leaving Constantin somewhat disappointed.
For this time, the Purgatory Ancestors still had not responded to him.
However, as the only Demon God Priest appointed by the Purgatory Ancestors before their hibernation, Constantin’s ‘authority’ was very high.
After not receiving a response from the Purgatory Ancestors, an illusory figure of Constantin’s will also had a Black Gold rune emerge on the forehead, instantly resonating with the rules that permeated the entire starry sky.
Boom! The entire Dark Starry Sky shook thunderously, and real chains of rule sequence emerged, emitting an aura that filled all life with dread.
That terrifying power shook space-time, piercing through the material space.
In an instant, spanning billions of kilometers, the Dark Demon Air that enveloped the eight Purgatory Empires shook, thunder rumbled above the firmament, the wind howled, and an endless Dark Red Radiance descended.
Before the astonished gazes of countless Purgatory Demons, Demonized Alien Races, Demonized Beasts, demon kings, and Great Demon Kings, the demonic air in the sky dissipated, and a vast and boundless Dark Red Abyss World slowly descended.
This was not one of those illusory worlds projected by the power of Demon God rules, but a real Supreme Abyss Plane.
At this moment, it was like a gigantic celestial body billions of kilometers in size, standing in the heavens, a million kilometers above, with space-time shaking around it and phenomena swirling.
“Brooks, what, what is that!?”
In a city located on the outskirts of the Purgatory Demon Race, a demon king with branched horns on its head looked up at the sky in horror, while beside it, Brooks also wore a grave expression.
Such a terrifying scene, even hidden by clouds and mist, and more than three million kilometers away from the edge of the Purgatory Empire, Adam Garcetti and the others could still see it.
In an instant, auras of Ancient Level surged into the sky; Adam Garcetti, Primordial, the bases of the Heavenly Feather Clan, and Divine Kings all soared into the sky, standing ten thousand kilometers above with terrifying expressions.
Primordial True King exclaimed in horror, “What’s happening, who’s summoning the Abyss on such a grand scale? This power… Could it be that the Purgatory Ancestor has awakened?”
Boom! Just then, the illusory shadow of the Abyss Plane that enveloped billions of kilometers shook.
No ‘person’ could see it, but beneath the Plane, the Void distorted and a Dark Red scale of balance slowly condensed.
As the Dark Red scale took form in an instant, space-time shook, and a giant black scale emerged from the darkness, falling onto one end of the scale.
At the same time, a Dark Red small world with a diameter of a thousand kilometers and Black Gold blood condensed, with the name ‘Jack Clark’ written in Blue Star Human Race script, also placed on the other end of the scale by an unseen pair of clasping hands.
Hum!
As the balance concluded in an instant, a force that distorted space-time spanned hundreds of thousands of kilometers and appeared some twenty thousand kilometers behind the Outer Development Department.
There, a Golden-White Light Sphere had already expanded to over eight thousand kilometers in diameter, with a terrifying figure faintly visible inside, exuding a horror that shook Heaven and Earth.
And just as the force following the name arrived, the figure inside the Golden-White Light Sphere suddenly looked up, revealing a pair of giant Black Gold vertical pupils that covered the sky.
“This force involves balance and causality, and there’s… seemingly no danger.”
With a contemplative voice, the space around Jack twisted, and his silhouette silently vanished, causing the violently shaking Heavenly Energy of this World to pause momentarily.
Boom! The world, filled with endless Dark Red Radiance and flowing Scorching Magma, shook violently, a figure thousands of meters tall descending from the sky.
In an instant, the Earth shattered, the sky was filled with Scorching Magma and rocks that surged towards the heavens, and the Abyss Demonic Aura permeating between heaven and earth whipped up a massive cyclone that swept across tens of thousands of kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1578 - 1578 592 Breakthrough to Supreme Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1578: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Primordial Reincarnation_5 Chapter 1578: Chapter 592 Breakthrough to Supreme, Primordial Reincarnation_5 At this moment, Jack Clark had already stepped into the Supreme Realm, his aura terrifying, surrounded by golden-white lightning-like radiance.
This lightning, a manifestation of the Supreme Rule, was incredibly terrifying, shattering the Void wherever it passed as if it were a mirror, leaving behind long-lasting gold-red streaks.
Despite his breakthrough into the Supreme Realm, Jack’s true form had not changed much; he still had three faces and ten arms, with six arms on his back holding artifacts like the Great Sun and the Death Grindstone.
The most significant change was in the Eight Desolate War Halberd in his hand.
Enhanced to world-class, the halberd spanned over twenty thousand meters, its shaft wrapped in mysterious dark red runes, emitting an invisibly terrifying and oppressive aura.
Even without activation, the inherent power emanated intense distortion and heavy gravity, repelling the incoming Abyss Demonic Aura and forming a thousand-kilometer vacuum domain around him.
But before Jack could assess what was different about the Supreme Abyss and the Supreme Hell Plane, a brutal aura of Ancient Level ferocity suddenly descended.
Boom! The Earth, tens of thousands of kilometers from Jack, shattered again, and a vicious, mad roar of agony erupted from within the rolling smoke and dust.
Roar!
Beneath the terrifying roar, the entire world trembled as a dazzling dark red glow burst forth, arriving instantaneously at a speed that surpassed time.
Boom! A red mountain, massive as a giant silkworm and ten thousand kilometers in diameter, descended above Jack’s head.
An Alien Divine King, towering over thirty thousand meters tall and covered in fur, stood on the mountain peak, stamping down with the power to collapse the Void and crush eons.
Boom! Boom! Boom! Indescribable terrifying power shattered space over a vast expanse, creating layers of destructive tides that Destroyed Heaven and Earth.
“Seeking death.”
Having been locked onto by the rules, Jack let out a long howl as an even more violent and terrifying power burst forth from him, his halberd radiating dazzling light.
Boom! A Halberd Skill that spanned Heaven and Earth surged into the sky, carrying the pure power of destruction and unceremoniously striking down at the base of the Divine Mountain.
Boom! In an instant, the world fell silent.
Then, at the bottom of the mountain, which harbored the intrinsic power of an entire civilization, huge cracks emanated from the halberd at the center, quickly spreading across the whole Divine Mountain.
Boom! Like a continental block, the Divine Mountain exploded, shattering this piece of Heaven and Earth completely.
In the midst of this apocalypse, a radiance shot up to the sky, a phantom image of the halberd spanning tens of thousands of meters across the Void, suddenly appearing before the Alien Divine King.
Roar!
The Alien Divine King, burning its Origin and True Body, comparable in aura to the Ancient Late Stage, emitted a crazed and brutal roar with its arms crossed and shining with a dazzling Crystal Red Glow.
Under that Crystal Red Glow, the shattered space within a radius of thousands of kilometers froze, forming a dense crystal barrier in front of it.
Thump! Under the Unrivaled Domination of the halberd, Space-Time distorted, and the golden-red space crystals shattered instantly.
In the moment when the space shattered, the Halberd Skill, relentless and indescribably fast, struck the Alien Divine King, breaking the rules and exploding half of its True Body.
Roar! Accompanied by a painful and mad roar, the Alien Divine King turned into a beam of light that fell from the sky, harshly crashing onto the collapsing Abyssal Earth.
[There are two thousand words left for the climax, but it’s almost midnight, so I’m updating now. Brothers, refresh in half an hour.]
Boom! In an instant, the ground collapsed, unleashing endless eruptions of Scorching Magma,
Half of the True Body being blown apart, the terrifying power continued along the inherent fractures of the cosmos.
Roar! The reassembled True Demon God Body let out another roar. This time, without its rule-bound True Body, or rather, its rules had merged with that terrifying force.
Wrapped around the Space-Time Altar, it was shattered by a force like golden-white lightning, destroyed.
“Abyss, are you targeting my Space-Time Summoning Altar?”
Boom!
Under the Unrivaled Domination of the War Halberd, the Alien Divine King was blasted apart again, its aura plummeting yet it still charged at Jack like a frenzied demon, fierce and undeterred by death.
Boom!
Stepping into the Supreme Realm, Jack’s normal strength was comparable to the Ancient Late Stage, and with the world-class Eight Desolate War Halberd, his might was close to the pinnacle. Every move he made was the epitome of Unrivaled Domination.
He slashed out a hundred thousand halberds in an instant, the terrifying force nearly bursting this world apart, leaving the weakened Alien Divine King of the Ancient Late Stage without the slightest chance to counter.
The heavens crumbled, the Earth shuddered, and all things trembled.
But just then, within the completely exploded True Body of the Alien Divine King, a massive black scale appeared, exuding an aura that even Jack found daunting.
But…
Whoosh! In the same instant as the True Demon’s Scale appeared, Jack vanished, merging into the Void, untraceable.
Roar! Roar! The burning Alien Divine King let out a mad and agonizing roar, unable to find Jack.
In the Void, Jack watched the scale with cold eyes, contemplative, then he suddenly reappeared.
Boom! The horrifying True Demon’s Scale quaked Heaven and Earth, causing an apocalypse as the Alien Divine King burned away.
At the same time, the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate appeared behind Jack, as he entered a fearsomely powerful state, comparable to the pinnacle of demon gods, his formidable strike trembling Space-Time, tearing apart Heaven and Earth.
Even the True Demon’s Scale was smashed apart.
But just then, a force pierced through Space-Time and landed on the Space-Time Summoning Mark on Jack’s hand.
Thump! The mark shattered, and a cracking sound emanated.
“Purgatory Demon Race, seeking death,” Jack roared furiously, his voice even piercing through Space-Time and being heard by Tyris and Constantin at the ancestral seat.
“Success.”
But unknown to the two Demon Gods, the Space-Time Summoning Technique was simple for Jack. Just a few tens of thousands of Attribute points were enough for him to re-cultivate it instantly.

Half the True Body was blown apart, and terrifying power surged through the broken void.
Roar! The True Body of the Demon God from different races reconvened and roared again. Devoid of a Rule True Body, one could say its Rule True Body had merged into that terrifying power.
It entwined the Space-Time Altar but was shattered and destroyed by a golden-white radiance that struck like lightning.

Boom!
Under the War Halberd’s unrivaled domination, the Demon God from different races was blasted apart again, its aura falling drastically, yet it still lunged at Jack Clark with a ferocious and relentless intensity, as if possessed and undeterred by death.
Boom!

In just an instant, he struck a hundred thousand halberd blows, the terrifying power almost bursting this world apart. The weakened ancient late stage Demon God from different races had no strength to fight back.
The heavens split, the earth shattered, and all things trembled.

Roar roar!! The burning Demon God from different races issued a mad, painful roar but could not find Jack Clark.
In the void, Jack Clark watched the Demon Scale coldly, contemplative, and then suddenly he reappeared.
Boom! The terrifying True Demon’s Scale vibrated Heaven and Earth and under the Demon God’s fiery destruction, it wreaked havoc.
At the same time, behind Jack Clark, the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate emerged, taking his power to a frightful level, comparable to a mighty Demon God, and with a terrifying strike, he shook the space-time continuum, tearing apart Heaven and Earth.
Even the True Demon’s Scale was smashed into pieces.
But just then, a force pierced through space-time, landing on the Space-Time Summoning Mark on the back of Jack Clark’s hand.
Boom! The Mark shattered, and the sound of breaking echoed.
“Purgatory Demon Race, courting death,” Jack Clark bellowed in fury, his voice even piercing space-time, heard by Tyris and Constantin at the ancestral court.

In a place unknown to the two Demon Gods, the Space-Time Summoning Technique was simple for Jack Clark, who could instantly re-cultivate it at the expense of tens of thousands of Attribute points.
Boom! The Earth collapsed instantly, and endless streams of scorching magma erupted.
Half the True Body was blown apart, and terrifying power surged through the broken void.
Roar! The True Body of the Demon God from different races reconvened and roared again. Devoid of a Rule True Body, one could say its Rule True Body had merged into that terrifying power.
It entwined the Space-Time Altar but was shattered and destroyed by a golden-white radiance that struck like lightning.
“Abyss, is my Space-Time Summoning Altar your target?”
Boom!
Under the War Halberd’s unrivaled domination, the Demon God from different races was blasted apart again, its aura falling drastically, yet it still lunged at Jack Clark with a ferocious and relentless intensity, as if possessed and undeterred by death.
Boom!
Jack Clark, now at Supreme level, possessed the strength of an ancient late stage; with the world-class Eight Desolate Battle Halberd’s enhancement, his power rivaled the peak, and each movement he made was extremely overbearing.
In just an instant, he struck a hundred thousand halberd blows, the terrifying power almost bursting this world apart. The weakened ancient late stage Demon God from different races had no strength to fight back.
The heavens split, the earth shattered, and all things trembled.
But at that moment, within the thoroughly blown apart True Body of the Demon God, a massive black scale emerged, emanating an aura so dreadful that even Jack Clark’s heart shuddered.
But…
Whoosh! The moment the True Demon’s Scale appeared, Jack Clark disappeared without a trace, merging into the Void and becoming undetectable.
Roar! Roar!! The burning demon of different races let out a crazed, painful roar, but it couldn’t find Jack Clark.
In the Void, Jack Clark’s gaze was ice cold as he watched that demon scale thoughtfully; suddenly, Jack Clark reappeared.
Boom! The terrifying True Demon’s Scale shook Heaven and Earth, utterly Destroying Heaven and Earth as it burned the demon of the different races.
At the same time, the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate appeared behind Jack Clark, entering a terrifying state, comparable to an extreme Demon God; his terrifying strike shook Space-Time, tearing apart Heaven and Earth.
That included the True Demon’s Scale, which was also smashed to pieces.
But just then, a force pierced through Space-Time, landing on the Space-Time Summoning Mark on the back of Jack Clark’s hand.
Bang! The mark shattered, and the sound of it bursting echoed.
“Purgatory Demon Race, you’re courting death,” Jack Clark roared in anger, his voice even penetrating Space-Time to be heard by Tyris and Constantin at the ancestral court.
“Success.”
In a place unknown to the two Demon Gods, the Space-Time Summoning Technique was rather simple for Jack Clark. It only took tens of thousands of Attribute points to instantly recultivate.
Boom! The Earth collapsed in an instant, and endless Scorching Magma erupted explosively.
Half of his True Body was blasted away, and the terrifying power continued along an unseen path of destruction.
Roar! The True Body of the demon of different races reconvened and roared again. There was no Rule True Body, or rather, its Rule True Body had been integrated into that terrifying power.
Encircling the Time-Space Summoning Altar, it was annihilated by a golden-white radiance like lightning, completely obliterated.
“Abyss, you are targeting my Time-Space Summoning Altar?”
Boom!
Under the Unrivaled Domination of the War Halberd, the demon of different races was again blown to pieces, and its aura fell sharply, but it still lunged at Jack Clark like a crazed demon, in a terribly fierce, do-or-die assault.
Boom!
Jack Clark, having stepped into the Supreme realm, had normal strength comparable to the ancient late stage. With the support of the World-class Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, he was akin to the peak, every move he made bursting with Overbearing force.
In just an instant, he struck out a hundred thousand times with his halberd, the horrifying power almost exploding this world, leaving the weakened ancient late-stage demon of different races utterly powerless to retaliate.
The heavens split and the Earth shook, all things trembled.
But just at that moment, inside the completely exploded True Body of the demon of different races, a huge black demon scale appeared, emitting an aura that even made Jack Clark’s heart palpitate with fear.
But…
Whoosh! The moment the True Demon’s Scale appeared, Jack Clark vanished, the whole person merging into the Void, impossible to detect.
Roar! Roar!! The burning demon of different races let out a crazed, painful howl, yet it still couldn’t find Jack Clark.
In the Void, Jack Clark looked at that demon scale with a cold gaze, as though lost in thought, then suddenly he appeared.
Boom! The terrifying True Demon’s Scale shook Heaven and Earth, utterly Destroying Heaven and Earth as the demon of different races burned fiercely.
Simultaneously, the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate emerged behind Jack Clark, entering a terrifying state, matching an extreme Demon God; his fearsome strike shook Space-Time, ripping apart Heaven and Earth.
That included the True Demon’s Scale, which was also shattered.
But just then, a power shot through Space-Time, landing on the Space-Time Summoning Mark on Jack Clark’s hand.
Bang! The mark crumbled, and a sound of breaking resounded.
“Purgatory Demon Race, you’re courting death,” Jack Clark bellowed in fury, his voice even penetrating Space-Time, heard by Tyris and Constantin at the ancestral court.
“Success.”
In a location unsuspected by the two Demon Gods, the Space-Time Summoning Technique was quite simple for Jack Clark; with just tens of thousands of Attribute points, he could instantly recultivate.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1580: Chapter 593 The True Name ‘Tian’, Arrival of the Immortal Spirit Chapter 1580: Chapter 593 The True Name ‘Tian’, Arrival of the Immortal Spirit Above the vast crater with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers and a depth of 10,000 kilometers, Jack Clark’s gigantic form rapidly shrank like a deflated balloon and soon returned to its normal size.
Standing in the sky with his black hair wildly dancing, Jack Clark’s eyes seemed pensive.
The Purgatory Demon Race, having existed for over ten thousand years, truly deserved its reputation with its endless tactics. Had he not been strong enough, he would have fallen to one of the many targeted assassinations by now.
Since entering the sight of the higher echelons of the Purgatory Demon Race, Jack Clark had survived three deadly attacks.
One occurred during the Ninth Heavens when he was cursed by a Demon God with a forbidden weapon from a distant space-time; that time, it was blocked by the Beast Soul Seal Forbidden Weapon bestowed by the Primordial True King.
The second time was in the depths of the Purgatory Empire’s rear, where he was ambushed by three Demon Gods who also utilized the strength of the Ancestors.
This attack seemed less dangerous, but that was because he had just made a breakthrough to the Supreme Level; otherwise, if not dead, he would have sustained heavy injuries.
Burning everything in a frenzy akin to that of a king at the peak of the ancient late stage, a godly king imbued with the True Spirit Power within a demonic scale—if the target had been the Primordial True King, he probably would have perished.
“No, their names… the older, the wiser, huh,” Jack Clark realized and couldn’t help but sigh lightly.
He suddenly discovered that he didn’t know the true names of the Primordial True Kings, including Adam Garcetti, the First Councilor; that name probably wasn’t real either.
The fact that he was accurately located and pulled into the Supreme Plane must have been related to his name.
Otherwise, he could not understand how the enemy was able to find him.
The three Supreme Experts of the Human Race were very cautious and had obviously noticed this problem long ago, erasing all information related to their real names.
The names of Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others were no exceptions.
As for him, because he became famous too quickly, he hadn’t had the chance to erase the relevant information before ‘Jack Clark’ became known to the Purgatory Demon Race.
Even though he usually used the pseudonym Darren Callum.
However, the enemy’s expenditure must have been significant this time; otherwise, they would have located and killed each of the Human Race’s kings by now.
Jack Clark slowly exhaled, “It seems I need to find a way to cultivate a Secret Skill that can block this kind of causal power.”
As he spoke, with a thought, Jack summoned the attribute page.
Only now did he have time to go through the changes in the data.
Realm: Supreme early stage[Level: Twelve Tier]
Origin. Physique: 231
Origin. Soul: 205
True Demon God Body: [Juvenile Body, an innate creature from the Beginning of Heaven and Earth, has passed the initial stage and condensed a complete Rule True Body.
Top-tier Divine Power: Vacuum Destruction, Absolute Force Field.
Senior Divine Power: Cross-World Divine Walk, Hidden Deity Heavenly Eye[Condensation of the Rule True Body, underwent Transformation under the influence of Primordial Aura, all previous abilities were improved and enhanced.
True and False Aspect: Consumes Hidden Deity’s energy to touch the intangible fate, condenses a secret Pseudo. True Name, connecting to causality]
Peeping Void True Eye[Upon condensation of the Rule True Body under the influence of Primordial Aura, the Heart’s Eye Divine Power underwent Transformation, and all original characteristics were further enhanced.
Gazing into the Future: Summon the full strength of the True Eye Divine Power, reflect the future with mental power, and have a certain probability to glimpse the shattered fragments of future images.
Remark: The past is set, but the future is not necessarily the future]
Companion Demon God War Weapons: World-Destroying Great Sun, Thunder God’s Spear, Death Grindstone, Soul Lock, Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate]
Deification Talent: Soul Split, Void Death Pupil
Rule of Power: Supreme Power[Proficient]
Primordial Genesis[Proficient, half-merged with Soul Source, temporarily unable to Mobilize, Soul Source Transformation progress 11％]
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture[Seventh Layer 10％]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark[Incomplete, unusable, can consume 60,000 Points Attribute to reinforce, reconstruct the altar structure, and complete the missing space portion]
Supreme Divine Power: Time Reincarnation[+1 Incomplete]
Special Marking: Ancient Duel Mark, Hell’s Eye
Real World: Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder[Large Plane, true range 11,000 kilometers]
Equipment: Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Heavy Halberd[World Level]Demon God Dark World Battle Armor[Pseudo. World Level]
Attribute points: 475200
Soul Points: 3570
Avatar Body: Azure Heaven Dragon
Level: Ancient Middle Stage[Body length 11,600 meters]
Rule: Chaos Doomsday…
Evolution value: 183148/2000000
After a complete step into the Supreme Realm, the attribute page ‘updated’ together with Jack Clark’s increased strength, becoming more concise.
The four major attributes were simplified to two, only physique and soul remained, and the remark changed from the Heavenly Dragon to ‘Origin.’
‘Origin’ refers to those ancient level creatures that have become the beginning of their current bloodline, to advance further would require breaking the shackles of Heaven and Earth.
The data of 231 indicates Jack Clark’s current True Demon God Body strength, equivalent to the compressed overlay of physique from more than two hundred dragons at the ancient early stage.
This was why, just after stepping into the Ancient Realm, his combat power was almost at the peak of the ancient, with the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate shattered, he could even reach the terrifying state of a half-step True Spirit.
Why he isn’t as strong as the Destruction Emperor Dragon who managed to oppose the True Spirit just after breaking into the Ancient Realm, is due to the Heavenly Tier bloodline.
The Heavenly Tier bloodline allowed the Destruction Emperor Dragon to have a higher limit, defying the Heavenly Earth Rules that suppress ancient beings, naturally transforming the force within it to True Spirit Level under Chaos Doomsday form.
Otherwise, the mere ‘quality’ gap in the force level is enough to crush all ancient creatures.
In addition to the change in physique, the Primordial Demon God True Body, due to the condensation of the Rule True Body, passed the initial stage, and other aspects didn’t change too much.

chapters.title: Chapter 1581 - 1581 593 True Name Tian Immortal Spirit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1581: Chapter 593 True Name ‘Tian’, Immortal Spirit Arrives_2 Chapter 1581: Chapter 593 True Name ‘Tian’, Immortal Spirit Arrives_2 Vacuum Destruction still ranks as a top-tier Divine Power, but the previously ordinary Hidden Deity’s Eye has transformed into the Heavenly Eye.
The newly acquired True and False Aspect ability made Jack Clark’s eyes light up, and he couldn’t help but reveal a faint smile on his face, “It seems like a pillow has come when one is dozing off.”
He was just thinking about how to deal with the issue of his name, and he didn’t expect the Hidden God Divine Skill that evolved with his True Demon God Body would solve this problem.
Directly on the level of his life’s fate, he condensed a true name that truly belonged to him to replace the trace of his current name in the realm between heaven and earth.
The reason why the word ‘pseudo’ precedes his true name is because Jack Clark’s current strength has not reached the Primordial, and he has no right to possess a true name.
In addition, the Heart’s Eye also advanced to a Senior Divine Power and, as Jack Clark casually guessed before, gained the ability to peep into the future.
However, for now, he can only briefly see some fragmented future images, not a complete foreseeing of the future, so it’s not as strong as imagined.
This is why there are further notes.
The past is set and cannot be changed, but the future one sees might not necessarily be the future since the future is always changing.
As long as the things that are destined to happen in the future have not yet occurred, not becoming a done deed, they can always change due to an accident.
Besides, the Illusion Meditation Scripture which cultivates the soul has also unconsciously made a breakthrough to the Seventh Layer.
As for changes, Jack Clark only felt that his soul became stronger, but he was unsure whether this was due to the breakthrough of the Cultivation Methods or the influence of the Primordial creation rules.
Then, there was the shattered Space-Time Summoning Mark. Jack Clark had already planned to re-cultivate it from scratch, but to his surprise, it only required 60,000 Attribute points to be reshaped.
Seeing the remarks behind the Secret Skill, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but smile.
The Purgatory Demon Race spent a lot this time, paying the price of an Alien Divine King from the ancient late stage, yet they only made him expend 60,000 Attribute points.
If they knew this was the outcome, one wonders if they would die of rage.
With a single thought from Jack Clark, a voice rose in his mind, and he decisively said, “Expend 60,000 Attribute points, repair the Space-Time Summoning Mark.”
Although his current peak combat power should be comparable to half a step into the True Spirit, the Space-Time Summoning Secret Skill is still an ace up his sleeve before the True Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon arrives.
There is a big difference between having it and not having it.
As 60,000 Attribute points vanished, a surge of potent strengthening energy emerged within Jack Clark and poured into the back of his left hand, majestic and awe-inspiring.
Boom!
The incomplete mark, with only a few gloomy blue traces remaining, shone brightly while countless Rune Sequence Chains burst forth, rotating around Jack Clark and continuously proliferating.
Soon a huge gloomy blue altar reappeared at Jack Clark’s feet, its invisible radiance distorting space-time.
Just as the Space-Time Summoning Mark was recondensing, the Black Gold Giant Beast that had reached the other side of the Chaotic Turbulent Region stopped in its tracks and looked up in this direction.
Although the mark was repaired, Jack Clark did not leave immediately; instead, he sat cross-legged in the Void.
The problem of his name still needed to be solved; otherwise, situations like this one would arise again, and the ‘Person’ taking action might be an even more powerful being from the different races.
“What should the true name be?” Jack Clark mused softly as he sat cross-legged.
He had a premonition that this ‘modification’ of his true name might well be his real name when he broke through to the Primordial in the future, so it had to be something more domineering.
If the Destruction Emperor Dragon is ‘Cang,’ then his true name shall be ‘Tian,’
When the time comes for late-stage Deification Unity, he will be the true Cangtian (Heaven).
Boom!
Just as Jack Clark affirmed in his heart that the pseudo. True Name was Tian, a thunderous roar that no one could hear seemed to explode in the Firmament above, vibrating the Void.
……
“The peak of the Demon God, how is that possible!”
With a cry of astonishment, Air Vibration erupted, and a black radiance shot up from the Ancestral Palace, reconstituting the figure of Constantin under the dark red Firmament.
But now, Constantin’s face was filled with shock, as he said to Tyris who stood solidly behind the cracks with great concern, “Tyris, that human has stepped into the Demon God Level!”
The rate of Jack Clark’s growth had once again surpassed Constantin’s imagination.
At the battle ten Star Hours ago, although that human’s combat power was comparable to a Demon God of the Ancient Middle Stage, his realm was still in the late period of the Human Race’s Heavenly King.
In Constantin’s estimation, no matter how stunning that human’s talent was, it would take at least a Sun Wheel above to advance to the Demon God Level.
This amount of time would have been enough for them to congregate all their power and destroy the Human Alliance.
After all, under normal conditions, a Great Demon King with extraordinary talent would consume decades just to progress from the mid period to the peak.
And from the Great Demon King to the Demon God realm, it could take hundreds of years to break through.
Therefore, Constantin’s expectation for Jack Clark was already quite exaggerated, even considering the possibility that he might be a reincarnation of a wisp of Primordial Origin.
But unexpectedly, in the blink of an eye, the human had stepped into the Demon God Realm.
And at the moment when the second True Demon’s Scale was activated, revealing a surge of True Spirit Power, the overseeing Constantin vaguely saw that overbearing halberd thrust.
It was a terrifying strike comparable to the peak of the Demon God Level, a strength that could not be easily found even among the entire Purgatory Demon Race.
Observing the somewhat ‘out of control’ Constantin, Tyris spoke gravely, “The growth rate of that human is indeed a bit beyond our expectations.”
“However, he has just stepped into the Demon God Realm; while his real combat strength has reached the peak of the Demon God, he is not invincible.”
