chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1582: Chapter 593 True Name ‘Tian’, Arrival of the Immortal Spirit_3 Chapter 1582: Chapter 593 True Name ‘Tian’, Arrival of the Immortal Spirit_3 “And none of that matters. What’s important is that our goal has been achieved.”
Tyris’s voice was steady, his expression detached and calm, “Now, without that Summoned Giant Beast, there is no one in the Human Alliance who can stand against me.”
Tyris was confident; even before he had assimilated the trunk of the Eternal Divine Tree, the peak of his battle prowess with two True Demon God Bodies merged was comparable to a demi True Spirit.
Now, a single True Demon God Body had reached the limit of Demon Gods, and with both True Bodies merged, he would completely surpass the Demon God Limit, obtaining the strength to directly contend with a true True Spirit entity.
Although it was just the kind of ‘ordinary’ True Spirit who had just entered the True Spirit Realm, and had no ability to battle above their level.
Even so, his strength still reigned supreme over all demons.
Had it not been for fear of that stronger Summoned Giant Beast, he would have long since invaded the Human Alliance and suppressed everything with absolute power.
Constantin said solemnly, “Tyris, we can’t give that human any more time. We must immediately wage war and crush the Human Alliance.”
“Indeed, we cannot give that human any more time.”
Tyris slowly nodded, “Wait for me to personally visit the Saint Demon Anke Empire, and notify Diorus to get ready. Five Star Hours (five days) later, we’ll launch an annihilative war.”
Unlike the Heavenly Feather Clan, which appeared massive but had reached the limit of current civilization’s development, and could be slowly exhausted and worn down over time,
the Human Race, an enemy that grows swiftly and expands every moment, must be rapidly suppressed with overwhelming might.
Even if this battle costs many Purgatory Demon Gods, and results in the fall of a large number of demon kings and Great Demon Kings, it would be worth it—after all, these demons are meant to be expended at crucial moments.
Additionally, with caution in mind, Tyris is preparing to meet with another Great Demon King.
With the Immortal Spirit Remnant Race annihilated, and having assimilated the intrinsic power of a civilization, Carthius’s strength was no less than his; together, they would be sufficient to suppress the Human Alliance.
Moreover, the injuries of the Purgatory ancestors were more severe than they had imagined.
Without the threat of the Human Alliance, Constantin surely would not dare to awaken the Ancestor forcefully, or else he would be unable to bear the wrath of the Ancestral Demon.
This was good news for him.
Boom! The Void trembled, and Tyris’s huge True Body slowly vanished into the depths of the cracks, leaving only Constantin standing solemn in the Firmament.
After a long while, Constantin turned into a black Radiance and disappeared in the Demon Palace of the ancestral land.
Soon, the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, where the elite legion had nearly been annihilated in a recent battle, and the Grita War Demon Empire were shaken once again, and the various Great Demon Kings and demon kings emerged from retreat one after another.
At the same time, over two hundred million of the Purgatory Legion, from the union of the Demon King Dark Sky, Belvetan, and Freymand’s three empires, arrived just outside of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.
Even before they approached, the overwhelming Demon Power plunged the entire world into darkness.
In the clouds of Demon Clouds that blotted out the sky and sun, the towering figures of over a hundred demon kings and Great Demon Kings stood, as if they were an expedition emerging from the depths of Abyssal Hell.
Above these demon kings, six figures emitting Terrifying Auras appeared intermittently visible.
On the edge of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, Brooks, enveloped by demon gas, stood behind Tarolia, his expression grave as he looked ahead.
They came fast. The last great battle had only just ended a short while ago, and legions from the other empires had already come to support them. Weren’t there supposed to be disputes among the Eight Great Empires?
While Tyris was heading for the Saint Demon Anke Empire, and Jack Clark was consolidating his pseudo-true name, an atmosphere of tension arose on the side of the Human Alliance due to the terrifying phenomenon that had just occurred.
Above the base in the forbidden area battlefield, in the empty white space, ten towering figures stood on their thrones.
The ten figures were the three Supreme Experts of the Human Race including the True Martial Heavenly King, as well as the Heavenly King Mad Wheeler, who had returned from the pinnacle of the Heavenly King realm and wielded the Supreme Law comparable to Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings.
The rest were the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan, the Lord of Holy Light at the pinnacle of the Main Gods who could compare with the ordinary Demon Gods, and Tarodel, a Divine King of the Divine Gods Alliance.
Adam Garcetti said slowly, “Ladies and gentlemen, did you all witness the Abyssal Descent that just occurred?”
The Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy nodded gravely, “Such an astonishing phenomenon has naturally been seen by all, but it is currently uncertain whether it signifies the awakening of the Purgatory ancestor.”
“That Purgatory ancestor is said to have been grievously injured and in hibernation for thousands of years. If it’s awakened, it means the injuries have healed, and that would spell despair for us all.”
As he said this, all ‘persons’ fell into silence.
Though they had never truly seen the Purgatory ancestor, as an ancient True Spirit level being, even its name alone was enough to make all the Divine Kings and Supreme Experts feel suffocated.
Adam Garcetti nodded, “That’s why I’ve called this meeting, to discuss our countermeasures.”
[Please wait, there is a bit more to wrap up. Brothers, refresh in half an hour]

chapters.title: Chapter 1583 - 1583 594 Five-Colored True Spirit The Clash
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1583: Chapter 594: Five-Colored True Spirit, The Clash Between Empires Chapter 1583: Chapter 594: Five-Colored True Spirit, The Clash Between Empires The Great Sun sank westward, and the lingering glow of the sunset tinted the entire world a dark blue.
Above a forest resembling a blue ocean, composed of countless towering ancient trees, more than a hundred massive cities, each dozens to hundreds of kilometers in diameter, were suspended.
Cloud Mist wove between these cities, where many dressed in ancient-styled clothes from the Immortal Spirit Clan all looked solemn, their gazes fixed on the front of the formation.
There, high above, where blue celestial light diffused like an ocean, stood more than a dozen figures enveloped by white, blue, and purple celestial auras, resembling immortal gods from legends.
Among these individuals were the Nether Heavenly King of the Human Race and over a dozen Immortal Monarchs and Kings.
At this time, every ‘Person’ had a grave expression as they looked toward where Jack was, and although they were separated by over a hundred thousand kilometers, the terrifying impact of the explosion in front of them still trembled their hearts and souls.
That power was too mighty, like a self-detonation of an Immortal King, with a lingering oppressive force that still hung between heaven and earth, refusing to dissipate.
The Nether Heavenly King said with concern, “That region is close to the range of our clan’s Outer Development Department, the vast rear. How could such a strong fluctuation of battle occur there?”
Next to the Nether Heavenly King, a handsome middle-aged man pondered, “The Nobility Tripartite Alliance, the power it has gathered is no less than our clan at its peak.”
“With such strength, even if besieged by three or four Purgatory Empires, they would be able to hold on for quite some time. It’s unlikely that the situation would change so drastically in such a short period.”
“The force that erupted earlier had an Overbearing aura distinct from the darkness of the Purgatory Demon Race; there is a high chance it was caused by a battle between ancient creatures that had wandered into the area.”
“Brother Russ speaks logically,” the Nether Heavenly King nodded slightly.
As the two conversed, three rays of light flickered above the heads of the crowd and transformed into three figures, each exuding terrifying pressure of the Ancient Level.
In an instant, all the people’s expressions turned serious, and they greeted with respect, “We see before us three Immortal Kings.”
Among the three, an elderly man with white hair nodded slightly and said slowly, “The fluctuation of Heavenly Energy ahead has subsided, with only a faint aura remaining; one party to the conflict has already left.”
“This vicinity is nearing the Human Race, and forbidden areas surround both sides, making detours clearly impossible.”
“Next, I will go over with Sean and the others to investigate. You all lead the army and follow behind. If you detect an outbreak of battle ahead, stop immediately.”
Although there were no longer any signs of battle up front, the three Immortal Kings of the Immortal Spirit Remnant Race remained cautious, not daring to take any chances when unsure if they were approaching friends or foes.
Moreover, with their cultivation, joining forces was sufficient to deter any ancient beings lingering there from making a move against the troop.
After exchanging greetings, the white-haired Elder, along with the middle-aged man holding a pagoda and the young man in a white robe carrying a long sword, turned into streaks of light and vanished in an instant.
As they watched the three Immortal Kings depart, the fourteen Immortal Monarchs standing in the blue light and cloud sea paused briefly before scattering as rays of light to various cities.
Soon, the cluster of Floating Cities shook mightily, carrying the roar of mountains and seas, as they flew towards the front.
To the three mighty Immortal Kings, a hundred thousand kilometers was a distance quickly traversed; they appeared atop a gigantic crater tens of thousands of kilometers wide.
The three Immortal Kings were concealed within the Space Cracks, their auras withdrawn, undetectable.
But before they could survey their surroundings or search for the figure with the lingering powerful aura, a deep voice slowly resonated between heaven and earth.
“Who might you be?”
As the deep voice echoed, the space in the distance distorted, and Jack, with his black hair flowing over his shoulders, appeared out of thin air, standing in the void with an indifferent expression, eyeing the area where the three were in the Space Interlayer.
Beneath the gaze of those Black Gold vertical pupils, all things lost color and could not hide, even if the others had blended into the depths of space with the power of rules.
“This… strong man of the Human Race, please do not misunderstand. We did not intend to pry,” an old voice said.
Amid the elderly tone, three Immortal Kings emerged from the depths of the Space Interlayer, all carrying a trace of surprise and gravity in their eyes as they looked at the young man in the distance.
Their astonishment stemmed from the aura of the realm the other party emitted, which seemed from the early stages of ancient times.
And their gravity was because this apparently Human Race young man exuded an unseen aura that made them feel in danger, a sign that his true strength far surpassed his realm.
As their conversation carried the Will of Divine Souls, despite the language barrier, it did not hinder communication.
Facing the three ancient figures, Jack said slowly, “It seems the three sirs are familiar with our Human Race. May I inquire as to your names?”
Truly a Supreme Expert of the Human Race. The faces of the three Immortal Kings immediately displayed smiles.
The middle-aged man holding the pagoda said with a smile, “To actually meet a Supreme Expert of the Human Race, we are Immortal Kings from the Immortal Spirit Clan, invited by the noble Nether Heavenly King to form an alliance.”
“Strong fluctuations of ancient-level battle appeared here, so we came ahead to check. The main force is still in the rear.”
The Immortal Spirit Clan.
Even Jack paused for a moment at this before his face broke into a warm smile, “I didn’t expect to meet the renowned Immortal Kings of the Immortal Spirit Clan. You’ve traveled a long way; your efforts are appreciated.”
“I am the Human Race’s fourth Supreme Expert, having made a breakthrough to Supreme ‘not long ago,’ my title is Divine Martial, may I ask how to address the three of you?”
Jack of course knew about the Nether Heavenly King’s envoy to the Immortal Spirit Clan, but he had not expected that they had truly managed to bring this different race over.
Together with the coming main force, once this power joined the Human Alliance, the strength of the alliance would surge significantly.
The elder with white whiskers stroked his beard and sighed, “Divine Martial sir flatters us. A defeated race is not worth mentioning. This time, we have come in the hope of gathering everyone’s strength to resist Purgatory together.”
“I am known as Wind Heaven,” said the elder, looking towards the middle-aged man holding the pagoda, “This is Sean Immortal King, and the one over there is Profound Sky King.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1584 - 1584 594 The Collision between Empires of the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1584: Chapter 594 The Collision between Empires of the Five-Colored True Spirit_2 Chapter 1584: Chapter 594 The Collision between Empires of the Five-Colored True Spirit_2 “Greetings to both Immortal Kings,” Jack Clark greeted them with a courteous nod.
“You’re too kind,” the two Immortal Kings returned the gesture.
The smiles on the faces of the four of them grew warmer. Jack Clark’s was due to the arrival of another batch of reinforcements, which added an edge to the upcoming battle that was on the verge of bursting into action.
The Elder amongst the three Immortal Kings was the strongest, emitting an aura that faintly disclosed a presence at the peak of the ancient stages, while the other two were also in the ancient late and mid-stages.
In terms of comprehensive strength, they were a level above the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan.
The three Immortal Kings were equally excited.
They hadn’t expected that a member of the Human Race who had just advanced to become a Supreme Expert would possess such formidable strength, causing even the Wind Heavenly King to feel some apprehension. What of the three seasoned Supremes mentioned by the Nether Heavenly King?
Besides that, there was also the Divine Gods Alliance, another strong force from the Heavenly Feather Clan that had been at war with the Purgatory Empire for many years.
With these thoughts, all three Divine Kings were brimming with confidence for the upcoming alliance expedition.
Although the group had revealed themselves to prevent misunderstandings and conflict, it wasn’t so easy to fully trust one another at once.
Thus, after exchanging greetings, the four of them stood tall above the Firmament, chatting in a relaxed and casual tone, quietly awaiting the arrival of the main force from the rear.
Jack Clark needed to see the Nether Heavenly King to confirm his identity, and the thoughts of the three Heavenly Kings were much the same.
Soon, as the four waited, an hour passed. From behind, a massive fleet of Floating Cities rapidly appeared on the horizon, casting vast shadows.
When the Immortal Spirit Clan army was still a thousand kilometers away, more than a dozen Radiant lights streaked across the sky, appearing behind the three Immortal Kings and all looking towards the black-haired young man standing in the Void.
The Nether Heavenly King was especially taken aback, unable to confirm with certainty, “You are… Jack… Clark?”
He was very familiar with the young man before him; after all, he had personally witnessed Jack Clark completing the Path of the Gods. What baffled him was the Realm breath that was faintly emanating from Jack Clark.
Supreme!! How could that be?
Jack Clark smiled slightly, “Senior Nether, welcome back, you must have had a tough journey.”
The Nether Heavenly King shook his head slightly, still in a daze, “This mission to the Immortal Spirit Clan was not particularly arduous, but… what’s with your realm, Jack Clark?”
At that moment, the Nether Heavenly King still couldn’t fathom that, in just half a year or so, Jack Clark would evolve from a mere Seven Layer Heaven Cultivator to a Supreme Expert.
This was just too exaggerated, wasn’t it? Even the Nether Heavenly King couldn’t help but inwardly complain at that moment.
Knowing what he was thinking, Jack Clark smiled slightly, “After you left, Senior, many major events unfolded, and my cultivation also broke through its limits amidst successive battles…”
With that, Jack Clark briefly recounted to the Nether Heavenly King the events that transpired since his departure: the erupting Heavenly Abyss War, the fall of the Primordial Beasts, the Heaven-Earth Mutated Sky Curtain battle, and the expedition against the Heavenly Feather Clan.
He also mentioned the great battle in the forbidden area sparked by the alliance of the three major powers and slaying four Demon Gods, including, incidentally, the changes in his own strength. Anyway, after every major battle, his cultivation soared, ultimately culminating in a breakthrough to Supreme.
By the time Jack Clark finished recounting, the Nether Heavenly King was so stunned he didn’t know what to say, as if he felt the era had abruptly shifted.
Just by embarking on a mission to the Immortal Spirit Clan, the strength of the Human Race had suddenly swelled, becoming a powerful force that openly possessed eleven Supreme and Divine King level combatants.
And they had indeed formed an alliance with the Heavenly Feather Clan.
That was not all; the once-emerging monster had, in the blink of an eye, become a central pillar of the alliance, with strength so great that even he had to look up to him.
While the Nether Heavenly King was flabbergasted, the three Immortal Kings and fourteen Immortal Monarchs were greatly heartened, seeing hope for victory over the Purgatory Demon Race in the news shared by Jack Clark.
The Nether Heavenly King expressed his amazement with a sigh, “I had no idea that so much had happened in the half year I was away.”
“Indeed, there have been significant changes,” Jack Clark nodded in agreement.
As he spoke, Jack Clark turned to the three Immortal Kings of the Immortal Spirit Clan and apologized, “Esteemed guests, you have travelled far, and ordinarily, I should personally take you to the alliance.”
“However, I have matters to attend to at the moment and must venture into the mythical world, so I must continue to rely on Senior Nether to escort everyone there. I hope for your understanding.”
With the Nether Heavenly King vouching for them and the Heart’s Eye confirming there was no issue, Jack Clark was ready to deal with the Giant God Grayson.
Now that he had attained the Supreme rank, his next step was to conclusively settle the grudges with the Evil God Alliance.
“…Over there, no need for formalities, Lord Divine Martial,” the three Immortal Kings paused for a moment, then immediately smiled, indicating there was no need to worry.
With the information from Jack Clark indicating that the Human Alliance currently held an advantageous position, the mood of the Immortal Kings and Monarchs was relatively light, including the Nether Heavenly King.
After exchanging greetings and with Jack Clark’s departure, the fleet of Floating Cities vibrated once more and headed off in the direction of the Outer Development Department.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark dealt with Giant God Grayson, the Giant Beast legions that had just travelled a million kilometers outside the Chaotic Domain gradually came to a halt.
Before the vast ranks of the Giant Beast legions lay mountain ranges interweaving across the land, scattered with variously colored ores and vegetation that looked like a dreamy paradise under the dim sky above.
What made the Giant Beast legions stop was a kilometer-long blue metal Flying Dragon with Mythical Aura and twin wings, as well as the different races that mounted the dragon.
An entity standing a hundred meters tall, covered in thick blue armor, with two horns on its head resembling a humanoid bull monster, wielded a gigantic trident weapon and shouted.
“Halt! This is the territory of the great Five-Colored Realm, and without the permission of the great Five-Colored Sovereign, no mythical creatures are allowed to enter.”

﻿Chapter 1585: Chapter 594: The Collision Between Empires and the Five-Colored True Spirit_3 Chapter 1585: Chapter 594: The Collision Between Empires and the Five-Colored True Spirit_3 Facing giant beasts with bodies as immense as mountain ranges, exuding the aura of ancient times, this realm’s Mythical Peak alien Bull-man showed not a trace of fear.
And when it raised its trident, the heaven and earth behind it shook with a thunderous rumble, the Earth’s surface bursting with five-colored light, endless brilliance soaring up to the sky.
Boom!
In an instant, a True Spirit Level Terrifying Will descended, transforming into a five-colored giant shadow that stretched across the space between heaven and earth.
This was the Heaven-Patrolling Yaksha’s confidence—responsible for patrolling the empire’s territorial boundaries, it not only possessed great personal strength but also held the right to mobilize the Heavenly Earth Rules of this world.
Of course, the most important thing was the True Spirit Life standing behind it.
Therefore, even when facing an army with several Ancient Beasts, it knew no fear; such beings were not uncommon in their empire.
Looking at the Terrifying Aura of the giant shadow behind the Heaven-Patrolling Yaksha, as well as the Power Pressure of True Spirit Level strength, all beasts except the Destruction Emperor Dragon had a moment of concentration in their eyes.
The Dust Serpent, with a body length of over ten thousand meters, hissed, “King, ahead lies an empire established by True Spirit Life. Should we detour?”
The other Ancient Beasts also looked towards the leading Black Gold Giant Beast.
Their target this time was an expedition against a civilization known as Purgatory Demon and felt it unnecessary to provoke a conflict with a strange True Spirit empire.
Casting a glance at the five-colored giant shadow stretching across the world, emanating True Spirit Aura, the Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its head to look at the Time Dragon.
The Time Dragon was somewhat baffled, “When I passed by here over a hundred years ago, it didn’t look like this. There were no giant beasts founding an empire.”
“Is that so.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon nodded slowly, then its gaze turned icy as it looked at the hostile Heaven-Patrolling Yaksha, its deep, authoritative growl shaking heaven and earth.
“Let’s go, pass through directly. Taking a detour is too time-consuming.”
The chassis controlled by True Spirit Level Giant Beasts spanned at least tens of millions of kilometers, not to mention the possible forbidden areas or faults nearby, making detours excessively time-consuming.
Besides, the True Spirit Power it stirred seemed not very strong and did not give it a sense of danger.
If the other side was wise, it would join the empire for the expedition. If it sought death, the Destruction Emperor Dragon wouldn’t mind ‘eating’ it—it needed more energy to grow anyway.
“Stand…” Watching the Black Gold Giant Beast burst into motion, brazenly invading the five-colored territory, the Heaven-Patrolling Yaksha was startled and was about to block its way.
Boom! Underneath the Black Gold Dragon Claw, everything in heaven and earth, including space, exploded, forming a chaotic Hollow a thousand kilometers in diameter.
The Heaven-Patrolling Yaksha, along with the Bronze Flying Dragon beneath it, exploded without even a chance to scream, their Divine Souls annihilated by leaping black lightning.
A mere Mythical Life dared to be so arrogant in its presence, courting death.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon casually eradicated the Heaven-Patrolling Yaksha with a single swipe, the five-colored giant shadow standing in the world began to tremble, its eyes suddenly lighting up.
Roar!
This time, not waiting for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to make a move, the Ancient Lava Giant Beast following behind let out a brutal roar, the light intensifying in the mouths of its nine heads.
Nine breaths, resembling condensed magma, shot out, spanning thousands of kilometers and instantly slamming into the five-colored luminous shadow.
Boom! Dazzling light flashed between heaven and earth, a Terrifying Full-Force Strike instantly shattering the five-colored giant shadow, leaving behind only an expanding dark red Great Sun.
The dark red Great Sun expanded to three thousand kilometers before it abruptly stopped, then rapidly collapsed. In extreme compression, it burst forth with even more dazzling light.
Boom!
Infinite red light erupted, sweeping over a range of more than ten thousand kilometers in an instant. Where it passed, space shattered, mountain ranges crumbled, and the Earth disintegrated into ashes.
In the blink of an eye, the world that had been colorful and paradisiacal turned into a hell with flowing Scorching Magma, casting the shadows of Doomsday against the darkened sky.
Looking at the Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon standing next to the Destruction Beast, exuding Terrifying Aura, awe filled the eyes of all Titans and Mythical Giant Beasts behind it.
Including the Ancient Beasts like the Time Dragon, they were also surprised by the power of this strike.
Only the Destruction Emperor Dragon had an indifferent and calm expression.
Each head of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon had the attacking might of a full-strength blow from an Ancient late-stage Beast, coupled with the integrated strength of the Lava World within its body, its power only beneath that of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“Go!”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled lowly, its massive body bursting through space, creating waves of dark turbulence as it flew straight ahead, appearing ten thousand kilometers away in an instant.
Roar roar roar!! The Dust Serpent and the other Giant Beasts let out dignified roars, at full Power Explosion, and hurriedly followed behind.
Since the Destruction Emperor Dragon didn’t care, what was there to fear? They just had to charge forward.
The Dragon Palace possessed eight Ancient-level Giant Beasts, among which the strongest, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, surpassed the Ancient Boundary. Even if the others were also True Spirits, what of it?
“Roar! Wait, King.”
The last Kirin Beast roared, its body bursting with dazzling Black Gold light, covering thousands of kilometers and encompassing all the Giant Beast legions before erupting outwards.
The Titans and Mythical Giant Beasts were too slow; by the time they reached the battlefield, it would be ages. Therefore, they needed the Ancient Beasts to carry them ‘in flight.’
Although this would consume more, it didn’t matter with so many of them around. They would take turns in rotation.
And just as the Giant Beast legions invaded, bursting the five-colored giant shadow, thousands of kilometers away, a Five-colored Mountain Range tens of thousands of kilometers long violently trembled.
Boom boom boom!!

﻿Chapter 1587: Chapter 595: Doomsday Again, The True Spirit Great War Chapter 1587: Chapter 595: Doomsday Again, The True Spirit Great War So powerful!
The moment the Single-horned Spawn Roc and other Giant Beasts that were awakening saw the five-colored Giant Beast that stood ten thousand kilometers tall on Earth, their souls instinctively felt a tremor of fear.
Even the Time Dragon and the other seven Ancient Beasts felt their bodies sink, and their Soul Will began to move sluggishly.
Including the power of the Rules they held within, which seemed to have become obscure and difficult to mobilize, immensely heavy.
Unlike ancient creatures that controlled Rules, True Spirits had merged the Rules within them, and the Rules they mastered were recognized by the Origin of the Mythical World.
The gap between them was like the difference between Transcendents of the Sixth-level Heaven and the Seventh Layer Heaven.
Ancient creatures relied on the powerful force of Rules within them in battle, at most letting Rules erode a range of ten or twenty thousand kilometers of Heaven and Earth, and controlling the collision of the Power of Heaven and Earth on a large scale.
True Spirits, however, became the Rules themselves, directly merging into Heaven and Earth, becoming the masters of a domain, and the nations they established were extensions of their strength.
Like this colorful and splendid Heaven and Earth.
In this Five-Colored Realm, infused with the Rules of the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast, every word and action of this beast represented absolute authority.
With a mere thought, it could alter some of the basic Rules, such as making all plants, all materials, minerals, and even biological beings turn into five-colored attributes, transforming substances.
Of course, such basic Rule modifications are still limited, and can only change the Rule they command.
Yet, even so, this True Spirit Beast is powerful beyond the imagination of all other beasts, with every move carrying the vast and mighty Power of Heaven and Earth.
And these are only the basic differences.
As all the Ancient Beasts of the Dragon Palace Empire showed hesitation, and the Titans and Mythical Giant Beasts felt fear, a series of high-pitched and excited roars exploded.
The Silver Giant Dragon spiraled in the dark red storm: “Roar! Tim Abott, what a huge beast, the Great Sethia wants to stand on top of it and roar.”
The Single-horned Giant Beast, like a Spawn Roc over fifteen hundred meters long, let out an excited cry: “Charge, let’s kill them.”
The Dragon Turtle surrounded by a yellow domain, with crimson eyes and trembling, roared: “Roar! Kidora, you block the front later, I’ll bombard with Breath.”
Even the usually quiet Candle Dragon’s blood was boiling: “Roar! I’m going to take down the Titan Beast.”
Elegant, the Great Telsafi must be elegant.
While several beasts roared excitedly, the similarly awakened golden-blue Giant Dragon elegantly circled around the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Looking at those agitated and excited ones, only the Dragon King, who was at the level of Titans and Legendary Realm, along with all other beasts were somewhat confused. Isn’t your reaction a bit odd?
That is a True Spirit Beast, a mighty True Spirit lifeform, and moreover surrounded by numerous Ancient Beasts, Titan Beasts, Mythical Giant Beasts, and an encircling Alien Corps.
Boom!
The dazzling crimson radiance from the Destruction Emperor Dragon exploded, its body rapidly inflated like a balloon, instantly swelling to more than thirty-five thousand meters long.
Instantly, the terrifying pressure pierced through the Cloud Sky, filled Heaven and Earth, and rings of red light waves spread out in all directions from the center of the Deep red emperor dragon.
Where those red light waves passed, the five-colored light pervasive between heaven and earth trembled, shattered, and erupted in earth-shattering roars upon collision.
At the same time, the dark red storm clouds driven by the thunderstorm also surged, expanding at a terrifying speed to a range of one hundred thousand kilometers.
Such might made the previously indifferent Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast suddenly stand upright, its eyes showing gravity.
Compared to the ancient early stage, the realm of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had only ascended by a small level, but after entering the Deep Red Form, it had completely stepped from the Ancient Limit into the True Spirit Level.
Suddenly, all the different races, beasts, who were originally full of confidence and waiting for those invading beasts to come and die, all had their expressions congeal.
Trouble, there was also a True Spirit level existence on the other side; no wonder they dared to invade the great Five-Colored Empire.
Just as all the beasts, including those from the Dragon Palace Empire, were shocked by the strength of the Emperor Dragon in Deep Red Form, a layer of pitch-black flames began to burn on the Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
Boom! Beneath the power of the Black Flames, everything around collapsed and disintegrated, including Heavenly Earth Rules, and even the space that carried it all shattered like a mirror.
The size of the Deep Red Emperor Dragon enveloped in the black flames surged again, reaching forty-one thousand meters, with muscles swelling, stretching the thick Black Gold Scale Armor taut.
Atop that colossal body burning with black flames, terrifying gold-red lightning leaped, emitting an aura that made all other beasts shudder with fierceness.
Boom, boom, boom!!
With the descent of the Doomsday Destruction Emperor Dragon, a fifty-thousand-kilometer radius of Heaven and Earth shook, all things lost their luster, and the whole world seemed to fall back into Chaos.
The terror of its aura even surpassed that of the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast.
Roar!
The Doomsday form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared to the sky, its endless crimson radiance bursting forth and painting the Firmament of the entire Five-Colored World crimson.
Amidst the ominous gleam of red light, a Deep Red World twisted spacetime for its descent.
Instantly, the already extreme aura of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon surged again, its body reaching forty-three thousand meters, with sharp red bone spurs growing on each joint, surrounded by a halo of crimson light.
In this moment, the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon was incomparably ferocious and terrifying, wrapped in an aura of finality that could destroy Heaven and Earth, leading the world to annihilation.
Merely standing there, tens of thousands of kilometers of Heaven and Earth had already shattered, turned into a violent state of chaotic destruction.
The dark red storm clouds enveloping Heaven and Earth exploded with a bang, mixed with blood-like lightning spreading in all directions, covering tens of thousands of kilometers.

﻿Chapter 1588: Chapter 595: Doomsday Again, The True Spirit Great War_2 Chapter 1588: Chapter 595: Doomsday Again, The True Spirit Great War_2 Under the crimson lightning, the True Spirit of the five-colors merging with the rules of Heaven and Earth kept collapsing, and the established order began to descend into chaos.
At the same time, whispers of “destruction,” “doomsday,” and “annihilation of everything…” rose in the Void, an ominous prophecy echoing across the cosmos.
This was the second time the Destruction Emperor Dragon had entered this form, its strength amplifying to become even more formidable.
And all this occurred in an instant, those surrounding Giant Beasts, including the Silver Giant Dragon, hadn’t even reacted before the erupting pressure had swept them away.
Boom, boom, boom! Over a hundred Giant Beasts were cast out like shooting stars, the furthest thrown tens of thousands of kilometers, leaving them dazed and confused.
This was them being enveloped by an Invisible Power the moment they were flung out.
Otherwise, under the sweep of the golden-crimson lightning that destroyed everything, aside from those Ancient Beasts, the other Giant Beasts would have exploded instantly, if not dead then heavily injured.
“Roar! The Great Scythia feels a bit dizzy,” the Silver Giant Dragon, after being blown away for ten thousand kilometers and taking quite the tumble, shook its head vigorously before finally turning to look into the distance.
Gazing at the ferocious, enormous silhouette standing at the center of the red light of chaos and destruction, all including the Silver Giant Dragon were shocked into stunned silence.
Even the Time Dragon, experienced and wise, inexplicably felt a deep-seated fear at this moment.
This creature called Thunderflame was an outright monster, monstrous, terrifying even at its ancient level—once it reached True Spirit!
“Charge, kill them all.”
Fierce roars resonated between heaven and earth as the Deep Red World that descended from above was forcefully pressed down by the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, exploding the myriad colors into bursts of light under its substantial pressure.
“Roar! Invading Giant Beasts, you are courting death.”
Witnessing the Doomsday Emperor Dragon crossing over a hundred thousand kilometers, the Five-Colored Giant Beast, with its ten thousand kilometer-long body, emitted a thunderous roar, and the five-colored scale armor protruding from its body shone like crystal.
Thousands of pillars of light, some dozens of meters, hundreds of meters, or even kilometers thick in white, blue, red, and other colors, pierced through Carney Turner and exploded everything; they contained the Power of Heaven and Earth within a radius of millions of kilometers.
Seen from afar, it was as if there were thousands of universe-class Battleships below, all main guns firing simultaneously in an epic, shocking display.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The entire world was obscured by the light of the explosions, the terrifying energy blasts violently shaking the arriving Deep Red World, causing concentric rings of light that vibrated through space-time and spread over hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
The moment two True Spirit Level Giant Beasts clashed, the entire Heaven and Earth plunged into Chaos; countless other Giant Beasts and different races trembled mentally, leaving only the thundering shock waves.
Roar!
A deep, majestic, and fierce roar exploded, and amidst the boundless brilliance of the explosions, a Giant Beast enshrouded in Black Flames and radiant red light let out a bellowing cry.
Boom!
Coming at the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was a three-thousand-meter-thick pillar of red light, its might reaching the True Spirit level, filled with Earth-shattering and scorching power.
Upon impact, the pillar of light hit the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, who neither dodged nor flinched, and erupted into a brilliant illumination, like a crimson Great Sun with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers.
The violent forces of destruction caused the Earth to shake wildly and the land to collapse.
But just then, the core of the exploding sun suddenly collapsed, as if being devoured, turning into a pitch-black Hollow several thousand kilometers in diameter.
And there was the Red Beast, unharmed within the black hole, its presence invisibly crushing time and space, emanating a Terrifying Aura that could crush eons.
Such a terrible scene caused the pupils of those Ancient Beasts crouching beneath the Five-Colored Giant Beast to shrink.
Then, the Void Python as long as ten thousand or more meters raised its head and let out a savage hiss, “Roar! Kill, wipe out those invading Giant Beasts.”
Bang! The space around the Void Python shattered, its huge body instantly diving into the Void towards the Gray Python tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Roar, roar, roar!!
The three Golden Dragons too let out violent roars, their bodies burning with golden flames that appeared supremely holy, each transforming into a golden light that pierced through Heaven and Earth.
And its target was the ancient Lava Giant Dragon.
Under the lead of the two Ancient Beasts, other Giant Beasts also bellowed and charged, including the Bull Demon Alien Corps that was shaken to the ground by the horrific energy impact.
Whether it was the beasts from the Five-Colored Empire or those from the Dragon Palace, they instinctively lunged at each other at the first opportunity.
As for the central True Spirit Level battle, that was not something they could interfere with, nor even qualify to approach.
Boom!
Heaven and Earth trembled, and the huge Red Claw covered the sky and the sun; entwined with golden-crimson lightning, it extinguished a space of thousands of kilometers, forming a massive Black Hole.
Hum!
Surrounding the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast for tens of thousands of kilometers, the five-colored radiance shone, forming nine hundred and ninety-nine layers of Rule Barriers, which shattered one by one beneath the Crimson Gigantification.
With each layer of the Five-Colored Rule Boundary Wall shattered, the Red Beast dimmed and, after breaking through more than a hundred layers, it dissipated, exhausted.
In comparison to those Giant Beasts which had truly reached the True Spirit level, the Emperor Dragon in its doomsday form was powerful, but the rule power it released was still a bit lacking in intensity.
Roar!
The Five-Colored True Spirit Beast looked up and let out a bellow, its enormous eyes cold as it calmly watched the Doomsday Emperor Dragon standing amidst the red light at the center of the sky.
In that brief encounter, the Giant Beast had shown a terrifying level of energy output and seemingly endless surrounding layers of Rule Barriers.
Gazing down at the True Spirit Beast below, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s eyes were icy cold, and its deep, resonant roar slowly filled heaven and earth.
“Standing tall upon the Earth, wielding the inexhaustible scepter of strength and that Tempering of endless five-colored material, constructing the massive Heaven-Earth True Body, hm?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1589 - 1589 595 Doomsday Revisited The Great True
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1589: Chapter 595: Doomsday Revisited, The Great True Spirit War_3 Chapter 1589: Chapter 595: Doomsday Revisited, The Great True Spirit War_3 “If that’s all you’ve got, you are destined to lose today,”
The Heaven-Earth True Body is another path of Evolution for the Giant Beast.
Similarly involving the smelting of Heaven and Earth to strengthen oneself, but unlike the Ancient Giant Dragons that refine a small world within their bodies, it fuses all essences to forge an immensely vast and formidable True Body.
This point bears some resemblance to the Power of Dark Star wielded by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
One devours and refines all heavy mineral elements, while the other smelts Five-Colored Crystal Ore.
The Five-Colored True Spirit Beast lifted its head, its massive mouth slightly ajar, revealing teeth like mountain peaks of colorful crystals, and its voice, even more sonorous and authoritative, resounded through Heaven and Earth.
“Invading Giant Beast, I acknowledge your strength is formidable,”
“But don’t forget, your growth realm is only at the Ancient Middle Stage. How long can you maintain this state of Limit Breakthrough, one Star Moment, or two?”
The Five-Colored True Spirit Beast, like those Giant Beasts that chose to fight rather than flee upon witnessing the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Burst form, had confidence.
It believed the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s ability to momentarily boost its strength by hundreds or even thousands of times across a Major Realm could not last long.
As long as the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s strength was depleted, it could easily obliterate any Giant Beast at the Ancient Middle Stage with a single claw.
At that time, it would show these invading beasts the true meaning of despair.
And the earth-shaking roar of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast also revitalized all the Golden Dragons under the shadow of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s might.
Looking down at the self-assured, composed Five-Colored True Spirit Beast on the Earth, the corners of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s mouth slightly curled up, revealing a fierce, cruel smirk.
Under normal conditions, it would be so, but alas, it was the exception.
The Heavenly Tier bloodline was like a massive blue bar, granting the Destruction Emperor Dragon a terrifyingly profound Intrinsic strength. It felt sustaining such a transcendental Burst would be no issue for a day or two.
Therefore… Kill.
Boom!
Space shattered massively like a mirror, and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, transformed into a red Radiance, descended from the sky, piercing everything before appearing in front of the Boundary Wall tens of kilometers thick.
Thud, thud, thud!!
Before the endlessly shining Doomsday Emperor Dragon, each layer of the Boundary Wall, thick with kilometers of pure Rule forces, shattered layer by layer.
Effortlessly crushing all resistance in its path.
From afar,
it only took an instant for the Doomsday Emperor Dragon to tear through nine hundred and ninety-nine layers of the Rule Barrier and become a beam of light piercing through Heaven and Earth, landing on the head of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast.
Boom! The huge head of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast suddenly sank, countless crystals shattered on its crown, leaving a crater tens of kilometers wide.
Thousands of kilometers deep, the crater’s immense cracks spread all around, covering half of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast’s head, as the pure force from the collision caused the surrounding space to collapse in an instant.
Such solidity.
Roar!
In that instant when the Doomsday Emperor Dragon landed on its head, the vast body of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast heaved, its head as large as a comet smashing into the ground.
Boom!
The Earth within a radius of over a hundred thousand kilometers shattered, chunks of enormous Five-Colored stone slabs, tens to hundreds of kilometers in size, soared skywards, flying thousands of kilometers high, tearing the heavens asunder, shaking the foundations of Space-Time.
The cataclysmic impact released energy like a colossal collision of the cosmos, emitting blinding light and forming rings of red shockwaves that spread to all directions.
The scorching waves swept across hundreds of thousands of kilometers of the surface, reducing countless substances to ashes, and melting the Earth into Scorching Magma.
The true Destroy Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1590 - 1590 596
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1590: Chapter 596 Chapter 1590: Chapter 596 Chapter 596: Devouring the Earth, Bursting the True Spirit
The Earth shattered, and searing shockwaves swept across like a sprawling sky curtain thousands of kilometers high, instantaneously submerging the Dragon Palace Giant Beast legions.
Boom, boom, boom! The Ice Crystal Destruction Storm Domain surrounding the Silver Giant Dragon convulsed wildly, shrinking continuously under the cataclysmic assault.
In that moment, only ancient creatures like the black Kirin Beast could withstand the residual shockwaves of the two ‘True Spirit’ Giant Beasts and stand firm.
The rest of the Titan Beasts and Mythical Giant Beasts, including the Golden Blue Giant Dragon and other Dragon Kings, were like insects in a hurricane, swept away tens of thousands of kilometers in an instant.
This was because they were positioned away from the center of the battle.
The worst off were the subordinates of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast, who had not yet flown tens of thousands of kilometers before being blown away by the explosive impact of the two True Spirit Giant Beasts colliding with the Earth.
Under normal conditions, facing the aftermath of a True Spirit Battle up close would reduce all Mythical-level beings, including those below Mythical-level, to ashes.
Even the Undying of Titan Level would be heavily injured, with only Ancient Beasts barely able to hold their ground.
But just as those giant beasts were about to be obliterated, five-colored lights flickered on their bodies, resonating with the five-colored glow that permeated between heaven and earth, and under the flash of light, they disappeared into thin air.
When they reappeared, they had been moved by the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast tens of thousands of kilometers away, not far from the Dragon Palace legions.
In the midst of the rolling heat waves, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle let out an excited roar at several Mythical Giant Beasts wandering in the distance: “Roar! Don’t run away, you guys. The Old man Domination is going to take you down.”
Boom!
The Mythical early-stage Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, with its yellow Oscillation Domain swirling around, lunged directly at the four Mythical Giant Beasts in the distance, appearing utterly mad.
Compared to the dragon turtle from the sea that used to be fearful and timid, having followed the Destruction Emperor Dragon through countless battles, this Giant Beast had undergone a massive transformation.
At the same time, other giant beasts also pounced towards their respective adversaries, including those Ancient Beasts, immediately sparking a vicious Giant Beast warfare that echoed across heaven and Earth with brutal roars.
But as soon as the battle began, the Five-Colored Empire found itself at a disadvantage.
Apart from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Dragon Palace had seven Ancient-level Giant Beasts, two more than the Five-Colored Empire.
Among them, the Ancient Refining Giant Beast, the black Kirin Beast, and the Dust Serpent Giant Beast had all assimilated a One-side World and its complete fragments, making their strength far surpass their realm.
The Dust Serpent, having just broken through to the Ancient Middle Stage, boasted the combat strength of an ancient late stage.
The Time Dragon, wielding the Time Rule, also had the power to fight across realms and had only been at a disadvantage when facing a Titan Peak against the Devil God Emperor Eros.
Further, the Ancient Middle Stage Batfish Beast, commanding the Chaotic destructive current, was comparable to the Ancient Late Stage.
And as for the Blue-White Giant Dragon, who had been very low profile, as a Titan Beast who had once shot down the Time Dragon, it too had grown immensely powerful upon entering the Ancient Realm.
These giant beasts could basically cross a minor realm, otherwise, they wouldn’t have caught the eye of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Counting them up, only the Blade Giant Beast was the weakest, but its targets were not those ancient beings; it directly led a legion of over thirty Mythical Giant Beasts against those Titan Beasts.
And the Silver Giant Dragon got the best luck, the closest to it was an army of more than a hundred thousand level eight Bull Demon Aliens.
Suddenly, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes lit up, emitting an excited, cruel roar: “Roar! Despicable fellows, you actually dare to stop Tim Abott from passing. Today, Great Scythia will make your blood flow like rivers.”
Hum!
An Ice Crystal Destruction Breath hundreds of meters thick burst forth, piercing through heaven and earth, freezing and fracturing space in its path, and in an instant, it covered over two thousand kilometers, slamming into the Bull Demon army.
Boom! In an instant, countless frigid powers exploded into action, turning into white mist that dissipated over hundreds of kilometers, freezing and shattering everything in its wake.
While the Giant Beast legions of the two empires and Alien Corps were ferociously battling, the two True Spirit Giant Beasts that would determine the course of the great battle let out brutal roars.
In an instant, the center of the 40,000-meter-long Doomsday Emperor Dragon stood amidst the chaos, wrapped in countless golden-red lightnings.
The fierce, Overbearing Red Beast extended its double claws to the sky; muscles swollen, it unleashed a terrifying force that pushed against heaven and earth, blocking the head of the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast.
At this moment, the height of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was level with the pre-shattered Earth, and below its feet lay an abyssal pit tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter, filled with violent currents that could destroy everything.
The last collision was merely the residual force that obliterated the nearby Earth as well as space itself, yet it didn’t shake the Doomsday Emperor Dragon in the slightest, let alone knock it deep into the Earth.
Boom, boom, boom!!
As the two True Spirit Giant Beasts grappled and contested strength, the five-colored light and golden-red lightning that filled the ten thousand-kilometer surroundings constantly collided and exploded, causing earth-shattering booms.
Each collision and explosion saw the dissipating five-colored shards and golden-red lightnings vanish, mutually annihilating each other, shaking the fabric of space-time.
Roar! The Doomsday Emperor Dragon roared to the heavens, its muscles swelling again, and a formidable power released waves of black lightning from within its muscular frame.
The Rule-level talent and secret technique, Doomsday Dominance Body, erupted, and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s strength surged multiple times, its claws propping up the sky, as it pivoted on its right foot, crushing the Void with a violent twist.
Boom! Under this terrifying force, the entire world seemed to flip at that moment.
The several thousand kilometers long Five-Colored Giant Beast roared as its colossal body was hurled away with a bang, shaking space-time and sending out waves of red halo shockwaves tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Roar! An angry and brutal roar exploded between heaven and earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1591 - 1591 596
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1591: Chapter 596 Chapter 1591: Chapter 596 In the blink of an eye, across a stretch of earth millions of kilometers wide, countless rays of five-colored radiance shot up into the sky, forming a crisscrossing rainbow of light behind the True Spirit Beast.
Boom!
Under the five-colored net of Rule Chains formed by Rule Manifestation, the colossal body of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast shuddered violently as it flew at high speed before slowly landing on the ground.
In an instant, the earth trembled over tens of thousands of kilometers, as its four massive claws landed, shooting countless pebbles into the sky like pillars of heaven.
Crackle! Crackle!!
Under the flickering five-colored light, the half of the True Spirit Beast’s head, which resembled an ore vein, healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, mending the open cracks.
True Spirit Beasts not only possess incomparably formidable true bodies, but their vitality is also unimaginably abundant.
Roar! The Doomsday Emperor Dragon bellowed tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Centered around the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, an endless burst of golden-white flames erupted, forming a World-Destroying Great Sun with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, its outer layer of Black Flames burning fiercely.
The mystery of Rule, the Doomsday Great Sun.
In the instant the Great Sun manifested, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon appeared in the sky above the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast with a Mystical Instantaneous Divine Shift, and plummeted down.
Such a terrifying speed left the True Spirit Beast no time to react; the surrounding five-colored radiance shattered under the black-red light waves emitted by the Great Sun.
Boom! An endless stream of golden-black flames erupted, engulfing everything within a radius of hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
The sky seemed to burn, the sea boiled, and everything was annihilated under the flames imbued with the Doomsday Rule, including the five-colored ore on the skin of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast, which melted into scorching lava and disintegrated layer by layer.
The target of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s strike was the power that connected the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast to the Earth.
Enveloped by flames as terrifying as the core of the sun, the Five-Colored Giant Beast, covered in streaming magma, let out a tyrannical roar, raising its massive front claws, which were as thick as pillars of heaven.
Boom!
The moment the Giant Beast’s hoof-like double claws landed, layers of transparent ripples burst forth, sweeping across Heaven and Earth, carrying an extremely terrifying force of suppression.
Under that heavy Rule suppression, the intensely hot flames that wrapped around the ten-thousand-kilometer great sun suddenly snuffed out, revealing the figure of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon standing tall in the dark Void.
Roar!
The Five-Colored True Spirit Beast roared toward the sky, its massive mouth filled with five-colored mountain-peak sharp teeth opened wide, with a vortex of five-colored light taking shape inside.
In the instant the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast’s mouth opened, a terrifying suction force that could devour the sky and earth enveloped the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, along with the surrounding area of ten thousand kilometers.
Within this range, space-time solidified, and the edge’s five-colored brilliance penetrated the Void, forming a sky-covering, planet-devouring, ferocious maw.
This Five-Colored True Spirit Beast also possessed a Devouring talent, aiming to swallow the Doomsday Emperor Dragon in one gulp.
At this moment, the ‘tiny’ Doomsday Emperor Dragon also opened its massive maw wide, as behind it an even larger, pitch-black Black Hole appeared.
Boom!! The collision of two forces containing the talent of spatial Devourment obliterated tens of thousands of kilometers, plunging the area into Chaos.
But just then, a seven-colored light beam hundreds of thousands of kilometers long swept across Heaven and Earth as if separating space-time, instantly engulfing the Doomsday Emperor Dragon with a tail of light.
Time seemed to freeze at that moment, and a streak of red light burst forth at the speed of light, slamming into a spot over a million kilometers away.
Only then did the earth-shattering roar boom out as under the red light, the earth crumbled within tens of thousands of kilometers, and a gigantic mushroom cloud rose slowly.
In the center of the explosion, endless Scorching Magma erupted, scattering fan-shaped over a hundred thousand kilometers, a sight to astonish.
But immediately after, that patch of Heaven and Earth began to tremble; among the explosive light that shattered even the Void, a massive and ferocious Red Beast slowly emerged unscathed.
Even more vigorous Black Flames burned across its body, and its Full-body Scales Armor shone brightly, unharmed.
Such powerful Defense caused the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast’s gaze to grow more solemn. This beast was even more powerful and difficult to deal with than it had imagined.
Roar! The Five-Colored True Spirit Beast roared again, as dazzling five-colored radiance once more flashed across its body.
“`
The earth within a ten-million-kilometer range began to shake slightly as numerous five-colored trees, mountain ranges, and rivers all emitted light, engulfing the night sky in a canopy of rosy glows.
Under the endless radiance of the five-colored lights, the surface of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast recovered and grew at a visible rate even as hundred-kilometer-thick mountain ranges melted away under the World-Destroying Great Sun.
As the sovereign of this world, the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast possessed boundless strength.
Unless it was obliterated in one strike or its Soul Source was injured, any severe damage could be healed instantly with the Power of Heaven and Earth pouring backwards into it.
And its body, already tens of thousands of kilometers long, swelled even further as the endless light surged in, its aura becoming more magnificent and terrifying, filled with vast, boundless strength.
Merely standing there, the surrounding heaven and earth silently shattered, forming massive Black Cracks that spread in all directions.
An intimidating presence.
This is the power of a Rule Level True Spirit Beast, now completely without any weaknesses.
Even the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, after battling up to this moment, found this True Spirit Beast somewhat troublesome, especially when it stood within the Five-Colored Empire, much like deities standing in the Divine Realm.
It received enhancements from all aspects, and its strength ascended a level.
But no matter how troublesome, it had to be done.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared to the heavens, its body emitting a more dazzling red light that dyed the firmament, beneath which dark red Thunder Cloud Storms gathered.
This time, however, the Thunder Cloud Storm did not disperse but rather formed a funnel a hundred thousand kilometers across, carrying endless Blood Red Lightning and thunder magnetism to pour into the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
At the same time, black lightning burst from deep within its muscles, unleashing power that was violent to the extreme.
Rule Mystery, Doomsday Dominance Body; Rule Mystery, Thunderbolt Tyrant.
Boom boom boom!!
Fully releasing its muscular strength, and with the overlay an eruption of two Mysteries absorbing the endless thunders and magnetisms of the world, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s aura exploded to a height of fifty thousand meters, its muscles bursting, its scale armor bulging prominently.
Its entire body was surrounded by threads of blood-colored, golden-red, and black lightning.
So powerful and immense was this force that the surrounding space-time collapsed, forming a black hole a ten-thousand-kilometer diameter, whose unseen gravitational pull twisted everything around it, devouring even the light.
At this moment, even the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast felt a tremor of fear.
Without a sound, the space above the head of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast annihilated, and from within the pitch-black void, a claw burning with Black Flames and coiled with three colors of lightning descended once again.
Thump thump thump! With one supremely Overbearing claw strike, the newly re-formed Five-Colored Rule Boundary Wall, thick as ten thousand kilometers, instantly shattered.
Time seemed to freeze at this moment, leaving only the continuously spreading darkness, a terrifying phenomenon where everything was destroyed and turned into nothingness.
Even sound disappeared in this moment, the only thing remaining was the sight of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast’s head, as wide as a thousand-kilometer mountain range, crumbling apart.
As the enormous mountain range that was its head broke apart midway, a pained roar shook space-time, and time suddenly resumed its flow.
The vast body of the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast crashed down hard, its front half smashed into the earth by the peerless power of a claw attack, releasing a Burst of dazzling light in an instant.
Boom! Space shattered, the earth exploded, and endless Scorching Magma material was flung around, forming circular explosive rings.
In the centre of this earth-shattering explosion of light, an extremely sharp Tail Blade cut through space-time, slashing at the neck of the roaring Five-Colored True Spirit Beast in an instant.
Thump!
Under the supremely sharp red Tail Blade, a five-colored mountain ridge eight hundred kilometers in diameter shattered, cleaved with a massive crack hundreds of kilometers long and more than two hundred kilometers deep.
Within the depths of the crack, one could faintly see bones as tough as five-colored steel, with muscles on either side torn like crystal ice, forming a gorge-like wound.
In the instant when the blade nearly severed the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast’s neck, the Doomsday Tyrant form of the Emperor Dragon disappeared in a flash.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1592 - 1592 597 The Ten Great Mysteries Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1592: Chapter 597: The Ten Great Mysteries, Devouring True Spirit Chapter 1592: Chapter 597: The Ten Great Mysteries, Devouring True Spirit Just as the eye on the side of the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast’s abdomen shattered in an instant, deep within the rift that tore a hundred kilometers deep, a burst of purple-black light exploded.
Boom!
The exploded purple-black light, an intangible material, burned with a layer of Black Flames on the surface, which immediately permeated into the body of the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast, resembling minerals.
Wherever it passed, those five-colored materials instantly lost their color, much like rocks weathered for ten thousand years, filled with the Aura of Death and decay.
Just in the blink of an eye, the purple-black light spread over two thousand kilometers, covering half of the abdomen of the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast with countless purple-black veins as it continued to penetrate inward.
Roar! An angry roar shook space-time, as a vast and boundless five-colored light burst forth from inside the True Spirit Beast.
These shimmers of rule contained a rich vitality force, which abated the spread of the purple-black corrosive poisonous gas for a moment, as plumes of black smoke were purged away.
Yet, the speed at which this purging of the purple-black force occurred was nowhere near as fast as its blinking eye’s speed when healing its shattered body.
This purple-black force was one of the ten Higher-order Laws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Poison Series Power, which up until now hadn’t much presence.
Upon the breakthrough into the Ancient Realm, all ten Higher-order Laws advanced to incorporate unique characteristics, becoming even more powerful rule mysteries.
Under the fusion of the Doomsday Rule, the might of Corrosion of Everything tremendously soared, corroding all material energy and vitality, including the rule-based body of the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast.
Boom!
The layers of colorful Boundary Walls surrounding the Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast shattered, as the joints of its hind legs burst open, punctured by the suddenly appearing Doomsday Emperor Dragon, leaving a Hollow over ten kilometers in diameter and more than a hundred kilometers deep.
Within the wound as deep as a mine’s pathway, a compressed and condensed purple-black ‘fireball’ exploded instantly, with endless corrosive Rule power spreading in all directions.
Roar!
The Five-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast let out a roar of shock and anger, radiating six-colored light that illuminated and penetrated space-time with a Destructive Aura.
Boom!
Like the collapse of a dike, everything was submerged in the six-colored brilliance emanating from the True Spirit Giant Beast, with even space being assimilated.
In the blink of an eye, an ocean of six colors with a diameter of a hundred thousand kilometers appeared, with the True Spirit Giant Beast at the heart of the ocean, thousands of meters long, roaring with power fluctuations that shook the world.
As the True Spirit Origin erupted, the wounds on the Giant Beast’s abdomen and hind legs healed instantly, and the purple-black force corroding its body was also forcibly purged.
But at this moment, the gaze of the Six-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast became extremely grave as it stared straight ahead.
All it could see within the ocean formed by its True Spirit Origin was the figure of the other beast, five thousand meters long, diminutive as an ‘insect,’ standing tall.
Malevolent red light flickered on the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, with three colors of lightning leaping about, exuding an ultimate Destructive Aura that shattered everything around it.
Including the omnipresent True Spirit Origin rule power from all around, everything was obliterated, forming a Chaotic Destruction Domain spanning thousands of kilometers.
After a brief standoff, the two True Spirit Giant Beasts clashed in battle once again.
The Six-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast roared, its body spanning thousands of kilometers, riddled with cracks, revealing numerous crystal-like colorful eyes.
Hum! Countless eyes twinkled with colorful light, emitting dazzling brilliance and Spatial Fluctuations.
Boom boom boom!!
In an instant, the Void around the Doomsday Emperor Dragon shattered, and columns of colorful light erupted forth like thousands of cannons being fired, engulfing the entire Heaven and Earth.
These columns of light were the True Spirit Giant Beast burning its Origin to condense the power of the six elemental rules, imbued with Unrivaled Domination destructive force.
Having witnessed the nearly peerless within the same rank physical Defense of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon and its Chaotic Force Field impervious to all laws, it found a countermeasure right away.
That was to annihilate with pure Origin.
No matter how strong the impervious force field was, it was still composed of rules and strength. As long as the intensity and quantity of the attack were sufficient and reached a certain threshold, it could breakthrough the Defense.
However, the columns of light that nearly drowned Heaven and Earth and instantly destroyed tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of kilometers of energy could not keep up with the movements of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Boom!!
Even within the range of the True Spirit Origin that painted space-time, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon still ignored all obstacles, instantly appearing on the back of the Six-Colored Giant Beast.
Blood-red, black, and golden-red lightning coiled around its double claws, smashing and destroying everything as they struck the Giant Beast’s backbone.
Boom!
Half a mountain range collapsed thunderously, countless colored minerals shattered, forming a huge pit hundreds of kilometers wide, with cracks spreading over a thousand kilometers.
At the same time, violent purple-black flames erupted between the double claws, emitting a Terrifying Aura that corroded and dissolved everything.
Hum!
Just as the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s attack paused, the brilliance of eyes scattered among the mountain ranges in all directions flared up, but this time it was not an attack of light columns; instead, there were layers of transparent ripples.
This move, previously used by the Six-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast with its hooves stomping the firmament, contained the mighty power to Suppress space-time and extinguish everything.
But just as the ripples, nearly as fast as the speed of light, were spreading, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon had already vanished in an instant, leaving behind only the rippling space-time and the roaring mountains on the Giant Beast’s back.
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon, having broken through the Ancient Realm, wielded ten terrifying rule talents in its activities.
Whether it was the Overbearing Chaos Heaven with the full release of its physical strength or the Vajra Undying Defense, peerless within its rank, or even the Undying force that could resurrect twice in the instant of Death.
In addition to the Gigantification from Deep Red Destruction, the Thunderbolt Tyrant that assimilated the Power of Heaven and Earth into its body, and the nearly unparalleled speed of the Instantaneous Divine Shift.
It was just that, in the past, there were few opponents that required the Doomsday Emperor Dragon to fight to its limits, and it usually burst them with absolute strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 1593 - 1593 597 The Ten Great Mysteries Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1593: Chapter 597: The Ten Great Mysteries, Devouring True Spirit_2 Chapter 1593: Chapter 597: The Ten Great Mysteries, Devouring True Spirit_2 In this situation, these mysteries of the rules were seldom used, but today, they were displayed against a giant beast whose power almost rivaled that of a mid-period True Spirit, with a heaven-earth true body that was enormous and formidable.
Boom boom boom!!
Relying on a terrifying speed that ignored all obstacles and transcended time, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon avoided all of the Six-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast’s attacks, and its avatars appeared in hundreds around the giant beast from all directions.
Those fierce and sharp double claws tore through everything, and the Tail Blade cut through space-time, leaving behind wounds tens and hundreds of kilometers long.
But these wounds were merely ‘scratches’ to the Six-Colored Giant Beast, yet the corrosive destructive force that each attack drove into the beast’s body elicited its furious and outraged roar.
The purple flame, merged with the Doomsday Rule, was unspeakably terrifying, annihilating all vitality and eroding the Rule Body of the giant beast at an astonishing rate.
Under these conditions, the Six-Colored Giant Beast could only rely on its vast and boundless vitality to continuously purge the deathly forces spreading throughout its body.
By now, the great battle had suddenly entered a phase of mutual attrition, except that the stronger Doomsday Emperor Dragon was gaining the upper hand.
Immediately, the furious roars of the Six-Colored Giant Beast could be heard incessantly between heaven and earth, along with the brilliant beams of light that occasionally swept across and destroyed everything.
Under the terror of the great battle, nearly a million-kilometer area was completely devastated, with the sky collapsing and the earth caving in.
The destructive fluctuations that permeated the world invisibly, and the rule forces that shook space-time, made those giant beasts locked in fierce combat tremble with fear.
Boom!!
The Ancient Lava Giant Beast, its body streaming with golden magma, roared, its claws containing the power of a one-sided world, and with a bang, it suppressed three Golden Dragons.
Roar roar roar!!
The Lava Giant Dragon’s nine dragon heads roared, three of which bit onto the neck of a Golden Dragon and exploded with a rumble akin to a nuclear explosion.
At the same time, the Light Beams from the other six heads flashed, and instantly five streams of dark golden lava breath roared out, engulfing the Golden Dragon beneath them.
Roar! Within the dazzling light, screams echoed between heaven and earth.
While suppressing the Golden Dragon and starting to erode its true body with the power of rule breath, an idle dragon head of the Ancient Lava Giant Beast turned to look into the distance, horror showing in its eyes.
Because the space-time in the distance had been blasted open, the earth’s crust was fractured, filled with violent currents that even the Ancient Beasts found alarming.
Too powerful, is this the power wielded by True Spirit Beasts?
Compared to the Ancient Beasts, the power held by the True Spirit Beasts was nearly invincible; even though the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was suppressing the True Spirit Rhino, it was because the Emperor Dragon was even stronger.
Under normal conditions, the Ancient Beasts would hardly even qualify to approach the True Spirit Beasts.
The Rule Barrier surrounding the Six-Colored Giant Beast, formed by more than nine hundred layers of colored void space spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, was so strong that even the Ancient Beasts could not shake it.
Even a strong man like Tyris, who had broken through the Ancient Limit, would not be able to destroy more than a few layers, unable to keep up with the speed of recovery.
Not to mention the rule forces that suppressed everything between heaven and earth, and those various powerful gifted powers.
But this strength was only formidable against beasts below the level of True Spirits. To the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, whose strength had reached the same level and whose power was even greater, it was outright disregard.
Had the opponent’s heaven-earth true body not been so massive, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon would have already torn the beast apart as it had done in the past.
In the midst of intense fighting, more than half a day quickly passed, and the roars of the True Spirit Giant Beast gradually weakened a lot, and the pervasive brilliance seemed somewhat dim.
At the chaotic center of the battle, the ten-thousand-kilometer-long Six-Colored Giant Beast was covered with massive wounds, some extending two to three thousand kilometers long, and hundreds to thousands of kilometers deep.
Even its head was partly shattered, with both pairs of its enormous horns broken, appearing extremely wretched.
Most significantly, these wounds were all permeated with a thick purple-black fog, which spread over most of the giant beast’s body, eroding and dissolving all vitality.
Under this relentless erosion, the Six-Colored mineral veins on the beast’s surface all dimmed and discolored, turning into grey-white rock.
Even though the dazzling colored brilliance within its body burst forth, engulfing its entire form, it still could not instantly heal the wounds, only managing to slowly purge and dissolve the enveloping corrosive forces.
If this continued, the downfall of this True Spirit Giant Beast was only a matter of time.
Boom!
The Six-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast let out a brutal roar, its massive body radiating dazzling brilliance once more, drawing the power of this World to collide against the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
With a sweep of its vast body, it nearly dissipated the raging chaotic currents, creating layers of destructive waves that surged in all directions like Mountains and Seas shaking.
This strike held enough power to shatter a planet as big as Jupiter.
But this time, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon did not evade; its body erupted with endless crimson light, making the Deep Red World behind it appear even clearer.
Vaguely, one could see a colossal shadow standing within that world, watching the battle, seemingly ready to cross the Boundary and descend at any moment.
Boom!
When the two massive beasts collided, the power to squeeze space-time Burst forth, shaking millions of kilometers of Heaven and Earth violently.
In comparison to the true enormity of the True Spirit Beast, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was tiny as an insect, but upon impact, it stood unyielding, radiating a terrifyingly destructive aura.
It was the True Spirit Giant Beast, however, whose shoulder’s gray-white rock crumbled extensively, many enormous hard fragments falling away, thundering down below.
But at that moment, the True Spirit Giant Beast’s eyes revealed a fierce light, its neck breaking to reveal a ferocious mouth capable of tearing half a body, emitting a Seven-Colored Glow.
From that mouth, like a Seven-Colored Abyss, the terrifying power of Devouring once again Burst forth and this time the might surged by dozens of times.
Under the fearful suction, space-time within tens of thousands of kilometers collapsed with a roar, forming a huge funnel that twisted everything, with all matter and energy vanishing into that fierce maw.
As the Seven-Colored Glow bloomed, the entire world suddenly froze, streams of light from millions of kilometers converging to bathe this World in a seven-colored spectacle.
At this moment, when gathering all the power of the Five-Colored Empire and exhausting the origin of the True Spirit in an instant, space-time and all things were frozen and Suppressed.
That included the Doomsday Emperor Dragon standing beneath the Deep Red World.
This was the ultimate killing strike that the True Spirit Giant Beast had been brewing for a long time.
As long as it could Devour the red Giant Beast, it could, with energy tens of thousands times greater from the rules, grind it into nothingness, turning the tide of battle.
“Do you really think you can kill me with that, isn’t that a bit too simplistic?”
In a deep and profound roar, the Doomsday Giant Beast’s body silently cracked, including those invincible scale armor, and in an instant, a Mountains and Seas shaking black light erupted.
In an instant, an atmosphere of great horror and Great Destruction Burst into existence.
At this moment, the entire world only consisted of that endlessly expanding black hole of destruction and, emerging slowly from the center of the black hole, a Giant Dragon head tens of thousands of kilometers large.
Final Darkness, Devouring!
In an instant, burning ninety percent of the Divine Soul and Rule Origin, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s strength soared to an unimaginable degree.
Almost completely transformed into an avatar of destruction, it heralded Doomsday, with a bite that severed space-time, swallowing the whole body of the Seven-Colored True Spirit Giant Beast.
