But just as the Doomsday Dragon head swallowed the True Spirit Giant Beast, its body, tens of thousands of kilometers long, shattered and exploded, and in an instant, the cosmos itself was shaken.
As the Heaven-Earth True Body of the True Spirit Giant Beast Self-Destructed, the energy released directly blew apart the black hole-like Doomsday Dragon head.
Boom!
An earth-shattering explosion echoed without end, the Destroy Heaven and Earth impact sweeping across hundreds of thousands of kilometers, like a supernova, the emitted light illuminating the entire world.
Roar! A howl full of unwillingness resounded through Heaven and Earth.
In the infinitely expanding explosion’s radiance, a nine-colored figure soared into the sky.
But just then, a huge figure crashed through the Void, its ferocious mouth wide open, revealing a black hole within, savagely biting off a piece of that nine-colored figure.
But to kill a True Spirit Giant Beast was extremely difficult.
The moment the Doomsday Emperor Dragon tore away part of the True Spirit Giant Beast’s True Body, the remaining mostly pure-energetic body burst into the Space-Time Chaos, vanishing into the depths of space-time.
Roar!
The red Giant Beast standing above the Firmament howled to the sky, its massive body fractured and damaged, the earth below continuously repairing itself from collapse and explosion, its body radiating a ferociously boundless terrifying pressure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1594 - 1594 598 The Great Battle Concludes Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1594: Chapter 598: The Great Battle Concludes, Devouring the True Spirit’s Intrinsic Essence Chapter 1594: Chapter 598: The Great Battle Concludes, Devouring the True Spirit’s Intrinsic Essence Above the Firmament shaken by spatial turbulence, a Doomsday Giant Beast roared furiously, its body ablaze with billowing dark energy like flames, a hint of regret visible in its golden-red vertical pupils amidst the chaos and destruction.
It was already prepared to sacrifice one of its lives in a fight to the death with the True Spirit Beast.
Who knew that just as the True Spirit Beast was about to be devoured by the Final Darkness Devouring, it self-detonated its Heaven-Earth True Body, forsaking centuries of accumulation and escaping with heavy injuries inflicted upon itself.
And these injuries came from it biting off a part of its own True Body at the last moment.
As for the massive wounds covering the True Spirit Beast’s Heaven-Earth True Body from the earlier fight, those were merely light injuries, not affecting its foundations at all.
The body that seemed to refine Heaven and Earth, congregated like veins of ore, was merely “scale armor”, whereas the real body was the nine-colored silhouette that burst forth at the end.
Of course, if the Giant Beast hadn’t self-detonated and escaped, it would’ve been devoured by the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s all-consuming burst of Final Darkness Devouring and likewise would’ve suffered heavy injuries if not death.
Even if it couldn’t tear apart the spatial realm of the Final Darkness Devouring, it would have been slowly eroded and refined.
Alas, such an outcome was merely wishful thinking, as a True Spirit Beast wouldn’t be so easy to kill if it were an entity governed by rules.
To kill a True Spirit-level life, unless there’s an overwhelming difference in strength from all aspects, otherwise, the opponent can simply transform into the rules and merge into Heaven and Earth to escape.
Not to mention the gap between this True Spirit Beast and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was not significant; both had reached the mid phase of the True Spirit level.
However, where the Five-Colored True Spirit Beast barely compared to the mid phase of True Spirit, the Destruction Emperor Dragon in its Doomsday state had fully stepped into it.
Add to that, the expertise in ten potent Rule Mysteries involving physical and rule defense, Power Explosion, teleportation speed, and corrosion of life, to suppress the opponent in all aspects.
But even so, it could not slay the True Spirit Beast unless it chose to fight to the death.
Boom!
Breathing out scorching hot gusts through its nostrils, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon dissolved the space tens of kilometers in front of it, creating a pitch-black Hollow that reached into the Void.
At the same time, with a mere thought from the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, the surrounding electromagnetic storms, crimson lightning, and black lightning all dissipated one by one, and its colossal body rapidly shrank.
In the blink of an eye, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon had returned to a size of eleven thousand meters and its aura plummeted from mid True Spirit phase, a strong sense of weakness emanating from it.
At the same time, its ferocious, huge body was covered in cracks, resembling a shattered piece of porcelain that had been put back together; from the back to the tail, its scale armor remained crimson.
Yiyaya!!
Sensing the weak aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon under the dragon horns within the black Dragon’s Mane, which had not been startled awake by the cataclysmic battle, opened its eyes, revealing a look of concern.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon softly growled, “I am fine, just slightly overexerted. I will recover shortly.”
“Keep your power of Creation for me, I will need it later.”
Yiyaya!! Since the Destruction Emperor Dragon had said as much, the Purple little dragon nodded in agreement.
Boom!
Faint nine-colored lights flickered within the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body, as a tremendous burst of energy akin to a galaxy pouring out exploded from its stomach, sounding like thunderous roars.
Only now did the True Spirit Beast’s hind leg, which the Destruction Emperor Dragon had swallowed, begin to be refined.
Under the surge of infinite, pure energy, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s broken body gleamed with vitality, its overstretched muscles and cells bursting with vigorous life.
In just a few breaths, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body healed from all its cracks, cells divided, scale armor expanded, and its gigantic body visibly began to grow.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The expanding body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, wrapped in an aura of chaos and destruction, exploded everything around it, sending black shockwaves sweeping in all directions.
With ample energy containing rule factors, the length of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body quickly surpassed twelve thousand meters, and then thirteen thousand meters…
However, no beast witnessed this scene.
Following the battle between the two True Spirit Beasts, the Heaven and Earth within a million-kilometer radius had crumbled, filled with chaotic airflows insidious enough to instantly heavily injure a Titan Level Giant Beast, infused with rules.
Add to that the abyssal space-time fractures running deep into the Void, giant cracks—these were all forbidden areas at once.
Or to say, many of the dangerous areas and forbidden zones in the mythical world were the aftermath of battles between Ancient Beasts, True Spirit Creatures, and even higher beings.
Only a small part was naturally formed by Heaven and Earth.
And at the moment the True Spirit Giant Beast fled, on a battlefield over a million kilometers away, all the Five-Colored Giant Beast eyes revealed horror.
For that familiar True Spirit oppression had vanished.
The towering Ancient Minotaur, clad in Five-Colored Battle Armor, let out a stunned roar, “How is it possible, how could the great king of the empire be defeated.”
In its moment of shock, space around it shattered, turbulent winds carrying the aura of chaos and destruction howled, instantly forming a towering hurricane that razed everything to the ground.
Boom!! Under the devastating hurricane that shred space-time, the red and white Rule Domains converging around the Ancient Minotaur collapsed.
Subsequently, the sturdy and powerful Five-Colored Battle Armor followed, its emitted radiance being ground down, shattered, and ultimately the True Body of the Ancient Minotaur itself.
At this time, it wasn’t just this Ancient Minotaur; after half a day of destruction, the already decimated ranks of the Five-Colored Empire Giant Beasts also let out cries of despair.
Meanwhile, all the Giant Beasts of the Dragon Palace Empire were emboldened, their aura surged, and they let out triumphant roars as they once again pounced on their opponents.
Above the lava-covered Earth, an Ancient Lava Giant Dragon, over twelve thousand meters long, stood towering; flames burned fiercely on its body, its claws gripping two shattered Golden Dragon Heads.

chapters.title: Chapter 1595 - 1595 598 The Great Battle Concludes Devouring
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1595: Chapter 598: The Great Battle Concludes, Devouring the True Spirit’s Intrinsic Essence_2 Chapter 1595: Chapter 598: The Great Battle Concludes, Devouring the True Spirit’s Intrinsic Essence_2 “`
Facing the Lava Giant Dragon at the peak of the ancient realm, the Golden Three-headed Dragon fell to the disadvantage instantly upon engagement and was quickly suppressed.
However, the strong vitality of the Ancient Beast still exhausted the Lava Giant Dragon for half a day before it was finally vanquished and slain.
Clutching its spoils of war, the nine dragon heads of the ancient Lava Giant Beast turned their gaze in all directions, their sights settling on the Gray Python fighting the Void Python, roaring ferociously as their howls echoed through Heaven and Earth.
“Jormungand, you are too slow. The king has already defeated the True Spirit Beast, and you still haven’t taken down your opponent. Do you need my help?”
The Gray Python, whose body stretched over thirteen thousand meters and beneath whom a phantom of a rocky world emerged, hurriedly hissed back, “No need for help, I am confident I can defeat it.”
Really? Doubt flickered in the eyes of the ancient Lava Giant Dragon.
Compared to the other battlefields where the fights were either completely one-sided or a case of many against few, likely to end soon, the battlefield where the Gray Python was seemed somewhat strange.
After fully refining the complete fragments of a Great World, the realm of the Gray Python had also ascended to the Ancient Middle Stage.
As an Ancient Beast that, in the ancient early stage, managed to barely rival the strength of the ancient late period through its talent of entwining the World Serpent, its strength was now even more formidable.
Yet it had been fighting for such a long time against a python, which was sixteen thousand meters long and similarly in the Ancient Middle Stage, covered in crystal-clear white scales, and the battle remained evenly matched.
And even though they seemed to fight fiercely, it looked like neither had sustained much injury?
Just as all the Giant Beasts and Bull Demon Aliens of the two great empires engaged in a grand battle, spreading across hundreds of thousands of kilometers in a frenzied slaughter, suddenly a terrifying aura descended.
In the night illuminated by various colors, the Firmament shattered, revealing a Black Gold Giant Beast, fifteen thousand meters long with wings that covered the sky, appearing out of the darkness.
The Black Gold Giant Beast seemed to travel from past to present, descending from ancient space-time, its body crackling with golden red lightning, invisibly exuding a Destructive Aura that seemed to crush Heaven and Earth.
The space around it was annihilated, revealing apocalyptic visions of worlds reaching their Doomsday.
Such a terrifying scene instinctively made all the Giant Beasts and Bull Demon Aliens at the scene palpitate with fear, and those Giant Beasts already at a disadvantage completely lost their will to fight.
“Roar! Run.”
“The king has already fallen.”
“I surrender, I surrender…”
But it was already too late. The moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon made its powerful entrance, golden red lightning erupted from it as the center, sweeping tens of thousands of kilometers.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the illumination of lightning carrying the essence of Chaos Doomsday, one Mythical Giant Beast after another’s True Body instantly shattered, quickly turning to ash under the continuous explosions of golden red lightning.
Roar!
Watching the golden red lightning spread from the Firmament, the Titan Giant Beast, whose colossal body was mutilated and tail already torn by the Golden Blue Giant Dragon, let out a roar of despair.
Boom!
Under the golden red lightning, the Titan Giant Beast’s Law Flame Domain crumbled, its body exploded, and then it was devoured by a passing darkness.
At this moment, the entire ‘world’ fell into despair.
Under the golden red lightning sweeping across Heaven and Earth, and the terrifying speed of the Black Gold light streaking across the battlefield, countless Bull Demon Aliens were reduced to ashes in an instant, and Mythical Giant Beasts exploded.
Whereas the Titan Level Giant Beasts were devoured in one bite by the sweeping Destruction Emperor Dragon, not even having a chance to react.
Chirp!
Amid the thundering red lightning and the encircling storm, the flying Giant Beast let out a frightened cry, its dazzling red aura erupting and repelling the Ice Crystal-encircled Blue-White Giant Dragon.
Boom!
In the thunderous moment for the awe-striking Blue-White Giant Dragon, the space around the Red Beast, shaped like a Dragon Eagle, collapsed, forming a black hole spanning ten thousand kilometers.
“`
But just as the Dragon Eagle Giant Beast’s body thundered into the Void, aiming to escape, a dragon claw wrapped in golden-red lightning appeared above its head.
Under the huge Black Gold dragon claw, Space-Time was shattered and the storm of rules dissipated.
In an instant, the Dragon Eagle Giant Beast let out a piteous scream, half of its wing was smashed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon with one strike, and its colossal body turned into a red light that pierced through Heaven and Earth before forcefully crashing into the Earth.
Boom! The Earth within a range of thousands of kilometers shattered and exploded, the enormous explosion illuminating the sky like a rising mushroom cloud.
Amidst the wild explosion of light, a Black Gold Giant Beast standing over ten thousand meters tall roared into life, its double claws tearing apart the Dragon Eagle Giant Beast in one swift motion.
A sharp and miserable scream echoed throughout Heaven and Earth before abruptly halting.
Within the terrifying explosion of light, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stepped out from the shattered Void, its body half-drenched with burning blood, clutching the torn remains of the Dragon Eagle Giant Beast in its claws.
Crystal Red droplets of blood slowly dripped from the corner of its mouth, making a horrifying rumbling noise as its ferocious jaws chewed.
Witnessing this scene, the Blue-White Giant Dragon couldn’t help but reveal a look of shock in its eyes.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon was too powerful at that moment, slaughtering an Ancient Middle Stage Giant Beast as if squashing an insect, tearing it apart in a matter of blinks.
Soon another Giant Beast, over ten thousand meters long, resembling a python and a dragon with segmented Black Armor covering its body, also let out a despairing scream.
With the fall of this Giant Beast, the world fell silent in an instant, and the great war between the two empires came to an end.
Looking at the shattered world before them, the roaring lightning and pervasive Furious Power, all the beasts of the Dragon Palace Empire felt somewhat dazed.
Because victory seemed a little too easy.
They had simply defeated a vast empire guarded by a True Spirit Beast, suppressing all Giant Beasts, be it ancient, Titan, or Mythical.
Wait, the battle is not over yet.
Sensing ancient energy fluctuations coming from afar, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon flapped their wings, transforming into a beam of light that streaked across Carney Turner.
Soon, the two Giant Dragons approached the battlefield and saw from a distance those two battling Ancient Giant Pythons, as well as the Destruction Emperor Dragon and other Giant Beasts watching from the edge of the battlefield.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re too formidable.”
The Silver Giant Dragon let out a cheering roar, excitedly pouncing towards the Black Gold Giant Beast, completely ignoring the terrifying golden-red lightning dancing around its body.
As the Silver Giant Dragon neared, the golden-red lightning jumping around the Destruction Emperor Dragon vanished one by one.
Boom!
Diving at several hundred times the speed of sound, the Silver Giant Dragon smashed into Destruction Emperor Dragon’s left shoulder with a thundering impact, the powerful shockwave exploding the surrounding air into concentric white waves.
Relative to the Black Gold Giant Beast, which now stood over fifteen thousand meters tall, the Silver Giant Dragon, at merely sixteen hundred meters in length, was like a baby sitting on an adult’s shoulder.
The Silver Giant Dragon, clutching at one of the Black Gold Dorsal Fins, roared excitedly, “Tim Abott, did you take down that big guy? Where’s the corpse?”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon turned its massive head to look back at the Silver Giant Dragon and slowly growled, “… It got away. It’s still a bit difficult for me to slay a True Spirit Beast right now.”
“It got away, huh.” The Silver Giant Dragon sounded somewhat disappointed; it had wanted to see a True Spirit Beast’s corpse.
At that moment, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon’s soft roar came from the side: “Even so, Thunderflame, your battle achievements shine across the stars, looking down on all Dragon Palace Giant Beasts.”
The sudden sound startled the Silver Giant Dragon, a little surprised, “Roar! Telsafi, why are you here, and when did you arrive?”
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon stood elegantly on the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s left shoulder, growling slowly, “Why shouldn’t the great Telsafi be here?”
“As for when, I was right behind you just now.”
[There’s a little bit of wrap-up left, brothers, refresh in a moment]

chapters.title: Chapter 1596 - 1596 599 Heaven-Earth Divine Vein the Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1596: Chapter 599: Heaven-Earth Divine Vein, the Great Demon King Attacks Chapter 1596: Chapter 599: Heaven-Earth Divine Vein, the Great Demon King Attacks The shattered world interwoven with void and space was coiled by a white crystal giant python over sixteen thousand meters long, winding like a white mountain range.
Surrounded by ancient beasts one after another and the terrifying presence of the black gold Emperor Dragon, the white crystal giant python lowered its head, issuing a gentle hiss.
“I am willing to submit,” it declared.
These ancient beasts were different from the Purgatory Demon God; they had a superior-subordinate relationship with that five-colored True Spirit Beast and were not bloodline descendants.
Therefore, there was no absolute loyalty or reverence, merely the common occurrence of lesser beasts attaching themselves to stronger beings.
Now that the True Spirit Beast had been injured and fled, the vast Five-Colored Empire had been destroyed, and all the mythical beasts above and different races had perished except for it.
In such a situation, the white crystal giant python, which had been prepared to be torn apart by that terrifying beast, naturally would not refuse.
For it, the choice merely involved following a more powerful beast, similar to the black Kirin Beast and others that had been subdued and opted to join the Dragon Palace.
In the enormous Dragon Palace Empire now, only the Silver Giant Dragon, the gold and blue Giant Dragons, and the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles that hailed from Blue Star were absolutely loyal and reverent to the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
This was why the Destruction Emperor Dragon allocated resources to cultivate them.
The sharp Tail Blade of the Destruction Emperor Dragon behind it moved slowly, retracting while issuing a deep growl, “Although you belong to a defeated nation, as an ancient creature, you are entitled to the position of Dragon King.”
“From this moment forward, you are the sixteenth Dragon King of the empire, the Void Serpent.”
Having said this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon peered at the excited Gray Python trembling with its tail, “By the way, Void Dragon King, we still do not know your name?”
Watching the black gold sharp Tail Blade leave above it, the white crystal giant python breathed a slight sigh of relief and then respectfully said, “Respected King of Thunderflame, my name is Mina Warti.”
“Mina Warti, is it,” murmured the Destruction Emperor Dragon, slowly nodding, then continued to growl.
“The structure of the Dragon Palace Empire differs from the typical Beast Empires. There are over a dozen Dragon Kings in existence, each of whom holds the right to discuss matters in the Dragon King Hall.”
“As for the details, let Jormungand explain them to you.”
“Scythia, I’ll leave the tallying of losses from this battle to you. I’ll go over there to take a look,” the Destruction Emperor Dragon said.
Right after that, the large body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon shot through the space with one flap of its double wings, causing an explosive boom that shook heaven and earth as it vanished into the sky.
Although the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not yet a True Spirit Beast and was unfamiliar with the evolutionary paths of other True Spirit Beasts,
it served as the center of a territory spanning millions of kilometers where a ten-thousand-kilometer mountain range typically harbored True Spirit Beasts, definitely a place rich in essence.
Soon enough, the Destruction Emperor Dragon crossed hundreds of thousands of kilometers, returning to where the five-colored True Spirit Beast initially stood tall.
The land had collapsed under the impact of that True Spirit Beast, and space had shattered, forming a huge sinkhole tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter, piercing through the void like a gigantic funnel.
As soon as the Destruction Emperor Dragon approached, it saw a colorful mineral vein under the howling spatial storm on the ground, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers long and over five thousand kilometers at its widest.
And this was just a part of the mineral vein; it stretched across the void and into the depths of the Earth – its full length unknown.
Unlike the five-colored Heaven-Earth True Body of that True Spirit Beast, this vein’s degree of colorful crystallization was very low, resembling grey rock with about one-third mineral contents.
The moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon sighted the mountain range, a rich, almost liquid energy infused with mottled rules came forth from the world.
Amidst the Divine Light, the Destruction Emperor Dragon even spotted numerous Law Divine Artifacts and Rule Level Divine Objects glowing on the range.
At this moment, information blossomed spontaneously in the heart of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
A Heavenly Tier bloodline held stature equal to heaven by rank, and as the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s strength increased, the bloodline’s “awakening” slowly unveiled many instinctive marvels.
For example, upon seeing an unrecognizable Heaven and Earth Treasure or resource, the relevant information and introduction naturally emerged in the mind without the need for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to speculate or experiment.
It felt as if one was born with this knowledge.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had begun to sense this ability when crossing the Chaotic Turbulent Region; it became even more mystical after the breakthrough into the ancient tier.
That surge of information from “Heaven and Earth” described the mountain range as a ‘Divine Vein.’
It was assembled by that True Spirit Beast gathering the Power of Heaven and Earth spanning millions of kilometers, the Laws’ Origin, and the natural nuances of the world, akin to a core of the World Origin of One-side World.
This Divine Vein stretched for who knows how many tens of thousands of kilometers, connected to the circulatory system of rules in this World.
Its purpose was to nurture the Heaven-Earth True Body of True Spirit Beasts, aiding the True Body in faster rule-based transformation, ultimately becoming a fearsome giant beast tens of thousands of kilometers long.
In other words, the mineral vein was also part of that True Spirit Beast’s ‘body’, and even larger.
“I didn’t expect that this time the big reward would be here,” the corners of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mouth lifted slightly, revealing a hideous smile, while feeling somewhat relieved.
Relief that the Nine-Colored Giant Beast likely had only recently achieved its True Spirit breakthrough and that the establishment of this Five-Colored Empire happened only one to two hundred years ago, hence its Heaven-Earth True Body was only half-complete.
Otherwise, with more time, once the ten-thousand-kilometer mountain range fully turned into nine colors, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon would be no match for it.
This battle was less a clash with a beast tens of thousands of kilometers in length, and more a fight against a True Spirit Beast wielding a ‘shell’ of a ten-thousand-kilometer mountain range.

chapters.title: Chapter 1597 - 1597 599 Heaven-Earth Divine Vein the Great
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1597: Chapter 599: Heaven-Earth Divine Vein, the Great Demon King Attacks – Part 2 Chapter 1597: Chapter 599: Heaven-Earth Divine Vein, the Great Demon King Attacks – Part 2 “After ‘devouring’ this divine vein, I should be able to breakthrough to the ancient late stage,” said the Destruction Emperor Dragon as it vibrated its double wings and flew towards the mountain ranges below.
Although its body length had increased by more than three thousand meters, the realm of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was still slightly short of the ancient late stage.
There was no helping it; its True Body was too formidable. With each evolution and breakthrough strengthening, after stepping into the ancient realm, the strength of the Giant Beast Body even surpassed its past self.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had estimated that at Level 9, the overall density and muscular skeletal strength of its Giant Beast body was about tens of times that of a giant beast of the same level.
After becoming a Mythical Giant Beast, not only had this gap not diluted, but it had also skyrocketed to nearly a hundredfold.
Subsequently, breaking through to the Titan level and absorbing and devouring more energy, the gap widened to over one hundred fifty times after being strengthened by even stronger Rule powers, becoming even more formidable.
And with its Dark Star talent, devouring and refining countless types of material elements, it had further widened the gap to over two hundred times that of its peers.
This two hundredfold difference isn’t the ‘strength’ of two hundred similar level giant beasts stacked together, but rather a geometric growth after compression.
This is also the reason it could suppress all ancient beasts already at the ancient late stage; the terrifying foundation of the Giant Beast Body made all its talents and powers surge proportionately.
This advantage, after stepping into ancient level and devouring and refining that nearly ten thousand kilometers long mountain range, directly doubled with the Transformation of its life level.
Therefore, even after devouring the hind leg of a True Spirit Beast, approximately one-fifth of the True Body, it only brought the Destruction Emperor Dragon close to the ancient late stage.
“This Seven-color Lustrous contains the pure origin of the laws and could benefit the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle; eating it should further strengthen its talent for shockwaves,” it thought.
“This pile of Li Dragon Divine Soil can be given to the Lava Giant Dragon, which could further enhance its rule origin of lava…”
Among the mountain ranges enveloped in colorful mists, the Destruction Emperor Dragon kept flickering, collecting one Heaven and Earth Treasure after another, whether atop mountain peaks or in pure energy valleys.
After more than two hours had passed, the giant beasts such as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtles that had scattered in all directions finally flew over. The Destruction Emperor Dragon was already waiting for them at the edge of the Earth’s fault line.
Suspended around the Destruction Emperor Dragon were more than a hundred varieties of Heaven and Earth Treasures, the Nine-Leaves Purple Crystal Lotus, bamboos flickering with lightning, pure energy materials that resembled a light dragon, and so on.
Immediately, at the forefront of the grand procession of giant beasts, the Silver Giant Dragon let out a cheering roar, “Roar! Tim Abott, did you find that True Spirit Beast’s treasure hoard?”
No sooner had it spoken, it stirred up a raging wind and pounced over.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc, now even more massive in size, also lit up with excitement and rushed forward, excitingly chirping as it eyed a pure black pearl, a hundred meters in diameter, under the feet of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Roar roar roar!! Thunderflame, Thunderflame, I want this thing, I feel like I’ll become even more powerful after eating it.
Roar roar roar!! I want to eat it too. The Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, also over a thousand meters long, was equally excited, uttering chaotic roars as it flew over.
Following them was the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, trotting over with heavy, eager steps.
Including the red Candle Dragon, which silently twisted time and appeared next to a divine tree that stood a kilometer tall, made seemingly out of black and white crystal with dragon patterns faintly flowing inside its trunk and leaves.
Watching those few ‘little’ giants roaring excitedly around the Black Gold Giant Beast, ancient beasts like the black Kirin, and Titan-level creatures like the Giant Dragon mother and others, all stopped tens of kilometers away.
As the might displayed by the Destruction Emperor Dragon became ever more fearful, its authority within the empire also grew day by day. Even these ancient Dragon Kings dared not act recklessly.
Thus, at this moment, they could only look on with envy at those few ordinary Dragon Kings.
In front of the present Destruction Emperor Dragon, only those few beasts could afford to be so casual.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slightly lowered its head, looking down at creatures like the kid-sized Ghidorah beneath its feet. Its deep and robust voice shook Heaven and Earth.
“Among these resources, you may freely choose any Divine Object that suits you,” it said.
“Roar! Thunderflame, that’s amazing, freaking awesome!” the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, eyeing a half Rule Level Divine Object, let out an excited roar as soon as the Destruction Emperor Dragon finished speaking.
Boom!
No sooner had the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle finished speaking, its form suddenly sank explosively, pressed into the Earth by an enormous and invisible Dragon Claw, forming a huge claw imprint a hundred kilometers in diameter and tens of kilometers deep.
Within the billowing smoke and dust, the Destruction Emperor Dragon raised its head to look at the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon and other ancient Dragon Kings, followed by Titan Batfish and dozens of Mythical Creatures behind them.
Five were missing—four Mythical Giant Beasts and one early Titan stage beast, which seemed to be a subordinate of Jormungand’s.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon immediately noticed the change in ‘numbers.’ although the battle at the Dragon Palace had been a great success, and they held the advantages on all fronts, some beasts had still perished under the enemy’s counterattack.
With a low growl, the Destruction Emperor Dragon said, “In this battle against the True Spirit Beast Empire, except for a few individuals, everyone performed well. You were fearless and did not tarnish the dignity of the Dragon Palace.”
“These Heaven-Earth Divine Objects are what I obtained from that True Spirit Beast’s ‘treasury.’ Now they will be distributed according to everyone’s merits.”
“This Heaven Blue Golden Thunder Bamboo, a half-step Creation Level Divine Object, contains a strand of Heaven Blue Divine Thunder’s rule origin. The ancient beasts that refine it may have the chance to gain a second Rule talent.”
As it spoke, the Destruction Emperor Dragon brought forward the several hundred-meter-tall green bamboo wrapped in space-shattering thunder, moving it in front of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon.
Roar roar roar!! All nine heads of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon let out excited roars, as one head promptly took the divine bamboo into its mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1598 - 1598 599 Heaven-Earth Divine Vein Great Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1598: Chapter 599: Heaven-Earth Divine Vein, Great Demon King Attacks_3 Chapter 1598: Chapter 599: Heaven-Earth Divine Vein, Great Demon King Attacks_3 “`
The other ancient beasts in the vicinity immediately showed envy in their eyes, for such a purification of bloodline and the birth of a second type of divine artifact embodying a rule were exceedingly rare.
Only in a vein of divine essence—where the spiritual essence of this world converged—could such a divine artifact be born.
As for why the True Spirit Beast did not bestow its subordinates with such artifacts, it was because these ‘transplanted’ divine objects would ultimately be absorbed by the divine vein, becoming part of its true form.
Afterward, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, following the principle of rewarding based on merit, bestowed all the Heaven and Earth Treasures it had acquired.
Apart from the Gray Python and the newly surrendered White Crystal Giant Python, even the weakest beast from the early myths received a reward of a Law Level Divine Artifact.
During the ceremony conducted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon, with the title of Big Dragon King, held a piece of black profound ice wrapped in rule patterns and burning with internal flames in its double claws.
The Silver Giant Dragon let out a proud roar, “Roar! Telsafi, this Heavenly Glow Ice Flame harmonizes perfectly with the origin of the Great Sethia, and after I refine it, I might even awaken the Ice Flame talent.”
“When that time comes, you will not be a match for the Great Sethia, I will thoroughly suppress you and spit on your back.”
“Childish.”
The golden-blue Giant Dragon let out an indifferent low growl, standing elegantly upon the ground with its double wings slightly unfurled, emanating a Seven-Colored Glow and full of scorn for the Silver Giant Dragon’s provocation.
In the golden-blue Giant Dragon’s foreclaws was a crystal stone, as iridescent as colored glaze, with complete rule patterns circulating within.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon naturally wouldn’t ‘mistreat’ the two Giant Dragons; among the hundred or so Heaven and Earth Treasures, all of Law Level or higher, it selected two artifacts that best resonated with them.
Boom!
The Heaven and Earth trembled as the Destruction Emperor Dragon swallowed the remaining dozen or so Divine Artefacts in one gulp, and then its colossal form thunderously turned and plunged into the void beneath the Abyss.
At the same time, the roar of the Destruction Emperor Dragon echoed through the Void, “All Giant Beasts, stay back. This king too intends to refine what I’ve garnered.”
Without waiting for the Silver Giant Dragon and other beasts to react, suddenly the entire world shook, and the vast expanse of land within a radius of hundreds of thousands of kilometers undulated like sea waves.
The sudden change shocked all the Giant Beasts.
“Roar! Wait a moment, Tim Abott, the Great Sethia doesn’t want to be blown away again,” the Silver Giant Dragon bellowed in alarm, flapping its double wings and turning into a beam of silver light, flying away swiftly.
Every time the Destruction Emperor Dragon erupted, fought, or made a breakthrough, the Silver Giant Dragon would be sent flying by the violent forces at play.
This had already become an instinctive reaction for the Silver Giant Dragon.
In just a few blinks of an eye, the Silver Giant Dragon, warping space, appeared tens of thousands of kilometers away, at an altitude of a thousand kilometers, then looked back.
It saw a gigantic pit, with a radius of tens of thousands of kilometers, where the sky was falling and the earth was fracturing, space and time trembling, and the entire world collapsing toward the central region.
A black hole of Black Gold emerged from the shattered earth deep within the divine vein, with a diameter spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, rapidly expanding in all directions.
The sphere, akin to a black hole and emitting an immensely heavy and terrifying aura, distorted space so that not even light could escape, devouring everything.
…
At the outskirts of the Channel One City of the Human Race, a Golden Divine Tree, standing over thirty thousand meters tall, radiated brilliant golden light, illuminating the night sky for thousands of kilometers around.
Below the crown of the Golden Divine Tree was a platform in the shape of a Stone Disk, towering a thousand kilometers high with a diameter covering hundreds of kilometers.
“`
Tens of thousands of elite Heavenly Feather Clan soldiers flew in the air, their golden, silver, and white wings flapping behind them, protecting the statuesque figures standing on the Stone Disk platform.
These figures were the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan and more than ten Main Gods, including Anstice.
Opposite the Heavenly Feather Clan was the Human Race, with three shadows of Supreme Will materialized, ten Heavenly Kings standing tall, and several sky-based battleships, each several kilometers long, hovering.
To the left of the Human Race, the newly arrived Immortal Spirit Clan’s three Immortal Kings sat on their splendid thrones, with solemn expressions, each backed by more than ten Immortal Monarchs.
As for those Floating Cities, they flew outside the Stone Disk, their numbers mighty.
Opposite the Immortal Spirit Clan was the Divine Gods Alliance. However, compared to the heavily populated three races, the Divine Gods Alliance had fewer members, with only Tarrod as a Divine King.
There were also only three Main Gods, one of whom had been quite hostile to the Human Race.
But after the Human Race managed to defeat four Demon Gods in the frontlines, that Main God was deeply shaken and then decisively led a million-strong army to join the ‘alliance’.
This scene was captured by Ninth Heaven Cultivators flying at a distance, each carrying a high-definition satellite video camera.
As one of the cameramen, Damon Lopes’s face turned red with excitement, “Damn! This shot is so badass, truly a historic moment.”
“The alliance of the four major racial powers, instantly forming a superpower with eleven Supreme Experts, nearly forty Heavenly Kings, and a hundred and several King-level warriors.”
Standing beside Lopes, Eddy Keller, dressed in a white robe with his hair flowing and full of the aura of a strong man, proudly nodded at the words.
“Indeed, this is a moment for the history books. I have a premonition that we are about to enter a Golden Age brimming with geniuses.”
“This is a rare opportunity for us, as well as a challenge. Either we emerge as Supreme Experts whose names echo throughout this chaotic world, or we become stepping stones for other geniuses.”
Looking at Eddy Keller, who was talking while casually flying over to block his camera, Lopes spoke without amusement, “Hey Keller, could you move aside, don’t block my shot here.”
With his long hair fluttering in an invisible breeze, making him look effortlessly cool, Eddy Keller turned back, looked towards the camera with a ‘serene’ expression full of the temperament of an expert, and said casually.
“Lopes, you take your shot. It won’t hinder my discussion on the serious topic of the coming Golden Age.”
“Damn it, go show off somewhere else, man. I’m going to send these shots to those ‘girlfriends’ of mine, they’re going to be so excited they won’t keep their clothes on.”
Eddy Keller paused, then said irritably, “Damn, why didn’t you say earlier your footage wasn’t going to the alliance archive, wasting my expression for half a day.”
As he spoke, Keller looked around and then flew towards a Ninth Heaven Expert carrying a video camera dozens of kilometers away.
As Eddy Keller flew over, Divine Dragon Shadows swirled around him. His deliberately long black hair danced wildly in the raging wind while still maintaining his hairstyle, looking proud and defiant.
Watching this, Lopes couldn’t help but flip a middle finger at Keller’s retreating figure, then shook his head in regret.
“It’s a pity Jack Clark isn’t here. Otherwise, with his charm, he’d undoubtedly be the main character of this alliance of four great powers, his exploits forever archived for future generations to worship.”
At the Human Race’s side, as the Immortal Spirit Clan had arrived and they were redrafting the alliance treaty.
From the direction of the Purgatory Demon Race, the Great Demon King Tyris also crossed the entire territory of the Purgatory Demon Race and came to the battlefield of the devastated Immortal Spirit Alien Race.
[There are two thousand more words after this. I’m updating just before twelve o’clock. Brothers, refresh in an hour, and I won’t split it into two chapters.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1599 - 1599 600 Time Corridor Focusing the Seal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1599: Chapter 600: Time Corridor, Focusing the Seal Again Chapter 1599: Chapter 600: Time Corridor, Focusing the Seal Again Unlike the Eternal World that sacrificed the Deep Red Plane, the Ancestral Land of the Immortal Spirit Clan was completely shattered by the Purgatory Demon God, forming an area of destruction over a million kilometers wide.
The rules here are chaotic, space is fractured, and the Earth has turned into countless pieces floating in the ocean-like dark demon air.
In that boundless roiling darkness lurked terrifying auras, and from time to time, enormous and fearsome figures could be seen flashing by, resembling Abyss Hell.
Just then, the boundary of the Area of Destruction trembled, and space burst with a bang, tearing a black crack that stretched over a thousand kilometers.
From within the crack, Tyris, who normally stood a hundred meters tall and resembled a demon with double wings on his back, slowly walked out.
Immediately, a terrible pressure from the rule enveloped the area, causing such shaking of heaven and earth in this world that many True Demons turned their attention to the commotion.
Boom boom boom!!
Nine Demon God Level pressures erupted from deep within the Area of Destruction, causing the entire world to quake, with dark demon air churning like mountains and seas.
The nine Demon God pressures were divided into three camps, one of which was relatively weak, with an aura that seemed to have just broken through the ancient early stage.
The strongest pressure matched Tyris’s, shining brightly with demon power like a crimson demon pillar piercing the cloud sky, forming an illusory will that touched Heaven and Earth.
Surrounded by dark red light bands formed by the rules, the Demon God Illusion’s gaze traveled tens of thousands of kilometers, falling upon Tyris at the edge of the region, with a voice deep and slow.
“Tyris, have you come here because of that Human Alliance?”
Tyris nodded slowly, “Indeed, that suddenly emerging Human Alliance is very strong and has started to threaten our Purgatory tribe.”
“Especially with the rate their strength is expanding, it almost feels like they’re the chosen race of the mythical world, and they need to be dealt with swiftly.”
“Of course, the most important thing is the possibility of the Primordial ‘Origin’ existing. Don’t tell me you’re not tempted.”
The vast Demon God Illusion spoke with a deep, indifferent tone, “Stephenl has informed me of that matter, and naturally I am interested.”
“Once I’ve assimilated the intrinsic strength of the Immortal Spirit Clan, I will naturally go to that battlefield.”
“There’s no time left.”
Tyris spoke slowly, “That member of the human race has appeared as a Child of Destiny, with a rate of power increase that is almost shocking even to me.”
“You wouldn’t believe that just one Sun Wheel ago at the Heavenly Feather Clan battlefield, that human had only reached the peak of the demon king cultivation realm, his strength comparable to the peak of the Great Demon King.”
“Now, one Sun Wheel later, his cultivation realm has already stepped into the Demon God Level, and his combat power is so great that I am not a hundred percent confident of suppressing him.”
Boom! The terrifying will on the Demon God Illusion’s body fluctuated, voice laden with gravity, “Tyris, are you sure you’re not joking?”
“Do I look like I’m joking?” Tyris’s voice was cold.
Although he had successfully destroyed Jack Clark’s Summoning Altar earlier, Clark’s displayed realm and power had also stunned Tyris.
“And most importantly, Constantin is already preparing to forcibly awaken an Ancestor to deal with the threat of the Human Alliance.”
“Although I have already stopped him personally, regardless of the reason, we must act swiftly to suppress the Human Alliance and strangle all threats in the cradle.”
Upon hearing that Constantin was preparing to forcibly awaken a Purgatory ancestor, the eyes of the colossal Demon God Illusion sharpened instantly, radiating a terrifying murderous intent, “Damn him, he’s actually trying to awaken the Ancestor forcefully.”
“When I proposed that we join forces to kill him, you should have agreed, then we wouldn’t be having this problem now.”
While the two Great Demon Kings communicated, their voices were shrouded in rule power, so aside from them, other demons in the Area of Destruction couldn’t perceive their conversation.
“To kill him would’ve been too uncertain, more loss than gain, especially since we weren’t sure of the extent of his injuries back then,” Tyris said indifferently.
“This time, by utilizing the destruction of Jack’s Summoning Altar, I ‘saw’ the figure of that Ancestor; its injuries have already largely recovered.”
“This is troublesome.”
“Indeed, we don’t have much time left. Our only opportunity now is to suppress the Human Alliance and enter that primordial world before it awakens.”
“If we can obtain a piece of the Origin, there is still hope for us.”
Boom boom boom!!
Soon the entire Area of Destruction began to shake, and nine towering Demon God figures slowly walked out of the darkness, followed by a legion of billions of Purgatory True Demons.
These Purgatory Legions were led by demon kings, with Great Demon Kings as their generals, magnificently marching away under the cover of the omnipresent dark demon air.
…
Over a million kilometers away from the Human Race’s Outer Development Department, there lay a perilous realm filled with raging winds, where all life had ceased, leaving only grey-white rock mountain ranges.
“This should be the place.”
Atop the wind-eroded mountain range that stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers, Jack Clark appeared out of thin air, his black hair cascading down his shoulders as he stood on the towering mountain peak and surveyed the surroundings.
According to the information provided by Sky King Denny Kaye, the entrance to that ancient relic was at the highest peak of this eroded mountain range.
As for how exactly to get inside…
Boom! With a stomp, Jack Clark’s terrifying strength burst forth, shattering the space for tens of kilometers around, creating a circle of black shock waves that swept through heaven and earth.
The mountain peak under his feet exploded, turning into a sky full of debris and smoke and dust erupting in all directions, with a mighty momentum.
The entire world was left with just the earth-shattering roar of the explosion.
Under Jack Clark’s nearly space-time shattering strength, an ancient and powerful force emerged from the mountainside.

chapters.title: Chapter 1600 - 1600 600 Time Corridor Re-Stamping the Mark_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1600: Chapter 600 Time Corridor, Re-Stamping the Mark_2 Chapter 1600: Chapter 600 Time Corridor, Re-Stamping the Mark_2 “`
Buzz!
Circles of white light waves rippled out across the mountainside, where they passed, smoke and dust dispersed, and space calmed down. An eroded stone gate slowly emerged in the Void.
The gate was less than a kilometer tall, far smaller than those grand buildings that easily reached tens of thousands of meters. On the left and right sides of the gate, images of beings from different races were carved.
These alien figures had double wings on their backs, their forms blurred as they kneeled on one knee.
One of them held a fragment of a stone slab in its hands, while the other’s hands were empty.
Mysterious patterns surrounded the two aliens, faintly exuding the force of time, distorting space-time. It seemed as though they stood there, yet they were not within this space-time.
“Actually involves the power of time,” Jack Clark’s eyes immediately revealed a look of interest.
Originally, he had only come to deal with the Evil God Grayson. As for the relic, rumored to be not very large, it was optional; even if there were any Heaven and Earth Treasures, they would have already been refined by Grayson.
Buzz! A fragment of a stone slab appeared in Jack Clark’s hand, trembling slightly. The residual strength activated, emitting a faint ripple that resonated with the gray gate.
Instantly the entire gate vibrated, the surrounding time emitting ripples of invisible waves that enveloped Jack Clark or, more accurately, the stone slab in his hand.
Without Jack attempting to prevent it, the stone slab flew out of his hand and directly fell into the hands of the alien etched onto the gate pattern, the one with empty hands.
Boom!
The gate opened thunderously, revealing three straight and broad white pathways, enshrouded in a white mist so dense that even Jack could not see far.
Feeling confident in his strength and possessing the Hell Coordinates, Jack did not hesitate. He flashed through the gate and entered the relic.
As soon as Jack stepped into the relic, he felt the world around him turn upside down. He had been aiming for the middle pathway but found himself on the left instead, and the other two pathways vanished.
“This alien seems to be quite skilled with time and space, but my visit this time is not for exploration.” Standing in a corridor filled with white fog, a world-shaking strength exploded from Jack Clark.
Boom! Dazzling golden-white lightning burst forth from him, the Heaven and Earth trembling in an instant.
Under that golden-white lightning, manifestation of Supreme Power Rules, the entire corridor started to shake and collapse, the surrounding mists being eradicated.
At that moment, it felt as if the world was ending, and with each step that Jack took, wrapped in golden-white lightning, the surrounding pathways collapsed and exploded.
Including the time-space constraints left by the ancient aliens, various dangerous mechanisms did not even have the chance to be activated before being destroyed by the sweeping golden-white lightning.
With absolute strength, he destroyed everything in his path; Jack quickly traversed the corridor and entered into a majestic stone palace thousands of meters high.
However, the vast stone palace contained nothing but some simple murals.
Boom!
An even more overbearing golden-white burst forth from the center of Jack Clark, containing the power to destroy heaven and earth, completely demolishing the stone palace and casting it into the Void.
Within a dark Void filled with intense space-time power, entrances to two pathways appeared on the left and right.
“Nothing.”
“Still nothing…”
Jack stomped through like a Giant Beast destroying everything, moving along corridors made of white jade-like stone, and entering palace after palace.
Whether it was because the relic had been explored many times or because the aliens who left it were poor, Jack found not a single ‘pickup’.
In the half-collapsed broken stone palace, the towering figure of Evil God Grayson sat cross-legged, his body faintly exuding the mighty pressure of Heavenly King level.
In the distance from Grayson, beyond the crumbling stone wall was nothing but void and darkness, save for a massive white vortex that rotated slowly, sending out ripples of white light.
As these ripples spread, time twisted around them, enveloping a great portion of the palace. Bizarre images intermittently appeared.
Like a gigantic head with an enormous body, yet only one-hundredth in size, akin to puppet dolls, or a world where heaven and earth were desolate, all life extinct, drifting in white ashes.
This sight made Grayson, sitting in the corner, extremely grim.
Because those white ripples in front of him were terrifying.
After his breakthrough to Heavenly King level, he had cut off an arm and reached out to test the waters. The moment his arm touched the ripples, it lost contact with him and turned into black ash.
It was as if it had decayed for ten thousand years in an instant.
This caused Grayson’s mood to darken considerably. Although he had succeeded in obtaining the power of inheritance and had his breakthrough to Heavenly King level within the relic, he was also trapped here.
He felt that only when the day came that he broke through to Supreme, to contend with the Rule’s power, would he have a slight hope of escape.
That was, if he were at the edge of the vortex’s ripples, where the time ripples were not strong.
But the question was, could he wait that long?
This space-time vortex, recorded in the alien inheritance, was incredibly terrible, having destroyed an entire civilization. It only subsided after the concentrated efforts of an entire tribe to suppress and seal it.
Now, as he had taken the Inheritance item, the space-time vortex reappeared, inevitably expanding to engulf this world, pulling everything into a distorted, absurd temporal corridor.
Just then, Grayson’s gaze suddenly paused, turning towards the direction of the great hall’s right side, where the white misty corridor seemed to be echoing some sound.
“A ‘Person’ has entered the relic? Purgatory Demon God.” Thinking this, a hint of hope shone in Grayson’s eyes.
He had almost exhausted the Divine Strength accumulated over the years, linking up with Blue Star’s sacrificial rites and the Purgatory Empire through his faith, managing to make a deal narrowly.
As for why it involved Blue Star’s ritual sacrifice, it was naturally because all the cultists from the mythical world of Giant God Sect had perished.
At this moment, an even louder roar came, the Void itself trembling.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1601 - 1601 600 Time Corridor Re-Stamping the Mark_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1601: Chapter 600 Time Corridor, Re-Stamping the Mark_3 Chapter 1601: Chapter 600 Time Corridor, Re-Stamping the Mark_3 “Someone actually came in,” Grayson’s eyes showed a trace of excitement, followed by surprise and uncertainty. When had the Purgatory Demon God become so trustworthy?
Or was it someone from another race, or perhaps… a human strong man.
Under Grayson’s solemn and astonished gaze, the rumbling noise grew louder and louder, even causing the entire Great Hall to tremble, as if a gigantic creature was rapidly approaching.
Boom! High tens of kilometers, the right side corridor of the Great Hall, supported by huge stone pillars, collapsed, and a black-haired young man with loose hair slowly emerged from the violent smoke and dust.
Terrifying golden-white lightning leaped around his body, emitting a Destructive Aura that even made Grayson’s heart tremble.
“Darren Callum!”
Upon seeing the newcomer’s appearance, Grayson’s face instantly showed horror and disbelief because, at that moment, Jack Clark was emitting a Supreme Level of Rule Aura.
“…Monster, simply not human.” Intense jealousy flickered in Grayson’s eyes.
With the help of the Blue Star sacrificial rites, during this time gathering information about Darren Callum, or rather Jack Clark, he even knew more than the Purgatory Empire.
And the more he knew, even he couldn’t help feeling jealous, envious.
That’s when Jack Clark slowly spoke, “Giant God Grayson, I once said, ‘When we meet again, I will slay you.'”
Grayson suppressed the emotions in his heart, his voice cold, “I acknowledge your strength is great now, but to think you can kill me is probably too premature.”
At that moment, the two stood tens of kilometers apart, to the side where half of the Great Hall had collapsed, in the Void outside the wall, a Space-Time vortex with a diameter of tens of kilometers slowly rotated.
Centering on the white vortex, invisible white ripples covered most of the Great Hall, filled with terrifying Space-Time Distortion forces.
This vortex in front, which made Grayson feel desperate, now became his shield.
Meanwhile, Grayson also wanted to infuriate Jack Clark, if he could pull Jack into the distorted Space-Time, even if this monstrously talented being was undying, he would still be heavily injured, or pulled into the endless Space-Time.
Just as Grayson coldly observed Jack from tens of kilometers away, Jack indifferently said, “Your reliance, is it the distorted Space-Time Power in front of you?”
Speaking, Jack directly stretched out his right hand, gently touching the white ripple sweeping in front of him.
“How is it possible, how can you be unharmed!?” In an instant, Grayson was once again shocked, watching as Jack touched the white purgatory and remained unchanged, he suddenly stood up.
“Merely the Power of Time, is it hard to resist?” With that, Jack directly stepped into the range of the white ripples.
Immediately, even more intense Time Power enveloped Jack, Space-Time distorted, and his entire figure blurred, silver runes like feathers on his forehead shining brightly.
Watching that figure wandering in the white ripples, continuously approaching him, madness and unwillingness surfaced in Grayson’s eyes, “You’ve actually mastered Time, you’ve actually mastered the Time Rule as well.”
“Why, why does Destiny favor you so much? I am unwilling, I am unwilling!”
As the first generation Innate Awakened One, Grayson was certainly a genius. He had experienced the first Mythical Impact, the Dark Age, and then ventured deep into the mythical world to establish a Divine Realm.
But in front of Jack, this monster, what was he?
At this moment, even after breaking through to Heavenly King and arrogantly looking down on all beings with his talent, Grayson felt an illusion of being abandoned by the era.
Watching the increasingly close blurred figure, madness flashed in Grayson’s eyes, “Darren Callum, to kill me, won’t be so easy.”
Boom! A strong burst of power erupted from Grayson’s body, radiating dazzling black radiance. His already three-hundred-meter-tall figure kept swelling.
In just the blink of an eye, Grayson transformed into a five-thousand-meter-tall giant clad in black heavy armor, surrounded by black light bands, emitting an incredibly heavy Aura.
Simultaneously, in his hands appeared a several thousand meters high stone statue resembling a lion and a tiger, with two pairs of curved dragon horns, invisibly emitting a terrifying Aura that suppressed Space-Time.
Boom!
Revealing his True Body, Grayson charged into the Space-Time ripples. However, he wasn’t fleeing, but directly lunged towards the white vortex extending into the Void outside the stone palace.
Puff!!
The formidable Grayson had just charged into the range of the white ripples when his figure turned to black ash at a terrifying speed, and in the blink of an eye, half his body dispersed into nothing.
This dispersal was complete, erased by some force, including that part of the soul and the Laws’ Origin.
“Accompany me in death, Darren Callum.” Desperation and madness appeared on the remaining half of Grayson’s face, his arm holding the statue erupting with power.
Boom! The mountainous stone statue shot up into the sky, emitting an oppressive force that suppressed Space-Time flying towards the white vortex.
However, when the statue touched those white ripples, instead of calming the surrounding Space-Time Power, it became more violent.
Watching this scene, a rampant mad smile appeared on Grayson’s face. Even in death, he wanted to make this human pay a price.
Just then, a cold, indifferent voice sounded next to Grayson’s ear, a palm appearing out of thin air above his head: “You know nothing of my power.”
Putt! A mere slight jump of golden-white lightning turned the lower part of Grayson’s body under him into nothingness.
Simultaneously, the statue already nearing the Space-Time vortex, suddenly stiffened and then, under the stirrings of the golden-white lightning, exploded into pieces, scattering in all directions.
Instantly, the vast Great Hall had only Jack remaining.
The Evil God, who once stirred Blue Star and entangled with the Purgatory Demon King causing the Federation much trouble, was like an insect casually squeezed to death by Jack.
Standing amidst the layers of distorted Space-Time ripples,]]

chapters.title: Chapter 1602 - 1602 601 Great Sun Body Refinement Shocking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1602: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return Chapter 1602: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return Blue Star World
On the edge of the sun, Number One slowly flew through the solar corona that was hundreds of millions of kilometers thick, its body clad in black-red armor exuding a dazzling white radiance.
At that moment, the surroundings of Number One were suffused with a terrifying gravitational force capable of tearing apart space and crushing the True Body of the Heavenly King, along with temperatures exceeding a million degrees Celsius.
The speed had also dropped to just over four hundred times the speed of sound under the frightful gravity.
Even so, as it flew, colliding with gravity and the scorching particles, it felt as if hundreds of nuclear bombs exploded around Number One every second, deafening even in the vacuum of space.
Yet these were all unable to shake Number One, which had begun to revive.
Around the thousands of kilometers tall Number One, the power from ancient life circled, forming a force field that shielded against both gravity and extreme heat.
Inside Number One, Freya Louise, dressed in golden-white God Machine Armament—herself and the armor both semi-transparent—gazed coldly and silently at the immense sun before her.
Boom!
In an instant, the twisted Void vibrated thunderously, and after days of flight, Number One transformed into a black-red beam of light, piercing through the corona and formally entering the territory of the sun.
Immediately, Freya sharply sensed that the surrounding temperature was dropping rapidly, while an even more terrifying pulling force came from below the sun.
Beneath the coronal layer was the chromosphere, similar to the Blue Star’s ethereal layer of Cloud Mist, over two thousand kilometers thick, brimming with endless scorching substances.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Number One’s descent speed accelerated, resembling a meteor captured by the sun, and in an instant, its speed had broken through a thousand times the speed of sound, clashing with the pervasive materials of Heaven and Earth with intensified friction.
From afar, it appeared as a barely detectable flash of light streaking across the surface of the sun.
Compared to the sun’s diameter of over a million kilometers, the nearly four-thousand-meter-tall Number One was smaller than a speck of dust.
But the moment Number One passed through the chromosphere, infinite ‘flames’ erupted below, forming a ring with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers.
The powerful energies and searing temperatures mixed with the destroy-Heaven-and-Earth rays engulfed Number One, emitting a glow visible to even the Blue Star.
Roar!
Under the energy impact that could instantly destroy the Blue Star, Number One let out a savage roar by instinct, its red and white radiance bursting forth, emanating a terrifying suction force.
Bang! The space and scorching materials around Number One collapsed violently, forming a black hole with a diameter of a thousand kilometers, devouring everything in its path.
As the heart became whole and ancient power revived, Number One instinctively awakened many higher life forms’ abilities, such as energy absorption and conversion.
Such devouring power had basically reached the Ancient Level and above that most life forms would master.
However, unlike the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Final Darkness Devouring that devoured and refined everything, most Ancient Level beings could only absorb and transform specific energies and materials.
As endless solar materials and energy poured into Number One’s body, it let out an even more violent roar, its Aura surged, and its size expanded from three thousand eight hundred meters to four thousand meters.
Radiating a Terrifying Aura and burning with red and white light, Number One pierced through the chromosphere and entered the sun’s photosphere, a mere few hundred kilometers thick.
To Blue Star’s physicists, the photosphere appeared as an opaque thin layer, teeming with intense solar magnetic fields.
But the moment Number One entered the photosphere, a magnetic field explosion that even made Freya’s expression tighten, directly shredded the thousand-kilometer spatial phase force field surrounding Number One.
Boom, boom, boom! Under the dreadful and distorted sun’s magnetic field, pieces of black-red armor, strong enough to withstand the attack of the Great Demon King, continuously shattered.
“Alert, subjected to strong solar magnetic field impact, outer armor loss rate has reached 30%, constraint on Number One’s biological form weakening.”
Staring at the flickering red light before her, Freya’s gaze remained as always, calm and cold, without a trace of emotional fluctuation.
Under the pull of the sun’s gravity, Number One’s descent speed increased even faster, almost instantly piercing through the photosphere and plunging into the convection zone, tens of thousands of kilometers thick.
This region churned with the sun’s seething materials, also the surface of the sun that normal people see through telescopes.
Here, the temperature paradoxically dropped even further; in Freya’s perception, it was only tens of thousands of degrees Celsius, although higher than the few thousand degrees Celsius by physical observation, but…
Boom!
Under the greater gravitational pressure, Number One’s black-red armor once again crumbled, like a beam of light rushing into the sun.
Until now, mankind’s understanding of the sun’s structure, layers, and observations were all inferred from the laws of physics, but it was only at this moment, entering the sun, that Freya understood the true terror of the sun.
The high temperatures where atomic and molecular energies pulsed, rays emitted, spaces twisted and collapsed, as well as the most terrifying celestial gravitational magnetic field.
Such force could bind light, energy, and all matter, forming a gravitational field with pressure billions of times greater than atmospheric pressure.
For a being like Number One, with an astonishingly dense body, proportionally tens of thousands of times denser than any alloy, the solar gravitational magnetic field would generate an even more powerful gravitational force.
Suddenly, Number One’s sinking speed became even faster, and under the frightful gravity and searing pulsed rays, the armor restricting its life form shattered even more rapidly.
Roar!
As the last piece of constraining armor completely crumbled, a majestic and savage roar reverberated throughout space, filled with a wild and ancient Aura.
Boom!
Having dived tens of thousands of kilometers into the sun’s outer layer, Number One erupted with an even more dreadful sucking force, devouring all the scorching matter around it, forming a black hole spanning tens of kilometers even deep within the sun.

chapters.title: Chapter 1603 - 1603 601 Great Sun Body Refinement Shocking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1603: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return_2 Chapter 1603: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return_2 Infinite energy surged, and Number One’s body swelled once again, a red tail springing forth with a “puff,” its surface covered with red and white patterns.
Besides that, a pair of arms tore through the skin under its armpits, wrapped in sun-like red patterns, instantly making its aura even stronger.
But what was most important was that as it absorbed more and more Stellar Energy, the nature of Number One’s body, which was undergoing transformation and rebirth, was also changing.
It was becoming more like the life of the Blue Star World, rather than an ancient creature of the mythical world.
This was why Freya Louise wanted to make her breakthrough in the Legendary Realm on Blue Star and fuse with Number One.
Simply stripping this ancient life’s resurgence, the returned strands of Soul Will and information were not enough insurance; one also had to simultaneously carry out the body’s transformation.
Only when both body and soul belonged to ‘her’ could she finally eradicate the brand of that ancient life’s existence.
Otherwise, in the end, it would still be making a wedding dress for that ancient life.
As Number One roared when it delved 70,000 kilometers into the sun, dark golden rune chains formed of Super God Energy burst forth from its body.
Boom!
These rune sequence chains spread out over a thousand kilometers, reaching into the deep Distortion space like a giant net, anchoring Number One amidst the intense material energy flow.
This was the limit for Number One; continuing to descend would result in it being torn apart by the sun’s gravitational magnetic field and burned to ashes.
By that time, perhaps only Number One’s heart could be left behind.
“It’s really here.” Feeling the faint mysterious call coming from deep within the sun, Freya Louise’s gaze was cold and calm, and then she slowly closed her eyes.
In an instant, the suction emanating from Number One’s body surged once more, frantically Devouring and absorbing the endless Stellar Energy around it, and its body began to grow at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Pfft!!
On Number One’s shoulders, the originally golden-white skin tore open, and a piece of golden-white scale armor grew from nothing, followed by the second and the third.
The surfaces of these scales were adorned with beautiful and mysterious red patterns, resembling gleaming lights and burning flames.
Apart from the changes to the scale armor, Number One, free from its restraining armor, began to change in shape as it grew, becoming increasingly ferocious and terrifying.
Plus, the surrounding dark Devouring domain and the intense flames filling the environment made it resemble an ancient deity nurtured deep within the sun.
“Number One has successfully entered the sun.”
At Simon Research Base, Elvis Louise stood in front of the big screen, looking at the High-definition Satellite images of the sun, his gaze steadfast… and silent.
At the same time, in the mythical world, the divine light outside the No.1 Logistics City under the night illuminated half of the night sky as bright as day, deterring all life within tens of thousands of kilometers.
On a stone platform as high as mountain ranges, the alliance meeting of the four races had already concluded discussions on the new territories for the Immortal Spirit Remnant Race and the Heavenly Feather Remnant Race, including subsequent cooperation among the four races.
Despite having the Purgatory Demon Race as a common enemy, both the Heavenly Feather Divine King and the Immortal Spirit Immortal King had to be responsible for their races, so new breeding territories were crucial.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t take long for both races to be completely extinct; instead of that outcome, it was better to delve deeper into the mythical world and start anew in some corner.
Moreover, with the post-alliance, the combined strength was stronger, and with the power systems of the four races and the exchange of civilization, it would be beneficial for everyone if a complementary relationship could be established.
For the races of the mythical world, progress in civilization also meant an enhancement in overall strength.
In particular, ‘technology’ from the Human Race was of great interest to the other three races.
But just then, True King Heavenly King, sitting behind the three Supreme Experts, stiffened as the black stele he held trembled slightly, and a row of text emerged.
The content was the order sent down from the Demon God alliance meeting of Diorus and the rest, millions of kilometers away.
Looking at the information appearing on the stele, True Martial Heavenly King’s expression was grave; the thing he feared most had happened.
As the Human Race’s power expanded, sensing threat, the empires of the Purgatory Demon Race started to band together, but unexpectedly, the Eight Great Empires had formed an alliance.
Didn’t those Demon Gods have enmities between them?
True Martial Heavenly King looked at the various Divine Kings and Supreme Experts and spoke slowly, “Everyone, I’ve just received word that the Eight Great Empires of the Purgatory Demon Race have united.”
“What.”
Boom, boom, boom!!
As soon as True Martial Heavenly King’s voice fell, the auras of the Divine Kings and Immortal Kings of the three races, including the Human Race’s three Supreme Experts, erupted in unison, sending Heaven and Earth into a tremor.
This sudden turn of events left all the high-plane beings behind the Divine Kings in shock, not knowing what had happened.
For when True Martial Heavenly King spoke, he had enveloped the message with Rule power, ensuring only those with Ancient Level strength could hear to avoid causing panic.
Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy’s expression was solemn, “True Martial Excellency, is the source of this message accurate? Tyris and the rest have come out from the Deep Red World so soon?”
The Heavenly Feather Clan once deeply researched the Deep Red World, and thus, they were acutely aware of the terror of that Supreme Plane; if one were not lucky, even True Spirits would fall if they became trapped.
This time, offering the Eternal World as a sacrifice, under normal conditions, the destructive force released during the fall should have been enough to attract powerful Deep Red beings.
Even if they couldn’t annihilate all the Purgatory Demon Race, those Demon Gods shouldn’t have been able to leave the Deep Red World so quickly, right?
“I can confirm that the message is accurate.”
True Martial Heavenly King nodded affirmatively, his expression solemn, “After more than twenty years of effort, my race has successfully infiltrated an insider into the higher-ups of the Purgatory Empire.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1604 - 1604 601 Great Sun Body Refinement Shocking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1604: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return_3 Chapter 1604: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return_3 “The news comes from the conference that the Purgatory Demon Gods just concluded. Currently, in the rear of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, the armies of the three to five major empires led by Demon King Dark Sky have already gathered.”
“Including a vast number of demon kings, Great Demon Kings, and six Demon Gods.”
“In addition, all the armies and Demon Gods from the Three Major Empires of Saint Demon Anke, which were previously at war with the Immortal Spirit Alliance Race, will arrive in six days to lead their armies here.”
“It’s expected that the Purgatory Demon Race will spend four days reorganizing and at the break of dawn, they will launch a deadly battle against us.”
Although those present were all ‘insiders’, Jack, the True Martial Heavenly King, still somewhat obscured the information, describing Brooks, who had joined the Purgatory Demon Race half a year ago, as having been with them for over twenty years.
By doing so, even if some unexpected events were to occur, and the Purgatory Empire became aware of an informant within the Human Race, they would investigate going back over twenty years.
Instantly, the expressions of every ‘Person’ became incomparably grave.
The slight joy they felt in their hearts due to the alliance between the four races, which had greatly increased their strength, dissipated immediately.
The pressure of the eight combined Purgatory Empires was too immense.
At this moment, still composed under the dire news, Adam Garcetti smiled and said, “My friends, do not panic. The convergence of the Demon Gods from the eight empires does indeed place great pressure on us.”
“But compared to the worst-case scenario of the Purgatory ancestors not awakening, don’t you think it pales in significance?”
Two days passed and the news that the Purgatory ancestors had not awakened was relayed back through Brooks’ investigations, allowing Adam Garcetti and others who had prepared for the worst to breathe a sigh of relief.
This was also why they still had the leisure to form alliances and hold conferences here.
Otherwise, facing that existence, which had been around for over one hundred thousand years and possessed strength far surpassing that of the average True Spirit, even if Jack summoned the Thunderflame Behemoth to help, it would not be a match.
And Brooks’ initial plan to absorb the Blood of Demon God and transform into a Purgatory True Demon was of great help to the Human Race.
It allowed the Human Race to receive the first-hand movements of the Purgatory Demon Race, especially after Brooks’ breakthrough to demon king, giving him access to even more critical information.
Including the last plan of Diorus to refine the Demon God Puppet of Blue Star.
And with the cooperation of the Federation, Brooks managed to put all the blame on the Giant God Sect—a convenient scapegoat since those Giant God Sect Apostles had been captured and could not refute the claims.
Divine King Tarodel slowly nodded in agreement: “Speaker Adam Garcetti is correct. Compared to the awakening of that Ancestor, this pressure is indeed not worth mentioning.”
“Relying on the God Defense completed by the Human Race and the special nature of this forbidden area, we still have the power to fight.”
Hearing this, the Immortal King and the Heavenly Feather Divine King also slowly nodded. After carefully weighing the combined forces of both sides, they felt that a battle was not out of the question.
At present, the god-level powerhouses of the Human Alliance including the True Martial Heavenly King and Jack numbered twelve, comparable to three powerhouses at the level of Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings.
Despite the fall of Demon God Level powerhouses in the prior destructive wars between the two races and the earlier battles in the Human forbidden areas, the total number of powerhouses from the Eight Great Empires would not exceed twenty.
Coupled with a few Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings, the gap in upper-tier strength was not too vast—at least the opponents could not manage a two-on-one advantage.
However… the Immortal King of the Immortal Spirit Clan, with perfectly white hair, spoke gravely, “For us, the main trouble comes from Carthius, as well as another Great Demon King of equal notoriety.”
“The Purgatory Demon Race possesses special strength that allows them to sacrifice and refine our clan’s intrinsic culture to massively increase their power.”
“Although both our clan and the Heavenly Feather Clan used similar destruction tactics in our defeats, we still couldn’t prevent those two Great Demon Kings from reaping benefits.”
