“I have the premonition that when we meet again, the strength of those two Great Demon Kings will become even more terrifying.”
Adam Garcetti smiled faintly: “Those two Great Demon Kings are indeed troublesome, but we have ways to counter them, like the Thunderflame Behemoth that Jack summons.”
“The noble Divine Martial Emperor, right?” The Immortal King Wind Heaven thought of the young man with shoulder-length black hair and couldn’t help but nod slowly.
Although they had only seen him once, the impression Jack left on them was profoundly deep.
Moreover, before the ‘meeting’, the Heavenly Feather Divine King Tolstoy had detailed to them the last great battle, in which the Summoned Giant Beast had shocked them.
In just ten minutes of existence, it killed three Demon Gods, a feat of strength that completely surpassed the Ancient Level.
Speaking of Jack, the faces of the three Divine Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan showed a hint of relief. Tolstoy nodded faintly: “Indeed, let’s not forget about the True Martial Heavenly King of the Human Race, or rather, the Divine Martial Speaker.”
Even the Divine King Tarodel couldn’t help but exclaim: “This newly appointed Speaker of the Human Race has a talent that indeed makes us feel ashamed.”
With the return of the Immortal Spirit Remnant Race and the Nether Heavenly King, the news of Jack’s breakthrough to Supreme had spread among the upper tiers of the alliance, but at the time, there were ‘too many matters’ to attend to, resulting in little time for marveling.
However, after marveling, everyone became solemn once again.
Because even if the Summoned Giant Beast could hold off two Great Demon Kings, Jack couldn’t maintain the beast for an extended period and beyond that…
Tolstoy spoke gravely, “Among the Eight Great Empires, Diorus and the fallen Belidier pose the weakest threat, but we cannot overlook the strength of lords of empires like Belvetan.”
Adam Garcetti and others slowly nodded in agreement.
Each of these Lords of the Empires possessed ancient late-stage cultivation, coupled with World-class weapons, each boasted power comparable to the Peak of the Ancient.
Currently, the only ones in the alliance with stable Peak of the Ancient battle strength were Divine King Tarodel and Immortal King Wind Heaven.

chapters.title: Chapter 1605 - 1605 601 Great Sun Body Refinement Shocking
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1605: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return_4 Chapter 1605: Chapter 601 Great Sun Body Refinement, Shocking Return_4 Adam Garcetti, relying on the ancient divine weapon in combination with the rules of life and death, could momentarily possess peak combat strength under the cycle of life and death flourishing, yet that state too could not last long.
Tolstoy’s power was slightly inferior to that of the four lords of the empire.
The Immortal King Wind Heaven slowly said, “In this respect, it is indeed disadvantageous for us, but there are ways to resolve it. I have an array that can suppress the battlefield.”
As he spoke, behind the Immortal King Wind Heaven, space silently shattered, and a palace as vast as a world emerged, emitting an aura that startled Adam Garcetti and others.
“This has been the effort of our clan for thousands of years, exhausting resources, condensing the Ninefold Heavenly Palace. Originally held by the Immortal Emperor…” at this point, the countenances of the three Immortal Kings slightly darkened.
The Heavenly Feather Clan had an Eternal Divine Tree sapling as the core for their tribe’s transference. The Immortal Spirit Alien Race possessed a Race Background Weapon as well.
Wind Heavenly King continued, “The greatest power of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace is to integrate strength and suppress an era. If there are nine Immortal Kings each guarding a Layer of Heaven, it can even cover a domain of Heaven and Earth.”
“Although it cannot allow us to break the limits of strength and step into the True Spirit, each Immortal King in the Ninefold Heavenly Palace fights with the combined power of nine.”
Primordial True King was astonished, “That’s so strong!”
Others couldn’t help pausing too, each strike equivalent to the combined strength of nine Divine Kings. Which Demon God at the same level could resist?
And if this Heavenly Palace was so powerful, how could the Immortal Spirit Clan have been defeated?
Wind Heavenly King faintly smiled bitterly, “Everyone need not be so shocked. Although the Ninefold Heavenly Palace is powerful, its weaknesses are also very clear, like needing all nine Immortal Kings to unleash its maximum power.”
“At our clan’s pinnacle, there were only seven Immortal Kings. Besides, the guarding Immortal Kings need to maintain a specific alternation frequency during battle and cannot attack at the same time.”
“The core of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace is to dominate, and the power can only overflow by thirty percent.”
“That means if two Immortal Kings attack at the same time, the increase in power of the Divine Ability will only be six times. If three attack simultaneously, it’s four times, and three times for four kings, decreasing successively.”
So it was. Adam Garcetti and the others nodded slightly.
This weakness was indeed very apparent. Added to the fact that the Immortal Spirit Clan did not have enough Immortal Kings to unleash the strongest power of this Race Background Weapon, they had reached their limits after holding on for so many years.
However, with this great array, the integrated strength of the alliance increased somewhat, ensuring they could guard the entrance to the Forbidden Area battlefield.
Just as these Supreme Experts were silently calculating what could enhance their chances in the forthcoming great battle, suddenly the entire heaven and earth started shaking.
Boom! A range of ten thousand kilometers trembled. Mountain ranges undulated, as if a boundlessly gigantic creature was moving.
Immediately, everyone instinctively turned their heads, looking towards the direction of the Outer Development Department, including Damon Lopes and other ‘ordinary people’ outside the alliance conference.
In the dim horizon, a great expanse of light emerged. Infinite golden radiance surged like a flood, extending thirty thousand miles, instantly spreading a Supreme oppressive force.
The glowing radiance formed a golden path between Heaven and Earth, surrounded by circles of multicolored halos, a grandiose scene.
Above, a figure wrapped in colored haze, as if descending from ancient times, a peerless deity, filled the heavens and earth with a vast aura. With every step, a white lotus bloomed beneath his feet, lingering for a long time.
Such an astonishing entrance left everyone at the scene, apart from those Supreme and Heavenly King Level strong men, completely dumbfounded.
Due to the distance, combined with the halo of light invoked by the rules resonating with heaven and earth, Adam Garcetti and the others could not discern the newcomer’s appearance for a time.
Of course, they couldn’t see clearly, but the aura was so familiar they naturally wouldn’t mistake it.
But before Adam Garcetti and the others could speak, Damon Lopes in the distance, carrying a video camera, excitedly shouted, “Damn, what an awesome entrance.”
As he spoke, the excited Damon looked into the distance, shouting to Eddy Keller, “Old Keller, dare you bet with me that the person coming is Jack Clark?”
“Get lost.” Eddy Keller immediately rolled his eyes.
Is there even a need to bet? Who else could perform such an exaggerated entrance other than that guy?
[Separation]
The Heavenly Feather Clan had a sapling of the Eternal Divine Tree as their tribal core transfer, while the Immortal Spirit Alien Race possessed a Race Background Weapon.
Wind Heavenly King continued, “The greatest power of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace is to unify strength and suppress an era. If there are nine Immortal Kings each guarding one Layer of Heaven, it can even cover a region of heaven and earth.”
“Although it cannot allow us to break through the limit of strength and step into the True Spirit, each strike from an Immortal King in the Ninefold Heavenly Palace is equivalent to the combined force of nine kings.”
Primordial True King was shocked, “That’s so strong!”
The others couldn’t help but pause, each strike being equivalent to the combined force of nine Divine Kings—what demon god of the same level could withstand that?
And with such a strong heavenly palace, how could the Immortal Spirit Clan have been defeated?
Wind Heavenly King gave a wry smile, “Gentlemen, no need to be so surprised. Although the Ninefold Heavenly Palace is powerful, its weakness is also quite obvious, such as needing all nine Immortal Kings to gather to exert its greatest power.”
“At our peak, there were only seven Immortal Kings in our clan. Furthermore, the defending Immortal Kings must maintain a certain frequency of alternation and cannot act at the same time.”
“The core of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace is dominion, with only thirty percent of the strength being able to overflow.”
“This means that if two Immortal Kings act at the same time, the enhancement received by their divine powers is only six times; if three act at the same time, it is four times; with four, three times, and so on, decreasing in turn.”
So that’s how it is. Adam Garcetti and the others nodded slightly.
This weakness was indeed very obvious. Coupled with the insufficient number of Immortal Kings in the Immortal Spirit Clan, they were unable to unleash the full power of this Race Background Weapon; that they had held on for so many years was already the limit.
However, with the addition of this great formation, the comprehensive strength of the alliance had increased a fraction, ensuring the guarding of the entrance to the forbidden area battlefield.
As the Supreme Experts were silently calculating and considering what else could increase the odds in the upcoming grand battle, suddenly the whole world began trembling.
Boom! A ten-thousand-kilometer area of the Earth shook violently, the mountain ranges undulated as if a vast, boundless creature was moving.
Immediately, everyone instinctively turned their heads, looking toward the direction of the Outer Development Department, including Damon Lopes, and other ‘ordinary people’ who were not part of the alliance meeting.
They saw in the dim horizon, a vast expanse of brightness emerged where endless golden twilight cascaded down from the heavens, stretching thirty thousand li. In an instant, a Supreme oppression spread everywhere.
The dazzling radiance formed a golden path between heaven and earth, surrounded by rings of multicolored halos, creating a majestic scene.
Above it, a figure wrapped in colorful twilight appeared, as if descended from ancient times, a peerless deity. His aura was vast, filling heaven and earth, and with every step he took, a white lotus would appear beneath his feet, lingering for a long time.
Such a shocking entrance left everyone on the scene other than those Supreme Experts and Heavenly King Level powerhouses staring in awe.
And because of the distance, coupled with the twilight halo triggered by the rule resonance between heaven and earth, Adam Garcetti and the others couldn’t make out the newcomer’s features for a moment.
Of course, while they couldn’t see clearly, the aura was so familiar they couldn’t be mistaken.
But before Adam Garcetti and the others could speak, Damon Lopes off in the distance carrying a video camera excitedly shouted, “Damn, what an awesome entrance!”
As he spoke, the excited Damon Lopes looked into the distance and called out to Eddy Keller, “Old Eddy, do you dare to bet with me that that person is Jack Clark?”
“Get lost.” Eddy Keller immediately rolled his eyes.
Is there even a need to bet? Who else could perform such an exaggerated entrance other than that guy?

chapters.title: Chapter 1606 - 1606 602 Youre Actually an Undercover
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1606: Chapter 602 You’re Actually an Undercover, Expedition of the Giant Beast Legions Chapter 1606: Chapter 602 You’re Actually an Undercover, Expedition of the Giant Beast Legions Jack Clark made such a high-profile arrival not just for showmanship, but also for deterrence.
Currently, among the four tribes, the Human Race has the strongest comprehensive strength, but in terms of the number of Mythical Kings and Heavenly King Powerhouses, it slightly trails behind the Immortal Spirit Clan and the Heavenly Feather Clan.
Including the number and strength of the Supreme Experts, Jack Clark wasn’t at an advantage before he stepped into the Supreme Realm.
Compared to the First Councilor Adam Garcetti, Divine King Tarodel, and the realm of the Wind Heavenly King of the Immortal Spirit Clan, which are all at the Peak of the Ancient,
the slightly lesser Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy, whose realm has reached the Ancient Late Stage, is comparable to a Peak of the Ancient powerhouse when wielding a Top-tier Pseudo-World Level Weapon.
Although at present everyone is quite united under the leadership of the Human Race, over time friction is bound to occur among the members of the four tribes.
This friction stems from the distribution of benefits after victory, the level of resources in their respective stationed areas, logistical support, and other aspects.
Thus, upon his breakthrough and return, Jack Clark immediately displayed a terrifying might that surpassed the Peak of the Ancient, intimidating all high-order powerhouses of the four tribes.
Feeling the indescribable, terrifying pressure above the Firmament, alongside the Human Alliance’s cries of ‘Congratulations on stepping into the Ancient,’ ‘Achieve immortality,’ and ‘Eternal undying,’ some members of the Immortal Spirit Alien Race, Heavenly Feather Clan, and different races of the Divine Gods Alliance also instinctively shouted in excitement.
Watching this scene, as the leading big brother Damon Lopes excitedly held up the video camera, “Film this, film this, damn it, if this scene is shown to those ‘girlfriends,’ they’ll definitely be thrilled.”
As Damon Lopes got to know more people, the number of female friends in his mobile phone had exploded, now exceeding several thousand.
Among these were ordinary beauties added during missions on Blue Star, female cultivators added after entering the mythical world, and some beauties from the Heavenly Feather Clan.
During this period, whenever Damon Lopes took a liking to any Heavenly Feather beauty, he would visit under the banner of inter-tribal friendship, gift a mobile phone, and casually add her as a friend while teaching her how to use it.
It’s just that, whether it’s because his reputation as an Innate Awakened One isn’t notable enough or due to cultural differences between the tribes, for now, he hasn’t managed to collect any risqué photos of Heavenly Feather beauties.
The least numerous Divine Gods Alliance, standing behind Divine King Tarodel, the Phantom Serpent Main God felt a bit shocked, “Good thing, we didn’t side with the Purgatory Demon Clan back then.”
“Indeed,” nodded the Main God of the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe gravely.
Initially, within the Divine Gods Alliance, there was a split opinion regarding the Purgatory Family and the stance towards the Human Race, otherwise, they wouldn’t have allowed the Purgatory Demon King to establish the Demon God Sect.
Then everything changed following the rise of Jack Clark.
At this moment, the majestic Divine Light slowly faded, revealing Jack Clark’s figure, behind whom a golden-white Divine Wheel spun, like the aura of Immortal Gods from mythological legends, sacred and majestic.
Boom!
A stone seat, representing the position of a Supreme Expert, slowly rose beside Adam Garcetti.
When Jack Clark sat down, the Primordial True King recapped all the issues discussed earlier, including information about the Ninefold Heavenly Palace of the Immortal Spirit Clan within a short time.
After the Primordial True King finished speaking, Jack Clark pondered solemnly.
“Everyone has considered thoroughly, but for this great war, my idea is to rely on a defensive strategy along the border, more than 100,000 kilometers from the entrance to the forbidden battlefield area.”
“And unless the situation reaches a point of life and death crisis, I will not summon the Thunderflame Beheamoth.”
“Why?” the other Divine Kings were slightly startled.
The war initiated by the Purgatory Demon Clan was a fight to the death, disregarding all losses and continuing until the bitter end against the Human Alliance; wouldn’t it be reasonable to meet them head-on and display an unyielding will to boost morale?
Jack Clark glanced around, then the golden-white Divine Wheel behind him emitted rings of light that enveloped the entire platform, before he slowly continued.
“Because I want to buy time, waiting for reinforcements.”
At this, even Adam Garcetti and the Sky-based God King paused, as with the arrival of the Immortal Spirit Clan, there seemed to be no external force capable of intervening in the battle between the two tribes.
Under the gaze of more than ten Divine Kings and Extreme Realm Experts, Jack Clark slowly said, “You are all familiar with the ‘Thunderflame’ Beheamoth I’ve summoned multiple times, aren’t you?”
“Its current strength is already comparable to the True Spirit Level, but its weakness is also very clear; once it enters the Limit Breakthrough state, even the current me can only maintain it for an hour at most.”
“At that time, if those two Great Demon Kings join forces and delay until the Thunderflame Beheamoth departs, with their strength, no one will be able to stop them.”
The Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy and other Divine Kings nodded gravely, naturally aware of this issue.
The solution is for Tarodel to burn this divine Avatar and attain Peak of the Ancient limit fighting strength, joining forces with Jack Clark to hold off one Great Demon King.
Meanwhile, the Thunderflame Beheamoth would Burst at full strength, severely injuring or even slaying the other Great Demon King.
While the plan seemed ideal, the Purgatory Family, which held a numerical advantage in demon gods, might not play along, and there was a good chance that both Tarodel and Jack Clark could be tied down by a Lord of the Empire.
At this moment, another Immortal King from the Immortal Spirit Clan caught on, “Divine Martial Emperor, are the reinforcements you spoke of that Thunderflame Beheamoth?”
“Indeed.”
Jack Clark nodded, “After the end of the battles in the forbidden zone, at my ‘request,’ Thunderflame has already led the Giant Beast legions on an expedition to provide support.”
When he mentioned ‘request,’ no one noticed the strange flicker in Jack Clark’s eyes.
After all, talking about requesting oneself for something always felt a bit odd.

chapters.title: Chapter 1607 - 1607 602 Youre Actually an Undercover the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1607: Chapter 602 You’re Actually an Undercover, the Expedition’s Giant Beast Legions_2 Chapter 1607: Chapter 602 You’re Actually an Undercover, the Expedition’s Giant Beast Legions_2 “What, the Giant Beast itself is soon to arrive.”
“Under the Divine Martial Emperor, is this information confirmed?” All Divine and Immortal Kings, including Adam Garcetti and the Primordial True King, were invigorated, their faces showing excitement.
If the Giant Beast with True Spirit Combat Power were to arrive, there would be no need to worry about its time of existence.
By that time, even if the Purgatory Ancestor were to awaken, they would possess a combat power equal in level, and although the Giant Beast might not be a match for the Purgatory Ancestor, they wouldn’t be completely hopeless.
“Wait, the Giant Beast legions, this reinforcement isn’t just the Thunderflame Behemoth?” At this point, the Golden Winged Divine King, Tolstoy, realized.
Jack Clark nodded at Adam Garcetti and others, who were equally astonished, “Correct, the legions. Previously on Blue Star, Thunderflame established a Giant Beast Empire known as Dragon Palace in the deep sea.”
“After leaving through the pathway from the Blue Star sea, it appeared in another direction in the mythical world.”
“There, various powerful Giant Beasts and creatures of different races flourished. During this period of rapid growth, Thunderflame also accomplished unification, establishing an even vaster Giant Beast Empire.”
“The Giant Beast Empire, known as Dragon Palace, now possesses eight Ancient-level Dragon Kings, nearly a hundred Titan and Mythical-level Giant Beasts, all following Thunderflame to support us.”
“It’s just that the place is very far from us. Although they have set off for a while, I estimate it will still take about ten more days equivalent to Blue Star’s time to arrive.”
Because the Destruction Emperor Dragon was still in the process of devouring the Heaven-Earth Divine Vein to break through to the ancient late stage, Jack Clark wasn’t sure about the arrival time.
But even so, this brought a relieved smile to Adam Garcetti and others’ faces.
Once that Thunderflame Behemoth, along with the seven Ancient Dragon Kings equivalent to the Divine King Realm arrive, the Human Alliance would be no weaker than the Purgatory Demon Race.
Adding in Jack Clark and the terrifying growth speed of the Thunderflame Behemoth, as long as the war could be dragged out for a few years…
Indeed, their decision to ally with the Human Race was the right choice.
In this race, which had entered the mythical world more than ten years ago (forty years in Human Race time), the Giants saw something called a miracle.
At this moment, the hearts of three Heavenly Feather Divine Kings and three Immortal Spirit Divine Kings swelled with emotion, reminiscent of the time they first stepped into the Legendary Realm.
Adam Garcetti spoke solemnly, nodding his head, “If there are no objections, then as Divine Martial advises, in this war, we shall focus primarily on defense and wait for the Giant Beast legions to arrive before launching a counterattack.”
“I agree.”
“I also agree.”
At this time, Jack Clark thoughtfully said, “Currently, aside from the Three Major Empires of Saint Demon Anke, most of the power of the Purgatory Demon Race is concentrated in the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.”
“There’s about ten days left before they gather their forces and are ready to attack; during this time, I think we should do something.”
…
More than three hundred million kilometers from the Human Alliance’s battlefield in the forbidden zone, at the edge of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, mountain ranges stretched on, and a towering peak, tens of thousands of meters high, stood surrounded by clouds, bathed in moonlight like a fairyland.
At the cliff edge, Jack Clark stood with his hands behind his back, his expression indifferent as he looked down at the boundless forest below and the black clouds permeating the Earth thousands of kilometers away.
Compared to a few months back, the entire Purgatory Empire had now been demonized, resembling a massive dark creature entrenched on the Earth.
At that moment, a shadow flashed in the trees below, and soon the fog behind Jack Clark dispersed.
With heavy steps, a figure ten meters tall, clad in black armor, covered in dark red scale armor, slowly emerged—an image of the Purgatory Demon King, like a Hell demon.
Jack Clark turned around, smiling slightly, “Long time no see, Brudos.”
“Indeed, it’s been a long time.” Brudos, hideous and resembling a Hell demon, nodded reflectively.
By now, this was their third encounter.
The first was at Mathilda Ward’s hibernation ceremony where Brudos had officiated as the person in charge; the second was on the Road to Becoming a God, after which he had mysteriously left following their departure from the relic.
And in just these three meetings, Jack Clark had managed to impress him each time, especially now.
In just half a year, while he had been using the resources and research of the Purgatory Demon Race to break through to demon king status, this monster had already become the fourth Supreme Expert among the Human Race.
He had achieved breakthroughs earlier than the True Martial Heavenly King and even Mad Wheeler Heavenly King, who had previously been the most anticipated.
And from the start of his cultivation until now, it had taken less than a year and a half, giving him the feeling of being in a dream—it was truly monstrous.
While Brudos was in this daze, a light, like a white serpent, appeared in Jack Clark’s hand, slowly twisting and emitting terrifying fluctuations of time distortion.
“According to the plan, when you go back, hand this pure Power of Time to Diorus.”
“Tell it that around forty thousand kilometers south of the empire in the Deep Forbidden Zone, a secret realm suspected to contain treasures of the Time Rule has been discovered.”
Because they had to wait for Carthius and other Demon Gods, as well as the armies of the Three Major Empires, it would take Diorus and the other Demon Gods ten days to be ready.
During this long period, Jack Clark and the others naturally wouldn’t just wait idly.
To avoid alerting the hibernating Purgatory Ancestor, and because all True Demons would significantly increase their power when in the Demon Domain, the Human Race didn’t dare to launch a major attack on the rear of the already demonized Purgatory Empire.
And on the side of the Purgatory Demon Race, until all Demon Gods from the Eight Great Empires fully gathered, they were actually at a disadvantage against the current Human Alliance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1608 - 1608 602 Youre Actually an Undercover The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1608: Chapter 602 You’re Actually an Undercover, The Giant Beast Legion’s Expedition_3 Chapter 1608: Chapter 602 You’re Actually an Undercover, The Giant Beast Legion’s Expedition_3 Under such circumstances, naturally, no one dared to make the first move.
Then, this led to the currently strange standoff.
But as the final battle was about to erupt, Jack Clark and his allies planned to strike first and draw out Devil God Emperor Eros to kill him, weakening the enemy’s strength.
And this time, the target wasn’t only Diorus.
The key to this plan was that Brooks, a demon king, had already infiltrated deep within the Purgatory Empire, and to deceive Diorus, he even personally condensed a strand of pure Power of Time.
As a Demon God who commanded the Divine Power of the time-related bloodline, this materialized pure time was a Divine Object that greatly supplemented Diorus.
If there was enough of it, it could even allow his bloodline to further elevate and purify, and in turn, his strength would surge, possibly even breaking through to the ancient late stage.
Boom!!
Black Flames danced in Brooks’s hands, radiating horrifying high temperatures that burned space, slowly encasing the strand of materialized Power of Time that Jack held in his hands.
But the power of time was too overwhelming; even just a strand consumed thirty percent of Brooks’s Abyssal Hellfire Law.
Almost half an hour later, Brooks finally exhaled slowly, his expression solemn as he looked at the over 3 meters long black transparent crystal in his hands.
Is this his current strength now? Just a casually condensed strand of power had caused him such enormous consumption.
Brooks stored away the sealed crystal, his face showing a somewhat ferocious smile, “Divine Martial Emperor, to avoid arousing Diorus’s suspicion, I need two or three days to prepare.”
Jack Clark nodded slightly, “No problem, we also need a little time to set up.”
But just as Brooks was about to leave, Jack suddenly looked towards the distant forest shrouded in Cloud Mist, indifferently saying, “Thinking of leaving now, isn’t it a bit late?”
Deep within the forest, the Horned-Split Demon King, who had almost fused with everything, showed a look of shock on his face.
How was it possible that the human had discovered him?
The Toddus tribe’s innate Divine Power, once cultivated to its grand accomplishment, could nearly transform into pure wood elementals, fusing with all vegetation.
As long as there was no leakage of strength fluctuations, and not exiting the wooden state, even beings of higher realms wouldn’t be able to detect him.
Boom!
An over one-thousand-meter-tall ancient tree, akin to a small hill, exploded, countless black-green radiances burst open, and instantly merged into the trees in all directions, vanishing from sight.
Watching this scene, Jack Clark’s expression remained as indifferent as ever, “In my presence, do you think you can escape?” With that, he stretched out his hand and lightly pressed down.
Boom!
Under the pressure of Unrivaled Domineering Power, space itself instantly shattered, all matter, trees turned to dust, mountain peaks collapsed, forming a giant palm imprint with a diameter of one hundred kilometers and several kilometers deep.
Rocks and dirt, almost pressed into Vajra-like crystal material at the center of the glassy palm imprint, several pools of black-green blood struggled, desperately trying to approach and fuse.
But under that invisible and pervasive terrifying force of Will, the pools of dark green flesh and blood gradually dissipated, with the life aura growing weaker and weaker.
Just as the demon king was about to be suppressed by Jack’s casual palm in that instant, Brooks suddenly spoke up, “Divine Martial Emperor, please show mercy.”
Jack Clark paused, but in the end, he still dispersed the Supreme Will that permeated between heaven and earth.
Immediately after the invisible suppression lifted, the dark green flesh and blood writhed and merged, quickly reforming into the silhouette of the Horned-Split Demon King.
However, at this point, the demon king appeared extremely weak with serious damage to his vital energy, his body covered with huge cracks, as he watched Brooks stand tall in the distance with a pitiful gaze.
“Brooks, you’re actually a traitor.”
Brooks said calmly, “I’ve never considered myself a traitor. Neither you nor I are essentially part of the Purgatory Demon Race from the beginning.”
“If we are not from the Purgatory Demon Race, then there’s no betrayal.”
With that, Brooks sighed, “Gulden, you shouldn’t have followed. Now that you have seen what you shouldn’t have, it’s impossible for me to let you go even if I wanted to.”
A miserable smile appeared on the Horned-Split Demon King’s face: “Indeed, I should not have followed you out of curiosity, relying on the tribal Divine Power.”
“But now that it has come to this, go ahead.”
“If I can die at your hand, Brooks, then I, Gulden, have no regrets in this life.”
At this time, the Horned-Split Demon King’s eyes showed determination. It understood that even if its good friend Brooks wanted to let it go, that terrifying human would not agree.
Rather than trouble a friend, it would prefer to die by his hand to prevent him from being blamed by that terrifying human.
With a sigh!
Watching the massive Divine Soul shadow emerge behind him, awaiting his move, Brooks took a deep breath, turned his head to look at the black-haired young man standing with his hands behind his back and spoke solemnly, “Divine Martial Emperor, could you possibly spare its life? With Gulden’s cooperation, it might be easier to gain Diorus’s trust.”
Jack Clark replied indifferently, “Sparing its life is not out of the question, but I’m not sure if it is willing to betray the Purgatory Demon Race.”
A common demon king could easily be controlled or crushed to death with his current strength.
However, though he could impose a Seal to control life and death of the soul, he could not influence its thoughts; any control over will would be immediately detected by those Demon Gods.
In other words, Brooks was gambling his own life on the demon’s loyalty to the Purgatory Demon Race.
And in consideration of Brooks’s contribution to the Human Race, Jack Clark did not reject the request.
Brooks, not expecting Jack Clark to be so agreeable, paused then gratefully glanced at him, then turned to look at the distant Horned-Split Demon King: “Gulden, did you hear? Now release your Divine Soul and let the Emperor impose the Seal, swear to join the Human Alliance, and you can be spared from death.”
“No, I can’t do that,” the Horned-Split Demon King struggled as he spoke.
Brooks, astonished, asked, “Why?”
He couldn’t understand why the Horned-Split Demon King would refuse.
The Horned-Split Demon King, with a resolute gaze, declared, “Our Toddus tribe reveres the soul. We believe the soul is supremely pure and sacred. Even in death, it shall not be desecrated by others. It is absolutely impossible for me to open up my soul and let him impose the Seal.”
Damn, what kind of belief is this? Even Brooks couldn’t help but curse at this moment.
Jack Clark had already agreed to spare the creature’s life, yet it ended up dying for its own beliefs.
As Brooks pondered how to persuade this fool, the Horned-Split Demon King earnestly said, “But if you, Brooks, are the one to impose the soul Seal on me, I can reluctantly go against my beliefs.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1609 - 1609 603 Chrono Silver Wings Bloodline
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1609: Chapter 603: Chrono Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection Chapter 1609: Chapter 603: Chrono Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection Is there a bromance?
Looking at the Horned-Split Demon King who struggled and betrayed his soul belief for Brooks, Jack Clark felt an inexplicable déjà vu as if witnessing an intense stare-down between two passionate burly men.
Because the demon king’s body was tall and sturdy, his appearance rough and fierce, even Jack Clark didn’t consider the possibility of it being a “woman.”
After all, even though Purgatory True Demons might look ferocious, the differences between males and females were still quite obvious. For instance, the Tarolia who had injured him with three slashes appeared to be a beauty with long purple hair and a figure that was explosively attractive.
Faced with the Horned-Split Demon King’s earnest gaze, Brooks, feeling uncomfortable under the scrutiny, shook his head subconsciously, “Forget it, under the Divine Martial Emperor, just kill it.”
“…Sure?” Jack Clark paused.
Brooks quickly said, “Just kidding, Your Excellency, please don’t take offense.”
There definitely was a connection.
Seeing this scene, Jack Clark became even more certain of his thoughts. He hadn’t expected the heir of Simon Top Group to have such a unique sexual orientation.
But he had heard that over at Simon’s side, they indeed had a more open attitude in this regard.
As Jack Clark pondered, Brooks transformed into a black light and arrived in front of the Horned Demon King. Upon seeing this, a silver pupil in the center of Jack Clark’s forehead also gradually emerged.
In an instant, everything disappeared from Jack’s vision; standing in the Void, countless white light streams rushed past him like a flood engulfing heaven and earth.
Whenever Jack’s gaze lingered momentarily on the streams of light flying by, information bombarded him like a universe exploding, causing his consciousness to rumble and vibrate uncontrollably.
Given his current formidable physique, his brain processed information in an instant at a speed even more staggering than cyberbrains, which says volumes about the terrifying nature of that information.
Collecting his thoughts and forsaking the temptation to peer into the future, Jack followed an intuition that had flickered mysteriously.
After advancing Heart’s Eye to a Senior Divine Power, not only could he peer through everything along his line of sight, sense danger, but he also managed to capture brief, incomplete visions of the future.
However, foreseeing the future consumed too much energy and thus could not be used recklessly.
Opening it for less than a second, the silver pupil on Jack Clark’s forehead slowly closed.
He didn’t sense any danger or unease from the Horned Demon King, which seemed to confirm that this “surrender” posed no issues.
Although Heart’s Eye Perception was not 100% accurate, any existence capable of eluding Jack’s senses would at least be of the Ancient Level or above.
Clearly, this Horned Demon King was not among them.
Half an hour later, two figures surrounded by demon gas plunged into the forest below and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
After the two ‘persons’ left, Jack Clark also rose to the sky, turning into a faint shadow existing between illusion and reality, and flew off to a location tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Beneath the night sky, Jack maintained a flying altitude of about a hundred kilometers; the undulating mountain ranges and peaks thousands of meters tall receded continuously into the distance.
Coupled with the swirling Cloud Mist around those peaks and the occasional hisses and screams, a sense of primitive desolation washed over him.
This is the mythical world: mysterious, magnificent, vast.
As Jack Clark crossed over a hundred thousand kilometers, admiring the landscape en route, atop a towering mountain peak over fifty thousand meters tall in the distance, a fierce roar echoed between heaven and earth.
Roar!
With the terrifying sonic boom, the mountain peak exploded, trees flew in every direction, and a Mythical Giant Beast with a length of over eight hundred meters and exuding a Mid-Mythical Stage aura emerged roaring from the Cloud Mist.
The beast, resembling a black tiger with wings, was engulfed by a black storm, its eyes filled with murderous rage; it swooped towards Jack Clark riding on the raging wind.
To ambush the Purgatory Demon God, Jack Clark had concealed his aura along the way, which led the Mythical Giant Beast to treat him as an intruder invading its territory.
“Seeking death.”
Jack’s gaze was indifferent as he casually drew a line through the Void with his hand.
Rip!
Space was like a piece of fragile cloth, torn apart by Jack to reveal a terrifying world filled with storms and Thunder.
Boom!
The immense World Rift opened like a voracious maw. Under the terrifying suction force, space shattered, the mountain ranges shook, and the Earth collapsed.
Roar! The Black Winged Giant Beast issued a cry of terror, its body covered in raging Black Flames, doubling in size as if cast from Black Divine Iron.
But it was of no use.
Under the devouring Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, everything within a thousand-kilometer radius, including the Mythical Giant Beast, was consumed, and a massive pit appeared.
Boom, boom, boom!
Huge rocks, dirt, Sky-touching Trees thousands of meters high, along with the Mythical Giant Beast, were instantly crushed under the terrible Black Wind upon entering the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane.
The beast’s soul and will also perished instantly between heaven and earth under the twisting Purple Thunder Light.
As this Supreme Rule-bearing Plane expanded to a radius of ten thousand kilometers, its terrifying power began to manifest in the Real World.
However, this Plane was the foundation of Jack Clark’s path to power, of great importance; damage to it could affect his cultivation progress, hence its use was reserved only for eliminating pests.
After casually erasing a Mythical Giant Beast, Jack continued on his journey and soon crossed hundreds of thousands of kilometers to his destination.
Under the night, the space tens of thousands of kilometers ahead fractured and distorted, forming a pitch-black forbidden area that stretched across heaven and Earth.
On the edge of this forbidden area, rife with Spatial Storms, was a forest made of silver trees whose branches and leaves shimmered silver, with white mist throughout like an entrance.
Hum!
Behind Jack, Space-Time vibrated, and a three-thousand-meter-long transparent river gradually surfaced, upon which two ‘Jack Clarks’ in black Imperial Robes stood tall.

chapters.title: Chapter 1610 - 1610 603 Temporal Silver Wings Bloodline
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1610: Chapter 603: Temporal Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_2 Chapter 1610: Chapter 603: Temporal Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_2 However, the aura emitted from one of the Time Clones was only at the level of a Heavenly King, an ancient one from the early stages.
Boom!
The transparent river trembled, and Jack Clark, with the aura of the ancient early stage, stepped out from the river surface. He transformed into a silver light, ripping through the distorted Spatial Barrier of the silver forest and bursting into the forbidden zone.
And just as the Time Clone charged into the forbidden zone, it was as if he had entered a world composed of white light, a stark contrast to the darkness seen from the outside.
This white light was extremely sharp, a special phenomenon formed from the solidification of shattered space, incomparably keen. Ordinary mythical creatures entering would be heavily injured in an instant, and a slight misstep could lead to their downfall.
Then there was nothing.
Boom boom boom! Encircled by golden-white lightning, Jack Clark, clad in a black imperial robe, crushed everything in his path, shooting straight towards the heart of the forbidden zone like a streak of light.
At this point, the space was almost completely formless, transforming into a massive white vortex that penetrated the deep layers of the Void, creating a vast black hole.
Boom! Space and time shook; Jack Clark charged directly into the center of the vortex. Immediately, dazzling silver radiance emanated from his body, manifesting as a pair of wings, each a kilometer wide, as if forged from silver metal – a magnificent sight.
Engraved upon the wings were intricate Rune Trails. Space and time around them distorted, and a Terrifying Aura spread throughout the forbidden zone.
At first glance, the silver wings exuded the essence of a timeless treasure.
The very instant his Time True Body transformed into silver wings, the entire Dark Forbidden Zone trembled, and a silver beam of light, ten thousand meters thick, erupted from the central area, piercing thousands of kilometers through the Firmament.
In an instant, winds and clouds converged, and dense Heavenly Energy formed dozens of silver haloes around the beam, enveloping hundreds to thousands of kilometers and illuminating the entire night sky.
Such a grand spectacle was witnessed by all life within a range of tens of thousands of kilometers, including the True Demons stationed at the border of the Purgatory Empire, who also faintly glimpsed the silver radiance.
Outside the forbidden zone, Jack Clark watched the silver column that pierced Heaven and Earth, his figure silently vanishing.
This disappearance wasn’t just an absence of aura, but even his presence between heaven and earth was erased under the power of Divine Powers, rendering him undetectable even by a Demon God of equal standing from up close, without emitting any killing intent.
In the depths of the Space Interlayer, Jack Clark’s figure nearly merged with the surrounding Void, quietly waiting for Diorus’s arrival.
At the same time, Jack Clark could clearly feel the power in the Time Reincarnation Mystic Power imprint quickly depleting.
The Time Clone was strong, but maintaining its existence also required a significant amount of Power of Time. Without unleashing his full strength, Jack Clark estimated he could last for about a month.
During the wait, Jack Clark’s realm of thought stirred, summoning the attribute page and looking over the remaining four hundred forty-one thousand Attribute points. The voice of his intention resounded in his mind.
“Burn attributes, enter epiphany state.”
Two days could not simply be wasted; to Jack Clark at this moment, every minute was precious. He needed to seize every chance to elevate his strength.
Just then, a row of transparent text floated before Jack Clark’s eyes.
“Do you wish to burn one hundred thousand Attribute points to enter the epiphany state?”
One hundred thousand… Jack Clark hesitated for a moment.
After his breakthrough to high-order realm, the attribute page evolved the function to burn Attribute points to enter the state of enlightenment, where initially, just one thousand points would suffice for Jack Clark to achieve enlightenment overnight.
And the speed of cultivation during the epiphany state was over a hundred times faster, extremely formidable.
Latterly, after breaking through to the Legendary Realm, the standard for entering the state of enlightenment rose to ten thousand points, for he was comprehending rules, which was one reason for his swift advancement.
Now, having broken through to the Ancient Realm and mastering its Rule, the requirement rose again, reaching a staggering one hundred thousand points, meaning his forty-one thousand Attribute points were only enough for two days of cultivation.
For Jack Clark, the Ancient Realm was merely a new starting point.
Thus, after a brief pause, he made up his mind without hesitation. The voice echoed in his mind: “Burn four hundred thousand Attribute points, enter the epiphany state.”
Boom!
Instantly, four hundred thousand Attribute points on the page vanished, transforming into an aura of Mysterious profundity, as if unveiling Chaos, conceiving a mystical precept that enshrouded Jack Clark.
Even this Mysterious precept began to materialize around Jack Clark, forming an ephemeral and transparent round realm shadow.
Jack Clark sat cross-legged at the center of this world shadow; around him, a towering ten thousand meter transparent tree emerged, its massive branches stretching out in all directions.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s consciousness followed the trunk and branches, spreading out in every direction. Countless insights surged into his mind.
The trunk of the transparent tree was hearty and robust, containing pure and Overbearing strength. Its branches spread out, each one representing a Higher-order Law, Divine Power, or True Body bloodline.
In Jack Clark’s perception, these branches were actually composed of complex Rune Sequence Chains, which, as they rotated slowly, revealed the essence of these powers.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s consciousness split into dozens of strands, each comprehending heaven and earth, as the tree representing his Rule ‘grew’ and expanded visibly.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark engaged in Closed-door Cultivation,
The City Center of a border city in the Purgatory Empire, a day later, a figure flew rapidly towards the center.
There lay the former headquarters of the Assassination Department, now the location of the Intelligence Department. Soon, the figure bearing Nine Demonic Marks plunged into the grand hall of the Intelligence Department.
Shortly thereafter, led by two Demon Kings and accompanied by a dozen Purgatory True Demons, they ascended to the skies, heading towards a location over four hundred thousand kilometers away.
To arrive more swiftly, the leading demon, Brooks, even unfolded his Rule Demon Domain, propelling all those with him towards their destination at a hundred times the speed of sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 1611 - 1611 603 Temporal Silver Wings Bloodline
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1611: Chapter 603: Temporal Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_3 Chapter 1611: Chapter 603: Temporal Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_3 Unlike the Human Territory surrounded by traps in the forbidden area, the threats around the Purgatory Empire were numerous, but they had not yet reached the point of being everywhere.
Thus, it took only three hours for Brooks and other demons to approach the Silver Forbidden Zone.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!!
More than a dozen figures landed on the canopy of a tree as tall as a mountain peak; Titan looked toward the dark area that spanned Heaven and Earth a hundred kilometers away, as well as the silver column of light that pierced through.
Brooks spoke slowly, “Tabor, is this the treasure you talked about?”
One of the Purgatory True Demons with Nine Demonic Marks bowed respectfully, “Yes, Lord Brooks, although my strength isn’t very strong, I have once awakened a special bloodline talent.”
“After receiving a report of anomaly from the Boundary, I personally came to investigate, and then I felt an overwhelmingly fearful sensation emanating from that beam of light.”
“I can be certain, there is a tremendously powerful treasure emerging inside, fostered by one of the forbidden zones, it might even be a Pseudo-World Level Weapon.”
“It’s just that it’s very dangerous inside, and I am unable to approach it, otherwise I would have already taken the treasure out and handed it over to the minister.”
As soon as the True Demon finished speaking, a greedy look appeared on the faces of all the Purgatory Demon Race around, including ‘Brooks and the Horned Demon King.’
And at this moment, the aura of the Horned Demon King was ‘normal,’ his injuries seemed to have healed.
Brooks nodded slowly, “This place is indeed very dangerous, the entrance forest is filled with intense Space Tear forces, even I feel a bit uneasy.”
“You all stay here, Gulden and I will go in and take a look.”
The dozen or more high-order True Demons respectfully said, “Yes, my lord.”
Boom, boom!!
Brooks and the Horned Demon King’s aura burst forth, their bodies swelling in size, revealing hundreds of meters high Demon King’s True Forms, and rushed into the silver forest enveloped in rolling Dark Demon Air.
But only after a short while, two disheveled figures rushed out of the silver forest.
The true form of Brooks was in tatters, covered with huge wounds, and sharp silver light circulated on these wounds, clashing with the dark laws.
The Horned Demon King was even more severely injured; only half of his body was left, and his Divine Soul was heavily injured and had passed out.
In an instant, more than a dozen Purgatory True Demons were shocked and hurried up, “Lord Brooks, Lord Gulden, are you all right?”
Brooks, covered in wounds, looked somewhat excited and shocked, he roared, “Tabor, you take two demons and guard here, do not allow any living beings to approach the forbidden area.”
“The rest of the demons and I will immediately rush back to report the situation here to Emperor Diorus.”
“Yes.” The rest of the True Demons were all shocked.
Clearly, the treasure inside that forbidden area was more valuable than they had imagined, maybe even more than just Pseudo-World Level, and it warranted an audience with the Demon God.
Supporting the unconscious Gulden, Brooks burst out with Dark Demon Air and whisked away his nine underlings towards the direction of the Purgatory Empire at high speed.
Several hours later, the rolling Dark Demon Clouds returned to the Purgatory Empire and then continued flying towards the Demon Domain a million kilometers away.
When Brooks entered the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, he used the empire’s demon network to send a message for an important matter and requested an audience with Emperor Diorus.
“This Intelligence Chief wants to see His Majesty again.”
In the newly-rebuilt Demon Domain, a woman with purple hair, donning a red splendid battle armor and with a voluptuous figure, lazily leaned on the throne, gazing at the black mark that appeared in front of her, pondering slightly.
After a moment of thought, Tarolia stood up and turned to walk towards the back of the Demon Palace.
Passing through fortresses of the stern Dark Demon Palaces, Tarolia arrived at the core of the depths of the Demon Domain, in front of a vortex that seemed to Devour worlds.
“Your Majesty, just now, the charge of the Intelligence Department, Demon King Brooks, has sent a request to meet.”
The dark vortex vibrated slightly, and Emperor Diorus’s deep and icy voice came through, “Haven’t I said, unless it’s the appointed time, let no demon disturb me?”
Due to the previous battle in the forbidden area, to avoid being targeted by that terrifying Giant Beast, Emperor Diorus, while incessantly burning his Origin, sustained no light injuries.
Furthermore, following his recent failed incursion into Blue Star, with the expenditure of slicing two strands of his Soul Source, his injuries had become even heavier.
So, after confirming the plan orchestrated jointly by the Eight Great Empires, he returned to the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire’s Demon Domain for Closed-door Cultivation, planning to recover somewhat before the war started.
Tarolia respectfully said, “Your Majesty, I dare not disturb you over ordinary matters, but this time, the Intelligence Chief says he has made a significant discovery that concerns Your Majesty.”
“Concerns me?” The dark vortex vibrated subtly.
After a pause, the voice of Emperor Diorus came from the depths of the vortex, “Where is Brooks now?”
“He has just returned from outside the empire, and is currently on his way to Kude Great City to use the Void Demon Eye Array for transport, and is expected to arrive in half an hour.”
“When he arrives, bring him here to see me.”
Tarolia respectfully said, “Yes, Your Majesty.”
Outside the Demon Domain, the Firmament enshrouded by dark red Demon Clouds suddenly rolled violently, forming a huge vortex that spun and revealed the huge blood-red eyes that slowly opened behind it.
Boom!
From within the blood-red eyes, a few vague figures traversed the Void, and then a red column of light burst forth from Heaven and Earth, thundering down onto the altar on Earth.
The altar, engraved with countless demon patterns and resembling a giant eye, saw the appearance of Brooks, the severely injured Horned Demon King, and nine high-order True Demons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1612 - 1612 603 Time Silver Wings Bloodline
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1612: Chapter 603: Time Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_4 Chapter 1612: Chapter 603: Time Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_4 Surrounding the altar, the Purgatory True Demon guarding the Void Demon Eye Transmission Array spoke respectfully, “Greetings, Lord Brooks, the Prince has ordered that I escort you into the Demon Domain.”
Brooks nodded with an indifferent expression, “Lead the way.”
Soon, under the guidance of the Purgatory military, Brooks and the other demons crossed the Demon Domain Enchantment and arrived within the Purgatory Empire’s Imperial City.
The vast Demon Domain was filled with majestic and dignified buildings, with countless Purgatory True Demons of noble bearings walking and shuttling about, and occasionally the silhouette of a giant Demonized Beast could be seen.
But before those True Demons who entered the Demon Domain for the first time could take the time to curiously look around, a line of True Demons rode a hundred-meter-long four-winged black dragon that soared into the sky, heading for the Demon God Palace several hundred kilometers away.
Because Emperor Diorus had given the order, Brooks and his companions had an unimpeded journey and soon met Tarolia within the towering Demon Palace.
Looking at the supremely beautiful ‘woman’ standing atop the High Platform, Brooks said respectfully, “Intelligence Department Chief, Brooks has seen the Prince.”
Facing the Great Demon King whose strength was nearly at its ultimate realm, Brooks did not dare to show the slightest neglect.
Aside from Gulden, who was heavily injured and unconscious, the other high-order True Demons were even more tense, kneeling on the ground and not daring to look directly at the imperial might of the Prince of the Empire.
Tarolia glanced at the disordered aura of Brooks below and the heavily damaged True Form of the Demon King, her eyes calm, “His Majesty has already permitted your audience, follow me.”
Saying so, Tarolia, with an indifferent expression, turned and walked towards the back of the Demon Palace.
If it were before, a mere Demon King at the Early Myth level wouldn’t even have the qualifications to see her, let alone have her personally lead the way.
But with the succcessive large-scale battles, the vast empire had a severe talent drain.
The number of Great Demon Kings and Demon Kings currently only accounted for one-fifth of what it used to be, and most of the remaining Demon Kings were also injured and needed to undergo Closed-door Cultivation to recover.
Thus, a short man was forced to stand tall, and these two Demon Kings who had just broken through to the Legendary Realm were entrusted with heavy responsibilities, taking charge of the Intelligence Department.
However, these two Demon Kings seemed to be quite effective in their duties, as it had been less than a Sun Wheel’s time, and from their looks, they appeared to have discovered something significant.
All the True Demons behind Tarolia were nervous, and even Brooks felt somewhat somber, sensing a strong sense of danger while passing through those Demon Palaces.
It seemed that if they revealed the slightest flaw, they would be annihilated by a terrifying force in an instant.
Indeed, this was the abode where Demon Gods dwelled, Brooks’s expression turned solemn, his eyes filled with respect.
Soon, a huge Dark Vortex appeared before all the True Demons, and without waiting for Tarolia to report, a terrifying Will suddenly descended.
Boom! Under the fearsome might of the Demon God, all the high-order True Demons’ figures sank, their bodies going limp and collapsing to the ground, their faces full of fear and reverence.
Brooks knelt on one knee, saying respectfully, “Greetings to the great Emperor Diorus.”
The terrifying Demon God’s Will circled in the Void, shaking the atmosphere, with the authoritative and low voice of Emperor Diorus coming through, “Brooks, what happened to your injuries, and to Gulden?”
Brooks’s expression became somewhat excited, “Your Majesty, a natural treasure containing Time Power, an innate treasure, has emerged in the Silver Tree Forbidden Zone to the south of the empire.”
In an instant, the Dark Vortex shook, and an even more terrifying presssure of the Demon God’s might erupted, with Emperor Diorus’s low and cautious voice resounding, “Confirm, it contains Time Power, this treasure?”
With the great battle imminent and the previous ambush of Blue Star in mind, Emperor Diorus was filled with caution towards the cunning and treacherous Human Race.
Therefore, his first reaction upon hearing about the treasure of time was wariness.
Tarolia, standing beside him, also had a flickering gaze, somewhat surprised. A natural treasure from a forbidden zone, at the very least, would be a Pseudo-World Level Weapon.
And a natural treasure of time was even more precious, not inferior to a World-class weapon.
If Emperor Diorus, who possessed Time Divine Power, were to acquire this treasure, his strength would surge by dozens of times, comparable to lords of empires like Belvetan.
Brooks grew more excited, “Your Majesty, I am one hundred percent certain.”
Within the depths of the Dark Vortex, surrounded by the rich Aura of Heaven and Earth’s Origin, the towering figure of Emperor Diorus sat cross-legged, his expression cold and calm.
‘Looking’ at the Vortex World outside where Brooks knelt respectfully, and at Gulden, lying on the ground with sharp Space Power still lingering on him, behind him eight arms simultaneously formed a strange seal.
In an instant, strands of transparent Temporal Power emerged around him, merging into the Void, sensing something in the great beyond.
After a long while, Emperor Diorus finally spoke slowly, “Brooks, recount all the information about the innate treasure you found in that forbidden zone.”
Even though he had just spent time using his Bloodline Power without sensing any danger, acting on a whim, Emperor Diorus remained extremely cautious.
After all, a time-related treasure suddenly appearing at this critical juncture seemed too coincidental, didn’t it?
And although beings at the level of Demon Gods were ‘Undying and Unyielding,’ that only meant they were free from calamities and disasters; they could still be slain and fall if faced with terrifyingly powerful enemies.
“Your Majesty,” responded Brooks, “about two Star Hours (two days) ago, a Silver Brilliance suddenly flashed in the forbidden area to the south of the empire, catching the attention of the Boundary Intelligence Subdivision.”
“Mortapol, who was in charge of the subdivision, went to investigate immediately, but the forbidden area was dangerous, and his strength was not enough to approach.”
“However, using his awakened bloodline power, from the phenomenon of a light pillar piercing through the forbidden zone and lighting up Heaven and Earth, he sensed the strong fluctuations of an innate treasure…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1613 - 1613 603 Time Silver Wings Bloodline
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1613: Chapter 603: Time Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_5 Chapter 1613: Chapter 603: Time Silver Wings, Bloodline Retrospection_5 Brooks reported that when the anomaly in the forbidden area Burst more than a day ago, he and the Horned Demon King rushed over to investigate all the heavy injuries mentioned.
Finally, Brooks excitedly said, “That forbidden area is very dangerous, even with heavy injuries preventing me and Gulden from approaching the core area, we could only catch a vague glimpse of where the treasure is located.”
“Your Majesty, this is what that treasure looks like.”
As he spoke, the power of Dark Laws flowed around Brooks, projecting an Illusory Projection in the air.
The image startlingly displayed a world filled with endless White Light, the center featured a vortex distorting Space-Time, and deep within the vortex, silver wings spanning kilometers unfolded, with Space-Time distorting around it.
However, due to Brooks’ limited strength, he could only project a blurry image of the Time Wings, along with rings of silver light waves emitted.
“Your Majesty, although the two demons can’t approach, Gulden, relying on his heavy injuries, managed to capture a strand of Time Power emitted by the treasure. This is also the reason why we are certain that the treasure is related to Time.”
While speaking, an excited Brooks took out a crystal over 3 meters long from his Storage Space, which was a black transparent crystal sealing a strand of pure White Light.
Bang! The Void trembled, and a dark vortex emitted a shocking suction force enveloping the black transparent crystal, disappearing into the depths of the vortex.
In the Vortex World, Diorus’s gaze instantly fell on the floating black transparent crystal, sensing the extremely pure Power of Time within, and a rare excitement showed in his eyes.
Could it be true?
Boom!
With a slight application of force from Diorus’s fingers, the crystal, condensed from Brooks’ thirty percent of Law Power origin, shattered, revealing a small snake-like White Light.
Immediately, the strand of White Light released a pure and incomparable aura of Time, distorting the surrounding Void, foggy as if it were about to disappear the next moment.
“Such pure Power of Time.” Diorus spoke excitedly, his figure suddenly straightening up, his belief in Brooks’ message solidifying by fifty percent.
But then…
Bang, bang, bang!!
Without warning, the bodies of the nine high-order True Demons suddenly exploded, turning into a mist of blood that rolled under a terrible Will, rushing into the dark vortex.
The sudden change startled Brooks.
He had brought these Purgatory True Demon subordinates merely to serve as ‘witnesses’ for this plan, to increase trust when Diorus questioned or sensed.
But he hadn’t anticipated being directly annihilated by Diorus.
Indeed, each of these Purgatory Demon Gods was sinister and ferocious, without a shred of ‘humanity’.
Deep within the dark vortex, strands of dark red blood mist traveled at the fingertips of Diorus, under the power of their bloodlines, extracting all information seen and observed by those high-order True Demons.
As the Imperial Demon God of this empire, Diorus’ Rule Power was almost merged into all Dark Demon Air, the bloodline ‘origin’ of all Purgatory True Demons.
Thus, within the entire empire, not a single Purgatory True Demon could defy his Will, including those demon kings, Great Demon Kings.
However, Brooks and other demon kings were relatively valuable and capable, so the cautious Diorus only extracted the bloodlines of those high-order True Demons.
After reviewing all the blood memories of the True Demons, Diorus’s face revealed a faint smile.
Because Brooks had not lied.
At the same time, through the ‘eyes’ of those True Demons, it was as if he were present on the scene, seeing that earth-shattering silver light column, and sensing no danger in the evolution of time.
It seems destiny was in his favor, on the verge of a great war bursting forth, a Time Treasure emerged at the edges of his empire.
After a long while, Diorus suppressed the stirring emotions in his heart, his massive figure slowly stood up, and the entire Vortex World shook.
Soon the entire Demon Domain trembled, a giant figure appearing tens of thousands of kilometers above, tearing through the Void at a fearsome speed, flying towards the Silver Tree Forbidden Zone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1614 - 1614 604 You traitors blow up the Demon God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1614: Chapter 604 You traitors, blow up the Demon God Chapter 1614: Chapter 604 You traitors, blow up the Demon God As Diorus set off, on another edge of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, Ancestral Demon God Levides suddenly opened his eyes.
In the Void around Levides, eight dark red Magic Crystals floated, and at this moment, the one representing Diorus was trembling slightly.
As Levides’ eyes opened, Diorus’s voice emanated from within the Magic Crystal.
“Levides, to the south of my empire a disturbance has erupted in the external forbidden area, with the appearance of a Time Power-related Innate Treasure. I am going there to investigate.”
“This coincidental timing of the Innate Treasure’s appearance, although I have confirmed the news to be true, to prevent the unforeseen, I hope you can follow shortly after.”
True Martial Heavenly Kings had ways of communicating across vast distances, and so naturally did these Demon Gods.
However, after transmitting this piece of information, the dark red Magic Crystal representing Diorus dimmed a bit, shadowed by the subsequent gloom.
Based on this dimming, it could at most transmit one-way two more times before its strength would be exhausted.
Though everything seemed without issues, the cautious Diorus still notified Levides.
This was the base of the allied forces of the three major empires, and by informing Levides, it was as good as informing the other Demon Gods, hoping to draw a few over to bolster the ranks.
With the strength of these Demon Gods, crossing over two million kilometers to reach the Silver Forest Forbidden Zone would not take long.
As it entered the relic, Levides and the other Demon Gods would arrive more or less simultaneously. Should any accidents occur, several Demon Gods working together could still make a full retreat.
After all, their already demonized empire’s territory wasn’t far away.
…
Above in the Firmament, dark red Demon Clouds rolled, spreading at a startling speed to the horizon, and soon flew out of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire.
The remaining four hundred thousand kilometers, under the Demon God’s space-distorting speed, were crossed in just an instant, and from afar, they could see the Silver Brilliance that pierced Heaven and Earth.
Separate by tens of thousands of kilometers, Diorus could feel the intense oscillations of Time Power emanating from the halos circling the pillar of light.
Most importantly, the incredibly powerful source of Time Power deep within the Dark Forbidden Zone, like the sun, instantly caused the Demon God bloodline within Diorus to boil.
Rule Level, comparable to a World-class weapon, an Innate World Divine Object.
In that moment, even Diorus couldn’t help but take a sharp breath, his eyes revealing an intense demonic radiance.
Boom!
A heaven-reaching, earth-piercing dark red Demon Pillar descended from above, and under the invisible pressure it exerted, the Tabor guarding here and two high-order Purgatory True Demons were all pressed to the ground.
Within the demonic light, Diorus’s massive silhouette slowly emerged, followed by Brooks who was behind him, and the heavily injured Horned Demon King.
Feeling the terror from their bloodline, Tabor, trembling on the ground, spoke with reverence, “I greet, Your Majesty.”
However, Diorus merely glanced at him indifferently, not uttering a word, his attention all focused on the deeper, stronger Time Power emanating from the forbidden area.
Behind Diorus, Brooks solemnly asked, “Tabor, has there been any abnormal situation here since I left?”
Tabor respectfully said, “My lord, after you left, I and Devyn split into three directions to monitor all surroundings, no abnormalities discovered.”
Hearing this, Brooks nodded, then looked up to Diorus, his loyalty shining through, “Your Majesty, do you need your subordinate to scout the path again?”
Diorus’s gaze flickered, and he slowly shook his head, “No need, a mere mid-level forbidden area is of no concern to me in the Demon God Realm.”
“You have done well this time. Here is your reward.”
Saying so, the space broke in Diorus’s hand, revealing two one-meter sized droplets of pure black blood, emitting terrifying oscillations floating slowly into view.
The Original Blood of the Demon God! Tabor, lying on the ground, and the three high-order True Demons’ eyes widened, revealing intense greed and envy.
The Original Blood of the Demon God, different from demon god’s blood extracted and refined from the blood of countless Giant Beasts and powerful beings, was the actual condensation of the Demon God’s Original bloodline.
In terms of level, it was equivalent to half a Rule Level Divine Object, and to an average Purgatory True Demon, it was even more precious than a typical Rule Level Divine Object.
Even a Great Demon King who obtained it could significantly enhance their bloodline and strengthen their rule’s power after absorbing and refining it. For a Demon King like Brooks in the Early Myth stage, such refinement could directly lead to a breakthrough into the Mid-Mythical Stage.
Most importantly, it would greatly raise the purity of their Purgatory Bloodline, move their True Body closer in essence to Diorus, and possibly awaken Time Power-related bloodline talents.
Immediately, Brooks knelt on one knee, emotionally grateful, “Thank you for your gracious gift, Your Majesty. Your subordinate will serve you with even greater effort, through fire and water.”
Diorus nodded in satisfaction, quite pleased with this Demon King that he had personally promoted.
Although the last venture into Blue Star was unsuccessful, the fault did not lie with Brooks, but with a Giant God Sect Apostle who had already colluded with the Human Race and passed on false information.
And now, with the appearance of the Time Divine Object, from the anomaly’s emergence to Brooks personally delving in to confirm that there were no issues, and immediately rushing back to report, everything had been done cleanly and efficiently.
However, since the Divine Object turned out to be real, the next step was to quickly claim it, otherwise Levides and the others would soon arrive.
Thinking of this, Diorus felt a tinge of regret; knowing this, he should have been less cautious and delayed notifying Levides.
“Stand guard here, I will go retrieve that Innate Treasure.”
“Yes, Your Majesty.”
Boom!
Diorus, like a vast and boundless creature, crossed a thousand kilometers in an instant as space trembled violently, arriving in front of the Silver Forest.

chapters.title: Chapter 1615 - 1615 604 You traitors blow up the Demon God_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1615: Chapter 604 You traitors, blow up the Demon God_2 Chapter 1615: Chapter 604 You traitors, blow up the Demon God_2 With the arrival of Diorus, those trees that were over a thousand meters tall, lush as if cast from silver metal, continuously shattered and collapsed, forming a straight and wide pathway.
Under the powerful dark rules, the space distortion magnetic fields permeating the forest were forcibly suppressed, creating circles of violent shockwaves that swept across thousands of kilometers.
Such a display left distant onlookers like Brooks and other True Demons profoundly shaken.
“No wonder he is the Demon God. Too powerful.”
Amidst his emotions, Brooks swallowed a drop of the Demon God’s Essence Blood that floated before him and then brought another drop to the Horned Demon King, slapping it into its body.
Boom boom!! In an instant, both Brooks and the unconscious Horned Demon King’s aura surged dramatically.
Diorus was about to enter the ambush, and if they didn’t refine the Demon God’s Original Blood, which represented a part of its bloodline power, soon, they would lose their chance when it reacted.
While Brooks swallowed and refined the Demonic God’s Essence Blood, Diorus, radiating boundless Demon Power, entered the Silver Forbidden Zone.
Suddenly the entire forbidden area vibrated under the pervasive Dark Rules that filled heaven and earth, with violent and sharp spatial radiance erupting and destroying everything around it.
But just as Diorus stepped into the Silver Forbidden Zone, not yet near the center ten thousand kilometers away, an incredibly intense sense of crisis welled up in its heart.
Something was wrong, there was a problem!
Boom! The figure of Diorus swelled up, an endless Dark Demon Air burst forth from its body, manifesting a Demon God True Body that towered ten thousand meters high.
“You’ve come, now stay.”
Jack’s indifferent and cold voice resounded from three directions. One from the center of the forbidden area, where dazzling golden-white lightning burst forth like a spider-web in all directions.
The silver wings, which in Diorus’s perception emitted terrifying temporal fluctuations, disappeared, revealing Jack clothed in a black Imperial Robe.
Outside the forbidden area where the Void shattered, a figure with three faces and ten arms, ten thousand meters tall, slowly emerged, with Nine-Layered Heavenly Gates, wrapped in dark gold dragon patterned chains, standing tall behind it.
Furthermore, from another direction at the entrance of the forbidden area, another figure of Jack manifested, slightly weaker, with a true body three thousand meters tall, with three faces and eight arms, and likewise with Nine-Layered Heavenly Gates standing behind.
“Darren!” Diorus roared in shock and fury.
Bang, bang, bang!!
Diorus’s four arms behind its back exploded instantly, turning into a sky full of dark red mist rushing towards the two arms holding the head of a ferocious behemoth and a broken piece of blue mirror.
In the instant of sacrificing four Demon God arms, Diorus’s body surged with endless Dark Flames that soared into the sky, scorched heaven and boiled the sea, forming a massive boundless black lotus.
In the center of the Lotus Stand, time was pervasive, vaguely connecting the past and the future, forming a winding transparent river stretching to both the past and the future.
Boom, boom!! Instantly, two Demon God Level auras, one strong and one weak, descended, and two figures of Diorus from the past and future arrived upon the transparent river of time.
Suddenly, the entire world seemed to shake, and at this moment, time itself became confused, with past and future intertwined, the present distorted.
Facing the intense threat of death, Diorus not only instantly sacrificed four Demon God arms but also directly burned and sacrificed all bloodline power to summon its true bodies from the past and future.
Even if it managed to escape by luck, it would suffer a severe loss of vitality for hundreds of years, and its realm would fall by a small level.
And in the instant that Diorus erupted with all its might, three even more terrifying auras arrived.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The Nine-Layered Heavenly Gates behind the three figures of Jack simultaneously shattered, and from within, dragons imbued with the power of Dark Star Apocalypse roared forth, pouring into Jack’s body.
In an instant, terrifying dark gold radiance lit up the entire night sky, shattering heaven and earth, and the destructive pressure instantly caused the entire forbidden area to burst, collapsing the Void.
Roar, roar, roar!! Screams that were neither human nor beast echoed endlessly between heaven and earth.
The entire world then plunged into extreme darkness, where three golden-white lightning rods, entwined and slowly descending like battle halberds made of pure dark golden radiance, annihilated everything beneath the terrifying might that appeared slow but actually transcended time itself. Only that overbearing strength that could crush the heavens and space-time remained.
Boom!!
With a joint strike at their limits, Jack Clark and his two Avatars obliterated space-time. The entire forbidden area was blown apart, forming a black hole tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter.
Moreover, the force of the strike was incredibly concentrated, not leaking even a trace of energy, so much so that Brooks and others, thousands of kilometers away from the forbidden area, did not feel any destructive tremors.
This scene even instilled fear in the newly awakened Horned Demon King.
The human strong man’s control over strength was too terrifying.
At that moment, from the almost chaotic and void dark hollow, a red crystal-like tree bark over ten meters tall, shaped like a Purgatory Evil Demon, emerged.
It was covered with cracks, then silently shattered into rings of red light waves.
Amidst the destroyed red light waves, the figure of Diorus, who had been blown apart by Jack Clark’s strike, reappeared as if time had reversed, materializing out of nowhere. However, his aura was weak, having fallen back to the ancient early stage.
All this happened in the blink of an eye.
In just an instant of Jack Clark’s gaze, the figure of Diorus vanished into the power of space distortion, leaving behind only a roar of hatred resonating through the Void.
“Darren Callum, I will definitely kill everyone related to you, obliterate everything related to you.”
“And those few traitors, you’re doomed, absolutely doomed.”
In this moment, Diorus was nearly driven to madness. Still, facing Jack Clark, who could nearly instantly annihilate his True Body and obliterate eighty percent of his Divine Soul, he dared not linger for even a moment.
Diorus’s escape caused a slight change in Brooks and the Horned Demon King’s expressions.
Conversely, Jack Clark was in no hurry at all. The three Avatars stood coldly indifferent in three directions of the obliterated forbidden area, “As expected, this guy is hard to kill, actually having a life substitute Divine Object in hand.”
A Divine Object that could spare a Purgatory Demon God from death even once, its level was almost reaching Creation Level, incredibly precious and rare.
Speaking thus, Jack Clark calmly took out a palm-sized transparent crystal from his Storage Space, within which a Demon God Illusion of a Purgatory Demon God was sealed.
It was the very soul essence that came from Diorus, which had once infiltrated the Demon God puppet on Blue Star.
Bang!
Jack Clark crushed the crystal and directly grasped the soul essence in his hand while a silver rune on his forehead emanated brilliant radiance, like a pair of silver light wings.
“Found you,” he said coldly, as the surrounding time distortion faded into silence, appearing immensely mystical.
Normally, although Jack Clark possessed Time-Type Divine Power, he could only absorb and refine the Power of Time to form Clones or use the Power of Time to shield his surroundings from the effects of time.
However, now, with the connection between soul sources, he only needed to pinpoint the location to consume the Power of Time and enter a Time Rift, appearing at the node where Diorus was located.
