While Jack Clark’s true body pursued Diorus across time, his two Time Clones did not follow, instead turning to look in the direction of Purgatory Empire.
The instant Jack Clark boldly struck, obliterating Diorus, seven bursts of Demon God Level Power erupted from a distance.
The terrifying Rule Power shook Heaven and Earth.
Adam Garcetti, the King of Immortal Spirit Wind Heaven, Divine King Tarodel, Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy, and three assisting Demon Gods had clashed.
Boom!
Spaces shattered, and two Avatars of Jack Clark, donning black Imperial Robes and in their Dark Star Apocalypse Emperor Dragon Forms, crossed the vast sky, heading towards the battlefield tens of thousands of kilometers away.
This time, their target wasn’t just the demon king Diorus.

chapters.title: Chapter 1616 - 1616 605 Slaying Diorus A Reunion After Ten
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1616: Chapter 605: Slaying Diorus, A Reunion After Ten Thousand Years Chapter 1616: Chapter 605: Slaying Diorus, A Reunion After Ten Thousand Years The already tainted borders of the empire were winding like mountain ranges that sliced through Heaven and Earth, slowly eroding the forests and rivers with the ever-crawling Dark Demon Air.
From a distance, it resembled a massive, boundless Dark Giant Beast devouring its surroundings.
At that moment, tens of thousands of kilometers above, the Void shook as three figures exuding the oppressive might of Demon Gods descended, sweeping away the demon gas and flying into the distance.
They had barely stepped out of the empire’s borders when their figures suddenly halted.
In their ‘eyes,’ tens of thousands of kilometers away, a Terrifying Power that surpassed Demon God Limit burst forth, its invisible rule fluctuations shaking Heaven and Earth.
Levides’s face paled terribly, “This is bad, Diorus indeed fell into an ambush!”
Among the three Demon Gods, the one with the most Terrifying Aura spoke solemnly, “Diorus has always been cautious and astute, for him to blunder at this time.”
“Let’s go, we must support him now, otherwise it might be too late and that fool might have fallen.”
“I have already notified Bektivi to come and support.”
Despite their fury at Diorus’s foolishness at this critical moment, the three Demon Gods did not hesitate, instantly tearing through space with a Terrifying Speed to rush there.
As the newly risen Lord of the Empire, Diorus’s strength, even among the Purgatory Demon Race’s Demon Gods, was above average, comparable to an Ancient Late Stage.
Plus, his special time bloodline power made him even more difficult to kill.
If he were to fall in an ambush by the Human Race before the major battle, it would be a significant blow to the morale of the entire Purgatory Demon Race, and it would also weaken their high-end combat power.
However, no sooner had the three Demon Gods crossed two hundred thousand kilometers than their figures halted again.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The Firmament collapsed, and four figures emitting Terrifying Auras tore through the Void to descend, appearing around the three Demon Gods in a square formation, enveloping them.
Directly ahead, Adam Garcetti held aloft a black-and-white Yin-Yang Divine Wheel, dividing the entire Heaven and Earth into Yin and Yang realms, standing at the center of the world as if he controlled life and death.
To the left, the incomparably handsome Tarodel sat upon the Divine King’s throne, behind him a vast endless world of golden radiance slowly descending.
On the right, the Ancient Late Stage Tolstoy, with five pairs of Golden Light Wings unfurled behind him, covering the sun and reaching out as if holding the Great Sun in his hand.
To the rear, the aged Immortal Spirit King Wind Heaven, his face bearing a smile and a giant Green Lotus unfolding under his feet, emanated a transcendent and ethereal spirit.
“Despicable Human Race!”
Boom!
Levides had just let out a furious roar when Adam Garcetti already mercilessly made his move, with the shining black-and-white Divine Wheel spanning across Heaven and Earth, tearing the world apart.
The invisible Yin-Yang life-death force that permeated the rules reflected on the skin and scales of the three Demon Gods, emitting a decaying and deathly aura.
“Damned Purgatory Demon Race.” Dive Heaven Immortal King’s gaze was ice-cold, manifesting a six-arm statute that towered tens of thousands of meters behind him, each hand forming a mysterious seal.
Hum!
Beneath Wind Heaven Immortal King’s feet, the light of the Green Lotus surged, spreading a dazzling Green Light across Heaven and Earth, the invisible reflection causing the surrounding Dark Demon Air around the three Demon Gods to continually dissipate.
It was like murky, pitch-black ink gradually becoming clear, and the consequence was a drastic reduction in the aura of the three Demon Gods.
At the same moment, Divine King Tarodel and Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy also struck, their Terrifying Power, nearly reaching the Peak of the Ancient, directly shattered Heaven and Earth.
“Just with you, you think you can kill us? You are thinking too simply.”
As Carotis spoke, a boundless Dark Red Glow erupted from his body. The Unrivaled Domination rule repelled everything, including Wind Heaven Immortal King’s boundless green light.
In the booming collision of rules, a thirty-four-armed Demon God that was over sixty thousand meters tall stood tall, his feet on the Abyss, and in his hand, he held a slash blade emitting a Terrifying Aura.
Under the Heaven-and-Earth shattering blood-colored blade-light, the world smashed apart, creating an interweaving Abyss of black and red light that confronted the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel.
Boom!
Ancient Divine Weapon clashed with a World-class weapon, instantly causing a dazzling light to burst forth, signifying terrifying phenomena of complete world destruction.
But the strength of this Lord of the Empire was too Terrifying; under that Unrivaled Domination blood-colored blade-light, the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel trembled, continuously fracturing and slicing the realm of life and death.
The released Destructive Impact swept across tens of thousands of kilometers of Heaven and Earth, melting the Earth like snow under the scorching sun.
At the moment the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel was suppressed, Adam Garcetti’s hair, previously streaked with black and white, instantly turned all black, and a far stronger aura erupted.
“Life and Death Reversed, Prosperity Reborn.”
Boom! The light of the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel surged, crossing with the blood-colored blade-light hundreds of thousands of times in an instant.
While Adam Garcetti reversed life and death and distracted Carotis, Levides and another Demon God emitting an Ancient Middle Stage aura roared and manifested their true six-headed, ten-armed Demon God Forms.
But under the combined assault of three Divine and Immortal Kings at the Ancient Late Stage and the Peak of the Ancient, the two Demon Gods’ domains instantly collapsed, spewing blood.
Boom! Two black light columns fell from tens of thousands of kilometers above, smashing fiercely onto the ground that had been melted by blood light for hundreds of kilometers.
Within a ten thousand-kilometer radius, the Earth shattered, infinite Dark Red Firelight erupted from deep within the Earth, mixing with the scorching magma and shattered stones, flung tens of thousands of kilometers away.
The moment the original three Demon Gods appeared, the four communicated through their realms of thought, dividing the targets.
Adam Garcetti burned the Origin of Death, bursting forth to hold Carotis, while the stronger Tarodel and others ganged up on the two Ancient Middle Stage Demon Gods.
But reaching the Demon God Level, with more survival techniques and Secret Skills available, killing them proved extremely difficult.
Just as the two Demon Gods were blasted into the Earth, beneath the ground like a supernova explosion, two auras exploded, surging tens of times more powerful into the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1617 - 1617 605 Slaying Diorus A Reunion After Ten
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1617: Chapter 605: Slaying Diorus, A Reunion After Ten Thousand Years_2 Chapter 1617: Chapter 605: Slaying Diorus, A Reunion After Ten Thousand Years_2 Boom!
The Void Annihilated, a towering Demon God Illusion slowly emerged, with ten arms behind it like huge mountain ranges, sweeping across with surging waves of air toward Tolstoy and the other two.
Powerful strength stirred the rules of heaven and earth across tens of thousands of kilometers, shaking space and time.
“You cannot escape today,” standing atop the divine throne, Tarodel completely ignored the towering Demon God Illusion, his brow radiating dazzling light.
Simultaneously, in the golden world behind him, another enormous golden eye slowly opened.
The huge golden eye, icy and devoid of any emotion, stared directly down as the Void shattered layer by layer, forming a dark passage spanning ten thousand kilometers.
At the end of the passage, the figures of two Demon Gods emerged.
Meanwhile, the towering Demon God Illusion also collapsed under a strike from Tolstoy and the Immortal King Wind Heaven, dissipating into swirling Dark Demon Air in all directions.
“I’ll hold them off; you all retreat to the area shrouded in darkness.”
Boom!
Carotis’s roar echoed through heaven and earth, and soon a blood-red sword light swept across, cutting off the space and time between the three and the two Demon Gods with its sharp, unrivaled edge.
But just then, a flood of black and white light poured out, forming the Boundary of Life and Death, connecting heaven and earth.
“Your opponent is me.” At the juncture of Yin and Yang, Adam Garcetti held the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel again to block Carotis.
Boom, boom, boom!
An even more intense battle erupted instantly. Under the combined effort of three more powerful Divine Kings and Immortal Kings, the two real bodies of Levides Demon Gods kept shattering, unable to break through the encirclement even by burning their origin.
And between the two Demon Gods and Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, the distance of two hundred thousand kilometers, which would normally take only a few moments to cross, now seemed like the boundary between life and death.
And just then, two terrifying auras from the direction of the silver forest forbidden zone were rapidly approaching.
There appeared Jack Clark with three faces and eight arms, three faces and ten arms of the Demon God’s true body, wielding a War Halberd, with terrifying golden-white lightning obscuring the Firmament behind him.
Especially the Time Clone from the ancient early-stage realm, even Carotis’s expression slightly changed with the aura it emitted.
The faces of the two Levides Demon Gods revealed utter despair.
Yet the two arriving ‘Jack Clarks’ merely glanced at them before brushing past the battlefield spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, tearing through space towards the empire’s frontier.
There, rolling Dark Demon Air swirled, and several powerful Demon God auras rushed in with astonishing speed.
It was the other Demon Gods rushing to support, crossing the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire horizontally from another boundary, following Carotis’s message.
This is why the ancient powerhouses from powerful civilizations are so difficult to kill.
These strong men inherently have many life-saving methods, and can quickly cross tens to millions of kilometers with the support from peers of the same level, enabling them to leave by just stalling briefly.
Instantly at the imperial frontier, a second Demon God-level battlefield erupted.
The two Time Clones of Jack Clark forcibly clashed with three Demon Gods, one of whom wielded a World-class weapon, the Lord of the Belvetan Empire, Bektivi.
And under the shroud of the Dark Domain, the strength of the three Demon Gods was greatly enhanced.
Yet even so, the ancient realm avatar of Jack Clark was still able to hold his own two-to-one, while another avatar from the late-stage Heavenly King realm blocked another ancient mid-stage Demon God.
At the same time, as the great battle erupted, two Demon Gods stationed at the Grita War Demon Empire border immediately pounced towards the human forbidden zone battlefield.
If this time all human Demon God-level forces had gone there to ambush Diorus, then these two Demon Gods could slaughters the entire rear of the alliance.
…
In the depths of the Time Rift, with time in disarray, behind Diorus, a pair of blood-red energy-based dragon wings formed, separating the intertwined times.
But just upon entering the Time Rift, Diorus’s face reveled shock, suddenly turning back.
There, time shook, releasing endless dark golden light as Jack Clark crossed through time to arrive, most importantly, holding Soul Power in one hand.
“That strand of soul is actually in your hands!” Diorus’s eyes flashed with madness.
The two Demon God puppets that had infiltrated Blue Star, containing two strands of soul source—one annihilated and the other losing connection—had given Diorus a bad premonition earlier.
This was also why he had been so cautious previously.
But a time-class Innate treasure was too precious. If obtained, his survival chances in subsequent battles would be greater, and it would also be of higher value to possibly revived Purgatory ancestors.
Moreover, the location was not far, only about four hundred thousand kilometers from the empire.
This distance he could quickly cross by burning his origin, even if attacked by two or three Demon God-level strong men, he could use the Time Rift to quickly escape.
But unexpectedly, the strength of this human had grown terrifyingly powerful.
And the Time Clone that had been ambushed and exploded in the previous forbidden zone battle, not only recovered but also reformed an even stronger clone.
At this moment, Diorus suddenly felt as though his demise was destined today.
But instantly, Diorus’s face showed a crazed murderous intent; how could it possibly fall here, being a rare Purgatory Demon God who mastered the time bloodline.
“Jack Callum, if you wish us to perish together, I will fulfill your wish.”
Boom!
Blood-colored flames erupted from Diorus’s body, his bloodline and remaining soul source burned, momentarily restoring him to his peak state.
Roar! Amidst the blood light, a roar resembling but not quite a dragon exploded, the strong demon power causing even the calm time nodes to sway.

chapters.title: Chapter 1618 - 1618 605 Slaying Diorus A Reunion After Ten
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1618: Chapter 605: Slaying Diorus, A Reunion After Ten Thousand Years_3 Chapter 1618: Chapter 605: Slaying Diorus, A Reunion After Ten Thousand Years_3 At that moment, time itself suddenly froze, as if a pure, dark golden war halberd pierced through everything in its path, suppressing time with its unmatched power aura.
Boom!
In an instant, Diorus’s true body shattered into pieces, spraying dark red blood like a mountain torrent erupting, dyeing the surrounding space-time a dark red hue.
At this time, before Jack Clark, the powerful demon god, who had once nearly annihilated him with a single palm on the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, couldn’t withstand a single blow.
Boom!
It was not until then that the powerful aftershocks of strength burst forth, shaking space-time, and under the overbearing power rules, the narrow time rift instantly collapsed.
Immediately, intense time tremors formed, sweeping everything in circles of silver tsunamis, instantly obliterating the scattered flesh and blood of the broken Diorus.
Standing in the Time Storm, Jack Clark unfurled a pair of magnificent silver wings behind him, standing unshaken like a reef rock amidst a tsunami.
Jack Clark lowered his head slightly, looking at the strand of dark red radiance he was holding in his hand, his gaze icy, “Was your desperate struggle just now just an illusion?”
Everything just now was an illusion. Knowing he was no match, Diorus didn’t truly intend to fight to the death but sought to leverage Jack Clark’s strength to shatter this time rift.
Currently under the Time Storm, the remnants of Diorus’s true body scattered across different times and nodes.
Even with a strand of soul positioning, Jack Clark could not simultaneously traverse so many points in time to annihilate them all.
After all, both Diorus and Jack Clark were only beings with divine powers or bloodlines involving the power of time, not those life forms that could wander through time at will.
They couldn’t manipulate time or effortlessly traverse its descent; each entry into a time node rift consumed a vast amount.
Although this meant the true body and soul would scatter and be fragmented, reducing Diorus’s power to below the realm of a demon god,
And if those fragmented souls and true body could not be retrieved, its injuries would never heal. But for Diorus, as long as it lived, there was hope.
At this moment, Diorus exhibited a surprising will to survive.
Unfortunately, it encountered Jack Clark.
“Your power is too troublesome, you must die today,” he said in a deep voice, his left half-illusory demon god face slowly opening a blood-colored eye in the forehead.
Boom!
The violent Time Chaos shook, and above Jack Clark, a crimson bloodstain emerged, an endless amount of blood gushing out, staining the entire space-time red.
Under the Supreme Power Rules and the power of Supreme Hell, this space-time gradually calmed.
Standing amid the crossroads of time in Hell, Jack Clark slowly swung the Eight Desolate War Halberd in his hand, its surface intertwined with strands of silvery Power of Time and crimson Power of Hell.
In the moment of his swing, the tip of the Heaven-opening Halberd silently vanished.
At the same time, in a distant point in time, a pitiful scream sounded as a kilometer-long arm disintegrated into ash under the terrifying halberd skill.
With the power of Supreme Hell, Jack Clark could effortlessly traverse any place, world, distance, even past and future.
Coupled with the Power of Time’s Time Reincarnation and Diorus’s soul source positioning, in this moment, its scattered remnants across dozens of time periods were precisely annihilated by Jack Clark.
The barren, lifeless earth shattered, forming a crater hundreds of kilometers in diameter with a kilometer-sized, mountain-like grotesque head standing at the bottom.
Around the edge of the crater, tens of thousands of Bearmen, ten meters tall and humanoid, slowly gathered, looking in shocked amazement at the huge head at the bottom of the pit.
And just then, the Firmament shook, space-time distorted, and a massive dark golden halberd tip descended across space-time, causing the entire world to tremble violently.
The terrifying force shook more than a hundred thousand kilometers, and within this range, hundreds of billions of Bearmen of an alien civilization in a feudal era lay on the ground, frightened and trembling.
“I will not submit.”
A desperate and unwilling roar echoed between Heaven and Earth, and under that cross-temporal strike, Diorus’s last head was submerged.
Immediately, a Destroy Heaven and Earth power burst forth, destroying the entire continental block along with the habitat and breeding grounds of the Bearmen civilization residing in this world.
In the explosion meant to Destroy Heaven and Earth, a dazzling Blood Moon slowly emerged and then crashed resoundingly.
At this moment, this demon god, entangled in karma with Jack Clark, had thoroughly perished.
In the depths of the Time Rift, Jack Clark slowly exhaled, retracting the Eight Desolate War Halberd from the distorted space-time.
At the same time, as Jack’s realm of thought stirred, the shattered gates of heaven behind him appeared, and his entire form visibly shrank, returning to its normal size of ten kilometers.
Immediately his aura plummeted, slightly weakened.
This kind of attack across space-time, even for Jack Clark, had a significant toll.
However, being able to suppress this troublesome demon god, the consumption was inconsequential.
Along with the previously slain Demon Dragon Carthius, all the demon gods of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire had fallen, which normally equaled a conquered nation.
Especially with the demon king of the Purgatory Empire, the Great Demon King, and millions of elite legions all largely lost in the previous great battle.
With Diorus having fallen, what was left was to return home.
Boom!
Using the Time Clone for positioning, Jack Clark’s mind stirred, connecting to the power of Hell Coordinates, and immediately a vast Blood Light flourished behind him, a massive Eye of Hell slowly emerging.
But just as the surrounding space-time twisted and countless world scenes receded, Jack Clark’s silvery eyes suddenly opened in his forehead, looking sharply to one side.
Buzz! In the vision of the Mind’s Eye, the world vanished, and endless streams of light surged past him like a torrent.
Following an inner psychic premonition, Jack Clark’s gaze fixed on one particular point among those streams of light, and instantly the strength within his body vanished terrifyingly fast.
At the same time, that future scenario rapidly enlarged in his eyes until it froze.
In the scene, Heaven and Earth shattered, space-time was broken, and a woman exuding a terrifying aura stood in the Void, confronting a monstrous creature that obscured the sky.
And most importantly, that woman looked somewhat familiar to Jack Clark.
“Sherry Williams!?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1619 - 1619 606 Blood Moon in the Sky Great Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1619: Chapter 606: Blood Moon in the Sky, Great Demon King Descends Chapter 1619: Chapter 606: Blood Moon in the Sky, Great Demon King Descends In the colorful glimmer where time rapidly rewound, Jack Clark’s silver pupil on his forehead shone with a dazzling divine light, illuminating the frozen frame that spied upon the future.
Staring at the figure standing off against Void Creatures, emitting a Terrifying Aura, Jack couldn’t help but reveal a hint of astonishment in his eyes.
Because that woman looked like Sherry Williams.
Yet relative to the youthful girl of merely sixteen or seventeen from before, the woman in the frame was more mature, beautiful, and her figure fuller than in the past.
Cough! What am I thinking about? Jack shook his head; at the same time, the silver pupil on his forehead slowly dimmed and disappeared.
This impromptu urge to peer through the Space-Time Storm into the future had in just an instant consumed one-tenth of the ‘Strength’ within Jack Clark’s body, a consumption that could be called terrifying.
Yet the vision of the future glimpsed was of great importance, it somehow involved an ‘acquaintance’ known in the Lost World.
Although it was just a glimpse of some future scene, not being there in person, one could infer from the corner of that Void Creature, which exceeded a thousand kilometers in size, that the strengths of both sides were greater than that of ancient times.
And that Lost World from before couldn’t have borne beings of such caliber, evidently, years after his departure, unknown how many, Sherry Williams and others joined the mythical world, embarking on the path following ancient legacies.
And with high likelihood, with the help of coordinates on the altar, they had found the Ancient Human Race.
“Unfortunately, this time it was only a vision of the future; it wasn’t possible to establish contact with her or the Ancient Human Race behind her.”
“Otherwise, if they sent one or two True Spirit Level beings to support, or even one Ancient Civilization Emperor’s return, they could Suppress the Purgatory Demon Race with a flip of the hand.”
Amid faint feelings of regret, Jack disappeared into the Time Chaos.
And just as Jack used his Time Clone to position himself, leaping back with the aid of the Supreme Hell Coordinate in that instant, at some moment in the future, the dark-haired woman standing in the Void suddenly looked up.
“Who’s spying?”
Boom!
Terrifying might erupted from Sherry Williams; Infinite Black Flames surged to the heavens becoming a dark Great Sun, emitting the Annihilation Rule’s terrifying high temperatures.
Those Black Flames melted everything, both Heavenly Earth Rules and the fabric of space were annihilated, creating Dark Cracks reaching deep into the space-time and spreading incessantly.
Just as Sherry Williams was about to trace back the omniscient gaze spying upon her through that undefined surveillance, in the depths of the Void, a roar, evil and chaotic, suddenly exploded.
Roar!
In the ferocious roar, dozens of sharp-spiked black tentacles emerged from the Void, shrouded in gray mist, spreading Despair over all Living Beings.
At the center of the Black Great Sun, Sherry, her gaze interrupted, eyes flaming with Black Flames, turned icy: “Seeking death.”
Instantly, a great battle erupted.
…
Above the ruins of the Silver Forest Forbidden Zone, where Jack had blasted a pit tens of thousands of kilometers across with his halberd, space suddenly twisted and folded, forming concentric ripples.
Within the ripples, Jack’s figure emerged from nothingness, finally breaking free from the depths of time.
Due to the timing of the positioning, only a few minutes had passed from Jack diving into the Time Rift to his return.
And at the moment of Jack’s return, the sky collapsed, infinite black and white Radiance exploded in all directions, immersing the entire world.
Simultaneously, a gigantic black and white Divine Wheel descended from the skies, cutting through space and forming a Dark Rift extending for tens of thousands of kilometers between Heaven and Earth.
Boom! As if it was the edge of an Abyss, the ground around the pit shattered, forming a ‘small crater’ tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter.
Under the intense release of Yin-Yang energy, countless rocks and dirt soared into the sky, thrown thousands of kilometers away, with smoke and dust and Raging Winds covering tens of thousands of kilometers.
Above the Firmament tens of thousands of kilometers away, a Demon King wielding a Crimson Blood Slasher stood tall, emanating an extremely ferocious and menacing Aura.
Wherever the Blade Edge went, it annihilated all in its path.
Facing this late-stage ancient being, the Lord of the Empire wielding a World-class weapon, with the might of an Ancient Divine Weapon, Adam Garcetti could only barely resist by reversing the rules of life and death to reach peak battle strength.
Deep in the collapsing space of the pit, Adam Garcetti suppressed the boiling Aura within him. Holding the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel in hand, a hint of hesitation flickered in his eyes.
He was considering whether to use that Inherited item within him.
At that moment, tens of thousands of kilometers away, Jack’s voice came, deep and resonant: “Senior Adam Garcetti, I will handle this Demon King.”
And, as Jack spoke up, a presence which had been instinctively hidden, was exposed; Carotis, the Demon standing above the Firmament tens of thousands of kilometers away, suddenly looked over.
Sensing Jack’s Aura, a smile appeared on Adam Garcetti’s face.
Jack’s true body had returned, and clearly, their first target, Diorus had been felled, once more reducing the combat strength of a Demon God from the Purgatory Demon Race.
“This place is yours now, Jack,” Adam Garcetti bellowed, sweeping up Yin-Yang Divine Light, and rushed towards a distant battlefield.
There, Levides was still early in a fight with two Demon Gods but was shattered by the trio of ‘Persons’ from Tarodel, weakened and almost dissipating, repeatedly trying to escape by burning his Origin but to no avail.
Sensing the rapidly approaching Aura of life and death rules over Yin-Yang from over seventy thousand kilometers away, both Demon Gods’ faces showed complete Despair.
Ignoring Adam Garcetti leaving the battlefield and looking at the Demon approaching from afar, walking on the Void holding a halberd, Carotis’ expression turned serious.
Although Jack, due to significant exertion, had exited the Dark Star Apocalypse Emperor Dragon Form, the oppressive might he now radiated was still heavy and Overbearing, shaking the Fabric of the world.
Amidst the encircling dark red blood light, like an Abyssal Great Demon, Carotis slowly spoke in a chill, low voice: “Human, you are the most exceptionally talented individual I have seen in ten thousand years.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1620 - 1620 606 Blood Moon in the Sky Great Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1620: Chapter 606: Blood Moon in the Sky, Great Demon King Descends_2 Chapter 1620: Chapter 606: Blood Moon in the Sky, Great Demon King Descends_2 Emperor Carotis was certainly no stranger to Jack Clark. On the battlefield of the decisive battle with the Heavenly Feather Clan, this human had slain a Demon God while being at the Great Demon King Realm by using Reverse Defeating.
Even though the realm of that Demon God was only at the ancient early stage, and had only broken through not long before.
But this feat still aroused the killing intent of all Demon Gods including Emperor Carotis.
Had it not been for the Divine King of Light binding them at that time, the lords of the three major empires, including Tyris, would have joined forces long ago to suppress him with the overwhelming might of Thunder.
And now, after not seeing him for more than a day or two, this human had stepped into the Demon God Realm, and the aura he radiated even made it perceive a strong sense of danger.
Seeing that this Demon God hadn’t made the first move, and holding the advantage firmly in hand, an exhausted Jack Clark naturally wasn’t in a hurry and said lightly,
“I never thought that one day, I would hear words of praise coming from the mouth of an opposing Demon God. Should I feel honored right now?”
Emperor Carotis’s gaze was icy, “You should indeed feel honored. However, in this vast world, often times having too much talent can lead to an even quicker death.”
“I hope the next time we meet, you can still be this relaxed.”
The moment the voice dropped, the dark red Abyss World behind Emperor Carotis trembled, and an enormous, boundless black demon claw reached out from the depths of the abyss.
Immediately, an incredibly deep and dark aura filled the area, and with overwhelming superiority, just a whiff of the aura suppressed the Great Dao of this region of Heaven and Earth.
Looking at that huge demon claw covered in black hair, Jack Clark’s pupils shrank slightly, as he sensed a heart-palpitating aura coming from it.
This demon claw originated from the true Supreme Abyss.
Boom!
Jack Clark radiated an extremely dazzling and brilliant light, like a scorching star, and numerous golden-white streaks of lightning burst forth, forming a massive electrical grid that enveloped tens of thousands of kilometers.
Whether it was due to the influence of the ‘Heaven’ tier aura from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, after his breakthrough into the Ancient Realm, the Supreme Rule manifestation that Jack Clark had mastered also took the form of lightning.
Under that dominant and mighty pure strength, space within tens of thousands of kilometers shattered thunderously.
Amidst the destructive dark vortex filled with power Rule, ferocious Spatial Storms, a Black Gold Halberd Skill entwined with golden-white light pierced through time and space.
From afar, it looked like two ancient God Demons, towering and enormous, were clashing, with the War Halberd intersecting with the demon claw in an instant.
At this moment, the whole world seemed to have come to a standstill.
Crackle Crackle!!
Giant fissures appeared on the Black Gold Halberd Skill, while the eclipsing black demon claw also emitted golden-white Radiance.
Boom!
The Halberd Skill shattered, the demon claw exploded, and the destructive power released in an instant was like a star that had expanded tens of thousands of times over, releasing golden-black light that illuminated the entire world.
Under the terrifying explosion, even Jack Clark was blown away.
Amidst the torrential energy flood that wiped out all Living Beings, all Jack Clark heard was the roaring thunder of the explosion, his Rule Domain trembled, and the surrounding golden rhombus halos sparkled.
Using the ferocious impact of this strike, Emperor Carotis instantly shattered the Void, turning into a dark red rainbow light spanning Heaven and Earth, and in an instant, had surged tens of thousands of kilometers away.
With Jack Clark returning, knowing that the tide had turned, Emperor Carotis did not linger for battle.
He directly employed the Purgatory Demon God bloodline Divine Power, burning his Origin, and Summoning from the Supreme Abyss a terrifying demon claw with might reaching half-step True Spirit.
In the instant he shockingly repelled Jack Clark with a single strike, he made a decisive retreat, preparing to enter the Dark Domain and regroup with the other Demon Gods.
Otherwise, if he waited until Levides and the two Demon Gods had fallen, and people like Tarodel came to surround and kill him, even he would be left behind today.
Watching the light that crossed the edge of the battlefield, within the tens of thousands of kilometers diameter Green Lotus light, Levides, who was being suppressed and besieged, suddenly revealed a glimmer of hope in his eyes.
“Emperor Carotis, save me.”
Thousands of kilometers away, another Demon God also revealed hope in its eyes.
“Your Majesty Emperor Carotis, me too.”
“What are you waiting for if you’re not fighting with all your might right now?” Emperor Carotis hesitated only for an instant before roaring angrily, echoing through Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
The slash blade in Emperor Carotis’s hand vibrated, reflecting an entire whole world, and the light of the blade collapsed Heaven and Earth, forming a crimson slash light tens of thousands of kilometers long.
Under the supremely tyrannical slash, the ‘world’ of the Green Lotus immediately wavered, countless blood-red cracks spread in all directions, and resoundingly shattered.
“Kill!” The moment the Green Lotus world was cut open, the two suppressed Demon Gods roared in fury.
Bang Bang!! With their True Demon God Bodies already cracked, half of them completely exploded, and sacrificing their bloodline, burning their True Bodies, their aura greatly surged.
Especially the two special weapons that appeared in their hands, under the power of the blood sacrifice, emitted dazzling blue and White Light, reflecting an Eternal Brilliant Radiance.
Indistinctly, countless ‘Person’ phantoms of Alien Civilizations manifested within tens of thousands of kilometers, fighting, dwelling, proliferating, all conveying a sense of the desolate and desolation.
“Where do you think you’re going?”
“They still have alien Intrinsic Weapons in their hands.”
“Stop them.”
On the divine seat above, the three-eyed young man who had been calm suddenly stood up, his eyes sharp, his figure transforming amidst an explosion of endless golden light into a Gold Alien clad in Golden Scales.
Tarodel, having manifested his Divine King True Body, stretched out his arms, revealing hundreds of golden eyes beneath his forearms.
Puff Puff Puff!!
From those eyes, streaks of golden light shot out, incredibly powerful, and with the intersecting rays, this part of the world was sliced and pierced into countless fragments.
Including the two Demon Gods whose True Bodies had half exploded, their incomplete True Bodies kept shattering under those sharp golden beams, emitting anguished, piercing screams.

chapters.title: Chapter 1621 - 1621 606 Blood Moon in the Sky Great Demon
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1621: Chapter 606: Blood Moon in the Sky, Great Demon King Descends_3 Chapter 1621: Chapter 606: Blood Moon in the Sky, Great Demon King Descends_3 Because those golden rays were still eroding their Divine Souls, even the Demon Gods could not help but let out agonizing screams under the piercing pain to their souls.
At the same time, Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy and Adam Garcetti, who had just arrived, took action immediately.
In an instant, five pairs of heaven-covering golden wings appeared like phantoms, continuously extending and cascading down, enveloping the bursting and crumbling Green Lotus, sealing heaven and earth.
Adam Garcetti directly split into two, transforming into one body with black hair representing Yang, and another with white hair representing Yin. The Aura surged once more in an instant.
In his hands, he carried black and white Divine Wheels, standing above the sky and earth sealed by the golden wings.
Added to this was the Wind Heavenly King, who sprayed a mouthful of Essence Blood on the Green Lotus beneath him. Instantly, the immense world of the Green Lotus blossomed once again, and under the green light, all rules and strength between heaven and earth were suppressed.
Boom!
Just at the moment when heaven and earth were heavily sealed, a ray of White Light appeared, piercing the golden wings and Green Lotus, tearing a small hole, several kilometers in size.
Moreover, this White Light was intertwined with a faint Aura of Time, and in the moment when the black and white Divine Wheels united, it burst forth from the edge.
“No!” Despite the strike from the four peak strong men, the Demon God that had not managed to escape let out a cry of despair.
Boom! The already heavily injured True Demon God Body was immediately blasted into nothingness, and the tenacious and powerful Divine Soul Intent was ripped into countless fragments, constantly being eroded under the terrifying power of four rules.
The cutting golden rays, the spinning Yin-Yang Divine Wheel, the wings that shot out numerous golden feathers, and the Green Lotus that sealed Space-Time ––
This scene caused Levides, who had escaped tens of thousands of kilometers through space and time in an instant, to be chilled to the bone.
These God Kings of the Human Alliance were all mad, clearly having the upper hand, but they had ignited their Origin at the start of battle without regard to consumption, using their Origins to erode the enemy’s Origin as a means to suppress them.
And just as Levides, who was left with only two Demon God heads, broke through the encirclement and flew towards the Dark Domain, tens of thousands of kilometers away under the cover of White Light, a cold voice resounded between heaven and earth.
“It seems you have forgotten me.”
Boom! The expanse of tens of thousands of kilometers in front of him collapsed, and endless darkness descended.
In the world’s center, like a black hole, endless dark golden light flashed, and a terrifying figure appeared as though descending from the past, holding a War Halberd, emitting a profound and immensely powerful Aura.
In this moment, Jack Clark once again entered his Dark Star Apocalypse Emperor Dragon Form, and his dreadful Aura caused Carotis, over fifty thousand kilometers away, to change his expression dramatically.
“Carotis, save me…”
But this time, Carotis did not intervene, decisively turning and transforming into a dark red blood light, rushing towards the empire’s border.
Boom!!
Underneath the dark golden palms composed of light, Space-Time solidified, and the dark domain enveloped by Levides, under the unyielding rule of strength, was directly crushed.
Despair filled Levides’ eyes once again.
And this time, no one could save it.
Boom! The two immensely heavy dark golden palms collapsed the Void, grabbing both of Levides’ Demon God heads.
But this time Jack Clark did not crush its heads immediately; instead, dazzling Dark Golden Radiance poured from his hands, submerging Levides’ heads.
Instantly, a heart-wrenchingly piercing scream echoed through heaven and Earth.
Under the wash and erosion of Supreme Rule power, Levides’ Aura grew weaker and weaker, and the piercing scream made Carotis, who had already reached the empire’s border, incredibly enraged.
“`
“Get lost,” Carotis bellowed as the demon blade in his hand blazed with light, casting a crimson sword glow that split the heaven and earth before him, forming a black crack spanning over ten thousand kilometers.
The target was startlingly Jack Clark’s Time Clone in his Heavenly King state.
“Human, you still refuse to die.”
Enshrouded in boundless darkness, the Demon God who battled with the Time Clone roared furiously and hurled the black mountain he shouldered into the fray.
Boom!
The earth trembled as the titanic black mountain, tens of thousands of feet high, caused a massive collapse of the space beneath it, layer upon layer, echoing with the bone-chilling momentum of a black destructive tsunami.
Caught in the pincer attack and also in the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, the three-faced and eight-armed ‘Jack Clark’ looked cold and indifferent, his War Halberd suddenly sweeping across all directions.
In an instant, a ring-shaped Sky Curtain formed between heaven and earth, swelling with golden flames and purple lightning, containing the edge that could tear apart space-time, expanding continuously.
Boom!
Just as the Sky Curtain made contact with the overbearing, sharp crimson sword glow, it exploded thunderously, sending rings upon rings of violently raging golden fiery radiance sweeping across heaven and earth.
Under the devastating aftermath of ‘Jack Clark’s’ explosive power imbued with crushing properties, the black mountain was shattered instantly.
Even the ancient peak-powered, blood-red sharp sword gleam was progressively weakened until, by the time it landed on ‘Jack Clark,’ only a tenth of its strength remained.
Crack! The space in front of ‘Jack Clark’ quivered, emitting a splendid diamond-shaped golden halo, continuously vibrating.
Top-tier Divine Power: Absolute Defense.
However, this incarnation of Jack Clark was only a Time Clone at the Heavenly King level, its Defense and strength reaching the pinnacle in every aspect, but still fell short against the Lord of the Empire wielding a World-class weapon.
Puff!
With the swish of a Bloodstain, ‘Jack Clark’s’ True Body was slashed with a colossal wound three thousand kilometers long, nearly cleaving him in half diagonally.
The wounded ‘Jack Clark’ glanced impassively at Carotis, the space-time around him distorting as he vanished into the horizon with a speed beyond description in a streak of light.
At the same time, the Ancient Time Clone dueling two Demon Gods single-handedly struck a blow with its halberd to repel the foes before vanishing into the fabric of time itself.
This sudden turn of events caused the four Demon Gods to halt abruptly, their gazes shooting towards the distant horizon.
There, over a hundred thousand kilometers away, the two ‘Jack Clark’ clones appeared on either side of Jack Clark’s True Body.
The three-faced and ten-armed Jack Clark held a War Halberd with one hand, his seven other arms each wielding a variety of war weapons, and the remaining two hands each gripping the head of Levides.
Behind him, the Golden Divine Wheel slowly revolved, its emanating golden-white light illuminating and dominating the entire night sky with an aura of unparalleled majesty and terror.
Boom!
At that moment, right behind the three ‘Jack Clarks,’ an immense, dazzling Blood Moon slowly emerged, its tremendous aura of Rules descending slowly, the very Demon God suppressed by Adam Garcetti and the others finally obliterated.
This scene brought a grave focus to the eyes of Carotis and the four Demon Gods.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1622 - 1622 607 Smelting Time the Dyed Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1622: Chapter 607: Smelting Time, the Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon Chapter 1622: Chapter 607: Smelting Time, the Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon “This alliance has already posed a significant threat to our clan,”
In the sky darkened by the Dark Demon Air, four Demon Gods, including Carotis, stood tall, their gaze cold as they watched Jack Clark and the others disappear tens of thousands of kilometers away.
As for intercepting them, none of the Demon Gods entertained the thought, as they simply couldn’t stop them.
With Jack Clark’s two Time Clones, the number of strong members in the Human Alliance reached seven, and even the weakest among them was at the ancient late stage.
The vast disparity in power meant they couldn’t even hinder them a bit.
Particularly, Darren Callum of the Human Race, under the effects of Time Divine Power, could ignite his Origin and Burst forth enough strength to contend against all four Demon Gods alone.
The voice of the Lord of the Empire, Demon God Bektivi, was chilling as he said, “The growth rate of this human is terrifying. In the upcoming great battle, we must find a way to surround and annihilate him, otherwise…”
Immediately, the other three Demon Gods, including Carotis, all slowly nodded their heads.
With Jack Clark’s terrifying growth rate and his ability to transcend realms in battle, given two or three more Sun Wheels, even the revival of Purgatory ancestors might not be able to Suppress him.
Especially his Time Divine Power; once, when slaughtering the Extreme Realm Great Demon King Hamdanman in the Eternal Divine Domain, nine Avatars had appeared at once.
At that time, though, those clones’ strength was only at the level of Great Demon Kings, so Carotis and the others did not take them seriously.
But now… The thought of Jack Clark possibly consolidating nine Avatars with the same combat strength as his main body sent shivers down even the spines of Lords like Carotis.
That scenario was far too terrifying.
However, fortunately, Darren Callum’s Time Divine Power should be greatly limited. As his cultivation increased, so too did the difficulty of condensing corresponding Time Clones.
Otherwise, had he possessed nine great Avatars at this time, he would be capable of pushing over all the Demon Gods alone.
Boom!
While Carotis and the other three Demon Gods stood solemnly, a terrifying presence descended tens of thousands of kilometers away, shaking the Dark Demon Air.
Tyris slightly looked down at the four demons of Carotis, his True Demon God Body casting huge shadows under the moonlight.
“Carotis, where are those humans?”
Carotis’ tone was flat, his voice deep as he said, “They have already left.” As he spoke, the Demon Blade emitting a terrifying blood light in his hand slowly vanished as he put it away.
Tyris’s gaze grew colder, his voice booming like thunder, shaking Heaven and Earth, “Why didn’t you hold them back? I stirred the Dark Rules just to signal for you to wait for my arrival.”
Behind him, with a pair of huge black Bat Wings, Bektivi cloaked in black Ferocious War Armor slightly shook his head.
“It’s not that we didn’t want to make a move, but the Human Experts who came this time were too strong, we couldn’t stop them.”
“Right before you all arrived, in less than half an hour of combat, Diorus, Levides, and Hadicasa successively fell.”
“Three Demon Gods fallen, does the enemy have True Spirit Ancestor Tier beings!?” Even Carthius, who had surveyed the battlefield upon his arrival, suddenly turned his attention.
Including the fallen demons like Diorus, there were altogether seven Demon Gods on the scene, each at least at the Ancient Middle Stage or above.
In such a scenario, to Suppress them and swiftly slay three Demon Gods, the enemy must have deployed more than twice their number of Demon Gods or True Spirit Horrific Lives.
Carotis gave a wry smile: “There were no True Spirit Tier beings, and overall, the enemy had fewer in number than us.
“Are you sure you’re not joking?” Tyris’s eyes burst with a terrifying Radiance.
“This battle today was a carefully designed ambush by the humans.”
Bektivi’s voice was low: “Initially, the Human Race released news of an Innate treasure related to Time, informed to Diorus by a traitor within the empire.”
“For Diorus, who possessed Time-related bloodline strength, such an Innate treasure was extremely important and could greatly enhance his strength.”
“However, Diorus must have felt something odd at that moment, as before setting off, he informed Levides and asked Carotis to follow and provide support…”
Following this, Bektivi detailed the events of the great battle.
The plan was actually very simple, a classic tactic of encircling to relieve allies, but the outcome was incredibly unbelievable to all the Demon Gods.
Had Diorus waited a bit longer for Levides and others to arrive and for the four Demon Gods to enter the Silver Forest Forbidden Zone together, they wouldn’t have ended up picked off one by one by the Human Experts.
Then, whether it was joining forces to break through or waiting for Bektivi and the others to arrive, the outcome would not have been death.
Six Demon Gods stood amidst the Dark Demon Air, fell silent for a moment, then Carotis spoke again, his expression exceedingly serious: “Tyris, I suggest we launch the great battle as soon as the mighty army arrives.”
“There’s nothing much to prepare. We can’t give Darren Callum any more time. This human’s talent has become terrifying beyond imagination.”
“Although he has only recently made a breakthrough to the ancient early stage, with those two Time Clones, even you, Tyris, who has almost stepped beyond that realm, cannot Suppress him.”
Jack Clark, with his main body and the Time Clones showing the power near the very limit of Half-Step True Spirit.
That level of strength was now comparable to the Great Demon God Tyris.
Before the fusion of his two True Bodies, his current strength as a single True Body was also at the Half-Step True Spirit, Demon God level; only by combining the Divine and Abyss True Bodies could he break the Boundary.
The Great Demon God Carthius slowly nodded. “This human indeed must die, and it has become an urgent priority.”
“When the great battle starts, Carotis, you suppress those Human Alliance Experts. Tyris and I will join forces and Suppress him immediately.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1623 - 1623 607 Melting Time Dyed Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1623: Chapter 607 Melting Time, Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_2 Chapter 1623: Chapter 607 Melting Time, Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_2 Tyris nodded slightly, his expression solemn.
Initially, when he tested the state of the Purgatory ancestor and used one ancestor’s Origin to delay its revival, he had sensed Darren Callum’s strength was comparable to the Ancient Limit but did not care at that moment.
After all, the gap between the Ancient Limit and the merging of dual True Bodies, barely stepping into the True Spirit Level, was insurmountable.
However, he hadn’t expected this human’s Divine Power of time to already be able to condense an Avatar comparable to the Ancient Limit, much stronger than the ordinary True Demon God Bodies that had appeared on the battlefield before.
If they continued to delay, and that human managed to condense another such Avatar…
Thinking of this, Tyris’s voice grew somber, “We must now discuss in detail how to utterly eliminate this human.”
As they neared the True Spirit Level, even if two slightly stronger Demon Gods of the same realm attacked together, defeating and heavily injuring him would be simple, but killing him would be difficult.
This could be seen from the human race’s four Ancient Late-Stage, even Peak Powerhouses, attacking two Ancient Middle-Stage Demon Gods.
If it weren’t for Jack Clark joining in with support from Levides and Carotis, they would have used their intrinsic weapons and True Bodies to escape amidst massive self-destruction.
Over thousands of years of conquest, the territory of the True Demons of Purgatory had expanded from nothing to over a hundred million kilometers, annihilating many civilizations, similar to the Divine Gods Alliance.
Collecting many demonized weapons of civilization, which could serve as one-time uses of terrifying power.
Thus, to absolutely kill Darren Callum without letting him escape, even if two Great Demon Kings joined hands, they would still need careful planning to restrict his various abilities.
At this moment, Carotis thought of something and looked towards Carthius, “Remember, among those who ambushed us, there was an Immortal King of the Immortal Spirit Clan.”
“The ones who escaped?”
Carthius slowly nodded, “It seems that the part of the Immortal Spirit Clan that vanished joined the Human Alliance just like the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
Tyris turned his head to ask, “How many have disappeared?”
Carthius pondered, “Three Kings of Immortal Spirit, most of the elite main fighting force. At the time, I thought they had given up their tribal lands to delve into the Vast World.”
“Unexpectedly, they joined the Human Alliance. This human civilization is indeed different from the different races we’ve encountered before.”
Hundreds of years of war between the two civilizations, both had a count of Mythical-level warriors and above, a loss or gain of even one would raise alarm.
And from the previous war of annihilation, so many Immortal Monarchs and Immortal Kings disappearing immediately caught the attention of Carthius and other Demon Gods.
But it wasn’t until the old Immortal Emperor fell that this missing force did not appear, so Carthius and other Demon Gods had not minded it since then.
Immediately, Carotis’s expression became grave again, “Including the three Kings of Immortal Spirit Clan, the Human Alliance now likely has eleven Demon God Level Powerhouses.”
The atmosphere went slightly silent.
“…Do not worry, we still hold the advantage.”
Tyris spoke lowly, “Without the threat of the Summoned Giant Beast, as long as Carthius and I swiftly kill Darren Clark, the humans will still face annihilation.”
The forces that came to support included seven Demon God Powerhouses from the Dark Demon Empire of Demon King Dark Sky, eight from the Three Major Empires of Saint Demon Anke.
Together with those who survived the last great battle—Diorus, Rudeus, the Ancestral Demon God Levides, and Constantin—there were nineteen Demon Gods.
Whereas the original nine Demon God Level Powerhouses of the Human Alliance, including Jack Clark, were completely outnumbered, enabling a two-to-one advantage.
Not to mention, their side’s Demon God Level Powerhouses mostly surpassed those of the opponent.
Two Great Demon Kings, four equivalent to the Emperor Dragon at the Peak of the Ancient, and several like Diorus who had reached the Ancient Late Stage of powerful Demon Gods.
However, unexpectedly, the humans struck first.
Within the few Star Hours (days) after his departure, they daringly launched an attack, killing three Demon Gods and further reducing the disparity between the high-end warriors of both sides.
In fact, had Diorus been more cautious and not stepped out of the empire’s boundaries, standing firm in the Dark Demon Realm with Carotis, Jack Clark’s side wouldn’t have succeeded at all.
“Fool.” Thinking of this, even Tyris couldn’t help but curse.
“Let’s go, we will soon raise a dark tide that will submerge everything.”
However, launching a death battle against a slightly weaker civilization alliance wasn’t just about talking; it required many preparations.
Like gathering all the Demon God’s powers, dragging the Dark Demon Realm that covered billions of kilometers to move, and drowning Heaven and Earth.
For all demonized creatures, enveloped in the dark demon gas extending from the power of the Purgatory ancestors, strength, recovery, and endurance would all improve by a level.
This included these Demon God Level Powerhouses.
At the same time, the dark demon gas would contaminate and erode the Heavenly Energy, suppressing all rules and laws except those of the dark attribute.
As this wore on, the advantage for the Purgatory Demon Race would continually widen with the duration of the large-scale battle, finally completely overwhelming the enemy.
And just as the six Demon Gods prepared to leave, Tyris and the other Demon Gods suddenly turned to look towards the direction of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire, where an unfamiliar aura of a Demon God surfaced suddenly.
In the heart of the Demon Realm over a million kilometers away, seated high on the throne and guarding the Demon Realm, Tarolia, with her purple hair wildly dancing behind her, was amassing a terrifying power within her body.
Feeling the threads of broken rules being pulled between heaven and earth, Tarolia looked beyond the Demon Realm, a faint smile appearing on her face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1624 - 1624 607 Melting Time The Dyed Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1624: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_3 Chapter 1624: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_3 Because the Demon God indeed perished.
Although Brooks’s performance was perfect earlier, showing not a single flaw, Tarolia, as a woman, could not shake the feeling that something was amiss.
Despite sensing something unusual, Tarolia did not speak up.
As long as Diorus existed for even a day, it would not dare to make a breakthrough, or to be more precise, under the rule suppression of the same empire bloodline origin, it, which had reached its limit, was unable to break through.
Because this recently established Purgatory Empire could only bear the rule of one Demon God of the same bloodline.
Just like the entire Purgatory Demon Race, which could only bear one Purgatory Ancestor.
Boom!
The aura of Tarolia that transcended the shackles of a demon king burst forth completely, and in an instant, the Dark Demon Air of the Mokaya Dark Demon Empire tumbled and roared.
The air between heaven and earth merged with the Dark Demon Air, and following Diorus’s fall, the fragmented rule forces swarmed in, transforming into strands of Dark Red Glow descending from the sky.
Suddenly, a strange rule pressure suffused heaven and earth, and the numerous Purgatory Demons below, originally panicked by the fall of Diorus, were now stirred up, looking towards the direction of the Demon Domain.
“Another Demon God has been born in the empire.”
“Our empire has not been destroyed, not destroyed…”
…
The forbidden area battlefield, where the entrance’s mountain ranges stretched tens of thousands of kilometers on both sides, the mountain ridges peppered with simple bases of the Human Race and Heavenly Feather Clan, and fire points.
Above these bases, tens of thousands of kilometers in the sky, the Primordial True King of the Human Race, the Light Wing Divine King of the Heavenly Feather Clan, and the Immortal King of the Immortal Spirit Clan stood towering, their majestic rule aura filling up the space between heaven and earth.
Far away, tens of thousands of kilometers out, lingered the pressure of two Demon God Level Powerhouses.
Feeling the presence of several Divine Kings remaining from the Human Race, the two Demon God Powerhouses swayed intimidatingly but then prudently chose to retreat.
To avoid being sandwiched by the returning Human Race powerhouses from both sides.
Those Human Race cultivators busy establishing bases below were unaware of the changes above, operating various huge machines to transport mountain rocks.
Half an hour later, suddenly, five majestic auras permeated the horizon, instantly altering the celestial phenomena, an endless golden light illuminating the world.
“They are back.”
Feeling those familiar auras, the faces of the Primordial True King and others could not help but smile.
In the eyes of the Primordial True King and others, no matter the outcome of the plan or whether the set goals were achieved, as long as those who ventured out returned safely, it was a victory.
Soon, Jack Clark and his four companions, who had returned to their normal forms, along with Brooks who followed behind, two Demon Kings, appeared on a golden cloud mat.
The Primordial True King smiled and said, “Everyone has worked hard. How was the mission this time?”
“A great victory.”
Adam Garcetti smiled and said, “The ambush was more perfect than we planned. Diorus, wary of other Demon Gods dissipating ‘Time Precious’, entered the forbidden area alone just as we predicted.”
“What exceeded the plan was Jack Clark, I didn’t expect him to condense an even stronger Time Clone.”
“This battle not only slayed Diorus but also seized the opportunity to slay two Demon Gods who came to support, and all of us were barely injured.”
Saying this, the faces of Tolstoy and others beside him revealed astonishment.
They, of course, knew of Jack Clark’s Time Clone; it had been said that he had survived the ultimate strike from seven Demon Gods in a great battle thanks to that Time Clone.
But they had not anticipated that this time, not only did he break through the Ancient Realm, but he also condensed another avatar of equal strength.
Moreover, with the altar that could Summon Giant Beasts at any time, this guy seemed unfathomable, appearing to have more hidden cards than these veteran strong men who had existed for thousands of years.
“Three Demon Gods!” Hearing the news, the Primordial True King, Profound Sky Immortal King, and Light Wing Divine King Segovia were all astonished.
Jack Clark said gravely, “Although we are victorious this time, it’s merely the prelude to the upcoming war. The other side will probably launch a full-scale attack soon.”
Thinking of those two terrifying Great Demon King auras, Adam Garcetti and the others looked slightly solemn.
This time, though they had killed three Demon Gods, they had also exposed a lot, like the existence of the Immortal Spirit Clan and the high-ranking undercover infiltration of Brooks into the enemy’s ranks.
“There’s been significant expenditure this time; everyone should return and focus on recuperating as soon as possible.”
Saying this, Adam Garcetti looked at Jack Clark seriously and said, “Especially you, Jack Clark. You’ve consumed too much in successive bursts to slay two Demon Gods.”
“Indeed, there’s no time to waste, let’s go.”
Without further chitchat, they all departed, tearing through space, returning to their respective stations after leaving the Primordial True King and Light Wing Divine King Segovia to Suppress the frontier.
Just as Adam Garcetti had said, the consumption for the five of them was quite substantial during this mission.
Especially Jack Clark, who had withdrawn from his Dark Star Apocalypse Demon Dragon Apocalypse Form due to the consecutive battles after killing Diorus, and because using Hell Coordinates for jumping consumed too much.
Yet, to quickly slay Levides, he had forcibly entered the Apocalypse Form again, and the immense strain had caused considerable damage to his True Demon God Body.
Including the four like Adam Garcetti, they had managed to Suppress two Demon Gods and kill one with great advantage, but not without significant expenditure.
As there was no time to wear them down slowly, they needed a quick resolution, which meant consuming a large amount of Rule Origin to balance out.
Fortunately, the consumption of the Origin was spread amongst the four this time, within an acceptable range for them, and a few days of using some precious resources in Closed-door Cultivation would not affect the upcoming war.
But as Jack Clark and the others withdrew to recover, Adam Garcetti still had matters to attend to.

chapters.title: Chapter 1625 - 1625 607 Melting Time The Dyed Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1625: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_4 Chapter 1625: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_4 In the spacious and simple meeting room, Adam Garcetti looked at the ten-meter-tall, fierce-looking Brooks with a look of satisfaction on his face, “This undercover plan, Brudos performed very well.”
“Because of you, we not only avoided greater losses but also thwarted the Purgatory Empire’s attacks and assassinations multiple times.”
“Given your huge contribution, as the First Councilor of the Federation, I can promise to help you three times for free and additionally give you two forbidden weapons.”
“Moreover, upon your return this time, your status will be directly elevated to a civilization inheritor, granting you Heavenly King-level permissions, which allow you to mobilize all resources within the scope of Heavenly King authority.”
Brooks, or rather, whose real name was Brudos, smiled slightly, “Thank you, Speaker.”
“I would like the Speaker to help me and Gulden cut away the will of the Blood of Demon God inside us, retaining only the strength of the Purgatory True Demon.”
Adam Garcetti paused, looking at Brudos to remind, “Are you sure? Doing so will drastically reduce your strength.”
The power system of the Purgatory Demon Race is based on bloodline, originating from the hibernating Purgatory ancestors, and further divided into various Demon Gods and empires.
Inheriting this power are the will of the bloodlines within all Purgatory True Demon bodies, or the nearly imperceptible Purgatory Rule.
Therefore, cutting off that thread of willpower also means that Brudos and his kin would lose all sorts of bloodline talents and evolutionary directions, leaving only the Purgatory Demon King’s True Form.
“I’m sure,” Brudos nodded.
“I… will follow Brooks’s decision,” the Horned Demon King hesitated for a moment, then chose to affirm.
“Since that is the case, do not resist later.”
Boom! The space around the three shattered, and instantly, they arrived in a world where Heaven and Earth were divided by Yin and Yang.
In this Rule world, the figure of Adam Garcetti was infinitely large, like an Ancient God who reached through Heaven and Earth, his palm dictating life and death, slowly reaching towards the two Demon Kings.
Just as the two Demon Kings did not resist and allowed Adam Garcetti’s power to penetrate deep into their bodies, and even into their souls, a ferocious and authoritative roar echoed through the Void.
Roar!
Endless Dark Demon Air erupted from within the two Demon Kings’ bodies, resonating with some powerful Rule in the universe, transforming into two ferocious Purgatory Evil Demon phantasms.
Yet, within the Rule world manifested by the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel, these two threads of bloodline will had no chance to resist.
They barely hindered before bursting with a puff into nothingness, directly wiped out by the Rule of life and death.
Instantly, Brudos and the Horned Demon King groaned, their full-body scales armor shattered, their flesh and blood torn open, and a fountain of dark red blood spouted out.
Their aura weakened to the extreme.
Originally having absorbed the Demonic God’s Essence Blood, and having reached the Mid-Mythical Stage, he dropped back to the Early Myth, almost falling from the Transcendence Realm.
However, although his aura was weak, sensing the disappearing constraining power of bloodline inside him, Brudos’s face showed a radiant smile.
“Just as I thought, the power that binds the Abyssal Gene comes from the will of the bloodline.”
Speaking energized, Brudos looked at Adam Garcetti, “Speaker, I wish to return to Blue Star for a while to investigate the possibilities of merging the Abyssal Gene and human genes.”
During this time working inside the Purgatory Demon Race, Brudos had not been idle; aside from cultivating to cope with tasks, all his time was spent researching the Purgatory Demon Race.
This was his biggest goal when he originally merged with the Blood of Demon God and joined the Purgatory Demon Race.
He was very curious about the genes and life forms of the Purgatory Demon Race and wanted to know if it was possible to integrate them into humans’ gene sequences, just like the fusion with the Alien Beast Gene.
However, this research halted when it reached the core restructuring of the nucleus, as no matter how Brudos replicated, the cultured Purgatory Demon cells would suddenly collapse under some power’s interference, unable to divide on their own.
Now, without that willpower binding his life genes, he felt that if successful, a fourth path of cultivation might appear in the Human Federation, one of bloodline.
And it would be a Mythical Race Purgatory Bloodline.
Faced with Brudos’s request, Adam Garcetti did not refuse, and soon a sky-based battleship took the two Demon Kings towards the Blue Star pathway.
At that moment, Jack Clark was sitting cross-legged on the Black Divine Mountain of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, staring at the two silver complex seals floating in front of him.
The seal belonging to the Heavenly King Time True Body had a clear red mark in the middle, severing one-third of the structure.
Carotis’s World-level Demon Blade was extremely powerful, and an overbearing slash from it left the Time Clone, only at the strength of the Ancient Middle Stage, with a heavy injury.
However, the injury to the Time Clone was different from Jack’s; it affected the core seal.
And once the seal is damaged and shattered, the Time True Body would also dissipate completely.
“There isn’t much time; the decisive battle might erupt in the next few days, I can only do this,” murmuring softly, Jack reached out and grasped the Heavenly King Seal, crushing it fiercely.
Boom!
The entire Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane shook under the boundless release of the Power of Time, which painted the world in translucent silver, causing a distortion of Space-Time.
But, at that moment, the other Ancient Seal emitted a strong suction force, like a Black Hole vortex, attracting all the permeating Power of Time.
After devouring it, the pervasive Power of Time quickly vanished.
The once somewhat dim Ancient Seal also revived with vitality, emitting rings of silver light, transforming into a ray of silver light that rushed into Jack’s forehead.
Instantly, a strand of Jack’s hair on the forehead turned silver, giving him an inexplicable air of mature and weathered wisdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 1626 - 1626 607 Melting Time The Dyed Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1626: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_5 Chapter 1626: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_5 In this great war, Jack Clark served as the main force, with both his time clones entering the Dark Star Apocalypse Form to fiercely confront three Demon Gods, including a Lord of the Empire.
Although the battle didn’t last long, the consumption was enormous due to the opponent’s endless strength from deep within the Demon Domain.
The ancient avatar had consumed about one-third of its power, while Jack Clark, utilizing the divine power of Time Reincarnation, absorbed the power of time a bit slowly.
In just a few days, he couldn’t recover even one-tenth of what the ancient seal had consumed.
Rather than this, it would be better to shatter the now damaged, power-depleted Heavenly King Seal and extract all the power of time to replenish the ancient seal to prepare for the upcoming great war.
Of course, another reason was that after Jack Clark’s breakthrough to the Ancient Realm, his Time True Body, which had been condensed at the Heavenly King Realm, could no longer keep up.
After all, his next opponents were either the Great Demon Kings or the “True Spirits.”
While Jack Clark and others retreated for closed-door recovery in preparation for the coming battle, the entire forbidden area battlefield also became increasingly busy.
Countless transport fighter aircraft, ships, and Giant Beasts shuttled back and forth, forming a vast fleet to supply bases with materials and ammunition.
In this war, the Human Federation had mobilized nearly all of their military, coupled with dozens of Alien Corps from the Divine Gods Alliance, and over a hundred transcendent militaries from the Heavenly Feather and Immortal Spirit Clans.
All in all, nearly twenty million Transcendent Lives with at least Fourth Layer Heaven strength had gathered.
Besides that, the Human Race worked overtime, furiously producing and retrofitting the stockpiled unmanned War Pattern Mechs, amounting to more than ten million.
The atmosphere of the entire forbidden area battlefield was extremely tense and serious, as if a great war could break out at any moment.
However, the gravity of the situation here did not affect Blue Star.
The national competition had ended, and the top ten from each empire had all gone to the Simon Empire, about to begin the global Martial Arts final showdown.
And Glenn Clark, who had already broken through to the Seventh Layer Heaven, was known by over two billion people around the world as the champion of the Eastern Summer national competition.
Countless people were astounded by Glenn Clark’s youth, his talent no less monstrous than his brother, Jack Clark.
On this day, many royal families and major clans from several countries around the world were covertly inquiring about the Clark family tree, wanting to know whether there were any other relatives.
A monster like Jack or Glenn Clark would be understandable as a one-off, but with both brothers possessing such exaggerated talent, it wasn’t hard to suspect their parents’ genes.
No one knew just how good the genes of Jack Clark’s parents must be, to produce two such prodigies in one family.
But with Jack Clark already shining like the midday sun and Glenn Clark beginning to show his prominence, thoughts of forming marital alliances were out of the question—even those of Heavenly King descent felt they had no standing to propose.
However, if there was no hope with the Clark brothers, there were still their direct relatives.
Even if their genes were a notch below, mating with the descendants of Mythical Kings might still result in offspring who were Innate Awakened Ones, right?
As the undercurrents surged on Blue Star, deep within the sun, Number One had grown to over 8,000 meters in length under abundant energy.
But even at this size, it still seemed as tiny as dust against the sun’s diameter of over a million kilometers.
Yet to lives above the level of mythology, size didn’t necessarily equate to strength.
For example, at this moment, Number One’s aura was incredibly terrifying, and behind it had even condensed a golden Light Sphere with a diameter of one kilometer, continuously radiating light.
As Number One’s strength continued to grow, the flesh and blood extending from its heart had nearly completed the replacement of the original biological tissue, further deepening its revival.
As a result, Number One’s attraction to those Remnant Souls lingering in the Time River became even stronger.
During this time, space-time around Number One twisted occasionally, causing the entire sun to tremble, and terrifying ancient Remnant Souls returned one after another.
Every time these ancient Remnant Souls descended, they were pulled into the Primitive Azure Sky by a force.
In this world, left by someone greater than Freya Louise, her will merged with the entire sky—cold, indifferent, surveying the huge phantom that gathered below.
As more seals stripped from the Remnant Souls accumulated, the property of Eternity converged, and those traces of power instinctively melded together without a soul to guide them.
But since they had no conscious intent, they could not break through this primitive, ancient ‘sky’ and affect Freya Louise.
On the second day of Jack Clark’s closed-door recovery,
the center of the Five-Colored Empire vanished, and space was obliterated, forming a dark, twisting area of tens of thousands of kilometers.
There, a dark gold Light Sphere with a diameter of a hundred thousand kilometers floated like a celestial body, invisibly emitting a terrifyingly heavy aura, distorting the surrounding Space-Time.
Roar!
Suddenly, a pressure roar resounded, causing the souls of all living beings within a million kilometers to tremble instinctively.
Boom!
The dark gold heaven and earth trembled, rapidly shrinking at a visible speed, disappearing to reveal a horrifying Giant Beast that had swelled in body length to more than 19,000 meters.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, devouring the Heaven-Earth Divine Vein condensed by a True Spirit Beast Empire with the power of tens of millions of kilometers, successfully achieved its breakthrough in the ancient late stage, considerably growing in stature.
For Giant Beast lifeforms, the growth of the True Body also meant a simultaneous enhancement of all their Talent Abilities and the might of their Rule.
Despite its body length of only a little over 19,000 meters, the essence of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was an incredibly vast mountain range, or rather a compressed world.
Merely standing there, the invisible gravitational force it emitted twisted the surrounding Space-Time and devoured light, standing tall like a true Black Hole celestial body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1627 - 1627 607 Melting Time The Dyed Destruction
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1627: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_6 Chapter 1627: Chapter 607 Melting Time, The Dyed Destruction Emperor Dragon_6 All the power and matter approaching it were torn apart and obliterated by an extreme terrifying force, frightfully immense.
Moreover, this time not only did its strength change, but its appearance also subtly adjusted due to the devouring of the Heaven-Earth Divine Vein.
For instance, the edges of the scales all over its body, which were Black Gold, now had some seven-colored crystalline substances, including faint colored patterns on its dorsal fins.
There was also the mane of black hair dancing effortlessly behind its head, the tips of which now had a hint of color, as if dyed.
At this moment, as the mane fluttered, the tips invisibly emitted a faint seven-colored glow, adding an inexplicably magnificent aura to the fierce-looking Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Feeling slightly the changes from this growth, the Destruction Emperor Dragon let out a low roar, retracting the terrifying power it emitted.
Instantly, the oppressive aura that filled hundreds of thousands of kilometers vanished; all the Giant Beasts from the Dragon Palace Empire around this area relaxed instinctively.
Boom! Heaven and Earth shook as the Destruction Emperor Dragon stepped out, traversing tens of thousands of kilometers to arrive at the edge of the Earth’s fault.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, you look fierce now.”
Immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon, which had already absorbed the Divine Object and grown to a length of over two thousand one hundred meters, approaching the mid Titan stage, spread its wings and flew over with an excited roar.
Like a towering mountain range, the Destruction Emperor Dragon stood upon the Earth; the void beneath its feet shattered, nodding slightly as it issued a low growl deep like thunder.
“Not bad, this gain is quite substantial.”
Speaking, other Giant Beasts also gathered around—seven Ancient Dragon Kings, and the Blade Giant Beast with even more powerful and terrifying soul fluctuations.
This time, with the divine vein essence bestowed by Jack Clark, the Purple-eyed Great Beast, which had been at the Titan Peak for years, finally stepped into the ancient stage.
At this moment, its body was still undergoing transformation, dividing a portion of its consciousness to control the body of an ancient-level Giant Beast.
“King, congratulations on your breakthrough in strength.”
“Thunderflame, you have greatly improved this time.”
“Truly worthy of a king, your growth potential and talent are incomparable to us.”
The Seven-headed Ancient Beasts and the Blade Giant Beast roared low, their tones instinctively carrying a trace of awe.
Even the Black Kirin and the Ancient Batfin were larger in size than the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Apart from these ancient-level Giant Beasts, only the mother of the Gold Blue Giant Dragon, the Crystal Red One, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Nine-headed Dragon Kidora, and the Red Candle Dragon dared to approach the Destruction Emperor Dragon at this moment.
