Before the now mighty Destruction Emperor Dragon, the kilometer-long Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and Nine-headed Flood Dragon looked like two insignificant bugs.
Including the Mythical Peak Giant Beast Candle Dragon, which had grown to over two thousand meters, was only about the size of a single dorsal fin on its back.
Roar! Thunderflame, you are becoming more and more awesome. The Deep Sea Dragon Palace looked up and roared excitedly, still not as tall as the front of the Destruction Emperor Dragon
Roar Roar Roar!! Invincible, awesome.
Kidora’s nine dragon heads also twisted excitedly, but luckily, this time only the nine dragon heads twisted and shook; their bodies did not tangle uncontrollably due to confused consciousness as before.
As for the remaining eighty-plus Mythical Giant Beasts, Titan Beasts’ subordinates, they all stood respectfully in the distance, their gazes fervently watching the ferocious behemoth.
This scene was like a thousand beasts worshipping.
Too bad there wasn’t a video camera; otherwise, having someone film this and post it online would have been incredibly cool.
Cough! What am I thinking. The Destruction Emperor Dragon shook its head and then issued a majestic, deep roar: “It seems that everyone has gained quite a bit this time.”
The Time Dragon’s eyes showed a trace of a smile, softly roaring: “Indeed, our strength has grown this time.”
This time, defeating a True Spirit Beast Empire and plundering the intrinsic essence of this World gathered by that True Spirit Beast, all the Giant Beasts had a substantial harvest.
Some of the resources were very helpful to these ancient-level Giant Beasts.
Of course, this time it was merely a boost in strength, not yet an advancement by a minor realm, given that ancient-level Beasts face greater difficulties in advancing than humans.
Because fundamentally, their Giant Beast bodies had already merged with ‘World,’ walking the path towards becoming True Spirits.
“Let’s go, next we’ll rush at full speed to the Purgatory Battlefield.”
Boom!
A black-red intertwined radiance expanded from Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body, enveloping ten thousand kilometers, covering all Titans and Mythical Giant Beasts, tearing through space at an astonishing speed.
Roar Roar Roar!!
The other ancient-level Giant Beasts also let out spirited roars, flying at terrifying speeds towards a battlefield billions of kilometers away.
The ancient late-stage realm gave the Destruction Emperor Dragon the confidence to contend with that revered Purgatory ancestor, even if it couldn’t defeat the opponent, it could still directly withstand a confrontation, therefore no longer slowing down to delay time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1628 - 1628 608 The War of Extermination Bursts
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1628: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, An Opportunity for Promotion Chapter 1628: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, An Opportunity for Promotion Just as the Giant Beast Legions began to travel at full speed, crossing forbidden areas and dangerous regions with spatial cracks,
Thousands of Purgatory True Demon’s Main Battle Legions and Alien Affiliated Legions gathered near the Human Territory’s closest Grita War Demon Empire, blanketing the sky and covering the Earth.
The numbers in each legion ranged from tens of thousands to over a hundred thousand, with the total surpassing five hundred million.
Each legion was commanded by a Top-tier True Demon with Nine Demonic Marks, with over a dozen legions surrounding a Demon King’s castle, the formation stretching nearly ten thousand kilometers.
Moreover, aside from the affiliated legions that exceeded a hundred different races in number, there were also many demonized monsters within the multimillion-strong army.
Some of these monsters resembled giants with double and triple heads, towering hundreds to thousands of kilometers high, while others were demonized mutations of Dark Giant Beasts, continuously emitting ferocious and brutal roars.
With so many Purgatory True Demons, the invisible Dark Demon Air that emanated from their bodies resonated with one another, shaking Heaven and Earth.
An endless stream of Dark Demon Air encircled the three hundred-odd Demon King castles, forming dark vortexes spanning thousands of kilometers, turning into Demon Pillars tens of thousands of meters thick that surged towards the sky.
Thousands of kilometers in high altitude, the thickness of the crimson Demon Cloud reached a thousand kilometers, and atop the Demon Cloud stood eighteen Demon Gods exuding a Terrifying Aura.
These Demon Gods were led by Tyris and Carthius, two Great Demon Gods, below them were the Lords of the Four Great Empires, revealing their towering true bodies, reaching heights of a hundred thousand meters and tens of thousands of meters.
Apart from the six strongest Demon Gods including Constantin, who guarded the ancestral seat, and Tarolia, who had just made a breakthrough into the Demon God Realm, there were others present.
At the sides of the eighteen Demon Gods stood five Extreme Realm Great Demon Kings with powerful Auras, nearly matching the pressure of ordinary Demon Gods, majestically imposing.
In addition, below them stood more than sixty Great Demon Kings on the rolling Demon Cloud overhead, each revealing their true forms thousands of kilometers tall, their surroundings enveloped by the glow of Dark Laws, the scene was terrifying.
It felt as if the Abyssal Demon World was arriving, about to destroy the world.
In such a scene, even the Demon Kings of the Legendary Realm didn’t have the qualifications to stand here.
However, currently, there were only eighteen Purgatory Demon Gods, a mere over sixty Great Demon Kings, and just over three hundred Demon Kings—the proportions always felt somewhat distorted.
The reason behind all this was the most recent series of fierce battles.
In the battles at the Heavenly Feather Battlefield and the Immortal Spirit Battlefield, the Great Demon Kings and Demon King Level Strong of the Six Great Empires suffered heavy losses in the desperate counterattacks when both races’ territories were destroyed.
After all, compared to the Demon Gods who ruled the empires, these Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings were still cannon fodder.
If it were not for the fact that many peak True Demons of the Six Great Empires and some of the peak Legendary Realm Demon Kings had made breakthroughs to fill in half the void after the annihilation of the two races, the numbers would be even fewer.
As for the two Purgatory Empires, which had been at war with the Human Race for over twenty years, their elite forces were nearly wiped out in the last battle, including both Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings.
Seated high upon a Demon God throne fashioned from huge dark-colored beast skeletons, Tyris’s eyes burned with dark red flames, a terrifying gaze sweeping across those Demon Gods, then a voice deep as thunder shook the ten-thousand-kilometer Heaven and Earth.
“In this battle, our sole purpose is one, to extinguish all life within the Human Alliance.”
“Hence, whether they be ordinary True Demon soldiers or Great Demon Kings, any who take a step back on the battlefield and shake the army’s morale, will be executed without exception.”
“Fight to the death, ceaselessly and relentlessly.”
“For the glory of the great Purgatory Demon Race, annihilate all humans, annihilate all life in the alliance.”
On the Earth, billions of Purgatory True Demons and demonized alien races let out crazed shouts.
All these True Demons looked up, fervently watching the Firmament above, their gazes piercing through the Hollows in the clouds created by the dark Demon Pillars, focusing on the figures of those Demon Gods.
Feeling the pervasive Battle Intent between heaven and earth, Tyris nodded in satisfaction, then turned to glance at Carthius.
As opposed to Tyris, Carthius, who was seated high on the throne, seemed somewhat nonchalant, his gaze sweeping over the dozen-plus Demon Gods at his sides before speaking indifferently,
“I have nothing much to say, just carry out everything according to the plan; let us depart.”
“Depart.”
Boom!
The Dark Demon Air, which spanned millions of kilometers wide and reached high into the skies, roared into motion, like a Sky Curtain of destruction moving slowly towards a destination millions of kilometers away.
While the motion was described as ‘slow’, it was only in relation to the overcasting Dark Sky Curtain; in actuality, its speed was astonishing.
Within the surging Dark Demon Air, billions of Purgatory Demons shouted wildly; some ran across the Earth, others controlled the Demon Air to fly and escape through the Earth.
These Purgatory Demons, like countless ‘points’, echoed the pervasive Demonic Energy between heaven and earth, and gradually, a terrifying strength converged.
As the source of all True Demons, the Dark Demon Air encompassing millions of kilometers in range was the extension of the Purgatory ancestors’ rule.
Usually, this strength was so dispersed within all Dark Demon Air that it was too faint to perceive, incapable of active Mobilization, only passively forming a certain enhancement.
But now, under the guidance of billions of True Demons, Great Demon Kings, and all the Demon Gods, these rule forces began to converge.
Soon, in the rear of the legions that had already spread tens of thousands of kilometers apart, the surging Demon Air compressed continuously, gradually forming a colossal True Demon phantom that pierced the heavens and Earth.
Boom! In an instant, the strength of all Purgatory True Demons surged, including the might of Demon Gods like Tyris, which also increased by a tenth.
This was the blessing of the Abyssal rule from the Purgatory ancestors.
Looking at that vast moving mass, which devoured forests and mountain ranges, a Divine King from within the Void, tens of thousands of kilometers away, watching over the movements of the Purgatory Demon Race, grew tense.
After a deep look at the Dark Sky Curtain, the Divine King decisively turned and moved away from the Space Cracks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1629 - 1629 608 The War of Extermination Bursts
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1629: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, Promotion Opportunity_2 Chapter 1629: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, Promotion Opportunity_2 Soon, the forbidden area battlefield received news of the Purgatory Demon Race’s mighty army setting out.
On the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, after three days of Closed-door Cultivation, Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes and looked at the shattered Mom-son Moonstone in front of him: “They are finally here.”
As he spoke, space in front of Jack Clark shattered, forming a black crack, with the Human Race’s rear Base City visible on the other side.
As soon as Jack Clark stepped out of the Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, he saw tens of thousands of Long-Range Energy Bombers taking off, roaring towards their respective bases in the sky.
In addition, there were more than a hundred thousand Flying Giant Beasts roaring, under the control of cultivators, they soared into the sky to perform the task of guarding the Sky Base Satellite.
Moreover, countless transport ships were constantly taking off and landing; this scene had been ongoing for half a month.
Inside the vast Base City, millions of logistical personnel transferred from the Sky Curtain Battlefield were all busy, with aircraft densely packed between the skyscrapers.
Everyone knew this battle was of utmost importance.
Hundreds of kilometers above the firmament, a white Mech structure several hundred kilometers long floated, resembling a gigantic, majestic, and icy Mech head.
Within the God Defense Base, Jack Clark appeared silently in the spacious and bright white lobby with his high access privileges.
Adam Garcetti, the First Councilor, the Primordial True King, and the True Martial Heavenly King were already there, and they all smiled when they saw Jack Clark. Adam Garcetti asked,
“Jack, how has your injury recovered?”
Jack Clark shook his head, “It’s just a minor injury, don’t worry about it. What’s the current situation?”
A few days earlier, he had sustained only a light injury due to excessive force expenditure and overloading his True Body, a type of injury that was insignificant to him.
If it involved consuming his Origin, he could recover in the blink of an eye.
A golden Rubik’s Cube, 3 meters in size, slowly rotated in mid-air, emitting the aged voice of the Sky-based God King: “During this time, I have completed the basic deployment, and three batches of Doomsday Nuclear Weapons have been fully installed at the coordinate points.”
“Besides, the corps of all four clans reached the various bases yesterday, forming five echelons of battle lines centered on the middle of the forbidden area battlefield.”
“Next, we just wait for those Purgatory Demons to come in for a fight to the death.”
As the Sky-based God King spoke, a light screen tens of thousands of meters large appeared in front of the five individuals, clearly projecting a map of the entire forbidden area battlefield.
Mountain ranges stretching tens of thousands of kilometers, numerous rivers and forests, along with ordinary forbidden areas and danger zones.
Relying on those forbidden areas and danger zones surrounding the central region, the four clans had built hundreds of thousands of bases and firepower points, resembling a ‘pathway’ around a hundred thousand kilometers wide and extending hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Compared to the Purgatory True Demons which integrated the power system, could channel endless Dark Demon Air, and had Rule enhancements, the Human Alliance was at a disadvantage in every aspect.
The number of the Transcendent Corps together was nearly twenty million, and their power systems were different, unable to form extensive Rule enhancements.
Therefore, the best method was to fight independently, retract defense, and reduce the battlefield scope.
Divine King-level strong men, with the Ninefold Heavenly Palace as the core, restrained the opponent’s Demon Gods, allowing the Heavenly Kings and Main Gods below to conduct a war of attrition using Human Race technology.
Therefore, around those forbidden areas surrounding the Human Race battlefield were distributed black spots shaped like skulls, each representing a Doomsday Nuclear Weapon manufactured with dark matter at its core.
Including the entrance to the forbidden area stretching over a hundred thousand kilometers, the front and back were also marked with more than a dozen black skulls.
The plan was that once half of the Purgatory Demon Race’s army entered the battlefield, the Sky-based God King would detonate those Doomsday Nuclear Weapons, massively slaughtering those True Demons and destroying the entrance simultaneously.
As for the bases established on those mountain ranges at the entrance to the forbidden area, they were just a cover.
Those places were manned by Unmanned Mech Corps.
Considering the respective strengths, number of personnel, timing, and geographical advantages, the Sky-based God King had already calculated millions of times.
Looking at the countless information flashing across the map—details like the personnel at each base, combined strength, ammunition quantities, and how long they could hold out—Jack Clark nodded slightly.
Because of the computations done by the Celestial God, the wireless signals imbued with the Rule power of the Sky-based God King could ignore disturbances from the Heavenly Energy, permeating the entire battlefield.
In simple terms, the Human Alliance virtually had a ‘God’s perspective’ in this battle, where the Sky-based God Kingürger could precisely control the entire battlefield’s firepower and execute refined personnel movements, unleashing 200% to 300% of their potential strength.
The individuals then discussed some details, followed by Adam Garcetti speaking earnestly, “Jack, your situation will likely be very dangerous this time, be sure to be careful when the time comes.”
“Yes, I understand.” Jack nodded.
He was well aware of this fact; in the previous battle where he slew Diorus and other Demon Gods, besides the Hell Coordinates, he could also summon the Destruction Emperor Dragon, but all his other cards had been revealed.
Facing him as a massive threat, those Purgatory Demon Gods would definitely come together for another decisive attempt.
Just like last time.
At that moment, Adam Garcetti looked towards the True Martial Heavenly King and asked, “True Martial, how is the accumulation of the Rule power in the True Martial Divine Tablet, can you not breakthrough yet?”
The True Martial Heavenly King slowly shook his head, “I’m still missing about a third, if the duration of this great war is long enough, I should be able to complete the accumulation.”
“Still that much?” Adam nodded, somewhat regretfully.
Speaking of this, the True Martial Heavenly King couldn’t help but smile wryly, “No choice, the battle at the Heavenly Feather ended too soon, the True Martial Divine Tablet didn’t absorb much Rule power there.”
Unlike Jack Clark and the other orthodox cultivators, everything about the True Martial Heavenly King was dependent on the True Martial Divine Tablet.
As a Human Race Intrinsic Weapon representing the ‘Rule’ of the True Martial Way, the True Martial Divine Tablet had already become powerful enough to rival Rules, directly confronting Ancient Middle Stage Demon Gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1630 - 1630 608 The War of Extermination Bursts
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1630: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, Promotion Opportunity_3 Chapter 1630: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, Promotion Opportunity_3 But the difference between rule-comparison and promotion rules is significant.
True Martial Way, created by the Human Race through battle, centers its core on combat—carving a path of hope and future for the Human Race through relentless struggle.
Therefore, it requires absorbing the immense Rule Powers on the vast battlefield, which are imbued with the wild will of combat from the battles of Demon God Level Powerhouses.
Once these powers accumulate to a certain extent, True Martial Heavenly King can break free from shackles with absolute strength, achieving Man-Stele Unity and stepping into the Supreme level.
At the same time, as the Intrinsic Weapon of the Human Race, the power of the True Martial Divine Stele would surge tremendously.
Originally, the purpose of True Martial Heavenly King’s last support at the Heavenly Feather battlefield was to use the ongoing battle of more than ten Demon God Level Powerhouses to absorb the diffused Rule Power and complete the accumulation.
Unexpectedly, due to Jack Clark’s disturbance at the Grand Demon King Level of Absolute Domination, the Demon Gods led by Tyris decided to initiate the War of Extermination ahead of schedule.
Following that, after a battle that annihilated two empires, they also entered the mode of the final decisive battle.
Thinking of this, even the True Martial Heavenly King couldn’t help feeling a bit vexed.
In his original expectations, with just one more year, he would have likely stabilized into the Supreme level and become the fourth Supreme Expert wielding Intrinsic strength for the Human Race.
By then, his power would increase explosively, no less than Adam Garcetti.
But ever since Jack Clark, that monster, began to rise, whether it was the Human Race’s plan to keep a low profile or the offensive intensity from the Purgatory Empire, everything became chaotic …
Uh … why are you looking at me like that? Facing the resentful gaze of True Martial Heavenly King, Jack Clark was somewhat baffled.
Jack Clark pondered a bit, “Senior fellows, please take care of the other matters. I need a bit of time to make some preparations.”
“Leave it to us.”
Although they did not know what further preparations Jack Clark had to make, Adam Garcetti and the others didn’t ask more.
Distorting space, Jack Clark quickly leaped over a hundred thousand kilometers, reaching the edge of the Ice-encrusted Forbidden Zone extending tens of thousands of kilometers, whereupon his left hand’s back emitted a gloomy blue light.
Meanwhile, billions of kilometers away under the night sky, emitting black-red light and piercing everything with a terrifying speed, the Destruction Meteor suddenly halted.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, why have you stopped?”
The Black-Gold Giant Beast with a body length of nineteen thousand meters and radiating a terrifying aura inquired through a puzzled low growl.
Earlier, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had just talked about hurrying on the journey, but now, after not flying long, it had suddenly stopped.
In the black-red realm of this world, other Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts also looked over curiously, wondering why the great invincible king had stopped.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “I need to make some bombs.”
“Bombs, what are those?” The Gold Blue Giant Dragon beside it asked curiously.
Behind the black-red world domain, the following seven Ancient Beasts also stopped.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon did not answer but turned to look behind at multiple robust Black Gold Dorsal Fins, his gaze settling on one a thousand meters long and over a hundred meters thick at the base.
In the mountains and seas shaking wind, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly extended its right claw, and with a boom, grabbed the Dorsal Fin that resembled a small hill; immediately its arm muscles violently expanded.
Boom!
The base of the Dorsal Fin vibrated, breaking under the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s terrifying power with a boom akin to billions of tons of Hydrogen Bombs exploding.
The space even tore a huge crack due to the terrifying force emitted at the break.
Raging wind breathed, air vibrated.
This scene made all the Ancient Beasts instinctively shrink their necks.
Too brutal, not only enjoying tearing apart rival Giant Beasts but also so harsh on itself.
For the Ancient Beasts that had fused their souls and True Bodies, these Dorsal Fins were also a part of their bodies, just like flesh and blood. Breaking a Dorsal Fin was no different from breaking a claw.
The Silver Giant Dragon roared, “Roar! Great Scythia will know, that human is once again seeking help from you, Tim Abbott.”
The Gold Blue Giant Dragon nodded slightly, “It is evident.” They had witnessed this scene before.
However, this time the Destruction Emperor Dragon wasn’t crafting Sky Base weapons.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon emitted a deep roar, and instantly, terrifying power began to converge within its body, with limitless, golden-white flames flowing into the Dorsal Fin along its retracted claw.
Soon, the Dorsal Fin emitted an exceedingly brilliant radiance, resembling a golden-white light sphere. The formless high-temperature destruction scared all the Giant Beasts into retreating instinctively.
Including the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold Blue Giant Dragon.
Until those Giant Beasts withdrew several thousand kilometers, the surrounding space of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already annihilated, leaving only a diameter of several hundred kilometers golden-white sun.
The formless energy fluctuation made the seven Ancient Beasts tremble slightly.
Just then, a purple halo surfaced on the golden-white sun’s surface, instantly making the aura even more ferocious, seemingly about to explode the next moment and obliterate this World.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, and golden-red lightning exploded all over its body, densely enveloping the golden-white sun.
Boom!
The golden-white sun’s radiance intensified, suddenly expanding several times, but it didn’t completely explode. Instead, it was gradually compressed by the Doomsday Rule.
About ten minutes later, a golden-red crystal a hundred meters in diameter appeared in the paw of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The crystal’s surface was covered in golden-red Rule lines, with a liquid-like golden-white substance slowly flowing inside, emitting terrifying fluctuations that shook heaven and earth.
This was the bomb the Destruction Emperor Dragon intended to make.
With fifty percent of its Heaven-Scorching Golden Flame Origin compressed and combined with ten percent of its Corrosion Origin, using the Dorsal Fin as a carrier to solidify the “bomb”.
Under the Seal of the Doomsday Rule ignition, its destructive power was comparable to a full-force strike of an Ancient Beast at the True Spirit Initial Stage, and among the True Spirits, it was one of the stronger kinds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1631 - 1631 608 The War of Extermination Bursts
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1631: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, Promotion Opportunity_4 Chapter 1631: Chapter 608: The War of Extermination Bursts Forth, Promotion Opportunity_4 This was Jack Clark’s final preparation, his ace up the sleeve.
To avoid the desperation of the enemy, the Destruction Emperor Dragon could not be summoned for the time being, but that didn’t mean it couldn’t do other things.
Thus, just when all the Giant Beasts thought it was over, the Destruction Emperor Dragon had already turned around again, its left claw grabbing a second Dorsal Fin.
Boom! An instant of terrifying shockwaves once again resounded through Heaven and Earth.
This time, the Dorsal Fin broken by the Destruction Emperor Dragon was a bit smaller. Clutching the hill-sized fin, purple-black Thunder began to leap on its left claw.
This time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon infused it with the power of the Annihilation True Thunder, also combining a tenth of the Corrosion Origin and sealing it with the Chaos Doomsday Rule.
When the dazzling lightning that lit up the surroundings dissipated, a hundred-meter-long purple-black Crystal appeared in the claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, containing a thread of terrifying lightning compressed to the extreme, bouncing within.
“Roar! Tim Abott, you’re making bombs again?” The Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes widened as it watched the Destruction Emperor Dragon turn to grasp another Dorsal Fin.
The creation of these ‘bombs,’ which consumed the Origin and a part of the True Body, could indeed damage the Destruction Emperor Dragon, using up a significant amount of power.
“Just one more bomb should suffice.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon growled slowly, again breaking off another Dorsal Fin, immediately leaving a bald spot on its back.
And this time, the Destruction Emperor Dragon infused it with the Corrosion Origin, the surrounding space that had just been repaired silently perished under circles of purple Radiance, turning into a dense array of black holes.
Such a terrifying sight made all the beasts of the Dragon Palace Empire’s skin crawl.
At the same time, they were shocked by the number of talents the Destruction Emperor Dragon had mastered.
Under the breathless gaze of all the Giant Beasts, after more than ten minutes, the third ‘bomb’ was completed, and a hundred-meter-thick purple crystal Crystal materialized in the claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
At this point, the aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was clearly weakened.
But it didn’t matter.
Boom!
Flames burned alongside the three pairs of Crystal Red feather horns of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, as golden flames leaped about, with silver spatial runes inscribed and integrated into its True Body, lighting up one after another.
At the same time, beneath the feet of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a Summoning Altar with a diameter of over a hundred thousand meters in gloomy blue emerged.
Suddenly, the silver light on the golden red feather horns intensified, complementing the Spatial Channel Rune, a silver-blue Spatial Channel appeared in front, rotating and continually expanding.
Before long, the Spatial Channel expanded to a diameter of a kilometer, resembling a deep pathway, through which one could clearly see the black-haired young man standing on the other side.
“It’s that human.” The Time Dragon growled from thousands of kilometers away, immediately recognizing Jack Clark.
After all, the human and dragon had been comrades in arms, even if the Time Dragon had now broken through to the Ancient Level. The human… “Roar! How is that possible?”
Feeling the invisible terrifying pressure emanating from Jack across the pathway, along with the aura of the same Ancient Level realm, the Time Dragon couldn’t help but widen its eyes.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon turned its head, looking puzzled at the shocked Time Dragon: “What’s wrong, do you know that ‘human’?”
The Time Dragon took a deep breath, suppressing the shock in its heart and growled lowly: “More than just knowing him, that human… is just as monstrous as the Thunderflame Beheamoth.”
The human, upon his return from the past, had clearly only been at the late period of Myth level, and by time’s reckoning, it had only been a little more than a Sun Wheel since his return.
Just over a Sun Wheel, was it even possible to become so monstrous?
At this moment, the Time Dragon inexplicably felt as if they were all living on borrowed time.
To have one with terrifying talent who has quickly stepped into the heavens-defying Ancient-Level combat power of the Thunderflame Beheamoth was odd enough, but for that human’s talent to be equally intimidating…
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, of course, knew nothing of the Time Dragon’s shock, slowly gathering the three bombs in front of it, then suddenly thrusting them into the summon channel.
Boom!
[The story concludes with a thousand words, brothers wait half an hour and refresh.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1632 - 1632 609 Dark Matter Collapse Ambush Jack
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1632: Chapter 609: Dark Matter Collapse, Ambush Jack Clark Chapter 1632: Chapter 609: Dark Matter Collapse, Ambush Jack Clark As Tyris’s voice faded, five Demon Gods, each revealing their true forms of ten thousand and over twenty thousand meters, fiercely took action.
However, they did not directly pounce towards the alliance camp, instead, they manipulated the Dark Demon Air with their own rules.
Boom!
Across the entrance of the forbidden area, the Dark Demon Air that spread over hundred thousand kilometers burst forth, forming a massive dragon head with thirty-six demon horns spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
Although it was just Dark Demon Air coalesced like smoke, the moment the colossal dark dragon head, towering tens of thousands of kilometers, appeared, an extremely terrifying oppressive force burst out.
Bang!
This world instantly emitted a groaning sound of overwhelmed fury; mountain peaks within ten thousand kilometers of the dragon head collapsed, towering trees exploded, branches fracturing in a radiative fashion.
Roar!
The immense, boundless dark dragon head let out a chaotic, mindless roar, biting towards the Ninefold Heavenly Palace that spanned between heaven and earth, appearing like an overlap of nine illusionary worlds of red, blue, yellow, and purple.
Observing the majestic and vast dark dragon head, standing within the Second Layer of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace, Adam Garcetti, holding the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel, saw his divine radiance of black and white surge explosively.
The Ninefold Heavenly Palace, as the intrinsic weapon of the Immortal Spirit Clan, possessed the characteristic of combining the strength of all Supreme Experts.
When one of the Supreme Experts took action, every move would unleash a power twelve times amplified. At that moment, under Adam Garcetti’s full strength activation of the Divine Wheel, the entire heaven and earth were instantly divided into yin and yang.
“Yin and Yang reverse, disperse!”
As if two grinding discs of destruction, one black and one white, the heaven and earth suddenly merged at the instant the dark dragon head bit down.
Boom!
The tens of thousands of kilometers wide dark dragon head instantly collapsed, transforming into an endless surge of Dark Demon Air that flooded in all directions.
Then a thunderous roar exploded; the entire entrance of the forbidden area battlefield shook, with the mixed Dark Demon Air sweeping across all sides, radiating brilliance akin to rainbows at its periphery.
That was the order chain of the Heavenly Earth Law manifesting intangibly under the impact of fierce and violent strength.
However, when the Dark Demon Air horizontally submerged over a hundred thousand kilometers and a depth of over fifty thousand kilometers at the entrance of the forbidden area, it immediately collided with an invisible barrier.
Stretched over two hundred thousand kilometers, the lowest layer of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace, the Back Soil Imperial Capital glowing with faint yellow radiance and connected with the Earth, exuded an immovable will.
Simultaneously, outside the illusory world of the Heavenly Palace, strands of white Rule Radiance flickered between heaven and earth.
That was the Power of Heaven and Earth, refined by the Divine King of the alliance, painting this World’s laws into a weak Rule Domain, repelling all dark forces.
But compared to the eighteen Demon Gods’ force guiding the Overbearing and polluting Dark Demon Air, Adam Garcetti and his cohorts were merely eroding the Heavenly Energy “not a match.”
In front of that horizontal, crazily surging dark tsunami that spanned tens of thousands of kilometers, the entire world was rapidly contaminated, devouring the Earth.
Only the Ninefold Heavenly Palace shone steadfastly immovable, like a massive land spanning over two hundred thousand kilometers, transversing the dark void ocean.
“Kill them.”
“Charge.”
“Eliminate all humans.”
At the entrance of the forbidden area submerged in a mist-like black demonic qi, billions from the Purgatory Legion let out a mad exhilarated roar, riding Demonized Beasts covering the sky as they surged towards the frontline.
Above these charging legions, dozens of Demon King castles moved swiftly, each surrounded by tens of thousands of Flying Demonized Giant Beasts.
Most importantly, on the backs of these several hundred meters spanning Flying Giants, structures resembling artillery platforms were constructed, where black demon patterns flickered.
Buzz! As they charged up, these hundred-meter-tall demonic cannons lit up with Dark Red Glow, emitting energy fluctuations comparable to tactical Nuclear Bombs.
Meanwhile, in the middle area of these legions, on the Earth, tens of thousands of mammoth-like beasts each a kilometer high and several kilometers long, seeming like condensed rock, moved.
These mountain range creatures, like walking in the clouds, seemed to move slowly, but each step covered more than a kilometer, with the surrounding black air currents rolling, their momentum magnificent.
On these mountainous creatures’ backs, even larger structures resembling both altars and artillery platforms in dark red were constructed.
At that moment around these massive artillery platforms, dozens of high-order True Demons stood, activating inscribed demon arrays, absorbing and channeling the surrounding Dark Demon Air to charge.
Standing on the highest layer of the Ninth Heavens Palace, the Wind Heavenly King with an icy gaze, slowly said, “These are the elite long-range legions of the Saint Demon Anke Empire, Destroyer Armament Units.”
“These legions have a maximum attack range of over ten thousand kilometers; when front-line armies of both clans engage and high-end forces are drawn in, they are almost impossible to counter.”
Hearing this, Adam Garcetti slowly nodded, “Such a long attack distance is indeed a bit troublesome.”
A range of ten thousand kilometers, for Divine King and Immortal King-level powerful beings, naturally isn’t significant, but that’s only when high-end forces can free their hands.
Otherwise, with the suppression of the Dark Demon Realm and surrounding Demon King castles, even Main God-level powerful beings charging in would be powerless against those mountainous legions.
However, long-range attacks are also something the Human Race excels at.
Just as the Purgatory Legion was approaching in full force, at the edge of the area influenced by the power of the Back Soil Imperial Capital, under the mountains, over a hundred legions were already positioned.
These legions primarily consisted of Human Race Unmanned Mech War Pattern legions, relying on constructed fortifications, clad in yellow light membranes waiting.
Simultaneously, in the sky above the rear, floating thousands of kilometers high in the clouds, Sky Base Satellites twinkled slightly, uploading all imaging and mapping data.
Inside the God Defense Base at the rear, countless data flickered across a large screen, with over ten thousand light points emerging on the maps of the frontline border on both sides.
A third of these light points were white, located near the battlefield on the Human Race’s side, in the mountains and rear.

chapters.title: Chapter 1633 - 1633 609 Dark Matter Burst Ambush Jack
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1633: Chapter 609 Dark Matter Burst, Ambush Jack Clark_2 Chapter 1633: Chapter 609 Dark Matter Burst, Ambush Jack Clark_2 More red dots were scattered throughout the rolling Black Demonic Qi, penetrating no deeper than 10,000 kilometers, locking onto Purgatory Legions.
“Coordinates adjusted.”
“A3, A5… Fifty-seven missile launch bases with a range of 10,000 kilometers have been deployed…”
“Strategic bombers equipped with Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bomb warheads have taken off and are expected to reach the designated launch point in half an hour to commence extended range deployment.”
“The Divine Light Warships of the Heavenly Feather Clan are ready for long-range attacks, locking onto seventeen coordinates in the defense area.”
“The five Azure Sky-class warcities of the Immortal Spirit Clan have completed energy storage and are ready to launch an attack at any time…”
“At the location of Blue Star, the Sky-based doomsday satellite is expected to complete energy storage in half an hour, and the world passageways have been angle-corrected; please, King of the Sky, be prepared to guide…”
After a direct frontal hit, eighteen Demon Gods stood proudly amidst the churning Black Demonic Qi, confronting Adam Garcetti and others who were 100,000 kilometers apart, controlling the Ninefold Heavenly Palace.
Jack Clark and Divine King Tarrod stood on the edge of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace, not entering that particular boundary.
At this moment, everyone seemed to be watching each other with cold gazes, quietly waiting for the great battle to erupt below, but in reality, they had already clashed thousands of times at the rule level.
The dark tide spanning between heaven and earth was the tentacles of those Demon Gods, constantly tearing at the pervasive Power of Heaven and Earth.
This time, with the Purgatory Demon God bringing the entire Purgatory Domain and the Black Demonic Qi containing the strength of Purgatory ancestors, Adam Garcetti and the others were almost ‘defeated at every turn.’
Merely touching it, the weakly willful Divine Power of Heaven and Earth was contaminated, demonized.
This Dark Demon Qi was extremely overbearing, unstoppable. That was the ‘strength’ of that Purgatory ancestor, and merely a manifestation of part of the rules was already so terrifying.
At this moment, the supreme experts of the Human Alliance felt somewhat horrified.
Including the Divine King of the Heavenly Feather and the King of Immortal Spirit who had battled the Six Great Empires for hundreds of years prior, this was their first encounter with such overpowering darkness.
The Dark Demon Qi that pervaded past battlefields was merely an extension of Tyris or Carthius’ strength.
Though powerful, it was not impossible to resist.
In just a moment, the range of the smothering Dark Demon Qi advanced thousands of kilometers again, including the Back Soil Imperial Capital range, which was eroded by a loud rumble for a thousand kilometers.
At this rate, the entire forbidden area battlefield would be submerged in less than ten days.
Watching this unfold, Tyris and other Demon Gods had an even colder look in their eyes, under the overwhelming force this time, waiting to see what you would use to resist.
It was difficult to slay Demon God Level beings unless they were completely dominated in all aspects.
For example, Jack Clark’s battle where he slew Diorus not long ago.
But sometimes, slaying Demon God Level Powerhouses was very simple, just crush them with absolute dominance, like the obliterated Heavenly Feather and Immortal Spirit Clan lands.
In that regard, Tyris and other Demon Gods had rich experience.
Just by drawing the Dark Domain to flood this forbidden area, even all the territories of the Human Race, these humans would either abandon their lands and flee or fight to the death.
No matter the race, those who fought to the death in the Dark Demon Realm would only have one way to die.
And most importantly, finding an opportunity to completely slay Darren Callum… Thinking this, many Demon Gods’ gazes flickered over Jack Clark, who stood proudly upon the Firmament.
Suddenly, a strong malice enveloped Jack Clark.
Feeling those intense murderous gazes, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly. “These guys, just like last time, want to ambush me first?”
But Tyris and other Demon Gods were not in a rush, and naturally, neither was Jack Clark.
In his perception, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, along with the Giant Beast legions, had already covered half the distance, about two billion kilometers left.
Unless something unexpected happened, they were expected to arrive at the battlefield in no more than three days.
And if not for the perilously many forbidden areas along the way, some of which even the Destruction Emperor Dragon had to detour, they might have arrived in half a day.
Thinking this, Jack Clark’s realm of thought stirred, and his Divine Soul fluctuations resonated in the ears of those Immortal and Divine Kings: “Everyone, hold on for the next three days.”
“Three days,” Wind Heaven and others suddenly felt uplifted under the immense pressure.
In the standoff between both sides’ high-order powerhouses, more than three hours passed silently, and the smothering Dark Tide pushed forward another 20,000 kilometers.
Due to the gourd shape of the forbidden area, the deeper it went, the broader it became. By now, the rampant expansion of the Dark Domain had already exceeded 400,000 kilometers.
The boundless black fog covered the sky and endlessly surged into the heart of the battlefield, filled with a sense of oppression.
But just at that moment, an intense, invisible signal pierced through the front of the Dark Domain.
Instantly catching up to the rolling Dark Demon Qi, nine dazzling mushroom clouds slowly rose more than 5,000 kilometers behind the Purgatory Legion, on the verge of approaching the humans.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The already embedded trees served as billions of equivalents of Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs detonated, akin to nine stars on the surface, illuminating thousands of kilometers of darkness.
Under the energy that could Destroy Heaven and Earth, it seemed as if the entire world was shaking.
Especially the millions of Celsius temperatures from the nuclear explosion, instantly forming a Destructive Shockwave that swept everything away, engulfing the surrounding tens of Purgatory Legions immediately.
Under the intense heat, all materials on the surface ignited, rocks melted, over a million Demonized Alien Race beings of high-order and below did not even have the chance to scream before turning to ash.
The high-order Purgatory True Demons reacted a tad faster, immediately bursting demon gas to resist.
However, these True Demons only lasted a moment before being swept away by the raging wind from the nuclear blast, screaming as they slowly burned within the rolling fiery smoke and dust.

chapters.title: Chapter 1634 - 1634 609 Dark Matter Burst Ambush Jack
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1634: Chapter 609 Dark Matter Burst, Ambush Jack Clark_3 Chapter 1634: Chapter 609 Dark Matter Burst, Ambush Jack Clark_3 “It’s the Human Race’s hydrogen bomb, suppress.” Above the Firmament, Demon God Rudeus let out a surprise roar of fury, radiating a dazzling Dark Red Glow.
Boom!
Under the sway of Rudeus invoking the might of the Dark Demon Realm, nine nuclear mushroom clouds—already expanded to a hundred kilometers—trembled
Within a thousand kilometers, the originally disintegrated Dark Demon Air surged amidst the scorching shock, rolling like a substantial entity towards the mushroom clouds continually releasing nuclear energy.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The Dark Demon Air, like a pair of invisible grand hands, forcefully suppressed the strength released by the Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs, and the nuclear blast shock that had spread hundreds of kilometers slowly dissipated.
Due to the suppression of the Dark Demon Realm, the Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs, originally capable of erasing more than twenty nearby Purgatory Legions, ultimately only released half their energy.
Watching this scene, the Primordial True King frowned slightly, “Troublesome, these Dark Demon Realms also have a great suppression on thermal weapons.”
“Indeed, somewhat troublesome.”
Adam Garcetti slowly nodded, “The Dark Demon Air containing the power of that Ancestor is like a solid entity, its suppressive force is hundreds of times stronger than the Dark Demon Air led by those Demon Gods.”
Far more than a hundred times.
Jack Clark’s gaze turned solemn. That Dark Demon Air was essentially a manifestation of some kind of Rule.
Because of the ‘experience’ with the battle between the Destruction Emperor Dragon and the Colorful True Spirit Beast, Jack had already come into contact with True Spirit level powers.
Through the performance of this Dark Demon Air, he was certain that the Dark Demon Air enshrouding the Purgatory Demon Race’s millions of kilometers of territory was, in essence, the ‘True Body’ of that Purgatory True Demon.
Thinking this, pity flashed in Jack Clark’s eyes as he looked at those Purgatory Demon Gods.
“Kill!”
“Charge.”
On the fringes of the roiling Dark Demon Air, more than four hundred army corps, tens of millions from the Purgatory Demon Race and vassal alien army corps, let out bloodthirsty roars, rushing towards the Alliance Army’s position awaiting them.
Boom Boom Boom!!
In that instant, the Purgatory Legion and cultivators wrapped in black mist, millions of Unmanned Mechs, Deity Alien Races, Heavenly Feather Legions, and Immortal Spirit Corps made contact.
The great battle spread across nearly a hundred thousand kilometers, divided into more than twenty battlefields separated by two forbidden areas and some perilous mountain terrains.
Just as the battle erupted, behind those battlefields, thousands of kilometers away, countless High-Yield Missiles and Tactical Crystal Energy Nuclear Bombs spewed forth scorching firewaves into the sky.
Dense swarms of unmanned bombers took off above, diving towards the dark, sky-blocking flight of Demonized Beasts.
Simultaneously, more than two hundred sky-based battleships, each tens of kilometers long and resembling space ships, their main and secondary cannons all emitted dazzling Radiance, unleashing dense Light Beams stretching over ten thousand kilometers in an instant.
Besides this, the Golden Warships of the Heavenly Feather Clan also fired repeated hundred-meter thick energy cannons, accurately hitting the midst of those Purgatory Legions.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Thousands of blinding Firelights rose from the Earth, the strong energy cannon bombardments shattered the ground, countless Purgatory True Demons and different races let out screams of agony.
Immediately after were the dense rain of missiles and rockets pouring into the battlefield, turning the whole Heaven and Earth into a cacophony of explosive roars.
But whether it was the Crystal Energy Missiles, Sky Base Main Cannons or Golden Energy Cannons, their lethality… was only half of what it once was, as the energy from the explosions was suppressed by the Dark Domain.
Roar Roar Roar!! Inside the Dark Domain, Mountain Stone Beasts seven thousand kilometers away let out deep roars, the giant cannons on their backs shining brightly.
Boom!!
Thousands of beams, a hundred meters thick and radiating a Dark Red Glow, streaked across the sky, wildly absorbing the surrounding diffuse Dark Demon Air as they expanded.
By the time those beams traversed tens of thousands of kilometers—tracing a solid arc and dropping into the rear of the Alliance’s battlefield—they had expanded to over a thousand meters thick, their power inflating several times over.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The intense explosions shook Heaven and Earth; mountains collapsed beneath those red light cannons, countless unmanned mechs and missile bases destroyed.
Over a dozen Golden Warships shook, two of them exploding violently as their energy was depleted.
At the same time, a thousand kilometers away at the edge of the roiling Dark Demon Air, behind eight battlefields, smaller cannons on the backs of Flying Demonized Giant Beasts also shone with blinding Radiance.
But just then, dense flashes of light twinkled behind the Human Race; missiles carrying thousands of Tactical Nuclear Bombs entered the Dark Domain, flying toward those far superior army corps.
“Those are the Human Race’s ‘missiles,’ some are very powerful, some average. Fifth and Seventh Corps, take aim and intercept those missiles…”
“Wrath of Bronze, Divine Punishment for All Eternity.”
At the rear of the Immortal Spirit Clan’s positions, a tremendous voice echoed through Heaven and Earth, and subsequently colossal blue formations emerged above the battlefield.
At the center of these formations covering a hundred kilometers, huge actual-sized Bronze Swords tore through the Void, emitting a destructive might capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth as they ripped through the Dark Mist and thundered down with a rumble.
Roar Roar Roar!!
Thousands of Four-Armed Violent Apes, towering a kilometer high and emanating a ferocious aura, roared skyward, each holding a hundred-meter diameter black ‘rock’ in their four hands.
The Demonized Battle Apes bent back, then with a Power Explosion, they hurled the black stone spheres burning with Black Flames, which were in their grip, into the sky at tens of times the speed of sound.
Boom Boom!! These black spheres streaked across more than two thousand kilometers, falling onto the battlefield, instantly shattering the Earth, spewing scorching Black Flames that enshrouded an area of several kilometers.
With the force shown, each stone sphere equaled a High-Yield Crystal Energy Missile explosion.
After delivering one ‘cannonball,’ the Demonized Battle Apes bent down, their four arms burrowing deep into the Earth, and using their Gifted Power, they once again condensed another black stone sphere from deep within the Earth.
In just an instant upon contact, the battle between the two Transcendent Corps entered a fever pitch.

chapters.title: Chapter 1635 - 1635 609 Dark Matter Collapse Ambush Jack
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1635: Chapter 609 Dark Matter Collapse, Ambush Jack Clark_4 Chapter 1635: Chapter 609 Dark Matter Collapse, Ambush Jack Clark_4 The entire night sky was ablaze, with the shouts of battle thundering through heaven and earth, and the Earth was covered with the radiant glows of nuclear explosions, with mountain ranges collapsing and rivers ceasing to flow.
At the same time, high above, a battle between kings had erupted.
Over two hundred demon kings, commanding their castles, clashed with more than twenty human kings, over thirty Heavenly Feather deities, and more than forty Immortal generals and twenty-plus deities resolutely engaging in combat.
In terms of numbers, the Purgatory Demon Kings nearly held an absolute advantage, their nearly two-on-one ratio doubling the pressure on the alliance’s side.
Including the skies above, spanning a thousand kilometers, the battle of the Heavenly Kings had also ignited instantly, with twenty-seven Heavenly Kings and Main God-level powerhouses from the Human Alliance entering the fray.
The Purgatory Demon Race had even more—over forty Great Demon Kings took action instantly.
Beyond the immediate battlefield stretching over a hundred thousand kilometers, billions of Purgatory Legionnaires continued to press deeper into the Ninefold Heavenly Palace’s sides, led by a hundred demon kings and the Great Demon King, amidst the rolling Dark Demon Air, resembling two constantly closing Dark Tentacles intending to envelop the Human Alliance.
Far above in the sky, over ten thousand kilometers up, with more than ten Demon Gods encircling him, Carthius, the Abyssal Overlord, sneered coldly, his voice deep, “Do you truly believe that with this weapon from the Immortal Spirit Clan, you’ll be able to halt my advance?”
“If this thing were of any use, the Immortal Spirit Clan wouldn’t have been annihilated by me.”
“Before the Dark Demon Realm encircles you completely, you may have a slim chance by retreating; but once the Demon Realm shrouds the entire world, suppressing you will be as easy as flipping a hand.”
However, as beings at the pinnacle of their race, such words naturally could not shake the will of Adam Garcetti and others, who replied indifferently, “We’ll only know if it works after we fight.”
“And do you truly believe you already hold the winning hand?”
Watching Adam Garcetti’s calm visage, both Tyris and Carthius narrowed their eyes subconsciously, sensing something amiss.
And before they could probe further, Adam Garcetti softly stated, “Time-wise, it should be about now.”
Over sixty thousand kilometers away, at the entry point to the forbidden zone, extending across more than a hundred thousand kilometers, at the mountainside location of the Human Bases, which had been trampled flat by the Purgatory Legion.
Hundreds of meters beneath the surface of the Earth, within fifteen ‘Nuclear Bombs,’ each over five hundred meters long with a diameter of forty meters, mechanical dials slowly ticked, emitting an almost imperceptible clicking sound.
Here, deeply entrenched within the Dark Domain and enveloped by dense Dark Demon Air, the Heaven and Earth had been contaminated and demonized, rendering even the Sky-based God King’s power incapable of penetrating.
Thus, when the bases were ‘destroyed,’ the mechanical detonation devices inside the Doomsday Nuclear Weapons were activated and timed.
As the sound of Adam Garcetti’s voice fell, the hands on the dials engraved with runes, within the fifteen Doomsday Nuclear Weapons presumably capable of destroying the world, also reached the end.
Boom Boom Boom!! A red and white radiance a thousand times brighter than the previous Crystal Energy Bombs rose from the Earth.
The instantly scorching radiance from these bombs dispersed the Dark Demon Air across a ten thousand kilometer radius, and endless Scorching Magma was cast thousands of kilometers high in the blast.
The terrifying explosion caused the Earth to collapse, reversing the cosmos, almost completely severing the entire forbidden zone battlefield.
Millions of the Purgatory Legionnaires who were continuously advancing into the forbidden zone were instantly reduced to ashes, and the fiery raging winds swept across a radius of over twenty thousand kilometers with overwhelming force.
Such a potent explosion, nearly reaching Ancient-level destructive power, caught even the numerous Demon Gods by surprise.
But… a regular Demon God-level strike, in such a battle, would only eradicate some Transcendent Corps on a large scale and annihilate a few demon kings, not enough to turn the tide of battle.
Just as Tyris narrowed his eyes and was about to mobilize the power of the Dark Domain to suppress the exploding forces with a mere thought,
Instantly, a strength that made all Demon Gods shudder appeared.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Fifteen nuclear fireballs, expanded to over three thousand kilometers in diameter, suddenly collapsed—a terrifying implosion force causing space to shatter and Space-Time to distort.
In the blink of an eye, fifteen Black Holes materialized, and compression to the extreme meant destruction.
Boom!
Centered around the fifteen Black Holes, an infinite and pitch-black Strength erupted, causing everything to crumble beneath the explosive Radiance that seemed like matter.
Heavenly Earth Laws, the foundational space, even the basic Rules of the world.
Under the annihilation of the dark matter explosion, the Dark Forbidden Zone at the entryway to the Space-Time fault lines went berserk,
“Trouble, kill!” Tyris bellowed in fury.
[Please wait a moment for a refresh, and there’s one more thing.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1636 - 1636 610 Mythical Impact Causal Reversal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1636: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash Chapter 1636: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash In the very moment that the two Jack Clarks entered the Dark Star Apocalypse Form, a blinding radiance painted the entire world in a purple-gold color, saturating heaven and earth with a profound and vast aura.
The true body with three faces and ten arms swelled from ten thousand meters to thirty thousand meters, and each of the six arms grasped weapons like a stellar sun, the Death Grindstone, and other associated armaments.
Especially noteworthy was the golden-white light wheel manifested from the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, emanating rings of dazzling halos, rippling out like tremors in water.
Together with the two towering Demon Gods standing opposite, Jack Clark at this moment seemed like a deity who had descended from the past, one who commanded the flow of time and suppressed the Demon God of World-Destroying.
But as immense as Jack Clark’s aura was, Tyris and Carthius, the two Demon Gods, exuded an even more overwhelming demon power, their terrifying presence surging straight into the sky.
“Darren Callum!”
Boom!
Within a ferocious roar, Tyris’s demon blade glimmered with light, and in an instant, a black blade light tens of thousands of meters long was unleashed with the force of opening the heavens and splitting the earth.
Under the terrifying Dark Demon Blade, the whole world was cleaved in two, forming a Black Abyss that spanned tens of thousands of kilometers.
Just as Tyris made his move, Jack Clark, dressed in dark gold Dragon Scales battle armor and with long hair burning like purple-gold flames, shattered the void and burst forth.
The dark gold war halberd, as heavy as a neutron star, caused heaven and earth to shatter extensively, creating a Dark Void spanning tens of thousands of kilometers and pulverizing everything.
Yet, in just an instant, the immensely heavy Eight Desolate Battle Halberd clashed with the blade light.
Boom!
The entire world began to shake wildly as layers of black gold radiance exploded between heaven and earth, akin to an ever-expanding black hole bringing about destruction of heaven and earth.
In that instant, swelling to over thirty thousand kilometers, the black hole that devoured both the sky and the earth ferociously had two forces clashing within its depths.
But in just a moment, the mighty Eight Desolate War Halberd, bearing the intent of opening the heavens, swept across unmatched, and with the support of the top-tier divine power Vacuum Destruction, its strength was unrivaled.
The exploding Golden-White Stellar Suns were like supernova explosions, instantly obliterating a swath of tens of thousands of kilometers.
And the Dark Demon Blade wielded by Tyris was equally dreadful, each of its strikes possessed the terrifying power to annihilate an entire world.
Under its blade light, the rules of heaven and earth collapsed, space-time shattered, regardless of whether it was the purple lightning light spears that stretched for tens of thousands of meters or the grey millstones that spanned heaven and earth, all were sliced apart with a single strike.
Even the intangible Soul Locks, aimed at targeting the soul, were shattered by the Dark Demon Blade.
That Dark Demon Blade, imbued with the force of an entire world’s rules, exhibited unparalleled might in Tyris’s hands, demolishing everything in its path with ease.
The whole of heaven and earth trembled violently under the clash of ‘the two,’ with the thunderous roars of explosions echoing endlessly.
Even because the forces of their clash were so tremendously powerful, comparable to half-step True Spirits, a space of a hundred thousand kilometers was laid waste in the blink of an eye.
The invisible waves of destruction alarmed even the Demon Gods and the Heavenly Feather King who were engaged in distant combat.
For they recognized that this was a power on an entirely different level.
Indeed, so powerful were their forces that they pierced the deeper layers of space, tearing Black Cracks thousands of kilometers long that extended deep into the void and lingered persistently.
In the depths of those cracks, eyes filled with malice and madness peered out, observing the material world ‘above.’
Yet feeling the terrifying aura of battle outside, the Void Creatures did not dare to step forward.
Boom!
The pitch-black blade light severed heaven and earth, spanning more than fifty thousand kilometers, and with its horrifying edge it struck at the Fifth Heaven Gate guarded by the Golden Winged Divine King, Tolstoy.
The fearsome air of destruction caused Tolstoy’s expression to shift momentarily, especially since he was facing an Ancient Late Stage and an Ancient Middle Stage Demon God.
“Do not be distracted, leave it to me.”
At the highest level of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace, the Wind Heavenly King, holding the Green Lotus, channeled the Power of Heaven and Earth into an immense Green Palm Imprint that struck at the black blade light.
Boom!
Before the unstoppable Dark Demon Blade light, the Azure Sky Palm Imprint was slightly resisted before it exploded with a bang, dispersing into a sky full of azure radiance that filled heaven and earth.
The powerful blade light continued unabated, striking at the Fifth Layer Heaven Gate, which looked like a golden bulwark; the trait of world-severing even tore open a thirty thousand-kilometer-long crack in the Heaven Gate.
Spurt! In an instant, Tolstoy, standing guard at the Heaven Gate, spat out a mouthful of blood, his breath fluctuating wildly from the rebound.
There was a qualitative gap between the force at the peak of the ancients and that which was half a step to a True Spirit.
But before the two Demon Gods cornering Tolstoy could rejoice, a Dark Golden Halberd Skill had already transcended time and arrived, exploding between heaven and earth.
Instantly, space collapsed above the two Demon Gods’ heads, forming a huge black hole thousands of kilometers wide.
“Be careful!”
“Block it.”
The two genuine bodies of the Demon Gods, towering at ten thousand meters and twenty thousand meters, roared in anger, their bodies wreathed in Black Flames and a Dark Red Glow, their auras surging as they were bolstered by the Dark Domain.
Instantly, behind the Ancient Late Stage Demon God, a towering and penetrating creature with a Dark-Red aura lifted itself from the abyss, its monstrous shadow slowly rising from the Demon Domain.
At the same time, around another Demon God rose one hundred and eight pillars, each a kilometer thick and tangible, blazing with the Hellfire of the Abyssal Hell, shooting up into the heavens.
Thump, thump, thump!! Under the heavy and unmatched Halberd Skill, the Dark-Red monster’s shadow instantly shattered, each pillar of the Hell Demon God exploded.
The two Demon Gods themselves had half their true bodies shattered, spewing blood from their mouths, plunging into the Dark Domain like meteorites falling from the heavens, smashing fiercely onto the Earth below after traversing tens of thousands of kilometers.
Boom! Heaven and Earth splintered, the Earth for tens of thousands of kilometers cracked open, the violent explosion sent countless stones soaring into the sky.
“Darren Callum, you’re courting death.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1637 - 1637 610 Mythical Impact Causal Reversal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1637: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash_2 Chapter 1637: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash_2 “`
Boom, boom, boom!! An even fiercer battle erupted instantly between the two.
But under Jack Clark’s deliberate guidance, the battlefield moved deeper into the forbidden area, away from Adam Garcetti and others who were contending with over a dozen Demon Gods.
While Jack Clark’s Ancient Time True Body was blocking Tyris’ True Demon God Body, Jack Clark’s own expression became grave as he gazed towards something tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Compared to Tyris, who had revealed only his True Demon God Body and exerted half his strength, the Great Demon King named Carthius exuded an even more terrifying aura at this moment.
Unlike those Demon Gods whose cultivation was higher and thus had more arms, Carthius’ True Body, which was a hundred thousand meters tall and had only three heads and six arms, was robust and slender.
Clad entirely in pitch-black battle armor covered with barbs and sharp horns, including the demonic skull-like head with nine demon horns, all was enveloped in darkness.
Overall, it resembled the Purgatory True Demon noble that Jack Clark had first encountered on the Southern Battlefield.
Except much more powerful and fearsome.
Standing in a dark red Abyss World, its invisible presence oppressed the Heavenly Earth Rules, collapsed space, twisted space-time, like a lord of the Abyss.
Or rather, completely embodying the Abyssal rule and bringing down the real Supreme Abyss Plane, it had become the overlord of the Abyss.
Standing amid the Abyss, Carthius’ gaze from behind his mask shone with a crimson radiance, and his voice imbued with Divine Soul Will thundered through space-time,
“Human, your talent is something even I have not seen in ten thousand years, and you may have had a chance to become an Outer Star if born among those top-tier civilizations.”
“Unfortunately, today you are destined to die by my hand.”
“The thought of killing an unparalleled monster with the primordial hope of excellence makes my blood begin to boil, hahaha, hahahaha…”
While speaking, this Great Demon King emitted an aura of madness, filled with endless evil dark intent to kill.
Boom!
A shining light coursed over Carthius’ pitch-black battle armor as his figure shattered the space, crashing through heaven and earth to forge a tens of thousands of kilometers long pitch-black pathway, appearing right before Jack Clark.
Because the speed was so terrifyingly fast, time itself seemed to freeze in Jack Clark’s perception.
In the instant Carthius’ dragon claw-like hand shot out, Jack Clark also made a fearless move, bursting forth with even greater speed.
Within the time-stilled dimension, Jack Clark’s War Halberd, heavy and sharp, swept across, obliterating all, forming a pitch-black fan-shaped slash on top of the dark demon claw.
There were no earth-shattering explosions, only black ripples that pierced through space-time spreading, destroying layers upon layers of the world where it passed.
It was only then that a black hole over forty thousand kilometers in diameter emerged, with a world-shaking rumble that exploded.
Boom! Space-time vibrated, and chaotic currents raged wildly.
Under the powerful force, Jack Clark’s expression changed slightly, his form suddenly sank, and he was directly blasted into the depths of the Void by Carthius’ Unrivaled Domineering Power.
“Human, you are too weak,” Carthius, standing in the Void filled with dark corrupting power, had eyes filled with fierce savagery and distorted madness.
At this moment, it felt even more monstrous than those creatures of the Void.
Boom!
An even more horrific aura burst from Carthius, the dark red Supreme Abyss Plane once again descended behind him, suppressing the Void.
“I’ve achieved the grand accomplishment of the Abyssal rule and fused with the world-class Dark Heavenly Demon battle armor, already reaching the realm where perfect rules unite heaven and earth.”
“If it weren’t for Bloodline Shackles, I would have already become the Abyssal Overlord and stepped into True Spirit.”
“For me, the Dark Demon Realm is irrelevant, hence the distorted forces and matter here in the depths of the Void have no effect on me.”
“However, here, you will use up your strength bit by bit, until you are destined to be torn apart by me in this place.”
Carthius wasn’t just spouting nonsense but aimed to ‘strike’ at Jack Clark with words, to shake his resolve and will.
For Jack Clark, having reached his level and strength, killing him would be as difficult as defeating an ordinary True Spirit.
Thus Carthius would not miss any opportunity to strike at his opponent.
But what it didn’t know was that Jack Clark had mastered the Void Law, and with the addition of the Void Death Pupil Talent, the Void to him was not much different from home ground.
Endless purple-gold radiance flickered around him, Jack Clark, wielding the War Halberd, did not speak but instead activated another force within his body with a thought.
Boom!
An even more powerful Power Explosion erupted from within Jack Clark, his entire body covered in purple-black Dragon Scales, a pair of forked dragon horns emerging on his head, and a tail shooting out behind him.
With the burst of Emperor Dragon Bloodline, Jack Clark’s already massive True Body of thirty thousand meters swelled even more, muscles bulging.
At the same time, the crimson eye at the center of the phantom Demon God’s face on his left opened wide.
Pshht!
A blood-colored crack in the Void ripped open behind Jack Clark, an infinite flood of blood light pouring out like the Milky Way, forming a hellish realm filled with blood-colored light.
And in the instant the Supreme Hell Plane descended, that blood light surged mightily into Jack Clark’s body.
Dark Star Apocalypse, Emperor Dragon Bloodline, coupled with the Supreme Plane Hell’s blood and power containment.
Instantly, Jack Clark, already at his limit, surged once more in aura, transforming into an apocalyptic Demon Dragon glowing with blood-red radiance, exuding an indescribable terror and pressure.
Boom, boom, boom!! The immensely strong presence permeated the Void, countless hidden Void Creatures within a hundred thousand kilometers exploded, instantly wiped clean.
Even the River of Time shook at this moment.
In a confrontation earlier, Jack Clark was instantly suppressed in absolute strength by Carthius.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1638 - 1638 610 Mythical Impact Causal Reversal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1638: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash_3 Chapter 1638: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash_3 The invincible and overbearing power that shattered space-time and everything within it had completely reached the True Spirit level, and coupled with the armor defense that disregarded the sharpness of the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, Jack Clark felt a tremendous pressure.
Therefore, he disregarded the consumption and instantly entered the peak state of a Limit Breakthrough.
“Let’s go again.”
Jack Clark let out a long howl, both human and dragon-like, and under the terrifying speed of the Speed Divine Power and the Bound Crossing Divine Ability, he appeared in front of Carthius, transcending time itself.
In his hand, the War Halberd imbued with the essence of Opening the Heavens shone, and in an instant, he swung it tens of thousands of times, even bursting the void itself.
Under the terrifying power, the world formed by the Supreme Abyss power crumbled instantly, resembling a ten-thousand-kilometer-wide demonic face composed of countless halberd skills, like a collapsing world.
Just as the Great Thousand Burial technique, the Eight Desolations Destruction, was executed, Carthius’s six arms combined and he violently tore through it.
The formless void, as well as the demonic face imbued with the power of Destroy Heaven and Earth, were all directly ripped apart by the explosive power of Carthius’s demon claw.
The power of destruction erupted.
The powerful force penetrated the void, sweeping across a radius of tens of thousands of kilometers, where pitch-black chains appeared, occasionally forming various phenomena.
Deep within the forbidden area of the battlefield, millions of kilometers away from the main battleground, space violently shattered.
Two terrifying figures descended with endless blood-colored radiance and a dark red glow, and upon touching the ground, the land within tens of thousands of kilometers exploded instantly.
“Human, come again.”
Carthius roared, stepping forward and appearing in front of Jack Clark. His true body, towering a hundred thousand meters tall, loomed oppressively as his six arms struck down at Jack Clark’s shoulders and head.
But Jack Clark’s figure slightly shimmered, and he disappeared from sight, entering the void once again.
“Where are you going?” Carthius’s face contorted menacingly, and his figure also flickered and vanished in an instant.
Boom, boom, boom!
At a level not even perceivable by the consciousness of a Mythical King, Jack Clark and Carthius pursued each other madly, clashing across hundreds of thousands of kilometers at a blink of an eye.
Wherever they passed, space exploded, and the earth shattered, occasionally breaking deep into the void causing heaven shattering and earth-splitting turmoil.
The powerful force stirred the Heavenly Earth Rules, and occasionally an invisible force swept across, instantly turning a million living beings to ashes.
This included three Demon Kings and two Immortal Spirit generals who were also directly annihilated.
Even space-time formed faults, turning into a forbidden death domain stretching tens of thousands of kilometers.
After entering the Triplex Extreme State, Jack Clark’s power could barely hold against Carthius, and although at a disadvantage, he managed to exchange blows back and forth.
The terrifying force of the two battlefields made the main battlefield, where more than twenty Demon Gods, Divine Kings, and Supreme Experts were clashing, seem dim and unimpressive.
While stunned by the tremendous power of the three, all the Divine Kings and Demon Gods of both races were somewhat shocked, astonished that Jack Clark could face two Great Demon Gods head-on in a two versus one.
This instantly greatly boosted the morale of everyone on the Human Alliance’s side.
However, they didn’t know that Jack Clark, who seemed to possess heavenly might, was growing more solemn.
Unlike his massive consumption during the Limit Breakthrough, both Tyris and Carthius were currently in their normal peak combat states.
With each exchange, his consumption was dozens of times that of his opponents.
Most importantly, the Time Clone facing Tyris was rapidly depleting the Power of Time within his body, which would disperse and vanish once exhausted.
At that moment, when Tyris’s two true bodies combined with Carthius, the heavily spent Jack Clark would instantly find himself in peril.
Clearly, this was the reason why the two Great Demon Gods were unhurried.
They were waiting, waiting for Jack Clark to reach his limit, at which point their chance to play their trump card and deliver a fatal strike would come.
Want to drag out the time? That suits me fine. Jack Clark, engaged in a fierce battle with Carthius, had a calm look in his eyes, without any hint of panic or unrest.
Meanwhile, within the Time Clone’s body, the broken Heavenly King True Body Mark pieces were continuously dispersing, releasing a relentless stream of Time Power.
Originally, to condense that Heavenly King Realm Time Mark, the Purple little dragon had nearly exhausted its Creation power, taking three days and three nights to succeed.
One could imagine how immense the Time Power contained within that Heavenly King True Body was.
However, continuing this way, Jack Clark’s ‘defeat’ was only a matter of time, as the difference in their realms was too great.
Compared to Jack Clark, who had just broken through to the Ancient Realm, Tyris and Carthius had been at the Peak of the Ancient for thousands of years, having reached their limits in every aspect long ago.
Especially after this time refining the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Immortal Spirit Clan, they took yet another step forward.
As they had said, if not for the Bloodline Shackles from their Purgatory ancestors, with their talents and accumulation, they would have already broken the boundaries and stepped into the True Spirit level.
But no one knew all this.
On the thundering main battlefield where explosions roared, a black purple Thunder Light flashed across the earth, turning each of the Nine Demonic Marked Purgatory True Demons wherever it passed into flying ash.
“Ha ha ha ha… before Daoist Master me, you guys who claim to be peerless within the same rank are completely incapable of withstanding a single blow.”
As Damon Lopes rampaged through the battlefield, deeply plunging into the enemy army slaughtering those Purgatory True Demons, the air above his head vibrated, and a gigantic black palm descended from the sky.
“Human, you are courting death.”
A demon king who was engaged with a Human King noticed Damon Lopes, turned, and left the battlefield to pounce toward him.
Because there were more of them, Leo Hart, who was clashing with another Mythical Peak demon king, could only watch the demon king leave.
Of course, mainly because the demon king’s target was Damon Lopes, there was no need to worry too much.

chapters.title: Chapter 1639 - 1639 610 Mythical Impact Causal Reversal
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1639: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash_4 Chapter 1639: Chapter 610: Mythical Impact, Causal Reversal Slash_4 Although this guy was only at the peak of Ninth Heaven Peak, just half a step away from entering the Legendary Realm, his combat strength surpassed that of an ordinary king-level, comparable to a Mid-Mythical Stage demon king.
As an awakened one who innately possessed the Power of Thunder, he had acquired the second Origin of Thunder on the Void Relic Continent.
Later, he obtained the Body Refining Technique of the Thunder Monarch, an Ancient Civilization taught by Jack Clark, and combined with the Chaotic Crystals he already possessed, he mastered two Higher-order Laws upon reaching the peak of Ninth Heaven.
Such talent could already be said to look down upon his peers.
In this generation, aside from the monstrous Jack Clark and the rising Glenn Clark, it was now evident that Damon Lopes possessed the highest talent.
The brutality of this battle exceeded everyone’s imagination, with hundreds of millions from the Human Race, Heavenly Feather Clan, Immortal Spirit Clan, and True Purgatory Demons, and hundreds of different races slaughtering each other on the Earth.
The battlefield stretched over tens of thousands of kilometers, with piercing roars and explosions filling the sky and the ground.
Various Law Radiance’s sparkled, with skies full of high-yield missiles, Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs, and Tactical Crystal Energy Nuclear Bombs flying overhead, occasionally being blown up by enemy demon kings.
That day, the entire Blue Star also fell into chaos, with red light pillars and pitch-black light beams flashing through Outer Space, disappearing deep into the Berlin Empire.
Every flash of light represented the activation of a Sky-based doomsday satellite, a deadline satellite.
