The invisible waves of destructive force, even from thousands of kilometers away, still shook the spirits of countless ordinary cultivators, leaving them dazed for a long time.
In the Simon Empire, at the edge of the rooftop of the three-thousand-meter-high Empire Tower, Mathilda Ward, with her silver hair flowing, looked up at the sky, showing a trace of concern in her eyes.
“The situation over there has reached this point, huh? All the Sky-based doomsday satellites, deadline satellites have been activated.”
“I wonder how my father, and he, are doing now.”
Due to certain reasons, Mathilda Ward, who was half a step into the Legendary Realm, did not go to the frontline battlefield but stayed on Blue Star as the person-in-charge of the Eastern Summer Empire, leading the competition team.
At this time, the interior of Blue Star was somewhat empty, with only a few Nine-fold Peak cultivators remaining as the strongest.
Including Marcellus Larry, who had guarded the world passageways for decades, had also gone to the frontline to join this crucial battle of extermination.
However, these ordinary people on Blue Star, including Glenn Clark and other cultivators, were unaware of this.
On the bustling streets of the Simon Empire, Glenn Clark, seeing a red light pillar piercing the atmosphere, excitedly shouted: “Brother Justin, Brother Marcus, look! Another Sky-based Annihilation Cannon has been fired.”
“Damn, the battle over there is so intense. I really want to go and see it,” Glenn said, his face showing longing.
Justin Welan showed a face full of regret and remorse, “If I had known that a Civilization War would erupt this soon, I wouldn’t have listened to Jack Clark and come back. I should have stayed on the battlefield.”
“Ha ha… serves you right. Coming back this time, not only did you fail to show off, but you’ve also become a green leaf to this guy Tiger, making him look even more dazzling.”
While saying this, Marcus Lindsay heartily patted Justin Welan’s shoulder, somewhat schadenfreude.
Fortunately, not everyone was kicking a man when he was down, Zac Maben comforted with a laugh, “No worries. After the global competition ends, we’ll all enter the Mythical World together.”
“Then, let’s make the Purgatory Demon Race flee in terror and let the Prestige of our Killing Squad resound across the battlefield.”
Justin Welan rolled his eyes, “You’re dreaming, Mr. Lewis. A Seventh Layer cultivation on the frontline battlefield is just cannon fodder, let alone commanding awe. Be careful not to even bring back your ashes.”
“Is it really that exaggerated?” White Veil was somewhat incredulous.
Compared to Justin Welan, who had participated in a Civilization War once, these guys had never entered the Mythical World and naturally didn’t know the cruelty of the frontline battlefield.
While these carefree guys discussed their future ventures into the Mythical World and how to dominate, the battle in the forbidden area became increasingly fierce.
Under the massive assault of the Purgatory Legion, the Human Alliance kept retreating, one position after another flattened, consumed by rolling darkness.
Including the Mythical King battlefield and Heavenly King battlefield above Firmament, the Human Alliance was at a disadvantage and suppressed.
Even Adam Garcetti and others who suppressed the Ninefold Heavenly Palace faced ever-increasing pressure as the demon gods unleashed various Bloodline Divine Powers and Secret Skills, pulling the Dark Demon Realm into a frenzied drain.
Thirteen Demon Gods, led by three emperor-level authorities of peak ancient strength, repeatedly attacked, continuously shattering the Ninefold Heavenly Palace with their powerful shockwaves.
The only one who seemed at ease was the Divine King Troy.
His Avatar held off a Demon God while his True Body, still possessing the peak ancient combat strength, bravely confronted an emperor-level authority and a Demon God without falling behind.
As time slipped away, a day passed in the blink of an eye.
The Human’s position retreated a hundred thousand kilometers, and to both sides, boundless black demon air eroded an additional six hundred thousand kilometers deep.
Just when everyone thought the war would continue, Jack Clark’s Avatar, who was clashing with Troy, suddenly solidified; the surrounding time distorted, transforming into a skyful of silver radiance that dissipated.
This sudden change caused even Troy to pause slightly, then, with terrifying murderous intent in his eyes, he abruptly turned his head to gaze a million kilometers away.
“Darren Callum!” His roar, laden with terrifying murderous intent, echoed through Heaven and Earth.
Suddenly, Troy’s aura surged, and another True Body of the same gigantic size, a hundred thousand meters tall, emerged from the depths of the Abyss and pounced towards Troy.
Boom!
With the fusion of Troy’s two Demon God True Bodies, heaven and earth shook, and a terrifying power that twisted space-time burst forth, unleashing an endless black radiance.
At that moment, the entire world plunged into darkness, lit only by the figure of a Demon God, holding a dark demon blade, radiating a presence as terrifying as that of a True Spirit Level entity.
The dreadful aura shook the entire forbidden area battlefield, making Adam Garcetti and the others’ faces pale dramatically.
“It’s bad, Jack Clark’s Time Clone has been shattered!”
Feeling the disappearance of one of Jack Clark’s auras, the faces of the many Demon Gods besieging them twisted into savage smiles, “Humans, your end has come.”
Instantly, even more powerful auras burst forth from all the Demon Gods, burning their Origins in a desperate struggle.
According to the plan, at the moment Troy and the others made their move, the final battle officially began.
Boom!
A black blade light, like a streak of light, flashed past; beneath its path, all things ceased, rules were destroyed, and it shook space-time as it slashed towards Jack Clark, who was clashing with Carthius.
And just as Troy erupted, Carthius, who had been fiercely battling Jack Clark for an entire day, had the madness in his eyes vanish, replaced by an incomparably cold, calm demeanor.
Behind him, in one of his demon claws, appeared a simplistic ancient black lamp.
The lamp, wrapped in black, snake-like demon patterns, emitted a strange and terrifying aura.
The moment the black serpent demon lamp appeared, boundless darkness devoured fifty thousand kilometers, plunging all life into total darkness, halting consciousness and thought, erasing all perception.
This scene was somewhat reminiscent of Jack Clark’s innate ability with the Void Double Pupils, Void Descent, only on a much larger scale and with greater power. Under that nearly conceptual dark force, even Demon God Level Powerhouses lost all perception instantly, including their reactions to murderous intent.
Thoughtless, without life or death.
In the silent darkness that arose, sharp black bone spurs grew from Carthius’s back, making him like a terrifying dark slaughter Demon God.
His double claws wrapped in pure black smoke, reversed causality and instantaneously appeared at Jack Clark’s chest.
Meanwhile, Troy had already charged into the darkness, and along with Carthius, appeared on Jack’s left and right, swinging a terrifying blade.
At this moment, it was a deadly assault.
But just then, in front of Jack Clark, there appeared a hundred-meter-long crystal red crystal, radiating light, releasing an energy so astonishing that it shocked everyone.
Boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 1640 - 1640 611 Civilization Flames Mythical Impact
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1640: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst Chapter 1640: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst As the golden-red crystals appeared in an instant, the two Great Demon Kings felt a strong sense of danger from above.
But before they could react, the strength of the Dorsal Fin Crystal’s Doomsday Rule, sealed and condensed within, was unleashed by Jack Clark’s soul will with the same origin.
Boom!
In the pitch-black Void, devoid of any material elements and permeated by endless contaminating energy, a dazzling golden supernova appeared.
Like a golden sphere of heated material, its surface danced with red lightning, emanating an horrific high temperature exceeding a billion degrees Celsius, annihilating everything.
The expansion speed even surpassed ‘light’, transcending time to form a Golden Sun of a hundred thousand kilometers across the sky.
But after expanding to its limit, the golden star did not explode violently; instead, it stretched across the Void like a true Sun, burning fiercely.
Beneath the terrifying intense power, space-time warped and melted everything. It radiated endless light and heat down into the Material World, appearing on the right side of the central battlefield in the forbidden area.
In an instant, blinding light pierced Heaven and Earth, lighting up the night sky as if it were day, and even the moonlight from the Blood Moon was scattered.
The terrifying energy shook the entire forbidden area battlefield as invisible and pervasive True Spirit Level Power Pressure enveloped over two million kilometers. Countless people trembled instinctively under the aura of the Emperor Dragon.
Including those with Purgatory Bloodline under the domain of the Lord of the Dark Demon Realm, even demon kings and the Great Demon King felt an indescribable suppression from an invisible power, weakening their aura.
Just then, the Golden Sun suddenly collapsed inward and then exploded with a thunderous boom.
Boom! Over a hundred thousand kilometers of Heaven and Earth collapsed, the Earth melted away, and the blast from the explosion unleashed a golden shockwave sweeping across more than two hundred thousand kilometers, destroying everything.
At the center of the explosion, amidst the wild chaotic currents, Jack Clark stood holding his War Halberd, his purple-gold hair whipping like flames behind him, surrounded by rings of shimmering multicolored energy halos, his aura immense.
Because of the same origin of souls, the power of the Doomsday Rule imbued with the will of the Destruction Emperor Dragon invisibly grazed past Jack Clark when the Great Sun Flame Power exploded.
Only the destructive force that erupted would indiscriminately attack, causing him harm.
But now, lacking the protection of rules with the might of True Spirit Level, these incandescent impacts that could melt space-time only caused Jack Clark’s aura to roil slightly.
After all, at this moment, Jack Clark’s strength approached infinitely close to True Spirit Level.
And tens of thousands of kilometers away, the Great Demon Kings, Tyris and Carthius, standing amidst the fierce chaos, fared much worse.
On their true bodies, towering a hundred thousand meters high and enveloped in the power of rules, appeared crimson cracks. The surrounding Abyss World they conjured shattered under the explosion.
The two Great Demon Kings were barely stronger than ancient creatures, their strength just breaking through the Ancient Limit, comparable to those newly ascended True Spirits, but essentially they remained ancient beings.
At this moment, they still had faint golden-red lightning flickering on them, which were the Doomsday Destruction Rules of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Under the power of the Supreme Rule, which was nearly fully accomplished, each time the red lightning exploded, their surrounding Dark Rules and Abyssal Rules instantly collapsed, their flesh and blood flying.
Nevertheless, this power was quickly extinguished one by one under the erosion of the origins of the Great Demon Kings’ rules.
With the rule’s suppression no longer present, the wounds on both Great Demon Kings healed in the blink of an eye. They then looked solemnly at Jack Clark’s shoulder, focusing on the remaining two crystal decorations that seemed like wings.
Previously overlooked by them, mistaken for mere adornments on Jack Clark’s battle armor, they never expected them to contain such terrifying destructive powers.
Tyris spoke slowly, his voice deep, “This power, it must be from that Summoned Giant Beast, right? To think that after I destroyed your Summoning Altar, you still had this trick up your sleeve.”
As he spoke, a cold sneer flashed in Tyris’s eyes, “That Giant Beast’s power is indeed strong, even we cannot defend against the destructive force released in that instant.”
“Just now you only have two left. If we endure a bit of injury to block them, you will still be left with no escape.”
Jack Clark’s lips curved slightly, noncommittally responding, “You’re right, but how can you be so sure that I only have two Dorsal Fin Destruction Crystals?”
The two Great Demon Kings’ expressions turned solemn.
Under normal conditions, such things couldn’t possibly be all on one’s person to be seen by enemies; humans, with their cunning and deceit, might have many more in hand.
But just as the Great Demon Kings paused for a moment, a terrifying murderous intent burst forth from them.
“Even if you have more of these one-time forbidden weapons, what of it?”
Instantly, the Void ruptured, and an overbearing Black Blade Light cut through Heaven and Earth, creating a black grand canyon tens of thousands of kilometers long before Jack Clark.
The Will of the Great Thousand surged around Jack Clark, his aura brilliant with divine light.
His hundred-thousand-meter-long dark-golden War Halberd thrust toward the heavens, entwined with golden-white lightning, and as the space-time crumbled under the pressure of the most powerful and rigid rules, a terrible slash ensued.
Under the fearsome strike, the Transparent Power of rules that surrounded Jack Clark over tens of thousands of kilometers shattered, impacting against the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd.
Boom!
Under the dreadful strike, even Jack Clark’s stature sank, the newly repaired layers of space below him shattered once more, plunging him back into the depths of the Void.
Even in the presence of the merged True Bodies of Tyris, Jack Clark was momentarily overpowered.
But just as he plunged into the depths of the Void, the eight arms on Jack Clark’s back furiously stretched out, one of them wielding the golden-white Great Sun hammering towards the rear on the right.
Boom!
A dazzling golden-white Light Sphere exploded, expanding rapidly and instantly becoming a Sun of ten thousand kilometers in diameter, stretching between Carthius and Jack Clark.

chapters.title: Chapter 1641 - 1641 611 Civilization Flames Mythical Impact
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1641: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst_2 Chapter 1641: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst_2 Under the Carthius’s six-arm strike filled with absolute power, the World-Destroying Great Sun exploded and shattered instantly.
In the turbulent flow of destructive power, an ancient red abyss world surrounded Carthius, releasing an extremely powerful and evil aura targeting Jack Clark.
But just at that moment, a grey radiance filled with the scent of death enveloped it, and above the Void, a death grindstone the size of ten thousand kilometers appeared, covering the sky and distorting the boundary between life and death.
Just then, the Void collapsed and a fist enshrouded in black smoke appeared beneath the grindstone.
Boom!
Purely domineering, as if the pinnacle of the Rule of Power, the Death Grindstone exploded violently, dispersing as circles of pure death power spread over hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Under that death aura of Rule Level, countless monsters in the Void, unable to escape in time, stiffened instantly. They decayed and turned to dust.
Having fused the world-class weapon into his True Body, all powers including the bloodline were refined, making Carthius’s power unimaginably pure and powerful to the peak of ancient levels.
Just as Carthius was blocked, Tyris had already instantly struck over a thousand blows.
The terrifying blade light was incomparably sharp, nearly annihilating a hundred thousand kilometers of the Void into purer nothingness, making Jack Clark continuously retreat, his Qi Blood boiling.
Boom!!
Behind Jack, dazzling golden diamond-shaped radiance vibrated, and a pair of pitch-black ferocious claws emerged from behind his waist.
This strike, containing the power to reverse causality, was too fast for even Jack to block. The Divine Power of absolute defense managed to block it only for an instant before being torn apart.
Boom! As countless golden crystalline shards exploded, the demon claw containing a World-Penetrating Power struck Jack’s back in an instant.
Boom! Under the Terrifying Power, the Demon God Dark World Battle Armor fiercely collapsed, covered in cracks.
However, after being blocked by the Divine Power of absolute defense, and just a step away from becoming a world-class armor defense, this strike only made Jack spit blood.
But just then, Carthius suddenly disappeared.
Just as Carthius vanished, Jack’s War Halberd swept back, emitting dazzling golden-white radiance. The halberd’s tip, bearing the intent of Opening the Heavens, passed across his neck.
Had the strike landed, even the world-class weapon’s battle armor would have been split open.
In the instant Carthius was repelled, the space and time around Jack distorted, disappearing at speeds surpassing temporal perception, instantly turned to nothingness by the overbearingly relentless blade lights.
Hundreds of thousands of kilometers away, Jack’s gaze was icy and grave.
Trouble. One Great Demon King was already pressuring him greatly, now with two Great Demon Kings working together, he was injured in the blink of an eye.
Now that the situation had come to this, there was no way to retreat, only fight desperately, trying to delay.
Just as countless thoughts flashed through Jack’s mind, on the right side, the previously closed eyes of the ethereal Demon-God Facade suddenly opened.
Instantly, the entire Void plunged into absolute darkness, enveloping hundreds of thousands of kilometers. This scene somewhat resembled the Black Serpent Demon Lamp in Carthius’s hand.
Although smaller in scope and might, it still suppressed the perception of the two Great Demon Kings, making it difficult for them to determine Jack’s location.
The Void Death Pupil’s Void Descent power, deploying in the deeper Void, had its might amplified several times.
And at the moment of the Void’s Descent, a pair of huge Black Gold vertical pupils emerged in the darkness, their eyes harboring terrifying smashing power, gazing towards Tyris.
Boom!
The Void surrounding Tyris within ten thousand kilometers burst apart, the powerful tearing force even shattering time and space, this strike powerful enough to grind a True Demon God Body to dust.
But… “Get lost!”
A roar shaking the Void exploded, a pitch-dark dazzling blade light soared into the sky, the tangible Pupil Power was instantly split, along with the dark Sky Curtain of the Void.
While the dark Sky Curtain blocked the two Great Demon Kings, the empty arms behind Jack reached into space-time, ‘slowly’ pulling out a towering Stone Gate, ancient in its entirety and black in color.
The black Stone Gate stood in front of Jack, instantly blocking the unavoidable, dark double fists born from reversing causation.
Boom!
Strong and Overbearingly Dominant, the Stone Gate vibrated, followed immediately by a force several times stronger rebounding, creating rings of black impacts that destroyed space-time.
Boom, boom, boom! Under the multiplied rebounding force, Carthius’s shape shook, stepping back several paces, reappearing tens of thousands of kilometers away surrounded by distorted space-time.
Looking at that towering black Stone Gate in the Void, Carthius was slightly stunned, thinking his punch would have injured Jack.
This Stone Gate, Jack had originally obtained from a deep ancient relic of the Divine Gods Alliance, belonging to a gateway of the inner world of a being who had once strived for higher realms but fell.
That being, Jack estimated to be at the True Spirit peak evolution, for just one door of the inner world to be so solid, remaining undecayed for who knows how many tens of thousands of years.
And this Stone Gate, after being refined by Jack, had always served as a suppressive relic of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, never been used before.
The reason being, it consumed a lot, so much that Jack still couldn’t use it easily.
Moreover, this Stone Gate, possessing only traits like suppression and incredible solidity and lacking the power bestowed to weapons like the War Halberd or Demon Blade, normally had ‘little use’.
But at this moment, it was perfectly suited to withstand that unstoppable attack from Carthius.
Feeling the power inside swiftly depleting, Jack’s eyes sharpened, the surrounding Void suddenly collapsed, sinking deeper into the Void.
“Darren Callum, where are you going.”
The Dark Demon Blade, surpassing light and time, slashed through space-time, instantly appearing in front of Jack.

chapters.title: Chapter 1642 - 1642 611 Civilization Flames Mythical Impact
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1642: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst_3 Chapter 1642: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst_3 “`
Boom!
The Demon Blade clashed with the weighty Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, unleashing a terrifying strength. The invisible sharpness even sliced a crack in the golden diamond-shaped radiance surrounding Jack Clark.
At the instant Jack was restrained by Tyris’s blade, the figure of Carthius appeared silently behind him, six fists clenched, exuding pure nothingness and darkness beneath them.
Boom!
The fist, infused with a destroy heaven and earth power, struck the black stele, sending powerful vibrations through it, and blasting Jack Clark along with it into the air.
“Don’t hold back anymore, Tyris.”
Carthius roared, with dozens of dark red Rule Chains emerging behind him, like ribbons dancing in the air, and his aura instantly increased several fold.
Seeing Jack Clark, who still had cards up his sleeve and barely managed to defend, Carthius burned a tenth of his Origin.
Upon seeing this, Tyris roared and a stream of black gold blood sprayed from his mouth onto the Dark Demon Blade.
Buzz!
The overbearing Dark Demon Blade trembled, countless blood threads linking it to Tyris’s arm like veins, drawing in the surrounding Abyss World into the blade with a powerful suction.
Boom!
In an instant, an even stronger and sharper presence burst forth from the Demon Blade, its radiance brilliant, leaving the entire world with nothing but the dark glow of the blade.
“Fighting to the death, is it? Then bring it on,” Jack Clark howled, his body igniting in golden-white flames.
Not only was he burning Rule Origin, but at this moment his life force began to burn as well, his aura instantly soaring tenfold, the powerful energy erupting in a dazzling blaze in all directions.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
An even more brutal battle broke out, the collision of strength comparable to that of ordinary True Spirit Level made the space-time crumble, the Void pierced, turning into three dazzling radiance in the Material World.
The two Great Demon Kings, having already gauged Jack’s limits, gave him no respite, pressing him with a relentless assault, aiming to shatter his will without wavering.
As for the explosive power of the Dorsal Fin Crystal in Jack’s hands, it mattered little as long as it couldn’t heavily injure them in an instant or pose a threat to their lives.
At worst, they would go into Closed-door Cultivation for ten or a hundred years after this battle.
But Jack’s True Body was exceedingly powerful and essentially not a mere vessel of pure Rule energy but a physique that had undergone thousands of Evolutions.
Hence his recovery, vitality, and resilience were beyond imagination, seemingly endless in life force.
Under the joint effort of the two Great Demon Kings, Jack’s True Body was battered with fractures and wounds, which healed in the blink of an eye, without any loss to his Rule Origin.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark fiercely held his ground against the two Great Demon Kings,
On the frontlines, as Adam Garcetti and others, who stood against the Lord of the Empire Carotis, witnessed this scene, they erupted in a howl, the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel shining with intense light.
Boom! Like the power of a Yin-Yang world, a space of a thousand kilometers collapsed, and the formidable energy even repelled Carotis.
Having repulsed Carotis, Adam, with Rule Manifestation of life and death behind him, his feet on the black and white light said, “Primordial, this place is yours to handle; I’ll go help Jack.”
Primordial suddenly looked up, “Adam, are you planning to use that power… Don’t we still have hope?”
Adam’s expression remained calm, “We can’t wait any longer. The strength of those two Great Demon Kings surpassed our expectations. Jack can’t hold out for much longer, let alone stall them for ‘five days’.”
Based on the descriptions by the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Immortal Spirit King, everyone knew the two Great Demon Kings were formidable, nearly invincible in the Demon God Realm.
But Jack’s strength was also immense, on par with a demi True Spirit, together with a Time Clone of equivalent realm strength.
Hence before the battle began, Adam and the others felt that even if Jack couldn’t match the two Great Demon Kings, he wouldn’t be much weaker, and stalling a confrontation for three days should be no problem.
By then, with the support of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace and a frontal clash against those Demon Kings, combined with the God Defense System of the Sky-based God King, they should be able to hold out until the Giant Beast legions arrived.
However, unexpectedly, the two Great Demon Kings proved so overwhelmingly strong that the Time Clone only lasted a day before being ‘exploded’, with Jack being suppressed and continuously injured.
It couldn’t go on for much longer.
Thus, as his words fell, a pure white flame suddenly ignited around Adam, with an indescribable aura spreading between heaven and earth.
This aura didn’t bear the overpowering strength or the might to destroy heaven and earth, but an indescribable weight, ancient and time-worn.
As if it were a scroll through history, unfolding slowly with the burning of the white flame around Adam, vaguely forming visions of mountains and rivers, sun, moon, and stars.
The sudden change caught all of the Divine Kings and Immortal Kings of the alliance, as well as the more than ten Demon Gods on the opposite side, off guard.
“Stop him, we can’t let him assist Jack.”
Seeing Adam obviously activating some explosive Secret Skill, Carotis roared, the Blood-Red Demon Blade in his hand surging with light.
Boom!
Blood-Red radiance reflected heaven and earth, instantly tearing a crack over twenty thousand kilometers long in the Earth, with Heavenly Earth Rules severed beneath the blade’s light.
Facing this attack, Adam, with ever more vigorous white flames covering him, simply brandished the Wheel.
Boom!
Ignited with the white flame, the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel manifested as a shadow ten thousand kilometers wide, filled with Invisible Power capable of destroying the world.
Bang!
The blood-red light of the blade, lasting thousands of kilometers, disintegrated, and Carotis’s face changed drastically, his figure vanishing with a bang into a Dark Red Glow amidst the rolling Dark Demon Air.
In this moment, as he burned his Soul Source, Life Origin, and True Body of Rules, along with the entire Inheritance power of the ‘Human Race’, Adam’s realm transcended infinitely, vaguely stepping into another level.

chapters.title: Chapter 1643 - 1643 611 Civilization Flames Mythical Impact
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1643: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst_4 Chapter 1643: Chapter 611: Civilization Flames, Mythical Impact Burst_4 The one who had been directly pressing against him, Carotis, was blasted away with a single strike, immensely powerful.
Yet, the cost was enormous to the point that even the Golden Winged Divine King and others remained silent.
Because after only burning for the span of two breaths, Adam Garcetti had already ‘disappeared’ a bit, bits of white ash dancing around him, dissipating.
At this rate, he might burn into nothingness in no more than a day, completely dissipate and fall.
Tolstoy couldn’t help but speak, “Speaker Garcetti, is this worth it?”
At this moment, Adam Garcetti’s expression was incredibly calm, and he slowly spoke, “It’s worth it, for my duty is to protect civilization, protect the Human Race, and Jack Clark is the ‘person’ I am meant to protect.”
“In this battle, anyone from the Human Race can die, including me, Primordial one, and Heavenly Base, but Jack Clark must survive. As long as he is here, our race continues.”
“Primordial one, after I leave, it’ll be up to you.”
A voice filled with a heavy historical aura resonated between heaven and earth, as Adam Garcetti’s palm reached into the Void and appeared before the Primordial True King, his fingertip flickering with a white flame.
In the instant that everyone watched that flame, it was as if they saw a glorious, prosperous, even radiant civilization touching their souls, unforgettable.
Wind Heavenly King’s eyes widened in disbelief in that instant, showing a color of incredulity, “How is it possible? The Fire of Civilization, the Human Race actually condensed the brilliance of inheritance.”
Once, the Wind Heavenly King had seen records of the Fire of Civilization in a relic, faint phrases left behind.
When a race’s civilization grows strong to a certain extent, if an Immortal Emperor, skilled in the power of luck, acts, they can extract the historical luck of that race and condense the light of inheritance to protect civilization.
As long as the Fire of Civilization exists, this ‘race’ exists, and even if it perishes one day, there’s the hope of rising anew.
And this was the reason for Wind Heavenly King’s astonishment; how could the Human Race, possessing only three Immortal King-level strong men, condense the Fire of Civilization?
Could it be… Just as Wind Heavenly King’s mind was shaken, that white flame had already silently merged into the body of Primordial True King.
And all of this happened in an instant.
After passing the Fire of Civilization to the Primordial True King, Adam Garcetti transformed into a sky full of white radiance and disappeared in an instant, appearing a million kilometers away.
“Jack Clark, leave Tyris to me.”
Holding the Divine Wheel, stepping on life and death, Adam Garcetti appeared like the first streak of Yin-Yang radiance when opening heaven and earth, instantly plunging into the battlefield amidst the burning white flames.
The Divine Wheel, with a diameter reaching ten thousand kilometers, appeared like a Yin-Yang world unto its own, with spaces distorting and layers of world phantoms emerging around it, as if encircling endless multiverses.
Three dark blade lights aimed at Jack Clark shook, tearing through the layers of world phantoms, finally intersecting with the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel and emitting dazzling radiance and a Destructive Impact.
Boom! Heaven and earth shook, and above ten thousand kilometers of the Firmament, rings of black and white halos exploded, sweeping across an area of a hundred thousand kilometers.
Jack Clark was startled, “Speaker Garcetti.”
Standing in the Void, with white flames rising tens of thousands of meters high, Adam Garcetti turned back with a faint smile, “Compared to us old folks, you are more important.”
“Also, don’t forget the Void Secret Sea.”
Watching the increasingly magnificent and sacred aura of Adam Garcetti, a horrifying killing intent appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes, and the radiance from the Eight Desolate War Halberd surged, “Carthius, let’s go again.”
Boom!
Holding weapons equal to two World-class weapons and also burning his Life Origin for a Limit Breakthrough, Jack Clark’s combat power was nearly on par with Carthius.
The battle that erupted instantaneously was even more fierce.
And this time, Jack Clark fought in a manner accepting mutual destruction with Carthius, venting the killing intent and fury in his heart.
The killing intent stemmed from the fact that no matter the outcome of this war, Adam Garcetti was destined to fall.
Although the Void Secret Sea possessed the ability for ‘Resurrection’, would Adam Garcetti, resurrected with the power of the Void, still be the Garcetti who had protected the Human Race for decades?
For this legislator who had sheltered the Human Race and dedicated everything to his people, including once taking care of Jack Clark in many aspects, Jack had always held respect.
Now, watching helplessly as he walked towards death, that sense of powerlessness made Jack Clark extremely furious.
If not for the rationality still present in his heart, he would have already summoned the True Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to descend and directly tear apart the two Great Demon Kings.
But that was not possible.
These Demon Gods, linking to the Dark Demon Realm to initiate a War of Extermination, once the significantly stronger Destruction Emperor Dragon True Body descended, with strength akin to a mature True Spirit, there was a high probability it would awaken the Purgatory ancestors.
And even if the Purgatory ancestors were not awakened, under the threat of death, there would certainly be a Demon God sacrifice, forcefully awakening that ancestor.
Thus, they had to wait until the Giant Beast True Body arrived.
And while Jack Clark and Adam Garcetti joined forces, staunchly confronting the two Great Demon Kings, the aftershocks of the battle nearly collapsed the Forbidden Area’s battlefield on the right side spanning a million kilometers, the direct frontline’s Demon Gods also launched a frenzied counterattack.
‘It’s impossible to delay for five days’, from this phrase, these Demon Gods acutely sensed that these humans still had some tricks up their sleeves.
It seemed that if they just held on, there would be hope for turning defeat into victory.
In an instant, under the assault of thirteen Demon Gods leading the Dark Demon Realm, the nearly twenty thousand kilometers wide Ninefold Heavenly Palace let out an overwhelmed trembling roar.
Just then, after Adam Garcetti left and their strength weakened, all eight Divine Kings and Immortal Kings present changed their expressions dramatically, their pressure surging.
But under the blood-red moonlight, as the battle grew even more horrendous, with billions of living beings frantically fighting, an indescribable majestic roar sounded from deep within the mythical world.
Instantly, the entire world shook, heaven and earth thundered,
An invisible impact swept across the entire mythical world, awakening countless ancient and powerful beings.
Above the Firmament, dozens of stars shone, and in a distant place invisible from the earth, even more stars flashed by.
The originally obscured moonlight by the Blood Moon shone brightly, followed by several terrifying roars echoing through heaven and earth.
Under that vast majestic roar covering the entire mythical world, three golden, red, and blue Great Suns rose at the end of the night sky, emitting terrifying radiance that obscured heaven and earth.
The Great Suns crossed, with twin moons sharing the sky, such terrifying phenomena caused the entire world to fall into chaos, the rules of Heaven and Earth tremored, and laws manifested.
The invisible pressure made the two warring races subconsciously repel their opponents and look up at the sky.
“The second impact, it has erupted.”
[Just a little bit more, refreshing in ten minutes]

chapters.title: Chapter 1644 - 1644 612 Tearing Apart the Solar System
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1644: Chapter 612: Tearing Apart the Solar System, Shattering the Great Demon King Chapter 1644: Chapter 612: Tearing Apart the Solar System, Shattering the Great Demon King [The plot details of yesterday’s chapter have been adjusted a bit; due to it being finished quite late, there was no time for meticulous revision, resulting in some flaws.]
With that roar echoing through the depths of the mythical world, an invisible impact swept across the vast world.
In an instant, countless small ‘bubbles’, complete world fragments attached to the deep space cracks in the mythical world and interlayers of crystal walls, exploded like brilliant fireworks.
Including the Blue Star World, the entire solar system trembled under that invisible impact.
Centered around the sun, at the edge of an area of over thirty billion kilometers in diameter, an invisible transparent film appeared in the pitch-dark cosmic space.
This film, like a giant transparent dome, enveloped the solar system, its boundary over one hundred and thirty billion kilometers away from the nearest Neptune, majestic and immense beyond imagination.
The moment this transparent film appeared, it was detected by the research base floating millions of kilometers above the atmosphere of Blue Star, drifting in space.
Inside the base, resembling a colossal floating island, an elder exuding the aura of a Heavenly King, yet with unimaginably aged white hair and beard, spoke gravely,
“Is this our ‘world’s boundary’? It has been completely seized by the mythical world.”
Despite being a Heavenly King with vigorous vitality, a faint sense of decay permeated this elder’s being,
like an ordinary old man nearing the end of his life.
Boom!
At that moment, an even more intense impact swept through the solar system, and the vast transparent film trembled slightly, then the entire world seemed to plummet suddenly.
Huge, boundless spherical light film slowly sank into the void, the space around it distorted, forming rings of twisted transparent cracks spreading out in all directions.
As the distance was too vast, ordinary people on Blue Star felt nothing at all.
They could hardly imagine that at this moment, the entire solar system appeared like a giant, boundless ‘bubble’, beginning to fall into the mythical world under the pull of an invisible force.
Beneath the surface of the sun, twenty thousand kilometers deep, Number One’s eyes suddenly lit up, emitting dazzling blue-white radiance.
“The Second Mythical Impact, has it finally begun?”
At this moment, Number One’s overall form became more slender, its entire body covered with golden-white luxurious armor resembling skin, the surface of the Mecha adorned with mysterious rune matrix patterns.
The aura was immensely vast; tangible golden energy formed halos around it, creating a thousand-kilometer vacuum even under the tremendous pressure within the terrifying star.
In this area swirled only the pure scorching golden energy material, with Number One at the center standing like a Creator God, its demeanor immensely majestic.
As the heart of that ancient being was completed deep within Number One, and Freya Louise replaced the soul to form a complete entity, Number One’s strength skyrocketed at a terrifying speed.
Fundamentally, Number One was not about cultivation but about absorbing energy centered on the heart, reconstituting flesh and blood from scratch, and resurrecting strength.
Unfortunately, time was still too short.
Inside Number One, Freya Louise, now an energy form, exhibited a hint of regret in her eyes.
If she had been given another six months to absorb enough stellar energy, Number One may not have regained its past strength but would at least have completed reshaping its true body.
By then, she would be one hundred percent confident in supporting the solar system.
However, she might not be able to withstand the intense imprint wash from the all-gathered remnant souls of that ancient existence, an example of gains and losses.
Feeling the third completed reshaping of the true body, Freya Louise moved her realm of thought, and Number One instantly transformed into a beam of pure light flying toward the depths of the sun.
Boom, boom, boom, boom!!
Moving rapidly, Number One collided intensely with the star material every moment, each causing indescribably terrifying explosions on its surface.
Yet these destructive energies, which could injure ordinary Demon Gods, could not shake the golden-white luxurious armor on Number One.
The stellar energy absorbed during this period was controlled by Freya Louise, prioritizing the reconstitution of Number One’s surface armor.
Or rather, this layer of reconstituted armor essentially comprised scale armor from a mighty ancient being, incredibly strong and solid.
This was Freya Louise’s reliance on piloting Number One into the star.
The deeper Number One plunged, the surrounding stellar pressure surged exponentially; the condensed tangible scorching energy materials reached temperatures of tens of millions of Celsius.
Here, nuclear fusion occurred every moment, releasing energy and terrifying radiation capable of instantly destroying all planets in the solar system, energy pulses.
Yet, when Number One was just one hundred thousand kilometers from the sun’s core, its rapidly descending form suddenly slowed.
By then, the pressure was indescribably immense, comparable to a white dwarf. Even the Super God Energy inside Number One, comparable to the Rule, somewhat struggled to withstand.
Yet that ‘hollow’ was still over ten thousand kilometers away.
To bear the world, to uphold the heavens, Number One had to enter it.
Roar!
The heavily compressed form of Number One roared towards the heavens, its golden-white armor instantly ignited, releasing tens of times more terrifying strength.
Boom! The surrounding compressed hot materials exploded, and in that moment, Number One nearly transformed into a pure diamond-shaped radiance.
Burning part of its true body as the price, Number One surged through ten thousand kilometers rapidly, now just three thousand kilometers from that hollow.
Here, under atmospheric pressure exceeding two hundred billion times, space-time itself was squeezed to collapse. Number One’s manifested diamond-shaped radiance was compressed from fifteen thousand meters to just over three thousand.

chapters.title: Chapter 1645 - 1645 612 Tearing Apart the Solar System
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1645: Chapter 612: Tearing Apart the Solar System, Exploding the Great Demon King_2 Chapter 1645: Chapter 612: Tearing Apart the Solar System, Exploding the Great Demon King_2 The entire “person” was like steel forged through rigorous training, shrunk down several times.
“Still not enough.”
Boom!
The upper half of Number One’s body armor burst into flames, unleashing an even more ferocious and powerful Power Explosion, emitting a dazzling radiance that pierced through everything and surged into that invisible Hollow.
The moment Number One burst into that point, the oppressive destruction of Space-Time surrounding it vanished instantly, replaced by a white sphere of light.
Staring at it, seemingly infinitely large yet floating at an infinitely distant place, resembling a planet with a diameter of thousands of kilometers, Freya Louise had a feeling of gazing upon the entire Solar System.
“So this, is this the Heart of the World where our world was born? We’ve finally reached this stage,” Freya Louise whispered softly, then her consciousness began to return.
And this time, it wasn’t just her will returning; that part of her consciousness that had fused and invisibly become part of the Heavenly Dao as the Primitive Azure Sky was also being pulled.
Acting as an intermediary between the two ‘worlds’, tempted by the freshly born Heart of the World, the sinking Solar System suddenly shook violently.
Immediately above the Solar System, the transparent membrane changed to azure.
That azure radiance obscured the Firmament, reflecting down and dying the atmosphere of Blue Star into aquamarine, clearing and greening the cloudless sky.
The sudden change left everyone on Blue Star in shock.
In the capital of the Simon Empire, at the opening ceremony of the Global Martial Arts Competition, hundreds of geniuses from various countries and over a hundred thousand spectators were in awe as they looked up at the gradually changing azure sky.
Zac Maben wondered aloud, “What’s happening? Why is the sky changing?”
Beside him, Marcus Lindsay stroked his chin, “Although I don’t know what’s happened, it feels like something powerful.”
“Obviously, the freaking sky has changed; how could it not be intense?” Justin Welan rolled his eyes.
Surrounded by a few people, the taller and more formidable Glenn Clark looked up at the transitioning azure Firmament, feeling an inexplicable tremor deep within, slightly dazed.
“Our world’s sky has changed.”
“I, I think I see Sister Freya Louise; she’s walking towards the throne step by step…”
Seeing the slightly dazed Glenn Clark, Justin Welan and the others were taken aback, “Freya, didn’t she go to the Frontline Battlefield? What throne are you talking about?”
Justin’s words snapped Glenn out of his daze, bringing him back to his senses.
In the main seat of the audience, with silvery hair and dragon horns on her head, Mathilda Ward’s expression suddenly became grave as she stood up abruptly: “The Mythical Impact has burst ahead of time!”
Saying this, Mathilda Ward looked towards her secretary with a commanding tone, “Immediately notify all countries, all cities, sound the air raid alarms and relocate to the outskirts for assembly.”
“Yes, general!”
In less than a minute, the shrill air raid alarms were set off globally, and millions of regular troops of Blue Star and lower-level Transcendent Special Forces mobilized towards the nearest cities.
The law enforcement teams in those cities also received orders to mobilize and maintain order.
Suddenly, the entire Blue Star World was plunged into chaos, with countless people bewildered, moving towards the outskirts of the cities in accordance with the flow of people, amidst the piercing alarms and broadcasts.
While the entire Blue Star was engulfed in chaos, up in the Firmament, centered around the Human Territory in the mythical world, the clouds across millions of kilometers also kept trembling and collapsing.
Looking up high in the firmament, a massive, boundless world phantom began to emerge and plummet towards this Space-Time, this Earth at an alarming speed.
“Humanity, your doom is sealed.”
“Ha ha ha ha… With the passing of three days under the same sky, the major changes of the Vast World have reached your world, and it seems you insignificant insects are doomed.”
“Once the Blue Star World collapses, your technological advantage will disappear instantly.”
“Not only that, without the rules of other worlds boosting your strength, the cultivation talent of your entire race’s next generation will entirely become mediocre.”
“You have no future.”
High above, numerous Demon Kings and Great Demon Kings laughed wildly, intensifying their attacks like a tempest pummeling towards those king-level fighters of the Human Race.
On Earth, Damon Lopes and Eddy Keller, disoriented, stood on a ten-thousand-meter Mountain Peak, shocked as they watched the slowly emerging massive world phantom in the sky.
That dazzling Star, and the encircling planets around it, felt so familiar.
Boom!
Just then, a kilometer-wide Light Beam pierced through the clouds, immediately causing a thousand-kilometer area on the ground to collapse, mountain ranges to fall, followed by a Destroy Heaven and Earth impact wave.
Instantly, the already injured Damon Lopes and Eddy Keller were startled.
“Watch out!”
In an instant, Damon Lopes and Eddy Keller were thrown into the air by the explosion’s impact.
Just as the sky changed, at the Number One pathway entrance in the City outskirts, the tens of thousands of meters tall Golden Divine Tree in the mythical world suddenly shook, and a strong will slowly awoke from within.
Buzz! The branches of the Golden Divine Tree swayed, its dazzling radiance even blotting out the sunlight.
Inside the Eternal Divine Tree, that profound and dignified will erupted, shaking Space-Time: “Adam Garcetti, as per our agreement, I shall entangle the world; I hope you keep your promise.”
Hundreds of thousands of kilometers away, with his True Body burned by white flames and expanded to tens of thousands of meters high, Adam Garcetti repelled Tyris with a strike and turned back with a calm gaze.
“Rest assured, as a Civilization Guardian, my promise represents the entire Human Race.”
Boom!
In No.1 Logistics City, as countless people watched in shock, the tens of thousands of meters high Eternal Divine Tree began to rapidly expand, and in the blink of an eye, a couple of hundred thousand kilometers high Golden Divine Tree appeared between Heaven and Earth.
This scene instantly sent countless members of the Heavenly Feather Clan into a frenzy of excitement.
“It’s the Eternal Divine Tree; our Mother Tree has returned.”
“Turns out the Mother Tree never fell, it was all fake, ha ha ha ha…”
