chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1646: Chapter 612: Tearing Apart the Solar System, Exploding the Great Demon King_3 Chapter 1646: Chapter 612: Tearing Apart the Solar System, Exploding the Great Demon King_3 “Our Heavenly Feather Clan’s homeland still exists, we still have hope.”
But as the Heavenly Feather soldiers became excited and frenzied, Anstice and the other main gods of the Heavenly Feather Clan, including the three Divine Kings like Tolstoy, looked somewhat solemn.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The power from the core of the Eternal Divine Tree was fully released, not even reaching a height of hundred thousand kilometers yet, as the trunk trembled and countless massive roots plunged directly into Channel One.
Instantly, the entire silver vortex channel continuously expanded and ballooned, emitting dazzling silver light waves and spatial fluctuations.
These roots, forged like gold, delved into the Void, crossing the storm between the mythical world and the Blue Star world, following the light membrane of the Solar System’s “world” barrier, and gradually merging into it.
As these golden roots merged into the boundary wall of the Blue Star World, ignoring the giant dragons of the world and space, they spread to a million kilometers, even millions of kilometers, causing the trembling Blue Star World to stabilize somewhat.
Moreover, the Blue Star World’s fall into the mythical world also slowed down a bit, as if it had gained a supporting point.
The eruption of the Second Mythical Impact exceeded everyone’s expectations.
While the demon kings and Great Demon Kings from the Purgatory Empire laughed in excitement, everyone in the Human Alliance felt unsettled and frantic, and the already disadvantaged alliance’s morale instantly weakened.
The cultivators of the Human Race were worried about the safety of the Blue Star World and their families there.
The other three races in the alliance were concerned whether the fall and shattering of the human inner world would cause a complete collapse.
In addition, if the inner world fell, the Human Race would definitely have to draw some strong men back to rescue the billions of ordinary clansmen in the inner world.
Otherwise, under the fierce and violent infusion of Heavenly Energy in the Vast World, most of those said to be ordinary creatures among the human inner circle would either burst or mutate instantly.
“Darren Callum, let’s see what you can do now, hahaha…” Tyris, blocked by Adam Garcetti, burst into wild laughter, feeling as if Heaven was also helping him.
In his hand, the Dark demon blade harbored unmatched power; with full strength in a single strike, heaven and earth lost color, slashing a tens of thousands of kilometers long dark grand canyon.
This Terrifying Power in a single strike severed the Yin-Yang world engulfing Heaven and Earth, sending Adam Garcetti flying over a hundred thousand kilometers, his aura overwhelming.
Yet, this strike only caused Adam Garcetti’s aura to tremble slightly, the white flame burning on his body became even more vigorous, engulfing heaven and earth massively.
Holding the Divine Wheel, Adam Garcetti took a deep breath, his Divine Soul shaking heaven and earth: “Jack Clark, we need to adjust our plan, the impact has erupted prematurely; Primordial and Mad Wheeler must go back for support.”
“Primordial as the second-generation inheritance guardian can ignite the flame of civilization to stabilize the world, and Mad Wheeler’s inner world is everyone’s escape route…”
“Senior, I understand your meaning.”
Twenty thousand kilometers away, Jack Clark, facing Carthius, showed the color of resolve in his eyes, and with a long howl said: “Did you really think I couldn’t kill you?”
Boom! Heaven and earth trembled, behind Jack Clark an imposing figure wearing a black Imperial Robe, holding the Soul Suppression Emperor Seal, appeared.
It was notably the Soul True Body, temporarily separated from the True Body due to the transformation of the Soul Source.
Boom!
The Soul True Body ferociously leapt into Jack Clark’s body, and in an instant, a terrifying aura burst forth from him, causing the entire heaven and earth to shake violently.
At that moment, the entire forbidden area battlefield slightly trembled, shaken by the breath that had truly stepped into the True Spirit Level.
“The second Supreme Rule, how is that possible!?”
In the ancient early stage realm, wielding the powerful Supreme Rules, and additionally with that formidable True Body wielding a World-class weapon, the combat power was already crazily comparable toItem.Render Lavender a half-step True Spirit.
But what was the situation with the now manifest second Supreme Rule!?
At this moment, even with Carthius and Tyris’s composure, their faces changed drastically, their eyes revealing disbelief, feeling an unreal sense of falsehood.
It’s fake, definitely fake.
How could a ‘human’, in the Ancient Realm, and particularly at the ancient early stage, consolidate two rules, two Supreme Rules.
At this moment, all the Divine Kings, Immortal Kings, and Demon Gods in the forbidden area battlefield at the Ancient Realm also all shockingly looked towards the direction where Jack Clark was, shocked by the aura comparable toItem.Render Lavender a True Spirit.
Especially the Demon God Priest, Constantin, his expression crazier: “Tyris, why did you stop me from awakening the Ancestor back then, you are a criminal to the entire Purgatory Family!!”
Normally, Jack Clark stepping into the True Spirit Level with extreme burst strength was exaggerated, but neither Carthius nor Tyris were at this level, not enough to completely turn the tide of battle.
Once Adam Garcetti burned out and fell, facing the siege of two peak Great Demon Gods, Jack Clark definitely wouldn’t last long.
Once the internal power was exhausted, he still couldn’t avoid a doomed fate.
But the issue was the talent and potential displayed by Jack Clark at this moment were too terrifying, terrifying enough toItem.Render Lavender make the Demon God Priest, who knew what the two Supreme Rules meant, lose control of his emotions.
Especially since this monster had just broken through toItem.Render Lavender the ancient early stage realm.
From Jack Clark, Constantin felt an unprecedented threat.
He had a premonition that if they couldn’t kill this monster today, even if the Purgatory ancestors awakened later, they might not stop his rise.
At that time, what awaited their Purgatory Family would be the despair of their tribe’s annihilation.
He must kill him, must forcibly awaken the Ancestor toItem.Render Lavender kill him. Constantin’s eyes revealed a crazed look, looking at those Demon Gods currently engaging with the alliance’s Divine Kings.
And just as Constantin considered which Demon God was suited for ‘sacrifice’…

chapters.title: Chapter 1647 - 1647 612 Tearing Apart the Solar System
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1647: Chapter 612 Tearing Apart the Solar System, Destroying the Great Demon King_4 Chapter 1647: Chapter 612 Tearing Apart the Solar System, Destroying the Great Demon King_4 It didn’t know that the cost for Jack Clark to mobilize the second Supreme Rule strength was extremely high—losing the chance for a soul origin in the Ancient Realm to transform into the Primordial.
That was also why Adam Garcetti, even though he burnt himself, hadn’t used the second Rule strength.
Of course, this was also related to the internal plans of the Human Race, where Adam Garcetti sacrificing himself to become the Lord of Void was one of them.
Before the eruption of this great battle, aside from supporting True Martial Heavenly King’s breakthrough to the Supreme Realm, there was also Adam Garcetti’s plan to sacrifice himself and turn into the Lord of Void.
Regarding the Void, both the contemporary Human Race and the Ancient Civilization were extremely curious.
Especially since the relics left on Blue Star had once been destroyed under the assault of the Void.
The transformation into an Ancient Level Void life filled people like Adam Garcetti with temptation; many times, they entertained the idea of what it would feel like to transform into Void life.
Moreover, if a “person” transformed into an Ancient Level Void life and retained autonomous consciousness, could they carve out a new system of strength, a new path for the Human Race?
Even using the power of the Void and the strength system they had once controlled, could they quickly break free from their shackles and step into the Emperor Realm?
And after failing to block the Mythical Impact, could they make all humanity ‘ascend’ to become Void life, Undying and Unyielding.
Yet all these speculations and conjectures came to a halt due to the responsibilities they bore, stopping the three Supreme Experts who had defended the Human Race for decades from taking that step.
But today’s situation and the presence of Jack Clark made Adam Garcetti firmly resolve.
Therefore, seemingly burning the life of the strongest current member of the Human Race as a cost to only block a Great Demon King for a day or two seemed a blood loss, but in reality, it wasn’t much of a loss at all.
Soon Adam Garcetti would return from the depths of Void in a new form.
Jack Clark’s sudden burst all happened in an instant, under the entry of the second Primordial Rule, his True Body instantaneously swelled to eighty thousand meters.
He was clad in a black scale-like battle armor resembling the Dragon Scale Imperial Robe, wearing the All-Heaven Emperor Crown, like a Monarch descending from the Mythical Era.
Two layers of world projection emerged around him, one like a newly born galaxy slowly spinning, drifting on a continent filled with raging wind and thunder in the Void.
Even from the Firmament, a world fall released endless purple twilight light spontaneously appearing, spreading a million kilometers as if celebrating the arrival of this ‘complete’ monster.
“Kill!”
Enshrouded in the sky full of purple aura, behind Jack Clark eight arms furiously extended, a war halberd tens of thousands of meters long with exploding black holes beneath it, carried Supreme Divine Might appearing above Carthius’s head.
“Human, only now are you worthy to have a full-strength battle with me.”
Carthius’s eyes showed crazed Battle Intent, utterly fearless, his six arms furiously extending, containing the power to shake the Great Thousand Worlds, rushing towards Jack Clark, Demon Power overwhelming.
In a dimension where time almost stood still, Carthius instantly threw more than ten thousand punches, Terrifying Power fracturing the space-time in front of him.
Yet with two Supreme Rules enhancement, plus the immense world-class weapon, Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, Jack Clark’s strength expanded to an indescribable realm.
Boom! The Void surrounding Carthius for ten thousand kilometers collapsed, dragging down the approaching Supreme Abyss burst apart.
Carthius’s formidable six arms, even under the Overbearing power of a war halberd capable of toppling Heaven and Earth, had their scale armor shattered, Aura reverberated and directly was blasted away by a halberd.
Such Overbearing prowess invigorated the battle mood of Tolstoy and other Divine Kings on the distant front battlefield.
So powerful, the fully-formed Jack Clark was even suppressing the Great Demon King head-on; with the situation going this way, delaying until those Giant Beast legions can’t catch up isn’t without hope.
The instant Jack Clark blasted Carthius away, holding the war halberd, time around him flew by, his figure flickering, instantly catching up with Carthius under the power of Speed Divine Power.
Tear apart!
Two Supreme Rules intertwined, the Eight Desolate War Halberd bearing the intent of Opening the Heavens sweeping across, Terrifying Power tearing the Rule world surrounding Carthius.
Meanwhile, Jack Clark reached out both arms from behind, holding the remaining double purple-black and purple Crystals, pressing them onto Carthius amidst his shocked gaze.
“No!”
Boom boom!! The energy destroying worlds exploded, accompanied by Carthius’s scream echoing throughout the forbidden area battlefield.
The purple-black thunder spreading the capacity of destroying Heaven and Earth covered a hundred thousand kilometers, the purple corrosion Rule melting everything, Radiance erasing all Vitality within several hundred thousand kilometers.
The explosive power of the two Crystals tearing the Dorsal Fin was several times more than the previous one, added with the close explosive power being even more massive.
The instant unleashed Destroying Power directly obliterated Carthius’s incredibly formidable True Body, including Jack Clark also being blasted with three arms shattered.
Within the explosion center filled with Chaotic destructive current, a supremely strong Will rose to the sky, echoing through the forbidden area battlefield.
“Heaven Base Senior, now’s the time.”
Buzz!
In the major rear of the battlefield, commanding the battlefield, like a gigantic Mecha head, the eyes of the God Base suddenly lit up.
Boom boom boom!! Jack
[There are a few hundred more words to wrap up, brothers please wait twenty minutes and refresh]
And right when Jack Clark shattered Carthius’s True Body, trapping the heavily injured him within the black holes of several Doomsday Nuclear Weapons.
From the distant ends of Heaven and Earth, the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, double wings vibrating, sweeping all Giant Beast legions into the space-time storm filled chaotic starry space ahead.
Beyond this forbidden area lies the territory of the Purgatory Demon Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 1648 - 1648 613 The Ancestor Revives The Emperor
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1648: Chapter 613: The Ancestor Revives, The Emperor Dragon Arrives Chapter 1648: Chapter 613: The Ancestor Revives, The Emperor Dragon Arrives The decisive battle between the Human Alliance and the Purgatory Demon Race spiraled out of control from the start, veering off the plan of the Demon God Level Powerhouses from both races.
Including the sudden eruption of the Second Mythical Impact and the event where Carthius’ True Body burst open the Dark Matter Black Hole it was suppressing.
Sensing that even from a million kilometers away, the terrifying aura that still made their hearts palpitate had vanished, the Divine Kings and Immortal Kings of the Human Alliance and the Demon God powerhouses of the Purgatory Demon Race all revealed expressions of horror.
“How is that possible!”
“His Majesty Carthius lost, killed by that human?”
“It’s impossible, it must be fake, His Majesty must have used some kind of bloodline Divine Power to erase his own aura.”
A Demon God from the Ancient Middle Stage roared, “His Majesty’s strength has already broken through the Ancient Limit, even when facing a true True Spirit Level existence, he would be able to resist for quite some time.”
“Let alone being killed in such a short time by a human who has just broken through to the Ancient Realm.”
Immediately, hesitation appeared on the faces of those Demon Gods who were shocked and lost in thought due to Carthius’ “death,” feeling that there might be some reason in that.
Because they were too far away, the explosions of the destruction crystals and Doomsday Nuclear Weapons released energy that stirred the Heaven and Earth within tens of thousands of kilometers, colorful and smoke billowing.
As a result, these Demon Gods could not see the specific situation over there and could only judge the situation through the fluctuations of the aura when Carthius and Tyris were fighting.
At this moment, the roar of Tyris thundered through Heaven and Earth.
“Carthius was only careless and got suppressed into the Destruction Black Hole created by human weapons by Darren Callum.”
“Bektivi, Christoff, stop entangling with those guys over there, come over and restrain Adam Garcetti of the Human Race; I want to go over and kill Darren Callum.”
Suddenly, all the Demon Gods’ spirits were lifted, and endless blood light and Black Flames erupted from the two Demon Kings who were pushing back the Primordial True King and the other eight.
“Out of the way!”
In the hands of Christoff, the Lord of the Sagundo Empire, a magic spear covered with sharp spikes exploded, transforming into nine Dark Demon Dragons each exceeding a hundred thousand meters in length and exuding an ancient aura.
The nine Dark Demon Dragons roared like comets, appearing instantly in front of Tolstoy and the purple crystal face formed by the Heavenly Feather Clan’s defensive formation.
Boom, boom, boom! The explosion of the Nine-headed Demon Dragons released endless Dark Demon Air that swept tens of thousands of kilometers.
Under the powerful force, Heaven and Earth trembled, and the entire “world” was pushed sideways over a thousand kilometers, with huge cracks covering the purple crystal face.
And Tolstoy’s ten golden wings spread out, forming a five-layer golden wing defense that was also torn apart.
“Where do you think you’re going, your opponent is me.”
Tolstoy, who was sent retreating with a blow, roared angrily, the pure golden battle sword in his hand glowing brightly, with countless golden feathers appearing out of nowhere within a thirty-thousand-kilometer radius.
These golden feathers emitted a gentle yet overbearing Radiance, forming figures like angels with double wings on their backs, encircling Christoff in twelve layers, inside and out.
These angels’ mouths slightly opened, seemingly silent, yet filled with holy and sacred chants echoing throughout the Void.
Instantly, the world bathed in golden light fell silent, unmoving, including the trembling Heavenly Earth Law and the raging energy.
Christoff, who had initially sent Tolstoy retreating with one blow and was about to tear through space to exit the battlefield, slowed his movements by tens of thousands of times.
This Lord of the Empire was powerful, but as the strongest under the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Divine King of Light, Tolstoy’s strength was not weak either.
The only difference between him and these Lords of the Purgatory Empire was that the weapon in his hand was only of the top Pseudo-World Level, so he was slightly at a disadvantage in a head-to-head confrontation.
But he had no problem in stalling the enemy.
Just then, an endless Dark Demon Air rolled behind Christoff, transforming into a giant demon skull tens of thousands of kilometers large, biting down on the frozen Time-Space angel Divine Formation.
At the same time, Christoff, who was surrounded by the angelic light formation, roared.
Boom! Under the assault from both front and back, the angelic light formation collapsed immediately.
Another Demon God emerged from the Dark Demon Domain, his ancient middle-stage might filling the air, and looked towards Tolstoy: “Your Majesty, I shall deal with this remnant of the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
“I’ll leave it to you, Asder.”
With Garcetti’s departure, the battlefield, which was originally a thirteen-against-eight situation, got even worse as three Lords of the Empire joined forces, elevating their overall combined realm.
Therefore, Tolstoy could only watch helplessly as the Demon God departed.
However, another Lord of the Empire was intercepted and blocked by the outburst of Wind Heavenly King, True Martial Heavenly King, and two other Immortal Kings, as well as the Heavenly Feather Divine King.
Boom, boom, boom!
Across the frontline battlefield that extended over two hundred thousand kilometers, Divine Kings and Demon Gods showing their tens of thousands of meters large True Bodies clashed, releasing destructive waves that destroyed Heaven and Earth, with an impressive momentum.
At this moment, not only was the Demon God Level battlefield standing amidst ten thousand kilometers chaotic, but half of the forbidden area was plunged into confusion, with countless Transcendent soldiers fighting desperately.
The battlefields of the Demon Kings, Great Demon Kings, Heavenly Kings, and king-level beings, spanning over hundreds of thousands of kilometers, were filled with Law Radiance of various racks, forming a complex and clashing spectacle.
From time to time, a Demon King’s True Form would be shattered and fall from the sky, and deities would be torn apart by the joint hands of two Demon Kings, screaming as divine blood rained from heaven.
Missiles and Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs seemingly exploded without any cost, lighting up the entire battlefield under the control and guidance of the Sky-based God King.
When any battlefield was breached, millions from the Purgatory Legion would sweep in with rolling demon gas, only to be met by precision strikes of tens of Crystal Energy Nuclear Bombs with billions of tonnage.
The instantly released destructive force erased everything.
Even a Demon King, when directly hit by Crystal Energy Hydrogen Bombs with over a billion-ton yield, would vomit blood and suffer injuries.

chapters.title: Chapter 1649 - 1649 613 The Revival of the Ancestor Arrival
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1649: Chapter 613: The Revival of the Ancestor, Arrival of the Emperor Dragon_2 Chapter 1649: Chapter 613: The Revival of the Ancestor, Arrival of the Emperor Dragon_2 Human Race’s Nuclear Weapons, in terms of the intensity of the destructive strength unleashed in an instant, were similar to those of Ordinary Myth’s Rules, but the quantity was dozens to hundreds of times greater.
This kind of weapon was most suitable for extensively cleansing the map of a Transcendent battlefield.
Even when the battlefield spilled over to the central borders, the Sky-based God King would detonate the Doomsday Nuclear Weapons already buried, instantly annihilating everything within tens of thousands of kilometers.
As the dark matter energy continued to explode, the widest horizontal place of over 1.8 million kilometers and a length of more than 2 million kilometers of Heavenly Earth Rules began to exhibit unstable fluctuations.
The surrounding destructive forces, such as the Space-Time Storm, Death Gust, and Doomsday Thunderbolt that originally swirled stably around the battlefield, seemed to spread inward, taking advantage of the situation.
This scene was only noticed by the Sky-based God King, who was overseeing the entire battlefield.
At every moment, as tens of thousands of alliance soldiers and Purgatory True Demons fell in death, the Black Holes that exploded from the seventeen Doomsday Nuclear Weapons also emitted strong shocks.
Spreading over 5,000 kilometers, a Black Hole, like pitch-black ink obliterating all matter and space, suddenly transmitted the unwilling roar of Carthius the inheritor.
“I do not accept this!” The Black Hole shook, and a giant black arm with only a bit of meat on it struggled and reached out.
The arm, with barely any flesh left, revealed a dark golden skeleton wrapped in black, lacquer-like liquid material, emitting an aura that made Jack Clark’s heart palpitate.
Boom! The space collapsed, and a zigolden Halberd Radiance spanning tens of thousands of meters descended from the sky, tearing through the Void and slashing at that tattered arm.
Under the powerful force, the arm broke off, and along with the zigolden Halberd Radiance, it was pulled into the dark abyss, disappearing without a trace. Only Carthius’s agonized screams filled with hatred echoed between heaven and earth.
Above the firmament, tens of thousands of kilometers away, Jack Clark, standing holding a halberd, suddenly appeared slightly weakened, his expression icy and grave.
Just now, in suppressing Carthius, the rule and part of Jack’s Divine Soul Intent infused in that strike were also devoured by the dark matter that obliterated everything.
This devouring was similar to the Final Darkness Devouring ability of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, belonging to complete eradication.
Compared to completely erasing a Great Demon King, this loss was nothing but blood profit, as Jack perceived Carthius’s aura falling at a terrifying speed within the dark matter.
Even Carthius’s True Body, tempered to the extreme and fused with World-class weapons to become incredibly strong, was useless.
Including the Supreme Abyss Plane forces Carthius was drawing on, they too were dissolved by the exploding dark matter forces, robbing it of its last hope.
Such terrible destructiveness, even in Jack’s eyes, elicited a tinge of wariness.
“Get lost!”
Boom!
Under the unrivaled domination of dark demon light, half the heaven and earth were split in two, forming a deep Abyssal crack tens of thousands of kilometers long, bisecting the space between heaven and earth.
Under the frantic burst of Tyris’s strike, the surging white flames burned, and Adam Garcetti, already somewhat transparent, grunted and was directly repelled.
Even the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel in his hand was split with a crack.
After burning and erupting until now, Adam Garcetti’s aura began an inevitable slide after maintaining the peak for half a day to entangle Tyris.
“Christoff, I leave this human to you.”
The colossal form of Tyris, towering ten thousand meters, loomed like an Abyssal Great Demon with surging demon power. Holding a Demon Blade, now fused into the flesh of his arm, he pounced on Jack Clark.
And Christoff, the Lord of the Empire who had rushed from the front battlefield, blocked Adam Garcetti’s advance.
Watching the towering True Body of fifty thousand meters, standing amidst the endless sinister aura of the dark demon air, with his long hair fluttering like snow within the white flames, Adam Garcetti laughed heartily.
“Never thought that in my last moments, I would be able to take down a Lord of the Empire with me.”
Tens of thousands of kilometers away, Christoff’s gaze was ice cold, his voice deep and chilly: “Afraid you don’t have the strength for that, Human. With you in your current state, I only need to delay a while and you’ll turn to ash.”
“Before that happens, cutting you down will suffice.”
Boom! The flames burning on Adam Garcetti exploded, and he split into two entities; from inside, a version of Adam with black hair walked out.
The moment the black-haired Adam appeared, his True Body’s burning speed suddenly accelerated by dozens of times; the brightness dazzled, and around him, a flourishing civilization’s phantom faintly emerged.
Most importantly, with Adam Garcetti’s splitting into two, the life-and-death rule he grasped also split into the Rule of Life and the Rule of Death.
Christoff, who did not expect Adam Garcetti to have a last resort, showed a look of shock and anger: “Don’t think you’re the only one with an explosive secret technique.”
Roar!
Christoff’s True Body exploded, transforming into a skyful of blood mist merged with the Dark Demon Realm. Instantly, the Demon Realm of several hundred thousand kilometers trembled; endless Dark Demon Air and Purgatory Ancestor’s rule forces converged.
The rampaging demon air roiled, and a hundred-thousand-meter-long Three-headed Demon Dragon emerged, exuding an extremely terrifying, bloodthirsty aura.
Facing Adam Garcetti, who wanted to take it down with him before death, Christoff also chose to burn his bloodline power and display his most potent form using the bloodline divine powers.
Roar, roar, roar!! The Three-headed Demon Dragon roared, and six wings spread from behind, sweeping up the entire dark demon air and obscuring the brightly-lit sky.
“In your current state before me, whether or not you burst your bloodline makes no difference.” Both forms of Adam Garcetti whispered regretfully.
In his hands, the Yin-Yang Divine Wheel split into two, turning into one white and one black Divine Light merging into his body. Suddenly, endless black and white light enveloped heaven and earth.
“Yin and Yang, Life and Death, Eternal Silence of the Heavens.”
Puchi!!
The Three-headed Demon Dragon screamed, and its surrounding Dark Demon Realm, along with the world, ripped apart instantly, split by the pure interwoven black and white lights.

chapters.title: Chapter 1650 - 1650 613 The Revival of the Ancestor Arrival
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1650: Chapter 613: The Revival of the Ancestor, Arrival of the Emperor Dragon_3 Chapter 1650: Chapter 613: The Revival of the Ancestor, Arrival of the Emperor Dragon_3 As far as the eye could see, it seemed as if a ‘X’ stretching 30,000 kilometers appeared between heaven and earth, lingering indefinitely.
The torn fault was filled with endless pure Yin-Yang and life-death rules; Yin and Yang ground away, life and death alternated, and Christoff’s torn True Body and Divine Soul were immediately annihilated.
This was Adam Garcetti, once again bursting through his limits and stepping into the True Spirit realm.
Beneath the True Spirit, there was simply no resistance, no way to block it.
As cultivation reached its later stages, the span of strength levels grew larger, and the boundary between True Spirit and the ancient times was like a chasm, which the entire Purgatory Demon Race had only managed to break twice in ten thousand years due to two supremely talented monsters.
Boom Boom Boom!!
In front of the intensely burning Adam Garcetti, the previously spirited True Body of the Demon God Christoff was shattered repeatedly, spraying blood of the Demon God that dyed the sky red.
The powerful shockwave destroyed everything within a 100,000-kilometer radius.
And under the controlled intent of Adam Garcetti, the two quickly moved towards the front battle area, soon appearing in the central region of the forbidden area, instantly causing all the Demon Gods to change their expressions drastically.
The Demon God Priest, Constantin, bellowed, “Carotis, Bektivi, stop that human.”
Boom Boom!! Two Demon Gods repelled their opponents and turned to charge toward Adam Garcetti, dozens of thousands of kilometers away.
With Adam Garcetti’s return, his single-handed battle against the lords of the three major empires immediately reduced the alliance’s pressure on the front battlefield. However, at this moment, the Primordial True King let out a long howl.
“Folks, there are changes in our Inner World; we must return immediately. The battlefield here is left in your hands.”
After speaking, without waiting for the Wind Heavenly King and others to respond, the Primordial True King repelled his opponent, tore through space, and flew toward the Human Race’s rear.
Also retreating were Heavenly King Mad Wheeler, who was suppressing a Supreme Realm Great Demon King, and another who needed to head back to oversee things, preventing Freya Louise’s failure to uphold the sky.
Suddenly, the battlefield became somewhat chaotic.
However, on the human side, with Adam Garcetti burning himself out in a deadly battle, holding back the lords of the three empires, his fierce aura left the Wind Heavenly King and others with not much to say.
Even to make a point, they each burned their origins a second time to burst forth.
As the three lords of the empires joined hands, the unstoppable momentum of Adam Garcetti was immediately blocked, and his aura visibly weakened at a visible speed.
But just then, Adam Garcetti suddenly looked towards a battlefield hundreds of thousands of kilometers away, his voice of Divine Soul Thought resonating under the power of the rules, shaking heaven and earth.
“Tarrod, while I am about to perish, my promise remains the same. After this battle, my entire Human Race shall protect your law and assist you in stepping into the realm of the Ancient God.”
Adam Garcetti’s words made Tarrod pause.
“I naturally trust the promise of your Human Race.”
For his race, a strong man like Adam Garcetti fought to the death and burned to the very last step.
Jack Clark, a monstrous talent, was fighting desperately alone against two Great Demon Kings.
And there were those Human Kings and Heavenly Kings who, facing several times their number of enemies, fought to the death without retreating, showing such a powerful unity and racial dedication that even a being like Tarrod was moved.
Only seen tens of thousands of kilometers away, Tarrod’s deities’ Avatar battling another Ancient Middle Stage Demon God dissipated, transforming into a sky full of golden light spanning space-time, merging into Tarrod’s True Body.
Boom!
Inside him, an aura comparable to a demi-True Spirit burst forth, an endless golden radiance spreading across, painting the sky and earth over tens of thousands of kilometers into a golden ocean.
Amidst the radiance, Tarrod’s True Body swelled, reaching 100,000 meters high, covered with densely packed golden eyes, appearing immensely majestic and terrifying.
Immediately, the entire battlefield shook once again.
All ‘people’ never expected that Tarrod, a longstanding Divine King of the Divine Gods Alliance, had hidden his power so deeply.
His realm had already reached the brink of breakthrough, but for unknown reasons, he had always restrained himself, even dividing his power to suppress his own realm.
In the instant those Demon Gods were stunned, a giant golden eyeball slowly emerged around the Demon God battling with Tarrod’s Avatar.
This golden eyeball, resembling an illusory world, enveloped the Demon God together with the surrounding rule domain, and enclosed within, then silently shattered.
Boom!
Under terrifying power, a space of over ten thousand kilometers collapsed, the Void exploded, and even that Demon God’s True Body was torn and burst apart.
This was the might of a being whose realm had truly reached demi-True Spirit.
With a blast that shattered that kind of Demon God’s True Body, Tarrod’s right hand stretched out, reaching into the Void, transforming into a huge, golden palm that even the shattered heaven and earth could not obscure.
On that pure golden palm, a faint immortal aura spread, suppressing the Heavenly Earth Rules.
Boom Boom Boom!! Under the golden radiance containing part of the True Spirit’s might, the foundational space of that swath of heaven and earth was segmented, collapsing crazily compressed.
“Assist!”
The Lord of the Empire, Brihades, roared, and behind him the eighteen arms grasping the dark Demon Banner burgeoned, forming pole after pole of banners standing tall in all directions.
Before the eighteen Dark Demon Banners could display their might, the densely packed eyes on Tarrod’s body suddenly shone brightly, emitting numerous light beams.
Spurt Spurt!!
These golden light beams, incredibly sharp and containing the power to penetrate everything, formed tens of thousands of pitch-black, tiny pathways between heaven and earth, lingering indefinitely.
Such might made even Brihades’ expression slightly change, his weapon that resembled a thundering hammer bursting with demonic light, held horizontally in front.
In front of the truly powerful Tarrod, three mighty Demon Gods were instantly suppressed.
One whose True Body was blown apart followed, in the glaring gaze of two Demon Gods, the space of tens of thousands of kilometers was segmented, shrinking into a hundred-kilometer-sized micro world held in Tarrod’s hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 1651 - 1651 613 The Revival of the Ancestor Arrival
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1651: Chapter 613: The Revival of the Ancestor, Arrival of the Emperor Dragon_4 Chapter 1651: Chapter 613: The Revival of the Ancestor, Arrival of the Emperor Dragon_4 A minuscule world inside was filled with terrifying destructive forces, gradually grinding away at the True Demon God Body.
Instantly, the shrill and miserable screams from that True Demon God echoed through Heaven and Earth, causing the Demon Gods on the frontlines to become extremely shocked and furious.
Clearly, whether in terms of numbers or overall strength, they had the upper hand, so why had they not achieved much since the battle began, but instead suffered huge losses.
And this damned alliance, they actually hid so deeply.
Just as the situation on this side fell into a stalemate where both forces were equally matched, a more terrifying great battle was erupting a million kilometers away.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Enveloped by two Supreme Rules, Jack Clark, like an ancient true god, moved with terrifying might capable of exploding Heaven and Earth, fiercely clashing with Tyris who wielded the Dark Demon Blade.
Time distorted and stalled around the two of them, stepping on the timelines with terrifying speed, crazily exchanging blows, each second fighting tens of thousands of times.
Halberd Skill brilliance illuminated Heaven and Earth, the Dark Demon Blade annihilating all directions.
The invisible, pervasive power of the Rules shook Heaven and Earth, vibrating the entire forbidden area battlefield.
Yet, even as Tyris roared in anger, burning his Origin for a Burst, he could not suppress Jack Clark, who was pushing his Vitality to the Limit Breakthrough, let alone drive him back.
Tyris’s eyes were fierce and terrifying, filled with murderous intent, “Human, even if Carthius falls, it will not change the outcome of your extinction.”
“So what.”
Boom!
Jack Clark’s War Halberd swept horizontally, shattering Space-Time, and lifting a dark tide over a hundred thousand kilometers drowning Tyris, the powerful strength flattening everything.
When Jack knocked back Tyris with a single halberd strike, he didn’t pursue but stood in front of seventeen Dark Matter Black Holes.
Watching this scene from tens of thousands of kilometers away, Tyris’s eyes inadvertently showed impatience along with a faint unease, then he issued an even more furious roar and lunged towards Jack Clark.
The horrific fallout from the great battle kept everyone from daring to approach this World.
For a time, the entire battlefield was enveloped in a grim atmosphere, as countless humans and True Demons frenziedly slew each other, under the light of the Blood Moon appearing ever more bloodthirsty and insane.
Not knowing how long had passed, suddenly, a strong Rule Burst interfused with Heaven and Earth, forming a Blood Moon with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers above the battlefield.
The moment that Blood Moon rose, everyone knew that the Great Demon King Carthius had completely fallen.
Boom! Millions of kilometers away, deep within the Purgatory territory, an invisible shock spread out, instantly permeating billions of kilometers.
From that shock, which vibrated millions throughout the Dark Demon Realms, all Purgatory True Demons felt an incredibly subtle yet terrifying Will.
That faint Will was very vague, permeated with a sense of mild confusion.
“It’s the Ancestor, the Ancestor’s Will has been awakened,” on the frontline battlefield, the Demon God Priest Constantin’s face showed frenzy and excitement.
Other Demon Gods were also visibly shaken, the Lords of the Four Empires showed grave expressions, and surprise, as they seemed not very keen on the resurgence of the Purgatory Ancestor.
But that faint Will was merely a flash and had no further action, which allowed the Human Race’s strong men to breathe a little relief.
Including Jack Clark, who was also startled.
But at this moment, Adam Garcetti, who had been forcefully fighting till now, suddenly weakened.
Boom! Carotis instinctively executed a strike, instantly causing the half of the magnificent True Body of Adam Garcetti to collapse, his Yin-Yang Divine Wheel also blasted away.
This sudden turn of events brought a smile to all Demon Gods’ faces, this human finally could no longer hold on.
“Tarrod”
Just when the frontline battlefield was twelve against eight, and the pressure slightly eased, Constantin seized the opportunity and sneak-attacked a Demon God from ancient early stage that had been injured in the fight.
He used the Dark Nail to Seal the Bloodline Power and began a sacrifice deep in the Demon Domain.
Other Demon Gods thundered in rage, Tyris commanded one who intended to save the Demon God, but it was blocked by a Demon Dragon summoned by Constantin.
At this moment, Jack Clark also slowly appeared, his aura ghastly.
Simultaneously above in the Firmament’s World, Number One’s figure emerged, immensely majestic, his head reaching the heavens and feet treading the universe, standing tall.
As Freya Louise began to hold up the heavens, Adam Garcetti fell, Jack Clark faced Tyris, and the great battle again fell into a deadlock.
At this time, an earth-shattering roar exploded, the Destruction Emperor Dragon leading the army rushing over.
[This part has not yet been finely edited, please wait, it’s already twelve, updating to keep attendance]

chapters.title: Chapter 1652 - 1652 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1652: Chapter 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends, Blasting Everything Chapter 1652: Chapter 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends, Blasting Everything During the ritualistic sacrifice conducted by Constantin, forcibly awakening the Purgatory ancestors…
At the edge of the chaotic star space spanning billions of kilometers, celestial bodies the size of planets, over 50,000 kilometers in diameter, exploded into pieces, their immense fragmentation illuminated by the dazzling burst of fire, where a gigantic black-gold behemoth towered.
Roar!
On the forbidden path of the chaotic star space after devouring divine objects of Heaven and Earth, the now even more colossal Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, transforming into a black radiance that tore through the storm ahead.
Boom! As the Destruction Emperor Dragon burst out from the boundary that transected Heaven and Earth, the invisible, pervasive suppressing rules around, those twisting the laws of nature, instantly vanished.
Simultaneously, behind the Destruction Emperor Dragon, from the thousands of kilometers-long cracks, one giant beast after another flew out.
“Roar! Tim Abott, we’ve finally made it out,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly.
At this moment, not just the dragon, but the spirits of the other giant beasts were also highly excited.
There was no helping it; the chaotic zone they had just traversed was filled with ancient threats that could heavily injure or even potentially annihilate ancient beings.
Such as the celestial bodies that had just been smashed to smithereens by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
At this time, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, thousands of kilometers long and surrounded by the Yellow Earth Domain, flew up to stand before the mountain-range-like Destruction Emperor Dragon, standing over seven thousand meters tall, and roared excitedly.
“Roar! Thunderflame, how much longer till we reach the battlefield? I can hardly wait to tear apart a Demon God.”
Hearing this, even the Destruction Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but be speechless, retracting its gaze that had been fixed on the ominous Sky Curtain and let out a deep growl.
“Let’s go, there are no more barriers ahead, and we will soon reach the battlefield.”
Boom!
A black-red domain emanated from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, shattering space and enveloping all Giant Beast legions as they plunged into the subspace, disappearing from sight.
The moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon vanished, millions of kilometers away amidst the rolling Dark Demon Air, an awakening terrifying will faintly sensed its gaze.
The Forbidden Area Battlefield
The ritual conducted by Demon God Priest Constantin to forcibly awaken the Purgatory ancestors had caught everyone off-guard.
Including the Great Demon King Tyris who was fighting with Jack Clark, who turned his head towards the demonic domain millions of kilometers away, his eyes revealing a crazed killing intent.
“You damned beings!” Tyris’s dark aura vibrated the Void, his eight arms grasping the hilt of the Dark Demon Blade, instantly the entwined dark Sword Qi surged enormously.
Boom!
A thousand kilometers long dark blade light exploded in space, forming a night-black grand canyon that cleaved Heaven and Earth, repelling Jack Clark with a single strike.
The emitted sharp edge even shattered the earth below, forming giant cracks tens of thousands of kilometers long, spreading out in a fan shape.
Such tremendous power made even the Sky-based Divine King, who controlled the battlefield, stiffen.
However, after repelling Jack Clark with one strike, Tyris did not engage further, and even the terrifying killing intent on him dissipated.
Boom! Space shattered.
With a cold expression, Tyris tore through space and appeared on the front lines. His True Body, towering a hundred thousand meters tall, approached and its invisible, dreadful aura made Kings such as Tolstoy involuntarily step back.
“Tyris, what are you planning to do?” Carotis instinctively held his blade in readiness, while other Demon Gods also looked solemn.
Tyris scoffed, “Naturally, I’ve come to welcome our ancestor’s return.”
The ritual had already started, the will of the Purgatory ancestors began to awaken, and even he could not, and dared not, attempt to stop it.
Boom! At the edge of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace, the space shattered, and Jack Clark, standing eight thousand meters tall, descended with his halberd.
The burning Dark Star Demon Dragon’s true form emitted an exceedingly heavy aura, and with two Supreme Rules entwined around him, it made those Demon Gods’ eyes twitch.
But at this moment, neither Jack Clark nor the Human Alliance, nor the Purgatory Demon Gods made a move; they just confronted each other from tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Around these Demon Gods, the air rolled like black fog, each wisp of Black Demonic Qi carrying a faintly discernible and terrifying aura.
Most importantly, the pressure only perceivable by ancient-level strong men, or perhaps the strengthening rule force, was present.
It was over!
At this moment, on the faces of Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy and others, despair appeared.
According to their agreed timing, the great battle had only begun two Star Hours (two days) ago, and the True Spirit Beast named Thunderflame was still a day away.
By then, the Purgatory ancestor would have long awakened, capable of annihilating them all.
Including previously unrevealed, now displaying half-step True Spirit capabilities, Divine King Tarrod, who now stood firm within a world formed by golden radiance, his features rigid.
At this moment, a sound resembling either rule fluctuations or a wireless signal slowly echoed in everyone’s ears, carrying the aged voice of the Sky-based Divine King.
“Gentlemen, prepare for retreat. I am ready to completely destroy this realm, to delay the ancestor’s advance.”
Destroying this realm, to completely detonate the power of the entire forbidden area, was the desperate measure planned before the battle should the situation reach its most critical point.
By then, in the face of the destructive power surging from the fall of the Primordial Beast, not even the Purgatory ancestor would be able to cross.
And so-called preparation meant readying to jointly overturn the Earth around the Nine Layers Palace for over a hundred thousand kilometers, taking all subordinates under the blast of Doomsday Nuclear Weapons to escape.
But Jack Clark merely shook his head slightly, his voice resonating in everyone’s ears, “Senior Sky-based, don’t rush, there’s something off with the state of the Purgatory ancestor, we can still fight.”
“Also, the Thunderflame Giant Beast has crossed the last forbidden zone, expecting to arrive in half a Star Moment (half an hour).”

chapters.title: Chapter 1653 - 1653 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1653: Chapter 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends, Blasting Everything_2 Chapter 1653: Chapter 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends, Blasting Everything_2 Within the heightened and more acutely perceptive senses of Jack Clark, the weak Rule Power that permeated the demon gas encroaching upon the forbidden area’s battlefield, spanning a million kilometers, was being siphoned away.
The Terrifying Aura that Tolstoy and the others perceived was merely an illusion manifested by those Rule Powers.
All the Rule Powers that were drawn away surged ten million kilometers towards the Purgatory Demon Race’s rear, tens of millions of kilometers away, where an Aura that shook Space-Time was reviving.
But the revival’s speed was somewhat slow, not as instantaneous as they had imagined.
Jack Clark’s words caused everyone to pause, their eyes revealing astonishment as Wind Heavenly King subconsciously said, “Divine Martial Sir, is it true that in half a Star Moment, the Giant Beast will arrive?”
Jack Clark slowly nodded, “In matters like these, I naturally wouldn’t joke.”
“If the mighty army of the Thunderflame Beheamoth arrives first, we will strike them from both front and rear, joining forces to leave no Purgatory Demon Gods or their army behind.”
“If the Purgatory ancestor revives first and the situation turns against us, we will decisively retreat.”
Upon hearing this, Tolstoy and the others took a moment to ponder before slowly nodding, agreeing to the proposal.
Because the state of that Refining Ancestor was indeed somewhat off, whether it was due to hibernation for too long or its legendary wounds not yet fully healed, they did not know.
It had not arrived immediately.
Relative to Jack Clark, who could only vaguely perceive it, Tyris, also of the Purgatory Demon Race and whose realm was half a step into True Spirit, perceived it much more clearly.
“The True Body of the Ancestor is actually there!”
Standing amidst the rolling Dark Demon Air, Tyris looked back toward the depths of the Demon Domain. His gaze traversed over forty million kilometers, looking toward the center of the Dark Demon Realm.
There, Space-Time collapsed, forming a Distorted nexus, much like a Black Hole tens of thousands of kilometers wide.
At this moment, within the Dark Demon Realm that enveloped billions of kilometers, an endless manifestation of Rule Powers materialized like substance and surged into the Black Hole.
A colossal vague figure stood there, surrounded by chaotic Time Powers.
Perceiving this scene, Tyris looked on with an utterly cold gaze, sweeping over the Demon God Priest Constantin, who stood tens of thousands of kilometers away, beneath the altar.
The Purgatory ancestor was extremely cautious. Thousands of years ago, during its Hibernation, not a single being knew the point where its True Body lay, not even Demon Gods like Tyris were trusted.
The chosen point of revival wasn’t the ancestral court of the Purgatory Demon Race but a Space-Time Distortion nexus.
This was a very special secret realm that, should the Purgatory ancestors one day revive, would prevent anyone wishing to interrupt the process from locating it.
Just like now, even if Tyris tore apart Space-Time without any restraint, it was impossible to approach the reviving Purgatory ancestor. He could only watch helplessly as it woke bit by bit.
Beneath the altar, Constantin presided over the flickering dark gold runes, his consciousness roaring and shaking under the peculiar power of the altar, returning once more to that Dark Starry Sky.
At this moment, the entire Dark Void twisted, strands of dark red substantial Rule Powers materialized from thin air, endlessly converging toward the colossal body in the depths of the stars.
As these Origins returned, the Aura of the colossal figure grew increasingly formidable. The intangible Aura it emitted made the entire starry sky quake.
Moreover, it wasn’t just these Origins. Around the colossal figure where Space-Time distorted, a series of vague phantoms exuding powerful Wills also returned.
These phantoms were the Soul Wills scattered into the river of time by the Purgatory ancestor before it hibernated.
Witnessing this scene and feeling the increasingly powerful Aura of the Purgatory ancestor, Constantin’s eyes revealed fanatical reverence, “Ancestor, your humble servant joyfully welcomes your return.”
Boom!
The terrifying Divine Soul Intent shook Space-Time, followed by a vast voice slowly rising.
“Constantin. Why have you initiated the altar and awakened me before my designated return time?”
Each word was measured and slow, somewhat reminiscent of the time-enshrouded Giant Beast Candle Dragon.
Only, the Purgatory ancestor was “slow” because its consciousness hadn’t fully returned, and the underlying faint annoyance made Constantin tremble all over.
Constantin bowed respectfully, “In reply to the ancestor, I forcibly awakened you this time because our clan has faced an unprecedented enemy.”
“A civilization of the Vast World that has just entered less than ten years ago, yet has the capacity to contend head-on with the combined forces of our Eight Great Empires, the Human Race.”
“Especially this generation of that race, has produced a monster with indescribable talent, whose strength in a short time is already comparable to a typical True Spirit Level being.”
“And, just moments ago, Carthius was blown up by that human, eroding away in front of Tyris until he perished.”
Boom! Instantly, the entire Dark Starry Sky went into violent turmoil, the voice laden with terrifying killing intent, vibrating Space-Time, word by word.
“Constantin. What did you just say?”
Under that raging terrifying Will, Constantin trembled, anxiously saying, “Just now, in confusion, Carthius was blown up by that human, and perished by erosion.”
Boom! The starry sky quaked, the tremendous Will filled with horrifying killing intent vibrated, and the crushing pressure of the Void enveloped Constantin.
The vibrating Soul Will made Constantin’s brain numb, feeling as if the whole world was in uproar.
“I, wasn’t, asking, about, that, human! You, just, said, that, the civilization, entering, the Vast World, is called ‘Human Race’?”
Constantin spoke with a trembling voice, “Yes, ancestor, the civilization is called the Human Race.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1654 - 1654 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1654: Chapter 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends, Blasting Everything_3 Chapter 1654: Chapter 614 Destruction Emperor Dragon Descends, Blasting Everything_3 “Human Race!” A will imbued with intense murderous intent roared, shaking the entire world.
Boom!
The enormous figure lying across the starry sky suddenly trembled, its demon claw crackling and twisting as the piece of soul will that had just returned tried forcefully to awaken and take control of the body to stand up.
However, this True Body, whose cultivation had without a doubt amassed over tens of thousands of years and gathered endless strength, was too powerful for that newly returned sliver of will to fully control.
It was akin to a vast and boundless Mecha that had only booted up some software, with the entire system yet to be fully activated.
Nevertheless, even though it had not fully revived, upon learning that this time the enemy was from the Purgatory Demon Clan, the Purgatory ancestors began to consciously accelerate the pace of resurgence.
Around the twisting rivers of time, blurred afterimages began to appear incessantly.
Instantly, the Purgatory ancestors started to exude a sense of completeness and immortality, and their powerful will spread throughout the Dark Void, distorting reality and creating a real Abyss.
And at this time-distorted juncture, a simple exchange between two “people,” due to the differential flow of time, had already been going on for a while in the outside world.
In the center of the forbidden area battlefield, endless Dark Demon Air rumbled and roared like a Tsunami, crashing against the stacked layers of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace Boundary Wall with a deafening boom.
Meanwhile, the strong men from both major forces had been in a standoff for some time, with neither side initiating further battle.
On the side of the Purgatory Demon Clan, they were waiting for the Ancestor to awaken and completely crush the Human Alliance. As for the Human Race, they were similarly awaiting the arrival of the Giant Beast legions.
Furthermore, following the orders of the Sky-based God King, the ground battlefield spanning over hundreds of thousands of kilometers also fell into an eerie calm.
The previously frantic, life-and-death battling Alliance Army gradually disentangled from their enemies and retreated thousands of kilometers to take position below the yellow Boundary Wall of the Ninefold Heavenly Palace.
Including those king-level Heavenly Kings and Main Gods, they also repelled their opponents amidst chaotic aura, standing firm at high altitude.
Only, whether it was those Heavenly Kings or kings, as well as the soldiers from the four-race legions on the Earth, all felt somewhat at a loss, not understanding why the great battle had suddenly ceased.
And the Demon Race Legion on the opposite side did not pursue them.
Huff huff! Gentry Gail caught his breath and turned to the somewhat disheveled Golden Dragon Heavenly King, “Old Gold, what’s going on, why has everything stopped?”
The Golden Dragon, thousands of kilometers long, slowly shook his head, also puzzled, “I don’t know either. The First Councilor has just fallen, logically the enemy should intensify their offensive.”
Speaking, the Golden Dragon Heavenly King looked up, his gaze solemn as he observed deep into the Firmament, “Something must have changed with the higher-ups.”
Gentry Gail licked his lips, “It’s a pity, with our current strength, we can’t break through the Heavenly Earth Rules suppression, or else we’d go up and ask.”
At that moment, Gabriel King’s soft voice reached their ears, “You all take the time to recover a bit, there might be an even more fierce battle to erupt shortly.”
“Mm,” both Heavenly Kings nodded slightly.
Currently, it wasn’t just them; with the great battle temporarily coming to a halt, everyone was seizing the moment to recuperate, swallowing down the distributed recovery resources without regard for depletion.
In the Dark Demon Realm, Carotis glanced at the indifferent looking Tyris, speaking with a solemn voice, “Be careful, everyone. Those cunning humans might be planning their escape.”
Speaking, Carotis slightly bowed his head, glancing at the tens of thousands of kilometers away, where the retreating Alliance Army was disengaging from the battlefield.
Upon hearing this, the other Lords of the Empire nodded slightly.
As the Purgatory ancestors began to revive, once they completely awakened, this alliance would not stand a chance against the powerful and invincible Purgatory Ancestor.
Even that monstrously strong human who, relying on various methods to ignite and burst forth, barely comparable to a newly broken through True Spirit, was no match for the mighty Purgatory Ancestor.
The other side surely understood this too.
The apparent calmness in facing them must be a ruse, as they sought a moment to flee, to negotiate who would be left behind as a sacrificial rearguard.
This tactic had been employed before, in the battle that annihilated the Heavenly Feather Clan, and the Immortal Spirit Clan; facing the unbeatable Six Great Empires, both chose to survive by cutting off their own tails.
With this in mind, the Lords of the Purgatory Empire looked at Tyris, then communicated with their own empire’s Demon God subordinates, spreading slightly to the sides of the Demon Domain.
With the Ancestor returning, these Demon Gods naturally wanted to show their worth, such as by keeping all those alliance strong men engaged.
Today, not one of these foes would escape.
Just as the Demon Gods were leisurely assuming that the seemingly composed alliance strong men were actually preparing to run away, kings like Tolstoy were indeed tense, making preparations to escape.
But for Jack Clark, as time passed, his gaze became ever more tranquil.
Even though the revival aura from the depths of the tumbling Dark Demon Realm was growing stronger and had far surpassed common True Spirit level beings, he didn’t care.
Because the Destruction Emperor Dragon that was rushing along the edge of the Demon Realm was about to arrive.
Once the Giant Beast True Body arrived, even if the power of that Purgatory ancestor reached the Late Stage of True Spirit or the Pinnacle of True Spirit, he didn’t care.
Because he had already prepared for Deification Unity.
Today, he intended to completely erase this race, utterly removing the threat to humanity, and then he, along with the human beings of Blue Star World, would have a more spacious environment and time to develop.
Ever since he made a breakthrough to the Sixth-level Heaven and stepped out of the Southern Battlefield, once he knew about the great enemy of the Purgatory Demon Race, he felt an inexplicable strong sense of urgency.
It seemed that if his strength’s improvement pace was even slightly slower, the entire Human Race, including himself and his family, would one day be destroyed, wiped out.
This was also the reason why, aside from cultivation, he would immerse himself in cultivation, madly increasing his strength.
Finally, today everything would come to an end.
Sigh! Jack Clark took a deep breath, feeling as if the large stone in his heart named ‘Purgatory Demon Race’ had loosened a bit.
And right when these two major forces had momentarily stopped their battle and were confronting each other, the giant world that kept falling from the far firmament became more and more clear.
One could even see the shadows of some cities on the planet named Blue Star.
Meanwhile, over a million kilometers away at the rear, where the shattered Channel One lay, endless golden roots penetrated the Void, slowly forming a huge golden fulcrum.
The Primordial True King, Mad Wheeler Heavenly King, was watching with a heavy expression as transparent worlds were being entangled by golden roots before him.
At the same time, deep within this World, in the core of the Void Ocean situated between the Material World and the Void, a mammoth Void Creature emanating Ancient Level aura was emerging.
And it was in the depths of this Void Ocean that as an ancient Void Creature was undergoing transformation at birth, the entire Void Ocean trembled slightly.
In the depths of the Void Secret Sea, a power was completely activated.
Buzz! An invisible fluctuation spread throughout the Void, instantaneously reaching infinitely distant places.
In a place incredibly far away from the human domain, where the Six Domains of Human were located, suddenly, something terrifying stirred in the starry firmament above, causing this star space to quiver slightly.
“The Secret Sea that I left in the clan grounds has been activated, and the dimensional vibrations coming through the Void match with the Vast World.”
“It seems that after so many years, the clan grounds have not only rebirthed ‘human’ civilization but have also stepped onto the Transcendent Path, entering this Vast World.”
“The return of the clan grounds, this news needs to be passed on, and someone should be sent to check.”
“Alas, I must oversee the Ancient Battlefield, otherwise I would personally return for a visit to see if the flowers I planted in the courtyard are still blooming.”
…
Forbidden area battlefield.
Half a Star Moment passed in the blink of an eye, just as a colossal and majestic figure was about to fully revive from the depths of the Demon Realm and all the Demon Gods were excited and tense.
Standing at the forefront, Jack Clark’s mouth suddenly curved upward. Finally, they were here.
“Welcome your destruction.”
Just as Jack Clark’s voice fell, all the Demon Gods, including Tyris, instantly turned around, their faces showing horrified expressions as they looked in the direction behind them.
Sixty thousand kilometers away, a dazzling golden-red Light Beam pierced through Heaven and Earth, carrying a terrifyingly extreme force that slammed into the entrance of the forbidden area battlefield.
Boom!
[There are a few thousand more words, please wait an hour for them to be edited. The latter part will be free, so refresh the page then to continue reading.]

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1655: Chapter 615: Shadow of the Primordial, True Spirit Great War Chapter 1655: Chapter 615: Shadow of the Primordial, True Spirit Great War “Human Race!”
Filled with killing intent, the realm of thought shook Heaven and Earth.
Standing deeply within the Abyssal Hell, billions of kilometers away, a terrifying figure thousand of kilometers tall, feet treading the Void. Enveloped by swirling Black Demonic Qi, it slowly turned its gaze towards the battlefield.
That dreadful gaze spanned tens of millions of kilometers, falling upon the cultivators who were battling the Purgatory Demon Gods and legions.
Those Special Forces Soldiers, king-level individuals, and Heavenly Kings, their appearances and the life auras they emitted, provoked a surge of murderous intent in the heart of the Purgatory ancestor.
Yes, this was the race, the very same race as that woman from before.
Only, this Human Race civilization seemed weak, the strongest among them only at the Ancient Middle Stage. However, that human at the ancient early stage had a surprisingly strong aura, comparable to an ordinary True Spirit.
It appeared this human was indeed the monster spoken of by Constantin.
In Tyris’s bloodline information, there was also a record of this human, even more detailed: two Supreme Rules, a physical body stronger than Ancient Beasts.
Standing at the center of the Abyssal Demon Domain, the Purgatory ancestor’s narrow eyes held a cold glance as roaring Black Flames ignited, leaping and piercing through space, forming four giant voids in front.
While observing the information contained in those bloodlines, the Purgatory ancestor’s body resonated with ghostly wails and divine howls, billions of chaotic consciousnesses roared and struggled.
However, these consciousnesses, clinging onto threads of bloodline strength, couldn’t shake the Supreme Will of the Purgatory ancestor.
Every tremor of the Purgatory ancestor’s Soul Will wiped out tens of millions of bloodline thoughts in an instant, suddenly making his suppressive presence even more formidable.
As for Tyris’s consciousness, it had long been crushed and wiped out by the Purgatory ancestor.
Including that ‘loyally devoted’ Demon God Priest Constantin, who was devoured at the first moment of the Purgatory ancestor’s revival.
Huff, huff!!
Around the Purgatory ancestor, substantialized Dark Rules spread out like black fog, morphing into countless black silhouettes in the blink of an eye.
These silhouettes were those devoured True Purgatory Demons, re-manifested under the rule power of the Purgatory ancestor.
And these Dark Shadows were not simple puppets; every one of them existed independently, containing different life information, akin to genuine creatures of darkness.
Soon more than ten billion Dark Shadows had congregated around the Purgatory ancestor, gathering more and more, their lifeforce vibrations blending into the Dark Rules.
Boom! The rules of power enveloping the Purgatory ancestor surged mightily.
Especially under the Purgatory ancestor’s feet, as a black silhouette ten thousand meters tall gathered, instantly the aura of a Great Demon God permeated.
This was one of Purgatory ancestor’s Talent Abilities.
Devouring all True Demon bloodline strength demonized by his Dark Rules, enhancing his own strength, while the Abyssal rules reflect life fluctuations to consolidate Dark Shadows, forming billions of legions to amplify the Dark Rule’s power.
And all this happened in a very short time.
Soon, the number of Dark Shadows condensed by the Purgatory ancestor surpassed hundreds of billions, layering endlessly below his waist.
Simultaneously, the substantialized Dark Rules joined together, forming nine black chains of light behind him.
Boom!
At the moment the nine Dark Rings congealed, the Purgatory ancestor’s aura surged twofold, a powerful force emanated from his True Body, roaring thunderously and continually shrinking.
In just a few breaths, amidst the rolling Dark Demonic Qi, the True Form of the Purgatory ancestor had shrunk to a thousand kilometers, but his aura was even more terrifying, heavy.
“Today, no one can stop me from erasing the Human Race.” A voice, filled with terrifying suppressive force and murderous intent, echoed through Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
Enveloped by the Dark Shadow Legion, the True Form of the Purgatory ancestor bolted, the Void exploded, setting off towering Demon Power towards the forbidden area battlefield.
The formless power made the entire Heaven and Earth shake, Space-Time distorted, with just one step spanning a million kilometers.
In the range covered by the Abyssal Demon Domain, he was the absolute ruler, the embodiment of rules, his will reigning supreme over everything.
And he was not only out to annihilate the Human Race but also to devour those of the Purgatory Demon Clan in the forbidden area battlefield.
Billions of Purgatory Main Battle Corps, and several hundred demon kings, dozens of Great Demon Kings and Demon Gods—nearly the essence of the entire Purgatory Demon Clan.
Once all devoured and absorbed, all their bloodline strength returning, his strength would ascend another level.
Even possibly moving from the Late Stage of True Spirit into the Pinnacle of True Spirit, advancing his Cultivation significantly.
Back then, that one battle had annihilated the entire Purgatory Demon Clan by a sword light, and he, too, had been heavily injured, hibernating for thousands of years.
Thousands of years had passed and not only had his injuries recovered, but in dividing his soul Will, projecting into the river of time to mend the soul wounds, he had unexpectedly gained Tempering.
At this moment, his soul Will had surpassed his Cultivation, comparable to the Pinnacle of True Spirit.
Now, he only lacked the bloodline strength and the Rule Demon Domains.
Roar!
Watching the vast black shadow rolling through the sky, accompanied by the boundless Dark Legion, the Destruction Emperor Dragon roared heavenward, a powerful Battle Intent surging skyward.
This Purgatory ancestor was as strong as it had surmised, even not inferior to that True Spirit Beast that once dwelt in the river of time.
But what of it, it had come today to battle him.
Boom! The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s body erupted with Black Power like flames, fiercely burning, endless, exuding an aura of Doomsday for all creatures.
Under the Black Flames, the entire world began to disintegrate, everything fading, space dissolving, as if Doomsday had truly arrived.
In the center filled with absolute destruction and Doomsday, the seventy-thousand-meter-long body of the Red Beast grew explosively to a hundred thousand meters, its muscles swelling, stretching the heavy scale armor.
