chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1656: Chapter 615: Shadow of the Primordial, True Spirit Great Battle_2 Chapter 1656: Chapter 615: Shadow of the Primordial, True Spirit Great Battle_2 “`
Roar!
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon entered its doomsday state, the heavens and earth within a million kilometers were shaking, the terrifying aura making even the Purgatory ancestors who had traversed the vast distances pause in their tracks.
Behind them, separated by hundreds of thousands of kilometers in the forbidden area battlefield, all king-level beings and demon kings above the Legendary Realm were shocked as they looked towards the outside of the battlefield.
That horrifying power pressure, that bloodline aura which towered above millions of living beings, instinctively made everyone feel a tremor in their hearts.
Both were ten thousand meters in size, but the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not something Tyris could compare to.
Devouring countless flesh and blood, undergoing hundreds of thousands of minor Evolutions, as well as the tempering by rules and laws, the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was almost as dense as neutron star material, concentrated.
At this moment, it stood towering between heaven and earth, and the formless destructive power that it emitted destroyed a range of one hundred thousand kilometers, creating a domain as chaotic as the dark abyss.
At this moment, all the strong men above the mythological level in the Human Alliance were trembling with excitement.
That supporting Giant Beast was too terrifying! Too powerful!
With such strength, even if the Purgatory ancestors had returned from hibernation, they still had hope for victory today, or at least they could retreat in whole if they could not defeat the enemy.
But it wasn’t over yet.
Roar! The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared towards the sky, its body bursting with even brighter red radiance, turning the firmament, veiled in darkness, into an endless crimson.
Amid that glow, filled with an ominous aura, a world teeming with red light distorted space-time and descended slowly.
Boom!
The aura of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon surged once more, its body length reaching one hundred and ten thousand meters, with sharp red bone spurs growing from its joints and on both sides of its scale armor, surrounded by a crimson glow.
At this moment, the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon appeared incredibly hideous and terrifying.
The golden red lightning that leaped upon the body of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon turned into blood red color, the edges emitting black radiance, spreading endlessly in all directions, enveloping a million kilometers.
Where those black blood-colored lightning bolts passed, countless black smoke dissipated, disappeared, directly eradicated by the unrivaled domination of chaotic doomsday power.
Even hundreds of thousands of kilometers to the rear, where the forbidden area was being destroyed by Doomsday Nuclear Weapons, was disintegrating bit by bit.
So extreme was the power that, dominant and overbearing, phenomena sprung up between heaven and earth, and the Void inexplicably echoed with chants whispering of cosmic Great Destruction and doomsday.
As the growth level of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Evolution increased, the amplification of its doomsday state became ever more terrifying.
Moreover, the provoked power of the Deep Red World grew more vast and mighty, the Deep Red World that veiled tens of thousands of kilometers clashed instantly with the Abyssal Demon Domain millions of kilometers away.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The collision of two powerful supreme plane forces was unimaginably frightening; the mere invisible clash and its resultant shockwaves affected a billion-kilometer range, the atmosphere roiled tumultuously, and the Heavenly Energy surged violently.
The pervasive pressure made countless Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts within this range tremble in fear, and numerous ordinary beings of different races panicked restlessly.
As the powers of two supreme planes collided, from the depths of the Deep Red World emerged a colossal beast, as vast as the stars, surrounded by endless crimson radiance.
In an instant, an indescribable terrifying aura pierced through space-time, and even the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but look up, while the Purgatory ancestors approaching from nearly a million kilometers away halted in their steps.
However, that terrifying Giant Beast simply stood silently in the depths of the Deep Red World, quietly observing from afar, unable to descend forcibly.
Or rather, it could not force its way into the mythical world.
Roar!
The Doomsday Destruction Emperor Dragon roared towards the sky and, amidst the enveloping dark and chaotic aura, pounced towards the Purgatory ancestor, crossing a million kilometers to appear before the dark red world looming over the sky.
The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon immediately noticed the problem with the Purgatory ancestor, whose strength had skyrocketed after devouring billions of living beings, permeated by the power of Dark Rules.
Although unaware of the specifics, its instincts told it not to allow the devouring of those Purgatory Demons and demon kings on the forbidden area battlefield.
Its earlier subconscious act of destroying the entrance to the forbidden area with a breath, severing the connection with the Dark Demon Realm, had inadvertently prevented this true Purgatory True Demon from regaining peak strength.
Rip!
Under its bone spur-entwined double claws enveloped by blood red lightning, the Boundary Wall of the Abyssal Demon Domain crumbled thunderously, tearing open a crack tens of thousands of kilometers long.
At the moment the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon fearlessly charged into the Abyssal Demon Domain, Dark Demon Air, as tangible as reality, bore the Power of Heaven and Earth of billions of kilometers and compressed around it.
Boom, boom, boom!!
When that Dark Demon Air drew near a million kilometers to the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, it intersected with the omnipresent Blood Red Lightning, creating earth-shattering explosive roars.
These Blood Red Lightnings and Dark Demon Air were the power extensions of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon and the Purgatory ancestors, the Rules they wielded, a part of their bodies.
Each zigzagging streak of Blood Red Lightning caused vast expanses of Dark Mist to explode and vanish, including the fundamental Abyssal space, leaving behind unhealable dark fissures.
This was the power of ten Higher-order Laws, ten powers condensed by Deification Talent into chaotic doomsday rules, unrivaled, annihilating everything.
Such an extreme destructive force made even the Purgatory ancestors feel a hint of danger, as their eyes burning with Black Flames revealed a trace of solemnity.
What’s going on?
It had been hibernating for thousands of years; had the entire Vast World changed?
Any being that could step into the True Spirit Level possesses a talent so high that one could emerge from billions, possibly even from hundreds of billions.
And the strength of such existences goes without saying; each one is immensely powerful, embodying the Rules, and those able to fight beyond a minor realm at their level are considered to have heaven-defying battle prowess.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1657 - 1657 615 Shadow of the Primordial True Spirit
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1657: Chapter 615: Shadow of the Primordial, True Spirit Great War_3 Chapter 1657: Chapter 615: Shadow of the Primordial, True Spirit Great War_3 But today, it had encountered two monsters that defied its comprehension, abominations.
The human of the ancient early stage who had broken free of limits, possessing the combat power of an ordinary True Spirit, could be overlooked, but this Giant Beast of the ancient late stage was even more terrifying.
That overbearing power of destruction couldn’t even be suppressed by the rules it had conjured by drawing on the Supreme Abyssal Power, after demonizing the Power of Heaven and Earth across a range of hundreds of millions of kilometers.
Even the Purgatory ancestors felt an inexplicable doubt about their demonic origins at this moment.
But that was quickly followed by rage, an inexplicable anger that sprang from the depths of its soul. It abhorred the terrifyingly talented Giant Beast before it and yearned to tear it apart and devour it.
Boom!
With three heads and eight arms, its body covered in black vicious scale armor, the Purgatory ancestor roared as its arms tore through the Void and plunged into the churning black demon air, shaking the entire Abyssal Demon Domain.
A dark red magic spear stretched over two thousand kilometers in length, like a mountain range, slowly emerged. Its shaft was engraved with materialized black rule chains, shaking space-time.
As the Purgatory ancestor grasped the Everdark Heavenly Demon Spear, instantly, an incredibly sharp aura shook the heavens and earth.
“Those who block my path, die.”
Boom!
The Purgatory ancestor, wielding the spear with four arms, enveloped in endless black demon gas, appeared before the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, the pinnacle of presence, looking down upon eternity.
As the two stood millions of kilometers apart, the entire Abyssal Demon Domain was violently shaken, the infinite power converging into a spear shadow that pierced the heavens and the earth.
At this moment, the entire world fell into stasis, save for that ‘slowly’ descending dark red spear shadow, which condensed terrifying strength.
Beneath the spear, space collapsed, the world shattered, creating a black grand canyon a million kilometers long, its tremendous strength pulverizing any blood-red lightning.
Boom! As the dark red spear shadow entered into the expanse filled with chaotic dark destruction, a terrifying force of distortion burst, tearing apart everything in its path.
Instantly, the earth-shattering spear shadow vibrated and exploded, instantly releasing a radiant black halo of light that unleashed power capable of destroying stars.
Under this formidable force, everything within a range of millions of kilometers was instantaneously pulverized; rules dissipated, and the entire range of the Abyss Purgatory trembled.
The Earth was torn asunder; mountain ranges stretching tens of thousands of kilometers crumbled.
The cataclysmic explosion tore through the chaotic darkness; the two thousand plus kilometers of the true dark red magic spear spanned the heavens and the earth, falling with unparalleled demonic majesty.
Roar!
The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon roared without retreating, raising its muscular double claws high. In an instant, terrifying strength powerful enough to shake the Great Thousand Worlds burst forth from within its body.
Boom! Space collapsed, the Void expanded, and a pitch-black hollow over a hundred million kilometers in diameter appeared within the Abyssal Demon Domain in an instant.
Here, space, matter, energy—nothing existed but the two colossal figures that had materialized.
Compared to the thousand-kilometer-tall Purgatory ancestor’s true body, the 110,000-meter-long Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, equivalent to a hundred and ten kilometers, was like an infant.
But the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon stood and crossed its claws, blocking the enormous magic spear that spanned the heavens and earth above its head, stepping on the Void, unyielding.
In the eyes of the Doomsday Destruction Emperor Dragon, blood-red lightning danced, glaring at the magnificent True Demon ‘within arm’s reach,’ its malicious maw slightly agape as it growled, its deep voice shaking space-time.
“I am the king of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire, master of thunder and flames, leader of chaos and silence, Thunderflame Tim Abbott, Brock Abbott.”
“Your strength is formidable, worthy enough for me to know your name, to become one of the great deeds etched in my conquest of the Vast World.”
“Such big words.”
The Purgatory ancestor tilted its head slightly, all three heads filled with coldness and cruelty: “I cannot imagine how you, who barely withstand my normal state after your Limit Breakthrough, can engage me in prolonged combat?”
“But it matters not to share my namesake with you.”
“Remember this, I am from the Supreme Abyss Purgatory Clan, Idril McAllistergui Farias…”
It seemed as though the demon and beast had only exchanged a single strike, yet in that instant, they had competed in almost every aspect.
From the collision of rules, the clash of Rule Domains and powers of the Supreme Plane, to the impact between the powerful rule-embodied true body and the absolute strength of the Giant Beast Body.
In the apocalyptic strike, the rules domain surrounding the Destruction Emperor Dragon was directly shattered.
But the Purgatory ancestor, with a spear strike powered by the entire Abyssal Demon Domain, could not disturb the Giant Beast Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose strength, defense, and solidity were all supremely mighty.
At this moment, the strength of both sides had earned each other’s recognition, even if the upcoming battle would be relentless until death parted them.
Yet, compared to the self-proclaimed titles and names of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, this guy’s name was so long that it made the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s scalp tingle.
In that rolling barrage of introductions, nearly three thousand characters spilled out before the introduction was complete.
The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, who was already overwhelmed, roared instantly.
Boom! The terrifying battle erupted in an instant.
The entire firmament was obscured by crimson radiance, which enshrouded the Abyssal Demon Domain with a thick aura of ominousness.
The True Spirit Late Stage Purgatory Ancestors had such indescribable strength, standing tall in the Abyssal Demon Domain, each strike bearing the startling might of Heaven and Earth, destroying everything within tens of millions of kilometers.
The power of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was also immensely strong, what was even more terrifying was its defense.
Impervious to all spells, indestructible, ignoring all strange or powerful rule-based attacks, it fiercely countered a menacing demon spear capable of bursting a star.
The speed of both sides even transcended time, as a mere clash could obliterate tens of millions of kilometers of sky and shatter the earth.
The invisible power that radiated through even pierced through space-time, creating terrifying phenomena, but all this was beyond anyone’s approach, let alone sight.
And just as the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon blocked the Purgatory Ancestor, the frenzy of the forbidden area battlefield intensified.
After witnessing a scene where countless living beings were reduced to a mist of blood, all demons fell into despair.
This was followed by a frenzied battle with the alliance Divine Kings, trading wound for wound.
The revival of the Ancestors not only failed to bring hope to these demons but plunged them into an even deeper despair.
Faced with a Purgatory Ancestor who wanted to devour all True Demons, even demons had no power to resist under the pressure of bloodlines, their deaths were certain.
As for escape… blocked by the Human Alliance, they had nowhere to run, as both sides were sworn enemies.
If such was the case, they might as well take some humans with them — a fiery fall on the battlefield was better than being crushed like a bug by a Purgatory Ancestor.
But with the arrival of the Giant Beast legions, it was too late even for demons like Carotis to attempt a desperate stand.
Two Great Demon Kings fell, one Lord of the Empire was torn apart and devoured by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, plus one demon killed by Divine King Tarrod, the sacrificial demon, and the sacrificial Constantin swallowed by the Purgatory Ancestor.
With the fall of six demon gods in total, the number of demons in the Purgatory Empire dropped to thirteen.
While on the Human Alliance’s side, with Adam Garcetti ‘fallen’ and the Primordial True King returning to Blue Star, plus the Supreme Level combat power of the True Martial Heavenly King, there remained nine.
But with the addition of eight Ancient Dragon Kings, the number of Demon God-level creatures actually gained the upper hand.
Not to mention, there was also Jack Clark, invincible at the Demon God Realm.
Boom!
Under the envelopment of golden-white lightning and purple-golden halberd radiance, the mid-stage Ancient Demon God Rudeus let out a pitiful scream, his True Body shattered, and dark red blood stained the Firmament crimson.
Yet before Rudeus’s True Body could gather and burn his Origin to escape, the grey millstone emanating the aura of death appeared, covering an area of tens of thousands of kilometers from above and below.
Gurgling noises emerged under that almost deathly grey power, and the shattered demon’s flesh and blood suddenly spewed out thick black smoke.
What was once blood teeming with vibrant life turned grey and decayed, exuding an aura of corruption.
Just as Jack was about to obliterate the true body of the exploding Rudeus with a flick of his hand, the silhouette of the Silver Giant Dragon appeared behind him, issuing an excited roar.
“Human, step aside, let the Great Scythia handle this demon.”
“Today the Great Scythia will create rivers of blood and suppress the Ancient Demon with the body of Titan.”
… Looking at the excitedly circling Silver Giant Dragon in front of him, Jack paused for a moment.
Forget it, he couldn’t be bothered to deal with this fool. Shaking his head, Jack stepped forward, instantly traversing tens of thousands of kilometers and appearing in front of Carotis.
“Roar! The Great Scythia is invincible.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly, sweeping up a black ice crystal destruction storm that engulfed the already weakened form of Rudeus, who couldn’t maintain itself.
[Damn, there’s a bit more that’s not polished yet. Wait ten minutes and refresh, brothers]

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1658: Chapter 616: The Dragon of Destruction with Hands Cradling a Star Chapter 1658: Chapter 616: The Dragon of Destruction with Hands Cradling a Star “`
In response to Glenn Clark’s bewilderment, Justin Welan chuckled and said, “This time, with the Heaven-Earth Mutated event, what the distortion of space-time projected were only fragments of the battlefield. Not seeing your brother’s figure is quite normal.”
“Jack is currently the number one strong man of the Human Race, he must be involved in the Civilization Great War, and we might see him soon.”
At this moment, the entire Blue Star, including the surrounding billions of kilometers of space, was full of strange phenomena, with twisted projections of the mythical world appearing one after another.
Similarly, projections of the Solar System were also cast in the mythical world.
Planets filled with extreme Ice Crystals, Saturn encircled by a beautiful yellow Star Ring, as well as the steel forest cities of the Blue Star World, all appeared above the Firmament.
In the original territory of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, atop soaring mountain ranges, the Black Colossus shaped like the West Wind Giant Dragon lifted its head in amazement, looking at the bustling city scenes appearing in the sky.
Across another deep-sea world passageway, atop a Cloud Mist-shrouded Mountain Peak sat a clear and transparent lake, scattered with various beautiful red, blue, and white Crystal Stones.
Just then, as the Cloud Mist dissipated, a Red Flood Dragon burst forth into the sky, and with a resounding roar, it landed on the edge of the lake.
After landing, the Red Flood Dragon first cautiously examined its front claw, and upon realizing it hadn’t touched the clear waters of the lake, it visibly relaxed before hurriedly roaring out,
“Roar, king, something terrible has happened.”
Bang!
The lake exploded, and a White Giant Dragon covered in white scale armor, but adorned with a pair of red dragon horns, the Eastern Divine Dragon behemoth, emerged halfway out of the water.
The bewildered White Giant Dragon opened its eyes, revealing confusion in its silver-golden vertical pupils: “Something wrong? What’s happened?”
The Red Flood Dragon behemoth said in a panic, “Above, in the sky! A huge fireball has appeared, it’s hurtling towards us, we need to run, king.”
Only then did the White Giant Dragon subconsciously look up, noticing the entire sky illuminated by golden light.
From an unknown vast Firmament above, an immense fireball obscured the sky, emitting an endless blaze of light as it slowly ‘descended.’
The grandeur of the scene caused the entire Earth to stir in an instant, with countless Giant Beasts in the forest emitting panic-stricken roars.
However, as a Giant Beast at the Mythical Peak currently making a breakthrough as a Titan, the White Giant Dragon immediately realized something was off about the huge fireball, paused for a moment, and then let out a languid growl,
“Don’t worry about it, Red Mane. That thing in the sky is just a projection from an unknown space-time, it won’t fall.”
With that, the White Giant Dragon yawned, “I’m so sleepy, this king is going to sleep, don’t disturb my ‘cultivation,’ got it Red Mane?”
“Got it, king,” the Red Flood Dragon behemoth also instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
Saying this, the Flood Dragon behemoth carefully backed up a few steps before slowly turning around, ready to fly away.
It was just that when the Red Flood Dragon behemoth turned, its thick tail swung through the air, and the tail tip, which was like the tuft of a lion’s tail, accidentally brushed the surface of the lake.
An earth-shattering roar erupted in an instant.
“Roar! Red Mane, you’ve dirtied my water again.”
But by then, the Red Flood Dragon had already soared into the sky, turning into a streak of red light and vanishing into the Cloud Mist, leaving the White Giant Dragon who was just about to sleep, very angry.
Meanwhile, on the sea surface where the waves of the Chaos Turbulent Sea were raging, a Level 9 Peak Blue Giant Crab waved its pincers excitedly, expelling a string of bubbles from its mouth.
Gurgle gurgle!! My wife and children, look at the sky, that sea above is the home of General Crab, I can see home.
Gurgle gurgle!!
Around the Blue Giant Crab, thousands of crablike behemoths, alongside swarms of tiny crabs, curiously looked up at the blue ocean scene appearing in the sky.
Boom boom! In the distance, a Black Tiger Whale burst out of the sea excitedly, calling out in whines,
“Miss Keller, it’s the sea, the sea of our world.”
On the sea surface, a Female Tiger Whale with a pink ‘backpack’ hung on her dorsal fin nodded obediently, “Whine whine whine!! I see it, leader.”
While the behemoths left behind in the Dragon Palace were excitedly crying out, in the air, Female Tiger Whales gave off a faint worried look, letting out a soft low hum,
“Our world seems to be in trouble.”
Blue Star
Suddenly, Justin Welan pointed excitedly to the western sky, “Look, there’s Jack.”
One could see the space outside the atmosphere twisting, revealing a figure standing amidst golden-white flames and purple lightning in the center, emitting a Terrifying Aura.
The True Body, standing a hundred thousand meters tall, was over ten times higher than the highest peak of the Himalayas and would reach into the atmosphere if it stood on the surface of Blue Star.
The figure’s frontal head was crowned with the All-Heaven Emperor Crown, with a third eye tightly shut between the eyebrows, while both eyes looked indifferent, the long black hair behind its head fluttering like flames, exuding supreme dignity.
The left side of the face was covered in fine red scales, also with three eyes, only the third eye between the eyebrows was already open, filled with endless blood light, godlike and demonic.
And the right side of the face had both eyes firmly shut, radiating a Terrifying Aura as if the opening of those eyes would spell the onset of Doomsday.
The two ethereal and one real triple faces gave off the impression of the supreme deity of ancient myth, overlooking all living beings.
Coupled with the ferocious War Halberd over thirty kilometers long in hand, the eight arms holding various Divine Weapons gleamed sacredly in the reflection of the rotating golden-white Divine Wheel.
Even though they were worlds apart, the pressure emitted invisibly made countless people in the Blue Star World hold their breath, in tension and awe.
Boom!
The God Demon with three faces and ten arms swept across with the halberd, the terrifying strike fractured space-time, and the fifty-thousand-meter tall Demon God wielding a blood-red Demon Blade screamed, its True Body cut to pieces.
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1659 - 1659 616 Holding Up the Star the Burning
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1659: Chapter 616: Holding Up the Star, the Burning Dragon of Destruction_2 Chapter 1659: Chapter 616: Holding Up the Star, the Burning Dragon of Destruction_2 Tremendous strength shattered Heaven and Earth; an invisible shockwave swept across the land, instantly forming a chasm tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter, deep enough to bury several Blue Stars.
Such exaggerated and terrifying power left countless people utterly shocked.
Justin Welan exclaimed excitedly, “Damn, Jack has become even more powerful than during the last battle, making those Purgatory Demon Gods look like they are no match for him.”
Glenn Clark was also somewhat excited, exclaiming with exhilaration, “My brother is so fierce, badass, fighting those demons feels as easy as bashing grandsons.”
Saying this, Glenn Clark clenched his fists, invigorated, “When it’s my turn to enter the mythical world, I’ll also find a few Demon Gods to kill, to chop up those ugly creatures.”
As a few of them cheered, many of the Cultivation Geniuses surrounding them who heard their conversation were also visibly shaken: “Is that the King of Divine Martial? His true body is so huge.”
“It’s more than just huge, he’s invincible!!”
These geniuses were equally thrilled.
Among the younger generation of the entire Federal Cultivation World, Jack Clark had become a legend, his terrifying pace of cultivation and increasingly astonishing battle achievements inspired everyone to cultivate diligently.
Including the Lewis sisters, Crystal and Mandy, standing on the steps afar, who were also stunned as they watched the extraordinary phenomenon in the western sky, lost in thought for a long time.
Buzz! The whole world suddenly trembled slightly, and then shock appeared on everyone’s faces again.
In the blinding light of the Sun, a figure hundreds of millions of kilometers tall, like an Illusory Projection of a huge body, clearly emerged.
The immense figure was like a slender Mecha, its entire body covered in golden-white armor like skin, engraved with various mysterious patterns of dark gold.
Behind the towering Mecha Projection’s head, nine golden Light Spheres floated, slowly rotating, emitting boundless Radiance and a majestic Aura, shaking the entire Star System.
Suddenly, in the audience stand, Mathilda Ward’s eyes showed solemnity: “Have we finally reached this stage?”
Deep within the Solar System, at the core of the World Origin, under the White Light Sphere, Number One extended its hands, lightly supporting the ‘world.’
Simultaneously, in the projected image of space, the Mecha Projection towering millions of kilometers also stretched out its hands, slowly holding the Sun in place.
Boom! The moment Number One resisted the slowly sinking White Light Sphere, an indescribably heavy, Power Explosion erupted.
Under the Terrifying Power, space-time instantly shattered, causing Number One’s form to dip, emitting crackle crackle sounds from within as if it could not withstand the pressure.
Besides, beneath Number One, there was an even more terrifying tearing force.
That was the invisible gravitational pull from the mythical world, drawing and capturing the Solar System located in another vast universe, all acting upon Number One at this moment.
Screech screech screech!! Number One’s upper half sank, the extremely solid and powerful golden-white armor slowly deformed.
Simultaneously, under the unseen pulling force from the mythical world, cracks began to appear on the lower half of its body, and the awful power was enough to instantly tear apart a Purgatory Demon God.
Moreover, this was just the pressure at the level of strength; the moment Number One attempted to bear the weight of this world, the Rule Origin that contained the endless mysteries of one world, like a collapsing galaxy.
Poured into Number One’s interior, cleansing everything.
The majestic and vast Origin Power was enough to assimilate the True Body of an Ancient Level Divine King in an instant, erasing the soul.
But fundamentally, as a True Spirit, and above that a fragmented body, Number One’s bearing capacity was terrifyingly great, barely resisting the first wave of impact.
Freya Louise’s Spiritual Will merged with the Primitive Azure Sky, like an endless lakeshore, ceaselessly absorbing all information.
As these Origin Rule information, or rather strength, surged in, the Azure Firmament summoned by Freya’s Soul Will began showing signs of merging with the Solar System.
Roar!
Suddenly, Number One let out an angry roar, its eyes shining with a bright azure-white Radiance, its body crackling as it was slowly bent by the Terrifying Power.
Boom! All of Number One’s upper golden-white armor exploded off, revealing the dark gold Flesh and Blood and Bones underneath, dripping with blood.
No, I can’t hold on much longer!!
Inside Number One, Freya as an energy form remained calm, her eyes cold and indifferent without a flicker of emotion, “As expected, there wasn’t enough time, Number One has not fully grown yet.”
“Luckily, there’s still a chance…”
Roar! Number One roared again with wild ferocity.
The outer Azure Firmament trembled, and a boundless colossal shadow emerged deep within the Azure Sky, descending along the Firmament under the astounded gaze of countless people.
Boom!
Just as the shadow, formed of ancient life information, appeared like a Giant Beast or a monstrous entity, the entire Solar System shook once more.
The moment it arrived, the shadow of the Giant Beast, attracted by an unseen body, yearned to rush towards the Sun.
But just when it was about to tear through the pathway, the Primordial True King, having returned with his sealed Cultivation, appeared at the edge of the Blue Star’s space, and a voice filled with desolation rang out.
“Heaven and Earth are profound and yellow, from the beginning of creation, mankind descended upon the world, countless eons passed in an instant, the orbit of Heaven continues without ceasing…”
“Here I hold the mandate of Heaven to protect all beings, to protect the Human Race. Now, I pray to the eternal will of the Human Race, may the Human Race forever flourish, may the Human Race live in peace and order…”
As the Primordial True King chanted the sacrificial texts in some ancient language, an Aura belonging to the Supreme permeated out, turning into a Furious Ape standing ten thousand meters tall in the cosmos.
Simultaneously, a vast expanse of white flames burned around him, like a huge torch, emitting dazzling Radiance.
Inexplicably, everyone in the Blue Star World felt something leaving their bodies, converging towards the Primordial True King.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1660: Chapter 616: The Dragon of Destruction Cradling a Star_3 Chapter 1660: Chapter 616: The Dragon of Destruction Cradling a Star_3 In addition to their startling discovery, Justin Welan and others realized that the entire world seemed to be distorting, with layers of ephemeral shadows overlapping, reviving the ancient primordial wilderness.
There stood towering ancient palaces upon the earth, with countless people in ancient attire worshipping them.
Giants towering tens of thousands of meters tall ran across the earth, roaring at the firmament, chasing the sun in the sky.
Ancient deities descended upon the world, transforming seas into mulberry fields with a wave of their hands, changing all things…
Under the illumination of the burning flame of civilization, the wildness reappeared, countless strengths traversing space-time descended, becoming kindling that blazed fiercely, forming an invisible power that enshrouded the shadow of the giant beast.
Roar!
The beast, lacking a soul to anchor it and composed only of some imprinted information, let out an angry roar, struggling furiously but unable to break free from the bonds of civilization’s fire.
At this moment, massive golden roots ventured out from the void, coalescing into a golden lotus beneath the feet of Number One’s shadow.
And the shadow of that beast, ensnared by the chains of civilization, kept shrinking, finally resting on the edge of the golden lotus, encircling the side of the massive shadow of Number One.
The Eternal Tree that enveloped the world, the ancient beast imprinted from the origin, and the Flame of Civilization’s Guardian coming from the Human Race’s luck.
Roar!
With the blessing of these three parties, Number One howled at the sky, its back, which had been bent under pressure, gradually straightened up again, propping up the entire world.
Boom boom boom!!
As the first phase of bearing the world was completed, under the endless surge of the Rule Origin’s information, or the influx of the Endless World’s Rule Origins, the aura of Number One began to soar wildly.
In the depths of the World Core, its form swelled at a terrifying speed: fifty thousand meters, one hundred thousand meters, two hundred thousand meters…
This scene was also witnessed by countless individuals on the forbidden battlefield of the mythical world.
“We have succeeded!” Sky King Denny Kaye, with a breath of bitter struggle, revealed ecstasy on his face.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King, grasping a demon king’s head in his hand, also laughed loudly: “Hahahaha… We have held back the Second Mythical Impact.”
As he spoke, the Mysterious Martial Sky King roared, “Fight on, brothers, once this battle is over, we will have won completely, and those younger generations won’t need to take the battlefield anymore.”
Purple Heaven Heavenly King let out a long howl: “Mysterious Martial is right, brothers, exterminate all of the Purgatory Demon Race, and we humans will stand firmly in the mythical world.”
“Kill, exterminate all the Purgatory True Demons.” Splitting Sky Sword King roared furiously.
And it wasn’t just the strong man of the Human Race who bellowed across heaven and earth, but the supporting Giant Beasts were even more enthusiastic than anyone else.
“Roar roar roar!! Candle Dragon, that demon king was clearly the one I had my eyes on first.” Kidora, revealing its Law Domain’s True Body, spanning thousands of miles, let out a chaotic roar in the sky.
In the alternating darkness of day and night up ahead, the Candle Dragon Giant Beast, with a form over ten thousand meters long, slowly turned its head, emitting a deep and thick roar: “You, are too slow.”
In the claws of the Giant Beast Candle Dragon, it held a torn-apart Demon King’s True Form at the Mythical Peak.
Above the firmament, the Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by a storm of black ice crystals, let out an excited roar: “Roar! Telsafi, the Great Sethia is invincible, having slain a Demon God.”
The Gold Blue Giant Dragon, locked in battle with a Great Demon King in the sky, rolled its eyes and then flapped its angry wings, with its crystal-like scale armor shining radiantly.
Boom boom boom!!
Thousands of powerful, colorful Light Beams pierced through heaven and earth, destroying everything within thousands of kilometers, shattering space, and wreaking havoc on earth and sky.
“This king is unconvinced.”
Filled with unwilling cries of despair, a Blood Moon appeared gradually in the sky, falling downward.
At this moment, originally having the upper hand, the Purgatory Demon Race began to retreat across the battlefield, with four more Demon Gods having fallen once again, and other Demon Gods weakened, heavily injured in the siege.
And it wasn’t just the Demon Gods, the Great Demon Kings and Demon King Level Strong ones also suffered heavy losses.
As one after the other, Demon Gods and Great Demon Kings fell, the remaining Great Demon Kings and Demon Kings were filled with sorrow and indignation.
In the past, it was they who massacred and suppressed different races and civilizations, leading vast armies to crush the opposition with absolute strength, eradicating all.
And today, they found themselves being suppressed by several races that were once defeated under their rule.
This change was hard for these demon kings and Demon Gods to accept.
Boom!
Under the Overbearing Eight Desolate War Halberd, the surrounding world of rules collapsed around the Lord of the Empire, Bektivi, his True Body shattered into pieces, his violent strength sweeping across a hundred thousand kilometers, sending everything flying.
Standing amidst the rolling waves of destruction, Jack Clark holding a halberd, looked gravely towards the far horizon.
Compared to the exhilaration of others, Jack Clark knew that winning this battle would not be so simple, the real battlefield that could decide the outcome of the war was outside the forbidden area.
The late-stage True Spirit battlefield of those two equally matched entities.
And the Second Mythical Impact, could it really be held back? Jack Clark slowly raised his head, looking at the celestial shadow reflected in the sky, bearing the sun.
Freya Louise’s Sky-Pillar Plan seemed very perfect, every step within the calculations of the Sky-based God King and the others.
Especially after contact with the Heavenly Feather Clan and the transplant of the Eternal Tree’s heart, within millions of computations of the Astrocomputer, the success rate had reached ninety percent.
But Jack Clark felt as though something was still missing.
In contemplation, Jack Clark retracted his gaze and looked at Bektivi, who was re-forming his True Body in the distance.
Having his True Body unravelled more than a dozen times by Jack Clark, Bektivi’s breath was weak, and even his realm had fallen to the ancient early stage, his downfall already a foregone conclusion.
Bektivi revealed a wry smile, “Humans, the fault of today’s battle does not lie with us; if not for the Ancestors’ anomaly, even if we could not win, we could have retreated completely.”
“Indeed,” Jack Clark nodded lightly.

﻿Chapter 1661: Chapter 616: Holding Up the Star, the Burning Dragon of Destruction_4 Chapter 1661: Chapter 616: Holding Up the Star, the Burning Dragon of Destruction_4 The opponent was a Demon God, so Jack Clark spoke calmly, offering basic respect.
Jack’s demeanor made Bektivi, who had expected mockery, pause briefly before he broke the silence, “Actually, you’re wasting your effort.”
Without waiting for Jack to respond, Bektivi turned to look beyond the forbidden area at the terrifying battlefield, “The strength of our ancestors exceeds your imagination. It seems you’ve slain my kind and halted it from absorbing our strength, but in reality, you’re achieving nothing.”
“It is the source of all Purgatory Bloodlines. The strength of every fallen Purgatory True Demon returns to it, unstoppable and unblockable.”
Bektivi’s words made Jack focus sharply, wondering why the Purgatory Ancestor hadn’t forcibly shattered the Destruction Emperor Dragon to come and devour everyone.
Something about Bektivi’s words seemed to provoke something. The Purgatory Ancestor, who was engaged in a fierce battle with the Destruction Emperor Dragon, suddenly let out a roar, and an even more terrifying Aura Burst forth.
Boom!
Invisible waves of Rule vibrations swept across billions of kilometers, instantly causing the kings, demon kings, and the several hundred million True Demons fighting furiously with the alliance to stiffen.
Bang bang bang!!
All the True Demon True Bodies disintegrated, turning into a blood mist that merged with the Dark Demon Air swirling above the battlefield, tainting the Dark Mist that enveloped millions of kilometers around the forbidden zone with crimson.
Instantly, only nine weakened Demon Gods remained on the entire battlefield.
The sudden turn of events left everyone stunned.
With a soft sigh, Bektivi said, “With that True Spirit Beast, you should have chosen to retreat initially and destroy this area to block the ancestor’s path.”
“But now it’s too late. It has become stronger and we can no longer resist that summoning power…”
“No!”
“We won’t resign ourselves.”
The remaining Demon Gods’ faces showed fury and struggle, and soon they exploded under the invisible force of the Rules, turning into a sky full of blood mist.
As all the True Demon True Bodies merged and integrated, the entire Dark Demon Realm turned crimson, like wriggling tentacles surging beyond the forbidden area.
“Not good, block those dark demonic airs.”
Roar!
At this moment, all Divine Kings and Ancient Beasts sensed something, emitting roars of fury and long cries, with powerful Rule forces shaking space-time.
Boom boom boom!! Brilliant sword lights tore through the Void, and the breath columns from nine dragon heads exploded, turning into a hundred thousand kilometers wide expanse of Magma Flames, incinerating everything.
But these attacks upon hitting the dark crimson mist, were like slashing water with a sword, causing no significant damage.
In just a few breaths, the rolling dark crimson mist surged out of the forbidden area, darkening the sky and merging into the Abyssal Demon Realm millions of kilometers away.
Boom!
Light of endless blackness pierced through the Cloud Sky from millions of kilometers away, shaking the starry sky.
Emerging within the grand black Demon Pillar, which swelled to over three thousand kilometers, the Purgatory Ancestor, covered in black spikes, appeared, enveloped in endless Abyss Demonic Aura.
Around it, chains of black Rule condensed underfoot, with an endless army of Dark Shadow Legions gathering behind.
Among these tens of billions of Dark Shadows, eighteen towering figures stood, emitting Auras not lesser in their prime.
At this moment, the true Purgatory True Demons.
As all Bloodline strengths returned, the Purgatory Ancestor who devoured billions finally stepped into the Pinnacle of True Spirit, its Demon Power truly darkening the skies, turning the entire world dark.
Including the forbidden zone battlefield millions of kilometers away, which was also enveloped by the Purgatory Ancestor’s Rule power.
Despite three suns and two moons shining brightly in the sky above, scattering radiant light, the sky was still covered in darkness.
The invisible oppressive force made all members of the four-race alliance tremble in fear, looking towards the horizon in terror at the towering figure of the True Demon projection.
The entire world was filled with darkness, bloodshed, greed, and bloodthirst among other malevolent wills.
Under the influence of this dark annihilative will, reaching the concept of Rules, countless eyes turned inexplicably red, Killing Intent suffused, slowly shifting towards their ‘comrades.’
Including the Mythical Kings and deities, all harbored a terrifying urge to shred everything in sight.
Deep within the Abyssal Demon Realm, the Aura of the Purgatory Ancestor at this moment was immensely grand and vast, exuding a black light of Rules that paradoxically gave an impression of brilliance.
The Purgatory Ancestor’s massive True Body slowly bowed its head, looking towards the Deep Red Giant Beast standing in the center of the chaotic darkness, its voice thundering like a roar, resounding across the world.
“Thunderflame Dragon King, from this moment, our battle truly begins.”
The Purgatory Ancestor brought six arms together, palms from the front uniting, while the remaining four formed different Demon Seals. In an instant, an immensely mighty strength Burst.
A gigantic arm, covered in black scales and numerous black hairs, reached out from behind the Purgatory Ancestor.
Under its world-shielding demonic palm, the Blood Red Lightning spanning a million kilometers furiously dispersed, warping a hundred thousand kilometers range of chaotic darkness into collapse.
Boom! The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon vanished in an instant, as tens of thousands of kilometers of land outside the forbidden zone and the Void around it collapsed.
Just one strike, and the previously evenly matched Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon was blasted away, such was the power of the current Purgatory Ancestor, unmatched.
The gap between the Late Stage of True Spirit and the Pinnacle of True Spirit was just a small realm, but the difference in strength was a hundredfold.
Boom! Heaven and Earth shook, a single strike crushing the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon
[There’s a bit more to wrap up, refresh in ten minutes]

chapters.title: Chapter 1662 - 1662 617 Half-step Primordial Jack Clark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1662: Chapter 617: Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Props Up the Sky Chapter 1662: Chapter 617: Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Props Up the Sky Enshrouded by the crimson hues of the Abyssal Demon Domain, stretching across billions of kilometers, a pitch-black Hollow emerged that devoured all.
In the heart of darkness, an Emperor Dragon whose body swelled to 150,000 meters beamed with the dazzling glow of Black Gold, scintillating to the extreme, like it was composed of pure radiance.
The energy and mass it emitted were indescribably potent, distorting space-time and bending light within a million-kilometer radius and forming a white halo with a diameter of 100,000 kilometers around the black hole.
In this domain, space collapsed and the rules of the Abyssal Demon Domain shredded, creating an absolute realm of destruction.
Such terrifying might made even the majestic presence standing deep within the projection of the endless Deep Red World bow its head slightly.
A terror-filled gaze that seemed almost unreal pierced through space-time, falling upon the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon from a supreme world, seemingly astonished by its resolve.
None had anticipated that, facing the Purgatory Ancestor whose strength had peaked, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, whose combat prowess defied the heavens, would choose to shatter its bloodline.
Including the Purgatory Ancestor.
In its ultimate form, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, comparable to the Late Stage of True Spirit in all aspects, was indeed powerful. Even if it couldn’t defeat the Purgatory Ancestor, it could escape, and the latter was powerless to detain it.
Therefore, this extreme act of either dying together or dying alone gave the Purgatory Ancestor pause before a thunderous, angry voice that echoed for billions of kilometers boomed through Heaven and Earth,
“Thunderflame Dragon King, is an alien civilization really worth this?”
The Purgatory Ancestor was not unjustly enraged; with its current strength, it was confident it could suppress this Giant Beast and forcefully erase the Human Race’s civilization.
But it had only prepared to suppress and repel the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, not to consider killing it—one was difficult to achieve, and even if it managed to kill the foe who refused to retreat, it would suffer heavy injuries.
For the Purgatory Ancestor, who sought to recover from its wounds and advance its cultivation further, this was not a worthwhile trade.
Its soul and will, now a hundred times more robust, caught a glimpse of hope for a breakthrough to the Primordial. Naturally, it was unwilling to be wounded and enter Hibernation for hundreds of years right after awakening.
From within the black hole came the ominous and resounding growl of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, “To me, it matters not whether it is worth it or not.”
Right then, the Gold Blue Giant Dragon within the forbidden battle area let out a frenzied roar, “Thunderflame, have you lost your mind? You’ll die, you, stop the burning state at once.”
The other Ancient Beasts couldn’t believe it either, clueless as to why the Destruction Emperor Dragon would go to such lengths.
The Ancient Lava Giant Dragon’s searing flames erupted as its nine dragon heads roared, “Roar! King, we just came to support; if we cannot defeat them, we can retreat first.”
“Roar! Yes, retreat if we can’t win.”
“Whimper! With your growth rate, you’ll blast this guy to pieces in the next Sun Wheel.”
Each of the Ancient Beasts issued frantic roars, including the Blue-White Giant Dragon, which couldn’t help but speak out,
“Thunderflame, you’re just over a year old in the Life Mark Wheel, with tremendous potential; there’s no need to fight to the death with this Chaos Domain True Demon. We can retreat first.”
Just over a year old!?
In an instant, the Kings of Immortal Spirit, Heavenly Feather Divine Kings, and Tarrod Divine Kings and the like, all showed stunned expressions.
They hadn’t misheard, had they? That terrifying Giant Beast, comparable to the Late Stage of True Spirit—was a little over a year old.
“It’s already too late to stop now.” Within the heart of the black hole, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, whose Full-body Scales Armor was cracked and whose body radiated brilliant Radiance, turned back, showing a fierce smile.
However, due to the distortion of vision, no ‘person’ could see that smile.
“Since stepping onto the Transcendent Path, I have roamed freely across the wastelands, invincible in my era; I have always blasted my enemies head-on, never once suppressed by anyone, kill.”
Boom!
A roar that shook the world exploded, and the destructive, twisted black hole surged forth, instantly appearing in front of the Purgatory Ancestor millions of kilometers away.
Wherever it passed, the stronghold and space of the Abyssal Demon Domain, suffused with Dark Rules, crumbled, forming a pitch-black pathway.
“If you wish to die, I shall oblige you, Fourth Layer. Eternal Night Dark.”
The true body of the Purgatory Ancestor, towering thousands of kilometers and shrouded in endless darkness, held the spear in both hands while enigmatic black demon patterns on the four arms behind it flickered, forming Demon Seals.
And this time, the Demon Seals formed were identical.
The entire Abyssal Demon Domain trembled, boundless strength converging behind the Purgatory Ancestor, forming faces with two legs and heads like Demons or devils.
Four terrifying demon faces, each as large as a hundred thousand kilometers and resembling Abyssal Overlords, overlapped and merged instantly into the Everdark Heavenly Demon Spear wielded by the Purgatory Ancestor.
Boom!
With the bolstering of bloodline Divine Power, the light from the spear intensified, surrounded by chains of Rule sequences blasting through the Chaotic Black Hole, appearing instantly before the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
Greeting the spear was a Dragon Claw composed of pure Black Gold radiance.
The claw, bearing Terrifying Power, transcended the past and the future, veiling Heaven and Earth as it ‘slowly’ reached out, causing the entire world to quake.
Boom!
At the instant when the Dragon Claw intersected with the Demon Spear, the black hole rapidly expanded, the surrounding halo shone brightly, and the Fourth Layer of rule chains condensed on the Everdark Heavenly Demon Spear shattered.
The power filled with Chaos and destruction remained undiminished, erupting forth, causing the Abyssal Demon Domain within a range of millions of kilometers to crumble, with rules dispersing like an explosion of Deep Red crystal facets.
Thump, thump, thump! The massive body of the Purgatory Ancestor shook, each step it retreated shattering the Void, forming pitch-black hollows of nothingness.
One arm holding the Demon Spear cracked at the scale armor, flesh and blood obscured, and droplets of black blood imbued with Terrifying Energy sprayed out, burning through the Void and disappearing.
In front of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, which was burning all its strength, even the Pinnacle of True Spirit, the Purgatory Ancestor, was at a disadvantage.

chapters.title: Chapter 1663 - 1663 617 Half-step Primordial Jack Clark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1663: Chapter 617 Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Supports the Sky_2 Chapter 1663: Chapter 617 Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Supports the Sky_2 This infuriated the Purgatory Ancestor, who had just stepped on the peak, sending Doomsday Emperor Dragon flying with a single punch, his fighting spirit high.
Again, it was the same.
Despite having a higher realm and cultivation, being stronger in power, he still found himself at a disadvantage when facing that woman of yesteryear and the giant beast today.
Unforgivable.
“You all deserve to die.”
Filled with murderous intent, the roar echoed through heaven and earth as Purgatory Ancestor’s aura suddenly surged, dark red flames burning fiercely on his body, shooting up ten thousand kilometers high.
But burning a tenth of his Origin to enhance his strength was not enough. One saw the Purgatory Ancestor, with three heads and six arms, roar and tear off a head from his left side with his hand.
Pfft! The ripped wound was a blur of flesh and blood, a black-red crystal-like spine was exposed, and a few drops of black blood sprayed out, extremely bloody and terrifying.
The demon head held in his own arm stared deathly at Doomsday Emperor Dragon, its mouth slightly open, whispering some sort of terrifying language, then dissipated into black smoke and vanished.
Pfft, pfft, pfft!
Countless black runes suddenly appeared on the body of Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, each rune like a malicious ghost trying to latch onto its flesh and blood.
But these curse-like black runes barely approached the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, disappearing into black smoke under the radiant light shining from its body.
These black curse runes were extremely terrifying, surpassing ordinary rules and nearing concepts, appearing infinitely and rushing out crazily.
Even Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon’s Chaotic Dark Power Talent, an impenetrable force field, couldn’t completely dissolve them, and occasionally a black rune would land on the scale armor, creating a several meters wide black mark.
These marks, like grimacing faces with sinister smiles, crazily drained the life force of Doomsday Destruction Emperor Dragon.
But relative to the massive body of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, these black marks were nearly imperceptible, and the bit of life force they drained was negligible in its burning state.
But if they accumulated too much…
Boom!
In an instant, the Abyssal Demon Domain shook, the central area collapsed, and two figures exuding terrifying aura clashed once more, this time to the death.
Although Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon was very strong at this moment, Purgatory Ancestor knew that its state of disintegrating life form could at most last half a day before turning to ash.
In half a day’s time, it could at most endure some consumption, losing part of its Origin.
Feeling the terrifying energy fluctuations tens of millions of kilometers away, the Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings and let out excited, triumphant Dragon Roars, “Roar! Fight, Tim Abbott, blow that guy up.”
On the Earth below, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle stood on all fours, also extending its neck and roaring with excitement.
“Thunderflame, blow that darn thing up, it’s best to tear it apart alive.”
Ying ying ying! Kill, slaughter everything, Thunderflame is invincible. The Single-horned Spawn Roc, which had already broken through the Early Titan stage, flew in the sky like a massive Spawn Roc with wings.
Roar roar roar! How mighty Abbott is, invincible, awesome.
“Thunderflame, invincible.”
The Nine-headed Flood Dragon and the Giant Beast Candle Dragon coiled in the sky, also let out deep and high Dragon Roars, trembling with excitement as they felt the invisible, spreading Terrifying Aura in the distance.
Compared to those Ancient Dragon Kings, the giant beasts that had followed Destruction Emperor Dragon from Blue Star knew it better.
Although every battle of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was incredibly fierce and bloodthirsty, in reality, it was extremely cautious, never taking chances.
And they all remembered that Destruction Emperor Dragon still possessed life class Talent Abilities.
But just as these giant beasts roared across heaven and earth, cheering for the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon fighting in the distance, boundless Dark Demon Air surged from outside the forbidden area.
Within the demon gas, billions of Dark Shadow Legion roared, with the eighteen leading demon shadows emitting pressure comparable to Demon Gods.
Although the Doomsday Destruction Emperor Dragon intended to block them, it meant Purgatory Ancestor couldn’t approach the forbidden area, but that didn’t mean he had no other means.
With ten arms on three sides, emanating pressure comparable to ordinary True Spirits, Jack Clark bellowed, “All ‘people’ above the Legendary Realm, follow me, block the entrance to the forbidden area.”
“Those demon shadows are undying and unyielding. They must not be allowed to come in.”
Boom! Space collapsed, and in a few steps, Jack Clark crossed tens of thousands of kilometers to reach the edge of the forbidden area.
Here, after the explosion of the Doomsday Nuclear Weapons and Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Breath strike, the forbidden area, which was originally over a hundred thousand kilometers wide, now had only about a hundred thousand kilometers left.
And this region, dreaded even by the Ancient Level, was split into several dozen pathways of varying sizes.
The widest one was over thirty thousand kilometers, and the narrower ones were only a few hundred to a thousand kilometers wide.
Roar roar roar!
Led by four demon shadows exuding Demon God pressure, countless Dark Shadow Legions roared violently and surged towards Jack Clark, who stood firm at the widest entrance.
Boom! A Halberd Skill, shining with dazzling dark golden Radiance, crossed the Void and struck down, exploding heaven and earth and forming a Destruction Tunnel over a hundred thousand kilometers long and ten thousand kilometers wide.
Under the Unrivaled Domination Power, tens of millions of the Dark Shadow Legion turned to ash, including those four Demon God Illusions.
The undying and unyielding, Dark Shadow Legion, born from the Rule of Purgatory Ancestor, was terrifying, but at the same time, it wasn’t without weaknesses.
That is, the more powerful these reflected demon shadows were, the further they fell. For example, the Tyris Demon Shadow blasted by Jack Clark’s halberd strike was only at one-tenth of its peak strength.
And they lacked their own consciousness, possessing only partial combat instincts.
Even so, they were still incredibly terrifying.
If Purgatory Ancestor had enough time to corrupt a larger expanse of heaven and Earth, demonizing trillions of Transcendent Life and Mythical Creatures, its strength would be unspeakably horrifying.

chapters.title: Chapter 1664 - 1664 617 Half-step Primordial Jack Clark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1664: Chapter 617: Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Props Up the Sky_3 Chapter 1664: Chapter 617: Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Props Up the Sky_3 Because one of its Talent Abilities was to absorb the bloodline strength grown from its own demonization and nourish itself.
Moreover, after devouring those demonized True Demons, it could transform them into Dark Shadows, making this a seemingly unsolvable complement of bloodline abilities.
Were it not for a “slight” deficit in talent, this Purgatory True Demon would have ascended to even higher realms in the span of a hundred thousand years.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Standing at the entrance, Jack Clark held his ground alone, wielding his Halberd Skill with Unrivaled Domination, shrouding the entrance and most of its surroundings.
His Terrifying Power was unstoppable, crushing everything in his path.
Meanwhile, the King of Immortal Spirit and other strong men pressed forward, their powerful rule auras spreading wide, eradicating the dark army and defending each of the forbidden area entrances.
Instantly, battle cries echoed once again between heaven and earth, and this time only those above the Mythical King rank joined the battle.
In the center of the forbidden area, tens of millions of Transcendent Warriors from the different races stood somewhat bewildered, feeling waves of potent energy from the sky and not knowing what to do.
At that moment, an aged voice rang in everyone’s ears,
“The coming battle is beyond your participation; those unharmed should spread out to the periphery to treat the injured.”
“Those with minor injuries should move to the nearest strategic defense fortification to receive healing resources; soldiers from the rear logistics immediately enter the battlefield…”
Under the command of the Sky-based God King, the entire battlefield swiftly bustled into action, methodically cleaning up the aftermath.
Of course, the battle had not yet ended.
At the edge of the forbidden area.
As time slipped away, three hours passed in the blink of an eye. Jack Clark, guarding the widest entrance, still emanated a mighty aura, and in the face of the unceasing onslaught of Dark Shadows, he nearly slaughtered hundreds of billions.
But the moment those Dark Shadows were obliterated, they would reconstitute from the surging demon gas behind them, emitting a Mountains and Seas shaking hiss as they continued their charge.
The situation at the other entrances was much the same, with everyone roaring in rage, massively wiping out the reforming Dark Shadows in the fierce battle with demon kings and Great Demon Kings.
Among them, a few of the wills just short of the threshold, from the different races of the Divine Gods Alliance, began to show signs of panic.
Those who had not directly entered the battlefield could hardly imagine the terror and oppression felt from an unending tide of undying and unyielding Dark Shadows.
“It’s almost two hours left, and the Giant Beast Body is about to collapse,” Jack Clark, overseeing all directions, perceived the situation thoughtfully.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon’s life talent, upon breaking through ancient times, evolved into the Undying Strength, allowing the condensation of two drops of Rebirth Blood which could resurrect and recover in an instant as the physical body shattered into oblivion.
This meant that the Destruction Emperor Dragon had three lives.
Therefore, shattering the Talent Runes and triggering a Burst of all-consuming energy was an ordinary combat tactic for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, a means to see just how many cards the Purgatory True Demon held.
Such an old creature, having lived for over a hundred thousand years—equivalent to two to three hundred thousand years on Blue Star—had reached the limits in both mastery of strength and exploitation of bloodline abilities.
For instance, tearing its own head to transform it into the power of a curse was immensely strong, nearly penetrating the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s defenses against all spells.
It caused the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which was expected to withstand half a day’s battle, to collapse two hours ahead of schedule.
This was also due to the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s terrifyingly strong defenses, which rendered many of the Purgatory Ancestor’s assaults ineffective, forcing it to rely on head-on confrontation with absolute Strength.
Otherwise, under various time and curse-related abilities, any peer of the same rank would be left in a very dire state.
Apart from this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s outbreak aimed to delay the timing, as Jack Clark wasn’t yet ready to Deify and slay this True Demon.
He was waiting, waiting for Freya Louise’s support to reach completion.
Otherwise, even if the Purgatory Demon Race was annihilated in this battle, the Human Race would still have lost, losing half of its future.
Every world captured would plummet into the mythical world, where, under the violent energy suffusing between heaven and earth, most ordinary lives would burst and perish.
Some would suffer genetic collapse and become twisted monsters with chaotic consciousness, like the giants Jack Clark had seen upon first entering the mythical world.
Only a very few would survive to become the new adaptors.
Yet, these adaptors’ talents, cultivation speed, and potential would all fall short of the geniuses who underwent Innate Awakening and mutations under the twin-world convergence and rule influence.
Thus, if the Mythical Impact failed, the Human Race would lose half of its future prospects, and the other half rested with Jack Clark.
As long as he remained, there would always be hope for humanity.
Pondering, Jack Clark unleashed a halberd stroke, exploding two Demon God Illusions and millions from the dark army roaring towards him, his Terrifying Strength forming a separate layer of Space-Time fault, cutting off heaven and earth.
“The second phase is approaching.”
Jack Clark looked up, gazing at the increasingly vivid projection of the Solar System World in the Firmament, along with the horizontal illusion upheld at the center of the system, his gaze sharpening.
In the stone tablets obtained from the Stone Statue Ruins by the Human Federation upon entering the mythical world, there were fragmented records of successful previous attempts at support.
The entire support process was divided into two stages: the first involved entering The Heart of the World, bearing the weight of the world, and slowing its approach.
The second stage would be to withstand the endless wash of World Rule Origin, absorbing those forces to grow.
Simultaneously, this was also a process of assimilation and transformation.
The individual undertaking the support would align themselves with heaven in terms of life strata, with their True Body bearing the world, and their Will merging with it to become akin to a Heavenly Dao presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1665 - 1665 617 Half-step Primordial Jack Clark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1665: Chapter 617: Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Props Up the Sky_4 Chapter 1665: Chapter 617: Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark Props Up the Sky_4 If successful, the Solar System torn apart by the mythical world would become a complete, independent world with its own set of fully functioning World Rules.
At the same time, it would gain the recognition of the Chaos Void, situated between the mythical world’s Boundary Wall and the Void of Chaos.
Gazing at the increasingly distinct projection of Number One next to the sun, Jack Clark’s Black Gold vertical pupils slowly surfaced in his eyes, and in an instant, the scene in his eyes transformed.
Above the sky spanning billions of kilometers, the distorted Space-Time surrounding the approaching Solar System vanished, replaced by layer upon layer of spatial barriers formed by an endless Seven-Colored Glow.
And the Solar System, like an enormous boundless bubble, kept sinking, shattering layer upon layer of fundamental space as it neared the surface world of the mythical world.
The projection of Number One, towering tens of millions of kilometers high, was not actually holding the sun in its hands but stood beneath the Boundary Wall of the Solar System, its arms propping up the heavens, supporting the entire world to prevent it from falling.
This was the act of supporting the heavens.
And between the Solar System and the mythical world, behind Number One, countless golden roots entwined to form a vast and boundless phantom of the Golden Divine Tree, propping between the two worlds.
But at this moment, the situation of Number One seemed a bit dire.
The colossal projection let out roars, yet it couldn’t stop the Solar System from falling, its body bending bit by bit under the terribly heavy force that was beyond description.
“We’re in trouble,” muttered Jack Clark, his expression becoming extremely serious as he watched the scene unfold.
Because Freya Louise, or rather, the ancient being that was Number One’s true body, was not recognized by the newly born world of the Solar System. It was now merely propping things up with brute strength.
That was a large world whose surface space spanned hundreds of billions in range. In terms of mass alone, the Star sun was heavy enough to crush a True Spirit.
Not to mention those planets orbiting the sun, countless meteor materials, and the essence of the entire world.
The true act of supporting the heavens was to activate the World Origin Rules for a grand cycle, using the World Rules of the Solar System World to counter the invisible Devouring force of mythical time.
If things continued this way, it wouldn’t be long before Number One reached its limit and got crushed into dust by the impact force of both worlds, completely annihilated.
No wonder Jack Clark had always felt something was missing.
“Tarrod, the Divine King, I’ll leave it to you to oversee things here.”
Jack Clark let out a long howl as his massive True Body suddenly moved, tearing open space with a few flickers crossing tens of thousands of kilometers to the shock of all who watched.
And just as Jack Clark left, Tarrod, who was suppressing another entrance, arrived without hesitation, emanating the might of a Half-step True Spirit and descending.
Seeing this, Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy, who was stationed at a pathway with Sean Immortal King, made a move to fill the vacant entrance.
Boom! A Terrifying Aura burst forth from the rear.
“Lord Tolstoy, please leave this place to me.”
The True Martial Heavenly King, who had successfully broken through to the Supreme Realm, emerged radiating a sky-full of Black Gold Divine Light, with tangible Rule chains manifesting around him, his might vast and powerful.
“Hahahaha… True Martial, you’ve finally broken through to the Supreme,” roared the Mysterious Martial Sky King with laughter.
The faces of the other Mythical Kings and Heavenly Kings also showed smiles; the Human Race had added another Supreme.
“Yes, I’ve finally made the breakthrough.”
The True Martial Heavenly King, solemn in demeanor, clad in a black robe resembling the True Martial Emperor of Mythical Legends, cracked a slight smile at throwing the black stele he was holding.
Boom! The stele, engraved with the words True Martial, surged in size, transforming into a black mountain tens of thousands of kilometers tall that landed firmly at the entrance.
The invisible, heavy Aura gathered upon the stele, suppressing Space-Time. Within a range of tens of thousands of kilometers, millions of creatures from the Dark Army turned to ash, while shadows of Demon Gods thousands of meters high also exploded into oblivion.
After breaking through to the Ancient Realm, the now powerfully combative True Martial Heavenly King, amplified by the simultaneously breakthrough stele of True Martial, boasted a strength comparable to the ancient late stage.
Moreover, he was among the stronger existences within that realm.
At the same time, over a million kilometers away, above the Logistics City of Channel One engulfed in golden light, space shattered as a God Demon with three faces and ten arms descended.
Under the gaze of over a million cultivators, Jack Clark reached into the Void behind him, tearing through the golden tree root-formed pathway and bursting into it forcibly.
Boom! The Eternal Divine Tree phantom, towering tens of thousands of kilometers high, trembled.
The capacity of Channel One of the Blue Star World, its ultimate limit being a peak Heavenly King under normal conditions, prevented Jack Clark, whose essence was already comparable to that of a Demon at the extreme, from entering.
But with the countless golden roots of the Eternal Divine Tree reinforcing it, the channel’s capacity soared, becoming tremendously solid while filled with a storm that could tear apart a Heavenly King, even injuring a regular Ancient Powerhouse.
The Blue Star World.
Just as everyone’s heads turned up in shock at the heavens-supporting projection and the surrounding unfolding visions of the past, the entire Blue Star suddenly trembled.
Then an indescribable Terrifying Aura filled Heaven and Earth.
Under the majestic divine authority that represented the rules of one side and the dreadful pressure, all of Blue Star’s nearly two and a half billion people felt their bodies sink and their legs grow weak, involuntarily kneeling down.
Boom!
The Void trembled, and to the astonishment of countless eyes looking towards the direction of Eastern Summer, an immense figure slowly rose, its upper body even reaching beyond the atmosphere.
Released from the firm spatial restraints of the mythical world and arriving on Blue Star, Jack Clark’s True Body inflated like a balloon being filled with air, transforming into a towering figure over ten thousand kilometers tall.
At this moment, layers of the atmosphere orbited around him, mixed with many satellites that looked like specks of dust.
Such a colossal True Body, due to its unavoidable gravitational pull, left the entire Eastern Hemisphere without gravity; countless people and buildings started to float, the Earth vibrated and cracked.
Even the entire Blue Star rocked, its crust rippling like sea water on the verge of tearing apart.
Boom!
In that instant, behind Jack Clark, the Golden Divine Wheel shone brightly, its invisible heavy pressure enveloping the Blue Star, forcibly suppressing the destructive power about to erupt from deep within the Earth.
In space, the True Body, also freed from spatial constraints and resembling a ten-thousand-meter Furious Ape, turned around in amazement.
“Jack Clark, why have you returned?”
Jack Clark spoke slowly, “Freya Louise, or rather, the Position Pattern of Number One is not enough; it’s merely Half-step Primordial and cannot gain the recognition of the Solar System World.”
Boom!
With a step, the entire Blue Star sank tens of thousands of kilometers. Jack Clark took one stride into space and tore through the space towards the sun.
[There are a few hundred words left to wrap up, brothers, refresh in ten minutes]

chapters.title: Chapter 1666 - 1666 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1666: Chapter 618: Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Fusion Chapter 1666: Chapter 618: Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Fusion Jack Clark infiltrated the returnees from the Frontline Battlefield, his True Body swelling to tens of thousands of kilometers, the invisible power fluctuations nearly ripping Blue Star apart, shocking everyone.
At this moment, the more than two billion ordinary people and tens of millions of ordinary cultivators on Blue Star finally understood the meaning of the term “Supreme Experts.”
They represented a lifeform that completely towered above the human species, an existence far more powerful than many gods and buddhas in mythical legends.
Merely gazing at the even more imposing shadow that appeared beside the sun in the sky, a sense of panic inexplicably surged in everyone’s hearts.
Not right.
The King of Divine Martial was stationed at the frontline, resisting the Purgatory Demon Clan, so why had he suddenly returned? And like that enormous ‘Mecha,’ he appeared beside the sun.
At this time, anyone with a brain could clearly feel that something was amiss; the situation was not as simple as a mere anomaly.
Was Doomsday approaching?
Crystal Lewis gravely said, “Miss Karen, something big might have happened.”
Due to their insufficient strength, Crystal Lewis and the other high-level cultivators were not yet qualified to be informed about the news of the second impact, a ‘secret’ known only to those at the king level and above.
“It’s okay, if the sky falls, there will be tall ones holding it up, isn’t Jack still there?” Mandy Lewis didn’t care too much.
Facing such a world-destroying crisis, they, as ordinary cultivators, couldn’t provide any help even if they wanted to.
At this moment, not just on Blue Star, the kings and Heavenly Kings on the forbidden area battlefield were also shocked, looking at the projection above the sky, especially that immeasurably huge projection.
Sky King Denny Kaye was flabbergasted, “How did Jack get back to prop up the sky!?”
Boom!
The thousand-meter-tall Mysterious Martial’s legs stomped upon the Void, sending out an invisible yellow shockwave sweeping across thousands of kilometers, shattering a Dark Shadow emanating the aura of a Great Demon King.
Then the Mysterious Martial Sky King looked up solemnly, “There must be a problem with Number One.”
“Trouble.”
The Heavenly Kings and kings of the Human Race all had serious expressions on their faces.
The Giant Beast that came to their aid was very strong, having blocked the nearly invincible Purgatory ancestor, but the Human Race’s main pillar of support was still Jack Clark.
Adam Garcetti had fallen, the Primordial True King had returned to Blue Star, and currently, only the Sky-based God King remained stationed here.
However, the Sky-based God King was currently in a special state, and as the contingency plan for the Beast named Thunderflame that could not be overcome, he could not move lightly but had to continue standing guard at the rear.
If Jack Clark’s attempt to prop up the sky failed and he perished, leading to the destruction of the world, it would be an unbearable loss for the Human Race.
Deep within the Solar System, the core of the world within Number One vibrated, and Freya Louise’s voice came through, tinged with a hint of urgency and indifference: “Jack Clark, let go quickly, you’ll die.”
“Die!”
Jack Clark, towering tens of thousands of kilometers high, slowly looked down at Number One, which was just over a hundred kilometers below him, and slowly said, “Don’t worry, it’s just propping up a world.”
“Rise,” Jack Clark roared.
Boom!
Already in a state of Limit Breakthrough, an aura that surpassed the Heavenly Earth Rules and dominated billions of living beings, aligning with Heaven itself, erupted from the depths of Jack Clark’s soul.
Roar! A deep and desolate Dragon Roar echoed through the Void, filled with an indescribable majesty.
Under the guidance of a weak Heavenly Tier aura at the Soul Source, Jack Clark’s hair wildly danced, as a pair of Black Gold dragon horns grew from his head, and a Dragon Tail that stretched tens of thousands of kilometers materialized behind him.
In an instant, the entire Solar System trembled, and the white Light Sphere at the Heart of the World shone even brighter, an endless flow of Rule Origin pouring out like the Milky Way.
Boom! Jack Clark’s aura surged wildly.
His body, initially weakened by burning his Life Origin for a Limit Breakthrough, began to recover at an astonishing rate under the Origin Energy of a vast world.
That included the replenishment of the consumed Life Origin Power.
The moment his injuries recovered, the True Demon God Body, which had already reached the Primordial (juvenile) stage, emitted a terrifying suction force.
Every cell, flesh and blood, and even gene chains in his body were fully activated, brimming with fearsome Vitality.
At this time, Jack Clark’s True Body was like a desert that had been dry for ten thousand years, growing at an astonishing rate under the Origin containing the information of a vast world and Star System.
All Talent Runes and Law Chains within the body evolved and improved with terrifying speed.
Including the Supreme Power Rules and the Primordial Genesis Rules, they absorbed endless Origin Rule information under the ‘guidance’ of that trace of Heavenly Tier aura, perfecting and extending themselves.
Boom boom boom!!
