At this moment, Jack Clark’s cultivation soared like there were no limits, quickly breaking through the Ancient Middle Stage, then, under Freya Louise’s shocked gaze, stepping into the Ancient Late Stage.
As his cultivation skyrocketed, Jack Clark’s True Body became even more enormous, reaching thirteen thousand kilometers, fifteen thousand kilometers, thirty thousand kilometers.
The projection manifested in the Outer World also grew rapidly to over fifteen million kilometers, and the sun, over a million kilometers in diameter, was like a basketball in his hand.
The aura he emitted became even more terrifying, shaking space-time; under the amplification of the World Rules Origin, it enveloped nearly the entire Solar System.
Boom boom boom!!
On Blue Star, the knees of the more than two billion people who had just stood up went weak, instinctively kneeling under that supreme pressure, faces reflecting awe and astonishment.
“Damn, damn!! Jack’s totally awesome this time.”
The very moment he knelt, Justin Welan, who had chosen to lie down on the ground, looked up at the figure in the sky like a Creator God, his face flushed with excitement.
Beside him, lying on the ground like Justin Welan, Zac Maben’s voice trembled a bit, “Although you’re strong, Jack, it’s still a bit difficult to make Henry kneel.”
“Did it succeed?” Mathilda Ward slumped into a chair, looking up at the increasingly radiant figure in the sky with excited eyes.
At this time, throughout Blue Star, only two people were standing; one was Glenn Clark of the Simon Empire, and the other was Doris Clark looking up to the sky in Mist River City.

chapters.title: Chapter 1667 - 1667 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1667: Chapter 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Integration_2 Chapter 1667: Chapter 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Integration_2 Not knowing if it was because of their bloodlines’ shared origin or not, under the tremendous pressure of the descending Supreme Deities, they didn’t feel any discomfort.
Instead, within Glenn Clark’s body, under the nourishment of Jack Clark’s bloodline strength, a powerful force was reviving.
Even Doris Clark felt warm all over, as if her body suddenly became filled with strength, even having the illusion that she could punch and explode a building with one fist.
Outer Space.
Carrying the fire of civilization and steering the power of his race to augment Number One, the Primordial True King was also a bit stunned.
He hesitated over whether to continue augmenting Number One or to bestow the race’s civilizational strength upon Jack Clark.
No, Jack Clark seemed not to need his or the Eternal Divine Tree’s help anymore.
In the senses of the Primordial True King, the entire Solar System seemed to come to life, filled with vitality, and the previously chaotic rules torn from the Original Universe started to reconstitute and cycle one by one.
It was a success—Heavenshield.
But the success was so effortless that the Primordial True King was somewhat unable to react.
They had prepared for over twenty years, and even with everything going smoothly, they nearly failed; the much-anticipated Number One fell just short.
But now, this guy, Jack Clark, just went straight in and earned the recognition of Heaven and Earth, and with his own being, he completed The Heart of the World.
At that moment, at the core of the Solar System’s world, Jack Clark’s cultivation had already broken through to the Peak of the Ancient, and even there, it didn’t stop.
His True Body, towering thirty thousand kilometers high, was enveloped in dazzling radiance, resembling a light sphere spanning across the center of the world, expanding and contracting with each breath.
At the same time, the strand of Heavenly Tier aura at Jack Clark’s chest, after drawing in the vast World Origin, started to congeal into substance, forming a white Light sphere.
Inside, it seemed to harbor a terrifying existence, a Heavenly Dao…
And after Jack Clark absorbed most of the onslaught, Freya Louise, piloting Number One, felt the pressure lessen. Her strength continued to grow with the constant influx of World Origin.
Feeling the increasingly powerful strength within her body, even Freya Louise couldn’t help but be shocked.
She perceived that the Blue Star World, or rather the Solar System, was so strong that just the dissipation of a fraction of the World Origin could sustain the birth of a True Spirit Level Monarch.
It was indeed a ‘world’ that had once borne the weight of seven Ancient Emperors.
Even after the mythical world was torn from the universe, its intrinsic depth remained horrifyingly profound.
Roar! The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon in the mythical world bellowed, its already-peak-burning aura suddenly soaring.
Boom!
Like a Tail Blade composed of Black Gold radiance sweeping across, the terrifying blade light obliterated time, forming a pitch-black gash extending a million kilometers.
Boom!
The Purgatory ancestor, armed with his magic spear, blocked it head-on. A massive Power Explosion occurred, instantly causing the heavens to collapse and the earth to split, with this slice of space-time completely annihilating under the clash of the two.
True Spirit Level, and at the Pinnacle of True Spirit, a powerful Rule-based entity already influenced the surrounding time to flow away, able to forcefully enter the river of time at any moment.
One more step and he would become an existence that stepped out of the river of time, standing above billions of beings and Heaven and Earth, hanging beyond the sky.
Bang Bang!!
The Purgatory ancestor’s arms exploded, shattered by the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon’s double claws the instant they blocked the Tail Blade, but in an instant, a Demon Seal struck the Emperor Dragon’s chest.
Boom!
With great force, the Emperor Dragon was blasted back a million kilometers, smashing the Void and causing the scales on its chest, riddled with cracks, to shatter, turning into a sky full of glowing specks which burnt and dissipated.
“Roar! Come again.”
The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon instantly appeared above the Purgatory ancestor, its aura swelling even further. Its double claws, like a Human Path Grandmaster’s clasped hands, shone brilliantly, gathering all the strength within to strike down.
Boom!
The Earth within a range of a million kilometers shattered, the scorching magma erupted, sweeping across millions of kilometers in concentric rings, turning into a sky full of flame meteors falling down.
Amidst the blaze of Firelight, the Purgatory ancestor, who held off the strike with his spear, was blasted tens of thousands of kilometers into the ground, standing defiant in the rampaging Void, his face showing shock and fury.
“How is this possible!”
Because the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, whose true body was already burning to the limit and starting to crumble with countless cracks, was actually recovering its vigor.
This totally defied the operating rules of the world.
Roar!
The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon roared to the sky, emitting an exceptionally brilliant Black Gold radiance, turning into a Light Beam that spanned tens of thousands of kilometers through Heaven and Earth, rushing towards the Purgatory ancestor.
In an instant, the colossal battle reignited.
As Jack Clark’s cultivation soared, absorbing the endless World Origin, some of the Origin power flowed into the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon through the Soul Channel.
Repairing the shattered cells throughout the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon’s body, the collapsing Life Origin.
Of course, this bit of feedback naturally couldn’t reverse the ‘injury’ of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon; it only delayed the pace of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon’s annihilation.
At this time, under the clash of two True Spirits, a range of tens of millions of kilometers in Heaven and Earth would be destroyed, the Void collapsing, filled with Black Holes swirling with Destruction storms.
Such a terrifying battle—if it occurred in a Star System, it would be enough to annihilate everything, including the Stars.
The power of a Pinnacle of True Spirit could collapse a million-kilometer range of Heaven and Earth in one strike and, although it couldn’t blow up a Star in one go, causing it to destabilize and explode was not a problem.
Meanwhile, the battle at the entrance to the forbidden area was just as fierce.
Under the endless, innumerable Dark army, those king-level, Heavenly Kings, and even Divine Kings were hugely depleted, and from time to time, someone would be wounded and fall from the sky.
Without Jack Clark’s absolute suppression, even Tarrod, a half-step True Spirit Divine King at the central region, could only just hold off against three Demon Gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1668 - 1668 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1668: Chapter 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Integration_3 Chapter 1668: Chapter 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Integration_3 Among them was the Tyris Demon Shadow, whose strength had weakened significantly.
Boom! A Giant Beast True Body, over 800 meters in length, exploded, torn apart by two demon kings in a surrounding attack.
“Roar! Damn you, daring to kill a War General of the Dragon Palace, you’re asking for death.” The Silver Giant Dragon let out an angry roar, its mouth flashing with white radiance.
Bang! An extremely cold breath fell in the midst of the demon army, instantly exploding, spreading cold air that froze a range of thousands of kilometers, turning it into countless ice sculptures.
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon got aroused from killing and wanted to pounce toward the vast dark tsunami, a low growl from a Blue-White Giant Dragon came from afar.
“Scythia, don’t rush out, stay behind.”
Immediately, the somewhat reddish eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon cleared, and it flapped its wings quickly to stabilize its body, narrowly avoiding rushing out.
Under the invisible dark aura emitted by the Purgatory ancestors, the space between heaven and earth was filled with various dark and evil wills, amplifying the negative emotions in the hearts of all humans and beasts.
One needed only be careless for a moment to have their will blinded and then, aroused to kill, rush into that boundless darkness.
By that time, even the powerful Divine Kings and Immortal Kings, including the Ancient Beasts, might die under the attack of those dark shadows.
Since Jack Clark’s return to Blue Star, in just over two hours, five Mythical Powerhouses and two Mythical Giant Beasts had already rushed out and been torn apart.
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon caught its breath and glared fiercely at the endless dark army outside, suddenly, an extremely brilliant radiance burst in the distant sky.
Boom!
Instantly, a Black Gold Light sphere expanded to more than two million kilometers, dazzling Heaven and Earth, tearing half of the Abyssal Demon Domain apart, creating giant cracks in the sky.
The bursting Destructive Impact pierced through space-time, with the radiance of the Deep Red World shining, those spreading cracks hundreds of millions of kilometers long faintly revealed terrifying figures.
“Human Race, your doomsday has arrived.” As the entire world trembled, amidst the earth-shattering explosion, came the murderous roar of the Purgatory ancestor.
At this moment, everyone’s faces showed terror, including the Ancient Beasts, whose eyes were also filled with panic.
For the life and soul aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had both disappeared.
That terrifyingly powerful beast had fallen!
“Impossible, how could the king possibly fall?” The Ancient Batfin Beast found it somewhat incomprehensible.
“Thunderflame, impossible to die.” The Gold Blue Giant Dragon also found it hard to believe.
At that moment, the other beasts roared, their voices revealing a hint of retreat.
Without the blockage of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, neither humans nor beasts were opponents of that terrifying Purgatory ancestor; a single strike from it could blast their true bodies and souls, annihilating them with a mere flip of its hand.
The gap between the Ancient Realm and the Pinnacle of True Spirit was too huge, not even on the same level.
“Has it come to this?”
Behind the forbidden area battlefield, the Sky-based God King sighed slightly, his hundred-kilometer-sized body unfolding like a Mecha head, stretching out into a massive, ornate Mecha.
At the same time, the voice of the Sky-based God King resounded in the ears of all the Divine Kings.
“Ladies and gentlemen, we can’t hold on here anymore, follow the plan, take everyone and retreat, I’ll stay to cover.”
“Roar! We’re not leaving, Great Sethia doesn’t believe Tim Abott is just dead.” The Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, letting out an angry roar.
Just then, the aura belonging to the Destruction Emperor Dragon suddenly appeared in the sky.
In the center of that black gold explosion that wrecked heaven and earth, a hundred-meter diameter of purple gold blood appeared out of nowhere, exuding a terrifying extreme life aura.
As if not existing in this space and time, the moment this blood appeared, it infinitely evolved, flesh and blood recombining, and in the blink of an eye, a Giant Beast of eleven thousand meters in Black Gold color reappeared.
“Resurrection Talent! No wonder you dared to dissolve your Life Origin.”
Feeling the reappearance of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s aura, and as powerful as ever, the Purgatory ancestor halted its steps, its face looking grim.
It hadn’t expected this beast to have such a rare Talent Ability.
Resurrection-type Divine Powers were extremely rare across the Vast World, a special power that completely defied the supreme rules of life and death.
Especially a Divine Talent that could instantly resurrect a True Spirit Beast was exceptionally rare to the extreme.
Even the Purgatory ancestor couldn’t help but feel a touch of envy at this moment.
If it had possessed this Divine Power, it could have risked its life to kill that human back then, even many extreme actions it dared not try in the past would have been undertaken.
Boom! Heaven and Earth shook, and amid the sky filled with Destructive Glow, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly emerged, facing the massive Purgatory ancestor and let out a deep roar.
“Now, we begin the second round.”
Boom!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon emitted an endless red radiance, channeling the Deep Red Strength into its body, its surface ablaze with Black Flames, instantly swelling to a hundred and ten thousand meters.
Meanwhile, ten Talent Runes appeared in the eyes of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, shattering.
Roar! A ferociously brutal roar shook the world.
The gene chains began to collapse, all cells exploding, and the just-resurrected Destruction Emperor Dragon instantly entered its Chaos Doomsday Apocalypse Form once more.
That encompassing black hole a million kilometers in size reappeared, the terrifying power fluctuations shocking the Purgatory ancestor, and also angering it.
“You’re insane, do you have to fight to such an extent?” the Purgatory ancestor roared, unable to understand, not knowing why the Destruction Emperor Dragon was fighting so hard.
Even using its instant resurrection trump card, it still continued; could it really not fear death?
Or could it be that this monster’s resurrection ability isn’t limited to just once!?

chapters.title: Chapter 1669 - 1669 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1669: Chapter 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Integration_4 Chapter 1669: Chapter 618 Heavenly Path Incarnation, Deification, Integration_4 Considering this, the Purgatory ancestors felt a madness not of their own, but more so of this world, the ability to defy the supreme rules and resurrect more than once was actually possessed by “humans”?
However, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was not interested in wasting words with it, and it burst through the Void, appearing before the Purgatory ancestors with the power to suppress space-time.
Boom! Boom! Boom! A ground-shaking battle erupted once again, and this time the Purgatory ancestors were directly suppressed, falling into a disadvantage.
Because it feared that the Destruction Emperor Dragon still had more opportunities to resurrect, the Purgatory ancestors hesitated, not daring to burn their Origin in a frenzied fight.
Otherwise, if it overextended itself, there was even a possibility that it could be slain by the Giant Beast today.
Meanwhile, a tactical retreat notion subtly arose in the heart of the Purgatory ancestors; after all, it was just an “ordinary race”, if it couldn’t be eradicated today, then so be it.
Compared to avenging a sword from years past, returning to the supreme Purgatory Abyss held greater importance.
Having evolved its Purgatory Bloodline to the peak, all it needed now was to return to its kin, and with the grace of the Eternal Lord, there would be a sliver of hope to breakthrough to the Primordial and become a True Demon.
The out-of-nowhere resurrection of the Destruction Emperor Dragon shocked all the Divine Kings and Ancient Beasts on the battlefield in the forbidden area, beyond belief.
Similar to the feelings of the Purgatory ancestors, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s talent was terrifying, and its battle prowess was against the heavens—now it even possessed the ability to instantly resurrect a True Spirit.
How the hell are other Giant Beasts and “humans” supposed to live with this?
At that moment, even though these Giant Beasts and Divine Kings were allies, they all felt the unfairness of fate, and how heavily favored that Beast named Thunderflame was.
No, there was also a human.
That human’s talent was equally monstrous, their fighting strength exaggerated.
Thinking this, many looked up into the sky and then noticed that the World Solar System Domain above the Firmament, lying beyond layers of space-time, had inexplicably stopped its descending speed.
“The Second Mythical Impact has been held back,” witnessing this scene, all Human Kings and Heavenly Kings showed surprised joy, bursting with excitement.
With the Second Mythical Impact blocked, Blue Star’s solar system stood independently between the mythical world and the Original Universe.
Armed with the advantages of two universes and World Rules, the Human Alliance would possess the foundation to become a peak race of the mythical world— an era where everyone could be as dragons was no longer a dream.
Why was the Human Race able to grow so much within fifty years of stepping foot into the mythical world?
The astonishing speed of cultivators’ cultivation, the emergence of innumerable Mythical Kings, Heavenly Kings, and even Supreme beings stemmed from this very reason.
As beings from another universe, humans had soul imprints, cellular structures, genetic makeup, and life chains vastly different from the creatures of the mythical world.
Simply put, the people and creatures of Blue Star World were filled with instability; no one knew what they could evolve into, whether weak or strong.
Whereas the creatures of the mythical world had their life forms fixed, governed by the World Rules of the mythical world, tending towards stability, including the time imprints wrapped around them.
“Charge, my brothers, victory today will surely be ours!” the Mysterious Martial Sky King roared inspiringly, his massive Mysterious Martial True Body surging forward, smashing the shadow of a Great Demon King.
“Alliance victorious!” the Golden Winged Divine King shone brightly, all ten wings spreading furiously, eclipse the sun and lighting up both Heaven and Earth.
Not only were those Human Experts seeing hope at this time, but the powerhouses of the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Immortal Spirit Clan also felt a surge of spirit, smiles spreading across their faces.
As allies of the Human Race, although it seemed unlikely to stand on equal footing for now, the Human Race, known for its unity and spirit of sacrifice, would likely not let them down.
Under the protection of the soon to be mighty Human Race, their tribes would redevelop, stronger than before.
Indeed, the choice they made earlier was the right one.
And now, throughout this great battle, the emotions of the strong beings of all four races had undergone several intense rises and falls, alternating between despair and surging hope.
Even Titans like Tolstoy were beginning to feel a bit fatigued.
As the great battle in the mythical world surged on, in the depths of the Solar System World, a True Spirit level Terrifying Aura emanated from The Heart of the World.
Boom! Boom!
With one-third of the sun’s surface swelling, solar flare explosions became more intense, streams of fire hundreds of thousands of kilometers high shot up into the sky, in a display of raw power.
“`
Buzz! Radiant dawn light permeated the Outer World, spreading across the cosmic space and illuminating half of the Solar System.
Bathed in that sacred brilliant dawn, the atmosphere of Blue Star World turned rainbow-colored, causing everyone to feel a tremor, as if sensing the birth of the Heavenly Dao.
“This… could this be the Position Pattern of the Heavenly Dao?”
At the core of The Heart of the World, dense rainbow light shimmered. Jack Clark, whose True Body towered fifty thousand kilometers tall, stood erect, exuding the genuine aura of a True Spirit.
With the infinite support of the World Origin Rules and the inducement of a Heavenly Tier Aura, he had become a genuine ‘True Spirit’ being.
But at this moment, looking at the pure white, ancient seal forming before him and the transparent text that appeared before his eyes, Jack’s eyes slightly narrowed.
“The Mark of Heavenly Path, constructed by the world’s core rule with the Heavenly Tier Aura as the catalyst, is the most exalted object of this world.”
“Suggestion One, by merging with the Mark of Heavenly Path, you will obtain the ultimate authority of this world, becoming a Heavenly Dao-like existence. A mere thought will allow you to transform Heaven and Earth, holding the power of life and death over all things.”
“Suggestion Two, once you merge with the Mark of Heavenly Path, you will be forever bound to this world, unable to transcend.”
“Note: If you abandon the Mark of Heavenly Path, everything gained from supporting the heavens this time will be stripped away, including the Cultivation breakthrough achieved with the help of the World Rules Origin.”
“There is even the possibility of exhausting your strength to death. Please choose carefully.”
Gazing at the transparent text only he could see, Jack’s expression was calm; he had already made a decision.
The Cultivation of a True Spirit and the heavenly mandate of this grand world would be an insane temptation to everyone other than Jack, an offer too alluring to refuse.
Billions and billions of living beings spend thousands or even tens of thousands of years cultivating, yet not one True Spirit may arise.
For Jack too, the temptation of a True Spirit was substantial, but when becoming a True Spirit meant sacrificing ‘freedom,’ it became worthless.
Jack turned his head slightly, looking at Freya Louise, whose true form had swollen to two hundred thousand meters tall, her nine golden halos turning behind her, emanating an ancient and powerful aura.
“Freya, this thing, keep it safe for me.”
Saying so, Jack slowly handed the ancient seal, representing the Position Pattern of the Heavenly Dao, into Freya’s hands.
Boom!
The moment Jack chose to renounce it, the Mark of Heavenly Path, sensing something, fiercely rejected and wrestled free from Number One’s grasp.
Simultaneously, a Terrifying Power enveloped Jack’s True Body.
With Jack offering no resistance, the life force and Soul Fluctuations within him rapidly diminished, and his towering True Body began to disintegrate and collapse.
On the outside, to the astonishment of countless eyes, the towering figure in the center of the rainbow light, holding the sun like the majestic war god, slowly fell.
“Jack Clark! How is this possible??” The Primordial True King, perceiving the dissipating aura of Jack, revealed a look of utter disbelief.
“Brother!”
“Jack!!”
On Blue Star, Glenn Clark and Doris Clark felt something unbelievable and looked at the vast figure in the sky that was slowly collapsing.
In the mythical world, in the forbidden area, the Mysterious Martial Sky King and others suddenly looked up, horrified at the sky.
What’s going on? Wasn’t the sky support successful? Why is Jack’s True Body projection collapsing?
At that moment, within the dissipating light of the True Body thousands of kilometers tall, a weak figure appeared, piercing through layers of space-time and emerging in the mythical world.
Roar!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon roared, as all eyes watched in shock, retreating the Purgatory Ancestor with a strike and soaring upwards from the edge of the forbidden area; its terrifying maw aimed at biting the Firmament above, towards the World Illusion.
Everyone was stunned, in disbelief, the Ancient Beast had devoured Jack Clark?
“`

chapters.title: Chapter 1670 - 1670 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon Beyond
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1670: Chapter 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon, Beyond Heaven and Earth Chapter 1670: Chapter 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon, Beyond Heaven and Earth Jack Clark had always suppressed his Godlike form, waiting for the result of the Mythical Impact.
The fate of The Purgatory Family in this battle had been sealed from the moment the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s True Body arrived, with the main concern being the Blue Star World.
If he had merged with the Giant Beast Body too early, the overly powerful strength would have been unable to enter Blue Star, and there would have been no way to lend aid should the situation there change.
Now that the Blue Star World was stable, Jack Clark no longer had any concerns holding him back.
Just when he, weakened to his last breath, fell into the maw of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, with the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon as the core, he initiated Deification.
Silent and unnoticeable, Jack Clark’s formidable True Body instantly disintegrated, transforming into a sky-full of blood mist that merged into the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
This fusion was not just of the True Body, but also of the once-split soul reuniting.
It included all of the Higher-order Rules Jack Clark had mastered, the two Supreme Rules, six Great Divine Powers, the Void Death Pupil Talent, and the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane.
Everything under Soul Talent Ability merged with the Supreme Rules of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon and the ten Talent Abilities, producing a horrifying chemical reaction.
Roar!
Above the Firmament, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon that swallowed Jack Clark howled to the sky, releasing a dazzling nine-colored radiance that illuminated the entire world.
In that brilliant light, an aura surfaced that made everyone, even the Purgatory ancestors, tremble with fear.
“What’s happening!?”
In the Abyssal Demon Domain tinged with colorful light, the Purgatory ancestor, whose true form spanned thousands of kilometers, roared. Surrounding him were substantial chains of Dark Rules and his Demon Power was overwhelming.
Sensing the terrifying aura suddenly bursting from the body of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, the Purgatory ancestor let out a roar of fright and anger. The magic spear in his hand gleamed with black light, smashing through space-time.
Under the Purgatory ancestor’s full-force strike, this spear carried nearly all the strength of a billion-kilometer Demon Domain, with the Power of Heaven and Earth converging into a colossal world phantom.
From afar, it looked like a giant world rising from the Earth towards the Firmament, smashing into that brilliant light.
Boom!
The magic spear shockwave, powerful enough to burst half a star, disintegrated under the relentless release of the nine-colored light as it approached within a million kilometers of the Emperor Dragon.
The full-force strike of the Pinnacle of True Spirit Purgatory ancestor couldn’t even get close to the Deified state of the Emperor Dragon.
Such a horrific scene shocked all Immortal and Divine Kings and Ancient Beasts; they all watched the dazzling light above the Firmament in disbelief.
There, the figure emitting a nine-colored radiance continuously expanded, thousand kilometers, ten thousand kilometers, hundred thousand kilometers.
The aura grew stronger, overbearing even over True Spirits, filling Heaven and Earth with pressure, causing the space of a hundred billion kilometers to tremble under the dazzling light.
The invisible aura emitted further collapsed the Void, causing everyone, including the gigantic beasts, to crash onto the ground with a boom.
As for the hundreds of billions in the Dark Army, they all disintegrated and disappeared.
Under the magnificent Heavenly might reflected by that light, those demons formed by Dark Powers had nowhere to hide, their foundational rules instantly collapsing.
This scene bore some resemblance to the sun and moon suspended in the sky.
Primordial! Everyone spontaneously conjured this unreachable, indescribable word in their minds.
But immediately, Mysterious Martial Sky King and others showed anger on their faces, looking at the imposing figure spanning the Void above the Firmament filled with rage.
So, this was why the Giant Beast had always been helping Jack Clark.
It was all to devour Jack Clark and absorb everything about him.
Because the horrific transformation of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon only occurred the moment he swallowed Jack Clark, although they were unaware of ‘Deification’ and didn’t realize both were part of the same entity, they guessed the reason immediately.
However, facing a terrifying beast almost turning into a Primordial existence, even if the Mysterious Martial Sky King and others were furious, they dared not speak up or provoke the creature.
They weren’t afraid to die, but they feared provoking the beast to a point where it could wipe out all humanity with a single swipe.
Primordial, a power that surpassed Monarchs and was incomparable.
Just then, the darkness of the Primordial suddenly receded, including the strong aura of Purgatory ancestors that shook Heaven and Earth rapidly weakening and disappearing in the blink of an eye.
It fled.
That majestic Purgatory True Demon, upon seeing its full-force strike fall short of even approaching the Deified Emperor Dragon, decisively chose to flee.
“Gone, is it?”
Above the Firmament, the Deified Emperor Dragon emitting endless radiance ‘slowly’ turned its head, its terrifying gaze crossing space-time, landing deep in the Void billions of kilometers away.
At this moment, though the Deified Emperor Dragon emitted a brilliant nine-colored radiance, its True Body of one hundred twenty thousand kilometers was half pitch-black and half golden.
The pitch-black side was filled with an indescribable aura of destruction and doom, like the epitome of primordial chaotic destruction materialized; any life below the level of myths vanishing into ashes upon a mere glance.
On the other side, the golden-colored scale armor and dorsal fin, including the fierce and sharp Dragon Claws, exuded an aura of genesis, seemingly containing limitless vitality and future possibilities.
Even the three pairs of six dragon horns on its head displayed black and gold, looking incredibly majestic and fierce.
Yet its mane remained pitch black, the tips of its hair emitting a nine-colored radiance, extending along the dorsal fin to the tail, swaying without wind like burning flames.
Left to wield destruction and Doomsday, right to oversee Primordial genesis—this was the Godlike Form Jack Clark achieved after merging his True Body with the Giant Beast Body.
And it wasn’t just a change in appearance, the power of this moment’s Deified Emperor Dragon was too formidable to describe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1671 - 1671 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon Beyond
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1671: Chapter 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon, Beyond Heaven and Earth_2 Chapter 1671: Chapter 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon, Beyond Heaven and Earth_2 Realm had broken through from the ancient late stage to the pinnacle of True Spirit, and even took half a step into the Primordial’s realm. His true strength had shattered the rules of the mythical world, stepping into the Primordial.
This was also why Jack Clark chose to primarily integrate with the Giant Beast Body.
After giving up the Mark of Heavenly Path, the cultivation and strength he had broken through with the help of the Solar System World’s Origin were all stripped away and left in the Solar System.
And because of propping up the heavens, he had exhausted all his strength and nearly died from exhaustion.
That near death was only prevented by the sufficient strength of his Soul Source.
Compared to heading on as a human in early ancient stage, it was very possible he could breakthrough into the initial or mid period of True Spirit during deification.
Under such circumstances, it naturally was safer to lead with the Giant Beast Body of ancient late stage.
At that moment, the Divinized Emperor Dragon felt immeasurably powerful, so potent that a mere flick of its claw could obliterate the Abyssal Demon Domain and the Purgatory ancestors stretching billions of kilometers.
This time, it wasn’t just the explosive growth of his realm. At this moment, to the Divinized Emperor Dragon, the whole world seemed like it had lifted a thick curtain, revealing its true face.
The Earth beneath seemed tremendously small in its eye, made up of layer upon layer of space, vast and boundless.
Similarly, the sky also became exceptionally clear. Three suns radiating gold, red, and a gloomy blue light seemed like three limitless Giant Beasts standing distortion in space and time beyond the world.
As for the silver and blood-colored moon, they appeared like boundless Plane Worlds.
Especially the Blood Moon radiating endless blood-colored light; the Divinized Emperor Dragon felt it was akin to the deep red plane at its pinnacle, its radiance lighting not only the mythical world but also vanishing into other space-times.
Not only the suns and moon above but even the surrounding space-time around the Divinized Emperor Dragon itself was twisting, semi-independent from the world.
Otherwise, its enormous body and mass coupled with the energy it emitted would have instantly shredded Heaven and Earth below, forming a destructive Black Hole spanning tens of millions of kilometers.
“The world is rejecting me,” the Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly growled, its gaze sweeping past the sun and moon, looking towards the profound beyond.
There, many stars shone. Some were bright; some were dim. Each star represented a Primordial Beast or other powerful life forms.
And as the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s realm grew to half-step Primordial, many terrifying gazes crossed distant space-time and fell upon it.
Among those gazes filled with dreadful pressure, some conveyed surprise and joy, while others were full of malice and greed, wishing they could devour it in one bite.
Just as the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s gaze turned to the heavens, a near imperceptible pulling force was transmitted from above.
It seemed to be telling it that there lay the destiny of Primordial Beasts.
Roar! An almost ethereal roar traveled from the heavens, followed by intense battle fluctuations. Far beyond in the depths of the heavens, two dimly lit stars were entangled in battle.
Being dim didn’t signify that those two stars were weak, but merely because they were too distant, making their emitted light invisible.
Just like the stars deep in the universe of the Blue Star World, they seemed dim, not as bright as the sun and moon, but in reality, each was a star.
Some were even tens or hundreds of thousands of times larger than the sun.
“So it turns out, on the mythical world’s Earth, the Primordial is not allowed to exist,” murmured the Divinized Emperor Dragon softly, then withdrew its gaze, looking back towards the Purgatory ancestors.
Although the Divinized Emperor Dragon had thought for ‘a while,’ only a moment had passed since its Deification Unity to the Purgatory ancestors’ escape.
After becoming ‘Primordial,’ the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s perception of time also underwent immense changes, as if standing outside of time, no longer bound by it.
In just a moment, the Purgatory ancestors had already fled hundreds of millions of kilometers, shooting through the Void like a pure black ray of light, plunging into the river of time.
“Idril, our battle is not over yet. Now begins the third round.”
A deep and thick roar reverberated through space-time, appearing next to the Purgatory ancestors’ ear. Immediately ahead in the rippling, color-striped transparent river, space-time collapsed.
Boom!
A tributary of the river of time instantly surged, tossing up towering waves, an endless myriad of colorful radiance seeping in from the collapsed time beyond.
“Thunderflame!” The Purgatory ancestors looked uneasy.
Ahead, outside the colorful vortex of collapsed time, an enormous Dragon Head emerged, its vertical pupils—one black, one white—coldly watching it.
“To kill me, even you as you are now must pay a price.”
On the time tributary, Demon Power surged around the Purgatory Ancestors, who stood with a spear, his four arms reaching into the revolving Rule Halo behind him, vibrating the space-time of this area.
“You, overestimate yourself.”
Boom! Emitting colorful radiance yet inherently pitch black, the Dragon Claw reached into time, the chaotic and destructive aura immediately collapsing this branch of the river.
The formless emitting aura weighed down so heavily on the Purgatory Ancestors that his form sunk, his body crackling under the pressure, unable to bear it.
Mythical world.
Suddenly, the sky collapsed, forming a hollow hundreds of thousands of kilometers wide, a pitch-black pillar of light pierced through Heaven and Earth, smashing into the Earth at an indescribable speed.
Boom! Millions of kilometers of earth shattered, space collapsed, an infinite amount of black smoke burst out like a Tsunami in all directions.
Accompanied by the crackling sound of shattering.
In an instant, mountain ranges and plains spanning thousands of kilometers were thrown into the air, shattered by the black impact while still aloft, including the many Giant Beasts and different races dwelling above.
The tremendous strength even wiped out the entire space, forming a pitch-black Hollow filled with the destructive power capable of annihilating ancient creatures.

chapters.title: Chapter 1672 - 1672 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon Beyond
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1672: Chapter 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon, Beyond Heaven and Earth_3 Chapter 1672: Chapter 619 Divinized Emperor Dragon, Beyond Heaven and Earth_3 Outside the forbidden area battlefield, above the vast Firmament a hundred million kilometers high, the Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly retracted its left claw without even moving its body.
That was its current strength; a casual strike had crossed an immense distance, shaking the Purgatory ancestors out of time and directly bursting their true bodies.
The gap in absolute strength was so vast, it was beyond imagination.
“I won’t accept this!”
A hundred million kilometers down, within a Dragon Claw pit that reached a hundred thousand kilometers into the Earth, a mournful and resolute roar exploded, and a sky full of black radiance surged upwards, reconstituting the true body of the Purgatory ancestors.
However, at that time, its true body was covered with countless black cracks, oozing blood imbued with a faint immortality, dyeing its battle armor red, its aura weakened.
The previous strike of the Divinized Emperor Dragon had not only shattered its true body but also destroyed the Abyssal Demon Domain which represented half of its strength, causing a heavy injury to its Origin.
What was most important was the gap between them, which had grown so large that it drove the demon to despair.
Previously, the Beast, which needed to dissolve its Life Origin to fight under its suppression, became comparable to the Primordial in the blink of an eye, even stronger than the average Primordial Beast.
Such a huge transformation was something the now more potent and buoyant Purgatory ancestors could not accept after its revival.
Standing outside Heaven and Earth, the Divinized Emperor Dragon slightly lowered its head to look at the Purgatory ancestors ‘below’, emitting a low growl that resonated with terrifying majesty, shaking Heaven and Earth.
“I am Destruction, the end.”
Boom! As soon as the voice of the Divinized Emperor Dragon faded, the Purgatory ancestor’s remaining two heads revealed a look of determination.
Bang Bang Bang!!
The Purgatory ancestors’ six arms and one head exploded in succession, turning into a sky full of blood mist that spread throughout the air, tainting half of the sky a dark red.
At once, the thick scent of blood permeated the air.
The Purgatory ancestors chanted an eerie incantation, and the instantly exploding blood mist writhed like living creatures, forming a colossal blood array a hundred thousand kilometers wide, resembling a ferocious head stitched together from nine faces.
And all this happened in an instant.
The moment the massive organized head formed, it seemed to connect with some unknown, terrifying entity, and an indescribable mighty force pierced through distant Space-Time.
Boom!
Above the head of the Purgatory ancestors, Space-Time distorted, forming a dark red vortex tens of thousands of kilometers across, its invisible and pervasive Radiance making Heaven and Earth shudder.
At the moment when the world was enveloped by the light of the Abyss, an Invisible Power covered the Purgatory ancestors, causing a look of ecstasy to spread across its face, followed by unrestrained laughter.
“Hahaha… The Overlord of Purgatory has responded to my call.”
“Hahaha, you Beast King Thunderflame, even with your overwhelming power, you can’t kill me today.”
Amidst laughter, Space-Time around the Purgatory ancestors twisted, its figure gradually becoming transparent, as if it would leave the mythical world in the next moment.
“I’ve said it before; I am the end, Destruction. Everything before me will turn to nothing.”
Boom!
The Divinized Emperor Dragon suddenly stood straight, a flow of Qi Blood shaking the Great Thousand Worlds emanated from within, shaking Cloud Sky, watching as the Purgatory ancestors, almost gone from this Space-Time, opened its massive mouth in anger.
Crack!! The spot where the Purgatory ancestors were instantly became a hollow void a hundred thousand kilometers in diameter.
Everything there was erased, whether it was Time, Space, matter, or the Supreme Strength and Abyssal coordinates that descended, all Devoured.
Above the Black Hole void, a Beast several hundred thousand kilometers long, emanating nine-colored radiance, burst forth an aura that made Heaven and Earth tremble, overseeing the past and the future.
Seeking death! A low and terrifying voice came from the depths of the dark red vortex.
Immediately, a horrifying demon claw striped with black and red reached out from the vortex, towering above the sands of time, and instantly pierced through everything to appear on the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s back.
Boom!
Greeting this strike was a Golden Dragon Claw, imbued with the notion of creation and boundless strength, which directly smashed the demon claw, with jet-black blood dripping down continuously.
In pain, the frightful demon claw retracted instantly, and the dark red vortex also disappeared along with it, leaving only a roar of “How is this possible!”
The voice was filled with an unbelievable shock.
It seemed to be in shock that a Beast, not yet fully departed from the Vast World, with an aura of merely a Half-step Primordial, could injure it.
Watching the disappearing Abyssal vortex, the Divinized Emperor Dragon looked on coldly, responding with a mere low growl.
“So weak!”
Boom!
A faint force exploded within the Divinized Emperor Dragon, shaking the entire Heaven and Earth, winds and clouds converged, forming a Blood Moon a hundred thousand kilometers in diameter, slowly descending.
At the moment when the Blood Moon appeared, everyone on the distant forbidden area battlefield inexplicably felt something.
The Purgatory ancestors had fallen.
At this moment, the whole world seemed to quiet down, leaving only that massive figure, standing high in the Firmament, shining with dazzling radiance, with an incredibly powerful aura.
“Did we win?” Gentry Gail asked somewhat blankly.
War King Elmore Hall hesitated before nodding with some uncertainty, “We should have… won, I guess.”
Was this battle fierce?
Fierce. The Human Alliance lost millions in their army, countless Mythical Powerhouses, Main Gods, including Adam Garcetti, the First Councilor.
But compared to the Purgatory Family, who were completely wiped out, these losses seemed trivial.
Nineteen Demon Gods, countless Purgatory True Demons, including an Ancestor at the Late Stage of True Spirit or even the peak, the accomplishments were brilliant, even exaggerated.
Furthermore, the Second Mythical Impact, which had suddenly erupted, was also successfully repelled by them.
It could be said that this Civilization War was a grand victory, unprecedented.
But…
The Mysterious Martial Sky King, Sky King Denny Kaye, Knife King Joel Moore, and all other human strong men above the mythic level, all clutched their hands tightly, staring at those Dragon Palace Giant Beasts.
Jack Clark had died; while upholding the sky, Jack Clark was taken advantage of by that Giant Beast. At his weakest moment, it devoured him in one gulp.
“Roar! What are you staring at us for? The Great Sethia helped you defeat those despicable Purgatory Demons,” the Silver Giant Dragon roared, displeased.
“Scythia, go to the back.”
The Blue-White Giant Dragon appeared silently in front of the Silver Giant Dragon, growling softly, his gaze wary of those human strong men.
Immediately, the atmosphere between the two sides became tense.

chapters.title: Chapter 1673 - 1673 620 The Call from the Bloodline of
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1673: Chapter 620: The Call from the Bloodline of Creation Origin Chapter 1673: Chapter 620: The Call from the Bloodline of Creation Origin “Ladies and gentlemen, please, calm down.”
At the moment when the atmosphere between the Human Experts and the Beast Empire suddenly turned grave, Wind Heavenly King appeared in the middle, holding a blue lotus, and hurriedly tried to smooth things over.
Divine King Tarrod also gradually appeared, with an endless golden light converging into a One-side World behind him, looking towards True Martial King with a solemn expression.
“True Martial Sir, and all from the Human Race, whatever matters there are, we can discuss them slowly, let’s not be rash.”
Now that the Purgatory Demon Race has been annihilated and the alliance is victorious, what the four races need to do is rest and recuperate, to usher in a new golden era.
Thus there is no need for any complications to arise at this juncture.
Although these Divine Kings and Immortal Kings felt it was a pity about Jack Clark’s death, they didn’t expect the Giant Beast to take advantage of someone else’s danger by devouring him.
Perhaps this was the reason the Giant Beast was willing to come from its distant empire territory to provide support.
Also, because of devouring Jack Clark, its strength inexplicably surged to an indescribable degree, allowing it to so effortlessly suppress the Purgatory ancestors.
Otherwise, with the terrifying strength of that Ancestor at the Pinnacle of True Spirit, if it wished to leave, even a normal Half-step Primordial couldn’t have killed it.
But these people and the Giant Beasts are not familiar with each other, and given the terrifying momentum of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, those from the Dragon Palace Empire don’t care at all about Tarrod and Wind Heavenly Immortal King.
The seven Ancient Dragon Kings stirred up raging wind currents as they flew in, looking at the Heavenly Kings and king-level experts gathering on the Human’s side, the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon slowly growled.
“Roar! What, want to fight?”
Compared to the Human side with only two Ancient Level, including the Sky-based God King, and nine Titan Level Heavenly Kings, thirty-plus Mythical Kings, the Beast Empire had a clearly more overwhelming number of beasts.
True Martial King responded with an indifferent expression, “Our strongest has fallen to the Thunderflame Dragon King, and although we are not your match in strength, we still require an explanation.”
“We want to know, was there any agreement between Thunderflame Dragon King and Jack Clark.”
Just as True Martial King said, the death of Jack Clark cannot simply be let go.
If the Human side were to fear the invincible strength of the Divinized Emperor Dragon and act as if nothing happened, how could they have any standing in the mythical world in the future, and what would become of unity?
The alliance with Heavenly Feather and the Three Tribes of Immortal Spirit would also become problematic, at least they could no longer lead it.
Before the Silver Giant Dragon and the other Giant Beasts could speak, a majestic and deep voice slowly resounded from above, instantly causing this world to tremble under that terrifying pressure.
“An agreement, you could say that.”
A splendid radiance fell from the sky, enveloping the entire forbidden battlefield, transforming the broken world into one filled with dazzling, multicolored lights.
In that instant, everyone dared not move, including the Giant Beasts from the Dragon Palace Empire, all of them locked in place, their internal rules frozen and unable to be mobilized.
In the face of that pervasive invisible might, even Tarrod, the Half-step True Spirit Divine King, held his breath unconsciously.
Previously, because of the vast distance, these people only felt the Divinized Emperor Dragon was very strong, unmatched, but they did not have a clear concept of just how powerful it was.
Now, as the True Body of the Emperor Dragon descended, these people knew what terror was.
It was the difference between a Giant Dragon and an ant, not in the same dimension at all, the opponent could wipe them out with just a breath.
Is this the strength of a Primordial Beast! The faces of all Immortal Kings and Divine Kings showed horror.
Boom boom boom! The world shook violently.
Tens of thousands of kilometers high in the sky, the massive beast slowly lowered its head; its fearsome head was like a world-destroying meteor entering from outside the atmosphere, smashing the Void and creating black concentric shockwaves.
Instantly, clouds within millions of kilometers dispersed, forming a giant Hollow, revealing the towering figure that blotted out the sun and radiated multicolored light.
Because the Giant Beast Body was too powerful, the Divinized Emperor Dragon was no longer able to enter the lower surface world, with the dragon head eventually stopping at fifteen thousand kilometers high above.
This was still because the realm of the Divinized Emperor Dragon was only Half-step Primordial, otherwise it would have already been rejected by the mythical world into the starry sky beyond.
The terrifying black and white vertical pupils looked down, and the Divinized Emperor Dragon growled slowly, its voice shaking Heaven and Earth, “Once, Jack Clark and I shared a special Creation, each of us gaining a portion of strength.”
“This time I became so strong because I used up both Jack Clark’s part and the portion of strength I possess, temporarily entering the current state.”
“Also, Jack Clark has not completely fallen, he is just exhausted from propping up the sky, and currently, his True Body is preserved within my ‘World’, there is still a hope for Resurrection.”
Naturally, the secret that his True Body and Giant Beast Body were one, Jack would not expose.
A soul split in two could act as two complete entities, with all aspects as perfect as the other, free from the constraints of an Avatar, this talent was Jack’s biggest secret.
This secret, unless later fully combined with Deification Unity, would not be told to anyone or any beast.
“Jack Clark hasn’t completely fallen, he can still be revived!?” Mysterious Martial Sky King and the others showed surprise and excitement.
Including the Sky-based God King with God’s Armament True Body resembling a thousand-kilometer giant Mecha, nobody expected Jack Clark to still be alive; they had misunderstood the Giant Beast.
As the Human Experts were shaken, Tarrod and the other Divine Kings, as well as the Ancient Dragon Kings from the Beast Empire, were also somewhat surprised.
Compared to the life and death of Jack Clark, they were more curious about the Creation mentioned by the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
What kind of strength could allow a giant beast from the ancient late stage to reach Half-step Primordial in an instant, strength comparable to a true Primordial Beast.
Moreover, it seemed that the terrifying state of this Giant Beast was only temporary.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1674: Chapter 620: The Call of the Bloodline from the Creation Origin_2 Chapter 1674: Chapter 620: The Call of the Bloodline from the Creation Origin_2 As the Time Dragon and other Giant Beasts were shocked by this information, the Silver Giant Dragon already roared curiously, “Tim Abbott, is your bond with that human so exaggerated due to some kind of opportunity?”
“That’s one way to put it,” the Divinized Emperor Dragon answered vaguely.
Speaking of which, the Divinized Emperor Dragon looked towards the True Martial King and others, slowly growling, “Jack Clark’s injuries stem from the Power of Heavenly Way of the Blue Star World, and resurrection is a bit troublesome.”
“I need to awaken Miss Joseline to see if her Creation origin can resuscitate Jack Clark. If not, we’ll need to think of another method.”
The True Martial King was somewhat excited, bowing deeply to the enormous beasts in the sky, “Many thanks, Thunderflame Dragon King. This kindness will be eternally remembered by our Human Race.”
“From now on, whatever the task, no matter the request, our Human Race will brave any danger and refuse no call.”
“Thank you, Thunderflame Dragon King, for your great kindness.” All the Heavenly Kings and Mythical Kings were solemn and respectfully bowed to the immense figure standing in the sky.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “My friends, there is no need for such formality. My relationship with Jack Clark is closer than that of brothers, I naturally would not stand by and watch him die.”
As he spoke of being closer than brothers, no one, including the Giant Beasts, noticed a strange glint flash across the eyes of the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
This feeling of playing oneself was always a bit odd.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon shook its head, about to retract its head.
“Roar! Tim Abbott, the Great Scythia wishes to ascend,” at this moment, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar and transformed into a beam of silver light, shooting up into the sky.
Ah, a Primordial Beast, an invincible being surpassing True Spirits, the Silver Giant Dragon was naturally full of curiosity.
It wanted to touch the scale armor of the Divinized Emperor Dragon to see how it differed from its own.
Of course, if it were any other Primordial Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon wouldn’t dare to show even a bubble of courage, and would be lying on the ground shivering, unable to move.
But the Divinized Emperor Dragon was different; it was a good friend who ‘grew up fighting together’, so rushing up was okay, even if its tail remained limp and could not raise.
“Thunderflame, the Great Torsa also wishes to ascend,” the Gold Blue Giant Dragon said, its double wings fluttering and emitting a Seven-Colored Glow as it excitedly chased after, roaring with excitement.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Just as the two Titan Dragons had flown up more than three thousand kilometers, overwhelming pressure from above the Firmament suddenly surged, causing the Law Domains around them to shake continuously.
The sky of the mythical world was not the atmosphere of the Blue Star World, it contained powerful rules of suppression.
The higher they went, the greater the pressure became, and only those with a certain level of strength were qualified to continue ‘ascending’.
For instance, Mythical Powerhouses could fly below a thousand kilometers, Heavenly King Powerhouses’ ‘activity space’ was generally between one thousand to five thousand kilometers.
Only Ancient Level Powerhouses could stand above ten thousand kilometers in the Firmament.
Up here, the constraints of space and the suppression of strength were even stronger than on the surface, and the destruction and impact caused by battles between ancient beings were suppressed even more.
Continuing to ascend, reaching altitudes over a million kilometers would enter the isolated Primordial Starry Sky.
Just as the two Titan Beasts were about to struggle reaching four thousand kilometers, barely sustaining themselves, a Nine-colored Radiance flooded their surroundings, and time flew by, transforming them into two beams of light piercing through Heaven and Earth.
Immediately below, several other Giant Beasts’ eyes lit up.
Roar, roar, roar!! Thunderflame, I want to ascend too, I want to as well. The Single-horned Spawn Roc flapped its wings excitedly, rings of Black and White Domain spinning around it as it dashed towards the sky.
Roar! Domination too, Domination wants to see how cool you became up close.
Roar, roar, roar!! Abbott, me too, and me.
Three Mythical Dragon Kings eagerly followed, as they were brothers from the same Great River as the Divinized Emperor Dragon, no issues just hanging around on its back to watch.
However, just as the three Giant Beasts had ascended a few hundred kilometers into high altitude, they were enveloped by an invisible force of gravity, transforming into three beams of light falling from the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!! Mountains collapsed, smoke and dust billowing.
Above in the Firmament, the deep growl of the Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly resounded, “You are too weak to bear the pressure here, better to stay below.”
I knew Thunderflame wouldn’t let us ascend. I’ve seen exactly what kind of dragon it is.
From the depths of a thousand-kilometer-wide crater, the Single-horned Spawn Roc let out an unhappy roar.
Indeed, that guy was too unreasonable. Inside the other two craters, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed Flood Dragon both nodded in agreement.
They would explode under the pressure, do they mean the Silver Giant Dragon and the others, who are only a bit stronger, would be fine? That was a height even Primordial Beasts couldn’t endure.
So whether it worked out or not was still a thought within the realm of the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Above the Firmament at more than thirty thousand kilometers, here space-time began to distort, filled with space-tearing hurricanes, capable of ripping apart the True Bodies of ancient beasts.
Within the raging black void of the edge of space, an Emperor Dragon with a length of a hundred and twenty thousand kilometers, colored Black Gold, stood, emanating an aura heavy and terrifying like a black hole celestial body.
In front of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, the Gold Blue Giant Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon, with their mere one thousand eight hundred meters in length, seemed like mere specks of dust.
Surrounded by the Divinized Nine-colored Glow, a solid shield emanated, blocking the pervasive Black Hurricane and the invisible, destructive pressure from the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Looking up at the enormous dragon head, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers and blotting out the sun, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but exclaim in awe, “Roar! Tim Abbott, you’ve become so big.”
“Indeed, very big,” even the Gold Blue Giant Dragon was somewhat dazed.
They had only wanted to come up and take a look, completely forgetting the terrifying difference in their sizes, and only now they realized that ascending here was pointless.
Because at a single glance, their entire field of vision was blocked.
Looking at the excited Silver Giant Dragon and the somewhat dazed Gold Blue Giant Dragon, the Divinized Emperor Dragon let out a deep growl, “Have fun on your own, I’m about to awaken Miss Joseline.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1675 - 1675 620 The Call of the Bloodline from the
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1675: Chapter 620: The Call of the Bloodline from the Creation Origin_3 Chapter 1675: Chapter 620: The Call of the Bloodline from the Creation Origin_3 Ignoring the two Giant Dragons excitedly circling around it, its attention was drawn to the top of its head.
As the Divinized Emperor Dragon had a breakthrough to the Half-step Primordial state, simulating its life’s magnetic field and life fluctuation, the Purple little dragon, in perfect harmony with the Divinized Emperor Dragon, also reaped massive benefits.
With the Primordial life aura pouring into it, the Purple little dragon’s cultivation not only skyrocketed from the Mid-Mythical Stage to the Mythical Peak, but its bloodline had also significantly improved.
If the Silver Giant Dragon and the others knew about this, they would definitely widen their eyes in shock.
They thought about how much hardship they had to bear to break through to the Titan Level, the countless battles and slaughter they went through, and the long period of cultivation required to gain their current strength.
Yet the Purple little dragon, since hatching, has been sleeping on the head of the Divinized Emperor Dragon all day long, and it had reached the Mythical Peak in its sleep.
Moreover, its bloodline level was incredibly high.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon’s realm of thought swept over its head, and underneath a golden dragon horn that spanned kilometer-wide gaps in scale armor, it found the curled up Purple little dragon.
“Miss Joseline, wake up.”
Yi ya yi ya! The now thirty-meters-long Purple little dragon slowly opened its eyes, looking somewhat lost.
The thoughts of the Divinized Emperor Dragon reverberated in the surroundings, deep and rich: “We’ve just finished a battle, and I need your Creation origin ‘Healing’ right now.”
The Mythical Fusion Form was mighty, the Divinized Emperor Dragon in this state had a terrifying understanding of strength, and both forces within the body had reached a dreadful level.
But Jack Clark had a premonition that the longer he maintained the Godlike Form, the more difficult it would be to separate.
This separation was not just between the soul and the Giant Beast Body, but also the fusion of those talents, Divine Powers, various rules, and the origins of Rule.
Yi ya yi ya! No problem, trust your brother.
Hearing that the Divinized Emperor Dragon needed it, and having recovered from the previous consumption and now even stronger, the Purple little dragon’s eyes lit up, excited.
Boom!
Dazzling purple lightning Burst from the Purple little dragon’s body, its size swelling instantly, transforming into a Purple Divine Dragon over nineteen hundred meters long appearing in the sky.
At the same time, an aura of the Peak of the Mythical Realm, along with an oppressive force comparable to the late Titan Level, spread out, shaking the Void.
The Silver Giant Dragon circling over the back of the Divinized Emperor Dragon suddenly turned its head, its eyes widening: “Roar! This aura, how did Miss Joseline become so strong?!”
The Gold Blue Giant Dragon spread its double wings, gracefully flying through the towering kilometer-high Dorsal Fins: “It’s simple, because it’s always followed Thunderflame.”
Thinking of the Purple little dragon’s method of cultivation, the Silver Giant Dragon felt envious.
“Damn, even the Great Sethia wants to gain strength that effortlessly.”
Roar! While the two Giant Dragons roamed the back of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon had already opened its mouth wide, a blinding purple Radiance gathering inside it.
Boom!
A pure purple mist sprayed out from the little dragon’s mouth, endlessly flowing into the forehead of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, penetrating the dense scale armor and merging into muscle and bones, spreading to the surroundings.
Suddenly, countless Rune Sequence Chains deep within the cells around the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s forehead began to vibrate, showing signs of splitting at their limits.
After the soul talents fused through Deification, Jack Clark and the Giant Beast Body needed enough Creation origin to separate.
They relied on the power of Creation to split back into two.
As the continuous stream of Creation strength fused into the body, the mane on the head of the Divinized Emperor Dragon stirred without wind, the three pairs of golden and black dragon horns emitted dazzling Radiance, slowly starting to fade.
However… after half a day, the Purple little dragon was panting, flying in the air, while the aura of the Divinized Emperor Dragon was still majestic and terrifying, with only the forehead fading in color.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon roared deeply: “It’s still not enough, Miss Joseline.”
Yi ya yi ya!! Don’t worry, brother, the great May still has an ultimate move I haven’t used yet, watch me.
“Roar! Burn, my world.” The Purple little dragon roared, its entire body igniting into purple-red flames, its aura surging by tens of times in an instant.
As part of its origin burned along with its Bloodline Power, the Purple little dragon’s size swelled instantly to three thousand meters, its aura growing even stronger.
And inside it, a Terrifying Power was activated.
Boom!
A Purple Gold Dragon Ball, one hundred meters in diameter looking like pure crystal, slowly emerged above the Purple little dragon’s head, containing faint images of mountains and rivers.
The Purple Gold Dragon Ball emitted a brilliant glow, instantly a nearly liquidified purple beam shot forth, rushing into the forehead of the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Hum! The Divinized Emperor Dragon’s body shone brightly, invisible specks of light flying out from within, converging into its mouth.
Gradually, an ethereal humanoid shadow emerged from nothingness.
Just at the moment when the Purple little dragon burned its bloodline and origin, sacrificing its primordial Dragon Ball, two million kilometers away, the area where the fallen Primordial Beast lay suddenly shook.
The Purple Gold Dragon Ball emitted a brilliant glow, instantly a nearly liquidified purple beam shot forth, rushing into the forehead of the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Hum! The Divinized Emperor Dragon’s body shone brightly, invisible specks of light flying out from within, converging into its mouth.
Gradually, an ethereal humanoid shadow emerged from nothingness.
Just at the moment when the Purple little dragon burned its bloodline and origin, sacrificing its primordial Dragon Ball, two million kilometers away, the area where the fallen Primordial Beast lay suddenly shook.

chapters.title: Chapter 1676 - 1676 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl Nightmare
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1676: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies Chapter 1676: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies For the Purple little dragon lacking in Creation origin, the Divinized Emperor Dragon had actually anticipated this from the start.
The solution to this problem was simple, it just needed to condense a drop of Essence Blood.
With the true body of the Divinized Emperor Dragon being comparable to the Primordial, a single drop of its Essence Blood contained energy that was almost more exaggerated than that of an Ancient Beast, not to mention the included Bloodline Power.
It was enough to forcibly enable the Mythical Peak Purple little dragon to break through to a Titan, or even into the late period of a Titan.
By then, with the Purple little dragon’s bloodline, the might of the fully developed Law of Creation could even approach the Rule. With a desperate effort, it should be enough for Jack Clark and the Giant Beast Body to separate.
However, this would injure the Purple little dragon a bit.
The bloodline of the Divinized Emperor Dragon was too powerful. The life imprint it contained would forcibly influence the future growth path of the Purple little dragon, causing all aspects to converge towards it.
Then, it would truly become its ‘daughter.’
In addition, condensing Essence Blood would damage the foundation, which was also the reason why the Divinized Emperor Dragon did not choose this option immediately.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon had been hesitant about whether to condense Essence Blood, but unexpectedly, there was a disturbance in the Primordial Forbidden Zone, and the Purple little dragon felt the call from the bloodline even more.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly turned its head, looking towards the direction where the Primordial Beast had fallen. Brilliant auroras shimmered, obscuring the light of the three suns in the sky.
From there, the Divinized Emperor Dragon vaguely felt a force awakening.
The forbidden area where the Human Race resided was once formed by the fall of a Primordial Beast. The Dragon Egg of the Purple little dragon fell into the seabed of Blue Star from a Space Crack during a Heaven-Earth Mutated event several decades ago.
Before its fall, this Primordial Beast smashed into this region, and a falling tail stretched over a hundred thousand kilometers in length, isolating the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
At this moment, as the Purple little dragon was burning its bloodline and Origin, sacrificing the Dragon Ball to transform the Creation origin, a bloodline reaction surprisingly came from that place.
Could it be that the fallen Primordial Beast was the father or mother of the Purple little dragon?
A thoughtful look flashed in the Dragon Eyes of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, followed by a deep roar shaking the Firmament.
“Miss Joseline, stop for now, let’s go over and take a look.”
Yiyayiya!!
The Purple little dragon obediently nodded, the flames of Origin and the radiance of the bloodline on its body gradually dimmed. Opening its mouth wide, it swallowed the Dragon Ball in one gulp.
Buzz!
Purple radiance sparkled, and the body of the Purple little dragon shrank. In the blink of an eye, it reduced from over nineteen hundred meters to thirty meters in size, appearing somewhat adorable.
It could grow big or small, rise high or hide well; when large, it soared amongst clouds, and when small, it concealed its form.
From this, one can tell that Blue Star must have started to connect with the mythical world many years ago.
Then some people entered the mythical world, or some mythical world creatures appeared on Blue Star, which led to the spread of various Mythical Legends.
But back then, the pathways or cracks were too small and not stable enough, so no mutation occurred, and Blue Star, including the Solar System, had not yet been detected by the mythical world.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon looked down from above, its Will shaking Heaven and Earth: “Jack Clark’s Resurrection is a bit troublesome; I need to go that land of the Primordial fallen to seek the Origin.”
“While I am away, Adriana will control all the Dragon Kings. Every Giant Beast below the Dragon King must obey orders until I return.”
The expedition of the Dragon Palace Empire this time was only to offer support. After the great battle, they would leave and would not have too much interaction with the Human Alliance.
To prevent any friction from occurring when it entered the Primordial land, it had the Blue-White Giant Dragon keep an eye on things.
Compared to those Ancient Dragon Kings who were almost like the Great Kings of the mountains, the Blue-White Giant Dragon seemed a bit more reliable.
The True Martial King, holding the stele in hand, looked up at the massive figure stirring in the sky with a somber expression.
The other Heavenly Kings and king-level beings felt likewise. They hadn’t expected Jack Clark’s injuries to be so severe that even the Giant Beast, almost comparable to the Primordial, couldn’t help temporarily.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The movement of the Black Gold Giant Beast spanning a hundred and twenty thousand kilometers vibrated the forbidden area, distorting time, creating dazzling phenomena of flowing light like pathways through time around it.
Beside the large dragon head of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon, surrounded by a halo of nine-color radiance, flapped its double wings: “Roar! Tim Abott, do you really think there is Primordial Origin in there?”
Under the curious gaze of the two Giant Dragons, one of the Dragon Eyes of the Divinized Emperor Dragon that spanned hundreds of kilometers blinked slowly and let out a low growl: “Under normal conditions, no.”
Before achieving Deification Unity, Jack Clark had also been curious about the land where the Primordial Beast had fallen and was planning to explore it when his strength was sufficient to see if there was Primordial Origin.
But after reaching the Half-step Primordial in the Deification Realm and fully entering the Primordial Realm in terms of true combat strength, the Divinized Emperor Dragon no longer harbored this idea.
A Primordial Beast had transcended the conventional meaning of life, ruled above ‘gods,’ becoming another high-dimensional existence, possessing Immortal characteristics.
If such a high-ranking creature were to fall, basically everything would dissipate between heaven and earth, leaving nothing, and all traces would be erased by enemies.
Otherwise, leaving behind a drop of Essence Blood or a piece of flesh and blood remains would allow it to resurrect someday in the future.
This could be seen from the case of Number One, a lifeform that had nearly reached Primordial and for some reason had fallen ancient times ago. Even with only a remnant heart left, it almost managed to resuscitate with the help of the Human Race.
What’s more, the most important thing was that the Primordial Beast had probably not completely perished yet.
Its life Origin scattering into the mythical world and its true body disintegrating and merging with Heaven and Earth was its last method of Resurrection, preventing the entity that defeated it from pursuing and descending.

chapters.title: Chapter 1677 - 1677 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl Nightmare
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1677: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies_2 Chapter 1677: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies_2 Even if the Divinized Emperor Dragon forcefully tore through and entered, it was unable to find the hidden Origin or anything else.
Unless the Primordial Beast, after ages, failed to revive and completely dissipated, melding into the forbidden area of Heaven and Earth, perhaps one or two strands of Origin could be found.
Just like the initial First Councilor, Adam Garcetti.
In the blink of an eye, the Divinized Emperor Dragon traversed the forbidden area with the three “little ones” and arrived in the Land of Fallen over a million kilometers away.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon coiled in the Firmament over three hundred thousand kilometers high, looking down, it could see this region shrouded in White Mist, twisting like a Divine Dragon spanning over two million kilometers.
In this region, Space-Time collapsed, White Mist roiled filled with berserk destructive power, those glows appeared to permeate from the depths of the Void, illuminating Heaven and Earth.
The Gold Blue Giant Dragon revealed its shock, “Thunderflame, this already fallen Primordial Beast… so powerful.”
“Roar! Damn, Great Sethia feels a bit uncomfortable.” The Silver Giant Dragon let out an irritable roar, unconsciously flying towards the head of the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Just upon approaching this area, the bloodlines within the Gold Blue Giant Dragon and Silver Giant Dragon experienced terrifying suppression, their strength solidified, making even breathing feel difficult.
However, Purple Little Dragon’s eyes brightened, under those diffused rule powers, it felt its entire body’s strength and bloodline become exceptionally active.
Boom! Purple Little Dragon’s body erupted with purple lightning, involuntarily revealing its true form of over one thousand nine hundred meters.
Eeek Eeek!! Brother, charge, Miss Joseline feels it, there are good things inside.
Having said that, without waiting for the Divinized Emperor Dragon to speak, Purple Little Dragon let out an excited roar and rushed into the forbidden area, plunging into the White Mist permeating Heaven and Earth.
Without hindrance, without danger, Purple Little Dragon vanished like a purple light.
“Miss Joseline, slow down,” the Divinized Emperor Dragon growled lowly.
Looking at the white fog area filled with destructive power ahead, fearing that Purple Little Dragon would encounter any danger, the Divinized Emperor Dragon let out a low growl, its resplendent Qi Blood Radiance bursting forth.
Boom! Heaven and Earth shook, endless multicolored radiance shined, and the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s claws, containing both destruction and creation, “slowly” reached out.
Beneath the Black Dragon Claw, space shattered showing various terrifying phenomena of universal destruction and the collapsing of worlds, leading all things back to Chaos.
While the Golden Dragon Claw sparkled with dazzling golden brilliance, spreading invisibly between Heaven and Earth, morphing into the boundless night sky, the vista of the Great Thousand Worlds being opened.
Under the intermingling light of destruction and creation, the radiance was dazzling and splendid, illuminating billions of kilometers.
At this moment, the aura of the Divinized Emperor Dragon was immensely grand, majestic, and the invisible pressure emitted even pierced the mythical world, descending upon the recently stabilized Solar System.
On Blue Star, countless people were still not recovered from the celestial phenomena, their faces once again displaying shock.
Looking at the multicolored brilliance illuminating the entire world and the vague giant shadow covering the sky above, over two billion people all felt somewhat heart-pounded, fearful.
White Veil’s legs trembled, “What is that!?”
Justin Welan swallowed hard, “I don’t know, I only know it’s terrifying, very powerful.”
“Aren’t those obvious words…”
Boom!
Under one strike of the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s merging claws, the entire Primordial Land of Fallen shook, the Void even resounding with chants of destruction and creation.
Between the claws, boundless light burst forth, forming a ring of Chaotic Halo sweeping across a million kilometers.
Wherever it passed, the White Mist dispersed, forming a vast Black Hole where nothing existed, with the hinted shadow of a One-side World faintly emerging within the depths of the Black Hole.
Roar! The Divinized Emperor Dragon roared, its vast body thundered as it plunged into the Black Hole, into the world forcibly torn open by a pathway.
Boom!
The moment the twelve thousand kilometers long Giant Beast arrived, the space shattered, the starry sky filled with White Mist and Black Flames vibrated violently.
As soon as it arrived in this world transformed by the Primordial Beast, the Divinized Emperor Dragon, along with the Silver and Gold Blue Giant Dragons, all focused their gaze.
