In this starry sky pervaded with mist, floated several thousands to tens of thousands of meters long remnants of Eastern Divine Dragons of green, blue, red, and other colors.
Some were cut in half at the waist, some without heads, or shredded into pieces.
And these Giant Beasts, the weakest among them possessed Titan Level strength, not lacking Ancient Level.
Among them, several with only parts of bodies reaching tens of thousands of meters long, even emitted an intangible pressure comparable to True Spirit, their scale armor damaged, dragon horns broken.
One could imagine what a fierce battle once erupted here.
Apart from these Divine Dragon corpses, in the boundless vast starry sky were also some remnants of black monsters’ bodies meters to thousands of meters in size.
These black monsters, their upper bodies resembling the Furious Ape, bodies robust, arms elongated, each with a pair of sharp double claws as large as half their bodies.
Their lower bodies were like insects, legs bent in a way filled with Burst power, their entire bodies cloaked in insect-shell-like pitch-black armor, resembling a Slaughter Machine.
And most importantly, the Terrifying Aura emanating from these black monsters made the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold Blue Giant Dragon feel some heart throb, discomfort.
It was like facing a natural enemy.
Standing on the head of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, resembling an ant, the Silver Giant Dragon couldn’t help but roar, “Damn, what are these monsters, to actually make Great Sethia feel this uncomfortable.”
The Gold Blue Giant Dragon’s gaze was grave, “These must be the subordinates of that one that killed the Primordial Beast, very terrifying.”
The Divinized Emperor Dragon merely looked coldly at those corpses for a moment, its huge body suddenly moved, following the connection with Purple Little Dragon, it flew toward a certain direction deep in the starry sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 1678 - 1678 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl Nightmare
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1678: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies_3 Chapter 1678: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies_3 The Purple Little Dragon had initially absorbed the life force of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to complete its own emergence from its shell.
It then continued to absorb the diffused life aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon for cultivation and growth, forming a certain bond between them, such as a vague sense of each other’s presence.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Under the huge body of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, White mist trembled, Black Flames annihilated, and corpses of Giant Beasts instantly turned to dust and dispersed.
These corpses of Giant Beasts were like rotten wood that had decayed for ten thousand years, without a trace of energy remaining, disintegrating into ash with a slight touch.
But just as the Divinized Emperor Dragon had flown millions of kilometers, a fierce roar came from the starry space ahead, and the sky filled with Black Flames burned, enveloping tens of thousands of kilometers.
In the sea of Black Flames, a creature that stood a hundred thousand meters tall, seemingly formed of Black Flames, emerged with blood-red eyes staring deathly at the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
At the same time, an aura of near-True Spirit level of terrifying spread, causing two Giant Dragons’ tails to stand erect as they emitted low growls.
“Roar! Damn it, the Great Scythia hates this aura, and this species too.”
Boom!
The starry space collapsed, forming a Hollow a million kilometers wide, under the terrifying Black Dragon Claw the creature exploded instantly, and the pervasive destructive force further annihilated the sea of fire.
In front of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, this kind of projection, condensed by residual will, was no match at all.
But just then, the Divinized Emperor Dragon suddenly looked up, its black-and-white vertical pupils coldly gazing above the Firmament, sensing a terrifying gaze from far beyond space-time.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Just to erase a residual will within the power triggers a response, huh.”
“So powerful, a Primordial Creature, really want to tear it apart and eat it.” The Divinized Emperor Dragon growled, suppressing the somewhat boiling blood and Battle Intent within.
Now was not the time to travel to the outer space.
Following the vague senses, the Divinized Emperor Dragon continued forward, encountering vast battlefields of Divine Dragons and corpses of Black Beasts in the mist-shrouded starry space.
Including the Black Flames burning the starry space.
These flames were remnants of another Primordial Stars’ power, continuing to erode the Primordial Beast’s Inner World, melting everything.
And wherever these Black Flames exceeded ten thousand kilometers, the residual power and will would condense and form half-real, half-illusory Black Beasts.
Boom Boom Boom!! In front of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, one after another Black Beast was blown apart, their powerful strength shaking the starry space, even causing this Primordial world to tremble.
And the undying intent contained in those Black Flames were also obliterated by the even more Overbearing Chaotic force, completely dissipating.
After distorting the space, nearly traversing hundreds of billions of kilometers, the Divinized Emperor Dragon finally neared the last known location of the Purple Little Dragon’s “aura.”
But upon arriving there, the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s form slowly came to a halt.
Ahead, the starry space collapsed, endless Black Flames burned, engulfing millions of kilometers, and the fierce flames occasionally leaped, causing a tsunami of ten thousand feet.
Boom!
As the Divinized Emperor Dragon appeared, the sea of fire shook violently, the endless flames converged to form a giant figure a thousand kilometers tall, covered in Black smooth armor.
Instantly a True Spirit level Aura permeated, rattling space-time.
Looking at the Giant Beast over a hundred thousand kilometers long, the creature’s eyes filled with ferocious and tyrannical light flickered with intelligence, its gaze cold, its will shaking the starry space.
“You do not carry the bloodline of the Xu Tian Divine Dragon on you, you, who are you?”
The Divinized Emperor Dragon’s eyes flickered with surprise, Xu Tian Divine Dragon, It seemed this was Misss Joseline’s tribe, the name sounded quite imposing.
Watching the Divinized Emperor Dragon, who was just coldly observing it without speaking, the terrifying Black Beast’s gaze grew colder and more fierce, emitting horrible waves of will.
“Strange Giant Beast, leave immediately, otherwise you will be regarded as the enemy of the Nightmare Beast Clan, and you will be torn apart and slained, ending up like that Xu Tian Divine Dragon.”
As soon as the Black Beast finished speaking, before the Divinized Emperor Dragon could respond, the Silver Giant Dragon on its head already let out an angry roar, “Roar! Damn you, dare to threaten Tim Abott, you’re seeking death.”
Suddenly, the True Spirit level Beast paused, its ferocious and tyrannical gaze falling on the head of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, flashing a hint of perplexity.
What were those two tiny specks like dust?
“Roar! Damn you, how dare you ignore the Great Scythia.” The Silver Giant Dragon, sensing the perplexity in the Beast’s eyes, immediately jumped.
“And the great Telsafi.” The Gold Blue Giant Dragon also roared.
That guy, completely ignoring them, was outright… Wrong, they were just at Early Titan, being ignored by the True Spirit level creature seemed quite normal.
Thinking this, both the Silver and Gold Blue Giant Dragons felt somewhat frustrated, but there was no helping it, being weak was just like that.
Of course, both Giant Dragons dared to confront that True Spirit level creature because their confidence came from the Divinized Emperor Dragon, as long as the Divinized Emperor Dragon was there, even True Spirit level beasts were no match.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly opened its mouth, instantly the terrifying will vibrated the Void, “From the moment you threatened me, my relationship with your Nightmare Beast Clan, or should I say ‘you’, has already become hostile.”
“Next time we meet, I will definitely tear you apart.”
Boom! Space-Time shook, under the terrifying power the whole world fell into stasis, only that “slowly” enveloping darkness in the starry space, devouring everything.
“You’re seeking death!”
Right at the moment when darkness devoured everything, that creature named Nightmare Beast roared, its body bursting with a power filled with utmost darkness and calamity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1679 - 1679 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl Nightmare
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1679: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies_4 Chapter 1679: Chapter 621 Primordial Dragon Pearl, Nightmare Beast from Beyond the Skies_4 Boom Boom Boom!! A black sea of flames erupted, forming nine vortexes tens of thousands of kilometers wide.
In the depths of the vortexes, blue hurricanes, dark red flames, black waters corroding rules, the Light of Oblivion, and other six calamitous powers erupted like boundless oceans.
Under such terrifying power, everything would be destroyed, disintegrated, shattered—to include the fundamental rules that constituted this starry sky world.
Then… Boom!
Above the black hole where everything had turned to nothingness, a Giant Beast twelve million kilometers long stood erect, emitting an aura of terror that destroyed Heaven and Earth, trembling Space-Time.
Under the devouring forces of Final Darkness, a million kilometers all around was devoured by the Divinized Emperor Dragon, including those calamitous powers, the sea of fire, and the black monster.
A terrifying roar exploded, resounding around the Divinized Emperor Dragon in the Void across vast Space-Time.
Unmoved by the roar of that Primordial Creature, as a force exploded inside its body, the huge form of the Divinized Emperor Dragon visibly grew larger.
Whoosh!
The Divinized Emperor Dragon breathed out a destructive hurricane, obliterating the starry sky in a ten-thousand-kilometer radius, nodding in satisfaction, “This feeling of eating one’s fill at one go, not bad.”
The black True Spirit Level beast that had just been devoured contained a rich energy, equivalent to an entire True Spirit Beast.
Plus, part of the Celestial Creature’s Soul Will—it, after digesting it, even the size of the Divinized Emperor Dragon increased by several hundred meters.
Unfortunately, it was still not enough, if it could devour that Primordial Beast, it should be able to grow directly to the Primordial Level.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon shook its head, looking towards the depths of the black hole, where a transparent long river emerged.
A point of White Light shone atop the Time River, emerging from the depths of time, finally turning into a majestic palace a million kilometers large.
Eehee Eehee!! Brother, Misss Joseline is here.
At the edge of the palace enveloped in White Light, the Purple little dragon waved its claws excitedly at the Divinized Emperor Dragon, making infantile eehee eehee sounds.
Eehee Eehee!! Misss Joseline knew Brother could find his way here.
Eehee Eehee!! Misss Joseline has already opened the door, Brother hurry, there are many goodies inside.
Compared to the palace as large as a star, the Purple little dragon was almost infinitesimally small—if it weren’t for the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s excellent eyesight, it could hardly be seen.
Boom! Space-Time twisted around the Divinized Emperor Dragon, its colossal form flying into the depths of Space-Time.
As it approached the palace, the Divinized Emperor Dragon keenly sensed changes in the ‘space’ around it, a power enveloping its True Body.
Once it crossed vast Space-Time, coming before the great doors of the palace, the Real Body of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, under spatial compression, shrunk to ten thousand kilometers.
Boom! The Divinized Emperor Dragon’s heavy steps fell on the stairs of the palace, instantly causing the entire building to shake violently, even suddenly sinking a section deeper into the depths of Space-Time.
Buzz!
The Divine temple slightly vibrated, the carved Divine Dragons on the walls and stone pillars shining brightly, emitting roars of Dragon Roars, reinforcing this piece of Space-Time.
In front of the massive beast like a star, the Purple little dragon a thousand nine hundred meters long made an impatient sound: Eehee Eehee!! Brother hurry, May can’t wait any longer.
Saying so, it took the lead and flew into the palace.
This little guy. A hint of warmth flashed in the eyes of the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Clearly, after entering the Land of Fallen, the Purple little dragon directly penetrated into Space-Time, coming to this palace, and due to bloodline reasons, it easily opened the palace doors.
However, to wait for it, this small creature had always resisted the intense calling of the bloodline inheritance, wanting to share the ‘things’ left behind by that Primordial Beast with it.
“Roar! Tim, it’s so big in here.”
Just upon entering the palace, the Silver Giant Dragon, the Gold Blue Giant Dragon, widened their eyes.
The inside of the palace was still a pitch-dark starry sky, but there was no White mist pervading, instead twinkling with thirty-six sparkling red and blue turning purple Crystal Heavenly Bodies.
Each of these heavenly bodies was ten thousand kilometers in diameter, standing in two rows, akin to planets.
At the end of the planetary bodies stood a ‘throne’ several hundred thousand kilometers high, like an inverted White Crystal Divine Mountain standing in the cosmos, engraved with countless mysterious rules patterns.
At this time, most of the thirty-six planetary bodies were damaged and cracked, with only two intact.
In one, a depression in the center formed a pool a thousand kilometers large, filled with sparkling light purple liquid, emitting a special Aura.
Just at the sight of that pool, the Silver Giant Dragon, the Gold Blue Giant Dragon, brightened their eyes, breathing heavily.
On another planetary crystal, there was a purple stream like a band of light floating, the invisible Aura of Creation distorting the Void, forming a One-side World.
Other than these, at the end of the crystal throne, floated a Seven-color Dragon Pearl, a thousand kilometers in diameter.
The Dragon Pearl’s radiance was dim, covered in countless cracks, seeming like it could completely shatter at any moment.
But even so, the Dragon Pearl still emitted a Primordial Terror Aura, crushing the entering Silver Giant Dragon, Gold Blue Giant Dragon, unable to move a muscle.
As for the Divinized Emperor Dragon, it simply ignored it.
Eehee Eehee!! Brother, that is the Primordial Origin, containing the power of Creation.
And that pool is the Heavenly Dragon Pool, all Giant Beast creatures entering will gain the Dragon Bloodline, and if it is the same Dragon-type Giant Beasts entering, it will further enhance the purity of the Dragon Bloodline.
Unfortunately, the other good things are all consumed and exploded, otherwise after Brother splits… recovers, devouring them would definitely greatly enhance strength.
The Purple little dragon that entered here seemed to have received some information, being very familiar with the things inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 1680 - 1680 622 Devouring Planets New Age Begins
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1680: Chapter 622: Devouring Planets, New Age Begins Chapter 1680: Chapter 622: Devouring Planets, New Age Begins Bloodlines are essentially life marks interwoven with rules.
The stronger the origin strength of the bloodline’s source, the higher the strength and limit of that bloodline’s descendants. There are many ways of inheritance, not just through basic reproduction.
For example, the Purgatory Ancestors would demonize other beings with the Dark Demon Air, transforming them into members of the Purgatory Demon Race, or most python-like creatures would instinctively evolve toward dragons.
And whenever rules are involved, one cannot trust them completely.
Especially since this is a Primordial Beast, it is simple to alter bloodline information to deceive the Purple little dragon at the Mythical Peak.
Hence, when the Purple little dragon told it that its bloodline perception informed it that the fallen Primordial held no malice towards it, the Divinized Emperor Dragon did not fully believe it.
Even though the other party had only a bit of a ‘Remnant Soul’ left.
Thus, when the Purple little dragon, with permission from the Divinized Emperor Dragon, excitedly flew more than a hundred thousand kilometers to the Crystal Throne.
Crackle Crackle!!
The thick scale armor on the brow of the Divinized Emperor Dragon cracked and split open, and a huge silver vertical pupil slowly opened, its eyes crystal clear, seeming to contain the past and the future.
After the deification fusion, the divine power of the Peeping Void Eye also became much stronger.
With a hum! Under the tangible gaze, the starry world vanished, leaving only the broken star spanning the Void, emitting endless purple halos, the pervasive force distorting the surrounding space-time.
This is the true nature of that Dragon Ball.
However, this time the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s gaze did not peer into the future but pierced through layers of purple crystal wall-like Rule Barriers, following the cracks into the star-like Dragon Ball’s interior.
Inside, thin purple mist permeated, each strand a powerful Primordial Force.
In that faint purple ocean, a Divine Dragon Shadow, a million kilometers long and nearly transparent to mere simple lines, lay in hibernation.
The Divine Dragon’s entire body was purple, but the mane on its head and the mane stretching from the Dorsal Fin to the tail were golden, appearing incredibly majestic and sacred.
And ‘beautiful.’
Beautiful, why would I feel this way? The gaze of the Divinized Emperor Dragon paused slightly.
Boom! Under the gaze of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, the Divine Dragon Shadow suddenly shook.
But this strand of Remnant Soul was too weak; it had already exhausted its last strength by leading the Purple little dragon here, so it only trembled slightly before falling back into silence.
After a long while, the silver vertical pupil on the brow of the Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly closed, because this Primordial Beast indeed held no malice toward the Purple little dragon.
With the current strength of the Divinized Emperor Dragon, even a slight ‘malice’ from the other party would not escape its Heart’s Eye Perception.
At the same time, the terrifying power gathered in the left claw of the Divinized Emperor Dragon slowly lowered.
Just now, if it had sensed even a slight problem with that Dragon Ball, the Divinized Emperor Dragon would have directly struck to explode it.
Sensing the killing intent dissipating from the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s body, the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly approached its eye, “Roar! Tim Abott, can we take a bath there?”
The ‘bath’ the Silver Giant Dragon referred to, naturally, was the Heavenly Dragon Pool.
The Divinized Emperor Dragon issued a deep growl, “Go ahead, the power contained within should enhance your strength and even Purify your Bloodline.”
As the world declined and the Primordial Beasts as sources of power fell, the power contained within this Heavenly Dragon Pool was actually not much.
Given permission, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, “Roar! Rush, Telsafi, let’s have a bath.”
“No, it should be called soaking,” the Gold Blue Giant Dragon also seemed excited, both dragons spreading their double wings, streaking across the starry sky, heading ten thousand kilometers away.
Not until then did the Divinized Emperor Dragon turn its gaze toward the purple light strip floating eighty thousand kilometers away, on the crystalline planet.
Boom!
The Divinized Emperor Dragon moved its foot; an invisible, pervasive aura vibrated the entire starry space, bridging tens of thousands of kilometers in just one step to stand before the Origin of Creation.
This venture into the Land of Fallen had surprisingly resulted in picking up a stream of Primordial Origin due to the Homologous Bloodline of the Purple little dragon, and it was even a Creation attribute.
Or was this ‘fate’?
Looking at the Origin that could allow it to split again, the Divinized Emperor Dragon hesitated briefly, then opened its massive mouth, instantly emitting a terrifying sucking force capable of devouring the world.
Boom!
The purple light strip, formed from vast Rules of Creation and stretching for thousands of kilometers, shot skyward, turning into a sky full of purple starlight and devoured in one gulp by the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Sigh! An immensely satisfying sensation arose in the heart of the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Under the infinite and boundless power of Creation washing over it, the Divinized Emperor Dragon’s body emitted a dazzling purple halo.
Thump Thump Thump!! Within its body, the cells—hovering between energy and flesh and blood—quivered, the runes in their nuclei serving as the genetic chain continuously shattered.
Instantly, the body of the Divinized Emperor Dragon began to lose color, shrinking at a rate visible to the naked eye.
Including the surrounding space-time’s invisible pervasive radiance of nine colors, it too gradually transformed into specks of light and dispersed.
This Deification Unity brought Jack Clark to the realm of Half-step Primordial, and his combat strength was powerfully invincible, suppressing the Purgatory ancestors that had still been overpowering the Primordial Beast just earlier.
Jack Clark naturally felt some attachment to this tremendous force.
But after only a slight hesitation, he decisively chose to separate.
Compared to traversing from an ancient realm to a Half-step Primordial, Jack Clark’s ambition was greater; he wanted to leverage the soul’s Deification Talent to cross the eternal chasm.
As Transcendent Life progresses, it becomes slower and more challenging towards the end.
Under normal conditions, reaching the True Spirit Level, merely hibernating and entering Closed-door Cultivation once could take hundreds to thousands of years, and the pace of progress in cultivation was infuriatingly slow.
Take the Purgatory Ancestor, for instance, who hibernated for thousands of years and only managed to break through from the Late Stage of True Spirit to the Pinnacle of True Spirit by a fluke.

chapters.title: Chapter 1681 - 1681 622 Devouring Planets The New Age
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1681: Chapter 622 Devouring Planets, The New Age Begins_2 Chapter 1681: Chapter 622 Devouring Planets, The New Age Begins_2 Nor should one speak of the realm above the True Spirit, the Primordial Realm.
At the moment Jack Clark’s strength stepped into the Half-step Primordial, the Divinized Emperor Dragon gazed into the infinite outer space, its Heavenly Rank Bloodline throbbing, and the direction of what came after Primordial became crystal clear in his mind.
Primordial was merely the threshold to departure from the Mythical Earth.
The distance from Primordial to Eternity was still immensely vast; many powerful lives struggled in the Primordial Realm for millions of years, still wandering on the path to Eternity.
For instance, the Three suns that reflected across the entire Mythical World, whose radiance and projections covered countless worlds and space-times, were still within the Primordial Realm.
However, those Three suns stood at the pinnacle of Primordial, possessing strength so formidable it was indescribable.
Hence, Jack Clark naturally would not be satisfied with the present; his goal was supreme Eternity.
As the overwhelming pressure that filled the starry sky receded with an astonishing speed, the two Giant Dragons that had already flown to the edge of the Heavenly Dragon Pool, and the Purple little dragon that was drawn by the bloodline power to the Crystal Throne, all suddenly looked back.
Watching the Divinized Emperor Dragon that had shrunk to eighty thousand kilometers, the Silver Giant Dragon revealed a look of regret, “Telsafi, Tim Abott has used up that powerful strength inside him.”
Fool. The Gold Blue Giant Dragon gave a glance at the Silver Giant Dragon and could not help but reveal a look of regarding an idiot.
It really was you, Great Sethia, do you actually believe that Thunderflame swallowing that human and suddenly becoming so strong was due to that ‘special power’?
The excuses the Divinized Emperor Dragon gave earlier to appease the public and the Giant Beasts were believed by almost no one, except for some particularly simple-minded beings.
Including Giant Beasts like the Gold Blue Giant Dragon.
Any ‘normal person’ would not believe there is any power that could make an ancient late-stage Giant Beast instantly make a breakthrough to Half-step Primordial, with a simultaneous explosive increase in combat power.
Nevertheless, this secret was undoubtedly of utmost importance to both Jack Clark and the Divinized Emperor Dragon.
Therefore, after the Divinized Emperor Dragon threw them a bone, everyone pretended to believe this reason.
Sensing the Gold Blue Giant Dragon’s strange look, the Silver Giant Dragon immediately became agitated, “Roar! Telsafi, what kind of look is that? Are you thinking that the Great Sethia is a fool again in your mind?”
However, this time the Gold Blue Giant Dragon didn’t provoke it further, lazily roaring, “How could that be, Sethia? How could someone as clever as you be a fool?”
“Alright, let’s go take a bath.” Saying that, the Gold Blue Giant Dragon turned around, ignoring the fool, and with an elegant posture, burst into the Dragon Pond with a thunderous splash, sending water flying everywhere.
“Damn it, don’t think you can fool me, Telsafi, you were definitely thinking that just now.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared as it plunged into the Dragon Pond, and two proud Dragon Roars echoed through the starry sky, both Giant Dragons releasing a raging bloodline aura.
Even though the energy in the Heavenly Dragon Pool was almost depleted, it still came from a Primordial Beast and contained Creation.
Boom boom boom!!
Like an inland sea, the water of the Dragon Pond roared, forming two massive whirlpools around the two Giant Dragons, with endless marrow-cleansing strength pouring into their bodies.
At this moment, the Purple little dragon also arrived in front of the damaged Dragon Ball.
Compared to the seven-color Dragon Pearl with a diameter of a thousand kilometers, the Purple little dragon at just over nineteen hundred meters seemed like an insignificant insect, looking somewhat bewildered at the massive Dragon Ball before it.
As the Purple little dragon turned its head, pondering how to ‘devour’ this Dragon Ball, the Dragon Ball on the verge of shattering emitted a faint radiance.
Hum! Space-time collapsed around the Seven-color Dragon Pearl, shrinking continuously, and in no time, it was reduced to a hundred meters.
At the same time, a throbbing of bloodline came from within the Purple little dragon, and instinctively it opened its dragon mouth, and its own purple Dragon Ball flew out from within.
Without a sound, the two Dragon Balls overlapped like Illusory Projections.
Boom!
Beneath the Purple little dragon, the Crystal Throne, towering more than a hundred thousand kilometers high like an upside-down Floating Island, trembled, and its surface became covered in dense, complex colorful rule runes.
Substantial Rule Radiance enveloped the Crystal Floating Island, compressing and collapsing, transforming into a Seven-color Dragon Egg ten thousand kilometers in size, slightly expanding and contracting.
Instantly, a terrifyingly powerful Aura spread, the invisible bloodline pressure shaking Space-Time.
At the moment the Seven-color Dragon Egg formed, the entire forbidden space of the starry sky shook wildly, collapsing, with endless space and matter rushing towards the Divine Temple and the Seven-color Dragon Egg.
When everything had poured into the Dragon Egg, the entire fog-shrouded forbidden area had become a void, with only that majestic Divine Temple standing within the depths of Space-Time.
Inside the temple, thirty-six Colored Crystals, each with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, floated like stars, their glow illuminating the starry sky.
On one of the Planetary Crystals ten thousand kilometers in diameter, a Black Gold Primordial Beast two thousand, two hundred meters long stood tall, with the figure of black-haired Jack Clark sitting cross-legged on its head.
With the help of that Primordial Creation Origin, Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon soon completed their separation.
And at this moment, whether it was the Destruction Emperor Dragon or Jack Clark, they were both enveloped by a purple glow, emitting a thick aura of Creation Energy within them, vibrating Heaven and Earth.
Primordial Origin was like Essence Blood, containing the life essence of a Primordial Beast.
That stream of power containing Primordial Origin was almost equivalent to one percent of a Primordial Beast, vast and magnificent.
After gathering Jack Clark’s True Body and healing the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s True Body from the damage caused during the separation, about ten percent of this Creation Energy remained.
Glancing at the two evolving Giant Dragons in Hibernation in the Heavenly Dragon Pool and the Seven-color Dragon Egg, Jack Clark pondered briefly before slowly closing his eyes.
Simultaneously, the Purple Radiance surrounding the Destruction Emperor Dragon shook as it surged crazily toward Jack Clark, overwhelmingly vast.

chapters.title: Chapter 1682 - 1682 622 Devouring Planets The New Age
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1682: Chapter 622 Devouring Planets, The New Age Begins_3 Chapter 1682: Chapter 622 Devouring Planets, The New Age Begins_3 A man and a beast were originally one entity, so when part of the Creation Energy within the Destruction Emperor Dragon entered Jack Clark’s body, there was not a single obstruction felt.
It was like seawater pouring into a river.
As those Creation Origins fused with the True Body, Jack Clark’s consciousness entered a state akin to enlightenment, spontaneously bringing forth the perceptions experienced during the state of Deification.
Boom!
A Supreme Aura erupted from Jack Clark, infinite golden-white lightning danced, and his True Body swelled to become a three-faced, ten-armed Demon God of 50,000 meters in height.
Sitting cross-legged, Jack Clark wore a black imperial robe, his head donned with the All-Heaven Emperor Crown, his right arm holding a halberd at his back, and his left hand supporting a Soul Emperor Seal exuding an ancient aura, while the Plane of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder manifested around him.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s aura was majestic and vast, akin to a Heaven Emperor descending from ancient times, his presence climbing swiftly towards the Ancient Middle Stage.
Huff!
The Destruction Emperor Dragon exhaled slowly, feeling the rapid depletion of Creation Energy within its other body, its gaze drifting towards the Crystal Heavenly Bodies floating in the surrounding starry space.
This venture into the Land of Fallen brought not only that stream of Creation Origin, but these Crystal Heavenly Bodies were also exceedingly valuable.
Serving as ornaments to the Palace of the Primordial Beast Starry Sky Divine Temple, the thrones where its powerful underlings stood were all condensed from solid pure Energy Crystal Bodies.
The purity of these energies was almost a hundredfold that of the top-grade Crystal Stones currently mined by the Federation.
A fist-sized piece could allow Mythical Powerhouses to rapidly recover their Law Divine Power or accelerate their cultivation speed.
And most importantly, the quantity, a Crystal Planet of ten thousand kilometers in diameter contained vast energy, and even if the quality was somewhat less, it was still highly nourishing for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Thirty-six Crystal Planets, including the grand palaces—all of them devoured—should be sufficient for the Destruction Emperor Dragon to break through the Peak of the Ancient and step into the True Spirit.
Indeed, the Destruction Emperor Dragon also had its eyes on the temple inhabited by the Primordial Beast.
The temple interior harbored a starry space and could even hold a Primordial Beast, indicating the rarity and solidity of its materials.
It even contained a portion of Primordial Force.
For the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which could refine all matter and energy, these were substantial nourishment, equivalent to the flesh and corpses of True Spirit Beasts.
Roar! The Black Gold Giant Beast bellowed.
Boom!
The starry space vibrated, an endless burst of dark golden radiance transformed into a black hole, devouring a Crystal Planet with a ten thousand kilometer diameter bit by bit.
As the Crystal Planet vanished in an instant, the majestic energy within the Destruction Emperor Dragon exploded, sweeping mightily throughout its body.
With abundant energy, the muscles of the Destruction Emperor Dragon began to bulge, its bones grew, and its body swelled at a visible rate, its aura becoming heavier and more terrifying.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon neared the Peak of the Ancient, the Evolution value requirement for its sixth progression also approached two million on the attribute page.
And while Jack Clark engaged in closed-door cultivation and the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly refined each Crystal Planet, those outside were busy as well.
Under the orders of the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the Giant Beast legions were stationed outside the forbidden area battlefield, having minimal contact with the Human Alliance, including those Ancient Dragon Kings.
After spending two days to clear the battlefield, the Human Alliance Army returned.
The rear of the Human Territory instantly bustled with life, and cheers from city after city of logistics resounded across the sky.
At the original location of Channel One, the shadow of the towering Golden Divine Tree, hundreds of thousands of kilometers high, unfolded slowly, and its emitted golden light rendered the Human Territory as magnificent as a Golden Divine Domain.
Above the grand, vast shadow of the Golden Divine Tree, was a world so colossal that even the mere corner visible spanned millions of kilometers, obscuring the sun and casting shadows.
The rest of the Solar System, having achieved Sky Expansion, lay hidden in the depths of layered space-time, undiscoverable by anyone.
Packed densely around the Golden Divine Tree were golden warships, sky-based battleships, Floating Cities, and Divine Realms, all surrounded and filled with elite forces from the four races.
At this moment, everyone was filled with excitement and fervor, looking up at the waist of the golden divine tree where strands of mythical-level and Main God-level auras converged.
Above these kings and Heavenly Kings, at the crown of the tree, ten majestic figures emanating Divine King Level presence stood tall, their invisible might permeating and intimidating Heaven and Earth.
The great war had ended, and the Purgatory Demon Race had been wiped out; naturally, the time had come to divide the ‘spoils of war.’
With the danger of the Purgatory Demon Race gone, the division of territories within hundreds of millions of kilometers nearby, as well as the parts of ‘garrisoning points’ promised by the Human Race for successfully holding up the sky, were on the agenda.
These Immortal Spirit Clan, Heavenly Feather Clan, and Deity Alien Races were not natives of the Solar System and could not obtain the rule branding of the Solar System.
While this generation might not make it, the next one, as long as it is conceived and born in the Solar System, will receive a mark different from the mythical world, filled with uncertainties just like the current Human Race.
Of course, with gains come losses.
Due to the ‘poor’ environment of Blue Star and even the Solar System, their next generation, which is born as Fourth Layer beings, might regress in their base potential.
For example, newborns of their race could fall to First and Second Layer Transcendents, or even become ordinary life forms.
But it doesn’t matter. As long as one individual like Jack Clark, a heaven-defying monster, appears in the hundreds or thousands of years of their race’s propagation, everything will have been worth it.
At the top of the crown, the Golden Winged Divine King, Tolstoy, looked towards the True Martial King, Sky-based God King, and the Primordial True King, three Supreme Human Experts, and began to speak slowly.
“True Martial Lord, I think there’s no need to rush the second Four Races Alliance council. It can be held after the return of Divine Martial under the Emperor Crown.”
The Divine King Tarrod, the highest in realm and strongest in might among those present, slowly nodded as well: “Indeed, I too feel there is no need to rush.”
For that monster with True Spirit Combat Power from the ancient early stage, no one dared to underestimate it.
Though Jack Clark had died due to exhaustion from holding up the sky and was ‘devoured’ by that Giant Beast, since the beast said that he had not completely fallen, there was a high probability that he would resurrect and return.
After all, with the invincible strength of the Giant Beast at that time, there was no need to trick them with lies.
Therefore, the Golden Winged Divine King and others felt it was better to discuss the division of Human Territory once Jack Clark returned, as this would show adequate respect to him.
Moreover, if Jack Clark was dissatisfied with the results of the council and felt someone had encroached upon Human Territory, any resulting displeasure could be troublesome.
The Primordial True King shook his head: “No matter, before the war began, several of us had exchanged opinions on this matter, including the distribution of spoils should we win the war.”
“In this Civilization War against the Purgatory Demon Clan, you all led your races to gamble on everything. The Human Race is immensely grateful, no matter what the reason.”
“Now that the war has ended, and the Purgatory Demon Clan has been eradicated, naturally, it is the turn of the Human Race to honor our promises.”
As for what the three races were concerned about, the Primordial True Kings were naturally aware. However, with the uncertainty of when Jack Clark might return, they naturally could not continue to delay.
Anyway, it was just about allocating some unused places.
And what was more important was the integration of the ‘strength’ of the four races and the start of a New Age for the Human Race.
At that moment, the Primordial True King changed the subject: “However, the second council of the Four Races Alliance will still be presided over by our First Councilor, Adam Garcetti.”
“First Councilor Adam Garcetti!”
All the Divine and Immortal Kings of the three races were stunned. Hadn’t Adam Garcetti fallen in the grand battle before?
Boom!
Space trembled, and a thousand-kilometer-long Black Crack slowly tore open deep within the golden canopy, its edges revealing a pair of huge, ferocious black claws.
Behind the crack, a colossal figure shrouded in darkness emerged, and instantly a violent, brutal, dark and distorted terrible aura spread out.
[Over a thousand more words need meticulous editing; I’ll update for full attendance first. Brothers, refresh in an hour or the morning, and forgive me as the start of the new volume is a bit slow. Thank you.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1683 - 1683 623 True Emperors Edict Ancient Late
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1683: Chapter 623: True Emperor’s Edict, Ancient Late Stage Chapter 1683: Chapter 623: True Emperor’s Edict, Ancient Late Stage While Jack Clark was in closed-door cultivation, the Firmament, separated from the Human Race by countless dangerous areas, suddenly collapsed, unleashing a Spatial Storm that destroyed everything in the vicinity.
The storm, filled with a Destructive Aura, spread Black Flames, and from the depths of the Void a woman with the black hair of a king-emperor slowly emerged.
The very instant Sherry Williams stepped out of the deeper space, this World shook violently, and an invisible shockwave emanated from her, sweeping across hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Wherever the shockwave passed, Cloud Mist dispersed, leaving only the blazing Black Sun hanging in the Firmament.
Sherry Williams looked back at the healing black Hollow, her eyes ice cold, “You’re lucky you fled fast, a mere ordinary ancient artefact from the Void daring to block this Vice Hall Master, courting death.”
Whoosh!
With a thought from Sherry Williams, the sky full of Black Flames contracted and disappeared into the Great Sun mark that emerged on her forehead, immediately dispersing the terrifying majesty that filled Heaven and Earth.
Just as Sherry Williams was about to continue towards the Human Race direction, following the sensation of the Token, her figure suddenly halted.
On her left wrist, an exquisite and gorgeous dark purple Phoenix-tail bracelet lit up with countless runes, exuding White Light, and in the air, it converged into a projection screen.
In the projection, a woman appeared, clad in white and gold sumptuous divine clothing, her face exquisitely noble. Eyes as dazzling as the stars crossed Space-Time and landed on Sherry Williams.
“Sis?” Sherry Williams was somewhat surprised.
By the shores of Starry Sky Lake, Sara Williams spoke slowly, “Sherry, what you’re seeing now is just a residual image of me. I have an important mission for you.”
“Half an hour before I issued this Rule Decree, the Void True Emperor conveyed an oracle: the Ancestral Land of the Human Race has appeared, and its coordinates overlap with the direction you are heading.”
“Since you are closest to that location, the Great Flame Emperor has ordered you to go check out the situation first.”
“Thousands of years have passed, how the ancestral land has developed, what step has the newly established civilization reached, and so on.”
“Besides that, teams formed from the Six Great Divine Domains have also set out. They carry the True Emperor’s Edict, prepared to welcome the ancestral land back to the Divine Realm.”
At this point, Sara Williams’s figure disappeared, and the projection in the air turned into a topographic map a thousand kilometers in size.
In the middle of the map, notes were added for various civilized races, including the red boundaries marking their range of strength. When the map expanded to the central area, it became sparse.
About one-tenth of the area was annotated with warnings of dangerous forbidden areas, and the outer edges of the map were even more blurred—these were all unrecorded and unexplored territories.
And Sherry Williams was currently in the Southeast, within the blurred outer regions of the map, around ten billion kilometers away from the red point marked on the map.
The lost Ancestral Land of the Human Race, lost for tens of thousands of years, has actually appeared in the Vast World?
Looking at the huge map projection in the air, Sherry Williams was surprised for a moment, then thought of the Heritage Token she had left behind. The sensation it gave off was also in that direction.
“Could it be that the one who activated my Heritage Token is someone from the ancestral land? Or possibly…” Thinking this, Sherry Williams’s eyes showed excitement.
For ten thousand years, she and her sister had been searching for news of Jack Clark, but it was as if this person never existed at all, without a trace to be found.
This included the many ancient Human Race forces that had later caught up with the expedition, returning to the six domains, who also had no information about Jack Clark.
This led many from the Lost World to wonder if Jack Clark really existed, or if the name Jack Clark, or even the person, was just an Avatar of some unknown powerful entity.
And now, the Human Race’s ancestral land has appeared and linked to the Vast World. Perhaps Brother Clark was there.
But it was unknown what realm Jack Clark’s cultivation had reached after more than ten thousand years.
With his cultivation already at king-level back then, and only two days away from forging all ancient books into a new talent, it was possible he was about to enter the Primordial True Emperor Realm, right?
Boom!
The space around Sherry Williams shattered, and her figure instantly disappeared.
Meanwhile, in the Crimson Supreme Plane of another Space-Time, the heavens fell and the Earth cracked, a violent Destructive Aura pervaded a million kilometers.
In the shattered Crimson cracks of the Void, there lay a fragmentary corpse of the Deep Red Giant Beast over sixty thousand meters in length, with a Demon God holding a halberd, surrounded by a Dark Red Glow, standing tall by its side.
With the fall of the Purgatory ancestors, Left Demon, who was far in the Crimson Supreme Plane, also completely lost his chains.
At this moment, the Aura emanating from his body was indescribably dreadful. His entire battle armor was soaked in blood-red, emanating an aura of both dark depth and tyrannical destruction.
Although he had only broken through to the Demon God Realm not long ago, his majesty was terrifying, on par with the late stage of the Demon God Realm.
And it wasn’t just Left Demon; on its broad shoulders like a mountain ridge, the girl carrying four long swords also had her black hair turn blood-red.
A Dark Red Sword Intent emerged on Jane Aiken’s forehead, weaving together red runes, releasing an incomparably sharp and destructive Sword Intent.
Most importantly, her Aura had already made a breakthrough beyond king-level.
“An Ancient Level battle just erupted here, and the energy fluctuations it released will draw the attention of more terrifying destructive creatures nearby; we need to leave quickly.”
“The Deep Red World projects numerous worlds and Space-Times; all we need to do is find a crack linked to the mythical world, and we can return.”
“Hmm,” Jane Aiken nodded slowly.
Boom! Left Demon, with his massive True Body, burst into motion, condensed his Aura, and instantly turned into a Crimson Radiance, disappearing at the far end of the Earth below.
Just as Left Demon and Jane Aiken left, a terrifying roar exploded in the distance, and soon after, a massive figure emerged on the horizon, its invisible presence stirring up tens of thousands of kilometers of red light.

chapters.title: Chapter 1684 - 1684 623 True Emperors Edict Ancient Late
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1684: Chapter 623: True Emperor’s Edict, Ancient Late Stage_2 Chapter 1684: Chapter 623: True Emperor’s Edict, Ancient Late Stage_2 …
Blue Star, January 29th.
Ten days had passed since the Human Alliance’s great victory in the Second Mythical Impact.
Following a series of upheavals, everyone in the Blue Star World had matured a lot, including those who were still in elementary or middle school.
The impact was even greater for the cultivators living among society.
The projection of the God Demon battlefield that emerged during the overlapping of the two worlds, the Law True Bodies that could Destroy Heaven and Earth with a mere gesture, and the Demon Gods capable of blasting ranges of tens of thousands of kilometers of Heaven and Earth with a single strike completely shattered everyone’s worldview.
In the past, cultivators on Blue Star viewed those at the Seventh and Eighth Layers as lofty figures, while those at the Nine-fold Peak were seen as top-tier existences, capable of leveling mountain peaks with a single blow.
As for Mythical Kings, they were entirely out of reach, existing in a different world altogether from ordinary people and cultivators.
But after this anomaly, watching videos online of people catching rocket grenades barehanded or punching through walls made everyone feel incredibly weak.
At the same time, their desire for strength intensified, filled with motivation for cultivation.
Because they suddenly realized that a cultivator could become so terrifyingly strong to tear apart Space-Time, destroy a star with a single blow, and even prop up the entire Solar System!!
Simon, a World Competition contestant’s independent villa.
“The Cuervo Group of the Berlin Empire announced yesterday that the fifth-generation Giant God gene potion has completed clinical trials and has received certification from the Federation.”
“This potion can stimulate genetic sequences, unlocking human potential, with a 0.5 percent chance of awakening a Talent Ability.”
“Even if the awakening fails, this potion can also enhance bodily functions, augmenting physical strength by up to 0.5 times, significantly accelerating the pace of Body Refiners’ cultivation.”
“The Hundred Foxes Nation’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced yesterday that it has reached a significant cooperation with the Golden Wing Clan of the Heavenly Feather Tribe.”
“The President of the Hundred Foxes Nation, Qingqiu Shouyi, will take the Tianqi Star spaceship to Venus on the sixth of next month for a friendly visit to the Holy City of the Heavenly Feather Tribe.”
“The Eastern Summer Empire announced this morning that it will continue to increase its resource inclination towards the new generation of cultivators, training more elite strong men for the Federation.”
“Simultaneously, the Immortal Spirit Clan, Heavenly Feather Lightwing Clan, and the Tri-Eye Divine Tribe of Jupiter I have jointly announced a friendly cooperation with South Sky Martial Height of Mist River City in the Eastern Summer Empire.”
“The three tribes’ strong men will be appointed as special professors at South Sky Martial Height, offering specialized cultivation courses about the three tribes.”
“South Sky Martial Height has made an announcement that on February 25th, after the Lantern Festival, the school official website will open for online applications, and all students worldwide that meet the requirements can apply.”
“For more detailed application requirements, please scan the QR code at the bottom left of the news broadcast or call the international hotline 0218:555999 for consultation…”
Suddenly, Teresa Wilson, who was adjusting Glenn Clark’s collar, looked surprised, “Jim, is South Sky Martial Height going to offer courses on different races’ cultivation methods?”
Glenn Clark nodded slightly, “Hmm, Sister Ilisa mentioned it yesterday. It seems the Main Gods of the three tribes took the initiative to seek them out, wanting to set up a pilot project.”
Saying this, Glenn Clark glanced at the clock on the wall, “We should be heading out now, May.”
“Okay,” Teresa Wilson nodded with a hint of excitement.
Today was the final battle for the top four in Group B of the Global Martial Arts Competition which would determine the strongest in the group, competing against Jack Clark, who had already claimed first place in Group A, for the title of world’s number one.
At the villa’s entrance, upon seeing the two emerge, the driver standing by the black business car quickly opened the door, speaking respectfully, “Mr. Clark, Miss Wilson, please get in the car.”
“Thank you,” Glenn Clark nodded slightly and then bent over to get into the car.
As soon as the burly Glenn Clark sat down, the entire business car suddenly sank, as if not a man, but a Giant Beast had climbed aboard.
Today, Simon Imperial Capital was bustling with activity, as countless people flocked toward the stadium.
By the time Glenn Clark arrived in a designated car from behind, the massive stadium had already filled with over a hundred thousand spectators, excitedly shouting for their supported strong men.
The voices of more than a hundred thousand people roared like mountains and seas shaking, vibrating the roof of the stadium.
Meanwhile, in the audience seats below the organizers, on both sides sat hundreds of cultivators, among them were Justin Welan, Zac Maben, and others who had already been defeated by Glenn Clark.
And when Glenn Clark, accompanied by Teresa Wilson, emerged from backstage and slowly made his way to the few empty seats at the very top, all the cultivators’ expressions instantly stiffened.
One of the high-level cultivators defeated by Glenn Clark said dryly, “The monster has arrived.”
“Do you guys think Tagore and the others stand a chance?” someone asked gravely.
Their companion shook his head, “Forget it, today is less about deciding who will compete in the finals, and more about contesting for the second place in the Global Martial Arts Competition.”
“Indeed, that guy is totally like a Great Demon King, with overbearing strength, almost invincible.”
Below, those geniuses whispered among themselves and looked up at Glenn Clark with eyes filled with awe.
At Glenn Clark’s right, the space two seats over distorted, and Mathilda Ward with silver hair draped over her shoulders, and a somewhat pale Marcellus Larry appeared out of thin air.
Glenn Clark greeted politely, “Senior Marcellus, Sister Ilisa, you’ve arrived.”
Teresa Wilson appeared a bit restrained and respectful, “I’ve seen the Mythical King Marcellus, General Ward.”
A smile appeared on Mathilda Ward’s face, “Tiger, you seem even more profound in these two days, it looks like your cultivation has improved again.”
You’re truly worthy of being his brother, your talent is no less than his.”
Glenn Clark touched the back of his head, modestly saying, “Not at all, Sister Ilisa, I’m still far behind my brother. I only made a breakthrough to the late phase of the Eight Layer Heaven yesterday.”
As Jack Clark propped up the heavens, the moment his cultivation broke through to the True Spirit, Glenn Clark’s cultivation leaped directly from the mid-stage of the Seventh Layer Heaven to the mid-stage of the Eighth Layer.
Moreover, the nature of his strength throughout his body became even heavier and more terrifying, allowing him to sweep all the geniuses in Group A.
Whether they were from the Seventh Layer or the early stage geniuses of the Eight Layer Heaven, none could withstand one of his punches. His terrifying might became a shadow in many people’s hearts, like an invincible Great Demon King.
Late Eighth Layer.
Marcellus Larry, who had just come back from the Deification World to host the Global Martial Arts Competition finals, was somewhat moved, then exclaimed with amazement, “With your current rate of cultivation, Glenn, I feel that you might break your brother’s record for breaking through to a king-level.”
Glenn Clark slightly shook his head, “It’s not the same, Senior Marcellus. The reason for my fast cultivation is that I had a higher starting point, while my brother had nothing when he started.”
“So, even if I break through to king-level in less than a year, it doesn’t mean that my talent is better than my brother’s.”
After experiencing Jack Clark’s ‘fall’, the current Glenn Clark had become even more mature and steady, displaying none of the restlessness of a sixteen-year-old youth.
Of course, Mathilda Ward would later tell Glenn Clark and Doris Clark that Jack Clark was not dead, bringing the two, who were deep in sorrow and anger, a mix of shock and joy.
Afterward, Marcellus Larry continued to chat warmly with Glenn Clark for a while before turning his gaze to Mathilda Ward, a trace of curiosity in his expression.
“Ilisa, you touched the rules quite early and reached the boundary of half a step into a myth, so why haven’t you broken through by now?”
Unlike those cultivators at the Nine-fold Peak, Mathilda Ward, who had fused with a complete Dragon’s Law, was already considered half a myth.
All she needed to do next was to familiarize herself with the power, train her True Body, and she could naturally step into the Legendary Realm.
Thus, from the moment of her awakening, Mathilda Ward was treated as a quasi-Mythical King, stationed at Blue Star waiting for the moment to break through.
Faced with this question, Mathilda Ward also showed a puzzled look: “Senior Marcellus, I’m not sure what the reason is, but my current state is quite strange.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1685 - 1685 624
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1685: Chapter 624 Chapter 1685: Chapter 624 Chapter 624: Ancient Times Reappear
Within the pitch-black cosmos of the Divine Temple, Jack Clark’s true body, towering at seventy thousand meters, sat cross-legged, three faces and ten arms, like an Ancient Demon God suppressing the Heavens.
Behind him, a golden Divine Wheel with a diameter of thirty thousand meters rotated, its edges entwined with strands of gold, purple, black, and yellow light resembling flames. The radiance emanated by its rotation filled the starry sky, creating a dazzling, multicolored world.
“This, is this what it feels like to have Complete Rules?” Jack slowly opened his eyes.
His right eye flickered with a startling, golden-white lightning, exuding a force that seemed to shatter all laws, an incredibly heavy and overbearing sense of power.
His left eye, meanwhile, reflected a murky world, like the Beginning of Heaven and Earth, as if it were the dawn of creation itself, radiating an exceedingly mysterious aura.
At this moment, Jack felt an illusion of being immensely powerful, as if a mere movement could burst the entire ‘world.’
Having absorbed and refined the Primordial Creation Origin Energy, it seemed only seven days had passed, but with the distortion and acceleration of the surrounding Space-Time, Jack felt he had cultivated for almost half a year.
In the ‘half-year,’ the two Supreme Rules both evolved and deduced to grand accomplishment, the realm leaping from the early stage to the ancient late stage.
At the same time, after constant Tempering by the two Supreme Rules, the Primordial Demon God True Body gained further enhancement, rising to become incredibly formidable.
Now, with Jack merely sitting in the Void, the intangible heavy Aura he emitted twisted the surrounding starry sky, forming a Space-Time curvature vortex spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
Quietly feeling the surge of power within him, Jack’s eyes narrowed slightly.
At this point, his journey on the path of Rules had essentially come to an end.
Next would be the fusion of the true body with the Rule world, breaking through the Peak of the Ancient, shattering the fetters of Heaven and Earth to become a True Spirit Level Rule lifeform.
However, under normal conditions, this step would take a very long time.
For instance, the Divine King Tarrod, from his late period to peak, reportedly took hundreds of years, and the subsequent step to become a half-step True Spirit took even longer.
Although Jack boasted an ‘exceptional’ talent, he felt that under normal conditions, it would take over a decade to complete this step.
Especially since he possessed two Supreme Rules, requiring two fusions, the time and difficulty would increase geometrically, possibly taking decades.
Therefore, he needed to find a way to obtain more Life Crystals on this outing. Jack thoughtfully pondered.
By now, Life Crystals were still very beneficial, as burning attribute points to enter an epiphany state could accelerate Jack’s cultivation speed by a hundredfold.
Now that the Purgatory Demon Clan had been eradicated, the vast territories nearby had all fallen under the control of the Human Alliance.
With his current identity and status, a single command from him would suffice; not to mention the Divine Kings assisting, all Heavenly Kings and Main God-level beings could be mobilized.
By then, hundreds of king-level and Heavenly King Main God figures would sweep across millions of kilometers in no time, collecting a vast number of Life Crystals.
His cultivation speed would still advance at a rapid pace.
Thinking this, a slight smile appeared on Jack’s face before he turned to look at his surroundings.
In the colorful and dazzling cosmos, a Black Gold Giant Beast stood tall, emanating a peak ancient aura, its body shrouded in strong energy fluctuations, visibly growing at an observable speed.
A few days had passed, and the thirty-six crystal planets with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers had been Devoured by the Destruction Emperor Dragon. Its body length had swelled from just over twenty thousand meters to thirty-seven thousand and more.
At thirty-seven thousand meters long, it appeared to have been overtaken by Jack’s seventy thousand meter true body, looking half the size of Jack.
But between the two, one coalesced by rule power, and the other an Evolution entity fused with flesh and blood rules, held entirely different levels of contained energy and strength.
Overall, the Giant Beast Body was still more powerful.
In particular, on the attribute page, the Evolution value of the Destruction Emperor Dragon had also accumulated to two million, ready for hibernation and Evolution to breakthrough True Spirit at any moment.
Yet the Destruction Emperor Dragon felt it could still consume a bit more, devouring this enormous Divine Temple, accumulating more energy before breaking through to True Spirit.
Myth, Titan, Ancient; these are all seen as a single large stage. And breaking through to True Spirit, whether in terms of power held or life level, would reach a higher echelon.
Thus, this breakthrough of the Destruction Emperor Dragon would be quite exaggerated and would need a longer hibernation and Transformation time.
Next, just waiting for the Purple little dragon to complete the Inheritance, as well as the Silver Giant Dragon and Gold Blue Giant Dragon to emerge from the Heavenly Dragon Pool, they could devour the Divine Temple and leave.
With that thought, Jack and the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gazes involuntarily turned to the distance, landing on the Crystal Throne as massive as Jupiter.
There, the colorful pulsing light egg had reached a point of stability; the Purple little dragon was almost ready to emerge.
Hum! Suddenly, a faint light emitted from the gray mark on Jack’s arm, representing the Ancient Dueling Arena, as Space-Time around him froze, his figure beginning to sink.
But this time Jack didn’t directly descend; with a thought, the golden-white Divine Wheel behind him shone intensely, suppressing Space-Time, restraining the pulling force.
Looking at the flickering gray mark on his left arm, Jack’s gaze was cold, his Will resounding through the Void.
“Give me an undeniable reason to continue participating in life-or-death duels.”
The Ancient Dueling Arena required one to slay the opponent to leave; the loser perished, while the victor received seemingly substantial random rewards.
Once the rules of the Dueling Arena were set in motion, not even the Primordial Power could break them.
But as long as he had not entered the Dueling Ground, the Rule not yet enacted, Jack could refuse, even erase the Dueling mark from his arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1686 - 1686 624_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1686: Chapter 624_2 Chapter 1686: Chapter 624_2 Last time when Jack Clark had made his breakthrough to the peak of the Heavenly King, he had again descended onto the Ancient Dueling Arena, where he had slain a being who was also at the peak of the Heavenly King realm, marginally comparable to the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe of the ancient late stage.
But the rewards from that duel were mediocre compared to the risks he undertook.
Therefore, if the rewards from the Dueling Ground were poor this time, Jack not only intended to refuse them but also prepared to erase this somewhat burdensome mark.
It seemed as if the surroundings sensed Jack’s determination, and the distorted space-time around him slightly solidified, revealing some gray patterns.
These gray rule patterns converged before Jack into a row of twisted ancient characters, from which a surge of information instantly emanated.
“Slay the contestant and obtain a ‘Source of Creation.'”
Source of Creation. Suddenly, Jack’s gaze slightly stirred.
In the same league as the ‘Heaven and Earth Treasure’ at the Creation Level, the Source of Creation contained pure Creation Force, enough to directly enable Jack to complete a fusion with a Supreme Rule.
It was almost tantamount to directly ascending a cultivation realm.
This time, the rewards were indeed substantial, worthy of making him raise his hand to slay a supremely invincible strong man of the same realm.
Jack nodded slightly; the radiance of the golden divine wheel behind him receded, the invisible suppressive force dissipated, and instantly, the surrounding space-time distorted, and his figure plummeted.
And at the moment when space-time halted and Jack disappeared, the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which had also been frozen in “time,” slowly turned its head, its golden vertical pupils cold.
That Dueling Ground was indeed mysterious and powerful, but it posed no significant risk to Jack.
With his current strength, he could at any moment harness the power of Supreme Hell, use the coordinates to jump directly, or cross space-time to summon the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to annihilate powerful enemies.
After all, the Giant Beast was him, and he was the Giant Beast, hence, it still belonged to the power within the rules.
And so far, Jack had not encountered an opponent of the same realm who could suppress him, let alone defeat and slay him.
Boom!
With three faces and ten arms, the seventy-thousand-meter tall Jack descended from the sky, instantly shattering the earth beneath him into an explosion, as rock debris whipped up smoke and dust and hurricanes that swept in all directions.
Standing atop a meteorite crater with a thousand kilometers in diameter, Jack’s gaze was coldly indifferent toward his surroundings.
It was still the roughly stone-built Dueling Ground, the marks of the last great battle had vanished, and the devastated square seemed to rewind time and restore as before.
And this time, the space had expanded again, reaching three hundred thousand kilometers in length and breadth, large enough to accommodate several Jupiter-sized planets, immensely vast.
The expansion of the venue made the surrounding walls exceed ten thousand kilometers, with the mottled blood stains on the edge’s stone walls magnified accordingly, emitting an immensely terrifying aura.
True Spirits, and even Primordial entities!
It seemed only battles of the True Spirit level and above were qualified to leave marks in the Dueling Ground.
As Jack engaged in duels of increasingly higher levels, the Dueling Ground, like some seals being undone, revealed some parts of its true nature.
Including the thousands of varied, towering, and massive stone statues standing in the audience seats, their aura more obscure, some of them even making Jack sense intense danger.
Jack narrowed his eyes. Those statues, “hadn’t died.”
Boom!
Tens of thousands of kilometers away, the Void trembled, forming a huge silver vortex. Invisible transparent ripples enveloped tens of thousands of kilometers, distorting space-time.
In the center of the vortex, a thousand-meter tall silhouette, humanoid in shape with two pairs of narrow white pupils, resembling a figure cast from obsidian, appeared.
Behind this formidable being from different races, a pair of slash blades over a thousand meters long emitted a pitch-black radiance, invisibly releasing an extremely sharp edge.
The instant this being from a different race of the ancient late stage appeared, the entire “world” was suppressed by an invisible aura.
At this moment, it seemed the entire world only consisted of that supremely noble figure, towering above millions of beings and God Demons, its existence the center of the world.
Jack slowly spoke, his voice imbued with Divine Soul Intent, resonating through Heaven and Earth, “Primordial, bloodline.”
That noble figure from the obsidian different races revealed a proud look in its two pairs of eyes, emitting a sound like the clashing of stones, “So you know of the Primordial Bloodline, it seems you are not without significant background.”
“Good, the stronger the opponent, the greater the sense of achievement after I slay them,” said this being from the different races with Primordial Bloodline, its tone haughty as it slightly tilted its head.
“Unknown being from different races, state your name, this Lord does not slay the nameless under his blade.”
Jack’s expression remained calm, he lightly said, “Before that, shouldn’t you introduce yourself first, or do you mean to say that the so-called Primordial Bloodline, is just a group of uncivilized savages without any cultural depth?”
“Seeking death.”
Jack’s attitude made that scion of the Primordial chill, its eyes revealing a horrifying intent to kill, followed by a cold smile, “Telling you is no matter, after all, soon this Lord will chop off your head.”
“Remember this, vile different races, I am from the You Tian War God Clan, Lord of the Fifth Heavenly Domain under Voyislav Erasti, an ancient Lord.”
These powerful races had a strong sense of pride in their heritage, and Jack’s casual provocation had caused this being to reveal its kin and ‘true name.’
But due to Jack’s limited understanding of the mythical world, he had no recognition of this You Tian War God Clan, naturally unaware of the opponent’s strengths.
However, since the other party had introduced itself, Jack naturally would not lose his status, slowly opening his mouth.
“Human Race, Lord of the Solar Divine Domain, Darren Callum.”
But no sooner had Jack finished speaking than the figure cast from obsidian like Voyislav abruptly halted, his eyes turning incredibly sharp, “Human Race, Darren Callum.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1687 - 1687 624_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1687: Chapter 624_3 Chapter 1687: Chapter 624_3 “Ancient Dueling Arena, yes, it’s you.”
“You, have you heard of me?” Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly.
Voyislav did not reply, his narrow eyes revealing an even greater murderous intent, “I didn’t expect my luck as a Lord to be this good, actually encountering you in the dueling arena.”
“Ancient late-stage cultivation, it looks like when you were slaying Nashigyas of the Golden Eternal Clan, you must have been in the past, or rather I must have existed in some future time period.”
“No wonder, there’s no information about you found in the Human Six Domains, you seemed not to exist in any time period.”
The Ancient Dueling Arena was incredibly mysterious, existing outside of the river of time, hence every dueler pulled into it could not be sure of the period they were in.
Thus, the Lord of the You Tian War God Clan was mistaken.
After all, it had been less than half a Sun Wheel, less than a day, since the name Darren Callum started to spread within a small range amongst the peak races.
In such a short time, it was impossible to think that one could advance from the peak of the eleventh stage Titan to the twelfth stage of ancient late period.
Looking at the somewhat agitated Voyislav, Jack acting as though he was reporting his ‘true name,’ contemplated thoughtfully.
Indeed, these civilizations of peak races involved with primordial power knew about the ‘Human Race,’ it seemed the ancient human race, lost for who knows how many tens of thousands of years, had become even stronger.
But before Jack could continue to fish for words, an incredibly evil and gloomy aura burst forth from Voyislav.
Boom!
Under the terrifying aura, the entire dueling ground shook, and the earth tore open with huge cracks, from deep within the cracks a gloomy blue radiance erupted, like fierce scars.
In the dazzling gloomy blue radiance, Voyislav’s true body swelled to a hundred thousand meters, with two heads and four arms, and two spiral horns growing on his head, looking rugged and fierce.
On the true body, forged of black crystals, numerous mysterious gloomy blue rule patterns were inscribed, shimmering with light, emanating a powerful pressure comparable to a true spirit.
Such was the monstrous strength of a peak race potent with Primordial Bloodline.
Late-stage ancient strength was comparable to ordinary true spirits, not inferior to great demons like Tyris who were a half-step true spirit, but with a potential that surpassed them.
Yet here it still hadn’t ended, within Voyislav’s hands a drop of pure black blood with a hundred-meter diameter appeared, suddenly squeezed to burst.
Boom! The moment it was burst, the drop of blood released endless black mists.
These black mists resembled the Abyssal Demonic Aura from Purgatory ancestors to a degree, yet were even stronger, filled with an incredibly dark, deep, terrifying attribute.
Rolling black mists merged into Voyislav’s true body, instantly causing his aura to explode again.
All of this happened in an instant.
Standing amidst the boundless dark mist, Voyislav, whose aura was even stronger than an average true spirit, suddenly moved, his hands wielding two sharp, elongated slash blades flashing brilliantly.
“Human, Darren Callum, today is your day of death.”
Boom boom!!
Two slash blades extending hundreds of thousands of meters crossed each other in a ‘X’ pattern, ripping apart the firmament, the invisible power emanating shook the entire dueling ground violently.
Beneath the slash blades, the whole world was split into four, appearing instantly before Jack Clark with a terrifying speed that surpassed time.
Boom boom boom!! The cross-shaped slash blades, just approaching within ten thousand kilometers of Jack, were blocked by an invisible force, clashing and emitting a brilliant golden rhombus halo.
Centered on Jack, the golden rhombus haze permeated ten thousand kilometers, resembling a circular golden light sphere.
Two slash blades of unmatched power, capable of splitting Saturn itself, shone brightly but could not stir the golden circle by a fraction, emanating an unshakeable resolve.
As Jack’s cultivation reached the ancient late stage, his true body became even stronger, and the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane also expanded to a hundred thousand kilometers during the full accomplishment of the Supreme Power Rules, becoming even more boundless.
Under these circumstances, merging with the World’s Power of the Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder Plane, forming an Absolute Force Field with Jack’s true body life field as the center, the defense had also become incredibly potent.
So potent that it outright disregarded this descendant of the Primordial Bloodline’s full-force strikes.
Such was the intimidating nature of being hexagonal, that all-encompassing strength capable of driving opponents to despair.
“Impossible!!”
Looking at the human, standing unyielding at the center of the Absolute Force Field, Voyislav’s eyes revealed shock, followed by an unbelievable rage.
Voyislav, wielding four blades, swept across the sky with gloomy blue Divine Light and black Demonic Qi, instantly slashing tens of thousands of times, carrying force enough to pulverize this space-time.
Boom boom boom!!
The sky-filling blade light annihilated everything, instantly engulfing Jack, the golden rhombus ripples exploding in all directions emitted a brilliance akin to a star.
The leftover power and sharpness destroyed the land within a range of hundreds of thousands of kilometers, forming bottomless black abysses.
The incorporated rule powers continued unabated, creating tangible shockwaves like tsunamis, sweeping across the entire dueling arena, harshly colliding with mountain walls in all directions.
Instantly, the entire dueling arena crazily shook, the mountain walls standing ten thousand kilometers high crumbled, countless boulders thundering down, resembling doomsday.
Within the center of this world-annihilating ferocious wave, enshrouded in golden radiance, the Absolute Force Field enveloped all sides, unchallengeable.
At the center of the Absolute Force Field, a seventy-thousand-meter-high Demon God stood upon the void, his gaze coldly watching Voyislav from a distance of ten thousand kilometers, with four arms wielding blades, surrounded by endless gloomy blue Radiance.
On this descendant of the Primordial Bloodline’s face, shock and rage were abundant.
He, a powerhouse of a peak civilization, bestowed with the title of Ancient Overlord by the Lord of the Heavenly Domain, an Unparalleled Genius]])

chapters.title: Chapter 1688 - 1688 624_4
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1688: Chapter 624_4 Chapter 1688: Chapter 624_4 The opponent didn’t even lift a hand, simply standing there quietly, looking down at it with a gaze full of insult.
Unforgivable.
But at this moment, Voyislav’s expression turned cold, and he slowly spoke, “Human, is this your strength? Indeed, it’s powerful, almost invincible among peers in terms of defense talent.”
“But soon, it will be mine.”
Buzz! A rune that looked both like and unlike an eye, shimmering with a gloomy blue light, appeared between Voyislav’s eyebrows.
An aura of the Primordial that transcended rules and reached infinity emanated from Voyislav, and the rune inscriptions all over his body shone brightly, undergoing transformation.
Boom!
Amidst the violent flux of Chaos, two golden diamond-shaped radiance collided and compressed, like two vast worlds erupting with a roar that shook the world.
In the center of the two golden diamond-shaped circles stood Jack Clark and Voyislav respectively.
Even Jack couldn’t help but pause for an instant, then he spoke in a deep voice, “Duplicate Divine Power, so this is your Primordial bloodline talent?”
“Exactly, this is one of the talents of my Nether Heaven War God Clan’s bloodline, Duplicate. Any Divine Power I witness can be replicated with the Primordial Force.”
At this time, an utterly calm expression adorned Voyislav’s face, showing not the slightest hint of madness or impulsiveness.
Clearly, the ‘full strength’ attack he had just launched was all to make Jack display his formidable strength, to facilitate its replication.
Jack nodded indifferently, “This ability is strong, but no matter how powerful, it depends on who uses it.”
Boom!
Behind Jack, the Divine Wheel shone intensely, and a power that terrified Voyislav exploded, making the entire Dueling Ground tremble, even the statues in the audience seats were shaking.
Amidst a sky filled with golden-white Radiance, a black-gold battle halberd, dazzling with light, pierced through space-time and appeared above Voyislav’s head, collapsing the Firmament and destroying all in its path.
Including the Absolute Defense Divine Power that Voyislav had just replicated, which also burst apart with a crash.
Before the invisible embodiment of absolute strength even fell, Voyislav’s figure plummeted with a crash, his complexion drastically changed, revealing horror and disbelief.
“How is this possible!”
Boom!
The cosmos turned on its head, and an explosion ripped through everything; in an instant, a black hole tens of thousands of kilometers wide, representing absolute Vacuum, appeared at the center of the Dueling Ground.
And there, standing atop the black hole like a Supreme Demon God descending from the past, a figure with a Terrifying Aura that suppressed all heavens circled around, shrouding the sun.
As the Supreme Power Rules achieved grand accomplishment, Jack’s control over strength reached an exceedingly high realm of divine insight, where every gesture contained the power to shatter everything.
There were no extra waves of power spilling out, only an incredibly concentrated Overbearing force.
Tens of thousands of kilometers away, a gravely weakened Voyislav, his true body covered in cracks, stood and gazed at that ten-armed figure whose Divine Might dominated the sky, his face incredibly ugly.
“The same absolute defense, why can you break it!?”
