If he had not fused into the Void using the rules of obscurity and escaped at the very moment the halberd descended, he would undoubtedly have been blasted into oblivion by that halberd strike.
This was somewhat hard for Voyislav to accept.
“I’ve said before, the strength of the same Divine Power ultimately depends on the person using it,” Jack said as the Radiance of his War Halberd intensified, and the entire world shook again.
“Don’t think you’re the only one with great power.”
Voyislav roared, his body shining with a gloomy blue Radiance, turning the entire Dueling Ground into a sea of blue.
Boom boom!! Two black Blade Lights, their might increased tenfold, crossed each other, cutting through the world and containing an Overbearing force that looked down upon the Eight Wastes, unstoppable by anyone.
Indeed, it was Jack’s strength Divine Power, Vacuum Destruction.
But to no avail!
Boom!
Beneath the golden-white Eight Desolate War Halberd, the entire sky burst apart, including the Absolute Force Field that Voyislav had just consolidated around him.
As the Blade Light extinguished, a diamond-shaped golden radiance circle with the diameter of ten thousand kilometers exploded like a bursting star, followed by Voyislav’s roaring figure crossed by dual blades.
Bang!
The irresistible force cracked the black slash blades, and all four arms, like black Crystal muscles, burst in explosions, plummeting Voyislav’s figure.
As his form collapsed into the Void, his True Body emerged with countless cracks under that Overbearing and supreme force, and he stumbled, kneeling before Jack.
This was Jack’s strength at this time, absolutely invincible among peers, even if the opponent was a descendant of the Primordial.
“To have the majestic Nether Heaven War God Clan kneel before me, Human Race, you deserve to die,” Voyislav raged, filled with fury and terror.
[Ten more paragraphs of meticulous revision, brothers wait an hour and refresh.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1689 - 1689 625 Before Leaving Sherry Williams
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1689: Chapter 625: Before Leaving, Sherry Williams Arrives Chapter 1689: Chapter 625: Before Leaving, Sherry Williams Arrives The fall of a “person” with the Primordial Bloodline enables the source of that bloodline to sense something in the obscure, even stretching the power to perceive parts of the scene, or the strongest obsession at the time.
Thus, the news of Jack Clark slaying the strong man of the You Tian War God Clan, Voyislav, bearing the title of Ancient Overlord, couldn’t be concealed.
However, since the fall was “too fast,” Voyislav’s final obsession only contained the information: Human Race, Darren Callum.
Therefore, aside from causing some stir on that side, there wasn’t much of a reaction, after all, it was just a prodigy of the Ancient Realm, deserving attention, but only just that.
And all these were currently too distant and likewise had no impact on Jack Clark.
In nearly the blink of an eye, Jack Clark returned from the Ancient Dueling Arena to the Primordial Divine Temple, where the flow of time around him resumed as if nothing had happened.
Jack Clark squinted, noticing this point.
This Primordial Beast had perished, but the residual strength still enveloped the temple, wandering deep within this span of Space-Time, imperceptible to even peers unless deliberately sought.
And the power from the Ancient Dueling Ground could extend here because of the mark.
However, Jack Clark did not erase the mark of the Dueling Ground.
Although that place was peculiar, it posed no significant danger to him at present, and the benefits outweighed the risks, especially now that he had the right to choose a “reward.”
Just as Jack Clark was about to use the Creation Force to merge with the Supreme Rule, the distant starscape trembled violently.
On a crystal ‘throne’ with a diameter of over a hundred thousand kilometers, a seven-colored light egg exploded, and a Purple Divine Dragon Shadow, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers, soared into the sky, dissipating into a sky full of light spots.
Roar! A lofty and excited Dragon Roar echoed throughout the Void.
Amidst the seven-colored light rain, a Purple little dragon, its size having ballooned to over four thousand meters, appeared with an Aura of a mid-period Titan, emanating ‘powerful’ vibes.
Not only did its Growth Level break through from the Mythical Peak to Titan, but the bloodline of the Purple Divine Dragon also underwent a Transformation.
Being born with a Monarch bloodline and Innate Divine Holy, the little dragon, during this period, as it absorbed the life Aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and Devoured resources such as the Chaos Crystal Core, also benefited from a certain upgrade in its bloodline.
This time, having inherited the fragmented Dragon Ball of the Primordial Beast and under the sway of the encapsulated Primordial Power, the bloodline of the purple little dragon had purified to the high-order Emperor.
One step further, and it would reach the Pseudo-heavenly tier once held by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Of course, under normal conditions, not to mention the purple little dragon, many Primordial Beasts could not reach it.
And the bloodline upgrade slightly altered the appearance of the purple little dragon, such as the gold color now edged the crystal-like purple scales covering its body.
Simultaneously, gold threads also intermingled with the elegantly flowing purple Dragon’s Mane on its head, giving off a more dignified, self-rising effect without wind.
The originally single-pronged Purple Crystal dragon horns on its head now sprouted two new prongs, becoming longer and more elegant, and its underbelly and four claws grew stronger.
Watching this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark simultaneously got the impression that the purple little dragon had suddenly grown from a three-year-old child to a ten-year-old student.
This brought them great comfort.
Starlit purple radiance flickered; in just a few breaths, the purple little dragon traversed tens of thousands of kilometers to appear before the Destruction Emperor Dragon, with a voice still holding a trace of juvenile naivety.
Yiya yiya!! “Brother, Miss Joseline has become awesome now, I can help you fight from now on, anyone who dares to mess with brother will be killed by Miss Joseline.”
“I’ll slay them until blood flows like a river, tearing them all to shreds.”
Looking at the excited purple Divine Dragon waving its small claws and acting like a junior gangster, the much larger and fiercer Gold Blue Giant Dragon could not help but twitch at the corner of its mouth.
Because during this time, it had been either fighting or on the path of Evolution through combat and had completely forgotten the importance of providing ideological education to the purple little dragon.
After all, how could a little girl think about fighting all day long and want to cause a river of blood, that’s just too cruel.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, with a deep and resonant voice declared, “We’ll talk about fighting some other time, it’s about time for us to head back out.” Saying this, the Destruction Emperor Dragon glanced into the distance.
There, a thousand-kilometer wide pool floated, with two enormous Silver Giant Dragon and Gold Blue Giant Dragon coiled peacefully, sleeping and undergoing transformation.
Under the Influence of the Primordial Power resonating in the Heavenly Dragon Pool, both dragons’ bloodlines also finally reached a tipping point.
Following the Destruction Emperor Dragon for this time, not only had their strength improved astonishingly quickly, but their bloodlines had also undergone several purifications and upgrades.
When they made the breakthrough to Titan, the bloodline of the Silver Giant Dragon had already reached high-order Monarch, and they awakened two Top-Tier Talents, just one step away from Monarch.
But evolving from Monarch to Emperor wasn’t that simple.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon still felt a great gap between their bloodlines and that of a Monarch.
This gap was the process of going from two top-tier talents to four top-tier talents.
Without external assistance, relying solely on the power of the Dragon Pond, the two Giant Dragons could at best upgrade one talent to the Top Tier, so…
Boom! Above the heads of the two Giant Dragons, the Void collapsed, and two gigantic Dragon Claws enwrapped in gold-red lightning emerged, shadowing the sky.
Crackle Crackle! Under the overwhelming Supreme Rule that suppressed the starscape, the space around the Silver Giant Dragon and Gold Blue Giant Dragon within thousands of kilometers stiffened and compressed.
In just the blink of an eye, two crystal-like ‘Amber’ with a diameter of a kilometer, almost resembling a small world, appeared in the Void.
Watching this, the purple little dragon became somewhat puzzled: Yi yi ya ya!! “Brother, why did you Seal Scythia and the others?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1690 - 1690 625 Before Leaving Sherry Williams
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1690: Chapter 625: Before Leaving, Sherry Williams Arrives_2 Chapter 1690: Chapter 625: Before Leaving, Sherry Williams Arrives_2 “This Dragon Pond Transformation presents an opportunity for them.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “If combined with the god-given power of my bloodline for Evolution, their bloodlines might possibly break through to Emperor level, of course, there is only a certain chance.”
“So some preparations are still necessary, such as placing them beside me when I enter hibernation for the True Spirit breakthrough.”
This time going out, the Destruction Emperor Dragon is about to enter hibernation for its True Spirit breakthrough.
At that time, under the driving force of its breakthrough power and the further awakening of the Heavenly Tier bloodline aura, the two Giant Dragons could almost certainly awaken the Emperor bloodline.
Ee ya ee ya!! Big brother, you are too kind to Scythia and them.
Even the Purple little dragon couldn’t help but feel a bit envious at this moment.
It was not envious of the bloodline of the two Giant Dragons about to be promoted to Emperor, but of the Destruction Emperor Dragon being ‘too good’ to them, considering all aspects so thoroughly.
“It’s different.” A faint voice sounded in the Void.
With long hair cascading over his shoulders, Jack Clark appeared above the Purple little dragon’s head, touching its rugged, mountain-peak-like crystal dragon horns, “This time breaking through to True Spirit, I plan to enter beyond the heavens in advance.”
“At that time, probably only you, Miss Joseline, can accompany me up, so this side of the Beast Empire needs to have someone ‘in charge’.”
After Jack finished speaking, the huge form of the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, “Compared to Disaster Tyria and them, Scythia and the others have ‘deeper emotions’ for the Dragon Palace and Domination.”
“Thus, even if we leave, there won’t be worries about their safety in the Chaotic Turbulent Region.”
Because of the rapid increase in strength, creatures such as the Single-horned Spawn Roc and Deep Sea Dragon Turtle that followed the Destruction Emperor Dragon in the Blue Star Ocean can no longer keep up with the pace.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon that had always been with them was completely left behind.
Therefore, before leaving, the Destruction Emperor Dragon needs to make some preparations to ensure the safety of these Blue Star Giant Beasts after its departure.
After all, the current stability of the Dragon Palace Empire was due to its suppression; once it leaves, Late Ancient and Middle Ancient Lava Giant Dragons, Black Kirins, and other Giant Beasts naturally would not submit to the Silver Giant Dragon.
Then, even if the Dragon Palace doesn’t fall apart completely, it might operate independently.
The parents of the Silver Giant Dragon are Ancient Dragon Kings, so their safety is not an issue, but those like the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle at the Legendary Realm have some trouble.
After all, among the Giant Beasts, they completely believe in the law of the jungle.
Jack patted the dragon horns of the Purple little dragon, “Let’s go Miss Joseline, we should head out now.”
Ee ya ee ya!! Okay, big brother.
The Purple little dragon obediently nodded and then let out a long Dragon Roar, its massive body turning into a purple light flying outward, finally charging out the main gate.
Since its identity had already been guessed by the Purple little dragon, Jack did not hide the secret of being two-in-one in front of it.
Boom!
Just as Jack and the Purple little dragon flew out of the Primordial Divine Temple, a raging Time Storm roared towards them, instantly colliding with the Absolute Force Field that surrounded ten thousand kilometers, emitting a roaring sound like mountains and seas shaking.
Meanwhile, behind them, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly turned its head, looking at the massive divine temple floating deep in time, suddenly opening its ferocious huge mouth.
Boom!
A vast dark golden Black Hole appeared above the temple, like a celestial dog swallowing the moon, slowly covering the million-kilometer-large temple.
The ‘material’ the temple was constructed from, and the energy contained within, were ‘great supplements’ for the Destruction Emperor Dragon, naturally, it wouldn’t let them go.
Just as it was about to Devour, the temple suddenly shook, the splendid carvings and rule runes on its surface emitting brilliant light, along with world-shaking terrifying power.
Boom boom boom!!
The Final Darkness Devouring swallowed the sky and ground; under the temple’s resistance that already developed a bit of ‘instinct’, it forcibly engulfed it, the released power shaking this part of space-time.
And just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was passing by, taking everything in its path.
The entrance to the two-hundred-million-kilometer-wide forbidden area battlefield, with thousands of meters of constructions on the Immortal Spirit Clan city in the mountains being built, endless Black Flames appeared.
Boom! The terrifying oppressive force of a True Spirit Level existence erupted, filling Heaven and Earth, pressing down tens of thousands of Immortal Spirit Alien Race figures below, all kneeling on the ground.
Including the Immortal general stationed in this newly built city, his face showing shock, disbelievingly looking at the figure standing amidst the Black Flames in the sky, emitting True Spirit pressure.
Wasn’t the great war over? Where did this unfamiliar True Spirit level Powerhouse pop up from?
Within the terrifying flames that twisted the rules, Sherry Williams looked down at those below her resembling humans with silver feathered wings for ears, sweeping over their bodies.
These, are they the ‘Humans’ newly born in the clan’s territory?
Sherry Williams revealed a hint of doubt in her eyes.
Crossing over billions of kilometers, including the territories of the blasted Purgatory Demon Clan,
Sherry Williams arrived at the coordinates given by the Void True Emperor, which is here.
However, looking at the Immortal Spirit Alien Race below, her eyes revealed hesitation.
Because these people seemed to be very different from the ancient humans, not just with ears resembling silver feathered wings, but also their body structure and the life aura they emitted.
If tens of thousands of years later the newly emerged civilization from the clan’s territory looks like this,
then Jack Clark… who has the same life form as hers might not be here.
Before Sherry Williams could speak, two ancient auras suddenly burst tens of thousands of kilometers away.
A boundless green glow filled the sky, transforming into a giant green lotus, followed by the appearance of the figures of Wind Heaven Immortal Spirit King and Sean Immortal Spirit King.
Seeing the vague figures standing amid the Black Sea of flames, twisting space-time, both the Immortal Spirit Kings’ expressions became extremely solemn and respectful.
“Immortal Spirit Clan Wind Heaven, Sean, have met the unfamiliar True Spirit Emperor Monarch.”
“Immortal Spirit Clan.”
Sherry Williams slowly opened her mouth: “Are you the cultivation civilization that has grown up again after tens of thousands of years in the clan’s territory?”
Clan’s territory!?
Wind Heaven Immortal Spirit King and Sean Immortal Spirit King exchanged glances, both revealing puzzled looks.
Because they were shrouded in the flames of True Spirit, the two Immortal Spirit Kings couldn’t see Sherry Williams’ appearance clearly, which made them a bit confused by this question.
After a slight hesitation, Wind Heaven Immortal Spirit King respectfully said, “My lord, our Immortal Spirit Clan’s homeland has been destroyed, and we have just moved to this place. Is there some misunderstanding?”
“You, aren’t the new generation of humans?” Sherry Williams paused.
“Human.”
Both Immortal Spirit Kings paused, and then Sean Immortal Spirit King somewhat shockingly said, “My lord, are you a strong man of the Human Race?”
Boom!
Endless Black Flames erupted, engulfing the entire sky and covering tens of thousands of kilometers; the sea of flames split apart, revealing the figure of Sherry Williams.
Sherry Williams, dressed in a purple gown, her black hair dancing in the flames, looked at the two Immortal Spirit Kings with eyes revealing a Black Great Sun burning Heaven and Earth, containing terrifying might.
“The humans here, where are they?”
Feeling the terrifying might from Sherry Williams that far surpassed an ordinary True Spirit, Wind Heaven Immortal Spirit King’s eyes showed a hint of alarm, but he then took a deep breath.
Boom!
The Wind Heaven Immortal Spirit King had layer upon layer of green petals unfurling, creating a rule rune that enveloped the sky, blocking the almost crushing Heavenly and Earthly True Spirit might.
Wind Heaven Immortal Spirit King showed caution in his eyes and slowly said, “My lord, before answering your question, could you tell us your relationship with the Human Race?”
“Indeed, otherwise we refuse to answer this question,” Sean Immortal Spirit King also revealed a Glazed Pagoda in his hand, his aura connecting with Wind Heaven Immortal Spirit King, taking a stance of opposition.
At the same time, another hand crushed a piece of divine jade, sending the news of the appearance of the unfamiliar True Spirit Powerhouse over a million kilometers away.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Around the Golden Divine Tree extending over tens of thousands of kilometers, ancient auras burst forth, tearing apart space, bringing immense pressure to the forbidden area’s battlefield entrance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1691 - 1691 626 A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1691: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs Chapter 1691: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs Human Race’s Six Great Divine Domains, Imperial Dynasty, Vice Hall Master of the Heaven Observation Hall.
Indeed, a Human Expert!
The moment Sherry Williams spoke, Wind Heavenly King and Sean felt relieved, betting it was one of theirs.
In fact, even without Jack Clark and the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Human Alliance combined with the remaining Ancient Beasts could still withstand an existence at the True Spirit Initial Stage.
Half-step True Spirit Divine King Tarrod, Peak of the Ancient Wind Heaven, Adam Garcetti who broke through the ancient late stage after Void transformation possessing peak combat power, Nine-heads Lava Giant Dragon.
If these peak powerhouses were to unite and desperately burn their Origin, along with the other dozen or so Ancient Powerhouses, even an ordinary True Spirit could be held back.
Just like when Tyris allied with the lords of two empires and four Demon Gods, resisting the Divine King of Light who temporarily stepped into True Spirit.
Of course, the premise is that Sherry Williams’s strength is only an ‘ordinary’ initial-stage True Spirit.
If she has a Creation Divine Weapon in her hands, or possesses crossover combat power of a mid-stage True Spirit, then Wind Heaven and others can only await death.
Wind Heavenly King showed a smile on his face, and with a thought, slowly retracted the overarching green Lotus Stand, and his tone returned to being polite.
“So it’s another strong man from our Human Race, let me reintroduce, we are Ancient Alliance Council Members, Immortal Spirit Wind Heaven, Sean, pleased to meet you, Vice Hall Master.”
“The Human Race you asked about is one of our four clans in the Ancient Alliance, stationed a million kilometers away in the rear.”
The Purgatory Demon Race was annihilated, but the Four-Clans Alliance did not enter the region that was broken apart, they simply divided the forbidden area battlefield into three parts.
Among them, the Human Race occupies tens of thousands of kilometers near the Sky Curtain Battlefield, followed by the Heavenly Feather Clan and Immortal Spirit Clan dividing the remaining area.
Having gone through hundreds of years of the Civilization War, the clan land was annihilated, with populations of the two clans being as many as tens of millions and as few as a few million elites, occupying large territories but unable to develop construction.
Besides, being too far apart, it was not conducive for them to mix with the Human Race, including developing planets in the Solar System World.
As for the Divine Gods Alliance, while the total number of people is higher, reaching tens of millions, there are still only a few million soldiers above the Sixth-level Heaven, and the territories they occupy are already vast enough.
Before Sherry Williams, who was smiling, could speak, a series of loud roars shook the Void. The sky was engulfed by boundless flames, black storms, and twisting light of time.
Under the complete release of Sherry Williams’ True Spirit might, the first to arrive were the Giant Beast powers from tens of thousands of kilometers away.
Seven Ancient Dragon Kings, including the enormous figure of King of Blade Edge, the greatest War General, appeared, with their massive rule auras interweaving in Heaven and Earth, forming rolling airwaves that ignited the atmosphere.
From tens of thousands of kilometers away, the strongest aura, the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon roared: “Roar! That side’s King of Immortal Spirit, are your rules warning, is this True Spirit attacking the Human Alliance?”
Although everyone had an average relationship, especially since there was almost a conflict that nearly broke out before, when a formidable enemy appeared, these Giant Beasts still ran very fast.
Wind Heavenly King repeatedly waved his hands: “Thanks to all Dragon Kings for the support, but this Lord is not an enemy, it’s a misunderstanding, all a misunderstanding.”
“It turns out to be a misunderstanding.” Those Ancient Dragon Kings immediately showed a faint regret on their faces.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon had once promised that if this expedition could slay a Demon God, or perform outstandingly in the great battle, he would personally help them strengthen their bloodlines once.
But earlier, when the Destruction Emperor Dragon blocked the Purgatory ancestors, Jack Clark’s combat power was too strong, nearly dominating the battlefield, and all the Demon Gods under his halberd were hardly opponents.
Therefore, in the earlier Civilization Great War, only the Lava Giant Dragon and Blue-White Giant Dragon, with the help of the Time Dragon, respectively, slew one Ancient Middle Stage and one Ancient Early Stage Demon God.
As for the other Ancient Dragon Kings, their gains were not significant, bursting over a dozen Great Demon Kings and some demon kings, this count of heads was not enough for bloodline Evolution.
Sensing the regret in these Ancient Beasts, Sherry Williams’s eyes slightly squinted, revealing a faint chill: “You all, seem quite eager to contest with this Hall Master?”
Since her breakthrough to True Spirit, it had been many years since any life below True Spirit dared to show disrespect in front of her.
Unexpectedly this time stepping out, without even entering the Human Race’s territory, the ancestors she encountered from different races and these Ancient Beasts actually all bared their teeth at her.
These guys, have they never witnessed The Majesty of the Emperor.
Boom!
Endless Black Flames erupted from Sherry Williams, instantly enveloping tens of thousands of kilometers, casting the light that turned Heaven and Earth into darkness like ink.
Under the intense heat filled with the intent of destruction, the Heavenly Earth Law disintegrated, space dissolved, forming layers of black destructive Tsunami sweeping across Heaven and Earth, engulfing all humans and Giant Beasts.
Instantly seven Ancient Beasts roared, including the two Kings of Immortal Spirit whose faces showed shock, their body rule glows bursting.
Boom boom boom!!
Under the terrifying power, both Kings of Immortal Spirit and the seven Ancient Beasts surrounded by shaken, shattered rule worlds, giant bodies transformed into streams of light piercing through Heaven and Earth.
Instantly Heaven and Earth split apart, nine giant mushroom clouds rose from the ground, Earth shattered, countless mountains and plains soared skyward, creating rolling smoke and hurricanes.
Above the Firmament, Sherry Williams stood with her feet on the Void, her black hair behind her dancing wildly, emitting tremendous Divine Might.
Behind her a thousand-kilometer-tall figure, dressed in ornate divine robes, Black Flames shadow slowly retracted its palm, merging back into the widespread sea of flames.
And under the black flames that obscured the Firmament, around the Blue-White Giant Dragon, frost storms circled, and in front of it floated a Black Gold scale, over seven hundred meters in size and more than thirty meters thick.

chapters.title: Chapter 1692 - 1692 626 A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1692: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs_2 Chapter 1692: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs_2 The scales were inscribed with many mysterious black and golden patterns, with fine gold-red lightning jumping, forming a delicate electric net.
All invisible high temperatures that approached the gold-red electric net, Black Flames all shattered and annihilated.
“This, is this the confidence you dare to challenge the Lord of the Palace with?” Sherry Williams’s gaze was icy, with a touch of solemnity passing by as she looked at the Black Gold scales on the blue-white body.
On those scales, she actually felt a dangerous aura.
The Blue-White Giant Dragon growled slowly: “This ‘Lord of the Palace,’ our empire has no intention of offending you; please forgive the Hell Dragon King’s offensive tone.”
“If the Lord of the Palace is still unsatisfied, you may wait for the return of the Imperial Dragon King of our Dragon King Hall to have an equal conversation with you.”
Because of the reliance on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Blue-White Giant Dragon remained neither humble nor arrogant in the face of this very strong True Spirit being, but at the same time, its attitude was very low, daring not to provoke too much.
As for the Black Gold scales in its hand, they were specifically given by the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Inside, it contained a part of the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Rule Origin, strong enough to block several powerful attacks from a mid-stage True Spirit.
For this Giant Beast, who had provided a lot of help and resources upon its entry into the mythical world, the Destruction Emperor Dragon naturally wanted to return the favor after its growth.
It’s just that when the Destruction Emperor Dragon earlier gave the Rule scales to the Blue-White Giant Dragon, the Time Dragon beside it looked a bit puzzled, leaving the Destruction Emperor Dragon somewhat baffled.
Within the Black Flames, Sherry Williams’s gaze was icy as she said indifferently: “The owner of the scales in your hand is strong, but not enough to deter the Lord of the Palace.”
“However, I have already taken action just now to teach them a lesson; let’s not dwell on this matter for the moment. If there is any offense next time, do not blame the Lord of the Palace for being impolite.”
The beast that left the scales is very strong, but it is only at the True Spirit Level.
For Sherry Williams, who is also a True Spirit Level strong man and a high-level official of the Human Race’s Divine Realm empire, it is not enough to make her wary and frightened.
Especially since standing behind her is a Primordial True Emperor.
Back when she first made a breakthrough to True Spirit and delved into the Vast World seeking news of her fellow Human Race, she dared to strike against a Late Stage Purgatory True Demon.
Eventually, she even Summoned a True Emperor’s power to come down and heavily injure that Purgatory True Demon.
Although she also suffered heavy injuries and took many years to recover somewhat, leaving the forbidden area where she healed to return to the Divine Realm, it was enough to illustrate her character.
After Jack Clark left, Sherry Williams followed Sherry Williams and companions from the Lost World into the Vast World, embarking on an expedition in search of Ancient Civilization.
Along the way, they experienced countless life-and-death battles.
Joining the Flame Wheel Dynasty later and being taken under the wing of a True Emperor, she fought even more battles, so her personality has become even more overbearing and strong-willed, no longer the ‘little girl’ who once followed behind Jack Clark.
Watching the figure standing in the flames above the Firmament, the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s eyes showed solemnity.
It could feel that the strong confidence radiating from this unknown True Spirit being was not just from her own strength, but also from the even stronger force behind her.
At this time, the rear of the battlefield in the forbidden area shook, and a series of figures emitting strong auras plunged into the Heaven and Earth enveloped in Black Flames.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Adam Garcetti and others spread the power of rules all around, forming domains covering tens of thousands of kilometers, colliding with the apocalyptic high temperatures of the Black Flames filling between Heaven and Earth.
Quickly, with Adam Garcetti and Tarrod at the lead, nine Ancient Powerhouses arrived, appearing at the sides of the Blue-White Giant Dragon.
Looking at the terrifying figure enveloped by Black Flames tens of thousands of kilometers away, Adam Garcetti and others all became very solemn, not knowing where this True Spirit being had come from.
“Misunderstanding, Speaker Adam Garcetti, don’t act rashly.” Just as the solemn Adam Garcetti was about to speak, an urgent voice from the Wind Heavenly King came from below.
Then, the smoke and dust obscuring the Earth dispersed, forming a Hollow; blue Immortal Light pierced through Heaven and Earth.
The moment it appeared, the Wind Heavenly King quickly introduced: “Speaker Adam Garcetti, this Lord of the Palace is one of your Human Experts, claiming to be from the Flame Wheel Divine Domain.”
“It was all a misunderstanding just now; we can talk this out.”
The Wind Heavenly King was somewhat afraid; not only was this Human Race True Spirit overbearing and powerful, but the Giant Beast allies also looked down on everyone, almost causing an incident.
They were clearly more dominant figures from the Human Race seeking kin, but you don’t want to end up turning friends into foes, which would be really troublesome.
Now, the Immortal Spirit Clan just wants to rest and recuperate, and the Wind Heavenly King is also preparing to practice quietly in pursuit of True Spirit early, not wanting any more complications.
The Wind Heavenly King had just finished speaking when Adam Garcetti, the Primordial True Emperor, the Sky-based God King, and the True Martial King all looked slightly stunned, and then disbelief appeared on their faces.
“Flame Wheel Divine Domain, you come from Ancient Civilization!?”
“You actually know of the Ancient; it seems you are a cultivation civilization recently grown from our racial lands.” Sherry Williams said as the space-time around her twisted and the Black Flames burning Heaven and Earth dispersed.
Just like Lost World back in the day, these heirs of the racial lands refer to the Expeditionary Army as Ancient Civilization.
Therefore, Sherry Williams was basically sure of the other party’s identity, even if Adam Garcetti radiated a loathsome Aura of the Void, his eyes faintly showing madness.
“I am Lord of the Palace Sherry Williams, from the Flame Wheel Divine Domain established by the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, who was one of the Seven Great Emperors of the past expeditions and has now achieved the Primordial state.”
“And what do you call yourselves, the newly risen kin of ours?”
To these fellow Human Race kin, Sherry Williams’s attitude was slightly better.
One of the Seven Great Emperors, a Primordial existence!!
In an instant, all the Divine Kings, Immortal Kings, and Ancient Dragon Kings flying up from below all showed shock; no wonder this Human Race strong man was so formidable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1693 - 1693 626 A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1693: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs_3 Chapter 1693: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs_3 From a major power backed by Primordial presences.
Moreover, from her words, it seems this Ancient Human Race has more than one Primordial; after all, this Primordial was just one of the Seven Great Emperors who left those years ago.
Damn, struck it rich!
After the excitement, Wind Heavenly King, Golden Winged Divine King Tarrod, and others showed excitement on their faces.
They hadn’t expected the Human Race to have such a significant background.
If the Human Federation recognizes the Ancient Human Race, following the Federation, they won’t have to fear the extinction crisis upon facing unfamiliar Primordial powers.
At this moment, not only were these Divine Kings and Immortal Kings excited, but Adam Garcetti and others were also greatly stirred.
Indeed, those powerhouses who left in ancient times were still alive, and they have become even stronger, now being Primordial Stars across the Firmament.
With black ashen flames burning on his body, resembling twisted shadows, Adam Garcetti slowly said, “Adam Garcetti, the First Councilor of the Human Federation, greets Lord of the Palace.”
The Golden Rubik’s Cube cradled in vast Mecha arms spun, emitting an aged voice: “Second Councilor of the Federation, greetings to fellow powerhouse.”
“The Third Councilor, titled Primordial, greets Lord of the Palace.” The Primordial True King also seemed excited.
During the self-introduction, Primordial True King specifically highlighted that his title was “Primordial.”
Decades ago, when establishing the Human Federation and choosing titles in place of names, Primordial True King chose a very Overbearing title.
Back then, he couldn’t even imagine what ‘Primordial’ implied.
Lastly, the True Martial King with a smile on his face, holding a black stele, politely said, “Fourth Councilor True Martial, welcomes the Lord of the Palace.”
“Please, don’t be too formal.”
Sherry Williams slightly nodded, “I am here because the Void True Emperor sensed the appearance of the ancestral land and sent me to inspect.”
“The appearance of the ancestral lands has already shaken the Six Domains of Human, apart from me, there is an official Divine Realm Delegation arriving soon to discuss matters concerning the ancestral land.”
Such emphasis on ‘us’? Adam Garcetti and the others exchanged glances, feeling somewhat grave.
Their power was definitely insignificant to the Ancient Civilization; although originating from the same root, there were no deeper ’emotions’.
Under normal circumstances, they should gradually be contacted, given some support, and slowly integrated.
Blue Star World, ancestral land.
Immediately, the four understood the true intentions of these ancient powerhouses; they were more concerned about the emergence of the ancestral land.
Hoping the appearance of Ancient Civilization does not cause too big an impact on the current situation. For a moment, Adam Garcetti and his cohort’s expression became grave, with numerous thoughts flashing through their minds.
In contrast to the somewhat grave group of Adam Garcetti and others, the King of Immortal Spirit and others were again shocked.
Indeed, these ancient humans had more than one Primordial True Emperor.
Roar! Damn, such formidable Human race. The ancient Lava Giant Dragons, among other Giant Beasts, instinctively stepped back, showing some wariness in their eyes looking at Sherry.
They hadn’t expected that the Human race they were supposed to support had such significant backers, with multiple Primordial presences in presence.
No wonder they act so Overbearingly; not someone to provoke.
At this moment, Sherry Williams’ gaze swept over Adam Garcetti and the others, a hint of disappointment flashed through her eyes, then somewhat reluctantly asked, “Councilor Adam Garcetti, are all the human strong men of the Federation here?”
Adam Garcetti paused slightly: “…If the Lord of the Palace means those of the Ancient Realm, apart from us four, the King of Divine Martial is not here.”
“At the moment, the power of Divine Martial is considered the strongest within the Federation, it’s just that he was heavily injured in the recent Civilization Great War against the Purgatory Demon Race and isn’t here.”
King of Divine Martial. A trace of disappointment flashed in Sherry Williams’ eyes.
Wait, all these people’s names are titles.
Sherry Williams realized and inquired subconsciously, “May I ask, what is the real name of that King of Divine Martial?”
Adam Garcetti and the others paused.
For cultivators, revealing a real name is not to be taken lightly, but Jack Clark’s name was different as too many people already knew it, leaving no need to hide.
True Martial King politely said, “Lord of the Palace, the real name of the King of Divine Martial is Jack Clark.”
Jack Clark!
Boom!
On Sherry Williams, black flames erupted like a millennia-old volcano, her hair fluttering, and flames in her eyes reflecting the moon casting a black Great Sun, her voice trembling slightly.
“You just said, that heavily injured Human strong man is named Jack Clark, are you sure?”
“…Yes, the real name of the King of Divine Martial is indeed Jack Clark.” True Martial King hesitated, unsure why she was so agitated.
Brother Clark is really here!?
Sherry Williams’ hands trembled, a wisp of black flame condensed in front of her, forming the figure of a young man with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a ferocious and gorgeous battle armor.
“That Jack Clark, does he look like this?”
Looking at the young man formed in front of Sherry Williams, Adam Garcetti and the others were stunned, Primordial True King somewhat confused, “Uh…Lord of the Palace, you know Jack Clark?”
Sister, I found Brother Clark.
Sherry Williams’ face displayed a radiant smile, such breathtaking beauty even the giant beasts felt dazzled.
And others like Wind Heavenly King, Divine King Tarrod and others were somewhat puzzled, what’s happening, this distant coming powerhouse of the Human ancient power seems to know Jack Clark.
Roar! An extremely fierce and Overbearing roar shook Heaven and Earth.
Under the terrifying roar, the whole world shook, and a sea of black flames covering tens of thousands of kilometers raged, and then a terrifyingly majestic Giant Beast appeared at the end of a long ‘crack’, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1694 - 1694 626 A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1694: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs_4 Chapter 1694: Chapter 626: A Farewell Across Ten Thousand Years, The Giant Beast Departs_4 Upon witnessing the instant appearance of that Black Gold Giant Beast, everyone felt as if the world was collapsing, completely engulfed by the illusion of that boundlessly colossal beast.
Merely standing there, the terrifying aura it emanated seemed to oppress the entire world beyond its capacity to bear.
This Giant Beast was truly fearsome. At this moment, even Sherry Williams showed a rare look of solemnity in her eyes.
But soon, excitement flashed through Sherry’s eyes as they landed on the black-haired young man standing with his hands behind his back beside the Giant Beast: “Brother Clark.”
“Sherry.” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised too.
Since he had glimpsed Sherry’s figure in the visions of the future he had spied upon before, Jack Clark was surprised by her appearance, but not too astonished.
Boom! Space collapsed, forming a long, narrow black Hole.
Sherry Williams ripped through space and emerged in front of Jack Clark as a streak of Black Flames, her voice trembling with excitement: “Brother Clark, I’ve been looking for you for so many years, how could you be here?”
As for the terrifyingly powerful Destruction Emperor Dragon beside her, she simply ignored it.
Jack Clark smiled faintly: “Well, that’s a bit of a long story.”
“Speaking of which, how did you find this place, Sherry? Where is your sister?” The reunion with an old friend brought some joy to Jack Clark’s mood.
Sherry Williams smiled brightly and spoke cheerfully: “My sister is over at the Flame Wheel Divine Domain, busy as the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall.”
“If she knew Brother Clark was here, she would rush over immediately.”
“After leaving the Lost World and finding the Expeditionary Army on the Ancient Road, my sister and I have been looking for Brother Clark.”
“But I didn’t expect you to be in the ancestral land. No wonder there has been no trace of you for all these years.”
“You’ve worked hard.” Although Sherry Williams had only said a few simple words, Jack Clark could feel the sisters’ sincere intentions, which moved him somewhat.
Yiyaya!?
On the gigantic Dragon Head of the beast beside them, the Purple little dragon, now shrunk to a hundred meters, blinked its large eyes curiously at Sherry Williams.
Because of the synchronicity of their life fluctuations, the Purple little dragon could keenly feel that the Destruction Emperor Dragon it was sitting on was in a good mood, pleased.
“They really do know each other.”
Watching the two people ‘chatting happily’ in the distance, Adam Garcetti and the others felt somewhat puzzled, wondering when Jack Clark had gotten involved with the strong men of the ancient Human Race?
Or had Jack Clark been in contact with the ancient Human Race all along, which explained the terrifying speed of his cultivation?
Could it be the Emperor Inheritance he received on the Continent of Void Heritage?
It’s possible.
But that can’t be right. If Jack Clark had early contacts with the ancient Human Race, he would not have failed to inform the Human Federation of the difficulties, asking for support.
Given how much the ancient Human Race valued Blue Star, if they had known about the Purgatory Demon Race’s intent to destroy the Federation, they would have sent powerful True Spirits over long ago.
For a moment, the thoughts of the four Supreme Experts were somewhat confused and bewildered, unclear about the current situation.
However, regardless of anything else, what mattered was that Jack Clark had successfully returned from Resurrection, and it seemed that the Giant Beast hadn’t lied to them.
Thinking this, smiles appeared on the faces of the four from the Garcetti group.
In contrast to the Garcetti group’s complex thoughts, Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy and the others had simpler considerations.
“We didn’t expect the King of Divine Martial to have known the strong men of the ancient Human Race for so long. No wonder his power is so great and his cultivation speed so fast.”
Wind Heavenly King stroked his beard and nodded in agreement: “Indeed, only the backing of a power presided over by the Primordial could create such an Unparalleled Genius.”
“The King of Divine Martial really kept us in the dark.”
“Yes, if we had known earlier that such a powerful force stood behind the Human Race, we wouldn’t have felt so desperate during the previous Civilization Great Wars.”
Boom! Suddenly, the entire world shook violently.
Just as the excited Sherry Williams was about to say something else, the body of the Black Gold Giant Beast, which had already swelled to fifty thousand meters and resembled a mountain range hundreds of kilometers long, moved beneath its feet.
Even though the Destruction Emperor Dragon had restrained its power fluctuations and supremacy, it was enshrouded by an invisible and immensely terrifying aura.
At every step, the entire world shook, and the space for tens of thousands of kilometers around was like sea water, raising up ring after ring of transparent ripples.
Heavenly Energy within millions of kilometers also went wild, raising Mountains and Seas shaking gusts of wind when the beast, like a Black Hole in substance, moved; the momentum was vast.
Such dreadful authority instantly brought Sherry Williams back to her senses.
Astonishment flashed across the faces of Tarrod and the other Divine Kings as they instinctively trembled at the sight of the Destruction Beast stepping through the Void, leaving behind gaping Black Holes with each enormous footprint.
Although the Giant Beast had exited its terrifying form, its strength didn’t seem to have weakened much; it was too horrifying.
“Roar! King, you have returned.”
The Lava Giant Beast, Ancient Batfin, Black Kirin, Gray Python, Blue-White Giant Dragon, Time Dragon, as well as the Void Python and the King of Blade Edge all roared and excitedly rushed forward.
Faced with the increasingly powerful and majestic Destruction Emperor Dragon, all the Ancient Dragon Kings submitted with heartfelt respect.
After experiencing other True Spirit beings being slapped to the ground just moments ago, the return of the Destruction Emperor Dragon brought a full sense of security to these Ancient Beasts.
It was as if they had found their backbone.
But as they approached, the eyes of the Blue-White Giant Dragon and Time Dragon immediately fell on the two ‘amber’ stones held in the claws of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
“King, what’s wrong with Scythia and the others?” The Blue-White Giant Dragon’s voice carried a hint of nervousness.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly spoke, its low growl full of terror and majesty, echoing through Heaven and Earth: “They are fine, they absorbed some resources in the Land of Fallen previously and are now undergoing Transformation in Hibernation.”
As it spoke, the Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly swept its gaze over the behemoth before it and the strong men of the four clans. Under the gaze of those fearsome golden vertical pupils, everyone lowered their heads, not daring to look directly.
“It’s time for us to return.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1695 - 1695 627 Life Shackles Terrifying Giant Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1695: Chapter 627 Life Shackles, Terrifying Giant Beast Chapter 1695: Chapter 627 Life Shackles, Terrifying Giant Beast Roar Roar Roar!!
Surrounded by Ancient Beasts, the massive silhouette of the Destruction Emperor Dragon quickly faded into the horizon.
No one expected that the Destruction Beast came in a hurry, and left promptly after the great battle, as if even staying to speak a word was a waste of time.
Or perhaps, among those present, aside from Jack Clark, there was none whom it deemed worthy of respect.
Sigh! The Primordial True King slowly exhaled, somewhat emotional: “This beast, its potential is terrifyingly unimaginable.”
The True Martial King slowly nodded: “Indeed.”
In fact, among the human Supreme Experts present, which one wasn’t a peerless genius of their time, otherwise they wouldn’t have achieved a breakthrough to the Ancient Realm within mere decades.
Especially when compared to the Heavenly Feather Clan and Immortal Spirit Clan, who had cultivated for a thousand years, equivalent to several thousands of years in the Blue Star World.
But compared to the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which in just a little over a year, evolved from a sixth level Transcendent Giant Beast to the peak of the Ancient Extreme Realm with an exaggerated combat power, they were still not at the same level.
“It always feels somewhat surreal; do you think there really are creatures whose growth rate is this exaggerated?”
“Yes, and there’s another one.” As they spoke, the crowd looked towards a blurred figure standing amidst the violent winds, seventy thousand kilometers away, their faces slowly registering astonishment.
The Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy appeared confused: “Ancient late stage, what’s going on!?”
Because everyone’s attention had been on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, it was only now they discovered the faint aura of the ancient late stage unconcealed around Jack Clark, who had just ‘resurrected’.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Spaces around these Ancient Powerhouses shattered, powerful Rule forces penetrated Heaven and Earth, transforming into streaks of red, blue, and white light crossing tens of thousands of kilometers.
In just a few breaths, eleven Ancient level strong men appeared around Jack Clark, with the Primordial True King speaking first, somewhat surprised.
“Jack Clark, have you advanced to the ancient late period?”
“Yes, late period.”
Jack Clark nodded with a smile: “This time, ‘Thunderflame’ discovered an Origin source in the Land of Fallen. After recovering from my injuries, I managed to breakthrough naturally.”
“Primordial Origin!”
“No wonder.”
“There really was an Origin there.”
Adam Garcetti and others suddenly understood, while the Divine Kings like the Golden Winged Divine King showed envy.
Primordial Origin, if they could obtain one, not only would their cultivation improve further, but the Rule Origin would also imbibe the primordial aura, and they could break through to True Spirit as long as their cultivation level was sufficient.
However, these Divine Kings could only envy.
The Land of Fallen not only was fraught with danger, the Rule barrier surrounding it couldn’t be broken even by True Spirits, let alone them.
Just as these Divine Kings were envying and marveling, Sherry also appeared somewhat astonished: “Brother Clark, you are just at the ancient late stage!?”
Similar to Adam Garcetti and the others, due to too much excitement and elation, Sherry hadn’t noticed that Jack Clark’s aura seemed somewhat ‘weak’, and was actually just at the ancient late stage?
Before Jack Clark could speak, Tolstoy looked bizarrely: “Just… Hall Lord Williams, do you perhaps have a misunderstanding about the cultivation speed of the King of Divine Martial?”
Before this ultimate clan annihilation war started, Tolstoy, Wind Heaven, and others had specifically inquired about Jack Clark, especially his cultivation journey.
From starting cultivation to reaching Foundation Establishment and stepping into the Transcendent, then breaking through to Mythical Realm and advancing to the Ancient Realm, it only took him about fifteen Sun Wheels.
Fifteen Sun Wheels, not even a fraction of the time they took for one session of closed-door cultivation.
But in almost the blink of an eye, a monster with combat power comparable to True Spirit suddenly rose, leading the four tribes against the rampaging Purgatory Great Clan that had ravaged for ten thousand years.
Because of Jack Clark’s existence, even if the eight Great Purgatory Empires joined forces, they dared to fight.
With Jack Clark’s terrifying growth speed, as long as the war could be prolonged by a few more Sun Wheels, the victory would definitely be theirs, even if the Purgatory ancestors were revived.
And they did not bet wrong.
Although many unexpected events occurred during the period, the outcome of the great war was almost as they had predicted.
Looking at those Ancient Powerhouses with somewhat strange gazes, Sherry also paused slightly, wondering if what she said just now was indeed inappropriate?
But when Jack Clark left initially, he was already at the Mythical Realm, and now more than ten thousand years had passed, only reaching the ancient late stage indeed seemed a bit slow?
After all, with his talent, he should at least be at the Pinnacle of True Spirit or half-step Primordial by now.
“Actually, there’s indeed a bit of a misunderstanding here.”
Jack Clark smiled: “But this isn’t the place to talk; let’s go back to the rear base and discuss it, we can also talk about the matters regarding the ancient envoy.”
…
Originally Channel One, now the only world passageway, underneath the virtual silhouette of the Golden Divine Tree, at the top floor of the central building of the expanded city alliance’s main city.
Space compressed, the conference room, a million times broader than the outer world, where Jack Clark, Sherry, Adam Garcetti, Primordial True King, Sky-based God King, and True Martial King sat around the office table.
As this was an internal conference of the human inner circle, Wind Heavenly King and others did not participate.
In the main seat, Jack Clark smiled slightly: “I know, everyone is curious how I came to know Sherry.”
The Primordial True King, appearing like an ordinary old man, chuckled and nodded: “Indeed very curious, after all, the Human Divine Domain is so far from here, it seems impossible for you two to have any intersection.”
“Under normal conditions this would be true, but sometimes destiny is just so ingeniously arranged.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark also felt somewhat emotional: “That time when I broke through to the Mythical Realm and ventured deep into the rear of the Purgatory Empire to slay a group of demon kings and Great Demon Kings, I was surrounded and attacked by three Demon Gods.”
“Although I heavily injured a Demon God and left, I too sustained heavy injuries and was knocked into the Time Chaos by Diorus breaking the transportation forbidden weapon.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1696 - 1696 627 Life Shackles Terrifying Giant
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1696: Chapter 627 Life Shackles, Terrifying Giant Beast_2 Chapter 1696: Chapter 627 Life Shackles, Terrifying Giant Beast_2 “At the time, I happened to encounter a Titan Level Time Silver Butterfly Giant Beast and engaged in a fierce battle. I ultimately slew it, but in its final moments, that Titan Beast also detonated the Time Crystal Core.”
“The powerful Time Power Burst erupted, coincidentally at the same time as the Space-Time Chaos, and in an instant, the Time Storm sucked me in, along with a Time Dragon.”
“It was because of that event that I traveled back countless years to an age unknown, arriving in the Lost World on the brink of Doomsday, where I met Sherry and her sister…”
Following that, Jack Clark gave a rough account of his initial arrival in the past, though naturally, some details were embellished.
For instance, the act of deliberately crushing the Time Crystal Core was changed to its detonation upon the giant beast’s death, and the use of the Hell Coordinates to leap back was attributed to the Time Dragon.
By the time Jack Clark finished his story, Adam Garcetti and the others were so shocked they didn’t know what to say.
Cornered by three Demon Gods at the Legendary Realm, sustaining heavy injuries, then encountering a Titan Level Time Giant Beast and traveling back to the Lost World from ten thousand years ago.
Any one of these experiences would equate to certain death for them; even if they miraculously survived, there was no way to return from ten thousand years in the past to the present, forever lost in the Time Chaos.
While the Primordial True Kings were in shock, Hall Lord Williams was a bit puzzled: “No wonder when Brother Clark you left, there was such intense time fluctuation.”
In fact, after many years of pursuit without finding any trace of Jack Clark, Hall Lord Williams and her sister had vaguely guessed that Jack Clark and they might not exist in the same time period.
But they had never imagined that there would be a gap of over ten thousand years between them.
After all, under normal conditions, cultivators of the Legendary Realm didn’t even qualify to touch Time, much less cross through it to arrive in the past or future.
“…Wait a second, Brother Clark, may I ask how old you are now?” Hall Lord Williams suddenly reacted, her gaze flickering as she stared intently at Jack Clark.
Before Jack Clark could answer, the True Martial King pondered for a moment.
“I remember I have seen Jack Clark’s birthday; it seems to be January 13th. Now it’s already late January; it looks like he has just turned eighteen.”
Instantly, the entire conference room fell silent.
Hall Lord Williams opened her mouth wide, in disbelief: “Brother Clark, you’re only ‘eighteen years old’!?”
The Primordial True King nodded in reflection: “Indeed, Jack Clark is actually only eighteen, so now, Hall Lord Williams, you understand why we were so shocked about his breakthrough to the ancient late stage.”
“Moreover, that’s just his realm. Even at the ancient early stage, his strength was comparable to an ordinary True Spirit, casually bursting a True Demon God Body with a strike of his halberd on the battlefield.”
“Now that his cultivation has broken through to the ancient late stage, it’s hard to imagine how strong he is now…”
At this point, the Primordial True King suddenly didn’t feel like speaking anymore, and the True Martial King and Sky-based God King were already immersed in silence.
Though they had been shocked many times before, whenever they thought of Jack Clark’s age, as well as his current cultivation level and strength, they all felt an eerie sense of unreality.
Jack Clark shook his head: “There is no need for everyone to be so surprised. Ever since the breakthrough to the Ancient Realm, age has actually lost its meaning for us.”
“Provided we don’t encounter major disasters or calamities, we could live for at least several hundred thousand to a million years, and if we can condense the Innate Demon God True Body, we might even live as long as Heaven itself.”
“So a few decades or a few thousand years, in fact, don’t make much difference.”
It seems… there is some sense in that. The True Martial King subconsciously nodded, but then immediately snapped back to reality.
What kind of sense is that? You reached the Ancient Realm in just a year or two, and it took me decades to break through to the ancient stage. There’s no difference?
With your rate of cultivation, perhaps in another two years, while I am still consolidating my early ancient stage cultivation, you might have already crossed into the Primordial as a True Spirit.
But just then, Hall Lord Williams wholeheartedly agreed: “Brother Clark is right; age truly has no meaning for us anymore. There’s not much difference between being twenty and a few thousand years old.”
Jack Clark chuckled: “Right, no difference. Sherry, you look much the same as you did back then, still that sixteen-year-old girl.”
Suddenly, even Hall Lord Williams felt a little bit shy: “Brother Clark, although I’m happy you say so, it is still an exaggeration.”
Nevertheless, even as she said so, Hall Lord Williams’ smile grew even more radiant.
Any woman likes to be complimented on looking young, especially when the person saying so is Jack Clark.
“Cough! Let’s continue with the next topic,” the Primordial True King coughed dryly before becoming serious. He looked at Sherry Williams and said solemnly.
“Lord of the Palace, may I ask if the upcoming Divine Realm Delegation will cause us any trouble?”
Because Jack Clark and Sherry Williams were ‘very close,’ the Primordial True King asked so directly.
Facing this question, Sherry Williams also looked somewhat grave: “To some extent, it’s very troublesome, especially since the delegation also carries a True Emperor’s Edict.”
The True Martial King narrowed his eyes: “Could it be that they will take action, forcibly Suppressing and ruling over us?”
Sherry Williams shook her head: “No, in front of the Six Great Divine Domains, the Human Federation, with at most five Ancient Powerhouses, is insignificant. They don’t care about us.”
“Their target is our ancestral land; they might forcibly drag the ‘world’ away.”
The Primordial True King was startled: “Isn’t that… a good thing for us?”
If the Solar System World was moved to the Human Divine Domain, protected by the powerful forces stationed by the Primordial True King, and with cultural and technological exchanges, it wouldn’t take ten years for the Federation’s power to surge tens or even hundreds of times.
So, for Blue Star, moving to the Divine Realm is a good thing, right?
Sherry Williams shook her head slightly: “What they want is the world, not the people on the ancestral star.”
“Of course, as fellow members of the Human Race, they will not slaughter the people of the Federation. They should carve out an area for you within the Divine Realm, where everyone can adapt to a new environment.”
Then, without waiting for Adam Garcetti and the others to ask further, Sherry Williams continued gravely: “You have no idea what the ancestral land means to those below the True Spirit.”
“It means that Ancient Powerhouses can rely on the World Rules of the ancestral land to more easily step into the Emperor Realm.”
“It means that their descendants can break through Life Shackles and obtain a terrifying cultivation speed far surpassing that of life in the Vast World, like yourselves.”
“Surely, Brother Clark, you have noticed that your cultivation speed is abnormal.”
“Not to mention Brother Clark, even Speaker Garcetti, your cultivation speed is ten to dozens of times faster than those of comparable realm in the Vast World.”
“In the current Six Domains of Human, there are more than five hundred billion people over thousands of years, where every newborn is a Transcendent Life, and as adults, they are comparable to Fourth Tier cultivators.”
“However, not many can cultivate and breakthrough to the Legendary Realm within a hundred years, and those who can become Titan Monarchs in a thousand years are already geniuses.”
“As for the top-tier Monarchs in the Ancient Realm, they are one in a billion, not to mention stepping into the True Spirit Realm of the Civilization Emperor Realm.”
“Including myself, since breaking through to the True Spirit Realm, thousands of years have passed, and my cultivation has only progressed a small step, approaching mid-term True Spirit. I expect it will take another ten years to achieve a breakthrough.”
“Why is this the case?” The True Martial King was a bit astonished.
Sherry Williams said gravely: “Because the Vast World is an unimaginably huge ‘Giant Beast,’ and we are essentially living within the body of this terrifying creature.”
“The Vast World is filled with rich Heavenly Energy, stable space, and perfect Heavenly Earth Rules; in a sense, it’s entirely a cultivation sanctuary.”
“However, due to biological characteristics, us living within this terrifying Giant Beast are also affected by it.”
“Such as time.”
“In our original concept, a day equals twelve hours, but in the understanding of this indescribably terrifying Giant Beast, time is incredibly ‘slow.'”
“According to my master, the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, a single breath of this hibernating Giant Beast is over forty days, and a single thought takes three years.”
“Therefore, everything for us is slowed down.”
“As independent living beings, our thoughts and consciousness are unaffected, but our cultivation, our comprehensions of the Heavenly Earth Law, Rules, growth, and everything else are shrouded by this Giant Beast’s concept of time.”
“Therefore, the longer we ‘live’ in the Vast World, the deeper the Time Mark on us, the greater the influence of the World Rules, or rather, the Rules of that terrifying Giant Beast.”
“Especially for those born in the Vast World, from the moment they are born, they are ‘assimilated’ by the Vast World, as if their lives have been shackled.”
“That explains it, no wonder,” Jack Clark murmured thoughtfully, considering the new humans born in the mythical world.
