chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1697: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens Chapter 1697: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens Sherry Williams’s words not only applied pressure from the delegation of the Six Great Divine Domains but also deepened Jack Clark and the others’ understanding of the mythical world, especially regarding the Life Shackles.
Although the Federation had previously discovered the new humans born from the mythical world, who cultivated slowly and found Cultivating True Martial Arts less effective than Body Refinement, they thought it was due to stable genetic issues.
Unexpectedly, it turned out to be due to ‘assimilation’ over time.
Amidst the concerned expressions of Adam Garcetti and the others, Jack Clark pondered: “Since there are rules against the Human Race members killing each other, we don’t have to worry too much; this issue is manageable.”
“The Solar System is vast, they can easily terraform a Saturn or Jupiter to accommodate hundreds of billions of people.”
“And if that’s still not enough, using meteors to create some Space Continents is also possible; as an Ancient Civilization, altering environments and condensing an atmosphere should be simple for them.”
“Of course, if the decision-makers of the Six Great Divine Domains are too Overbearing and don’t allow the Federation’s people to ‘survive’, don’t blame me for cutting off the passageways between the Solar System and the mythical world.”
Speaking to this point, Jack Clark’s eyes became slightly cold: “By that time, sealing the Solar System for a few years until I step into the Primordial, then we can settle things slowly.”
Adam Garcetti slowly nodded: “You’ll be in charge of this matter when the time comes, Jack.”
The Primordial True King said with a chuckle: “I have no objections.”
The True Martial King also smiled slightly: “Now that you, Jack, are our Federation’s number one strong man, it seems you’ve got the big task of handling this standoff.”
Currently, only Jack Clark’s strength has stepped into the True Spirit Level, qualifying him to speak on equal terms with those Supreme Experts from the Divine Realms.
Sherry Williams said confidently: “Brother Clark, rest assured, I will help you when the time comes. I have my master’s Decree, and the messengers from the Flame Wheel Divine Domain have to obey my orders.”
“As for the other Divine Realm messengers, my sister can exert pressure on them; they definitely cannot bully Jack… the Federation, we must engage in friendly and equal exchanges.”
Jack Clark was somewhat surprised: “What realm is Sara at now, to have such great influence?”
Admiration showed on Sherry’s face: “My sister is much more formidable than me, having broken through to the Late Stage of True Spirit a thousand years ago, she is one of the five Lords of the Palace in the Imperial Dynasty, with status just below that of the Flame Wheel Great Emperor.”
“Moreover, unlike my ‘ordinary’ True Spirit, due to an opportunity from outside the Chaotic Heavens, she already possesses the foundation of the Primordial and is one of the ten True Emperors most likely to step into the Primordial in the Six Great Divine Domains.”
“In addition to being a direct disciple of the True Emperor, her status is even not inferior to the Flame Wheel Dynasty’s Great Emperor.”
“…That’s incredible.” Surprise showed in Jack Clark’s eyes.
But indeed, Sara Williams’s talent was higher than Sherry Williams’s, and over the course of more than ten thousand years, Sherry has cultivated to the True Spirit Initial Stage, so it seemed quite normal for Sara to break through to the Late Stage of True Spirit.
However, Jack Clark did not notice the strange expressions that flickered briefly over the faces of the Primordial True King and the others.
They had originally thought that knowing a True Spirit Level Divine Realm strong man was already something, but unexpectedly there was another with even greater strength, in the Late Stage of True Spirit, possessing the foundation of the Primordial, with a status comparable to that of an Imperial Dynasty Great Emperor.
Also, considering the two sisters’ methods of pursuing for ten thousand years, their attitude towards Jack Clark was evidently not as simple as the surface ‘gratitude’.
A trace of a smile flashed in the eyes of the Primordial True King, looking towards the True Martial King: “I never expected that Jack Clark was not only formidable in cultivation, but also had the talent to live off ‘women’s fortunes’.”
“Haha… I’ve long said that the rise of the Federation depends on Jack Clark, haven’t I been correct? He is indeed the Federation’s blessing.” The True Martial King also showed a hint of a smile.
“Isn’t that obvious? Everyone knows that Jack Clark is our Federation’s future.” The Primordial True King rolled his eyes.
While the two Supreme experts were ‘exchanging winks’ and communicating through glances as they sat opposite each other, Adam Garcetti’s message of thought came to their ears: “You two, mind your image.”
Cough cough!!
Continuing with the serious matters.
The True Martial King politely said: “Hall Lord Williams, may I ask what specifically differentiates the Divine Realms?”
“What’s different about the Divine Realms…”
Sherry Williams thought for a moment and then said: “I’ve mentioned before that the Vast World is an incomparably enormous and terrifying Giant Beast, within which all life proliferates and thrives.”
“But when a cultivator makes a breakthrough to the Primordial, it’s like ‘transcending’, rising above Heaven and Earth, earning the right to enter the Chaos Void.”
“And the Divine Realm is the ‘world’ carved out by the Primordial Powerhouses, with pathways linked to Chaos, allowing Mythical-level strong men and above to enter outside Heaven.”
“Chaos Void, are there more resources there?” Jack Clark pondered.
After coalescing his Innate Demon God True Body, Jack Clark’s body is linked to the Chaos Void, allowing him to subtly absorb purer energy to strengthen himself.
Including the Destruction Emperor Dragon, after its bloodline made a Heavenly Tier breakthrough, not only did it link to the Chaos Void, it also absorbed Chaos Energy at quantities a million times more than Jack Clark’s.
No wonder, after he reached the half-step Primordial in the Deification Realm, there was a strong call from beyond the heavens. Evidently, that environment is more suitable for Primordial life. As for the mythical world, its upper limit is only True Spirit, and once one reaches the True Spirit level, there are nearly no suitable resources to accelerate advancement, only slow grinding.
Sherry Williams nodded: “Yes, the Chaos Void has more resources; many Chaotic Divine Objects can even break the limits of life and coalesce various Innate Divine Bodies.”
“Therefore, every year when the Heavenly Gates of the Six Great Divine Domains open, countless strong men above Mythical Realm gather and enter majestically.”
“Hence, having a Divine Realm or not is a symbol of a top-tier civilization since only with sufficient resources can a powerful civilization continue to grow.”
“Otherwise, if a race is always killing each other every day, competing for limited resources, they will never be able to grow strong.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1698 - 1698 628 Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1698: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens_2 Chapter 1698: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens_2 “Indeed.” Jack Clark and the others nodded, agreeing with this point.
Is resources important?
Of course, important, without those Heaven and Earth Treasures and Divine Objects, neither Jack Clark nor Destruction Emperor Dragon could grow so rapidly.
Especially those treasures that break the life limitations, they are extremely precious.
After all, cultivation can be accumulated slowly over time, but the limitation is a chasm; if it can’t be broken, one will be forever trapped in a certain realm for thousands of years.
Just like those long-standing cultivators from the Blue Star World who are at Eight Layer Heaven and Ninth Heavens.
Is it because they don’t work hard enough or don’t want to make a breakthrough to king-level? Of course not, it’s just that their talent is too weak to take a step further.
Otherwise, as long as one lives long enough and has enough resources, they would be able to continuously become stronger—wouldn’t it mean that everyone in the Six Great Divine Domains could break through to True Spirit, break through to Primordial.
The Primordial True King felt some envy: “I didn’t expect that the cultivators in the Divine Realm could enter the Chaos Outside Heaven at the Legendary Realm, no wonder there are so many True Spirit Powerhouses.”
“It’s not that simple; risk and reward are always proportional, no matter when,” Sherry Williams said wryly.
“The Chaos Outside Heaven is far more dangerous than the Vast World, filled with all sorts of terrifying hazardous areas. Ordinary Mythical Powerhouses can only operate on the fringes of the Chaos Outside Heaven, only the Primordial True Emperors are capable of diving deeper.”
“Besides that, the environment is also very harsh, the rules are incomplete, and only True Spirit Powerhouses can absorb the energy impregnated with violent chaotic aura, unable to stay for long.”
“According to Master’s words, the Chaos Void is actually a ‘calm area’ formed around it when ‘vast Giants’ wander through Chaos, swallowing and spewing chaotic power.”
“Therefore, it is wider and boundless compared to the Vast World, no one knows how many Divine Domains link to the Chaos Outside Heaven nor does anyone know exactly how many powerhouses there are.”
“In the Chaos Void, one may encounter other top-tier civilizations, peak different races, or unknown beings from different planes that are temporarily linked due to distortions in space-time.”
“That’s why the Chaos Outside Heaven is also known as the Ancient Battlefield, where a significant number of powerhouses from the six domains perish every year.”
“In fact, when the Seven Great Emperors joined forces, they entered the battleground of the Chaos Void; later, they collectively suppressed a Primordial Powerhouse using the pathways of Divine Realm to advance into the Vast World.”
After Sherry Williams finished speaking, the Primordial True King’s face showed a hint of excitement: “So that’s the truth behind the expedition back then.”
The True Martial King also showed a strong Battle Intent in his eyes: “The contest of a hundred races, the battlefield of the heavens, it indeed sounds quite thrilling.”
At this moment, Adam Garcetti’s eyes burned with ethereal flames, the Golden Rubik’s Cube was spinning continuously, and even Jack Clark felt a sense of yearning.
They had not expected the mythical world to be far more vast and mysterious than they imagined, just the surface inhabited by billions of civilizations was merely the newbie village.
And the Ancient Battlefield beyond the heavens, is full of countless opportunities and powerhouses.
After understanding the special aspects of the Divine Realm, Jack Clark and others inquired about information on the Six Great Divine Domains, such as structure, number of powerhouses, and so on.
According to Sherry Williams’ introduction, the Six Great Divine Domains are actually very far apart, and each Divine Domain’s ‘culture’ is different.
For example, one of the Seven Great Emperors ‘Reincarnation’, the current ruler, Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor, the creator of the Reincarnation Divine Realm, is very mysterious.
It is said that the domain is divided by sects, which are fewer in number than other Divine Domains. Many geniuses and strong men like to engage in Closed-door Cultivation, quiet cultivation, and do not like to venture out.
Next is the king ‘Void’ who left the Void Secret Sea, the current Void True Emperor, opened up the Void Divine Realm located between Void and the Material World.
There, the clans are dominant, one clan, one family ruling over one Boundary, the cultivation system focuses on the Void, and many cultivators even contaminate themselves with Void to become Void beings.
The Seven Great Emperors ‘Battle’, the current Slaughter Heaven True Emperor, opened the Slaughter Divine Domain, where cultivators are more combative and aggressive, with an insatiable desire and pursuit for strength.
The cultivators that come out of the Slaughter Divine Domain, once they engage in battle, become insanely bloodthirsty; the more they get injured, the stronger they become, complete madmen.
Compared to these three Divine Domains, the Flame Wheel Divine Domain opened up by the Seven Great Emperors ‘Sparkling Heaven’, the current Blazing Heaven True Emperor, the Ten Thousand Swords Divine Realm established by ‘Sword’, Quiet Sword True Emperor, and ‘Ancient’, the Chaotic Ancient Divine Realm opened by the Eternal True Emperor, are much more normal.
Among them, the Chaotic Ancient Divine Realm is mainly a sect-based system, but all kinds of Cultivation Systems exist, Body Refinement, Qi Training, Tool Forging, Sword Cultivation, Beast Mastery, bloodlines, and so on.
The remaining Ten Thousand Swords Divine Realm and Flame Wheel Divine Realm, however, follow a standard Imperial Dynasty system.
For example, the Flame Wheel Dynasty is governed by a central imperial court that controls all directions, consists of five Divine temples, fifteen boundaries, two hundred ninety-seven states, with a population of over 1.3 trillion.
Whereas the Ten Thousand Swords Divine Realm is similar to the Flame Wheel Divine Realm, except there, all are sword cultivators; cultivation focuses on the sword, with stronger offense, but weaker in other aspects.
As for the population, they also exceed a trillion, and together with the Flame Wheel Divine Realm, they nearly make up half of the ancient Human Race.
The reason for this, of course, is ‘stability.’
After all, compared to the other four Divine Domains that are either chaotic or ‘strange’, the system of these two Imperial Dynasties is more complete, sound, and suitable for life.
And from the time of the Ancient Civilization’s expedition until now, more than 30,000 years have passed, which translates to nearly 100,000 Star Hours.
During such a long period, the population of the ancient Human Race has only reached a little over five hundred billion, which may not seem much.
But one must know that these are not ordinary people; each is born as a Transcendent Life, hence making procreation more challenging than for ordinary people in the Blue Star World.
Besides, the core issue is the lack of desire for procreation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1699 - 1699 628 Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1699: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens_3 Chapter 1699: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens_3 For cultivators, especially high-order female practitioners, giving birth to offspring consumes vital life energy and at the same time delays cultivation, diluting the already ‘insufficient’ resources.
Not to mention those strong men whose lifespan reaches ten thousand years or even tens of thousands of years, or are eternal, with cultivation realms above the mythical world.
These strong entities have even less desire to proliferate, as they no longer need ‘inheritance,’ being able to exist eternally by themselves.
This is also one of the reasons why the population of the Human Race remains low.
As for exactly how many powerful beings the Six Great Divine Domains have, Sherry Williams isn’t very clear, because each Divine Domain is an independent Boundary, some are xenophobic.
She only knows that the five Great Halls and the fifteen Domain Lords of the Flame Wheel Dynasty are all at the True Spirit Level, it’s just that the Lords of the five Great Halls have stronger cultivation.
For instance, Sara Williams, the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall, is a late-stage True Spirit powerhouse.
And all the provincial governors of the two hundred ninety-seven provinces are ancient level existences, and they are among the stronger kind within the Ancient Realm; the weaker ones simply have no qualifications to control a province.
The strongest of the Imperial Dynasty, the Flame Wheel Great Emperor, a descendant of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, has a cultivation level of half-step Primordial and wields a Creation Divine Weapon given by the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, his strength is extremely terrifying.
And these are only the forces of the Imperial Dynasty that are visible; after all, throughout the years, there may be those who have broken through the True Spirit without revealing themselves while reclusively cultivating outside Heaven.
Not to mention those Titan-level monarchs and Ancient Monarch Kings who are hidden and reclusively cultivating within the vast Divine Domains.
As for the strength of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor within the Primordial, it’s among the very strong, but as for how strong exactly, Sherry Williams doesn’t know.
After all, the Primordial Realm is too distant for her, and such beings would not likely ‘show off their skills’ in front of her.
Once Sherry Williams finished speaking, the entire meeting room fell silent, and people like Adam Garcetti showed expressions of shock on their faces.
They hadn’t expected the strength of the Six Domains of Human to be this powerful.
Because their attention was all on the Six Great True Emperors before, they completely overlooked the number of strong entities below the Primordial True Emperor.
Under the suppression of the six powerful Primordial Beings, after tens of thousands of years of development and attacking the Chaotic Heavens outside, the Six Great Divine Domains have amassed countless resources and also countless formidable cultivators.
Over time, a large base of Mythical Powerhouses has amassed an astonishing number of Ancient Monarch Kings and True Spirit Emperors.
In front of the ancient humans, the Purgatory Demon Race is not worth mentioning at all and can be suppressed with just the forces from one Great Hall of an Imperial Dynasty.
After a while, Jack Clark lamented, “It seems we need to hasten the improvement of our strength; otherwise, we won’t be able to catch up with those ancient seniors.”
Just as Jack Clark finished speaking, even the True Martial King looked up at the sky, not knowing what to say or rather not wanting to speak with him.
You’re already at the ancient late stage in less than two years, yet you still complain that the speed is not fast enough and want to improve; is this even human talk?
Jack Clark looked at the three people strangely: “Senior Adam Garcetti, what are you looking at the ceiling for?”
“Cough! Nothing.”
Adam Garcetti coughed: “But Jack Clark, what you said is right, we do need to cultivate more diligently, or else we won’t be able to protect ourselves once we go outside Heaven.”
Next, if they have a ‘good’ contact with the Human Divine Domain, Adam Garcetti and the others plan to borrow a path to enter the Chaos Void, to a more vast battlefield.
With their talent, if they have enough opportunities, they might quickly break through the True Spirit.
After all, in the ‘barren’ Blue Star, with such a big background of the mythical world, they managed to break through to the Ancient Realm in just over a decade, let alone the Chaotic Heavens outside.
Jack Clark looked at Sherry Williams: “Sherry, how soon will those messengers arrive?”
Sherry Williams thought for a moment: “Since we have specific coordinates, and that the messengers coming this time are at least at the True Spirit Powerhouse level, they should arrive within about two Sun Wheels.”
“More than two months, huh? That should be enough time.”
Saying this, Jack Clark solemnly said: “Sherry, I plan to return to the Solar System World for Closed-door Cultivation to see if I can push my cultivation to the Peak of the Ancient as soon as possible.”
“If those messengers arrive early, you Sherry will receive them first and keep them steady, tell people to go back and inform me.”
“Four seniors, I need to mobilize all the Federation’s forces to hunt those Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts around the hunting territories, collecting Life Crystals, as many as possible to send to the Sun.”
Jack Clark has a Creation Force within him, which enables him to quickly complete a Supreme Rule fusion.
Additionally, his Soul Source has undergone some Transformation, and his True Demon God Body has also become a Primordial juvenile form, not to say that he can break through to Primordial unimpeded, at least there should be no bottleneck before half-step Primordial.
Of course, having no bottlenecks doesn’t mean just needing resource accumulation; one also needs to sense the Heavenly Earth Rules to perfect one’s own path, hence the need for Life Crystals.
Burning attribute points, entering a state of enlightenment.
…
“Are you sure you can come in with me?”
Beneath the tens of thousands of kilometers high virtual image of the Golden Divine Tree, Jack Clark looks at Sherry Williams, who, even after concealing her Aura, still exudes a kind of subtle vastness.
Sherry Williams smiles at the corner of her mouth: “Don’t worry, Brother Clark, in the Chaotic Heavens outside, I often Seal my strength and enter some weak small worlds.”
Speaking, Sherry Williams’s hand torn a Space Tear, revealing a white blank scroll.
“This is a Domain Heaven Tome crafted from the bark of the Ancient Void Tree, it can turn the space I am in into a complete Space Bubble, isolating everything.”
Saying this, the scroll in Sherry Williams’s hand emits a gentle glow, hovering by her side, and emits a circle of white halo slowly enveloping her and a ten-meter range.
In an instant, the powerful fluctuations of Sherry Williams’s True Spirit life disappeared, including the essence of energy, like a white ‘bubble’ floating in front of Jack Clark.
Compared to the Human Federation, the cultivation system of the Six Great Divine Domains has already evolved to the pinnacle, not only in combat but also in other aspects, with a multitude of methods.

chapters.title: Chapter 1700 - 1700 628 Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1700: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens_4 Chapter 1700: Chapter 628: Hundred Clans Struggle for Supremacy, Battlefields of the Heavens_4 Sherry Williams was somewhat looking forward to it and said, “Brother Clark, what would be the best gift to bring for my first meeting with Auntie?”
Jack Clark paused, “…There’s no need for anything that troublesome.”
This time, upon his return, Jack Clark naturally planned to visit Doris Clark first and then close himself off for cultivation at the Sun Wheel.
As for Glenn Clark, that fellow didn’t need much attention; having won first place in the global competition, he was already preparing to start his training in the mythical world.
For instance, the Flame Wheel Dynasty governs from the central imperial seat, extending its rule in all directions, with control over five Divine Palaces, fifteen Domain Territories, and two hundred ninety-seven states, with a population exceeding 1.3 trillion.
The Ten Thousand Swords Divine Realm is similar to the Flame Wheel Divine Domain, with the only difference being that there, all cultivators are swordsmen who practice the way of the sword, making their offensive capabilities stronger, but weaker in other aspects.
As for the population, it too surpasses one trillion, nearly accounting for half of the ancient Human Race.
The reason, naturally, is ‘stability.’
After all, compared to the other four Divine Domains, which are either chaotic or ‘peculiar,’ the systems of these two imperial domains are more complete, robust, and suitable for living.
And from the time of the Ancient Civilization’s expedition to the present, more than thirty thousand years have passed, which is nearly a hundred thousand years in Blue Star World time.
Such a long duration, and the population of the ancient Human Race is only just over five hundred billion, which may seem not too numerous.
But it must be understood that these are not ordinary people; each one born is a Transcendent Life, making reproduction a bit more difficult than for the average person in the Blue Star World.
Moreover, the most core issue is the lack of desire to procreate.
For cultivators, especially female cultivators of high-order, giving birth can consume vital life essence and delay cultivation, diluting already ‘insufficient’ resources.
Not to mention those with lifespans of tens of thousands of years or even eternal life, whose cultivation reaches above the Legendary Realm.
These powerful beings have an even lower desire to procreate since they no longer need ‘Inheritance’; they can exist forever.
This is also one of the reasons why the population of the Human Race fails to increase significantly.
As for how many powerful beings there are in the Six Great Divine Domains, Sherry Williams isn’t very clear, because each Divine Domain is an independent world, some with a xenophobic tendency.
She only knows that the Domain Lords of the Flame Wheel Dynasty’s five Divine Palaces and fifteen Domain Territories are all of True Spirit Level, though the five Palace Lords possess even stronger cultivation.
For example, Sara Williams, the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall, is a late-stage powerhouse of True Spirit.
And the governors of the two hundred ninety-seven states are all of ancient-level existence, and in the Ancient Realm, belong to the stronger category; those too weak simply don’t qualify to control a state.
The strongest in the dynasty, Flame Wheel Great Emperor, is a descendant of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, with half-step Primordial cultivation, wielding the Creation Divine Weapon bestowed by the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, his strength unimaginably formidable.
And these are just the overt strengths of the dynasty; after all, it’s uncertain if any who have broken through True Spirit have been in secluded cultivation outside of Heaven, keeping out of sight.
Not to mention those Titan-level monarchs and Ancient Monarchs hidden in the vast Divine Domain.
As for the strength of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor among the Primordial, it is considered very strong, but Sherry Williams doesn’t know exactly how strong.
After all, the Primordial Realm is too far removed for her; such beings would not ‘show off their skills’ before her.
After Sherry Williams finished speaking, the entire conference room fell into silence; Adam Garcetti and others showed shock on their faces.
They had not anticipated that the Six Domains of Human would possess such a formidable power.
Because their attention had been previously focused on the Six Great True Emperors, they entirely overlooked the number of powerful beings below the Primordial True Emperor.
Under the suppression of the six powerful Primordials, developing for tens of thousands of years, and assaulting the Chaotic Heavens, the Six Great Divine Domains had accumulated countless resources and numerous powerful cultivators.
Over time, a significant base of Mythical Powerhouses has piled up, resulting in a surprising number of Ancient Monarchs and True Spirit Emperors.
In the face of the Ancient Human Race, the Purgatory Demon Race is inconsequential and could be suppressed merely by the forces of one palace under the jurisdiction of the dynasty.
After a while, Jack Clark remarked, “It seems that we need to speed up the enhancement of our strength. Otherwise, we won’t be able to catch up with those ancient seniors.”
As soon as Jack Clark finished speaking, everyone including the True Martial King lifted their heads to look at the sky, not knowing what to say, or perhaps not wanting to say anything to him.
You’ve reached the ancient late stage in less than two years, and yet you’re still complaining that the speed is not fast enough and you need to further enhance it. Is this even humanly possible?
Jack Clark looked at the three people in confusion: “Adam Garcetti, what are you staring at the ceiling for?”
“Cough! It’s nothing.”
Adam Garcetti coughed and said, “But you’re right, Jack Clark, we do need to cultivate harder, otherwise, we won’t be able to protect ourselves when we go beyond the heavens.”
If the contact with the Human Divine Domain goes ‘well’, Adam Garcetti and the others are prepared to take a shortcut to enter the Chaos Void, to a broader battlefield.
With their talent, if they have enough opportunities, they may soon be able to make a breakthrough to the True Spirit level.
After all, in the ‘barren’ Blue Star, in such a small mythical world, they were able to break through to ancient times in just over a decade, not to mention the Chaotic Heavens outside.
Jack Clark looked at Sherry Williams: “Sherry, how soon will those messengers arrive?”
Sherry Williams thought for a moment, “Since there are specific coordinates, and the envoys coming this time are at least True Spirit Powerhouses, they should arrive within two Star Hours.”
“Over two months, huh? That should be enough time.”
As he spoke, Jack Clark said resolutely, “Sherry, I plan to return to the Solar System World for closed-door cultivation, to see if I can push my cultivation to the Peak of the Ancient.”
“When those messengers come early, you, Sherry, will entertain them first and stabilize them, and send someone back to notify me.”
“Four seniors, I need to mobilize all the forces of the Federation, to hunt the Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts around our territory, to collect Life Crystals, and send as many as possible to the Sun.”
Jack Clark had a strand of Creation Force in his body, which could quickly complete the fusion of a Supreme Rule.
Plus, his Soul Source had already undergone some transformation, and the True Demon God Body had become a Primordial juvenile. It’s not to say that he could smoothly make a breakthrough to the Primordial with no obstruction, but at least there were no bottlenecks before the half-step Primordial.
Of course, having no bottlenecks doesn’t mean that only resource accumulation is needed; it’s also necessary to comprehend the Heavenly Earth Rules and perfect one’s path, and so Life Crystals are needed.
Burning attribute points to enter the state of enlightenment.
…
“Are you sure you can enter with me?”
Under the phantom of a golden divine tree tens of thousands of kilometers high, Jack Clark looked at Sherry Williams, who still emanated an obscure and vast aura even after concealing it.
Sherry Williams showed a smile: “Don’t worry, Brother Clark, I often seal my powers to enter some weak worlds in the Chaotic Heavens outside.”
With that, Sherry Williams caused a Space Tear with her hand, and a blank white scroll appeared.
“This is the Domain Heaven Tome refined from the bark of the Ancient Void Tree, which can transform my own space into a complete space bubble, isolating everything.”
Speaking, Sherry Williams’s scroll emitted a gentle light, hovering at her side and radiating a ring of white halo slowly enveloping her and a ten-meter range around her.
In an instant, the strong fluctuations of Sherry Williams’ True Spirit life ceased to exist, including the nature of her energy, resembling a white ‘bubble’ floating in front of Jack Clark.
Compared to the Human Federation, the cultivation physiques of the Six Great Divine Domains had evolved to their peak, not only in combat but in other aspects as well, their methods were numerous.
Sherry Williams said with some anticipation: “Brother Clark, what do you think would be a better gift to bring for the first time meeting Auntie?”
Jack Clark paused: “…There’s no need for that much trouble.”
On his return, Jack Clark naturally planned to visit Doris Clark first, then close himself off for cultivation on the Sun.
As for Glenn Clark, he didn’t need to be bothered; it was reported that the guy, who had already won the first place in the global contest, was now preparing to undergo training in the mythical world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1701 - 1701 629 The Mythical Era The Sixth Evolution
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1701: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution Chapter 1701: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution On the street, two young men and women of distinguished temperament walked side by side, holding roasted sweet potatoes they’d bought from a street stall, which looked somewhat out of place.
There was an invisible power enveloping them, and when they walked past people on the street, not one person noticed them.
After taking a bite of the sweet potato roasted by a Mythical King, Jack Clark felt somewhat emotional: “I didn’t expect that Heritage Token to have been left by you, Sherry.”
Back then, it was thanks to the Violent Dragon civilization’s Seal Token that the talent and laws of the Time Silver Butterfly were sealed.
Otherwise, given the special nature of the time-manipulating Titan creatures, even if Jack’s strength was greater than that of the Time Silver Butterfly, he would not have been able to slay it as it could have escaped into the Time Rift at any moment.
Sherry Williams smiled with a twinkle in her eye: “At that time, I was bored recovering from an injury and casually taught those different races the War Pattern Cultivation Methods, taking them in as subordinates to handle some miscellaneous tasks.”
“I never expected that the token I left behind on a whim would be found by Brother Clark you, a thousand years later. I can’t help but marvel at the magic of Destiny.”
“Indeed,” Jack Clark nodded in agreement.
Because the power in the Heritage Token was activated by Jack Clark, Sherry Williams sensed it immediately and was curious enough to seek him out proactively.
So even without the Void True Emperor’s location, Sherry Williams would have found this place on her own.
That’s why she marveled at the mysterious ways of Destiny.
Soon, Jack Clark’s home came into view.
It was just past ten in the morning, and Doris Clark, who was off today, was picking vegetables in the courtyard, assisted by Gwen Gail’s mother, Aunt Roe.
The two women chatted, mainly discussing Glenn Clark’s earning the title of the first among the young generation in the Global Martial Arts Competition, so they did not notice Jack Clark and Sherry Williams coming in.
Jack Clark spoke up: “Mom, I’m back.”
“Jack, you’re back,” Doris Clark turned around, surprised and delighted.
“Yeah, I’ve finished things on that side and came back to check in,” Jack said to Gwen Gail’s mother with a nod, “Aunt Roe, hello.”
“Hello, hello, Divine Martial Sir,” Erica Roe was a bit nervous.
Jack Clark smiled: “Aunt Roe, you can just call me Jack Clark. Gwen, Sinclair, and I are friends and Senior Gail has also taken great care of me. No need to be so formal.”
Erica Roe shook her head: “It’s different, we can’t neglect the formalities.”
Jack Clark was no longer just the person who had broken through to become a Mythical King or a Heavenly King; he was now the strongest in the Human Alliance, a terrifying being whose power rivaled that of a Civilization Emperor.
“It’s good that you’re back, good that you’re back,” Doris Clark was somewhat excited.
During the previous Heaven-Earth Mutated event, the brief moment when Jack’s True Body collapsed after his ‘failed’ support, Doris inexplicably felt a heartache, almost dying of fright.
Thankfully later on, someone from the Federation told her that Jack Clark was okay, just slightly injured and ‘recovering’ in the Deification World, which barely calmed her down.
At this time, Doris Clark noticed Sherry Williams standing to the side with a hint of hesitance in her eyes: “Jack, who is this?”
When entering the Blue Star earlier, Sherry Williams had changed her outfit from a gorgeous ancient-style dress.
For example, her clothes had changed to a white long-sleeved T-shirt with a bright pink flower simply printed on it, and white slim-fit trousers, revealing a tall and slender figure.
Her shoes were blue high heels, and paired with her black hair tied back in a ponytail, she looked every bit the stylish and radiant urban beauty.
Sherry Williams was no stranger to modern civilization’s clothing and culture.
The civilization in the Lost World had developed to the modern era, but it was eventually destroyed due to a world-ending virus.
What made Doris Clark hesitant was that this unfamiliar woman was very beautiful, with an indescribably noble temperament, as if not a human, but an ancient deity, was standing before her.
Jack Clark smiled: “Mom, this is Sherry Williams, a friend of mine who has come from a faraway place. She came back with me this time to visit you.”
Sara Williams greeted politely: “Aunt Roe, hello.”
“Hello, hello, don’t stand outside, come in and sit,” Doris Clark hurriedly nodded.
“Doris, I won’t go in right now, we can talk another time,” being from a King’s Family, Erica Roe naturally wouldn’t intrude at this moment.
“Take care, Aunt Roe,” Jack Clark said with politeness, which left Erica Roe somewhat flustered.
Taking the lead to enter the house, Doris Clark lamented: “If I had known you’d be coming back, I would have bought more vegetables this morning. Now, we only have a bit of Green Jade Carving meat and regular beef and pork.”
“No worries, Aunt Roe, just make whatever you can.”
“Right, Mom, anything will do. Eating, for us now, is more about tasting your cooking than necessity.”
Then Doris Clark asked: “Jack, how long can you stay this time?”
Jack Clark shook his head: “Not long, we’ll leave after lunch. I need to go into Closed-door Cultivation to improve my strength, and Sherry has other matters to attend to.”
“I see,” Doris Clark was somewhat disappointed.
Since Jack Clark went to the Southern Battlefield, he rarely came home, and the longest stay was just two days before he had to leave in a hurry.
But Doris Clark understood, after all, Jack Clark’s status was different now, and he surely had many responsibilities, especially where cultivation could not be neglected.
If his power was insufficient when facing powerful enemies in the future, he would be the one to die.
As Doris Clark was heading to the kitchen, Sherry Williams took the initiative to follow: “Aunt Roe, let me give you a hand.”
“No, no, Ms. Williams, you’re a guest, we can’t have you lifting a finger,” Doris Clark quickly refused.
“Don’t worry, Aunt Roe, I ‘used to’ cook often, I won’t be a burden. I’ll help you chop the vegetables, and you can just handle the cooking,” she offered.

chapters.title: Chapter 1702 - 1702 629 The Mythical Era The Sixth
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1702: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_2 Chapter 1702: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_2 “I didn’t mean that.”
After Sherry Williams’ strong ‘request’, Doris Clark ultimately did not refuse.
Looking at the two women busy in the kitchen, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but pause—having a True Spirit Powerhouse of Civilization Emperor Level cook, who would believe it if it were said out loud?
Shaking his head, Jack Clark walked upstairs.
Squeak!
A soft creaking sound arose as Jack Clark pushed open his bedroom door, returning to his room after a long absence.
Looking at the spotless room with its familiar layout, the desk, and the empty fish tank on it, Jack Clark felt a range of emotions.
It seemed like it was only yesterday when he opened his eyes in a haze and made eye contact with the white Six-legged Salamander.
Yet in just over a year, the frail youth had grown into an Ancient Powerhouse capable of shouldering a Star System, and the palmed-sized salamander had transformed into a Giant Beast that overshadowed the sky.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s gaze paused and landed on the painting hung on the wall.
In the picture, there were blue skies, white clouds, and a lake filled with lotus leaves and flowers.
On the island in the middle, tree branches stretched out, the grass glistened, a youth lay resting with his head on his hands napping under the tree, and a female student sat to the side, sketching the beautiful lake scene in front of her.
Whether it was the lotus leaves or the lawn, including the appearance of the youth and girls, everything was vividly portrayed on the paper.
Looking at the Spring Outing Painting, a gentle smile couldn’t help but appear on Jack Clark’s face.
Back when Freya Louise drew this picture, they were just at Third Layer Heaven, but now that girl was already living on the sun, becoming an ‘executor’ of the Solar System World’s Heavenly Dao and couldn’t return for a short time.
At this time, Jack Clark shifted, walked to the wall, and touched the A3 paper, a coiling Invisible Power pulsing from his hand.
Whoosh!
As Jack Clark’s rules and will were imbued, the scroll moved without wind, gaining an ‘overwhelming presence’ that seemed to solidify the surrounding space.
…
After having lunch and resting for a while, Jack Clark was ready to leave.
“Jack, Jim said he’s taking a spaceship to space in a couple of days, passing through the world passageways there to the mythical world. Do you think it’ll be dangerous?”
In the courtyard, Doris Clark was somewhat worried.
“Don’t worry about him, Mom.”
Jack Clark smiled and said, “Jim got the first prize of the Global Martial Arts Competition this time, and after assimilating it, his cultivation has broken through to the Eighth Layer Peak. His strength is even greater than when I entered the mythical world.”
“Moreover, the external threats around the Human Alliance have been basically eliminated now, so long as he doesn’t run around indiscriminately, he is unlikely to encounter any danger.”
As the true Child of Destiny of the Blue Star World, the first Global Martial Arts Competition was practically Jim’s leveling journey.
Starting from the Triplex and growing all the way, by the time he finished the competition and received all rewards and additional opportunities, he was almost breaking through to the Ninth Heavens.
Adding to that, his Innate talents like Tyrant Body and Gigantification, along with the Top-tier and very compatible Dark Star Body Refining Method, his real combat power was almost comparable to late period Nine Layers, and his Limit Breakthrough was comparable to the peak.
This strength indeed was stronger than Jack Clark when he first entered the mythical world with only the Eighth Layer Early Phase cultivation.
Moreover, when Jack Clark first entered the mythical world, he also had to face being hunted by the Evil God Sect and Purgatory Demon Race demon kings, which was almost full of crises.
As for now, the surroundings are either allies of the Human Alliance or their own people, so there is no need to worry about safety.
The Legendary Realm and above Giant Beasts in the vicinity had also been nearly driven away or slain by Human Experts, so as long as he does not court death, he could grow and develop rapidly.
But Doris Clark didn’t understand all these things, which was why she was a bit worried, just like she had been with Jack Clark in the past.
At this moment, Sherry Williams reminded, “Auntie, remember to take the Heaven Mysterious Secret Dew I gave you, one capsule a day, it can speed up your transformation.”
“And there’s also the matching heart technique Cultivation Method; if you circulate it when you sleep every day, you can cultivate automatically, it won’t interfere with your daily life.”
Speaking of this made Doris Clark smile: “I will definitely remember.”
As a first-time meeting gift, while helping out in the kitchen, Sherry Williams gave Doris Clark a bottle of ‘elixir’ that was gentle in energy and could be used by Low-level cultivators.
In addition, there was a Cultivation Method from the Profound Sky Right Sect, the Spiritual Imprint of which was embedded into Doris Clark’s mind, guiding her to complete her first cultivation.
Originally, Doris Clark was an ordinary person, unable to cultivate.
But previously, due to Jack Clark nearly becoming ‘Heavenly Dao’, his bloodline feedback also substantially enhanced her body.
Now, Doris Clark’s physical condition was roughly similar to a Sixth Layer Senior cultivator, and furthermore, a rich Heavenly Energy was always surrounding Doris Clark, nurturing her body.
This prevented her, who couldn’t cultivate, from becoming weak due to insufficient energy absorption.
Looking at the graceful and pretty woman before her, Doris Clark said with a hint of regret: “Sherry, remember to come and visit when you have time.”
Since she had received gifts, Doris Clark felt a growing fondness for Sherry Williams, whom she met for the first time, finding this pretty girl to be very nice.
“Sure, Auntie. I’ll come visit you when I have time,” Sherry Williams did not decline.
“Mom, we’re leaving,” Jack Clark waved to Doris Clark.
“Go ahead.”
In silence, the two figures who left the courtyard disappeared into thin air, causing all the surrounding cultivators who noticed this scene to breathe a sigh of relief.
Although Jack Clark and Sherry Williams both reined in their aura and pressure, their very presence was a huge mental pressure for those cultivator guards.
And as Doris Clark watched Jack Clark and the others disappear, her face showed a faint look of concern.
She noticed that there were many beautiful girls around Jack Clark.

chapters.title: Chapter 1703 - 1703 629 The Mythical Era The Sixth
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1703: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_3 Chapter 1703: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_3 For instance, Mathilda Ward, who had been seen a few times before, and Jack Clark’s beautiful classmate Freya Louise, both had unique temperaments and appearances.
These girls would make Doris Clark very happy to have as a daughter-in-law.
But when these girls were all gathered together, it gave Doris Clark a bit of a headache, worrying if Jack Clark might invite trouble due to too many romantic entanglements.
Blue Star, at the edge of the atmosphere.
Standing in the Void, Jack Clark turned his head, looking at the beautiful woman with flowing hair beside him: “Sherry, I’m going into closed-door cultivation next, and won’t have time to accompany you, do you want me to help ‘guide’ you around?”
“No need, Brother Clark.” Sherry Williams shook her head: “I’m more convenient on my own, and I’m planning to notify my sister about the situation here once you start your cultivation.”
“If I can manage, perhaps my sister will also come over.”
At this point, Sherry Williams’ face showed interest: “After finishing up my tasks, I plan to take a good look around Blue Star, it has been many years since I’ve seen such a modern civilized society.”
The Six Great Divine Domains are very strong and their civilizations are also very advanced, but this advancement is in the transcendental aspects, not in technology.
Civilizational progress is a thing full of contingencies.
Because of the presence of transcendental powers, the Divine Domains abound with Heavenly Energy and rich resources, naturally, no one would think about how to improve food production while the societal elites and high-intelligence geniuses are all cultivating, in closed-door cultivation.
Under such circumstances, the scientific foundation of modern civilization is naturally weakened.
Even if someone wanted to enhance productivity, they would rely on runes and transcendental powers, like the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Golden Battleship, using energy runs.
After separating from Sherry Williams, Jack Clark’s thought connected to a mysterious power in the obscurity.
Boom!
The sun, emitting scorching radiance, suddenly burst forth with light, its surface erupting in flames, forming tens of hundreds of thousands of kilometers high solar flares, numerous terrifying rays shooting into space.
Hundreds of thousands of kilometers into the sun, close to the core, the eyes of the massive golden-white Mecha slowly lit up, emitting a pale blue-white light.
In front of the gigantic Mecha’s head, blue light converged to form the figure of Freya Louise, who looked delightedly at Jack Clark materializing out of thin air amidst the blazing seas of fire.
“Jack Clark, your wounds have healed,” Freya Louise said cheerfully.
“They have.” Jack Clark smiled slightly, his gaze falling on Number One, its aura strengthened somewhat, thinking deeply.
“Freya, are you also planning to integrate that piece of ‘sky’ as well?”
At this moment, behind the titanic golden-white Mecha, blue light diffused, tinting every moment of the constantly fusing and terrifying energy-emitting star interior into an ethereal world.
As Number One absorbed and digested the Azure Sky World powers, its aura emitted became increasingly ancient.
Freya Louise’s phantom slowly nodded: “This time, with the aid of the Mythical Impact, I managed to touch the core of that world when I drew down a corner of the Primordial Azure Sky.”
“That Azure Sky’s former creator has disappeared, not sure if they have fallen or left, it’s in an ‘ownerless’ state.”
“If we use the World Origin energy of the Solar System World to refine and integrate it with Number One, not only can we erase all the marks of this ancient life, there’s even a hope to become more ancient and break free from the shackles.”
As she merged with Number One, having touched the information of the True Spirit Remnant Soul, Freya Louise’s realm, her understanding of power was already not inferior to that of an Ancient Powerhouse.
It was even higher in certain respects.
Jack Clark slowly nodded: “It’s worth a try, but remember to be careful, if any problems arise, immediately mobilize the Heavenly Dao powers of this world to suppress it.”
Because of Jack Clark’s ‘delegation’ of power, and having been involved from the start, the newly born Solar System World did not repel Freya Louise, making her a perfect executor of the Heavenly Dao.
“Yes,” nodded Freya Louise.
At this moment, Jack Clark thought of something and said: “By the way, Freya, you must have felt it, the person who came back with me this time.”
Freya Louise blinked: “Are you talking about that strong woman who went with you to see aunt?”
As the executor, Freya was aware of Sherry Williams entering the Solar System World right away, but due to some reasons, she was temporarily unable to leave the sun.
Jack Clark nodded: “Yes, that’s her, but Freya, you would never guess, she comes from an Ancient Civilization.”
“Ancient Human Race!” Freya Louise was startled.
“Yes, those Ancient Powerhouses who went on expeditions are still around and they have established the Six Great Divine Domains far away…”
Jack Clark then detailed to Freya Louise the news about the Ancient Divine Domains, the True Emperors, numerous True Spirit Powerhouses below the True Emperor, Chaos Outside Heaven…
After a long while, Freya Louise slowly came back to her senses, the shock on her face slightly fading: “I didn’t expect that those Ancient Emperors are still around, and they have all broken through the Primordial.”
At this point, Freya Louise reacted.
“Wait, Jack, wasn’t there Seven Great Emperors during the initial expedition, how come there are only six Great Divine Domains and six True Emperors, did the remaining one fall?”
Jack Clark shook his head: “I asked Sherry about this, but even she didn’t know the situation of the seventh Emperor, only that he hadn’t fallen.”
“Clearly, the news about the seventh Emperor is a top-secret matter in the Six Great Divine Domains.”
The two continued to chat for a while, then Jack Clark slowly reached out and summoned the ancient Great Seal in Number One’s hand with a slight gesture.
Buzz! The Mark of Heavenly Path emitted a pure white transparent glow, silently appearing in Jack Clark’s hand.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark held the Mark of Heavenly Path, the entire Solar System World slightly trembled, a tremendous tide of energy centered around the sun, sweeping across the whole world.
At this moment, all cultivators keenly felt that something had changed in the world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1704 - 1704 629 The Mythical Era The Sixth
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1704: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_4 Chapter 1704: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_4 It’s like a supreme deity returning to their rightful place, suppressing the universe.
Deep within the hot energy materials, covered by the radiance of Heavenly Dao, Jack Clark exuded an incomparably majestic and vast aura; he nodded slightly towards Freya Louise, then headed deeper towards the sun.
Wherever Jack Clark passed, the intense pressure in front of him, capable of tearing apart Ancient Beasts, silently split the fiery materials open, forming a path.
Holding the Mark of Heavenly Path, Jack Clark easily reached the sun’s core, more than 600,000 kilometers deep.
Here, the density of the material is terrifying; the scorching temperature and magnetic field pressure almost form a twisted forbidden area that even Freya Louise cannot enter.
Yet when Jack Clark arrived at the core region of the sun, he keenly noticed the changes here.
With the infinite influx of Chaos Void Energy, the sun, as the Solar System World Core, also underwent special changes, feeling as if it had been imbued with ‘vitality’.
At this moment, beneath the surface of the sun, Jack Clark ‘saw’ a vortex with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers, where endless hot energy converged to form a massive fireball.
Inside the fireball, which churned like magma material, there was a faint mythical-level life fluctuation.
Inexplicably, the image of a three-legged golden bird engulfed in flames emerged in Jack Clark’s mind.
Additionally, within the sun’s chromosphere, similar regions of atmospheric high temperature also had some hot energy convergence points, where some weak life auras were being nurtured.
The Great Sun Golden Crow, and some flame-type life forms are being nurtured, Jack Clark thought pensively.
Immortal Spirit Clan, Heavenly Feather Clan, Eastern Summer Martial Arts, Simon Mech, Berlin gene-beast transformation—at this moment, Jack Clark inexplicably felt that the ‘Mythical Era’ was truly about to arrive.
Especially with the subsequent intervention and information exchange from the Divine Realm, as well as ‘technological development,’ the development speed of the Human Federation would become even more terrifying.
Possibly covering hundreds or thousands of years of progress in just a few years.
Sigh! Jack Clark slowly exhaled, and the breath caused the entire sun to tremble slightly.
Suppressing the surging emotions in his heart, Jack Clark’s gaze landed on the archaic seal he held in his hands.
With the Mark of Heavenly Path in hand, Jack Clark essentially possessed the strength of an early-stage True Spirit and could mobilize the World Rules of the entire Solar System; his power was almost invincible at the True Spirit Realm.
This was also why he wasn’t particularly concerned about the approaching Divine Realm Delegation.
Regardless if those people were at the late stage of True Spirit or at the peak, without his permission, they would be unable to set foot in the Solar System World, let alone pull the world coordinates to leave this area.
The only thing that made Jack Clark wary was the ‘True Emperor’s Edict’.
According to Sherry Williams, the True Emperor’s Edict contained the Primordial Force of the Primordial True Emperor and could summon an attack from outside the Heavenly Dao, comparable to a primordial strike.
Thousands of years ago when she encountered that Purgatory True Demon, she activated the Edict’s power and summoned the True Emperor’s strength.
It’s just that, at the time, only a tenth of the Edict’s power remained in her hands, and even with the outside World Rules of the Vast World diminishing its strength, it almost obliterated the Purgatory ancestors with a single sword strike.
Had it not been for the Purgatory ancestors devouring all Demon Gods, demon kings, and Purgatory True Demons at the time, and fusing those ‘people”s souls to block the majority of the attack, he would have perished then and there.
Apart from its offensive capabilities, the True Emperor’s Edict also contained other powers, not necessarily for attacking.
For example, using the True Emperor’s strength to shift the location and coordinates of the Solar System.
However, with the Solar System having gone through the second deepening shock and the return of Heavenly Dao, without Jack Clark’s consent, the True Emperor’s Edict is unable to forcefully shift coordinates.
Moreover, under normal conditions, those Divine Realm messengers wouldn’t dare to summon the Primordial Force to descend, to slay or heavily injure Jack Clark, as that would lead to a relentless conflict between the two parties.
Yet although the Mark of Heavenly Path is ‘powerful’, it is a ‘dead object’ once stripped away and cannot unleash its full strength without someone in control.
Including Freya Louise, she could only mobilize a part of the world’s power.
Looking at the floating Mark of Heavenly Path before him, Jack Clark pondered for a moment, and then a transparent river stretching over three thousand meters long appeared behind him, with an illusory, transparent figure standing atop it.
During the previous clash between the two clans, this Time Clone resisted Tyris for one day until its Time Power was exhausted, and ultimately it returned.
Now, Jack Clark was considering whether or not to merge this Time Clone with the Mark of Heavenly Path.
The essence of the Time Mark is to extract a ‘branding’ from a period in Jack Clark’s past, projecting it into the present with the power of time.
Since it belongs to a branding of the past, without the sustainment of time’s power, it will dissipate and cannot defy the underlying rules governing world operation.
However, as the Heavenly Path of a One-side World, the Original World Power is not governed by ‘basic rules’.
If successfully merged, Jack Clark would have a True Spirit Level Heavenly Path Avatar, which would also continue to enhance with the growth of the Solar System World.
Moreover, this Time Mark from the ancient early stage can no longer keep up with Jack Clark’s current cultivation; it is not of much use to keep it.
After all, the enemies he would encounter hereafter all start from at least True Spirit.
Jack Clark was hesitant not because of the strength of merging the Time Mark with the Mark of Heavenly Path, but because once merged, his Divine Power of Time Reincarnation would become ‘incomplete’.
At that time, Jack Clark could only condense up to eight Time Clones, incapable of the union of the nine clones to execute the most potent and pinnacle move of the Time Reincarnation Divine Power.
However, after a slight hesitation, Jack Clark made a decision.
With his rate of strength improvement, he has no hope of condensing all Time True Bodies in the short term, thus Time Reincarnation is actually dispensable for him.
Unless one day he undergoes Closed-door Cultivation for ten years, with the help of the Purple little dragon, he might have a chance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1705 - 1705 629 The Mythical Era The Sixth
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1705: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_5 Chapter 1705: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_5 Jack Clark’s figure behind the small river trembles, as the illusory figure standing above it takes a step, crossing time from the past to arrive, directly pouncing towards the floating Mark of Heavenly Path.
There are no obstacles
It is one with the Mark of Heavenly Path, which is formed by the power of Jack Clark’s flesh and part of his soul will, combined with the world rules of the Solar System.
Boom! The Mark of Heavenly Path shines brilliantly, emitting an incomparably dazzling white glow, piercing through the sun and illuminating the entire world.
At this moment, no one can distinguish whether the light shining on them is from the sun or from the Mark of Heavenly Path.
As countless people look up subconsciously, they vaguely see, atop that endlessly luminous sun, the fleeting illusion of a figure holding the great seal.
The blue and white light in Number One’s eyes flickers, revealing a touch of puzzlement.
In Freya Louise’s perception, it seems as if a second Jack Clark appeared?
Feeling the ‘True Body’ being reshaped inside the Mark of Heavenly Path, and the faint connection, Jack Clark is slightly surprised, not expecting the ‘integration’ to be so simple.
Then he focuses his attention inside his body, ‘observing’ that mysterious power exuding the essence of creation.
Boom! Inside Jack Clark, an even more brilliant white light explodes, almost rendering the solar core white.
Within the shining glow, the shadow of the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane with a diameter of over one hundred thousand kilometers emerges, with space and time around it collapsing, endlessly collapsing towards Jack Clark’s True Body.
Space, matter, Heavenly Energy, and rules, including the Supreme Rule, all begin to integrate with Jack Clark.
Boom boom boom!!
Jack Clark feels all the cells within his body explode at this moment, releasing an indescribable powerful force, as if thousands of planets have exploded.
As a true Plane integrates, Jack Clark’s already formidable body is activated, and in an instant, a surge of extremely potent Qi Blood bursts forth.
Roar!
In the Void, a majestic and fierce Dragon Roar resounds, the invisible power causing the entire sun to shake, startling countless people in an instant.
“His strength, has it become stronger again!?” Freya Louise exclaims, watching this scene.
Outside the atmosphere of Blue Star, looking towards the direction of the sun, Marcellus Larry reflects: “Such an unrivaled monster, rare even in a million years.”
Jack Clark, who has reached the ancient late stage in his cultivation, not only has not slowed down but is instead soaring at a terrifying speed with no end in sight.
At this rate of increase, he might step into the True Spirit Realm within two years.
Marcellus Larry, who has struggled in the Legendary Realm for decades and only recently grasped the chance for breakthrough, cannot understand or imagine this—attributing it only to talent.
In South City, on the busy street, Sherry Williams is also looking up while holding an ice cream, with a smile and admiration in her eyes.
On Saturn, Venus, and Mars, three Main Gods and over a dozen Mythical Powerhouses look up at the shining sun, their faces revealing awe and horror.
“That Human Expert, he’s too terrifying!!”
“Born holy, with the makings of the Primordial!”
As countless people gasp and marvel at the might of Jack Clark’s Closed-door Cultivation, the Giant Beast legions of the Purgatory Demon Race also return to the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, which has almost reached the Ancient Limit and could enter hibernation at any moment to break through to True Spirit, possesses terrifying power and leads the charge, swiftly crossing one forbidden area after another.
Boom!
The moment the Giant Beast legions enter the Chaotic Turbulent Region, an incomparably fierce and brutal pressure envelops billions of kilometers of the domain.
This terrible presence even penetrates various small worlds and space fragments. At this moment, countless Giant Beasts and beings of different races tremble beneath that horrifying pressure.
Even the True Spirit Beast perched on the river of time, ‘fishing,’ cannot help but look up, its gaze piercing through layers of time to fall on the Black Gold Giant Beast.
“It’s that little guy!”
The Time True Spirit Beast entrenched in the river of time reveals surprise in its eyes.
[First update to keep up with the schedule, another two thousand words will follow in an hour, refreshing later. Today’s promised ten thousand words will definitely be written.]
Finally, it dives deeper into the depths of time.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon looks in that direction, piercing through time, but besides ‘seeing’ some ripples, it does not find any trace of that Time True Spirit Beast.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t mind having a battle with that beast before hibernation.
From ‘birth’ until now, the only time it was suppressed was by that beast.
But hibernation doesn’t mean it lacks strength; it can forcefully awaken anytime in the face of danger.
Returning to the Dragon Palace, all the beasts cheer and are shocked.
Phew! Jack slowly exhales a breath, its flow causing the whole sun to slightly tremble.
Suppressing the surging emotions in his heart, Jack Clark’s gaze falls on the ancient great seal he holds in his hand.
With the Mark of Heavenly Path in hand, Jack Clark has the cultivation of the True Spirit Initial Stage and can mobilize the world rules of the entire Solar System, his power nearly invincible in the True Spirit Realm.
This is also why he is not very concerned about the upcoming Divine Realm Delegation.
No matter if those individuals are at the late stage of True Spirit or the peak, they cannot set foot in the Solar System World without his permission, let alone lead the world coordinates away from this region.
The only thing Jack Clark is wary of is the ‘True Emperor’s Edict’.
According to Sherry Williams, the True Emperor’s Edict contains the power of the heavens from the Primordial True Emperor, capable of drawing on extraterrestrial forces to unleash a strike comparable to the Primordial.
Thousands of years ago, when she encountered the Purgatory True Demon, it was by invoking the power of the Edict and drawing on the power of the True Emperor.
But at the time, the strength of the Edict in her hands was barely a tenth of its original power, and with the extraterrestrial rules of the Vast World significantly weakened, even so, it nearly obliterated the Purgatory ancestor in one strike.
Had it not been for the Purgatory ancestor who devoured all the Demon Gods, demon kings, and Purgatory True Demons at the time, merging their ‘human’ souls to block most of the attack, it would have fallen then and there.

﻿Chapter 1706: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_6 Chapter 1706: Chapter 629 The Mythical Era, The Sixth Evolution_6 Apart from attacking, the True Emperor’s Edict also contains other formidable powers.
For instance, using the power of the True Emperor to shift the coordinates and position of the Solar System.
However, since the Solar System has undergone its second deepening impact and the Heavenly Path has been restored, the True Emperor’s Edict cannot forcibly move the coordinates without Jack Clark’s consent.
Moreover, under normal conditions, the messengers of the Divine Realm dare not invoke the Primordial Force to descend and kill or heavily injure Jack Clark, lest they provoke an endless battle.
But the Mark of Heavenly Path, though ‘strong’, becomes a ‘dead object’ after being stripped by Jack Clark; without anyone in control, it cannot unleash its full power.
Including Freya Louise, who can only channel part of the world’s power.
Looking at the floating Mark of Heavenly Path before him, Jack Clark ponders briefly, then behind him appears a transparent long river stretching over three thousand meters, with an ethereal transparent figure standing atop it.
Previously, during the great battle between the two races, this Time Clone resisted Tyris for one day with the power of time exhausted, eventually returning.
Now, Jack Clark is contemplating whether or not to integrate this Time Clone into the Mark of Heavenly Path.
Essentially, the Time Mark extracts an ‘imprint’ from a past period of Jack Clark, reenacting it at present with the power of time.
Since it is an imprint from the past, without the maintenance of time’s power, it will dissipate and cannot contradict the basic rules of the world’s operation.
Yet as the Heavenly Path of a world, the Original World Power is not governed by the ‘basic rules’.
If the integration is successful, Jack Clark will possess a True Spirit Level Heavenly Path Avatar, which will continue to enhance as the Solar System World thrives.
Moreover, this Time Mark from the ancient early stage already lags behind Jack Clark’s current cultivation level, keeping it is of little use.
After all, the enemies he will face next are at least starting from the True Spirit level.
What makes Jack Clark hesitant is that once the Time Mark merges with the Mark of Heavenly Path, losing one imprint will make his Time Reincarnation Divine Power ‘incomplete’.
At that time, Jack Clark could only condense eight Time Clones at most, unable to unite the nine clones and perform the most powerful and pinnacle move of the Time Reincarnation Divine Power.
However, after only a slight hesitation, Jack Clark makes his decision.
Considering the rapid pace of his strength enhancement, he has little hope of gathering all Time True Bodies in the short term; practically making the move of Time Reincarnation somewhat needless.
Unless one day he goes into closed-door cultivation for ten years, collaborating with the Purple Little Dragon might give him a chance.
Behind Jack Clark, the transparent river vibrates, and the ethereal figure standing on it steps forward, crossing time from the past to charge directly at the floating Mark of Heavenly Path.
Without obstruction,
merging directly with the Mark of Heavenly Path—the very representation of Jack Clark’s physical strength and part of his Soul Will, combined with the world rules of the Solar System.
Boom! The Mark of Heavenly Path bursts into radiance, emitting an incredibly brilliant white light, permeating the sun and illuminating the entire world.
At this moment, no one can distinguish whether the light falling on them is sunlight or the brilliance of the Heavenly Path.
As countless people subconsciously look up, they faintly see a shadow with a great seal passing over the endlessly bright sun.
Number One’s eyes shine with blue and white light, revealing a trace of confusion.
In Freya Louise’s perception, it seems like a second Jack Clark has appeared?
Feeling the ‘True Body’ being reshaped inside the Mark of Heavenly Path, along with a faint connection, Jack Clark is somewhat surprised, not expecting the ‘integration’ to be so simple.
Then he shifts his focus inward, ‘observing’ that mysterious world-creating force inside him.
Boom! An even more dazzling white light explodes inside Jack Clark, the intense light almost rendering the sun’s core white.
Within the brilliant radiance, a space-time of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder spanning over a hundred thousand kilometers appears as a phantom, the surrounding space-time collapses, endlessly collapsing toward Jack Clark’s True Body.
Space, matter, Heavenly Energy, rules, and even the Supreme Rules, all began to merge with Jack Clark.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Jack Clark feels all the cells in his body explosively burst in an instant, releasing an indescribable mighty power, as if thousands of planets were exploding.
As a real plane merges, Jack Clark’s already immensely powerful body is stimulated, and in an instant, a mighty surge of Qi Blood erupts.
Roar!
In the Void, a majestic and fierce Dragon Roar resonates, the invisible strength causing the entire sun to shake, startling countless people instantly.
“His strength… has grown stronger!?” Freya Louise exclaims while watching this scene.
Outside the atmosphere of Blue Star, Marcellus Larry who looks towards the sun, marvels: “Such a freak of nature only appears once in a million years.”
Jack Clark, whose cultivation has reached the ancient late stage, not only hasn’t slowed down but is even skyrocketing at a terrifyingly limitless pace.
At this rate, he might step into the True Spirit within two years.
Making Sherry Williams, who has struggled in the Legendary Realm for decades and only recently sensed a breakthrough opportunity, unable to understand or imagine, only attributing it to talent.
In South City, on the bustling street, Sherry Williams, holding an ice cream, also looks up, her eyes revealing a smile and admiration.
On Saturn, Venus, and Mars, the three Main Gods and over a dozen Mythical Powerhouses look up at the shining sun, their faces showing fear and astonishment.
“That Human Expert is too terrifying!!”
“Born divine, with Primordial qualifications!”
While countless people exclaim in shock at Jack Clark’s retreat prowess, the Giant Beast legions of the Purgatory Demon Race also return to the Chaotic Turbulent Region.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon, almost reaching the Ancient Limit and ready to hibernate and break through to True Spirit, is unbearably terrifying; under its lead, they charge directly, swiftly crossing through various forbidden areas.
Boom!
The moment the Giant Beast legions enter the Chaotic Turbulent Region, an extremely brutal and ferocious pressure envelops billions of kilometers of the region.
This terrifying hegemony even permeates various minor worlds and space fragments, causing countless beasts and different races to tremble under this frightening pressure.
Even the True Spirit Beast stationed in this period of Time River, who is ‘fishing’, cannot help but look up, his gaze penetrating layers of time to fall on that Black Gold Giant Beast.
“It’s that little guy!”
The True Spirit Beast, perched on the Time River, reveals astonishment in its eyes.
