chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1707: Chapter 630: Tenfold Heavenly Gate, Super Divine Lifeline Talent Chapter 1707: Chapter 630: Tenfold Heavenly Gate, Super Divine Lifeline Talent At the very moment when Jack Clark confirmed his Evolution.
In the Chaotic Turbulent Region, within the depths of the Destruction Emperor Dragon that has ascended to a height of 10,000 kilometers in the high altitude, the Evolution Energy that had been accumulating since the Deification Realm burst forth like a mountain flood.
Boom!
Centered on the Destruction Emperor Dragon, endless golden-red lightning spread out in all directions, illuminating the dark and oppressive Chaotic Turbulent Region, the pervasive aura of chaos and destruction like Doomsday descending.
Within the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Rule Origin boiled like water, emitting a dazzling light, and apparent sequences of rules emerged like reality, permeating the surrounding space, the Void, the entire world.
As the rules began to fuse with Heaven and Earth, to merge with the mythical world, the terrifying physical strength of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was fully unleashed, its hot Qi Blood trembling the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region like the radiance of a great steady star.
Among them, there was a vibration of the World Star Core of the Chaotic Turbulent Region that had once been absorbed and refined.
Boom!
Under the influence of the same origin of power, the energy of Heaven and Earth within the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region suddenly surged wildly, bringing with it the essence of Heaven and Earth towards the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Because the energy gathered was so immense, it formed colorful rays of light that extended for millions to tens of millions of kilometers.
Finally, they converged around the Destruction Emperor Dragon, which continued to rise and reached an altitude of over 100,000 kilometers, forming a colorful vortex with a diameter of a million kilometers, dense as a mountain.
Such a majestic spectacle greatly excited and shocked the countless Giant Beasts of the Dragon Palace Empire on the earth below.
Roar!
Above the Firmament, a majestic and profound Dragon Roar bellowed, echoing through Heaven and Earth. Within the swirling layers of colorful clouds, a vaguely discernible giant shadow, stretching over hundreds of thousands of kilometers, lay coiled.
That was an illusion reflected by the scorching and majestic Qi Blood of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, and in an instant, an awe-inspiring pressure as if “Heaven” had descended erupted.
Bang bang bang!!
As the earth shattered and smoke and dust billowed, under the supreme presence of the Heavenly Tier bloodline, neither the Ancient Beasts nor ordinary Extraordinary Giant Beasts could stand upright.
“Roar! Worthy of being the king, even just the momentum of the breakthrough is this terrifying.”
The nine dragon heads of an Ancient Lava Giant Beast lying on the ground trembled as they lifted, their eyes showing reverence and longing; the reactions of other Ancient Beasts were similar.
Especially the Blue-White Giant Dragon, whose eyes filled with a faint shock and a sense of poignancy.
After all, just five Sun Wheels ago, this terrifying beast had only just entered the Vast World, measuring a mere 700-plus meters in length, completely a little one.
Its age was only one year old.
At that time, the Blue-White Giant Dragon knew this ‘indigenous’ beast held limitless potential, and coupled with the attention it paid to its daughter Scythia, it also bestowed upon it a generous amount of Divine Objects.
But even if it cracked open its head, the Blue-White Giant Dragon could not have imagined the terror that the beast represented.
In just what it thought of as ‘five days,’ the beast had grown to the peak of the ancients, its combat power unrivalled, having Reverse Defeated and Suppressed the Purgatory Demon Ancestor at the Pinnacle of True Spirit.
“Perhaps its limit is not merely Primordial,” the Blue-White Giant Dragon’s eyes gradually showed disbelief.
Given the growth rate and talent shown by the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the Blue-White Giant Dragon felt that in less than a year, it would become a Primordial Level Giant Beast, shining brightly in Heaven and Earth.
And then, it would challenge that utmost eternal realm.
After all, even by age, the Destruction Emperor Dragon who would become Primordial only a year later would still be just two years old!!
As the countless Giant Beasts below were excited and shaken, the true body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon also began to Transform, with countless Talent Runes emerging within its body, forming billions upon billions of chains covering its entire form.
Bang bang bang!!
Above the Firmament, a sky filled with Golden-White flames burned, emitting a horrifying high temperature that melted space, transforming into a layer of apocalyptic sea of fire hanging above.
Following that were rumbling Blue-purple Thunders spreading out in all directions, like winding millions of kilometers long terrifying Thunder Dragons, followed by black lightning that would destroy Heaven and Earth…
This breakthrough, somewhat similar to the previous bloodline advancement to the Heavenly Tier, allowed all the talents of the Destruction Emperor Dragon to emerge again under the Evolution Energy in a pure strength form.
Radiant and multi-colored, destroying everything around, forming a Chaotic colorful light ring spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, Devouring all surrounding energy.
Just like human cultivators, Giant Beasts require a fusion of the Giant Beast Body with rules during a breakthrough to become a Rule Level terrifying Giant Beast.
Unlike cultivators who need to break through the limits of Heaven and Earth and gain recognition from the mythical world, ‘indigenous’ Giant Beasts can directly merge with Heaven and Earth.
Of course, a lesser difficulty does not mean that all Ancient Giant Beasts at their peak can become True Spirits; the few Giant Beasts that do successfully breakthrough are still a minority.
Should the breakthrough fail, the bodies of these beasts will collapse with the rules, transforming into mountain ranges or plains to contribute back to Heaven and Earth.
A few stronger beasts will become petrified, turning into ancient creatures lying in Hibernation like mountain ranges, with the remnants of their Divine Soul Source continuing to harness power in the hope of one day being revived as True Spirits.
The key to success or failure lies in the Ancient Giant Beast’s breakthrough, when rules merge into Heaven and Earth, smelt the Power of Heaven and Earth to reforge the rule body and condense the Lifeline Talent.
In this respect, it was incredibly simple for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
The Chaos Doomsday Rule, forged by ten complete Higher-order Rules, was immensely powerful, instantly enveloping a range of millions of kilometers and invoking the Power of Heaven and Earth from the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region.
Just as the Destruction Emperor Dragon was about to hibernate, smelt the endless Power of Heaven and Earth, and begin to reforge its rule body, its consciousness suddenly thundered.
Boom!
Under the Invisible Power, the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s consciousness once more entered the colorful depth of the World Origin, where an ancient Great Path Character ‘Cang’ hovered.
The moment his consciousness arrived there, a stream of information emerged in the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1708 - 1708 630 Tenfold Heavenly Gate Super Divine
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1708: Chapter 630: Tenfold Heavenly Gate, Super Divine Lifeline Talent 2 Chapter 1708: Chapter 630: Tenfold Heavenly Gate, Super Divine Lifeline Talent 2 Absorbing the Creation Force from the depths of the mythical world’s origin, refining his Lifeline Talent.
This privilege was originally only reserved for True Spirit Beasts during their breakthrough into the Primordial Realm, when their true names, along with their strength, delved deeper into the mythical world’s origin to touch upon the Creation Force.
Absorbing the Creation Force from the depths of the mythical world’s origin, transforming the rules and the True Body into the Primordial Force, Primordial Body.
Simultaneously refining a talent that has evolved to ‘Deification’, consolidating other talent characteristics to form a more powerful Lifeline Talent, possessing terrifying power that defies the rules.
A power that transcends ‘all gods’.
As a Heavenly Tier life, the true name ‘Cang’ gathered by the Destruction Emperor Dragon is even deeper than those Primordial Beasts who have just broken through.
It’s just that in the past its Growth Level was too low, and the Divine Soul Intent could not autonomously merge with the true name, hence it could not touch the Creation Force.
As for Deification Talent… Destruction Emperor Dragon’s ten talents have been enhanced by Jack Clark to the realm of Deification, reaching an unsurpassable godly status.
In the past, constrained by the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s growth realm, the performance of the Deification Talent wasn’t particularly strong.
When initially breaking through the Legendary Realm, the Deification Talent’s converted rules and Top Tier Talent were only Higher-order Laws, though they belonged to a branch of the Supreme Law.
Thus, overall, it did not seem much different from Top Tier Talents.
It was only now that the Destruction Emperor Dragon has broken through to True Spirit, that the Deification Talent truly showcased its potential, with Deification Talent as the core, the Creation Force as the kindling, refining the Lifeline Talent.
However, immediately afterward, a surge of information emerged within the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s heart, a reminder from the subconscious of the bloodline.
“Can only one kind be refined?” Destruction Emperor Dragon’s consciousness trembled, a tinge of regret surfacing.
Since it is through the body of True Spirit that the Lifeline Talent is condensed across ranks, even the strong True Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon can only prematurely refine one.
Just occupying the additional talent ‘slot’ that came with this evolution.
Originally, after the Destruction Emperor Dragon planned to break through to True Spirit, it aimed to carefully select a suitable power and consume the giant beast to absorb the eleventh talent.
Nevertheless, as a primordial inherent ability, it’s obviously better to condense it earlier.
Compared to those beasts who have just broken through to Primordial, owning only a few Top Tier Talents and one or two Deification Talents, the advantage of Destruction Emperor Dragon is even more terrifying.
Ten Deification Talents signify it can combine ten terrifying Lifeline Talents, plus its True Body which is hundreds of times stronger than its peers, and the Supreme Rules.
Once stepping into Primordial, the power of the Destruction Emperor Dragon could be even more exaggerated, sweeping through its peers.
Suppressing the urge to hibernate emitting from its body, Destruction Emperor Dragon’s Sea of Consciousness trembled, with ten phantoms of the black, golden, blue, purple, and golden ‘Destruction Emperor Dragon’ manifesting.
Each phantom represents one Deification Talent.
Refining the Lifeline Divine Power and breaking through the Ancient Realm, the fusion of ten Higher-order Laws to forge the Supreme Rule is different; merging different types of Talent Sequence Chains could even have opposite effects.
This refined Lifeline Talent is very crucial for the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
It relates to whether its strength after breaking through to True Spirit compares to the Pinnacle of True Spirit, is a half-step to Primordial, or even breaking boundaries to forcefully clash with Primordial.
Thus, after only a slight hesitation, Destruction Emperor Dragon’s gaze fell on Chaos Dominant Body, Vajra Immortal, Deep Red Destruction, and Chaotic Force Field as talents.
Chaos Dominant Body represents strength, Vajra Immortal and Chaotic Force Field represent physical Defense and energy Defense, while Deep Red Destruction is further destruction and Burst.
With Chaos Dominant Body as the main, and three Deification Talents as auxiliary, if successful in forging, the acquired Lifeline ability should be an enhanced version of the Doomsday Deep Red Destruction Form.
At that time, the power advantage of the Destruction Emperor Dragon would further unleash.
Moreover, Destruction Emperor Dragon also considers the Instantaneous Divine Shift Talent representing speed, and the Undying Force of Vitality as alternatives.
If the forging goes smoothly, add them in; if obstructed, then stop and readjust.
At the moment when Destruction Emperor Dragon made a decision, within the colorful depths of the Origin, the true name ‘Cang’ vibrated, emitting a strong suction force.
Instantly, streams of black, red, and blue Origin emerged around, continuously flowing into the true name ‘Cang’, disappearing from sight.
In the perceptions of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, these colored Origins were autonomously converging and merging within the true name, gradually forming strands of translucent White Light.
This Breath of Creation, through the connection between the true name and the True Body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon, passed through an invisible pathway and appeared within the body of the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Boom!
A more terrifying Aura burst from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, its entire body’s blood boiling, and the Talent Runes merging with countless cells shining brightly.
Subsequently, consciousness fell into Hibernation.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon broke through, with the True Body forged into an endless Power of Heaven and Earth turning it into a Rule World Body, its power soared at a terrifying speed.
Similarly, within the Solar System where Jack Clarkwas in Closed-door Cultivation, strands of Evolution Energy and faint Breath of Creation continuously emerged in the Soul Channel.
Instantly merging with the Supreme Rule, Jack Clark’s Aura integrated with the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane surged once again.
The invisible emission of power fluctuations and intense gravity caused the sun to tremble again, with the core’s endless nuclear energy erupting, forming streams of flames tens or hundreds of thousands of kilometers long.
The sudden abnormality made Freya Louise, who had just closed her eyes, startle once more.
Meanwhile, throughout the entire Solar System, all cultivators of high-order and above keenly felt the sun becoming hotter and even larger in size.

chapters.title: Chapter 1709 - 1709 630 Tenfold Heavenly Gate Super Divine
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1709: Chapter 630: Tenfold Heavenly Gate, Super Divine Lifeline Talent_3 Chapter 1709: Chapter 630: Tenfold Heavenly Gate, Super Divine Lifeline Talent_3 In the Capital City of the Simon Empire, Sherry Williams, who appeared at some unknown time, stood on the bustling street. She held a printed sun umbrella in her hand, looking up at the sun with a hint of awe.
“Brother Clark’s aura has become even more powerful.”
Separated by hundreds of millions of kilometers, just through the sunlight, Sherry Williams felt an invisible oppressive force.
It was as if not an emperor from the ancient late stage, but a ruler from the mid or even late stage of True Spirit was in closed-door cultivation—an unimaginably strong being.
While Jack Clark’s true body was continuously strengthened by the influx of Evolution Energy, enhancing its might, his consciousness briefly awoke.
Sensing the faint power that was arising within, Jack Clark pondered, “So, the force of creation has this use as well.”
The Creation Force that he gained from the Ancient Dueling Arena was only enough for him to integrate one Supreme Law, normally sufficient to break through to the peak of the ancient stage and consolidate it before considering a breakthrough to the True Spirit level.
But Jack Clark was different. He mastered two Supreme Rules; therefore, there would still be some distance before he could breakthrough to True Spirit when the time came.
Boom!
The inside of Jack Clark’s body vibrated, waves of Primordial Genesis Rule power emerged, separating those faint Breath of Creation from his body and collecting them together.
These Breath of Creation could also enhance the strength of his true body, but using them here seemed somewhat wasteful.
Jack Clark intended to see—if the Breath of Creation that was transmitted by the Destruction Emperor Dragon could condense into one and was sufficient to integrate the Primordial Genesis Rule, he would merge the rule.
If it wasn’t enough, he would use it to strengthen the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate, and deduce the Tenth Heavenly Gate.
Or rather, compared to merging the Primordial Genesis Rule, the benefits of the Tenth Heavenly Gate might be greater, achieving a power increase of a thousandfold base strength, which might not be less than the Lifeline Talent that was about to be born from the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Huff! Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Jack Clark’s consciousness once again sank into silence.
As the Destruction Emperor Dragon evolved and went into hibernation, as Jack Clark went into seclusion, time rapidly passed. On Blue Star, Mars, and Venus, earth-shattering changes were happening every day.
Especially on Blue Star, as the Heavenly Energy grew richer—even morning mists were gatherings of energy—suddenly, a global cultivation craze erupted.
Men and women, young and old—all who longed for strength, dreamed of flying and immortality.
In the past, the world was barren, and cultivation was only for the few.
But now, a New Age had arrived.
Even without cultivation talent, one could still practice the official Basic Body Refining Technique, gradually strengthening the body by absorbing the Heavenly Earth Energy.
As long as one could cultivate to the Third Layer, they could join the officials to continue body refining, or specialize in True Martial, Genetic Martial Arts, or Mecha Martial Arts.
Not only humans but countless animals on Blue Star, even insects, were mutating under the dense Heavenly Energy. The increasingly rich oceanic life was seething.
…
Roar!
On the glittering sea surface, a hundred-meter-long giant creature covered in black-and-white scales, which looked like a Black Tiger Whale, roared. Its tail fluke slammed down fiercely.
Boom!
The sea surface exploded, and the Giant Beast’s massive body shot up towards the sky. After reaching a kilometer in height, it crashed back down onto the sea, raising a sky-full of water spray.
Thump, thump, thump!!
The mighty aura of an Eighth Level Beast permeated the area, causing the nearby water to churn, and countless fish, some meters to over ten meters long, burst out of the water, fleeing in all directions.
At once, the Eighth Level Tiger Whale Giant Beast let out an even more excited roar, its aura brutal and uncontrolled.
Above the firmament at ten thousand meters, shrouded in Cloud Mist, Sherry Williams stood in the Void, overlooking below with a faint smile on her face: “This really is a world brimming with vitality.”
“And it’s also the world protected by Brother Clark, the Ancestral Land of the Human Race.”
Saying this, Sherry Williams turned her head to look behind her, where an extraordinary ‘altar’ emerged amidst floating clouds.
The altar stood fifty meters high, made of white boulders, shaped according to the Eight Diagrams, with many Ancient Runes inscribed upon it—somewhat similar to the Ancient Coordinates found in the Lost World.
But unlike that coordinate, this altar was even more complex, with a token inscribed with the word ‘Entombment’ slowly levitating above it.
Moreover, surrounding the altar were seven black steles, each a kilometer tall and a hundred meters wide.
On each stele was inscribed an ancient character, which were respectively: Henry, Void, War, Ancient, Radiance, Wheel, Sword, all of which emitted a Mysterious Aura.
Looking at the unresponsive altar, Sherry Williams sighed, “The Emperor’s Altar still hasn’t reacted until now; it seems my sister hasn’t come back from Chaos Outside Heaven.”
The mythical world is vast, filled with zones that disrupt both time-space and the rules of Heaven and Earth.
Even the ancient Human Race, once the distance exceeds a certain range, finds it extremely difficult to communicate with each other. Information transmitted through rules may also be cut off.
Only entities at the Primordial Level can ignore the restrictions of the rules of Heaven and Earth and communicate instantly across vast distances with a mere thought.
But even Primordial Powerhouses face limitations if they are outside the chaotic realms of Heaven, as one is within the mythical world and the other is beyond it.
Just as Sherry Williams was about to turn away from the altar and continue wandering around Blue Star,
Hum!
Seven steles inscribed with the real names of Ancient Emperors vibrated, emitting invisible fluctuations like an invisible signal piercing the sky, passing through the Solar System World, the Firmament of the mythical world.
Instantly, another stream of information descended from an infinite distance along the stele’s signal.
Boom! The altar shook, the token inscribed with ‘Burial of Heaven’ bursting with brilliance, spreading golden light, rendering this world into a golden starry sky.
In the starry sky, silver amber rippled, with a pavilion by its side, where a stunningly beautiful woman with black hair draped over her shoulders, dressed in a white and gold-edged divine outfit, sat within.
Compared to Sherry Williams, Sara Williams had an even more noble aura, especially the Great Sun mark on her forehead, emanating a faint undying and mysterious meaning.
As if a splendid Great Sun hung in the sky, full of dignity.
Sherry Williams excitedly said: “Sister, I’ve finally gotten in touch with you, I found Brother Clark.”
“What! You found Brother Clark?” Sara Williams suddenly stood up, a powerful aura bursting forth, shaking the entire starry sky.
Sara Williams was a bit excited.
Sherry Williams nodded: “Yes, I found Brother Clark, he’s on the Ancestral Land side.”
Sara Williams took a deep breath, suppressing the excitement in her heart, her voice trembling slightly: “So that’s why we couldn’t find any trace of his existence.”
“Very good, Sherry, you did well this time, you haven’t been running around to no avail for so long.”
A smile couldn’t help but appear on Sara Williams’s face as she sat down again: “It’s been ten thousand years. Brother Clark’s cultivation must have gotten higher, right? Is he about to make a breakthrough to Primordial?”
“No, Brother Clark is still a long way from reaching the Primordial level.” Sherry Williams shook her head.
“A long way away?”
Sara Williams was stunned: “How is that possible, Brother Clark’s talent is clearly higher than ours.”
“Brother Clark’s talent is definitely higher than ours, it’s just that he has cultivated for too short a time, so he is now at the ancient late stage, attempting to break through to the peak of the ancient.”
As she spoke, without waiting for Sara Williams who had doubt in her eyes to speak, Sherry Williams cheerfully said: “Sister, you definitely wouldn’t guess that Brother Clark is only eighteen years old?”
Cough cough!!
The projected image of Sara Williams nearly choked, even someone as strong as she was ‘lost control’ a bit upon hearing that Jack Clark was only eighteen.
“Eighteen years old, Sherry, are you sure you’re not joking?” Sara Williams was somewhat stunned.
Sherry Williams was very pleased with Sara Williams’s reaction, smiling with a light-hearted tone: “There’s no way I would joke about this, I’ve also confirmed it through multiple sources.”
“I can be one hundred percent certain, Brother Clark is only eighteen years old.”
These past few days, Sherry Williams had been touring around Blue Star, understanding the development history of the Human Federation.
Although she believed Jack Clark and the others, as the Vice Hall Master of the Flame Wheel Divine Domain’s Heaven Observation Hall, she also had a responsibility to the Imperial Dynasty, gathering firsthand information about the Ancestral Land.
Especially the news about Jack Clark, she paid more attention to.
As a True Spirit Level entity, she could almost invade the Federation’s ‘Heaven Network’ with a mere thought, including the Heavenly Think Tank, leaving no information hidden from her.
Sara Williams exhaled, pressing down the shock in her heart once more.
“Alright, stop teasing, tell me all the news you know, starting with Brother Clark.”
“Hehe, no problem.”
Sherry Williams said with a grin: “Brother Clark really is only eighteen years old. He met us after being caught in a Time Storm and got stranded over ten thousand years back in time…”
Next, Sherry Williams recounted all the information about Jack Clark and Blue Star in its entirety.
[There’s still a thousand-character proofreading update coming, brothers refresh in half an hour, updating first]

﻿Chapter 1710: Chapter 631: True Emperor Takes Action, Child of the Plane Chapter 1710: Chapter 631: True Emperor Takes Action, Child of the Plane There was no earth, no plants, no living beings, only a gentle white mist that pervaded the space between heaven and earth, and a massive phantom, like a star, appeared.
The phantom was somewhat blurred, resembling a woman dressed in a luxurious white gold imperial robe, wearing an imperial crown, holding the Great Sun, with endless red flames burning behind her.
Moreover, this towering phantom, showing only its upper body, reached a height of over a hundred thousand kilometers, emanating an indescribably terrifying pressure, causing the surrounding space-time to distort.
The towering phantom looked down, observing the figure of Sara Williams hidden in the Cloud Mist below, and slowly spoke up, her deep and dignified voice resonating across the entire world.
“Sherry, you have entered the Outer Battle City and initiated the Summoning to the Cloud Azure Heavenly Domain. What important matter do you have?”
“Yes, Master, your disciple has a very important matter to report.”
From within the mist, the partially visible figure of Sara Williams respectfully said, “The emergence of our ancestral land occurred not far from here, and Sherry hurried to that place, only to be utterly astonished upon arriving.”
“In the ancestral land, a person used less than two years, equivalent to about fifteen Sun Wheels in the Vast World, to transition from an ordinary person to a Transcendent, culminating in reaching the Peak of the Ancient Monarch King.”
Boom!
At that moment, a supremely powerful will Burst forth from the towering phantom, causing even the sky to shake continuously, her tone infused with a hint of surprise.
“Fifteen Sun Wheels, are you certain there’s no mistake?”
A normal year and a half to advance from an ordinary person to the Peak of the Ancient Monarch King Realm – even this Primordial True Emperor was somewhat astounded to hear it.
Sara Williams respectfully said, “Sherry has verified this from multiple sources; indeed, it took that person only fifteen Sun Wheels to attain such a level.”
“The ancestral land, over fifty years ago, bordered the Vast World and initiated the Transcendent Era, meanwhile uncovering the Inheritance you left behind in those days.”
“Assisted by the Inheritance, the ancestral land rose swiftly, establishing a force named the Federation, from which emerged three Ancient Powerhouses, over ten Titan Monarch Kings, and dozens of Mythic War Generals within decades.”
“It’s just that the area bordering the ancestral land contains a mighty civilization overseen by a Hibernating True Spirit, known as the Purgatory Demon, and is simultaneously at war with several neighboring civilizations.”
“The Human Federation was initially disadvantaged, constantly facing the threat of annihilation, but with the advent of a genius named Jack Clark, it quickly ascended.”
“In just a little more than a year’s time, the Purgatory Demon Race was eradicated, including the awakened True Demon with Pinnacle of True Spirit strength, who was also Suppressed.”
“Peak Ancient Realm, Suppressing a Pinnacle of True Spirit Purgatory True Demon!?” Sparkling Heaven True Emperor paused.
“…Master, it wasn’t Jack Clark who killed the Purgatory True Demon.” Sara Williams also knew that she might have exaggerated and felt somewhat embarrassed.
“Not only did an Unparalleled Monster like Brother Clark appear this time in the ancestral land, but also a mutated Giant Beast, whose talent is equally terrifying.”
“According to the documentation that Sherry found, this Giant Beast appeared about ten Sun Wheels ago, at that time at the Seventh Tier, but now it has grown to the Peak of the Ancient…”
Sara Williams then meticulously recounted the recorded growth progression of the Destruction Emperor Dragon and its ‘Summoning’ relationship with Jack Clark.
She included the frightening growth speed, being peerless within the same rank, the ability to leap over a Major Realm and fight across ranks after surpassing the Ancient Realm, tearing apart enemies with terrifying combat power.
Once Sara Williams had finished speaking, even the Sparkling Heaven True Emperor remained stunned for a long time.
She never imagined that the ancestral land would actually witness the emergence of two such terrifying ‘monsters’ – one human and one beast, whose innate abilities were so shocking that even she felt shaken.
Even during their era, there had never been such exaggeratedly unique beings.
The one known for the fastest cultivation speed, who went from an ordinary person to Enlightenment in one day, reaching the Mythic War General Realm, even took seven years to breakthrough to the Ancient Monarch King Realm, and twenty years to become a Monarch.
Yet that Unparalleled Genius named Jack Clark, with his still rampant and bottle-neck free terrifying cultivation speed, might be able to ascend to Monarch in just two years.
Monarch in two years, Primordial in five? And Eternal within a hundred?
Thinking of this, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor slowly exhaled, her voice full of horrific pressure shaking the world.
“Sara, you’ve done well this time. Compared to the ‘importance’ of the ancestral land, this genius named Jack Clark is even more important to the Human Divine Domain.”
“Should news of his existence leak, True Emperor Level strong beings will make a move, crossing Space-Time and reversing causality to attack.”
“Wait, Jack Clark – I recall the Williams sisters seemed to have been searching for someone named Jack Clark over these ten thousand years, right?” Just then, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor reacted.
As her disciples, the Williams sisters had been investigating Jack Clark for ten thousand years, and she had paid attention to it as well.
It was only that the news of someone seventeen years old, breaking through to the Peak of the Ancient Realm in less than two years, had been too shocking for her to almost overlook this point.
“Yes, Master, your disciple has been searching for Brother Clark’s trail all along, and this Jack Clark is him.”
“Including the recently slightly famous incident in the Ancient Dueling Arena where Darren Callum, who slaughtered the bloodline of Heavenly Gods of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe and the Ancient Overlord of the You Tian War God Clan, is also him.
“I didn’t expect you two to have this relationship,” Sparkling Heaven True Emperor nodded slowly.
“Tell Sherry that when Jack Clark is ready to head to the Human Divine Domain, bring him directly to the Outer Imperial City; I will be stationed there during this period.”
“Master is preparing to meet Brother Clark?”
“Mm.”
Sparkling Heaven True Emperor slowly nodded: “As mentioned earlier, if his existence is discovered by other Peak Civilizations, True Emperor Level strong beings will attack immediately.”
“Therefore, I am planning to find Henry, to have him act and veil Jack Clark’s true identity, so that even the strong who are proficient in prophecy, destiny, and causality will be unable to trace his whereabouts.”

﻿Chapter 1711: Chapter 631: True Emperor Takes Action, Child of the Plane_2 Chapter 1711: Chapter 631: True Emperor Takes Action, Child of the Plane_2 “Just keep a low profile, and he should not encounter danger in the short term.”
Just like the assassination of geniuses between the Human Federation and the Purgatory Demon Race, it’s not peaceful on the side of the ancient Human Race either.
The vast range of influence, only civilizations and tribes of the same level can contend with them, and over tens of thousands of years, some of them have become enemies.
Slaughtering enemy geniuses on the Divine Realm and the frontal battles in the Chaos Void, depleting their living forces, including infiltrating the Divine Realm to probe or convert traitors, are all methods used to their extremes.
Therefore, Jack Clark’s situation is very dangerous.
If those peak civilizations know of his existence, he will instantly face a horrific assassination, even those neutral or friendly civilization powerhouses will secretly make their moves.
Because no one wants another civilization, race, to bring forth a strong man who might attain Eternity.
Such existences, when they appear, will come with endless bloody slaughter, the bones of the defeated enough to cover the Earth, and the blood sea rising to the sky.
“Sara, give this decree to Sherry, and have her pass it to Jack Clark; it contains the ‘insights’ from when I first opened up the Divine Realm.”
Having seen the entire history of developments in Blue Star up till now and the anomalies around Jack Clark, Sherry Williams now understands that the Solar System World has been successfully upheld.
Thus, the insights of the Divine Realm opened by the Blazing Heaven True Emperor will help Jack Clark in some ways.
…
In the mythical world, a hundred-kilometer-long golden flying craft, like a golden shuttle, rapidly flies across the ten thousand kilometer high sky, leaving behind a pitch-black pathway.
The violent Heavenly Energy, chaotic rules, and fractured space-time, all penetrated by the Golden Shuttle.
Unstoppable, cannot be blocked.
Currently, inside the expanded space of the Golden Shuttle, it resembled an ancient, majestic city with mountains and rivers, beautiful palaces, and mists swirling around like a fairyland.
Above a towering divine tower, standing ten thousand meters high, six young men and women, wearing robes, training attire, or long dresses, emitting the aura of True Spirits, chatted.
Their topic was about the Ancestral Land of the Human Race.
But at this moment, the silver-haired youth at the main seat suddenly paused, then abruptly stood up, a golden token engraved with the character “Sparkling” appeared in his hand.
The token emitted rings of red lights, like flames, under which the surroundings turned ethereal, transforming into an illusory world filled with red flames.
The blazing flames at the edge of the world converged, forming a pair of star-like flaming eyes, filled with terrifying pressure.
Immediately, the five True Spirits dared not neglect, all of them bowed respectfully: “We greet His Majesty, the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, and welcome the descent of your will.”
The silver-haired youth also showed respectful colors: “Your remote descendant Rex, meets the Ancestor.”
“No need for excessive formalities.”
A deep, authoritative voice resonated in the Flame World: “My will descends this time to inform you that the situation has changed. There’s no need to go to the Ancestral Land of the Human Race.”
“No need to go there.” All six True Spirit powerhouses were stunned.
The burning eyes coldly and authoritatively looked on, without an explanation, directly said: “And not just not going, but I will also seal all your memories regarding the Ancestral Land.”
“As for the team members accompanying you, I will also borrow Rex’s hand to erase their memories regarding this trip.”
“Now, lower your Divine Soul defenses.”
“…Yes, Your Majesty Blazing Heaven.” The five True Spirit powerhouses from other Divine Realms hesitated briefly before respectfully complying.
Facing the existence of a True Emperor with supreme authority, these powerhouses, the weakest among them being mid-period True Spirits, did not dare to question, even though each was from a royal family of a Divine Realm.
Each True Emperor of the Six Domains of Human race represents an existence surpassing the ordinary Primordial beings and shares ties of kinship.
When the will of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor descends to order the sealing of part of their memories, it signifies that other True Emperors are already aware and have agreed.
Boom!
A terrifying power within the silver-haired youth was activated, his silver hair wildly dancing, red flames gathered behind him, forming a phantom of a woman dressed in a golden-white Imperial Robe.
One could see her holding a Great Sun, the firelight blazing brightly, emitting light that pierced through those True Spirit powerhouses, penetrating every person and object in the Golden Shuttle Flying City.
Buzz! A hundred-kilometer-long Golden Shuttle trembled slightly and then abruptly hovered in mid-air.
Several minutes later, the Golden Shuttle turned around and disappeared into the horizon in the blink of an eye.
In the Human Alliance, after Sherry Williams suddenly convened a meeting for those above the Myth level, information about Jack Clark inexplicably began disappearing within the Human Alliance.
Including online discussion popularity, topics, and even past deeds and legends progressively being erased by a force.
Only ordinary people were unaware of these changes.
In this New Era where intense changes occur daily, everyone is striving to catch the tide of the era to reach the pinnacle and ascend to divinity and royalty.
In the mythical world, under the shadow of the colossal golden tree that spanned tens of thousands of kilometers, stood Justin Welan, Zac Maben, White Veil, Marcus Lindsay, Mandy Lewis, and Crystal Lewis among others.
Justin Welan looked at the burly figure of Glenn Clark with some hesitation, “Tiger, are you sure you don’t want to come with us?”
“No, big brother Justin.”
Glenn Clark rubbed the back of his head, displaying a naive smile on his face: “My brother joined the Outer Development Department when he first entered the mythical world, so I am planning to go there to take a look.”
“Compared to joining the Main Battle Legions, I am more interested in the mysterious regions of the Divine Gods Alliance that have yet to be explored.”
“This… Tiger, we are mainly worried about your safety.”
Zac Maben also scratched his head: “Although your strength is strong, and you’re about to break through to the Ninth Heavens, such strength is common in the mythical world.”
“You’ve just entered the mythical world and lack experience, it might be better to stick with us.”
“Mr. Willard and Crystal have rich experience, having performed many missions, and even participated in Civilization Wars. If something happens, they would know how to handle it.”
Justin Welan nodded: “Right, you are that guy’s brother; if anything happens to you in the mythical world, it would be difficult for us to explain to him.”
“Although the Purgatory Demon Race has been exterminated, the dangers of the mythical world are far more than that, and even king-level figures can fall with just a slight mistake.”
“Thank you all for your concern, but really, there’s no need,” Glenn Clark shook his head, still refusing.
Faced with Glenn Clark’s resolute departure, Justin Welan and others were unable to change his will and after an unsuccessful persuasion, could only sigh and give up.
Justin Welan, Crystal Lewis, and Mandy Lewis needed to head to the frontline and report to their respective Main Battle Legions.
White Veil, Zac Maben, and Marcus Lindsay joined the cleaning department at the edge of the forbidden battlefield, mainly responsible for dealing with Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts that were demonized by the Dark Demon Air between mountains and rivers.
However, just as everyone was about to leave, the ground beneath Glenn Clark, along with the space, suddenly shattered, forming a violently hollow space of over ten meters in diameter.
Boom! The strong devouring force from the shattered space instantly swallowed Glenn Clark, who had no time to react.
“Be careful.”
“Not good.”
Justin Welan and others were shocked, but before they could do anything, a terrifying king-level power burst above them, transforming into a Golden Sword Light that slashed at the Spatial Channel.
Rip!
Under the extremely sharp Sword Intent, the ordinary-strength channel was torn apart, creating a crack extending for ten thousand meters.
In the turbulent Space Interlayer on the other side of the crack, a transparent fragment with an intact internal space floated, resembling a mirror fragment tens of kilometers in size.
In the center of the fragment, a ‘pool’ about tens of meters in diameter floated, consisting of pure, translucent dark red liquid that emitted extremely pure energy fluctuations.
And the disappeared Glenn Clark was now appearing inside the pool.
Simultaneously, within that nearly transparent fragment, faint traces of golden-white lightning jolted, and the invisible pervasive Destructive Aura made even the appearance of Golden Sword King Cyril quite somber, including his astonishment.
As Justin Welan and others anxiously waited, King Cyril slowly said: “Don’t worry, Glenn Clark is not in danger, his life-saving forbidden weapon has not been triggered.”
“This is a piece of space fragment, likely a residual from a major battle that blasted apart space, drifting about with the spatial storms.”
“If I am not mistaken, the liquid inside the fragment should be a drop of Blood of Demon God,”

﻿Chapter 1712: Chapter 632: Void Creation Transformation, Tearing True Spirit Alive Chapter 1712: Chapter 632: Void Creation Transformation, Tearing True Spirit Alive In late March 2027, as Earth rejuvenates, brimming with vitality, there has been a noticeable increase in Mutated Creatures in the wilderness.
Outside Mist River City, two energy fighters flew across the sky, followed shortly by loud explosions, firelight, and roaring overhead.
“Recently, there seem to be a lot of Mutated Beasts.”
In the evening, by the riverside, after dinner when Doris Clark went for a walk, she looked up and noted the remains of Unique Beasts falling from the sky, feeling somewhat contemplative.
Just over two years ago, Mutated Creatures were still a remote concern for ordinary people, hardly encountered.
Beside her, Sherry Williams, dressed as an ordinary person with long black hair, a white T-shirt, and jeans, smiled and spoke, “They are all low-level creatures, auntie, don’t worry about them.”
“By the way, Sherry, aren’t you busy? Why do you come to keep this idler company every day?” Doris Clark was puzzled.
Jack Clark only told Doris Clark that Sherry Williams was his friend, but he didn’t reveal much about her identity or how strong she was.
But knowing she could be friends with the current Jack Clark, Doris Clark understood that Sherry Williams was no ordinary person.
During over a month of Jack Clark’s Closed-door Cultivation, Sherry Williams frequently visited Doris Clark, and the two gradually became closer.
Sherry Williams smiled slightly, “Yes, auntie, I am busy, but right now, my task is to wait for Brother Clark to finish his Closed-door Cultivation, as I have something important to give him.”
“So that’s it,” Doris Clark realized.
While Glenn Clark was adventuring in the mythical world, Sherry Williams frequented visits to Doris Clark to ‘chat.’
Deep in the Sun, a pair of eyes— one Black Gold and one Golden-White—slowly opened. Under their horrific gaze, the intensely hot material in front was silently annihilated as space-time distorted.
This phase of Closed-door Cultivation took Jack Clark longer than he expected, about one and a half months.
By now, he had fused the Supreme Power Rules and the True Body with the Real Plane of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, and his realm thoroughly stepped into the Peak of the Ancient.
Of course, due to the Primordial Genesis Rules, he was still a little short of reaching True Spirit.
This time, Jack Clark was awoken by a faint sense of danger emanating from the Giant Beast Body, sensing that something was targeting the hibernating Destruction Emperor Dragon.
…
The previously gloomy and oppressive Chaotic Turbulent Region, now ravaged by storms, was enveloped by majestic dawn light, resembling a fairyland from legends.
Above the Firmament, inside the multi-colored vortex covering a million kilometers, the Chaotic Light Egg spanning tens of thousands of kilometers kept contracting and expanding like a living creature, breathing in the infinite Power of Heaven and Earth.
The invisible, formidable suppression permeating between heaven and earth quieted everything.
Including the Chaos Sea with tsunamis a thousand meters tall, now lay calm, still as a blue mirror under the gleam of dawn, reflecting myriad colors.
Hoo!
In the sky, a Spawn Roc over 2400 meters long, covered in black ferocious scale armor and of vast and stout body, swimming leisurely spread its double wings casting large shadows.
On the sea surface, a Dragon Turtle resembling a yellowish-brown mountain peak raised its head, emitting a dissatisfied roar.
Roar! Joe, this fellow, just because he had a breakthrough to the Titan Realm before us, what’s there to be so proud of.
Not far away, the body of Nine-headed monster Ghidorah coiled atop an ice mountain nodded, with all nine dragon heads roaring in chaotic unison.
“This guy is indeed annoying. He has been flying around this area for more than a Sun Wheel; even if showing off, he should have had enough.”
“Roar! Ghidorah, let’s go, ignore him.”
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared, its gigantic body plunging with a thunderous crash, splashing the ocean wide.
Crash! The ice mountain shattered explosively, and the body of the Nine-headed Flood Dragon surged into the sea, disappearing with the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle.
Hoo!
In the sky, the Spawn Roc with slowly spreading wings let out a triumphant long cry, continuing to circle around the Dragon Palace, emitting an invisible aura belonging to a Titan Giant Beast.
Meanwhile, on an island thousands of kilometers away, in the ruggedly ancient city spanning 2800 meters and standing a thousand meters tall, Longa King in human-snake form was being worshipped by countless Longa Tribe members.
Today was the annual Holy Praise Day for the Longa Tribe.
As the supreme king of the tribe, all Longa were to offer praises to Alicia, even the Ancient Giant Clams that lived alongside Longa surfaced.
These hundreds of gigantic clams opening their shells resembled vast fan-seats.
Together with the Mythical Giant Beasts occasionally bursting skyward, emitting deep roars, it gave the impression of returning to the desolate and mysterious ancient wilderness of legends.
This is the Beast Empire.
Unlike the orderly human civilization and other race civilizations, there was no ‘Great War;’ everyone did what they wanted, dispersing across the land, flying wherever they wished.
Including those Ancient Dragon Kings, now spread out tens’)}}”

﻿Chapter 1713: Chapter 632: Void Creation Transformation, Tearing True Spirit Alive_2 Chapter 1713: Chapter 632: Void Creation Transformation, Tearing True Spirit Alive_2 Such an immense momentum naturally attracted the attention of countless Void Creatures.
But the terrifying Destructive Aura, even those Void Creatures that only possess destructive, slaughtering, polluting, and mad instincts fear it, not daring to approach.
Until now, it finally attracted a Time True Spirit Void King.
In the pitch-black, twisted depths of the Void, a massive creature with a body length of over two thousand kilometers floats, surrounded by terrifying Black Power, like a black hole twisting everything.
This Void Creature, akin to a gigantic bear standing upright, has a robust body covered in black hair as long as a hundred kilometers, floating like seaweed.
On the head of this creature, several hundred-kilometer-long tentacles, similar to venomous snakes, writhed, probing into the Void, looking utterly fierce.
Staring at the Chaos Light Egg piercing through the Void, expanding and contracting continuously, this creature radiating a True Spirit Aura revealed greed in its eyes, as well as intense malice.
But gradually, the creature shifted its gaze, looking through the fragile Space Cracks around the Light Egg, landing on the Ancient Beasts on the Earth below.
Though the Aura of the Destruction Emperor Dragon was subdued, this Void Creature still instinctively held some fear.
Thus, it set its sights on those Ancient Dragon Kings and Titan Beasts, whose flesh and blood emitted a rich life aura, incredibly enticing to Void Creatures.
“Kill, eat!”
A terrifying growl filled with malice echoed through the Void, the massive body of the Void Creature abruptly moved, slowly ascending towards the Material World, shattering the thin layers of space it passed through.
And just as this Void Creature was preparing to descend upon the Material World to hunt and devour those Giant Beasts, and even to devour that True Spirit Beast undergoing a breakthrough after awakening.
In the deep parts of the Transparent River of Time, a Giant Beast perched on one of its tributaries suddenly opened its eyes, its gaze twisting space-time, focusing on that creature in the Void.
Looking at the lurking Void Creature, the Time True Spirit Beast’s gaze was cold, with a hint of mockery.
A fool who dares to provoke that beast.
Around the Chaos Turbulent Sea, an Ancient Lava Giant Beast lying in the fiery Lava Ocean, an Ancient Batfin floating in a gray stream, and other Ancient Beasts surrounded by black streams all suddenly looked up.
Boom! A colorful vortex at the edge of space shattered, forming a hollow tens of thousands of kilometers wide, with giant cracks spreading tens of thousands of kilometers around.
From the pitch-black hollow and those cracks, endless Black Void Energy surged out, mighty and vast, like a galaxy pouring down and submerging everything.
At the same time, from the depths of the black hollow, a massive Void Creature emerged, instantly spreading a True Spirit-level pressure.
Unlike the True Spirit Beasts encountered before, the pressure emitted by this True Spirit Void Creature mixed a Terrifying Aura that made all Giant Beasts instinctively fear and tremble.
Thump, thump, thump! Each of the Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts flying in the sky fell heavily, crashing onto the sea surface.
Including the Single-horned Spawn Roc that had been boasting for over a month.
Boom! Twenty thousand kilometers away, the fiery magma ocean exploded, the Ancient Lava Giant Beast flapping its double wings: “Roar! A Void Creature has arrived, must not disturb the King.”
“Woo! Damn it, even dare to provoke our Dragon Palace Empire, let’s all attack together,” the Ancient Batfin roared.
Roar!
On the Icebound Mountain Range spanning millions of kilometers, the Blue-White Giant Dragon roared, without hesitation, whipping up a storm of black ice crystals and soaring into the sky.
Even though its realm was only at the ancient early stage, it still was fearless.
But the Time Dragon dwelling in the time rift was startled, quickly roaring, its massive body bursting out from the time risks, with time twisting around it chasing after.
Besides that, the Gray Python Jormungand, recently breakthrough Blade Giant Beast, the black-colored Kirin Beast, and that white crystal-colored Void Serpent also ascended to the sky.
True Spirit Creatures are strong, but these Ancient Beasts are fearless.
True Spirit Creature only, not like they’ve never seen one before.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Eight Ancient Beasts soaring into the sky from tens of thousands of kilometers apart, their mouths shining with light, instantly sixteen horrifying energy wave light beams penetrated Heaven and Earth.
Sixteen breaths under the control of these Ancient Dragon Kings converge near the Dark Void in an instant.
Boom!
A shocking, earth-shaking boom resounded, the universe vibrated, the entire world shaking madly under a rapidly expanding, instantaneously spreading hundred thousand-kilometer-wide Light Sphere.
Powerful strength destroyed everything, submerging the half-emerged body of the Void Creature, and the explosion’s energy light even annihilated all Void Energy.
Wild shockwaves swept across Heaven and Earth, phenomena abundant, terrifying Rule impacts causing tens of thousands of kilometers of Earth to collapse and tremble.
The thousands of meters deep ocean was directly lifted, the sea water evaporated revealing the cracked sea bed below, like Doomsday.
Such a powerful strike, almost reaching the True Spirit Level, this is the might of eight Ancient Beasts joining forces.
But at this moment, above the heads of the eight Ancient Beasts, the Void shattered, tentacles penetrating the Void like mountain ranges stretching tens of thousands of kilometers falling down.
Terrifying strength instantly crumbling Heaven and Earth, space-time twisted, unavoidable, inescapable.
Roar! Roar! Roar! The eight Ancient Beasts let out enraged roars, the surrounding Rule Domain light blazing.
Around the Blue-White Giant Dragon within the black ice crystal storm, peaks of ice crystals soared skywards, supporting Heaven and Earth, the Time Dragon’s surrounding time twisted, vanishing into thin air.
Around the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon, the Lava World emerged, transforming into a Giant Shadow Beast extending its wings thousands of kilometers, roaring and lifting the sky-high magma to meet the black tentacles.

﻿Chapter 1714: Chapter 632: Void Creation Transformation, Tearing True Spirit Alive_3 Chapter 1714: Chapter 632: Void Creation Transformation, Tearing True Spirit Alive_3 Gray Python was surrounded by an even brighter Gray Light, and a continent of more than 10,000 kilometers emerged, around which a python of more than 100,000 kilometers in length coiled.
At this moment, all ancient beasts unleashed their strongest strike.
But…
Boom boom boom!! The Blue-White Giant Dragon was surrounded by shattering Ice Crystals, and its massive body slammed into the Earth with a bang, engulfed by a black tentacle.
The Void that had enveloped the World Serpent of more than 100,000 kilometers dissipated with a mournful scream of agony.
The ancient Lava Giant Beast’s Lava World exploded, the massive lava Rule phantom dispersed, and its colossal body turned into a beam of light that pierced Heaven and Earth and fell to the ground.
Boom!!
Eight black tentacles stretched across Heaven and Earth, and the moment they landed, a span of 300,000 kilometers of land shattered, countless antithetical rocks mixed with the fiery Destructive Glow flew for tens of thousands of kilometers.
The breach of the land under the impact of the destruction extended for more than 100,000 kilometers out to the sea, where countless Giant Beasts and the Longa Alien Tribe were engulfed by the soaring sea water and vanished into the sky.
Deep in the fractured Earth, all eight Ancient Beasts were injured.
The most severely injured Gray Python lost the latter half of its body, while half of the Ancient Batfin’s True Body crumbled.
The wings of the ancient Lava Giant Beast snapped, a Dragon Head exploded, and its Aura was miserable, while the Black Kirin Giant Beast’s True Body was also full of cracks, like porcelain about to shatter at any moment.
Including the Void Python, lying on the ground weakened, its white scales mostly shattered.
The least injured was actually the Blue-White Giant Dragon, now looking up at the Void Creature that blocked out the sun with anger and shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 1716 - 1716 633 A World-Shocking Power Jack Clark
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1716: Chapter 633: A World-Shocking Power, Jack Clark Emerges from Seclusion Chapter 1716: Chapter 633: A World-Shocking Power, Jack Clark Emerges from Seclusion Emanating endless light and heat, the sun’s coronal layer twisted in silence, breaking apart, and a hand reached out from within, seizing the floating golden wooden box.
As the ‘Heavenly Dao’, Jack Clark possessed absolute authority in the Solar System.
However, this time, located at the center of the star, spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers tearing apart space-time, he did not use the World’s Power, but instead a portion of the Speed Divine Power’s application.
As a Peak of the Ancient, just one step away from becoming a Law True Spirit, Jack Clark’s strength already surpassed ordinary people’s imagination.
Not only could a casual strike blow up Jupiter and Saturn, but his full strength could tear apart ordinary stars with terrifying destructive power—and there were various other abilities comparable to Mythical Legends.
Changing the environments of Heaven and Earth, instant movement, warping time, including eternal youth and changing shape at will, the basic ability to fly didn’t even need to be mentioned.
Including Opening the Heavens and Earth, condensing and evolving a real world, holding up a Star System world and so on, Jack Clark had also experienced.
All manner of marvels, stronger than the immortals in Mythical Legends.
In the depths of the star, filled with terrible pressure, a figure with a height of one hundred thousand meters and three faces and ten arms sat cross-legged, with thirty thousand meters of black hair, like a waterfall, dancing and leaping in the intense flames.
Behind Jack Clark, who had already merged with the Earth, Fire, Wind and Thunder Plane, was a Divine Wheel, ten thousand meters in diameter, rotating slowly, seemingly forged from actual gold with two layers, inner and outer.
The outer Divine Wheel surface was twined with gold, blue, purple, and yellow hollow patterns, which looked incredibly splendid, radiating an extremely Overbearing and heavy aura as it rotated clockwise.
The inner Divine Wheel’s diameter was sixty thousand meters, pure purple-black, like substantial metal, rotating counterclockwise, giving off a sense of all-encompassing mystery.
Under such illumination, Jack Clark appeared like an ancient God Demon born from the sun eons ago, majestically divine.
Jack Clark’s massive head bowed slightly, his gaze flickered, and the wooden box capable of withstanding the coronal layer’s million Celsius high temperature and tearing planetary gravity, silently shattered.
Instantly, myriad white, blue, and gold Life Crystals appeared before Jack Clark, and the rich aroma of life diffused.
These crystals all started from Level 5, numbering over one hundred thousand, including nearly a thousand Level 9 Crystals from quasi-mythical behemoths.
Just a rough estimate, the translatable Attribute points easily exceeded thirty million, and even Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
At his order, this time the Human Alliance mobilized a large number of Mythical Kings, Heavenly Kings and Main Gods to slay all high-level alien beasts and High-rank Behemoths within the known vicinity.
These Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts had reached the peak of their race, their bodies condensed Life Crystals, which would then be blasted apart to retrieve the Crystal Cores.
It is imaginable that within ten years, a gap would appear in the behemoths of Mythical-level and above around the alliance, which will ensure safety for the alliance’s members expanding outwards and promote development.
“It seems I’ve incidentally done a good deed this time.”
Speaking, a faint smile appeared on Jack Clark’s cold and majestic face, his ten arms slowly extended, grabbing all the Life Crystals in his hands.
“Convert all these Life Crystals into Attribute points.”
As Jack Clark’s thought echoed in his mind that instant, he keenly sensed an Invisible Power spreading from the depths of his soul, enveloping all the Life Crystals.
Boom!
Like a Tsunami, Life Energy erupted, flowing out from inside the tens of thousands of Life Crystals, transforming into Invisible Power entering Jack Clark’s body, vanishing without a trace.
Simultaneously, on the transparent page that appeared before Jack Clark’s eyes, the Attribute points skyrocketed terrifyingly fast, breaking through one million, three million, eight million, ten million…
In just a few breaths, all Life Crystals were converted, and the final Attribute points stopped at 34,120,487.
Thirty-four million Attribute points were nearly enough for Jack Clark to strengthen several weapons from nothing to world-class, or enhance hundreds of Deification Talents.
Of course, this is provided that he or the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s life gene’s carrying capacity was sufficient.
And that is the advantage of controlling a major power.
With the Attribute points converted, the Breath of Creation also accumulated nearly enough, and no more Breath of Creation was flowing in from the Destruction Emperor Dragon that was about to breakthrough.
Thus, Jack Clark merely paused for a moment, his thought resounded in his mind: “Burn one million Attribute points, enter the epiphany state.”
While entering the epiphany state, Jack Clark activated a thought, drawing all the Breath of Creation toward his heart.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s heart ‘exploded’, and within his body appeared nine overlapping golden Heavenly Gates, layer upon layer, vaguely exuding an unspeakably heavy, intense Qi Blood meaning.
The Nine-Layered Heavenly Gates, condensed by Jack Clark’s cultivation that had reached a state of perfection in Dark Star Body Refinement, the Heavenly Gate Body Refining Technique amalgamated with Dark Star Rune, Heavenly Gate Rune, and Emperor Dragon Bloodline.
The Dark Star Heavenly Gate holds the functions to store, absorb, and convert the Qi Blood within Jack Clark’s body.
And as a being of the Ancient Realm ‘Demon God’, with the strength of the Giant Beast Body as a bonus, Jack Clark’s True Body was hundreds of times stronger than his contemporaries.
Therefore, the Qi Blood he possessed was so boundless it was unimaginable, and his endurance and recovery were incredibly terrifying.
Hence, Jack Clark’s body always maintained at ninety-nine percent of a ‘sub-healthy’ level.
Only in this way, would the True Body instinctively absorb Heavenly Energy, generating extremely robust Qi Blood recovery until the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gates reached the storage limit before stopping.
And the stored Qi Blood would be infinitely compressed by the Nine-Layered Heavenly Gates, transforming into another powerful concentrated force: the Dragon Blood Power.
Each Layered Heavenly Gate contained more powerful compression force than the one before, and the Ninth Heavenly Gate contained a gravity almost as terrifying as that of a Black Hole.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1717: Chapter 633: The Power that Shocks the World, Jack Clark Emerges_2 Chapter 1717: Chapter 633: The Power that Shocks the World, Jack Clark Emerges_2 Under such circumstances, the transformed and compressed Dragon Blood Power was also extremely terrifying, immense.
Especially the strongest Ninth Heavenly Gate, with its Instantaneous Explosion, the foundational strength, Power Explosion, and Defense of Jack Clark’s True Body increased by more than five hundred times.
At this moment, as the Breath of Creation flowed in, the materialized Ninth Heavenly Gates vibrated crazily in an instant, emitting dazzling golden light.
Within the resplendent light, countless Talent Runes surfaced, forming complex and Mysterious Rune Sequence Chains, which continuously evolved, becoming even more intricate and profound.
Gradually, deeper within the Ninth Heavenly Gate, a transparent door frame slowly emerged, surrounded by a black and red dragon-shaped phantom that resembled the Eastern Divine Dragon.
While the talents evolved and advanced, Jack Clark, who was in an epiphany state, immersed his entire mind and soul within his body.
Following the inscrutable hints of fate, Jack Clark used the power of his Divine Soul Intent and his will to accelerate the evolution of the Talent Runes, with countless Rune Sequence Chains coming into existence every moment…
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, it was April 1st, the weather clear.
This morning, as countless people went out to head to work, their faces revealed astonishment, because something seemed off about the sun today.
Around the slowly rising sun, the vague phantom of a massive, boundless golden gate appeared, with a black and red Divine Dragon stretching hundreds of millions of kilometers encircling it.
At this time, not just ordinary people, but the Human Kings stationed within the Solar System also noticed this anomaly.
The towering phantom of the golden gate, akin to a pathway to heaven, stood at the center of the Solar System. Despite not emitting any terrifying aura, it inexplicably caused those kings to feel heart palpitations and an unwarranted panic.
As if it represented some terrifying power, once born, it would Destroy Heaven and Earth.
On the surface of Venus, a golden divine tree thousands of meters tall stood erect, its lush and massive branches unfurled, with a Heavenly Feather Deity gaping towards the sun above.
“Your Highness, what is that gate?”
With three pairs of white light wings spread out like a Seraph, Anstice shook her head slowly: “I don’t know, but it probably has something to do with the King of the Human Race’s Divine Martial.”
Well, that Heavenly Feather Deity also knew they had asked a foolish question.
Everyone knew that the Supreme Expert of the Human Race was in Closed-door Cultivation deep within the sun, and this terrible anomaly that appeared now, without thinking, was related to him.
Only such a being could trigger such a terrifying celestial phenomenon.
As expected of him, the power he possessed was beyond our imagination. At this moment, all the deities, Main Gods, and Human Kings stationed throughout the Solar System harbored this thought in their hearts.
And this abnormality in the Solar System was also immediately reported to the mythical world, soon followed by the return of many Supreme Experts, Divine Kings, Immortal Kings, and a large number of Main Gods and Heavenly Kings.
Boom boom boom boom!!
In the Outer Space around Blue Star, figures exuding strong pressures descended, their bodies wrapped in the aura of Rules, intangibly interweaving, shaking the cosmos.
After arriving, all these figures looked towards the sun, their faces showing a mixture of seriousness, shock, and admiration.
They had no choice; compared to Jack Clark, whose cultivation was still skyrocketing at a terrifying speed with no end in sight, they might as well be marking time.
Even though these strong men had been stunned many times by such a scene, they still felt a complex mix of emotions, and could only watch in silence.
Meanwhile, in Mist River City, Sherry Williams, who had been waiting for more than a month, looked up, a faint smile on her face: “Brother Clark, are you finally coming out of seclusion?”
Under the gaze of all the strong men, the golden heavenly gate became increasingly distinct.
Just as the golden heavenly gate was about to fully materialize, the entire Solar System began to brighten gradually.
Endless golden light appeared out of nowhere, covering the cosmic space, the sky of Blue Star, the oceans, resembling petal after petal of golden petals.
At the same time, sacred chants seemed to echo faintly in the Void, as if billions of angels were blessing, celebrating.
Such a grand heavenly phenomenon shocked everyone, all of them excitedly and shockingly looking up at the sky at the increasingly clear gate, surrounded by the phantom of a black and red Divine Dragon.
And just as countless people were excited, thinking that this was a sign of celestial good fortune, a Heavenly Dao blessing, in the depths of the sun, Freya Louise, who was also awakened, had a rather solemn expression and a sense of relief.
“Thankfully, Jack Clark is making a breakthrough in the Solar System this time. If it were in the mythical world, it might have led to a disaster.”
At this moment, in Freya’s perception, the entire Solar System World’s Origin forces were raging.
The innate impulse of the entire world to destroy everything and ruin that golden Heavenly Gate emerged as though that golden gate should not exist in this world.
But because this Heavenly Gate originated from Jack Clark, from the savior, from the ‘savior’ of this world.
Hence, the power that thrives on the strength of the entire Solar System World suddenly transformed into a sky full of golden petals, and even the intent of destruction became a Void eulogy echoing throughout the world.
Under the gaze of countless eyes, that golden Heavenly Gate completely materialized into reality.
Roar! At this moment, everyone faintly heard an extremely terrifying Dragon Roar exploding in their ears.
At this moment, all cultivators, king-level figures, Heavenly Kings, and Divine Kings, felt the power within their bodies momentarily solidified, or even vanished, beyond perception.
Instantly, everyone’s faces drastically changed, showing fear.
Fortunately, this terrifying phenomenon was just a fleeting moment; the powers within these cultivators reappeared in an instant, as if what just happened was merely an illusion.
And in that mere instant, the golden gate that spanned the depths of the Solar System had already vanished.
Including the golden petals that enveloped the world and the chanting, all traces disappeared, leaving the entire world incredibly silent, an eerie calm that instilled an inexplicable panic.
Deep within the sun, Jack Clark, who had already awakened, was focusing his gaze on the transparent page before him.

﻿Chapter 1718: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark Chapter 1718: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark In the cosmos, the surface of the sun, which had expanded almost twofold, resembled ‘magma’, roiling with intense heat.
At this moment, a crack spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers appeared on the surface of the sun, emitting brilliant golden light.
Under the obscure force of ‘Heavenly Dao’, these lights converged to form a golden light pathway that spanned through space, extending to Blue Star, appearing like a bridge spanning a hundred million kilometers.
At either end of this golden sky bridge, countless shadowy figures of living beings emerged, worshipping the towering figure that walked out from the depths of the sun.
It seemed to celebrate his achievement of possessing the divine power exclusive to primordial beings, even though he had not yet broken through to the True Spirit realm but had crossed over two major realms.
Heavenly Dao paved the way, and all beings welcomed him.
Such was Jack Clark’s presence upon emerging from seclusion; with the support of Heavenly Dao, it was even more exaggerated than the breakthroughs of Divine Kings from the ancient realms to the True Spirit level.
Furthermore, with the overwhelming pressure that filled the entire Solar System, all the standing strong men beyond Blue Star’s atmosphere unconsciously spoke out in respect and congratulations.
“Congratulations to the Divine Martial Emperor on coming out of seclusion!”
Stepping on the golden sky bridge that distorted and folded space, with each step Jack Clark crossed vast distances, and by the time he reached just outside Blue Star’s atmosphere, he had reverted to humanoid form.
In the Void, with black hair cascading over his shoulders and wearing a black imperial robe with purple edges, Jack Clark, his eyes flickering with golden starlight, gazed at over a hundred strong men from four races and spoke slowly.
“Gentlemen, no need for such courtesies.”
“And you all flatter me too much, my current realm is only the peak of ancient times, just one step away from the True Spirit Level of a Civilization Emperor.”
Divine Martial Emperor Tarrod solemnly shook his head: “That may be true, however, Divine Martial King, your current aura is even stronger than many True Spirits, truly deserving of the title of emperor.”
“Indeed, in our eyes, Divine Martial King, you are no different from True Spirits, the title of emperor is well deserved.”
Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy spoke, filled with amazement.
Previously, during the extermination war with the Purgatory Demon Clan, Jack Clark’s realm was only at the early stage of ancient times, burning everything to forever match the horrifying battle strength of the initial stage of True Spirit.
That was a limit of burst power that couldn’t last, therefore it couldn’t be considered a real existence at the level of True Spirit.
But now he had reached the peak of the ancient realm, his strength greatly increased by dozens or hundreds of times, his normal battle strength stably entering True Spirit.
Not to mention that golden divine gate stretching across the Void earlier, which trembled the hearts of everyone, representing some unknown powerful divine power or divine talent.
As the Divine Kings of the three races expressed their emotions, Primordial True King laughed heartily: “Hahaha… Jack Clark, don’t be modest, in the mythical world, strength is revered.”
“Our congratulations just now were not only for you personally but also for our respect for higher levels of power.”
True Martial King, holding the stele, also nodded in approval: “Indeed, Civilization Emperor, even in the vast and unblemished mythical world, belongs to a type of overlord, deserving respect.”
“Haha, yes, respect,” Mysterious Martial Sky King also laughed and nodded.
The Human Race’s camp—Sky King Denny Kaye, Gabriel King, Leo Hart, and other kings—also nodded in agreement, “Yes, must respect; you are indeed the top strong man of the Federation right now.”
“Of course, just a bit young, hahaha…” saying so, all of them laughed.
Unlike the somewhat awe-inspiring strong men of the three races, these strong men of the Human Race had almost all watched Jack Clark grow up, many of whom had taken care of him at some point.
Thus, trusting Jack Clark’s character and integrity completely, these strong men were filled with only excitement and pride without any restraint.
The laughter of the Human Race’s strong men dispersed the solemn atmosphere permeating through space, and Jack Clark also showed a light smile, looking towards Primordial True King: “Primordial Senior, have the delegations from the Divine Realms arrived?”
Although he had been in closed-door cultivation for years deep within the sun, unaware of time, Jack Clark roughly felt he had been cultivating for about two months.
Estimating the time, the delegations from the Six Great Divine Domains should have arrived, which was also why he came out of seclusion.
Before Primordial True King and the others could respond, space twisted and Sherry Williams emerged from the cracks, smiling: “Brother Clark, the delegations are not coming.”
“They’re not coming,” Jack Clark paused.
The surrounding strong men from the four races were also somewhat stunned.
Previously, Sherry Williams had only forcibly issued an order to erase Jack Clark’s information, and other details had not been disclosed, so True Martial King and others were unaware of the news that the Divine Realm delegations were not coming.
Sherry Williams nodded, explaining: “When you were in seclusion earlier, I contacted my sister using the God’s True Stele, informing her about the situation here.”
“Then, my sister went directly to the Chaotic Heavens Outside to meet our master.”
“Regarding our ancestral land here, the Six Great True Emperors have already unified their opinions; everything is decided autonomously by you all, and no one and no force from the Six Great Divine Domains may interfere.”
“When you feel the time is right, you can take the initiative to go to the Divine Realms, the gates of the Ancient Divine Domain are always open to you.”
“Also, Brother Clark, the master said when you go to Flame Wheel Heaven, she wants me to take you to see her.”
“She’s curious about the genius who is leading the rise of the ancestral land and suppressing powerful civilizations with True Spirits nearby.”
“Also, as fellow members of the Human Race, the Divine Realms will provide certain assistance to our side.”
“For instance, the library of the Imperial Dynasty will be open to you, containing various Secret Skills, cultivation systems, secrets and documents of Beyond the Heavens accumulated over tens of thousands of years.”
“Those with outstanding talent can also use the pathway of the Flame Wheel Divine Domain to venture Beyond the Heavens for training.”
“There, opportunities are everywhere, and you can even compete with top-tier talents from other peak races and civilizations. That place is, indeed, a suitable stage for someone with your unparalleled talent, Brother Clark.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1719 - 1719 634 True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1719: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark – 2 Chapter 1719: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark – 2 “And if you continue to stay here, within the Vast World, by the time your realm fully breaks through to True Spirit Emperor, you will touch the world’s limits.”
“Although with your talent, your cultivation will not stagnate, the speed of cultivation will slow down by ten times or even a hundred times.”
“This is the suppression of all non-Giant Beast lives by the Vast World, not just the life shackles formed by time assimilation.” Sherry Williams finished speaking, then looked at Jack Clark with expectant eyes.
She was eager to know what kind of dazzling light the terrifyingly talented Jack Clark would radiate once he descends outside Heaven.
Could it really be as her sister said, cultivating to True Spirit in the third year, and Primordial in five.
Jack Clark slowly said, “Blazing Heaven True Emperor flatters me, but I indeed have some yearning for Chaos Outside Heaven, and will go to check it out after arranging things here.”
“As for the departure of the delegation, please thank Sara for me, and thank you Sherry for your hard work during this time.”
Jack Clark did not expect the Divine Realm Delegation, which he considered the ‘current great enemy’, to be just recalled by the Primordial True Emperor; he was still thinking about how to face them when the time came.
Should he forcefully suppress all the messengers, or be polite and beat them all up to show off his strength, then slowly negotiate the control over the Solar System World.
But these guys not coming is also good, saving a lot of trouble, just that if he knew earlier they wouldn’t come, he would have cultivated more… well.
Whether or not the Six Great Divine Domains Delegation was present, Jack Clark was about to finish his retreat.
With his current understanding of Heaven and Earth, by using the ‘strength’ of the Solar System, he estimated that he would complete the fusion of the second Supreme Rule and break through to True Spirit in about three years.
This speed, for someone like Wind Heaven who took nearly a thousand years to cultivate from the late period of Immortal King to the peak of Immortal King, is terrifyingly fast, but in Jack Clark’s eyes, it was too slow.
And in the absence of resources efficient for the rapid cultivation of True Spirit Level strong ones in the surroundings, heading to the Six Great Divine Domains became a necessary move.
