Entering Chaos Void outside Heaven through the pathway of the Six Great Divine Domains, he might quickly find a Creator-level Divine Treasure, integrating the Supreme Rule and breaking through to True Spirit in one fell swoop.
While Jack Clark was deep in thought, he didn’t notice the curious and surprised expressions on the faces of the surrounding Human Experts.
They were surprised that the authority of the Flame Wheel Divine Domain’s Heaven Observation Hall Lord, who Sara spoke of, was greater than what Sherry had described, influencing the Six Primordial True Emperors directly.
As for the odd expressions, anyone present who was not foolish could hear that everything done by the named Sara, the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall, was for Jack Clark.
Because of this ‘genius’, who once had interactions with them thousands of years ago.
Regarding this, the strong ones had nothing but envy.
At this moment, Sherry Williams smilingly said, “Brother Clark, there’s no need for such politeness, if not for you, my sister and I would have died in the Lost World years ago.”
“By the way, Brother Clark, our master also has an item for me to pass to you.”
Saying this, Sherry Williams’s expression became solemn, and she extended her right hand.
On the back of her hand was a red flame mark, which now blazed intensely, forming a burning red lotus suspended in the air.
The moment the fist-sized, red lotus emanating a faint halo appeared, everyone had the illusion of seeing a One-side World, witnessing all things emerge from nothing.
At the same time, an indescribable terrifying pressure spread from the red lotus.
Just a faint trace of aura was enough to make everyone sink their forms instantaneously, even making the entire cosmic space tremble as if it couldn’t bear it.
Is this the power of a Primordial existence, how strong!! Faces of people like True Martial King showed shock.
And Sherry Williams, who summoned the red lotus flame, also turned slightly pale, obviously bearing a great burden from maintaining this aura, as she took a breath and said,
“Brother Clark, here are some insights from our master when she opened the Flame Wheel Divine Domain, which she asked me to pass on to you, saying it should be somewhat helpful to you.”
“Besides this, there are some other items, said to be for your use when you go to the Divine Realm.”
Looking at the burning, jumping lotus in front of him, where every arc of the flame seemed to contain endless profound mysteries, even Jack Clark was slightly astounded.
He didn’t expect, that the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, whom he hasn’t met before, was so ‘kind’ to him?
Or was it that the ancient Human Race was more united than he imagined, that this True Emperor gave him a huge gift before even meeting?
Regardless of the reason, Jack Clark felt a fondness for the yet-unseen Blazing Heaven True Emperor, including the other True Emperors, truly worthy of being pioneers who carved out hope for the Human Race.
Moreover, tallying up, Jack Clark had already received many helps from these ancient civilization Emperors.
Like on the Void Relic Continent, obtaining the Emperor Inheritance left by ‘Henry’, the Civilization Emperor’s Primordial Blank Rule appearing like the prototype of a universe.
Which is now the core of Jack Clark’s second Primordial Genesis Rule.
Aside from this, there is a terrifyingly powerful myth-level Divine Power that only True Spirit Level strong ones have successfully condensed nine Avatars and performed—the Time Reincarnation.
Also from one of the Seven Ancient Emperors, ‘Wheel’.
Therefore, facing the gift from Blazing Heaven True Emperor, Jack Clark did not refuse, slowly reaching out and holding the floating red lotus in front of Sherry Williams.
Under the gaze of the people standing in space, Jack Clark’s consciousness plunged, entering the red lotus.
Boom! Jack Clark’s consciousness exploded in an onslaught as he arrived in a world filled with endless red flames, where Heaven and Earth were unopened, in the Void a towering figure appeared.
At the moment when the figure clad in a magnificent long gown appeared, endless information and insights flooded Jack Clark’s consciousness, vast beyond description.

chapters.title: Chapter 1720 - 1720 634 True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1720: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark – 3 Chapter 1720: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark – 3 Even with Jack Clark’s current cultivation, it took him nearly half a day to recover his senses, as the confusion slowly receded from his eyes.
“Turns out the Divine Realm is a Great Thousand World, one that is in the midst of growing.” A hint of shock appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes, along with exhilaration.
The existence at the True Spirit Level represents the terrestrial limit of the mythical world.
At this step, a being has already transformed into a rule, the mark of its existence engraved deep within the mythical world, forming a true name, invisibly influencing countless lives.
But at the same time, it is akin to a ‘Giant Beast’ that is unimaginably vast and in a state of hibernation.
Once a life reaches the pinnacle of True Spirit, and makes a breakthrough to the Primordial, it will be expelled by the mythical world and enter the perilous Chaos Sea.
The true Chaos Sea is such a terrifying place that ‘ordinary’ Primordials would be instantaneously annihilated upon entering.
This ‘ordinary’ refers to the Giant Beasts and cultivators who have just breached the Primordial realm not long ago, not those with average strength.
Therefore, to protect themselves and to advance even further, many Primordial Powerhouses choose to create their own solid and formidable worlds.
Or rather, this world is the partial true incarnation of that Primordial Powerhouse, transformed into stars, suspended outside the mythical world.
This includes some Primordial Beasts, who also chose to establish their Divine Realm, like the Void Heaven Divine Dragon that perished outside the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
Of course, evolving a part of the true body into a Great Thousand World is just one of the paths after reaching Primordial.
Some Primordial beings do not choose to evolve a Great Thousand, but instead use themselves as a furnace to Devour and refine everything, becoming incredibly powerful individuals wandering in the Chaos Void, and even the Chaos Sea.
Apart from these, some Primordial existences, despite also evolving a part of their true body into a Great Thousand World, have chosen not to depend on the mythical world and instead become an independent Supreme Plane outside of Heaven and Earth.
Moreover, partially evolving into a Great Thousand World is only a ‘symbol’ for those powerful Primordials.
As for how these Primordial existences cultivate and improve their strength and cultivation, every Primordial is different; some Devour worlds, while others reflect upon the heavens.
And the establishment of a Divine Realm requires the complete act of Opening the Heavens and Earth, creating a powerful and vast Great Thousand World with absolute strength.
Or by turning their Rule world from intangible to tangible, condensing a part of the Chaos Void, relying on the Primordial Fate and Rule Origin to support and carry the Great Thousand.
At the present, Jack Clark is unable to accomplish either of these.
But his situation is somewhat special.
The Solar System World, as a piece of Star System torn from the universe where the mythical world previously resided, is vast in scope and has reached the limit of a Great World.
A further step would be the level of a Great Thousand World, albeit the smallest kind.
At the same time, as the ‘world’ that once bore and nurtured the seven Ancient Emperors, the universe where the Solar System originally resided is incredibly stable and powerful.
Even if the ‘Devouring’ by the mythical world has caused a decline in the spatial solidity of the Solar System region, it is still sufficient to serve as the foundation for a Divine Realm.
As a Pillar of Heaven, Jack Clark only needs to cut a part of his True Body to merge with the Solar System World and condense the Heavenly Path Incarnation.
Through the method of Solidifying Heaven taught by Blazing Heaven True Emperor, there is a chance that the Solar System could be opened as the Human Federation’s Seventh Divine Realm, and due to its ‘independence,’ Jack Clark would not be bound here.
Once Solidifying Heaven succeeds, the Solar System will slowly ‘ascend,’ growing continuously, and eventually moving from the interlayer of the Deification World Crystal Wall to the outside of the heavens.
Then, Jack Clark will obtain an incarnation at the Primordial Level of the Heavenly Path.
This Avatar, different from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, is akin to an out-of-body incarnation, existing in the form of natural will of a One-side World, and under normal circumstances, will not manifest under the rule of Chaos.
But should Jack Clark one day fall in the Chaos Void, and his soul disperse to the point of becoming nothingness, he could also use the Heavenly Path Incarnation to reflect upon past space-time and resurrect to return.
In other words, it’s an additional method of saving his life.
And most importantly, this Heavenly Path Incarnation coincides perfectly with the time when Jack Clark was preparing to solidify the Heavenly Path Avatar by integrating the Mark of Time into the Mark of Heavenly Path.
It directly skips the most crucial step.
And with the method of Solidifying Heaven given by Blazing Heaven True Emperor, originally with only a slim chance, Jack Clark is confident that within half a month, he can finish ‘Heavenly Path’ solidification.
Plus, using the power of Heavenly Path to adjust the World Origin rules of the Solar System World and condense the characteristics of the Divine Realm, a total of about one month is anticipated.
Sigh!
Thinking of this, Jack Clark slowly let out a breath, his expression solemn as he looked towards the Primordial True Emperors and others, “Gentlemen, I will continue Closed-door Cultivation next, which I expect to last one month.”
“If successful, this will be the Seventh Divine Realm of the Human Race, the Solar Divine Domain.”
“And when I emerge from cultivation, it will be time to head to the Ancient Divine Domain.”
“The Seventh Divine Realm!”
“The Solar Divine Domain!!”
Watching Jack Clark with a calm demeanor, the Primordial True Emperors and other people who had been waiting for half a day first showed shock on their faces, followed by excitement and exhilaration.
Although they did not fully understand the path of cultivation beyond True Spirit, if Jack Clark can condense the Solar System into a Divine Realm, doesn’t it mean he’s 100% certain to ‘ascend’ to Primordial?
And possessing the Seventh Divine Realm, the Human Federation’s potential for development will be incredibly formidable in the future.
As powerhouses originating from the Human Federation, the feedback from their race naturally brings them immense benefits; perhaps everyone present can advance further.
Several Supreme Experts become True Spirits, Heavenly Kings achieve Supreme, and all Mythical Kings will at least enter the Titan Realm.
Thinking of this, Gentry Gail, who had just broken through to the Heavenly King Realm not long ago, had his breathing quicken, “Come on, Jack Clark, we believe in you, you will definitely succeed in establishing the Seventh Divine Realm.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1721 - 1721 634 True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1721: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark – 4 Chapter 1721: Chapter 634: True. Seventh Solar Divine Domain, Heavenly Dao. Jack Clark – 4 “Senior Qingqiu, I only have some confidence, but nothing can be certain until success is achieved.”
Although Jack Clark was eighty percent confident in successfully condensing Heaven, many things could unexpectedly happen before reaching that step, hence he didn’t give a definite promise.
After all, if anything unexpected did occur, wouldn’t his emphatic assurances become a joke?
At this time, Wind Heavenly King suddenly said, “King of Divine Martial, when you set off for the Human Divine Domain, could we accompany you to broaden our horizons?”
Immediately, faces of strong individuals from the other three races showed their interest.
“King of Divine Martial, we too, yearn for the noble ancient Divine Realm, wondering what kind of resplendent civilization could have nurtured such a powerful race.”
Going to the Divine Realm with Jack Clark and the others was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for them to enter the Chaotic Heavens and witness an even more vast world, which none of them wanted to miss.
As for the possibility of Jack Clark failing to refine the Divine Domain, the strong individuals from the different races did not even consider it.
Fail? How could that be possible?
Jack Clark did not decide on this issue by himself, but instead looked towards Sherry Williams.
Sherry Williams smiled and said, “As long as Brother Clark agrees, I have no objections here; at that time everyone can enter the Divine Realm as ordinary members of the alliance, including those from beyond.”
The ancient Human Race naturally included more than just humans.
Over tens of thousands of years, the surroundings and even the interior of the Six Great Divine Domains have hosted a large number of different races attached to them. Each time they waged war against other peak civilizations, these races would also participate.
And they were even often the mid and low-end main force.
Immediately, the Divine Kings and Immortal Kings of the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Immortal Spirit Clan, as well as other strong beings like Main Gods, all showed smiles on their faces, “Thank you, King of Divine Martial, and Hall Lord Williams for making this possible.”
However, although it was agreed that these different races could go together, obviously, not everyone could leave.
Jack Clark looked towards the Primordial True King and others, “Primordial Senior, during the time I’m in closed-door cultivation, please discuss and decide on the candidates for this journey.”
“This place is our strategic rear; we need to leave a portion of our strength to safeguard it.”
The Primordial True King and others solemnly nodded, “Indeed, we do need to deliberate on the selection of candidates.”
As strong individuals who had fought their way from the Dark Age and grown up to the present without falling, each of these kings were highly proud and immensely talented.
However, in the past, they were suppressed by the Purgatory Demon Race, and since the resources in this region were ‘scarce,’ their ability to travel and cultivate was ‘somewhat slow.’
Now, faced with the opportunity to go to a broader world, to the Chaotic Heavens with more resources and opportunities, these kings naturally did not want to miss out.
Moreover, it’s not just these Mythical Kings, but also many old Level 9 Ninth Heavens realm strong individuals who ‘spent a lifetime’ contributing to the Federation, who might quickly achieve a breakthrough to king-level if they could go to the Divine Realm.
Including geniuses like Joshua Welan from this generation, who are young and have broken through to the Ninth Heavens, might also shine if they went.
And this journey was not just about that; it was also an opportunity for further advancement in both technology and the Transcendent system.
The Mecha Martial Arts of the Simon Empire, the Genetic Martial Arts of the Berlin Empire, and the True Martial Way that had proliferated to ancient times in Eastern Summer, might also be able to step further with the aid of knowledge from the Divine Realm.
Therefore, led by the Primordial True King, Sky-based God King, and True Martial King, a high-level council above myth was convened outside the atmosphere of Blue Star.
All the strong individuals from the four races were present, except for Adam Garcetti.
While these strong individuals were fiercely discussing the selection of candidates for the journey, Jack Clark was also preparing to continue his closed-door cultivation, but this time he was not entering deep into the sun, but rising infinitely.
Jack Clark’s figure seemed like a phantom, passing through layers of space, gradually approaching the boundary wall of the Solar System.
Here, the concepts of space and time had become vague, filled with the most pure World’s Power, forming a crystal-like boundary wall that enveloped everything.
Beside Jack Clark, the dazzling white brilliance of the Mark of Heavenly Path slowly emerged.
Boom!
Just as Jack Clark grasped the Mark of the Heavenly Path, the entire Solar System emitted an incomparably excited resonance once again, and at the same time, a vast and boundless aura spread out.
The method of Condensing Heaven, gathering the true Heaven.
Without a sound or trace, Jack Clark, along with the Mark of the Heavenly Path, ‘dissolved’, merging with the crystalline barrier that covered the entire Solar System.
This meeting outside the atmosphere of Blue Star lasted three days before dispersing.
Soon after, ripples spread throughout the Four Clans, followed by restlessness among countless people, especially within the Human Race; some showed excited smiles, while others looked dejected.
At the same time, many geniuses who had ventured out into the mythical world for exploration and training received orders to return.
In the Forbidden Battle Zone, Joshua Welan, who had just blasted a Ninth-level Demonized Giant Beast, Eddy Keller, who had cleared a Dark Forest Unique Beast, and Balderas, who roared and tore apart a Late Stage 9 Giant Beast.
Meanwhile, in South City, the Mysterious Martial Sky King interrupted Mathilda Ward, who was in closed-door cultivation.
“Go to the Divine Realm?” Mathilda Ward, with silver hair draped over her shoulders and dragon horns on her head, showed a questioning look in her eyes.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King nodded: “Yes, this time I’ve secured a spot for you. When the time comes, you will go with us to the Human Divine Domain, there should be a way there to help you breakthrough to the Mythical Realm.”
Having waged battle for decades, losing almost all his family to war or assassination, the Mysterious Martial Sky King had made tremendous contributions to both the Federation and the Human Race.
Therefore, not only did he secure a spot in the first batch, but his daughter, Mathilda Ward, was also eligible.
At the same time, amidst the tense and fierce selection of personnel within the three other clans that had also obtained some spots, the entire alliance was enveloped in an atmosphere of excitement and exhilaration, even ordinary people could keenly feel the world gradually changing.
For instance, the sky became brighter.
After the advent of the Primitive Azure Sky that shrouded the firmament, the original sky was somewhat hazy and distant, like a deep dark ocean that conveyed a faint sense of dread.
While now, that azure sky appeared clearer and more refreshing, lifting spirits at the sight.
Simultaneously, the thick Heavenly Energy pervading the entire world seemed to become more translucent, pure, and vigorous, becoming easier for people to absorb, and cultivation became more relaxed.
And the greatest change was the sun, which seemed to grow larger every day.
Every morning, looking up, one could feel the sun had expanded, just over a dozen days passed, and the sun had swollen to twice its original size.
If it weren’t for the temperature of the sunlight being unchanged from before, it would have long since caused widespread panic.
A month blinked by, and the date reached the first of May.
On this day, at the dark edge of the Solar System, a pair of immense silver-white eyes appeared, their gaze cold and majestic, looking upon all beings as if the high and mighty Heavenly Dao itself was surveying life below.
These eyes only appeared briefly, merely glancing at the central star that spanned the center of the star system and the surrounding planets before fading away.
Then, Jack Clark’s figure emerged in the Void, carrying an aura that was incomparably noble and concealed.
“It’s about time, I should be leaving.”
These eyes only appeared briefly, merely glancing at the central star that spanned the center of the star system and the surrounding planets before fading away.
Then, Jack Clark’s figure emerged in the Void, carrying an aura that was incomparably noble and concealed.
“It’s about time, I should be leaving.”
Then, Jack Clark’s figure emerged in the Void, carrying an aura that was incomparably noble and concealed.
“It’s about time, I should be leaving.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1722 - 1722 635 Departing on a Long Journey Target
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1722: Chapter 635 Departing on a Long Journey, Target: Ancient Human Race Chapter 1722: Chapter 635 Departing on a Long Journey, Target: Ancient Human Race As expected, it took Jack Clark half a month to complete the ‘structure’ of the Heavenly Path Incarnation, merging his Time Mark with the Mark of Heavenly Path.
Then, it was about disintegrating the Heavenly Path Incarnation and integrating it into the entire Solar System World, becoming a part of this world’s Origin.
For the remaining half a month, Jack Clark focused on rewriting the fundamental rules using the World’s Power of the Solar System as the core, completing the basic construction of the Solar System’s Divine Realm at the World Core.
This is also the reason why there have been subtle changes in the Solar System during this period.
However, the current Solar System World merely has the foundation of the Divine Realm. Next, it will continuously absorb the energy of the Chaos Void, strengthening itself.
Including the imprint of Jack Clark integrated into this world, it also needs to grow slowly and eventually dominate the entire world.
Pensively, Jack Clark took a step forward, his figure seemingly like a bubble piercing through layers of space, appearing instantly deep inside the sun, disregarding everything.
In the hot depths of the star, under the terrifying pressure of dense material reaching 200,000 meters high, stands a golden-white mecha resembling an ancient giant, its aura growing increasingly ancient.
Buzz! Sensing the arrival of Jack Clark, the Number One’s eyes lit up slightly, emitting a cyan-blue radiance.
“You, are you leaving?”
Freya Louise’s calm telepathic voice vibrated the surrounding space-time—even in the star’s core, where all matter was twisted and dissolved, it still transmitted ‘very far’.
With a transparent figure as if existing in another subspace, Jack Clark slowly spoke: “Yes, it’s about time to leave.”
Freya Louise fell silent for a moment, then sighed softly: “It’s a pity I can’t leave, but with me here, you can rest assured about the Solar System.”
“I think so too.”
Although Jack Clark has condensed the Heavenly Path Incarnation, after merging into the ‘Heaven’ of the Solar System World, he was restricted by Chaos Rules, just like Hongjun in the mythical legends, unable to appear at will.
Unless there is a threat to Doris Clark’s life and death, ‘Jack Clark’ will disregard backlash and forcefully descend.
Therefore, the usual security of the Solar System needs the ‘ancient’ strong man, Freya Louise, stationed here. Under authorization granted by Jack Clark, she can mobilize some of the Heavenly Path power, making her quite strong.
Other strong men are responsible for the safety on the side of the mythical world.
Internally and externally, the Human Federation in this region could be considered as secure as a fortified bastlet.
Speaking of which, Jack Clark slightly frowned: “Freya Louise, how are you feeling now?”
“Pretty good, except for the slow integration. The instinctive backlash from that ancient life form and the Primitive Azure Sky has been suppressed by me using the World’s Power.”
Jack Clark nodded: “As long as there are no surprises.”
Freya Louise reaching this point could be described as a complete miracle and partly coincidental.
For instance, the Primitive Cultivation Method she practiced originated from the Primordial Beast that had fallen within the Human Territory, or rather, the civilization that once worshipped the beast inside that giant beast.
Through the inheritance of the Primitive Secret Technique, Freya Louise ‘made contact’ with the fragmented Primitive Azure Sky after the fall of that primordial beast.
Her previously ethereal consciousness, as if existing in another world, was reflecting that sky and even merging bit by bit.
This is also why she could withstand the runaway of the Number One, ignoring the spiritual corrosion.
But even so, it wouldn’t be enough for Freya Louise to survive until now; the second Mythical Impact was almost a death sentence for her.
The awakening Number One, whose realm before its fall was half a step into the Primordial and whose Position Pattern was insufficient to uphold the Solar System World, thus its death from exhaustion was already predetermined.
Even if Freya Louise survived this ordeal and successfully carried the world, drawing down a corner of the Primitive Azure Sky, her soul having been long integrated would lose its self, becoming a puppet without personal feelings and character.
The sky condensed by the Primordial Beast was simply out of her reach.
But all this was interrupted by Jack Clark’s help in supporting the sky.
At the same time, through misfortune, Freya Louise gained partial authority of the Solar World, thus seeing an opportunity to integrate with the fragmented Azure Sky, thoroughly assimilating the Number One.
Of course, even if Freya Louise succeeds after many years, she would only possess a part of the Primordial foundation; this does not mean she can leap up to become a primordial being.
After all, the Number One as the foundation was only a half-step Primordial in the past.
Not to mention that all the power marks of this ancient life were stripped and suppressed within the Solar System World, just like the fragmented Azure Sky, belonged to a defective product.
Afterwards, Jack Clark and Freya Louise chatted for a while before he finally left.
This departure might take several years before he could return, and there’s even a ‘slight’ possibility of perishing outside the heavens, given the dangers abound in the Chaotic Heavens.
It’s a place where even Primordials can perish if they’re not careful. Just like in the Human Race’s current region, where two primordial beasts had fallen, one after another.
Thus, Jack Clark had a few people he needed to say goodbye to.
In Mist River City, Doris Clark, seeing Jack Clark appear out of thin air, was momentarily startled, her heart vaguely sensing something.
Jack Clark smiled slightly: “Mom, I’m taking a team on a long trip soon, it might be a while before I can return. Please take care of yourself at home.”
“I know,” Doris Clark nodded, not asking how long Jack Clark would be gone for.
As the current strongest person in the Federation, stronger even than God Demons, Doris Clark knew the heavy responsibilities Jack Clark carried.
As a mother, the only help she could offer was not to hold Jack Clark back.
That’s why she almost never leaves Mist River City, didn’t move to more bustling megacities, nor ventured into unfamiliar, potentially dangerous places.
But with Jack Clark leaving for an extended period, Doris Clark still felt a bit reluctant: “Jack, it’s been a long time since you’ve accompanied me for a walk, let’s go to the riverside.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1723 - 1723 635 Departing on a Long Journey Target
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1723: Chapter 635 Departing on a Long Journey, Target: Ancient Human Race_2 Chapter 1723: Chapter 635 Departing on a Long Journey, Target: Ancient Human Race_2 “Alright.”
The sunset painted the river’s surface with a glittering light, resembling a giant dragon covered with a golden-red scale armor.
Not far from the Clark Family, on the roadside by the river where Jack Clark once released the Six-legged Salamander, Jack Clark and Doris Clark walked leisurely, looking just like an ordinary mother and son.
It’s just that ordinary people couldn’t see them.
Doris Clark sighed, “Jack, Jim has been in the mythical world for almost two months, and there has been no news. Do you think he’s encountered any danger?”
“There shouldn’t be anything serious.”
Jack Clark shook his head: “The mythical world is not like Blue Star. It is filled with dangers for those below the Legendary Realm, but at the same time, it also contains countless opportunities.”
“As for danger, Jim is usually followed by people who will act in the face of lethal threats, so you don’t need to worry, Mom.”
As Jack Clark’s brother, and with a talent that ranked almost first among his generation of young people, Jim’s identity was even ‘more important’ than many Mythical Kings.
Even before entering the mythical world, he had always been under the watch of king-level protectors to ensure his safety.
After entering the mythical world, Gentry Gail, who had just achieved the Heavenly King level not long ago, volunteered to protect him until Jim achieved the king-level.
Therefore, Jack Clark was quite confident about Jim’s safety.
If, under the current circumstances of the Purgatory Demon Race’s extermination plus the protection of a Heavenly King, Jim still fell during his trials in the vicinity, it would only mean that his luck was too bad.
…
In Outer Space beyond Blue Star, looking at the black-haired young man who passed through the atmosphere and ascended unhurriedly, Marcellus Larry showed a smile on his face: “Jack Clark, you’ve come out of your closed-door cultivation.”
“Senior Larry, why are you here?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
According to the requirement, everyone who was about to depart should be waiting on the opposite side for him, and with the ‘contribution’ of Marcellus Larry’s decades of guarding Blue Star, he should definitely be among the first batch selected.
Marcellus Larry laughed and shook his head: “This old man just doesn’t want to join this time. I will leave the opportunity to those ‘younger’ ones with more potential.”
“When their cultivation has made a breakthrough, and they come back to replace them, then I’ll go over there and have a look.”
Of course, these words were just a courtesy.
Jack Clark said slowly: “…Actually, whether there is one more king-level protector or one less, doesn’t make a big difference to the current situation of the Federation. If senior went with us this time, maybe you’ll come back as an Ancient Supreme Being next time.”
“Hehe… It’s okay, Jack Clark. I’m still ‘young.’ Being a few years late or early really doesn’t matter,” Marcellus Larry said with a laugh.
Alright, the sixty or seventy-year-old Marcellus Larry, for a king-level protector whose life span is measured in tens of thousands of years, is indeed still young.
Seeing that he had made up his mind, Jack Clark didn’t say anything more. After greeting Marcellus Larry, he entered the pathway and disappeared without causing a single ripple.
Looking at the calm golden vortex, Marcellus Larry subconsciously took a deep breath, his eyes filled with expectation.
With Jack Clark’s talent, the next time he returns, he might very well be at the Primordial True Emperor level. By then, their place would truly be The Seventh Divine Domain.
Boom!
In the mythical world, the virtual shadow of the Golden Divine Tree, which spanned over 100,000 kilometers across Heaven and Earth, shone brightly like a portal, and a figure emerged from the tree trunk.
“Greetings Divine Martial Emperor.”
As soon as Jack Clark appeared, the thunderous cheer of mountains and seas shouting came from below. On the black warship that stretched over a hundred kilometers, which resembled a Phoenix Bird, tens of thousands of fervent people looked towards him with excitement.
The warship belonged to Sherry Williams, and the tens of thousands of high-order cultivators on it were the ‘staff’ selected this time for an exchange to the Flame Wheel Divine Domain.
The task of these people was to use the super astrocomputer they carried to study and analyze various ‘knowledge’ of the Flame Wheel Dynasty.
Astronomy, geography, power system, inheritance, surrounding civilizations, specific talents involved, including the data on Unique Beasts, Giant Beasts, and extraterrestrial materials accumulated over the years, and so on.
Besides these staff, more than forty Human Kings mobilized thirty-one, and eleven Heavenly Kings mobilized eight.
Ancient Supreme Beings like the Primordial True King, the Sky-based God King, and the True Martial King were also prepared to go to the Divine Realm, including half of the powerhouses from the Heavenly Feather Clan and the Immortal Spirit Clan.
On the other hand, there were very few members from the Divine Gods Alliance.
There was only Tarrod from the Ancient Realm, who was currently in closed-door cultivation, making the final adjustments for the breakthrough to the True Spirit Realm, and of the three Main Gods, only one was ready to leave.
As Jack Clark nodded slightly to the people on the warship, the True Martial King flew over and handed him a chip.
“Jack Clark, this is the list of people who will accompany you to the Flame Wheel Divine Domain. Have a look and see if there’s anyone you need to adjust or add.”
“Let me see.”
Jack Clark took the crystal chip, scanned it with his mind, and instantly the names of tens of thousands and the notes on why they were chosen all appeared.
In the list, Jack Clark saw many familiar names.
For example, Mandy Lewis and Crystal Lewis, who had already made breakthroughs to the Eight Layer Heaven, were also included, with the note being that their talent was ranked within the top hundred among the Younger Generation and sufficiently strong.
Also, as the recipient of the Ancient Inferno Heavenly Empress’s Inheritance, if that Ancient Monarch King hadn’t fallen, the two sisters might have other opportunities on this trip.
Besides them, there were Ilisa Ward, Damon Lopes, Eddy Keller, Balderas, Justin Welan, Joshua Welan, and others.
During the two months of Jack Clark’s closed-door cultivation, Damon Lopes had broken through to a Mythical King, Eddy Keller, and Balderas had also reached the peak of the Ninth Heavens.
As for Justin Welan, also at the Eight Layer realm, his remark was also for receiving ancient inheritance, which could give him a chance to tempt his fate in the Divine Realm.
But then Jack Clark’s gaze paused and landed on the name ‘Howard Lambert.’
This guy, since his show-off attempt failed at the Senior One’s new semester opening ceremony, re-entered the mythical world, then took on an exploration mission and had since vanished without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1724 - 1724 635 Departing on a Long Journey Target
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1724: Chapter 635 Departing on a Long Journey, Target: Ancient Human Race_3 Chapter 1724: Chapter 635 Departing on a Long Journey, Target: Ancient Human Race_3 He was unable to participate in the two major battles with the Purgatory Demon Race that followed.
Now reappearing, his cultivation realm has broken through the late period of the Ninth Heavens and it’s noted that he similarly obtained an ancient inheritance and possesses outstanding talent.
His disappearance for so long was due to his fall into a relic that he was exploring, and it wasn’t until recently that his cultivation realm broke through, allowing him to emerge.
“This guy is actually quite lucky.”
Among the southern younger generation of South Sky Martial Height, Howard Lambert ranks third, just behind Jack Clark and Jane Aiken, but amongst the entire southern younger generation, his talent is considered above average.
However, with a will as mad as a demon’s, through numerous insane battles and leveraging insights from near-death experiences to break limits, he continuously progressed.
Unexpectedly, he once again received an ancient inheritance from a Divine Gods Alliance relic, which directly bumped his cultivation realm to catch up with Eddy Keller.
This time, due to another relic, after a few months in seclusion, his cultivation has broken through the late Ninth Heavens and placed him among the top geniuses, just below Eddy Keller and Balderas.
However, after Jack Clark finished checking the list, he looked puzzled towards the True Martial King: “True Martial Senior, why don’t I see Jim?”
Glenn Clark’s talent is undoubtedly unquestionable, and even without relying on Jack Clark’s influence, he was still among the first to be confirmed for this expedition.
But on the list, Jack Clark did not see Glenn Clark.
The True Martial King gave a bitter smile: “…Glenn’s current status is a bit special.”
“Is he in trouble?” Jack Clark frowned slightly, wondering if his guess was correct.
But it wasn’t right; as brothers, if Glenn was in trouble, Jack would have sensed it immediately with his blood bond.
The True Martial King shook his head with a bitter smile: “No trouble, or rather, he has obtained an immense fortune, Jack, you know of that ancient relic sent by the Divine Gods Alliance right?”
“I know, where did Jim go?”
For that ancient relic spanning millions of kilometers, inaccessible even by ancient powerhouses, Jack Clark was naturally familiar.
War King Elmore Hall had obtained a heritage there, possessing the battle strength to confront the Great Demon King using the Legendary Realm.
Jonathan Walker had betrayed them because he encountered Tyris in that relic.
The True Martial King explained: “A month ago, Glenn broke through the late Ninth Heavens, and hearing about that relic, he set off immediately, hoping to encounter some opportunity to advance into the Mythical-level earlier than planned.”
“Unexpectedly, he really found such an opportunity, and it was in the most ancient core divine temple of that relic, which has never been opened for tens of thousands of years.”
“When Glenn entered the relic and accidentally triggered a prohibited area, he was transported instantaneously into the divine temple that emerged from deep within the space-time.”
“At that moment, when Glenn was enveloped by the prohibition, Gentry Gail, who was following behind, prepared to take action, but was stopped by the First Councilor emerging from the depths of the Void.”
“The First Councilor is currently guarding that relic and asked me to assure you to be at ease; Glenn is fine and is accepting the heritage of the relic.”
“As for him, having discovered something else deeper within the Void, he’s preparing to research it, so he won’t be joining us on our trip to the Divine Realm.”
“And incidentally, he will be guarding this book from the mythical world.”
“Jim, he actually triggered the inheritance of that relic!” Jack Clark narrowed his eyes, somewhat surprised by this outcome.
He had also guessed that Glenn could very likely be the last Child of Destiny of the Blue Star World, born of fate.
If Jack had not awakened his memories, awakened the Giant Beast Body and ‘talent’ attribute page, the person leading the rise of the Human Race would have been him.
Including the conjecture once held by Demon God Constantin that Jack was a reincarnation from a strand of origin of the Primordial Giant Beast that had fallen unknown years ago in the Human Territory.
Jack had also entertained this thought, but he felt that the person should be Glenn.
Otherwise, the Child of Destiny alone, from before the destruction of Blue Star, could not support Glenn’s heaven-defying luck and growth speed – entirely the treatment of a Child of Destiny.
But unexpectedly, Glenn’s real opportunity was in that ancient relic.
“Since Senior Adam Garcetti said he is fine, then let’s leave him be.” Jack Clark nodded.
At this moment, Glenn’s entraction to the ancient relic might be a kind of sign, like his path not being on the side of ancient humans, but rather having another fate.
“Let’s go, we’re departing.”
At the forefront of the warship, resembling a mountain peak thousands of meters high, the bridge, Sherry Williams’ face showed a faint smile as she saw Jack Clark approaching.
Chirp! Bright and majestic, like the cry of a true Phoenix Bird resurging, echoing through heaven and earth.
Suddenly, extending over a hundred kilometers, like a real Black Colossus, the warship jolted into motion, emitting circles of black halos twisting the space, shooting forward.
In just a blink, the black Phoenix Bird transformed into a black rainbow light appearing over hundreds of thousands of kilometers, comparable to a True Spirit Powerhouse.
As they watched the Earth swiftly shrink behind them at a terrifying speed, on the edge of the warship, the faces of tens of thousands of humans showed nervous, excited, and dazed expressions.
This departure might last a very long time.
After all, the journey between the Human Federation and the Divine Realm is vast; even with a map, a True Spirit Powerhouse takes over two months, while a Mythical Powerhouse journeying might take over ten years.
This is due to the disparity in speeds and many dangerous forbidden areas that Mythical Powerhouses cannot traverse.
And at that very moment, as Jack Clark and the others departed, many felt a premonition.
In the Divine Gods Alliance, deep within the majestic golden temple, prepared for breaking through to True Spirit, Tarrod looked up, his third eye in the center of his forehead shimmering with golden light, peering in this direction.
Blue Star World.
On the scorching surface of the sun, a towering mech of two hundred thousand meters stood, its pale blue gaze piercing the world, silently watching the direction the warship vanished.
Beneath the feet of Number One, stood a thousand-meter-long, golden-feather-covered Three-legged Divine Bird.
This Divine Bird had just been born, still in its juvenile stage, yet it already exuded a Mythical-level aura, clearly an Innate Life.

chapters.title: Chapter 1725 - 1725 636 The Emperor Dragon Awakens I Must
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1725: Chapter 636: The Emperor Dragon Awakens, I Must Leave Now Chapter 1725: Chapter 636: The Emperor Dragon Awakens, I Must Leave Now The moment the departing troop set off, a red lotus the size of a palm slowly emerged in the void above the projection of the Golden Divine Tree, tens of thousands of kilometers tall, and then exploded.
An infinite burst of flames erupted in an instant.
These flames, like phantoms, expanded at an indescribable speed, looking from afar like a red lotus unfolding over an area of millions of kilometers.
At this moment, time in this World seemed to have come to a standstill.
An invisible force even seeped through layers of space, infiltrating the Solar System World via the pathway of the Golden Divine Tree’s projection, enveloping the space around Blue Star.
In an instant, everyone’s ‘memories’ of Jack Clark changed.
For those below the Legendary Realm, their memories were directly tampered with, while for those above, the memories were blurred.
In these ‘people’s memories, the two-year timeline was stretched by more than tenfold, Jack Clark still had exceptional talents and great strength, but was no longer as shocking as before.
Forcibly modifying the memories of Mythical Powerhouses was bound to cause bugs, but merely extending the memory timeline seemed more reasonable.
Including all traces that Jack Clark once existed in this space, all were burned by tendrils of red flames.
On the side of the mythical world, the ethereal red lotus continued to bloom and spread, becoming fainter as it swept past ten million kilometers before slowly disappearing.
Everything that happened in this World was the same as in the Solar System.
All Living Beings’ memories of Jack Clark changed, and the traces of his existence were burned to nothingness by the purgatorial flames.
Plus, with Sherry Williams earlier convening all Mythical Powerhouses to erase Jack Clark’s information on the internet, in books, and in some material records.
At this moment, apart from a few limited individuals, no one remembered a ‘youth’ who was a Peak of the Ancient at less than two years, with invincible fighting power and heaven-defying talent.
“His traces of existence have been erased.”
Standing above the sun, the Golden-White Mecha trembled slightly as it watched the red lotus purgatorial flames disappear, turning its massive body to walk into the depths of the sun, somewhat disoriented.
“Let’s go, Little Gold, it’s time to ‘return’.”
With a whoosh! The Three-legged Golden Crow spread its double wings, stirring up the sky with flames as it soared, slowly disappearing together with Freya Louise.
Due to the power of the Heavenly Dao, Freya Louise wasn’t much affected, but watching the path once ‘traveled’ by that youth being erased, she inexplicably felt a touch of faint sadness.
Because in those traces of time spent at South Sky Martial Height, there was her presence.
In the mythical world, deep into layers of space, all that remained was the immense blackness of the Void, a huge shadow stood, with a faint look of confusion in its eyes.
“My memory seems to have been influenced by some force?”
At this moment, Adam Garcetti’s figure constantly shifted, alternating among three forms: a human, a God Demon with three heads and eight arms, and an upper body of a human with the lower half of a pitch-black snake.
His gaze fluctuated between composed, mad, and indifferent expressions.
Around him, the rules of life and death and the Void tangled and interwoven, forming a region where life and death were illusory and twisted, with bizarre visions flickering from time to time.
Only the upper half of a baby with a sinister smile, a white teddy bear with nine feet, and a black python covered in eyes all over and no mouth.
Under the twirl of these eerie twisted phantoms, Adam Garcetti, standing in the Void, gave off a sense of absurd, twisted madness, eeriness, and majesty.
As if he were a Hell Demon God suppressing the infinite Void.
Meanwhile, in the material space corresponding to this Void, in an ancient Golden Divine temple drifting deep in time, stood a lavishly tall Golden Divine Throne.
Upon the Golden Divine Throne sat Glenn Clark, whose towering figure was clad in pure gold battle armor; he slowly opened his eyes.
Boom!
An instant terrifying pressure spread out, a magnificent Overbearing strength filling the entire Divine temple, causing it to tremble slightly, elevating Glenn Clark’s majesty to the extreme.
Glenn Clark looked up with eyes as pure as if they were forged, a vague shadow of a red lotus appearing within, followed by his deep and resonant voice vibrating through the Void.
“Big brother, have you left?”
With that, Glenn Clark slowly closed his eyes again, the throne ensconced by a pillar of golden light that pierced Heaven and Earth, like an eternal supreme being.
…
The Black Warship, which had flown out more than two million kilometers, was also swept over by the instantly spreading red lotus purgatorial flames.
Under that power, everyone’s memories were affected.
Standing atop the towering Heaven Observation Tower, Jack Clark and Sherry Williams stood shoulder to shoulder, admiring the lotus spreading across the Firmament from its bloom to disappearance.
“The Blazing Heaven True Emperor has really thought it through.”
The flame lotus Sherry Williams handed to Jack Clark earlier contained not only the experiences and Secret Skills for opening up the Divine Realm but also this Primordial Force.
To be used when Jack Clark was departing, erasing the last hidden danger about his information.
“Master has always been thoughtful,” Sherry said with a faint smile on her face.
“However, this move can only delay for a while. Once you enter Chaos Outside Heaven, with your talents, Brother Clark, you’ll still be exposed to the eyes of other peak races.”
Jack Clark also smiled, “No worries, as long as it can be delayed for half a year to a year, by then even if the Primordial tries to assassinate me, I’m confident I can retreat unscathed.”
As he finished speaking, Jack Clark paused slightly.
Noticing the change in Jack Clark’s expression, Sherry became curious, “Brother Clark, what’s wrong?”
“Nothing.” Jack Clark came back to his senses, shaking his head.
However, at this moment, in his other perspective, the entire world was cheering.
Chaotic Turbulent Region.
The Seven-colored Dawn Vortex that had shrouded the Firmament for over two months was dissipating, turning into a sky full of seven-colored light rain and streams of seven-colored ribbons falling down.

chapters.title: Chapter 1726 - 1726 636 The Emperor Dragon Awakens I Must
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1726: Chapter 636: The Emperor Dragon Awakens, I Must Leave Now_2 Chapter 1726: Chapter 636: The Emperor Dragon Awakens, I Must Leave Now_2 These light rains contain an incredibly marvelous power. The moment they hit the ground, lush grasslands and towering forests of tall trees spring up on the previously barren and silent land at a shocking speed. At the same time, countless vapors in the sky converge out of thin air, turning into a torrential downpour mixed with the light rain.
Just a moment ago, due to the arrival of the True Spirit of the Void, a million kilometers of the land destroyed by the aftermath of the battle is now teeming with vitality.
This scene leaves all the Giant Beasts of the Dragon Palace Empire dumbfounded.
It is at this time that the Time Dragon roars: “Roar! Don’t stand there in a daze. This is an opportunity bestowed by Heaven and Earth, celebrating the appearance of a new True Spirit and new Heavenly Earth Rules.”
“Pay attention to those rainbow lights. They are the manifestations of the pure Power of Heaven and Earth and can be directly absorbed.”
Boom!
The Time Dragon’s body bursts with silver brilliance, its terrifying Time Power envelops a range of ten thousand kilometers, slowing time to a crawl within this area.
Only the figure with massive, unfurled wings chasing streamers of rainbow light rising into the sky is unaffected.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!! In the blink of an eye, the Time Dragon inhales more than a dozen streamers of rainbow light, each dozens of meters long like silk ribbons.
With every streamer of rainbow light it swallows, the Time Dragon’s aura grows stronger, and even the powerful bloodline within its body becomes more active.
Roar roar roar!!
Immediately all the Giant Beasts respond, roaring excitedly as they surge into the sky.
Among them, the eight Ancient Dragon Kings have the most massive presence, unfolding their rules and directly covering tens of thousands of kilometers, with the Titan Beasts and Mythical Giant Beasts not willing to show weakness.
Roar roar roar!! Mine, it’s all mine.
The Single-horned Spawn Roc spreads its wings, its surrounding Black and White Domain turns black, forming a black hole with a thousand kilometer diameter, exerting a terrifying suction force and madly absorbing the surrounding light rain and streamers.
Roar! Damn it, leave some for Old man Domination.
The cumbersome Deep Sea Dragon Turtle rises from the sea and pounces on a hundred-meter-long rainbow streamer.
The Red Candle Dragon, the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, the Titan Longa King, as well as the Female Tiger Whale, the Blue Giant Crab, and other Giant Beasts are not to be outdone.
On the calm azure sea surface, the black Little Tiger Whale looks at the Mythical Giant Beasts and Titan Beasts roaring into the sky and turns its head to fly towards the distance.
Roar roar roar!! Miss Keller, follow me over there, they’ve taken everything here.
Roar roar!! Alright, leader. The Female Tiger Whale, one hundred and forty meters long and carrying a pink little bag on its Dorsal Fin, hurriedly follows.
This light rain covers millions of kilometers, with streamers of rainbow light drifting across the sky, magnificently vast, as if the whole world is celebrating.
Compared to breaking through to True Spirit, humans or other different races that become too powerful will be suppressed, but Giant Beasts are the darlings of this World.
While head after head of excited Giant Beasts chase after the rainbow brilliance, in the skies above, the Chaos Light Egg gathering more Power of Heaven and Earth is collapsing and compressing.
Soon, the light egg with a diameter of more than a hundred thousand kilometers disappears, and a Colossal Beast covered in black-red Scaled Armor appears, surrounded by a dazzling halo of black-red brilliance.
And just at the moment this Colossal Beast appears, an extreme terror of oppression bursts forth.
Boom!
The brains of all Giant Beasts roar, feeling as if the whole world is shaking, Heaven and Earth reversing, everything collapsing, and the only thing remaining in their eyes is that sky-obscuring black-red figure.
Thump thump thump!!
All the Giant Beasts fall from the sky, their massive bodies crashing onto the Earth like meteors, causing the surrounding land to shatter, mountain peaks to collapse, and amid the clouds of smoke and dust, all Giant Beasts instinctively bow their heads.
Even those Ancient Beasts, including the Peak of the Ancient’s Lava nine-headed giant dragon, do not possess the right to stand before that terrifying Colossal Beast at this moment.
It’s at this time that two proud and dignified roars explode, mixed with the auras belonging to the peaks of the Titans.
“Roar! The invincible Great Sethia.”
“And the magnificent Telsafi.”
Around the large black-red Colossal Beast, a four-thousand three-hundred-meter-long Silver Giant Dragon and a gold-blue Giant Dragon excitedly circle, emitting high and proud Dragon Roars.
At this moment, the two dramatically transformed giant dragons were enveloped in the celestial pressure of Monarch-level bloodlines, appearing extremely noble and majestic.
The scene below showed countless Ancient Beasts with their eyes widening in astonishment.
“The Monarch, the bloodlines of Great Scythia have actually ascended to Monarch level!!” The Time Dragon was somewhat shocked and bewildered.
It had not anticipated that with the assistance from the Destruction Emperor Dragon, the two Titan Realm giant dragons would truly break through the Bloodline Shackles and step into the Monarch level.
At this time, all of the Ancient Beasts’ eyes revealed intense envy.
For it was a bloodline echelon on par with the True Spirit Beasts and many Primordial Beasts, and given no mishaps along the way, the two giant dragons were guaranteed to reach the True Spirit realm.
While those beasts were stunned and disoriented, the Black-red Colossal Beast, orbited by the two ‘Little’ ones, lowered its head, and with its terrifying and oppressive golden vertical pupils, surveyed itself.
The biggest change from this breakthrough into the True Spirit was the color of its scale armor, turning from Black Gold to an ink-black hue, deep and abyss-like.
Yet within the cracks between those black scales, a blood-red light shimmered, exuding a strong sense of ill omen and destructive intent.
Especially the large and hefty scales, each raised with sharp ridges fanning outward like blades.
Coupled with the three rows of sharp mountain peak-like dorsal fins on its back, the black barbs grown from the joints on its four claws, and a tail that resembled a slender slash blade—its appearance was utterly fierce.
As for the dragon head, it still had black mane-like flames dancing about, malevolent dragon horns akin to a crown, and three pairs of razor-sharp feather horns resembling two pairs of wings, adding splendor and authority to its visage.
Its appearance hadn’t changed drastically, but its body length had surged from 50,000 meters to over 198,000 meters, resembling a true Black-red mountain range spanning across the Firmament.
What was most terrifying was inside the Destruction Emperor Dragon.
Fused with the Supreme Rule of Chaos Doomsday, and melding the Power of Heaven and Earth across billions of kilometers, the True Body of the Giant Beast was extraordinarily potent; its pulsing, fiery Qi Blood capable of incinerating Heaven and Earth, akin to the Apocalypse Cauldron.
Just standing in the Firmament, its invisible power twisted all matter, space, and even time around it, affecting a radius of a million kilometers.
If the Destruction Emperor Dragon had not contained its power, the horrific gravity that surrounded it would have long shredded the orbiting Silver Giant Dragon and Gold-Blue Giant Dragon.
Moreover, it couldn’t descend anymore.
Boom!
With a heavy step, the Destruction Emperor Dragon caused the entire Chaotic Turbulent Region to shake violently. Around it, chains of tangible rules emerged, emanating strong rejection.
Although the Giant Beasts were favored in the mythical world, the Destruction Emperor Dragon at this moment was too strong, essentially too formidable for this world to bear.
“Roar! Tim Abott, aren’t we descending?”
The excited Silver Giant Dragon, witnessing the enormous beast move a foot only to stop again, revealed a puzzled look.
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly lowered its head, looking at the tiny Silver Giant Dragon before it, its sinister mouth opening slightly to emit a terrifying growl: “I… I can’t go down.”
…Can’t go down? The Silver Giant Dragon was taken aback.
The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon’s eyes revealed seriousness: “Is it because your Thunderflame power is too great?”
“Yes.”
The Destruction Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, its voice like thunder from the Heavenly Dao, shaking the entire world and resounding in the ears of all the beasts: “I… am about to leave.”
Departure.
On the ground, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, and other excited beasts that had just broken through to the True Spirit were all bewildered.
They had anticipated that after the Destruction Emperor Dragon’s ascension to the True Spirit, becoming even more invincible, it would lead them to dominate the entire Vast World.
How suddenly it mentioned leaving.
However, for this spectacle, the Time Dragon and other Ancient Dragon Kings like the Blue-White Giant Dragon had long anticipated it. As the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon said, the Destruction Emperor Dragon was too powerful.
In the Ancient Late Stage, capable of contending with the Late Stage of True Spirit, Purgatory ancestors, now crossing the Peak of the Ancient to become even more fearsome True Spirit Beasts, its strength was unfathomable.
It had even surpassed the True Spirit Category, akin to the Primordial; naturally, this world could not sustain it.
Or it’s not that the mythical world couldn’t bear the Primordial life, but such beings, akin to a black hole, would affect the stability of the world around them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1727 - 1727 637 Tearing the Blue Sky Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1727: Chapter 637: Tearing the Blue Sky, Primordial Beast Horde Chapter 1727: Chapter 637: Tearing the Blue Sky, Primordial Beast Horde Above the Firmament, chains hundreds of meters thick, white and transparent, formed by the pure Heavenly Earth Rules, emerged, emitting a dazzling light.
These Rule Chains, one end reaching into the Void, and the other end intersecting and converging like a net of light, appeared under the Black-red Colossal Beast to prevent it from descending onto the Earth.
At the same time, there was an invisible repelling force around it, gradually strengthening.
According to the growth rate of this repulsive strength, it is estimated that in at most half a day, even if the Terminal Emperor Dragon does not leave on its own, it will be forcibly expelled from the mythical world.
And in front of the two hundred kilometers long Terminal Emperor Dragon, was the Silver Giant Dragon and the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, only a few kilometers in length, hovering with their wings spread.
However, at this time, the two dragons no longer retained the excitement they had upon first awakening and advancing in their bloodline.
This included those Giant Beasts on the Earth, who were also stunned by the Azure Heaven Emperor Dragon’s statement about its departure.
Watching the shocked and bewildered Giant Beasts below, and the stunned Silver Giant Dragon, the deep and majestic voice of the Terminal Emperor Dragon echoed through Heaven and Earth once more.
“Everyone, there is no need for sorrow. This king is merely venturing to the Chaos Outside Heaven, not perishing. The day when you all enter the realm beyond, we shall meet again.”
“Perhaps by then, this king will have established an even greater Beast Empire and dominated the Chaos Void.”
“And once this king’s strength becomes even mightier later, I will come back to tear open a stable pathway. By then, even Mythical Giant Beasts should be able to enter the realm beyond.”
Having broken through to the True Spirit Realm and fused with Doomsday, which contains the Supreme Rules of ‘Chaos and Destruction’, and molded by the Power of Heaven and Earth a thousand times that of his peers, the body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon had already exceeded the True Spirit Category.
However, despite his power surpassing the realm, he still belonged to the True Spirit level and was still some distance away from the Primordial True Emperors, thus incapable of creating a stable pathway outside heaven.
Still, even this was enough to uplift the spirits of the Giant Beasts below.
The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle roared excitedly, “Thunderflame, remember your promise! You must come back and open the pathway and take us to the realm beyond to eat and drink well.”
Roar roar roar! Thunderflame, remember to save us some good stuff. The Single-horned Spawn Roc was instantly excited.
Bearing the invisible oppression, the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah writhing its nine dragon heads, roared chaotically, “Roar roar roar!! Abbott, when I enter the realm beyond, I still want to hang with you.”
These Giant Beasts, which were just now a bit uneasy and sorrowful, ignited with excitement once again.
With the terrifying growth rate of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, and entering the vast and magnificent Chaos Void, its strength might grow even more frighteningly fast.
It might not be long before the Terminal Emperor Dragon returns to open the pathway to the realm beyond.
Subsequently, the Giant Beasts roared and called one after another, and after about more than ten minutes, the Terminal Emperor Dragon continued to speak, his voice thundering and echoing through Heaven and Earth like thunder.
“Before leaving, this king has some matters to inform.”
“From now on, all Dragon Kings shall preside over regions, each ruling part of the empire territory, with the range of the territory determined by strength—the stronger the rule, the larger the territory.”
“And regarding important matters of the Beast Empire, a Dragon King Hall meeting shall still be convened.”
“As for the position of the Lord of the Dragon King Hall, Scythia will act as a substitute after this king departs, holding absolute decision power. I suppose no one has any objections.”
In the past, more than ten Dragon Kings, including eight Ancient Beasts, could coexist harmoniously because they were suppressed by the more overbearing and powerful Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Once it leaves, if the centralized model of the past was to continue, given the combative nature and racial instincts of the beasts, it would not be long before unrest occurs.
Therefore, separation is the best method, avoiding friction among the various Dragon Kings.
Especially for those like the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle and the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah, who are only of the Legendary Realm but hold the position of Dragon King, they are naturally a rank below those Ancient Dragon Kings.
Thus, this command is actually a form of protection for them.
As for Scythia, the Lord of the Dragon King Hall.
As a Titan Peak Giant Dragon, and having ascended to Monarch bloodline with four top-tier talents, the Silver Giant Dragon’s strength was already not inferior to the ancient level.
Together with the ‘good friends’ Gold-Blue Giant Dragon, the Ancient Beast Blue-White Giant Dragon, and the Time Dragon for support, it was sufficient to securely hold the position of Lord and Big Dragon King.
The vast Ancient Lava Giant Beast growled lowly, “We will follow the king’s arrangement, we have no objections.”
Seeing the strongest Lava Giant Beast speaking out, the other Giant Beasts naturally had no objections, or rather, faced with the commands of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, they dared not voice any objections, and nodded in agreement.
But today, the Silver Giant Dragon was unusually quiet. Emerging as the Lord of the Dragon King Hall, it didn’t issue an excited roar.
With its majestic wings fluttering slightly, the Gold-Blue Giant Dragon’s dragon head approached the Silver Giant Dragon, growling inquisitively, “Scythia, are you alright?”
“Roar! Go away, Torsa! Great Scythia is not in a good mood and doesn’t want to deal with you.”
Saying this, the wings of the Silver Giant Dragon fluttered, turning into a silver brilliance and flying towards the back, disappearing behind the gigantic ridge-like back of the Terminal Emperor Dragon in the blink of an eye.
So this guy is really in a bad mood. The Gold-Blue Giant Dragon sighed internally.
It, too, was reluctant about the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s sudden departure, but there was no helping it. The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s growth and talents were too fearsome.
Even if they used all their strength, they couldn’t catch up to its shadow.
This day had been anticipated, but it had arrived sooner than expected.
The gigantic and fierce dragon head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon turned back, looking at the somewhat dejected Silver Giant Dragon that flew behind its tail, drifting in the void, its back turned to them, and paused for a moment.
At that moment, the Silver Giant Dragon was like a sulking little girl crouching in a corner doodling circles.

chapters.title: Chapter 1728 - 1728 637 Tearing the Azure Sky Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1728: Chapter 637: Tearing the Azure Sky, Primordial Giant Beast Group_2 Chapter 1728: Chapter 637: Tearing the Azure Sky, Primordial Giant Beast Group_2 But in the end, the Terminal Emperor Dragon still shook its head slightly, dismissing the thought of bringing the Silver Giant Dragon along.
The Chaotic Outside Heaven is too dangerous. The environment itself is not a big deal. The trouble is the Primordial Beasts, different races of primordial creatures, and the horrific entities that could be encountered at any time.
Even for the Terminal Emperor Dragon, there’s no certainty that it could protect it against these formidable lives that have evolved beyond primordial times.
“Ultimately, this king made a promise to elevate the bloodlines for you, Disaster Tyria, after the breakthrough to True Spirit. Do not resist what comes next.”
Roar roar!! Suddenly, even the Ancient Lava Giant Beast and the Blue-White Giant Dragon couldn’t help but let out excited roars, while the King of Blade Edge’s beast also seemed excited.
Because only a few of them qualified in the great expedition battle.
Boom!
A terrifying pressure oscillated through space-time; in the Firmament above, an endless resplendence of black-red light gathered, forming the giant shadow of a beast that stretched over a hundred thousand kilometers.
The star-like phantasmal beast slowly lowered its head.
Roar!
A roar containing Heavenly Tier bloodline resonated through heaven and earth, echoing across this realm of space-time. All beasts instinctively felt awe, trembling, and an uprising under that supreme pressure.
The bloodlines of all the giant beasts from the Dragon Palace Empire explosively erupted, unleashing a horrifying strength like boiling water, causing them great discomfort.
Roar roar roar!!
In pain, all the giant beasts couldn’t help but let out ferocious roars, rolling wildly on the ground destroying everything in their surroundings.
While all the empire’s beasts were having their bloodlines activated under the roar of the black-red phantasmal beast, more than twenty strands of pure golden light flickered through heaven and earth.
These glimmers of light, vast and small, were condensed from the aura of the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s bloodline and the origin of the power of Heaven and Earth.
Among them, three strands of bloodline light, each a hundred meters long, entered the bodies of the Ancient Lava Giant Beast, the Blue-White Giant Dragon, and the King of Blade Edge, which had performed best in the previous battle, under the control of an invisible force.
Following that, four strands of bloodline light, each more than 50 meters long, merged into the bodies of the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the Red Candle Dragon, the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, and the Nine-headed monster Ghidorah.
Then, five strands of bloodline light, each more than thirty meters long, disappeared on the bodies of the Time Dragon, the Ancient Batfin, the black Kirin, the Gray Python, and the Void Python – the Five Ancient Dragon Kings.
Apart from that, the Titan Longa King, the Kamaitachi Beast, the Female Tiger Whale, the Blue Giant Crab, Tiger One, Tiger Two, Tiger Three, and the three little Tiger Whales did not go unnoticed, each receiving a strand of bloodline light that is ten meters long.
Even the ‘wife’ of the black Little Tiger Whale, Miss Keller, and the unnoticeable mermaid sisters Rain Lawson and Ning Lawson each received a strand of light that is one meter long.
This event could be said to celebrate the entire sky. All the giant beasts that were remembered by the Terminal Emperor Dragon received the bestowed gifts.
Particularly those beasts that started following the Terminal Emperor Dragon from the Blue Star World, all received terrifying rewards.
A strand of Heavenly Tier bloodline essence, plus the origin of the Power of Heaven and Earth of a True Spirit Beast, was enough to significantly purify or even advance their bloodlines, causing their strength to skyrocket.
Boom boom boom!!
As a powerful aura erupted on each of the giant beasts, flashes of Rule and Law Origin light shone, causing the surroundings of heaven and earth to go into turmoil, with endless Heavenly Energy pouring towards them like crazy.
Looking at the colorful land of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, the Terminal Emperor Dragon suppressed the boiling of its own bloodline and looked ahead at the regally elegant gold-blue Giant Dragon.
“Telsafi, your bloodline level along with Scythia’s has now crossed into Monarch. All you need to do now is to cultivate with effort, and one day you will step into the realm of True Spirit.”
“Keep it up, I’ll wait for you in the Chaotic Outside Heaven.”
The gold-blue giant dragon growled, “Don’t worry Thunderflame, I will cultivate diligently and catch up with you soon.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded slowly, and finally glanced at the Silver Giant Dragon drawing circles behind its tail, no longer suppressing the repulsion force from Heaven and Earth.
Boom!
The massive body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon shook as its wings unfolded. The surrounding space-time began to twist as it flew higher into a realm beyond under the mythical world’s repulsion.
At the same time, around the body of the gold-blue giant dragon, an invisible power encircled and guided it to fly down towards the Earth.
More than a hundred thousand kilometers high Firmament is a region where only True Spirit Beasts can stand. Any creature without True Spirit Level strength will be torn apart by the terrifying rules in an instant.
Therefore, while leaving, the Terminal Emperor Dragon did not forget to escort them part of the way.
But just then, as the Terminal Emperor Dragon ascended, the Silver Giant Dragon, which had been squatting in the corner drawing circles, burst into a dazzling silver light.
Crack!!
Around the Silver Giant Dragon, the invisible force that was protecting them to fly downward was torn apart, and then it opened its massive mouth, biting onto the tail of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
“Scythia, what are you doing?” The gold-blue giant dragon, already a thousand kilometers fallen, showed a look of astonishment, and what replied to it was an excited roar from the Silver Giant Dragon.
Because it clung tightly to the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s tail, the Silver Giant Dragon shook the world with its will this time.
“Roar! Who cares about Dragon King Hall’s Lord, the Big Dragon King. Great Scythia doesn’t give a damn.”
“Great Scythia wants to go with Tim Abott to the Chaotic Outside Heaven, to battle in the Void, wanting to make the primordial beasts’ blood run in rivers.”
Damn, this guy must have been planning this the whole time.
Watching the Silver Giant Dragon that was ‘gradually’ ascending and showing a triumphant look while latched onto Terminal Emperor Dragon’s tail, the gold-blue giant dragon that kept plummeting felt regretful.
It never expected to be outsmarted by that idiot one day.
The depressed, angry look the Silver Giant Dragon showed before was actually just to numb it. Damn, when did this guy get so smart?
The ascending Black-red Colossal Beast looked back and saw the Silver Giant Dragon biting its tail, much like a white mouse, and paused for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1729 - 1729 637 Tearing the Azure Sky Primordial
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1729: Chapter 637: Tearing the Azure Sky, Primordial Giant Beast Group_3 Chapter 1729: Chapter 637: Tearing the Azure Sky, Primordial Giant Beast Group_3 The Silver Giant Dragon was startled and roared lowly: “Roar! Tim Abott, you can’t just abandon Great Sethia!”
“Fine then.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon roared lowly and then a blood-red lightning shattered the warped space-time around, lifting the Silver Giant Dragon by its tail onto its back.
Actually, the Silver Giant Dragon was tearing through space and biting towards its tail when the Terminal Emperor Dragon noticed, always ready to react.
It’s just that feeling the solid will emanating from the Silver Giant Dragon, the Terminal Emperor Dragon softened its heart for a moment and did not refuse. If this fool wants to go beyond the heavens, let him be.
“Roar! Tim Abott, I knew you were the best.”
Standing on the broad and solid shoulders of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, looking down more proudly where the golden-blue dragon had already disappeared into the layers of Cloud Mist.
Including the earlier ‘conversation’ between the Terminal Emperor Dragon and the other giant beasts, space-time between both sides was distorted.
Otherwise, separated by hundreds of thousands of kilometers, aside from those Ancient Beasts, no other beast could see it.
Outside the Chaotic Heavens, which seemed a million kilometers away from the Earth of the mythical world, was actually an immensely far real distance, separated by the extremely solid Boundary Wall.
When the Terminal Emperor Dragon ascended to 300,000 kilometers high, all matter around had vanished, filled with chaotic and powerful Space-Time Storm.
These Space-Time Storms merged with the World’s Power, their strength was enough to heavily injure a True Spirit Beast.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Black-red radiance enveloped the surroundings of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, covering an area of ten thousand kilometers, filled with chaos, destructive rules annihilated all the Space-Time Storms, and emitted a dazzling energy halo.
From afar, it looked like a dazzling star with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers was rising.
Deep within the mythical land, waves of Terrifying Aura surged, many powerful and ancient lives were startled, gazing at that rising and increasingly shining black-red star.
“Has another beast broken through to Primordial?”
“Heaven and Earth are unfair, why do these beasts achieve primordial breakthroughs more easily than us.”
“Pity, I don’t know if I will ever turn into a star…”
Sighing, lamenting, and voices of discontent arose from various places in the mythical world, yet those who reached the Pinnacle of True Spirit but could not break through went back into hibernation.
“Brother Clark, a beast has made a primordial breakthrough.”
Upon the swiftly flying Black Warship, Sherry Williams was also somewhat astonished while looking at the shining star in the sky, vaguely discerning a blurred beast figure.
“Yes.”
Looking at the increasingly ‘distant’ black-red star in the sky, Jack Clark slowly nodded.
…
Darkness, void, filled with murky streams, a heavy transparent Boundary Wall lay across, boundless, like a wall dividing the void above and below.
At that moment, the heavy transparent Boundary Wall below gradually became indistinct, and a Black-red Colossal Beast of about two hundred thousand meters in length appeared.
Boom!
The moment the Terminal Emperor Dragon arrived in the Chaos Void, the surrounding murky streams vibrated, forming rings of violent circular air bursts sweeping hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
And the moment the Terminal Emperor Dragon arrived, it keenly sensed that this part addCriterion( were somewhat ‘terrifying’.
There was no complete space here, the Void seemed dark, yet was like fragments of space of varying sizes and strengths composed of numerous patches.
Simply put, it was similar to a honeycomb, ‘space’ only occupied one-tenth, filled with countless gigantic void black holes leading to unknown locations.
Those faint murky streams, surrounding those ‘space materials’, invisibly emitted a Destructive Aura that dissolved all matter and energy.
This scene had some similarities to the Destruction Forbidden Zone where the Ancient Batfin Beast resided.
“Roar! Tim Abott, is this the outer Chaos?”
Standing on the shoulder of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon surveyed its surroundings, especially the grey stream-filled dark regions, which made it feel somewhat uneasy.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon lowly roared, “Yes, this is the outer Chaos.”
“But we are still within a safe zone, at the border between the Vast World and the Chao Sea.” Saying this, the Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly lowered its head, looking downwards.
That boundless, enveloping the mythical world’s transparent Boundary Wall, commanded nearly all the view.
From the ‘height’ of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, even its vision reaching trillions of kilometers was not excessive, but in its eyes, the entire transparent Boundary Wall extended towards the end of the void, immense beyond imagination.
This ‘Mythical Giant Beast’ in hibernation, its size unimaginably vast, its exact size spanning countless light-years undetermined.
Just when the Terminal Emperor Dragon was shocked by the grandeur of the mythical world, above its head, the Purple little dragon that had absorbed the Primordial Dragon Pearl’s Inheritance opened its eyes, its gaze bewildered.
Squeak squeak!! Big brother, where is this place? Misss Joseline feels very comfortable.
Before the Terminal Emperor Dragon could speak, the Silver Giant Dragon on its shoulder already proudly roared, “Misss Joseline, you’ve woken up, this is the outer Chaos.”
“After Tim Abott broke through to True Spirit, his strength became too strong, and he was expelled by the Vast World.”
Squeak squeak!! Have we already come to the outer Heaven? Big brother is so powerful. As the Purple little dragon’s eyes revealed an admiring gaze.
But compared to the nearly two hundred thousand meters long Terminal Emperor Dragon, in its tiny form, the hundred-meter-long Purple little dragon was like a speck of dust.
Looking around at the murky streams, the Purple little dragon felt somewhat excited.
