Squeak squeak!! Big brother, Misss Joseline is hungry, let’s eat something first.
Buzz!
A radiance burst forth from the Purple little dragon, amidst dazzling brilliance a five-thousand-meters long Purple Divine Dragon emitting a Titan Aura appeared.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1730: Chapter 637: Tearing the Azure Sky, Primordial Beast Group_4 Chapter 1730: Chapter 637: Tearing the Azure Sky, Primordial Beast Group_4 Roar! The Void Dragon’s roar exploded through the air as a streak of purple radiance flashed by, and the Purple little dragon appeared in the distant Void, opening its mouth wide towards the murky currents.
Boom!
Thousands of kilometers of turbulent currents raged towards the maw of the Purple little dragon, continuously devoured by it.
As it swallowed the weak Chaos Qi, the aura of the Purple little dragon rapidly increased, and the purple glow radiating from its body grew ever brighter, turning its surroundings into a purple ocean.
Roar! The brilliance of the purple ocean churned as the enormous, boundless silhouette of the Purple Divine Dragon emerged, majestic and awe-inspiring, bellowing across the heavens.
Clearly, the Purple little dragon’s consumption of the Chaos Qi was not just out of hunger; the damaged Dragon Ball within it also needed the energy of Chaos.
However, the Purple Divine Dragon Shadow was merely the lingering aura of the Primordial Beast that fell, activated by the stimulation of the Chaos Qi.
So after roaring, it dissipated and vanished.
But the roar of the Divine Dragon Shadow alarmed some profound creatures deep within the Chaos.
In the incredibly distant depths of the Chaos, several stars twinkled faintly, and then several terrifying roars echoed through the Void, turning into intangible waves that spread outwards.
The Purple little dragon paused its engulfing of the murky currents and vaguely looked towards the direction of the twinkling stars, not outstretched its Dragon Claw towards that direction.
Eek eek!! Brother, it seems like someone is calling for Misss Joseline.
“Calling for you?” The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s gaze concentrated, looking deep into the pitch-black Void, it also faintly saw the light emitted by those stars.
The Purple little dragon nodded, emitting an immature sound: “Yes, it feels similar to the call coming from the Land of Fallen, very familiar.”
Primordial Beast herd!
At once, even the Terminal Emperor Dragon was slightly startled, it hadn’t expected the ‘family’ of the Purple little dragon to be so potent; especially as it had already witnessed the fall of two Primordial Beasts in a row, there were still Primordial presences ahead.
And it seemed there was more than one.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon growled softly: “Misss Joseline, do you want to go over there?”
“…I do, but Misss Joseline is afraid Brother will encounter danger,” hesitated the Purple little dragon, worry showing in its eyes.
In the fragment of the inherited Dragon Ball’s memory, there was a record of the Chaos Outside Heaven, knowing this place was dreadful, the deeper one went into the Void, the more dangerous it became.
But to its hesitation, the Terminal Emperor Dragon did not pay it much mind.
“If Misss Joseline wishes to go, then let’s, it would be a good opportunity to encounter those Primordial Beasts.”
Boom!
The Void trembled as the massive figure of the Black-red Colossal Beast stirred, like moving in the deep sea, stirring up the tumultuous currents as it soared towards the depths of the Void.
The colossal beasts of the Chaos Outside Heaven and the powers of the Human Divine Realm hardly interact.
These beasts, upon breaking through the Primordial Realm, would actively fly into the depths of the Chaos Void, to a fearsome battlefield, fighting against unknown formidable creatures.
In recent years, the Primordial Beasts that have been recorded as fallen by the ancient Human Race exceed a dozen.
Whenever they fell, these Primordial Beasts would tear through the heavens, turning into a ray of light falling from the sky into the mythical world, such as the Void Heaven Divine Dragon that ripped through the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
Regarding this phenomenon, the powerful peak races including the ancient Human Race were naturally curious.
But up to now, apart from the Primordial Powerhouses of these peak race civilizations, even Sherry Williams and other high-ranking officials of the Divine Realm did not know why this happened.
Of course, the Terminal Emperor Dragon knew that those Primordial Beasts were indeed battling another powerful force.
For instance, the Nightmare Beast Clan that slew the Void Heaven Divine Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1731 - 1731 638 Devouring Planets Horrific Life
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1731: Chapter 638: Devouring Planets, Horrific Life Chapter 1731: Chapter 638: Devouring Planets, Horrific Life Void, the dark Chaos Outside Heaven.
Boom!
Tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter, as if an invisible pane of glass shattered, exploded, triggering a Spatial Storm that swept across hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Like a black Tsunami, the Spatial Storm surged forth, with the Black-red Colossal Beast turning into a ray of light, bursting forth with its double wings spread, eclipsing the sun, and shattering everything.
Soon, a mass covering tens of thousands of kilometers, like a gigantic vortex, dispersed.
In this space, where no complete form existed and time was distorted, scattered with dark voids of Chaos Outside Heaven, the speed of the Terminal Emperor Dragon was sometimes fast and sometimes slow.
Sometimes it appeared tens of millions of kilometers away in an instant, sometimes it seemed to turn into a Black-red Radiance piercing the Void for half an hour, yet only traveling hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
While following the bloodline sensing of the Purple little dragon, flying towards those distant Primordial Beasts, the Terminal Emperor Dragon snatched the massive body of a Thorned Dragon Ferocious Beast and fed on it.
Boom!
Under the fierce and sharp teeth, the sharp bone spurs on the body surface of the Thorned Dragon Ferocious Beast broke, the scale armor shattered, emitting energy and explosive roars like a nuclear explosion.
The muscles fused with rules are incredibly solid and terrifying, and tearing them even caused a screech that made the Silver Giant Dragon, and the Purple little dragon have numb scalps.
The instant they were torn, those already rule-transformed flesh and blood released a dazzling Gray Light, causing an even more horrific explosion in the mouth of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Then it was chewed up, swallowed.
As a large amount of True Spirit Level Ferocious Beasts were devoured, the rich rule-bearing biological energy transformed, the True Body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon visibly swelled at a pace observable by the naked eye.
Ten meters, a hundred meters, a thousand meters…
When the Terminal Emperor Dragon devoured most of the True Spirit Beast, which was over five hundred kilometers long, it swelled to a size of two hundred and thirty thousand kilometers.
Calculating, eating this True Spirit Initial Stage Beast could likely increase the Terminal Emperor Dragon by about five thousand kilometers.
Sensing the power surge within his body, the Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, not bad, eating a few dozen True Spirit Initial Stage Ferocious Beasts should allow me to grow to the mid period of True Spirit.
Compared to the True Spirit Beasts of the mythical world, these beasts from the Chaos Void contained more energy in their bodies because they breathed murky air, and it was more pure.
If the Terminal Emperor Dragon could eat a Primordial Beast, especially one that just broke through Primordial, its growth realm could shoot directly into the mid period of True Spirit in one breath.
Of course, this thought could only be contemplated for now.
The strength of the Primordial Realm beasts was extremely powerful, even the ones that just broke through Primordial, the current Terminal Emperor Dragon wasn’t confident it could annihilate them.
After all, driving them away, defeating, and annihilating are completely different concepts.
While the Terminal Emperor Dragon was contemplating, on its broad and hefty shoulders, the Silver Giant Dragon poked its head over, curiously roaring, “Tim Abott, what does the flesh and blood of a True Spirit Beast taste like?”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slightly turned its head, its ferocious mouth aglow with Golden Firelight barely opened, emitting a booming roar, “Want to eat?”
The silver and gold vertical pupils of the Silver Giant Dragon blinked, like two bright sparkling gems, although it didn’t speak, the meaning was clear.
Boom Boom!! The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s sharp claws scratched over the flesh of the Thorned Dragon Ferocious Beast, forcibly tearing off a small piece (hundreds of meters in size), handing it to the Silver Giant Dragon.
“Tim Abott, you’re the best.” The Silver Giant Dragon cheered, opening its mouth emitting silver-blue cold air, biting down in one gulp.
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon bit into the meat, it let out a panicked roar, with icy blue Breath spraying out, sweeping thousands of kilometers in a fan shape.
Including that piece of Ferocious Beast meat.
Under the extreme cold rule power, that piece of Ferocious Beast meat had already frozen into an ice mountain of hundreds of kilometers.
At this moment, inside the ice mountain, faint gray-gold power permeated, wherever it passed, the ice crystals freezing the space constantly melted, corroded, turning into a forbidden area thousands of kilometers across.
This is the terror of True Spirit; even though it had already perished, died, the flesh and blood are still persistently solid and immutable, the formless permeating rules still alter the surrounding environment.
The Breath in the Silver Giant Dragon’s mouth disappeared, then it spouted two more breaths of cold air before gasping and roaring, “Tim Abott, the flesh and blood of True Spirit Ferocious Beasts is really tough to eat.”
“It’s okay, the flesh and blood of this beast contain a lot of energy, about five times that of a normal True Spirit Giant Dragon.”
As he spoke, the Terminal Emperor Dragon crunched down, tearing a piece of meat ten thousand meters in size, its chewing causing explosive roars that shattered the surrounding space, a ferocious scene.
Since there was no hurry, the Terminal Emperor Dragon didn’t use Final Darkness Devouring Talent.
In a leisurely manner, like eating snacks, after he finished eating the flesh and blood of that beast, the body length of the Terminal Emperor Dragon explosively increased to two hundred forty thousand meters, almost what it anticipated.
The explosive increase in size also proportionately enhanced the power, Defense, Talent capability, and Rule Origin of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, becoming even more formidable.
Including Jack Clark over there, reacting to the growth of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the True Body Strength also increased by 1 point, with physique reaching 500.
At the top floor of Heaven-Piercing Pavilion, feeling a heavier and almost overwhelming Terrifying Aura from Jack Clark, causing the surrounding Void to collapse, Sherry Williams was somewhat astonished.
“Brother Clark, your strength?”
Holding back the boiling power within, Jack Clark shook his head, “Nothing major, just now observing that Primordial Beast ascend, felt a little realization, and gained some strength.”
“As expected from Brother Clark,” Sherry Williams exclaimed.
Just witnessing a Primordial Beast ascend, already reaching the Peak of the Ancient could still breakthrough, such high talent was simply indescribable.
To Sherry Williams’ praise, Jack Clark just smiled faintly.
He is the Terminal Emperor Dragon, and the Terminal Emperor Dragon is him, two in one, mutually enhancing each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 1732 - 1732 638 Devouring Planets Horrific Life_2
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1732: Chapter 638: Devouring Planets, Horrific Life_2 Chapter 1732: Chapter 638: Devouring Planets, Horrific Life_2 Without the continuous supply of Evolution Energy from the Giant Beast’s body to strengthen his physique and drive soul growth, Jack Clark’s cultivation speed and combat power would definitely not have reached the level they are now.
And without the attribute point enhancement provided by the human body, to bolster all talents to the Deification Realm, the bloodline of the Terminal Emperor Dragon would not have reached the Heavenly Tier.
Not to mention the combat power that is absolutely invincible among peers, and the ability to fight across a Major Realm even after reaching the late stages of True Spirit.
However, after flying for half a day, the trio of Terminal Emperor Dragons crossed more than a billion kilometers through the dangerous Chaos Void in a straight line, without encountering another Ferocious Beast or other creatures.
As for Heaven and Earth Treasures, only a Golden Lotus was found.
The lotus grew in a vortex with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, formed by a large amount of turbid airflows, containing a strand of pure and unattributed Chaos Energy.
It was of Rule Level, and was given to the Purple little dragon in the mid-period of the Titan tier.
In terms of combat, the Purple little dragon’s strength isn’t much help to the Terminal Emperor Dragon, but the Rules of Creation it carries is the perfect aid.
All of the Creation origin within it, when sprayed out, could instantly heal even the Terminal Emperor Dragon from heavy injuries, equating to a drop of regeneration blood.
As for the Silver Giant Dragon, thinking of this, Terminal Emperor Dragon’s gaze moved slightly, then let out a low growl: “Great Scythia, you take the lead from here.”
“Me?” The Silver Giant Dragon perched on the shoulders of the Terminal Emperor Dragon blinked in surprise.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon rumbled slowly: “Heaven and Earth Treasures are scattered all over Chaos Outside Heaven, but we’ve flown so long without finding anything, obviously luck is needed to pick up these treasures.”
Just like what the Terminal Emperor Dragon said, Chaos Outside Heaven is indeed filled with resources, but the problem is that the Chaos Void is too vast, unimaginably so.
Immediately, the eyes of the Silver Giant Dragon lit up: “Roar! Luck, something that I, the Great Scythia, am good at. Leave it to me, Tim Abott.”
Without the Terminal Emperor Dragon mentioning it, the Silver Giant Dragon nearly forgot its ‘talent’ for picking up treasures.
From a young age, the Silver Giant Dragon was very lucky, always finding treasures whenever it snuck out.
For example, in the depths of the Chaotic Turbulent Region, after crossing the Area of Destruction, under the guidance of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Destruction Emperor Dragon and other Giant Beasts encountered the Time Fish.
Its contained energy allowed the Destruction Emperor Dragon to break through directly to the Titan Peak.
However, the Silver Giant Dragon’s luck is quite special; encountering danger is a must when picking up Heaven and Earth Treasures, and the higher the level of the Divine Object, the greater the danger.
Such as the Time True Spirit Beast that was nurturing the Time Fish, which with a casual blow sent the Destruction Emperor Dragon flying and injured.
If not for the lack of killing intent, even if the Destructor Emperor Dragon could have escaped, it would have lost a life, not to mention the Single-horned Spawn Roc, Silver Giant Dragon, and Golden-blue Giant Dragon accompanying it—they would have perished without a doubt.
It was just as the saying goes, blessed by luck, followed by disaster.
And compared to the treasure hunting talent, the Single-horned Spawn Roc, which can only sense the fluctuations of Heaven and Earth Treasures within tens of thousands of kilometers, the Silver Giant Dragon plays a bigger role in Chaos Outside Heaven.
After all, this place is too vast, sometimes with nothing in tens of billions of kilometers, and without concrete concepts of up, down, left, or right, it would take an eternity for the Spawn Roc to ‘scan.’
Boom boom boom!!
The Black Destruction Storm collided with the turbid air pervading the Void, creating a piercing roar and Energy Halo, like a silver sword piercing through the world.
Chaos Outside Heaven is very dangerous, but that refers to the depth of Chaos far away from the mythical world.
In the space around the mythical world, beings of the Legendary Realm can generally survive, and with the strength of ancient times, the Silver Giant Dragon only needs to be a bit careful; it’s not a big problem.
Not to mention that it is followed by the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
In the Chaos Void, the Silver Giant Dragon leading the way passed through turbid rivers, crossed pitch-black Hollows, and flying as it was, deviated from the planned route.
Or rather, it was just a general direction, and the Purple little dragon did not know how far away those few Primordial Giant Dragons were.
Just as the Silver Giant Dragon had meandered through about ten million kilometers, behind it by a thousand kilometers, the Terminal Emperor Dragon suddenly growled: “Scythia, stop.”
“Roar! What’s the matter, Tim Abott?” The Silver Giant Dragon hovering in the Void stopped in her tracks, puzzled as she turned back, watching the Black-red Colossal Beast stirring up rolling waves behind it.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon looked forward at the turbid river that seemed to be only tens of thousands of kilometers wide and extending for over a million kilometers, and rumbled slowly: “It’s a bit dangerous for you up ahead, come onto my back.”
“Okay.”
With a flap of its double wings, the Silver Giant Dragon turned into a silver glow and landed on the shoulders of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, its tail that stretched for two kilometers swaying slightly in the air.
Since the Silver Giant Dragon wanted to cross the turbid river, the Terminal Emperor Dragon didn’t change direction but charged straight in.
Boom!
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon entered the turbid river, the surrounding space-time collapsed, forming a massive black vortex of Destruction, filled with a destructive power capable of tearing apart any Ancient Beast.
Even the Peak of the Ancient Lava Giant Dragon appearing here would be torn apart instantly.
Deep within the river, a True Spirit Beast as long as over two thousand kilometers, with a slender body resembling a black Ferocious Dragon, tumbled, emanating a powerful aura of a Late Stage True Spirit.
Roar!
The ferocious roar that shocked the Void erupted, and an endless Black-Red Radiance burst forth, instantly destroying the Destruction Black Hole with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers.
Boom! Void collapsed, space-time shook.
Under the powerful force, the turbid river fractured, revealing the menacing behemoth wrapped in Black-Red Radiance, its icy gaze fixed on the black Ferocious Dragon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1733 - 1733 638 Devouring Planets Horrific Life_3
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1733: Chapter 638: Devouring Planets, Horrific Life_3 Chapter 1733: Chapter 638: Devouring Planets, Horrific Life_3 There is also a thousand kilometers long crack behind it.
This True Spirit Beast was hiding before the world behind that crack, obscured by a murky river formed of Chaos Qi, undetectable even to the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
It could only faintly sense something lurking in the river.
And as this True Spirit Fierce Dragon revealed itself, it was greeted by death.
Even the pitch-black double claws and the black fanged teeth protruding from its mouth emitted a faint dangerous aura that even the Terminal Emperor Dragon sensed.
Boom!
A pressure that made even the Void tremble erupted from the Terminal Emperor Dragon, its body radiated dazzling blood red light, forming bolts of blood red lightning that covered a million kilometers.

The dark golden dragon head faced down towards the violent black hole and the scattered remains of the True Spirit Ferocious Dragon bodies spread across tens of thousands of kilometers, slowly opening its mouth.
Instantly, a devouring force capable of swallowing heaven and earth burst forth, under the dark golden dragon head, space-time twisted.
Boom!
In the chaotic Void, a pitch-black hole, with a diameter of one hundred thousand kilometers, emerged, devouring everything within its scope—space, matter, energy, and even time.
At the same time, inside the body of the Doomsday Crimson Emperor Dragon, boundless energy erupted, along with a barely audible giant beast’s scream.
The Late Stage True Spirit Chaotic Ferocious Dragon, fallen.
Domineering, ferocious, this is the power of the Terminal Emperor Dragon that had broken through the True Spirit.
“Roar! Tim Abott, kill! Great Scythia loves to see rivers of blood,” the Silver Giant Dragon, enveloped by red light and standing on the shoulder of the Doomsday Crimson Emperor Dragon, exclaimed excitedly.
Feeling the aura of True Spirit falling between heaven and earth, only the Silver Giant Dragon’s legs trembled, tail going limp.
Too powerful was the current Tim Abott, what Chaotic Ferocious Beasts, True Spirit Ferocious Dragons, before Tim Abott, all were insignificant, exploding and devoured in two strikes.
Invincible!
Crackle Crackle! As the True Body of the True Spirit Fierce Dragon was gradually refined, the form of the Doomsday Crimson Emperor Dragon radiating dazzling light expanded at an alarming rate.

In a low roar that shook the Void, the Emperor Dragon, digesting the flesh and blood of the Ferocious Dragon, suddenly moved, bringing along a horrifically destructive force to that crack.
Boom! Boom!Explosively, with double claws wrapped in blood red lightning, reaching out for the kilometer-long crack above and below, double claws’ strength erupted, violently tearing apart.

And the surrounding black-blue galaxy, as the planet slowly rotated, the emitted black light crushed the surrounding chaotic Void, forming an energy halo.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1735: Chapter 639: Lord of Hell, Plane Battlefield Chapter 1735: Chapter 639: Lord of Hell, Plane Battlefield The vast land stretched out with undulating mountain ranges, covered with lush forests, endless and boundless.
In the heart of this spherical world, a giant towering ten thousand kilometers high with its head reaching the Firmament and its feet firmly on the Earth, much of its body jutting out of the world, seemed like deities who had opened the heavens.
Because its True Body was too colossal, covering the world, the thick atmosphere of over two thousand kilometers only wrapped below its calves, making it appear incomparably majestic.
But now, in this corner of the world, nearly a hundred billion ten-meter-tall four-armed members of different races, facing the towering figure piercing sky and earth, all showed faces of despair.
With the awe-inspiring giant as the center, a skyful of golden red light spread out, turning into a vast and boundless Rule array that enveloped the entire atmosphere.
Millions upon millions of lives, shrouded in the golden-red light of the great array, uttered desperate and piercing screams of despair.
Whether it was the four-armed races or the Unique Beasts dwelling among the forests and mountain ranges, all their bodies collapsed, turning into a sky full of red and black smoke ascending.
The red carried an incredibly rich Aura of life, endlessly converging, forming a huge blood-red Lotus of Life under the feet of the World-Destroying Giant.
While the black light was filled with endless Death, despair, and hatred, a despairing pathway that penetrated the world, linking the Chaos Void.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils condensed their focus upon seeing this scene.
This World-Destroying Giant was sacrificing the entire world, sacrificing all life in hopes of transcendence; such ruthlessness, not even the Terminal Emperor Dragon had seen before.
Although the Purgatory Ancestors also Devoured everything in the past, absorbing all life within hundreds of millions of kilometers.
But those Dark Demon Air-contaminated Purgatory True Demons, demonized creatures, actually belonged to a part of the Purgatory Ancestors’ strength, hence it could be considered a return, not Devouring.
Of course, how many lives this World-Destroying Giant killed didn’t matter; after all, it wasn’t the Solar System World.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “Scythia, Misss Joseline, you guys stay back a bit; this big fellow is very strong, there might be a fierce battle later.”
The Silver Giant Dragon roared excitedly: “Go for it, Tim Abott, obliterate that guy.” It enjoyed seeing the Terminal Emperor Dragon obliterate those massive Giant Beasts the most.
Atop the head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon also excitedly waved its claws.
Squeak! Brother charge, Misss Joseline has stored a lot of saliva to help you recover, blow up that big guy, make rivers of blood, dye the starry sky red.
Two violent fellows. The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s mouth twitched.
Swoosh!
Covered with black and red strength, the Silver Giant Dragon and the Purple little dragon continually retreated, flying out tens of thousands of kilometers in the blink of an eye.
Meanwhile, inside the Terminal Emperor Dragon, terrifying strength began to converge, its gaze coldly fixed on the World-Destroying Giant whose shoulders and head had already squeezed out of the world, entering the Chaos Void.
Yet that World-Destroying Giant had already stopped struggling, its eyes emitting red light slowly turning towards the Terminal Emperor Dragon, showing a grave expression.
From the two hundred kilometers long giant, it felt a strong sense of danger.
Despite the Realm breath of the Giant Beast being of only the True Spirit Initial Stage, as a mighty being that had already gathered the Primordial Air and half-stepped into the Primordial, the World-Destroying Giant acutely sensed the terrifying power hidden within the Giant Beast’s body.
This wandering Chaos Void Giant Beast was very strong, extremely strong!
Indeed, it was the legendary ‘Eternity Upper Realm’, the sea of destiny for all transcendent lives, where even a randomly encountered Chaotic Giant Beast was so powerful.
Just as the Terminal Emperor Dragon stood a million kilometers away, waiting for the World-Destroying Giant to break free from the world and descend into the Chaos Void.
To the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s astonishment, the partially freed World-Destroying Giant took a deep look at it, and then immediately contracted its massive body, giving up ‘transcendence.’
Boom!
The vortex, losing the support of the transcendence power, collapsed thunderously, the powerful force shocking the Void, forming a turbid tidal wave sweeping over a range of more than a million kilometers.
The sudden twist made the Terminal Emperor Dragon pause: “That guy, actually gave up?”
But immediately, the Terminal Emperor Dragon narrowed its eyes, “No, it probably sees me as an ordinary Chaotic Ferocious Beast, planning to wait for me to leave and then gather strength to descend once more.”
This kind of sacrifice, amassing countless lives of a Great Thousand Worlds and converging endless strength to forcefully transcend, cannot be interrupted.
Otherwise, the World-Destroying Giant would not only fall from half-step Primordial, but its foundation would also suffer irreversible damage, forever losing the hope of breaking through to the Primordial.
“This fellow is quite cautious.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon watched how even in the violent Chaos region, the massive body slowly turned, flying towards the Silver Giant Dragon and the others.
Of course, the Terminal Emperor Dragon had no intention of letting the World-Destroying Giant go.
Half-step Primordial, lives that have vaguely given birth to the Air of Primordial within their bodies, to the current Terminal Emperor Dragon, were almost like a super tonic pill.
If it could eat it, it wouldn’t be too far from breaking through to the mid period of True Spirit.
The so-called half-step Primordial refers to those Giant Beasts whose True Bodies have begun to transform towards the Primordial, but which have not yet condensed their Lifeline Talent and the Sky of the Primordial.
Just like the World-Destroying Giant from the previous Deification Unity realm, the energy contained within these Giant Beasts’ True Bodies was more than a dozen times that of a Pinnacle of True Spirit Giant Beast.
And the Terminal Emperor Dragon eyeing the World-Destroying Giant was not only interested in the energy contained in its body but also the Lotus of Life condensed from the sacrifice of the entire world’s lives.
The Lotus of Life, containing the pure Creation Force of life on some level, was even stronger than a Creation Force.
That Lotus of Life should be the ‘luck’ of the Silver Giant Dragon this time. If it’s lucky enough to eat a lotus seed, it could directly breakthrough to ancient times.

﻿Chapter 1736: Chapter 639: Lord of Hell, Plane Battlefield_2 Chapter 1736: Chapter 639: Lord of Hell, Plane Battlefield_2 Similarly, if Jack Clark can refine a Life Lotus Seed, he can also quickly fuse the second Supreme Rule.
If he can refine two seeds, with the push of enough life Creation power, he might even make a breakthrough before reaching the Human Divine Domain.
By that time, whether in the Giant Beast Body or the human form, the strength he possesses would be enough to stride across the Chaotic Heavens.
Thus, the Destroy the world beast is doomed.
The Chaotic Void erupts in fury, as the Black-red Colossal Beast emits a ferocious roar shaking the world, gradually disappearing along with the Silver Giant Dragon and the Purple little dragon.
Meanwhile, as the Terminal Emperor Dragon lies in wait covertly for that half-step Primordial ‘Giant Beast.’
The Black Warship carrying the Human Race delegation has already flown out more than ten billion kilometers, with the boundless Red World emerging ahead, the whole Heaven and Earth dotted with pink petals.
“Brother Clark, the Flower Sea Forbidden Zone is right ahead,” Sherry Williams pointed to the front.
“This place is unique, enveloped by some powerful Rule, where the petals seem to come from nowhere, never withering as they eternally fall.”
“Under the influence of these petals, this area is permeated with a power that affects the spirit, ensnaring any life that enters into an everlasting illusion from which they cannot escape.”
“Of course, such a degree of spiritual influence is ineffective against us.”
Jack Clark nods, “I understand what you mean, I’ll remind them not to fly out of the Warship’s Defense field.”
Sherry Williams turned her head to look at Jack Clark, “Brother Clark, I’ve felt my realm loosening lately, so I am preparing for Closed-door Cultivation, hoping to make a breakthrough into the True Spirit mid period.”
“Congratulations,” Jack Clark smiled.
It took Sherry Williams many years after breaking through the True Spirit Initial Stage to the mid period, which just shows the abnormal growth rate of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
After saying goodbye to Jack Clark, Sherry Williams enters Closed-door Cultivation in the Heaven-Piercing Pavilion.
Just as Jack Clark steps out of the Heaven-Piercing Pavilion, standing tall at high altitude, preparing to check on Justin Welan, his gaze suddenly shifts, and he looks up to the sky.
In the center of his forehead, a red eye slowly emerges—it is the Hell’s Eye developed after the fusion of the Supreme Hell Mark and the Doomsday Blood Sea Domain.
At this moment, the Hell’s Eye is filled with rolling waves of the Sea of Blood, and the Supreme Hell Plane is calling for him.
After pondering briefly, Jack Clark does not resist the calling.
Boom!
Centered around Jack Clark, an endless burst of blood-colored light explodes, like a boundless Sea of Blood unleashing a Tsunami engulfing the entire world, as if Hell is descending.
Amid the innumerable blood-colored world, a towering specter wearing a blood robe and thousands of kilometers tall, slowly emerges, exuding a Terrifying Aura from the Primordial Level.
Just the arrival of a Will projection is suffocating, shattering the Void and shaking the Heavenly Earth Rules.
Looking at that somewhat familiar figure, Jack Clark slowly speaks, “Lord of Alvaron, long time no see.”
Jack Clark is naturally not unfamiliar with this terrifying being.
It was his breakthrough to the Legendary Realm and intrusion into the Divine Gods Alliance, where he exploded several Purgatory Demon Kings and tore through the projection of the Deep Red World, that invoked this Hell Lord’s arrival.
And the identity of Hell Messenger acquired then also helped Jack Clark escape danger multiple times.
If not for the ability to make leaps using Hell Coordinates, even with the Giant Beast Body as a coordinate, Jack Clark would not have been able to return from the Lost World from ten thousand years past.
Needless to say, without the Hell Coordinate as a trump card, Jack Clark would not have dared to crush the Time Crystal Core.
The star-like colossal figure looks down slightly at the black-haired young man standing in the Void, silent for a moment before slowly speaking, with a voice that rumbles and shakes the world.
“…Truly worthy of an Apostle noticed by a Supreme Will, your growth exceeds my expectations.”
Sensing the powerful force emanating faintly from within Jack Clark, even Alvaron couldn’t help feeling surprised.
Alvaron naturally remembers Jack Clark as it’s the Hell Messenger personally recruited by itself. But unless it’s mistaken, it’s only been a few Sun Wheels since they last met, right?
For beings like Alvaron, the concept of time is quite vague; a few Sun Wheels are no different than taking a nap.
But this life form that once seemed insignificant as an ant before it, has grown in such a short time to the extent that even it needs to take seriously.
While appearing to be at the peak of the ancient realm in terms of cultivation level, its true strength is no less than those peak kings of Hell under its command.
Jack Clark smiled slightly, modestly said: “There, I am still far from your strength, Lord of Alvaron, what is it that you suddenly call for me?”
“I do have a matter this time.”
Alvaron spoke slowly: “As my Hell Messenger, when your strength reaches the level that allows you to participate in the Plane Wars, I will descend and extend you an invitation.”
“Plane Wars, what is that?” Jack Clark raised an eyebrow.
Just as Alvaron was about to explain, suddenly its colossal body trembled slightly: “This is the hibernation place of that Supreme Being, my will cannot stay here.”
Boom!
Alvaron stretched out a claw, and the heavens filled with blood light gathered in its hand, forming a palm-sized disc surrounded with sharp spikes of shining light.
“All information about the Plane Battlefield is within, if you are interested…”
Boom! Before Alvaron could finish, the entire blood-colored world shook violently, and a terrifying aura of pressure descended.
Bang! Under the pressure of the Heavenly Dao from the mythical world, the blood-colored world along with the colossal Will Projection of Alvaron instantly collapsed.
This is the power of the mythical world; even the fifth-level king of the Supreme Hell Plane who descended with the power of the Hell Plane could not stay for long.
Not to mention the Primordial Level True Body, which could not descend at all.
In the Inner World high above the Black Warship, Jack Clark looked at the floating sharp red disc, pondered for a moment, then reached out to hold it, letting his Divine Soul Intent enter.
Buzz! The red spike disc vibrated slightly, emitting a red glow, while countless mysterious pieces of information flooded into Jack Clark’s mind.
These included an introduction to the Plane Wars and also some images related to that terrifying figure.
The so-called Plane Wars were the battleground for the four Supreme Planes—the Supreme Hell, Supreme Deep Red, Supreme Heaven, and Supreme Abyss—that involved countless worlds, planes, and the Chaos Void.
The four Supreme Planes are peculiar as they no longer have specific ‘world’ forms but spread over countless worlds and space-times as certain concepts.
Many worlds have shadows from these Supreme Planes.
And each plane has its envoys, such as a certain Hell Lord above the Primordial Realm like Alvaron, a Lord of the Infinite Abyss.
Or a Deep Red Destroyer Beast, a One-Side Heavenly Emperor.
These beings have a special relationship with the Supreme Planes, not hierarchical but symbiotic.
When beings like Alvaron use the power of the Supreme Planes to invade and plunder other worlds to strengthen their Supreme Plane, they too receive upgrades synchronously.
This method of cultivating through war and plunder allows for faster advancement than the normal accumulation for other strong men of the same realm.
Especially after reaching Primordial, not all Primordial Powerhouses can continue to ascend, some unable to take a single step forward after tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years.
Therefore, many Primordial Powers choose to join one of the four Supreme Planes, to conquer the heavens.
These Primordial Powers aren’t just born from the mythical world, but also from other worlds, similar to the World-Destroying Giant that the Terminal Emperor Dragon encountered, which was transcending into the Chaos Void.
And Alvaron personally descending to invite Jack Clark to participate in the Plane Wars certainly isn’t to use him as cannon fodder.
As a Hell Messenger with Hell Coordinates, owning a permanent ‘territory’ within the Hell Plane, the Position Pattern of Jack Clark is very high, offering the potential to become a Hell Lord of a layer.
Therefore, once he descends onto the Plane Battlefield, he is essentially a ruler in his own right, leading the Hell Legion to invade and destroy other worlds, including the Supreme Planes.
As long as he leads the Hell Legion to invade and annihilate planes, continually defeating other Supreme Plane envoys, devouring worlds, and Supreme Plane Origins, his strength will increase at a terrifying speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1737 - 1737 640 The Extinguished Primordial Stars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1737: Chapter 640: The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon Chapter 1737: Chapter 640: The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon “The fusion with the dragon within you, reversing life and death, coupled with the power from the Void Hidden Ground you experienced initially, makes your state quite peculiar under the judgment of the world rules, Sister Ilisa.”
“Not alive yet not similar, neither human nor dragon, this is probably why you cannot resonate with the heavenly earth law and step into the mythic realm.”
Jack Clark, Mathilda Ward, and the Mysterious Martial Sky King were sitting in the pavilion, discussing Mathilda Ward’s physical condition.
After Jack Clark finished speaking, Mathilda Ward, with silver hair cascading down her shoulders and a pair of lustrous dragon horns on her head, smiled faintly: “In fact, whether I can break through to the mythical stage, I feel it’s not that important.”
“Previously my father and I tested that my Dragon-Human True Body’s ‘strength’ is already comparable to a Mid-Mythical Stage Monarch, like a genuine human nature True Dragon Giant Beast.”
“Moreover, I can feel that as I breathe in and absorb massive amounts of Heavenly Energy every day, my strength is increasing at an amazing speed, with a sense that my potential is boundless.”
The Mysterious Martial Sky King gravely said: “Although that’s the case, the issue now is, Misss Joseline, without entering the Legendary Realm, you cannot condense a Rule True Body and have the trait of immortality.”
“The trait of immortality is the core of Mythical-level beings, becoming stronger as the realm advances, eventually reaching the point of eternal life and undying.”
“If you lack this, even if one day you, Misss Joseline, become as powerful as the Supreme, or even capable of suppressing Heaven and Earth, you will still die of old age.”
Jack Clark slowly nodded: “Indeed, no matter how powerful the being, including the True Dragons in mythical legends, theoretically, they all have a life span.”
“Actually, there is a way to solve this issue.”
Jack Clark thought for a moment: “Since Sister Ilisa is ‘excluded’ by the mythical timeline, then go beyond Heaven, refine the power of the Chaos Void to enter the mythical stage, or the ‘Divine’ realm.”
Having cultivated to this point, Jack Clark had long realized that the so-called Ninth Hevens, Myth, Titans, ancient times could actually be divided into two Major Realms.
Transcendent Nine Layers, is a process of continuously strengthening oneself until finally touching the Heavenly Earth Law and stepping into the Divine Realm.
The path of cultivators in the Divine Realm is to condense laws, rules, transform into rules, and ultimately become the source of this path, to become a Primordial Creature that transcends Heaven and Earth.
However, to become a deity in the space beyond Heaven, one would need to study the Cultivation Methods involving the Chaos Void.
Such methods, needless to say, are incredibly precious.
Jack Clark slowly said: “When we reach the Divine Realm later and meet that Blazing Heaven True Emperor Senior, I will ask on behalf of Sister Ilisa to see if that Senior would be generous enough to teach.”
Immediately, the Mysterious Martial Sky King’s face showed surprise: “Jack Clark, thank you.”
Mathilda Ward was also moved but before she could speak, Jack Clark shook his head with a smile: “Mysterious Martial Predecessor, there’s no need to be so formal with me, this is something I should do.”
This matter was very important to Mathilda Ward and them, but for Jack Clark, it was merely a simple inquiry.
After talking for a while longer, Jack Clark took his leave.
As the person in charge of this expedition, he naturally could not neglect everything, and although the specifics were handled by others, he still had to ‘patrol’ the area at least.
Standing atop the sky tens of thousands of meters high, Jack Clark’s will swept across the entire warship space, capturing all scenes outside the rooms into his sight.
For instance, Justin Welan Opposite of Jack Clark, who is in the Quasi-Mythical Realm, is fiercely practicing on a square, and class leader Sherry Lesser and Mandy Lewis, who are working hard in their cultivation.
And Howard Lambert, who is crazily battling by leveraging the tremendous pressure from Damon Lopes.
This expedition to the Divine Realm was a monumental opportunity for everyone.
As the first batch of personnel from the Ancestral Land of the Human Race, plus the importance placed on Jack Clark, the support and treatment given by the first contact with the Six Great Divine Domains were bound to be good.
As long as they could seize this opportunity, many might soar to the skies, breaking through to myth status rapidly, or even have hopes of becoming Heavenly Kings.
As for the ancient Supreme and True Spirit Emperors, they were too far out of reach for most people, their greatest ambition being to become Mythical Kings.
After all, not everyone is Jack Clark.
While Jack Clark was patrolling the team and quietly waiting for ‘feedback’ from the Giant Beast Body side, time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, five days passed.
Outside the Chaotic Heavens.
Several days had passed, and the area of violent impact caused by the collapse of the pathway when the World-Destroying Giant ‘gave up transcending’ and retreated had now returned to silence.
The pitch-black Void, filled with turbid airflows that dissolve and obliterate all matter and energy, obscured everything.
At that moment, the Void suddenly trembled, space-time twisted, and an Invisible Power stirred, causing the turbid airflows within tens of thousands of kilometers to riot.
Boom! At the center of the turbulent airflows, a collapse re-formed a vortex covering over two hundred thousand kilometers.
The vortex was filled with despair, and the black power of death that pervaded hatred spread throughout, forming a channel that pierced the Chaos Void.
Deep within the channel, that golden-red giant of tens of thousands of kilometers tall reappeared.
After days of accumulation, this World-Destroying Giant could no longer restrain itself, or rather, unable to interrupt the process of breaking through to the Primordial, it once again tore through the pathway.
Roar!
The ferocious and majestic roar echoed through the Void, the golden-red giant standing beyond the atmosphere roared skywards, Power Explosion breaking free from numerous Rule Chains.
And while probing half its head into the Chaos Void, the eyes of that golden-red giant spilled with terrifying vision, surveying the surroundings.
The vast Chaos Void contained nothing but darkness and pervading turbid airflows, and instantly, the golden-red giant let out a sigh of relief.
The Chaotic Ferocious Beast had indeed left.
Boom!
With no hesitation, an even more terrifying strength Burst within the body of the golden-red giant, its formidable pressure causing the Chaos Void to shake continuously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1738 - 1738 640 The Extinguished Primordial Stars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1738: Chapter 640: The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon_2 Chapter 1738: Chapter 640: The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon_2 At the same time, an air of primordial origin enveloped it, resonating with the Chaos Void.
Boom!!
The Chaos Void within a range of billions of kilometers trembled, endless golden red light appeared out of thin air, illuminating the void as if a dazzling star.
Even the gleaming light penetrated the Boundary Wall of the nearby mythical world.
Boom boom boom!! On the surface of Earth, those powerful beings just awakened from hibernation once more, staring at the golden red star in the sky, their auras trembling.
“What’s been happening lately, with powerful creatures making breakthroughs in primordial origin one after another!”
“Starlight’s brilliance, has another unknown powerful being made a breakthrough in the primordial origin?”
Looking at that radiating light from outside of Heaven, those beings who had reached the pinnacle of True Spirit for years, unable to condense Primordial Air, all yearned in their eyes.
But at this moment, not far from the dazzling light, sudden flashes of red light appeared.
Roar! From the Chaotic Heavens outside, millions of kilometers away from that World-Destroying Giant, an overbearing aura full of ferocity and brutality burst forth.
Boom boom boom!!
Space collapsed, blood red lightning spread in all directions, the terrifying power contained within shattering everything, turning a range of millions of kilometers into chaos.
Within the dazzling red light, a Red Beast towering twelve hundred kilometers appeared, resembling a beast of the apocalypse, radiating an extremely terrifying Destructive Aura.
Looking at the ferocious behemoth, especially the feathered horns on either side of its head, the World-Destroying Giant revealed a look of surprise, anger, and a strong intent to kill.
Last time, it only refrained from making a breakthrough to avoid disturbance, thus it suppressed the breakthrough process and returned to its own world, prepared to continue after the Chaotic Ferocious Beast left.
But unexpectedly, this Chaotic Ferocious Beast had been hiding in the vicinity all along.
Clearly, this True Spirit Initial Stage fierce beast had its eyes set on it.
“Roar! Seeking death, when I descend, I will surely tear you into pieces.”
Cotaselle roared furiously, his body’s golden red light intensifying, his enormous body brimming with even greater strength, shaking space-time, with above the shoulders penetrating the Chaos Void.
“You, have no hope left.” A deep and terrifying roar spread throughout the void.
The Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, standing at the center of endless blood red lightning, suddenly moved like a bolt of lightning, instantly traversing millions of kilometers at a speed beyond description.
Boom!
The Dragon Claw wrapped in blood red lightning annihilated everything, intersecting with the golden red Rule light, like two vast worlds colliding, emitting a world-shaking, terrifying roar.
From afar, it was like a boundless giant red beast fiercely crashing into the World-Destroying Giant, together plummeting into the world behind it.
Kloey Grand World.
Despair filled between heaven and earth; under the Heaven Sacrificial Array stretching over the Firmament, ninety-nine percent of all life in the world had perished, turning into nourishment for the breakthrough of the World-Destroying Giant.
Only the five cities sat upon by ancient-level beings of different races, by leveraging the Power of Heaven and Earth resisted through arrays set up over tens of thousands of years, were still barely holding on.
As the power of Heaven Sacrificial Array grew stronger and even as the attention of the World-Destroying Giant was focused on transcendence, it would not be long before these great cities would also be destroyed.
But at this moment, the entire world shook violently.
Under the shocked gazes of those stronger than mythical beings in the five Holy Cities, endless deep red light descended, like a river from heaven pouring down.
Amidst the red light filled with ominous destruction, a ferocious Giant Beast fell from the sky, along with the World-Destroying Giant which had already half transcended.
Boom!
At the center of the colossal floating land in the void, the ground within a range of millions of kilometers collapsed, countless rocks and magma mixed with blood red light soared into the sky.
In an instant, tens of millions of kilometers turned into Doomsday, countless flame-engulfed mountain peaks, and magma falling from the sky, roaring and destroying everything around.
Just as heaven and earth plunged into chaos, furious roars of the brutal beast and the World-Destroying Giant’s angry roar shook the world.
Space collapsed, the very center of the land pierced through, wild Rule forces permeated, two silhouettes radiating red and golden red light intermingled.
Boom!
Dragon Claw wrapped in Blood Red Lightning and palms bathed in golden red sequence chain brilliance collided, the force of their Instantaneous Explosion shaking the entire world, the starry sky trembling, as if the next moment the entire world would be destroyed.
Compared to the Deep Red Form Gigantification, Terminal Emperor Dragon, whose True Body was still only over a thousand kilometers, Cotaselle, with a True Body spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, was even more gigantic.
But under the Full-Force Strike from both sides, the power they displayed was evenly matched.
At the True Spirit Level, size does not determine victory or defeat; what truly decides the direction of the battlefield are the Rule, True Body, talent, and the strength they contain.
Boom boom boom!!
Between Cotaselle’s hands, a golden world emerged, containing immensely heavy power, intersecting with the destructive blood red lightning.
Looking at the ferocious behemoth in front of him, so close yet separated by a deep red Rule world, Cotaselle’s gaze was incredibly cold and cruel, with a thunderous roar coming from his mouth.
“Unknown giant beast, I acknowledge your strength is strong, able to stand against me head-on; no wonder you dare to covet my path.”
“But you dared to enter Kloey World, today, I’ll tell you what it means to be the lord of a Boundary for creatures born in the Chaos Upper Realm.”
Cotaselle bellowed, “Power, come forth.”
Boom!
The moment Cotaselle’s voice ceased, the entire world was engulfed in golden red light, a supreme and overwhelming gravity descended.
As the strongest in this world, on the verge of a breakthrough to the primordial, the might Cotaselle possessed was almost beyond imagination.

chapters.title: Chapter 1739 - 1739 640 The Extinguished Primordial Stars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1739: Chapter 640 The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon_3 Chapter 1739: Chapter 640 The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon_3 In the instant of Mobilizing the World’s Power, Cotaselle’s strength was indescribably immense, as a gigantic hand gathered terrifying power and fell upon the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
Boom! The seemingly slow strike made time and space halt, and the Heavenly Earth Rules shattered.
Even the blood-red world, solidified by the radiant Rules around the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, suddenly collapsed, forming a massive funnel-shaped Hollow.
Spurt!
At this moment, the entire world was split in two, with an almost formless Tail Blade, composed of red blood light and edged in utter blackness, spanning Heaven and Earth.
After devouring and refining a black Star, the already sharp Tail Blade became even more dreadful.
At this moment, beneath the Blade Edge, the Earth’s Strength from a part of the Great Thousand Worlds and the heavy, Overbearing power of the Supreme was directly cleaved in two, followed by the slowly falling palm behind it.
Boom! Heaven and Earth darkened, and the sun and moon lost their light.
The Tail Blade that severed the world intersected with the golden-red palm of the Earth in an instant, and the entire world fell still, then in the surrounding millions of kilometers, it silently shattered, utterly becoming Chaos.
Boom, boom!
In the face of the powerful reactive force, the towering Cotaselle, miles high, let out a roar, its upper body sharply rising, and its massive True Body retreating several steps to appear a million kilometers away.
A colossal wound appeared on its strong, resilient palm, nearly splitting the hand, which had begun to Transform towards the Primordial, in two.
As Cotaselle was sent reeling, a red light pierced heaven and earth, thundering across the Earth and tearing a crack millions of kilometers long before stopping.
But in an instant, a red light flashed between heaven and earth, and the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, sent flying by a palm strike, appeared above Cotaselle.
However, before the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon could strike, a rune rotating counterclockwise appeared in Cotaselle’s eyes.
Boom!
From Cotaselle as the epicenter, an indescribably powerful repulsive force Burst forth, whipping up layer upon layer of transparent spatial tides that swept across Heaven and Earth.
From a distance, it looked like a Light sphere millions of kilometers across had exploded.
Even the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon was blasted away by the powerful repulsive force, its figure slamming into the ground tens of millions of kilometers away, instantly causing millions of kilometers of Earth to obliterate.
The terrifying explosion completely obliterated a massive city spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
A Destructive Impact rose high into the sky, forming a tremendous mushroom cloud that broke through the atmosphere, with an overwhelming momentum.
The moment the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was repelled and sent flying, Cotaselle, standing at the center of the raging Chaos, clenched its fists and suddenly pressed down towards the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
“World-Ending Heavenly Star.”
Boom!
Centered on the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, the Earth within a range of three million kilometers collapsed, with countless rocks shooting up from all directions, merging together under the terrifying gravitation of a Black Hole.
Amid the shaking smoke and dust, a ‘star’ with a diameter of three million kilometers appeared, surrounded by countless golden-red Rule Chains collapsing continuously.
Boom, boom, boom!
Under the power of a being half a step into the Primordial, wielding the Earth’s Strength of a part of the Great Thousand Worlds, and deploying the talent of the Heavenly Earth Rules, the star, akin to a Star, compressed inwards with terrifying speed.
The heavy strength it emitted was tremendously powerful, crushing space-time and Suppressing everything.
Yet at this stage, Cotaselle was still not assured.
“Be Suppressed by me!”
With a roar, Cotaselle’s massive body descended from the sky, appearing above the celestial body that had been compressed to a million kilometers, as if composed of magma material.
Boom! The Rule Chains enveloping Heaven and Earth erupted in brilliance, unleashing an even more formidable strength.
With the Rule Chains, tens of meters thick and stretching millions of kilometers, tightening and enveloping, the searing celestial Star within let out a terrible roar.
Emitting a world-shaking thunderous sound, it continued to shrink, releasing a dreadfully extreme gravity.
But just then, the entire world seemed to resonate with the praises of destruction, Doomsday, and the Terminal.
The World-Ending Heavenly Star, now compressed to just over fifty thousand kilometers and resembling a blazing Star hovering over the Earth, suddenly began to shake, an Aura emerging within that unsettled even Cotaselle.
Boom! The Star-like Heaven and Earth exploded with a resounding bang, and the chains and sequences of the Heavenly Earth Rules crumbled under an indescribably immense force.
In the earth-shattering explosion, a black brilliance spread, engulfing heaven and earth, instantly the Void Continent and the surrounding black space, spanning tens of millions of kilometers in diameter.
The entire world at that moment plunged into darkness, with only that immensely large figure, utterly black yet radiating blinding light.
Rising to tens of thousands of kilometers and swollen to a hundred times its size, the Terminal Dragon stood tall, like pure darkness coalescing, exuding the terrifying might belonging to the Primordial Level.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon entered its Terminal Form, the fundamental Rules of the entire world began to collapse.
The sky let out the tearing sounds of being overburdened, as immense Black Cracks appeared, with endless Void Storms pouring through the fissures, obliterating everything.
Including the thick Earth at the center of this world, mountain ranges collapsed, and the Earth was torn asunder.
Scorching magma erupted from the depths of the Earth, forming towering black columns of rock reaching to the heavens.
“How can this be, your strength, your strength!!”
Witnessing the black, sinister figure resembling Chaos and the arrival of destruction, Cotaselle let out a howl of shocked fury, its face filled with incredulous horror.
It was already terrifying and exaggerated for the Terminal Emperor Dragon, at the initial stage of True Spirit, to unleash power comparable to half a step into the Primordial.
Yet, under the continual suppression backed by the talent of the Heavenly Earth Rules and the entire World’s Power, it displayed an even more horrifying form.

chapters.title: Chapter 1740 - 1740 640 The Extinguished Primordial Stars
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1740: Chapter 640: The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon_4 Chapter 1740: Chapter 640: The Extinguished Primordial Stars, Terminal Dragon_4 Primordial, even stronger than the typical Primordial strength.
How can this be fought?
At this moment, even Cotaselle, who has cultivated for over a hundred thousand years forging an incredibly resilient will, couldn’t help but reveal a look of despair in its eyes.
“I am destruction, the end!”
Like a voice emanating from the depths of the world, it shook the world, the Terminal Dragon standing in the endless dark slowly raising its right claw, instantly causing the whole world to shake even more violently.
Just beyond the shattered Firmament, a dark, world-destroying claw almost covering the sky appeared.
Looking at that strike about to fall, which would destroy the entire world, Cotaselle let out an angry roar: “I will not submit, even if this is my transcendent tribulation, today I will break this sky, break the Chaos Upper Realm.”
Boom!
Heaven and Earth trembled, beneath Cotaselle’s feet, a blood-red lotus formed from the life force of countless living beings of the whole world appeared, petals unfolding, covering a million kilometers.
Simultaneously, around it, the Black Power that tears apart the Chaos Void and congregates the transcending pathway gathered, forming an enormously huge Despair Battle Axe.
In that instant, standing on the force of life, wielding the Despair Battle Axe, Cotaselle erupted with blazing blood-red flames, surging thousands of kilometers into the sky.
Suddenly, an immeasurable amount of hot Qi Blood and a strong will soared.
In this moment, Cotaselle was like a peerless Demon God facing the suppression of the Heavenly Dao, its True Body encompassing the World’s Power expanded limitlessly, burning everything.
“Kill!”
The True Body expanded to a hundred thousand kilometers, wielding the Axe of Despair slashing towards the sky.
Yet at this moment, the Terminal Dragon, already indescribably powerful.
In its Terminal Form, it completely became the embodiment of supreme destruction, this strike not only gathered its own strength but also the ‘Supreme Destruction’ force that destroyed countless world planes.
Boom!
Under the dark Dragon Claw covering the Firmament, the World Crystal Wall shattered, forming a huge Hollow, appearing like a cosmic Evil God destroying everything with one claw strike on the Earth.
Whether it was space, time, Heavenly Earth Rules, or the peerless Demon God burning everything up to a hundred thousand kilometers, all were shattered by this claw.
Tens of millions of kilometers, the irregularly shaped continental blocks were also pierced through, forming a Hollow with a diameter of ten million kilometers.
In an instant, Heaven and Earth fell silent.
Boom boom boom!!
Only then did the energy that destroys Heaven and Earth finally burst forth, the central Earth of this world completely collapsed, exploding, turning into countless fragments thrown into the pitch-black Void.
Within the nearly chaotic center of the explosion, where all light and heat were devoured by darkness, only the large figure emitting a black glow stood tall.
Roar!
The Terminal Dragon, having struck through the world, roared, and behind it emerged a massive black dragon head as large as a Star, slowly biting down towards the front.
“No!”
In an instant, a desperate scream echoed through the whole world.
Boom boom boom!!
The entire Kloey World was filled with blood-red lightning thundering, a sky full of red rain falling out of nowhere, as if mourning for that half-step Primordial being that had fallen.
Blood rain, darkness, at this moment, the Great Thousand Worlds of Kloey were evidently filled with unprecedented despair.
Yet in this ultimate despair, there was also a hint of vitality.
For those in the four Holy Cities on the fragments of the shattered continental blocks, for the ten million remaining different races, Cotaselle’s fall was a great fortune.
Boom!
The world shook, and under the solemn and shaken “supervision” of several ancient-level Kloey strong men, the black figure that destroyed the world suddenly moved.
In its claws gripped the blood-red lotus and the black Despair Battle Axe, it turned and disappeared behind the shattered World Crystal Wall Hollow.
Instantly, the darkness enveloping the world began to fade, revealing the Earth broken into countless fragments scattered in the endless Void, blood-red lightning flashes and blood rain pouring amidst Heaven and Earth.
[Stick around for a little conclusion, refreshing in half an hour]

chapters.title: Chapter 1741 - 1741 641 Terrifying Roar Heavenly God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1741: Chapter 641 Terrifying Roar, Heavenly God Bloodline Chapter 1741: Chapter 641 Terrifying Roar, Heavenly God Bloodline Tens of thousands of kilometers above the Firmament, a massive silver vortex slowly dissipated, with two red crystals each of a hundred meters in diameter hanging in the air, emitting terrifying life fluctuations.
In addition, there was a kilometer-sized transparent crystal sealing a black Battle Axe inside.
Far away, behind Jack Clark, the Ten-Armed Demon God Phantom slowly faded away, feeling the loss of thirty percent of his strength, he gasped for air.
“Tearing a temporary pathway to the Chaos Outside Heaven, even now, with the combined effort of my Giant Beast Body, it’s still a bit strenuous.”
Suppressing the emptiness that surged up inside him, Jack Clark collected the Life Lotus Seed and the World-Destroying Giant’s Despair Battle Axe, then his figure vanished.
Next, he had to catch up to the Black Phoenix Warship, enter Closed-door Cultivation, and prepare for a breakthrough to the True Spirit Realm by merging with the Primordial Genesis Rules.
As for that black Battle Axe, which absorbed countless lives and despair from one Great Thousand Worlds and was close to the Creation Level, its blade could be merged with the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd, and its handle incorporated into the Demon God Battle Armor.
In the Chaos Void,
The Silver Giant Dragon stood on the shoulders of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, watching the disappearing Life Lotus Seed and damaged black Battle Axe in the silver vortex, revealing confusion in its eyes.
But before the Silver Giant Dragon could speak, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, which had grown to over twenty-seven thousand meters and was still growing, let out a slow roar, its deep and booming voice trembling through the Void.
“Scythia, let’s continue on our journey.”
“Roar! No problem, Tim Abott.” The Silver Giant Dragon let out an excited roar, its ten-thousand-meter-wide double wings flapped, transforming into a dazzling silver light that shot forth.
The Silver Giant Dragon had just broken through the Titan Peak not long ago, and consuming that Life Lotus Seed would guarantee a breakthrough to the ancient level.
However, this would cause it to fall into a period of hibernation, so the Terminal Emperor Dragon discussed with it, planning to let it absorb and sleep once they reached Joseline’s Tribe.
No helping it, they still needed its luck along the way to pick up more Heaven and Earth Treasures.
Meanwhile, atop the head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon, now shrunk back to a hundred meters, lay underneath a dragon horn, its body radiating a dense purple glow.
As an Innate Divine Dragon that had awakened the Creation Talent and concentrated the Law of Creation, the Purple little dragon and the energy of the Life Lotus Seed were almost a perfect match.
Now, under the enhancement of the Creation Origin, the aura emitted by the Purple little dragon was advancing at an astonishing speed.
After all, this was a Divine Object of the Creation Level that could single-handedly let an ancient late-stage strong man break through to the Peak of the Ancient and even directly to the True Spirit Realm if the realm was sufficient.
…
On the rapidly flying Black Warship, Jack Clark found the Primordial True King who wasn’t in Closed-door Cultivation but was leisurely drinking on the palace rooftop, nestled between mountain peaks.
Seeing Jack Clark appear out of nowhere, the Primordial True King chuckled: “Jack Clark, you suddenly coming to see this old fellow, what’s the matter?”
Jack Clark smiled slightly: “Primordial Senior, I’m preparing to enter Closed-door Cultivation to attempt a breakthrough to True Spirit Emperor, so I came to greet you.”
“…Breaking through to True Spirit Emperor, haven’t you just achieved the Peak of the Ancient not long ago?” The Primordial True King couldn’t help but be startled.
Jack Clark nodded: “Indeed, it hasn’t been long since I broke through to the Peak of the Ancient.”
“But recently I have felt that the integration speed of the second Supreme Rule is getting faster, and the bottleneck of the True Spirit is loosening, so I want to give it a try.”
…Is this something a person would say? The Primordial True King’s face showed a complex expression of surprise and entanglement.
The surprise was because Jack Clark’s cultivation was still progressing at a miraculous pace, and their branch of the Human Federation was about to birth a strong man at the Civilization Emperor Level, ensuring a stronger backbone.
After all, although Jack Clark was powerful, stronger than many True Spirit-level strong men, his realm was only at the Peak of the Ancient, thus his deterrent power was a bit weak.
The entanglement was because he thought of this guy breaking through realms as if drinking water, while he had been in the Ancient Realm for decades, only recently breaking through to Ancient Middle Stage.
Comparing this, he, who was once also a prodigy of an era, had a cultivation speed that was tragically slow.
As the Primordial True King made a vexed expression, Jack Clark’s figure soared into the sky.
However, he didn’t head to any of the Closed-door Cultivation rooms in the warship, but instead went to the center of a small world inside the battlefield, inside a mountain peak rising over ten thousand meters.
Boom!
The mountain trembled, the space inside shattered, ripped apart by Jack Clark to carve out a subspace hundreds of kilometers across.
This breakthrough, supported by the life Creation Energy contained in the Life Lotus Seed, didn’t require the ingestion of the Power of Heaven and Earth from the outside, thus a quiet temporary subspace sufficed.
Watching the slowly disappearing cracks at the entrance, sinking into the utter darkness of the subspace, Jack Clark’s face showed a faint smile: “Now, it’s time to witness a miracle.”
“A True Spirit Emperor in less than two years, if said out loud, would be enough to shock all Peak Civilizations.”
Saying this, the Life Lotus Seed as large as a hundred-meter diameter red crystal appeared beneath Jack Clark, and behind him emerged a True Body phantom as high as a hundred thousand meters, clad in a black Imperial Robe that looked neither like armor nor not like armor.
In the hands of the three-faced, ten-armed, ancient Heavenly God-like True Demon God Body, a heavy Soul Emperor Seal supporting a fledgling universe vibrated.
Silently, a slowly rotating gray orb enveloped Jack Clark and the entire subspace, emitting a faint halo, with a terrifying aura faintly discernable within.
As for Jack Clark entering Closed-door Cultivation for a breakthrough, aside from the Primordial True King and True Martial King, nobody knew.
The black warship continued on its predefined course, flying toward the Flame Wheel Divine Realm with terrifying speed, smashing through everything wrapped in Sherry Williams’ Rule Power.
Two days later, in the ‘chaotically flying’ Silver Giant Dragon in the Chaos Void, another discovery was made.
“Roar! Tim, what is that thing?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1742 - 1742 641 Terrifying Roar Heavenly God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1742: Chapter 641 Terrifying Roar, Heavenly God Bloodline_2 Chapter 1742: Chapter 641 Terrifying Roar, Heavenly God Bloodline_2 “It should be, a tree I guess.”
In the Void, with its thin and murky air currents, the Black-red Colossal Beast, which had completely absorbed and digested the World-Destroying Giant, swelling to a size of 320,000 meters, slowly approached the rear of the Silver Giant Dragon.
The shadow that it cast enveloped the Silver Giant Dragon that spanned 10,000 meters from wingtip to wingtip.
Tens of thousands of kilometers ahead of the two gigantic creatures, in the boundless pitch-black Void, floated a lake with a diameter of thousands of kilometers, formed from blue liquid.
Around the lake, murky air currents spread, and in the center stood a Black Giant Tree reaching 10,000 meters high.
What made the Silver Giant Dragon and the Terminal Emperor Dragon uncertain was that this Giant Tree had no branches or leaves, but instead was adorned with numerous things resembling both tree roots and tentacles.
Moreover, hanging from the lowest position of the tree roots, was a white fruit with a diameter of tens of meters, which radiated intense and pure Chaos Energy fluctuations.
The lake, the Black Giant Tree, countless tentacle-like tendrils, and the fruit containing Chaos Energy, all looked somewhat eerie no matter how one looked at them.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon glanced at the Black Giant Tree and then let out a low roar: “No matter what that thing is, let’s eat it first and then talk.”
Boom!
The murky air currents around the lake went berserk, the Void shattered, and a dragon head with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers appeared, invisibly exuding a Terrifying Aura of devouring heaven and earth.
The sudden change startled the Black Giant Tree, which let out a piercing scream resembling the crying of a baby.
At the same time, the black root tendrils on the trunk surged, growing like Black Pythons skyward, shattering the Void, attempting to block the descent of the black dragon head.
“Roar! Tim Abott, it’s so uncomfortable for the Great Scythia, quickly eat that thing.”
Beneath the ear-piercing scream that swept a range of tens of thousands of kilometers, carrying a terrifying resonance wave, the Silver Giant Dragon showed pain on its face, unable to resist, its Full-body Scales Armor vibrating.
Boom!
With one bite from the black dragon head, manifesting the True. Eternal Darkness Devouring Talent, the Chaos Void exploded, creating a massive Black Hole.
As for that screaming Black Giant Tree, the white crystal fruit, and the lake, they all disappeared, devoured by the Terminal Emperor Dragon in one gulp.
Within the rampaging Chaos Void, the enormous Black-red Colossal Beast’s internal energy continuously transformed, with all cells beginning to divide and compress crazily.
Half an hour later, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s size surged to over 328,000 meters, its Aura becoming even more terrifying.
At this moment, the Terminal Emperor Dragon just stood in the Void, the formless and heavy Aura emanating from its body twisted the space within a range of 100,000 kilometers, forming an independent world.
Even within this twisted area, the flow of time slowed down, giving the Silver Giant Dragon in its depths a feeling of temporal and spatial disorientation.
Looking at the increasingly powerful Black-red Colossal Beast, the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly approached, “Roar! Tim Abott, how does that fellow taste?”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly shook its head, “Ate too fast to feel much, but the energy contained in that blue water was plentiful.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon was very satisfied with this harvest. The Black Giant Tree was not a living entity and had no fluctuating rules or laws, yet it was very powerful.
However, the major spoils this time were those blue waters containing terrifying corrosion.
Once all converted into biological energy, the total amount was almost equivalent to a Giant Beast at the Late Stage of True Spirit.
“Scythia, continue leading the way. I’m going to devour the entire Chaos Void,” the continuous surge in strength had excited the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
The resources contained within the Chaos Void were too abundant, or rather, it was a habitat fit for Giant Beast organisms.
Based on the current growth rate, the Terminal Emperor Dragon felt that by the time they reached the area of the Primordial Beasts, it might have already made a breakthrough to the Late Stage of True Spirit or even to its peak.
The Evolution Talent combined with the Deification Level Devouring Talent, plus sufficient Chaos resources (all matter containing energy that could be devoured and refined), made the growth speed of the Terminal Emperor Dragon even more terrifying.
“Roar! Charge, Tim Abott, let us devour and annihilate everything together.”
The Silver Giant Dragon also let out an excited roar, continuing to dive deeper into the Chaos Void, darting around chaotically, flying wherever it wanted.
Fearless of whether it was an area with destruction storms that shattered everything, or murky seas home to powerful Ferocious Beasts.
After all, it was protected by the Terminal Emperor Dragon behind it.
But whether the Silver Giant Dragon had exhausted its short-term luck or the vast area was somewhat barren, they flew for more than ten days without any significant finds.
They only encountered three Ferocious Beasts of the Ancient Realm, found a white ‘Ginseng’ deeply rooted in the Void at a height of one kilometer, and a metallic planet with a diameter of 10,000 kilometers.
Boom
The chilling White Breath spanning thousands of kilometers penetrated, freezing and shattering a Black Ferocious Beast that was 3,000 meters long, coiled on a Floating Island.
In the Void, the Silver Giant Dragon spread its wings and let out a defiant roar, “Damn creature, daring to attempt a sneak attack on the Great Scythia, courting death.”
However, just when the Silver Giant Dragon was about to leave, a deep and resonant rumbling came from behind.
“Scythia, we have flown for so long without finding anything good. It seems this area is quite barren; it’s not worth wasting more time.”
“Just swallow that Life Lotus Seed here and start your breakthrough. I will carry you with me as we go.”
The murky air currents from behind churned and dispersed, revealing the Terminal Emperor Dragon that resembled a majestic mountain range, with an enormous body stretching 330,000 meters, radiating oppressiveness.
The Silver Giant Dragon shook its head, “Roar! Wait a bit longer Tim Abott. The Great Scythia has a premonition, next time, next time I will definitely find something good.”
Half a month with scant findings cooled down the ‘enthusiasm’ of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, deciding it was better to make contact with those Primordial Beasts sooner rather than later.

chapters.title: Chapter 1743 - 1743 641 Terrifying Roar Heavenly God
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1743: Chapter 641 Terrifying Roar, Heavenly God Bloodline_3 Chapter 1743: Chapter 641 Terrifying Roar, Heavenly God Bloodline_3 Over there, the ‘resources’ must be more abundant.
Of course, the accompanying dangers are definitely higher, which is why the Terminal Emperor Dragon wanted to become stronger before heading over.
Watching the Silver Giant Dragon trying to hold on a little longer, the Terminal Emperor Dragon paused, realizing there was a measure to consider between contacting the Primordial Beast herd sooner or later.
Roar!
Suddenly, a terrifying roar echoed from the depths of the Chaos Void, carrying a horrifying suppressive power that, even over infinite spacetime, shook countless strong beings.
Including the Terminal Emperor Dragon who was about to move and suddenly turned its head toward the front right.
Above the Firmament of the mythical world, deep within the Chaos Void where Space-Time intersected, the Great Sun in gold shone brightly, casting dazzling light, emitting a suppressive terror that dominated the heavens.
That vast, supreme grandeur pressure even made the bloodline of the Terminal Emperor Dragon boil, unable to resist roaring up at the sky.
Roar!
Roar! Roar!!
At this moment, not only the Terminal Emperor Dragon, deep within the Chaos Void came the roars of Giant Beasts, followed by the flashing lights of stars popping in the Void.
Huff huff!! The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s snort released a hot air wave that scorched the murky airflow in front, creating a pitch-black vacuum.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s eyes blazed as it looked toward the front right deep within the Chaos Void, where a great battle was erupting.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon roared: “Scythia, let’s go, it’s time to battle.”
