That beastly roar that shook all the realms of the world completely stirred up the belligerent blood of the Terminal Emperor Dragon. Accumulate? What was that? Head there and start the battle first.
Directly pick a Primordial Level enemy for a fight, eat it if it can be defeated, and think about the alternative if not.
For the resolute Terminal Emperor Dragon, no creature could change its mind. The Silver Giant Dragon, originally intending to wait until it became more powerful before heading to the Primordial battlefield, could only nod helplessly.
“Alright, Tim Abott.”
The Silver Giant Dragon flapped its wings, drawing a silver arc as it landed on the back of Terminal Emperor Dragon, finding a spot between two sturdy Dorsal Fins.
Crack!!
The Silver Giant Dragon swallowed the Life Lotus Seed, then slowly lay down, its body releasing substantial blue cold air and silver spatial energy.
Soon, the few Dorsal Fins of the Terminal Emperor Dragon were encased in Ice Crystals, forming an ice mountain ten thousand meters high.
Roar!
A tyrannical roar vibrated through the Void, with the ice mountain-bearing Terminal Emperor Dragon flaring its wings angrily, its surrounding Space-Time twisted, transforming into a black Light Beam that burst forth.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon adjusted its direction, at full strength, it gradually closed the distance with those faint, distant purple stars.
But the Chaos Void is riddled with dangers, some areas even the Terminal Emperor Dragon had to detour.
“What fire is this!”
Five days later, the Terminal Emperor Dragon traversed the Void, looking ahead at the vast expanse of white flames covering hundreds of billions of kilometers, feeling the intense danger emanating from it.
Even though the Terminal Emperor Dragon was still tens of billions of kilometers away from that sea of fire.
Even at such a distance, invisible hot energy swept through the Void, forming layers of red light bands spinning, distorting Space-Time.
After a deep look at that sea of fire in the Flame Sea Galaxy, the massive body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon slightly turned, transforming into a black rainbow light that bypassed it.
At this moment, the Terminal Emperor Dragon was far from the Mythical World. Using several Time-Space folds and leaps, by standard distance, it had already exceeded a hundred quadrillion kilometers.
But this distance, in the universe where the Solar System was initially situated, was still less than a light-year.
Simultaneously, it had only covered one-fifth of the distance to the location of those Primordial Beasts.
Such is the vastness of the Chaos Void, just to find a ‘small beast herd’ required flying so long and so far.
Meanwhile, because the Terminal Emperor Dragon focused on traveling, it didn’t have time to search for resources. It encountered nothing noteworthy along the way, only catching two ancient-level Ferocious Beasts as desserts.
Soon, the Terminal Emperor Dragon sped past that sea of fire with terrifying speed, but at that moment, an ocean formed by endless murky airflows appeared ahead, along with a massive city.
Just as the Terminal Emperor Dragon emerged, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, a strong pressure burst out from the city built of unknown gray rocks.
Boom! A pinnacle of True Spirit and containing a Primordial Bloodline aura shook the Space-Time.
Golden light spread from the city, rendering the entire world a golden ocean, and a lofty shadow spanning ten thousand kilometers appeared within this golden world.
This pinnacle of True Spirit being resembled a Dragon Man, covered in splendid golden battle armor, legs stout like claws, arms elongated, head ferocious.
Two pairs of pure golden horns on its head, sharp and cutting, a mane of golden hair like golden flames burned behind it, a golden tail spanning thousands of kilometers stretched across the Void.
The massive True Spirit apparition looked at the Terminal Emperor Dragon, its gaze cold and dignified, then a robust and grand voice shook the Void: “This is my territory, unknown colossal beast, leave immediately, or don’t blame me for suppressing you.”
As the majestic figure spoke, several figures emitting Mythical-level, Titan Level, and ancient-level powerful auras surged from the ancient city.
“Golden Eternal Divine Tribe.”
The massive body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon gradually halted.
The four-horned Golden Dragon Man slightly lifted its head, its authoritative cold gaze slanting at the Emperor Dragon: “From your reaction, it seems you know of our clan.”
The massive Black-red Colossal Beast slowly nodded, emitting a deep and resonant growl: “I’ve heard of you, your tribe supposedly has something called The Seventh Eternal Heavenly God.”
“That’s good, it appears you also have some Heavenly God bloodline, I’m still short of some energy.”
“Seeking death!”
Boom! Immediately, a terrifying roar and explosive thunder vibrated the Space-Time.
Soon, the area returned to calm, the only change was that the ancient city had disappeared, along with those of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe.
And just as that city, including that True Spirit Powerhouse with the Primordial Bloodline, fell.
Out in the distant spacetime, filled with endless golden light, a magnificent Great Hall suddenly vibrated with a powerful pressure.
“Not good, Tugulas Ancient God’s life aura has vanished, fallen.”
“How is that possible, Tugulas Ancient God was in the Late Stage of True Spirit, even awakened The Fifth Eternal Heavenly God bloodline, able to harness the power of a Heavenly God!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1744 - 1744 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1744: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent Chapter 1744: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent [Got confused while writing yesterday, a light year is only over nine trillion kilometers]
Thin and murky air currents spread through the Void, where a Black-red Colossal Beast, with a body length of 350,000 meters and having reached the mid period of the True Spirit realm, flew with an even more terrifying aura.
Because it was moving so fast it almost became a fleeting phantom light, every flash would cover several hundred thousand kilometers.
Just ‘looking at’ those three dimly lit purple stars in the distance, the Terminal Emperor Dragon estimated there were still dozens of light years to go, and it would take another two months of pure space-folding flight to get there.
In such a long time, by the time it got there those three Primordial Beasts might have already left.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s eyes revealed a deep thought: “There should be some shortcuts when rushing through the Chaos Void, otherwise even the Primordial Beasts would waste a lot of time traveling.”
Hum! Deep within the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils, a pair of black, rice-like complex runes slowly emerged.
Boom!
Under the activation of Heavenly Tier bloodline strength, the vertical pupils in the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s eyes released a dazzling light, its powerful gaze skyrocketed, penetrating space-time and capturing the vast Void into view.
At this moment, in the eyes of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Chaos Void revealed a different picture, like a Violent Ocean full of temporal chaos and scattered space fragments.
The Void Ocean was dotted densely with multicolored specks, with some stretching billions and even broader distances; each one a dangerous forbidden zone.
Among these forbidden areas, there are various sized silver nodes, each a Space-Time vortex twisted in form.
The largest one had a diameter of over ten thousand kilometers, emitting faint, transparent light beams, resonating with another vortex in the distant horizon.
Seeing that giant Space-Time vortex, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s eyes lit up: “As expected, the Chaos Void has large Space-Time Channels that jump farther distances.”
Boom! The Terminal Emperor Dragon disappeared instantly, leaving behind a Violent Black Hole tens of thousands of kilometers wide.
Although it saw the Space-Time Channel, there was still a great distance to cover, and even at the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s speed it would take about two days to arrive.
While the Terminal Emperor Dragon was on its way, the Black Warship heading toward the Human Divine Domain had also crossed half the journey.
But at this moment, those like Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy and King of Immortal Spirit Wind Heaven who were in Closed-door Cultivation, all made an appearance.
Looking at the golden-white thick clouds covering the sky and the faint terrifying pressure permeating between heaven and earth, expressions of shock showed on their faces.
“This aura, someone is making a breakthrough to the Ancient True Spirit God!!”
“Who is it?”
Just as the question left their lips, the image of that black-haired young man appeared in everyone’s minds.
In the current team, apart from Wind Heavenly King, only he was at the Peak of the Ancient realm, and with his ‘twenty-year’ cultivation speed to breakthrough to the Peak of the Ancient, the one breaking through now was obvious.
“True Spirit Immortal Emperor, ah.” Wind Heavenly King’s face showed longing.
Meanwhile, in the Transcendent Region, Justin Welan pointed at the faintly revealed golden-white patch of sky among the clouds: “Class Leader, I have a feeling, that phenomenon in the sky is definitely Jack’s doing.”
Justin Welan cheerfully said: “This kind of thing is what Jack does best, always likes to warm-up before showing off.”
In the distance, on the steps, Crystal Lewis, with red hair cascading over her shoulders, just finishing her cultivation and holding a sword, glanced at Justin Welan and said indifferently: “This isn’t showing off, it’s an astral phenomenon in response to the Heavenly Earth Law during a significant increase and breakthrough in cultivation.”
“But indeed, this bravado is very much his style.”
Although many ‘memories’ of the people were influenced by the power of the True Emperor, Jack Clark’s high cultivation, monstrous talent, and being the senior of this expedition team remained unchanged.
However, because of their ‘level’ being too low, they did not know that Jack Clark was breaking through to True Spirit, so their shock wasn’t as intense.
…
Chaos Void.
A silver vortex, more than ten thousand kilometers in diameter, slowly rotated, its invisible space-time fluctuations stirring a million kilometers, like a dazzling star system.
Roar!
A roaring that shook heaven and earth reverberated through the Void, and in the distance, murky air currents dispersed, revealing the Black-red Colossal Beast with its wings spanning over 600,000 meters.
After flying for two days, the Terminal Emperor Dragon finally arrived here, heading straight for the Space-Time vortex.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon approached the vortex within tens of thousands of kilometers, a powerful space-time warping force appeared, twisting space-time with an intensity capable of tearing ordinary True Spirit Beasts.
But ‘this’ level of power, upon nearing the Terminal Emperor Dragon, disintegrated instantly under an invisible force field around it.
Boom!!
The moment the Terminal Emperor Dragon charged into the Space-Time Channel, the channel shook, twisted, swelled wildly, and finally collapsed with a clamor, unable to bear the strain.
At the same time, tens of light years away, another light point also shone brightly, like a dazzling firework, radiating splendid light.
Roar!
As space-time collapsed, a Destruction storm that affected a few hundred thousand kilometer area reached out, and with a fierce and majestic roar, the Terminal Emperor Dragon emerged with its body’s black-red glow flashing.
An almost Primordial-level explosive fluctuation awoke the Purple little dragon, who after making a breakthrough to the late period of the Titan, yawned, lifted its head, its eyes showing confusion.
“What’s the matter, brother?”
“Nothing, just caused a collapse while passing through a Space-Time Channel just now.”
With a low growl, the Terminal Emperor Dragon turned to look back at the violently turbulent area in space-time, before turning its gaze towards the distance, where three purple stars shone brightly.
It was not far from the Void Heaven Divine Dragon cluster of beasts.
Even the Terminal Emperor Dragon could faintly sense several powerful Primordial-level energy fluctuations from there, with the majestic Dragon Roar and fierce roars coming through.
There was a great battle, a Primordial-level battle.
Suddenly the Terminal Emperor Dragon issued a deep roar: “Misss Joseline, let’s go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1745 - 1745 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1745: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent_2 Chapter 1745: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent_2 …
Spanning the Void, a massive continent stretching over billions of kilometers with mountain ranges winding through it, lush and verdant, filled with a dense and unparalleled Heavenly Energy—a hundred times that of the energy found in the mythical world.
Yet, at this moment, a terrifying battle erupts on this wonderland-like continent.
ROAR ROAR ROAR!!
Two Divine Dragons, one nearly two hundred thousand kilometers long and the other exceeding three hundred thousand kilometers, their bodies shimmering like purple-gold, roar furiously, their colossal forms streaking across tens of millions of kilometers in an instant.
Battling the Primordial Divine Dragons are two Nightmare Fiend Beasts, one towering at over seventy thousand kilometers and the other at a hundred and twenty thousand kilometers. Their bodies are covered in a heavy, insect-like black armor, ferocious to the extreme.
The upper bodies of these black ferocious beasts resemble the Furious Ape, with strong torsos and elongated arms, each armed with double claws as sharp and long as half their bodies.
Their lower halves are insect-like, with elongated, recurved legs that contain terrifying Burst strength. With every ejection of their legs, they instantly appear millions of kilometers away.
As the four Primordial Beasts clash, the terrifying force of each Instantaneous Explosion during their encounters destroys everything around them, shaking the Chaos Void.
But this World is incredibly stable; even a Full-Force Strike from a Primordial Level Giant Beast on the ground can only destroy an area of over a hundred thousand kilometers, creating a ‘small crater.’
In the midst of this land, countless dragons stretching thousands to tens of thousands of kilometers long and exuding an ancient aura and the presence of a Late Stage True Spirit, roar aggressively, battling against even more numerous Nightmare Fiend Beast Clan.
Every so often, white and red True Dragons scream as they are torn into over a dozen pieces and fall to the Earth.
Whenever a Xu Tian True Dragon falls and its blood dyes the earth, a Dragon Roar resounds from deep within the land, causing the mountain ranges to wriggle, come alive, and transform into a yellow True Dragon thousands of meters long that shoots up into the sky.
Not just the mountain ranges, but also the lush forests and winding rivers tens to hundreds of thousands of kilometers long continuously squirm and boil, transforming into green and blue True Dragons that roar as they emerge.
With an endless stream of True Dragons joining the fray, countless ferocious and terrifying Nightmare Fiend Beasts are torn to shreds.
The battlefield of the two clans spreads across the entire continent, exceptionally brutal. The entire Heaven and Earth are filled with a thick scent of blood, and Killing Intent permeates the entire Void.
Above that vast Chaos Continent, endless purple golden light converges to form a Void Heaven True Dragon exceeding a million kilometers in length.
This more terrifying Divine Dragon battles another beast as massive as a hundred thousand kilometers with its body covered in black armor and enshrouded with Golden Pattern—against a Nightmare Fiend Beast.
Around them, layers of sky envelop them, as though they are in a separate Space-Time. The power unleashed in each exchange, though capable of Destroy Heaven and Earth, does not let a single force escape.
The ‘starlight’ that the Terminal Emperor Dragon saw from tens of light-years away is the reflection cast into the Chaos Void by the power released by those three Void Heaven Divine Dragons.
As for the three equally terrifying Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beasts, there are no anomalies in the Void.
While the two clans engage in a frenzied, roaring battle, millions of kilometers away from the continent amidst turbulent, murky currents, a Black-red Colossal Beast stands tall, its gaze ablaze as it looks into the distance.
Feeling the formidable pressure emanating from the six Primordial Beasts, the Terminal Emperor Dragon only feels its blood boil.
Just then, the Purple little dragon atop the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s head looks gravely concerned and lets out a hesitant chirp: “Brother, the fight over there is so fierce; maybe we shouldn’t go over.”
Although sighting its kin excites the Purple little dragon, the three Primordial Nightmare Beasts are equally terrifying.
Especially the invisible Terrifying Aura that permeates from these Nightmare Beasts gives the Purple little dragon a feeling akin to facing a natural predator, instinctively terrified and frightened.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon naturally knows that the Purple little dragon is worried for its safety and roars softly, “Don’t worry, Misss Joseline, from the current situation, the top forces of both sides are evenly matched.”
“With my current strength, I’m not weaker than a typical Primordial Giant Beast in a one-on-one fight. If I join the battlefield, I can tip the balance.”
“Moreover, this is an opportunity,” the Terminal Emperor Dragon says, its eyes revealing a cold Killing Intent.
With its current strength, hunting a Primordial Level Giant Beast is almost impossible; it might defeat one, but it could not stop them if they chose to flee.
However, if there are peer-level beasts to assist, perhaps today they could capture a Primordial Beast. By devouring and refining it, it might break through to the Late Stage of True Spirit in one fell swoop.
And this is why it hurriedly came upon sensing the start of a Primordial battle here.
BOOM! The Terminal Emperor Dragon takes a heavy step; the Void beneath it collapses instantly, kicking up rolling murky currents that sweep across tens of thousands of kilometers.
Within it, a power that could shake the Great Thousand Worlds Bursts forth.
ROAR!
Under the astonished gaze of the Void Heaven Divine Dragons and the powerful Nightmare Beasts, endless red light Bursts beyond the continent, painting a world of blood over millions of kilometers.
At the center of that world, engulfed in Blood Red Lightning, a ferocious behemoth nearly two thousand kilometers long, its body covered with sharp red spikes and Sharp Horns, appears.
Most importantly, on that Blood Red Giant Beast, an almost Primordial-level powerful pressure looms.
Like a harbinger of Doomsday, heralding the arrival of destruction, a Purple Divine Dragon over five thousand meters long on top of the Giant Beast emits a childlike roar.
“Yi yi yi yi!! Brother charge, kill all those annoying black foes.”
“KILL!”
With the Doomsday Deep Red Giant Beast’s earth-shattering roar, its heavy footsteps stomp down as if a Destroy the world beast has descended, and the entire Chaos Void trembles mightily.
A writhing blood-colored lightning bolt streaks across the Void, spans millions of kilometers, and charges into the continent, heading straight for the Primordial Nightmare Beast towering over seventy thousand kilometers high.

chapters.title: Chapter 1746 - 1746 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1746: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent_3 Chapter 1746: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent_3 But just as he entered the range of that continental space, the blood-red lightning transformed by the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon paused, its speed suddenly slowed, weakened by dozens of times.
Moreover, in its perception, the Heaven and Earth were enveloped by a terrifying force that surpassed the Primordial, making the space immensely stable.
At this moment, millions of kilometers away, the Primordial Nightmare Beast, which was fighting with the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, roared, and a powerful Primordial Force burst from within, crossing blades in a reverse slash.
Roar! The Void Heaven Divine Dragon, stretching over hundreds of thousands of kilometers, roared, a purple-golden Dragon Claw reached out from under its belly, shadowing the sky and hard-hitting the heaven-defying blade.
Boom! In an instant, the nine heavens trembled, the sun and moon shone together, and the entire world trembled under the Full-Force Strike of the two Primordial Beasts.
Just as a Full-Force Strike was exchanged with that Void Heaven Divine Dragon, the moment both were pushed back by the powerful Primordial Force, the Nightmare Fiend Beast quickly turned around, bending its legs.
Boom! Under the terrifying force, the Void collapsed, and the Earth shattered forming a hollow of hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
And using the strong rebounding force, the Nightmare Fiend Beast’s figure vanished instantly, crossing millions of kilometers at an indescribable speed, appearing above the head of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
“Roar! Be careful, it’s targeting you.”
Only then did the roar of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon thunder, shaking the Void, its massive body turned into purple radiance appearing behind the Nightmare Fiend Beast.
But everything was too late, on the head of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon emanating red light, the Void broke for hundreds of thousands of kilometers around, and two black blades appeared.
Like blades, yet part of the body, wrapped by the black rule sequence chain, forming two brilliant serrated glows, wherever they passed ‘space’ was layered and split.
Including time, which also split into two under this blade, all things paused, leaving only those blades splitting the world in two.
At this moment, facing the Full-Force Strike of the Primordial level ferocious beast, the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon truly felt the power of the Primordial, the kind of power that surpassed all rules, irresistible.
Unstoppable, it would be injured! At this moment, the whole body of the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon trembled, it was a feeling of blood boiling with unparalleled excitement.
For a long time, it hadn’t felt the sense of danger.
This kind of threat that could injure it, unstoppable, was too exhilarating, too exhilarating.
While the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon was captivated by the power of this blade and its blood boiling, the Purple little dragon on its head had already collapsed weakly on the scale armor, unable to move.
Including the Silver Giant Dragon breaking through the ice on its back, was also startled by the sudden incoming terrifying force.
This is the Primordial, every move carries the Heaven’s Might that surpass all rules, powerful, invincible, suppressing all life under Primordial.
In that time-stopped layer, Morox watching from the darkness at the frozen Red Beast below, his gaze ice-cold and cruel.
Just a beast relying on erupting talent, barely approaching the Primordial in strength level, actually thinks to intervene in their Primordial-level battlefield, downright seeking death.
Roar! A fierce and brutal roar shook the Space-Time, echoing through the Chaos.
In an instant, darkness descended, the entire world emitted unbearable tearing sounds, strong and solid sky showing Black Cracks one after another, as if Doomsday had arrived.
In the darkness, an extremely black Dragon Claw rose to the skies, disregarding everything, grasping the black slash blades ripping the world with one claw.
Roar!
A fiercely brutal roar again exploded from the depths of darkness, bursting with indescribable powerful strength on the Dragon Claw, instantly sinking continents, upturning heaven and earth.
Boom!
Under that Overbearing force suppressing everything, Morox, like a planet ending all existence, crashed into the thick land below instantly.
Under the powerful impact force, even though this World was thick and solid, hundreds of thousands of kilometers of land rolled like a Tsunami, endless Scorching Magma erupting and thrown tens of thousands of kilometers.
Even though these magma emitted brilliant light, they could not illuminate the darkness covering Heaven and Earth.
That kind of black, wasn’t just mere absence of light or some kind of force, but a conceptual meaning of blackness, like everything ceasing to exist, world annihilating in nothingness.
Boom! The imposing Primordial pressure arrived, dazzling purple light turning part of the darkness purple-black, also accompanied by the roar of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon.
“Join forces, Suppress it.”
Roar!
In that extremely dark world center, the huge figure emitting black light suddenly moved, unparalleled Overbearing destructive force uncontrolled flowed around it.
Because it was too powerful, at this moment the Terminal Dragon almost turned into a true Black Hole, twisted surrounding all matter and space.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The collapsing land tore apart creating huge cracks, endless Black Flames erupted, the flames burning everything, Heavenly Earth Rules disintegrating under that force.
Two streams of Black Flames converged, stretching millions of kilometers of light penetrating Heaven and Earth, each slashing towards the diving Purple Divine Dragon and the Black Hole-like Terminal Dragon.
Roar!
The rising Blade Light intersected with the purple-golden Dragon Claw, strong forces causing a space explosion, like transparent liquid layers bursting.
Just as the Primordial Nightmare Beast blocked the Void Heaven Divine Dragon with one blade, another black Blade Light exploded, dispersing into a sky full of Black Flames under the dark Dragon Claw.
In the violently hot sea of fire, a black figure of ten thousand kilometers appeared, with the Void collapsing behind it, destroyed, a Tail Blade wrapped in black light undulating.
Silently, the entire Heaven and Earth were split by that leading supreme destructive Tail Blade, forming a fan-shaped black plane.
Including the Primordial Nightmare Beast surging from deep within the Earth, under its horrified gaze, the surrounding ‘Black World’ was also gradually split apart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1747 - 1747 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao Chaos
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1747: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent_4 Chapter 1747: Chapter 642 Primordial Heavenly Dao, Chaos Continent_4 That is its ‘Great Dark Heaven’ formed by the Primordial Rule.
That layer, which seems to be only a hundred kilometers, actually contains an infinite and distant space.
Just as the Tail Blade that cleaves the world appears before him in an instant, Morox lets out a tyrannical roar: “Get lost!”
The Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast crosses its slash blades on its forearms, outpacing time with a terrifying speed, and blocks the Tail Blade wrapped in Black Power.
Boom!
Although the blade is blocked, the overwhelming strength it carries blasts the Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast away.
Its body, reaching seventy thousand kilometers high, shoots outwards, dragging two trenches of millions of kilometers across the Earth, and only comes to a halt after toppling a metal mountain range spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
Such supreme strength catches the attention of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon perched in the sky.
Compared to it, with a true body length of tens of thousands of kilometers, and the seventy thousand kilometers long Nightmare Beast, the Emperor Dragon in its Terminal Form, reaching ten thousand kilometers, seems ‘small’.
However, the power contained within its dark body is incomparably overbearing.
Especially so, as the Black Power enveloping it nearly disregards the Primordial Nightmare Beast’s Great Dark ‘Heaven,’ almost harming its True Body.
Instantly, the Void Heaven Divine Dragon bellows: “Roar! Little fellow, your strength can cut through its Primordial Heavenly Realm. I shall take action to trap it next, leave the rest to you.”
“…No problem.” A terrifying roar that shakes Heaven and Earth resounds in the darkness.
Although unaware of what the ‘Primordial Heavenly Realm’ is, the Terminal Dragon’s goal is clear- to slay the Nightmare Beast and consume it.
Boom!
The Void Heaven Divine Dragon’s body bursts with dazzling purple light, swelling immensely, extending endlessly, and in an instant, a Divine Dragon stretching over a million kilometers appears.
The True Body of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon expands, its aura soaring tenfold, its formidable pressure shaking Heaven and Earth.
Amidst the resplendent purple light that colors the world, a vast and illusory sky emerges, and in an instant, a Supreme Force akin to the Heavenly Dao descends.
Roar!
The Void Heaven Divine Dragon roars, its colossal body appears above the trapped Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast, carrying the power of the Firmament. It transforms into a phantasmal streak of light that extends and encircles without form.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the activation of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon’s Lifeline Talent with the Burst of the Primordial Force, the Space-Time within millions of kilometers solidifies, like a purple translucent Crystal.
Yet within this transparent world, there mingles a layer of the Black World.
In the moment of entrapment, the Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast unleashes its Primordial Heavenly Realm Great Dark Heaven, offsetting the Void Heaven Divine Dragon’s Creation Purple Heaven.
Roar!
Amidst the intertwined purple and black world powered by the two Primordial Heavenly Realms, the Nightmare Fiend Beast, enveloped in Black Flames, lets out a tyrannical roar as its massive body slowly moves.
And at that moment when the two ‘Primordial’ beasts join forces to Suppress the Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast, a roar laden with terrifying murderous intent explodes, piercing through layers of worlds descending.
“Unknown Giant Beast, you are courting death, daring to intervene in the battle between our Nightmare Beast Clan and the Void Heaven Divine Dragon tribe.”
But simultaneously, in a distant Space-Time, a Purple Even-colored Divine Dragon that spans a million kilometers bellows: “Little fellow, fear not. Join forces with Purple Even, and Suppress that Primordial Nightmare Beast.”
Elsewhere on the Continent, an even mightier roar from another Void Heaven Divine Dragon resonates: “Roar! Kill, exterminate these ugly creatures.”
Roar, roar, roar!!
Feeling that unfamiliar Primordial Aura between heaven and earth, those True Spirit Level Void Heaven Divine Dragons, along with countless mountain ranges, rivers, and forests congealing True Spirits, let out tyrannical roars.
In an instant, an even more brutal great battle erupts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1748 - 1748 643 Tearing the Nightmare Beast
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1748: Chapter 643: Tearing the Nightmare Beast, Primordial Destruction Chapter 1748: Chapter 643: Tearing the Nightmare Beast, Primordial Destruction [The previous chapter can be refreshed. The latter part was written hastily and has been finely revised]
Primordial Level Giant Beast, not only is its true body massive, it contains terrifying strength capable of pushing through an entire Great Era of the world.
The surrounding aura of Primordial Rules is even more powerful, suppressing the Heavenly Earth Rules and all powers below Primordial, even affecting and distorting the surrounding space-time.
Additionally, with the environment of the Primordial Heavenly Realm compressing around this realm, without equivalent power, nothing can approach within a million kilometers of them, let alone cause them harm.
This level of absolute power is even more oppressive than True Spirit Level and Ancient Level exerting pressure on lower-level cultivators of a Major Realm.
However today, a sudden appearance of a Black-red Colossal Beast broke this rule.
With the Realm breath of mid-period True Spirit, it unexpectedly unleashed a combat strength comparable to Primordial.
And after its second transformation, entering its dark Terminal Form, it even surpassed the Primordial powers of the first day of Celestial Realm and the Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast of the Star Realm.
At this moment, as the Void Heaven Divine Dragon’s Lifeline Talent burst forth, transforming into a million kilometer long dragon to restrain, the Terminal Emperor Dragon suppressed the honored Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast directly into the earth to a depth of a million kilometers.
This continent, with unknown origins, not only has a sturdy space and contains some kind of terrifying suppressive force, the Earth itself is also extremely thick.
The deeper one goes underground, the feeling of invisible heavy pressure doubles, somewhat similar to the interior of a star, where even the power of Primordial Giant Beasts would be partially suppressed.
Under such circumstances, many life-preserving unique abilities, talents, and Divine Powers would also be significantly weakened, making it a natural burial ground.
Previously, Jack Clark in the Heavenly Feather battlefield, used the environmental conditions deep within the Earth to swiftly assassinate a Demon God before Tyris and other Great Demon Kings could even come to the rescue.
But this Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast is not that Demon God; it sensed the intentions of the Terminal Dragon right away.
“Get lost!” A roar filled with tremendous murderous intent shook the heavens and the earth.
In the depths of the million-kilometer deep pit, surging Black Flames transformed into a vortex spinning, the heart of the vortex slowly extended a blade-like yet insectoid black gigantic blade.
Right when that hundreds of thousands of kilometers long black gigantic blade appeared, that Void Heaven Divine Dragon roared long.
“Be careful, little one, that is the Nightmare Beast Blade, a cross space-time strike from an even more powerful Nightmare Fiend Beast, it can’t be intercepted directly, our true bodies cannot withstand it.”
Roar! The Void Heaven Dragon perched atop the Earth roared, its mouth gathering a dazzling radiance, and instantly a purple light column, thousands of kilometers thick, penetrated heaven and earth.
The Primordial Giant Beast’s breath was immensely powerful, shaking space-time with strong strength, forming dazzling halos around it.
A strike powerful enough to penetrate stars hit the black giant blade, unleashing dazzling light and a horrific explosion, infinite purple radiance erupting.
Boom! The Earth shook within a radius of millions of kilometers, rocks crumbled and dissolved, purple radiance erupted towards the firmament like volcanic magma.
Even if the purple Primordial radiance shone across heaven and earth, it still could not completely break through the darkness enveloping this world, within this area light was devoured, energy dissipated.
At the edge of the deep pit, the Terminal Dragon, towering ten thousand kilometers high, looked down with a cold gaze at the Black Giant Claw underneath that ignored the breath of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, seemingly slow but irresistibly thrusting forward.
Every Primordial Beast possesses a Lifeline Talent. The Void Heaven Divine Dragon resembles the Gigantification similar to Deep Red Destruction, with its size exploding directly from over a hundred thousand kilometers to over a million kilometers.
However, unlike the Deep Red which amplifies basic strength and basic Defense, the Void Heaven Divine Dragon significantly enhances the might of Primordial Force.
And this Nightmare Fiend Beast seems to lack a Lifeline Talent, but the power contained in its strike is so formidable that even the Void Heaven Divine Dragon dares not confront it head-on.
Even the Terminal Dragon feels the imminent danger from the sharpness emitted by the black colossal blade—very powerful, but no matter how powerful, it must be blocked, otherwise the Nightmare Beast following behind will escape.
Boom!
The Terminal Dragon’s right claw slowly reaches out, covered with a substance darker and heavier than darkness, also emitting an extremely sharp blade edge.
Meanwhile, around the Terminal Emperor Dragon, powers capable of destroying countless worlds and universes descend as supreme destructive forces, transformed into black bands of light gathering towards the Dragon Claw.
Once the Thunderflame Behemoth had thousands of force field binding runes engraved on its right claw scale armor that could significantly compress and condense the internal Flame Power, releasing a destructive power tens of times more potent in an instant.
And as the Thunderflame Behemoth continued to breakthrough, grow, and evolve, these artificially engraved force field binding runes had already merged with the True Body.
Though not forming a talent, under the Terminal Dragon’s drive, the constraint on power became even stronger.
At this moment, tens of thousands of even more complex grey runes appeared on the black scale armor of the Terminal Dragon’s right claw, forming a gravitational force field much like the collapse of a space-time black hole.
The powerful force field even forced the destructive powers drawn from outside the Chaos, bit by bit, forcibly pressurizing them into the Terminal Dragon’s claw, making the blade even darker and more dazzling.
Just as the Terminal Emperor Dragon thought before, since he did not know how to integrate this supreme destruction into the blade sharpness, he would forcefully compress it into his body.
And all this transpired in an instant, momentarily integrating thirty percent of the destructive power into the Dragon Claw—a terrifying aura of destruction pervaded the atmosphere.
At this moment, the Terminal Dragon’s claw almost loses its form, akin to the true light of darkness, exuding the supreme and majestic oppression, filling the entire heaven and earth.
The aura is upright and proper, just like the strong and bright Great Sun, devoid of any despair or dark intent of destruction.
And this, is the essence of destruction.
Everything that lives must die, everything created must be destroyed, including the world, planes, and the vast universe alike, all have a process from creation to extinction.
Huff!
The Terminal Claw, representing destruction, descends and meets the towering giant black blade, silently, a dark shockwave bursts forth.
Everything it passes—matter, space, energy—is erased.
Under the formidable force, the Terminal Dragon’s right claw disintegrates, turning to ash, while the black colossal blade, which even the Void Heaven Divine Dragon dared not directly confront, also shatters.
The right claw’s disintegrated Terminal Dragon stands in the darkness, looking at the fierce figure rising seventy thousand kilometers high from deep within the earth, and slowly roars, “So, this is the Primordial Force.”
As it speaks, a terrible aura permeates from the body of the Terminal Dragon.
Full-body scales armor, muscles, bones, and even cells have a regular, slight trembling, emitting a silent rhythm that faintly resembles countless lives praising destruction, a chant of demise.
Lifeline talent in its terminal form, multiplying the base strength and base defense by hundreds or even thousands times, allowed the Terminal Emperor Dragon to forcefully step into the Primordial level with absolute power.
However, its own realm still remained at the True Spirit level.
This realm encompasses the Doomsday Rule, the cognition of power, and the intensity of the Divine Soul Intent.
But now, leveraging the absolute power of the Primordial level, the Terminal Dragon forcefully compressed the essence of Supreme Destruction into its body, prematurely comprehending the ‘Primordial’ of destruction.
It even began to trigger the Supreme Destruction energy pervading outside the universe, letting the chaotic destructive power descend to enhance the Giant Beast Body.
Around the Terminal Dragon, strands of black light slowly merged into the pitch-black scales, and the black radiance emitted from its body gradually dimmed.
Yet its body size was swelling at an astonishing rate, quickly ballooning to twelve thousand kilometers, fifteen thousand kilometers…
Primordial, gathering all forces, the true body is a collection of all rules and talents; thus, the stronger the Primordial entity, the more enormous its form becomes.
Although at this moment the Terminal Dragon hadn’t stepped into the Primordial level, as these powers of Supreme Destruction Rules entered its body, the might of its terminal form further intensified.
This scene even made the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, lurking above the firmaments, somewhat dumbfounded.
Such a spectacle is nearly impossible for those beasts with ‘dull’ talents that are accustomed to evolving and elevating their realm through hibernation, passively relying on their Giant Beast bodies.
To put it simply, it is as if suddenly a handsome, highly enlightened genius appeared among a group of burly men only acquainted with boosting their strength through muscle training.
“Monster!”
In this moment, even in the eyes of the Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast, a sense of dread surfaced, as its body gathered the converging black flames into itself, legs fully bent.
Boom!
Beneath the Nightmare Fiend Beast, space-time collapsed, creating a pitch-black hollow. Its enormous body vanished at a speed indescribable and imperceptible even to the consciousness of Primordial creatures.
“It’s the Space-Time Rupture Ability of the Nightmare Beast Clan; it’s fleeing.”
The Void Heaven Divine Dragon, perching above the firmaments, roared, its body aglow with purple Primordial radiance that penetrated layers of space, influencing time, trying to prevent that Nightmare Fiend Beast from escaping.
But faced with this talent involving a tear in space-time, it was unable to stop it.
“Our battle is not over yet.” A resonant, space-time vibrating roar echoed slowly in the stillness of time.
In the space-time rupture, like a pitch-black cut surface, the Terminal Dragon, its measure soaring to twenty thousand kilometers, descended thunderously, its body pitch-black resembling a black hole, ignoring all space-time barriers.
At this time, the Terminal Dragon’s entire body scales displayed peculiar patterns, interwoven into a series of world-destructive, plane-collapsing images, appearing exceedingly ferocious and fearsome.
“Those who obstruct our clan shall be eternally buried in chaos!”
The Nightmare Fiend Beast roared, its giant double blades slashing across, transforming into a burning flame of a black cross intersecting, stretching a million kilometers.
Boom!
Beneath the dragon claw bearing the world-destructive pattern, the blade light shattered, the darkened heavens collapsed, including the indestructible double blades of the Nightmare Fiend Beast, which were destroyed in one strike.
Utterly irresistible, unstoppable.
And just as a claw shattered the Nightmare Fiend Beast’s double blades in an instant, the Terminal Dragon moved forward with a step, its gigantic body carrying the power to destroy worlds, smashing into the beast’s chest.
Boom!
Under the force of Unrivaled Domineering Power, the chest cavity of the Nightmare Fiend Beast collapsed, the heavy insect-shell-like scales shattered, and the flesh and blood containing terrifying energy exploded.
Roar!
The Nightmare Fiend Beast emitted a pained roar, and at the same time, the ferocity in its eyes surged, its broken arms suddenly clasped together, and a Burst of strength entrapped the Terminal Dragon.
Meanwhile, a black-red radiance flickered in its mouth, exuding an impressive dangerous aura.
Before the Nightmare Fiend Beast could expel its breath, its broken arms were forced apart by a powerful force, and a sharp, cutting black tail blade pierced through heaven and earth.
Pfft! The sharp tail blade pierced through the grinning mouth of the Nightmare Fiend Beast, tearing its lower jaw, interrupting the about to erupt breath.
Roar!
The Nightmare Fiend Beast roared in pain, its lower legs reflexively kicking out, striking the Terminal Dragon’s chest at a horrifying speed, forcing even the Terminal Dragon out of the space-time rupture.
In this moment, the two Primordial Giant Beasts fought like ordinary beasts in the most primitive close-quarters battle.
Only their actions contained immense power, the aftermath of their clash destroying the surrounding heaven and earth, collapsing space-time, forming a turbulent region spanning millions of kilometers.
This was only because the heavenly earth rules suppressed them; otherwise, merely the aftermath would have been enough to destroy an entire Star System.
“Stranger beast, daring to intervene in our clan’s battle with the Void Heaven Divine Dragon clan, one day I shall kill you.” The Nightmare Fiend Beast roared, its figure flickered…
Pfft!
As the Nightmare Fiend Beast leaped out of the space-time rupture and vanished, a ten thousand kilometers long pitch-black tail blade executed a horizontal slice, everything below its blade edge disappeared.
Instantly, a painful roar echoed throughout this world.
Stagnant time-space rupture, the lower body of the Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beast crashed down, the wound leaking terrifyingly powerful black blood like a mountain torrent, disappearing into the vast space-time.
Boom! Before the half-body of the Primordial Giant Beast could escape, a pitch-black Dragon Claw descended from the sky, firmly pinning it down.
Half a body, still not too bad.

chapters.title: Chapter 1749 - 1749 644 Devouring Ferocious Beasts The Third
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1749: Chapter 644: Devouring Ferocious Beasts, The Third Day in the Monarch Realm Chapter 1749: Chapter 644: Devouring Ferocious Beasts, The Third Day in the Monarch Realm Roar!
To the east of the Chaos Continent, darkness envelops billions of kilometers.
At the center of darkness, a pitch-black Giant Beast, with a body length of 20,000 kilometers, stands tall at 12,000 kilometers, roaring towards the sky, its ferocious aura shaking the Chaos Void.
In its claw, it grips the severed True Body of a Nightmare Fiend Beast, a sight that left all other Primordial Beasts somewhat astonished.
Three Void Heaven Divine Dragons, and the other two Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beasts did not anticipate that Morox would suddenly fall, his True Body severed.
It seemed that his possession of the Great Dark Heavenly Realm, the powerful Primordial Rule, and the invincible defense of his Primordial True Body were as if nonexistent.
Despite the disparities in strength between the two sides not being very significant, when the Terminal Dragon initially joined forces with that Void Heaven Divine Dragon, they only managed to suppress him.
Billions of kilometers away, the space-time shakes as the Morox, whose True Body has been severed, appeared weakened, watching the Nightmare Fiend Beast brawling with the other two Void Heaven Divine Dragons and roaring.
“Morocdo, Morocco, help me retrieve my True Body.”
“This Giant Beast’s strength is problematic; it’s not just Primordial destruction, it can ignore all strength and even space-time faults cannot restrain it.”
The Primordial True Body is the essence of a Primordial Beast.
With the True Body cut in half, if unable to retrieve it, this Primordial Nightmare would not only risk death but also require heavy injury and at least tens of thousands of years to recover.
Boom!
The continent above shakes in space-time, the even more dreadful Nightmare Fiend Beast roars, the blade in its hand imbued with terrifying force, cleaving through two worlds, making its figure clearer.
Immediately the cruel and dignified roar shakes Heaven and Earth, “Codo, forget that Void Heaven Divine Dragon, first help Morox retrieve his True Body.”
But at that moment, the battling Void Heaven Divine Dragon roared, “Morocco, do you think we do not exist? Purple Even, Purple Season, don’t give them any opportunity.”
“Little one, go ahead and suppress Morox’s shattered True Body; we will hold them off.”
“Kill!”
Those two Void Heaven Divine Dragons let out high and excited roars, with brilliant Primordial brilliance shining on their bodies, illuminating the Chaos Void, like two bright stars.
Boom boom boom!!
The great battle between the six Primordial Beasts erupted again, and this time both sides began to fight desperately, burning their origins and unleashing various terrifyingly powerful talents.
For instance, the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, whose True Body spans more than 300,000 kilometers, with a purple planet appearing above its head, surrounded by a ring of black halos.
The even more powerful Void Heaven Divine Dragon shone with golden light all over its body, a pure golden Dragon Claw growing from its abdomen, in an instant, a more noble and majestic aura descended.
Roar! The over one million kilometers long, powerful Void Heaven Divine Dragon roars, pouncing towards the lower half of the Nightmare Fiend Beast temporarily condensed from energy.
“Morox, let’s go again.”
“Damn it!” The Nightmare Fiend Beast, whose aura dropped a notch, roared like a ferocious ape holding sharp double blades.
Just as the two Primordial Nightmare Fiend Beasts were held back, the weakest being suppressed, the half Primordial True Body held by the Terminal Emperor Dragon also struggled.
The True Body of a Primordial Beast is a Rule aggregate, every drop of blood containing the will of a Primordial Beast.
Under normal conditions, even if severed, it could use the power to morph into another Primordial Beast, possessing partial Primordial powers, capable of formless flesh and blood regeneration.
Whoo Whoo!!
On the 30,000-kilometer-long True Body, Black Flames burn like the great sun and constant stars, trying to escape the suppression of the Terminal Dragon.
These Black Flames possess terrifying power, containing a force stronger than the abyss’s darkness, incinerating all rules and matter.
Even Primordial Beasts need to expend energy to resist, otherwise, their True Body would be burned.
But these Black Flames were outright ignored by the Terminal Dragon, whose foundational strength surged by hundreds to thousands of times, with foundational defensive enhancement, making its True Body incredibly powerful.
And this defense is not only physical but also a Chaotic domain that is immune to all rule and power-based damages.
It can be imagined how terrifying the defense of the Terminal Dragon is at this time; unless the strength exceeds the current defensive limits of the Terminal Dragon by tenfold, only then will it decrease step by step, causing damage.
Roar!
The Terminal Dragon roars, grabbing the struggling, shattered Giant Beast’s legs with its double claws, muscles in the claws bulging, endless strength converging, Burst.
Boom boom boom!! Terrifying strength tears through, between the legs of the Nightmare Fiend Beast an earth-shattering bellow emits, Black Flames blaze intensely.
On the solid exoskeleton-like armor, massive cracks continuously spread.
Including the muscles below that seem to be made of black divine gold, the indestructible bones are also being slowly torn apart by the invincible strength of the Terminal Dragon.
Boom! The 30,000-kilometer-long, connected part of being 7,000 kilometers thick, the Primordial Fierce Beast’s remaining body is directly torn into two halves.
And not only is the body of the Nightmare Fiend Beast severed this time but also the Primordial Rule contained within that part of the True Body, was also ruptured, instantly weakening its struggle.
Roar!
The Terminal Dragon standing in the darkness roars upwards, each claw grasping a section of the Primordial Beast’s body, an aura ferocious and cruel, awe-inspiring countless True Dragons.
Squeak squeak!! Brother invincible, charge, kill these annoying creatures.
On the massive planet-like head of the Black Colossus, a mere few thousand kilometers long Purple Divine Dragon, like an insignificant worm, excitedly waves its Dragon Claw.
Just entering the Chaotic Heavens, it tore apart a Primordial Beast, making the Terminal Dragon reach its pinnacle of aura, and also greatly exciting and inciting worship in the Purple little dragon.
Hum!
Brilliant light shines from the mouth of the Purple little dragon, subsequently, a continuous stream of purple brilliance sprouts from its mouth, directly merging into the scale armor of the Terminal Dragon below.
