chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1750: Chapter 644: Devouring Ferocious Beasts, The Third Day in the Monarch Realm – Part 2 Chapter 1750: Chapter 644: Devouring Ferocious Beasts, The Third Day in the Monarch Realm – Part 2 At that very moment, the aura of the Terminal Emperor Dragon suddenly surged. The speed of loss from its already half-consumed Terminal Origin slowed and even began to recover slightly.
“Is this the pure Creation Origin!?”
Feeling the power emanating from the mouth of the Purple little dragon, a look of utter astonishment appeared in the eyes of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, who was suppressing Morox.
And the existence of the Purple little dragon was also the reason why these Void Heaven Divine Dragons accepted the Terminal Emperor Dragon as soon as it appeared.
Just then, the Terminal Dragon roared again, its viciously wide mouth shimmering with black-red radiance, biting down fiercely on the body of the Primordial Beast it held.
The Primordial Force contained in the Primordial Beast’s body was too mighty, not certain if it could be Devoured by the externally deployed Eternal Darkness Devouring.
Therefore, in the end, everything reverted to the most primitive method of ingestion.
Boom Boom Boom!! Under the sharp and huge fangs, Black Flames exploded, and the thick Black Shell bit by bit shattered, followed by the incomparably tough muscles.
In the instant when the Primordial Body was gradually torn apart, a horrifying energy burst forth, resembling a planetary explosion, accompanied by light and heat.
But all this could not prevent the Terminal Dragon from tearing off and devouring a large chunk of the Primordial ‘flesh and blood’, echoing with thunderous munching into a stomach resembling an Apocalypse Cauldron.
Boom! A burst of intense, violent energy erupts instantly, spewing forth centered on the stomach of the Terminal Dragon.
Under the abundant and vigorous biological energy, the aura of the Terminal Dragon became even stronger, with its body now visibly growing at 20,000 kilometers in the blink of an eye.
“My True Body!” Watching the scene of the Terminal Dragon forcibly tearing and devouring its True Body, Morox’s eyes burst with intense murderous intent.
But no matter how fierce the murderous intent, it couldn’t change the fact that its True Body was being devoured piece by piece.
Suddenly, from the deep reaches of the continental spacetime, the terrifying Nightmare Fiend Beast roared: “Morocdo, Morox, today’s battle failed to severely damage the tribe of Void Heaven Divine Dragons, prepare to retreat.”
“But my True Body…”
“If you are reluctant, go and snatch it back yourself.” Morocco’s gaze was incredibly cold and cruel, appearing very calm, knowing that today’s efforts were in vain.
Similarly, the Nightmare Fiend Beast, whose True Body was being torn apart, also understood this.
Ultimately, the Primordial Beast could only watch the Terminal Dragon with intense reluctance and let out a furious roar: “Next time, next time I will surely kill you, and exterminate all Void Heaven Divine Dragons.”
Holding the remnant body in its claw, the Terminal Dragon slowly raised its head, its gaze cold, and issued a thunderous roar that shook Heaven and Earth: “I await you.”
“Remember, it is Brock Abbott, the king of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire, who tore your True Body today.”
Brock Abbott.
That moment, all the Primordial Beasts present remembered this name, remembered this giant creature of the mid-stage True Spirit Realm, yet capable of forcefully tearing the True Body of a Primordial Fierce Beast.
And as the two Primordial forces clashed, retreating wasn’t so simple.
The tribe of Void Heaven Divine Dragons, which had been somewhat overwhelmed, saw the balance of high-end power shattered with the addition of the Terminal Dragon, and they gained a significant advantage in return.
Under these circumstances, they naturally wouldn’t let the Nightmare Fiend Beasts escape so easily.
“Want to leave, it’s not that simple, kill.” Three Void Heaven Divine Dragons roared, and countless True Dragons across the continent issued excited dragon roars.
Including the Terminal Dragon, while mobilizing its power to Suppress and Devour the remnants of the Primordial Beast, it also turned its gaze towards the True Spirit-level battlefield sprawling across the Chaos Continent.
Those True Spirit-level Nightmare Fiend Beasts were also a great supplement for it.
Boom! Heaven and Earth trembled.
The massive body of the Emperor Dragon in its Terminal Form suddenly moved, stepping through time, appearing at incomprehensible speed over the head of a Late Stage True Spirit Nightmare Fiend Beast.
Roar! In the overshadowing darkness, the giant black dragon head swooped down, Devouring everything.
By the time the eclipsing darkness faded, only a black hole tens of thousands of kilometers wide remained in that place, a vacuum where matter and rules ceased to exist.
And under the terrifying aura of the Terminal Dragon, a True Spirit-level Void Heaven Divine Dragon stood rigid, not daring to move.
In its Terminal Form, the Emperor Dragon was immensely powerful. It had absolute dominion over Beasts beneath the Primordial level, with its True Eternal Darkness Devouring ability swallowing one with almost every bite.
And as the Terminal Dragon devoured nine True Spirit mid-stage, even Pinnacle-level Nightmare Fiend Beasts in one go.
“Dragon Palace King, you are seeking death.”
A fierce and brutal roar exploded, the twisted world above the continent shattered, and a Nightmare Fiend Beast, its entire body black covered with golden patterns, descended from another spacetime.
In an instant, an unprecedented sense of danger enveloped the Terminal Dragon.
Boom!
A black gold blade light, stretching for millions of kilometers, traversed Heaven and Earth. The light of the blade stirred spacetime, twisting the rules of Heavenly Earth, as if a colorful stream of light spun, covering the sun.
At the moment this blade slashed down, the solid and strong world around the Terminal Dragon collapsed layer by layer like building blocks.
At the same time, an extremely sharp will locked onto the Terminal Dragon, with no escape and no place to hide.
This is the strength of the Nightmare Fiend Beast, already immensely powerful as a Giant Beast and innately possessing a pair of unparalleled sharp slash blades, each mastery of Blade Path is otherworldly.
With dual layers stacked, even the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, another Primordial Beast and master of Supreme Rule, is suppressed in one-on-one combat.
Roar!
Facing that apocalypse-inducing blade that shattered spacetime and destroyed all heavens, the Terminal Dragon roared to the skies from the heart of endless darkness, splitting the darkness behind it into two, as an equally sharp black Tail Blade soared to the skies.
Boom!
The colorful blade light engulfed the Terminal Dragon, continuing unstoppably to slash onto the Earth, instantly creating a crack of tens of millions of kilometers on the sturdy Chaos Continent.
The aftermath of the explosion destroyed everything within tens of millions of kilometers, True Dragons screamed in agony, torn apart by the extremely sharp Invisible Power.
Just as the Nightmare Fiend Beast launched that apocalyptic blade, the void above burst open, and a massive golden Dragon Claw descended from the heavens.
The indestructible Golden Dragon Claw ripped through the triplex world enveloping the Nightmare Fiend Beast, striking its shoulder, releasing blinding golden light that illuminated Heaven and Earth.
“Purple Glow, this claw I have noted.”
A brutal and fierce roar echoed through the void, massive Black Flames surged like tides, engulfing all Nightmare Fiend Beasts rushing towards the void, along with three streams of Primordial Aura quickly disappearing into the depths of chaos.
Roar, roar, roar!! On the Chaos Continent, True Dragons of thousands to tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of meters, roared.
They once again repelled the attack of the Nightmare Fiend Beasts.
“Little guy, are you alright?”
Three Void Heaven Divine Dragons coiled above the Firmament, looking down towards the depths of the Earth, where tens of millions of kilometers were burning with black flames, terror-filled blade energy pervasive.
“I am fine.”
A deep, resonant roar vibrated Heaven and Earth. Subsequently, in the central region, black flames dissipated, revealing the massive and fierce silhouette of the Terminal Dragon.
From its shoulder to its abdomen, a hundred-kilometer deep crack emerged, like a vast canyon stretching for tens of thousands of kilometers.
Of course, while this wound seemed shocking, it had just cut open the Terminal Dragon’s scale armor, inflicting no severe damage.
Including the dark flames and blade-like Primordial Force emanating from the wound, all were eradicated by black lightning, the crack visibly healing at a rapid pace.
Seeing this scene, the three Void Heaven Divine Dragons breathed a sigh of relief.
They were also somewhat astonished by the defense of the Terminal Dragon, which was terrifying.
As a race that had fought against those original fierce beasts for many years, they naturally knew how strong that Nightmare Fiend Beast was.
Just now, if it were another Primordial Star Realm Giant Beast, including the one that teamed up with the Terminal Dragon, that one blade could have cut it in two.
In that moment, the aura of the Terminal Dragon suddenly plummeted, and the all-encompassing darkness receded.
With the battle over, there was no need to maintain the Terminal Form.
And the Terminal Emperor Dragon, having let go of the Terminal Form, looked up and asked, “Honored Divine Dragons, may I inquire what realm that Nightmare Fiend Beast was in?”
“Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary, Monarch-level.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1751 - 1751 645 Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon The
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1751: Chapter 645 Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon, The Battle of Eternity Chapter 1751: Chapter 645 Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon, The Battle of Eternity The Third Heavenly Realm, Primordial Monarch!
With a body length of over 360,000 meters, the Terminal Emperor Dragon spread its wings, subduing beneath its feet a more than 30,000-kilometer-long Primordial Fierce Beast torn in two.
After the Purple Glow Void Heaven Divine Dragon spoke, doubt did not completely fade from its eyes.
Originally, upon reaching half-step Primordial during the Deification Unity, the Terminal Emperor Dragon sensed a long journey ahead beyond the Primordial, simply unaware of the exact divisions.
Yet the ‘innate knowing’ ability of a Heavenly Tier bloodline required the Terminal Emperor Dragon to reach a certain realm before it would know the specifics of that realm.
Including when encountering some Heaven and Earth Treasure, related information would automatically emerge.
This premise required being in the mythical world; outside of the mythical world, even the True Spirit Seal, deep within the World Origin of the mythical world, would be clueless.
At this moment, the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, resembling a purple star, bowed its head, and surrounding air vibrated instantly, stirring up ring-shaped shockwaves that swept over hundreds of thousands of kilometers, filled with a sense of oppression.
“This is what I know about the detailed information of the Primordial Realm, which you can refer to.”
Amidst the earth-shaking Dragon Roar, a purple light sphere materialized out of thin air, slowly floating towards the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
For Terminal Emperor Dragon, who appeared to help at a critical moment, the attitude of these Void Heaven Divine Dragons was very gentle and close.
Boom!
The moment the Terminal Emperor Dragon grasped the Will Light Sphere, an overwhelming flood of information and visuals like a mountain-shaking and tsunami-heavy influx poured into its mind, recording the differences and distinctions of the realms beyond the Primordial.
Nine Layers of Primordial Heavens, the Eternal and Undying Path.
When a Giant Beast breaks through the Primordial, it reshapes its True Body with the force of the origin of the touched Rule, which is the Primordial Air, and the Lifeline Talent is condensed by absorbing the Creation Force.
Simultaneously, with both Primordial and Creation Forces, and the Rule World as the foundation, a Creation Heavenly Realm is carved out, nurturing the power of the Heavenly Dao.
The Creation Heavenly Realm is divided into internal and external paths.
The external Heavenly Realm is similar to the Divine Realm opened up by the Human True Emperors, and the internal Heavenly Realm is the infinite ‘space’ that surrounds the Void Heaven Divine Dragons and Nightmare Fiend Beasts.
A Giant Beast that has just broken through the Primordial is known as a Star Giant Beast, shining like a star, with the terrifying power to blow up stars and destroy a part of a small Great Thousand Worlds with a single strike.
The Second Heavenly Realm is called the Starry Sky Overlord, signifying that among the Primordial Giant Beasts, it also belongs to a leader.
The Third Heavenly Realm is the Starry Sea Monarch, with the Divine Dragon named Purple Glow and the Nightmare Fiend Beast that once slashed and injured the Terminal Dragon both belonging to this realm.
And once reaching the Primordial, whether cultivators or Giant Beasts, they all need to continuously carve out ‘Heavens’.
Every time a heavenly realm is opened, not only does one gain the empowerment of the Second Layer of Heavenly Dao, with stronger strength, but the owned power also undergoes a qualitative transformation.
As for how much strength is enhanced, it has to do with the foundation carrying the Heavenly Dao.
Every ‘Heaven’ requires sufficient Primordial Air and Creation Force to congeal and also a strong enough ‘vessel’ to bear it.
This vessel could be the expansion of an already existing Great Thousand Worlds by more than ten times, becoming even more immense, or it could be the cultivator’s second supremely powerful Divine Rule condensed.
It could also be an incredibly powerful Creation Divine Weapon, the immense body of a Giant Beast, or the Giant Beast’s second Lifeline Talent.
As long as it meets the foundational growth needs for the Primordial Heavenly Realm.
Some Primordial lifeforms break through to Starry Sky Overlord with only more than ten times the strength enhancement, while some Primordial Giant Beasts break through to become Starry Sky Overlords and have their strength increased by dozens, even up to a hundred times.
Thus, the gap between Primordial Stars and Primordial Hegemons can be very large or just average.
Take the Terminal Dragon, for instance, with normal battle strength at the Pinnacle of True Spirit, Half-step Primordial upon Doomsday Gigantification, and once it enters Terminal Form, its strength soars to the peak of Star Realm in an instant.
After absorbing the destructive Primordial Power into its body, its strength barely steps into the Monarch level.
With invincible defense and the double traits of destroying Chaos, it crushes the Star Realm Nightmare Fiend Beast, and even if slashed by the Starry Sea Monarch’s Nightmare Fiend Beast, it only breaks its defense, incapable of inflicting heavy injury.
At the same time, it can be seen from this that the strength of that Starry Sea Monarch-level Nightmare Fiend Beast is not ‘too strong.’
That beast’s Second Layer and Third Layer of Heavenly Realms that it carved out are average, probably only enhancing its strength by ten or twenty times, otherwise, it would have been able to suppress the Terminal Emperor Dragon with one strike.
But once a Primordial Giant Beast crosses the Fourth Heavenly Realm and becomes a Chaotic True Emperor, the gap starts to widen.
From the Fourth Heavenly Realm onwards, not only is a Chaotic True Emperor stronger, but they also truly begin to delve into Space-Time, standing independent of all rules, unbound by time.
Such powerful beings are regarded as emperors even within the Chaos Void.
Above the True Emperor, the Fifth Heavenly Realm is called the Chaos Great Emperor, suppressing one aspect and overlooking the ages.
As for the Sixth Heavenly Realm, the Chaotic True Ancestor can already be honored as Dao Ancestor, being the source of their bloodline and rules, with such lifeforms generally wandering deep within the Chaos Sea.
And here, the record ends.
What the realm above the Sixth Heavenly Realm is, what its characteristics are, even the Purple Glow Divine Dragon is unclear about, for none among its tribe had reached that point.
It only knows that it’s even more powerful, undying, with power that reflects across all heavens, spanning numerous dimensions, formidable beyond description.
Therefore, a Star Giant Beast of the Primordial First Heavenly Realm and an entity of the Ninth Heavenly Realm are entirely different concepts, with a gap so huge it’s unimaginable.
Reflecting upon countless worlds across the heavens, traversing dimensions, at this point, the Terminal Emperor Dragon thought of the Deep Red World and the Supreme Hell among these planes.
In addition to that, there were also those three suns above the mythical world that seemed like Giant Beast lifeforms.
Clearly not in the sky, not in the Chaos Void around the mythical world, but the strength they radiated was eternally fixed above the Firmament, fixed beyond the outer realm of those small worlds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1752 - 1752 645 Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon Battle
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1752: Chapter 645 Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon, Battle of Eternity_2 Chapter 1752: Chapter 645 Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon, Battle of Eternity_2 At the moment when the Terminal Emperor Dragon was looking at that information.
Three Void Heaven Divine Dragons, extending over a length of tens of thousands of kilometers, hundreds of thousands of kilometers, and millions of kilometers, resting in the First, Second, and Third Heavenly Realms, set their gaze upon the head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Being watched by three pairs of enormous eyes, the Purple little dragon showed no fear, instead, it blinked its large eyes and greeted them proactively.
Eeya eeya!! Hello big ones, my name is Emma Abbott.
The Purple Glow Divine Dragon slowly spoke, with its enormous dragon mouth opening and closing causing a mountain-shaking and sea-shaking gust of air and humming: “Hello, little one named Emma Abbott.”
“In you, I sense the aura of Purple Exquisite that had fallen into the Vast World during the earlier great battle after being besieged. It seems you have received its Inheritance.”
The Purple little dragon nodded, emitting a childish eeya sound: “Miss Joseline indeed received Aunt Purple Exquisite’s inheritance, its Dragon Ball is deep within Miss Joseline’s own Dragon Ball.”
Boom!
The aura on the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, which stretched for tens of thousands of kilometers, trembled, and with a shake of Heaven and Earth, its planet-like dragon head suddenly dove down, its tone somewhat excited.
“Purple Exquisite’s Dragon Ball still exists! How is it possible, your realm is only in the late-stages of Titan?”
The other two Void Heaven Divine Dragons also trembled in their aura, pupils constricting, sharp and terrifying gazes falling upon the Purple little dragon.
Apparently, they were also somewhat surprised by this news.
Not only surprised that the fallen Purple Exquisite Divine Dragon might have the hope of revival, but also astonished that the Purple little dragon, being only in the late-stage Titan Realm, could actually carry a Dragon Ball of a Primordial Giant Beast.
Even though that Dragon Ball was already broken, it should not be something that a Titan Giant Beast could bear.
The gap between them was like a Transcendent First Layer Unique Beast, harboring a Mythical Giant Beast, under such circumstances, even a wisp of power inadvertently emitted was enough to burst it.
Looking at the little one standing atop the Black-red Colossal Beast, the Purple Glow Divine Dragon slowly roared lowly: “Little one, from where do you come?”
The Purple little dragon blinked its large eyes and extended a Dragon Claw pointing towards the direction of the mythical world.
Eeya eeya!! Miss Joseline comes from the Blue Star World, initially, Miss Joseline was just an egg, hatched through the supplementing life force of my brother.
“Coming from the Vast World, the initial form was a Void Heaven Divine Dragon Dragon Egg, has our clan’s bloodline returned in recent years?”
The three Void Heaven Divine Dragons looked at each other, eyes showing faint confusion.
They originally thought that the Purple little dragon was some Giant Beast possessing Dragon Bloodline, which had undergone Transformation upon receiving the fallen Purple Exquisite Divine Dragon’s inheritance bloodline.
It turned out the opponent’s initial form was a Void Heaven Divine Dragon Dragon Egg, no wonder it could carry Purple Exquisite’s Dragon Ball.
Thinking of this, memories of almost a hundred thousand years surfaced in the brains of the three Void Heaven Divine Dragons, only to find, it seemed that in recent years, no Void Heaven Divine Dragon bloodline had returned to the Vast World.
If no bloodline had returned to the Vast World, where did the Purple little dragon come from?
Suddenly Purple Even Divine Dragon’s eyes showed shock, disbelieving, slightly trembling, a Dragon Roar vibrating Heaven and Earth: “Purple Season, Purple Glow, the Eternal Battle.”
“Besides, the little one in front had once exhaled Origin Dragon Breath to help Abbott regain his lost energy.”
“That power in my perception approached the nature of Creation Origin, or rather it was Creation Origin, just its power was too weak so the purity wasn’t enough.”
Boom boom!!
Two Primordial Overlords, Primordial Emperors’ Divine Dragons body shone with radiant light, illuminating this Chaos Void into a sea of purple, divine light flashing in their purple golden vertical pupils.
Roar! A majestic and profound Dragon Roar echoed through Heaven and Earth, permeating Space-Time, a horrifying Bloodline Power burst forth from the Purple Glow Divine Dragon.
Roar roar roar!!
Across the Chaos Continent, all True Dragons and Void Heaven True Dragon bloodlines were stirred, their blood boiling, instinctively emitting lofty Dragon Roars in response.
With the powerful bloodline power permeating, a suppressed horrifying power within the depths of the Purple little dragon was stirred, its entire body radiating immeasurably dazzling purple light.
Even due to being too dazzling, purple flames formed on the surface of the Purple little dragon’s body.
Boom!
In an instant, the aura of the Purple little dragon surged, and its dragon mane danced wildly under the shroud of a purple flame, even its originally naive eyes turned incomparably cold and majestic.
Roar! Behind the Purple little dragon, a massive boundless shadow of a Void Heaven Divine Dragon emerged from the endless purple sea.
Just as the shadow of this Void Heaven Divine Dragon coalesced, a bloodline pressure that was higher than Monarch level, close to the Heavenly Tier, and at the Pseudo-Heaven Tier level, began to spread.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Three Void Heaven Divine Dragons let out incredibly excited roars, incredulously watching the Divine Dragon Shadow straddling the purple sea, and the bloodline aura emanating from the Purple little dragon.
Watching the three excited Primordial Divine Dragons come to their senses, the Terminal Emperor Dragon looked up with a strange expression in its eyes and gave a soft growl.
“Three lords, is there an issue with Misss Joseline’s bloodline?”
It’s just Pseudo-Heaven Tier, to be this excited?
Huff! The Purple Glow Divine Dragon exhaled deeply, creating a world-destroying hurricane within hundreds of thousands of kilometers, barely suppressing its excited emotions.
But even so, its voice still trembled slightly, “No problem, we just did not expect that Misss Joseline turns out to be a descendant of the Ancestral Dragon from our Xu family.”
Not waiting for the Terminal Emperor Dragon to inquire further, the Purple Glow Divine Dragon continued, “The Ancestral Dragon was the strongest of our clan, just one step away from breaking through to the Primal Seventh Heavens.”
“But it was during that time that the Eternal War erupted, and the Ancestral Dragon perished completely in that battle.”
“Unexpectedly, an offspring of the Ancestral Dragon emerged after more than two hundred thousand years, breaking out of its shell bringing along Purple Exquisite’s Dragon Ball from the Vast World.”
“Perhaps this is destiny, indicating that our clan will not continue to decline.” Continuing, the Purple Glow Divine Dragon’s gaze solemnly fixed on the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
“Little one, no, respected Dragon Palace King, thank you, thank you for bringing back the descendant of the Ancestral Dragon.”
“From today onwards, you are the most honored guest of our clan, your matters are our clan’s matters, feel free to ask for assistance in anything, our clan will unquestionably support you wholeheartedly.”
Saying so, the three Void Heaven Divine Dragons bowed their heads, their three pairs of huge dragon horns touching above the firmament, seemingly performing some kind of oath.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly growled, “You three need not be so polite. I brought Misss Joseline here just because she sensed a familial bloodline call from this direction.”
“I’m also happy for Misss Joseline that she could find her kin.”
Speaking, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s eyes flickered, “Just now, Purple Glow Monarch, you mentioned something about the Eternal War, was it referring to the Vast World?”
“The Vast World and another fearsome eternal being erupted into a great battle?”
Curious about the existence of the mythical world, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, upon encountering a Void Heaven Divine Dragon who seemed to know something, naturally wanted to inquire.
The Purple Glow Divine Dragon nodded, setting off a mountain-sea shaking airstream and booming growl.
“Yes, Dragon Palace King, the Eternal War refers to the great battle between the Eternal Overlord and the Chaotic Nightmare Master, which occurred more than two hundred and seventy thousand years ago.”
“At that time, our realms were only at the True Spirit Level, unqualified to participate in the great battle deep in the Chaos Sea.”
“All we know is that the Ancestral Dragon fell during that battle, a battle with no victors as both sides were gravely injured, and the Eternal Overlord has been in hibernation since then.”
“While entering hibernation, the Eternal Overlord forcibly expelled all Primordial and above Behemoths from the Vast World, instinctively devouring Chaos Qi, devouring other dimensions and space-time worlds surrounding it to recover from his injuries.”
“At the same time, the followers of both eternal existences suffered severe casualties, and out of our nine Great Primordial Divine Dragons, only three returned.”
“And that battle has not truly ended, continuing to this day.”
“While the Eternal Overlord is in hibernation, we, the followers of our race, are still fighting at the edges of Chaos Void against the eight subordinates of the Chaotic Nightmare Master.”
Watching the passionately narrating Purple Glow Divine Dragon, whose eyes are solemn and tone excited, the Terminal Emperor Dragon felt somewhat shocked and exhilarated.
Indeed, the hierarchy of the mythical world is about what they had anticipated, above the Primordial, the legends of Eternity.
Two hundred and seventy thousand (more than eight hundred thousand in Blue Star years) years ago, two Eternal Beasts fought a colossal battle deep in the Chaos Sea, just imagining the scene reveals how astonishing it was.
Eternal Behemoths, one wonders just how powerful they are.
And wondering if there will be an opportunity in the future, to slay one.

chapters.title: Chapter 1753 - 1753 646 Keep Moving Strive to Eat
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1753: Chapter 646: Keep Moving, Strive to Eat Chapter 1753: Chapter 646: Keep Moving, Strive to Eat “Eternity is very powerful, unimaginable even.
After all, just those few suns and moons that revolve around the mythical world can illuminate the heavens, their strength spanning countless worlds and space-times.
But what of it?
As long as its (his) forward march doesn’t stop, the Terminal Emperor Dragon is confident he could step into that realm, and this time wouldn’t be far off.
At this moment, the power of the Dragon Blood surging within the body of the purple little dragon on top of the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s head gradually receded, and the dragon itself withdrew from that majestic, icy state.
The purple little dragon shook its head, its eyes filled with confusion: “Eeyah!! Brother, it seems like some power has been awakened inside me.”
“It’s nothing, just that the bloodline within you has been completely resurrected,” the Terminal Emperor Dragon roared lowly.
The little one hadn’t hatched for over two hundred thousand years, its vitality incomplete and flowing away, leading to some developmental issues, including a very weak Bloodline strength.
If not for the recent period of absorbing the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s life breath for recovery, even the Purple Glow Divine Dragon expending its Origin couldn’t have activated its bloodline power.
Now, the aura of the purple little dragon carried a faint sense of supreme authority, and an ancient, sacred majesty pervaded its body.
And in the perception of the Terminal Emperor Dragon and three Void Heaven Divine Dragons, streaks of almost imperceptible strength appeared out of thin air in the surrounding Void, converging towards the purple little dragon.
These forces came from the Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon that fell over two hundred thousand years ago, whose exact relationship to the purple little dragon, whether maternal or paternal, was unknown.
Even though that Primordial Beast of the sixth Heavenly Realm had completely perished and was annihilated by a more terrifyingly powerful force, the kind that couldn’t be resurrected.
But the rules it once cultivated above the Primordial still existed, those force traces scattered across countless space-times, across countless periods.
Now that the bloodline power of the purple little dragon’s Inheritance has been awakened, those traces are attracted and begin to converge onto it.
This is somewhat similar to the situation with the heart recovery of Number One.
However, that Supreme Power that annihilated the Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon also erased all its soul, will, and all traces of existence.
Therefore, the purple little dragon does not risk the danger of an Ancestral Dragon resurrection and having its soul consciousness occupied.
But at the same time, those force traces are fragmented, missing their most core parts, not only converging slowly, but even if the purple little dragon fully inherits them in the future, it could at most step into the Primordial.
Ignoring the confused purple little dragon, the Terminal Emperor Dragon turned to look at the three Void Heaven Divine Dragons.
“Purple Glow Emperor, you said earlier that during the battle of eternity, the Void Heavenly Dragon Race had three Primordial beings return; where are they…?”
“Purple Proliferation Great Emperor and the others are not here.”
The Purple Glow Divine Dragon slowly roared: “Over two hundred thousand years have passed, our clan has already regained some vitality.”
“Aside from our Expeditionary Army, there are currently six Primordial Divine Dragons in clan territory, including Purple Proliferation Great Emperor and the others.”
“This is still the case after five Primordial beings have fallen during battles with Nightmare Beasts and other Ferocious Beasts over the years, otherwise the overall strength would have already recovered to its peak period.”
“This time we discovered this Chaos Continent at the edge of the Chaos Void and thus, joined forces to prepare to escort it back to be merged into clan territory.”
“It’s just that on the way, we encountered an ambush from a Nightmare Fiend Beast army that had penetrated deeply into the Void, leading to the fall of Purple Exquisite.”
“However, fortunately, its Dragon Ball was brought back by Misss Joseline, and once we return to clan territory, with Purple Proliferation Great Emperor taking action and using the stored Creation Force, resurrection is possible.”
Such is the strength of a Primordial Beast; as long as it has not completely perished, with the help of some Creation treasures, such as sufficient Creation Force, there is hope for resurrection.
Having said this, the Purple Glow Divine Dragon continued to roar lowly, patiently explaining to the Terminal Emperor Dragon and the others.
“The Chaos Continent is actually the fragmented World Core shattered during the battle between the Eternal Overlord and the Chaotic Nightmare Master in the Chaotic Sea back then; it possesses an immensely strong carrying capacity.”
“The King of the Dragon Palace should have felt this as well.”
“Indeed quite special,” the Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded.
This continent is not only vast and immense, but the Earth is solid, and it is even capable of supporting the battles of Primordial Beasts.
”
Purple Glow Divine Dragon growled lowly: “A sufficiently profound and powerful clan territory can allow the descendants of our clan to grow faster, and at the same time increase the hope of breaking through the Primordial.”
“So that’s how it is.” Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded, indicating understanding.
It seems that these Primordial Beasts, on the edge of the Chaos Void, are battling against the Nightmare Fiend Beasts not just for factional reasons but also for interests.
And this interest is not limited to just the Chaos Continent.
Such an approach seemed only natural. As Primordial Creatures, these Giant Beasts have already lived as long as the Heavens themselves, possessing immeasurably extended lives and formidable strength.
Without sufficient interest, why would they risk falling to do battle with Giant Beasts of the same realm or even stronger?
Right at this moment, Terminal Emperor Dragon’s tone shifted: “By the way, Purple Glow Emperor, do you know about the Eternal Golden Divine Clan, the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan, and other peak races of the Vast World?”
“And there’s Crimson Supreme Plane, Hell’s Supreme Plane, Abyss Supreme Plane, and the like.”
Rarely encountering several veteran Primordial beings from old tribes, the Terminal Emperor Dragon naturally wanted to learn more about the situation from beyond the Chaotic Heavens through them.
Unexpectedly, as soon as Terminal Emperor Dragon finished speaking, the three-headed Void Heaven Divine Dragons slightly shook their heads.
Purple Even Divine Dragon growled lowly: “We’ve heard of those two peak races and the Supreme Planes you inquired about, but we don’t have specific knowledge.”
Saying this, a faint pride showed in the eyes of the three-headed Void Heaven Divine Dragons.
“As Primordial Beasts belonging to the lineage of the Eternal Overlord, we are perpetually battling the Eight Divisions of Chaotic Nightmare at the edges of the Chaos Void. We Giant Beasts have no interest in those different races that rose in later eras, and we’ve had no interactions.”
“As for those Supreme Planes, according to what Purple Proliferation Great Emperor said, they are outsiders coveting the power of the Eternal Overlord.”
Alright. Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded slightly.
He didn’t expect these Primordial Beasts and the forces of the Human Divine Domain to have no interaction whatsoever, seemingly belonging to two different ‘systems’.
But as more was learned through communication, Terminal Emperor Dragon’s own doubts grew, such as regarding those Supreme Planes.
However, these few Primordial Beasts seemed not to know very much, spending all day brawling on the edges of the Chaos Void – a bunch of barbarians.
Just as Terminal Emperor Dragon held contempt for the three Void Heaven Divine Dragons in his heart, the colossal Purple Glow Divine Dragon growled lowly: “King of the Dragon Palace, I am preparing to use full strength to pull the Chaos Continent back to its place and would like to invite you to visit our clan territory, may I…?”
With that said, the three Divine Dragons all looked towards the Purple little dragon above Terminal Emperor Dragon’s head.
Terminal Emperor Dragon’s mouth curved slightly, revealing a fierce grin: “No problem, I’m quite curious about the ancient territory of the Void Heavenly Dragon Race, and it will be good to witness it for myself.”
Terminal Emperor Dragon felt this was an opportunity to enter the circle of Primordial Beasts and understand the ‘world’ of the Giant Beasts from beyond the Chaotic Heavens; naturally, he wouldn’t refuse. Besides, it was a good chance to meet that ancient Purple Proliferation Dragon.
Moreover, it seemed that continuing to follow these Void Heaven Divine Dragons could result in another attack by the Nightmare Fiend Beasts.
Such bountiful prey delivered right to his doorstep saved Terminal Emperor Dragon the time of searching for food elsewhere, and perhaps he would be able to quickly breakthrough to the Late Stage of True Spirit, pinnacle, or even Primordial.
“Purple Even, you will be responsible for ‘entertaining’ the esteemed guest. Purple Season and I will join forces to pull the continent.”
Following Purple Glow Divine Dragon’s roar, two Divine Dragons transformed into two heaven-reaching beams of purple light, thunderously plunging into the Chaos Continent and disappearing into the depths of the Earth.
Boom!!
The Chaos Continent trembled, and a terrifying force from deep within the Earth was triggered, transforming into two purple Divine Dragon Shadows, each over ten million kilometers in length on the left side of the continent.
Roar Roar!! Authoritative and deep Dragon Roars reverberated through the Chaos Void, and the Chaos Continent shook mightily as it began to be pulled by the two Primordial Divine Dragons.
And their direction wasn’t towards the Mythical World, which was tens of lightyears away, but somewhere even further from the Mythical World.
Terminal Emperor Dragon didn’t care about this and, after greeting the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, started to Devour the ‘corpse’ of the Primordial Nightmare Beast suppressed under his feet.
In addition to the previously devoured nine True Spirit Level Nightmare Fiend Beasts, Terminal Emperor Dragon felt that this time he should be able to grow about a hundred thousand meters.
There’s no helping it. After breaking through to the mid period of True spirit, each meter of growth required several times more energy than the initial stage, and his current demand for biological energy was like an insatiable abyss.
Eat, eat voraciously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1754 - 1754 647 Double True Name Monarch Heaven
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1754: Chapter 647 Double True Name Monarch, ‘Heaven’ ‘Emperor Chapter 1754: Chapter 647 Double True Name Monarch, ‘Heaven’ ‘Emperor Chaos Continent
While the Terminal Emperor Dragon was communicating with three Void Heaven Divine Dragons, nineteen True Spirit Level Void Heaven True Dragons also gathered from all directions.
As for the previous battle, the number exceeded one hundred thousand, most of which emitted an ancient level aura, the vast True Dragon aura plummeted, and their huge true bodies dispersed into mountain ranges, rivers, forests returning to the Earth.
Suddenly, above the Firmament, tens of thousands of white, black, blue, and other colored True Dragons appeared.
Most of these True Dragons were between one thousand to four thousand kilometers long, radiating Mythical-level breath, a few were over five thousand kilometers with their realms reaching the Titan Level.
As for the ancient-level True Dragons, their bodies were all tens of thousands of kilometers long, with the longest one nearing one hundred thousand kilometers.
In addition, these ancient-level True Dragons in form, were very close to the Void Heaven True Dragons, their originally white, red scale armor gradually turning purple.
Roar Roar!!
The deep and majestic Dragon Roar vibrated Heaven and Earth, and more than an hour later, those Void Heaven True Dragons that were between twenty thousand kilometers and eighty thousand kilometers in length finally arrived.
There was no choice, this continent was too vast, and Heaven and Earth were stable.
However, when the nineteen Void Heaven True Dragons approached, they saw the Purple Even Divine Dragon, which was over ten thousand kilometers long, coiling in ten thousand kilometers high altitude, staring dumbfounded at what was in front.
There, a ferocious behemoth, one thousand nine hundred kilometers long and emitting red light all over, was continuously tearing and chewing the remains of the Primordial Nightmare Beast.
There was no choice, the Primordial Fierce Beast, caught by its legs and ripped in half from the waist, was still over thirty thousand kilometers long.
If the Terminal Emperor Dragon was still in its normal form of three hundred sixty thousand meters (over three hundred kilometers), biting piece by piece, who knows how many years it would take to consume it all.
Even if it didn’t need to worry about digestion, directly swallowing after tearing would still take a long time.
Of course, what amazed Purple Even Divine Dragon was not the natural Gigantification ability of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, but its terrifying growth speed after swallowing.
By now, the Terminal Emperor Dragon had only gnawed a leg of the Nightmare Beast to less than half, and its body had already grown from over one thousand seven hundred kilometers to one thousand nine hundred kilometers.
Excluding the Gigantification bonus, it equated to nearly twenty thousand meters of growth in just a half an hour.
For beast creatures, size represents strength and realm, which means in such a short time, the cultivation level of the Terminal Emperor Dragon had surged remarkably.
Equivalent to the achievements of other True Spirit Beasts hibernating and cultivating for decades, even hundreds or thousands of years.
After all, not all True Spirit Beasts can increase their strength infinitely; after reaching a certain level, the strength of most mythical creatures will stagnate.
This is a limitation brought by talent and life potential.
Whether it’s humans or beasts, geniuses are always few.
Thus, you can imagine how shocked, amazed Purple Even Divine Dragon was, just like the first time it saw this scene, similar to the Silver Giant Dragon, Gold-Blue Giant Dragon.
This terrifying energy transformation and growth speed had already surpassed their understanding.
“This Dragon Palace King, is very terrifying.” Purple Even Divine Dragon’s eyes showed seriousness and a faint awe, revering a beast that was only in the mid-period of True Spirit.
At this moment, those Void Heaven True Dragons flew over, respectfully roaring in the air: “Greetings, Lord Purple Even.”
Then these Void Heaven True Dragons all lifted their heads, looking towards the right claw of Purple Even Divine Dragon, where endless purple mist was gathering in a ten thousand kilometers wide huge Dragon Claw.
In the mist, a six thousand meters long Purple Little Dragon coiled, swallowing Primordial energy converging from all directions, its face with closed eyes showing human-like satisfaction.
The massively sized Void Heaven Divine Dragons whispered softly, a horrific will vibrating in the ears of those Void Heaven True Dragons.
“Quiet down, don’t disturb Lord Emma Abott’s sleep.” Saying this, Purple Even Divine Dragon increased the speed of absorbing the surrounding turbid air currents, transforming them into pure Primordial energy.
Suddenly, even richer purple mist diffused, like rolling clouds submerging the Purple Little Dragon.
Eeeyah! The Purple Little Dragon let out a comfortable, youthful sound.
Although it had grown to the late Titan period, already a massively sized beast, the Purple Little Dragon was only a few months ‘old’, essentially still a baby.
As for the Terminal Emperor Dragon… although Purple Even Divine Dragon could confirm its youthfulness through the aura of life it emitted,
because it couldn’t see the hidden Life Mark Wheel of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, thus Purple Even Divine Dragon didn’t know that this terrifying behemoth in front of him was really only two years old… not even yet.
“Lord Emma Abott!” All those Void Heaven True Dragons all widened their eyes, shocked looking towards the ‘small’ Purple Little Dragon.
Being called Lord by the Primordial Star Level Purple Even Divine Dragon, could this Purple Dragon following that terrifying behemoth be the offspring of their race’s strongest Purple Proliferation Great Emperor?
Just then, that eighty thousand kilometers long Void Heaven True Dragon suddenly stunned, amazedly looking towards the far-off Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon that was feeding.
“Roar! Wait, Dale, did you notice that the size of that behemoth seems to have grown a bit?”
The one called Dale, a seventy thousand meters long Late Stage True Dragon of True Spirit couldn’t believe it: “It’s not just seemed, it really has gotten much larger, wait, it’s even bigger again.”
True Spirit level creatures have terrifying memory.
Although those Void Heaven True Dragons that flew over just casually glanced at Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon, then saluted Purple Even Divine Dragon, they still accurately remembered the overall size of Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
But in just such a few breaths, these two strongest Void Heaven True Dragons shockingly discovered that the red behemoth that was feeding had already grown significantly larger.

chapters.title: Chapter 1755 - 1755 647 Double True Name Monarch Heaven
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1755: Chapter 647 Double True Name Monarch, ‘Heaven’ ‘Emperor’_2 Chapter 1755: Chapter 647 Double True Name Monarch, ‘Heaven’ ‘Emperor’_2 And just in the brief moment they conversed, the Beast’s body grew visibly larger by one segment.
This…
In an instant, all Void Heaven True Dragons were petrified, staring in horror at the Red Beast that grew with each chunk of Ferocious Beast’s flesh it tore off.
At this moment, the thoughts of Purple Even Divine Dragon vibrated around those Void Heaven True Dragons, majestic and profound: “That is the King of the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire, Brock Abbott, the Dragon King.”
“You have also seen that this time, fortunately with its support, otherwise even if we could repel those Nightmare Beast attacks, our losses would be severe.”
“Moreover, this Dragon Palace King brought back Emma Abbott, bringing hope back to our clan.”
“In facing it, all True Dragons must maintain the utmost respect, as you would towards me, towards Purple Glow, understand?”
“Yes, Lord Purple Even.”
All Void Heaven True Dragons respectfully bowed their heads, then continued to watch with shock as the Red Beast grew larger and larger as it fed.
This didn’t seem to concern the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon.
Or rather, as long as other Giant Beasts touched it, it couldn’t hide the fact that its growth was rapid unless it stored food and ate only after everyone dispersed.
But that would be a loss overall.
It was merely that its energy conversion and growth rate were slightly faster; within the world, countless Giant Beasts existed, and there would always be some who awaken against-the-heavens talents.
Or to say, the Beasts reaching the True Spirit Level, each possessed various top-tier talents, with their bloodlines reaching the Emperor-level.
And as for the Primordial Level Giant Beasts, their monstrous talents spoke for themselves, otherwise they couldn’t become a source of rules.
As the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon grew bigger and its strength increasingly formidable.
The Black Warship flying towards the Human Divine Domain had already stopped, massive golden clouds swirling above the ship, exuding a terrifying pressure that overhung a million kilometers.
The emitted Aura of Rules even drew upon tens of millions of kilometers’ Heavenly Energy, roaring and rushing like multicolored long rivers.
This scene somewhat resembled but also differed from the anomaly when the Terminal Emperor Dragon awakened.
At that time, everyone aboard and standing on the square, rooftops, mountain peaks stared upwards at the increasingly magnificent celestial phenomenon.
Within the multi-layered clouds thickening over tens of thousands of kilometers, dense golden-white lightning flickered, converging, forming an obscure figure with ten arms on three sides.
Just as this phantom appeared, a heavy, overwhelming power descended.
Boom! In an instant, a range of tens of millions of kilometers trembled, the air exploded, forming rings of Mountains and Seas shaking white currents dispersing in all directions.
Within this range, all Giant Beasts, different races, special life forms, including everyone on the warship felt a deep surge.
Those with strength lower than the Legendary Realm instinctively knelt down, while those above the Mythical level slightly bent as if welcoming the birth of some grand being.
“So fast, just half a month and he has completed his True Body’s dissolution, transforming into rules merging into Heaven and Earth, recognized by Heaven and Earth to reconverge into a Divine Emperor Body.”
The Primordial True King and True Martial King stood at the Great Hall rooftop, holding their breath, watching the increasingly clear figure in the sky nervously, yet excitedly.
Soon, the Human Federation would birth its first Civilization Emperor.
Next, as long as Jack Clark successfully consolidates his true name, he will fully step into the True Spirit Level.
But at this moment, the thick tens of thousands of kilometers golden-white clouds trembled, faint black chaotic clouds gathered above the clouds, obscuring heaven and earth.
Instantly, a cold aura carrying the majestic power of Opening the Heavens permeated between heaven and earth.
Within the rolling chaotic clouds, an obscure figure with ten arms on three sides also condensed, instantly the oppressive power in heaven and earth sky-rocketed.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Mountain ranges collapsed, oceans roared, and rivers flowed backward.
All life under the exploding heavenly pressure crashed to the ground, immobile, including those at the Mythical level and Heavenly King level powerhouses who all knelt on one knee.
In this moment, aside from the Ancient Powerhouses like the True Martial King, no one else had the qualifications to stand.
And at this time, not only the True Martial King and others were stunned, including Jack Clark whose True Spirit True Body was reconstructing and consciousness delving into the deep origin of the mythical world, was somewhat astonished.
In his perception, two tightly linked ‘powers’ were condensing here.
Jack Clark was familiar with this sensation; he had experienced it before during the advancement of the Destruction Emperor Dragon bloodline, becoming a Heavenly Tier Colossus, the process of True Spirit condensation.
But why were there two true names?
As Jack Clark was somewhat puzzled, his two strands of Soul Source and Rule Origin merged, gradually forming two ancient characters ‘Heaven’ and ‘Emperor’ deep within the mythical world.
With ‘Heaven’ outside and ‘Emperor’ within the depths of ‘Heaven’.
Just as the two overlapping true names formed, Jack Clark’s consciousness thundered, infinite Rule Mysteries rushing forth, instantly submerging his consciousness.
At the same time, above the Firmament, the murky dark clouds ten thousand kilometers high in his vague True Body fiercely lunged, merging with the golden-white figure condensed by Supreme Power Rules below.
Boom!
A dazzling brilliance revealed a figure with ten arms on three sides, ten thousand kilometers tall, wearing a black All-Heaven Emperor Crown and a luxurious Imperial Robe with black and golden edges.
Underneath him, a transparent long river meandered, disappearing into the Void.
Just then, heaven and earth hummed, and in the Void, a clear, insightful Rule Chant resonated, densely packed heavenly traces vividly emerged before everyone’s eyes.
At the same time, influenced by an Invisible Power, Heavenly Power from a range of tens of millions of kilometers converged forming numerous Golden Lotuses floating down, the scene majestically Divine.
Simultaneously, endless green light spread on the ground, boundless like an ocean engulfing the Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1756 - 1756 647 Double True Name Sovereigns Heaven
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1756: Chapter 647 Double True Name Sovereigns, ‘Heaven’ ‘Emperor’_3 Chapter 1756: Chapter 647 Double True Name Sovereigns, ‘Heaven’ ‘Emperor’_3 Golden lotuses descended from the sky, and blue light surged from the earth, bolstering Jack Clark at this moment as if he was walking through time, arriving from the past as a Supreme Heavenly Emperor, incomparably majestic, sacred.
“Wow, so strong!”
Looking at the bright figure standing firm above the Firmament, everyone in the black battlefield space was shocked and lost in awe.
At that moment, everyone’s minds thundered, and an invisible force scattered, instantly restoring all memories of Jack Clark’s past.
In an instant, Justin Welan, who was prostrate on the ground, widened his eyes: “Damn, damn, Jack is freaking awesome.”
Crystal Lewis, her sister Mandy Lewis, and Mathilda Ward were also stunned into silence, their eyes wide.
Under the terrifying celestial phenomenon of Jack Clark’s breakthrough, almost comparable to the Primordial, as well as the impact of the World’s Power from the mythical world, the seals on these people’s memories about Jack Clark shattered completely.
Damon Lopes, oppressed by the immense pressure to the ground, also trembled: “True Spirit Emperor, Brother Callum, no, the Divine Martial Emperor has made a breakthrough to become a Civilization Emperor.”
Suddenly, Damon Lopes widened his eyes and shouted: “Congratulations to His Majesty the Divine Martial Emperor on his ascension, his heavenly might vast and coexisting with the world.”
With Damon Lopes taking the lead, the elite members of the Human Race present also came to their senses, shouting in unison, filled with excitement.
“Congratulations to His Majesty the Divine Martial Emperor on his ascension, his heavenly might vast and coexisting with the world.”
Amidst the mountainous and oceanic roars, the Immortal Spirit Alien Race and the Heavenly Feather Clan respectfully shouted.
“Congratulations to His Majesty the Divine Martial Emperor on becoming the Ancient God (Immortal Emperor), his glory shining through eternity, undying forever…”
Amidst the numerous congratulatory shouts below, Jack Clark’s consciousness slowly returned, his eyes shining with a golden-white Divine Light, his gaze cold and dignified.
Ignoring the congratulations below, Jack Clark’s attention was on the faintly discernible true name in the depths of his soul, linked by a faint connection.
“Heaven, Emperor.”
Jack Clark was unsurprised that his true name was ‘Heaven’; he had previously concealed his name by condensing ‘Heaven’ with Divine Power. While it had been a false true name then, it still represented some sort of affinity.
But deep within the word ‘Heaven’, the true name of ‘Emperor’ took Jack Clark by surprise because he had never heard of anyone who could condense two true names simultaneously.
Adding the ‘Vast’ that belonged to the Terminal Emperor Dragon, he now had three true names.
Together they would be Vast Heaven. Emperor, or Vast Heaven. Emperor King?
“Is it because of the Supreme Rules of Primordial Genesis, or because of my Soul Split, or do all of these contribute?” Jack Clark pondered, his heart firmly validating the notion.
Just as nobody at the True Spirit breakthrough could condense and fuse two Superior Divine Powers.
Due to various coincidences, his breakthrough this time allowed the additional condensation of two true names. The advantage of dual true names made him more seamlessly integrated with the mythical world, the Heaven and Earth, and the Origin.
He received treatment akin to that of a Giant Beast.
In deep thought, Jack Clark summoned the attribute page with a mere thought.
This breakthrough was not just about embodying rules. All his Divine Powers, including the Attribute page, one of his Innate Soul Talents, underwent a promotion and sublimation.
Realm: True Spirit Initial Stage [Tier 13, a Civilization Emperor with the double true names ‘Heaven’ and ‘Emperor’]
Origin. Physique: 542→956 [1 point equals the strength of an Innate Demon God True Body at the same realm, base strength, base recovery, rule power capacity]
Origin. Soul: 462→851 [1 point equals the soul of an Innate Demon God at the same realm]
Primordial. True Demon God Body: [Growth body, a Primordial life from the beginning of Earth, a Demon God rule true body cast with dual Supreme Rules, perfectly integrating with Heaven and Earth.
Top-tier Divine Power: Vacuum Destruction, Absolute Force Field, Cross-World Divine Walk, Hidden Deity Heavenly Eye, Peeping Void True Eye
Demon God True Seal: World-Destroying Great Sun, Thunder God’s Light Spear, Death Grindstone, Soul Lock
Original. Tenfold Heavenly Gate [With the power of the whole world, this super talent breaks through and condenses established rules.
When breaking through the Dark Star Domain and incorporating the power of the World Annihilation Heavenly Dragon into his body, his true body’s base strength and defense are augmented by 814 times, possessing the absolute power to suppress all.
Note: This form consumes too much energy, unable to sustain, use with caution.
Hint: As an entity with a Primordial essence, when the Cultivation reaches the Pinnacle of True Spirit, the True Body will directly draw upon Primordial Air and transform into a Primordial Body.]
Deification Talent: Soul Split [Deification: 1/2] Void Death Pupil [The highest emperor pupil wielding the power of the Void]
Cultivation Methods: Illusion Meditation Scripture [8th layer 88%]
Secret Skill: Space-Time Summoning Mark [+ Enhanced Innate Space Rune]
Superior Divine Power: Time Reincarnation [+1 (Special stripping state)]
Special traces: Ancient Duel Mark, Hell’s Eye [Contains Seed of Hell of the Supreme, can consume the Plane Origin to evolve into a layer of Supreme Hell]
Weapon: Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd [Pseudo-Creation Level, wrapped with Opening the Heavens sharp force, within it seals an exceptional Divine Weapon from a world containing the power of Destruction.
Opening Edge: Chaos divided beneath the halberd blade, re-enacting Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder
Great Destruction: Draws upon the World’s Power fused with the War Halberd, invoking the power of Great Destruction that destroyed countless planes and worlds.]
Despair Demon God Armor [Pseudo-Creation Level, based on Emperor Dragon Scale Armor, forged by the Mysterious Yellow power of Heaven and Earth, and the despair of endless living beings.
Despair Protection: As the ‘person’ who slayed Cotaselle (Giant Beast), receives the protection of all blood-sacrificed beings in the Kloey World.
Despair Convergence: Absorbs all despair power such as death aura, wrath, and other negative emotions released by enemies after they are slain, transforming it into defense.
Despair Power: 10890, every ten thousand units can negate a ‘conceptual force’ damage inflicted by the full-force strike of a Primordial Stars level strong man.
Note: Despair Power can accumulate indefinitely, stacking with the defense power of the Absolute Defense Divine Power]
Attribute points: 26824897
Origin Points: 0 [Special energy transformed from World Origin, can be used as Creation Force and Primordial Air, including Giant Beast Body enhancement]
Avatar Body: Terminal Emperor Dragon
Level: True Spirit Mid Period [Current body length of 427,000 meters, a nascent giant beast of the heavens]
Bloodline: Heavenly Tier Emperor Dragon…

chapters.title: Chapter 1757 - 1757 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1757: Chapter 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens. Darren Callum, Eternity Great World Chapter 1757: Chapter 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens. Darren Callum, Eternity Great World The golden-white clouds that eclipse the sun whirl, with the center of the vortex reaching tens of thousands of kilometers high, where a figure with three faces and ten arms stands tall, stepping on the flow of time, his divine might vast and imposing.
Of course, Jack Clark’s true spirit in its real form isn’t that enormous. His current appearance is merely a projection of ‘expanded’ power right after his breakthrough.
Looking at the vanished transparent page, at this moment, Jack Clark felt incomparably powerful, and this time it was not an illusion.
With the breakthrough to True Spirit, the two Supreme Rules merged into heaven and earth, he could, with a mere thought, forcefully modify the rules of operation of this world, reversing the universe.
At this moment, Jack Clark slightly lowered his head, overlooking below, and then the world shook: “Everyone, no need for formalities.”
His deep and mighty voice echoed between heaven and earth like the roar of divine thunder, containing an undeniable and irresistible power, like the decrees of a Heavenly Monarch.
Instantly, everyone felt lighter and, as if by agreement, stood up from the ground.
On the square, Justin Welan’s legs trembled involuntarily. Looking up at the colossal star-like stalwart figure in the sky, he couldn’t utter the words ‘Damn, Jack is so fierce’ in his heart.
Including the sisters Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis, as they watched the time and space distort around the shining figure above, unavoidably feeling awe.
They knew very well that this former classmate was no longer on the same level, or even in the same world as them.
Just as countless people looked up, Jack Clark above the firmament slightly furrowed his brows: “The mythical world is rejecting me.”
Like the Terminal Emperor Dragon, as Jack Clark broke through to True Spirit, he clearly sensed a force of rejection from heaven and earth, from the entire mythical world.
But unlike the boundlessly huge Terminal Emperor Dragon, walking the path of Rules, his reality ‘smaller’ by nature, Jack Clark felt he could still suppress it for a while.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s enormous body suddenly collapsed and condensed, emitting an immensely brilliant golden-white light, like a fourth golden-white great sun appearing between heaven and earth.
Due to the dazzling brilliance, even the likes of True Martial Heavenly King had to close their eyes and dared not look directly.
At the same time, the golden clouds covering a million kilometers, the sky-full of falling golden lotuses, and the green light emitting from the ground among other phenomena, also dissipated in that dazzling light.
When everything vanished, above the firmament stood only a black-haired young man with his hair tied in a high crown, his gaze indifferent and dignified.
On Jack Clark, the Despair Demon God Armor transformed into a suit resembling both armor and a robe, with a base of black, double shoulders and waist covered by golden scale armor, and a luxurious garment marked with golden-white cloud patterns on the left chest.
At the same time, his body surface covered with a domain formed by twisting space centered on Supreme Rules, resembling an independent Heaven and Earth, concealing all aura and strength.
Instantly the rejection from all directions from the mythical world weakened.
As long as Jack Clark did not burst out with all his strength, not exceeding the original boundaries, he could still remain in the mythical world.
Only at this time did Jack Clark lightly exhale, the space around him twisted, and his figure silently appeared in front of True Martial Heavenly King and others.
But before anyone could speak, a light-hearted voice resounded in the void: “Congratulations Brother Clark, on breaking through to Monarch.”
As she spoke, the space in front broke apart, Sherry Williams dressed in a gorgeous long dress, her body wrapped in a powerful aura, walked out from the dark cracks, a faint smile on her beautiful face, her gaze fixed on Jack Clark.
Sensing the mid-period True Spirit pressure emanating from Sherry Williams, Jack Clark also revealed a smile, “Congratulations Sherry, your cultivation has advanced another step.”
As he spoke, Golden Winged Divine King Tolstoy, nine Heavenly Feather Main Gods, and over twenty deities appeared, all bowing to congratulate him.
“Congratulations to the Divine Martial King for stepping into the realm of Ancient Gods, henceforth equal to Heaven, immortal throughout the ages.”
Without waiting for Jack Clark to speak, Wind Heaven, Sean Immortal King, and many other Immortal Monarchs and Immortal Generals appeared, each performing a salute: “We’ve seen Divine Martial Emperor, his Divine Might vast, illuminating the world.”
Seeing this, Primordial True King and others also laughed heartily, dozens of Heavenly Kings, king-level beings, including Damon Lopes, once again bowed.
“Congratulations to our clan’s Divine Martial ascending to Emperor, may his martial fortune thrive, with eternity within reach.”
This scene resembled a true Heavenly Monarch’s arrival, deities paying their respects, watching from below those cultivators, including Eddy Keller and others, all feeling surging emotions, deeply stirred.
Jack Clark shook his head: “I already said, no need for so many formalities.”
But just at that moment, Jack Clark’s gaze shifted.
In his perception, the Hell Roulette placed in the Storage Space was slightly vibrating, emitting a faint blood light, a force from a distant spacetime calling.
Alvaron, what does it want from me?
A trace of confusion flickered through Jack Clark’s eyes.
The mythical world not only rejects native life at or above the Primordial level, the powers from Supreme Planes that span countless times and dimensions are also suppressed.
While it’s nothing big to pull through a Plane force projection, a powerful Lord of Hell like Alvaron would have its will projection instantly shattered.
And that shattering seems to also harm Alvaron, which is why it gave Jack Clark this Hell Roulette.
This artifact is not only a coordinate for participating in the Plane Battlefield, an entry ticket, but also a communicator, allowing Alvaron to contact Jack Clark more easily.
Pondering, Jack Clark with a thought released the restrictions on the Hell Roulette.
Instantly, from the depths of the Hell Roulette, came the voice of Alvaron’s will: “Hegemon Darren, I sense a change in the nature of the power you have assimilated into the Roulette, have you broken through to the thirteenth level!?”
Alvaron’s voice held a light astonishment.
After all, it had just met Jack Clark a while ago, at that time Jack Clark’s realm was only at the Peak of the Ancient, still a long road from True Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 1758 - 1758 648 The Evil God from Beyond the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1758: Chapter 648: The Evil God from Beyond the Heavens, Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_2 Chapter 1758: Chapter 648: The Evil God from Beyond the Heavens, Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_2 Jack Clark said indifferently, “Indeed, Lord of Alvaron, I have broken through to the thirteenth tier.”
“…As befitting a genius who caught the attention of the highest will of the Hell Plane back when he was only at the tenth tier,” Alvaron’s voice carried a hint of astonishment, which then shifted in tone.
“The fifth layer of Hell under my dominion is about to open a Plane Battlefield against a Great Thousand World deep within the Endless Sea.”
“That Great Thousand World has also caught the attention of the Abyss Plane, and there might be a double battlefield opening up. How about it, are you interested in coming to watch the battle?”
“Plane Wars.” Jack Clark narrowed his eyes.
Originally, Jack Clark’s plan was to make contact with the Sparkling Heaven True Emperor, an ancient civilization’s strong man, in the Divine Realm, and then consider the issue of the Plane Battlefield.
However, now with the breakthrough to True Spirit, and a peak combat power comparable to Primordial Stars, Jack Clark no longer had as many reservations about the Plane Battlefield as before.
“Lord of Alvaron inviting me personally is a great honor. Once I have arranged some trivial matters here, I will draw upon the Power of Hell to come over.”
“As for the interdimensional Plane Battlefield, I am also somewhat curious.” After only a brief pondering, Jack Clark made his decision.
“No rush, I also need a bit more time to erode the World Crystal Wall of that world. At that time, I will also introduce you to Hell’s Messengers from other times and powerful worlds.”
Alvaron’s voice was filled with satisfaction, pleased that Jack Clark had agreed to participate in the Plane War.
Their telepathic conversation occurred in an instant, not even noticed by Sherry Williams, that in such a split second, Jack Clark had already communicated with a Lord of Hell.
Drawing back his mind, Jack Clark glanced at the strong men surrounding him, then turned to Sherry Williams: “Sherry, how long until we reach the Flame Wheel Divine Domain?”
Sherry Williams thought for a moment, “According to Blue Star’s time measurement, it should be about ten days or so.”
“If Brother Clark wishes to arrive sooner, I could infuse the Warship with True Spirit Origin to enter subspace jumps, which should take about four days.”
Jack Clark shook his head, “No need to go through so much trouble. Ten days is just right for closed-door cultivation to consolidate my realm.”
Saying so, Jack Clark turned to the Primordial True King and the others.
Before Jack Clark could speak, the Primordial True King smiled, “Go ahead, your cultivation is more important, Jack Clark. We will take care of the expedition team.”
“Thanks to all the Seniors.” Jack Clark smiled and then directly warped space, vanishing in an instant.
As his cultivation level became higher and higher, Jack Clark acted more detached from the mundane world. For instance, he had not walked anywhere on foot for a long time, always moving instantly to his destinations.
And drawing upon the Power of Hell to go to the Plane Battlefield was different from the time-suspended arrival at the Ancient Dueling Arena, as time would flow normally in both places.
With Jack Clark’s current status, his sudden disappearance would certainly cause unrest, hence the need to find an excuse of closed-door cultivation to consolidate his realm.
Still on the mountain peak in the midst of the warship’s Earth, within the pitch-black space torn apart by Rule, the Hell Roulette floated slowly.
In front of the Roulette, which had expanded to a hundred meters in diameter, the blood-red Hell’s Eye in Jack Clark’s glabella slowly opened, full of endless bloody strength, and a towering Sea of Blood.
Jack Clark stretched out his right hand and slowly pressed it onto the Hell Roulette, as brilliant blood light surged from the Hell’s Eye in his forehead.
Boom! An endless stream of blood light poured from the Hell’s Eye into the Roulette, causing it to shake violently.
With the Power of Hell infused, the dense, somewhat sinister, red runes on the surface of the Roulette lit up one by one, even breaking away and flying out.
These twisted blood-colored runes rotated in the ink-black Void, converging, and gradually formed a monstrous and ferocious Hell Devil’s head, its huge mouth wide open, devouring Jack Clark in a gulp.
Boom!
Blood light burst forth, Space-Time collapsed, and both Jack Clark and the Hell Devil’s head vanished into thin air, leaving only the dimly lit Hell Roulette floating in the Void.
The Hell Roulette was not only the coordinate for descending, but also Jack Clark’s coordinate for returning.
Otherwise, once he left, as a being comparable to the Primordial, it would be very troublesome for Jack Clark to return to the mythical world, to this point in time.
…
The sky was dim, and the Earth was blood-red.
The scorching red Lava Rivers flowed on the Earth like blood vessels, emitting intense heat that burned everything, turning this world into Hell, or to say, this was Hell.
Towering crimson palaces thousands of kilometers high stood on the Earth, surrounded by clouds of blackness that spread over a million kilometers, with countless monsters bearing double wings circling within, emitting piercing hisses.
In front of the palace, supported by giant skeletons, thousands of massive Hell Devils made of white bone stood on the magma flames-burning square.
These Hell Devils varied in size, with the smallest one also being a hundred meters high, exuding a ferocity and pressure comparable to Myth, with blood trickling down, eerie and terrifying.
Inside the crimson Hell Demon Palace, twenty-nine White Bone Thrones, each reaching ten thousand meters tall, stood upright.
At this moment, thirteen figures, each emanating True Spirit Level pressure, sat on these White Bone Thrones, their appearances varied, some as tall as several thousand meters, and some only a few hundred.
Just then, in front of one of the White Bone Thrones on the left side, Space-Time twisted, and a red light point appeared out of nowhere.
Boom! Blood light expanded, and in an instant, an aura filled with endless slaughter and brutal ruthlessness spread out, painting the Great Hall as if it were a Doomsday Blood Sea Hell.
A figure shrouded in crimson light slowly emerged from within the Blood Sea Hell.
At this moment, Jack Clark, dressed in blood-red armor robes, with blood-like long hair and a handsome, perfect face covered in red scales, was in the form of the Hell Demon God, one of the three facets.
As soon as Jack Clark descended, Space-Time beneath the White Bone Throne collapsed and twisted, automatically shrinking to match his figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1759 - 1759 648 The Evil God from Beyond the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1759: Chapter 648: The Evil God from Beyond the Heavens, Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_3 Chapter 1759: Chapter 648: The Evil God from Beyond the Heavens, Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_3 But in the eyes of those Hell Messengers around, and the Hell Devils below, the White Bone Throne still appeared as immense as ten thousand meters, bathed in red light that rendered it incomparably majestic and Overbearing.
Looking at Jack Clark, who crossed Space-Time for his descent, all those Hell Messengers turned their gaze, their eyes revealing indifference, curiosity, and iciness, among other expressions.
Relative to the colossal figures of these Hell Messengers, Jack Clark, with an ordinary stature of just one meter ninety, was like an ant.
But these Hell Messengers dared not underestimate Jack Clark; none who participated in the Plane Battlefield were weak, for the weak had long turned to white bones.
And while those Hell Messengers sized up Jack Clark, he likewise scrutinized them with a cold gaze.
In his perception, even the weakest of these Hell Messengers exuded an Aura of the True Spirit Level, and their bodies concealed mysterious and powerful strength.
Clearly, these apostles were stronger than what their realm appeared to be; whether they could cross one minor Boundary or two could only be known upon taking action.
Among them was an apostle with a figure as slender as deadwood, covered entirely in a long black robe, from whom Jack Clark even sensed a faint aura of danger.
Pinnacle of True Spirit, or half a step into Primordial? Jack Clark narrowed his eyes slightly.
Because the power systems of these Hell Messengers were all different, although Jack Clark could sense they were all of True Spirit Level, he could not accurately determine their realm with their Aura concealed.
At this moment, from beneath the long robe congealed by black smoke, a chilling voice emerged, like countless creepings of reptiles, with a Terrifying Will resonating.
“This unfamiliar World Lord, looking at us like that, isn’t it a bit impolite?”
Feeling the faint hostility emanating from the other party, Jack Clark withdrew his gaze, and his voice emerged faintly: “Sorry, I just felt that you are the strongest here, so I took an extra look.”
The words of Jack Clark caused the Hell Messengers present to shift their gaze slightly, a hint of gravity flashing through their eyes.
Including the figure shrouded in black smoke, who only snorted coldly, took a deep look at Jack Clark, and said no more.
Each of the ‘people’ who made it here had cultivated for long years; without ascertaining the other’s background, they naturally wouldn’t make enemies casually.
At this moment to the left of Jack Clark stood a True Body towering over five thousand meters, resembling a gray Mountain Giant with three pairs of huge eyes on his face, who spoke with a sonorous voice.
“Impressive, you could discern that Insect Demon is the strongest; your strength must not be weak either.”
“Greetings, new World Lord, I am one of the three World Lords of the Heavy Mountain Plane, Boroedo.”
With the other being so polite, Jack Clark, as a well-mannered young man, naturally wouldn’t be rude; he nodded slowly, his voice filled with Will vibrating: “Hello, Lord Boroedo, I hail from…”
Just as he was about to name his world, Jack Clark suddenly paused.
The mythical world, Vast World were the terms by the Human Federation, Ancient Civilization, and Giant Beast for the mythical world, but no one knew its actual name.
But just then, a name spontaneously emerged in Jack Clark’s heart.
“…I hail from the Vinaglifis World, Darren Callum, one of the Speakers of the Sacred Alliance.”
As he finished speaking, Jack Clark paused slightly. Griffith, was it the name of the mythical world, or was it the name of that Hibernating Eternal Behemoth?
While Jack Clark pondered, five of the Hell Messengers present, including Boroedo and the figure shrouded in black smoke, all voiced their shock.
“Griffith, that legendary Greatest Era of the Eternal Supreme World!!”
“What? The Eternal Supreme Greatest Era!” Due to overwhelming astonishment and shock, the Aura of the dozens of Hell Messengers Burst.
Boom boom boom!!
Instantly, streams of strong and mysterious forces vibrated Space-Time, permeating inside the Crimson Demon Palace, making the Hell Devils outside weighed down by the intertwined Rule Pressure.
The reaction of these Hell Messengers was somewhat unexpected for Jack Clark.
It seemed the mythical world was quite famous in other Planes and Space-Times?
Jack Clark turned his head to look at the Hell Messenger resembling a Mountain Giant: “What, Lord Boroedo, have you all heard of my world?”
Whoosh!
The Mountain Giant exhaled deeply, forming dozens of Tornadoes in the Demon Palace, while his three pairs of narrow and cold eyes still revealed a trace of shock.
“Of course, we’ve heard of it; that is the Eternal World known in many strong worlds and powerful Planes.”
“Legends say that hundreds of thousands of years ago, the Griffith Eternal World waged war with another powerful Eternal Supreme World, shattering endless Chaos.”
“It’s just that, although I heard the legends of the Eternal World over ten thousand years ago, I have never seen or encountered a strong man from the Griffith Eternal World.”
“I never thought that in the Crimson Hell, controlled by Lord Alvaron, there would actually be an apostle from the Eternal World.”
