As he spoke, the Mountain Giant’s eyes flickered, continuously observing Jack Clark engulfed in Blood Red Lightning, as if trying to discern something different about him.
The other Hell Messengers similarly looked at Jack Clark with various gleams in their eyes, some even displaying intense greed.
Seeking death. Jack Clark glanced at a few of the messengers whose gaze held malice.
These apostles had let their guard down and their Aura leaked just now, allowing Jack Clark to confirm their realms; all were at least mid period of True Spirit.
The strongest was the apostle known as Insect Demon, half a step into Primordial.
Coupled with the possession of unknown mysterious powers, it was no wonder that even Jack Clark could sense a faint danger.
Boom!
A series of Blood Red Lightnings Burst from Jack Clark’s body, an instant unleashed a dreadfully Overbearing and soul-shaking Terrifying Aura, shattering all gazes fixed upon him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1760 - 1760 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 1760: Chapter 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens: Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_4 Chapter 1760: Chapter 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens: Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_4 Bang, bang, bang!!
Thirteen Hell Messengers’ aura shook, causing intense pain in their Divine Souls; all of them suddenly closed their eyes.
The Mountain Giant shook its head and then opened its eyes, its voice buzzing, “Apologies, Councilor Darren Callum, I was overly shocked that you come from the Eternal World, and meant no offense.”
Jack Clark’s gaze coldly swept over all the Hell Messengers, then he lightly said, “It’s alright.”
Despite saying so, none of the messengers dared to continue staring at Jack Clark, including those whose gazes bore ill intentions; they all reigned in their aura.
At that moment, the massive Mountain Giant leaned in slightly, its voice buzzing deeply, “Councilor Darren Callum, is this your first time participating in a Plane War?”
“Indeed,” Jack Clark nodded faintly, there was no need to conceal this.
The Mountain Giant’s huge face showed a smile, “I have participated in nineteen Plane Wars, two of which were led by the great Lord of Hell, Alvaron.”
Hearing this, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised, “Doesn’t the Lord of Hell participate in every war?”
“Of course not.”
The Mountain Giant shook its head, its deep voice explaining, “Normally, we roam in the depths of Space-Time or locate based on some world items we acquire.”
“When discovering a new and foreign Plane, we lead our subordinates to invade.”
“If that Plane or world is strong, we will team up with several known Hell Messengers to invade together, plunder everything, and drag that plane into the Supreme Hell.”
“Only when a plane or world with Primordial Living Beings is discovered does the great Lord of Hell personally take action.”
At this point, the Mountain Giant showed a strong wariness in its eyes.
“Such formidable and terrifying life forms are beyond what we messengers can shake, and with the Plane Rules suppressing, once we enter, we would be suppressed.”
“For instance, this target, the Rabio World, hosts a Primordial Level Life, which is extremely dangerous.”
“When it opens, Councilor, you mustn’t rush to enter first, otherwise, it’s easy to become the first suppression target of that Primordial Life.”
“Thanks for the reminder.” Jack Clark slowly nodded.
Subsequently, the ‘enthusiastic’ Mountain Giant spoke softly with Jack Clark, detailing him about its past experiences when invading planes.
Like sending its extended strength subordinates first, drawing in the Power of Hell to erode and suppress the Plane’s Heavenly Earth Rules.
How to Devour those foreign world living beings, foreign world deities, refine their life Blood Qi to strengthen oneself, how to tear those Planes apart, even dragging the entire world into Hell.
These actions were entirely those of a vicious Evil God.
Or to say, to those living beings in the invaded Planes, these Hell Messengers, including the Hell Lord Alvaron, were foreign Evil Gods.
World-destroying Evil Gods.
To this point, Jack Clark was indifferent because this was the Rule of the Endless World.
An even colder and crueler forest law.
Including the Human Federation, ancient Human Race civilization as well, if strength is insufficient, one will be eradicated by other civilizations and races, otherwise, they would occupy more resources and a broader territory.
However, unlike the Purgatory Demon Race that demonizes and slaughters everything and those different races that enslave weaker civilizations, Human Race’s methods are a bit softer, allowing some non-threatening races to join the alliance.
After finishing the discussion about things to be cautious of during the invasion of a Plane, the Mountain Giant introduced some of the Hell Messengers present to Jack Clark.
Like a certain Insect Demon Apostle, from the Black Flame Insect Realm Grand World, whose strength and realm were the strongest present, having cultivated for over a million years.
As for what strengths and talents it excelled in, the Mountain Giant wasn’t sure, as this was also only their second time invading a Plane together.
It only knew that during Plane invasions, the Apostle could unleash a swarm of black insects that are indestructible, possessing devoring rules, devouring all strength, and overwhelming everything.
Furthermore, another Apostle, named Mpolak, towering over two hundred meters, entirely covered in black scale armor, was also terrifying.
The Mountain Giant never teamed up with this Hell Messenger in Plane Battles before, but it heard about it from an acquaintance.
The opponent was from the Shadow Illusion World, an intangible material, non-existent in the real world, controlling all shadows including the enemy’s shadows projected on the ground.
It also seemed to possess a power similar to reversing causality.
That Apostle once saw on a Plane Battlefield, how Mpolak’s enemy tore its own shadow into two halves on the ground, causing the true body of that enemy to split in half as well.
Eerie, powerful, undefendable.
Next was an Apostle crouching on the White Bone Throne, its head resembling a demon, its body covered in black hair that moved like tentacles, while its torso was that of a giant bird…
When the Mountain Giant had finished, Jack Clark already had a general understanding of the other eight Hell Messengers.
As for the remaining five, Boroedo, the Mountain Giant didn’t know much about them, only aware they came from other Planes and Great Thousand Worlds.
Of course, although the Mountain Giant was enthusiastic, Jack Clark did not lower his guard.
There were no rules among the Hell Messengers forbidding killing each other, and many times, they were also enemies, competitors.
As for the revealed fact of coming from the Eternal World, Jack Clark didn’t care, as a bunch of True Spirit Level Messengers even if combined, Jack Clark was confident in suppressing.
And as for Alvaron, the Lord of Hell, there’s even less to worry about.
Hell Messengers could fight among themselves, but as one of the Will of the Hell Plane, the Lord of Hell must adhere to some fundamental rules.
Those are powers that cannot be defied.

chapters.title: Chapter 1761: 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens: Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 1761: Chapter 648 Evil God from Beyond the Heavens: Darren Callum, Eternity Great World_5
During this one-sided exchange, Jack Clark obtained quite a bit of useful information.
Aside from matters needing attention regarding the invasion of Planes, information on how to plunder the World Origin, there were also differences between the mythical world and the ‘Outer World’.
Like time.
In the words of the Purple Glow Divine Dragon, the battle of the two Eternities occurred more than two hundred thousand years ago, which is equivalent to about eight hundred thousand years in the Blue Star World.
Meanwhile, in the legends of plane beings like the Mountain Giant Boroedo, the two legendary Eternal Worlds have been at war for millions of years.
Clearly, there is a greater distortion of time.
There is also the Primordial Level, which seems to belong to very powerful beings in the endless planes; ancient and daunting to countless Living Beings of the planes.
Furthermore, there are likely many differences between the life of the mythical world and those of other space-time dimensional planes, which could be observed more when time allows.
Just as Jack Clark was thoughtfully pondering, the Crimson Demon Palace suddenly shook violently.
In the depths of the Demon Palace, blood-like blood light flowed, spread out, revealing a Blood Crown Throne standing tall amidst the twisted depths of space-time.
Atop the throne stood a figure with a True Body ten thousand kilometers tall, enveloped in a red robe, with a fierce crown on its head.
The moment that figure appeared, an Aura filled with horror and despair spread across billions of Living Beings, coupled with the terrifying Primordial pressure.
Boom boom boom!!
The entire Hell Plane shook, dark clouds spun, and magma roared.
On the square of the Hell Demon Palace, thousands of Hell Devils knelt and said, “We welcome the Great Crimson Lord of Hell.”
At the same time, all Hell Messengers stood up and bowed in deference, “We’ve seen the Great Overlord Alvaron.”
From beneath the blood-red robe, a horrifying gaze emerged and slowly swept over all Hell Devils and Hell Messengers, instantly making their heads bow even lower.
When that terrible gaze fell upon Jack Clark, Alvaron finally spoke slowly, his voice containing a terrifying Will echoing throughout the entire Hell Plane.
“Darren Callum, you have come.”
Jack Clark gave a slight bow, “Being invited by Great Overlord Alvaron, I naturally cannot neglect.”
Respect was due for the Lord of Hell, whose pressure far surpassed that of the Purple Glow Divine Dragon.
The previous two ‘encounters’ were only Will Projections of the other party, which were quickly suppressed by the powers of the mythical world, hence Jack Clark only felt that the other party’s strength was above Primordial.
However, he did not have a clear concept of how strong it actually was.
But now, facing the Lord of Hell directly, he felt his strength was immense; so much so that probably even the Terminal Emperor Dragon could not withstand a slap from him.
That was a premonition from Heart’s Eye.
And this was still under the condition that the other party’s True Body had not fully descended from the distant time-space.
Unbelievable, how terrifying would the true strength of this Lord of Hell be? Is it the Sixth Heaven Realm of Primordial Level, or the Seventh Heaven Realm?
While Jack Clark was speculating about Alvaron’s real power, this Lord of Hell slowly spoke again, his terrifying voice echoing throughout the Hell Plane.
“I have harnessed the Power of Hell to tear open the World Crystal Wall ahead, next, prepare for war.”
The moment Alvaron’s voice ended, the earth a million kilometers in front of the Bloody Demon Palace collapsed, forming an Abyssal fault that extended into the endless Void.
Outside the Plane, in the pitch-black unknown Void, a huge boundless white orb stood firm, and even with Jack Clark’s eyesight, he could not see the ends of it from any direction.
At this moment, countless crimson tentacles stretching for billions of kilometers reached out into the Void, connecting the Hell Plane with the white orb, resembling a massive pathway.
Within the pathway, space-time was twisted, and the white orb was rapidly enlarging at an alarming speed.
As he watched the approaching world, Jack Clark felt an overwhelming force head-on, and through the Crystal Wall, he faintly sensed several powerful Presences.
Obviously, the opposite side also noticed the invasion of Hell, and they had even made preparations for resistance.
But what the life in this world did not realize was that the invasion was not a projection of the Hell Plane, but the true descent of the Supreme Hell.
Even Jack Clark himself felt his blood beginning to boil.
The war which not only involved two Planes but would even include participation from the Supreme Abyss Plane, was an exhilarating prospect.
Just right, his Despair Demon God Armor can absorb the Death, despair, and hatred of the lives slain beneath its halberd, continually accumulating and stacking up Defense.

chapters.title: Chapter 1762: 649: Plane War, For the Tribe
chapters.content:
Chapter 1762: Chapter 649: Plane War, For the Tribe
Rabio World, the sky had been enveloped by blood-colored light for a year.
Just one year ago, at the moment when the blood light appeared, all the natural deities, Mythical Creatures, sages of all races, Sword Gods, War Gods, etc., from the entire Great Thousand Worlds received a notification from the Will of the World.
Doomsday was imminent.
One year later, the designated point for the descent of doomsday—the Despair Plains—had now gathered countless warriors from the Rabio World.
Among them, the most numerous are the members of the Caesar Race, clad in armor and covered with thick fur, resembling human apes, totaling a staggering forty-five billion from the Eight Great Empires and the thirty-seven Duch Countries.
However, the average strength of these warriors was mediocre; most were merely Second Layer Cultivators.
Yet, under the enhancement of armor, weapons, and battle formations led by Senior soldiers, they constituted the most formidable force in this world.
In addition to them, the second most numerous were the Troll Warriors, around ten meters tall, wearing simple clothing, and wielding massive weapons.
Responding to the call of the chieftains from the tribes of the Rabio World, nearly one billion warriors gathered.
Compared to the Caesar Race, although there were fewer Troll Warriors, each individual possessed greater strength; even the weakest troll possessed third-tier power.
Compared to these two most numerous races, there are others like the Green Wing Tribe with dragonfly wings yet lizard-like bodies, Tree Demons that resemble large trees covered with various buds.
And also the Earth Giants carrying stone pillars, the Giant Eagle Race with human faces and eagle bodies.
The Grey Python Tribe with human heads and snake bodies, covered in grey scales, and twenty-three other races, combined they numbered only in the hundreds of millions, but each of these different races commanded a powerful innate racial talent.
Apart from these Transcendent Warriors, the kings of these races all exuded a tremendous oppressive aura.
Including the kings of the Caesar and Troll Tribes, those Sword Gods and War Gods, Rage Kings, all radiated an aura surpassing that of myths.
And the most terrifying presence was that of the rulers of this world—the natural deities.
Innately in charge of the natural rules of earth, water, fire, wood, wind, lightning, light, and darkness, these deities were the Primordial Gods of the natural elements of this world.
The strongest amongst these Ancient Gods was surrounded by black and white elemental Halos, faintly forming primordial visions of opening Heaven and Earth, and the alternation of all things.
Around these Ancient Gods who controlled the elements of their respective worlds swirled other Innate Deities mastering the same type of element but different branches of rules.
Nearly a thousand Demigod creatures, Mythical-level creatures, Sword Gods, War Gods, dozens of Main Gods, Divine Kings, and Ancient Elemental Gods, even all life forms participating in the battle of Doomsday, were all enveloped by an immense force.
Blessed by the brilliance of the World Rules of Rabio, all living beings seemed to be donned in a layer of white battle armor, their aura skyrocketing, filled with abundant Battle Intent.
At this moment, all lives fighting for the world solemnly looked up at the ever-growing massive blood-red vortex in the sky.
On the opposite side of the vortex, a continent could already be vaguely seen approaching this world.
In that world of Dark Heavens and Earth, fourteen towering, ferocious figures stood tall.
Each was thousands to tens of thousands of kilometers in height, surrounded by terrifying blood light, some with a dozen heads, others resembling a congregation of countless insects.
Or possessing ten huge arms and three terrifying faces, surrounded by countless living beings emitting despairing wails, terrifying and shocking.
Those terrifying beings were now looking over with sinister and malevolent gazes, causing all the top warriors of all races to shudder uncontrollably, some growing restless.
Under the twisted space-time of the World Rules, the true forms of these Hell Messengers were all projected.
“Are those the Evil Gods invading this time?”
“So terrifying, just their gaze gives me a sense of despair, and this is still across the World Crystal Wall.”
“Yeah, so strong, it feels like those Evil Gods are even stronger than the Ancient Elemental Gods. Can we win?”
Before their descent, the Killing Intent emanating from the Hell Messengers that had destroyed and invaded countless planes already filled the hearts of the strong of the Rabio World with dread and chills.
At this moment, a figure standing within a white flame above the Firmament slowly began to speak, his voice filled with rule-laden authority that shook Heaven and Earth.
“Don’t be afraid, everyone. Although these Evil Gods are mighty, they are few in number; we still have a chance at victory.”
“Moreover, don’t forget, this is the Rabio World. As soon as they dare to come in, they will be suppressed by the World Rules, and retain only a fraction of their power; therefore, there’s no need for excessive fear.”
“It’s the Primordial Fire Ancient God.”
Above the Caesar Race, a Caesar War God towering thousands of kilometers high roared as he raised his Battle Axe: “The Ancient God is right. Those Evil Gods will be suppressed by the world once they enter.”
“Remember, everyone, the chance for our names to be passed down through the ages is today. And as long as we can repel the invasion of the Evil Gods, all of us will be rewarded by the Will of the World and ascend in position pattern.”
“Everyone prepare. According to the notice from the World Will, one hourglass of time remains before the Evil Gods begin their invasion.”
“Kill.”
“For the glory of the tribe.”
“For Rabio.”
“For wines and women…”
“Ula Ula!!”
The exhilarating battle cries echoed across the entire plains, as the Mages from the Caesar’s national legions began to chant spells, bestowing the power of magic upon the warriors.
The chieftains of the Troll Tribes also began to shout loudly, performing their war dances.
A fervent atmosphere of war began to spread instantly.
On the edge of the Crimson Hell’s Earth, Jack Clark arrogantly sat upon the White Bone Throne, his gaze indifferent as he watched the approaching world, and slowly spoke.
“Boroedo, how long has this plane war been prepared for?”
The huge Mountain Giant beside him shook his head: “Not for long. This plane has only half a Sun Wheel’s time since Storafl discovered it and reported it to Overlord Alvaron.”
“Oh, right, the Sun Wheel, this unit of time is said to have spread from your Griffith Eternal World.”
“Only half a Sun Wheel?”
Jack Clark nodded slowly, it seemed that such cross-space-time plane wars started very quickly, not giving the feeling of spending a year or two just traveling through space.
Just as the Hell Plane was about to invade, on the other end of the Rabio World, an endless dark red Dark Demon Air was spreading and converging.
In the dark red Abyss World, countless ferocious demons gathered, and one by one, powerful Demon Gods stood tall, emanating a Terrifying Aura.
However, unlike the Hell which had already drawn the power of the Supreme Plane and was eroding and tearing the Crystal Wall, the Supreme Abyss seemed to be waiting for something.
Silently waiting, the Hell continent that peeked through the corner of space-time crashed completely against the World Crystal Wall.
At the moment of collision, the Terrifying Power burst forth from Alvaron, who stood deep in space-time.
Boom! Out of the depths of Hell, a pair of immense, boundless demon claws, formed by converging blood, slowly reached into the Boundary Wall and violently tore.
Bang bang bang!! Sounds like that of shattering crystal echoed through the Void, echoing through the Rabio World.
In the eyes of countless soldiers of various races that witnessed the verification, the blood-colored vortex that had spun above the Firmament for a year suddenly shattered, forming a pitch-black Hollow that penetrated Heaven and Earth.
An endless blood-colored light spread from the black hole on the opposite side, giving off an ominous Aura.
Under the illumination of the blood light, all soldiers felt a certain suppression, the White Light bestowed by the world’s Will on their bodies dimmed, becoming weak and likely to disperse at any moment.
“Bad news, the world’s Will is suppressed by some evil force.”
“We cannot let those Evil Gods descend.”
“Act now, Seal the Firmament.”
Under the cover of Hell’s blood light, all deities who hoped to suppress the enemy with the World Rules turned pale.
“Kekekeke!! The pathway is finally open.”
“A bunch of fools, what do you think we were waiting for Hell’s descent for?”
“It’s useless, even if they know that our strength is not limited under the power of Hell, they have no way to stop the force from the Supreme Plane.”
Saying this, Boroedo, one of the fourteen Hell Messengers who had earlier advised Jack Clark not to charge too quickly, let out a thunderous rumble: “Gentlemen, let my Earth army take the lead.”
“Come out.”
Boom! Boroedo stretched his hands into the Void before him and fiercely tore it apart, instantly a crack spanning thousands of miles appeared.
The crack connected to another world, and within it millions of giants stood tall, the smallest at ten meters with a second-tier Aura, and the tallest at hundreds of meters with a quasi-mythical Aura.
These giants, sculpted like rocks, let out a resounding roar the moment Boroedo opened the Spatial Channel.
“For the great king of the world.”
“For the glory of the lords of Earth and mountain peaks, charge.”
“Kill!”
Countless Earth Giants poured out, marching majestically into the world passageways that resembled a dark vortex.
Roar!
Boroedo’s True Body swelled, transforming into a towering giant over eighty thousand meters tall, his shoulders bearing a stone pillar like a mountain range, entering the pathway surrounded by countless Earth Giants.
On the other side of the pathway, facing an endless stream of Earth monsters pouring out from the opposite side, the commanding general of the Caesar Race at the forefront of the army roared.
“Borsa Empire, all armies of Klara Empire, move forward and form a battle formation to block those invading monsters.”
“Barbira Elemental Legion, you provide support from behind, tear those ugly creatures to shreds for me.”
“Kill!”
Including the massive Boroedo, the wrath of an Ancient God known as the Primordial Fire targeted him, covering the entire sky with sky-reaching flames, while his powerful force filled Heaven and Earth.
Boom! Instantly, a great battle erupted, and the whole world was filled with the roars and howls of countless living beings.
As the Earth army began its invasion, the Insect Demon was the next to Summon its subordinates’ legion.
Under its body composed of black smoke, countless sinister insects of several meters in length, each exuding a strange and fierce Aura, surged into the pathway like floodwater.
“I am the Catastrophe.”
“The stage is set, now it’s time for the king-level to make their entrance.”
“Gentlemen, shall we witness together the beautiful scene of world destruction?”
With sounds of scoffs and excitement, the remaining eleven Hell Messengers also opened world passageways one after another, creating cracks to Summon endless legions of subordinates.
Surrounded by those legions, the Hell Messengers revealing bodies tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of meters in size transformed into gods of world destruction, descending with an Aura that could Destroy Heaven and Earth.
Suddenly, the grand scale plane war erupted in full force.

chapters.title: Chapter 1763: 650: Dark Forest, The Suppressed Crimson Supreme
chapters.content:
Chapter 1763: Chapter 650: Dark Forest, The Suppressed Crimson Supreme
A black hole spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers pierces through Hell and the Rabio Grand World.
Centered around the pathway, the blood light containing the supreme will spreads like a tsunami in the surroundings, suppressing the Heavenly Earth Rules, suppressing the world’s will, unstoppable.
In just a moment, the blood light covers millions of kilometers.
Under the envelopment of the Power of Hell, all Hell Messengers not only are unaffected by the suppression of heaven and earth but also have their aura surge twofold, their strength becoming even more formidable.
Thirteen Hell Messengers, seven of them singly taking on an Ancient Elemental God leading a divine faction, their ferocity soaring, occasionally tearing apart an Elemental Deity.
The Insect Demon and that Shadow Apostle join forces, besieging that half-step Primordial Light-Dark Overlord.
The remaining four Hell Messengers, meanwhile, command their subordinates to fiercely clash with Caesar, the troll races’ ancient gods, their army legions, the War God, and the High Priest among other strong figures.
The other subordinate creatures are battling the remaining various race armies, the battlefield affecting the surrounding million-kilometer area, and still spreading deeper into the world.
Apart from the sea of insects the Insect Demon controls, the other subordinate creature legions number at most several tens of millions, the fewest only several millions.
A grand battle involving billions of Extraordinary Creatures from two plane worlds, thousands of deities roaring, ancient gods bellowing, momentarily turning heaven and earth upside down, sun and moon without light.
Such a monumental plane war, yet to Jack Clark, it feels… somewhat weak.
It feels not much stronger than the last decisive battle with the Purgatory Demon Race, at most only a bit more in number of peak True Spirit Level ancient gods, including those of ancient times.
But the Transcendent Corps under his command is too weak.
In the mythical world, the weakest in a transcendent war are all above Fourth Tier in strength, most are within Fifth and Sixth Tier, with those from Eight Layer Heaven and Ninth Heavens as the main force.
However, the Extraordinary Soldiers of the Rabio World are mainly First Tier, with numbers drastically decreasing from Fourth Tier upwards.
Similarly, although those Hell Messengers are strong, their subordinate creatures are mostly around Second Tier, with only a few being Senior Soldiers led by a small portion of Eighth Tier and Ninth Tier.
Observing this scene, Jack Clark suddenly realized that it wasn’t that the technology-integrated Human Federation was weak, but that they have always been playing high-end games.
Certainly, the strength of this Grand Thousand World is still formidable, overall stronger than the ancient civilizations initially encountered during expeditions.
But unfortunately, this world, targeted by two Supreme Planes, is doomed to be destroyed, even dragged into Hell or the Abyss.
As Jack Clark was observing and analyzing the differences from the mythical world, beside him a will congealed, forming the lofty projection of Alvaron.
Watching as Jack Clark stood with hands behind his back, not entering the Rabio World, Alvaron slowly opened his mouth: “Darren Callum, is this your first participation in a plane war? Does it feel somewhat cruel?”
“It’s not too bad.”
Jack Clark shook his head slightly, not very concerned.
He isn’t a saint, without moral scruples; as long as it doesn’t involve him or the Human Race’s interests, under normal conditions, he won’t bully other weaker civilizations.
Similarly, without understanding the operational norms of the Endless World, he also won’t judge whether this plane invasion is ‘just’.
Or, the standards of justice are different in the eyes of different races from countless civilizations and various worlds.
Some cultivation civilizations abide by the law of the jungle, where strength is respected, resource plundering is pushed to the extreme, the entire societal form filled with suppression and selfishness.
And randomly seizing the weak is a basic rule in that world, with no mercy for the weak.
Not to mention something like sacrificing everything for the ethnicity, sacrificing all for the future’s spirit of unity.
While Jack Clark was deep in thought, distractedly pondering about life and the philosophical issue of morality, thinking that he was merely responding casually, Alvaron’s voice lowered,
“Darren Callum, don’t think the races of this world fighting bravely to protect their world, at the moment fearlessly battling, haven’t also invaded other worlds before our arrival.”
“The deities of the Rabio World also invaded other planes?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised, turning his head towards Alvaron.
The projection of the Lord of Hell slowly nodded: “Correct, even Supreme Hell has its own operational standards; devouring planes and worlds aligns with the basic rules of chaos.
“In the Chaos Sea, every moment worlds are born, destroyed, nurturing countless worlds and planes like the grains of sand in the River Ganges.
“These worlds exist in different spaces, different dimensions, including some internal small worlds within the Great Thousand Worlds, hence no one knows just how many worlds there are in the limitless space-time.
“Normally wandering the Chaos Sea, or roaming deep in space-time, it might take hundreds or thousands of years to discover a single world.
“Even I, wielding a Supreme Hell’s plane, find it difficult to randomly search for a strange world in the vast expanse of space-time.”
“In order to explore the mysteries beyond the world, to explore other planes, many strong beings have created various secret skills and divine powers for exploration.”
“Some tear the World Crystal Wall, sending beacons into the time river covering billions of worlds.”
“Some utilize lost extraordinary items from other worlds, reversing causality, performing reverse positioning.”
“Or else they condense seeds of power to throw into the time river, treating those lifeforms that pick up and fuse with their ‘power’ as seeds, using coordinates, establishing churches to develop forces and so on.”
“When the time is ripe, those powerful existences can traverse space-time and planes through these coordinates.”
“Currently, the first method of exploration in the Endless World is the most widely used, letting many strong beings across different planes know about extraterrestrial situations, even forming exchange alliances.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1764: 650: Dark Forest, The Suppressed Crimson Supreme_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1764: Chapter 650: Dark Forest, The Suppressed Crimson Supreme_2
“And the most accurate method to pinpoint otherworldly coordinates is the second kind, which relies on transcendent items.”
“This approach generally requires True Spirit level strength and a knack for extrapolating space-time; the stronger the power of the transcendent item, the more precise the coordinates.”
“The appearance of such otherworldly transcendent items in different worlds usually only happens for two reasons: invasion and being invaded.”
“In the neutral Supreme Heaven, many deities, whose own worlds have been destroyed by invasions, would sell the invading civilization artifacts they’ve collected.”
“For instance, the coordinates of Rabio World come from a fragmented artifact; its owner is a White Night Alien Race Main God, whose world shattered and sought refuge in the Supreme Heaven Plane.”
“The plane where that White Night Alien Race resided encountered an invasion from Rabio World’s natural divine church 250 years ago. ”
“The strongest of that world was just a Peak Divine King of ancient times, naturally no match for a True Spirit level Ancient Elemental God; their civilization was wiped out in just two years, and the plane collapsed.”
“And that broken artifact was obtained by that White Night Main God after slaying one of the Elemental Deities.”
“With his world shattered and in exile for over two hundred years, that alien race Main God’s heart is naturally filled with resentment.”
“After finding a way to enter Supreme Heaven, that fragmented artifact was eventually purchased by a Storafl apostle, leading to our descent here.”
“And isn’t this, once more, an arrangement of destiny.”
“Supreme Hell is the congregation place of all slaughter and despair, including those ‘worlds that revel in slaughter.'”
At this point, from beneath his crimson robe, Alvaron’s eyes revealed a calm and indifferent gaze, silently observing the opposite world being corroded by Hell.
Watching the Elemental Deities and Race War Gods, shrouded in intense killing intent, fighting in the great battle through the passageway, Jack Clark slowly said, “He who kills, shall he always be killed in turn?”
In Alvaron’s perspective, Endless World is akin to a Dark Forest, where any world that sticks its neck out risks attracting even more powerful worlds or lifeforms.
Even leading to annihilation.
As for the reason to invade, it’s naturally for resources, to make oneself stronger.
The Heaven and Earth Treasures of another world, containing different energy attributes and Heavenly Earth Law Factors, can act like a touchstone to many powerful beings.
Besides, different power systems could also serve for reference and cross-verification, furthering one’s own path.
Moreover, by tearing apart and destroying weaker planes, one can plunder a great deal of World Origin to enhance one’s cultivation; therefore, in Endless World, revealing your world’s coordinates is entirely foolish.
After all, in Endless World, there will always be worlds stronger than your own, life forms stronger than you.
A moment of carelessness could lead to destruction.
Even the mythical world has fought great battles with Eternal Worlds of the same level, ending with mutual damage, and is currently in a state of hibernation.
Of course, in every forest, however vast, there are always fools to be found.
For instance, the Blue Star World, before the opening of the Mythical Era last century, launched two Voyager probes into outer space in the hopes of interstellar exploration.
These probes bore human voices and images, along with other information, carrying bright hopes.
Hoping that in a few hundred years, these objects would be discovered by extraterrestrials, who would then find Blue Star and establish contact with humans, leading them beyond the Star System.
As to whether the other party would occupy Blue Star, eradicate its original life, or enslave it, those fools never considered these issues.
Perhaps they figured they would have long passed away by then, unconcerned about the deluge after their demise.
At this moment, Jack Clark suddenly thought of something and looked at Alvaron’s projection: “The great Lord of Alvaron, did you just mention that the Supreme Heaven Plane is neutral within Endless World?”
For Jack Clark, who was observed by the Supreme Will, Alvaron had a clearly different attitude and nodded slowly.
“Yes, among the four Supreme Planes, Hell and the Abyss operate under the rule of invasion, to assimilate other planes and absorb powerful lives to strengthen themselves.”
“While the Supreme Heaven Plane serves as a neutral hub, linking countless recognized worlds to form a vast network.”
“The deities of these worlds can pass through Supreme Heaven to enter other planes and worlds, for travel, exchange, and even teaming up to explore the Chaos Sea.”
“Thus, the forces of Supreme Heaven are even more powerful than Hell, and the Abyss Plane.”
“Of course, when speaking of the scope of power, those scattered dynasties of Supreme Heaven wouldn’t dare provoke our Supreme Hell.”
Jack Clark continued to inquire: “Great Lord of Alvaron, what about the Deep Red Plane?”
“The Deep Red Plane.”
At this point, Alvaron paused for a moment: “That is a special plane, where the sole task of the Deep Red Destroyer Beasts nested within is to destroy all worlds they encounter.”
“Because of their sheer destructiveness, the entities that used to trouble us most were not those of the Abyss Plane, but these Destroyer Beasts.”
“Every time a war erupts between the three great Supreme Planes, the final contest for domination would result in those domains being destroyed by the Crimson Beasts, making all efforts in vain.”
“However, fortunately, in the recent tens of thousands of years, the Deep Red Plane has quieted down somewhat, due to the suppression by the Griffith Eternal World of that number one ranked Giant Beast.”
Suppressed by the Eternal World, Jack Clark was startled.
Immediately after, he thought of the blood-colored moon hanging in outer space.
No wonder, when he, in his Godlike Form, looked towards the heavens, he found that the projections of the three suns and that moon were all Giant Beast Type Creatures.
But the projection of the blood-colored moon was the boundless Deep Red World.
He hadn’t expected that it was actually a Deep Red Beast suppressed by the mythical world.
Not sure if it was because he hadn’t chatted with anyone in a long time or if he was preparing to cultivate Jack Clark, Alvaron continued to speak in a low and dignified voice.
“The existence of the Deep Red is different from that of Hell and the Abyss; dominated by the strongest Destroyer Beast, it wanders the endless Space-Time, devouring the destructive forces formed from the annihilation of worlds to strengthen itself.”
“Therefore, when the strongest Deep Red Beast is suppressed, the Deep Red Plane was also pinned down in the Griffith Eternal World.”
“Unless one day the beast, which is said to have reached the end of the Primordial path and even touched Eternity, breaks free from the suppression, the Deep Red World will not reappear.”
“And because it’s backed by the powerful and even terrifying Eternal World, Darren Callum, as a Hell Messenger, you can move almost worry-free in the Plane Battlefield.”
“You need not fear meeting an enemy so strong that you can’t contend, who might chase you through causality back to your home world and threaten your race’s civilization.”
“Moreover, if you have the chance, you can attempt to use the power of the Griffith World to suppress and reverse hunt the powerful beings chasing you.”
Jack Clark nodded: “Thank you, Great Lord of Alvaron, for the reminder; this can indeed serve as a trump card.”
Just as the two were about to continue their conversation, suddenly from deep within the Rabio World, a terrifying Aura that was beyond Primordial burst forth, shaking the entire world violently.
Instantly, Boroedo and other Hell Messengers were startled; the pressure they were applying on their adversaries involuntarily receded a bit, not daring to push too aggressively.
Afraid they would become the first target of that concealed Primeval Deity.
Outside this world, sensing that fleeting oppressive force, Jack Clark’s eyes also became somewhat solemn: “This Primordial entity is quite strong.”
“It doesn’t matter; today, it will either have to flee to the Chaos Void, abandoning its world, or be suppressed by me.”
“If it continues to hesitate, once the Power of Hell and the imminent Abyss invade the entire world, it will be too late for it to escape.”
Alvaron’s tone was very calm, even with a Primordial being that had the support of the Original Great Thousand Worlds and the backing of the World Will, he didn’t regard it with much concern.
Its real opponent was the Abyssal Overlord that could arrive at any moment.
“Having spectated for so long, I shall also take a look inside.” Saying this, Jack Clark took a step, his figure surrounded by a blood light, appearing instantly at the entrance of the world passageway and stepping through.
Boom!
In the instant Jack Clark entered the pathway, the gigantic black vortex, with a diameter of hundreds of thousands of kilometers, suddenly started to violently shake.
It was as if a massive boundless Giant Beast was squeezing in, such a presence caused Alvaron’s gaze from beneath the blood-colored robe to flicker slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1765: 651: Heaven-Piercing Stele, Slaying Enough to Breakthrough the Primordial
chapters.content:
Chapter 1765: Chapter 651: Heaven-Piercing Stele, Slaying Enough to Breakthrough the Primordial
Jack Clark had just entered the world passageway when he felt a force from the Rabio World enveloping him, exuding intense malice, repelling and suppressing him.
However, the world suppression that could originally suppress eighty percent of his strength was directly neutralized by the Power of Hell surrounding Jack.
But…
Boom!
Endless blood light surrounded him, and as Jack’s figure descended, a terrifying oppressiveness spread out.
At the same time, as the fourteenth Hell Messenger descended, the extended Power of Hell surged.
From afar, the spread of blood light over a range of over two million kilometers suddenly expanded by hundreds of thousands of kilometers, enveloping many deities.
“No good, another Evil God has descended!”
“The aura of this Evil God is terrifying.”
“Be careful of the spreading blood light, do not let it envelop you, otherwise under the power of the Evil God, we will lose the protection of the world will, and our strength will drop.”
Jack slightly lowered his head, his terrifying gaze traveled tens of thousands of kilometers, landing on a crushed boulder below.
There, a person in silver armor was buried under the rocks, devoid of breath, already dead, but pretending to be dead was naturally not enough to deceive Jack.
The reason Jack noticed this top-tier Caesar warrior was because of its eyes.
Through those wide-open ‘dead’ pupils, Jack noticed that in their eyes, his image was that of a monster tens of thousands of meters tall.
Covered in blood-red Dragon Scales, his joints, double shoulder, and back were full of sharp spikes, his head had nine pairs of sharp dragon horns resembling a crown, appearing extremely ferocious.
And below his feet, endless streams of blood flowed, converging into a sea. In this Sea of Blood, billions of living beings struggled, wailed, issuing desperate and mournful screams, the scene was horrifying.
“So this is how I appear in the eyes of this world’s will.”
Seeing his own image through the eyes of the alien, Jack was not angered but instead felt that this form of his seemed even more domineering, and he was inspired to act.
Crackle Crackle!! Jack’s figure swelled, red Dragon Scales, dragon horns, and sharp spikes grew all over his body, around him the Blood Sea Doomsday unfolded, countless lives wailing…
Instantly on the Plane Battlefield, a ferocious and terrifying Hell-Dragon-Demon God appeared, and even the Hell Messengers like Boroedo felt some apprehension towards this formidable form.
“Darren Callum, brother, I’ve set my sights on this group; you go find other prey.”
Watching the figure whose movements made heaven and earth shake, surrounded by roaring Blood Seas that drowned everything, Boroedo’s Power Explosion repelled the ancient flame deity, then turned and shouted loudly.
In the roar, Boroedo’s mountain-column swept across, the space at the front end of the rule-wrapped column distorted, appearing instantly above the head of an elemental Main God.
Bang! The Main God hadn’t even reacted when it was instantly smashed by the powerful mountain column.
Watching the attentions of the other Hell Messengers, Jack’s voice was cold and deep: “Don’t worry, I’m not interested in your prey.”
He entered the Rabio World just to get an early feel of the differences in this world and to prepare for the upcoming Abyssal Descent.
Killing these common alien deities, plundering the resources of this world, was not as worthwhile as slaying the Abyssal agents.
As for that Primordial existence hidden deep in the world, with Alvaron watching over, once it made a move, it would be instantly intercepted and suppressed.
The Sea of Blood surged, wherever it passed, the Earth was submerged, forming a scarlet pathway tens of thousands of kilometers wide, spreading from the world passageway to a million kilometers beyond.
Wherever it passed, tens of millions of alien corps who couldn’t evade in time were devoured, including two million subordinates of two messengers.
And just as Jack controlled the Sea of Blood, stepping out of the range covered by the Power of Hell, the surrounding world suppression force surged, the Sea of Blood roared.
Boom Boom Boom!! Under the terrifying suppressive force, the Blood Sea Field surrounding Jack continued to collapse, compress, until it only covered over two thousand kilometers.
At the same time, his whole person’s aura weakened, the Realm breath of the early True Spirit stage instantly fell to the Peak of the Ancient.
In the deity system, the power still equal to the peak of a Divine King was powerful, but it was no longer unmanageable for the strong beings of the Rabio World.
Boom!
Jack’s headspace shattered, ripped apart by a sharp Sword Qi creating a crack tens of thousands of kilometers long.
Like the darkness of the Abyss, a figure a hundred thousand meters tall, wearing Golden Battle Armor, stood firm. An extremely sharp will surged to the sky, piercing through the clouds.
Boom!
The figure’s purely golden battle sword shone brilliantly, earth and heaven trembled, space shattered, and thirty-six heaven-piercing and penetrating Sword Lights slowly emerged from space.
At the moment when these massive Sword Lights, as large as planets and forged like pure gold, appeared, a powerful force descended.
Jack’s surrounding hundred-thousand-kilometer range froze in time and space, world cut apart.
At the same time, the aura of the ape surged a hundredfold, its body swelled, resembling a colossal ape with the sky as its crown, exuding a terrifying Aura close to the Pinnacle of True Spirit.
“Evil alien Evil God, today this will be the burial ground for your kind.”
The majestic and deep roar vibrated heaven and earth, the Golden War Sword in the ape’s hand slowly descended, piercing through heaven and earth, exuding a terrifying power capable of slaying gods and demons.
The edge, so sharp that even the Hell Messengers felt their Divine Souls ache.
Meanwhile, the thirty-six Sword Lights also simultaneously sealed space-time, cutting apart the earth and sky, ready to strike down Jack, the Evil God, in one blow.
“It is one of the two Supreme beings of Caesar, the Master of Ten Thousand Swords, the Ancient God.”
That was a powerhouse from the Eternal Great World; even if suppressed by Heaven and Earth to only retain a fraction of their power, they are not something a mere ordinary True Spirit from the Great Thousand Worlds could annihilate.
These messengers had never seen Jack Clark make a move, but they unanimously had immense confidence in him.
“What gave you the courage to ambush me?”
His indifferent, cold voice echoed between heaven and earth. Within the frozen golden space, the fiercely daunting Jack Clark slowly raised his head, his gaze coldly sweeping across the myriad of sword lights.
On his shoulder appeared a black stele enveloped in blood light, his arms embracing the stele as a terrifying power capable of shaking the heavens burst forth from within him.
Boom! Eons trembled, and the earth collapsed.
Thirty-six heaven-piercing and earth-shattering sword lights shattered, including that world-class weapon in the hands of the humanoid ape, and even the powerful real body bolstered by the world’s will was obliterated by a single stele.
Destroying heaven and earth, within the chaotic flow of destructive energy spanning a million kilometers, only the shadow of that black stele stood tall, emitting an aura capable of suppressing all heavens.
Beneath the black stele, a beam of golden light emitted a furious roar.
That was the deity known as the Master of Ten Thousand Swords, the humanoid ape Ancient God, whose true body was getting eroded by blood-red lightning, visibly dissipating.
How powerful!
How terrifying!
Witnessing this scene, all the deities felt their hearts tremble.
Bolstered by the world’s will, the battle strength of the Ancient God dubbed King of Ten Thousand Swords, almost comparable to the peak of Ancient Gods, was instantly demolished by the supreme artifact and its real body suppressed.
Even Boroedo and the other Hell Messengers focused their gaze.
At this moment, from another battlefield direction over two million kilometers away, another toweringly majestic humanoid ape Ancient God roared, “Ten Thousand Swords must not fall, make a move to save it.”
The Elemental Ancient Gods naturally knew this issue.
Initially, their number of God-level combat power was lesser, and in one-on-one battles they were almost all suppressed, their chances of victory would be even lower if the Master of Ten Thousand Swords fell.
However, seeing that terrifying figure standing atop the stele, with the blood sea churning around it, the Elemental Ancient Gods hesitated to desperately intervene for a moment.
That Evil God was too strong, a single strike had obliterated the Master of Ten Thousand Swords, and such terrifying power would result in the same outcome even if they replaced him.
Eventually, under the gaze of those deities, within less than ten minutes, the Master of Ten Thousand Swords, amidst reluctant and agonizing roars, was erased by the blood-red lightning.
Boom, boom, boom!
Just as the Master of Ten Thousand Swords fell, countless black thunderclaps exploded in the skies of the Rabio World, the black light illuminating the heaven and earth, carrying an ominous aura.
This was the first Ancient God-level entity to fall since the battle began.
At the moment Jack Clark slew that Ancient God, the surrounding sea of blood fiercely roared; the blood light surged explosively, spreading over three hundred thousand kilometers, merging with the blood light at the horizon.
Simultaneously, the Despair Battle Armor on Jack Clark turned even more crimson and fierce-looking, the unit of Despair Power on the attribute page skyrocketed directly from 10,890 to 15,750, further enhancing Defense.
Whoosh whoosh! Above Jack Clark’s head, strands of pure white energy spontaneously appeared within the blood light, as if threads of pure light sources were merging into his body.
It was the World Origin, and the quantity reached an astonishing count of thousands.
And a single World Origin could allow a Nine-fold Peak cultivator to break through to Myth, equivalent to a ticket to the realm of myth.
Even Jack Clark was slightly surprised, feeling the massive amount of origin power that had suddenly accumulated within his body, he exclaimed: “The rewards of plane warfare are astonishing.”
Killing a single True Spirit for thousands of Origin rewards, if pushing over a side of Great Thousand World, wouldn’t it accumulate tens or even hundreds of thousands of Origin?
At this moment, transparent text appeared before Jack Clark.
“Detecting a large convergence of World Origin within the body, convert to Origin Points?”
“Origin Points… Convert.” With only slight hesitation, Jack Clark chose to convert.
True Spirit Powerhouses could use vast amounts of Origin to hasten the evolution of rules and the tempering of the true body, equivalent to Heaven and Earth Treasures that could enhance the strength of True Spirits.
And it was the kind without side effects.
But Origin Points were more critical for Jack Clark, those were directly usable as Primordial Air, the power of creation, accumulating enough could leap over the second or third Heavenly Realm once breaking through the Primordial.
As for quickly advancing cultivation realm at True Spirit Realm, it could be supplemented by other creation-level Heaven and Earth Treasures, there was no need to utilize World Origin.
While Jack Clark contemplated, the accumulated World Origin within him scattered like a bursting dam, quickly disappearing.
Simultaneously on the attribute page, the previously 0 Origin Points surged to 12,100 points.
“A single Origin, can it convert to ten Origin Points?” Jack Clark pondered, his attention on the Origin Points.
“Condensing and opening the First Heavenly Realm requires 400,000 Origin.”
“Current Origin Points insufficient, unable to enhance.”
“Current cultivation realm insufficient, unable to transform into Primordial Body…”
As he observed the series of transparent text appearing, Jack Clark’s face revealed a fierce grin, since condensing the Primordial First Heavenly Realm only needed four hundred thousand Origin Points.
Which meant that slaying around forty True Spirits could accumulate enough.
Thinking this, Jack Clark looked towards the horizon, his gaze falling on those dreadfully mighty Elemental Ancient Gods, and the more than a dozen Hell Messengers.
Killing all these Ancient Gods and Hell Messengers, almost would gather the sufficient Origin to condense the first layer of the Primordial Heavenly Realm.
Suddenly, all those True Spirit level beings felt an inexplicable chill in their hearts.
However, after some thought, Jack Clark still suppressed the idea of slaying all these beings, his massive figure turned around and continued walking towards the horizon.
Following coordinates given by Alvaron, he was heading to block the gate, to seal the soon-to-be-arriving Abyssal Channel.
In plane warfare, the enemies of the Hell Messengers were never these world deities, but rather the Abyss Lords who also belong to the supreme plane powers.
And at this moment, in Jack Clark’s eyes, all those beings were simply strings of Origin Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 1766: 652
chapters.content:
Chapter 1766: Chapter 652
Chapter 652 Absolute Domination – Sword Demon, Jane Aiken
Rabio is a world where the sky is round and the earth is square.
Centered on a continent floating in the void of irregular shape, with mountain ranges crisscrossing and rivers intertwining, and surrounded by vast seas.
This structure somewhat resembles the primordial earth described in the mythologies of Blue Star.
At the ocean’s end is a white mist sea that blocks out the sun, permanently unreachable by life forms below ancient level.
In the southeast direction of the continent, where wars affecting millions of transcendent lives rupture the heavens and earth, a blood light spreads towards the west of the land at an astonishing speed.
Wherever the light passes, everything is shattered.
Whether it’s towering mountain ranges, forests, or cities of Caesar, Troll Tribes, forming a blood river that stretches for millions of kilometers.
That day, countless ordinary beings from different races guarding the rear were dominated by fear.
Meanwhile, in another direction outside the world, a huge boundless figure stands in the roaring chaos stream void of the Abyss, reaching out with double claws.
Boom!
Rabio world trembles, its solid and powerful crystal walls are torn apart, penetrating under the endless influx of Abyss Demonic Aura, forming a dark red pathway.
Watching the forming world passageway, over a dozen Abyssal Great Demons, who had been waiting, reveal vicious smiles on their faces.
Behind these Abyssal Great Demons, with demon gas billowing, billions of Abyssal Demons let out sharp hisses, their eyes filled with bloodthirsty desire for slaughter.
Under the watch of all Abyssal Great Demons, the pathway gradually stabilizes half an hour later, forming a dark red vortex of hundreds of thousands of kilometers in diameter that keeps rotating.
Through the hollow center of the vortex, one can vaguely see the opposite side composed of a boundless range of a million mountains.
Above the million mountains stands the Firmament, with blood seas encircling a formidable figure.
“Hell Messenger!”
Looking at the figure covered in Dragon Scales, filled with crimson sharp spikes, majestic horns, and long hair like blood-colored flames dancing and burning behind Jack Clark, all Abyssal Great Demons turn a cold gaze.
One of the Abyssal Great Demons shows a cruel expression: “Seeking death, a mere Hell Messenger at the True Spirit Initial Stage dares to block the pathway.”
Saying this, the Abyssal Great Demon looks up, turning towards the boundless projection of the Abyss Lord overhead, speaking respectfully.
“Oh great Lord Rezafavali, please allow me to suppress that Hell Messenger.”
The figure as vast as a star slightly lowers its head, its terrifying gaze passing through the world passageway, sweeping over the Plane War erupting millions of kilometers away, also landing on Jack Clark.
Because Jack Clark did not conceal his aura, the Abyss Lord discerns his realm at first glance.
True Spirit Initial Stage!
A Hell Messenger at the True Spirit Initial Stage dares to block the gate of the Abyss Plane?
After a brief silence, the vast figure slowly speaks: “Mills, go bring over the head of that Purgatory Apostle.”
“Do not be careless; this Hell Messenger is only at the True Spirit Initial Stage, but his strength should be very strong.”
Naturally, these beings are not deceived by Jack Clark’s displayed realm; after all, under normal conditions, he wouldn’t dare to block the Abyssal Descent alone without substantial strength.
As for how strong, they will find out through testing.
“Yes, great Abyss Lord, your subordinate will not be careless,” says the Abyssal Great Demon named Mills, bowing respectfully, his voracious face with black scales retaining a very calm gaze.
Boom! Mills’s body erupts like a nuclear explosion of red flames, burning heaven and earth, dispelling darkness.
In the heart of a terrifying sea of red flames, a fifteen-thousand-meter-tall demon, its body flowing with substantive liquid fire, stands enveloped with the pressure of Late Stage True Spirit.
In the sea of fire, tens of millions of fire demons of varying sizes, condensed from Abyssal blood fire, roar, surrounding Mills, the demon of flames.
Releasing his subordinates, showing his True Body entering his most powerful state, the demon of flames moves thunderously, sweeping the flames into the passageway with overwhelming aura.
Range of a million mountains.
Jack Clark stood upon the Sea of Blood, enveloped in a bright crimson glow. He gazed quietly at the dark red vortex sprawling between heaven and earth in the distance, and the flames that surged from it.
At Jack’s brow, the Hell’s Eye glittered red, the Power of Hell formed a crack behind him. From this crack, blood light burst forth, colliding with the dark red glow that permeated the space between heaven and earth.
Just like when Hell descends, a terrifying power spread from the opposite side of the Abyssal Channel, suppressing the Power of Heaven and Earth all around, oppressing everything.
The oppressive power from the Supreme Plane could only be countered by another power of the same level.
For example, the Rule mastered by Primordial Life, the powers from other Supreme Planes, or the World’s Power from worlds far stronger than the Rabio World.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Red flames erupted like a mountain torrent from the depths of the pathway, quickly enveloping hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Within the sea of fire that filled the sky, millions of fire demons roared and knelt towards the pathway, where the massive and fearsome figure of Mills slowly emerged, like a king from the fiery Abyss.
Boom!
As an Abyssal Great Demon descended, the dark red glow that had spread over a million kilometers intensified drastically, violently expanding hundreds of thousands of kilometers around.
Even the Abyssal Power suppressing Jack’s surroundings saw its power surge by ten percent.
Such is the purpose of the minions of the Supreme Plane like the Hell Messengers and Abyssal Great Demons.
They act as nodes of power, amplifiers, drawing and intensifying the highest plane power descending from another space-time, devouring everything.
Standing amidst the Abyssal Sea of Fire, Mills slowly spoke, his voice cold and deep as it echoed between heaven and earth, “I am Abyssal Great Demon Mills, Hell Messenger…”
Boom! Before Mills could finish his opening speech, the entire Firmament collapsed explosively, forming a gigantic black hole spanning a million kilometers.
From within the black hole, a War Halberd wrapped in blood light emerged slowly, reminiscent of a ten thousand kilometer mountain range. Before it even fell, the power it emitted shook the whole world.
The Abyssal Power that enveloped this world boiled like sea water under the Pseudo-Creation Level Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, collapsing, forming a ‘sea wall’ stretching a million kilometers.
Facing this Halberd, Mills’ pupils shrank, a look of terror appeared on his face.
“No!”
Boom! The heavens shattered, the earth split, and the black hole exploded.
One overbearing and terrifying halberd obliterated the million-mountain range in an instant. Hundreds of thousands of kilometers in range, the land collapsed, releasing energy akin to a red supernova explosion.
The blazing light almost illuminated the entire Rabio World, the Destructive Impact shook spacetime, reverberating through ages.
Mills, who was nearly at the Pinnacle of True Spirit but augmented by Abyssal Power, was instantly disintegrated by this halberd, a might that shocked all Abyssal Great Demons outside this world.
Including the battlefield over a hundred million kilometers away, all beings beyond the ancient times – Divine Kings, Ancient Gods, Hell Devils, Hell Messengers – also all turned their gaze towards this event.
Watching that red glow that illuminated the entire world, their eyes revealed a ghastly fear.
Under the watchful eyes of all ‘people’, the pervasive red glow between heaven and earth soon vanished, revealing a million-kilometer space of destroyed Area of Destruction.
And there stood a terrifying figure, thirty thousand meters in true height, holding a halberd, surrounded by a Sea of Blood beneath his feet, suppressing and erasing a fragmented phantom.
Outside this world, amongst the fourteen Abyssal Great Demons, the most terrifying one showed a frosty and solemn look, “This power, almost Primordial.”
“How could it be? With True Spirit Initial Stage of power, he has reached almost Primordial!”
The enormous figures of all Abyssal Great Demons revealed disbelief and shock.
Not just these Abyssal Great Demons, but also from the depths of the descending Abyss Plane high upon the throne, a terrorizing figure also revealed a cold gaze.
Indeed, this Hell Messenger was very strong.
Such a monster, must be eradicated. Thinking this, that terrifying figure’s gaze pierced through the worlds, looking towards the figure standing amidst the Blood Hell.
And just as the Abyssal Overlord and the Lord of Hell, Alvaron, exchanged looks.
On the high platform of the throne where the Abyssal Overlord sat, stood a girl with long hair as red as blood, a dark red sword mark on her brow, carrying four long swords on her back.
At this moment, the girl showed a faint astonishment in her eyes, looking at the figure standing across the pathway amidst the Chaos Void holding a halberd, suppressing the Abyssal Great Demon.
Especially the blood light entwined familiar-shaped red War Halberd in his hand.
Jack Clark, how is he here?

chapters.title: Chapter 1767: 653 Absolute Domination, Explode Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 1767: Chapter 653 Absolute Domination, Explode Everything
Breakthrough myth, after forging the Rule True Body, form is no longer fixed for cultivators, it can change at will, including a certain size.
Therefore, strong men above the myth usually base their distinction on soul fluctuations and strength.
There are also some familiar items with identifiable features, such as the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd in Jack Clark’s hand right now, which has changed in color but still retains its ferocious and dominating appearance.
For Jane Aiken, the weapon that has been with Jack Clark since the Fourth Layer Heaven and has been with him until now is naturally no stranger.
Additionally, his unrivaled dominating combat style, along with the overwhelming killing intent, Blood Sea Field shown once in the Ruins Continent, enabled Jane Aiken to recognize Jack Clark at first glance.
However, what surprised her was why Jack Clark was here?
Also, after not seeing him for half a year, he has already made a breakthrough to become a True Spirit Emperor, possessing terrifying strength that could even burst an Abyssal Great Demon at the Late Stage of True Spirit with a single strike.
“It really is you,” Jane Aiken sighed in her heart.
Originally, in the Heavenly Feather battleground, she, and Left Demon ended up falling into the Deep Red World, where the combined Left Demon easily broke through to the Ancient Realm.
After that, the father and daughter wandered the Deep Red World for more than a month, engaging in dozens of battles, and successfully found a Spatial Crack.
But unexpectedly, while leaving the Deep Red World through that crack, they encountered a Space-Time Storm.
When Left Demon, exhausted, burst out from the Space-Time Storm, they had already fallen into an Abyss Plane or had arrived at one of the Supreme Hell Planes, the Endless Abyss.
As a member of the Purgatory Demon Race, Left Demon felt like returning home in the deep Abyss filled with Dark Demon Air.
Under his protection, Jane Aiken not only avoided any danger but also had epiphanies after experiencing the power of the Deep Red Plane and the Abyss Plane, significantly hastening the increase of her strength.
Two months ago, when Jane Aiken was breaking through to the Heavenly King Realm in the Abyss Plane, she temporarily touched the ‘nature’ of the Endless Abyss with her terrifying epiphany talent, the Origin Core.
As a non-Abyssal Demon King, and only at the Initial Stage of Heavenly King Realm, she surprisingly touched the essence of one of the layers of a Supreme Plane.
This immediately alarmed the Overlord governing this layer.
Then, as Left Demon swept the surrounding Demon Kings and established territory in the Abyss Plane, the supreme ruler of this layer arrived.
This Overlord named Rezafavali immediately saw through all of Jane Aiken’s qualities.
Life Mark Wheel at eighteen years old, cultivation marks of less than ‘two years’, and an epiphany talent that aligns with Heaven and Earth even more than Innate Gods and Demons.
After an ‘interaction,’ Left Demon joined the Abyss Dark Demon Legion and became a great Demon Lord in charge of an army of tens of millions of demons.
At the same time, Jane Aiken was taken as a disciple, granted with Primordial True Blood, and in the absence of a form change, she possessed the bloodline of the Abyssal Overlord.
Plus the resources from the supreme overlord of a Supreme Plane, Jane Aiken’s cultivation has already broken through to the peak of Heavenly King, and she might have epiphanies at any time to break through to the supreme.
Originally, Jane Aiken thought that with the opportunities over this period, her cultivation should have caught up with, or at least come infinitely close to Jack Clark.
After all, when they separated half a year ago, Jack Clark had just broken through to the Heavenly King Realm, and even with his talent, he could at most make a breakthrough to Supreme in half a year.
Being a strong man at a supreme level of ancient strength in less than two years was already terrifying, but unexpectedly, Jack Clark’s cultivation had already broken through to True Spirit Emperor.
Even with Jane Aiken’s recently ‘broad experience’, she was somewhat stupefied at this moment.
Clearly, Jack Clark harbored many secrets unknown to others, such as the identity of a Supreme Hell Plane messenger, obviously, he had contacted the outside very early on.
As for Jack Clark’s current cultivation, though surprising to Jane Aiken, it did not shock her.
She had gotten used to it.
It’s just that currently, their camps are different, and they definitely cannot recognize each other.
At the moment when Jane Aiken recognized Jack Clark, under the throne of the Abyssal Overlord, amid the billions and billions of the marching Dark Demon Legion, one of the Purgatory Demon Gods also showed surprise in their eyes.
Left Demon also felt that the terrifyingly powerful Blood-Colored Battle Spear looked somewhat familiar.
However, unlike Jane Aiken, with little contact with Jack Clark, he did not recognize him at this time.
Just then, observing the blood-colored figure holding the halberd and the majestic figure of Alvaron sitting high on the throne from across the pathway, slowly spoke.
Suddenly, a voice containing terrifying majesty echoed throughout the Plane: “At the True Spirit Initial Stage, half-step with Primordial Force, indeed even I admire it.”
“But in the Endless World, there’s an unwritten rule, the higher talent one has, the faster they die, and genius talents fall at every moment.”
“Today will be no exception.”
As he spoke, Rezafavali slowly lifted his palm, and terrifying blue electric light danced in his claws, gathering to form a sphere like a blue star.
“Today, whoever slays that Hell Messenger, this Primordial Heart will belong to them.”
Immediately the remaining fourteen Abyssal Dark Demons all took a breath, and as they looked towards Jack Clark across the pathway, any hesitation in their eyes disappeared, revealing only murderous intent and madness.
The Primordial Heart, containing the Primordial Origin, a Divine Object higher than the Primordial Force.
If they could refine it, not only would their cultivation greatly enhance, but their True Bodies would also undergo Primordial Tempering, possessing half the characteristics of the Primordial.
Boom!! The fourteen Abyssal Dark Demons, at a True Spirit Level, burst forth with terrifying aura, revealing their True Bodies amidst the Chaotic Void’s overwhelming Dark Demon Air.

chapters.title: Chapter 1768: 653 Absolute Domination, Explode Everything_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1768: Chapter 653 Absolute Domination, Explode Everything_2
Among these, the strongest Abyssal Great Demon emitted an aura even mightier than the Insect Demon, faintly carrying with it the essence of primordial beginning.
This is a Pinnacle of True Spirit, who has even begun to take the crucial step of condensing Primordial Air within its body.
“For the dignity of the Supreme Abyss, this Hell Messenger must die.”
“Let’s join forces and suppress it.” An icy, fierce roar echoed through the Void.
Led by the Abyssal Great Demon, a half-step into the Primordial, fourteen True Spirit Level Demons thunderously charged into the dark-red vortex, preparing to besiege Jack Clark.
As for facing him one-on-one… these Abyssal Great Demons had no such intention.
They are Abyssal Demons, synonymous with cruelty, evil, and all forms of dark power.
In the Rabio World, beneath Jack Clark’s feet flowed a river of blood, with a faint smile appearing on his face as he suppressed the remains of the Abyssal Great Demon, looking somewhat fierce.
He burst the Abyssal Great Demon with one halberd strike, suppressing it but not quickly eradicating it, waiting for this very moment.
Boom!
Endless Abyss Demonic Aura burst forth, and three True Bodies of the Abyssal Great Demons, measuring 190,000 meters, 270,000 meters, and 490,000 meters, respectively, descended.
These Abyssal Great Demons came from different dark races; the “smallest” one among them resembles a Purgatory Demon God, with three heads and eight arms.
The True Spirit over two hundred thousand meters resembled a non-dragon, with six wings on its back.
The strongest one was like a congealed dark-red osseous substance, a terrifying Bone Demon. As it descended, countless sharp bone spurs spontaneously appeared within a radius of a hundred thousand kilometers around it, turning it into Hell.
“Kill!”
No nonsense, right at the moment of their arrival, three Abyssal Great Demons, separated by over four hundred thousand kilometers, brazenly acted.
Boom!
Directly above Jack Clark, the Void shattered, and a colossal blood-colored bone claw extended from it, falling slowly like a massive continental block.
Simultaneously, a force pervaded silently, erasing the Sea of Blood surrounding him, and the power of Supreme Hell, illuminating heaven and earth, also disappeared instantly.
Roar!
A ferocious and tyrannical roar shook heaven and earth; the heavenly dimensions ripped apart, and a creature resembling a fly but also somewhat like a locust, as large as a planet, emerged from the depths of the dimension.
Its sharp mouthparts ignored space, matter, and even the force fields formed by Absolute Divine Power, appearing silently behind Jack Clark.
But at that moment, blood-red lightning leapt around Jack Clark’s body, and his figure explosively enlarged, emitting dazzling blood light painting Heaven and Earth as a Blood Sea Hell.
The Blood Dragon Demon, enlarged to two hundred thousand meters, stood in the Void, roaring skywards.
“Begone!”
Bang! A palm holding Blood Thunderclap struck the Dimensional Demon Insect’s mouthparts, piercing through layers of Void, and crushed it in another dimension.
The terrifying power of Blood Thunderclap, even piercing through dimensions, enveloped the Abyssal Great Demon tens of thousands of meters tall.
The lightning, containing terrifying Rule power, leapt and exploded, continuously shattering the True Body of that Abyssal Great Demon, emitting enraged roars.
Meanwhile, behind Jack Clark, another hand holding the Blood-colored Giant Sun, appeared instantaneously in front of the six-winged, non-dragon Abyssal Great Demon, its radiance blazing.
Boom!
The light from the explosion of the blood-red supernova lit up the heavens and earth, with its terrifying power instantly pulverizing the Abyssal Demon Domain, shattering that Late Stage of True Spirit True Body.
Among the explosive light of Destroying Heaven and Earth, a blood-red Halberd Skill, stretching ten thousand kilometers, soared into the sky.
Wherever the Halberd Skill passed, everything was severed, including the dark-red bone claw containing the strike of Half-Step Primordial Power, leaving an unhealable Abyss a million kilometers long between Heaven and Earth.
As heaven and Earth were divided, Earth Water Wind Fire replayed.
This is the might of the Pseudo-Creation Level Weapon, Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd, which in the hands of Jack Clark, already possessing Unrivaled Domination, burst forth invincible strength.
In the raging storm of Destroy Heaven and Earth, the eyes of the Bone Demon burned with black flames, carrying a hint of solemnity.
Just as Jack Clark destroyed the True Bodies of two Abyssal Great Demons and clashed with the Half-Step Primordial, a surge of True Spirit Level suppression descended amidst the violent airflow.
It was the ten Abyssal Great Demons that followed him in.
At the same time, the two Abyssal Great Demons whose true bodies had been destroyed had their dark red flesh and blood converge in the sky, quickly reshaping their true bodies, albeit their aura was weakened by thirty percent, their facial expressions ferociously unsightly.
The Abyss Bone Demon roared lowly: “Be careful, this Hell Messenger is stronger than we anticipated; his mastered power is extremely overbearing, possessing the characteristic to pulverize and destroy everything.”
“You finally came.” A deep and thick voice vibrated the Void.
Tens of thousands of kilometers away, behind Jack Clark whose aura was soaring, a Heavenly Gate, stained with layers of blood light, emerged, totaling Eight Layers.
As to why it was Eight Layers instead of Nine, it was because consumption below Nine Layers was within the bearable range, and also because surpassing the ‘True Spirit Category’ would be very ‘dangerous.’
In all the horrified gazes of the Abyssal Great Demons, behind that hideous and massive Blood Dragon Demon, the Eight Blood Gates shattered; instantly, a surge of Qi Blood to the extreme burst forth towards the sky.
ROAR ROAR ROAR!!
Eight blood-colored dragon shadows roared fiercely, pouring massively into Jack Clark’s body, causing his aura to surge explosively, emitting a terrifying power that frightened all the great demons.
And all of this occurred within an instant.
Just when Jack Clark’s Eight Layer Heavenly Gate opened, the intangible power emitted instantly shattered the true body of Mills suppressed beneath his feet, sending out a desperate scream under the scorching Blood Qi.
In the extremely radiant red Qi Blood light, a power of Great Destruction descended, and immediately the entire Firmament was engulfed in darkness.
Between Heaven and Earth, only a Hundreds of Thousands of Kilometers long Blood-Red War Halberd spanned across, drawing the destruction power that shattered all things, slowly descending, enveloping all the Abyssal Great Demons.
At this moment, time halted, and Heaven and Earth solidified.
This was a phenomenon where all tangible and intangible material forces like rules, space, and time were suppressed by a much stronger and higher-level power.
If unable to escape, unable to break the imprisoned perception of time, all the Abyssal Great Demons would be destroyed at that frozen moment of consciousness.
“Break, for me!”
During the paused layer of space-time, a roar tinged with shock and anger slowly sounded; the true body of the Bone Demon, reaching tens of thousands of meters, slowly stretched out its double claws, tearing apart the solidified space-time in front of it.
Observing the World Extermination Halberd falling from the sky, the Abyss Bone Demon reached into its chest, yanked out violently, and instantly a fierce and terrifying aura spread across Heaven and Earth.
In the hands of the Abyss Bone Demon, a bone sword built from white bones and entwined with countless living beings’ arms appeared.
Just as the bone sword appeared, the original weak Primordial Intent on the Abyss Bone Demon surged explosively.
“Reverse, all things!”
From the mouth of the Abyss Bone Demon, a sincere low chant was emitted, the sword emitting Black-Red Radiance, twisting Heaven, Earth, and all material and rules, slowly confronting the World Extermination Halberd on the paused layer of space-time.
Silently and soundlessly, the two weapons possessing terrifying power intersected in the Void.
Just barely resisting, in the unbelieving gaze of the Abyss Bone Demon, the bone sword that carried its ‘Path,’ carrying all its power, shattered.
“How is this possible, your power!”
BOOM BOOM BOOM!!
The furious and terrified roar of the Abyss Bone Demon echoed across Heaven and Earth; under the strike of Extermination, including the Abyss Bone Demon, all fourteen Abyssal Great Demons’ true bodies exploded.
The terrifying power even pulverized, destroyed millions of kilometers of Heaven and Earth, penetrating layers of space, revealing the twisted depths of the World Crystal Wall.
Almost reaching the limit of True Spirit, just a bit short of stepping into Primordial, the power even caused the dark red vortex to violently shake.
Overbearing, invincible, this was Jack Clark’s dominance in the same realm.
Without a match.
Such power, instantly caused Rezafavali, who was seated on the throne in another world, to suddenly stand up, eyes revealing a horrified gaze.
