Including on the other side of the World, Alvaron, who was watching this battle, also showed astonishment.
Of course, what astonished them was not Jack Clark’s battle strength nearing Primordial, as in front of them, the lords of a Supreme Plane, even a Primordial Star-Level existence couldn’t withstand a single blow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1769: 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 1769: Chapter 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle
“Multiple Limits of Strength overlapping, no wonder his strength surpasses his realm by so much.”
Looking at the fierce figure standing with a halberd and surrounded by blood light in Rabio World, Rezafavali’s gaze was tremendously cold, and a terrifying aura pervaded.
Jane Aiken looked up in confusion, gazing at the immense figure that seemed like a constellation: “Master, what do you mean by that?”
Rezafavali slowly lowered his head, his voice resonating through space and time: “This Hell Messenger has mastered multiple types of powers, each one reaching the Strongest Sequence, and they amplify each other.”
“Whereas most cultivators and Transcendent Lives possess only one strongest power.”
“For example, at the breakthrough point of ancient times, forging the Supreme Rule with four top-tier laws at the core or creating the Supreme True Body from everything, or the Great Divine Power that is innately bestowed.”
“Those who can break through to True Spirit, have pushed one type of power to its limits; any other rules, talents, Divine Powers, and Secret Skills they possess are merely one of the cornerstones of that power.”
“But in this Hell Messenger, I see a peerless True Body within the same rank, an overbearing Rule of Power, another power-like Divine Power that is no less than the Rule of Power, and some ancient and powerful Dragon Bloodline Power.”
“Apart from these, there are some slightly weaker powers, also forged within.”
“All these are related to ‘power,’ stacking on top of each other, pushing his sheer power to the pinnacle, granting him Absolute Domination within his realm.”
“Whether it is at the Late Stage of True Spirit or a half-step into Primordial, as long as the power hasn’t broken the boundary and stepped into Primordial, none are his match.”
“Even Bone Demon Hepote, who has touched the Primordial Force, his Ten Thousand Bones Power mighty as it may be, is no match and cannot withstand his strike.”
“This kind of existence, having refined multiple types of powers to their extreme without any weaknesses, is extremely rare in the Endless World.”
At this point, Rezafavali’s tone inexplicably took on a grave note.
Peerless within the same rank at the True Spirit Initial Stage, such exaggerated combat strength, even if there is a decline upon breaking through to the Primordial, the combat power is still enough to rival a Monarch of The Third Day.
As long as he does not fall, he is almost certainly able to step into the Fourth Heavenly Realm True Emperor, and possibly achieve the Seventh Heavenly Eternal Realm.
If such a ‘person’ cannot be strangled in the cradle, then he must not be offended at all costs.
Thinking this, a terrifying intent to kill flowed in Rezafavali’s eyes, but then he slowly suppressed it, his gaze towards Rabio World turning dark and elusive.
“So it is, with more than four types of extreme powers, no wonder he’s so strong!” Jane Aiken exclaimed, now understanding why Jack Clark’s cultivation grew higher, and his power became even stronger.
His terrifying cultivation talent allowed him to refine every power obtained at the breakthrough to the extreme, and mutually amplify them.
At this moment, Rezafavali spoke slowly, encouragingly: “Young Aiken, do not belittle yourself. Your Fusion Sword Intent is not weak; forging the Supreme Rule is inevitable when breaking through ancient times.”
“Combined with the Primordial Abyssal Sword Dragon power in your body, and that Sword Diagram forged of the Laws World, the three together can instantaneously augment Hundred-fold Power.”
“Aside from combat, after absorbing the Heavenly Pure Origin and upgrading, your comprehension talent actually has greater potential. With my protection, the future will certainly see you stepping into Primordial.”
Of course, just Primordial.
In the Endless World, a Primordial Level existence is already one that suppresses a collective of worlds, with a supreme status, serving as the source of creation for that world.
But many with unparalleled talents exhaust all their intrinsic potential the moment they break through to Primordial, unable to advance further for millions of years.
Therefore, although Rezafavali is confident in nurturing Jane Aiken into a ruler of a layer of the Abyss, how far she can go after breaking through to Primordial is uncertain.
And the difference between the Primordial First Day Realm, the Fourth Day Realm, and the Seventh Day Realm is as vast as that between heaven and earth, not to mention reaching the end of Primordial.
An existence that shines across myriad worlds and realms.
Jane Aiken bowed slightly: “Thank you, Master, for your cultivation and kindness, your disciple will definitely strive hard in her cultivation.”
This Abyssal Overlord treated her well, thus Jane Aiken was very respectful in her attitude.
Of course, it is also possible that Rezafavali had other motives in taking her as a disciple, but these do not matter; for now, she will rely on its power to break through to Primordial.
Primordial, for the past Ancient Realm which represented the strongest in the Human Federation, was an inconceivable realm.
Given Jane Aiken’s past talents, although confident in breaking through to ancient, reaching the end of life likely signals the end at the True Spirit Realm.
Therefore, becoming a disciple of this Abyssal Overlord was more advantageous than disadvantageous for her.
Moreover, her father, as a ‘true’ Purgatory True Demon, the Infinite Abyss suited him too, and relying on the power of the Abyss, there was also a hope to step into True Spirit.
As the former Child of Destiny of Blue Star, Left Demon’s talent was even higher than individuals like Adam Garcetti.
Only, lured by Tyris and under the despair brought by the presence of Purgatory ancestors, he took a wrong step, and his soul and True Body split into three, wasting over a decade.
Now, with Left Demon’s three-in-one reintegration, along with three ancient relics within his body imbued with Rule powers, his combat power was peerless within the Ancient Realm.
In the midst of the conversation between the two ‘people’, another anomaly arose in Rabio World.

chapters.title: Chapter 1770: 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1770: Chapter 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle_2
Lifeforms at the True Spirit level incarnate rules, already possessing a fraction of the Undying and Inexhaustible traits.
Without entering the World Annihilation Heavenly Dragon Form, Jack Clark’s halberd only caused these Abyssal Great Demons’ True Bodies to burst, but it only inflicted minor injuries on them.
The Abyss Bone Demon, whose True Body swelled to 400,000 meters, like an ancient Divine Mountain, growled, “This Hell Messenger is too strong, we must coordinate offense and defense to stand a chance.”
Another Abyssal Great Demon, emanating the aura of the Late Stage of True Spirit, with a fierce appearance, growled, “I don’t believe his Limit Breakthrough state can exhaust all of our Origins.”
The terrifying strength displayed by Jack Clark nearly drove these Abyssal Great Demons to despair.
But, as beings that have survived countless slaughters and ascended to the True Spirit realm, every single Abyssal Great Demon possessed a will of steel, and they adjusted their mindset in an instant.
Then, they found Jack Clark’s weakness.
At the Initial Stage of True Spirit, yet bursting out with invincible strength that crushed all of the same level, Jack Clark was indeed mightily powerful in this form, but the consumption must also be unimaginably horrendous.
As long as they burned their Origins and cooperated to defend, dragging on until Jack Clark’s strength was exhausted, there was hope to suppress him.
As for retreating?
Under the watch of the Abyssal Overlord, these Abyssal Great Demons did not dare to retreat without orders.
And there was also the reward of the Primordial Heart; if one could obtain the Primordial Heart, there was hope to break the shackles of life and a chance to become an Abyssal Overlord.
“My World-Commanding Divine Ability could forcibly mobilize the One-side World’s Power into a pure defensive barrier, as long as heaven and earth exist, so shall the World-Commanding Barrier.”
“My Nine Nether True King Decree burns the Origin, and can enhance all Divine Powers, temporarily boosting their potency by sixteen times.”
“And me, my Demon Scale Alien Race from the Firmament specializes in Defense, mastering the Heavy Element Rule, melding all the worlds’ forces with rules to strengthen the heavy armor.”
Boom boom boom! Heaven and Earth trembled, as the strength of the world within tens of millions of kilometers was forcibly converged.
Led by an Abyssal Great Demon resembling a 230,000-meter tall, mountain-moving black turtle, and aided by four other Great Demons skilled in defensive rules and Divine Powers, a Black Scale Heavy Mountain stretching tens of thousands of kilometers across and penetrating the ends of the Firmament emerged.
At the moment this massive mountain descended, covering all the Abyssal Great Demons, covering the Abyssal Channel, a heavy force that suppressed space-time filled the surrounding.
The raging cascades, affecting millions of kilometers, suddenly dispersed, revealing the constantly shattering and self-repairing space, like a mirror covered with countless Black Cracks.
At the same time, the other nine Abyssal Great Demons attacked simultaneously, the light of Rule Mysteries and Abyssal Divine Powers enveloping a million kilometers, casting the world into darkness.
Under that overpowering and malevolent force, the just-repaired Heaven and Earth collapsed again, and rules dissipated.
“Overestimating oneself, like a mantis trying to stop a chariot,” a deep and dignified voice echoed through space-time, followed immediately by an explosively powerful and dominating aura.
Boom!
Heaven and Earth shook, a War Halberd Skill stretching hundreds of thousands of kilometers cleaved through the darkness, where it passed, earth, water, wind, fire reconstituted, all things returned to Chaos.
Under the crimson Blood Colored Battle Spear, all attacks from the Abyssal Great Demons were shattered by a surge of power.
Wielding the terrifying might that could annihilate a Great Thousand Worlds, the Blood Colored Battle Spear slashed at an unparalleled speed over the Black Scale Heavy Mountain formed by the joint effort of the five Abyssal Great Demons.
Bang! Unstoppable, and irrepressible, the mountain range covering tens of thousands of kilometers crumbled, immediately followed by an explosion of endless crimson Halberd Skills.
“Be careful!”
Shocking, angry, and fearful screams echoed through heaven and earth, the five chief Abyssal Great Demons were the first to be struck, their True Bodies burst again, destroyed by the power contained in the Halberd Skills.
The other six True Bodies also exploded under the sweep of the residual forces.
Only three of the strongest Abyssal Great Demons, including the Abyss Bone Demon, spat blood while flying back hundreds of thousands of kilometers, shaking heaven and earth, with the roar of explosion and destruction echoing endlessly.
With a casual strike, shattering the fourteen Abyssal Great Demons in that instant, Jack Clark’s figure moved, traversing over three hundred thousand kilometers to appear above a head of an Abyssal Great Demon.
Not waiting for that Abyssal Great Demon to reconstitute its True Body, two hands had already emerged behind Jack Clark, clawing downwards at the collapsing area of the Heavenly Earth Rules.
Boom boom boom! Under the covering Rule of Power, tens of thousands of kilometers of Void collapsed, space was shattered, endless red flames converged.
“Save me.” A piercing scream echoed between heaven and earth.
Above the palms behind Jack Clark, a blood-colored sun with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers, emanating endless light and heat, illuminated heaven and earth.
Deep within the blood-colored sun, a shattered figure of more than two hundred thousand meters was being grinded away by bloody lightning, emitting pitiful screams.
And it wasn’t just this Abyssal Great Demon.
Tens of thousands of kilometers away, at Jack Clark’s original position, a Sea of Blood stretching over tens of thousands of kilometers roared, below it also suppressing an Abyssal Great Demon with only half its True Body left.
This was the Great Demon that had first descended, whose aura was now increasingly weakening under the oppression.
“I don’t believe that your strength can maintain its peak forever.”
Boom!
The Void exploded, a dark-red figure of over five hundred thousand meters tall, like a gigantic skeleton, appeared, its aura emanating an utterly terrifying Destructive Aura.
As a being that had condensed the Primordial Air within its body, a True Body even fortified once by the Primordial Air, the Abyss Bone Demon, repeatedly blown apart by Jack Clark’s halberd, now raged immensly.
Its anger was not due to its True Body being shattered, but rather, it was furious as to why and what basis did that Hell Messenger have such staggering strength.
At the True Spirit Initial Stage, to actually crush an existence like itself that had touched upon the Primordial, being beaten repeatedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1771: 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1771: Chapter 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle_3
It doesn’t surrender, why should it?
After a million years of cultivation, has the realm been cultivated only to serve dogs?
Boom!
The Blood Colored Battle Spear, excessively overbearing, shakes the ages, shattering the hundred-million-meter-long Blood Abyssal Demon Sword along with the skeletons encircled by the Dark Red Star Ring.
In the instant that Jack Clark burst the Abyss Bone Demon with a strike, he swept horizontally with the halberd, and within the trembling of the Halberd Skill, endless mysteries were contained.
Boom boom boom!!
Within the area, six freshly condensed True Body Abyssal Great Demons were burst once again; the tremendous strength even pierced through Space-Time, forming a grand spectacle of Heaven and Earth being parted.
“I do not accept this!”
“Kill.”
The roars from over a dozen Abyssal Great Demons shook Heaven and Earth.
At this moment, half of the Rabio World trembled, the battlefield impacted tens of millions of kilometers, and the combat residual waves containing the power of rules destroyed everything in the vicinity.
But in the face of Jack Clark, who wielded the Eight Desolations World-Destroying Halberd, these Abyssal Great Demons couldn’t take a single strike; they were almost dead upon touch, and burst upon contact.
At this moment, Jack Clark, with the strength of one, suppressed over a dozen Abyssal Great Demons, resembling an invincible War God, unrivaled in all directions.
Such world-shocking combat power, seen by Alvaron, the Abyssal Overlord, whose gaze flickered, was even more intimidating to all True Spirit Level beings in another battlefield.
Be it those Ancient Elemental Gods, Great Clan War Gods, or Hell Messengers, they all subconsciously slowed down their attacks, looking towards the sky.
Though distant, these Hell Messengers couldn’t see the exact scene over there.
But through the pervasive Chaos Rule pressure between Heaven and Earth, they could still sense the general situation of the battlefield.
Boom!
In the battlefield above, the Blood-coloured Giant Sun gathered in Jack Clark’s hands; he suppressed and sealed a True Spirit mid-period Abyssal Great Demon along with the shattered Heaven and Earth spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
This was the third Abyssal Great Demon that Jack Clark had suppressed in a short period.
Without anyone intervening to rescue them, their fate would only be annihilation of their True Bodies and the grinding away of their Divine Soul Intents.
This made the remaining twelve Abyssal Great Demons extremely angry, as well as fearful.
Then, various trump cards were used all at once, ignoring the depletion, burning Origin to burst forth with shocking power, attempting to break the two Great Suns hanging in the Firmament and the Sea of Blood below.
Of course, their intention to save those three Abyssal Great Demons wasn’t due to ‘righteousness,’ but because if they didn’t, they might be next.
But it was futile.
Boom boom boom!! Under that all-scourging, supremely disdainful Blood Colored Halberd Skill, everything was blasted away.
No matter how powerful the Rule, summoned worlds from another dimension, or some ancient and powerful relic weapon, all were shattered.
Soon, the third Blood Red Giant Sun ascended into the sky, and the fourth Abyssal Great Demon was suppressed.
Watching this scene, Rezafavali, who sat high on his throne beyond the world, had no intention to intervene, just silently observed with cold eyes.
Like those Hell Messengers, Abyssal Great Demons are agents from other worlds and civilizations of the Supreme Plane.
These agents do not fall under the jurisdiction or command of Rezafavali, the Abyssal Overlord.
These Abyssal Great Demons were gathered from various layers of the Abyss and other worlds through an inter-planar notice when the Plane Wars were about to commence.
Therefore, even if all were to die, it meant nothing to him.
At this moment, Rezafavali only wanted to use these Abyssal Great Demons to gauge the entirety of that Hell Messenger’s ‘strength’ and consider whether to obliterate him with the might of a Thunderbolt, or to ‘ignore’ him.
Just then, a deep voice echoed from the Chaos Void: “Rezafavali, the last time I confronted you was over fifty thousand years ago.”
“Today, upon meeting again, let me see if you have progressed over the years.”
Chaos exploded, endless blood light spread along the boundary walls of the Rabio World, turning half of the Chaos red like Hell descending.
Or rather, that was Supreme Hell.
Unexpectedly, Alvaron did not wait for the outcome within the world before making a move, Rezafavali paused, then centered on it, an endless burst of Dark Demon Air erupted.
“If you want battle, then let’s battle, Alvaron.”
Boom! Chaos trembled, the firmament sunk.
The two Abyssal Overlords, Lords of Hell, possessed unimaginably potent strength, their power already supreme with the support of the Supreme Plane.
Being too powerful, beings like Jane Aiken within the Abyss Plane couldn’t see the battle clearly.
They could only see the berserk Chaos unfolding layer upon layer of Abyss and Hellish Worlds, forming layers of infinite depths into Space-Time, deep into Chaos.
In addition, there was an almost imperceptible, supremely oppressive Aura that frightened all Abyss Dark Demons.
In the meantime, at the instant the two Overlords clashed, the merely partially arrived Supreme Abyss and Supreme Hell shook violently, endless blood light and Dark Red Glow spreading.
Including the Earth, which also extended infinitely, at the intersection of Chaos, akin to two massive boundless continents colliding.
“Kill.”
“Annihilate those Hell Devils.”
“Nineteenth Legion Dark Demons, follow me as we enter Hell.”
The instant the Planes connected, countless Abyss Dark Demon Legions and Hell Devils roared forth, like two world-destroying Tsunamis clashing against each other.
Immediately, beyond the Rabio World, an even more gruesome great war erupted, the cries of battle shook the heavens.
Simultaneously, as the power of the two Supreme Planes spread, permeating Space-Time, the entire Rabio World was enveloped by blood light and Dark Red Glow, as if Doomsday had descended.
Even due to the erosion of Supreme Power, the crystal wall of the Rabio World continuously dematerialized, revealing scenes of countless Abyssal Demons and Hell Devils fiercely battling beyond the heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 1772: 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 1772: Chapter 654: Ten Days Across the Sky, the Ultimate Battle_4
And Jack Clark, who suppressed over a dozen Abyssal Great Demons by his own strength, glanced up at the sky in an instant, and saw the Left Demon on the battlefield with his formidable power at first glance.
He saw in the deep rear of the Abyssal army, under the towering throne that stood deep in space-time, the red-haired girl looking over the battlefield.
Jane Aiken, why is she here!? Suddenly, even Jack Clark was somewhat stunned.
On the battlefield of the Heavenly Feather decisive battle, Jane Aiken followed the Left Demon into the Deep Red World, and Jack Clark had also considered whether she might fall there.
But thinking of the Left Demon’s ‘talent’ and strength, Jack Clark felt that as long as they were careful, they should be alright in the Deep Red World.
But he didn’t expect to see them from such a distant space-time, far from the mythical world, and they had also joined the Supreme Abyss.
Just as Jack Clark looked up at the sky, his terrifying gaze penetrated everything and fell on Jane Aiken, wondering whether he should rush out to save them.
Suddenly, Jane Aiken’s lips moved slightly, without sound, but Jack Clark could understand from the movements of her lips that she was saying, “Jack Clark, don’t worry about me, I’m fine.”
She can actually see me. Surprise once again appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes.
Separated by one Plane and a far distance, as well as the Boundary Wall of the Great Thousand Worlds, Jane Aiken could actually see that he was watching her and notice the changes in his gaze.
It seems that the half-year separation allowed this amazing and brilliant girl to significantly improve her cultivation.
But now that Jane Aiken has said she was fine, Jack Clark set his mind at ease and directed his attention back to the battlefield.
As for the masters’ battle on the Supreme Plane outside the firmament, such a high-level fight had nothing to do with him; he was just a True Spirit Apostle with relatively strong power.
Boom! The Firmament shook, Chaos surged.
Under the Blood Colored Battle Spear containing absolute strength, the True Bodies of those Abyssal Great Demons were blasted to pieces time after time, their collected auras diminishing each round.
As a result, a Blood-coloured Giant Sun, with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers, slowly rose, its fiery blood light illuminating Heaven and Earth.
The fifth suppressed Abyssal Great Demon.
To prevent the other Abyssal Great Demons from being frightened away, after sealing these few, Jack Clark only infused a stream of the Rule of Power’s Origin to slowly erode their True Bodies.
Thus, the erosion was slow, predicted to take ten days to half a month to completely annihilate them.
The effect was quite good; at least until now, none of those Abyssal Great Demons had fled, all hoping to drag out until Jack Clark was exhausted and then counterattack and suppress him.
But just then, the entire Rabio World shook tremendously.
Under the battle of the two masters drawing on the might of the Supreme Plane, the terrible Supreme Power shook space-time, penetrated the world, and completely rendered the Rabio World a dark red.
Instantly within the world, the Auras of all the Hell Messengers and the Abyssal Great Demons surged by one-tenth.
Conversely, the willpower and the might of the Rabio World plummeted, even being suppressed bit by bit by the power of the Supreme Plane, causing the White Light on those from different races to dim.
And this was not the most desperate.
One could see in the sky like a Demon Cloud of Sea of Blood, dense Abyss Dark Demons, and huge, fierce Hell Devils penetrating the world, falling from the sky.
“Cackling!”
“Kill, kill all the ‘humans’.” Evil, bloodthirsty, and cruel roars echoed through Heaven and Earth.
With gains and losses, the already overpowered Rabio World army began to collapse, and the entire world fell into endless slaughter full of despairing screams.
Including the eight already heavily injured Ancient Gods, their faces drastically changed: “We can’t hold on, everyone retreat! Head to the Bonaster World pathway.”
Suddenly, the battlefield was stirred in agitation.
Amidst the chaos, one of the White Wing Tribe Divine Kings, covered in blood and weak in Aura, shouted in fury: “Ancient God Filippo, isn’t the Divine King taking action yet?”
Surrounded by black Thunder, the Thunder Ancient God, who had already charged tens of thousands of kilometers, paused, looked back at those entangled deities, and said, “The Divine King, has fallen 13,000 years ago.”
“What!?”
“How is that possible?”
“But what about that Divine Aura we felt earlier?”
Instantly, various expressions of shock, despair, and anger appeared on the faces of the deities of all races.
Another Ancient Elemental God spoke in a deep voice: “That was the world’s will imitating the Divine Aura, just to inspire everyone to fight hard and drive out the invaders.”
“But we never expected… the invading force from the Supreme Plane to be so powerful!”
Saying this, a wry smile appeared on all the Ancient Elemental Gods’ faces.
In the past, although they had also heard some legends of the Supreme Plane in other worlds, they had never imagined the Supreme Plane’s invasion
[More editing needed, one more chapter to go]

chapters.title: Chapter 1773: 655: Tearing the World Apart, The Great War Ends
chapters.content:
Chapter 1773: Chapter 655: Tearing the World Apart, The Great War Ends
“Mythical-level Abyssal Demon King, actually has two Origin rewards?”
“Approximately ten thousand demonized subordinates above the Sixth-Level Heaven can make up one Origin, killing those below the sixth tier elicits no response.”
“Indeed, one Abyssal Great Demon King rewarded thirty Origins, which can now be converted into more than thirty Origin Points.”
Under the dark red sky, tens of millions of kilometers are nearly blasted into chaos, with Jack Clark emitting endless blood light from his body, suppressing Heaven and Earth.
Under that overbearing Blood-Colored Battle Spear, each Abyssal Great Demon that gathers its rule-bound True Body is blasted apart.
Moreover, the Opening-the-Heavens edge contained in the battle spear leaves indelible, tearing scars on those Abyssal Great Demons, obliterating parts of their will.
As this accumulates, the aura of these Abyssal Great Demons becomes increasingly weak.
However, Jack Clark did not completely slay them; instead, he used these roaring Abyssal Great Demons as bait, continuously calling their subordinates left in the Abyss Plane to gather.
These are all money, no, Origin.
Made a fortune, a bloody fortune.
Looking at the skyrocketing Origin Points on the attribute page, and the ever-strengthening Despair Power surrounding his battle armor, a fierce smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face covered with blood-colored scales.
Kill, the more he kills, the greater the rewards.
At this moment, not only Jack Clark, but the Hell Messengers are also engaged in a grand slaughter, whether it is the Rabio World’s Alliance Army or the Abyssal Demons falling from the sky, all are blasted apart.
And this, is the true face of a Plane Battlefield, where one-side world has a sea of blood surging to the sky.
This time, because fifteen Abyssal Great Demons were suppressed by Jack Clark alone, it caused a shortage of high-end forces on the side of the Abyss Plane, leaving only the rampant laughter of Hell Messengers.
“Hahaha… Truly a strong man from the Eternal World, with Senator Darren Callum, these Abyssal fellows are getting utterly defeated.”
Bang! Amidst laughter, Boroedo smashed the Void with a fist, blasting apart the True Body of an Earth Divine King.
Other Hell Messengers also showed faint smiles and then slaughtered those Abyssal Demons, the People-Ape Army of Caesar, and deities even more crazily.
This battle lasted for three days and three nights, to the west of Rabio World, the direction entering from this side, the Abyssal Demons killed by Jack Clark were somewhat sparse.
At the same time, ten Blood-Colored Giant Suns spanned the sky, each suppressing a heavily injured Abyssal Great Demon on the verge of death.
Additionally, with the one suppressed under the Blood Sea Field, Mills, fifteen True Spirit demon beasts were suppressed by Jack Clark by more than half, leaving only the strongest like the Abyss Bone Demon, among four.
Four beings, half-consumed by Origin burning, True Spirit demon beasts with huge cracks all over the True Body.
Jack Clark tread on time, wandering above the firmament of this world at a terrifying speed, suppressing demons like the Abyss Bone Demon, while calculating the time.
“Calculating the time, these guys should be dealt with by now, delaying might lead to unexpected changes.”
Jack Clark naturally hasn’t forgotten that there is a horrifying Abyssal Overlord outside this world.
Although he does not know the outcome of the battle deep in space-time, Jack feels that there shouldn’t be a huge winner, after all, both are masters of a Supreme Plane.
Unless both sides fight to the death desperately.
But for a ‘regular level’ Great Thousand World, two Plane Masters probably wouldn’t fight to such an extent, after all, just earning ‘that little bit’ isn’t worth fighting desperately.
Just as Jack Clark’s gaze turned cold, preparing to make a move.
Boom! The entire Rabio World started crazily shaking.
Outside the world, two pairs of Supreme Plane powers manifesting as black-red and blood-colored double claws penetrate space-time, slowly tearing the Rabio World apart.
And this tear is not only the World Crystal Wall but also the entire conceptual meaning of ‘Heaven and Earth’.
From a distance, a slow red crack appears in the sky of the entire world, with two-thirds of its area enveloped in blood light.
Suddenly, everyone knew that the great battle was about to end.
The two Planar Overlords would forcibly tear apart the world, swallowing it into the Supreme Plane to end the war.
The heavily injured four Abyss Bone Demons dismissed a sigh of relief on their faces, preparing to harness the Power of the Abyss to retreat.
“Stay right where you are.”
Boom!
Dazzling blood light shone, and behind Jack Clark, the ninth Blood Gate emerged, instantly causing a drastic change in the expressions of the four Abyssal Great Demons.
Those Abyssal Great Demons, suppressed within ten Great Suns, their true bodies partially obliterated, all revealed a disbelief and horror in their eyes.
Naturally, these demons clearly remembered, previously Jack Clark shattered the Eight Layer in one breath, his strength surged by a hundred or two hundred times instantly, being peerless within the same rank, annihilating everything.
Unexpectedly, this Secret Skill form of his still had a ninth gate.
Before those Abyssal Great Demons could react, the Ninth-Layered Heavenly Gate behind Jack Clark shattered, and an Apocalypse Blood Dragon containing immense and vast Qi Blood roared out.
Boom!
Instantly Jack Clark’s True Body skyrocketed again, transforming into a 250,000-meter-tall Blood Dragon Demon God, his whole body turned into blood light, emitting an extremely dazzling glow.
Also, there was an extremely ferocious aura that entered the Primordial Stars Realm, pervading the entire world.
The entire Plane Battlefield suddenly quieted down, all existences above the ancient level looked towards the horizon.
“Primordial!”
Boom, boom, boom!!
The War Halberd swept across, exploding the ten Blood-colored Giant Suns in the sky, the true bodies of the suppressed Abyssal Great Demons inside obliterated, their Divine Soul Intents shattered emitting screams of despair.
Simultaneously, a greyish-red grindstone appeared in the sky, covering and darkening a range of one hundred thousand kilometers.
The Death Grindstone slowly rotated, emitting an extremely powerful force of Death, defining death for the crushed spirits of those Abyssal Great Demons, turning their True Bodies into a mist of blood.
“Gone too far.”
A deep and terrifying voice echoed across all of Space-Time, as Jack Clark’s halberd exploded everything, and Blood Soul Chains like Heavenly Dragons tore through the Void, an utmost powerful force descended.
Boom! The Rabio World’s Firmament darkened, a huge dark-red demon claw reached in from beyond the skies.
But the target wasn’t Jack Clark, instead, it grabbed the four heavily-injured, dying Abyssal Great Demons, pulling them back into the Abyss Plane.
Seeing this, Jack Clark took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the urge to open the Tenth Heavenly Gate and enter his strongest form.
Quit while ahead.
Eh!
Seeing that Rezafavali did not initiate a probe attack, a slap to kill Jack Clark, Alvaron, who was already prepared to intercept, was a bit surprised.
This guy, was he also cautious of Darren Callum.
The light flickered in Alvaron’s eyes, roughly guessing the intention of that Abyssal Overlord.
It was simple, with Alvaron present, Rezafavali was not 100% confident in eradicating Darren Callum, and thus, definitely could not afford to make a lethal enemy.
Otherwise, given the terrifying fighting strength Jack Clark exhibited, once he later breaks through to Primordial, breaking through the Fourth Heavenly Realm, even Rezafavali might not be his match.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the power of the two Supreme Planes, the vast and immense Rabio World eventually split into two, like meteors slowly falling into two ‘worlds’.
The great battle, ended.

chapters.title: Chapter 1774: 656
chapters.content:
Chapter 1774: Chapter 656
Chaos Void, endless blood-colored light and Dark Red Glow spread like two enormous, indescribable ghastly maws, slowly devouring the Rabio World that was torn in half.
Jack Clark, with a true body towering over two hundred thousand meters tall, like a divine mountain propping up the skies, held a War Halberd, his body aglow with resplendent blood light as he stood at the edge of the rupture.
Surrounding him, black dust swirled across the sky, exuding infinite despair and withering.
This dust was the true essence of the Abyssal Great Demons that had exploded, their will to live ground into oblivion by the Death Grindstone, covering tens of thousands of kilometers.
From afar, it resembled a silent kingdom of only drifting ashes, making Jack Clark, clad in his ferocious blood-colored battle armor, immensely terrifying.
Looking at the continuous consolidation of white energy around him, Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel emotional: “This plane war, it ended so quickly.”
In this great battle, he had slaughtered eleven True Spirit Level Abyssal Great Demons, one Ancient God, and about more than a billion subordinates and devils of level two and above.
However, only those Abyssal Demons of sixth-tier or above, upon being slain, provided rewards, ultimately granting Jack Clark over ninety thousand points of Origin.
Calculating it, that amounted to slaying seven True Spirit Level Ancient Gods.
Of course, this was a boon of the Plane Battlefield, a reward for slaying the demonized beings extended by the enemy forces of the Supreme Plane.
Otherwise, even if Jack Clark slaughtered ten times more True Spirit Level powerful beings and Transcendent Life forms in the Chaos Void, he wouldn’t collect even a trace of World Origin energy.
Feeling the Origin continuously integrating within his body, Jack Clark looked up ahead.
There, in the space-time rift, a Chaotic Destruction Flow that could grind True Spirit beings to dust pervaded. As for the Abyss Plane, it had disappeared.
Jack Clark was also somewhat curious, curious about why Jane Aiken and Left Demon were in the Abyss Plane, and by the looks of it, held significant status.
But under the gaze of the Abyssal Overlord, Jack Clark dared not blindly contact Jane Aiken directly.
There was no choice, in the plane battlefield, he stood for Hell, a stance that could not be defied, so he could only wait for a future opportunity to make contact in private.
As for Jane Aiken and Left Demon joining the Abyss, Jack Clark felt indifferent.
In the past, the enemies of the Human Federation were the Purgatory Demon Race, those Purgatory Demon Gods, and ancestors with Purgatory bloodlines, not the Supreme Abyss Plane.
Their mutual grievances also vanished with the fall of the Purgatory ancestors.
Including this time Jack Clark’s participation in the Plane Battlefield, slashing down a large number of Abyssal Great Demons and billions of demons, gave the mid and high levels of Hell an edge.
But once the plane war is over, and Jack Clark returns, his ‘grievance’ with the Abyss will also temporarily dissipate.
In the Endless World, the four Supreme Planes do not antagonize any ‘person,’ do not antagonize any world; everything operates according to the Supreme Rules.
Much like the indifferent Heavenly Dao, treating all equally.
As for those Lords of Hell, Abyssal Overlords, they are merely the will executors of the Supreme Plane.
As Jack Clark was deep in thought, analyzing his gains from this plane war, his gaze shifted slightly. In his eyes, the world being devoured by Hell was disintegrating.
Rocks, dirt, trees, rivers, and even space, Heavenly Earth Law, rules, all were decomposing one by one under the blood-colored light, disintegrating.
This sight was horrifying.
The whole world was fading, losing color, even dropping from higher dimensions to lower dimensions, transforming into a two-dimensional plane, a one-dimensional line…
In the end, the entire Rabio World vanished within the blood light, and Jack Clark reappeared in the lofty Crimson Demon Palace.
Including the other Hell Messengers, their subordinates, and the Hell Devil army, they too materialized on the boundless blood-colored land in front of the Demon Palace.
Seeing this, Jack Clark willed himself out of the Dark Star Form, his body shrank rapidly, the red light dissipated, eventually returning to normal human size.
Phew!! Feeling a faint sense of weakness from within, Jack Clark took a deep breath.
Although he had made a breakthrough to True Spirit, and his rule-true body could ignore the consumption of the Eight Layer Heaven’s gate, the Dark Star Form of the Ninth Heavens still greatly burdened him.
Not to mention the tenth-layer Dark Star Apocalypse Heavenly Dragon Form, that was his trump card.
Boom!
The Heaven and Earth shook, an eighty-thousand-meter-tall giant crushed the Earth, its presence like a Mountains and Seas shaking tsunami arriving in front of Jack Clark, its massive head lowering, eyes revealing curiosity and awe.
“Darren Callum council member, are all True Spirits from your Eternal World this powerful?”
Jack Clark slowly began, “Actually, my world is not as exaggerated as you imagine, I am also among the ‘stronger’ of the True Spirits there.”
“I see.”
Boroedo breathed a sigh of relief, “You gave me quite the scare. I thought all the living beings of the Eternal World were so powerful, killing their equals as easily as killing a Moro (a dog-like creature).”
“But council member Darren truly comes from the Eternal World; thanks to you, in this plane war, it is rare for none of us to fall or suffer heavy injuries.”
“Indeed, we owe this plane war to council member Darren.”
“For you suppressed all the Abyssal Great Demons, allowing us to resolve those Ancient Gods so easily.”
As they spoke, five out of the thirteen Hell Messengers, exuding True Spirit late-period Aura, gathered around, their tones respectful, tinged with a hint of awe.
Plane wars are exceedingly brutal; even True Spirit level Hell Messengers cannot guarantee their safety.
After all, their foes are equals in strength, possibly including primordial beings, along with those Abyssal Great Demons not inferior in strength to them.
Each of these beings, in their death throes, could inflict a heavy blow.

chapters.title: Chapter 1775: 656
chapters.content:
Chapter 1775: Chapter 656
Surrounded by six Hell Messengers, Jack Clark shook his head: “Gentlemen, you are mistaken, our ability to win is mainly due to the great Lord of Alvaron.”
“If it weren’t for the great Lord of Alvaron, even if we could suppress all the Abyssal Great Demons it would be futile.”
This is the Supreme Hell Plane, and for a terrifyingly powerful Plane Sovereign like Alvaron, Jack Clark naturally spared no compliments.
“Ha ha ha ha… Darren Callum, the councilman, is being too modest,” Boroedo laughed, appearing like a straightforward, robust man.
“The outcome of the Plane Battlefield is naturally determined by the great Lord of Alvaron, but we cannot overlook your contribution this time.”
The head of the Caesar Ancient God, held by the Mountain Giant Boroedo, suddenly trembled, emanating a strong Divine Soul Intent resistance power.
Hmph!
The Mountain Giant immediately let out a cold hum, his hand exploding with a blood-like strength, containing immense might, which once again suppressed that head of the ancient god.
Thousands of meters in size, resembling the head of a Furious Ape with blood flowing and eyes filled with despair, the image was strangely ferocious.
Holding the ancient god’s head, the Mountain Giant slowly spoke, his voice thunderously resonating: “Sorry to let Councilman Darren see such a spectacle.”
They are not Jack Clark; for them, slaughtering an equal counterpart, like the Hell Messengers far from here busy suppressing and obliterating those remnants of Ancient Elemental Gods, is difficult.
Crackle Crackle!!
Soon, cracks appeared on the Caesar Ancient God’s head held by the Mountain Giant, gradually petrifying.
As the last breath of that ancient god disappeared, the entire head turned completely into a massive rock, then was crushed by the Mountain Giant’s claw.
Boom! The sky filled with shattered rocks and smoke and dust billowed.
Buzz!
Following the complete slaughter of an invading World Ancient God, waves of white energy appeared around the Mountain Giant, which was the World Origin awarded by Hell.
Or rather, these awards are essentially the power contained within the fallen ancient god, transformed by the Supreme Plane in another way.
But soon, Jack Clark’s gaze slightly shifted.
He noticed that the World Origin reward obtained by this Hell Messenger seemed to be only around six hundred strands.
Compared to the thousand origin points he acquired from slaughtering that Caesar Ancient God, a full forty percent less, is it due to different strengths, or…
Jack Clark suddenly asked: “Boroedo, how many strands of World Origin do you receive for slaughtering an Abyssal Great Demon on the battlefield?”
Faced with this question, the Mountain Giant hesitated, then shamefully said.
“…I am ashamed to say, although I have participated in multiple plane wars, I have not yet personally slew an Abyssal Great Demon.”
Well… originally intending to probe some information, Jack Clark paused.
Since it was his first participation in a Plane War, Jack Clark was unaware that these Hell Messengers on the battlefield, although they faced Abyssal Great Demons of the same realm, mainly hunted those ancient demons.
No choice, those ancient demons are simply easier to kill.
At this moment, among the several Hell Messengers nearby, a messenger named Mpolak, over two hundred meters tall and covered in black scale armor, slowly spoke.
“I have previously slain three Abyssal Great Demons on the Plane Battlefield; the reward for each kind of Abyssal Great Demon was different.”
“One True Spirit Initial Stage Abyssal Great Demon provided eight hundred strands of World Origin, the other two True Spirit Mid Stage Abyssal Great Demons provided nine hundred strands.”
“I see,” Jack Clark nodded, somewhat surprised.
He found that the reward he received for slaughtering those ancient gods, Abyssal Great Demons, was significantly more, about forty percent more compared to these messengers.
For example, from the eleven Abyssal Great Demons he slew, the least rewarded provided over thirteen hundred strands of origin, the most rewarding provided over sixteen hundred strands.
Converted ten to one, he currently has accumulated 265180 origin points, already more than halfway towards the four hundred thousand needed for the first layer of the Heavenly Realm.
Just then, as if afraid Jack Clark would reveal something, a majestic voice of Alvaron softly echoed in his ear.
“Darren Hegemon, you are different from them.”
“You possess the Position Pattern of the Lord of Hell, so on the Plane Battlefield, including other battlefields where hell forces are drawn to invade worlds, the reward you gain for slaying enemies is a full hundred percent.”
“And these rewards all come from those Abyssal Great Demons you slaughtered, their traces of existence, their rules, including the torn parts of the Supreme Plane power.”
“Furthermore, do not reveal that you possess the Position Pattern of the Lord of Hell, otherwise it will bring danger.”
The words of the Lord of Alvaron made Jack Clark narrow his eyes, thinking of the Seed of Hell in the Hell’s Eye, realizing that this item was indeed the Position Pattern of the Lord of Hell.
This item originated from the Hell Roulette.
Clearly at the beginning, he was merely a Hell Messenger possessing coordinates, until the last time the projection of Alvaron descended again, causing changes.
“Rest assured, Darren Callum, I bear no malice towards you, my attention towards you is solely because you were once led by me, technically under the jurisdiction of my Crimson Hell.”
“As for the Position Pattern of the Lord of Hell, it is granted by the Will of the Supreme Hell, even we Lords of Hell have no authority over it.”
“Of course, if one day you can grow and become a Lord of Hell, it would also be beneficial to me, as there are conflicts among the various layers of Hell.”
The words of Alvaron slightly shook Jack Clark’s mind, not only because of the information conveyed by the other party but also because the other party could see through his thoughts through Mental Fluctuations.
In an instant, Jack Clark altered his realm of thought, severing the connection of wills between them.
The cautionary nature of Jack Clark was of no concern to Alvaron. After the connection was severed, a grand and majestic voice slowly resonated between heaven and earth, shaking Space-Time.
“Attention, in half an hour the Crimson Hell will ‘dissipate’, exiting this space and time.”
Boom!
The form of the Mountain Giant shook, its enormous body visibly shrinking in speed, returning to a few thousand meters in size, and looking at Jack Clark with a sincere tone.
“Councilor Darren, this is my Hell Beacon, I hope we may have opportunities to cooperate in the future.”
Saying this, the Mountain Giant produced a blood-stained stone slab of several dozen meters in size, engraved with complex runes imbued with the Power of Hell.
“Okay.” Jack Clark swept his senses across the bloody stone slab, after sensing the information contained, he collected it.
This item could be embedded into the Hell Roulette, possessing the effects of communication and actively displaying space-time coordinates.
For instance, if the Mountain Giant finds a suitable plane for invasion, it can contact Jack Clark through the Hell Beacon and pull the Power of Hell to descend.
Clearly, this Hell Messenger saw Jack Clark’s immense strength.
As a Hell Messenger, not every world discovered suitable for invasion is strong; some ‘weaker’ worlds might only have one or two True Spirits stationed.
In such worlds, a single or a couple of messengers might not always conquest successfully, and there might be risks of falling.
But if the world coordinates are submitted, led by a Lord of Hell to descend from the Supreme Hell, then whatever leftovers remain would yield minimal gains.
Jack Clark is different, his strength can almost sweep through all worlds not presided over by Primordial beings.
Even during that moment when Rabio World was torn apart, the peak form he displayed had barely stepped into Primordial, capable of clashing a few moves against true Primordial Stars.
Therefore, the Mountain Giant decisively offered its Hell Beacon.
Though it may expose its world to Jack Clark, bringing unknown risks, compared to the potential greater benefits in the future, these risks are worth taking.
Watching Jack Clark collect the Hell Beacon, the surrounding Hell Messengers’ gaze slightly flickered, but ultimately there were no other reactions.
These Hell Messengers all appeared to be very cautious.
It can’t be helped, the Endless World is too dangerous; this danger isn’t only from enemies but also from other civilizations and powerful beings, including other Hell Messengers.
And this caution is commendable.
Including Jack Clark, who didn’t fully trust what Alvaron just said.
Under the watch of many Hell Messengers, a Star Moment quickly passed, followed by the entire Hell Plane starting to tremble.
Boom, boom, boom!
Blood-tainted currents filled the air, roaring and vibrating as if substantial, instantly a terrorizing power, superior to all, descended, distorting space and time.
In an instant, the Void before Jack Clark collapsed, with surrounding lights retreating continuously.
Between Heaven and Earth, the imposing figures of Hell Messengers, including the Crimson Hell itself, grew increasingly distant in Jack Clark’s vision, ultimately disappearing.
When the surrounding space-time returned to calm, the whole person was back on the Black Warship, in the compressed space opened within the mountain.
In the pitch-black Void, a hundred-meter diameter Hell Roulette, surrounded by numerous sharp blood spines, hovered, its eerie blood light flickering, emitting an ominous aura.
[A little more proofreading, wait half an hour]

chapters.title: Chapter 1776: 657
chapters.content:
Chapter 1776: Chapter 657
Chapter 654 The Dragon of Luck, Fierce Giant Beast
The Void, ten thousand kilometers high, suddenly twisted in space, and like a Phoenix Bird, a vast black Warship appeared out of nowhere.
At the front of the Warship, on a square that stretched on for tens of kilometers, dense shadows of people were converging. At the very front were the strong figures of the Human Federation, the Heavenly Feather Clan, and the Immortal Spirit Clan, all above the Legendary Realm.
At this moment, everyone was looking forward excitedly to what lay ahead.
The sky and earth were separated by a layer of transparent red flames, raging as if they were an endless layer that couldn’t be seen from left to right, reaching beyond the sky, like a curtain of fire.
Opposite the Sky Curtain, there was a world where clouds and mist formed seas, with continents of tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands, even extending beyond one million kilometers in diameter, floating.
Ahead of the likes of the Primordial True King, Sherry Williams, dressed in a gorgeous dark dress, slowly spoke: “Ahead, that is the Flame Wheel Divine Domain.”
“We’ve finally arrived,” muttered the True Martial King with a slight sigh.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King nodded with some excitement: “Yes, we’ve finally arrived.”
After two months traversing vast distances aboard the Warship flying through subspace, they had finally arrived in this region governed by the Ancient Human Race.
What awaited everyone next was a new beginning.
Including the Ancient Powerhouses like the True Martial King, the Human Divine Domain was also a grander stage for them, a springboard for going farther.
On the square
Justin Welan stood by Joshua Welan, somewhat excited: “Brother, once we enter the Divine Domain, should we, the Welan brothers, form a duo and roam the world with swords in hand?”
“Roam the world with swords in hand? What’s that?” Joshua Welan was somewhat confused, unable to follow the train of thought of Justin Welan.
Justin Welan explained: “Didn’t Jack mention that the structure of the Flame Wheel Dynasty is similar to the ancient feudal systems, with royal centralization of power, under which cultivate nobility and powerful families?”
“In such a closed society, with communications sealed and complex routes to travel, countless wild forces lie dormant in the wilderness, and there is bound to be fighting and striving for grievances and passions.”
“Besides, this is the Divine Domain, an extraordinary imperial dynasty spanning tens of thousands of years. Both the local customs and the cultivation culture have much to learn from and witness.”
Seeing Justin Welan getting more and more excited, Joshua Welan was speechless and retorted irritably: “Roam the world with swords in hand? Nonsense, do you think this trip is for fun?”
“You said it yourself, this dynasty has existed for tens of thousands of years, equivalent to over twenty thousand years of Blue Star’s extraordinary dynasties, where myths are widespread, and ancient times strong figures capable of Opening the Heavens and Earth can be found everywhere.”
“In such an extraordinary society, do you think their level of civilization will be behind that of Blue Star?”
…Justin Welan paused, and upon reflection, realized that his brother might be right.
While countless people were in shock and excitement, the black Warship rammed headlong into the curtain of fire.
Boom!
Flames roared and churned around the black Warship; it was as if it had entered a world of red flames, a sea of fire, with endless flames rapidly retreating on both sides.
Roar!
In front of the black Warship, the sea of fire billowed, with flames surging sky-high, transforming into a towering figure made of flames, a million meters tall, wielding a long sword condensed from red flames.
And there wasn’t just one.
All around, the flames rolled violently, condensing into flame War Generals, each emitting an aura that even strong figures like the True Martial King found dangerous.
Chirp! From deep within the Warship, a clear bird song rang out.
In this moment, the Warship seemed to come alive; black radiance flickered, forming a gigantic shadow of a black Phoenix Bird outside the battlefield, while also radiating an oppressive aura.
Under that pressure, which belonged to the True Spirit Level and carried the identification of a Vice Hall Master, all the flame War Generals faltered and then bowed slightly to the Warship that was quickly passing through the center.
Deep within the sea of flames, an ancient voice slowly emerged: “Welcome back, Vice Hall Master Sherry, please convey my regards to the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall.”
On the ‘deck’ at the forefront of the Warship, Sherry Williams nodded calmly: “Sherry will certainly pass on the message.”
As she spoke, the sea of fire in front of the Warship roared, and the flames parted violently to either side, forming a crack thousands of kilometers long. Beyond the crack, a gentle mist could be seen floating.
The Warship charged through the crack, and instantly, a rich and pure surge of Heavenly Energy hit them head-on.
Whoosh! Everybody on the battlefield couldn’t help but take a deep breath, feeling refreshed, as their bodies experienced an indescribable ease and satisfaction.
The concentration of Heavenly Energy in the Divine Realm was similar to that outside, but compared to the violent energy of the mythical world, these energies were much purer and calmer.
To put it simply, humans in the mythical world were like freshwater fish in the ocean.
Weak (ordinary people) fish entering the ocean either mutate or die because they cannot adapt to the environment, while only the larger (cultivators) and more ferocious fish can survive in sea water.
The Divine Realm, created by the likes of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, maintained energy concentration equal to the mythical world, but the violent elements within it have been removed, making it suitable for human habitation.
This is also why the population of the Flame Wheel Divine Domain could exceed one hundred billion.
After all, even in the Human Divine Domain, not everyone has cultivation talent; strong figures are only the minority, and most people are still ordinary people.
Of course, ‘ordinary’ in comparison to the mythical world.
Due to the prevalence of cultivation, practically all people in the Divine Domain practice some simple cultivation, and by adulthood, they essentially have the physicality of Fourth Layer Heaven Cultivators.
At this moment, Sherry Williams turned around to look at the Primordial True King and others: “Next, we have to fly for half a day, passing through six Boundaries before reaching the Central Heavenly Realm where the Imperial Court resides.”
“As the Warship flies past those floating continents, it will conduct low altitude flight, allowing scenes of local landscapes to be seen from both sides of the ship.”
As soon as Sherry Williams finished speaking, the distant sea of clouds suddenly dispersed.
Whoosh whoosh!! Hundreds of grey whales, a thousand meters in length, shot up into the sky, the giant wing-like fins beneath them flapping as they soared towards higher heavens.

chapters.title: Chapter 1777: 657_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1777: Chapter 657_2
Suddenly, the crowd was shaken and restless, followed by many who could hardly wait to fly towards the ship’s sides tens of kilometers away.
As the distant traveling teams entered the Divine Realm, flying towards the Central Heavenly Realm at the heart of the Divine Realm.
Chaos Void
The continental blocks, massive and endless, dragged by the two Void Heaven Divine Dragons, were moving at an astonishing speed, rumbling with murky gales roaring through, affecting a hundred billion kilometers, the aura majestic.
Roar!
Amidst the turbulent roars of the murky gales, a Black-Red Colossal Beast with a body length exceeding 480,000 meters flapped its double wings, overturning the murky air within tens of thousands of kilometers.
Clutched in the double claws of the Terminal Emperor Dragon was a True Spirit Level Ferocious Beast, torn in two with a body length of 170,000 meters, its body surrounded by a savage aura, looking extremely ferocious.
ROAR ROAR ROAR!!
The True Spirit Ferocious Beast, with its true body torn apart, emitted ferocious roars, its body surface shimmered with azure light, forming rule chains like vines that shook space-time.
Despite the struggles of this True Spirit Ferocious Beast, it could not escape the suppression of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
ROAR!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s gaping maw issued a terrifying roar, its mouth shimmering with black-red radiance, biting down on the head of the True Spirit Ferocious Beast.
BOOM! The Void trembled, the firmament undulated.
Amidst the roaring like that of a million nuclear bombs exploding, the head and neck of the True Spirit Ferocious Beast vanished, bitten off by the Terminal Emperor Dragon, instantly weakening its struggle.
The ferocious beast, over a hundred thousand meters in length, was rapidly devoured by the Terminal Emperor Dragon with a CRACKLE CRACKLE, and its massive body swelled at a visible rate, growing over three hundred meters longer.
During the time Jack Clark was in closed-door cultivation for his breakthrough, the Terminal Emperor Dragon was not idle either.
It hunted down True Spirit Level and above Ferocious Beasts encountered along the way, as well as several creatures that seemed to come from other worlds, their forms growing even larger.
Its Growth Level was also nearing the Late Stage of True Spirit, feeling that devouring one or two Half-Step Primordial Beasts it would almost be able to breakthrough.
It’s just that those guys haven’t come to attack yet?
The Terminal Emperor Dragon looked around at the raging murky gales, its golden vertical pupils exuding a cold, brutal gaze.
During this period, the Terminal Emperor Dragon had been waiting, waiting for those Primordial Nightmare Beasts to strike again, then it planned to tear apart and eat the body of another Primordial Beast.
Perhaps even slay a Primordial Level Nightmare Beast.
But since the last time they were repelled, whether it was because they were getting close to the territory of the Void Heaven Divine Dragons or because those Nightmare Beasts had already left, they hadn’t reappeared until now.
This had somewhat disappointed the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Those Primordial Fierce Beasts contained high energy and were great nourishing food; eating one would allow significant growth, and perhaps after eating two, they might reach the Primordial Stage.
But now, those deliveries were not coming.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon shook its head, its massive body burst through the gales, and amidst the earth-shattering roars and explosions, it crossed the skies and quickly flew back to the Chaos Continent.
“ROAR! Tim Abott, you have returned.”
At the towering mountain peak twenty thousand meters high, engulfed in a raging storm and heavy snow, a Silver Giant Dragon, having broken through the ancient times with a body length reaching six thousand meters, stood tall.
BOOM!
The colossal Black-Red Beast landed at the foot of the mountain, causing heaven and earth to shake, the ground to crumble, and countless stones to surge skywards amidst the sun-obscuring smoke and dust.
Looking at the ‘small slope’ of the Silver Giant Dragon, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s ferocious maw parted slightly, emitting a resonating roar.
“Scythia, you’ve awakened.”
Following this breakthrough, the appearance and size of the Silver Giant Dragon grew more formidable, and golden tips appeared on the Dragon Horns and claw tips, exuding a sense of majesty.
In addition, there was a significant increase in strength; wreathed around the Silver Giant Dragon was an Aura of Spatial Fluctuations that contained the destructive power of Ice Crystals.
The Supreme Rule of the space category!
Immediately, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s eyes revealed a hint of satisfaction, like a little girl who had always followed behind him had finally been admitted to a good university.
Atop the mountain peak, the Silver Giant Dragon, looking at the beast as tall as the mountain, let out an excited roar: “Tim Abott, the feeling of the Great Sethia is now so strong.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, amid the howling winds between heaven and earth: “This breakthrough of yours, indeed, seems to have brought a significant increase in strength.”
The Silver Giant Dragon shook its head: “ROAR! Tim Abott, the Great Sethia is not talking about strength, but the feeling, I can sense that there is something surrounding us.”
“Over there, the Great Sethia could feel it. Far in that direction, there are good things.”
“And over there, there is a very fierce creature.” As it spoke, the Silver Giant Dragon stretched out its right claw, pointing towards the right side of the Void outside the moving Chaos Continent.
“Sethia, you can feel the luck surrounding you?” The Terminal Emperor Dragon asked with some surprise.
The Silver Giant Dragon blinked its large silver-golden Dragon Eyes, looking at the Terminal Emperor Dragon curiously: “Luck? Isn’t that the Great Sethia’s talent?”
“Well, talent.” The Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded, its eyes revealing a fierce smile.
“Purple Even Hall Lord, I’m taking Sethia for a spin, we will catch up later.”
A deep and majestic roar reverberated between heaven and earth, greeting the Void Heaven Divine Dragon seated on the continent; the Black-Red Beast then flapped its wings, taking the Silver Giant Dragon and flying out from the continent once more.
This breakthrough of the Silver Giant Dragon, being able to feel its luck more clearly, is good news.
Although its luck has always been a mix of fortune and misfortune, this was better.
Directed by luck, the Heaven and Earth Treasures that were eaten, as well as the Ferocious Beasts guarding those treasures, were all a double blessing for the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
But just after flying hundreds of billions of kilometers, the murky airflow in front exploded, revealing millions of black ferocious beasts.
Each of these creatures was only a thousand meters long and resembled flying swallows, their entire bodies jet black and covered in sharp scale armor, and they exuded a dangerous aura that even made the Silver Giant Dragon’s heart tremble.

chapters.title: Chapter 1778: 657_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1778: Chapter 657_3
Boom Boom Boom!!
The murky air streams exploded, tens of thousands of black ferocious beasts burst out like black rays of light, accelerating to terrifying speeds close to the speed of light, instantly appearing in front of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
There was no dodging.
The Black-red Colossal Beast stood like an island in the Void, even the surrounding Rule force fields converged, instantly submerged by a black tsunami.
Thump Thump Thump!! Dense Flying Swallow Ferocious Beasts collided with the Terminal Emperor Dragon, emitting a series of deep muffled drum-like sounds.
These ferocious beasts exuded Mythical-level energy fluctuations, yet their bodies were exceptionally solid, sharp, and their beaks contained a demon-breaking effect.
Additionally, with their terrifying movement speed almost comparable to that of a True Spirit, their kinetic energy could instantly destroy a planet.
This is what made the Silver Giant Dragon sense danger.
Under the rapid talent of these Flying Swallow Ferocious Beasts, although their attack method was simple and easy to evade, the power of their Limit Breakthrough had reached the ancient level.
And the collective strength of tens of thousands of Flying Swallow Ferocious Beasts was even enough to heavily injure and tear apart a True Spirit Beast.
However, in front of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, such attacks couldn’t breach its defense, and the terrifying rebound force of the impact instead blasted all Flying Swallow Ferocious Beasts into a sky full of black dust.
Boom!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon opened its massive jaw, releasing a tangible hurricane suction force, continuously devouring the black blood mist that spread over hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Swallowed in one gulp.
Satisfying!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon burped contentedly, its scale armor making a crackling sound as its massive body visibly swelled nearly a thousand meters.
No wonder it’s called Chaos Outside Heaven, the food is indeed plentiful.
After a good meal and drink, the Terminal Emperor Dragon continued flying with the Silver Giant Dragon resting on its back, brazenly crossing several dangerous areas capable of heavily injuring a True Spirit Beast.
After flying for about four hours, finally, something was discovered.
Deep within the Chaos Void, countless blue Ice Crystals of varying sizes converged, the creeping cold freezing space-time, resembling an ice river extending billions of kilometers.
Such extreme environments typically breed Heaven and Earth Treasures.
It’s evident from here how broad the Silver Giant Dragon’s luck perception range is, nearly a +15 enhanced version of a treasure-hunting Single-horned Spawn Roc.
Just when the Terminal Emperor Dragon and Silver Giant Dragon were a few tens of millions of kilometers from the ice river, deep within the ice river, a pair of broken blue eyes slowly opened, burning with blazing blue flames, exuding coldness and cruelty.
Roar!
A deep and violent roar shook the Void, countless huge blue Ice Crystals in the center of the ice river exploded, the blue cold air violently surged, and a massive figure soared into the sky.
This was a creature resembling but not resembling a tiger, with a sharp unicorn on its head, double wings on its back, and twelve tails like giant pythons behind it.
Its body, over a million meters long, spread out in the Void like majestic mountains, covered in transparent blue scale armor, emitting pure blue cold air.
This cold air invisibly spread, freezing time wherever it passed, solidifying, creating a silent and stagnant world around that giant beast.
Most importantly, these blue cold airs contained a faint hint of Primordial essence.
This was a beast whose power had begun to transform towards the Primordial, a half-step Primordial level creature.
Instantly, a hint of excitement appeared in the eyes of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, as a half-step Primordial beast contained abundant energy, and eating it would almost allow it to break through to the Late Stage of True Spirit.
Plus, such a beast was guarding a maturing Heaven and Earth Treasure, at least at the Creation Level.
For anything below Creation Level Divine Objects, which were too low-grade for such a beast’s level, they would not waste time here.
Roar!
Without any nonsense, the moment that ice blue fierce beast appeared, the Terminal Emperor Dragon roared towards the sky, its whole body emitting dazzling red radiance.
Boom!
The whole Chaotic realm was rendered into red light, and a terrifying figure wrapped in Blood Red Lightning, two million meters long, gradually appeared.
In an instant, a supremely powerful force spread across the Void.
Under the release of the terrifying power, everything around the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor twisted as if a true Primordial Beast had descended, even stronger than a typical Primordial Beast.
Roar!
Seeing the drastically increased size and power of the terrifying beast, the originally awakened and somewhat angry ice blue fierce beast instinctively let out a fearful roar.
However, immediately, under the intense stimulation of danger, the ice blue fierce beast, nurtured naturally, revealed an extremely fierce look in its eyes.
Roar!
An earth-shattering roar exploded, and the ice blue fierce beast’s twelve tails opened, radiating dazzling blue light, resonating with the entire ice river.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The billions of kilometers long ice river erupted, hundreds of Ice Dragons formed from blue Ice Crystals and cold air, each a million kilometers long, circled around the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon roaring.
The blue cold air froze everything, submerging billions of kilometers around.
[It’s twelve o’clock, 7K today, update first, continuing to polish the rest later, brothers refresh in an hour]
[Now 5K is a bit less, but can’t stay up all night to write another chapter, so the remaining 2,000 words are saved for later]
The massive Black-red Colossal Beast landed at the foot of the mountain, immediately causing the heaven and earth to tremble, the earth shattered, and countless rocks rose up in the sky full of smoke and dust.
Looking at the ‘small slope’ where the Silver Giant Dragon lay, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s ferocious mouth slightly opened, emitting a thunderous vibration.
“Scythia, you’ve awakened.”
This breakthrough, the Silver Giant Dragon’s appearance and size looked even more fierce, and notably, the tips of its dragon horns and claws each had a hint of gold, mysteriously appearing somewhat majestic.

chapters.title: Chapter 1779: 657_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 1779: Chapter 657_4
Besides the significant enhancement in strength, the Silver Giant Dragon is surrounded by spatial fluctuations containing the power of Ice Crystal Destruction.
Supreme Rule of Space!
Instantly, the Terminal Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but reveal a trace of relief in its eyes, feeling like a little girl who had been trailing behind him had finally entered a prestigious university.
Atop the Mountain Peak, the Silver Giant Dragon, looking at the Giant Beast as tall as the mountain, let out an excited roar: “Tim Abott, the feeling of the Great Sethia is so strong right now.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, and instantly a raging wind screamed between heaven and earth: “This breakthrough has indeed greatly enhanced your strength.”
The Silver Giant Dragon shook its head: “Roar! Tim Abott, it is not about strength, but feeling! I can sense something circling around us.”
“Over there, the Great Sethia senses it. There’s something valuable far in that direction.”
“And there, there is a very fierce creature.” Saying this, the Silver Giant Dragon extended its right claw, pointing towards the Void outside the moving Chaos Continent.
“Sethia, can you feel the luck surrounding you?” The Terminal Emperor Dragon asked, somewhat surprised.
The Silver Giant Dragon blinked its large silver-golden Dragon Eyes, looking oddly at the Terminal Emperor Dragon: “Luck? Isn’t that a talent of the Great Sethia?”
“Well, talent.” The Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded, showing a fierce smile in its eyes.
“Purple Even Hall Lord, I will take Sethia out for a spin and will catch up later.”
A deep and majestic roar shook heaven and earth, and having greeted the Xu Tian Divine Dragon who presided over the continent, the Black-red Colossal Beast flapped its double wings and flew off the continent with the Silver Giant Dragon once more.
This breakthrough for the Silver Giant Dragon is indeed good news as it can sense the luck surrounding it more clearly.
Although its luck has always been a mix of fortune and misfortune, this is better.
Guided by luck, devouring the Heaven and Earth Treasures and killing the Ferocious Beasts guarding them is indeed a double blessing for the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
But just as they had flown hundreds of billions of kilometers, the murky airflow exploded ahead, revealing millions of black Ferocious Beasts.
Each of these beasts, resembling Flying Swallows and utterly black, covered in sharp scale armor, and radiating a dangerous aura that made the Silver Giant Dragon’s heart palpitate.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The murky airflow exploded, and tens of thousands of black Ferocious Beasts burst out like beams of black light, shooting out at near-light speed, and instantly appearing in front of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
No avoiding.
The Black-red Colossal Beast stood like an island in the Void, even gathering the surrounding rules’ force field inward, instantly overwhelmed by a black Tsunami.
Boom, boom, boom!! The dense Flying Swallow Fierce Beasts struck the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s body, making intense muffled sounds like dense drums.
These beasts emitted Mythical-level energy fluctuations, but their bodies were extraordinarily solid and sharp, and their beaks possessed a demon-breaking effect.
Furthermore, with a movement speed almost akin to that of True Spirits, their instantaneous Burst could destroy a planet.
This was also why the Silver Giant Dragon felt danger.
Under the acceleration talent, these Flying Swallow Beasts, despite their straightforward attack method and ease of evasion, had achieved ancient-level power with their Limit Burst.
And the collective strength of tens of thousands of Flying Swallow Beasts was even sufficient to heavily injure and shred a True Spirit Beast.
But before the Terminal Emperor Dragon, such an attack could not even breach his defenses; the horrifying counter-shock instead blasted all the Flying Swallow Beasts into a sky full of black powder.
Boom!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon opened its large mouth, producing a tangible hurricane suction force, continuously devouring the black blood mist pervading tens of thousands of kilometers around.
Devouring it all in one gulp.
Comfortable!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon let out a full belch, the clatter of its expanding scale armor audible as its enormous body swelled a kilometer in size visible to the naked eye.
It truly is a feast in the Chaos Outside Heaven.
After eating to its heart’s content, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, with the Silver Giant Dragon lying on its back, kept flying, crossing several areas dangerous enough to heavily injure a True Spirit Beast without any inhibition.
About four hours into the flight, they finally made a discovery.
Deep within the Chaos Void, countless ice crystals of varying sizes converged, their coldness freezing space-time, resembling an ice river extending for billions of kilometers.
Such extreme environments usually birth Heaven and Earth Treasures.
And from this, one could tell how vast the Silver Giant Dragon’s range of fortune sensing was; it was truly like an enhanced +15 treasure hunting Single-horned Spawn Roc.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon approached the ice river by tens of millions of kilometers, deep within the ice river, a pair of shattered blue eyes slowly opened, burning with intense blue flames, exuding coldness and cruelty.
Roar!
A thick and rampant roar vibrated the Void, as countless massive blue ice crystals in the center of the ice river exploded, and the blue cold air surged, sending a large silhouette soaring into the sky.
This was a beast resembling but not quite a tiger, with a sharp horn on its head, double wings on its back, and twelve tails resembling giant pythons behind it.
With a body length of over a million meters unfolding in the Void, it was like a majestic mountain range, covered in ice-blue translucent scale armor, emitting pure blue cold air.
This cold air, invisible and pervasive, froze time wherever it passed, solidifying it, as if creating a silent, stagnant world around the giant beast.
Most importantly, this blue cold air contained a faint hint of Primordial essence.
This was a beast, its power transitioning towards Primordial, at the half-step Primordial level.
Immediately, excitement flashed in the eyes of the Terminal Emperor Dragon; a half-step Primordial beast contains abundant energy, devouring it would almost allow it to advance to the Late Stage of True Spirit.
Moreover, such beasts guard mature Heaven and Earth Treasures, which are at least of the Creation Level.
As for Divine Objects below the Creation Level, they are too low-level for such beasts and naturally wouldn’t waste time here.
Roar!
Without any nonsense, the moment the ice-blue fierce beast appeared, the Terminal Emperor Dragon let out a roar towards the sky, its whole body emitting dazzling red radiance.
Boom!
In the light that painted the entire Chaos in red, an intimidating silhouette, two million meters long and wrapped in blood-red lightning, slowly emerged.
Instantly, a power so strong it filled the Void spread out.
With terrifying power unleashed, everything around the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon distorted, as if a true Primordial Beast had descended, even stronger than a typical Primordial Beast.
Roar!
Seeing the rapidly swelling size and the surge in power emitted by the terrifying beast, the ice-blue fierce beast that was initially startled and enraged, subconsciously let out a roar of terror.
But then, stimulated by intense danger, the naturally fierce ice-blue beast showed extremely ferocious eyes.
Roar!
An earth-shaking roar exploded, the twelve tails of the ice-blue fierce beast spread out, emitting dazzling blue radiance, resonating with the entire ice river.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The ice river extending billions of kilometers erupted, hundreds of ice dragons formed from blue ice crystals and cold air, each a million kilometers long, encircled the Doomsday Deep Red Emperor Dragon as they roared.
The blue cold air froze everything, submerging billions of kilometers in its range.

chapters.title: Chapter 1780: 658: Nebula Divine Tree, Jack Clark Emerges
chapters.content:
Chapter 1780: Chapter 658: Nebula Divine Tree, Jack Clark Emerges
Chaos Void.
In the center of the Ice River, which was destroyed and split into two by a single blow, stands a ferocious behemoth 500,000 meters long, resembling a dragon but not a dragon, its entire body covered in pitch-black scale armor.
