Between the gaps in the Giant Beast’s full-body scale armor, as well as among the manes spreading from its head and Dorsal Fin fluttering in the wind, it emits a red glow like blood, appearing immensely vicious and tyrannical.
But this is just external change; within every muscle, bone, and even cells of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, countless runes are flickering.
These runes represent certain rules, regulations, and talents that come together to form a terrifying world of destruction within the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
This growth breakthrough has reached the late stage of True Spirit, and the Chaotic Doomsday rule world integrated with the Giant Beast Body has also attained grand accomplishment.
What comes next is continued growth, enabling the Giant Beast Body to reach the pinnacle of True Spirit, and “reach” the end of its own Chaotic Doomsday, becoming the source of this rule.
Then comes the most critical breakthrough of the primordial, the birth of Primordial Air within the body.
In the mythical world, many powerful Living Beings at the Pinnacle of True Spirit are stuck at this step, unable to breakthrough after tens to hundreds of thousands of years of Closed-door Cultivation, to become Outer Stars.
But for the Terminal Emperor Dragon, which has already battled the Primordial Nightmare Beast before and touched the source of Chaos destruction, this step can be directly crossed.
That is to say, as long as it reaches the Pinnacle of True Spirit, the Terminal Emperor Dragon can directly undertake its seventh Evolution, breaking through the primordial.
No need to rely on the accumulated evolution value that disappeared after the sixth Evolution, which came after the previous breakthrough to True Spirit.
Or rather, the Evolution Talent has become even stronger with each Evolution and Transformation of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, now so powerful that entering the Primordial Nine-layered Heavens no longer poses any obstruction.
Therefore, there is no need to accumulate evolution value nor Life Energy anymore when breaking through the shackles at the moment of breakthrough.
After sensing the strength within its body that has become even more powerful, the Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly exhaled a breath, the heat from its nostrils evaporating everything in front of it.
“Roar! Tim Abott, your breakthrough has ended,”
the Silver Giant Dragon, which was protected by a faint black glow on its surface, roared excitedly beside the huge dragon head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, pointing towards the latter half of the Ice River.
“Tim Abott, over there, Great Scythia senses something good in that direction.”
The massive and ferocious dragon head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded slowly and let out a deep growl: “Don’t run around, follow behind me; let’s go take a look.”
In the perception of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, there indeed was a faintly discernible dark energy fluctuation over there.
However, it did not possess the ‘treasure hunting’ talent, thus its perception was not as sharp as the Silver Giant Dragon’s, who could sense treasures even over a distance of more than a billion kilometers.
Boom!
Enormous black and crimson double wings unfurled behind the Terminal Emperor Dragon, covering hundreds of thousands of meters, as it plunged headfirst into the Ice River with the might to Destroy Heaven and Earth.
The Chaos immediately trembled; the Ice River roared.
Countless ice crystals as large as mountain ranges exploded, and the extremely cold blue mist caused tsunamis spanning thousands of miles, roaring and surging in all directions.
Next to the tens of thousands of meters large dragon head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the 6,000-meters-long Silver Giant Dragon circled excitedly, emitting high-pitched Dragon Roars.
“Roar! Tim Abott, charge, Great Scythia is invincible.”
“Roar, Roar!! Tim Abott, I have a hunch, Telsafi must be looking up from some corner of the Vast World, gazing at Great Scythia.”
Looking at the Silver Giant Dragon, which was extremely happy and excited, the Terminal Emperor Dragon shook its head and ignored it.
And as if it were a premonition deep in its soul.
The Mythical World
In the Chaotic Turbulent Region full of birdsong and fragrant flowers, on a Seven-color Crystal Mountain Range stretching for thousands of kilometers, a gold and blue Giant Dragon measuring over four thousand meters in length was looking up at the sky.
A red Star in the sky was slowly dimming.
Earlier, when the Terminal Emperor Dragon entered the Deep Red Form and its power reached the Primordial Stars level, its released energy twisted Space-Time, shining with the dazzling light of a Star.
Even separated by the Vast World and distant Space-Time.
The instinct of the gold and blue Giant Dragon told it that the star shining with red light was the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Only when the light from the red star faded did the gold and blue Giant Dragon let out a slow growl: “Hope Scythia, that fool, wouldn’t be as impulsive as before after going to the Outer Stars.”
Having witnessed the terrifying growth pace of the Terminal Emperor Dragon along the way, the gold and blue Giant Dragon was mentally prepared for not being able to keep up.
The behemoth from the Blue Star World has grown beyond what could be described as a peerless talent.
It is an outright monster that defies all growth rules.
It’s just that Scythia was foolish to recklessly follow into the Outer Stars despite the dangers, which worried the gold and blue Giant Dragon somewhat.
As a behemoth that already rivals Primordial forces, after entering the Outer Stars, the Terminal Emperor Dragon would definitely encounter enemies and opponents on the level of the Primordial.
In such a case, they, who were only at Titan Peak at that time, would be completely a burden.
Even a slightly stronger battle aftermath could wipe them out.
Thus, the self-aware gold and blue Giant Dragon did not follow to the Outer Stars at the time, fearing it would hold back the Terminal Emperor Dragon when facing those Primordial Fierce Beasts.
But unexpectedly, Scythia was just as impulsive and single-minded as before.
At this thought, the gold and blue Giant Dragon couldn’t help but shake its head, then closed its eyes and continued to fall into Hibernation (cultivation).
“Roar! Tim Abott, that thing looks very tasty,”
the Silver Giant Dragon commented, as a whirlpool encompassing tens of thousands of kilometers was formed by the accumulated blue cold air in the depths of the Ice River, which spanned millions of kilometers in width and hundreds of thousands of kilometers in depth.
In the center of the whirlpool, which looked like a nebula, there grew a massive Ice Crystal divine tree, several tens of thousands of kilometers in height, with a canopy covering tens of thousands of kilometers.

chapters.title: Chapter 1781: 658: Nebula Divine Tree, Jack Clark Emerges from Retreat_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1781: Chapter 658: Nebula Divine Tree, Jack Clark Emerges from Retreat_2
The roots of the Ice Tree pierced into the star nebula, meandering like a ribbon, delving deep into the entire glacier, absorbing the extreme cold energy contained in the river.
Meanwhile, amongst the tree trunks of the Ice Tree, which were as huge as planets, hung over a dozen deep blue fruits, each one thousand kilometers in diameter.
These fruits, resembling blue gems, contained a faint blue and white liquid like cold marrow flowing inside, emitting extremely powerful energy fluctuations.
Even due to the overly rich energy, a blue star ring formed around the fruits, making them appear magnificent and enticing.
Suddenly, the Terminal Emperor Dragon felt somewhat disappointed: “These star nebula Ice Tree fruits are only at the Rule Level, and have not yet nurtured the Primordial Aura of Ice Cold Rule.
But that seems normal.
The half-step Primordial blue ferocious beast lurking here is here to guard, or rather, to utilize this glacier to condense the Primordial Aura of Ice Cold Rule.
If these star nebula Ice Tree fruits had reached the Creation Level, they would have already been devoured and refined by it, using them to completely breakthrough to Primordial.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon roared lowly, its deep voice shaking the glacier: “Scythia, you’ve just broken through to the Ancient Realm, eating one of these is probably the limit.”
“The rest of these icy marrow fruits shall leave one for Miss Joseline, the others I will consume.”
“No problem, Tim Abott.” the Silver Giant Dragon nodded excitedly.
Boom!
A black and red Dragon Claw reached into the Void, enveloping two fruits each one thousand kilometers in diameter with trails of blood-red lightning, crushing the surrounding space, compressing, and slicing it.
Soon, two giant star nebula icy marrow fruits were sealed, transformed into two gems a few hundred meters in diameter, and flew in front of the Silver Giant Dragon.
After partitioning the two Divine Fruits, the Terminal Emperor Dragon roared.
Boom!
The glacier shook, countless ice crystals deep within shattered and exploded, a huge black and red dragon head slowly emerged above the star nebula, and then bit down.
At that instant, the Void exploded, and a Black Hole appeared.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon directly devoured the remaining eleven icy marrow fruits, along with the star nebula Ice Tree tens of thousands of kilometers tall.
Although the essence of this divine tree was all in the fruits, and the trunk and branches were merely a million years old ice formed from the Ice Cold Rule, eating them could still transform some energy.
Approximately an hour later, the side of the glacier burst open.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon, now swollen to a length of five hundred and twenty thousand meters, roared out, spreading its double wings, and pursued the direction of Chaos Continent together with the Silver Giant Dragon.
According to the Purple Even Divine Dragon, they were already very close to the Xutian Divine Dragon Clan Territory.
If those Nightmare Fiend Beasts lurking in the dark were still prepared to repel the Void Heavenly Dragon, tearing apart the Chaos Continent, then this distance was their last chance.
A Primordial-Level ferocious beast, if it could devour one, might let it directly breakthrough to Primordial.
And the worst result could let it grow to the Pinnacle of True Spirit in one breath, and then gathering a few more half-step Primordial Giant Beasts, or devouring a mineral-rich world would almost be enough.
…
Flame Wheel Divine Domain
After traversing one huge continent of Cloud Mist after another, the Black Warship finally arrived at the central Central Heavenly Realm, a floating continent as huge as a star.
At that moment, the edge of the continent was gas-lined in thousands.
Golden glow spread over tens of thousands of kilometers, with rainbows stretching across the sky, rendering the surrounding Cloud Mist into a colorful, dazzling world.
Between the Cloud Mist that resembled the Immortal World, lay a tens of thousands of miles of towering celestial path.
On both sides of the celestial path stood tens of thousands of soldiers, all clad in luxurious red battle armors, wielding long spears and other weapons, like the legendary celestial warriors.
At the very front of the troops stood a few hundred figures in luxurious robes of blue, green, and red, standing tall.
These figures were dispersed in all directions, standing in the Circular Position, each surrounded by white and red Law Radiance, emitting a powerful Aura at the Heavenly King Level.
In front of these Imperial Court powerhouses stood over sixty figures exuding an Ancient Level pressure.
Not only were these figures stronger, but they also wore purple robes or luxurious battle armors with a golden sun imprinted on the left shoulder, wore high crowns, and held even higher statuses.
Above these ancient powerhouses, Cloud Mist gathered, and Divine Light flowed.
Nine figures emitting True Spirit pressure, and at least to the mid-period of True Spirit, appeared dimly visible within the clouds.
This grand welcoming scene immediately alarmed the Central Heavenly Realm, and many powerhouses above the Mythical level hastily flew from various states and major cities.
Including the cities around the Domain border harbors, countless people swarmed together.
In just a moment, millions of cultivators above high-order levels gathered, standing on mountain peaks or clouds tens of thousands of kilometers away, astounded as they watched ahead.
“The entire Forbidden Army of the Imperial Dynasty is mobilized, what a grand display.”
“Not just the Forbidden Army, see those Circular Celestial Officials? Almost all the important officials of the Imperial Court have arrived.”
“And all the Star Official God Generals and Star Lords have also been dispatched.”
“Hiss! The few clusters of clouds in front have Rule Manifestation, reflecting a One-side World, it’s the Five Palace Emperors and the Domain Lords who guard the Imperial City, they have actually been mobilized too.”
The surrounding crowd all were shocked, not knowing which significant figure had arrived to cause the entire upper echelon of the Flame Wheel Imperial Court to take action.
While those Eighth and Ninth Tier cultivators and some Mythical Powerhouses were shocked, above in the higher layer of clouds, an Elder at the Heavenly King Realm also opened with surprise,
“The Imperial Court’s high officials have traveled hundreds of thousands of kilometers to welcome, does anyone know what happened?”
The dozen or so also at the Heavenly King Realm around him all shook their heads, they might be the rulers of their own main cities, suppressing all around.

chapters.title: Chapter 1782: 658: Nebula Divine Tree, Jack Clark Emerges from Retreat_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1782: Chapter 658: Nebula Divine Tree, Jack Clark Emerges from Retreat_3
But in the vast Central Heavenly Realm, a local Heavenly King can only be considered a strong man among others, without the right to access information from the upper echelons of the Imperial Court.
At this moment, space distorted and a middle-aged man carrying a black long sword and wearing a white robe appeared, his expression somewhat shocked, “Gentlemen, I know what has happened.”
Instantly, the expressions of the surrounding Heavenly King Powerhouses slightly shifted.
“Rift Heaven Sword Monarch, do you know the reason?”
The sword-bearing middle-aged man nodded, “It is said that the Ancestral Land of the Human Race, lost for tens of thousands of years, has sent an envoy, and thus the entire upper echelon of the Imperial Court has been alerted.”
“The Ancestral Land of the Human Race?”
Most of the Heavenly King Powerhouses present showed confusion in their eyes, only a few, including the white-haired elder, were taken aback.
The elder was surprised, “The Ancestral Land of the Human Race, wasn’t it said that its coordinates were already lost?”
“Moreover, when we followed the Monarchs on the expedition and left, the Heavenly Energy of the Ancestral Land world had already become so thin it could no longer sustain a cultivator’s breakthrough to the God level.”
The sword-bearing middle-aged man shook his head, “I’m not very clear about the details. My elder brother only mentioned in passing about the arrival of the envoy from the Ancestral Land, asking me to come over and witness it.”
Another silver-haired youth slowly spoke, “The elder brother of the Rift Heaven Sword Monarch is one of the eighteen deputy commanders of the Imperial Guards of the dynasty, so the message should be correct.”
“According to ancient records, back in the days, the Seven Great Emperors led the Human Race elite into the ancient battlefield, embarking on expeditions against nine opposing great worlds.”
“However, when suppressing the main army corps of the nine great worlds, the enemy also assembled an elite force to launch a surprise attack on our Human Race’s rear, eventually compelling the remaining War Generals to activate the strength left by the Void True Emperor.”
“The descent of the Void caused the Ancestral Land world to shift its position, and the coordinates were lost.” The silver-haired youth sighed at this point.
“Unexpectedly, after tens of thousands of years, the Ancestral Land has reappeared, and it seems that the current civilization there has developed well enough to send envoys over.”
While these observers were discussing animatedly, a black shadow flashed across the sky.
In the blink of an eye, the shadow appeared tens of thousands of kilometers away, eventually stopping above the Golden Cloud Sea, in front of the high-ranking officials of the Imperial Court.
At the front of the warship, the Primordial True King and the others, looking at the strong man standing above the cloud sea, were all shocked.
Although they had long known that the Flame Wheel Divine Domain had countless strong warriors and that mythical figures were everywhere, with those from the ancient times and above amounting to hundreds.
But hearing is not the same as seeing, and the shock upon actually witnessing it is indescribable.
And these strong men in front of them are but the powerful ones from the Imperial Court of the Central Heavenly Realm in the Flame Wheel Imperial Dynasty, and there are more than two hundred states in the fourteen realms beyond it.
As the True Martial King and others were taken aback, not knowing what to say, Sherry Williams had already begun to speak, her demeanor solemn.
“Gentlemen, upon knowing of your impending arrival, the Flame Wheel Great Emperor personally led officials of the Heavenly Tier to tear through space and come here to greet you.”
The Primordial True King immediately smiled wryly, “This welcome is a bit too grand.”
That was a descendent of the Primordial True Emperor, with cultivation just half a step from Primordial, commanding hundreds of billions of ‘Transcendents’ as a Monarch of the dynasty, and yet he personally led officials to receive them.
This did not make the Primordial True King and the others feel flattered, but rather somewhat frightened.
As for the Heavenly Feather Divine King and the other strong members of the Immortal Spirit Clan, they all stood at the rear, not daring to speak, or perhaps they were trembling under the terrifying pressure that filled the space between heaven and earth.
Damn it, too scary.
A bunch of True Spirit Level ancient gods, with Divine King Level and Main God-level powerhouses all over the place.
Is this the real strength of the Human Race?
Just as the Sky Knife King and others swallowed hard, standing tense and nervous, Sherry Williams shook her head, “Everyone, there’s no need to be nervous. This is merely the Great Emperor showing respect for your arrival.”
“According to the rites of the Imperial Court, all cultivators above the Legendary Realm, please follow me to meet the Great Emperor.”
All subconsciously nodded their heads.
“Yes.”
Following behind Sherry Williams, including the strong men from the Heavenly Feather Clan and Immortal Spirit Clan, more than a hundred figures soared into the sky, flying out from the space within the battlefield.
The moment everyone appeared, countless gazes fell upon them.
At the same time, the clouds at the highest level dispersed, revealing nine figures emanating the mighty pressure of True Spirits, among them was Sara Williams with her black hair cascading over her shoulders and wearing a white godly attire with golden patterns, exquisite and grand.
At that moment, her stunning face was calm, exuding dignity and majesty.
Yet the flicker in her eyes betrayed her emotions at this time.
Suppressing a trace of excitement, Sara Williams looked toward the figure on the golden path, her eyes sparkling like stars sweeping over everyone, and then paused.
Brother Clark, not here?
Sara Williams looked towards Sherry Williams at the front of the delegation with puzzled eyes.
But before Sherry Williams could speak, behind the crowd at an even higher place, a red glow shone like the Great Sun, endless light seeping out from the depths of space.
Under the illumination of the red light, the space became translucent, revealing an imposing figure dressed in a red Imperial Robe and donning an Imperial Crown.
The instant that towering figure appeared, an almost Primordial supreme pressure spread out, enveloping the entire world, causing everyone to feel a sudden heaviness in their bodies.
Tens of thousands from the Imperial Guards, including the hundreds of thousands of ‘spectators’ behind them, all knelt on one knee and said in unison with respect:
“We pay homage to the supremely exalted Flame Wheel Great Emperor, may the Great Emperor shine brilliantly for all eternity, never to perish.”
“Greetings to Your Majesty.”
“Welcome, Your Majesty.”
Those Heavenly King Level officers, including Ancient God-level Star Official God Generals, all bowed, and even Domain Lords like Sara Williams made a slight curtsey towards that supreme figure.
Primordial True Kings, True Martial Kings, and other Supreme experts like Mysterious Martial Sky King and Gail Hills Heavenly King also bowed subconsciously.
As for the Sky Knife King among other Mythical-level Powerhouses, their legs went soft, nearly kneeling under the invisible but terrifying pressure that filled the space between heaven and earth.
This is the majesty of a monarch of an Imperial Dynasty.
Even with his aura retracted, merely standing there was supremely exalted, and no one could look directly at him.
Even Joshua Welan and others within the battlefield space, who were only at the Transcendence Realm, had already prostrated themselves on the ground much earlier.
In the midst of countless people, there were only a few who were not prostrate; for instance, Justin Welan was lying on the ground gasping for breath: “In this world, no one can make Grandpa Walton prostrate.”
Not far away, also lying down, Howard Lambert struggled to extend his hand, giving Justin Welan a thumbs up: “Well said, Justin Welan.”
“Don’t mention that one, not even Jack Clark could make old man Howard here do more than lie down in salutation.”
“That’s right.” Justin Welan curled his lips into a proud smile.
Lying beside them, Joshua Welan, upon hearing this, shook his head speechlessly. There was nothing shameful about lying down and respectfully greeting in the presence of such a terrifying existence above the rules.
And the bit about turning over to lie down despite being injured was unnecessary.
Just then, within the depths of the Warship, erupted a force not inferior to the Flame Wheel Great Emperor, its might almost comparable to a half-step into Primordial, shaking heaven and earth.
Boom!
[I originally intended to rest after writing this part, but upon reflection, I decided to finish this segment in one go]
[Brothers, refresh in an hour, there will be about two thousand more words.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1783: 659
chapters.content:
Chapter 1783: Chapter 659
“The Six Great Divine Domains are located behind the Human Race, and most cultivators at the Legendary Realm are active outside the Chaotic Heavens.”
“And this area outside the Chaotic Heavens is not the broadly defined Chaos Void but a place called the Ancient Battlefield, where there are records of over a thousand different civilized races.”
“These civilizations come from the Vast World, and others are from different races that transcended the restraints of their worlds and spaces, with formidable strength.”
“Among them, there are existences at the True Emperor Level presiding, and more than twenty civilizations have reached the peak, with over one hundred and thirty top-tier civilizations guarded by Primordial entities.”
“The remaining races are either vassals of these peak civilizations or members of some civilization alliance; thus, the situation there is quite complex.”
“Currently, the Flame Wheel Divine Domain controls four Outer Battle Cities, located in different battle zones, supporting each other with the battle cities of other Divine Domains.”
“This time we are heading to the Azure Sycamore Imperial City, where our Master personally presides.”
“Master says that Brother Clark, your talent is exceptionally astonishing; as soon as you appear on the battlefield, you will quickly attract the supreme attention of the surrounding peak civilizations.”
“Each of those beings is mighty, and many possess peculiar powers that even our Master finds troublesome.”
“Therefore, before you step onto the Ancient Battlefield, some preparations are needed to avoid being targetted across space-time by True Emperor Level and above existences using cause-and-effect and the Power of Destiny for assassination.”
Above tens of thousands of kilometers of the Central Heavenly Realm, a towering Stone Gate reaching ten thousand kilometers high proudly stands.
Jack Clark, Sara Williams, and the one showing his True Body—an imposing middle-aged man wearing a golden red Imperial Robe, an Imperial Crown on his head, with red light shining behind his head.
After Sara Williams finished speaking, Jack Clark contemplated, “No wonder, it took so long flying from the Emperor Dragon’s side, only encountering a station of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe.”
Thinking of this, Jack Clark felt puzzled: “Sara, why do all these civilized races gather at the Ancient Battlefield?”
Upon hearing this and before Sara Williams could speak, the Flame Wheel Great Emperor gently smiled and explained: “Because it’s special, it’s a nexus that connects to the Supreme Chaos.”
“The Supreme Chaos is a place where only Eternal Beings and above can enter or exit,” knowing that Jack Clark was clueless about these matters, the Flame Wheel Great Emperor patiently explained.
“Nearly a million years ago, the Vast World itself and another Eternal Being had a battle that tore through the Supreme Chaos, creating a rift area.”
“At that time, a strand of Supreme Chaos power descended, transforming and forming a semi-Eternal level ‘multi-layered world’, which is the Ancient Battlefield.”
“There, space-time has collapsed, dimensions are chaotic, connecting to countless unknown and dangerous regions, extremely perilous.”
“At the same time, the dispersed Eternal Air from the battle between the two Eternal Behemoths and the energy leaked from the Supreme Chaos have fostered numerous Divine Objects and treasures.”
“That is also why various peak civilizations station there and compete with each other.”
“No matter the era or civilization, the core of conflict is always interest—even those Primordial entities high above are no different.”
Jack Clark nods, signifying his understanding.
If it weren’t for interests, those Primordial Level existences who have already achieved immortality might have long since found a place to squat and live leisurely for a few hundred million years before doing anything else.
But faced with temptations that could accelerate cultivation progress and break through realms stagnant for tens or hundreds of millions of years, even Eternals cannot resist.
After all, breaking through to Eternal doesn’t mean there’s no pursuit left.
Otherwise, why would the Eternal Behemoth and the Chaotic Nightmare Master engage in fierce battle?
Now, with Sara Williams and the Flame Wheel Great Emperor’s explanations, Jack Clark has resolved some of the doubts in his heart and has a general understanding of the situation beyond the heavens.
But there are still some questions.
“What’s the situation with those Primordial Beasts outside the Chaotic Heavens and the Four Supreme Planes, as well as the Ancient Battlefield?”
“This issue is a bit complex.”
After pondering, the Flame Wheel Great Emperor said: “Those Primordial Beasts have deep ties with the Vast World, battling for years in the depths of the Chaos Void against the subordinates of another eternal being.”
“Their main objective seems to be searching for fragments, seeking the ‘parts’ of the body that belonged to that Eternal Behemoth after it shattered.”
“Because the goals and ‘ranges of activity’ of the two sides differ, and those behemoths are somewhat xenophobic, they do not much interact with the various peak civilizations and races.”
“As for the Four Supreme Planes, they represent another form of special power. While they are called planes, in fact, they can be considered exceedingly powerful concepts of ‘life’ beyond description.”
“The Reincarnation True Emperor once spent thousands of years studying the essence of the Supreme Planes’ existence, but later for some reason chose to give up.”
“Merely stating that it’s another path, a path infinitely close to one that might lead to the threshold of Eternity.”
“As for complexity, in countless worlds and civilizations, including all major peak races, there are proxy agents for the three Supreme Planes.”
“As long as one has the aptitude and potential, and their cultivation of a certain power aligns with the Supreme Hell, Supreme Heaven, and Supreme Abyss, they will receive an invitation from the Supreme Planes.”
“This leads to many civilizations where, internally, there might suddenly arise situations where exceptional talents vie for life and death.”
“Including some civilizations of different races that, due to special opportunities, are recognized by a tribe of Primordial Beasts—though their levels might be ordinary—they might have a group of Primordial Beasts backing them.”
“They may even possess the bloodline of that Primordial Beast group, becoming a certain bloodline race, and pull the might of that Primordial Beast group into the Ancient Battlefield.”
“…Indeed very complex.” Even Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel overwhelmed by this explanation.
Unexpectedly, beyond the Chaotic Heavens, it was so ‘chaotic,’ with numerous strong entities and many powers, and each civilization had different purposes and goals for their races.
But chaos is good.
A faint smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face; an era of chaotic disorder suited him best—after all, one can fish in troubled waters.
In the midst of their conversation, the Rune Array inscribed on the surface of the Stone Gate finally lit up completely, forming a murky vortex within.
As the great vortex churned, the intangible materials around it, imperceptible to the senses, time and space, were all disrupted, emitting a majestic and fearsome surge.
Sara turned her head, speaking softly to Jack Clark: “Brother Clark, let’s go.”
“Through the Ancient Heavenly Gate, we can leap through space-time directly to the edge of the Ancient Battlefield, to the core of our Human Race’s Azure Sycamore Imperial City.”
“The Ancient Battlefield, huh.” Jack Clark was somewhat anticipatory as the three stepped into the vortex simultaneously.
Boom!
The Stone Gate trembled, a dazzling and magnificent grey pillar of light piercing through Heaven and Earth, through the Firmament of the mythical world, and into the far beyond, disappearing into the endless Void.
The glow that emanated nearly illuminated the entire Central Heavenly Realm’s mainland, causing countless people to involuntarily look up.
Including Mathilda Ward and others who had entered the Flame Wheel Imperial City, they too saw that towering grey column of light piercing through heaven and earth, the young man’s silhouette involuntarily surfacing in their minds.
Even though they did not know about the existence of the Ancient Heavenly Gate, intuition told her Jack Clark was inside.
Regrettably, as the disparity in their strengths grew wider, the once intertwined paths of these two people gradually diverged.
And all it took was one year.
In the square of the Imperial Dynasty library, the Mysterious Martial Sky King turned to look at Mathilda Ward, who had halted her steps, and gestured to her, “Miss Joseline, let’s go, we will proceed with registration for reading access first.”
“Coming, Father,” Mathilda Ward refocused her gaze.
…
In the Chaos Void stood an imposing and immensely large fortress, as if a one-sided world, towering in red.
In front of the fortress gate spanned a silver-blue Sky Curtain resembling an eye, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers, teeming with airships and Giant Beasts moving in and out between the Sky Curtain and the city.
Such prosperity is exceedingly rare in the boundless Chaos Void.
Behind the red fortress, on a combined area of tens of thousands of kilometers of square, dozens of varying sizes of upright planar vortexes slowly revolved.
Boom! The largest muddled vortex suddenly vibrated intensely, the majestic energy emitted stirring Space-Time.
In the center of the vortex, strands of golden red light shimmered, followed by three figures slowly emerging.
Instantly, dozens of cultivators guarding around the pathway all knelt on one knee, respectfully saying, “We pay homage to Your Majesty, greetings to the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall.”
Others passing through different pathways, along with many strangely-shaped beings of different races upon seeing this, also bowed in salute.
“We welcome Your Majesty.”
Amongst these people were not lacking those of Heavenly King and of ancient late stage, in addition to those emanating Eight Layer Heaven and Nine Layers Heaven aura from different races and cultivators, all being ‘Indigenous People’ born in Azure Sycamore Imperial City.
Although entering the Chaos Void requires at least being in the Legendary Realm, under the ‘Rule’ protection of the Imperial City, even those below the Legendary Realm could live there.
The Flame Wheel Great Emperor had an indifferent expression, surveyed his surroundings, and then slowly nodded, “Everyone, rise. Go about your business.”
“As you command,” the people bowed respectfully once more.
The abode of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor was located in a gorgeous golden palace suspended above the clouds of the Imperial City.
As Jack Clark followed Sara Williams and the Flame Wheel Great Emperor, passed through nine layers of checkpoints and several terrifying fluctuations that swept over them, he arrived deep into the palace.
Within a somewhat transparent illusory cosmos, endless red flames burned; an immeasurably majestic figure sat cross-legged at the center of the universe.
It was a woman, dressed in a white-gold feathered magnificent Imperial Robe, wearing a Golden Twenty-Four Heavens Crown on her head, holding a Great Sun in her hands, and her red hair cascaded down like a waterfall extending into the Void.
Meanwhile, Jack Clark and the two others stood on the edge of the cosmos.
Upon seeing that towering figure, Sara Williams respectfully said, “Master, I have brought Brother Clark over.”
The Flame Wheel Great Emperor also bowed slightly, “Flame Wheel greets Aunt-Mother.”
Aunt-Mother, isn’t she a descendant of a True Emperor? Jack Clark looked at the Flame Wheel Great Emperor in surprise, having always thought that the Flame Wheel Great Emperor was the son or grandson of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor.
At the center of the universe, the Blazing Heaven True Emperor slowly opened her eyes, and instantly two golden red Star-like eyes that burned with flames appeared, emitting a terrifying glow.
The moment those eyes looked towards Jack Clark, an extremely heavy pressure on the soul hit him head-on.
Boom! Jack Clark’s hair danced wildly, and behind him an illusory soul figure tens of thousands of kilometers tall, wearing a black Imperial Robe and a Twenty-Four Heavens Crown, emerged.
Under the oppression from the Soul Will level, Jack Clark’s soul avatar instinctively appeared.
Even so, he was still unable to withstand direct gaze from Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s eyes; the will carried in that look was too terrifying, potent enough to keep causing tremors to Jack Clark’s soul avatar.
Fortuitously, that dreadful will pressure flashed by in an instant, and then a soft voice resonated through the Void.
“My apologies, I’ve had some breakthroughs in my cultivation lately, a strand of my undying will inadvertently leaked and almost injured you.”
“I’m alright, Senior, no need to mind it.”
Just a strand of will was so terrifying; this was not any True Emperor of Fourth Heavenly Realm, Jack Clark suppressed the shock in his heart.
Having witnessed the strength of the Purple Glow Divine Dragon of the Third Day Realm, Jack Clark had some understanding of the few realms that precede the Primary stage.
Thus, he could confirm, Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s cultivation was not just of some Primary Fourth Heavenly Realm.
While Jack Clark was astounded by the cultivation of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, awe also emerged in her eyes, “If I remember correctly, hasn’t it only been three Sun Wheels since Sherry last reported about the ancestral lands?”
In the face of Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s gaze, Sara Williams respectfully nodded, “Yes, Master.”
Astonishment surfaced in Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s eyes, “Three Sun Wheels, and your cultivation has jumped from ancient late stage to mid period of True Spirit; even we cannot match this pace of cultivation.”
Jack Clark humbly shook his head, “Far from it, Senior is overpraising.”
“Compared to those ancestors of Human Race who braved into the unknown space-times on the brink of their doomsday tens of thousands of years ago; my achievements are negligible.”
In response, Blazing Heaven True Emperor smiled slightly and did not continue on the topic, “On your way here, Flame Wheel and others must have already introduced the situation to you, right?”
“Yes, they have.”
Blazing Heaven True Emperor slowly began, “Our Human Race has come this far, not relying on the strength of one person alone.”
“It is through mutual assistance and support that we have reached this day.”
“Hence, you don’t have to worry about us having any schemes against you; the help provided to you and those who come from the ancestral lands falls within what’s expected.”
“Of course, there are limits to this help. How far you can go still depends on yourselves.”
[]

chapters.title: Chapter 1784: 660: Tone it Down a Bit, Devouring Primordial
chapters.content:
Chapter 1784: Chapter 660: Tone it Down a Bit, Devouring Primordial
“Chaos Emperor City.”
Jack Clark was somewhat interested in the advice from Sparkling Heaven True Emperor.
Just as she said, for Jack Clark, who rose through constant battles, only the ancient battlefield where hundreds of tribes contend could let him grow faster.
By seizing more Chaotic Divine Objects and engaging in cosmic wars during ‘idle times,’ he believed he could breakthrough the Primordial realm soon.
Seeing that Jack Clark had no objections, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor slowly spoke: “Since you have no objections, Jack Clark, Sara will take you there soon and assist you as the deputy city lord in the meantime.”
“Yes, master,” Sara nodded.
Being new to the place and unfamiliar with everything, even with the True Emperor’s Edict, going there directly would still cause some troubles.
But with the assistance of Sara Williams, the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall, acting as his deputy would run the operations of the Chaos Emperor City smoothly, and Jack Clark understood this point.
Once things were set, the next was about detailing which was introduced by Flame Wheel Great Emperor, who had guarded that area for many years.
“The ancient battlefield is composed of multiple layers of the Chaos Cosmos, and the Chaos Emperor City is located in the First Layer, which produces Heaven and Earth Treasures and Innate Divine Weapons suitable for cultivators below the True Spirit Level.”
“Therefore, the starry space surrounding the city is vast, aside from explorers from the Six Great Divine Domains, there are three million Black Armored Imperial Guards stationed permanently to patrol the vicinity.”
“These Black Armored Imperial Guards consist of cultivators at the Ninth Tier, each of whom practices the Godslayer Battle Body, and their Godslayer Black Armor is also a standard issue.”
“Ten as a team, peerless within the same rank, a hundred form a formation capable of confronting Mythic War Generals, and a thousand teamed up can contest with Titan Monarchs.”
“If led by a War General, three thousand-strong teams can even slay a Titan; the more there are, the stronger the power enshrined in the Godslayer Battle Formation.”
“When a million-strong Godslayer army moves out, led by a True Spirit Divine General, they could even slay a True Spirit Emperor of the same realm.”
“Aside from our Human Race’s power, the known areas around the First Layer currently have five peak civilizations, thirty-seven top-tier civilizations, and several hundred powerful civilizations.”
“Among the five peak civilizations, the Gold Eternal Divine Clan, Heavenly Flame Divine Race, and Soul Devouring Mayfly Race are neutral, while the You Tian War God Clan and Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon are hostile towards the Human Race.”
“And among the thirty-seven top-tier civilizations …”
Since it was a ‘mission handover,’ Flame Wheel Great Emperor gave a thorough introduction.
For example, among the neighboring peak civilizations, every guardian of the semi-Primordial Realm holds Creation Level Divine Weapons and possesses the power of Primordial Stars.
Also, in the thirty-plus top-tier civilizations, some races’ strongest members may not have Creation Level Divine Weapons, but can still break the shackles under their terrifying racial talent.
The strongest three guardians among these top-tier civilizations, also at the semi-Primordial Realm, are not weaker than the guardians of the six peak civilizations.
Beyond these peak powerhouses, the forces stationed by various powers should not be underestimated.
For example, the three million Black Armored Imperial Guards stationed in Chaos Emperor City, three Divine Generals at mid True Spirit Level, thirty-five Ancient Powerhouses, and numerous Titan Levels and Mythic Levels.
Of course, even for the Flame Wheel Divine Domain with a population of a hundred billion, it’s tough to muster three million Ninth Tier cultivators into an army.
These individuals mainly consist of cultivators with ordinary talent who after joining the military go through rigorous selection processes and are cultivated using forbidden medicines in combination with the Godslayer Battle Body techniques.This approach significantly scales up the creation of elite Ninth Tier soldiers, the trade-off being that they can never break through to the Mythical Realm, and their cultivation will not progress further.
But nothing is absolute.
In the over twenty thousand years since the Black Armored Imperial Guards appeared, the Godslayer army has still produced some exceptional talents, who breached their limits through supreme will and opportunities.
And once these individuals break through to the Mythical Level, their progress in cultivation is explosive, and their combat power is unmatched.
After Flame Wheel Great Emperor finished speaking, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor slowly began, “The surroundings of Chaos Emperor City are fiercely contested, and the emergence of a Chaotic Divine Object imbued with the aura of Eternity always triggers a major war.”
“Therefore, this time, you should be a bit more restrained in your actions, Jack Clark. For instance, try to avoid killing the guardians of other peak civilizations.”
At this point, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor felt somewhat troubled.
Having ‘seen’ the information previously relayed by Sherry, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor and the others knew Jack Clark very well and were aware that his conduct was overbearing and his decisions, decisive.
That’s why they made a point of cautioning him.
Otherwise, once Jack Clark got there and acted during the struggle over a Chaotic Divine Object by killing a guarding city lord, any fool would understand that such a person should not be left unchecked.”
After all, every half-step Primordial from a peak civilization is an exceptional monster, backed by top-tier Cultivation Methods and Divine Powers.
In such cases, there may be differences between individuals of the same rank, but these gaps aren’t vast; typically, one might have the upper hand or be slightly suppressed, except when ganged upon.
But as a mid True Spirit Human, killing a semi Primordial guardian city lord would immediately ignite the nearby peak civilizations.”
Even those neutral civilizations would feel an intangible threat.”
Regarding this, Jack Clark only smiled and said, “Thank you, Senior, for the reminder. I will try to keep a low profile when the time comes.”
These peak True Emperor level existences indeed pose trouble, but as soon as the Terminal Emperor Dragon breaks through to Primordial, even if a True Emperor of the Fourth Heavenly Realm attacks, Jack Clark will still have the means to defend himself.”
And by then, Jack Clark might also have stepped halfway into the Primordial Realm, or even crossed into it.”
Subsequently, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor bestowed Jack Clark a decree, a token of his appointment as the city lord of the Chaos Emperor City.”
The five great cities belong not only to the Flame Wheel Divine Domain but also to the entire Human Race; besides the Chaos Emperor City, other cities are guarded by True Emperors or other Primordial powerhouses in rotation.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1785: 660: Tone it Down, Devouring the Primordial_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1785: Chapter 660: Tone it Down, Devouring the Primordial_2
Just before leaving, Jack Clark suddenly said, “Blazing Heaven Senior, may I presume to ask a question?”
“What question?”
“Senior, your cultivation level isn’t just at the Primary Fourth Heavenly Realm, is it?”
Jack Clark’s words took Sara Williams and Flame Wheel Great Emperor by surprise. They hadn’t expected him to ask this, although they were curious as well.
Regarding this question, Blazing Heaven True Emperor only slowly opened his mouth: “True Emperor was the title I and others used when sweeping through surrounding civilizations in Void ten thousand years ago.”
After finishing speaking, the image of Flame Universe and Blazing Heaven True Emperor slowly disappeared, revealing a red divine wall.
Already a True Emperor ten thousand years ago, Jack Clark pondered thoughtfully.
Outside the Azure Sycamore Imperial City, under the silvery blue Sky Curtain, the moment Jack Clark and Sara Williams stepped in, they appeared directly above a galaxy condensed, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers.
The starlight starts from the Azure Sycamore Imperial City and flows in four directions.
Walking above the river of starlight, Sara Williams, dressed in a gorgeous gown, her demeanor elegant and noble, beautifully incomparable, softly spoke,
“This is the Galaxy Passage opened by the Eternal True Emperor using the ancient battlefield entrance of the Imperial City as a node, combining the power of the five elements with the brilliance of the stars.”
“Walking upon it is like treading across the starry sky, enabling quick travel to the other four Imperial Cities without getting lost in the chaotic currents and without encountering dangers.”
“At the same time, it contains condensed rules, which can still warp space-time in the Galaxy Passage, moving along the pathway directions at a speed far faster than the Chaos Void.”
“With Brother Clark and my cultivation level, it’ll only take us about half a day to reach the Chaos Emperor City.”
Jack Clark scanned warships flying over the river surface, carrying people and supplies aboard gigantic beasts, and nodded in approval.
This pathway was indeed excellent, resembling speedways that penetrate deep into time and space, linking all five Emperor Cities, greatly facilitating the flow of people and supplies.
As for the teleportation stone doors of Azure Sycamore Imperial City, they could only be used in the Chaos Void, connecting the Six Great Divine Domains, and couldn’t traverse the Chaos Cosmos.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark took up his role as the Lord of Chaos Emperor City, the Terminal Emperor Dragon had finally waited for its meal to arrive.
Roar!
The deep and majestic Dragon Roar shook the Chaos, instantly causing the earth to tremble, creating upheavals among mountain ranges, dense forests, and mile-spanning rivers.
Roar roar roar!!
Tens of thousands of True Dragons, formed by the Power of Heaven and Earth roared, rising into the sky under the leadership of True Spirit-level True Spirits, rushing toward the outside world.
There, even more Nightmare Fiend Beasts surged like a vast Tsunami, overwhelming the sky and earth.
Compared to the majestic and sacred Void True Dragons, these black ferocious beasts with upper bodies resembling the Furious Ape and lower bodies with a pair of curved long legs, covered in an insect exoskeleton, seemed particularly ferocious.
The sharp slash blades on the forearms of these beasts were indestructible, revealing a mastery of Sword Skill.
Added to the gigantic beasts’ formidable strength and Defense, their abilities were no less than the same-tier Void True Dragons.
Yi ya yi ya!! May’s invincible, rivers of blood flowed.
Among the myriad Void True Dragons, a purely purple Mr. Loore resembling a crystal roared excitedly, following behind several True Spirit-level True Dragons.
In addition, a Silver Giant Dragon over 6,000 meters long also let out an excited Dragon Roar, lunging at a nearly 10,000-meter-tall Nightmare Fiend Beast.
As the grand battle erupted on the Chaos Continent, several Primordial Beasts in the Chaos Void outside the mainland also confronted each other.
Primordial Monarch-level Purple Glow Divine Dragon, Primordial Overlord-level Purple Season Divine Dragon, Star Level Purple Even, and Late Stage of True Spirit Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Among their opponents, aside from the three Nightmare Fiend Beasts repelled last time, there was also a strange gigantic beast exuding the aura of a Primordial Overlord.
It was a ferocious beast with a body covered in black scales, 140,000 kilometers long, with the lower half resembling a dragon-steed with four paws stepping through the void, while the upper body had a pair of strong claws, head resembling a Violent Dragon with a single horn.
Sharp bone spurs grew on this beast’s spine and joints, its tail stretching tens of thousands of kilometers like a gigantic python, but ended with a sharp bone spur.
Together with its mouthful of sharp teeth surrounded by tangible black hurricanes, it was completely a Slaughter Machine armed to the teeth.
The three Divine Dragons of Purple Glow felt somewhat solemn all of a sudden.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon was very strong; the second stage of its transformation even reached an Overlord-level in terms of Power Explosion.
But relying on bursts to barely reach Primordial Overlord and actually being a Primordial Overlord were totally different concepts—one was to reach the limit, the other was a normal state.
With a slight burst, it could suppress the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Not to mention, once the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s energy was exhausted, unable to maintain its second transformation, a single swipe of the claw from that Primitive Overlord beast could kill it.
The Purple Glow Divine Dragon growled lowly, its voice echoing among the three Divine Dragons and the Terminal Emperor Dragon,
“King of the Dragon Palace, be careful, that is one of the subordinates of the Chaotic Nightmare Master, the Prossian Beast, commanding speed and ferocity even surpassing the same-tier Nightmare Fiend Beasts.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly nodded: “That ferocious beast is indeed strong.”
In the senses of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the ferocious beast named Prossian Beast exuded a strong dangerous aura, clearly its strength was far from as simple as it appeared on the surface.
It feels only slightly weaker than that Third Day Monarch-level Nightmare Fiend Beast.
But this battle is not unwinnable. The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s gaze swept across the four fierce beasts, focusing on the one that was 70,000 kilometers long, its aura weakened,
The fierce beast it had cleaved in half during the last conflict.
Although it is unknown what Divine Object it relied on to ‘repair’ its True Body, the Divine Soul Intent, Rule Origin, and those talents it had annihilated could not be restored.

chapters.title: Chapter 1786: 660: Tone It Down a Bit, The Devouring Primordial_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1786: Chapter 660: Tone It Down a Bit, The Devouring Primordial_3
At that thought, a fierce light flashed through the golden vertical pupils of the Terminal Dragon, its powerful Divine Soul Intent connecting with the three Divine Dragons, instantly completing the communication.
Roar!
In the Chaos Void, the Purple Glow Divine Dragon, spanning a million kilometers, let out a roar, making the first move, with layers of ‘Heavenly Realm’ unfolding around it, pouncing towards the most formidable Nightmare Fiend Beast within the envelopment of the Triplex World.
Instantly, the Nightmare Fiend Beast, covered with Golden Patterns, revealed a cold and cruel glare, and its icy roar exploded in the Void in an instant.
“Facing such disadvantage, yet you not only did not flee in pieces but took the initiative to attack, I don’t know whether to call you arrogant or suicidal.”
“Since that’s the case, today let’s bury both yourselves and that shard in the Void, kill.”
Boom!
The six Layers of quasi-real worlds collided, the formidable strength warping space-time; an instant annihilation of the Void occurred between the worlds colliding, time distorted and overlapped.
Without sound, the two Primordial Monarch Beasts, as if in another space-time, another dimension, were entangled in combat.
Each strike contained the power to Destroy Heaven and Earth, echoing through ancient times, even ripping the river of time into view, transforming into a transparent river that pierced through the layers of worlds.
Roar!
The Purple Divine Dragon, spanning thirty thousand kilometers, roared, emitting an incomparably splendid purple light: “Morocdo, let us battle again.”
“Today, I shall sever your head.”
The Black Demon Ape, reaching over a hundred and twenty thousand kilometers in height and wielding a pair of pitch-black slash blades, roared out loud.
Boom!
Space shattered, and the hundred-thousand-kilometer-long dark blade light converged, forging a relentless Annihilation that left behind a Destruction Tunnel millions of kilometers long in the Chaos Void.
Roar! The Purple Season Divine Dragon roared, spitting out a gigantic purple Dragon Ball from its mouth.
Boom! The moment the Dragon Ball appeared, the Chaos Void within billions of kilometers trembled, endless muddled currents converged towards the Dragon Ball, continuously swelling in size.
Around the Dragon Ball, which had expanded to ten thousand kilometers in the blink of an eye, thirteen purple bands of light appeared, resembling order chains or Star Rings.
From a distance, the Dragon Ball resembled a white dwarf star encircled by Star Rings, radiating an immensely dazzling light and energy fluctuations.
“You’re insane!”
Watching the rotating Dragon Ball shredding everything, scattering the Chaos as it came, the Nightmare Fiend Beast issued an outraged roar.
Thump! The Dragon Ball struck and shattered the two million-kilometer-long blade lights; its momentum unabated, it instantly slammed into the pitch-black slash blade of the Nightmare Fiend Beast.
Boom! The entire Chaos Void shook.
The instantly released energy from the impact was incredibly dazzling, illuminating an area of hundreds of billions of kilometers, and the shockwave destroyed and compressed everything around into a black ‘material’ resembling condensed matter.
When this force accumulated to its peak in an instant, it suddenly burst in all directions.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The devastating shock instantly swept across billions of kilometers, layer upon layer, like a monstrous black Tsunami engulfing and ravaging the Void.
The formidable power even blasted the Nightmare Fiend Beast millions of kilometers away, its Dominance utterly overwhelming.
“Purple Season, don’t think you’re the only one with a Lifeline Talent.”
The enraged roar shook space-time, and the Chaotic Nightmare Ferocious Beast, measuring twelve thousand kilometers in height, burst forth with scorching Blood Qi, transforming into pitch-black flames that soared to the sky.
In an instant, the Nightmare Fiend Beast’s body swelled, sharp blackthorns grew all over its body, and even under its arms grew another pair of arm slash blades.
At the very moment that the two Primordial Overlord Level Void Heaven Divine Dragons and Nightmare Fiend Beast clashed, the Purple Even Divine Dragon, spanning tens of thousands of kilometers, also roared and pounced towards the Nightmare Fiend Beast.
As for the Terminal Emperor Dragon, its opponent was the Prossian beast.
Looking at the Black-red Colossal Beast, which was just fifty thousand meters in length and whose body length was more than two hundred times smaller and total size more than ten thousand times smaller than the black Ferocious Beast, a hideous smile split across its face.
Then a low growl that shook the Chaos slowly arose.
“I’ve heard of you, a mere mid-period True Spirit inflicting a heavy injury on Morox, even I wouldn’t… wait a minute.” The black Ferocious Beast suddenly paused.
Previously, due to the auras of the three Void Heaven Divine Dragons enveloping them, the three Nightmare Fiend Beasts, and that black Ferocious Beast, they all failed to detect something off about the aura of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
But before the black Ferocious Beast could speak, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s body was already radiating a dazzling red light, with a sky filled with crimson lightning erupting.
But just then the light vanished, and the entire Chaos Void was shrouded in darkness.
Boom! From deep within the darkness, an oppressive force comparable to that of the Primordial Overlords descended, along with a terrifying power that twisted the rules and filled the Chaos, shaking the Void.
It was as though a colossally vast Beast was lurking within, a slight move threatening to burst the Chaos.
Without sound or warning, a Dragon Claw wreathed in black Flame Power, as though carrying an entire supreme world of Destruction, emerged from the darkness above the black Ferocious Beast’s head.
Under that supremely Overbearing force, the two layers of worlds surrounding the black Ferocious Beast vibrated, revealing huge Black Cracks.
The terrifying power even forced the black Ferocious Beast’s body to sink downwards, its claws pressing down as the Void shattered layer by layer, forming rings of black-purple Halos tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter.
“That strength, you indeed deserve to die.”
Glimpsing the sky-obscuring, Death-representing black Dragon Claw above, the black Ferocious Beast let out a frenzied roar, with terror and murderous intent flashing in its eyes.
Just the disappearance of a single Sun Wheel enabled it to breakthrough from the mid to late periods of True Spirit, and the strength it possessed was almost comparable to that of the Primordial Overlords.
Especially this Beast with terrifying talent and combat strength, also hailing from Griffith Eternal World.
In that moment, this black Ferocious Beast felt much the same as the Demon Gods like Brutus upon discovering Jack Clark’s talent, sensing a tremendous threat emanating from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1787: 660: Tone It Down a Bit, The Devouring Primordial_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 1787: Chapter 660: Tone It Down a Bit, The Devouring Primordial_4
It was a fear that if not killed sooner, the adversary might become unbeatable the next time.
Death, this Giant Beast must be slain.
Boom!
From within the Black Colossus, a terrifying Power Explosion erupted, the sturdy back suddenly tore open, revealing the dripping blood-soaked flesh and blood and an even more terrifying figure beneath.
Like shedding its shell, a fierce behemoth, standing fifteen thousand kilometers tall, emerged from within the blood-splattered carcass of the black creature.
In general appearance identical, only the legs beneath had become a pair, the body even more robust, the arms elongated, and the claws amounted to a third of the body size.
And all this happened in an instant.
One could only see a colossal pitch-black claw shooting skyward, meeting the Black Flames-infused Dragon Claw that embodied Supreme Destruction, with boundless black hurricanes twisting between the claws, containing a world of destructive hurricanes.
Puff!
The pitch-black claw intersected with the Black Dragon Claw, there wasn’t a world-shaking explosion, just a black light wave that annihilated everything within tens of thousands of kilometers into nothingness.
Including the muddled currents pervading the Chaos Void.
All disappeared, leaving only the two massive, ferocious behemoths behind.
This strike resulted in a tie.
After breaking through to the Late Stage of True Spirit and entering the Terminal Dragon Form, the Emperor Dragon’s strength became even greater, barely reaching the threshold of a Primordial Overlord, now comparable to a mighty Overlord.
Within the darkness, the moment the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s claw collided with the black creature, dozens of black claws appeared out of nowhere around the Terminal Dragon.
These black claws moved so swiftly that even the consciousness of the Terminal Dragon could barely perceive them.
Moreover, at this moment, caught in the backlash of the Burst force, even the Terminal Force could only watch as dozens of black claws merged into one, piercing through the darkness, tearing the Chaos domain apart.
Boom!
The Primal Hegemon’s Full-Force Strike, akin to the second form’s Lifeline Talent burst, struck the chest of the Terminal Dragon, exploding with a terrifying roar.
Further amplified by a power capable of tearing and crushing worlds, even the Terminal Dragon was forced to retreat.
In the darkness, a Void Continent with a diameter of tens of thousands of kilometers billions of kilometers away exploded, releasing a supernova’s dazzling brilliance, yet all was devoured by darkness.
Amidst the destructiveness of the explosion, a thirty-thousand-kilometer-tall Black Colossus stood erect, its vertical pupil eyes excitedly burning with Black Flames.
On the chest scale armor of the Terminal Dragon, numerous fine cracks tens of meters wide and tens of thousands of meters long were slowly disappearing.
This was the Terminal Dragon’s second injury in recent times; last time it was the Nightmare Fiend Beast of the Primordial Monarch that slashed through its scale armor, and this time a ferocious beast of the Primal Hegemon.
“So this is your speed, indeed very fast,”
Looking at the black creature with an overwhelming aura billions of kilometers away, the Terminal Dragon let out an excited roar: “The feeling of being injured, so exhilarating, come again.”
Boom!
A pitch-black lightning arc wriggled through the Chaos Void, disregarding space and all obstacles, reaching the speed nearly a million times that of light, crossing billions of kilometers in an instant.
In the darkness, the Terminal Dragon appeared above the black creature’s head, both claws raised high, just like a human condensing a certain battle seal.
In an instant, the aura of the Terminal Dragon surged again, both claws radiated dazzling black light, so magnificent and brilliant it could not be described with words.
It was like the incarnation of Supreme Destruction and Doomsday, the destructive power filled the entire Chaos Void, turning into a boundless Black Colossus.
Unavoidable, inescapable.
Roar!
The black creature spewed substantial Black Hurricanes from around itself, shattering everything within tens of millions of kilometers, unveiling its slowly unfurling double claws capturing all the winds of destruction.
Like grasping an entire Great Thousand Worlds, it confronted the beast of destruction.
At this moment, the power unleashed by the two behemoths was even greater than that of Purple Even Divine Dragon and the Nightmare Fiend Beast, drawing the attention of the entire Chaos Void battlefield.
Boom!
The immense Black Colossus, manifested by the pure power of destruction and Doomsday, roared as it shattered the time-space-tearing Black Hurricane, grinding everything into dust.
Even the second form black creature’s claw scale armor shattered to pieces.
Its massive body crashed through the Void, slammed by the Terminal Dragon’s full-bodied power, a move akin to the Emperor Dragon Heaven-Treading Seal, into an unknown layer of Space-Time.
That powerful strike stirred Chaos, creating a pitch-black Hollow tens of millions of kilometers in size, with swirling winds and twisting space-time around it.
Even glimpses of other worlds appeared within this range, a plethora of strange phenomena.
This is the Supreme Destruction.
Roar! A ferocious and fierce roar shook the Chaos; the moment it pushed back the black creature with one strike, that black lightning snake wriggled through the darkness again.
And this time, the Terminal Dragon’s target was the Nightmare Fiend Beast that was entangling with Purple Even Divine Dragon.
Roar!
The roar of the Terminal Dragon was a signal; as it appeared behind the Primordial Star Fierce Beast at a terrifying speed beyond time and perception, Purple Even Divine Dragon also Instantaneous Explosion-ed.
Boom!
Under the shining of purple light, the Divine Dragon’s body, tens of thousands of kilometers long, swelled massively, indefinitely stretching into a dragon a million kilometers long.
The Aura surged tenfold, the formidable pressure filling Heaven and Earth.
A giant Dragon Claw reached out, under its grip was a colossal phantom sky, containing the Supreme power of Heavenly Dao that enveloped the Nightmare Beast Morox.
The coordinated pincer attack from the two behemoths exerted a terrifying pressure that made the Nightmare Fiend Beast’s soul panic.
At that moment, the Nightmare Fiend Beast remembered the fear of being bifurcated, torn apart into two halves: “Save me, Morocco, they target me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1788: 660: Tone It Down a Bit, The Devouring Primordial_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 1788: Chapter 660: Tone It Down a Bit, The Devouring Primordial_5
The roar of fear shakes the Chaos.
“Damn it.”
“Block them.”
The two entangled Nightmare Fiend Beasts let out furious roars, reacting in an instant as black flames erupted from their bodies, multiplying their aura by several times in an instant.
However, the distance between the two parties was too great, and with a Xu Tian Divine Dragon of the same level restraining them, rescue was impossible.
As for the Prossian beast whose task was to suppress, or even slay, the Terminal Dragon, its whereabouts were still unknown in space-time, let alone offering support.
In the Void illuminated by purple light, myriads of Divine Dragon Shadows, each tens of thousands of kilometers long, roared, freezing time and space, and everything was imprisoned, including the Nightmare Fiend Beast, which was sealed for an instant.
In a moment where time stood still, a pitch-black Tail Blade fell with the might of Opening Heaven and Earth, splitting heaven and earth in two and leaving a pitch-black abyss in the Chaos.
Including the true body of the Nightmare Fiend Beast, it was also slashed into two halves, seized by double claws burning with flame power akin to black flames.
The very moment the Terminal Dragon seized the beast’s body, countless black lightnings and black flames spread along its double claws, enveloping the fragmented body of the Nightmare Fiend Beast.
Under the powers of destruction, doomsday, and chaos, the already heavily injured beast’s strength and will were completely suppressed.
“Save us!” A desperate roar echoed in the Chaos Void.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Just as the Terminal Dragon suppressed the Nightmare Fiend Beast, the surrounding chaos shattered, an endless Black Hurricane surged forth, forming the massive figure of a black vicious beast.
But it was all too late.
Boom! A fierce snout flashing black-red radiance fell down, directly biting off the head of the Nightmare Fiend Beast held in the claw, emitting a terrifying roar.
“Roar! Shut up.”
The Prossian beast roared, launching a black hurricane that veiled the Chaos Void toward the Terminal Dragon, with a mighty force as if to overturn the entire chaos.
But at this moment, the Purple Even Divine Dragon, having entered its Lifeline Talent form, roared, standing between the Terminal Dragon and the black vicious beast.
“If you want to save it, defeat me first.”
The Xu Tian Divine Dragon, millions of kilometers long, roared with purple primordial light shining behind it, transforming into a vast sky.
Boom!
Under the black hurricane, the purple sky was directly shattered, and the massive true body of the Xu Tian Divine Dragon was also blasted away with many scale armor shattered.
Facing a black vicious beast that was considered very strong even among the Primordial Overlords, the Purple Even Divine Dragon, just at Star Level in the primordial, was no match.
Even though its size and the power, defense, and primordial rule forces had increased tens of times under its Lifeline Talent, it was still no match at all.
With the obstruction of the Purple Even Divine Dragon, the Terminal Dragon’s second bite came down, devouring the other half head of the Nightmare Fiend Beast.
Suddenly, the strength of the massive body held in the claws weakened.
Under the Eternal Darkness Devouring Talent, everything devoured by the Terminal Dragon, including matter, energy, flesh and blood, and even presence, would be completely erased.
Including part of the primordial fierce beast’s Divine Soul Intent, that part of the true body containing primordial rules, and talent.
“Roar! I said, if you want to save it, you need to defeat me first.”
The Xu Tian Divine Dragon, millions of kilometers in length and part of the true body shattered, roared, standing in front of the black vicious beast, its wounds continuously healing under the purple halo.
“Asking for death.”
Watching the Xu Tian Divine Dragon blocking its path again, a terrifying murderous intent appeared in the eyes of the black vicious beast.
Boom!
The entire Chaos Void was overwhelmed by the black hurricane; within the terrifying hurricane, the figure of the black vicious beast was omnipresent, the sharpness emitted by its double claws even sharper than blades similar to the Nightmare.
Instantly, the sky surrounding the Xu Tian Divine Dragon was shattered by the black hurricane.
The powerful resultant force instantly caused the Purple Even Divine Dragon to spew blood.
The pitch-black double claws that shredded space-time engulfed the Divine Dragon, transformed into a purple rainbow light, instantly scattering shattered scales and flesh and blood across the Void.
In front of the black vicious beast possessing extreme speed, the Xu Tian Divine Dragon, already a Major Realm weaker, was no match at all.
It was directly shredded, heavily injured.
Even its giant dragon head was chopped off by the black vicious beast, grasped in its claw, manifesting unspeakable ferocity and terror.
Watching this scene, the eyes of the Terminal Dragon were icy cold, its fierce snout wide open, directly stuffing the larger half of the Nightmare Fiend Beast’s body under its left claw into its mouth.
Boom, boom, boom!! This time the Terminal Dragon didn’t even bother to chew, almost stuffing the body of the Nightmare Fiend Beast down its throat.
The giant body of the Primordial Beast and the mouth and throat rubbing against each other, stretching widely, emitted earth-shaking roars and massive energy explosions.
And at this time, the flesh and blood of the Primordial Beast that the Terminal Dragon swallowed earlier also began to transform, with star-explosion-like energy erupting endlessly within its body.
Suddenly, the aura of the Terminal Dragon surged, its body swelling at a visible rate to a towering height of thirty thousand kilometers.
This scene shocked even the black vicious beast, followed by an even more intense killing intent, its massive body moving to stop the Terminal Dragon.
But just then, the giant purple dragon head held in its claw suddenly opened wide, its sharp teeth flashing pure purple brilliance, piercing everything, biting half of its true body in one bite.
“I said, if you want to save it, defeat me first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1789: 661: Terrifying Giant Beast, Chaos City Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 1789: Chapter 661: Terrifying Giant Beast, Chaos City Lord
Roar!
The obstructed Prossian beast roared, its double claws wrapped in a black hurricane, tearing huge cracks into the colossal dragon head of the Purple Even Divine Dragon.
However, under the True Body form in the Rule world, the Defense of the Purple Even Divine Dragon was astonishingly remarkable, especially since it was burning the Origin of Dragon Ball; its already most solid dragon head was exceedingly sturdy.
Therefore, even in its furious state, the Prossian beast couldn’t instantly shatter the dragon head that was clamped onto it.
Looking at the distant Terminal Dragon whose size had ballooned to over thirty-five thousand kilometers, its Aura growing ever stronger and still swelling at a shocking speed, the black Ferocious Beast roared.
“That Giant Beast possesses a Devouring Talent that leads directly to the Origin; we cannot let it assimilate Morox. Stop it.”
Roar Roar!!
On two other battlefields, the two Nightmare Fiend Beasts entangled by two Void Heaven Divine Dragons roared, their bodies emitting Black Flames that pierced through Chaos and scorched the Void.
They, of course, were aware they couldn’t allow that Giant Beast to Devour Morox.
Otherwise, if the strength of that beast, comparable to a Primordial Overlord, was allowed to rise further, not only would they fail to destroy that shard today, they would barely escape with their hides intact.
Boom! The universe trembled; Chaos collapsed.
Billions of kilometers away, as worlds shattered layer by layer, the Nightmare Fiend Beast engaging in combat with the Purple Glow Divine Dragon arrived. Its left arm guarded against a claw from the Purple Glow Divine Dragon while its right arm wielding a slash blade made a horizontal cut.
The terrifying edge of the blade tore apart the Void; a Black Gold slash blade’s light of millions of kilometers long stirred Space-Time and instantly appeared in front of the Terminal Dragon.
This is the strength of a Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary Ferocious Beasts, their attacks unhindered by distances that span billions of kilometers, equivalent to the scope of a Star System.
Colorful flowing light spun and obscured the sky, covering this patch of Chaos, overtaking this piece of Space-Time with ‘Darkness’, to Annihilate.
Including the surrounding absolute Defense force field of the Terminal Dragon, it too shattered layer by layer under the blade light imbued with a sharp Overbearing Will, tearing apart.
But the Terminal Dragon at this moment was no longer the same as before.
Roar!
The Terminal Dragon, holding half of a Nightmare Fiend Beast ‘corpse’ with its right claw, roared, its left claw filled with darkness, as if gripping a Black Hole to meet the blade light head-on.
Boom! A world-shaking explosion echoed through Chaos, lighting up this piece of the Void with colors.
The dispersing colored blade light covered tens of millions of kilometers, shredding everything, including the Prossian beast and the fighting Purple Even Divine Dragon head that were swept away.
Just as the blade light submerged the Terminal Dragon, the ‘corpse’ of the Nightmare Fiend Beast in its right claw shuddered, its heart exploding into a burst of dark red blood light.
That streak of blood light was incredibly brilliant, even breaking through the destructive suppression of the Terminal Dragon.
As the Terminal Dragon was suppressed by that blade in an instant, the blood light pierced through the darkness and disappeared into the Void like a bubble burst.
Immediately, the ‘corpse’ held in the claws of the Terminal Dragon weakened in Aura, and the Primordial Origin within it also vanished along with the fleeing Nightmare Fiend Beast.
At the level of Primordial Stars, the difficulty to slay increases all the more.
Even though the Terminal Dragon suppressed this Primordial Fierce Beast in all aspects, and it was still in a state of heavy injury, it managed to escape in an instant when a sliver of opportunity was found.
Meanwhile, the instant the Third Heavenly Boundary Fierce Beast delivered a slash, behind it, a shining Golden Dragon Claw emerged.
The surface of the Golden Dragon Claw was inscribed with Mysterious runes, unbreakable, with overwhelming force that shattered the three layers of worlds surrounding the Nightmare Fiend Beast, and in the instant it contracted its pupil, it struck its back.
Boom! In the Chaos Void, a dark flare exploded, sweeping across tens of millions of kilometers.
At the center of the dark flare, a pitch-black beam of light shot out wildly, piercing through Space-Time and smashing an asteroid of tens of thousands of kilometers millions of kilometers away.
The intense glow of the planet explosion had just been released when it was extinguished by a terrifying force, revealing the Tyrannical Ferocious Beast standing firm in the Void.
At this moment, the insect-like Black Shell on the back of the Monarch Realm Ferocious Beast was shattered, collapsing, revealing the pulverized flesh and blood beneath.
Amid those wounds, pure golden light coursed, hindering the beast from recovering.
Gazing at the distant Purple Glow Divine Dragon sprawling in the Void, a million kilometers long, the Nightmare Fiend Beast’s eyes flickered ferociously, wrapped in an even more savage and brutal Aura.
Moreover, billions of kilometers away, the colorful slash blade light also slowly dissipated, revealing the fierce-looking Terminal Dragon.
On its left claw, a crack extended along the back of the claw up to the shoulder; the slash had breached its Defense, but relative to the last time, only half of the thick scale armor had been sliced open this time.
With increased strength and enhancement in all aspects, including recovery, the Defense of the Terminal Form Emperor Dragon became even more formidable.
The crack was healed in the blink of an eye under the terrifying recovery ability.
Although the Nightmare Fiend Beast’s slash didn’t heavily injure the Terminal Dragon, it achieved its purpose, as in the distant Void, a giant Ferocious Beast shadow loomed, standing seven thousand kilometers tall.
“Roar! Morocco, I am too weak to continue fighting, I’m leaving first.”
The creature that had only a trace of Origin left roared, slamming into the Void, and under the pull of a certain force, it tore through the Chaos with an indescribable speed.
Although it did not perish this time, this Ferocious Beast was left with barely a breath, its condition only slightly better than that of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon that had fallen in the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield.
Returning to Hibernation for a million years might yield a chance of recovering the Divine Soul Intent and Rule Origin injury.
Roar!
The Terminal Dragon roared, its ferocious maw expanding several times in size, like a bottomless Black Hole, stuffing the remnants of the Ferocious Beast in its right claw into its mouth, forcibly Devouring it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1790: 661: Terrifying Giant Beast, Chaos City Lord_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1790: Chapter 661: Terrifying Giant Beast, Chaos City Lord_2
Boom!
The endless energy within the Terminal Dragon erupted, and as it absorbed ample energy, the Terminal Dragon’s form swelled, becoming ever more colossal.
