Meanwhile, its massive body shrouded in darkness suddenly moved, traversing tens of millions of kilometers in an instant, appearing above the Prossian beast’s head with the aid of the Divine Speed Talent.
Roar! A heaven-shaking roar reverberated through Chaos.
In the darkness, the Terminal Dragon’s double claws embraced, spinning a black hole formed from pure destructive force between them, stirring the Chaos Void as it crashed down thunderously.
At the same time, the Tail Blade trailing twenty thousand kilometers behind the Terminal Dragon disappeared silently, leaving behind an ominous Black Scar that even darkness couldn’t conceal.
Just as the Terminal Dragon appeared, the Purple Even Divine Dragon, its skull shattered and dragon horns broken, barely clinging to its bones, immediately released its bite in terror, as a purple glow burst from its mouth.
Boom!
The fierce backlash of energy caused the Purple Even Divine Dragon to retreat hastily, and its massive head rapidly shrank until it vanished into a streak of light.
At this moment, the Prossian beast had no time to concern itself with the Purple Even Divine Dragon.
Having devoured the body of a Primordial Giant Beast and digested half of the ‘energy,’ the strength of the Terminal Dragon skyrocketed, its formless aura even pressuring the ferocious beast.
A Black Hurricane centered around the Prossian beast abruptly converged within the Chaos Void, along with the collapse of Chaos encompassing several tens of millions of kilometers.
Similarly, each of the two Black Colossi had a piece of Primordial Rule ‘world’ in its grasp, their double claws clashing instantly.
Boom! The starry sky trembled, and a massive Hollow formed as Chaos collapsed.
In the heart of destruction, the Terminal Dragon, standing forty thousand kilometers tall, remained immovable, its double claws striking against the much larger black claws without yielding.
Thump!
Space-Time trembled behind the Black Colossus, and its Tail Blade, capable of severing Void, struck the colossal black tail, emitting a deafening roar.
Under the immense sharpness of the jet-black cutting edge, two layers of ‘world’ shattered in response, tearing through the black scales and creating a colossal gash deep enough to see bone.
Though such a wound would be trivial for a Primordial Overlord Level fierce beast to heal in the blink of an eye.
But the significance it represented infuriated the Prossian beast: “I will tear you to shreds.”
Boom!
The aura upon the Black Colossus surged once again, a dark red blood light emerging on its surface, resembling the energy burst when the Nightmare Fiend Beast broke free from the Terminal Dragon’s suppression.
Clearly, it was some higher level force.
Instantly, an even more intense battle erupted, filled with extreme brutality.
The now larger Prossian beast, uncaring of the Terminal Dragon’s assaults, attacked with world-shattering double claws and its fearsome maw aimed at all vital points.
At the same time, the tail that spanned across the Void, like a world-ending serpent, constantly tangled fiercely with the jet-black Tail Blade.
Yet the Terminal Dragon’s defense was even more astonishing; even a Monarch-level Nightmare Fiend Beast could barely breach it, let alone this Primordial Overlord Level beast.
But this beast, mightier than the Nightmare Fiend Beast, was equally astounding in defense.
After the Terminal Dragon destroyed the two layers of ‘world’ encircling its body, its destructive Dragon Claws could only shatter scale armor and tear gaping wounds hundreds of kilometers deep.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In a trade of blows for blows, blood infused with terrifying energy sprayed into Void as the scales of the Black Colossus continuously shattered and regenerated.
Accompanied by fierce and brutal roars.
Meanwhile, a Monarch-level battle in the far distance re-erupted, a Void Heaven Divine Dragon of a million kilometers roared and clashed repeatedly with the Furious Ape wielding a slash blade.
In such circumstances, another battleground hosting Primordial Overlord Level combat seemed the least spectacular.
The Void Heaven Divine Dragon, named Purple Season, and the Nightmare Fiend Beast engaged in battle, surrounded by Primordial Rules, stood defiantly amidst dual skies, fighting by the book.
Both colossal beasts clearly understood that with the current situation, neither could best the other.
As for the objective of destroying the Chaos Continent, it became unattainable as the Nightmare Fiend Beast, named Morox, fled heavily injured, and the Terminal Dragon gained power.
Now, their only purpose was to drag out the fight, waiting for the Black Colossus to finish its burst of power.
At that moment, the three beasts would join forces, disregarding their injuries to deliver a joint strike to suppress and annihilate it.
Like all colossal beasts that battled the Terminal Emperor Dragon in the past, these three Primordial Fierce Beasts saw the Emperor Dragon explode with Primordial Overlord battle power from a Late Stage of True Spirit growth realm.
This Lifeline Talent’s Limit Breakthrough surely couldn’t last, a basic tenet of the Chaos Rule.
The three beasts were not in a hurry, and neither were the two Void Heaven Divine Dragons and the Terminal Dragon; this area was already within the ‘domain’ of the mythical world.
The longer the three ferocious beasts stayed, the more difficult it would be for them to leave later.
On the outskirts of the three colossal beast battlefields, the Purple Divine Dragon, having restored its true form over a hundred thousand kilometers in size, coiled in the Void, growling weakly: “No good, too drained, I need to rest.”
Saying so, the Purple Even Divine Dragon turned slowly, gazing across the Chaos Continent battlefield.
In its current state, it couldn’t interfere in Primordial Overlord Level battles, but it had no trouble dealing with those True Spirit Level and ancient level Nightmare Fiend Beasts.
Just as the Void Heaven Divine Dragon prepared to go ‘slaughter’ those Nightmare Fiend Beasts, a dreadfully terrifying aura emerged from the depths of the Chaos Void.
At once, including the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the gaze of all colossal beasts changed.
A True Emperor Level fierce beast in the Fourth Heavenly Realm, how could it be here?
Similarly, the two Nightmare Fiend Beasts and the Prossian beast were initially stunned, then their eyes filled with cruel delight, they released furious roars: “Purple Glow, today is your end.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1791: 661: Terrifying Giant Beast, Chaos City Master_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1791: Chapter 661: Terrifying Giant Beast, Chaos City Master_3
But just then, an aura more powerful than that of the True Emperor Level Ferocious Beasts appeared, and immediately an endless red radiance spread forth.
After the appearance of the True Emperor Level Ferocious Beast’s aura, it streaked past the outskirts of the battlefield at an alarming speed.
Clearly, this True Emperor Level Ferocious Beast was fleeing for its life.
“Run!”
The ferociously bellowing Morocco, his entire body ablaze with golden patterns, transformed into pure gold as his aura experienced a sudden Power Explosion, increasing tenfold in an instant.
Boom!
Blades crossed, and a ten-million-kilometer-long Light Beam of Annihilation cut through everything; even the Purple Glow Divine Dragon’s gaze shifted.
At the same time, another Nightmare Fiend Beast, including the Prossian beast that was battling with the Terminal Dragon, also Burst forth with their ultimate moves, seeking to shock their opponent into retreat.
Just then, the chest of the Prossian beast suddenly split open, revealing an eye occupying half its body, its pupil flickering with purple-black radiance.
In an instant, an aura of danger enveloped the Terminal Dragon.
But to think it could simply fight when it wants, and flee when it wishes – it’s not that simple.
Roar!
The Terminal Dragon roared, its massive body radiating a ‘brilliant’ black light, like a true Black Hole descending, exuding terrifying gravitational pull.
The strong gravitational force of the Black Hole devoured light, energy, and shattered space; everything was compressed and twisted.
Facing the purple-black Light Beam emitted from the black eye, the Terminal Dragon pounced directly towards the Prossian beast, spreading its double claws to embrace it, biting into its shoulder.
Boom!
The chest of the Terminal Dragon emitted a dazzling purple-black halo, a powerful strike punctured the Absolute Chaos domain, unbreakable Vajra, Scales Broken.
Simultaneously, the bite of the Terminal Dragon also tore through layers of the world, shredding the Prossian beast’s scale armor, and tearing off chunks of flesh and blood from its shoulder.
Instantly, the Prossian beast let out a scream of agony, its double claws sweeping across, its strength Bursting forth to send the Terminal Dragon flying.
Watching the Terminal Dragon being blown back several steps, a distance of hundreds of thousands of kilometers away, the Prossian beast’s eyes gleamed with ferocity, but still, suppressed the killing intent in its heart and suddenly turned around.
But just then, behind it, another savage roar resounded.
A pitch-black and sharp Tail Blade swept across the Chaos, leading an endless dark and destructive force to appear behind the ferocious beast.
Boom! Chaos trembled, and a segment of tail, thousands of kilometers long, floated in the Void. As for the Prossian beast, it disappeared within the Black Hurricane.
“Such incredible speed.”
Perceiving the aura that nearly blinked out of existence billions of kilometers away, the Terminal Dragon’s eyes flashed with solemnity.
And while the three ferocious beasts erupted in their escape, a terrifying Will swept across the Void, enveloping this original battlefield, with a faint hesitation emanating from the formidable Will.
In the end, the unknown powerful Giant Beast did not come, and its aura quickly faded away.
Suddenly, the hundred-thousand-kilometer-long Purple Glow Divine Dragon let out a low growl of regret: “Pity, that Great Emperor was pursuing that True Emperor Level Ferocious Beast, otherwise all three of these fellows would not have escaped.”
“Indeed, it is a bit regrettable.” The Terminal Dragon growled lowly, then its aura plummeted, and its massive body visibly shrank at an observable rate.
Soon, the Terminal Emperor Dragon reverted back to its common form of six hundred and ten thousand meters.
In its gigantic double claws, it grasped a black tail several times longer than itself, with black lightning leaping through its claws enveloping the entire tail, suppressing the struggling strength contained within the tail.
As a part of the Primordial Overlord’s True Body, this tail contained astounding strength, as well as a portion of the Overlord’s will.
A moment’s inattention might allow it to break free and escape.
While suppressing this tail, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s body was still growing at an astonishing rate, its muscles bulging, and its scale armor expanding, soon approaching 620,000 meters.
The True Body of the Primordial Level Nightmare Fiend Beast had not yet been fully digested.
Although it was somewhat regrettable that some of the Origin had escaped, the Terminal Emperor Dragon estimated that after digesting the Nightmare Fiend Beast and consuming this tail, it should be able to grow and breakthrough to the Pinnacle of True Spirit.
This achievement left the Terminal Emperor Dragon very satisfied.
Just over a month since entering the Chaos Outside Heaven, it had grown from the initial stage of True Spirit to the pinnacle, a speed not inferior to the Legendary Realm.
Hold on, there’s still more food.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon turned around and looked towards the Chaos Continent, billions of kilometers away, where countless Nightmare Fiend Beasts roamed.
Because of the danger posed by the Primordial Great Emperor Level behemoths, the three ferocious beasts failed to take their contingent armies with them amidst their escape, leaving these Nightmare Fiend Beasts behind.
Roar!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon roared and, clutching that segment of tail, flew towards the Chaos Continent.
Food, it’s all food.
Meanwhile, as the battle with the Primordial Beasts ended, Jack Clark and Sara Williams followed the Galaxy Passage and arrived at the location of the Chaos Emperor City.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark stepped out of the passage and appeared on the boundless Yellow Earth outside the black city that spanned the heavens and the earth, his figure suddenly sank.
A gravity a billion times that of Blue Star was upon him.
Looking at the footprints sunk several tens of centimeters into the Earth, Jack Clark was somewhat surprised, “The gravity here is really strong.”
Sara Williams explained, “The world of the Ancient Battlefield is incomplete; the rules are broken, the Origin leaks out, making the environment extremely harsh, while also fully showcasing the terror of a half-Eternal Level world.”
“Indeed it is harsh,” Jack Clark nodded, his gaze sweeping over the barren Yellow Earth.
The billion-fold gravity had little effect on Jack Clark, whose True Body was formidable, but in such an environment, the density of objects in this ‘universe’, and the solidity of heaven and earth, would be frighteningly terrifying.
A Mythical Powerhouse capable of destroying ten thousand kilometers with one blow might not be able to shatter even a hundred kilometers of Earth here.
All attacks, the external power of law and rule, were greatly suppressed, like another higher plane of ‘Divine Realm’.
Compared to this, as the inside of an Eternal Behemoth, the mythical world due to its completeness had a relatively normal gravity, allowing countless living beings to dwell within.
While the two conversed, several figures flashed over the black battle city’s gate not far away, and five figures in black armor appeared before them.
One war general, exuding an ancient aura, respectfully said, “Greetings to the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall.”
As the five of them looked towards Jack Clark, astonishment filled their eyes.
At this moment, a terrifying pressure, almost comparable to half-step Primordial, faintly surrounded Jack Clark, causing them slight difficulty breathing.
“This is the new Chaos City Master,” Sara introduced.

chapters.title: Chapter 1792: 662: Chaotic Divine Objects, Gathering of All Tribes
chapters.content:
Chapter 1792: Chapter 662: Chaotic Divine Objects, Gathering of All Tribes
As the soon-to-be City Lord of the Imperial City, Jack Clark naturally wouldn’t have his cultivation be ‘too low’, becoming an object of contempt by the True Spirit Level strong man guarding the city, causing him to strike in anger and slap their faces.
Therefore, upon entering the Galaxy Passage, he released a wisp of the Aura of power belonging to the Primordial Demon God True Body.
“The new Chaos City Master!”
Seeing the young man before them, whose temperament was extremely noble, all five cultivators clad in black armor looked solemn and gave a respectful salute: “Black Armored Imperial Guards Fifth Army Corps Commander Demetrius.”
“Black Armored Imperial Guards Fifth Army Corps Deputy Commander Carl… pays respects to the City Lord.”
Looking at the four cultivators before him, radiating the peak and mid period of the ancient times, Jack Clark nodded slightly: “No need for formalities, gentlemen. Let’s head to the City Lord Grand Hall first.”
“Yes.” Demetrius nodded solemnly.
Because of Jack Clark’s half step to Primordial cultivation, along with Sara Williams leading the way, these individuals did not question Jack Clark’s identity.
However, their recognition alone was not enough; there were further procedures to follow, such as heading to the City Lord Grand Hall to activate the control over the city spirit and verify the True Emperor’s Edict.
Just as the group was about to turn and lead the way, the Aura on Jack Clark fluctuated slightly.
Suddenly, a hint of astonishment flashed across the faces of everyone, including Sara Williams, for in that brief moment, they keenly sensed that Jack Clark’s Aura had strengthened a bit.
Observing the subtle changes in their expressions, Jack Clark slowly said, “This ‘cosmos’ and its Heaven and Earth are somewhat special, which has inspired me a little, hence the slight advancement in strength.”
Of course, the real situation was that the advancement in strength was due to the Evolution Energy fed back from the Terminal Emperor Dragon during its growth, which was strengthening Jack Clark’s body.
Due to the release of the Primordial Aura, the surge in Blood Qi and strength from the fortification of his body also released undetectable fluctuations.
As expected of Brother Clark, who crossed from Transcendent to True Spirit in just two years. His talent is simply too astonishing, thought Sara Williams with a look of admiration in her eyes.
As for Demetrius and the others, although they were unfamiliar with Jack Clark, they were still shocked by his enlightenment that allowed him to improve his strength by merely walking.
This new City Lord seems a bit terrifying.
The gate to the Chaos Emperor City is different from the traditional sense; it is a white light screen with a diameter of a hundred kilometers and a height of a thousand kilometers, located above the city.
Or rather, it is a very sturdy small world passageway.
When Jack Clark and Sara Williams passed through the light screen, a pure white pupil slowly opened within the depths of the light, and an invisible gaze swept over them.
After seeing that both their True Bodies and wills were ‘human’, the pupil closed again.
When that invisible gaze swept over them, Jack Clark sensed something and looked up at the apparently instant, yet actually thousands of miles long passageway overhead.
In Jack Clark’s eyes, a pair of Black Gold vertical pupils appeared, while a silver pupil also opened on his forehead.
Combining the Void Death Pupil and the Peeping Void True Eye, Jack Clark’s gaze pierced through layers of Space-Time in an instant, seeing a space filled with white light and a white Giant Beast lying across the Void, its body stretching over a hundred thousand meters.
A True Spirit Level Unique Beast with surveillance talent.
Even a Primordial disguise would leave some traces under its scrutiny, and anyone below Primordial would have nowhere to hide. Their guard is well done.
Jack Clark nodded internally, the eyes of double pupils and the pupil on his forehead disappeared, and his vision changed, arriving at a grandiose city full of ancient charm.
Unlike the ancient cities of Blue Star, this city spanned tens of thousands of kilometers, encompassing countless mountains and rivers within it.
The buildings were also lofty and grand, with many pavilions and palaces rising alongside the mountains or directly lifting an island into the air.
The sky above the Imperial City was pitch-black with stars twinkling above, their moving trajectories hinting at a profound mystery, evidently part of a large array.
In the Chaos Cosmos, where gravity is a billion times stronger and one must be at least of Mythical-level cultivation to barely move and survive, the vast Chaos Emperor City is quite bustling.
On a central platform of the city that stands a thousand kilometers high and spans thousands of kilometers, shops stand in rows and people bustle.
Among these are Human Race powerhouses from the Six Great Divine Domains, deities from dozens of Vassal Races under the Six Great Divine Domains, as well as other friendly and neutral civilized powerhouses.
A Unique Beast with bird heads and double wings on its body shouts in the street corner: “Red Lotus Meteoric Core Iron from the Fallen Forbidden Zone, only a hundred Chaos Spirit Crystals.”
Opposite, a middle-aged member of the Human Race sits floating, with a pure white Giant Tiger ten meters in length beneath him excitingly shouting.
“Overturn Black Brilliance Sand, freshly fished out from the Silver Abyss Black Brilliance Sand, can greatly enhance the power of World-class weapons, a good thing not to be missed.”
“There are also Dragon Tiger Celestial Origin Fruits, which can help condense rules and increase the chance of a breakthrough to the ancient times by 20%. Only trading for Everlasting Purple Sun Wood, do not disturb if you don’t have it.”
Not far away, a twenty-meter-tall Unique Beast with skin as black as iron stood at the center of the street, with a Crystal Red item of hundreds of meters in size in front of it.
“Come and have a look! Freshly prepared Bloodscale Sky-Piercing Whale’s heart, with a Remnant Soul of the whale and thirty percent of its Essence Blood sealed inside…”
Above in the Firmament, within the subspace, Jack Clark watched what was happening below with a peculiar gaze, feeling that these cultivation civilizations seemed somewhat unsophisticated, or rather, backward.
While they were strong and their Cultivation System far surpassed that of the Human Federation.
But when everyone was akin to deities, they still traded in such a primitive way. Wasn’t there a sense of incongruity?
After tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years of civilization development, hasn’t anyone invented something like a rune network, a Rule trading platform, or express teleportation?
Or is it that those with high intelligence and wisdom are all devoted to cultivation, always either in Closed-door Cultivation or comprehending rules and laws, paying no mind to these matters?

chapters.title: Chapter 1793: 662: Chaotic Divine Objects, Gathering of All Tribes_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1793: Chapter 662: Chaotic Divine Objects, Gathering of All Tribes_2
In the midst of his thoughts, Jack Clark quickly followed Sara Williams and others to the City Lord Grand Hall.
It is a black palace built on a mountain peak tens of thousands of meters high, located thirty thousand kilometers east of Chaos Emperor City, solemn and majestic, guarded by ten thousand Black Armored Imperial Guards.
At the same time, Jack Clark could keenly sense that the area around the grand hall was filled with thousands of powerful prohibitions.
Upon arrival, without waiting for the divine general named Demetrius to speak, a golden-red token appeared in Sara Williams’ hand, engraved with a red Great Sun divine pattern.
The moment the token appeared, a terrifying oppressive force of the “Source of Ten Thousand Suns” spread out, forming a phantom of a blazing Great Sun in the firmament.
Within the phantom, a figure wearing an Imperial Robe and crown appeared, exalted and overlooking all beings.
In that instant, not only in the City Lord Grand Hall, but all residents within a near hundred thousand kilometers range of Chaos Emperor City saw the Great Sun phantom and the projection of the True Emperor in the sky.
All of their faces showed shock and reverence, and they also knew that with the appearance of the True Emperor’s Edict, something significant was about to happen.
“It is the True Emperor’s Edict!” exclaimed the hundreds of Imperial Guards on both sides respectfully.
Sara Williams’ voice slowly echoed between heaven and earth: “By the decree of the True Emperor, Flame Wheel Great Emperor returns to the Divine Realm, taking his place at the Imperial Court. Now, Supreme Divine Martial Jack Clark is appointed as the Chaos City Master, to guard this place.”
The Black Armored Imperial Guards on both sides of the gate immediately knelt on one knee, respectfully saying: “Greetings to Supreme Divine Martial, welcome the City Lord.”
At the same time, thousands of Imperial Guards, hundreds of officials inside the palace, and even all the Human Race cultivators in the entire Imperial City numbering in the hundreds of thousands respectfully bowed in the direction of the grand hall.
“Welcome the arrival of Supreme Divine Martial, suppressing the chaos, intimidating the surroundings.”
Supreme, a title in the Six Great Divine Domains for those who have reached the Pinnacle of True Spirit, breaking the shackles of power, not quite Primordial but comparable to it.
So, whether it was the majesty of the True Emperor or the identity and power of Jack Clark as the Chaos City Master, all were sufficient to command respect from these cultivators.
Under gazes filled with reverence, Jack Clark merely nodded slightly and, accompanied by Sara Williams, directly entered the City Lord’s residence, moving swiftly through three front halls.
When they entered the dark, majestic City Lord’s main hall, Jack Clark entered a world reminiscent of the Void.
On both sides of the Void, hundreds of black stone seats stood, their positions rising, guarding the highest placed throne made of black iron.
In front of the City Lord’s throne, a hundred-meter-diameter blue Star Ring floated, emitting a faint luminescence.
Standing at the steps below, Sara whispered, “Brother Clark, that is the controller of the City Spirit; it is also the core of all the prohibitions and defense arrays of Chaos Emperor City.”
“Only by gaining recognition from the core of Chaos Emperor City can one truly be the Chaos City Master.”
Jack Clark did not speak, but under the watchful eyes of the Imperial Guards behind him and officials from various departments of the Imperial City, he approached the high platform of the throne and slowly reached toward the blue Star Ring.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark’s hand touched the Star Ring, a powerful repelling force came forth, causing the entire Dark Void to violently shake.
However, this force from the entire Imperial City, capable of shaking off the Pinnacle of True Spirit, could not move Jack Clark’s hand by even a hair’s breadth.
That slender hand, as if containing the terrifying force to suppress the heavens, unstoppable and unblockable, slowly descended under the gaze of all.
At the same time, Sara’s hand threw the True Emperor’s Edict into the Star Ring.
Instantly, the resistance disappeared, and an endless stream of information exploded in Jack Clark’s Sea of Consciousness, his entire being enveloped by starlight as if clad in a magnificent Starry War Robe.
Seeing this, thousands of people below all bowed, respectfully saying: “Greetings to the Divine Martial City Master.”
Sara Williams also showed a smile on her face, slightly lifting her head to look up at the figure who had his back towards everyone.
Years ago, on the bridge of a black and red fighter aircraft, she stood behind Jack Clark in the same way, looking up at his towering figure overlooking the Lost World.
As dazzling as ever.
While everyone witnessed Jack Clark becoming the Chaos City Master, he was immersed in endless information at this moment.
The so-called control of the city spirit is actually the Artifact Spirit of the Chaos Emperor City, which in essence is a terrifyingly powerful weapon.
A superweapon forged jointly by the Six Great True Emperors.
Standing atop the Chaos Emperor City, even if a Primordial Second Heavenly Realm Overlord arrives, Jack Clark could forcefully confront the opponent; this is also why the main cities of various peak civilizations are difficult to conquer.
It’s just that the city’s might is indeed strong, but it cannot move, or moving consumes too much.
Therefore, it can only serve as a stable rear base.
The true function of the Chaos Emperor City is actually to assist, assisting in managing and dominating the surrounding territories, like how at this moment Jack Clark’s will is extending through a vast network covering a range of a hundred billion kilometers.
Yellow continental blocks floating in space with a diameter of ten million kilometers, violent chaotic streams, and thousands of astronomical bodies with diameters ranging from thousands to tens of thousands of kilometers that host surveillance points.
There are also three satellite cities inhabited by a million Black Armored Imperial Guards, all within the network of the Chaos Emperor City.
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, his gaze shimmering with countless stars, appearing extremely mysterious and profound, he softly spoke, “So there is a network here.”
“Brother Clark, what network?” Sara Williams paused below.
“It’s nothing.”
Jack Clark smiled and then turned to sit on the spacious City Lord’s throne, his expression solemn: “Star Spirit, link all stationed points and satellite cities, inform them of my arrival.”
Soundlessly, above the Void, starlight exploded, a wave spreading out faster than the speed of light.
Humming!!
The Void trembled, red, blue, and multicolored lights suddenly appeared from the depths of the Void, landing on those black stone seats, forming multiple projections.
Among these people, two with the strongest aura of Late Stage True Spirit, followed by three at the Initial Stage of True Spirit, and over thirty at Titan Heavenly King Class and Ancient levels.
Looking at the young man sitting high on the City Lord’s throne, two middle-aged men of Late Stage True Spirit politely said, “Curt Walters of the Ten Thousand Swords Divine Realm, greetings to the Divine Martial City Master.”
“Percy from the Chaotic Ancient Divine Realm, congratulates the Divine Martial City Master on your arrival…”
These Chaos Emperor City Forbidden Army Lords and commanders all saluted Jack Clark, simultaneously affirming his identity and officially declaring the power of the Human Race in this universe.
After everyone drew a line for their own homes, Jack Clark nodded unhurriedly and calmly said, “Gentlemen, no need for formalities, the main purpose this time is to meet everyone and get acquainted.”
“From now on, everything will operate in the original mode, except for matters involving Chaotic Divine Objects or civilizational conflicts, no need to report anything to me.”
He couldn’t stay for long this time, as he would leave once he achieved a breakthrough to the Primordial.
Thus, Jack Clark had no interest in handling affairs or flaunting the authority of a city lord; he would rather spend this time urging everyone to gather information to see where Chaotic Divine Objects emerged.
… Jack Clark’s words made everyone pause, then a man named Curt Walters, the lord commanding a million Black Armored Imperial Guards, said solemnly, “Speaking of which, I happen to have information about a Chaotic Divine Object to report to the City Master.”
“Oh, where?” Jack Clark, who had been strolling pensively, suddenly sat upright.

chapters.title: Chapter 1794: 663: Galactic Giant Beast, Eternal Air
chapters.content:
Chapter 1794: Chapter 663: Galactic Giant Beast, Eternal Air
Under the mythology, Heaven and Earth Treasures and materials are classified into Law Level, Rule Level, and Creation Level, which are useful for the Primordial or enhance strength.
The Chaotic Divine Objects are independent of the three levels and are unique to the Ancient Battlefield.
These Divine Objects might be just ordinary Law Level, or even more precious than Creation-Level Divine Objects.
Because every emerging Chaotic Divine Object contains the supreme power of Chaos, or the Eternal Air that scattered from the eternal lives that fought in the ancient times.
Such Divine Objects, in the cultivation category, can greatly enhance cultivation and break through realm restrictions.
As for Divine Armaments and Treasures, needless to say, containing various powerful and strange abilities, the top-tier Chaotic Supreme Treasures are even stronger than Creation-Level Divine Weapons.
So, knowing that a Chaotic Divine Object has emerged in the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, not only was Jack Clark moved; Sara Williams and the strong men below were all invigorated.
Sara Williams lifted her head, looking at Jack Clark on the City Lord’s throne, and softly said, “Brother Clark just arrived at the Imperial City, and now a Chaotic Divine Object has emerged. It seems that this Divine Object is destined for you.”
Jack Clark couldn’t help but smile: “It’s too early to say, we still don’t know the situation over there.”
“However, I am indeed interested in that Chaotic Divine Object,” said Jack Clark as he looked at the powerful figures below, and slowly spoke.
“The emergence of this Divine Object will inevitably trigger a chaotic battle amongst the races. Cultivators belonging to the Chaos Emperor City who are below the level of the ancients need not go,” he said.
“As for the Black Armored Imperial Guards, proficient in frontline battlefield combat, hence each of the Three Great Legions shall mobilize three hundred fifty thousand, forming a mighty army of one million to advance towards the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area,” he continued.
“Once there, the Black Armored Imperial Guards station outside the Forbidden Area to deter others, providing protection for the Divine Realm powerhouses entering…”
Subsequent detailed arrangements were made, and soon, the very first decree issued by the newly appointed City Master of Divine Martial shook the entire Chaos Emperor City and its surroundings.
Cultivators from the Six Great Divine Domains ‘training’ here, friendly and vassal race powerhouses, all became aware of the emergence of the Chaotic Divine Object.
Including other Top-tier and Peak Civilizations, a large number of powerhouses began to set off towards the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area.
The phenomenon of the Chaotic Divine Object emerging pierced through Space-Time, illuminating the expanse, hence although the phenomenon was seen, it just indicates that a Divine Object will emerge in that Forbidden Area next.
As for where it would appear, no one knows, it’s uncertain.
And as the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area is vast and vast, with inversed space inside, hence ‘everyone’ has a chance, perhaps by fate one could obtain the Divine Object.
Those in the cultivation category can be refined on the spot, and the treasures and divine weapons can directly recognize the owner.
By then, even if facing the custodian powerhouses of major civilizations attacking, they would still have the power to parley; if a True Spirit Powerhouse obtains a top-tier treasure, they could immediately become a dominant overlord.
Meanwhile, outside the Chaos Emperor City, a silver warship resembling a battle sword, a thousand kilometers long, smashed through the Void, entering the Space-Time Chaos and flying towards the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area at a terrifying speed.
Around the silver sword body, nine rings of runes forming chains swirled about, smashing through the rushing chaos and emitting earth-shattering roars.
Inside the warship, Sara Williams and Jack Clark sat opposite each other on the sword bridge: “This Chaotic Origin Imperial Capital is a Chaotic Supreme Treasure that I managed to snatch the last time I entered the Ancient Battlefield,” Sara said.
“Its level is Pseudo-Creation Level, generally ordinary in attack, however, its main function is swift flight, relatively faster than a True Spirit Pinnacle powerhouse at full speed,” she added.
“The core power is trans-Space-Time flying, ignoring most of the starry space forbidden areas, along with a sword body solid against destruction below Primordial, making it very convenient for fast travel and escaping,” she explained.
Jack Clark nodded, “This really is quite a remarkable item.”
This Chaotic Origin Imperial Capital may be said to be weak in attack, but that’s just a figure of speech, a sword body indestructible below Primordial already signifies its strength.
With the sword in hand, Sara Williams, at the Late Stage of True Spirit, could nearly sweep through all True Spirit Powerhouses, even those half-step Primordial beings might not necessarily suppress her unless they have a Creation-Level Divine Weapon.
Sara Williams softly said, “With the Chaotic Origin Imperial Capital, we estimate that it would take half a day to bypass the Boris Star System, Hundred Forest Void Marsh.”
“Utilizing the large cosmic cracks there, we can jump directly to the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, located over seven hundred star rings (light-years) away, arriving even before the Imperial Guard Corps,” she said.
Jack Clark slowly nodded, then closed his eyes.
However, Jack Clark, seemingly in cultivation, actually moved his realm of thought and summoned the attribute page, looking at the empty Origin Points and over twenty-six million Attribute Points, pondering slightly.
“Burn one million Attribute Points, enter the epiphany state,” he declared.
In half a day, Jack Clark planned to reconstruct (strengthen) the Space-Time Summoning Altar a bit, preparing for the upcoming great battle.
In the Chaos Outside Heaven, including the Ancient Battlefield here, the rules differ from the mythical world, combined with Jack Clark and the Terminal Emperor Dragon having already made breakthroughs in True Spirit.
The resulting changes mean that the Space-Time Summoning Altar could not bear it; even if the summoning is successful, it would be unstable.
Therefore, it is necessary to reinforce, expand the existing time and space structure, and modify some core parts of the altar, allowing for reverse summoning.
When the time comes, whether used for escaping or fighting, it will be much more convenient.
As Jack Clark heads towards the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, preparing to meet the strong men of various races.
Along with that, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, who ‘mixed’ with the Void Heavenly Dragon, also finally arrived at the Xutian Divine Dragon Clan Territory.
In the Chaotic Void, continents spanning billions of kilometers lie across, surrounded by raging turbid air waves roaring and bursting with the explosive echoing of Mountains and Seas shaking.
On the edge of the continent, a Black-red Colossal Beast standing seventy-three thousand meters tall, its golden vertical pupils coldly gazing forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1795: 663: Galactic Giant Beast, Eternal Air_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1795: Chapter 663: Galactic Giant Beast, Eternal Air_2
The vast Boundary Wall of the mythical world is like a Sky Curtain that stands eternally, covering everything to the left, right, above and below, with a Black Crack in the middle.
The crack, several light years in diameter, resembles a massive scar imprinted upon the body of the mythical world.
In contrast to this crack, the Chaos Continent stretching billions of kilometers in diameter is but a tiny sesame seed, utterly inconspicuous; and the likes of the Terminal Emperor Dragon and other giant beasts are even more insignificant.
At this moment, a large shadow is cast upon the head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, as the Purple Glow Divine Dragon, a hundred million kilometers long, appears in the Firmament, poking its dragon head out of the clouds and letting out a low roar.
“Dragon Palace King, ahead lies the ancestral land of our clan. Many thanks for your assistance this time; without you, we could not have successfully returned the Chaos Continent.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon lets out a low roar: “There’s no need for such formality, Purple Glow Emperor. As ‘Mythical Giant Beasts’, it is only natural that we support each other.”
Mythical Giant Beasts are a collective term for the mythological creatures from the mythical world, similar to their adversaries, the Chaotic Nightmare Ferocious Beasts.
The words of the Terminal Emperor Dragon made this Heavenly Realm Divine Dragon feel a friendlier sensation toward it, and after speaking, the Purple Glow Heavenly Dragon looks toward the head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
There, a Purple little dragon over five thousand meters long grows restless. Gazing at the colossal cracks, a mysterious longing surfaces in its eyes, and it can’t help but let out an immature roar.
Yiya yiya!! Brother, Misss Joseline feels like something is calling to me over there, like mother.
Standing on the shoulder of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, a Silver Giant Dragon over six thousand meters long turns its head, puzzled: “Roar! Misss Joseline, didn’t your mother already die?”
Yiya yiya!! It’s a feeling, just a feeling. The Purple little dragon waves its small claw, scratching the purple mane on its head.
That call resonating from deep within its bloodline fills the Purple little dragon with a sense of homesickness and trepidation, along with nervousness and anticipation, making its mood quite complex.
It seems as though by entering, it might truly be able to see its mother.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon roars lowly: “Misss Joseline, there’s no need to be nervous. As an offspring of the Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon, it’s normal for you to feel a connection to the bloodlands of the Void Heavenly Dragon Race.”
As for the ancestral lands of the Primordial Level giant beast clans, the Terminal Emperor Dragon knows without thinking that there must be a power Inheritance there.
However, seeing that the three Void Heavenly Dragons do not seem intent on elaborating on this matter, the Terminal Emperor Dragon does not speak further after mentioning it.
Gazing at the approaching Black Cracks, the Terminal Emperor Dragon also grows curious.
Curious about the benefits these Primordial Beasts gain from bringing fragments of the mythical world back after all these years of venturing deep into the Chaos Void to battle Ferocious Beasts.
And curious about the general state of the surrounding Primordial Beasts.
Although Jack Clark had inquired about the situation on the giant beast side when he met the Sparkling Heaven True Emperor earlier, the Sparkling Heaven True Emperor was not very knowledgeable about these beasts either.
For example, what are the different Primordial giant beast clans like the Void Heaven Dragon Tribe, and how strong is the strongest among them.
How many types of Chaotic Nightmare Ferocious Beast clans there are, what their capabilities are, whether there are beings of the Primordial Seventh Heavenly Undying Realm, and which regions they are active in, etc.
All of these are important for the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Its current Growth Level has already reached the Pinnacle of True Spirit, just “a bit” away from breaking through to Primordial, estimated to be about right when its body length reaches eight hundred thousand meters.
Once it breaks through to Primordial, its goal will be to hunt those Primordial Level Chaotic Nightmare Ferocious Beasts to accelerate its growth.
Therefore, it is essential to have a general understanding of the territories of these giant beast powers.
Otherwise, accidentally entering the domain of Primordial Great Emperor Level, or even Seventh Heavenly Undying Realm beast powers, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, even after breaking through to Primordial, might not be able to escape.
Throughout the journey, Jack Clark and the Terminal Emperor Dragon, seemingly engaging in battles beyond their levels, have actually been exceedingly cautious, keeping dangers within a manageable extent.
They never recklessly provoke enemies that are too powerful for them to handle.
Under the watchful gaze of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Chaos Continent, billions of kilometers in diameter, collides with the cracks at a speed that seems slow but actually surpasses the speed of light.
Boom! Just as the Chaos Continent enters the cracks, an extremely powerful force, so terrifying that even the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s heart quakes, descends with a force that pulls everything toward it.
Under the distortion force, more frightening than a real black hole, the utmostly solid Continent shakes violently.
In the shocked cries of the Purple little dragon and the Silver Giant Dragon, the sky of the Chaos Continent shatters, and the Earth collapses, tearing open numerous and immeasurable cracks stretching tens of millions to billions of kilometers.
Countless pieces of matter are crushed by that force, returning to their original state, transforming into wisps of grey strength that are absorbed by the mythical world, like an apple being peeled layer by layer.
At the same time, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon, and including the three Void Heavenly Dragons as well as over a hundred thousand Void Heaven True Dragons are enveloped in a purple light.
Guided by that power, the Terminal Emperor Dragon and the other giant beasts pass through layers of Void, appearing at the edge of a tract of silver land sprawling across the Void.
This is an unfathomably vast land, with both the sky and the earth shrouded in Silver Brilliance.
Amidst the sky and earth, blue, white, and red True Dragons, hundreds and thousands of meters long, spiral and roam between heaven and earth, occasionally letting out a majestic roar.
Beyond that, amidst the mountains and rivers upon the great land, many massive True Dragons, as large as mountain ranges, are Hibernating, with Rules emanating from their bodies, invisibly altering their surroundings.
Suddenly, a vast, thick and wild aura assails from all directions.
This is a world belonging to dragons.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Purple little dragon, and the Silver Giant Dragon are captivated by this spectacle, the entire world slightly trembles, the clouds millions of kilometers above disperse.
Behind the clouds, an enormous, endless Silver Giant Dragon head, almost covering the entire world, slowly emerges.
Golden vertical pupils, nearly as colossal as stars, shine brightly, emanating powerful majesty, and in an instant, a force more potent than the Sparkling Heaven True Emperor spreads out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1796: 663: Galactic Giant Beast, Eternal Air_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1796: Chapter 663: Galactic Giant Beast, Eternal Air_3
Boom!
Under the terrifying aura that almost crushed the world, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s figure sank; the Earth for hundreds of thousands of kilometers around crumbled, and countless mountain peaks and rocks soared into the sky.
And it was not only the Terminal Emperor Dragon that was affected. In the instant that the fearsome Giant Dragon appeared, countless True Dragons of the entire silver world fell prostrate to the ground, their bodies trembling.
It was the suppression of their bloodlines.
Even those three Void Heaven Divine Dragons at the Primordial Level fell onto the ground under the pressure of this bloodline, shaking the Earth continuously and causing explosions.
Amidst the spreading smoke and dust, the Purple Glow Divine Dragon, with a body length of a million kilometers, excitedly raised its head to look at the tremendous silver dragon head above: “Roar! Great Emperor, have you, have you achieved breakthrough?!”
Outside the Roger, the Silver Giant Dragon, nearly as vast as a Star System, slowly nodded: “Correct, I have crossed the Fifth Heavenly Realm, achieving breakthrough to the Sixth Heavenly Primordial Supreme Realm.”
The Purple Glow True Dragon realized: “No wonder, there was no response to the distress messages we sent to you, Great Emperor—no, Supreme.”
“Luckily, we had some good fortune this time; we were only entangled by a few ordinary Primordial Fierce Beasts, and with the help of the Dragon Palace King, we managed to bring back this fragment of the continent successfully.”
This fellow did well to not forget the Terminal Emperor Dragon when reporting the mission.
The Silver Giant Dragon slowly nodded: “Your gains this time are indeed remarkable, actually finding such a large fragment. The feedback from it is enough to elevate your strength by a whole level.”
“Dragon Palace King, is this the little one?” Saying so, the terrifying gaze of the Silver Giant Dragon fell upon the Terminal Emperor Dragon, a flash of surprise crossing its eyes.
For in its view, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, like a little thing, is fundamentally a world filled with endless destruction that takes a form similar to that of a Giant Beast.
A destructive world even more powerful than the Primordial Beasts.
But almost immediately, the Silver Giant Dragon’s attention was captured by the purple glow on the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s head, its eyes gradually showing excitement and amazement.
“It’s the Purple Glow, the bloodline!”
Boom! Overwhelmed by the excitement, a wisp of strength leaked from the Silver Giant Dragon, making the entire silver world continuously shake, unable to bear it.
The existence of a descendant from the lineage of the Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon excited even the Giant Beast that had broken through to the Sixth Heavenly Primordial Realm.
But immediately after, the Silver Giant Dragon suppressed its excitement. An awe-inspiring Will descended, enveloping the three Void Heaven Divine Dragons.
The Will communicated, and in an instant, the Silver Giant Dragon had ‘reviewed’ all the information regarding their encounter with the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Even the Silver Giant Dragon was somewhat astounded by the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s defiance of the natural order, taking on the Primordial Overlord head-on at the Late Stage of True Spirit!
“So that’s how it is,” the enormous silver dragon head regarded the Terminal Emperor Dragon, its eyes reflecting a more genial light as a grand and majestic roar echoed throughout the entire world.
“Dragon Palace King, thank you for bringing back the descendant of the Purple Glow.”
“The Purple Glow bloodline is exceedingly important to our clan. As thanks, you may receive half of the Eternal Air bestowed by the Eternal King.”
“Eternal Air.” The Terminal Emperor Dragon appeared slightly astonished.
The Silver Giant Dragon slowly nodded, causing the entire world to tremble with it: “Indeed, Eternal Air, the reward granted by the Eternal King to those Primordial Beasts who recover fragments.”
No wonder! The Terminal Emperor Dragon turned its head, looking at the Chaos Continent that continued to fade and vanish with a certain excitement.
No wonder these Primordial Giants disdain contact with diverse races, including the Human Race of Peak Civilizations, and ignore connections with the Supreme Planes, for they ‘lack the time.’
They’re busy searching for fragments in the depths of the Chaos Void.
To bring back a piece of the Chaos Continent fragment is to receive a significant amount of Eternal Air as a reward; this is much stronger than fighting to the death on the Ancient Battlefield over a bit of Eternal Air.
And what excited the Terminal Emperor Dragon is that if the feedback of Eternal Air this time is sufficient, it might break through Primordial directly in one go.
Barely two months in the Chaotic Heavens Outside and on the verge of breaking through to Primordial, the very thought of this speed excites me.

chapters.title: Chapter 1797: 664: Breakthrough Primordial, Ancestral Dragon Inheritance
chapters.content:
Chapter 1797: Chapter 664: Breakthrough Primordial, Ancestral Dragon Inheritance
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon gazed beyond the silver world, the massive Chaos Continent continued to dissolve and melt, the Silver Divine Dragon spoke once again from beyond Heaven.
However, this time its target was the Purple little dragon.
The voice that shook the sky slowly resounded through the silver world: “Little one with the purple bloodline, before Purple’s demise, a drop of Essence Blood was left here with me.”
“Eeya! Essence Blood?” Upon hearing this, the Purple little dragon abruptly stood straight, like a purple crystal rod, and it was obvious how excited it was.
No wonder, it felt its mother’s call from within.
The Silver Divine Dragon slowly growled, “Don’t be too excited yet, that drop of Essence Blood only has energy left. The will, soul power, and bloodline inheritance it contained have all been erased.”
“Back then, under a power that nearly touched eternity, every trace of Purple was instantly erased, including this drop of Essence Blood meant for resurrection.”
At this point, the tone of the Silver Divine Dragon became somewhat solemn, it was conceivable how tragic the battle of eternity had been back then.
Not only were both Eternal Behemoths severely injured, neither has awakened to this day, but many of the affiliated Primordial Beasts also perished completely.
The words of the Silver Divine Dragon poured cold water over the excited Purple little dragon, cooling its heart.
Thinking about it was right; if a true drop of Essence Blood remained, the will within would have activated at the moment of the Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon’s demise, gathering power to resurrect.
If that were the case, it wouldn’t have nearly suffocated to death in the egg.
Eeya!! Brother, the good stuff is gone.
The thought voice of the Purple little dragon arose within the mind of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, somewhat regretful, it even mentioned inheriting the Ancestral Dragon’s Essence Blood to directly become a Primordial Beast.
Sensing what the Purple little dragon was thinking, the Terminal Emperor Dragon couldn’t help but shake its head.
A drop of Essence Blood enabling breakthrough to Primordial status is wishful thinking; if it were that easy, wouldn’t Star Level Behemoths be mass-produced by the sixth Heavenly Tier?
Moreover, this little fellow didn’t even feel any sorrow.
That’s your mother… well, from the moment it had developed cognition and consciousness, the Purple little dragon had only been in contact with the Thunderflame Behemoth that gave it the Life Origin.
Therefore, for the existence of the Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon, the one-year-old Purple little dragon didn’t actually feel much.
However, this little fellow was still smart enough not to voice this thought.
Otherwise, if the terrifying Silver Divine Dragon overheard, even though the Purple little dragon is a descendant of the Ancestral Dragon, it might displease them, possibly leading to the refusal to give that drop of Essence Blood.
Although that drop of Essence Blood had only energy remaining, being from the bloodline of that peak sixth Heavenly Tier Divine Dragon, the benefits were still immense for the Purple little dragon to absorb.
“This drop of Essence Blood has been in my possession for many years; now that Purple’s descendant has returned, it should rightfully revert to its original owner.”
In a deep, majestic roar that shook Heaven and Earth, the entire silver world trembled mightily, as a giant dragon claw slowly reached in from beyond the sky.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The entire silver world shook, the sky shattered, the earth collapsed, tearing a heaven-reaching, Earth-penetrating black hole under the invisible power emanated by the dragon claw.
Within the hollow, a drop of purple-gold blood slowly emerged, emitting a dim glow.
And just at the moment this drop of Essence Blood appeared, within the silver world, all regular True Dragons and Void Heaven True Dragons deeply desired it.
Even though that drop of Essence Blood no longer held power, for these True Spirits, it was still a treasured bloodline relic.
Even the Silver Divine Dragon on the shoulder of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, looking at the diameter of tens of thousands of meters, like numerous dragon-shaped energies materially converging Essence Blood, also felt a bit restless.
“Go, little one, this belongs to you.”
A deep and robust Dragon Roar shook the world, the previously somewhat regretful Purple little dragon roared aloud, transforming into a purple beam of light surging towards the sky.
What seemed to be a distant distance, under a twist of invisible force in space-time, in merely a few blinks, the Purple little dragon dashed into the celestial black hole and into that drop of blood.
Boom! Just as the Purple little dragon entered, that drop of Essence Blood suddenly glowed brightly, releasing brilliant purple flames burning fiercely.
From afar, it looked like a purple sun had appeared in the sky.
Roar! Above the glowing purple firmament, a massive, boundless shadow of a Void Heaven Divine Dragon emerged.
And this time, the shadow of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon appeared clearer, more massive, with seven claws, like a massive purple solar system sprawling across the sky.
At the same time, a pressure equivalent to the Pseudo-Heaven Tier spread out, causing countless True Dragons to tremble all over.
Under this pressure, their bloodlines turned fiery, and some Void Heaven True Dragons began evolving, their forms transforming towards the Purple Void Heaven Divine Dragon.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Millions of True Dragons roared, their dragon cries shaking the heavens.
Not far from the Terminal Emperor Dragon, three Void Heaven Divine Dragons also excitedly raised their heads, looking at the celestial Purple Divine Dragon shadow with some excitement.
“The Essence Blood has successfully merged.”
“We weren’t wrong; it indeed is the Ancestral Dragon’s bloodline, and uniquely the second-generation descendant.”
As all True Dragons roared excitedly, including the Silver Divine Dragon watching the purple sun, the Terminal Emperor Dragon with the Silver Giant Dragon on his shoulder quietly growled.
“Roar! Kevin, Misss Joseline isn’t in danger, right?”
“…No worries.” The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly shook its head.
The Silver Giant Dragon expressed hesitation in its eyes: “But Kevin, haven’t you mentioned before that Divine Fruits don’t just fall from the sky, and every gift comes with a hidden price?”
“Seeing these fellows greet Misss Joseline with so many treasures today, could there be some ulterior motives?”
Today, the Silver Giant Dragon was rarely shrewd, appearing very cautious, hardly trusting that these Void Heavenly Dragons were really that generous.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s gaze flickered: “There definitely is a purpose, but it should be harmless to Misss Joseline.”
The purpose of these Void Heavenly Dragons is none other than to use the bloodline of the Purple little dragon to facilitate the resurrection and return of the Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon that perished in the past.
That ancestral dragon had indeed completely perished, all traces of it erased by Supreme Power.
Including the Purple little dragon, which was originally still an egg, its vitality kept dwindling not because of environment or time, but due to that terrifying force.
Had it not encountered the Terminal Emperor Dragon, it would have exhausted its vitality in a few years and turned into a dead egg.
Realizing this, the Terminal Emperor Dragon probably understood why these Void Heavenly Dragons valued the Purple little dragon so much; the Purple little dragon was the resurrection hope left by that Void Heaven Ancestral Dragon.
Is it dodging an inevitable death through the cycle of life and inheritance? The Terminal Emperor Dragon pondered thoughtfully.
As a descendant, when the Purple little dragon breaks through the Primordial Beast and experiences Heaven and Earth Resonance, it will likely trigger a strong bloodline retracing, potentially activating the Ancestral Dragon mark contained within the bloodline.
Similar to when Jack Clark succeeded in propping up the heavens and catalyzed a power retracing by forming a Heavenly Path Incarnation, directly turning Doris Clark into a Senior Transcendent and allowing Glenn Clark to achieve a breakthrough in strength.
Only, the retracing power of the Purple little dragon will be much more formidable.
This is the beginning of life, already possessing a hint of undying traits; even if completely annihilated, it can still resurrect and return someday in the future.
Suppressing the emotions in his heart and having clarified these matters, the Terminal Emperor Dragon no longer focused on the transformation of the Purple little dragon, turned around, and looked at the Chaos Continent that was already dissipating greatly.
With the return of this massive fragment, the mythical world… seemed to undergo little change.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon once again marveled at the vast expanse of the mythical world.
While those Void Heavenly Dragons were agitated and the Terminal Emperor Dragon silently waited, less than two hours passed, and the continent relative to a Star System completely dissipated.
Buzz! The Heaven and Earth vibrated slightly, and layer upon layer of transparent ripples spread outside the silver world, bringing the attention of those dragons in the Void back.
Purple Glow Divine Dragon roared lowly: “Dragon Palace King, be attentive, the Eternal King is about to bestow a blessing.”
“Eternal Air is the supreme, belonging to a power not of the Chaos Sea, which must be absorbed the instant it appears, or else it might draw the scrutiny of unknown terrifying beings.”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon nodded: “Thanks for the reminder.”
Without any earth-shattering phenomena or terrifying force that could destroy creation, under the gaze of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, four miles-long jade-like light ribbons slowly materialized in the void.
The moment those four jade-colored light bands appeared, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s entire body’s blood instantaneously boiled, his scalp exploded, his entire skin went numb, and his legs trembled.
So, so exciting, exciting to the point of bursting.
Roar!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon roared into the sky, his eyes blood-red, filled with a terrifying ferocity that could slay gods and Buddhas, a release of emotions stirred by the trepidation of life.
Huff, huff! At this moment, if anyone dared to snag its Eternal Air, the Terminal Emperor Dragon would definitely tear them to pieces.
Boom!
Under the Terminal Emperor Dragon, the Void exploded, its massive body surrounded by a massive blood red aura and killing intent as it soared skyward, lunging towards the green light bands beyond the boundary of the world.
But fortunately, the little remaining rationality in the Terminal Emperor Dragon knew that only two Eternal Airs were meant for him.
Roar!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s double claws fiercely extended, grabbing the two green light bands, immediately feeling a powerful rebound force as if he had seized two worlds.
And although the Eternal Air had initially no phenomena, at this moment, it came to life, like two green giant pythons twisting frantically, struggling to escape a fate of being refined.
Roar! The Terminal Emperor Dragon roared, a supremely powerful strength erupting from within, directly suppressing the rebound of the Eternal Air.
Immediately following, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s mouth flared open, resembling a massive black hole, directly stuffing the constantly vibrating and struggling Eternal Air into its mouth, crushing and swallowing it in one gulp.
Crunch!
Just as the Terminal Emperor Dragon swallowed the two strands of Eternal Air, the originally stable and strong Heavenly Tier genetic sequence within its body silently shattered.
Splendid green light radiated from deep within its body, permeating every bit of flesh, bones, and scale armor.
Simultaneously, a life force explosive enough to make even Silver Divine Dragons take notice burst forth.
Boom!
The aura of the Terminal Emperor Dragon surged tremendously, its body encapsulated in green light swelling at an astonishing rate, reaching 750,000 meters, 770,000 meters… 800,000 meters in the blink of an eye.
Just as the body size of the Terminal Emperor Dragon reached 800,000 meters, streaks of blood-red and black lightning erupted in all directions, exuding an aura of supreme destruction and supreme chaos that terrified all True Dragons.
Roar!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon roared once again into the heavens, its massive body crashing against the Boundary Wall, breaking through into a pitch-black hollow leading into the mythical world.
It was time to return for its groundbreaking Primordial breakthrough.
This time, the mythical world, which originally repelled everything above Primordial, did not repel the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
In just the blink of an eye, the massive body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon entered the hollow under the watch of those True Dragons, leaving the Purple little dragon hanging in the Xutian Divine Dragon Clan Territory.
Meanwhile, in the mythical world under the cover of night, countless living beings subconsciously looked up, watching the streak across the sky above, shining with splendid light from the green star.
The star surrounded by streaks of blood-red and black lightning appeared ominously mysterious and terrifying.
Human Federation, Solar System World.
Deep within the sun, a golden-white Mecha that had grown to over 600,000 meters suddenly opened its eyes, its gaze piercing through the sun world, staring at the falling star above with a strangely ‘familiar’ feeling.

chapters.title: Chapter 1798: 665: Son of Eternity, Heavenly Tier Revealed
chapters.content:
Chapter 1798: Chapter 665: Son of Eternity, Heavenly Tier Revealed
“Strange, why do I feel that falling star seems familiar!!”
As she watched the residual image of the falling star slowly fade away in the firmament, Freya Louise revealed a trace of faint confusion in her eyes, since she didn’t recognize any such primordial existence.
In her circle, the only one who had hope of achieving the primordial state was Jack Clark.
But when he left more than two months ago, Jack’s cultivation had just broken through to True Spirit, far from the primordial; could it be that he had reached the primordial in just over two months?
Thinking of this, Freya Louise couldn’t help but shake her head, feeling she might be overthinking it.
However, since she had already been awakened, Freya didn’t continue her hibernation.
Hum!
The massive Golden-White Mecha trembled slightly, and at the center of the forehead, a figure in a white dress slowly condensed, holding an ancient seal in her left hand.
After Jack cut out a Time Mark true body and fused it with the Heavenly Path Emperor Seal, he reconstituted another Emperor Seal imbued with the power of the Heavenly Path and gave it to Freya Louise.
This was so that she could carry out the authority of the Heavenly Path Avatar and not easily appear in the era when the fusion of avatar and laws was restricted while Jack was away.
Boom! Freya’s consciousness vibrated. Following the infinite spread of the power of the Heavenly Path, she crossed vast spans of spacetime in the blink of an eye and descended upon Blue Star, her gaze cast toward Mist River City.
“Manager Clark, there are two documents here that need your signature, for next month’s production material application.”
“Let me see.”
In the office, Doris Clark inspected the documents handed over by the staff and, finding no issues, signed her name below.
“When you go down, tell the manager of the materials warehouse to pay attention to the ore imported from Hundred Moon Country; there were quite a few impurities in the last batch.”
“If the quality of the next shipment is still poor, we’ll switch to another mine.”
“Alright, Manager Clark.” The staff member nodded politely.
After watching the staff leave, Doris Clark continued to immerse herself in work.
As the deputy manager of the Metal Refining Group for two years, although she usually didn’t need to handle many things, Doris had accumulated rich experience, and her executive demeanor became increasingly pronounced.
Of course, the main reason was that Doris was not interested in power and status; this deputy manager position was something the Group’s directors had pleaded with her to take.
Otherwise, with Jack’s status as one of the Federation’s ‘Top-tier’ powerhouses, it wouldn’t be a problem for Doris to be the president of a country.
Freya withdrew her consciousness from Mist River City and turned her gaze beyond the Solar System World, her will entering the mythical world through the pathway of the Eternal Divine Tree.
Unlike the immediate movement of trillions of kilometers in the Solar System, upon entering the mythical world, Freya’s perception was partially suppressed, and the operation slowed down somewhat.
Freya’s will extended along the domain of the Human Federation, silently chanting the name ‘Glenn Clark’ in her heart, and her consciousness quickly spread to the edge of the forbidden area battlefield.
Upon the shattered earth, a towering figure, 3 meters tall and clad in Golden Armor, stepped on the Void, exuding a terrifying pressure that enveloped Heaven and Earth.
Unparalleled arrogance, majesty.
Despite being merely at the Peak of the Mythical Realm, even the Nether Heavenly King’s aura seemed to be slightly suppressed by Glenn’s presence.
“I didn’t expect that War Demon of Punishing Heaven to get away. Just a Mythical late-stage Demonized creature, and yet so hard to kill,” the Nether Heavenly King said gravely.
The burly Glenn shook his head slightly, “Senior Nether, I let it go on purpose.”
“On purpose?” The Nether Heavenly King was somewhat surprised.
Glenn nodded, his voice deep: “This Punishing Heaven War Demon is a bit special; I saw traces of a human in it, and there’s a high chance it was a demonized human.”
“Moreover, during this time when the Demonized creatures have been rampaging around, but ever since this Punishing Heaven War Demon appeared, it has not killed a single human cultivator.”
“So, I wanted to see if it could be subdued and brought back to the Human Race.”
The Purgatory Demon Race had been annihilated, but the Dark Demon Air infused with the Rule’s might nearly destroyed everything, demonizing most of the creatures within millions of kilometers of the Southern Battlefield.
Thus, the Human Race, Heavenly Feather Clan, Immortal Spirit Clan demarcated their territories and busied themselves with those Demonized Unique Beasts and Giant Beasts.
Of course, these demonized creatures served as trials for the high-order cultivators above Seventh Layer Heaven with decent talent, including geniuses like Glenn who had just broken through the mythical realm not long ago.
As the person in charge of the Demon Suppression project, Glenn’s target was those rare Demonized creatures that had breached the Legendary Realm.
Such as this Punishing Heaven War Demon that had just escaped.
It was a giant that wielded a Black Battle Axe, its body as tough as cast metal, mastering the Dark Land and Dark Gravity Law of a Mountain Giant.
Because of its exceptionally burly form, with heavy double shoulders almost merging with its head, it was named Punishing Heaven.
“Reaching the Mythical Peak in less than a year, truly worthy to be his brother,” Freya thought with admiration, then withdrew her will as the Human ‘Luck’ faded away.
Of course, Glenn’s rapid cultivation was not only due to his astonishing talent and luck, akin to a Child of the Plane, but also related to having an even more terrifying older brother.
Just as Freya’s consciousness exited the boundary of the forbidden battlefield, she inadvertently paused.
Outside the former Sky Curtain Base City, Mason Watkins sat gasping for breath at the edge of the forest, with the corpse of a massive Giant Beast lying not far away.
Two years had passed, and this Martial Art Committee Member from Class 3 of South Sky Martial Height took advantage of the opportunity of the Golden Great Era and also broke through to Seventh Layer Heaven.
If such a cultivation at this age was mentioned two years ago, it would not be an exaggeration to call him the first among the younger generation in the south of Eastern Summer, especially since geniuses in the Southern Battlefield’s senior class were only at the Peak of Fifth Layer Heaven back then.
But in this age of myths, a high school Seventh Layer Heaven cultivator could only be considered decent.
Meanwhile, in just two years, those who started at the same point had diverged to heavens and earth apart.

chapters.title: Chapter 1799: 665: Son of Eternity, Heavenly Tier Revealed_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1799: Chapter 665: Son of Eternity, Heavenly Tier Revealed_2
“It seems she, along with Jack Clark and Justin Welan, are also nearing the entrance to the mythical world,” thought Freya Louise deeply.
Amidst the intense heart of a star, Freya Louise felt a surge of emotion and then slowly merged into the heart of Number One, continuing her closed-door cultivation to forge the Primitive Azure Sky.
Chirp!
Not far away, a golden-white Mecha, covered entirely with golden feathers and scale armor and possessing three-clawed golden avian wings, flapped suddenly, causing a violent surge of energy deep within the sun.
…
Primordial, is the starting point in the pursuit of eternity.
It is a process of evolving from a world-rule level creature to a Chaotic Primordial Creature, therefore even the Terminal Emperor Dragon dared not be careless and chose to return to the mythical world.
And to avoid being repelled by the mythical world, it completely unleashed the power of its Heavenly Tier bloodline, drawing out the true name imprinted deep within the origin of the mythical world.
Unlike those Giant Beasts who break through to Primal Seventh Heavenly level in the Chaotic Sea, transforming their bloodline to Heavenly Tier, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s Heavenly Tier bloodline is special, born within the mythical world as ‘Heaven’.
In a sense, it could be considered as half a ‘son’ of the mythical world.
This is also why it wasn’t repelled by the mythical world this time.
Yet, looking at the black and red figure plummeting into the mythical world, inside the Silver World, three Void Heaven Divine Dragons widened their eyes in disbelief.
The hundreds of thousands of kilometers long Purple Even Divine Dragon’s tail straightened out, letting out an incredulous roar: “How is this possible, a Heaven, Heavenly Tier bloodline!!”
The Monarch-level Purple Glow Divine Dragon slowly growled: “…No wonder, its growth rate and strength were so exaggerated.”
This time, even the Silver Divine Dragon outside of the world was somewhat shocked: “I didn’t expect that a Giant Beast could reach Heavenly Tier bloodline before the Primal Seventh Heaven level.”
“But even if it is a Heavenly Tier bloodline Giant Beast, it cannot enter the Vast World after reaching Primordial, could it be… the Eternal King…”
Hiss! The Silver Divine Dragon’s eyes widened, feeling like it had discovered a huge secret.
The Great Eternal King has offspring!!
While various theories filled the minds of the several Void Heaven Divine Dragons, the Terminal Emperor Dragon had already crossed the firmament of the mythical world and plummeted into an area shrouded with black mist.
Boom! A range of hundreds of millions of kilometers shook, a circle of black and red light waves exploded, annihilating all the black mist in its path.
Also dispersed were billions of creatures residing within the black mist.
This is the mythical ‘world’.
Weak creatures simply cannot master their destiny; they don’t need to be specifically targeted, just the aftermath of a powerful creature’s fall turns them all to ashes.
Boom boom boom!! Blood red and pitch black lightning, carrying a terrifyingly destructive aura of chaos, leapt about in the heaven and earth.
At the center of almost everything turning into chaos, the Terminal Emperor Dragon, now grown to a million meters in length, slowly closed its eyes, folding its wings.
And before it went into hibernation, a layer of pitch-black light shield covered the Silver Giant Dragon on its back.
“Roar! Great Sethia… so… sleepy, really want… to sleep…” the Silver Giant Dragon shook its head, its gaze groggy, and also closed its eyes.
Right now, under the glow of green light, the Monarch-level bloodline of the Silver Giant Dragon became extremely active.
Shrouded in the Primordial aura that the Terminal Emperor Dragon released during its breakthrough, the Silver Giant Dragon’s bloodline began another transformation, with countless complex and mysterious runes spontaneously forming among the flesh and blood.
These runes faintly exuded an indescribable, ‘fortune’-like mysterious meaning.
The intertwined fortune and calamity aura on the Silver Giant Dragon, under the influence of the Eternal and Primordial airs, was about to materialize into some kind of Top Tier Talent.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon broke through to Primordial, Jack Clark, being twinned with it, also had significant reactions.
Boom!
Within the Chaotic Origin Imperial Capital’s battle sword, Jack Clark, who was initially sitting cross-legged, suddenly fluctuated with an omnipresent aura of primordial authority which almost shattered this divine object.
“Brother Clark, what’s wrong!?” Nearby, standing at the edge of the bridge, Sara Williams was startled and turned her head suddenly.
“It’s nothing, just gained a bit of insight while I was meditating momentarily.”
Jack Clark opened his eyes, with blood red and black lightning jumping in them, and even similar terrifying arcs of red and black electricity intertwining among his hair.
The Omni-present aura of destruction from these electric arcs made Sara Williams feel an inexplicable terror in her heart.
It seemed that just one of those black lightnings could annihilate her into ashes, truly worthy of being Brother Clark.
Sara Williams once again marveled in her heart at such talent that constantly improves and strengthens every moment; she vaguely sensed a premonition.
Perhaps it wouldn’t be long before Jack Clark would break through to the primordial.
Not only Sara was astonished, but Jack Clark was also surprised by this time’s Terminal Emperor Dragon’s transformation.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon broke through, the originally unified Chaotic Doomsday Supreme Rules started to differentiate, breaking down into the Supreme Chaotic and Supreme Destructive Doomsday primordial rules.
In addition, within the body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, a second Lifeline Talent was condensing under the continuous supply of Eternal Air.
Eternal Air, similar to Creation Force but even more potent, directly facilitated the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s breakthrough into primordial.
What surprised Jack Clark was with the Emperor Dragon’s breakthrough into the primordial, the previously two independent entities—the Giant Beast and the True Body—began to influence each other.
For instance, those two evolving primordial rules were currently rushing into Jack Clark’s body through the Soul Channel, tempering the True Body and enhancing the already ‘Primordial’ level True Demon God Body at an astonishing speed.
Although because of the pathway limitations, Jack Clark could mobilize only a small amount of Primordial Chaos and Primordial Destruction rules.
But with this tempering speed, Jack felt that even without needing the World Origin or any Chaotic Divine Objects, he could cultivate to the Pinnacle of True Spirit in at most five months.
The cultivation speed is tens of times faster than before.
“Primordial, can now actually influence each other.” A faint excitement appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes.
This change in cultivation is secondary; the most important is the influence between the human body and the Giant Beast Body.
It signifies that once Jack Clark breaks through the primordial, the human body and the Giant Beast Body could very likely mobilize the rules, talents, and Divine Powers they possess.
By then, whether it’s Jack Clark or the Terminal Emperor Dragon, their strength will become even more terrifying and invincible.
For example, in the Terminal Dragon Form of the Emperor Dragon, just opening up the Tenfold Heavenly Gate, the strength would instantly increase several hundred times based on the original, showcasing the horrifying extent.
It’s essentially a weakened version of Deification Unity.
Thus, even Jack Clark’s mood was somewhat agitated at this moment, filled with anticipation.
“Brother Clark, we’re about to enter the cosmic rift, and past it lies the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area.”
Jack Clark nodded: “We are arriving, huh.”
Boom!
In the pitch-black starry sky, a thousand-kilometer-long battle sword burst out from the Space-Time Chaos, rushing headfirst into the purple rift ahead like a streak of silver light.
The Heaven Pool Forbidden Area is a special place similar to a bubble in the Great Thousand Worlds.
