At this moment, at the entrance connecting the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area to the Chaos Cosmos, various major powers gathered, and fortresses and palaces emitting multicolored Divine Lights floated around.
Among these powers, with the Human Experts and You Tian War God Clan who had already arrived, they stood in opposition to each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 1800: 666: Intimidating All Around, The Young Genius of Ten Thousand Years Old
chapters.content:
Chapter 1800: Chapter 666: Intimidating All Around, The Young Genius of Ten Thousand Years Old
Invisible gravity distortion ripples through the pitch-black starry sky, where the rules of Heaven and Earth are thrown into chaos. There, tens of thousands of Black Armored Imperial Guards, exuding great suppressive strength, stand tall, their formation vast and imposing.
At this moment, the three hundred thousand Black Armored Imperial Guards, along with Brave, the City Lord of All Mountain Guard City, all look up into the starry sky above them.
As a disciple of Blazing Heaven True Emperor, Sara Williams had naturally come to Chaos Emperor City before and had even served as a commander of one of the Imperial Guards Corps, deterring all opposition.
Therefore, both these Black Armored Imperial Guards and Brave recognized her ‘mount’.
Including the strong men of the You Tian War God Clan standing thousands of kilometers away in confrontation, who also recognized the Silver Battle Sword, with the leader being a Black Giant at the Late Stage of True Spirit, his expression growing more solemn.
“She actually came as well.”
Under the gaze of all, the Silver Battle Sword transformed into a skyful of brilliance and dissipated, revealing Sara Williams in her magnificent long dress, and Jack Clark in a black imperial robe.
Instantly, Brave and the others looked startled. Who was the young man standing shoulder to shoulder with Sara Williams?
Just at that moment, a burst of golden-white light exploded behind Jack Clark, brightly illuminating the entire starry sky like a star, accompanied by a terrifying outburst of aura.
Boom! Under the pressure akin to a half-step Primordial, the entire starry sky slightly shook, unable to bear the terrifying presence, like a giant beast that could cover the sky.
Roar!
At the location of the You Tian War God Clan, the leading Black Giant roared, his body shimmering with mysterious gloomy blue Rule patterns, and a sharp Blade Intent soared into the sky.
Already at the Rule Level, this Blade Intent drew upon the Power of Heaven and Earth, transforming into an illusory black slash blade that rose to the sky and cleaved through.
Boom! The starry sky shattered, rules in disarray.
Under the golden-white light, the Blade Intent condensed black slash blade cracked, shaking space-time, but the radiance enveloping the You Tian War God Clan was also cleaved open.
Moreover, the strong men of the other five top-tier civilizations took action, erupting with full strength, barely managing to block the half-step Primordial pressure.
As for those different races without a True Spirit presiding, the Rule domains that surrounded them were directly shaken apart by the golden-white light, their figures sinking as they nearly could not stand.
At this moment, apart from the You Tian War God Clan and those five top-tier civilization strong men, all bowed their heads, unable to gaze directly at the dazzling figure.
Boom!
The starry sky trembled, and beneath the golden-white radiance, it seemed as if there were invisible steps under Jack Clark’s feet. With every step he took, the entire starry sky shook along with him.
So strong!
As they watched the youth treading upon the light, Brave also showed a shocked expression, wondering which True Spirit Supreme from among the Six Great Divine Domains had arrived.
At this, both Brave and the Ancient and stronger strong men of this Forbidden Army heard the faint voice of Sara Williams in their ears.
“Gentlemen, Flame Wheel Great Emperor has already returned to the Divine Realm, ready to make a breakthrough to the Primordial. This is the newly-appointed Lord of Chaos Emperor City, Jack Clark, titled Supreme Divine Martial.”
The new City Lord.
Brave’s pupils constricted, then he respectfully saluted: “All Mountain Brave, I have seen the Supreme Divine Martial, congratulations to His Supreme for becoming the third Lord of Chaos Emperor City.”
The words of this Divine General caused a pause among the three hundred thousand Black Armored Imperial Guards, then their spirits lifted, not expecting this terrifying strong man to be the new City Lord.
“All Mountain Forbidden Army, welcomes the arrival of the City Lord.” The three hundred thousand Black Armored Imperial Guards kneeled on one knee, their voices resonating across the starry sky, enduring for a long time.
Looking down at the vast sea of Imperial Guards below, Jack Clark slowly nodded: “Gentlemen, rise. As fellow cultivators, this City Lord has just one step ahead, so there is no need for such formality.”
Her calm voice, like the Decree of Heavenly Dao, made all the Imperial Guards subconsciously stand up.
At the same time, the strong men of the You Tian War God Clan and those of different races also came to know that the frighteningly powerful young man of the Human Race was the newly-appointed Lord of Chaos Emperor City.
Jack Clark and Sara Williams approached the crowd, perching atop the head of a massive Giant Beast. Immediately, the True Spirit Beast instinctively trembled and issued an awe-filled growl in their presence.
Looking at Brave, whose rugged features resembled a middle-aged man in his forties, Jack Clark inquired: “Lord Brave, what is the current situation here?”
Brave solemnly replied: “At present, the Chaotic Divine Objects are exhibiting subtle anomalies with no sign of emergence.”
“Moreover, the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area’s environment is peculiar, the stronger the strength, the greater the repulsion and pressure faced, necessitating the expenditure of more strength to maintain a presence, and so we all wait outside the Forbidden Area.”
“Due to the spread of the news, the starry space surrounding the entrance has already gathered strong men from twenty-seven different races civilizations.”
“However, these individuals are not very powerful; they were already wandering nearby, hence they arrived quickly. The truly powerful beings of those different races have not yet arrived, including the You Tian War God Clan.”
Jack Clark nodded, his gaze shifting to the tens of thousands of Black Armored Imperial Guards.
These soldiers, all comprised of Ninth Heaven Cultivators, each donned in a set of black scales making up the scale armor, emitting black smoke, making their battle armor appear ferocious and domineering.
Furthermore, these smokes were as if tangible, blending with the surrounding mist to form an extensive cloud of black Cloud Mist that shrouded these Imperial Guards.
Additionally, in each hundred-man squad of Imperial Guards, there were those holding flags, which fluttered in the wind amidst the churning black fog, adding to their formidable aura.
Most importantly, each of these Imperial Guards possessed a steadfast expression and sharp eyes, not showing even the slightest fear when facing the Ancient and even True Spirit Level strong beings around them.
This spirit, will, and confidence, was enough to cause anomalies to arise within these Imperial Guards, giving birth to formidable beings defying the heavens.
As Jack Clark contemplated the Black Armored Imperial Guards thoughtfully, Brave looked towards Sara Williams: “Hall Lord Williams, you’re not far from making a breakthrough to the pinnacle, are you?”
Sara Williams shook her head slightly: “It’s difficult. Although my cultivation has improved a bit during the three hundred years of my Closed-door Cultivation, it will still take some time to break through to the Pinnacle of True Spirit.”
Though Sara Williams said it would take some time, she did not deny it. This made Brave and those five Ancient Divine Generals feel a bit envious.

chapters.title: Chapter 1801: 666: Intimidating All Directions, A Ten Thousand Year Old Young Genius_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1801: Chapter 666: Intimidating All Directions, A Ten Thousand Year Old Young Genius_2
Pinnacle of True Spirit, one more step and it’s the Primordial.
Although there’s a vast distance from the Pinnacle of True Spirit to the Primordial, many strong men at the peak have been stuck here for tens or even hundreds of thousands of years unable to advance further, but at least there is hope in sight now.
After greeting, Sara Williams turned to Jack Clark: “Brother Clark, as the City Lord of Chaos Emperor City, you need to maintain the necessary dignity when facing other civilizations.”
As she spoke, Sara Williams reached her left hand into the Void, pulling out a palm-sized purple-black Mini Divine Temple model, and then tossed it into the air.
Boom!
The Void vibrated, creating rings of airwaves sweeping in all directions, the purple-black Divine Light shone brightly and the Mini Divine Temple swelled, transforming into a towering eight thousand kilometers tall Great Hall.
Unlike ordinary temples, this temple, rather than being called a temple, is more like a King’s Platform.
Based on a black Floating Island with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, surrounded by thirty-six thick purple stone pillars that are a kilometer thick, each pillar is engraved with a giant beast bas-relief.
The temple has no walls, nor a roof, all the tops of the stone pillars reach into the Void, unknown where they connect.
These stone pillars are arranged in six rows, each layer consisting of six pillars, and at the end in the middle of the stone pillars there is a King’s Platform towering three thousand kilometers high, with nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine steps.
Above the King’s Platform stands a ten-thousand-meter tall purple-black throne.
The thick back of the throne is straight, like those stone pillars reaching deep into the Void, engraved with runes that comply with the mysterious rules of Heaven and Earth, solemn, sacred.
In front of this temple emanating an aura of Chaos, even True Spirit Powerhouses feel a tremor in their spirit.
As for those strong men of different races below True Spirit, they inexplicably feel an invisible oppression, showing awe towards the purple-black Divine Temple.
“It’s the Heavenly Dome Temple!” exclaims Brave, pausing.
Jack Clark became somewhat interested: “This temple is called the Heavenly Dome?”
Brave nodded: “Yes, City Lord, the Heavenly Dome Temple is a special Supreme Treasure, it appeared at an auction in the Chaotic Ancient Divine Realm thousands of years ago.”
“I happened to be there, fortunate enough to have seen it once.”
“However, this Supreme Treasure doesn’t have attacking or combat abilities, and it was priced high at the time, resulting in no bids, later it was said to have been bought by a strong man from another Divine Realm.”
“Unexpectedly, this Supreme Treasure is now in Lord Williams’s hands.”
As Brave spoke, he appeared somewhat puzzled, recalling that Sara Williams already possessed a Starry Sky Lake Pavilion Supreme Treasure, usually used for her travel grandeur.
And the style of the Heavenly Dome Temple did not match hers, it’s unclear why it was bought at a high price at the time.
After Brave finished speaking, Sara Williams then opened her mouth, looking at Jack Clark with a smile: “Brother Clark, this temple’s majestic grandeur doesn’t quite match my temperament, thus I’ve never used it.”
“Just today you need support for your departure, so I’ve prepared to give this temple to you, please do not refuse.”
… Brave and those five Ancient Divine Generals exchanged glances, all somewhat surprised.
To know that as a renowned strong man in the Flame Wheel Divine Domain, plus the identity of a True Emperor’s direct disciple and some special reasons, Sara Williams’s status in the Six Great Divine Domains is not inferior to those of Imperial Dynasty Great Emperors.
But at this moment, Sara Williams not only lowers her status, proactively offering a Chaotic Supreme Treasure, but also eagerly hoping the other party would accept it.
In front of Sara Williams’s expectant gaze, Jack Clark slightly shook his head: “Sara, you don’t have to be so polite, it’s rare for you to be considerate, I naturally will not refuse.”
Immediately, Sara Williams’s face revealed a radiant smile, regal and glorious, almost lighting up the entire world, her stunning demeanor nearly causing even Brave and other strong men to momentarily lose their composure.
In fact, when Jack Clark interacted with the Williams sisters, he also occasionally felt somewhat out of place, especially when they consistently called him Brother Clark.
After all, the two sisters are already over ten thousand years old, while he is only eighteen.
But once cultivators break through to the Ancient Realm, time has no significance for them, thus Jack Clark wasn’t particularly concerned about this issue, and they conversed quite naturally.
Jack Clark could also keenly feel the Williams sisters’ attachment to him.
This attachment isn’t ‘love’ but a special kind of emotion that’s indescribable, similar to kinship yet slightly different.
Regarding why this is so, it should be because of Jack Clark’s appearance in the moments of Doomsday despair years ago, which made a profound impact on their souls, leaving a deep impression.
Holding the control token for the Heavenly Dome Temple, Jack Clark flashed and passed through the thirty-six stone pillars with Sara Williams, appearing on the Platform of the Heavenly Dome Temple.
Under the gaze of onlookers, Jack Clark approached the throne and slowly sat down.
Boom!
The moment Jack Clark sat down, the entire temple shook slightly, the surrounding Space-Time warped, and his figure ‘expanded’, appearing like a ten-thousand-meter-tall deity matching the throne.
Below him, black mist rolled like the tides sweeping roaringly among the thirty-six stone pillars, appearing like a supreme ancient emperor who rules the universe.
Such majesty made the different races in the surrounding starry sky all look solemn.
But it wasn’t over yet, as Jack Clark sat on the throne, refining the temple, his aura merging with the Heavenly Dome Temple, suddenly the power of his bloodline was activated.
Roar!
The fierce and majestic roar echoed through the starry sky, the pressure contained causing all different races to shudder, a strong chill rising from the depths of their souls.
As if they encountered some terrifying natural enemy.
Behind the throne in the pitch-black Void, a giant shadow formed by lines slowly emerged.
It was a long-bodied giant beast, somewhat dragon-like yet not a dragon.
The black-purple dragon head was vast as stars, with three pairs of dragon horns like swords, sharp and straight, a row of tough dorsal fins extending backward along most of its body, disappearing into the depths of the Void.

chapters.title: Chapter 1802: 666: Intimidating All Directions, A Ten Thousand Year Old Young Genius_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1802: Chapter 666: Intimidating All Directions, A Ten Thousand Year Old Young Genius_3
This giant beast is none other than the shadow of the Emperor Dragon Bloodline within Jack Clark.
Although the power of the bloodline comes from the Terminal Emperor Dragon, with each of Jack Clark’s Evolutions and Transformations, ultimately becoming a Primordial Demon God, the bloodline has long since changed.
Witnessing this scene, Sara Williams, standing on the 9998th step, had an even brighter smile on her face.
You are destined to transform into the highest star, shining eternally, revered and worshipped by countless beings.
The Divine Might displayed by Jack Clark at this moment, directly caused the confronting You Tian War God Clan to tremble, retreating 100,000 kilometers within the black Divine Light.
The arrival of the Human City Lord, who is a half-step Primordial, naturally discouraged the opposing You Tian War God Clan from provoking in the absence of a peer powerhouse.
Seeing this, the other five top-tier civilization powerhouses also retreated, leaving the restricted zone entrance area tens of thousands of kilometers behind.
The Peak Civilization’s Gloomy Heaven Clan and the powerhouses of other top-tier civilizations retreated, leaving tens of thousands of other different races naturally not daring to hesitate, each transforming into streaks of Divine Light and scattering.
This scene greatly excited the hundreds of thousands of Black Armored Imperial Guards, who couldn’t help but shout: “City Lord’s Divine Might, unmatched in this world, all races retreat, the Human Race is eternal.”
The loud chants of the City Lord being unmatched, along with the frenetic atmosphere permeating between heaven and earth, even Jack Clark felt somewhat infected, his blood slightly boiling.
Is this the meaning of the existence of a race’s powerhouse?
To intimidate all directions, clear paths, lead the tribe, and pioneer the future.
Sitting high on the Divine Temple’s throne, Jack Clark looked indifferent, surveying all around, especially towards the thousands of vanguard troops of the Gloomy Heaven Clan, but ultimately, he didn’t strike.
Just as Sara Williams said, he is now the Overlord of the Human Divine Domain, needing to maintain necessary dignity.
These minor characters do not even qualify for him to deliberately strike, even if to kill, it would be during a casual eradication while clashing with a peer from the You Tian War God Clan.
Jack Clark withdrew his gaze, and looking at the woman standing beside with hands behind and her long dress fluttering, he asked curiously: “Sara, how many supreme treasures do you still have in your possession?”
“How many supreme treasures?”
Sara Williams thought for a moment: “For attack, there are top-tier supreme treasures like the Illusory Perishing Azure Feather Sword, Flying Phoenix Five-Colored Banner, Nine Heavens Bright Mirror Tower, for support, there are Chaotic Origin Imperial Capital Sword, Sun and Moon Reverse Thunder Lock…”
As Sara Williams calculated, names of ordinary divine objects, senior divine objects, top-tier divine objects repeatedly fell from her lips.
From finding the Ancient Divine Domain, being taken as a disciple by the Blazing Heaven True Emperor till now, thousands of years had passed, Sara Williams spent most of that time in the Ancient Battlefield.
She had both stationed and roamed the depths of space to explore secret realms, restricted zones, or even battled with powerhouses from other civilizations.
Thus, she accumulated a considerable “wealth.”
Of course, these Chaotic Supreme Treasures from the Ancient Battlefield, each was useful, and their special powers had numerous times aided Sara Williams to slay formidable enemies or escape.
The only useless supreme treasure was the Heavenly Dome Temple.
Until Sara Williams finished speaking, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but be surprised, both at Sara William’s accumulation and the abundance of treasures in the Ancient Battlefield.
If late-stage True Spirit Sara Williams already possessed so many treasures, what about those at the Primordial level?
Their hands must also hold numerous real ‘Chaotic Supreme Treasures’, wielding weapons that enable them to exert even greater powers.
Many Chaotic Supreme Treasures containing the utmost power of Chaos, their might unimaginable.
Thinking of this, Jack Clark suddenly understood why the Primordial Beasts of the mythical world and those different race civilizations are so distinctly separate.
Mythical Giant Beasts, compared to state-owned enterprises, have structure and massive projects, hence they disdain to ‘interact’ with these civilized different races.
This disdain probably also includes the reluctance to let these civilizations compete for their ‘orders’.
Regarding the Primordial Beasts searching for fragments in the depths of Chaos and bringing them back to the mythical world, Jack Clark does not believe that the True Emperor level or even higher powerhouses of those different races are unaware of it.
It’s just that the Ancient Battlefield has a greater attraction to different race civilizations, including the Human Experts.
Compared to the uncertain rewards of the Eternal Air, the various Heaven and Earth Treasures, Chaotic Divine Objects, and Chaotic Supreme Treasures from the Ancient Battlefield are obviously more suitable for them.
Similarly, most Chaotic Supreme Treasure Beasts usually don’t use them.
Therefore, those Primordial Beasts also rarely appear in the Ancient Battlefield.
[There are still over 2000 characters left, updating to maintain consistency, brothers can wait an hour or refresh tomorrow morning]

chapters.title: Chapter 1803: 667: They Are All Young People, Cosmic Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 1803: Chapter 667: They Are All Young People, Cosmic Life
With the arrival of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe and the Silver-Winged Sky Ants, all four peak forces of this Chaos Starry Sky have gathered, including the Guardians.
When Jack Clark felt that the Silver-Winged Sky Ant was very strong, Sara Williams also spoke with a serious gaze, whispering, “Brother Clark, be careful of that Guardian, the Silver-Winged Sky Ant.”
“That Guardian is named Darius. Though his realm has not broken through to Primordial, he reversed refined his bloodline during the Late Stage of True Spirit, successfully sublimating his racial power to a level comparable to his Lifeline Talent.”
“This ability can melt all Supreme Treasures and Divine Weapons, absorbing their essence to integrate into his True Body, which is very compatible with the Silver-Winged Sky Ants Clan.”
“After forging countless resources and over a dozen Supreme Treasures, this True Body of the Silver-Winged Sky Ant is now comparable to the Primordial Stars Level, unmatched in combat power.”
“My master once said, should this Silver-Winged Sky Ant break through to Primordial, its power would become terrifyingly formidable.”
“A Lifeline Talent comparable to Primordial, no wonder I feel a bit pressured.” Even Jack Clark couldn’t help being somewhat moved this time.
Jack Clark knows best just how strong a Lifeline Talent is, having gained control over it prematurely upon breaking through True Spirit.
This allowed him to possess the power to surpass limits during his Initial Stage of True Spirit, comparable to an ordinary Primordial Star.
“Ordinary” here refers to those geniuses with monstrous talents, but when breaking through to Primordial, their potential nearly exhausted, unable to fight beyond their current realm.
Though those who can break through to Primordial are each the most monstrous among their respective racial civilizations, having fought beyond their levels from the start of their cultivation.
But there’s always a higher sky, and among geniuses, there are disparities in strength.
Some monsters accumulate terrifyingly formidable power, capable even after breaking through True Spirit and Primordial to fight across major realms, like the Terminal Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark.
This accumulation comes from various aspects.
For instance, the Terminal Emperor Dragon continuously evolves, compresses, and grows until True Spirit, possessing a physique hundreds to thousands of times stronger than Giant Beasts of the same realm, ten Deification Talents, Supreme Rules, and Lifeline Talent.
These form the basis for the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s ability to fight across Major Realms.
Jack Clark is slightly weaker than the Terminal Emperor Dragon, but similarly possesses a physique hundreds of times stronger than Giant Beasts of the same realm, two Supreme Rules,
plus five Top-tier Divine Powers, one Superior Divine Power, Pseudo-Creation Level weapon and battle armor, and the Tenfold Heavenly Gate’s ‘Lifeline Talent’.
Such accumulations have created two monstrously powerful beings.
And the mythical world is vast and boundless, with the Chaos Sea nurturing countless civilizations and races, naturally giving rise to numerous monstrously talented beings.
Such as the Silver-Winged Sky Ant named Darius before us.
However, compared to Jack Clark, its ‘limit-breaking’ advantage is only the racial power comparable to Lifeline Talent, along with the Supreme Rule it commands, which is also comparable to the Primordial Stars.
This is still when its realm has reached halfway to Primordial.
After discussing the Silver-Winged Sky Ant Clan, Sara Williams introduced Jack Clark to another powerhouse of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, named Floralette.
Her strength is about the same as the Gloomy Heaven War God, holding a standard position halfway to the Primordial Realm and wielding Creation Level Divine Weapons.
Plus, with the control of three strong racial talents, Supreme Rules, and True Emperor Level Bloodline Power, her true strength has also reached the Primordial Stars Level.
What astonished Jack Clark was that this towering, muscularly built figure with a fierce appearance was actually a female.
As Jack Clark sized up the two Guardians from the Silver-Winged Sky Ants and the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, these two strong beings from different races were also observing him.
Looking at the young man sitting on the black-purple throne, wearing a Mysterious Colored Imperial Robe, adorned with an Imperial Crown, and the intense aura emanating from him, both foreign strong beings showed gravity in their eyes.
This human is very strong, very dangerous!
The golden figure with prominent antlers slowly spoke, their voice echoing through the starry sky: “Before arriving, I heard that the Human Race’s Chaos Emperor City has changed its City Lord.”
“I am Floralette of the Golden Eternity Race, hoping for a chance to exchange and spar with the Divine Martial City Lord.”
“To preside over the Chaos Emperor City, the strength of the Divine Martial City Lord must be at least on par with Flame Wheel, perhaps even stronger; I just wonder if there will be such an opportunity.”
On the surface, the relationship between the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe and the Human Race is neutral and friendly, hence the atmosphere between them is relatively amicable.
Jack Clark nodded slightly: “Floralette, the Ancient God praised, the formidable Divine Might of your Noble’s Eternal Heavenly Power arouses some curiosity in me.”
While saying this, Jack Clark looked towards the Silver-Winged Sky Ant.
However, also being neutral, the Silver-Winged Sky Ant Clan does not like to interact with other civilizations and remains independent.
Therefore, faced with Jack Clark’s gaze, that strong Silver-Winged Sky Ant showed no reaction, its form blurring, disappearing into the hexagonal silver brilliance.
Just then, from another direction in the starry sky, space-time twisted, and powerful auras emerged, lighting up the starry sky as more strong beings from different civilizations rushed over.
Among these people, only a few strong beings from top-tier civilizations qualified to catch Jack Clark’s attention.
At this moment, the role of Sara Williams, the Deputy City Lord, responsible for gathering intelligence, became evident as she recognized most of the strong beings from the surrounding civilizations.
Sara Williams pointed at several beings, about ten meters tall, human-like in appearance but covered with ancient bronze scales, each with a crimson single horn on their head: “Brother Clark, those are from the Crimson Single-Horned Tribe.”
“The one leading is among the top ten geniuses of their younger generation, Van Wood, at the True Spirit Initial Stage, possesses a Top-Tier Offensive Supreme Treasure, and his combat power is comparable to the Late Stage of True Spirit.”
The younger generation.
Jack Clark’s gaze shifted slightly: “How many years has it been since they became True Spirit Powerhouses?”
That a True Spirit Level powerhouse still counts as part of the younger generation, could it be that this individual has cultivated to the True Spirit Level in just a hundred years? Even Jack Clark couldn’t help but take this cultivation talent seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1804: 667: They Are All Young People, Cosmic Life_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1804: Chapter 667: They Are All Young People, Cosmic Life_2
But just as Jack Clark was solemnly observing the single-horned being from a different race, wrapped in crimson chains some hundred thousand kilometers away, Sara Williams spoke.
“According to the information we have, Van Wood has been cultivating for over eleven thousand years.”
“How many!?” Jack Clark turned his head to look at Sara Williams.
“Eleven thousand three hundred and seventy years.” This time, Sara Williams provided the data down to the tens digit.
Jack Clark was somewhat stunned for a moment: “Younger Generation over ten thousand years old, are you sure there’s no mistake?”
Even with the Life Shackles and time assimilation of the mythical world, it took more than ten thousand years to cultivate to the True Spirit realm. Such talent that ranks within the top ten of their race.
And still part of the Younger Generation!!
Knowing what amazed Jack Clark, Sara Williams shook her head: “Brother Clark, it’s different, these civilized races have been assimilated with the Vast World for a million, even millions of years.”
“Therefore, the shackles and Time Mark branded in their bloodlines are almost impossible to break.”
“Cultivating for ten thousand years to achieve a breakthrough to the realm of True Spirit Emperor, even in the Six Domains of Human, is considered to have outstanding talent in other Peak Civilizations, not to mention in top-tier civilizations like the crimson single-horns.”
“This is also why our Six Domains of Human could rise rapidly.”
“Weak Life Shackles, shallow time imprints, in thirty thousand years, numerous strong men have emerged from the Six Domains, quickly filling the middle-tier vacancies below the Six Great True Emperors.”
“Also, due to our rapid rise, we squeezed the interests and living space of other civilizations, which is why we are viewed as enemies by some Peak Civilizations.”
Alright, Jack Clark nodded in understanding.
That means Sara Williams and her sisters at over ten thousand years old also count as the Younger Generation.
At that moment, Sara Williams pointed to a meteorite over two hundred thousand kilometers away, where some strange shadows stood erect.
They were cloaked in ragged grey robes and held a dry wooden staff in their hands, looking like ‘old men’ about to be buried.
“Brother Clark, those are the Estrella Clan, a top-tier civilization with few members, but each one of them is very powerful and enigmatic,” said Sara Williams.
“Due to little contact, the Imperial Dynasty has no specific information on this clan as of now.”
“So secretive.” Jack Clark’s eyes revealed slowly emerging black gold vertical pupils, and in an instant, a terrifying gaze crossed the distant space-time, enveloping those few figures.
At the very moment when the gaze of the Void Death Pupils fell upon those figures.
Boom!
The leading enigmatic figure erupted with a grey mist, corroding everything around it, including the ‘gaze’ of the Void Death Pupils, emitting a silent pssht sound.
Within the grey mist, those few figures from the Estrella Clan disappeared silently, as if they had never appeared.
Even Jack Clark’s Void Double Pupils could only capture some grey traces deep in the Void; these different races had entered another dimensional layer.
Such a mysterious power. Jack Clark slightly narrowed his eyes, suppressing the impulse to open his Peeping Void True Eye and continue peering.
The previous scrutiny with the Void Double Pupils alarmed them, but those figures simply left, a sign of retreat. Should Jack Clark pursue further, it would seem like bullying and make unnecessary enemies.
Phew! Jack Clark exhaled slowly, his blood boiling instantly.
So many strong men from different races, how I wish to blow them all up.
Let’s see if their racial strength and civilization inheritance are stronger, or if my True Demon God Body is more invincible.
Sara Williams then pointed to a figure with four arms and towering a kilometer high, over a hundred thousand kilometers away.
These giant-like beings from a different race trod on starry space, each shouldering a totem that resembled a mountain pillar with numerous clods and fragments of dirt constantly condensing out of nowhere, exuding a heavy oppressive force.
“Brother Clark, those are from the top-tier civilization, the Pati Totem Clan,” she said.
“Leading them is Simonas, in the mid-period of True Spirit, who has cultivated for twenty thousand years. His totem pillar is a top-tier treasure. Coupled with the race’s innate combat talent, he is close to the pinnacle of True Spirit, very powerful.”
“Indeed not weak,” Jack Clark nodded.
Cultivation at the pinnacle of True Spirit, in this layer of the Chaos Cosmos other than the Guardians of the various Peak Civilizations, already belongs to the First echelon.
But that note of cultivating for twenty thousand years still made Jack Clark take notice.
Twenty thousand years, for eighteen-year-old Jack Clark, was an unimaginably long period, even older than the current historical legends of Blue Star.
But such a ‘historic’ giant, is still considered a young man.
Alright, compared to cultivating for nearly a hundred thousand years to reach Late Stage of True Spirit and eventually Devouring all bloodlines to achieve pinnacle of True Spirit, the talent of these different races is indeed strong.
As they waited, more top-tier civilization strong men arrived.
A tall and thin figure covered in golden fine scales, with dragon patterns on the forehead, possessing the bloodline of Golden Dragons from the Golden Scaled Dragon Pattern Clan.
Height a hundred meters, humanoid but covered in black fur, with a protruding snout and sharp ears, and sporting a tail like that of a Furious Ape from the Fude tribe.
Height 3 meters, human-like in shape, with purple fine scales on the face and exposed arms, with a third eye on the forehead, belonging to the Heavenly Wind Purple Thunder Clan.
Among them, the Golden Scaled Dragon Pattern Clan was friendly with the Human Race, while the Fude tribe was close to the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan; this strong man from a different race went straight to the Gloomy Heaven Clan upon arrival.
Jack Clark had some impression of this tribe.
The first time he entered the Ancient Dueling Arena, the Dueler he killed was from the Fude race.
That race’s strength left a deep impression on Jack Clark; they could transform like Saiyans and almost match his true form in combat.
And the Heavenly Wind Purple Thunder Clan, similar to the Silver-winged Heavenly Ants Clan, had cool relations with the surrounding civilizations.
This tribe, with scarce numbers inherently masters a Divine Power called Heavenly Wind Divine Thunder, and once they break through to the Legendary Realm, their talent will Transform into the Supreme Law of Heavenly Wind Purple Thunder.

chapters.title: Chapter 1805: 667: They Are All Young People, Cosmic Life_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1805: Chapter 667: They Are All Young People, Cosmic Life_3
When the breakthrough to the Ancient Realm occurs, one will advance to become imbued with the Supreme Rule of the Purple Heaven Divine Thunder, possessing formidable combat strength.
And this race, belonging to another Peak Civilization far removed from the Human Race, is known as a branch of the Heavenly Punishment Clan.
Just as Jack Clark was surveying the newcomers from several Top-tier civilizations, Sara Williams’s expression became solemn once again as she gazed into the starry sky over thirty million kilometers away.
There, the dazzling blue starlight twinkled, and three figures radiating True Spirit Level aura slowly emerged—two large and one small.
Sara spoke gravely: “Brother Clark, it’s the Star Ring Divine Clan!”
“Is this race very strong?”
“Very strong.”
Sara nodded emphatically: “Unlike us, who hail from the Vast World, and other civilizations like the Gloomy Heaven Clan, this different race comes from another universe.”
“They are born from the starlight, each one of a unique form, and the hallmark of each being is the speckles of blue starlight that encircle them.”
“These members of the Star Ring Divine Clan naturally possess the power to drive planetary celestial bodies, commanding powerful rules such as gravitation, rays, and the repulsion of gravity.”
“This is a civilization of terrifying potential; currently, the strongest being that has appeared in the Ancient Battlefield is a Monarch of the Third Heavenly Realm, hence the civilization’s classification as Top-tier.”
“However, once that Monarch clashed with a True Emperor of a Peak Civilization, not only did he not fall, but he transformed into a true Black Hole celestial body and tore apart the True Body of that True Emperor.”
“Even though the True Emperor, with his ability to transcend Space-Time, ultimately left with only some injuries, it nonetheless made the Star Ring Divine Clan’s name resonate across the battlefield.”
Even Jack Clark was somewhat shocked this time: “There actually exists such a being, born from the stars themselves, or rather, a cosmic life form innately birthed.”
Being born with control over top-tier powers like gravitation and gravity indeed fits the description of an Innate Demon God.
Moreover, being an Innate Demon God nurtured by an entire universe, they possess astounding potential. If not for their scarce numbers, and the strongest of them has yet to break through to True Emperor status, they would entirely be a new Peak Civilization.
And they are even more powerful than most Peak Civilization groups.
However, with gain comes loss; due to their innately strong individuality, these members of different races from these civilizations are relatively rare, especially when compared to the Human Race, whose numbers are counted in the hundreds of billions.
Thus, all four Great Peak Races and seven Top-tier Civilizations have arrived.
Together with almost a hundred different races scattered across a million kilometers, the atmosphere grows increasingly somber.
As for why there are so few Top-tier Civilizations in this expanse of the cosmic starry sky, it is because other Top-tier Civilizations deliberately avoid getting too close to these Peak Civilizations.
Only the confirmed emergence of a ‘Chaotic Supreme Treasure’ could attract those distant powers here.
“Brother Clark, the Star Ring Divine Clan has come over.”
Upon Sara’s reminder, three streaks of blue starlight cut through the starry sky, quickly appearing just a few thousand kilometers away at a terrifying speed that twisted time.
Boom! Brave, exuding the late-stage pressure of True Spirit, transformed into a massive figure standing before the Heavenly Dome Temple: “Halt, the area ahead is human territory, and unauthorized entry is not permitted.”
“There’s no need for alarm, we mean no harm,” a calm and gentle voice said, as the three streaks of starlight stopped three thousand kilometers away, and the engulfing blue starlight scattered to reveal their figures.
Two enormous figures, each nearly thirty thousand meters long, resembled Starry Sky Dragons clad in armor, lacking only dragon claws.
And that much smaller figure was unmistakably a person.
A young man dressed in a blue starlight robe, with long blue hair draped over his shoulders, was smiling calmly at Jack Clark, who sat on the throne, his eyes sparkling with a bright and mysterious starlight.
“I am Clive Dale, from the Star God Universe.”
“A century ago when I first entered the Ancient Battlefield, I had the fortune to make contact with a strong man of the Human Race, after which I developed a profound admiration for the human civilization.”
“Seeing the Human Experts again this time on the battlefield filled me with joy, so I specifically came over to greet you, please excuse the imposition.”
His tone of voice and even his name were very much in accordance with human customs, surprising Jack Clark, who couldn’t help but reveal a faint smile.
“Clive Dale is being too serious. Our Human Race has always loved peace and included all civilizations that come with goodwill as friends. Why would we mind such a trivial matter?”
“Since Clive Dale is interested in the Human Race’s civilization, once the matter here is concluded, you are welcome to visit the Chaos Emperor City as a guest.”
Faced with Jack Clark’s invitation, the Star Ring Divine Clan member called Clive Dale showed a smile and did not refuse: “Let’s agree on this. I will definitely come to visit the Chaos Emperor City when the time comes.”
[A bit more to wrap up, will be updated in ten minutes]

chapters.title: Chapter 1806: 668 The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure 'Bell
chapters.content:
Chapter 1806: Chapter 668 The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure ‘Bell
Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, where the internal sky and Earth are fragmented, splitting into countless black shard-like small worlds.
In the roaring chaos of Space-Time power, numerous ‘worlds’ are shattered while many new small worlds are birthed amidst the Chaos Qi, in an endless cycle.
This is an extremely dangerous forbidden realm, where even mythical life can be torn apart by the pervasive space-time whirlpools with just a slight misstep.
Only those above the Titan level have the power to protect themselves here.
At this moment, within the chaotic Space-Time turbulence, a vortex passage tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter trembles, diffusing brilliant multicolored light as figures exuding terrifying auras descend.
Upon bursting through the passage, these figures scatter in all directions.
Among them, several hundred streaks of light belonging to the Human Race head towards the Southeast, the Golden Eternal Clan to the Northwest side, and the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan towards the Southwest.
After the three peak civilizations depart, the entrance passage trembles once again, with Silver Brilliance sparkling as two Silver-winged Heavenly Ants slowly emerge.
Standing amid the Space-Time Chaos, Dalimos, with an aura of the Late Stage of True Spirit, reveals a look of surprise, emitting a sharp, metallic grating sound.
“Brother, didn’t their scouts confirm the direction where the Chaotic Divine Object emerged? Why are they all going in different directions?”
The coldly resolute Silver-winged Heavenly Ant, whose true form is as formidable and invincible as Primordial Stars, slowly responds: “It should be related to the environment here. With overlapping Space-Time and chaotic shards, it leads to the appearance of the emergent phenomenon of the Chaotic Divine Object in three different directions, in three different ‘worlds’.”
“As for which one is real, it’s all down to luck now.”
Dalimos hesitantly asks: “One real and two fakes, which one should we follow?”
“Let’s split up, Mos, you follow the Golden Eternal Clan. I will check on the Human Race.” As he speaks, the terrifying aura of the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant shatters and diffuses into a sky full of silver light spots, vanishing.
Seeing this, Dalimos nods and transforms into a streak of silver light, disappearing into the depths of the Space-Time Chaos.
No sooner have the Silver-winged Heavenly Ants left than the forbidden realm’s passage trembles again, as hundreds of mighty auras above the Titan level arrive—among them, the three from the Star Ring Divine Clan.
The newcomers are strong men from the seven top-tier civilizations. Upon arrival, sensing the lingering auras of the three initial races spread amidst the Space-Time turbulence, they too pause in bewilderment.
“Three directions.” Amidst the circling starlight, Clive Dale ponders softly.
“Let me follow the Human Race and see. Pota, you pick a random direction and follow them. Once you ascertain the truthfulness of the emergence point, immediately communicate via starlight.”
“Understood.” The two Starry Sky Dragons nod slowly, roaring as they plunge into the tumultuous Space-Time.
After the Star Ring Divine Clan departs, the other top-tier civilizations quickly make their decisions. Unlike the split into three groups, they pick a direction and follow.
Both the Golden Scaled Dragon Pattern Clan and the Pati Totem Clan trail behind the Human Race, while the Heavenly Wind Purple Thunder Clan transforms into lightning and disappears behind the Golden Eternal Clan.
The Fude tribe below, along with the Estrella Clan and the Crimson Single-Horned Tribe, each employ some method to fly towards the direction where the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan vanished.
Only after these strong auras have disappeared does the passage in the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area shake once more, resolute and clear.
Tens of thousands of Law Radiance in various colors flicker as a dense crowd of different races strong men appear, bewildered by the chaotic auras permeating the Space-Time turbulence.
All directions are covered, wasn’t the direction of the Chaotic Divine Object’s emergence discovered?
At that moment, an ancient strong man from a different race resembling an armored red Explosive Bear exclaims indignantly: “Those people from the top-tier civilizations are so despicable, they’ve actually confused the auras of the three races.”
“Indeed.” Other strong men from different races also show anger on their faces.
But anger is of no use.
In the Ancient Battlefield, might makes right; the gap between top-tier civilizations and powerful civilizations is not just a matter of Primordial beings taking charge but also heritage.
Once a different race produces a Primordial, under the feedback of power from the source of rules, it will elevate the entire power structure of the civilization.
To put it simply, Cultivation Methods become of higher level, and the race’s innate talents become stronger.
Therefore, the gap between civilizations comes from all aspects, not just the sheer number of strong individuals.
Faced with the issue of chaotic auras, these different races, after hesitating a moment, each pick a direction and transform into a series of dazzling shooting stars, vanishing.
Of course, they are not pursuing the Chaotic Divine Object.
With such a level of Divine Object, and under the suppression of the strong men from peak and powerful civilizations, even if they were extremely lucky to snatch it, they couldn’t guard it.
Their target is at the moment of the birth of the Divine Object; when the world that nurtured it collapses and scatters Heaven and Earth Treasures in every direction.
These resources, formed by the dispersing force of the Divine Object, also contain an almost imperceptible supreme Chaos force within them.
Though not as powerful as the Chaotic Divine Objects, their rarity makes them valuable treasures.
For these different races’ strong men, finding such an item would be a great fortune, and this also includes the divine cultivators who followed Jack Clark, aiming for these Heaven and Earth Treasures.
In the chaotic flow not far from the entrance, hundreds of figures of the Heavenly King Level and above within the Heavenly Dome Temple stand firm, all looking solemnly towards the end of the temple.
There, Jack Clark sits high upon the throne, thoughtfully observing the floating Light sphere in the air.
Within it is the recorded imagery of the emergence phenomenon of the Ancient Powerhouse’s Chaotic Divine Objects.
Clear cerulean sea surface, dotted with islands like pearls, under a blue sky completely cloudless—it would be a perfect vacation paradise if it were on Blue Star.
But at this moment, the sea water between these islands boils, forming a vortex several thousand kilometers across.

chapters.title: Chapter 1807: 668 The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure 'Bell' _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1807: Chapter 668 The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure ‘Bell’ _2
Across the vortex, there lay another world, an embryonic Chaos Void filled with murky auras, within which floated a gray stone resembling a cliff.
All attention, however, was focused on the ancient bronze bell resting atop that cliff.
Though the image was somewhat blurry, preventing a clear view of the bell’s specifics, the very sight of it through the divine projection left everyone feeling a profound heaviness in their spirits.
Especially Jack Clark, who felt as if he was witnessing an endless Chaos, perceiving not just a ‘bell’, but an entire Chao Sea encompassing boundless space and time.
Heavy, magnificent, suppressing all heavens.
Sara Williams’s expression grew serious, mixed with a hint of excitement: “Brother Clark, the Divine Object emerging this time might be a Chaotic Supreme Treasure.”
“Chaotic level.” Jack Clark’s gaze flickered slightly.
Sara nodded: “The difference between a Chaotic Supreme Treasure and a Top-tier Supreme Treasure lies in its integrity; it contains a complete Chaos Rule internally and possesses a unique rhythm.”
“This special rhythmic sense, I’ve previously encountered it on the Blazing Heaven Sun Wheel held by my master, I can’t be mistaken.”
To think it was a Chaotic Supreme Treasure. Golden-White lightning danced in Jack Clark’s eyes, as he sat up slightly straighter, suddenly emitting a terrifying aura.
Had this been only a Top-tier Supreme Treasure, Jack Clark might not have cared as much.
Take it if possible, leave it if not, without revealing too much.
But unexpectedly, it was comparable to a Creation Divine Weapon of Chaotic level, and seemingly of the offensive type, making this treasure even more precious and powerful than Creation Level Divine Weapons.
One is crafted by a Primordial Powerhouse themselves, the other is nurtured by the Chaos, their potential limits utterly divergent.
Crack!
The space around Jack Clark shattered like a mirror, unable to bear the trace of aura leaking from him, cracking into black spiderweb fractures.
Jack reached into the Void, slowly withdrawing a five-meter long, purple-black War Halberd wrapped in strands of blood-red light, looking towards Sara.
“Sara, take my Eight Desolations Halberd back, coordinate with Brave and the others to block the Forbidden Domain’s entrance.”
“Joined by all, and with a million Black Armored Imperial Guards, even the three clan Guardians can be fended off for a while, long enough for me to arrive.”
Because this anomaly appeared in three places simultaneously, Jack Clark couldn’t be certain if the direction they found was the actual emerging point, thus he prepared a precaution to block the entrance.
In case the Human Race’s discovered site was false, and the Chaotic Supreme Treasure ended up with the You Tian War God Clan or the Golden Eternal Clan, he would have to wrest it from them.
…Sara paused.
Jack Clark’s gaze turned icy, his voice low: “I am determined to obtain this Chaotic Supreme Treasure, no matter if it’s peak races or top-tier civilizations, all who dare to steal will be exterminated.”
Hide strength, develop low-key, what are those?
For this Chaotic Bronze Bell, Jack Clark was prepared to meet gods and slay gods, meet Buddhas and slay Buddhas.
As for the advice from the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, he cast it aside in his mind.
Once he gets the Chaotic Bronze Bell, especially if the Terminal Emperor Dragon breaks through to the Primordial, even if a True Emperor from the Fourth Heavenly Realm strikes, Jack Clark was confident he could retreat unscathed.
And just give him a month or two to develop; once he breaks through to Primordial here, even if a True Emperor comes, he’d show them by slaying.
Sensing the resolute will emanating from Jack Clark, Sara hesitated for a moment, but ultimately just gave a bitter smile, saying nothing.
Approaching the throne, Sara reached out to take the Eight Desolations Halberd.
Boom!
The moment she grasped the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, the ground under Sara suddenly sank, the hardened Divine temple ‘rock’ cracking open with fissures.
“So heavy, such Overbearing strength!” Sara exclaimed in shock.
It felt as though what she held was not a halberd, but a Great Thousand World filled with pure destructive power, also like a peerless blade that could Open Heaven and Earth and tear through Chaos.
Sharply unparalleled, destructively peerless.
Yet as an entity whose cultivation was infinitely close to the Pinnacle of True Spirit, the Eight Desolations World-Destroying Halberd still couldn’t suppress Sara. Golden sequence chains emerged around her arms.
Grasping the Eight Desolations World-Destroying Halberd, Sara nodded slightly towards Jack Clark, then tore through the black mist sea into the Space-Time Chaos, disappearing among those floating black fragments.
After sending Sara back, Jack Clark looked down at the figure clad in a blue Daoist robe below: “Recording Divine General, how much farther is it to that cluster of worlds?”
The Ancient Divine General respectfully replied: “Reporting to City Lord, according to the path, it will take about half a day more of flying to get there.”
Half a day, Jack Clark nodded slightly.
The next half day swiftly passed, and the Heavenly Dome Temple stopped in a region shrouded in murky airflows.
Before them, space twisted, layers upon layers of space, each layer being an independent small world. Some worlds had the complete ecologies of mountains and rivers while others were empty, filled only with darkness spreading.
Beneath the King’s Platform, the Divine General named Recording respectfully said: “City Lord, the sea we previously discovered is within this cluster of worlds.”
“Here, the Chaos Rules are chaotic, and space and time are interwoven, with thousands of World Fragments scattered around, forming various small worlds.”
“Furthermore, under the influence of some force, these worlds continuously rotate without any pattern.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1808: 668: The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure 'Bell'_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1808: Chapter 668: The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure ‘Bell’_3
“This is not your fault.”
Jack Clark looked forward, his eyes revealing golden vertical pupils as his terrifying visionary powers pierced through layers of space in an instant, sweeping over a dozen worlds.
Shattered Void, dim underground, scorching inner Earth magma, desolate lands drifting with black dust…
Jack Clark withdrew his gaze and turned towards the strong men below, one-third of them direct subordinates of the Imperial City, the rest were cultivators from the Six Great Divine Domains.
Jack Clark slowly said, “There is a force interfering with my vision here, so we can only go in one by one to search.”
“Next, everyone holding the Lord’s Command, enter those worlds separately. The moment you find the ocean, crush the Command immediately to notify me.”
“The first person to find the ocean will have priority in selecting five of the accompanying Heaven and Earth Treasures harvested this time.”
Since he prepared to make a Full-Force Strike, Jack Clark naturally intended to devour all the emerging Chaotic Supreme Treasures, including the Heaven and Earth Treasures nurtured by the same world.
He won’t stop until the blood flows into rivers.
“We shall strictly follow the City Lord’s Decree,” all the strong men below bowed respectfully, their expression invigorated.
They were naturally interested in the Chaotic Divine Objects, but at the same time, these strong men knew full well that the Chaotic Level treasures were not something they could touch without risking death.
Hum!
The Void trembled as streaks of golden-white lightning leaped on the King’s Platform, gathering and solidifying into three hundred and twenty-seven golden tokens engraved with lightning patterns.
Each Command contained Jack Clark’s aura of Supreme Rule, providing enough protection for these cultivators to cross the Space-Time Chaos between worlds.
Boom Boom Boom!!
These strong men, the weakest among them at Titan Level, flew out of the Heavenly Dome Temple and burst into the murky airflow in the blink of an eye, charging into a twisted grey projection.
After everyone left, Jack Clark turned his head towards the depths of Space-Time Chaos, speaking faintly.
“Clive Dale, you have followed me for so long. Now that we have arrived at the location of the Divine Object anomaly, aren’t you planning to show yourself?”
In that place, specks of blue starlight twinkled, looking like a member of the Star Ring Divine Clan with a youthful appearance and a smiling face emerged, gazing at Jack Clark.
“Compared to the so-called Chaotic Divine Objects, Clive is more interested in you, the Divine Martial City Master,” he said, revealing intense Battle Intent in his eyes.
Because of the Heavenly Dome Temple’s shielding, this member of the Star Ring Divine Clan didn’t overhear the conversation between Jack Clark and the others.
Thus, he didn’t know that the Divine Object that emerged this time was a Chaotic Supreme Treasure, not the Top-tier treasure everyone anticipated.
“Are you challenging me?” Jack Clark’s eyes slightly narrowed.
“Yes.”
Clive Dale, surrounded by frenzied Battle Intent, locked his eyes firmly on Jack Clark: “I am very eager to know how big the gap is between a top-tier civilization’s strong men and those of a Peak Civilization under the same realm conditions.”
Jack Clark spoke with a touch of surprise, “Clive Dale, you’ve managed to see through the realm I’ve hidden.”
After the breakthrough to True Spirit and advancement to a top-tier Divine Power, the Hidden Deity Heavenly Eye’s ability to conceal became stronger, capable of altering and covering one’s true name. After restraint of his aura, even Nuriel, halfway to Primordial, was unable to detect Jack Clark’s true realm.
Even when they clashed with their Full-Force Strike.
But unexpectedly, this mid-period True Spirit member of the Star Ring Divine Clan could see through his realm, no wonder he had shown such strong Battle Intent at the time.
In the eyes of this member of the Star Ring Divine Clan, everyone was a True Spirit Realm powerhouse; strength and weakness could only be discerned after a battle.
Even though Jack Clark had an aura comparable to half-step Primordial, and his combat power was comparable to the Primordial Stars, what of it? The Star Ring Divine Clan were born ‘gods’.
Since entering the Ancient Battlefield, he had been peerless within the same rank.
Whether his opponents were strong men of top-tier civilizations or Peak Race powerhouses, all were suppressed, which built an immense self-confidence in Clive Dale.
The young man surrounded by starlight slowly said, “The reason I can see through the Divine Martial City Master’s realm is because of the power I naturally wield, the Star Rhythm.”
“It is a power that exists independently of Rule, and with the guidance of the stars, nothing in the world can hide in front of me.”
“I was very shocked at the time. The City Lord of Chaos Emperor City, who contends with the Primordial powerhouses of peak civilizations, is actually only at the mid-period of True Spirit realm.”
“So I am very eager to see who is stronger or weaker between the Star Ring Divine Clan and the peak civilization’s Human Race below the Primordial, under the same Boundary.”
Jack Clark slowly nodded, “I see, it turns out the world is never absolute, it seems I need to be even more cautious in my future actions.”
“Please enlighten me.”
Boom! Without waiting for Jack Clark’s consent, Clive Dale burst into resplendent blue starlight, forming inner and outer nine layers of blue-white Star Rings.
The outermost and largest Star Ring had a diameter reaching a million kilometers, surrounded by luminous celestial bodies in the depths, majestic and overwhelmingly vast.
“Star God’s Wrath.” Instantly, Space-Time quivered, accompanied by a roar that seemed to rage from the heavens.
In the Star Ring that concealed the world, a giant blue-white finger slowly reached out, and the moment it appeared, the supreme aura it contained shattered several nearby small worlds.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The heavens collapsed and the Earth cracked, the Destructive Impact shattered worlds, annihilating everything.
But when the black tide of a Mountains and Seas shaking Tsunami approached the Heavenly Dome Temple, it was like colliding with a barrier formed by a layer of black mist, emitting a deafening roar.
Unlike Jack Clark and their use of Rule to suppress Heavenly Earth Rules and the surrounding Space-Time of their enemies when they strike, the power of the Star Ring Divine Clan didn’t involve Rules or decrees.
Therefore, they couldn’t solidify and create the phenomenon of time halting within the attack range.

chapters.title: Chapter 1809: 668 The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure 'Bell'_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 1809: Chapter 668 The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure ‘Bell’_4
But the nature of their strength is incomparably overbearing and ferocious, and the substantial energy is hundreds to thousands of times greater than that of their peers, endless like the boundless ocean.
In Jack Clark’s eyes, what ‘fell’ from the sky was not a finger but an entire Star System smashing towards him.
Its might was comparable to half a step into the Primordial.
At the mid stage of True Spirit realm, his combat power is actually comparable to half a step into Primordial. Such an astonishing span of combat power is the strongest talent Jack Clark has seen so far, aside from himself.
“No wonder, daring to challenge this City Lord, your strength has indeed qualified you to be taken seriously by me.”
The low and dignified voice resonated through Heaven and Earth. Jack Clark ‘slowly’ rose from his throne.
Instantly, the entire Heavenly Dome Temple trembled, the atmosphere-contained supporting function Burst, forming endless purple qi and rosy clouds behind Jack Clark.
Under the support of purple qi and rosy clouds that stretched for billions of kilometers, lightning that manifested supreme rules entwined around him, and Jack Clark, standing on the King’s Platform, resembled an unparalleled strong man descending from the Primordial Wilderness.
Boom! In the midst of the vast purple qi and rosy clouds, a transparent fist mark soared into the sky, unleashing a Terrifying Aura that made Heaven and Earth tremble.
Under that extremely overbearing strength, Heaven and Earth solidified in an instant, and then everything silently shattered into oblivion under the transparent fist mark.
Whether it was the Destructive Impact caused by the shattering of this layer of the world or the ‘Star System’ that seemed to smash across the universe, they were all blasted away by Jack Clark’s punch.
Boom!
Chaos oscillated, with blue and white starlight exploding, forming a ring-shaped shockwave sweeping across billions of kilometers. The powerful impact caused tides in the Space-Time Chaos, shattering World Fragments piece by piece.
Overbearing, invincible.
This is the power Jack Clark can wield after a breakthrough, with the Rule of Power at its core integrated with the Primordial Genesis and Terminal Emperor Dragon – a thread of Chaos, a thread of destructive supreme rule.
Fist suppressing the starry sky, strength breaking all laws.
Thud thud thud!!
The Star Rings surrounding Clive Dale vibrated, and the three outermost Star Rings shattered under the rebound force of Jack Clark’s punch, with his aura also trembling under that pure power.
Spurt!
Clive Dale, enveloped in starlight, spat out a mouthful of blue-gold blood, with his long hair and sleeves dancing wildly, his eyes revealing shock as he looked at Jack Clark.
He, he wasn’t even able to take a single punch from that Human Race City Lord, even though their realms were both merely at the mid-stage of True Spirit.
Or could it be that among the Peak Civilizations, the Human Race is distinct, possessing a terror-inducing strength that’s not on the same level at all?
I refuse to believe it.
Clive Dale let out a long howl, his Battle Intent even more intense, “Divine Martial City Master, I ask for another lesson, to take on my Full-Force Strike.”
Only to see a black star emerge and shatter at the center of Clive Dale’s forehead.
Boom!
At the moment when that black star emblem shattered, endless star Power Explosion occurred, Clive Dale’s aura soared dozens of times, stepping into the late stage of True Spirit.
An on-the-spot breakthrough? No, Clive Dale’s true cultivation level was actually the late stage of True Spirit. Jack Clark’s gaze was calm.
A shattered star behind Clive Dale formed a black ‘Hollow’ with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, at the center of which was an object with a diameter of ten kilometers, radiating blazing purple-white light.
At the very moment that object of purple-white color appeared, a terrifying gravity that could tear apart rules burst forth, shaking dozens of layers of the world in this region.
Boom boom boom!!
An invisible gravitational force tore apart Space-Time, causing everything to collapse, forming a Black Hole gravitational vortex that covered billions of kilometers.
At the edge of the distant world cluster, five small worlds were directly engulfed by the Black Hole’s gravitational pull, torn apart, forming long cracks ranging from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of kilometers in the Firmament.
Inside, mountain ranges collapsed, and countless materials and energies were lifted into the sky under the force of gravity, being torn apart by the gravity along with the shattering of their worlds.
Jack Clark, who was at the center of the gravitational force, sank slightly, with the ground of the Heavenly Dome Temple shaking.
Even the rolling black fog around the Heavenly Dome Temple began to move outward, slowly under the pull of that extreme gravity, like a dark, curving tentacle.
“To actually refine neutron star matter into a weapon!”
Sensing the terrifying density of that white object, the energy it emitted, and the gravitational distortion field, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but be moved.
Because that was a genuine neutron star.
Such celestial bodies have a terrifying density, with one cubic centimeter weighing a billion tons.
At this moment, the neutron star in Clive Dale’s hand reached ten kilometers in diameter, the smallest type among neutron stars, but the mass it contained was still indescribable.
The horrific mass and ‘tiny’ volume resulted in unparalleled gravity.
In a sense, this smaller neutron star matter, in terms of might, was no less than Creation Level Divine Weapons.
Furthermore, with the true cultivation of late-stage True Spirit, one can leap across three minor realms to wield power that transcends levels, no wonder there’s the confidence to challenge Jack Clark, surrounded by the pressure of ‘half a step into Primordial.’
This is the talent of the Star Ring Divine Clan.
At this point, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but envy the talent of this race.
Born amidst starlight, they naturally command planetary celestial bodies and master various powers of the cosmic stars, even refining those terrifying celestial bodies into weapons.
But just this much power is not enough to challenge him.
Boom!
Purple light trembled, and under another function of the Heavenly Dome Temple, ‘Aura and Projection a Hundredfold Amplification,’ a colossal Demon God Illusion slowly emerged.
Clad in the Imperial Robe, with three faces and ten arms, wearing the black twenty-four All-Heaven Emperor Crown on his head, and with a golden and purple-black inner and outer pair of Divine Wheels slowly rotating behind him, one positive and one negative.

chapters.title: Chapter 1810: 668: The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure 'Bell'_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 1810: Chapter 668: The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure ‘Bell’_5
Purple qi enveloped three hundred million kilometers, with the Divine Wheel’s light sparkling; Jack Clark stood majestically upon a transparent river, upheld in unmatched dignity and sanctity.
Behind the Demon God Illusion as tall as billions of meters, an arm moved, ejecting golden flames from the hand holding a golden-white sun, transforming into a Light sphere with a diameter of three million kilometers.
This was a fireball condensed purely from the ‘fire’ Origin, nearly indistinguishable from a real Star under the envelopment of the Supreme Rule, aside from lacking ‘material’ substance.
The True Star descends.
Furthermore, surrounding this Star were golden-white and purple-gray Supreme Rules in the form of lightning, whose scorching Destructive Aura shook Space-Time, moving the Heavens.
Boom!
Emitting endless light and heat, like a true Star, the Daylight Star appeared instantly, and Clive Dale’s manifested Neutron Star burst forth with an even greater gravitational pull.
Under the terrifying gravitational pull akin to a Black Hole, the surface of the searing Star distorted; countless flame tongues stretching millions of meters followed the gravitational vortex, incessantly Devoured by the dazzling Neutron Star.
In the blink of an eye, the Neutron Star transformed into a golden-white Light sphere, its radiance almost lighting up the surrounding Space-Time, plunging the entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area into darkness.
Such mighty power stirred the souls of many strong men, making them look instinctively in this direction.
In the eyes of those strong men of different races, the entire world and the Forbidden Area, even the roaring Space-Time, were shrouded in darkness, save for the exceptionally brilliant golden-white speck of light.
In the Starry Universe, Black Holes are the nemesis of all celestial bodies.
A moving Black Hole will shred and Devour everything in its path, including Stars, continually growing, forming even larger and more terrifying Black Holes.
And this time was no exception.
The World-Destroying Great Sun, manifested by the Demon God True Seal, was suppressed by the Neutron Star Black Hole, with its power being continuously torn apart and Devoured.
Yet soon, Clive Dale’s expression, which manifested the Neutron Star Black Hole, drastically changed as the power ‘within’ grew wilder and uncontrollable.
Boom!
The Neutron Star trembled, golden energy columns erupted from the top and bottom, a formidable power piercing through the world, ravaging and Destroying over a dozen small worlds that had been torn by gravity.
This was the ‘Daylight Star’ that had absorbed too much energy, unable to completely compress and Devour, resulting in an anomaly of energy Burst.
At this moment, the entire golden-white Star was almost torn apart, turning into an endless fiery sea that filled the entire Neutron Star Black Hole, including its gravitational range spanning billions of kilometers.
Under the infinite ‘Star’ energy supply, the central Neutron Star within the Black Hole shone even more brilliantly, nearly becoming pure light.
Boom, boom, boom!! The interior of the Neutron Star emitted unstable roars, cracks appeared on the surface, releasing even brighter light.
Just then, the flame engulfing the Black Hole’s gravity range suddenly contracted.
Boom! The cosmos thundered, Chaos shattered.
The Neutron Star, reaching its limit, exploded, infinite energy erupting from the center of the Black Hole, shaking the Heavens, the terrifying force unveiling the river of time.
The powerful surge made the whole Heaven Pool Forbidden Area quiver.
Countless unstable World Fragments shattered, the Space-Time Chaos within the Forbidden Area triggered a Destructive Tsunami, drowning everything amid the despair of many different races.
At the moment they were submerged, those Mythical-level and Titan Level different races thought only of regret.
If they had known the emergence of the Divine Object would be so perilous, they would not have come.
Before even entering the Forbidden Area, fallen were hundreds of strong men in the aftermath of the battle between the Divine Martial City Master and the Ancient Gloomy Heaven God, causing alarm among those different races.
Now having just entered the Forbidden Area, they encountered strong men clashing once again, with all Mythical-level different races obliterated under the tide of Destructive Space-Time, and the Titan Levels met with heavy losses.
Too tragic!!
Amidst the wildly rupturing chaos of Space-Time, Clive Dale stood firm with tattered clothes and disheveled hair, his aura weak and starlight dimmed.
Under Jack Clark’s punches and seals, this Star Ring Divine Clan strong man with talent enough to barely cross into the Primordial Stars suffered heavy injury.
This was still under the restraint of Jack Clark, who didn’t continue to strike.
Far from harboring resentment, Clive Dale even looked at Jack Clark with fervent eyes: “Is this the power of Divine Martial City Master, truly strong, Clive concedes.”
With the Demon God Illusion standing behind, Jack Clark on the King’s Platform slowly spoke: “To withstand two punches from this City Master, Mr. Clive’s strength is also formidable.”
Although Jack Clark’s just previous engagement was merely casual moves, not even entering the True Demon God Body state.
Still, it cannot be denied that this Star Ring Divine Clan strong man’s talent is indeed astounding; with that talent, he could definitely break through to the Primordial, and by then his power will become even more fearsome.
“How about it, do you wish to challenge further?” asked Jack Clark indifferently.
Clive Dale suppressed the turbulent starlight within and shook his head slightly: “I am utterly convinced of Divine Martial City Master’s strength, and to challenge further would be to disgrace myself.”
“Moreover, I claimed to challenge within the same realm, yet in the end couldn’t help but shatter stars, breaking the Seal to restore my Late Stage of True Spirit status, for which I truly feel ashamed.”
Clive Dale bowed deeply to Jack Clark, solemn in his demeanor: “Today I thank Divine Martial City Master for showing mercy and also for the instruction.”
“This battle has brought me great insights, especially realizing that my past belief in sealing my cultivation, suppressing my realm to accumulate a more solid foundation, was a misguided approach.”
Especially obtaining enlightenment, with such talent, truly worthy of an Innate Demon God in the vast Starry Universe. Jack Clark inwardly commended.
As Jack Clark became even more interested in this race, Clive Dale bowed again: “Divine Martial City Master, I’m ready to find a place for Closed-door Cultivation, to digest these gains, and not to participate in this battle for the Divine Object anymore.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1811: 668: The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure 'Bell'_6
chapters.content:
Chapter 1811: Chapter 668: The Second Lifeline Talent, Chaotic Supreme Treasure ‘Bell’_6
“Wait for me to come out of retreat, then I will visit the City Lord of the Chaos Emperor City and offer my thanks.”
Jack Clark paused slightly: “…Your Highness Clive Dale, you are too courteous, thanks and gifts are unnecessary. Your gain is a result of your exceptional talent and has nothing to do with this City Lord.”
“My Star Ring Divine Clan is clear about debts of gratitude and grievances, please, City Lord, do not refuse.”
Having said that, Clive Dale took a deep look at Jack Clark, turned into a sky full of starlight, and dispersed.
Watching the blue starlight fade away, Jack Clark’s gaze flickered but he did not stop it.
The strength of this Star Ring Divine Clan is formidable; with his current strength, defeating them would be easy, but to slay them would at least require entering the True Demon God Body form, or even opening several Heavenly Gates.
Before the Chaotic Supreme Treasure is born, there’s no need to expose his strength for a top-tier civilization of different races.
Moreover, he was indeed very interested in this otherworldly civilization because, like Blue Star, it originated from a ‘cosmic sky’ structure.
Of course, if the other party continues to bother him without knowing better, Jack Clark wouldn’t mind directly suppressing them to deter all around.
Right at this moment, Jack Clark turned his head towards the depths of the Space-Time Chaos, where a thousand-meter-tall giant stood, carrying a huge Totem Pillar on his shoulder.
It was the ‘genius’ of the Pati Totem Clan named Simonas, at the Pinnacle of True Spirit, a genius who has cultivated for twenty thousand years.
Jack Clark said indifferently, “What, do you also wish to challenge this City Lord?”
The giant carrying the Totem Pillar hurriedly shook his head: “Divine Martial City Master, please don’t misunderstand, I’m just passing by. I am in awe of your battle with the Star Ring Divine Clan and have no other intentions.”
“I will leave at once, immediately withdrawing from the search range of the Human Race, no, pulling out of this emergence of the Chaotic Divine Object.”
As he said this, the Totem Giant, whose combat power was comparable to the Pinnacle of True Spirit, decisively turned around, and with a rumbling sound, quickly disappeared into the Space-Time Chaos.
It went to notify its kin: leave, one cannot remain here.
This human is too terrifying; with him here, nobody has any hope of seizing the Chaotic Divine Object this time, nor even those accompanying Heaven and Earth Treasures.
With the frightening power he’s shown, just the tip of the iceberg, if he becomes fully aggressive, except for the peers among the other three peak civilizations, nobody can withstand even a few moves.
“These top-tier civilization races, not to be underestimated,” muttered Jack Clark, eyes narrowing slightly.
From this brief encounter, Jack Clark felt that the ‘power inheritances’ these top-tier civilizations of different races possess are indeed very strong, and each one is cautious, shrewd, and knows the ways of the world.
Such people are even more difficult to deal with.
Standing amidst the Chaotic Air Waves, almost an hour later, Jack Clark suddenly looked toward the World Clusters.
In his perception, one of the decrees he had formed shattered.
Boom!
Using that decree power as coordinates, Jack Clark moved with a thought, commanding the Heavenly Dome Temple to crush through the chaos, breaking through layers of fragile world Boundary Walls.
Raging through his path, Jack Clark quickly delved deep into the World Clusters, charging into a murky world hidden in the turbulent currents.
…
The boundless sky of a world with clear, azure sea water suddenly shattered, creating a huge hollow spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
In the heart of the hollow, an island with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers descended from the sky, surrounded by black mist spreading like tides, enveloping the majestic Divine temple above it.
“Greetings, City Lord.”
Thirteen beings exuding Heavenly King Level auras, along with two ancient beings at the Legendary Realm, stood in the air and saluted respectfully towards the descending temple.
“No need for such formalities.”
Sitting high on the throne, Jack Clark looked down slightly towards the bottom, where a string of islands scattered like pearls on the sea surface, with a huge vortex rotating at the center of the islands.
However, at the center of the vortex was the murky world.
It’s just that the Divine Object was hidden, and without the eruption of power shaking space-time to form anomalies, Jack Clark was unable to see where that Chaotic Supreme Treasure was.
As for forcibly tearing apart the world to enter, this idea was just contemplated by Jack Clark before he gave it up.
