The Chaotic Supreme Treasure had not yet matured; forcibly tearing the world apart would only cause the world nurturing the treasure to collapse prematurely, leaving the treasure’s rules incomplete.
By then, it might fall from the Chaotic level to become just a top-tier treasure, which would be a loss disproportionate to the gains.
And just when Jack Clark found the entrance to the ‘world’ where the treasure was located, in a distant space-time, the towering figure of the Ancient Gloomy Heaven God also stood above the blazing lava ocean.
In front of it, the earth collapsed, magma backfilled, forming a fiery abyss.
And at the end of the abyss was a gray, hazy Chaotic World, into which endless streams of magma flowed, emitting thunderous roars.
Jack Clark withdrew his gaze and looked at the cultivators in the sky: “Notify the others, be ready around this Marine World as the center, this treasure should be born within the next few days.”
“And this place is indeed the birthplace, or rather, an entrance.”
“Yes, City Lord,” they replied.
High upon his throne, Jack Clark glanced once more at the swirling vortex on the sea surface, then his mind sank, and he came to the side of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
At this moment, the body length of the Terminal Emperor Dragon had surged to 2,150,000 meters under the endless supply of the Eternal Air and was still growing at an astonishing speed.
At the same time, a terrifying force was being deliberately suppressed within the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
It was the power of the Lifeline Talent condensed when the Giant Beast was breaking through the Primordial.
Normally, when most Giant Beasts break through Primordial, only one talent is sublimated to the God Transformation Level; then, with this Deification Talent as the core and other talents as auxiliary, they forge even more powerful Lifeline Talents.
However, the Terminal Emperor Dragon has ten Deification Talents, thus presenting a bit of a quandary in its choice.
Too many talents.
Last time it broke through the Pinnacle of True Spirit, it condensed the Lifeline Talent Terminal Force, which is based on Chaos Dominant Body with Vajra Immortal, Deep Red Destruction, Chaotic Force Field, and Undying Forces as auxiliary.
The ultimate destructive power enabled the Terminal Emperor Dragon to suppress the Prossian beast of the second Heavenly Realm at the Primordial Monarch level, even at the peak of True Spirit.
And that Prossian beast, within the Primordial Overlord Level, is considered very strong.
According to the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s estimate, its strength at that time should have already touched the boundary of the Third Heavenly Realm, the Primordial Monarch.
The power of the Terminal Force made the Terminal Emperor Dragon/Jack Clark even more expectant of the second Lifeline Talent.
Jack Clark’s eyes swept over the ten virtual shadows of the ‘Emperor Dragon’ in black, gold, blue, purple, and gold inside the body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, and he pondered slightly.
Eventually, Jack Clark’s gaze settled on the golden Emperor Dragon’s virtual shadow of the projection of the ‘True. Indestructible Vajra’ Talent Rune.
In previous battles with Primordial beings, Jack Clark found that the defense of the Terminal Emperor Dragon was still not strong enough; peerless within the same rank, but attacks from higher realms could still break through its defense.
And the Terminal Force is the ultimate in destruction and annihilation, belonging to the category of strengths that boost attacks.
If the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s second Lifeline Talent also chooses an attack type, the combined boost doesn’t seem to be exaggerated, because there is a limit to the momentary increase in strength.
This is an unbreakable Chaos Rule.
Just like a cultivator at the Legendary Realm cannot rely on various transcendent Divine Powers to explode with billions of times their strength in an instant and hard-hitting Primordial.
And whether two attack-type Lifeline Talents can explode at the same time and form an overlap is still an unknown.
Therefore, it may be wiser to choose Defense, stacking defense to an even more extreme point, just like the Six-legged Salamander chose strength, defense during Evolution.
Since there is no conflict between attack and defense types, they should be able to simultaneously enter a dual Lifeline Talent state at that time.
This is also why Jack Clark chose defense, but this defense is not merely for protection.
Under Jack Clark’s realm of thought,
with True. Indestructible Vajra as the core, ‘True. Undying and Indestructible’ ‘True. Superstar Annihilation’ ‘True. Thunder Magnetic Monarch’ ‘True. Chaos Domain’ ‘True. Eternal Darkness Devouring’ manifested rune projections slowly overlapped.
At the same time, in the body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, strands of multicolored energy, condensed from the Origin at the core of the mythical world, appeared out of nowhere.
Roar! A majestic and ferocious roar shook space-time.
The condensation of the second Lifeline Talent also made Jack Clark’s aura stronger by a fraction in the far-distant space-time, and in the instant Jack Clark ‘thought’ about what Lifeline Talent to condense, three days had already passed.
Below, on the sea surface, the originally turbid vortex now radiated lights of various colors.
At the same time, an oppressive aura that could suppress all the heavens and ancient times pervaded, an intangible fluctuation of power that shook space-time, shaking the entire world madly.
The Chaotic Supreme Treasure is about to be born.

chapters.title: Chapter 1812: 669: 'Humans' from Billions of Years Ago, Great War Erupts
chapters.content:
Chapter 1812: Chapter 669: ‘Humans’ from Billions of Years Ago, Great War Erupts
On the sea surface, the originally calm vortex suddenly stirred up alarming waves.
The grey pathway connected to the Chaotic Supreme Treasure shone with radiant multicolored light, permeating through space-time, and invisibly, a massive and immense force spread out, shaking the entire Marine World.
“The Supreme Treasure is about to emerge!”
Above the seas, Human Experts standing from all directions were all exhilarated, their eyes filled with excitement.
Above these strong men, in the towering purple-black Divine Temple, Jack Clark, who exuded an even more terrifying aura, also stood up, his gaze focused on the increasingly trembling pathway below.
The emergence of this Chaotic Supreme Treasure would likely cause a great disturbance.
Jack Clark solemnly said: “Subjects of the Imperial City, heed my command, activate the Heaven and Earth Trap formation, and jointly seal the space-time around the pathway.”
“Yes.”
Six Ancient Powerhouses directly under the Imperial City, along with over thirty Heavenly King Level powerhouses promptly responded, with each of their hands wielding a hundred-meter-long golden and black banner.
The strong men dispersed around the vortex tens of thousands of kilometers, the power of Law and Rule pouring into the golden Heaven and black Earth banners, causing the banners to swell abruptly.
Boom, boom, boom!!
One flagstaff after another stood deep in the Void, shooting out strands of golden Rule silk threads navigating Heaven and Earth, merging with the black light curtain covering the sea surface, sealing the heavens and locking the earth.
Meanwhile, in other worlds around, other cultivators also watched the vortex pathway through the Heavenly Eye and Law Vision across boundaries, waiting for the world harboring the treasure to shatter.
In another dimension, a world of roiling magma, those towering hundreds to thousands of meters high, seemingly forged from obsidian, were also visibly excited, looking towards the depths of the Fire Abyss.
A Late Stage True Spirit member of the Gloomy Heaven Clan laughed loudly, his voice thundering: “Hahaha… we indeed gambled correctly, this is the birthplace of the Supreme Treasure.”
Nuriel, who had exchanged blows with Jack Clark, also wore a smile, his voice somber: “It seems destiny favors the War God Race, this time the emerging treasure and accompanying resources will be ours.”
With three emerging points, as reported by the dispatched scouts distant from each other, even a step away Primordial Powerhouse moving at full strength would take two Star Moments (one hour).
By the time they arrive, the Supreme Treasure would have already been secured by them.
Unfortunately, the Golden Race’s and Human Race’s surrounding worlds are well-guarded, and subordinates lurking there failed to gather more accurate information.
Just as this towering and ferocious giant’s gaze flickered, the Fire Abyss below, spewing endless magma, shook, subsequently erupting with a terrifying force.
Simultaneously, on Jack Clark’s side, the grey pathway also exploded directly, through the shattered Boundary Wall, one could see a grey hazy orb splitting into pieces.
Like a Chaotic Egg.
Boom!
The ocean covering tens of thousands of kilometers exploded, the Boundary Wall shattered, an apocalyptic tsunami formed by trillions of sea water mixed with Destructive Impact inundated everything.
The horrifying explosive force pierced through space-time, and roiling muddy Chaotic airwaves erupted.
In that boundless sweep of Chaotic airflow, brilliant streaks wrapped in the aura of Laws and Rules scattered in all directions.
“Heaven and Earth Trap, time reversal, reserve it for me.”
The Ancient Powerhouse presiding over the formation roared, his hands forming seals, fiercely slamming into the upright golden banners in front of him, instantly causing the Heaven and Earth Trap covering this space-time to reappear.
The net of interwoven golden Rule light, like an invisible barrier, allowed those murky airwaves to pass through, shaken continuously by the overwhelming force.
And when each Divine Object wrapped in the radiance of Laws hit the light net, it was immediately entangled like spider silk, with densely packed rune symbols sealing it, revealing the objects inside.
There were meter-high, root-entwined Blood-Colored Orchids like dragon claws, and beads surrounded by Ice Crystals with an indistinct Ice and Snow World inside…
As these Human Experts made their moves, standing in the Space-Time Chaos to capture those Divine Objects, Jack Clark did not rush to act.
Standing in front of the purple-black throne, Jack Clark’s eyes sparkled with golden-white lightning, his fearsome gaze piercing through Chaos and space-time, focused on the shattered world opposite.
There, the Gloomy Heaven War God Nuriel also looked solemnly at this side.
In Nuriel’s surrounding area, ferocious Chaotic airflow roared, the tsunamis were towering, inside them, numerous Gloomy Heaven strong men chased after the scattered Divine Objects on that side.
Both did not expect, the world harboring the Supreme Treasure on their opposite sides both had True Spirit Supreme Experts waiting.
Nuriel slowly spoke, his voice deep penetrating the Chaos: “It seems, between us today, a battle of life and death must ensue to determine the ownership of this Supreme Treasure.”
Saying so, Nuriel’s gaze heatedly focused on the explosive center of the Chaotic World.
There stood a thousand-meter-high, anciently styled Bronze Great Bell, its body engraved with birds, fish, insects, and rootless starscapes, profoundly mysterious.
An invisible aura spread down, the area around the Bronze Great Bell turning turbulent, containing power capable of crushing Ancient God King might, the Chaotic airflow slowly calmed down.
From afar, it looked like a murky yet calm mirror’s surface.
Suppressing the heavens and the Chaos, this was a Chaotic Supreme Treasure with suppressing power! Just one glance, and Nuriel discerned the level of the Bronze Great Bell.
But before it and Jack Clark could act, the Bronze Great Bell suddenly quivered slightly.
Dong! A bell sound containing immense suppression echoed across the entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, the invisible sound waves piercing through the Forbidden Area, reverberating through the endless starry space of this layer of the Chaos Cosmos.
Instantly, countless individuals were all shocked, turning their heads towards the cosmic starry sky.
These people included the strong men of the Chaos Emperor City and surrounding defending cities, as well as other peak civilization different races, people from other powerful civilizations, all trembling.
Someone trembled: “This, this pressure, is the phenomenon of a Chaos Level Supreme Treasure’s emergence!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1813: 669: The 'People' from a Billion Years Ago, Great War Bursts Out_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1813: Chapter 669: The ‘People’ from a Billion Years Ago, Great War Bursts Out_2
Meanwhile in another space-time within the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, Floralette of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe also suddenly turned around, looking towards the direction of the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan with anger flashing in her eyes.
“This is not the treasure emergence point.”
“This oppressive aura, it’s a Chaotic Supreme Treasure, indeed a Chaotic Supreme Treasure.”
“It’s too late now, I’ll go first, you guys form the battle array and follow immediately.” Amidst a low growl, Floralette burst into a golden radiance, transforming into a ten thousand kilometers tall Golden Dragon Man figure.
An aura as powerful as that of the Primordial Stars vibrates space-time, threateningly showing to the closest Nuriel, revealing an unyielding determination to obtain the Chaotic Supreme Treasure.
At this moment, not just Floralette from the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, but other civilization powerhouses also displayed their own Divine Powers and racial talents, flying towards the nearest Human Race or Gloomy Heaven War God Clan.
In their perception, the direction where the Chaotic Supreme Treasure has emerged is where the Human Race/Gloomy Heaven Clan is located.
As countless strong men hurriedly flew towards the treasure emergence point, some wise individuals remained unmoved.
Holding a Totem Pillar and radiating a mid-stage True Spirit aura, Simonas stepped out of the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area pathway, followed by all his tribe members he had gathered over these two days.
Feeling the aura of the Chaotic Supreme Treasure’s emergence, one of the ancient peak Totem Giants turned back, his expression shaken and excited: “Lord Simonas, it’s the Chaotic Supreme Treasure!”
“The Chaotic Supreme Treasure.”
Other Totem Giants felt tempted too, some unable to resist turning back to return to the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area.
But Simonas’s face changed drastically, his voice filled with authority as he roared across the starry sky: “Forget what treasure, leave, leave now.”
“But…” One Totem Giant at the initial stage of True Spirit was reluctant.
Simonas suddenly turned back, his eyes flashing with a terrifying killing intent: “Didn’t you hear my order, leave this place immediately.”
“With the emergence of the Chaotic Supreme Treasure, a horrifying war will soon erupt inside.”
“We don’t even have Primordial Level strength, how can we contend with the four peak civilizations for it, going back now is suicide, do you understand?”
Simonas’s words shook the Totem Giants to their core, pulling them from their greed for the Chaotic Supreme Treasure, fear rising in their hearts.
Indeed, if it were just a top-tier Supreme Treasure, it might be fine, who obtains it depends on fortune.
Even if they didn’t obtain the top-tier Supreme Treasure, those peak civilization guardians would keep their dignity, and wouldn’t chase top-level civilization powerhouses over a Pseudo-Creation Level Divine Object.
Heaven and Earth Treasures go to those with virtue, not obtaining it just means lacking destiny.
And between racial civilizations, there are diplomatic relationships, top-level civilizations belong to a strong force too, peak civilization powerhouses need to consider their image when unreasonably pursuing others.
But the Chaotic Supreme Treasure is different, it is an object that can enhance the battle strength of Primordial Powerhouses.
Moreover, these Chaotic Supreme Treasures contain a complete Chaotic Rule, if one can comprehend it, it’s enough to allow a Primordial Level powerhouse to advance further.
Therefore, it’s obvious to anyone thinking with their backside, a world-destroying war is about to erupt within the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area.
“Ladies and gentlemen, pardon the disturbance.”
Simonas briefly grinned awkwardly at Sara Williams standing not far from the entrance, as well at her companions like Brave and other powerhouses, quickly leading his tribe away.
As he turned to leave, Simonas’s gaze swept over the Black Armored Imperial Guards behind Sara Williams and her companions, his eyes involuntarily twitching.
The assembled Imperial Guards, reaching a million in number and stationed outside the entrance in the starry sky, were assembled in formation like a Dark Giant Beast lurking in space, radiating a cold killing aura.
As a ‘monster’ from the top-tier civilization, Simonas naturally knew about the Human Race’s Black Armored Imperial Guards.
They are a terrifying army capable of slaughtering gods, confronting half-step Primordials, and if overseen by a peak civilization guardian or even a late-stage True Spirit or peak powerhouse commanding the great formation, they could even challenge a civilization guardian.
The Human Race, well prepared. Simonas was internally shocked.
Seeing the surrounding rocks spontaneously generating, like being encircled by the Earth and flying away, Brave’s eyes emitted a cold light: “Lord Williams, should we keep them?”
Sara Williams shook her head: “No need, the emergence of the Chaotic Supreme Treasure is too significant, it can’t be concealed, keeping them makes no big difference.”
“Our task is to prevent any non-Human Race powerhouses from leaving the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area until Brother Clark returns or the ownership of the Chaotic Supreme Treasure is determined.”
As Sara Williams reached her hand into the Void, a transparent sword formed of feathers slowly was drawn out, an Invisible Power filling the universe, making this stretch of cosmic space a bit more void.
In the twisted space, ten suns emitting scorching radiance emerged, their light piercingly sharp causing pain to the onlookers.
Meanwhile, in a starry sky far from the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, a 300,000-meter-long Starry Sky Dragon suddenly turned back: “Arthas, it’s the Chaotic Supreme Treasure.”
Upon the head of the Starry Sky Dragon, Clive Dale, sitting cross-legged, furrowed his brows: “Don’t call me Arthas, my current name is Clive Dale.”
The Starry Sky Dragon growled softly: “Okay, Clive, aren’t we going back?”
Clive Dale’s gaze was calm as he stated: “No, the owner of the treasure that emerged this time was already determined from the start.”
Another Starry Sky Dragon approached, its blue starry eyes showing hesitation: “You mean, that Human who defeated you?”
“Correct.” Clive Dale nodded.
Clive Dale had once carefully studied Humans, knowing their strength was divided into three stages.
A normal Human form with 60% battle strength, a True Body form with 100% full-strength, and various Secret Skills bursting into extreme states.
Yet that particular Human had strength comparable to the Primordial Stars in his normal state, suppressing him, a scion of the Star Ring Divine Clan with a single strike; one can imagine how powerful his True Body governed by the rules must be.

chapters.title: Chapter 1814: 669: The 'Human' from a Billion Years Ago, the Great War Bursts Forth_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1814: Chapter 669: The ‘Human’ from a Billion Years Ago, the Great War Bursts Forth_3
Although Clive Dale had not clashed with the Guardians of the other three Peak Civilizations, his intuition told him that no one was a match for that human.
Of course, there are no absolutes.
If the Guardians of those three Peak Civilizations joined forces, the Divine Martial City Master, who was only at the mid period of the True Spirit realm, would probably not be able to hold them off and might even be repelled.
But no matter the outcome, they had no right to intervene.
Once the battle for the Divine Object erupts, those outside the four great Peak Civilizations will be wiped out first.
At this moment, the Starry Sky Dragon carrying Clive Dale let out a low growl: “Clive, why are you so interested in the Human Race, and why this time have you remolded your Origin form to take on a human shape?”
“Indeed, this question has always puzzled us.” Another Starry Sky Dragon also expressed its curiosity.
The Origin form is the core of the Star Ring Divine Clan, and the True Body can change at will, but the Origin form is always the shape forged at birth.
And with the Origin form comes corresponding mighty strength.
For example, their birth-formed shape as Starry Sky Dragons not only gave them the strong True Bodies and strength of the dragon species, but also retained the talent of starlight.
Thus, they are even more powerful than the Divine Dragon Sea, who is of the same True Spirit Level yet possesses the Primordial Bloodline.
Similarly, some born in the shape of a sun or a Neutron Star not only possess vast True Bodies, but also inherently inherit the ‘strength’ of stars and Neutron Stars.
Clive Dale’s initial Origin form was that of a Neutron Star.
Or to say, he was a cosmic life formed from a Neutron Star. That Neutron Star was his True Body, born with an ancient level of power, capable of ripping apart and bursting stars.
But a thousand years ago, Clive Dale suddenly severed his realm, carving out his Neutron Star essence to remold his Origin form, which took on the exceedingly ‘weak’ and ordinary human visage.
This move shook the entire Star Ring Divine Clan at the time, and even the supreme Black Hole Monarch turned his attention to it.
But why Clive Dale did this, and why he took on a human name, nobody knew except for the Black Hole Monarch.
Including the two brothers who were born with him.
And this time, Clive Dale showed no intention of answering, merely shaking his head slightly: “Some things cannot be said, or rather, I am unable to speak of them.”
…The eyes of the two Starry Sky Dragons instantly showed shock.
Because being unable to speak and not wanting to speak are vastly different.
What power is it that renders Clive Dale, a True Spirit Level being, ‘unable’ to speak? Could it be that this human contains other dreadful secrets?
While the two Starry Sky Dragons were shaken, Clive Dale’s mind involuntarily conjured up a blurry image.
The starry space was dark and hazy, the entire universe in its endless expansion, with countless materials and energy converging to form nebulae and galaxies in the dawn of the cosmos.
Within the nebulae surrounded by cosmic dust, a semi-energy material radiating purple-white light and strong gravity slowly spun.
At that moment, the whole universe trembled slightly as an immensely towering figure appeared, the colorful river of Destiny roaring beneath his feet, spanning endless Space-Time.
The figure lingered in front of the object emitting purple-white light for a moment, then departed, seemingly in search of something.
Traces of that figure had existed in that part of space for eons, undying through the ages, until one day, it vanished into thin air under the influence of some power.
This vision was a memory that resurfaced in Clive Dale’s mind when he first saw a human over a thousand years ago on the Ancient Battlefield.
The figure that had appeared in their universe eons ago was a human, and although Clive Dale couldn’t remember the person’s specific features, he knew the individual was incomparably powerful.
It was a mere passing encounter before his sentient birth, an impression that was imprinted deep in his memory.
And indescribable.
For instance, when he tried to ask other Star Ring Divine Clan members, which embodied powerful celestial forms, if they had ‘seen’ that human, the memories would be erased by an Invisible Power.
The question would be directly forgotten.
Including telling the Starry Sky Dragons that his remolding of the Origin form was because of that human, that thought too would be erased by the Invisible Power.
This kind of power almost made Clive Dale instinctively shudder.
Powerful, terrifying beyond words, it was a force that transcended the Primordial, it was Eternity itself.
The seemingly ordinary and weak human possessed the eternal potential to wipe out billions of species, far greater potential than their Star Ring Divine Clan.
Because even the strongest among them, the Black Hole Monarch, who had been born three million years ago, had been stuck at the Monarch-level for a hundred thousand years.
This was still the case ten thousand years ago when the Black Hole Monarch entered the Ancient Battlefield and, with the aid of the power systems of various racial civilizations, deduced the reasons behind the Star Ring form.
Before this, as they roamed the Starry Universe, they had no idea about cultivation.
They knew only to instinctively consume cosmic starry energy and slowly grow, with an infuriatingly slow improvement rate.
And the term ‘infuriating’ was even learned from the Human Race… For a moment, Clive Dale’s thoughts drifted as he studied the human knowledge stored in his mind.
This knowledge was obtained through a trade with a human.
In Clive Dale’s view, the most important aspects of a civilization are its script and knowledge, which contain the most core inheritance.
Therefore, he exchanged a Rule Level Divine Object for all the knowledge in that human’s Storage Ring, whether it was Cultivation Methods or other recorded texts.

chapters.title: Chapter 1815: 669: 'Human' from Hundreds of Millions of Years Ago, Great War Erupts_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 1815: Chapter 669: ‘Human’ from Hundreds of Millions of Years Ago, Great War Erupts_4
But many of the books’ contents were rather perplexing.
Such as “Basics of Poetry Rhythms,” “Three Hundred Essential Methods of the Poetry Deity,” “Latest Edition of the New Rhymes from Ancient Times,” “Collection of Three Thousand Poems by the Poetic Immortal Li Xiu,” “The Complete Collection of the Most Beautiful Ancient Poems and Songs”…
Could these things really be the reason for the boundless potential of the Human Race?
…
In the midst of the raging Chaotic Air Waves, a towering Obsidian Giant of tens of thousands of meters slowly drew the slash blade from its back, and in an instant, an incomparably sharp Will Burst forth.
Splat splat!!
The almost Divine Passage infused Blade Intent, formless and pervasive, shattered all the Chaotic Air Waves within tens of millions of kilometers around it, suppressing the tumultuous Space-Time.
“This bell should rightfully be mine.”
Nuriel roared lowly, with Black Flames burning on the obsidian slash blade in his hand, emitting an exceedingly evil and chillingly terrifying Aura that involuntarily shook the entire Chaos.
Boom!
In front of Jack Clark, the Chaos ‘shattered,’ with Black Cracks stretching for hundreds to tens of millions of kilometers appearing, from within which multiple figures of Nuriel simultaneously swung their blades down.
Boom boom boom!!
Thirty-six sharp and peerless Black Blade Lights cut through Space-Time and infinite ‘distance,’ instantly enveloping Jack Clark.
The might of this strike was over ten times stronger than the exchange between the two individuals from before; evidently, Nuriel had not exerted his true strength at that time.
Now, with a strike from across a Boundary, its sharp edge shattered Space-Time and obliterated Chaos, spreading over several hundred million kilometers.
And just as Nuriel made his move, in the Purple-Black Divine temple where Space-Time had come to a standstill, Golden-White and Purple-Grey lightning erupted, shattering the frozen Space-Time.
Amidst the endless flashes of lightning, the figure of a Demon God towering at three hundred thousand meters appeared, with three faces and ten arms, a Divine Wheel spinning behind, exerting a pressure comparable to the Primordial Stars.
Jack Clark, wearing an Imperial Crown and with an icy gaze, unfolded eight arms behind him, with his two front arms joined in prayer, carrying a Black Stele towering at ten million meters.
Boom!
The Black Stele, containing Terrifying Power, appeared in an instant, the Invisible Power compressing the Chaotic Air Waves within a three billion kilometer range into a substance, forming an unbreakable suppression domain.
But the Gloomy Heaven Blade Light, merged with Divine Passage Blade Intent, was indestructible, cutting through everything and slashing thirty-six million-kilometer-long cracks within the suppression domain of the Heaven-Piercing Stele, unstoppable like a bamboo splitter.
At that moment, Jack Clark carrying the Heaven-Piercing Stele suddenly swung it.
Boom!
The domain around the Black Stele exploded like shattering space, raising Mountains and Seas shaking Black destructive Air Waves, layered upon each other, the Power was so enormous and profound that it shook the heavens.
With a sweeping blow, all the Black Blade Lights were crushed by the Stele.
The powerful forces entwined on the Heaven-Piercing Stele twisted Space-Time, breaking open everything and intersecting silently with the Obsidian Slash Blade that had been swung from the depths of the Chaos Void.
Boom!
The entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area trembled, with nearby Human Experts and experts from the Gloomy Heaven Clan across the shattered Chaotic World feeling a moment of deafness.
In the center of the violent destruction, a three hundred thousand meter tall Jack Clark carrying the Black Stele, with muscles inflating in his arms, blocked the Obsidian Slash Blade that descended with the might of Opening the Heavens and Earth.
The Black Flames winding around the blade and the dual-colored lightning constantly collided, exploded, and emitted earth-shattering thunderous roars.
Half of its body emerged from a rift in Space-Time, Nuriel, high as a fifty thousand meter tall Dark Giant, gazed coldly at the imposing Demon God below.
Even under the full force of the Gloomy Heaven God-slaying Blade’s Power, the two were still evenly matched.
And at this moment, the weapon in the hands of this human was not Creation Level, but merely a Top World-level ordinary weapon, which had reached the Pseudo-Creation Level with the help of two Supreme Rules.
This realization sparked anger in Nuriel’s eyes.
As he unleashed his full strength, this human was still hiding his true capabilities.
But just as the two were about to make another move, the Bronze Great Bell that stood at the heart of Chaos suddenly vibrated, and the surrounding Chaos abruptly began to appear illusory.
In the darkness of another dimension, black smoke silently spread like a python slithering and coiling towards the Chaotic Supreme Treasure.
“Courting death.” Nuriel, who confronted Jack Clark, roared as a pair of narrow white eyes suddenly opened behind his head, revealing a terrifying murderous Power Explosion.
At the same time, Nuriel’s armpit tore open, and in an instant, a pair of huge arms grew out.
The arms reached into the Void, once again grasping a pitch-black slash blade, with Black Flames burning on it, exuding the terrifying suppression of Creation Level Divine Weapons.
It was another Gloomy Heaven War God Blade indeed.
Or perhaps the Gloomy Heaven War God Blade itself was a pair.
Boom! The blade light flowed like water, drowning Space-Time.
Under the incredibly sharp blade’s edge, the Bronze Great Bell was pulled into another dimensional Dark World and shattered in an instant, and the black python was also annihilated.
Suddenly, a muffled groan of agony arose from the depths of the Dark Void, faintly revealing a figure covered in a gray tattered robe.
It was unmistakably a member of the Estrella Clan from one of the top civilizations.
Seizing the moment Jack Clark and Nuriel clashed, this Estrella being, emitting a strange Aura, sought to benefit like a fisherman watching two others fight.
But just as the blade intended to slash through the ‘strength’ of the Estrella Clan, the sharp and Overbearing black blade light abruptly shifted, turning into an Invisible gentle hand grasping towards the Bronze Great Bell.
“Have you all forgotten about me?”
The low and indifferent voice vibrated through the Chaos, as the purple-black Thunder Spear in Jack Clark’s hand behind him shone brightly, transforming into a light beam extending millions of kilometers, piercing through Space-Time.
Bang! Under the lightning, the black blade light instantly shattered.
At the same time, behind Jack Clark, the World-Destroying Great Sun, the Death Grindstone, and the Soul Chains shone brightly, with the Golden-White Great Sun smashing downwards to the left.
Boom!
A supernova explosion under the destructive power, the Heavenly Wind Purple Thunder Clan expert, whose True Body had a third eye on his forehead and who was surrounded by Purple Divine Thunder, shattered.
Simultaneously, the Death Grindstone loomed over the Chaos, slowly rotating, casting a gray aura of death over Heaven and Earth.
The expert, whose entire body was covered in bronze scales and had a single horn on their head like a demon from the infernal Hell, roared. His True Body, towering tens of thousands of meters tall and emitting a scarlet radiance, reached out to the heavens with both arms, trying to block the Death Grindstone.
But under the grinding power of death, which erodes both Vitality and all living beings, the Crimson Single-Horned Tribe expert exuded the stench of decay.
The powerful Divine Rule true form was like an ordinary person struck with an incurable disease, the skin visibly turning ashen white and withered at a pace visible to the naked eye, the life aura gradually weakening.
Meanwhile, the pitch-black Soul Chains vanished into the depths of Space-Time, piercing through a Furious Ape wearing Red Battle Armor, standing at a hundred thousand meters tall, and at the True Spirit Initial Stage.
Just as Jack Clark instantly suppressed three True Spirit Powerhouses from top civilizations, Nuriel also roared furiously.
“Begone.”
Boom!
The black blade light cut through Chaos, its sharp edge splitting dimensions, and a figure holding a dried wooden staff—an ‘old man’—was directly cleaved in two.
This cleaving was not only of the physical body but also of the soul, will, and Origin strength of this Estrella Clan member, all severed.
Whoosh!
In the dark dimension, a pair of withered palms grasped the Estrella being, pulling it into the depths of the dimension. At the same time, a strange and hoarse voice sounded.
“This blade strike, our clan will remember, there shall be recompense in the future.”
“Courting death.”
Boom!
As Nuriel’s Power Explosion radiated from his hands, he pushed apart the heavy black stele of the Great Thousand Worlds: “Divine Martial, let us cease for now, cleanse them first, and continue the fight, how about that?”
Under the Imperial Crown, Jack Clark’s gaze was cold.
“Agreed.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1816: 670: Heavenly Gate Fully Open, Blast Everything
chapters.content:
Chapter 1816: Chapter 670: Heavenly Gate Fully Open, Blast Everything
Just as Jack Clark and Nuriel reached a temporary agreement, the faces of some ‘beings’ lurking in the shadows changed dramatically.
Among them, a mid-period True Spirit expert from the Golden Scaled Dragon Pattern Clan revealed himself from a distance, his surroundings roared with chaotic air waves as he hastily shouted: “Both of you, I have no intention of touching the Heaven and Earth Treasure, I will leave immediately.”
Boom! Behind the expert from the Golden Scaled Dragon Pattern Clan, a Dragon Roar echoed as he transformed into a golden dragon shadow that departed without looking back, showing great decisiveness.
At the same time, other strong men from the Golden Scaled Dragon Pattern Clan, the Crimson Single-Horned Tribe, and the Heavenly Wind Tribe, who were secretly following the Human Race and the Gloomy Heaven Clan, also revealed themselves.
These individuals were scattered billions of kilometers away, at a great distance, and upon revealing themselves, they transformed into sky-filling light scattering in all directions.
It was clear that the words of Jack Clark and Nuriel about cleaning up the area had intimidated these top-tier civilization strong men, who knew that staying here was akin to seeking death.
However, faced with the temptation of a Chaotic Supreme Treasure that was aggressive in nature, there were still some who harbored a stroke of luck.
“Seeking death.”
A silvery white eye in Jack Clark’s brow opened, the Peeping Void True Eye pierced through all illusions, searching and locking instantly onto two figures almost merged with the chaotic air waves.
In front of three-faced and ten-armed Jack Clark’s left arm supported an Obsidian stele, his right hand clenched into a fist, a power capable of Suppressing Heaven and Earth erupted from within him.
Boom! A black fist imprint with a diameter of a million kilometers suppressed Chaos, appearing instantly three billion kilometers away.
Beneath the fist imprint, Chaos roared, creating rings of murky air flows dispersing in all directions; the scene was like a world-ending meteorite penetrating the atmosphere.
Underneath the fist imprint, blood light sparkled as two figures radiating crimson light emerged, their single horns slanting towards the Firmament, exuding mid and initial True Spirit stages’ Auras.
Two True Spirit experts from the Crimson Single-Horned Tribe, who never expected to be found while using their Divine Power to conceal their tracks, let out terrified roars: “Block it!”
Boom!
The fist imprint, condensed by the Rule of Power and the power of the True Demon God Body, showed Unrivaled Domination; a Chaotic Hollow spanning millions of kilometers was blasted open, leaving a completely shattered void.
Including those two Crimson strong men who looked like demons from Hell, their True Bodies were directly smashed to pieces, turning into a blood mist that spread across a million kilometers.
This blood mist still contained a terrifying Vitality, as the crimson rule power permeated, attempting to gather and reshape the True Body.
But the residual Will from the fist imprint in this World suppressed the Rules and Will of the two True Spirit experts, forming a black transparent fist that slowly ground them down.
While Jack Clark suppressed two Crimson Single-Horned Tribe experts with a single punch, Nuriel’s figure also explosively moved, reappearing across the crumbling Chaotic World.
With four arms holding two Gloomy Heaven God-slaying Blades, he slashed violently towards both sides.
One of the blade lights aimed at a floating ore in the Void, which flew out during the collapse of the Chaotic World, emanating an incomplete Law Aura of an ordinary Heaven and Earth Treasure.
Because it was incomplete and of low level, the pursuing strong men of the Gloomy Heaven Clan didn’t give it a second glance.
Bang!
An ore several hundred meters in diameter exploded, and a Furious Ape clad in Red Battle Armor, burning with golden flames, roared into being, its face showing horror.
“Nuriel, the Ancient God, spare my life.”
Splat! Under the blade light, the true body of this mid-period True Spirit expert from the Fude clan, who had been hiding using a Secret Skill, was instantly shredded.
The blade’s momentum remained unabated, leaving behind a death passage tens of millions of kilometers long and dark as the Abyss in the chaotic currents before it finally dissipated slowly.
As for the other slash unleashed by Nuriel, it targeted an Obsidian Giant that revealed its rule True Body, towering over fifty thousand meters tall.
This member of the Gloomy Heaven Clan was in pursuit of a white light, which contained a silver token wrapped within, its surface entwined with rule traces, emitting a dazzling halo.
However, by this time the Gloomy Heaven Clan expert had no time to care for the token, and turned abruptly, looking at the blade light surpassing the speed of time with a face displaying terror.
“Supreme Ancient God, why!?”
Amidst the roar, the Obsidian Giant held a double-edged slash blade in his hands, his body burning with black rule flames, igniting his Origin, crossing the blades in an attempt to block the incoming slash.
Boom!
Under the black blade light, the two black flame slash blades shattered, followed by the arms of the mid-period True Spirit expert from the Gloomy Heaven Clan, who was abruptly obliterated, with his True Body severed in two by a single cut.
The Blade Intent already fused with the Rules, bolstered by Creation Level Divine Weapons, nothing could withstand its slash, nothing beneath the Primordial could survive it.
The sudden turn of events left the onlookers of the Gloomy Heaven Clan stunned, faces filled with shock and astonishment, not understanding why Nuriel would not spare even his own clansmen.
Amidst the raging chaotic air waves, Nuriel with the fearsome God-slaying Blade in hand spoke coldly: “You’re very good, I wonder from which clan you are, to have taken over and replaced a member of our clan.”
“If it weren’t for the emergence of the Chaotic Supreme Treasure earlier, your aura wouldn’t have leaked, otherwise even I would not have been able to detect that it had already been replaced.”
Hiss! All the experts of the Gloomy Heaven Clan inhaled sharply.
They had not expected that their own True Spirit clansman had long been replaced, his very True Body occupied, memories and even power taken over.
This eerie ability was too terrifying.
That was a True Spirit, and even if it was just a True Spirit Early Stage Expert who had recently made a breakthrough, it had already merged with the Rules it wielded.
To silently take control and occupy such a level of strong man, and to deceive Nuriel’s watchful eyes, that hidden powerhouse was incredibly powerful.
Hehehehe!!
A sinister laughter rang out, followed by a hoarse and twisted voice: “I didn’t expect to be discovered, seems like I have to abandon this body.”
In the depths of the dark cut, amid rising whispers, strands of grey smoke gathered, forming a tattered robe that enshrouded a Hollow figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1817: 670: Heavenly Gate Fully Open, Blast Everything_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1817: Chapter 670: Heavenly Gate Fully Open, Blast Everything_2
In its hand was a familiar withered walking stick, as well as an invisible pressure nearly reaching the Pinnacle of True Spirit.
It was astonishingly a strong man from the Estrella Clan, whose appearance instantly caused the Chaos within a million kilometers around to twist and gradually blur into darkness.
Pu! Without waiting for Nuriel to make a move, the dark ‘world’ that was like a dimension of Void burst and disappeared.
Like an annihilated black bubble, it vanished without a trace.
“You Estrellas are courting death.”
Seeing another of the Estrella Clan and having already infiltrated the Gloomy Heaven Clan, Nuriel felt an incredibly cold killing intent rise in his heart.
Boom!
The Black Blade Light in Nuriel’s hand surged as he raised two Black Gold colored slash blades, merging them into one to become a fierce Black Gold slash blade covered with sharp spikes.
The complete form of the Gloomy Heaven God-slaying Blade was even more powerful, and just the invisible sharp edges it emitted shredded the surrounding twisted rules and murky energy flows.
“Hundred Refinements Slaying Gods, Eight Desolations Unite!”
Five stretches of Black Blade Light, each ten million kilometers long, spanned the Void like five Demon Blades that tore through layers of dimensions, reaching deep into the twisted nothingness to shatter a figure.
A scream resounded instantly.
“Your strength can actually penetrate dimensions!” A strange voice filled with surprise, rage, and malice echoed as a piece of gray robe flew out, disappearing into the deeper layers of the dimensional realm.
“Consider yourself lucky for escaping so fast.” Nuriel’s gaze was icy cold.
With that full-force strike, Nuriel not only annihilated the true body of that weird figure but also destroyed ninety percent of its Origin Will, leaving it heavily injured and on the verge of death.
Although the life force of a True Spirit Level being should allow it to barely survive, its cultivation would fall and be difficult to recover.
Holding the fierce Demon Blade, Nuriel turned back to look at the opposite side of the shattered Chaotic World, where a Demon God with three faces and ten arms stood firmly, also looking toward him.
In an instant, the two sides cleared the field together, repelling or heavily injuring and slaying the strong men who were secretly watching from the five Top-tier civilizations.
What came next was to fight with all their strength before the other two Guardians arrived, determining who would become the owner of the Supreme Treasure.
As for the other strong men from different races who entered this time, they were directly ignored by the two.
Even if some among these different races might possess strange Secret Skills or Divine Powers that defy the rules, they were not qualified to take the Chaotic Bronze Bell away from them.
Dang! Just at that moment, the Bronze Bell standing at the center of Chaos vibrated again, emitting a profound and deep bell sound that resounded throughout the Chaos.
Instantly, with the Bronze Bell as the center, rings of transparent and powerful sound ripple bursts open, destroying everything around and forming a devastated area with a diameter of ten million kilometers.
In the midst of the Black destruction zone, a figure with double wings and standing ten thousand meters tall, wholly cast like silver metal, emerged.
At this moment, this Silver-winged Heavenly Ant strong man’s palm was only a few hundred meters away from the Bronze Bell, its arm wrapped in real Silver runes, radiating an extremely formidable Aura of strength.
Bang Bang Bang!!
Under the pure strength comparable to Primordial Stars, the sound ripples stirred by the Chaotic Bronze Bell were shattered layer by layer, unstoppable.
But with the obstruction of the Chaotic Bronze Bell, Nuriel quickly reacted: “Stop, Darius, put down the Chaotic Supreme Treasure.”
Boom!
Five stretches of Black Blade Light, each ten million kilometers long, reappeared, crossing dimensions and realms, bearing the sharpness to Destroy Heaven and Earth and instantly showing up behind the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant strong man.
Simultaneously, Jack Clark slowly spoke up, his voice arising in the almost stationary Space-Time: “You’re so anxious, I thought you’d continue to hide.”
Under the Heart’s Eye, which had already advanced to a Top-tier Divine Power, no one could track Jack Clark without being noticed.
Although sensing something following him and his own strong ability to hide, even Jack Clark couldn’t find the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant immediately without it making a move.
Boom!
The Heaven-Piercing Stele Suppresses the Chaos, four Golden-White Great Suns stretch across Carney Turner, coordinating with Nuriel’s strike as they cover the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant Clan.
The Invisible power that spread out caused even the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant to tense up, not daring to confront it recklessly.
Roar! A dragon-like roar exploded within the Chaos, brilliance shining on the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant, forming an immense Boundary-less Silver Heavenly Ant phantom.
Nearly reaching billions of kilometers, it’s like a Great Thousand Worlds Sky Ant phantom roared silently to the heavens, directly colliding with all attacks.
Boom Boom Boom!! Stars exploded, Abyss ruled the sky.
Under the Full-Force Strike of three beings with strength at the Star Level, the eruption of power shook years and Starry Universe, manifesting all sorts of terrifying cosmic events.
Under the onslaught, the Silver Heavenly Ant phantom shattered.
The Silver-winged Heavenly Ant was also sent flying back, its Qi Blood boiling and its True Body turning into a Silver Light, blasting through the Chaos Void, flying away for tens of millions of kilometers.
At the same time, the destructive aftermath of the trio’s clash also shattered all the transparent sound ripples, submerging the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
Dang!
The Bronze Bell emitted dazzling gray light, resonating with a deafening grand bell sound, and was also shaken away from the moment of creation by the aftermath of the strike.
The Green Light that the Bronze Bell turned into was heading directly toward where the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant was.
But before the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant could smile, all flowers, birds, fish, and insects on the Bronze Bell came to life, swimming in the Starry Universe.
Instantly, the light from the Bronze Bell grew even more dazzling, stopping abruptly with a burst of power comparable to Primordial Stars from within.
Watching the Chaotic Bronze Bell trembling continuously in the Chaos Void, Nuriel’s expression grew serious: “This is bad, the spirit of this Supreme Treasure is very active, it’s about to choose its master on its own so soon!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1818: 670: Heavenly Gate Fully Open, Blast Everything_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1818: Chapter 670: Heavenly Gate Fully Open, Blast Everything_3
Suddenly, Jack Clark, who was originally about to fly over, stopped his motion, and at the same time, other Human Experts and Gloomy Heaven Clan experts in this area were also somewhat excited.
Under the protection of Jack Clark and Nuriel, these people had collected a large number of Heaven and Earth Treasures that had coexisted with the supreme treasures.
Under normal conditions, they wouldn’t have had any further role to play, and could have just waited peacefully for Jack Clark and others to decide the ownership of the supreme treasure.
However, they did not expect that as soon as it emerged, the Chaotic Supreme Treasure would actively select its master, instilling a flicker of hope in everyone’s hearts and making them anxiously gaze towards the depth of the Chaos.
The selection of a master by the Chaotic Supreme Treasure only considers talent and compatibility with the treasure’s power, not the strength of cultivation.
Therefore, everyone present had a chance.
Once the Chaotic Supreme Treasure actively selects a master, the person who obtains the treasure can utilize its full power instantly.
With the power of this supreme treasure, even if an Ancient God King obtained it, they could immediately showcase combat abilities comparable to Primordial Stars.
Of course, that is just the potential power unlockable.
This kind of cross-Major Realm use of Chaotic Supreme Treasure consumes terrifying amounts of energy; even an Ancient God King-level expert could be exhausted after one strike, unable to continue the battle.
Hum!
Under everyone’s gaze, the Chaotic Bronze Bell emitted a more dazzling Divine Light, reflecting countless spectacles of flowers, birds, fish, and insects around it, and suddenly flew towards Jack Clark.
Instantly, the faces of Nuriel and the Silver-winged Sky Ant dramatically changed.
“The virtuous shall possess the treasure. Divine Martial, take my blade,”
“True, only through battle can the ownership of the supreme treasure be known.”
Nuriel and Silver-winged Sky Ant simultaneously took action, their powerful strengths causing the entire Chaos to burst, attacking Jack Clark with a Destroy Heaven and Earth momentum.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The incomparably sharp Black Blade Light slashed on the Heaven-Piercing Stele, tearing through the golden-white and purple-gray lightning, the powerful force constantly shaking the stele, creating a vast crack.
The gap is too significant between a top World-level ‘weapon’ and a Creation Level Divine Weapon.
Even with Jack Clark’s two Supreme Rules strengthening it, the Heaven-Piercing Stele still suffered damage under this blade.
At the same time, a pair of arms stretched out from behind Jack Clark, forming a fist seal, clashing instantly with a pair of silver palms that pierces the Void at the side, bursting into a ring of pitch-black light waves.
Boom! The Chaos currents exploded within a billion kilometers, the powerful shock wave sending all ‘humans’ flying in this area.
Jack Clark’s True Body is invincibly powerful, peerless within his rank, while the True Body of this Silver-winged Sky Ant is even comparable to Primordial Stars, extremely solid and powerful.
At this moment, both individuals clashed with absolute power, evenly matched.
Such a powerful True Body. As he watched the True Body clashing hard with the Silver-winged Sky Ant, appearing firm and immovable with a three-faced and ten-armed image, terror flashed across Nuriel’s eyes.
Shocked by the power of Jack Clark’s True Body.
But as the two attempted to block him, even Jack Clark had to momentarily stop in his tracks.
Meanwhile, as the two teamed up to attack Jack Clark, a shadow of an ant leg spanning ten million kilometers extended across the Void, smashing a spectacle shining with green light.
The powerful force even penetrated Space-Time, booming onto the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
Dong!
The deep and melodious bell sound resonated through the forbidden area once again, the green light shattered, and the Bronze Bell, having its ‘selecting master’ process interrupted, burst forth instantly, transforming into a beam of light disappearing into the depths of Chaos.
Boom, boom, boom!! Three tremendous auras exploded through the Chaos, chasing towards the direction of the Chaotic Bronze Bell with astonishing speed.
Jack Clark was seen stepping on a transparent long river, holding Heaven-Piercing Stele, World-Destroying Great Sun, Thunder God Vastness, and other weapons and the Demon God True Seal, continuously launching attacks.
At the same time, the remaining four arms vanished, striking mighty fist seals at a speed of a million times per second, blasting through heavens.
In his surroundings, Black Blade Light poured down like a Milky Way, Annihilating everything, under the glowing silver light even the Chaos was shaken, everything being destroyed by the absolute power.
In this chase, the three continuously exchanged blows; whoever moved slightly faster would risk being ganged up on by the other two as they tried to catch the Bronze Bell.
Thus, for a moment, they were in a deadlock, chasing behind the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
Such a commotion immediately caught Floralette’s attention.
As a strong man who is half a step into the Primordial realm and with true combat power comparable to that of the Primordial Stars, she crossed a large part of the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area in just a moment.
Then she stopped in her tracks, looking at the Green Light coming through the Chaos ahead, her anxious face revealing a look of surprise.
“Chaotic Supreme Treasure!”
Feeling the three powerful auras rapidly approaching from behind, Floralette did not hesitate to pounce towards the Bronze Bell.
Boom!
A hand covered with Golden Scales overshadowed the heavens, emitting golden light that suppressed Space-Time, pinning down the Chaotic Bronze Bell and everything within a million kilometers around it.
In the world turned into golden ice crystals, a powerful strength Burst forth from inside the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
Dong!
The tangible wave of sound, imbued with terrifying Shock Power, caused the entire world to shake billions of times, directly shattering the golden world.
Although the treasure was sentient and unwilling to be suppressed, as it continuously burst, resisting the Primordial Level power, the light emanating from the bell body grew increasingly dim.
“Where do you think you’re going.”
Just as the duck she almost had in hand was about to fly away, Floralette roared and was about to intervene in the scene.
But at that moment, three terrifying attacks enveloped her, a ten million kilometer long Black Blade Light, silver Space-Time distortion, and a gigantic claw of a Sky Ant as if descending from another dimension.
Plus a fist imprint wrapped around lightning, condensing terrifying power.
Boom!!
Three Primordial Stars level powers joined in one strike, instantly shattering the golden world surrounding Floralette and sending her flying out while spitting blood.
“You are courting death.”
Floralette roared in anger, golden flames burning on her body, a scorchingly overbearing power exploded, bursting Space-Time, bursting this Chaos.
Dazzling golden light even gathered behind Floralette, forming nine rings, each connected to a One-side World.
Boom!
The fifty-thousand-meter tall Golden Dragon Man roared, his six arms each clutching a rough long spear, a black wheel, a white flame, and a seven-color umbrella, emitting an aura stronger than a typical Primordial.
As for why it was stronger, not all Primordial Stars level beings possess Creation Level Divine Weapons.
And each Guardian of a Peak Civilization has reached half a step into Primordial, the boundary-breaking combat power making them comparable to ordinary Primordial Stars themselves.
With Creation Level Divine Weapons, they are strong among those in the Primordial Stars.
Only with such strength could they compete with Guardians from other Peak Civilizations.
But despite Floralette’s formidable might, Jack Clark and two others were not weak, instantly involving Floralette in a chaotic battle where friend and foe were indistinguishable.
Especially Jack Clark, who startled the other three.
Compared to Floralette, Nuriel, and the Silver-winged Heavenly Ants who had refined all Supreme Treasures and pushed their True Bodies to the Primordial Level, Jack Clark’s situation is different.
Besides a powerful Demon God True Seal, the weapon Jack Clark revealed was only a Top World-level black stele.
Apart from that, it was the two complete Supreme Rules and his formidable combat power comparable to Primordial Stars True Body, allowing him to face three Guardians holding Creation Divine Weapons without falling behind.
The other three naturally would not believe that Jack Clark, as a peak strong man of the Human Race, would lack a Creation Level Divine Weapon.
Just then, a sudden change occurred in the midst of their tangled battle, under the aftermath of their mutual combat, the Bronze Bell had already been thrown billions of kilometers away.
And at that moment, a Late Stage True Spirit Silver-winged Heavenly Ant appeared out of nowhere.
In its hand, it held a black mirror, emitting a ray of light that enveloped the Chaotic Bronze Bell, then silently took away the dimly lit Bronze Bell.
The sudden change startled everyone.
[Some tidying up to do, refresh in half an hour]

chapters.title: Chapter 1819: 671: Kill Them All, Heaven's Patrol Envoy
chapters.content:
Chapter 1819: Chapter 671: Kill Them All, Heaven’s Patrol Envoy
Originally, Jack Clark wanted to see if he could obtain the Bronze Bell without revealing his realm.
Thus, he was not concerned when the ‘theft’ of the Bell by the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant interrupted his earlier selection process, especially since Sara Williams was leading the Forbidden Army to guard the entrance.
Next, all he had to do was to hold off the other three Guardians, while joining forces with the other two to destroy the Silver Heavenly Ant.
As for the Star Ring Divine Clan, as long as Clive Dale does not want to offend Jack Clark, he will not spread the news about his true realm. Even if it leaks later, that would be a much later issue.
But unexpectedly, today he was still forced to begin a bloody massacre.
At the moment Nuriel ‘and the other two’ looked on in horror, golden gates began to appear behind Jack Clark, each one darker in color than the previous.
When the tenth gate appeared, it had turned completely Black Gold, with the purple-black dragon-shaped chains around it vibrating continuously, as if sealing some horrific creatures within.
“Kill him.”
Nuriel, who was just moments ago fighting alongside Jack Clark against the Silver Heavenly Ant, roared in anger, a hint of fear detectable in his voice that the other two strong men could sense.
In the mid-phase realm of True Spirit, their combat power was comparable to that of Primordial Stars, and that was not even their peak state after a Limit Breakthrough burning their Origin.
What kind of monster is this!!
Roar!
Floralette, resembling a Golden Dragon Man, roared towards the heavens, emitting a blazingly magnificent golden light, transforming billions of kilometers into a golden world.
Above the firmament of the golden world, a dragon head with ferocious horns, ten million kilometers in diameter, slowly emerged, one end plunging into Floralette’s body.
Boom!
Floralette’s aura instantly surged tens of times, the power of the True Emperor’s bloodline erupting, turning into solid golden flames burning on her body.
The Hegemon Azure Dragon Lance she held, over a million meters long, trembled. The dragon scales winding up its body stood erect, resembling a Divine Dragon exuding primordial aura.
Meanwhile, the previously weakened Silver Heavenly Ant with a damaged True Body exhibited silver lightning in its eyes, and a silver ‘stinger’ shot out explosively from its tail.
The million-kilometer-long Silver Stinger, an ethereal object, appeared instantly in front of Jack Clark, radiating a shockingly dangerous aura.
As for Nuriel, in the moment of his roar, purple-black patterns appeared all over his body, similarly burning the power of the True Emperor’s bloodline, transforming into an even more colossal Obsidian Giant.
Simultaneously, with shoulders shattered and a second head sprouting, its back tore open to reveal four more arms.
The giant, towering a million meters high, roared, combining the power of all eight arms. The fully manifested Gloomy Heaven God-slaying Blade turned completely into Black Flames, cleaving ‘Heaven’ itself in two across a billion kilometers.
Faced with Jack Clark, whose talent instilled fear in them, the three supremely powerful beings rivaling Primordial Stars all unleashed their most powerful peak strikes.
They must kill or heavily injure Jack Clark, who clearly was about to use his ‘ultimate move’.
But it was… too late.
Just as their attacks were about to submerge Jack Clark, an overwhelmingly powerful terror burst forth, shaking the entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area.
Boom!
Ten dragon shadows, especially the one belonging to the ten million kilometer-long Black Gold World Annihilation Heavenly Dragon, merged into his body in an instant, and Jack Clark was completely bathed in light, as his true form swelled within a burst of Golden-White light.
From a distance, it looked like a White Light sphere exploded with Jack Clark at its center, expanding infinitely.
And because the power was too great, all energy and matter on the outer layer of the sphere, including the remnants of the Heavenly Earth Rules and the essence of the ‘world’ of the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, were obliterated, forming a million-kilometer-thick halo of black light.
In front of that endlessly expanding White Light sphere, the black blade light, Golden Dragon Lance piercing through the Space-Time Storm, and the sharp silver giant needle were all shattered.
The three Guardian strong men were engulfed shortly after.
Boom Boom Boom!!
The pseudo-‘Heaven’ world around the three Guardians shattered, and their Rule Domains collapsed, before they were swept away by the expanding White Light sphere.
They crashed through countless World Fragments, creating three pathways over ten billion kilometers long within the violent Space-Time Chaos, before ‘the three of them’ finally stopped.
How could he be so powerful!! Nuriel, blood trailing from the corner of his mouth, watched in shock at the glow in the depths of Space-Time.
Even in this situation, his strength could still increase by so much. Just the force emitted during his transformation into his strongest form had dispersed their attacks and swept away their True Bodies.
This human is too terrifying, too terrifying!!
At that moment, the three strong men, each considered an exceptional talent within their civilizations, felt their hearts stop, a chill coursing through them, as if they were witnessing an all-consuming darkness surging forth.
And in the moment of their stupor, Nuriel suddenly turned and transformed into a black shadow, vanishing.
In the mid-phase realm of True Spirit, their Limit Breakthrough strength reached the Primal Hegemon, and even surpassed that of ordinary Overlords.
This message must be taken back.
As a civilization at odds with the Human Race, Jack Clark’s existence was already threatening the survival of the You Tian War God Clan, and they had to make sure to stifle him beneath the Primordial.
Otherwise, once he stepped into the Primordial, there would be no one who could stop him.
While Floralette and Darius did not have the same ‘concern,’ they too decided to flee decisively.
The Jack Clark with the Tenfold Heavenly Gate open was too strong, impossible to contend with, and impossible to withstand.
Just as the three were transforming into light using Secret Skills and Divine Power in an instant, millions of kilometers away stood Jack Clark, a million kilometers tall, covered in Purple Scaled Armor, a double-horned head, and a Dragon Tail stretching tens of thousands of meters across the Void, slowly speaking.
“Thinking of leaving? It’s too late.”
With his foundational strength increased by more than eight hundred times, the Supreme Rule that commanded all ‘strength’ was amplified to an incredibly terrifying degree.

chapters.title: Chapter 1820: 671: Kill Them All, Heaven's Patrol Envoy_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1820: Chapter 671: Kill Them All, Heaven’s Patrol Envoy_2
At the same time, the mastery of those top-tier Divine Powers, their might also surged in tandem with the explosive increase in the Rule of Power.
And this is what makes Divine Powers so terrifying; there is no upper limit, the stronger one’s strength, the more powerful the might of their Divine Powers become, growing increasingly divine, and ultimately, they may even transform into conceptual-level strength.
Boom! Jack Clark’s figure moved, vanishing instantly under the Bound Crossing Divine Ability.
Meanwhile, tens of billions of kilometers away, space-time shattered, forming a hollow with a diameter of tens of millions of kilometers.
At the center of the hollow, Jack Clark held his arms together, wrapping golden-white lightning around his hands to form a golden-white spear of light, and hurled it fiercely.
Bang!
Having entered deep space-time and located in different time segments, the Silver Heavenly Ant screamed, its massive true body of tens of thousands of kilometers shattered by the golden-white radiance.
By this time, Jack Clark had already vanished, reappearing instantly on a ‘world’ plane burning with Black Flames, another dimensional realm.
There, Nuriel, in the form of Black Flames, revealed a look of horror in his eyes.
Boom!
Before Nuriel could take any action, a white supernova exploded instantaneously within the Black Flames World, and the scorching power of world destruction obliterated the entire temporary dimensional world.
Including Nuriel, who had become entirely rule-based, was also directly annihilated.
With the world so immense, from the mouth of the Golden Dragon traversing upon the river of time, Floralette, towering at 800,000 meters with an imposing and fierce form, watched in terror at what was ahead.
“Divine Martial City Master, my Golden Eternity Race has been on good terms with the Human Race. I will leave immediately and will not compete with you for the Chaotic Bronze Bell.”
“That’s not important. What’s important is that you ‘know too much’.”
With white lightning coiled around his palm, Jack Clark’s hand formed a seal, striking down at a speed beyond Floralette’s perception, imprinting on its head.
Boom!
The river of time shook, the colossal Golden Dragon Head, large as a world unto itself, exploded, and the pervasive Overbearing power madly agitated the transparent river, manifesting within the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area.
Witnessing the sudden appearance of the mighty transparent river that spanned the entire forbidden area, and the figure standing upon time, exuding a suppressive force that could dominate the heavens, three beings from different races stood dumbfounded.
Before the three beings with rabbit ears and exuding the aura of an Ancient God King could react, a pure white bolt of lightning extended for tens of millions of kilometers.
Poof! Under the white electric light, the three Ancient God Kings were directly turned to ash.
And even their Divine Soul Intents were erased, completely extinguished.
However, beings of ancient tribes are easy to kill, but the top-tier Guardians comparable to Primordial Stars are difficult to eliminate.
Having touched upon the Origin, their vitality was incredibly fearsome; possessing a source of life, as long as their vitality was not exhausted, they could instantly reshape their true bodies.
Of course, if one could instantly erase their Divine Soul Intent, eradicating their rule-based existence, they could be directly slain.
But even a Primordial True Emperor wouldn’t possess such power.
Within the Forbidden Area filled with rampant Space-Time Chaos, separated by more than ten billion kilometers, nodes of gold, black, and silver lights converged, and the figures of three Guardians emerged.
However, their auras were somewhat weakened at this moment, and the sizes of their true bodies had shrunk by one-tenth.
Jack Clark’s power was too Overbearing; as he shattered their true bodies, the pure power laced within it partially eradicated their Divine Souls and rules along with them.
And just as they reshaped their true bodies, the three figures didn’t even think before turning tail and fleeing.
Moreover, this time the three of them fled in completely opposite directions.
“You are too slow.”
The figure of Jack Clark, standing upon time, flashed, splitting into three forms with indescribable speed, simultaneously appearing in three different directions billions of kilometers away.
Boom Boom!! Under two white stellar explosions, the Silver Heavenly Ant and Floralette in her Golden Heavenly God form were directly blown up.
“Do not think I lack the strength to fight back.”
Just as Jack Clark appeared, the fleeing Nuriel turned back with a furious roar, a kilometer-long pitch-black bone emerging in his hand, still dripping with ‘fresh’ dark-red blood at its broken end.
Just then, Nuriel forcefully flung it, the dark-red blood instantly flying out, and within that drop of blood, a force capable of driving endless beings to despair exploded in the blink of an eye.
Hiss Hiss!! As the blood dissipated, it turned into a dark-red mist, spreading in all directions, turning ‘everything’ it touched to grey, extinguishing all vitality.
Even erasing the life force of this broken Heaven and Earth.
It was a force capable of eroding the Great Thousand Worlds and killing them off; moreover, as it spread, it plundered a vast amount of ‘vitality’ and expanded even faster.
Meanwhile, the instant the blood exploded between Nuriel and Jack Clark, Nuriel showed a look of fear on his face and madly retreated without daring to delay.
As for the pitch-black bone in his hand, it turned into grey smoke and dust and disappeared the moment the blood flew out.
Boom!
The mist that expanded to tens of millions of kilometers in an instant shook as a violet-black fist imprinted plunged through the mist, bearing the power to Destroy Heaven and Earth and striking Nuriel’s back.
Bang!
Under the stellar burst of white lightning, Nuriel’s massive true body exploded and disintegrated under the white light, ultimately being erased.
Enshrouded in the dark-red mist, Jack Clark in his Dark Star Apocalypse Form slowly retracted his fist, his gaze cold and devoid of any emotion.
At the same time, surrounding Jack Clark, a grey millstone with a diameter of a million kilometers rotated slowly, radiating Primordial Grey Death Power, keeping the dark red mist at bay.
Yet this dark-red power was extremely formidable; even the Death Grindstone enhanced by a Supreme Rule to reach Primordial Origin level was still being slowly eroded, shrinking bit by bit.
When the two deathly forces collided, a distinct sizzling sound filled the air.
At the same time, Jack Clark could keenly feel that the absolute Defense field encircling him was also gradually weakening, being corroded into a dense network of hollows.

chapters.title: Chapter 1821: 671: Kill Them All, Heaven's Patrol Envoy_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1821: Chapter 671: Kill Them All, Heaven’s Patrol Envoy_3
You should know that at this moment, his basic defense has also increased by more than 800 times.
In addition, with the Power of the Elemental World of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder, and the protection of Despair Demon God Armor amounting to hundreds of thousands of points, where every ten thousand points could neutralize one full-force strike from a Primal Hegemon level expert, his defense has reached an incredibly powerful level.
Having fused these, Jack Clark’s defense has become so formidable that he could even dismiss a full-force attack from the Primal Overlord.
“These powers are so strong.” A hint of wariness flashes through Jack Clark’s eyes, as his figure flickers and he instantly dashes out of the range of the blackish-red blood fog.
At this moment, the spread of blood fog has reached over a hundred million kilometers, its massive presence roaring like Mountains and Seas shaking, endlessly expanding in all directions.
Within the Space-Time Chaos, Floralette, who has reshaped her true body, stares at the fog turning everything to ashes with a face filled with horror, recognizing what it is.
“Madman, Nuriel you madman, you actually released that thing.”
Boom!
Just as Floralette’s true body coalesces, it is pierced by a white Thunder God’s Radiance, shattered to pieces, which are annihilated by the lightning that spreads billions of kilometers.
Within the world-destroying White Light, with his hair flying and the Imperial Crown on his head, the figure of Jack Clark appears, dragon horns slanting towards the Firmament, exuding a majestic and indifferent aura.
Boom boom boom!! Under Jack Clark’s relentless pursuit, the three Guardians have no chance to fight back, their true bodies burst one after another.
Even though they activate various Chaotic Supreme Treasures and forbidden weapons, burning their origins and bursting forth with their limit strength, they are still no match for a single blow, ruthlessly shattered one by one.
The aftershocks of the battle between the four shake the cosmos; the entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area trembles uncontrollably.
At the same time, every expert of different races who ‘saw’ and ‘heard’ Jack Clark’s pursuit of the three is also wiped out by his hand, and in no time, the entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area becomes a river of blood.
The dissipating Qi Blood and intense resentment thoughts of these fallen experts almost dyed half of the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area red.
Meanwhile, near the birthplace of the Chaotic Supreme Treasure, all Human Experts received orders from Jack Clark, telling them to immediately head to the entrance to evacuate the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area.
Because that mass of blackish-red blood fog spread over tens of billions of kilometers in an instant.
As it devours a massive amount of ‘vitality’ from the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, its power surges tenfold in a short time, becoming more active and eroding the surroundings with even greater speed.
If this continues, it won’t be long before this power would engulf the entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, turning it into a land of death that even Jack Clark would not dare to enter.
While the aura of the three Guardians grows weaker and they let out roars of alarm and rage, a major battle erupts at the entrance of the Forbidden Area.
In the starry sky, a million Black Armored Imperial Guards form the Godslayer Legion Formation. Under the command of three True Spirits, they encircle and slaughter the thousands of Gloomy Heaven Clan left guarding the entrance.
These members of the Gloomy Heaven Clan are individually strong, with the weakest among them being of Mythical-level, led by three mid-period True Spirits.
Originally, the task of these strong experts was to keep the ‘three hundred thousand’ Black Armored Imperial Guards in check, but unexpectedly, a further six hundred thousand joined as reinforcements.
However, under normal conditions, with the likes of Nuriel and other powerful experts entering the Forbidden Area to deter them, the Human Race would not dare to make a move.
Unless they wanted to spark off a great war within the Imperial City.
But often, plans can’t keep up with change.
Beholding the frenzied slaughtering—or rather, the overwhelming massacre—of the Gloomy Heaven Clan by the Human Race’s Forbidden Army, various experts from other races who did not enter are all retreating in all directions.
They certainly do not wish to perish in the collateral damage of a great war between the two races.
And within the entry pathway of the Forbidden Area, that Silver-winged Heavenly Ant escaping with the Chaotic Bronze Bell is also nailed in the Void by a purple-black War Halberd thousands of kilometers long.
Surrounding the halberd are bands of blood-colored light, with golden-white and purple-gray lightning carrying Jack Clark’s will, jumping around and suppressing the strength within Dalimos.
However, this Late Stage True Spirit Silver Heavenly Ant is very powerful, with star-like silver strength shimmering deep within its body, eroding the suppressing power on it.
Given this rate, in just an hour, Dalimos would be able to break free.
But that is only if no one attacks it at this moment.
Manifesting its true body, a Silver Heavenly Ant thousands of kilometers long lies prostrate in the Void, struggling as it looks at Sara Williams, who stands with a long sword in the center of the void world.
“Human, there is no intersection between you and me; why do you obstruct my path today, and attack me without any cause?”
“Furthermore, there is no enmity or complication between our clan and the Human Race; aren’t you afraid of provoking a conflict between our two races?”
Unperturbed by the ‘threat’ of the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant, Sara Williams stood enveloped in illusory light at the center of the Illusion Annihilation world, her dress billowing as if she were an ancient god from a bygone era.
What made Dalimos wary was a strength on Sara Williams— a power that made it feel a strong sense of danger.
Within the gentle light, Sara Williams’ gaze was Hollow and void, and she slowly spoke; her voice was gentle yet authoritative, as if coming from another dimensional space-time.
“Your Silver-winged Heavenly Ants Clan’s territory is far from this starry sky; appearing here now and intervening in the struggle for the supreme treasure, you have already involved yourselves in karma.”
“Fate comes and goes, everything has long been predestined.”
“In you, this Lord of the Palace has already seen the conclusion of your downfall by my hand.”
“Of course, most importantly, Brother Clark has given an order: before he arrives, all ‘people’ who intend to leave the Forbidden Area are to be annihilated.”
The voice of Sara Williams was very gentle, as tender as if the girl next door was whispering in one’s ear.
But the intangible chill that seeped through made Dalimos’ soul tremble.
