At this moment, Sara Williams lifted the feather-like long sword in her hand and quietly said: “You are very strong, in order to swiftly execute you, this Lord of the Palace can only use that power.”
Following her words, behind Sara Williams, a light that was purer and ‘whiter’ than white spontaneously emerged, like the first light born from the Chaotic Sea.
The White Light spread, forming a white doorway behind Sara Williams.
One side of the door bore countless patterns of different races shuttling through, while the other side was engraved with dense and chaotic threads, inexplicably exuding an extremely Mysterious significance.
And upon seeing the doorway emerging in the white light, disbelief filled Dalimos’ eyes.
“Supreme Heaven, you are actually an inspector from the Supreme Heaven! No, wrong, you, you can actually mobilize the Divine Punishment power of Supreme Heaven, who are you!”
As one of the peak civilizations and familiar with the strength that permeates the heavens from the four Supreme Planes, Dalimos naturally knew of the Supreme Plane, and even once received an invitation from the Supreme Abyss.
But for strong individuals from peak civilizations, being a proxy for the Supreme Plane brought more disadvantages than benefits.
Hence, even if some accepted the Plane’s invitation, they would sever the Supreme Plane’s power after achieving the Late Stage of True Spirit, especially those with strong talents aiming for the Primordial.
This was also the reason for Dalimos’ disbelief; the human before it was of the same Late Stage of True Spirit, and the opponent was even stronger.
Besides, this human seemed very young in its perception, not very old, and had every chance of reaching the Primordial.
But unexpectedly, she turned out to be an inspector of the Heaven, one of the Supreme Planes, and she could even mobilize the Supreme Divine Punishment, already deeply bound with the Supreme Heaven.
Ignoring the words of Dalimos, Sara Williams raised her long sword amidst the white light and softly said: “Supreme, Heavenly Punishment.”
Boom!
The doorway behind Sara Williams suddenly flung wide open, and boundless White Light gushed out like a galaxy pouring forth; a white long sword stretching for a hundred thousand kilometers ‘slowly’ descended within the light.
Without any obstruction, the white long sword penetrated Dalimos silently from above as if it didn’t exist in this dimension.
Within the blur, one could faintly see a virtual figure of a Silver Heavenly Ant screaming in agony, dissipating under the white long sword, and instantly Dalimos’ ‘Vitality’ waned.
It lost thirty percent.
At the same time, Sara Williams’ face turned slightly pale; evidently, invoking the power of Supreme Heaven was a great burden on her.
But to swiftly execute a strong man from the same realm of a Peak Civilization without paying a price was impossible; with this in mind, Sara Williams’ gaze turned colder still.
Behind her, the door of Heaven trembled and a more powerful white long sword slowly descended, and vaguely in the background, one could see the silhouette of an immense white figure.
[There are a thousand words left to wrap up this battle, brothers refresh in half an hour]

chapters.title: Chapter 1822: 672: Chaos Rule, He is Darren Callum
chapters.content:
Chapter 1822: Chapter 672: Chaos Rule, He is Darren Callum
“Run, run fast.”
“What is this thing, my rules, my rules have ‘died’!”
In the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, which has been mostly eroded by the black-red mist, on the fringe, some of the different races that had escaped the calamity and not encountered Jack Clark let out desperate cries.
Everything touched by the mist turned to gray, vitality erased.
Small worlds within the Great Thousand Worlds shattered, rocks, forests, and those scattered pieces enveloped by berserk space-time chaos flows, as well as those strong men of different races.
The World-class weapons they burst forth hoping to resist with, ordinary precious treasures, even the Law Power within their bodies, all rotted, decayed, and died.
For a moment, the whole Heaven Pool Forbidden Area was filled with despair.
And when the entire Heaven Pool Forbidden Area was covered with black-red mist, the ‘vitality’ devoured, the already unstable Great Thousand Worlds because of a previous shattering, completely entered the Great Destruction.
However, unlike the earth-shaking noise that accompanies the destruction of a normal Great Thousand Worlds.
The gray forbidden area was silently destroyed, just like a rotting piece of wood continuously breaking down, dissipating, eventually forming a pitch-black hollow that spanned billions of kilometers in the Chaos Starry Sky.
Through the dark hollow, one could see a head billions of kilometers big emerging from the depths.
The head was blurry, condensed from endless black-red mist, nine solitary horns standing tall on its head like a crown.
Witnessing that terrifying head that devoured the Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, the Human Race’s million Black Armored Imperial Guards and the remaining thousands of different races’ strong men all trembled in their legs.
Fear rose naturally from the depths of their being, from a genetic level.
Including Jack Clark, who upon seeing that enormous blurry head, also trembled slightly, inexplicably feeling a strong threat.
And within him, the soul that had been tinged with a whiff of Heavenly Tier bloodline also became restless, as if encountering a ‘kin’.
Heavenly Tier, the owner of that drop of blood was a being with a Heavenly Tier bloodline.
Before their fall, they were at least a powerhouse of Primordial Seven Heavenly Realm.
No wonder that power was so terrible, even Jack Clark at that time could only defend, unable to do anything about the diffused black-red blood mist.
Only Jack Clark couldn’t understand where a half-step Primordial like Nuriel had obtained that black broken bone.
And having such gall, daring to keep such a thing in hand.
While Jack Clark looked on in astonishment, a hoarse voice filled with terrifying malicious intent rang out at the bottom of his heart. You, are very interesting, your Soul Source has already reached the Heavenly Tier.
The sudden voice startled Jack Clark.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s black hair danced wildly behind him, his body surfacing with golden-white and purple-gray dual-colored lightning leaping, shattering the surrounding Chaos Starry Sky, rules of Heaven and Earth repelling, forming an absolute domain of darkness.
And Jack Clark’s sudden outburst directly flung away Sara Williams, Brave, and the other True Spirit Powerhouses who were beside him.
Thousands of kilometers away, Sara Williams, who stabilized her figure, was shocked and looked towards Jack Clark surrounded by formidable Supreme Rule lightning: “Brother Clark, what’s wrong!”
The Human Race’s million Black Armored Imperial Guards and those strong men from different races also couldn’t help but look over.
“…It’s nothing.” Jack Clark slowly started speaking, his gaze sharp as he looked towards the black hole extending across the starry space in front of him.
At this moment, that terrifying head had already turned ‘away’, passing through the Boundary Wall of the universe where the hole had torn through, disappearing into the boundless Chaos Sea.
As the head disappeared, Jack Clark fell into a brief silence, then turned around.
“Let’s go, there’s nothing left here.”
“Yes.”
Soon, over a dozen massive islands where the Human Race resided started moving with a rumble, revolving around the central palace with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers and flying towards Chaos Emperor City.
As the Human Race left, the other strong men from different races looked at each other and then turned into streaks of light vanishing deep into the starry sky.
A day later, the civilizations in this part of the Chaos Starry Sky were shaken, and the news about this treasure contest spread at an astonishing speed.
The Heaven Pool Forbidden Area revealed a Chaos-level Divine Treasure, but during the treasure contest, an anomaly occurred, and Nuriel of the You Tian War God Clan, the Guardian, unleashed forbidden power.
That power devoured the whole Heaven Pool Forbidden Area, destroying it, and countless strong men from different races were affected and perished.
It included three semi-Primordial Guardians who were injured in the melee, the majority of the strong men from the five Top-tier Civilizations who entered the forbidden area, and ninety percent of the other strong men from different races
Among the four Guardians of the Peak Civilizations this time, only the heavily injured Divine Martial City Lord escaped.
As for the contested Chaos-level Divine Treasure, its whereabouts are currently unknown.
Unknown whether it was obtained by the Divine Martial City Lord or picked up secretly by some other Top-tier civilization powerhouse.
…
Chaos Emperor City
In the lofty Divine Temple situated above the clouds, Jack Clark sat in the City Lord’s throne, his eyes flickering as he looked at the broken slash blade and long spear floating before him.
Only Jack Clark could see the transparent text that appeared on the two damaged Divine Weapons.
“Gloomy Heaven God-slaying Blade [Creation Level. Damaged], can consume ten million Points Attribute to merge into the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd, greatly enhancing the battle sword’s might.”
“Eternal Heavenly Dragon Spear [Creation Level. Damaged], can consume ten million Points Attribute to merge into the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd.”
“Reminder: If the dragon spear and Gloomy Heaven War God Blade are merged into the War Halberd together, the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd’s level will reach Creation Level, and its might will surge.”
In the previous melee, Jack Clark killed the three Guardians and at the same time, obtained their Creation Level Divine Weapons.
However, Divine Weapons of such a level have become a part of their wielders, united with the person, just like Jack Clark and the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd.
When Jack Clark killed them, the two Divine Weapons were almost shattered, their Origin destroyed, leaving only parts of their ‘shells’.

chapters.title: Chapter 1823: 672: Chaos Rule, He is Darren Callum_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1823: Chapter 672: Chaos Rule, He is Darren Callum_2
This also necessitates the complete integration into the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd, only then can the Pseudo-Creation Level War Halberd be advanced, and what makes Jack Clark hesitate is the insufficiency of Attribute Points.
At this thought, Jack Clark sighed inwardly and slightly turned his head to look to the side.
Next to the towering throne of the divine temple, there stood quietly a bronze bell a kilometer high, engraved with endless patterns of flowers, birds, fish, insects, and starry skies on its body.
However, unlike its divine appearance when it first appeared, the Chaotic Supreme Treasure Divine Light was now dim, making it look just like an ordinary bronze bell.
But with Jack Clark’s cultivation, he could sharply sense the terrifying power contained within the bell.
At the same time, translucent text emerged above the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
“Chaotic Supreme Treasure, on par with Creation Level Divine Weapons, yet even more precious, containing a complete Chaos Rule within.”
“Upon initial refinement of the bronze bell, making the Supreme Treasure recognize its master, one can consume twenty million Attribute Points to swiftly reach the realm of unity between the artifact and the wielder, understanding that Chaos Rule.”
Twenty million Attribute Points. Jack Clark sighed in his heart again.
Currently, he only has a little over twenty-four million Attribute Points in hand, and he can only choose one.
On one hand is the enhancement of the lifebound divine weapon, the War Halberd, to Creation Level, while on the other hand is the unity with the Chaotic Supreme Treasure and grasping a Chaos Rule; even Jack Clark himself doesn’t know which to choose for a moment.
As the lifebound divine weapon that he cultivates alongside his life force, once the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd is enhanced to Creation Level, Jack Clark’s foundational strength will dramatically increase, with an enhancement far surpassing the refinement of the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
Refining the Chaotic Bronze Bell simply gives Jack Clark another powerful method of attack, but the enhancement of the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening Halberd corresponds to an enhancement of Jack Clark’s basic combat power.
Then, once entering the Dark Star Apocalypse Form with all ten gates opened, the boosting effect would make his combat strength even more formidable.
Yet the temptation of understanding a rule that harmonizes with Chaos makes Jack Clark waver, having pondered over this since his return to Chaos Emperor City for half a day already.
The Chaos Rule is different from the rules grasped by cultivators.
The laws and rules mastered by cultivators all stem from their perception and cognition of Heaven and Earth, condensing a force unique to themselves.
Even after breaking through to Primordial and standing at the source of that rule, it is still just the transition from personal power to being recognized and accepted as one of the core rules of a “world” that has been born.
Becoming a strong individual lifeform that can traverse the Chaos Void.
This is also why even after breaking through to the Primary Fourth Heavenly Realm, those True Emperors of the Human Race and Domain Lords of Peak Civilizations, along with the Eternal Heavenly Gods, have not completely detached from the mythical world.
Because even as Primordial life, if one enters a world so powerful and terrifying, their strength can be suppressed by Primordial Rules and be greatly reduced.
If those who are below Primordial, at True Spirit or Ancient Levels, have the rules they’ve condensed suppressed, the impact is even greater.
Simply put, it’s like having a mobile phone with no signal when entering a different country, unable to mobilize the Power of Heaven and Earth of that world, and everything must rely on oneself.
The energy within the body depletes with each use.
Hence, the path of Primordial essentially moves from a lifeform capable of wandering the Chaotic Sea to ultimately becoming so strong that one’s ‘power’ can influence endless Space-Time, an Endless World, an Endless Chaotic Sea.
It is only at that point that one truly reaches Eternity, immortality.
On the other hand, Chaos Rules are ‘universally accepted’ forces throughout the entire Chaotic Sea, some strong and some weak; the weaker ones are not much different from the common rules of the Deification World.
The stronger ones are even mightier than the ten Supreme Rules.
Of course, if Jack Clark chooses to refine the Chaotic Bronze Bell and successfully understands that Chaos Rule, this does not mean he fully masters the rule that covers the entire Chaotic Sea and countless worlds.
It only means that he has touched upon that rule, able to leverage a portion of that Chaos Rule’s power, untouched by any world’s suppression.
And because this rule does not belong to Jack Clark, it’s not a path he has opened, it will be hundreds or thousands of times more difficult to develop comprehension and progress in the future than the Rule of Power he currently masters.
Even slow advancement in the Chaos Rule could slightly delay his breakthrough to higher realms.
So both the advantages and disadvantages are quite distinct.
Just as Jack Clark was lost in contemplation, unable to decide, over ten streaks of white Divine Light flashed outside the divine temple, revealing the figures of Sara Williams, Brave, and others.
Looking up at the figure seated high upon the throne and the Black Broken Cleaving Blade and Golden Divine Spear that spanned ten thousand meters across the temple, Brave and the others all felt a chill in their hearts, respectfully saying.
“Greetings, City Lord.”
“You’ve arrived.” Jack Clark withdrew his gaze.
Brave respectfully said, “City Lord, according to your instructions, all that information has been released and has now spread to all the surrounding civilized forces.”
“Meanwhile, the compensation and resources for this battle have been allocated, divided according to functions.”
“Hmm, good job.” Jack Clark nodded, satisfied.
Sara Williams hesitantly said, “It’s just, Brother Clark, although we’ve attributed the deaths of the three Guardians of Nuriel to that taboo force, it probably won’t remain hidden for long.”
“Those Peak Civilizations, due to their bloodline reasons, all have their own Secret Skills to verify information, and they may soon find out it was you who slew them.”
“It doesn’t matter.”
Jack Clark said indifferently, “The capacity for accommodation in the Chaos Cosmos this time is up to the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary, and the resources born are suitable only for cultivators below Primordial.”
“So as long as I do not step out of Chaos Emperor City following this, even if Primordial Powerhouses of the Third Heavenly Realm attack, I’m confident I can fend them off.”
“I don’t believe those at the Third Heavenly Realm, those aspiring to touch the realm of True Emperor, would be willing to be stuck here in a stalemate with me.”
When Jack Clark acted to slay those Guardians, he had already thought of the consequences.

chapters.title: Chapter 1824: 672: Chaos Rule, He is Darren Callum_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1824: Chapter 672: Chaos Rule, He is Darren Callum_3
And then he realized it didn’t matter.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon began its breakthrough from the Primordial, the enhancement of its True Body along with the shared feedback of two strands of the Supreme Primordial Rules caused Jack Clark’s strength to surge dramatically.
His normal battle strength was originally at the half-step Primordial level, with his Nine-Layered Heavenly Gate barely comparable to the Primordial Stars, and only when the Tenfold Heavenly Gate was fully unleashed could he barely step into the Primordial Overlord Level.
But with the True Body enhancement and the rule-sharing feedback, Jack Clark’s current limit in battle strength was quite powerful even among Primordial Overlords.
Furthermore, with the blessings of the Chaos Emperor City, he no longer minded the Primordial Monarch-level beings he was previously somewhat wary of.
Just as he said, as long as he stayed within the influence sphere of the Chaos Emperor City from now on, those Primordial Monarchs couldn’t do anything to him.
If those ‘people’ outside started to slaughter the Human Race cultivators on a large scale, trying to force Jack Clark to show himself, then he would not hesitate to bring the Emperor City to obliterate their civilization’s base.
After all, the resources being burned belonged to the reserves of the Six Great Divine Domains.
With the rate of Jack Clark’s strength improvement, whether he is strengthening the Eight Desolate Battle Halberd or refining the Chaotic Bronze Bell, his strength will surge immensely.
Just wait until the Terminal Emperor Dragon completes its breakthrough and awakens, even if a True Emperor comes to assassinate him, he will have the assurance of escaping unscathed.
At this moment, Jack Clark turned to Sara Williams and asked, “Sara, does the Flame Wheel Divine Domain have a reserve of Life Crystals?”
The reason he asked about the Flame Wheel Divine Domain is because there are no Life Crystals in the Chaos Void; the weakest Ferocious Beasts here are of Mythical level.
And it’s not because of their strength, but due to the rules that govern here; even those few Mythical-level and below Ferocious Beasts do not have crystals within them.
“Life Crystals.” Sara Williams was startled, not understanding why Jack Clark was asking about this common resource.
After thinking for a moment, Sara said, “Life Crystals can enhance the physique of Transcendents, but because they serve a singular function and are much less effective than most Body Refinement elixirs, currently only a force in Starfall State breeds Giant Beasts to cultivate Life Crystals.”
“If Brother Clark wishes, I can issue an order for them to gather and send them over, but I don’t know how many you would want?”
“All of it.”
“All of it… No problem.” Sara Williams paused, then nodded.
Gathering Life Crystals from that state was a simple task, as she, being the Lord of the Heaven Observation Hall of the Flame Wheel Dynasty, could just issue a direct order to collect them.
As for Jack Clark, although he is the City Lord of the Chaos Emperor City, his power is independent of the six great divine domains, and hence he cannot directly order the internal forces of the Flame Wheel Dynasty.
It’s just uncertain how many Life Crystals that force has and whether they could be converted into twenty million attribute points.
“Sara, I plan to enter Closed-door Cultivation next. I’ll leave the matters of the city to you,” Jack Clark said.
Looking at Jack Clark’s somewhat pale face, still very weak in breath, Sara Williams’s expression turned serious: “Don’t worry, Brother Clark. I will handle the outside affairs; you just focus on recovering in Closed-door Cultivation.”
Jack Clark gave a slight nod, as he indeed needed to recover and heal.
For the purpose of killing and eradicating Nuriel and the other two, maintaining the Dark Star Apocalypse Form for an extended period did take a significant toll on Jack Clark, even damaging part of his Life Origin.
This was the price of the Hundred-fold Power increase.
However, Jack Clark’s main goal in the upcoming Closed-door Cultivation was to refine the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
After confirming the Flame Wheel Divine Domain had Life Crystals, he had already made his choice. As a Hell Messenger, he had many ways to increase his strength.
To him, the power of the Chaos Rule, which is not restricted by any world, was very important.
And as for the concern that mastering the Chaos Rule might slow down his future cultivation progress, with Attribute points for sudden enlightenment and Origin Points at his disposal, what is there to fear?

chapters.title: Chapter 1825: 673: The First Strong Man of the Human Race Revives, Save Me Brother
chapters.content:
Chapter 1825: Chapter 673: The First Strong Man of the Human Race Revives, Save Me Brother
In the Void, a pair of eyes as large as stars and golden appeared, containing a terrifying dignity, just like the eyes of the supreme cosmic god that have existed since ancient times.
But now, a trace of solemnity emerged in those terrifying eyes.
As a member of the Golden Tribe from the original Fourth Heavenly Realm, ranked seventh among the Eternal Heavenly Gods, could its sense of time be wrong?
Thinking of this, Siegmund couldn’t help but recall another piece of news about Darren Callum from the Divine Realm a few Sun Wheels ago.
Voyislav, a prodigy bearing the title of Ancient Overlord and at the peak realm of Ancient God Kings, was defeated in the Dueling Ground by this human, a Sun Wheel later.
And for them, even the most powerful Ancient God Kings are mere ants that can be obliterated with a mere thought.
Moreover, although it was a Sun Wheel later, due to the time disorder in the Ancient Dueling Arena, nobody could ascertain the exact time period of Nashigyas’ fall.
Therefore, Siegmund didn’t pay much attention and simply ordered to keep a close watch on this human’s information.
But unexpectedly, the next piece of news he heard about this human was that the guardian of Poluo Eternal Battle City, who was also a direct descendant of his bloodline, had fallen.
The most crucial was the strength of Floralette.
Boom!
In the golden eyes, divine light shone transparently, as if pure pupils deep within revealed mysterious runes shaped like clocks, slowly rotating counterclockwise.
Suddenly, a terrifying Time Power spread, invisibly distorting the starry sky.
Numerous Star Systems appeared, regressing from destruction, through their heyday, to the disintegration into dust particles, transforming into nebulae.
At the same time, in Siegmund’s eyes, ’cause and effect’ looped from his own bloodline to Floralette’s, and countless fragmented scenes about Floralette flashed past along the trace of bloodline.
Finally, the scenes stopped at Jack Clark sitting high in a purplish-black Divine Temple, nodding slightly, “Floralette, praised by the Ancient God, the Divine Might of the nobility’s Eternal Heavenly God’s power is magnificent, I am also a bit curious.”
By utilizing the traces of Floralette’s ‘past’, Siegmund also detected the aura of Jack Clark’s half-step Primordial, causing his pupils to slightly constrict.
Boom! The transparent light sparkling in the golden eyes grew even more brilliant, a much stronger Time Power Burst forth.
This time, he traced back the existence of the bloodline of Nashigyas, trying to pinpoint the time of Nashigyas’ fall.
In the unreachable depths of Space-Time, a city as vast as a Star System stood, filled with an invisible oppressive force.
Except for the central area spanning millions of kilometers, formed from gray rock, the Arena, everything around was destroyed by unknown forces, leaving nothing but ruins.
At that moment, a Space-Time disturbance burst above the Arena, a huge golden face slowly appeared, with golden eyes radiating a fearful pressure, looking downward.
A deep, majestic voice then slowly echoed above the Arena, shaking Space-Time.
“Honorable sleepers, pardon the disturbance.”
“I mean no offense by my descent this time, merely to see who it was that slew one of our clan’s prodigies recently fallen here.”
Looking down at the silent and unresponsive Arena, Siegmund fell slightly silent, then the mysterious rune shaped like a clock appeared in his eyes, reversing.
Suddenly, a strong Time Power enveloped the Arena, attempting to glimpse a scene from a specific past time fragment.
Boom! Instantly, the previously unresponsive Arena shook, and massive statues in the surrounding audience seats began to wobble.
Especially in a few of the highest main seats, one statue towering 150,000 kilometers high had fragments explode from its head, and a crack splitting its brow, as if forming an eye.
At the moment that crack appeared, an Aura terrifying enough to chill even the Primordial spread out.
Under the gaze of the crack, the Time in Siegmund’s eyes vibrated, directly shaking him out of the state of peering into the past, emitting an angry hiss.
“I was polite just now, merely avoiding conflict with you, do you really think I would fear a bunch of failures?”
Roar!
A roar that resembled a dragon but wasn’t, filled with terrifying pressure, echoed through Space-Time, Siegmund’s eyes shining brighter with transparent brilliance, as a second pair of golden vertical pupils opened.
Boom!
A pair of golden light beams burst from Siegmund’s eyes, piercing through Heaven and Earth, shooting through the powerful forces looming over the Arena, like sunlight piercing through gloom, shone upon the Arena’s ground.
And Siegmund’s ‘provocation’ also completely enraged those statues.
In an instant, terrifying hisses and screeches echoed from within those statues, the statue with the cracked brow vibrating even more violently, its right arm filled with numerous cracks.
Bang!
The right hand of the statue exploded, the ‘stone’ on the surface falling off, revealing a pitch-black arm beneath, instantly spreading a corrosive rotten stench through Space-Time.
This putrid stench turned corporeal, like a faint black smoke, ignoring Time, instantly enveloping the entire Ruin City.
Or rather, this entire Ruin City was filled with the scent of decay and rot, and the exploded arm merely activated it.
Puff puff puff!!
Under the engulfing corrosive rotten stench, the golden light beam formed by the Heavenly God’s bloodline power that permeated the Arena’s sky was eroded into pits and bumps.
At the same time, a terrifying aura of death that made even the rules obliterate, spread from the Heavenly God’s power towards the golden eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1826: 673: The First Strong Man of the Human Race Revives, Save Me Brother_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1826: Chapter 673: The First Strong Man of the Human Race Revives, Save Me Brother_2
Meanwhile, the pitch-black arm silently extended out, covering the entire space above the Arena, and in an instant, a terrifying strength enveloped Siegmund.
Boom! The golden face above the Arena shattered in an instant, and its eyes were destroyed.
From the depths of distant space-time, a roar filled with shock and fury exploded.
“Forcing the revival, have you gone mad!”
The stone statue trembled slightly, and from within it came a hoarse growl laced with terrible malice: “The dignity of the Arena is not to be violated!”
As Siegmund was repelled, the shaking stone statues in the audience seats of the Arena slowly calmed down.
At the primary seat, the huge stone statue also regained its calm, the cracks on its forehead silently disappeared, and at the same time, Gray Light surrounded the black arm and turned into stone again to cover it.
Everything, as if it never happened.
And at the primary seat, the other three even larger stone statues stood towering and motionless, like true stone, ignoring the passage of time, quietly watching the years change.
…
“These lunatics!”
In the dark cosmic starry sky, the immense golden eyes shone brilliantly, filled with majestic authority.
But compared to before, these golden eyes carried a faint hint of Death, as if a patient in critical condition could die at any moment.
However, immediately, a pure Gold Light diffused in Siegmund’s eyes, gradually thinning the aura of Death, until it completely disappeared.
But even though expelling this aura of Death was a considerable expenditure for Siegmund, his eyes, which were as brilliant as stars, dimmed significantly.
Although the damage was not small this time, Siegmund also obtained the result he wanted.
The time of Nashigyas’s fall has synchronized with the normal flow of time, which means that several Sun Wheels ago, that human named Darren Callum was just at the peak of the Main God realm!!
And in just a few Sun Wheels, he has already grown to the terrifying level of Half-step Primordial.
Even the calamity of the precious treasure this time and the fall of the three guardians of the Peak Civilizations were orchestrated by him, their deaths were not caused by the forbidden powers unleashed by Nuriel.
“This human must die.”
At this moment, even the high and mighty Siegmund felt an inexplicable fear.
Not fear of the strength of the one called Darren Callum, but of his growth rate, which was terrifying, so much so that it violated the Rule and overturned cognition.
Such a horrifying rate of progress is completely abnormal, or rather, it’s impossible for cultivation progress to be so fast; not even the Ancient God Kings could advance a Major Realm in just one or two Sun Wheels.
Moreover, it’s not just about advancing realms, the Combat Strength is also enhanced simultaneously, peerless within the same rank, able to fight across Major Realms.
It’s as if all his Divine Powers, Combat Techniques, and Secret Skills automatically reach perfection as his realm advances, needing no millennia of refinement.
The various performances of this human are less like cultivation and more like the revival of an immortal being from the Seventh Heaven Realm.
The Seventh Heaven… Could it be him, he’s not dead? With this thought, an immense weight appeared in the golden eyes.
If its conjecture is correct, then in the not-too-distant future, those peak races hostile to the Human Race are likely to encounter major trouble.
Even its own Golden Eternity Race will be impacted.
“Trouble indeed, although these are but my speculations, they’re highly likely to touch upon the truth,” muttered Siegmund, “But those most urgently concerned should be them. If they learn of the true identity of that Chaos City Master, those fellows will definitely be restless.”
“On the Ancient Battlefield of today, no one wishes for the emergence of an immortal existence to break the balance.”
“But this conjecture cannot be leaked from my Golden Tribe, in that case, only that body can be activated; it’s a pity, I had intended to keep it…”
Gloomy Heaven War God Divine Realm
The solemn dark doors of the Divine temple slowly opened, and a great rumbling that shook the Earth heralded the entrance of an Obsidian Giant standing ten thousand meters tall.
But compared to the massive temple, this giant exuding the aura of the True Spirit Initial Stage seemed like an ant, insignificant.
At the far end of the temple, a golden Pyramid Altar stood thousands of kilometers tall, flanked by two stone statues, each one hundred thousand meters high, resembling ferocious demons.
As the Black Giant walked in, the two even larger stone statues trembled, suddenly bowed their heads with fierce expressions, and shouted, “Ancient God Jamuhar, why do you dare to intrude upon the temple?”
Facing the interrogation of the two guardian demons, the one named Jamuhar revealed a bizarre smile, his voice sharp and cold.
“Jamuhar, this King is not some Ancient God Jamuhar.”
“Who are you!”
“How dare you, to defile the noble blood of the War God.”
Boom! Boom!!
The two demonic stone statues raged, the mighty strength comparable to the mid period of the True Spirit bursting from within them; six arms emerged from their armpits, blotting out the sky as they reached towards the Gloomy Heaven Clan member.
But just as the twelve claws were compressing space, tearing through the domain of Rule about to catch hold of the War God member, a look of fear appeared in the eyes of the stone statues.
Pffft!!
In the hands of the Gloomy Heaven Clan member, two streaks of Purple Thunder Light leaped forth, moving at a speed surpassing time itself, ascending the arms of the demonic stone statues.
Without a sound, the two True Spirits of the mid period disintegrated into ash, scattering across the temple, exuding a potent despair.
After casually eliminating the two broken True Spirits, the Gloomy Heaven Clan member looked indifferently towards the towering altar and spoke lightly.
“Alquest, this King holds important news about the life and death of your Gloomy Heaven Clan, how about it, are you interested in hearing it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1827: 673: The First Strong Man of the Human Race Revives, Save Me Brother_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1827: Chapter 673: The First Strong Man of the Human Race Revives, Save Me Brother_3
The vast Divine Temple was in complete silence, only the voice of the Gloomy Heaven Clan echoed in the depths.
But soon, the previously deathly still Pyramid Altar underwent a change, starting from the bottom layer, strands of Black Flames began to light up.
By the time the runes inscribed on the entire pyramid’s steps were activated, they immediately emitted a shining black light.
Boom!
At the top of the altar, a black pillar of light shot into the sky, piercing through the Divine Temple, disappearing into the vast expanse of the Void.
This black pillar of light acted like an ‘antenna’, guiding a terrifying will across the heavens to descend.
Upon the altar appeared a twisted face ablaze with Black Flames, and in the instant of its appearance, the whole of the Divine Realm cloaked in daylight was suddenly plunged into darkness.
Watching the suddenly darkened sky, countless living beings in the Gloomy Heaven Divine Domain showed fervent expressions and knelt down one after another.
“We welcome the arrival of the most exalted Domain Lord.”
“Praise the great Gloomy Heaven Domain Lord, your glory illuminates eternity, shining upon myriad creatures…”
As countless beings in the Divine Realm became frenzied, within the Divine Temple, the twisted face of flames with a fiery gaze full of dominant majesty looked down at the Gloomy Heaven Clan below.
In the temple, a voice of lofty indifference slowly rose: “Considering you did not hesitate to expose the hidden pawn within our clan to call upon my will, I shall grant you the chance to speak today.”
“Speak, elusive one, let me see how the news you carry concerns the life and death of our clan.”
The member of the Gloomy Heaven Clan revealed a brilliant smile, not being cryptic, and said directly: “The news is simple, that person from the Human Race who vanished for ten thousand years, has returned.”
“And there is a high probability that he has successfully made a breakthrough to the immortal realm.”
“What are you saying!”
Boom!
The entire temple shook, the Black Flames forming the twisted face distorted violently, with a pair of cross-shaped pupils appearing in the fiery eyes, staring intently at the Gloomy Heaven Clan member below.
Crackle Crackle!!
Under the gaze of those black cross-shaped pupils, the solid body of the Gloomy Heaven Clan member displayed huge cracks, like a shattered vase, unable to withstand the terrifying strength contained within that gaze.
Indifferent to the disintegrating True Body, the Gloomy Heaven Clan member kept the same smile: “You heard right, that so-called number one strong man of the Human Race, he has returned.”
“However, although he has broken through to the immortal realm, there seems to be some problems; he has returned under the human identity known as Darren Callum.”
As the Gloomy Heaven Clan member spoke, more and more cracks appeared on his body, it seemed as if he would completely shatter at any moment, and his life aura was also rapidly weakening.
“Darren Callum, I have some impression of that name,” said the face of flames as the pressure in the cross-shaped pupils intensified.
The Gloomy Heaven Clan member’s mouth tore into an exaggerated smile: “It’s normal for you to have an impression, because a few Sun Wheels ago, one of your Ancient Overlords of the Gloomy Heaven Clan died by his hand.”
“Before that, there was a Peak Main God of the Golden Tribe, who also had the potential to be an Overlord, and died by his hand in the Ancient Dueling Arena, separated by a Sun Wheel.”
“Moreover, this timing is the true time point, not the twisted temporal node of the Ancient Dueling Arena.”
“After a few Sun Wheels, that man named Darren Callum has grown to be half-step Primordial, and now with the Title of Divine Martial, he has become the City Lord of Chaos Emperor City.”
“Unfortunately, one Star Hour (one day) ago, the Guardians of your Gloomy Heaven Clan, Golden Tribe, and the Heavenly Ant Clan have all fallen by his hand.”
“In just a few Sun Wheels, he has gone from an eleventh-tier Main God to half-step Primordial, and even possesses combat strength comparable to primal beings, tell me, with his return, who else is there?”
“Hahahaha… Your Gloomy Heaven Clan’s doom is imminent, cherish the days that follow.”
Amidst the laughter, a bolt of Purple Thunder Light exploded within the Gloomy Heaven Clan member’s body, and the nearly shattered True Body instantly exploded, turning into black dust under the Purple Thunder Light.
Watching the swirling black dust within the temple, the fiery cross-shaped pupils showed a solemn gaze; this news was indeed astonishing.
If what the deceitful figure has said is true, then indeed, their Gloomy Heaven Clan is in trouble.
Of course, as an entity existent beyond the Primary Fourth Heavenly Realm, Alquest couldn’t just blindly believe everything the other party said, especially not a message of such importance.
Suppressing the astonishment in his heart, Alquest’s eyes once again flashed with contemplation as it pondered who that person could be.
The fact that the other party was revealing only bits and pieces, choosing to convey the message in this fashion, suggested that it must be someone ‘Alquest’ recognized; otherwise, there was no need to conceal their identity.
At the same time, this individual did not want to offend the Human Race, yet felt wary of the Human Race’s foremost strong man named Henry, who disappeared ten thousand years ago.
Thus, they must be seeking to use another’s hand to eliminate the human known as Darren Callum.
If that human is indeed the resurrected form of the strongest Human Race, even if they could not kill him completely, it would still be possible to disrupt his state and prevent his full resurgence.
And if that human was not the resurrected form of Henry, killing him would not be considered a loss.
Such a terrifying cultivation talent poses a huge threat to the Gloomy Heaven Tribe and also to the surrounding peak civilizations; they likewise do not wish for another True Emperor, or an even stronger figure, to emerge from the Human Race.
“This matter requires a discussion with the few of them.”
“Also, those Purple Mane King Wolf Dragons can’t stand idly by; their hatred for the Human Race is deeper than our clan’s.”
“Should they come to know that the human who once killed the Eternal Ancient Wolf Dragon is still alive and has returned with another identity, they will surely be even more urgent than our clan.”
“It may even provoke a Civilization Great War at the peak level.”
“That human from the Human Race is too overbearing. Merely sharing the same ‘Henry’ in his true name, he barged into the heartland of the Purple Mane King Wolf Dragons and killed that hibernating ancient wolf dragon.”
As the solemn voice echoed through the Divine Temple, the face formed from Black Flames slowly dissipated.
Of course, Jack Clark was completely oblivious to all this, never imagining that he had been mistaken for the first strong man of the Human Race, the legendary Henry, who was said to have disappeared after failing to breakthrough the Seventh Heaven Realm.
In the depths of the Chaos Emperor City, Jack Clark sat cross-legged within the sturdy Void.
Behind him stood a thousand-meter-tall Bronze Bell, which trembled slightly, letting out deep and sonorous ‘dong dong dong’ sounds.
These bell sounds invisibly vibrated Jack Clark’s True Body, stirring his mind and immersing him in some profound realm of thought.
At the same time, beneath Jack Clark and the Bronze Bell, an eighteen-grade pure white lotus floated, its white flame burning and smelting the Chaotic Bronze Bell.
Under the flames transformed by twenty million attribute points, the Bronze Bell was gradually merging with Jack Clark.
As the Chaotic Bronze Bell was refined, traces of bronze began to appear on Jack Clark’s skin, and the already formidable strength of his Primordial Demon God True Body was increasing at a startling speed.
An invisible force fluctuated and shook the entire Void, even causing the Chaos Emperor City to tremble slightly, as though a minor earthquake had occurred.
And it wasn’t just his physical strength; Jack Clark’s realm was also improving at an astonishing rate as he grasped the third Rule, the Chaos Rule, rapidly approaching the Late Stage of True Spirit.
As Jack Clark’s strength improved by leaps and bounds, someone in another dimension of space-time was also chanting his name.
In the depths of a dark and gloomy land, within a cavern that seemed endless, sat a shadowy figure as tall as a 5,000-plus meter grey mountain giant, its three pairs of eyes revealing sheer exhaustion.
At the same time, its body was covered with massive wounds, looking somewhat forlorn.
Just then, in the dark shadows of the cave, a 200-meter-tall silhouette swayed slightly and spoke in a hoarse voice: “Boroedo, have you made contact with Darren Callum?”
The Mountain Giant shook his head: “No, the rules of this world are too suppressive; even the power of the Supreme Plane is greatly limited.”
“Wait…”
Just as he finished speaking, the Mountain Giant’s face lit up with excitement: “There’s a signal, there’s a signal.” A rune on the blood-colored stone slab it was holding suddenly emitted a faint glow.
The Mountain Giant did not dare delay and sent a surge of will into the blood-colored rune.
“Darren Callum, brother, save me….”
“No, Darren Callum, brother, Mpolak and I have found the coordinates of a Great Thousand World, this world has so much World Origin Energy, so much that it would drive the Primordial mad…”

chapters.title: Chapter 1828: 674: Quake Rules, Evil God Jack Clark Descends
chapters.content:
Chapter 1828: Chapter 674: Quake Rules, Evil God Jack Clark Descends
Jack Clark slowly opened his eyes, the pupils clear and transparent, emitting a faint white luster, his gaze silently shattered the void in front of him into nothingness.
In the darkness, the hellish disk wrapped in red sharp spikes emerged, with blood-colored stone slabs embedded on it flickering with rapid red light.
“Boroedo, that Hell Messenger is looking for me,” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
In the Plane Battlefield he descended upon earlier, upon leaving, that apostle akin to a mountain giant had given him a way to contact, agreeing to collaborate on an invasion of other worlds should the opportunity arise.
Unexpectedly, just a few days had passed and there was already a response from there.
In contemplation, Jack Clark’s mind touched upon the blood-colored stone slab, and immediately the realm of thought from Boroedo came through with some urgency.
“Darren Callum brother, save me…”
“No wait, Darren Callum brother, Mpolak and I have discovered the coordinates of a Great Thousand World, with an abundance of World Origin, so much so that even Primordial beings would go mad…”
“Ran into trouble, huh? No wonder you’re seeking me out,” Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly.
From the tone of Boroedo, it seemed that they encountered no small trouble; not to mention invading and destroying that world, they couldn’t even extricate themselves.
But this was normal.
For Hell Messengers, every newly discovered world suitable for invasion represented a massive amount of World Origin.
If possible, they would naturally not share with others, only seeking the help of other messengers to join forces and conquer the world if they felt the invasion was challenging enough.
As for why they approached Jack Clark rather than the Lord of Hell Alvaron, it was either because they were not qualified and could not contact Alvaron, or they believed that as long as Jack Clark descended, he would be able to resolve the issue.
After all, during the last Plane invasion, Jack Clark had shown power comparable to Primordial beings.
“Lots of World Origin,” Jack Clark thought, then slowly closed his eyes again, his mind continuing to immerse in the realm of Chaos Rule.
Underneath him, the white lotus had shrunk to a tenth of its size, while the Bronze Bell behind him became more translucent, with the mysterious aura around it growing denser.
Naturally, Jack Clark was interested in World Origin, especially in an amount that would even drive Primordial beings insane.
However, even if he wanted to go there to take a look, he would have to wait until he had refined the Chaotic Bronze Bell first.
Once his cultivation broke through to the Late Stage of True Spirit and coupled with the Chaos Rule unrestricted by the Endless World, he would be able to protect himself and retreat in any unexpected situation.
The Chaotic Bronze Bell, a Supreme Treasure capable of unleashing the might of Primordial Stars on its own, contained an extremely profound strength within.
This was also why Jack Clark’s cultivation would surge upon merging and refining the Supreme Treasure and the Bronze Bell.
As for the Chaos Rule contained within the Bronze Bell, it was the Quake Rules, which wielded powerful shockwaves of Heaven and Earth to cause destructive sonic impacts.
If this Chaos Rule were cultivated to perfection, it would be enough to shatter the Great Thousand, shattering all heavens.
Of course, to shatter all the worlds, one would have to cultivate the Quake Rules above Eternity, to shatter and destroy the Endless Chaotic Sea in one blow.
While Jack Clark continued Closed-door Cultivation, the Fifth Domain Lord of the Gloomy Heaven Clan, Alquest, had already traversed the Chaos Void and arrived within the territory of the Sky King Denny Kaye.
And apart from Alquest, there was also another towering figure emitting a terrifying pressure.
However, whether it was Alquest or this Gloomy Heaven Domain Lord, their surroundings were engulfed in Black Flames, like a star with a diameter of millions of kilometers, clouding their true form from view.
Just as the two Domain Lords stepped into the Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon territory, they halted in their tracks, waiting in silence.
Soon, the turbulent currents of the void roared and converged, forming a vortex with a diameter of tens of millions of kilometers, within which a purple light emerged from the depths.
Whoosh whoosh!!
In the blink of an eye, endless purple flames ignited the chaotic airstream vortex, and a huge purple figure emerged from the sea of fire.
A muscular figure stood up on two legs, its head resembling that of a lion or a tiger, with a single sharp horn atop it. The dense purple mane behind it fluttered without wind, like dancing flames.
Looking at the black star spread across the void, that Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon’s gaze was icy cold as he indifferently said, “What brings you two here to my clan’s territory with such a grand entrance?”
Alquest slowly spoke, “Naturally, it’s about something very important.”
As he said this, centered around Alquest, multiple transparent black ‘sky’ layers unfolded, covering a realm of billions of kilometers, layered upon each other as if entering a deeper dimension.
What followed, nobody knew what they discussed.
A few days later, in a special Great Thousand World far away from the Human Race and from the activity of Peak Civilization clans, an astonishing bounty was issued.
The bounty was for the murder of a peek civilization strong man, against a reward of one attack class Chaotic Supreme Treasure, one special class Chaotic Supreme Treasure.
To slay a Peak Civilization Monarch, one would be rewarded with two Chaotic Supreme Treasures!!
As the bounty was posted, the Great Thousand World that acted as a transit hub for this world cluster stirred, with some top-tier and peak civilizations’ Primordial Powerhouses showing interest.
However, many Primordial Powerhouses who went to inquire covertly left with regret.
Because the requirements for accepting the task were very high; only Monarchs of The third day qualified.
Moreover, it had to be one of those top-tier Monarchs with ample power, capable of withstanding at least ten moves from a Heavenly King Level True Emperor at the fourth day.
…
While Jack Clark was in Closed-door Cultivation, time passed, and others were also ‘busy’.
Among them, the emissaries to the Flame Wheel Divine Domain belonging to the Human Race, were treated the best; most areas in the Imperial City Area were accessible to them, especially the largest Royal Library.
Therefore, during this period, geniuses of Eight Layer Heaven and Ninth Heavens, as well as Heavenly King Level powerhouses like Sky King Denny Kaye, were all reading books, studying Cultivation Methods, learning about astronomy and geography, revelations about the hundred clans, and so on.

chapters.title: Chapter 1829: 674: Quake Rules, Evil God Jack Clark Descends_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1829: Chapter 674: Quake Rules, Evil God Jack Clark Descends_2
Any knowledge of value, these strong men would all scrutinize.
And on the tenth day of Jack Clark’s closed-door cultivation, the fifteenth day after entering Chaos Outside Heaven, Mathilda Ward received a ‘delivery’ from the Chaotic Ancient Divine Realm.
The deliverer was an early-stage True Spirit Expert.
The Mysterious Martial Sky King and Mathilda Ward, who received the ‘delivery man,’ were both startled and hurriedly paid their respects.
In the living room, a young man with white hair draped over his shoulders stood with his hands behind his back, smiling at the nervous Mysterious Martial Sky King and company: “I am Flowing Wind, currently one of the elders of the Green Cloud Divine Sect from the Chaotic Ancient Divine Realm.”
“This visit is in accordance with the edict of the Eternal True Emperor to deliver to a girl named Mathilda Ward our sect’s foundational Cultivation Methods, Chaotic Origin Nine Heavens.”
As he spoke, the white-haired young man’s gaze turned towards Mathilda Ward.
After all, Mathilda Ward, with silver hair over her shoulders and a pair of dragon horns on her head, was the only woman present.
Mathilda Ward respectfully bowed: “The junior here is Mathilda Ward; I just don’t understand why the Eternal True Emperor would gift me cultivation methods?”
The white-haired youth smile and shook his head: “I do not know the details either, with my strength, I am not yet qualified to face the True Emperor directly, but it is said that this is related to Blazing Heaven True Emperor.”
Blazing Heaven True Emperor, could it be Jack Clark… Mathilda Ward and the Mysterious Martial Sky King paused, subconsciously thinking of Jack Clark.
Because half a month ago when Jack Clark departed, he went to meet the Blazing Heaven True Emperor following the Flame Wheel Great Emperor and his mentor Sara Williams.
Not long after, they received notification from an official of the Flame Wheel Dynasty that Jack Clark had become the City Lord of Chaos Emperor City and had gone to oversee the Ancient Battlefield.
And this cultivation method is likely the one that Jack Clark had found for her, connected with Chaos Outside Heaven.
At this thought, Mathilda Ward’s eyes immediately revealed her moved emotions.
When Mathilda Ward received the Chaos cultivation method, in another continent within the Flame Wheel Divine Domain, another True Spirit Powerhouse set off, taking all the collected Life Crystals to the Ancient Battlefield.
Time elapsed.
In just twenty days, with the help of Attribute Points, Jack Clark had completely refined the Chaotic Bronze Bell, achieving the highest realm of fusion between man and artifact.
Deep within Chaos Emperor City, in the core world.
A Demon God standing forty thousand meters tall, with ten arms and three faces, stands resolute, with eight arms outstretched, each holding ‘Divine Armaments and Treasures’ condensed from various Demon God True Seals.
A golden-white Great Sun burning with flames, a purple spear of lightning condensed, a grey wheel manifesting death, black chains of soul coalescence.
Beyond these, there is also a black stele containing suppressive forces, a purple-black Primordial Emperor Seal, and an ancient bronze bell.
Behind Jack Clark, the eight arms are now left with only one arm empty, slightly cupping the Positive and Negative Divine Wheel behind him, exuding an unmatched majestic sanctity.
Feeling the even more powerful strength within his body, all three faces of Jack Clark, both real and illusionary, showed a faint smile: “Coming to the Human Divine Domain was indeed a wise choice.”
The path of cultivation for human bodies is different from that of supreme Giant Beasts, as the lack of a Devouring Evolution Talent makes cultivation more difficult, especially in terms of the need for resources.
Only places like the Plane Battlefield and Ancient Battlefield can satisfy Jack Clark’s requirements for rapid cultivation advancement.
With a thought, the grand true form of Jack Clark swiftly shrank at a pace visible to the naked eye, soon reverting back to an ordinary human shape, looking forward.
There, a silent white pathway opened up, leading to the figure of his mentor Sara Williams at its end.
Jack Clark smiled slightly: “Sara, thank you for waiting.”
A few days ago, Jack Clark had sensed Sara’s ‘request to meet,’ but at that time, he was in the critical moment of comprehending Chaos Rules and refining a divine treasure.
Sara’s figure flickered slightly, and she entered the inner world of the Imperial City.
“Brother Clark, your cultivation!!”
Looking at the handsome youth with high-tied black hair, clad in an Imperial Robe, especially the Late Stage of True Spirit aura that Jack Clark was not hiding, Sara couldn’t help but reveal shock on her face.
In just twenty days, in less than a single rotation of the Sun Wheel, he had broken through from the mid-period to late period of True Spirit, wasn’t this a bit too exaggerated?
This rate of improvement, even knowing Jack Clark’s terrifying talent, having seen countless genius monsters over ten thousand years, Sara was still rather startled.
And wasn’t Jack Clark’s closed-door cultivation supposed to be for healing his injuries?
“Don’t be so astonished.”
Jack Clark said with a smile: “This time in seclusion, I incidentally refined the Chaotic Bronze Bell to the realm of unity between man and artifact, and at the same time gained understanding of the Chaos Rule contained within the treasure.”
“Thus my cultivation has naturally advanced, increasing by a minor level.”
Looking at Jack Clark’s casual tone, Sara’s rosy lips parted even wider, further shocked, to the point where she momentarily didn’t know what to say.
Within twenty days, he had refined a Chaos-level divine treasure and reached the man-artifact unity realm that Primordial Powerhouses would need hundreds to thousands of years in closed-door cultivation to achieve.
After a while, Sara finally let out a long breath, a wry smile on her face: “…As expected of Brother Clark.”
“Let’s not discuss this disheartening topic. Brother Clark, here are the Life Crystals you requested.” Saying this, Sara took out a white bracelet.
After Jack Clark took the Space Bracelet, Sara spoke softly.
“Life Crystals are ordinary Extraordinary Resources; the company in Starfall State also farms Giant Beasts as medicinal materials, so extracting them all and killing them off took some time.”
Saying so, Sara looked at Jack Clark, who seemed to be pondering, and hesitated: “Brother Clark, is it not enough?”
Jack Clark withdrew his consciousness from the bracelet, nodding: “Indeed, it is a bit short.”
The Life Crystals in the bracelet numbered over a hundred thousand, but the majority were ordinary crystals of Level 4 and Level 5, with fewer ones of level eight and nine.
All converted should yield between one point three to one point five million Attribute Points, still quite far from the two million points needed to fuse two broken Creation Divine Weapons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1830: 674: Quake Rules, The Descent of the Evil God Jack Clark_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1830: Chapter 674: Quake Rules, The Descent of the Evil God Jack Clark_3
Sara Williams said seriously, “This issue is simple. I’ll immediately notify the Flame Wheel Dynasty to dispatch legions from various territorial areas to sweep through the vast worlds around the Divine Realm.”
“Any Unique Beast or Giant Beast that meets the requirements will be slain, and their Life Crystals collected for Brother Clark.”
Jack Clark nodded: “I’ll leave this in your care then, Sara.”
“Brother Clark, you’re too polite. It’s what I should do.”
After that, the two chatted for a while, mainly Sara Williams ‘reporting’ to Jack Clark the situation outside.
Besides some trivial matters of the Chaos Emperor City, there were strong men of the Human Race who had discovered that the strong men of several peak civilizations around the Imperial City had been moving frequently.
This matter had attracted the attention of the Human True Emperor, and he advised Sara Williams to remind Jack Clark to be more cautious when he comes out of closed-door cultivation.
The mobilization of these strong men might be related to the treasures born in the Imperial City side last time, after all, the guardians of the three peak civilizations had all fallen inside.
Under normal conditions, it’s quite normal to have casualties in the struggle for a treasure.
But what’s abnormal is that the Human Race had minimal losses in that battle, and so anyone with common sense would know there were hidden circumstances in that battle.
The movement of these civilization strong men could very likely be targeting Jack Clark.
After a grave Sara Williams finished speaking, Jack Clark showed an unconcerned smile on his face: “It’s no big issue, as long as they don’t provoke us, we don’t need to bother with them.”
“By the way, Sara, next I’m planning to continue closed-door cultivation to consolidate my cultivation. Notify me when the Life Crystals arrive.”
“Understood, Brother Clark.” Sara Williams nodded.
After Sara Williams’s figure disappeared, a white pathway that only Jack Clark could open in the Void suddenly closed, vanishing.
“Targeting me, is it an assassination attempt by strong men from the second or third Primordial Heavenly Boundary, or some other scheme?” Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a thoughtful look.
But then Jack Clark smiled indifferently, reached out and tore through the Void, instantly, the Hell Roulette with menacing sharp spikes re-emerged.
Regardless of what those peak civilizations wanted to do, all Jack Clark needed was to continue enhancing his strength.
Before the next batch of Life Crystals is delivered, take a trip to the Great Thousand Worlds where Boroedo resides to see if it’s possible to collect enough World Origin to raise his cultivation to the Pinnacle of True Spirit.
Then come back and enhance the Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd to Creation Level.
By then, even if a Monarch of the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary tries to assassinate Jack Clark, he wouldn’t fear them. And if the Terminal Emperor Dragon has awakened by that time, it might be the other way around as to who’s killing whom.
Of course, if the World Origin obtained this time is enough for him to break through to the Primordial in one go, all the better.
However, given Jack Clark’s terrifying foundation, to rapidly break through from the Late Stage of True Spirit to the Primordial, the required Origin Points would be frighteningly substantial.
Therefore, even though Boroedo mentioned that world had an abundance of World Origin to the point of driving Primordials mad, Jack Clark didn’t harbor too much hope.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s hair flew wildly, and a blood-red eye on his forehead slowly opened, with endless scarlet light swirling inside, appearing like a Hell coagulated from blood.
Blood light from Hell poured out from Jack Clark’s forehead into the roulette, lighting up one by one those menacing red runes that then detached and flew out of the roulette.
These twisted runes spun and converged in the Void, gradually forming a scarlet, fierce Hell Devil’s skull.
At the center of the fierce Hell Devil’s skull’s forehead, there was an imprint of the blood-colored stone slab coming from Boroedo.
Using the corresponding blood-colored stone slab as the coordinates, the Hell Devil’s skull opened its gaping maw and devoured Jack Clark in one bite.
Boom!
Endless blood light erupted, space-time collapsed, and Jack Clark along with the Hell Devil’s skull vanished into thin air, leaving behind only the dimly lit Hell Roulette floating in the Void.
In the deep chasms where space-time intersects, blood light flickered, passing through one immense world after another, dimensions, rapidly approaching a certain unknown powerful world.
Although Jack Clark, enveloped by the Supreme Hell Plane, could not ‘see’ the outside, through the fleeting vague perception as he passed by, he felt that in just that moment, he had traversed thousands of worlds.
Jack Clark’s heart suddenly turned cold.
The Supreme Plane, so formidable!
The more Jack Clark understood about Heaven and Earth beyond the mythical world, the more colossal and vast the outside seemed to him, all the while his reverence for what lay beyond the Primordial, Eternity, deepened.
The four Supreme Planes were not Eternal Level, but their possessed power was already terrifying, so one could only imagine how ‘formidable’ Eternity is.
Just as Jack Clark’s thoughts were drifting, suddenly the scene before him changed, and he had leaped out from the depths of dimensional space.
Around him, Chaos Qi roared wildly, powerful enough to grind anything below Primordial to dust, and not far ahead, a black mist-shrouded orb slowly sank and floated.
From the invisible fluctuations radiating from this ‘world,’ it seemed to be just an ordinary Great Thousand World.
But could an ordinary Great Thousand World drive Boroedo, who had reached Rule Level as a Hell Messenger from the Shadow Special World, and Mpolak, who originated from the Shadow Special World, to seek his help?
Whoosh! Jack Clark pulled in the Power of Supreme Hell to form a blood light that enveloped his body, charging straight into the Black World. The moment of contact didn’t meet any resistance or repulsion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1831: 675: Valkyrie, Make a Pact with It/Him
chapters.content:
Chapter 1831: Chapter 675: Valkyrie, Make a Pact with It/Him
“Such strong rule suppression, this is definitely not an ordinary Great Thousand Worlds!”
“My strength is being absorbed… including the power from the Supreme Hell Plane…”
The moment Jack Clark entered the seemingly ordinary Black World, an overwhelming power capable of suppressing all True Spirits and instantly suppressing the Primordial Stars enveloped him.
Under this terrible World Rules, even Primordial Overlords like the Primordial Monarch would be suppressed, which took Jack Clark by surprise.
Although he was psychologically prepared due to the downfall of Boroedo and others, and knew that this world was not as simple as it seemed, he did not expect the World Rules’ suppression to be this strong.
In this situation, Jack Clark instinctively burst forth with power, attempting to break free from the suppression.
Then he discovered that no matter whether it was the energy bursting from him or the power of the Supreme Hell Plane swirling around him, it was absorbed by this world at an alarming rate.
And after absorbing his power, the rule suppression force surrounding him became even stronger.
In other words, the stronger Jack Clark struggled and burst forth with power, the faster his power was lost, and the stronger the world’s suppression on him became.
It was a complete vicious cycle.
No wonder the two guys from Boroedo made a mistake; this world is too weird. Jack Clark’s expression turned solemn, and a blurry image of a Bronze Bell emerged behind him.
Dong!
A deep and resonant bell tolled slowly between heaven and earth, and the invisible Shock Power caused the World’s Power suppressing Jack Clark’s surroundings to falter slightly.
Just then, the Blood Colored Eye in Jack Clark’s brow suddenly opened, releasing a strong suction force.
Boom!
The blood light surrounding Jack Clark shook, and the Power of Hell within him surged into the brow, into the depths of Hell’s Eye, eventually turning into a blood-colored Crystal Core that quietly floated like a budding flower.
And the moment he harnessed all the Power of Hell with the Seed of Hell, the phantom of the Bronze Bell behind Jack Clark suddenly covered him.
Dong! The lingering, deep sound of the bell echoed throughout the world; as the invisible Shock Power spread, the Red Land Palace that obscured the Firmament silently shattered into nothingness.
The falling blood-red meteor in the sky also disappeared simultaneously.
The sudden change left many excited and elated strong men on the Earth stunned.
“The projection of the Evil God Palace has disappeared?”
“What happened, did that Evil God break free from capture and escape…?”
Meanwhile, beneath the Earth, or rather, deeper within the world, the Mountain Giant towering over five thousand meters raised its head excitedly, its three pairs of narrow eyes piercing through the gloomy Firmament, its tone uplifted.
“Mpolak, the aura of our brother Darren Callum has disappeared.”
“I knew it, with his strength, how could he possibly be suppressed? He is a strong man from the Eternal World, hahahaha…”
Watching the excited Boroedo, a figure in the shadows lifted its head solemnly, eyes as dark as Black Holes also showing a faint excitement, its voice deep.
“Boroedo, be careful to restrain your power next, don’t let this world devour too much.”
“Once our brother Darren Callum figures out the situation of this world and follows the signal to find this place, we will be able to join forces with him to tear through the Boundary Wall and escape.”
“Don’t worry Mpolak, I may be big, but not stupid,” the Mountain Giant nodded.
While the two Hell Messengers anticipated, in the ‘Beyond the Universe’ of this world, a pitch-black Void filled with planets floated in the starry sky.
On a planet, formed from black-gray rocky material and ten thousand kilometers in diameter, Jack Clark stood silently.
At this moment, Jack Clark appeared like an ordinary person, black hair cascading over his shoulders, no signs of transcendental power aura on him, all his power repressed inwardly by the Chaotic Bronze Bell reversal suppression.
Because only by doing this, he could avoid the ‘scan’ of this world.
Of course, saying there is no power means not being able to use any law, rule, or Divine Power that does not belong to this world.
But ‘physical strength’ is not among these, especially since Jack Clark’s physical body and conventional rule-based true body differ.
Jack Clark’s physical body, evolved to its current state without using Divine Power or rules, alone has enough pure strength to shatter True Spirits.
Therefore, Jack Clark did not directly burst forth with power to tear the Boundary Wall and leave.
After all, his goal for coming here was to collect enough World Origin.
As for seeking Alvaron, drawing in a stronger Supreme Hell Power to tear this world apart and pull it into Hell, there was no need.
Upon Alvaron’s arrival, the ‘Big Head’ of the harvest would certainly belong to it; as long as he could guarantee his own escape at any time, Jack Clark naturally wouldn’t be so foolish.
Jack Clark glanced at the dark void of space around him, then looked towards a Light Sphere not far in front: “Such a strange world structure.”
As far as Jack Clark could see, the pitch-black Void of space floated with a large number of planets and asteroids, but the entire space had no signs of life.
No Stars, just lifeless planetary celestial bodies without atmospheres.
Moreover, without deploying the Void Death Pupil, within hundreds of light-years that his sight could reach, all the celestial bodies seemed to be moving subtly around the Light Sphere at the center.
It was as if the innumerable planetary celestial bodies in the outer space of this world were part of an immensely vast cosmic array.
And the focal point was the Light Sphere, billions of kilometers away from Jack Clark, which was a huge world wrapped in blue and gold atmosphere, where the Origin and Boroedo and his companions were likely located.
With that thought, Jack Clark slightly crouched, his thigh muscles bulged slightly, and his body gathered a pure and formidable strength; he then pushed powerfully against the ground with his feet.
Boom!
The planet vibrated, and the surface opened with a crater the size of an asteroid that expanded at a visible pace, collapsing, and then the entire planet shattered and exploded under Jack Clark’s foot.

chapters.title: Chapter 1832: 675: Valkyrie, Make a Pact with It/Him_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1832: Chapter 675: Valkyrie, Make a Pact with It/Him_2
Under the counter-shock force, Jack Clark was shot out instantly, reaching thousands of times the speed of sound.
Moreover, due to the lack of air resistance in space, Jack Clark’s speed continued to accelerate under the effect of the rebound force, like a fast-flying comet.
Bang! Millions of kilometers away, the surface of a celestial body with a tens of thousands of kilometers diameter collapsed, forming a crater thousands of kilometers wide.
Under the ferocious impact, countless amounts of dirt and rock melted and were thrown into the air in an instant, forming a scorching nuclear explosion shockwave mixed with smoke and dust sweeping the surface, destroying everything.
But almost immediately, the planet shook again, a dark shadow briefly flashed across the planet’s surface and vanished, leaving behind shattered remains of the planet to drift as supreme rubble in the Void.
Depending on his invincible body, after crushing dozens of planets, Jack Clark quickly approached that world.
It was a colossal planet wrapped within its atmosphere, with a diameter exceeding a million kilometers. From high altitude, one could clearly see that oceans covered most of the area.
Of course, this colossal size is in comparison to Blue Star, which is only tens of thousands of kilometers in diameter.
With Jack Clark’s current strength, under normal conditions, he could shatter a star with a casual strike, destroying everything within tens of millions of kilometers, annihilating an entire world.
But as he approached the world, Jack Clark’s figure gradually slowed down.
Because he acutely perceived that as he neared the ‘center’ of this world, an invisible repulsive force faintly emerged around him.
And as he drew closer to the world, this repulsive force grew stronger.
Was he still exposed?
Even after concealing all transcendent power, was he still detected by this world?
Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, his figure slowly coming to a halt, standing on a desolate planet with a diameter of a hundred thousand kilometers, millions of kilometers away from the golden-blue planet.
But at that moment, Jack Clark’s gaze flickered.
In front of him, a million kilometers away, on a red planet over a hundred thousand kilometers in diameter, there was actually a thin atmosphere, and even some massive creatures.
…
On the ground stood the World Trees with trunks thousands of kilometers in diameter, towering to heights of hundreds of thousands of meters, their canopies soaring into the clouds and covering hundreds of kilometers, resembling floating islands in the sky.
Centered around this World Tree, tens of millions of humans gathered to build a bustling and enormous City of the World.
At this time, in the southern district of this city, the Valkyrie Academy’s Phantom God Series, which encompassed vast forests and mountain peaks and rivers, was holding a Summoning ritual.
A beautiful woman who appeared to be in her thirties, with long red hair draped over her shoulders, wearing magnificent red crystal battle armor, stood on the edge of the High Platform, looking down solemnly.
Below her, over a hundred Valkyrie Cadets were scattered around the square.
The students, the youngest probably fourteen or fifteen and the oldest in their twenties, were all very beautiful.
Some had delicate features and fair, smooth skin, while others were more statuesque and voluptuously figured, with various colors of hair—black, blue, purple.
In addition, perhaps due to all being women, these cadets also pursued beauty in their attire.
Their academy uniforms were tailored to a certain proportion, appearing fashionably fit, with a flattering silhouette. Many had their trousers cut to thigh-height, revealing straight long legs in white stockings.
Even if they were wearing battle armor, the designs were still quite breezy.
For example, while the forearms were covered by thin armor, the double shoulders that should be well protected were left bare, exposing smooth shoulders and collarbones.
The chest area was covered by the ornate battle armor, but some Valkyrie Cadets’ bellies and fair backs were exposed.
At the waist, where one would expect armor, there was instead a folded princess skirt, revealing thighs with a silk train skirt resembling a swallowtail at the back.
Below the knees, although covered by battle boots forged from thin armor, the style of the boots was still high-heeled.
It seemed that this made them appear taller, with longer, straighter legs.
Furthermore, behind those twenty-something students in resplendent armor, stood Giant Beasts tens to over a hundred meters long.
These Giant Beasts, unlike those in the mythical world, were not covered with thick scale armor, but with plates of horn-like armor.
Beneath that armor, their bodies emanated faint white and blue glows, as if made of condensed energy.
“This year, our academy has a total of seven people who meet the Summoning qualifications; you will step up to the Summoning Altar in the order your names are called,”
said the red-haired Fiorina in a deep voice: “Remember, Phantom Beasts are your friends, comrades, kin, not slaves.”
“When you activate the altar with your God-given powers and respond to the Phantom Beasts tied to fate’s threads, you must touch them with the sincerity of your spirit.”
“Otherwise, if the Phantom Beast refuses, a minor wound to your spirit is the least of your problems. You may need three months of recuperation before you can summon again, missing the prime opportunity to awaken the Valkyrie Power.”
Fiorina’s words made the seven girls at the front a bit tense.
“The first one, Erin Fleurie, up you go.”
“Yes, teacher.”
A pretty girl with green hair and a somewhat petite figure stepped out, walked up to the altar surrounded by eight towering stone pillars and hundreds of meters high, under the watchful eyes of all the Phantom God Academy classmates.
At the center of the altar, the girl clasped her hands and silently chanted in her heart, “Void, Ocean, Ancient Earth, the sincere Erin Fleurie prays to you…”
Suddenly, the girl’s spirit slowly calmed, and it was not until this moment that her Spirit Power began to radiate.
Boom! Instantly, an awe-inspiring burst of Spirit Power exploded from the girl, resonating with the altar.

chapters.title: Chapter 1833: 675: Valkyrie, Make a Pact with It/Him_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1833: Chapter 675: Valkyrie, Make a Pact with It/Him_3
The altar shook abruptly, its engraved Thirty-Two Starlight Array blazed with light, and a phantom beam of light shot up into the sky before disappearing into the vast Void beyond.
“It has begun.”
“Erin Fleurie, you can do it.”
In the square, all the students, whether those who have already awakened the Valkyrie Power or those fourteen or fifteen-year-old girls just entering the academy, were cheering for Erin Fleurie.
For the students of Phantom God Academy, the ability to successfully summon a Phantom Beast and establish a contract with it was of paramount importance.
Success would mean awakening the Valkyrie Power, becoming a powerful Valkyrie Warrior; failure would leave one as nothing but an ordinary warrior, or worse, having to drop out and return home.
One step from heaven, one step from hell.
At this very tense moment below, a look of surprise gradually appeared on the face of Erin Fleurie on the altar.
Because, through the power of the altar, she entered the blurry spiritual perception of the stars beyond, and easily sensed a powerful Phantom Beast that resonated with her.
And without needing her to earnestly ‘speak out’, that Phantom Beast was impatient to respond to her request.
Boom!
The light of the altar shone brightly, and a twenty-meter long Giant Beast with blue Ice Crystal armor, resembling a fierce tiger but with three tails, appeared before Erin Fleurie.
At the same time, six of the eight surrounding stone pillars lit up.
“Erin Fleurie succeeded.”
“Five of the High Pillars glowing, it’s actually a King-level Phantom Beast.”
All the students below were astounded, including Fiorina on the High Platform, who was also somewhat surprised that Erin Fleurie had succeeded so quickly, and with a Phantom Beast possessing King-level Potential at that.
In previous years, the students who could summon Phantom Beasts with King-level Potential were always the most talented of their year.
