But in the prior tests, Erin Fleurie’s God-given power and spirit level were only above average, a whole major level lower than last year’s summoning of a King-level Phantom Beast?
Roar!
Upon the altar, the ‘massive’ Three-tailed Heavenly Tiger roared. Though only twenty meters long, the aura it exuded at that moment was on par with a Level 9 Giant Beast of Blue Star.
The green-haired girl turned back, looking towards the red-clad woman below with some confusion: “Teacher Fiorina, I’ve succeeded?”
Fiorina’s face revealed a smile: “… well done, come down now.”
After the green-haired girl descended with her blue Giant Tiger, Fiorina continued: “Next up, Rianna. Don’t be nervous later, you will surely do well.”
“Yes, Teacher.” A beautiful female student, already curvaceous at just eighteen, took a deep breath and stepped onto the altar.
Hum! The altar activated, and the Thirty-Two Starlight Array once again sent a burst of light soaring into the sky.
Under the watchful eyes of everyone around, a white rainbow light descended from the sky, revealing a Flying Giant Beast with wings spanning more than forty meters, adorned with feathers as beautiful as light.
At the same time, the light from the six stone pillars intensified.
“It’s King-level, another Phantom Beast with King-level Potential!”
All the students below were in uproar, wondering how it was that their series could consecutively summon two King-level Phantom Beasts this year. Could it be that the long-declining Phantom God Series was about to rise again?
What’s happening this year? Even Fiorina was somewhat puzzled.
“Next, Yulia…”
Roar! Atop the altar, a Furious Ape twenty-seven meters tall, covered in red armor, roared, its invisible might even causing the Earth to tremble slightly.
“King-level, and it’s close to having Emperor-level Potential!!”
“Next up, Tiana…”
In the stunned and numb gaze of all the classmates, six girls in a row went up and all succeeded, and the Phantom Beasts they contracted all possessed King-level Potential.
Especially the sixth girl to go up, Isabel, who contracted an Emperor-level Potential Phantom Beast with an initial form over forty meters long and an aura of fearsome might.
“Isabel, Isabel…”
“Ah, Teacher.”
Below, Fiorina frowned slightly, looking at the blonde girl on the altar who didn’t react for a long while: “Isabel, what’s wrong?”
“No, nothing.” The blonde girl shook her head.
Fiorina nodded: “You did very well this time, rarely summoning a Phantom Beast with Emperor-level Potential. There is hope that you will become a Nine-Star Valkyrie before graduation.”
“Now, go and rest first, and I’ll teach you all later how to unite with your Phantom Beast and awaken the Valkyrie Power.”
“Yes, Teacher.” The blonde girl nodded, descending from the altar slowly with the massive Black Giant Bear, its back lined with sharp bone spurs.
Then Fiorina turned to the last girl, with purple long hair, stunning looks, and an extremely serene presence: “Amitya, it’s your turn, good luck.”
“Mm.” The girl nodded lightly.
But just as the purple-haired girl was stepping onto the altar, crossing paths with the blonde girl, a trace of reluctance flashed in the blonde girl’s eyes, yet she still whispered in a very soft voice.
“Amitya, don’t choose the Phantom Beast that resonates with you. Remember, push forward at all costs, find it, find that Divine Position Beast that makes all King-level and Emperor-level Phantom Beasts dread and revere, desperately wanting to flee the Phantom Beast World, and contract it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1834: 676: He Wasn't Treated as Human, the King's Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 1834: Chapter 676: He Wasn’t Treated as Human, the King’s Arrival
“These creatures’ bodies can shift between energy and physical form, some of them can become intangible.”
“This should be ‘meridians’, the pathways for energy circulation, unlike the rune networks engraved deep within the muscle cells of the mythical world.”
“But what are those fleeting Mental Fluctuations about? They seem to involve Summoning?”
On the Red Planet, Jack Clark holds a several hundred meters long horn in his hand, his gaze thoughtful as he looks forward.
In his hand, the base of the forcibly torn horn, along with the remaining flesh and blood, emits a White Light while scattering energy little by little.
At the same time, lying at Jack Clark’s feet is the corpse of a white Giant Beast, ten thousand meters in length and with double wings.
This Giant Beast is all broken armor, its head collapsed to one side and many places where flesh and blood were smashed and burst by terrifying strength, exposing the organs inside.
And not just this one, on the shattered Earth lie the corpses of more than ten giant beasts, each several thousand meters long.
As for why he burst these Giant Beasts, of course, these creatures were seeking their own death.
Earlier Jack Clark leapt from another planet, and his landing on the surface created a meteor crater thousands of kilometers wide, which disturbed the strongest Giant Beast on this planet.
Then this Giant Beast, ten thousand meters in size and comparable to the Peak of the Ancient, led a group of Giant Beasts in attack.
As a result, it was directly burst by a punch from Jack Clark, the winds from his punch tearing the planet’s atmosphere apart and scattering the remaining Mythical Giant Beasts.
But just as Jack Clark was tearing apart the body of the Giant Beast, preparing to study the physical structure of these creatures, he keenly sensed a faint Mental Fluctuation.
A thousand miles away, under a Giant Beast swept away by his punch, a thirty-two-pointed blue Starlight Formation Array appeared out of nowhere.
The five hundred meter long Giant Beast, engulfed by the Starlight Formation Array, not only did not resist but roared excitedly, its body becoming luminescent, quickly shrinking to twenty meters.
This change surprised Jack Clark.
Because he noticed that after the Giant Beast shrank, its strength and level also fell, as if it had regressed to its juvenile phase, enveloped by the Array’s light as it flew towards the Gold-Blue World.
Jack Clark’s eyes gleamed as he watched this scene.
Boom!
A sonic boom roars, Jack Clark’s figure blinking as he crosses thousands of kilometers at thousands of times the speed of sound, a plasma light trail of ten thousand meters forming around his body from the intense friction.
Roar roar roar!!
Seeing the suddenly appearing black-haired young man, the ruins of the shattered mountain ranges, those Giant Beasts measuring hundreds to over a thousand meters long let out terrified roars.
“Shut up.”
Boom! The Earth trembles, smoke and dust billowing.
As Jack Clark presses down with his hand, all the Giant Beasts suddenly sink, their surroundings forming a huge palm impression one thousand kilometers in diameter and hundreds of meters deep.
Though it involves transcendent strength governed by rules and regulations, and talents and Divine Powers cannot be used, Jack Clark’s understanding and control over strength means that even using mere physical strength, his performance is akin to that of a Demon God.
After suppressing all the Giant Beasts with one palm, under Jack Clark’s calm observation, that blue Starlight Formation Array appears again under a flying giant beast with wings spanning over eight hundred meters.
Beyond this, there are faint Mental Fluctuations, seeming to be communicating with that Giant Beast.
Chirp! That Giant Beast emits an excited chirp, seemingly eager.
At the same time, Jack Clark sees more clearly, a somewhat complex micro starlight mark shining at the brow of the flying giant beast aligning with the Starlight Formation Array beneath it.
“That thing, it should be a Summoning contract.”
Jack Clark’s eyes narrow, watching as the flying giant beast undergoes metamorphosis under the Array’s light, shrinking and finally disappearing: “Perhaps, I can use that Summoning array to enter.”
Jack Clark’s intention of course is not to become a summoned beast, but rather to directly decipher and inverse-summon through that Starlight Array.
As he approaches the Gold-Blue World, the repelling force around Jack Clark grows stronger.
This rejection isn’t because he’s been discovered as a stowaway, but because his essence is too powerful and is instinctively repelled by that Gold-Blue World.
Including those Giant Beasts residing on the Red Planet, their immense power confines them to outer space.
Although by now, Jack Clark revealing his True Demon God Body and bursting with power could forcibly descend, tearing through the world’s barrier to enter the Gold-Blue World.
But doing so would mean either grabbing whatever he can and fleeing or, like Boroedo and the others, being suppressed.
Planning a long-term approach, Jack Clark naturally wouldn’t choose to do it that way.
Next, under Jack Clark’s watch, the Starlight Array appears three more times, each time establishing a contract with a Giant Beast, pulling them into that world.
Then Jack Clark realizes, he doesn’t understand.
The Starlight Array is too simple, just nine circles inside and outside and a dozen straight lines forming a pattern without any singular runes containing certain powers, nor forming complex Rune Sequence Chains.
If it wasn’t for the ability to reverse Space-Time to pull away those Giant Beasts, Jack Clark almost thought it was just an ordinary drawing.
“Troublesome, this Starlight Array isn’t an ‘Array’ in the strict sense, it should be considered a key activated by certain power, impossible to decipher inversely.” Jack Clark frowns slightly, hesitation showing in his eyes.
He hesitates whether or not to open the Void Death Pupil to directly perceive the essence of the world, as only thus could he be sure to completely see through the true nature of that array.
But doing so might ‘expose’ him.
Zhoom! At this moment, under a terrifying black Explosive Bear, measuring over a thousand meters in length, a massive blue Starlight Array emerges, flashing bright light.
Simultaneously, a stronger Mental Fluctuation appears, briefly communicating with the Explosive Bear before its direction turns and unexpectedly extends towards Jack Clark.

chapters.title: Chapter 1835: 676: He Wasn't Treated as Human, the King's Arrival_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1835: Chapter 676: He Wasn’t Treated as Human, the King’s Arrival_2
However, that ‘weak’ Mental Fluctuation could not advance any further after approaching within a hundred kilometers of Jack Clark.
Within the perception of that Mental Fluctuation, there seemed to be a pitch-black Black Hole ahead, devouring everything, emitting a terrifying suppression that caused the surrounding Giant Beasts to fear and dread.
At that moment, the Mental Fluctuation trembled slightly, vaguely transmitting a girl’s voice, tinged with a touch of faint pride.
“You, are you willing to follow Isabel and defeat the Evil God to save the world?”
“Scram!” Jack Clark’s brow twitched as his train of thought was interrupted, his voice indifferent, containing a formless shock, shattering that Mental Fluctuation directly.
With Jack Clark’s strength and status, not even a Primordial True Emperor had the right to make him follow.
And he was the ‘Evil God’, to fight against himself?
It seems that if he wants to enter that world right now, he still needs to rely on that Summoning power. Watching the Explosive Bear shrink to forty meters before disappearing amongst the starlight, Jack Clark pondered slightly.
Soon, under Jack Clark’s gaze, the seventh Starlight Array appeared, this time beneath a white Giant Beast that was over two thousand meters in length, resembling a Giant Dragon but with only two legs.
Along with it came a vast and pure Spirit Power, its intensity more than ten times greater than the fluctuation that tried to make Jack Clark follow, comparable in ‘intensity’ to a Ninth Heaven Expert.
Spirit Power so pure and resilient surprised even Jack Clark.
Spirit Power is neither the Divine Soul strength of Mythical Powerhouses nor the Power of Will of Eight Layer or Ninth Heaven Experts.
Without undergoing rule Tempering, without the condensation of the Power of Heaven and Earth, it was indeed surprising to reach such intensity.
Roar! The white Giant Beast’s eyes gleamed with excitement.
Finally, it could escape this terrifying place.
Thinking of this, the white Giant Beast looked reverently at Jack Clark, who was standing on a ‘small hill’ thousands of kilometers away.
In the eyes of these simple-minded Giant Beasts, Jack Clark, who could punch to death the king of the Phantom Beast World and those Emperor-level Phantom Beasts, was too terrifying.
He was an unmatched fierce god.
Just as the white Giant Beast was about to actively sign a contract, the Starlight Array beneath it stirred.
The Spirit Power ran away with the Starlight Array, and amid the baffled gazes of the restrained Phantom Beasts around, the thirty-thousand-meter-diameter Starlight Array stopped a hundred kilometers away from Jack Clark.
…
Valkyrie Academy
On the altar, the purple-haired girl’s eyes were tightly closed, her body surrounded by an astonishing Spirit Power, stirring gusts of wind and exuding an intimidating aura.
“Such strong Spiritual Power!”
“Worthy of being the one with the strongest Mental Talent this year.”
The students below were slightly restless, each looking enviously at the purple-haired girl on the altar.
This year’s strongest student in the Phantom God Series, Amitya, had reached SS Rank in Mental Talent, followed by S+ Rank Isabel.
According to past Summoning experiences, Amitya, with SS Rank talent, had a great chance to summon an Emperor-level beast, while S+ Rank talent Isabel was certain to summon a King-level Phantom Beast.
But this year, there was an anomaly; not only was the success rate of Phantom Beast summoning one hundred percent, but their quality was also very high.
Five King-level, one Emperor-level; what Rank of Phantom Beast will the more talented Amitya summon? Emperor Level, or above?
All eyes were filled with nervous anticipation, but at this moment, Amitya herself was somewhat bewildered.
Just like Isabel, in Amitya’s perception, the way forward was pitch dark, as if some terrifying presence lay in wait, blocking any further progress.
But here, she didn’t know what to do.
Since the Starlight Array had not appeared under the opponent’s feet, she could not directly communicate with that Divine Position Phantom Beast, nor could she clearly see what it looked like.
Moreover, Amitya’s intuition was telling her that there was danger ahead.
And that sense of danger was growing stronger, as if waiting any longer would bring about a terrifying threat.
This made Amitya hesitate because her intuition had been exceptionally accurate since childhood due to her Innate spiritual strength, helping her avoid dangers from the Outer World multiple times.
Clearly, summoning that Divine Position Phantom Beast would not be so simple.
But to give up…
Thinking of Isabel’s unwillingness in her eyes when she approached the altar, Amitya who had grown up with her couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
Boom! The air around the purple-haired girl vibrated, and a more enormous burst of Spirit Power erupted from her body.
The Spirit was so strong that it formed purple electric arcs around her, distorting reality and causing concentric shockwaves in the atmosphere.
“How is that possible, isn’t Amitya ranked SS in Mental Talent?”
The students below were in an uproar, incredulously staring at the altar where the purple-haired girl shone brightly, including a blonde girl who had already succeeded in summoning a Phantom Beast with Emperor-level potential.
“I knew it; this fellow still had strength hidden.”
On the High Platform, Fiorina frowned slightly as she looked at the girl with fluttering purple hair: “What did they discover that made Amitya unleash all her sealed Spirit Power?”
On the red planet, the Thirty-Two Starlight Array shone brightly.
In the midst of a mighty Mental Fluctuation almost comparable to Mythical-level, a purple girl’s ghostly figure condensed, turning illusion into reality and gaining a clear view of the Phantom Beast World.
In a world where both the sky and the Earth were red, huge craters dotted the landscape, and in the distance, massive Phantom Beasts looked on with eyes filled with fear and reverence.
“Humans!”
Just as Amitya ‘opened her eyes’ and saw the appearance of the Phantom Beast World for the first time, a voice tinged with faint surprise reached her ears, startling Amitya.

chapters.title: Chapter 1836: 676: He Wasn't Treated as Human, the King's Arrival_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1836: Chapter 676: He Wasn’t Treated as Human, the King’s Arrival_3
Following the voice, Amitya saw a young man with shoulder-length black hair slowly lowering his right hand at the edge of the Starlight Array.
Upon seeing the young man, and particularly his fair and slender palm in an instant, a sense of danger that shook the soul rose within Amitya’s heart.
Amitya had a premonition that if she had taken even one second longer to consolidate her spiritual projection, something would have gone wrong.
And the purple-haired girl was correct; just now, Jack Clark was ready to use a bit of Power of Will to intervene and seal off the array and Spirit Power.
Using the array and Spirit Power as ‘material’ to form a ‘garment’ should allow him to blend in.
That was another method Jack Clark thought of when he found that he could not decipher the summoning Formation.
And just mobilizing a wisp of weak Power of Will shouldn’t cause too intense a Rule reaction; the Bronze Bell should be able to block it.
But he hadn’t expected that the Spirit Power would actually condense into a ‘person’, which made Jack Clark subconsciously stop.
Because ‘human’ as a species is actually quite rare, currently, there is only the Human Federation of Blue Star, and an Ancient Civilization that carved out the Six Great Divine Domains tens of thousands of years ago.
Aside from those, in the mythical world, there are countless realms in the Endless World, though many species do share a resemblance to humans, only in partial aspects.
Females with a spiritual projection that nearly identically resembles a human, like the one before him, are almost nonexistent.
This was why Jack Clark subconsciously stopped. This world actually has humans?
Is the human race here one of the branches left behind by Ancient Civilization, similar to the Lost World where Sara Williams and others are from? Or is it another human civilization unrelated to Blue Star?
As Jack Clark pondered, Amitya was also somewhat bewildered.
The Divine Position Phantom Beast that so many Phantom Beasts feared and respected… was actually a human, or rather does a Phantom Beast evolve into its strongest form and become human!?
After hesitating for a moment, Amitya said nervously, “Hello, you.”
The purple-haired girl’s language was neither the language of Ancient Civilization nor any ‘foreign language’ Jack Clark knew, but he understood her through the Mental Fluctuation.
Jack Clark stood with his hands behind his back, his expression indifferent, his voice also carrying a faint Mental Fluctuation as he spoke: “What is your name, and what brings you here?”
She could speak, and it seemed she wasn’t very ferocious!
Taking a deep breath, Amitya replied with respect: “Honored and great King of Phantasmal Beasts, my name is Amitya, from the Valkyrie Academy’s Divine Phantasm Faculty.”
“According to the ancient agreement, our Divine Phantasm Faculty can open the altar to link to the Phantom Beast World, allowing students to form Summons contracts with certain Phantom Beasts.”
“Amitya has come here to seek a powerful Phantom Beast as a partner in the Phantom Beast World.”
Seeing the purple-haired girl nervously looking at him after finishing speaking, Jack Clark asked: “And then?”
“Then…” The purple-haired girl paused, thought for a moment, and said: “Then… I should join Isabel and others to fight the Labyrinth Demons.”
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a hint of amusement. He realized this girl with remarkable Mental Talent seemed a bit silly.
Looking at the young man with indifferent expression outside the Starlight Array, Amitya hesitated, thinking he wasn’t satisfied with her answer.
“Actually, I don’t like fighting. How about I make you delicious food every day?”
Alright, indeed a bit silly. Jack Clark shook his head inwardly.
When had he ever agreed to become her ‘Phantom Beast’?
And as a student of the Valkyrie Academy, summoning Phantom Beasts not to fight, but to cook delicious food for them every day, didn’t she find that weird?
Wait a minute, I was almost drawn into it.
Jack Clark suddenly came to his senses, realizing that in that instant, his thoughts had actually followed the girl’s words.
Suddenly, his eyes narrowed slightly, showing a hint of curiosity.
Having regained his bearings, he realized the girl’s Spirit Power or some kind of invisible mental power she possessed, actually affected him.
Even though he had sealed all his ‘strength’, it was enough to show that this girl was special.
This world, quite interesting.
At first glance, it appears ordinary, but it’s actually enticing otherworldly invaders and then suppressing them, the potential abundance of World Origin, and the newly emerged human civilization.
All these made Jack Clark increasingly curious about this world.
At that moment, the light from the Thirty-Two Starlight Array under the purple-haired girl dimmed, and her projection instantly twisted, becoming unstable.
“No good, the energy from the altar is running low,” Amitya exclaimed in shock, nervously looking towards Jack Clark outside the Starlight Array.
Looking at the flickering Starlight Array, Jack Clark remained calm, stating lightly: “I am not any kind of Phantom Beast, nor does anyone have the right to form a Summon contract with me.”
Amitya’s eyes showed regret.
I knew it, this is the legendary Divine Position Phantom Beast, which has never been bound by a contract with anyone.
But at that moment, Jack Clark’s tone shifted: “However, regarding that Labyrinth and its demons, I have an innate loathing and wish to destroy them all.”
Clearly, Jack Clark wasn’t going to be anyone’s Phantom Beast, but he didn’t want to miss the opportunity to enter the Gold-Blue World, so he casually found an excuse to give himself an out.
Suddenly, surprise filled the face of the recently disappointed purple-haired girl.
“Great King of Phantasmal Beasts, will you form a contract with Amitya!?”
Jack Clark stated indifferently: “As I said, no one is qualified to form a Summon contract with me, so the base terms of the contract must be amended.”
“Plus, I am not any ‘King of Phantom Beasts’.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1837: 676: He Wasn't Treated as Human, the King's Arrival_4
chapters.content:
Chapter 1837: Chapter 676: He Wasn’t Treated as Human, the King’s Arrival_4
“No problem, change whatever you like, great King of Phantasmal Beasts,” the purple-haired girl quickly nodded, dismissing the fact that Jack Clark was not the King of Phantasmal Beasts.
In the Phantom Beast World, revered and feared by those powerful Emperor Level and King-level Phantom Beasts, what is he if not the King of Phantasmal Beasts?
As for the Extraterrestrial Evil Gods, in the consciousness of the people of this world, all Evil Gods entering Cecilus World will be suppressed deep in the Earth.
Suppressed in the Evil God Palace.
Boom!
As Jack Clark stepped into the range of the Starlight Array, the already dim Array violently shook, as if a Giant Dragon suddenly barged into a small room.
The purple-haired girl facing Jack Clark, even though it was just a spiritual projection, felt a suffocating darkness envelop her world.
So powerful!
The purple-haired girl was somewhat nervous: “Great King of Phantasmal Beasts, this is the basic contract document for summoning phantom beasts, what would you like to alter?”
Between the girl and Jack Clark, a transparent golden scroll appeared.
This is the core of the Altar Array, which only appears when a Valkyrie Cadet initiates the altar, waiting for the cadet and the phantom beast’s Spirit Power to imprint on it to form a contract.
And this contract document, only Valkyrie Cadets have the authority to modify some of the basics.
Because previous Valkyrie Cadets, when encountering powerful phantom beasts they wanted to tame, would make promises like improving benefits.
In such cases, the contract naturally needs modification.
Including now.
“This rune that binds both parties from attacking each other, remove it.”
“This one, which requires strength to maintain, the contract space that stores the phantom beast, delete it…”
Jack Clark couldn’t make sense of the minimalistic lines of the Starlight Formation Array, but the contract document, full of mysterious rules, was all too clear to him at a glance.
Then came the modifications, deleting and trimming all conditions unfavorable to him.
Including changing the status of both parties from one of subordination to equality.
Of course, with Jack Clark’s understanding of ‘rules’, he could even alter the core of the contract document to enslave the purple-haired girl.
But as an existence comparable to the Primordial, Jack Clark naturally disdained to do so.
His current goal, because of the presence of ‘people’ in this world, had shifted from destruction and invasion to exploration, while also gathering the World Origin.
As for the likes of Boroedo, these Hell Messengers, he would see how things go.
Once all content was modified, the purple-haired girl, who didn’t realize she had just been turned from a slave status, looked at Jack Clark somewhat excitedly: “It’s done, let us seal the contract, great King of Phantasmal Beasts.”
Jack Clark, speechless, this girl when silent seemed gently elegant, like a refined lady, a goddess, but once she spoke, it was a complete change of style.
Seems even more naive than the Silver Giant Dragon Sissitia.
“…I told you, I am not some King of Phantasmal Beasts.” Jack Clark reminded once more.
The purple-haired girl nodded earnestly: “Okay, great King of Phantasmal Beasts.”
“…Fine, from now on, just call me Jack.” Jack Clark shook his head, giving up on correcting her thoughts, imprinting a faint trace of spirit on the contract document.
Valkyrie Academy.
Just at the moment Jack Clark and Amitya signed the contract, the altar’s light brightened immensely, emitting an extremely dazzling blue brilliance.
All eight towering stone pillars also lit up instantly.
“Eight, all eight Heaven Pillars are lit!”
“A god, the legendary Divine Position Phantom Beast.”
This scene instantly made all the students in the square widen their eyes in disbelief, including Fiorina who was presiding over the summoning ceremony.
Six Heaven Talent stone pillars represent king-level, seven lit up represent the summoned phantom beast’s potential reaching Emperor-level, but eight, that’s the mythical Divine Position Phantom Beast.
That is the terrifying phantom beast that can grow to its peak, capable of breaching the underground dungeon with its strength alone, and tearing apart Evil Gods.
“Amitya succeeded!” A blonde girl clenched her fist, somewhat begrudging yet excited.
Boom!
A heavenly blue column of light descended from the sky, piercing the void like a spilled galaxy, grandly landing on the Divine Phantasm Faculty’s Summoning Altar.
Amidst the flickering blue light, a figure with black shoulder-length hair and a straight frame appeared on the altar.
The spectacle once again stunned the Valkyrie students below, wondering what was going on. Wasn’t a powerful Divine Position Phantom Beast supposed to descend?
Bang Bang Bang!!
At that moment, in the square, the previously summoned King-level Potential and Emperor-level Potential phantom beasts all shuddered and collapsed to the ground in submission.
As if they were welcoming the supreme king’s arrival.
In addition, the powerful phantom beasts standing behind the senior Valkyrie Cadets also instinctively let out frightened growls and scratched the ground restlessly.
On the altar, looking at the descending Jack Clark, Amitya, pale-faced, smiled: “Wel, welcome, great Pha…”
Before she could finish, Amitya’s form slumped, about to fall over.
Summoning Jack Clark’s arrival, even though the contract rules had been modified, shifting the burden for maintaining his presence from Amitya to his own ‘stamina’.
But as the initiator of the contract, it still instantaneously depleted all of Amitya’s Spirit Power.
However, just at that moment, an arm appeared around the purple-haired girl’s waist, steadying her.
Whoosh!
A slight sound of breaking air, a red afterimage flashed, and the tall Fiorina appeared on the altar, looking solemnly at Jack Clark embracing Amitya.
“Amitya, are you alright? Who is he?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1838: 676: He Wasn't Treated as Human, the King's Arrival_5
chapters.content:
Chapter 1838: Chapter 676: He Wasn’t Treated as Human, the King’s Arrival_5
Emilia leaned weakly against Jack Clark, yet her eyes sparkled with a bright excitement, “Teacher, this is the King of the Phantasmal Beasts, Clark.”
The King of Phantasmal Beasts!
Fiorina took a deep breath, her eyes revealing shock; there stood before her a human-shaped Phantom Beast, and indeed it was the legendary Divine Position Phantom Beast.
Jack Clark sighed, “I’ve said before, I’m not the King of Phantasmal Beasts.”
“I know, great King of Phantasmal Beasts, your name is Clark.” The purple-haired girl in Jack’s arms nodded earnestly, showing she had remembered Jack Clark’s name.
Because she regarded Jack Clark as a ‘Phantom Beast,’ the purple-haired girl did not feel any shyness despite being held by him.
…Anyway, let’s not talk about this topic anymore.
Jack Clark shook his head, giving up on the topic completely, and nodded slightly to the red-haired woman in front of him, who exuded an aura rivaling that of a quasi-mythical being, his gaze sweeping the surroundings.
To the left lay endless dense forests, within which faint massive figures darted by.
To the right stood a Sky-touching Tree whose top disappeared into the clouds; from deep within that tree, Jack Clark felt tremendous Rule fluctuations. That tree was a manifestation of some of this world’s Rules.
A few kilometers ahead was a large complex of white buildings, where many beautiful women in magnificent battle armors or in skirts such as short skirts and princess dresses walked about.
Together with the beautiful girls in the square below, was this place all women?
Well, Valkyrie Cadets being all women made sense.
Observing the black-haired young man who was ‘curiously’ looking around, Fiorina suppressed the shock in her heart and politely said, “Mr. Callum, welcome to Cecil’s Great World.”
“Amitya’s Spirit Power has been exhausted; may we take her down to rest first?”
From the brief conversation between Jack Clark and Amitya, Fiorina keenly noticed that this Phantom Beast in human form did not like to continue being called a Phantom Beast, thus changed her address to ‘Mr.’
“Alright.” Jack Clark, unaware of these nuances, nodded.
With the signing of the contract, he had directly learned the language of this world through Amitya.
Just after greeting her, Fiorina’s figure flashed, and she leaped down from the several-hundred-meter-tall altar, landing solemnly before declaring.
“The events of today are of great importance to our Divine Phantasm Faculty. Until we have permission from the dean, no one is allowed to disclose any information, understood?”
“Yes, Teacher.”
This year’s Summoning Ceremony not only successfully summoned an Emperor-level Phantom Beast, but even a legendary Divine Position Phantom Beast made an appearance. Even without Fiorina’s reminder, the students knew the gravity of the situation.
“Alright, disperse now.”
“Isabel, you all go rest as well, connect with your Phantom Beasts, build rapport to increase your understanding, and meet me at the teachers’ building tomorrow.”
“Yes, Teacher.” The female students nodded and began to disperse.
As they left, the female students glanced at the black-haired young man on the altar holding Amitya, their eyes filled with curiosity.
Once all the students had left, Fiorina looked up at Jack Clark on the altar, seemingly ready to wait for him to come down before she would lead him and Amitya to the dormitory.
This left Jack Clark momentarily at a loss for words.
Clearly, Fiorina had no intention of coming up to carry the purple-haired girl away; instead, she waited for him to carry her down, they really didn’t regard him as a ‘person.’
Forget it, if you all don’t care, then I care even less.
With that thought, Jack Clark wrapped one arm around the purple-haired girl’s shoulders and one under her knees, gently lifting her up, then his figure blurred as he too leaped down.
Boom!
The Earth exploded within a hundred-meter radius under Jack Clark’s feet, countless rocks shooting out like cannonballs, creating a loud whistling noise that covered an area of over a thousand meters, their impact resounding impressively.
Watching as if a Giant Beast had stomped the ground, creating web-like cracks radiating hundreds of meters around, Fiorina’s eyes twitched involuntarily.
Truly the King of Phantasmal Beasts; even though on the surface he seemed human, his essence was still that of a ‘massive’ Phantom Beast!

chapters.title: Chapter 1839: 677: Henry's Tracks, Monsters Drop Equipment upon Death
chapters.content:
Chapter 1839: Chapter 677: Henry’s Tracks, Monsters Drop Equipment upon Death
“A humanoid Phantom Beast, named ‘Chu’.”
“Current initial strength is unknown, but estimated to be above nine stars.”
“When compared in strength to Fiorina, Dean of the Divine Phantasm Faculty, upon her first encounter with this Phantom Beast, she felt a strong sense of danger deep within her body, and an immediate impulse to flee.”
“This was an instinctual warning from her Innate Valkyrie battle body, indicating that the creature possesses far superior strength to hers and is incredibly dangerous.”
“Moreover, the moment the ‘Phantom Beast’ made its appearance, those with King-level Potential and Emperor Level Potential among the Phantom Beasts all bowed down in reverence, affirming its status as the King of Phantasmal Beasts without a doubt.”
“The life aura emitted by this Phantom Beast is vigorous and 99% similar to humans, the fluctuations presumably originating from the Contractor, Amitya, signifying a successful bond.”
“Additionally, when it entered the core area of the Institute, there was no reaction from the Calamity God Pearl of the Illusionary Divine Institute, eliminating the possibility of an extraterrestrial being’s invasion…”
In the spacious and simply furnished office, a woman with streaks of white in her hair carefully examined the documents in her hand, paying particular attention to the conclusions and remarks at the end.
Across from her, Fiorina, now dressed in a purple gown, sat comfortably in her chair, leisurely sipping a glass of red wine.
After a long while, Dean Carmen Lindon set the documents down, feeling somewhat astonished: “I didn’t expect such a big surprise from your Divine Phantasm Faculty this year.”
Fiorina rolled her eyes: “It seems like a surprise now, but it sure gave me a scare at the time.”
While saying this, Fiorina couldn’t help but cross her legs and lean back contently: “However, if this power can be cultivated properly, it should be able to breach the depths of the Evil God Palace in the labyrinth.”
“Haha… by then, my Illusionary Divine Institute will once again shake the continent, returning to its former glory.”
Watching the red-haired beauty, who couldn’t help but laugh and sweetly calculate the future, Carmen Lindon shook her head as a reminder: “It’s not that simple, Fiorina.”
“In the last two years, a large number of warriors have delved deep into the labyrinth. Even though the upper layers’ monsters have been cleared and the exploration reached the 55th layer underground, the casualties have been several times higher than in previous years.”
“Only cleared to the 55th layer…” Fiorina was somewhat astonished.
Carmen Lindon nodded gravely: “Correct, only to the 55th layer. The reason being that too many monsters breed in the depths of the labyrinth, and they seem endless.”
“Every time the main force of the exploration team returns to the surface, the area they cleared gets reoccupied by monsters, necessitating the reopening of these areas for exploration.”
“Therefore, I’m preparing to assemble an elite adventure team primarily composed of our Institute’s Valkyries and warriors to venture deep into the bottom of the labyrinth in one go.”
“We need to see what kind of creatures these Evil Gods lurking deep underground are like and what attributes their powers possess, to properly forge Valkyrie equipment.”
“It just so happens that this year’s Valkyrie Cadets from your Divine Phantasm Faculty have astonishing potential and will also join the exploration team.”
“This will not only train these students’ minds and accumulate combat experience against the labyrinth demons and underground monsters, but also facilitate the fast growth of those Phantom Beasts.”
“Okay,” Fiorina nodded.
“By the way, what is the King of the Phantom Beasts doing right now?”
“Reading books.”
“Reading books?” Carmen Lindon was taken aback.
……
In the library with its spiraling shelves, on the Second Layer, Jack Clark sits quietly in a corner; piles of books addressing a variety of subjects have formed a small hill next to him.
His goal, naturally, is to understand this world.
Presently, half a day since Jack Clark’s arrival, Amitya has slightly recovered her spirit, and, at Clark’s behest, led him to the library.
Even without employing his Divine Soul Intent, Jack Clark has a photographic memory, his eyes scanning like lasers.
According to the history of civilization, this is a Great Era named after Sesi, with human history traceable back more than 400,000 years.
This timeframe is even more ancient than the civilizations that emerged from the Blue Star World.
Before that time, this world had no humans, no civilization; it was dominated by innumerable immense creatures and pervaded by a rugged, primeval aura.
Until one day, the Eternal Heavenly God descended.
From that moment, humans appeared, and civilization evolved.
“Eternal, Henry!”
Jack Clark, holding a book one meter tall and 0.5 meters thick, squinted his eyes slightly, focusing on the blurred glyphs and images at the beginning of the book.
Back on the Road to Becoming a God, at its very end, he acquired the rudimentary rules left by Heng, one of the Monarchs of the Ancient Civilization, so the name Heng was particularly sensitive to Jack Clark.
Thus, when he saw that the source of this world’s civilization came from a deity named the Eternal Heavenly God, he subconsciously thought of the Ancient Monarch Heng.
And more than ten thousand years ago, this Ancient Monarch suddenly disappeared and was never seen again.
Coupled with the sudden appearance of humans in this world tens of thousands of years ago, all signs point to the Ancient Monarch Heng, the once strongest being of the ancient civilization.
As for the discrepancy between one disappearing over ten thousand years ago and the other that appeared for several hundred thousand years, it is easily explained by differing flows of time.
The flow of time in this world is dozens of times faster than in the mythical world.
Once he can verify this, Jack Clark is 80% confident in confirming whether the Eternal Heavenly God is Heng or not.
“I didn’t expect to find traces of Heng here,” Jack Clark revealed a slight smile on his face, and then scanned the books even faster.
Immediately, the fluttering sound of pages turning arose in the library.
Watching Jack Clark, who swiftly flipped through a book and quickly took up another, the purple-haired girl sitting opposite couldn’t help but show curiosity, wondering what he was searching for.
Of course, the fact that a ‘Phantom Beast’ wanted to read was already surprising, and it seemed quite normal that it couldn’t concentrate and merely flipped through the books for fun.
Ha… Amitya yawned, not having recovered much Spirit Power, and began to doze off, laying her head on the desk.
With Jack Clark’s ‘reading’ speed, he quickly went through hundreds of books and gained a complete understanding of this world.
Over 400,000 years ago, not long after the world was created by Opening the Heavens, the Eternal Heavenly God disappeared.
Guided by the Eternal Heavenly God, the first epoch of human civilization in this world quickly reached its peak, then moved towards destruction, even destroying the world itself.
Then humanity rebuilt civilization from the ruins. Through divisions and unions, they went through seven epochs and have now arrived at the current eighth epoch, the Valkyrie Epoch.
The current world is divided into three continents and nine oceans.
Yet of the three continents, only the Dongyun Continent belongs to the Human Race; around each World Tree, six great empires, dozens of kingdoms, and over a hundred duchies are established.
The remaining two continents and a multitude of islands in the seas are all occupied by monsters that have surged up from underground.
At the same time, the power system of this world is quite peculiar.
It is different from the usual sense of cultivation; strength comes entirely from divine gifts.
Slaying the Labyrinth Demons in the dungeons below could grant gifts from Heaven and Earth, grants of power, Transcendent Materials, upgrades in realm, including Divine Weapons.
Even slaying an Evil God could result in gaining a part of the Evil God’s authority, becoming a legendary warrior comparable to a powerful deity.
Simply put, it is like leveling up by monster slaying.
This game-like setting even left Jack Clark somewhat baffled.
However, the Chao Sea has nurtured countless worlds, countless civilizations and races, and innumerable strong beings; encountering one or two strange power systems can barely be accepted.
As for why it is called the Valkyrie Epoch, it is because the strongest beings in this world are all Valkyries.
Whether it’s due to the gifts from the heavens or some other reason, the warriors of this world can only grow up to Nine Stars at most, roughly corresponding to the Ninth Heavens.
Only girls with Special Talents can break through their shackles with the power of the Valkyrie and become a God Slayer above the Nine Stars.
They are also the main force against the dungeons underground and the Evil Gods deep beneath the earth’s surface.
At the same time, the lifespan of the people in this world is extremely short. Even the strongest Valkyries, capable of slaying Evil Gods, have only lived up to 150 years at most.
And those warriors at the Nine Star level, comparable to Ninth Heaven Cultivators, have lifespans that are generally around a hundred years.
The reason for this should be that their strength comes from gifts from Heaven and Earth, rather than their own step-by-step cultivation, breaking through physical shackles and life Evolution.
As for the World Origin Jack Clark was looking for, though he did not find any relevant information, having understood the structure of this world, he already had a good idea of where it might be.
The rewards from Heaven and Earth for slaying the demons of the dungeons, those items, Transcendent Materials, and equipment, are very likely all related to the World Origin.

chapters.title: Chapter 1840: 678: The Giant Beast Roars, Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary
chapters.content:
Chapter 1840: Chapter 678: The Giant Beast Roars, Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary
The trace of Henry, who has been missing for many years in the Six Great Divine Domains, has unexpectedly appeared, which indeed surprised Jack Clark.
This signifies that the strongest warrior of the Human Race in the Divine Realm might not have fallen yet.
However, these matters are of no importance to Jack Clark. What is important is that he has found the ‘Origin’ of this world, and the next step is to figure out how to collect it.
And let him breakthrough to the Pinnacle of True Spirit in one go, breaking through the Primordial.
Jack Clark puts down the gold-rimmed book in his hand and looks at the purple-haired girl opposite him, slowly saying: “Amitya, let’s go underground to kill some demonic beings.”
“Enter the underground labyrinth,” the girl with purple hair is startled.
“Exactly.”
Jack Clark nods: “As a Contractor, I feel it’s my duty to help you grow quickly and become the strongest Valkyrie.”
The sudden shift in the conversation confuses Amitya, whose Spirit Power has not yet recovered, and besides, didn’t they agree not to fight when they signed the contract?
“…But Jack, the talent strength I have accumulated so far is insufficient to enter the Valkyrie form; my power is only equivalent to that of an ordinary Three-Star Warrior.”
“It’s fine, once we get to the labyrinth, killing more demonic beings will give you the talent strength,” Jack Clark reassures.
Jack Clark’s ability to easily enter this world and not be rejected by the rules of this world relies on the contract with Amitya.
Jack Clark can clearly sense that there is a layer similar to an Enchantment of contract power covering his body, with a strength roughly relative to the Ninth Heavens.
As long as his strength does not exceed the limit of the contract Enchantment, he will not be ‘discovered.’
Furthermore, in the future, as Amitya’s strength improves, the contract’s endurance limit will also rise, serving as Jack Clark’s anchor in this world.
This is also the reason why Jack Clark is preparing to take her to the underground labyrinth for ‘leveling up.’
By the way, to verify his recent speculation.
…
“We need an armor-clad warrior, Three-Star strength is fine, just someone who can bear a heavy shield and stand in front.”
“The Swamp Crocodile Team needs two warriors with ordinary strength, mainly to help with moving supplies.”
“Sacks Adventurer Team is recruiting; this time our target is an elite Demon that appeared on the nineteenth floor underground, only requiring strength of four stars or higher…”
In the towering World Tree Plaza, extending hundreds of thousands of meters high, countless figures carrying weapons are bustling and shouting loudly.
At the same time, shops on both sides of the plaza are filled, selling weapons, armor, daily necessities, and medicines, where the liveliest places are the taverns and restaurants.
Walking on the ‘street’ that is ten thousand meters wide, Jack Clark takes an interested look around at the spectacle.
Compared to the Logistics City of the Human Race, which was fraught with urgency back then, this world, although it faces the invasion of Evil Gods, has a more relaxed atmosphere overall, creating a feeling of an adventure in a different world.
By Jack Clark’s side, the tall, high-heeled figure of the purple-haired girl, measuring about one hundred seventy-five centimeters, asks, “Jack, are we just going in directly without any preparation?”
Jack Clark glances at the girl and replies indifferently, “Do you think we need to prepare anything?”
…The purple-haired girl falls silent.
Well, considering Jack Clark’s terrifying strength, ignoring the Phantom Beast contract rules and not reverting to his original form after arriving, Amitya feels even Evil Gods might not necessarily be his match.
The entrance to the underground labyrinth is at the root of the World Tree, resembling a thousand-meter-high Stone Gate imprinted on the tree trunk, with a large number of warriors constantly coming in and out.
Those unaware might even think it’s a cave tourist attraction.
But as Jack Clark follows Amitya into the grey Stone Gate, he keenly senses they have passed through a layer of the world’s barrier.
In the ‘narrow’ pathway, one kilometer wide, a group of more than twenty people includes a young man with golden hair in glittering silver battle armor whose eyes suddenly light up.
Just as this young man is captivated by the breathtakingly beautiful and serene purple-haired girl and is about to approach her, someone suddenly grabs his shoulder.
The burly man with a bearded face and a formidable build whispers lowly, “David, what are you doing?”
The handsome blond young man turns around and explains, “Nothing much. I was just thinking of asking those two if they want to join us.”
“The pathways in the underground labyrinth are extensive and crisscrossed, and there are many demonic beings. It’s safer to descend in larger numbers.”
The burly man looks grave and whispers, “I don’t care what you really think, but don’t provoke those two people. We can’t afford to mess with them.”
“Remember, apart from demonic beings, also be cautious of solo travelers and women in the underground labyrinth. Do not recklessly provoke teams with just one or two people.”
“You know the dangers of the underground labyrinth, and if they dare to enter under these circumstances, they are either fools or extremely bold and skilled.”
“For instance, that girl only seems to have the strength of a Three-Star, but the young man beside her gives me an unfathomable feeling, very dangerous.”
The blond young man is startled: “That powerful? But brother, you’re a Seven-Star Warrior.”
The burly man replies coolly, “Seven-Star, it sounds strong, but in the eyes of those true strong men, we’re no different from the demonic beings that can be squashed with one hand.”
“Alright, let’s keep moving. If you want to get stronger, you have to fight hard.”
“Jack, what are you looking at?” Amitya asks, seeing Jack Clark suddenly stop.
Jack Clark shakes his head slightly, “Nothing, just suddenly felt that no matter where you are, the fools are always in the minority.”
…The girl’s face shows bewilderment.
She does not understand how this relates to his sudden stop.
Continuing down the slightly dimly lit path that runs downwards, after traveling almost ten kilometers, Jack Clark sees a view change in front of him. Ahead, the Earth forms a cliff a thousand meters high due to a fault line.
Below the cliff is a depressed basin extending over tens of kilometers, with caves of various sizes beneath the surrounding cliffs.
These caves, small being about a dozen meters and large being dozens or hundreds of meters, lead to the Second Layer of the labyrinth, with different adventurer teams heading toward different entrances here.

chapters.title: Chapter 1841: 678: The Giant Beast Roars, Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary - Part 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1841: Chapter 678: The Giant Beast Roars, Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary – Part 2
After years of sweeping and cleaning, a large number of warriors have come and gone, and almost no demons can be seen on the nearly ten layers close to the surface of the underground labyrinth.
At the same time, with each descending layer of the underground labyrinth, the ‘space’ increases tenfold, resembling an inverted pyramid world, and the suppressive power against darkness also grows stronger.
Twelfth underground layer.
In the dimly lit corridors hundreds of meters high, a demon resembling a wolf, over twenty meters long and covered in sharp spikes, slowly emerged from a dark corner, issuing a fierce growl.
Its blood-red eyes fixed on Jack Clark and Amitya, filled with bloodthirsty savagery.
“After such a long trek, we finally found a demon,”
Jack Clark sighed, then cheered on the purple-haired girl: “Go on, Amitya, start your greatest Valkyrie legend by taking down this demon.”
“…Me.”
Amitya looked bewildered. As a Valkyrie of the Phantom God Series, shouldn’t it be her partner (Phantom Beast) who faced the evil demon?
Most importantly, as a student of the Phantom God Series, without having awakened the Valkyrie Power, she had no real combat strength apart from her strong spirit power, even weaker than a typical Three-Star Warrior.
Roar! The Spiked Demon Wolf growled ferociously, looking undervalued by the two humans, and a Power Explosion erupted under its feet.
Boom!
The explosive roar thundered in the underground corridor, and the massive demon wolf, like a shadow, burst forth with speed comparable to a Fifth Layer Heaven Cultivator, appearing above the heads of Jack Clark and his companion in an instant.
“Be careful,” Amitya exclaimed, her eyes sparking with purple electrical arcs, her hair wildly fluttering.
Boom!
Amitya’s immense spirit power erupted, shaking the atmosphere, instantly compressing the surrounding air and forming rings of white wave.
The explosive air pressure, like a Tsunami, made the corridor shake, and the black demon wolf screamed in agony as if struck by a ten-thousand-ton heavy hammer, its flesh and blood exploding as it flew backward hundreds of meters.
In the instant when the corpse of the Fourth Layer, agile demon wolf landed, Jack Clark keenly noticed a faint fluctuation of rules flash by.
Following that, in front of the demon wolf’s corpse, a one-meter-large black iron shield appeared out of thin air.
At the same time, above Amitya’s head, a faint, nearly imperceptible white power spontaneously appeared and melded into her body, disappearing somewhere on her back.
Above Jack Clark’s head, a faint, hardly discernible white power also appeared out of nowhere.
This ‘invisible’ white power is God-given power that descends from Heaven and Earth after the people of this world slay demons, to be used to enhance the body and strengthen one’s power.
It can also elevate the level and realm after accumulating to a certain extent.
Sensing that thread of white power inside him, a smile emerged on Jack Clark’s face, confirming his speculation—God-given power was indeed the World Origin.
Whoosh! With a slight flicker, Jack Clark moved to the burst black iron shield, picking it up.
Then, under Amitya’s gaze, Jack Clark applied a slight force with his hand, and the black shield, comparable to alloy, shattered into a heap of scrap iron on the ground.
A look of regret appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
The black iron shield was also equipment condensed out of thin air by the transformation of the World Origin, but after crushing it, Jack Clark discovered it was just ordinary steel material.
Even if he returned to the origin, all he got was a bit of energy.
As for that bit of World Origin, it had completely disappeared in the basic rules of this world, a method of energy transformation that even made Jack Clark take notice.
No wonder it was said to have broken through the Primordial Seventh Heavens, an eternally indestructible existence.
Jack Clark turned around, looking at the purple-haired girl who seemed a bit weak after unleashing her spirit power, his handsome and beautiful face breaking into a broad smile.
“I suddenly find these Labyrinth Demons quite interesting; let’s continue.”
Saying this, Jack Clark’s right foot lifted slightly and stomped down hard.
Boom!
The entire underground labyrinth shook, the Earth split open, and the corridor collapsed, forming a pathway several thousand meters across and hundreds of kilometers deep, leading directly to the deeper underground levels.
As massive rocks tumbled down, amid a cloud of dust, Jack Clark descended from the sky with the purple-haired girl, directly appearing on the nineteenth layer of the labyrinth.
Roar roar roar!!
On the prairie with weeds several meters tall, hundreds of black-skinned, dog-headed creatures, each three meters tall and holding a stone pillar, roared savagely.
All these dog-headed demons radiated energy fluctuations comparable to the Fifth Layer, their eyes blood-red as they swarmed towards the ‘sky-born’ duo.
The purple-haired girl in Jack Clark’s arms exclaimed, “Be careful, Clark, these dog-headed demons’ teeth are very sharp, capable of piercing dragon skin, very dangerous.”
“Dangerous, but only to others,” Jack Clark spoke lightly, extending his hand and lightly pressing forward.
Boom!
Under billions of times of low-frequency vibrations in an instant, the space within a ten-kilometer radius vibrated, turning all rock, dirt, and matter into dust.
Simultaneously, hundreds of dog-headed demons were annihilated instantly, and a bunch of black Crystal Stones, a few pieces of metal, a dozen breastplates, shoulder guards, and two long knives rained down.
As equipment exploded all around, a large amount of God-given power appeared above both Jack Clark and Amitya.
As these energies melded into their bodies, Jack Clark saw a row of transparent text appear before his eyes, visible only to him, “Detected massive World Origin, convert to Origin Points?”
Jack Clark’s eyes flickered, and a thought resonated in his mind: “Convert.”
Soundlessly, the God-given power in Jack Clark’s body transformed into another type of energy, and on the transparent attribute page, the originally zero Origin Points jumped and changed to 11.
This harvest, even for Jack Clark, made him catch his breath, a terrifying murderous intent subtly emanating from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1842: 678: The Giant Beast Roars, Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary - Part 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1842: Chapter 678: The Giant Beast Roars, Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary – Part 3
Because the rewards for slaying these demons are too many.
Previously, when Jack Clark participated in the Plane war, slaying thousands of demonized followers from the Abyss Demons of the Sixth-level Heaven only amounted to one Origin, converting into ten Origin Points.
Slaying one Abyss Great Demon King grants thirty Origins, which can be converted into more than 300 Origin Points.
And now, just by wiping out over four hundred Labyrinth Demons, equivalent to the Fifth Tier, from the underground dungeon maze, the rewards from this world are already comparable to one Origin.
It’s tens to hundreds of times more than slaying the same demon creatures from the Supreme Abyss Plane.
That is to say, if Jack Clark slays a demon king with Mythical-level strength, he can directly receive rewards of hundreds of Origins, and slaying one with the strength of a Titan would earn at least thousands.
This reward is already comparable to slaying a True Spirit Ancient God of the Abyss Plane.
What made Jack Clark almost catch his breath is the fact that the Evil God Palace underground of this world remains indestructible, and the dungeon maze demons will endlessly regenerate.
These demons emerge from the dispersion of power from those Evil Gods under the operation of World Rules; slaying these demons is equivalent to weakening the Evil Gods.
Then when the Evil Gods are weakened to a certain point, the warriors grown from slaying demons will enter the dungeon and kill the Evil God.
This is an unsolvable vicious cycle.
Boom!
The Earth collapses under one punch from Jack Clark, forming a fist imprint tens of kilometers in diameter.
Then a powerful explosion erupts, like a nuclear explosion, the Destructive Impact stirs and shatters everything within hundreds of kilometers and all the demons within that range explode into pieces.
Such massive movements instantly startled the warriors from the thirty layers above and below the maze, not knowing what happened below.
In the midst of rising smoke and dust, Jack Clark stands coldly on a giant rock, holding a purple-haired girl, with his black hair moving without wind, like a World-Destroying Demon King.
“Wow, so powerful!” the purple-haired girl gets a bit excited.
As Jack Clark continues his strikes, massively wiping out the maze demons, Amitya as the summoner could clearly feel her power increasing.
Especially the God-given power inside her, which has already met the requirements for advancing to the four stars.
Even due to the excessive energy entering her body, she feels it’s about to overflow, making Amitya involuntarily raise her head: “Jack, I feel like I’m about to advance to four stars, awakening the Valkyrie Power.”
“No rush, let’s continue to delve deeper, to check the situation with the underground maze demons.”
Boom! Holding the purple-haired girl, Jack Clark directly crashes the Earth, creating a pathway thousands of meters deep, forcibly entering the forty-seventh layer of the dungeon maze.
Hisss! Magma flows and toxic smoke fills the underground, where tens of thousands of demons living in the lava look up.
But before they could react, they were already smashed under a terrifying shockwave of force, even the flat layers within thousands of kilometers were shattered by Jack Clark’s one punch.
Yet, this range was just the tip of the iceberg compared to the vast and astonishing forty-seventh layer of the maze.
Huff, huff!!
Jack Clark’s long hair flails wildly, with massive amounts of God-given power pouring in, the rewards from millions of demons equivalent to the Second Tier, directly converting into more than 1,000 Origin Points.
Together with the accumulated rewards from previously breaking through over thirty layers of the maze and slaughtering numerous demons.
In just half an hour, Jack Clark has harvested over 10,000 Origin Points, equivalent to the gains from slaying an Ancient True Spirit God in the Plane Battlefield.
Such astonishing gains, even Jack Clark’s eyes are slightly red. “This world is completely a treasury of Origins.”
And these Origins come from those alien Evil Gods, from those Hell Plane Messengers and Abyssal Great Demons of the Supreme Abyss Plane who want to invade this world.
This is a world that even hunts the powers of the Supreme Plane.
Or maybe the purpose of this world’s existence is to secretly, through those Hell Messengers, agents, gather the powers of the Supreme Plane.
For some unknown reason, ‘Henry’ disappeared not long after he transformed this world.
Because ‘no one’ was collecting it, with hundreds of thousands of years of hunting alien Evil Gods, the Origins accumulated in this world are so many that they can grant countless ordinary people Transcendent Power and easily condense equipment.
And due to the special reason of the strength system, this granted power does not disappear; it returns to the world after the warriors die and fall.
In such a cycle, the accumulated Origins are so numerous that even Jack Clark feels somewhat insane.
If these Origins could be ‘taken away’, not to mention breaking through the Primordial, it’s even enough for him and the Emperor Dragon to instantly condense the Triplex Heavenly Boundary, directly becoming the Monarch of the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary.
Roar!
The Mythical World, which has grown to ten million meters in length, like a mountain range stretching for thousands of kilometers, suddenly opens its eyes and lets out a thunderous, deep roar.
Immediately after, its massive body moves with a thunderous motion, slowly standing up, the invisible power causing this World to intensely shiver, its might overwhelming.
“Roar! Tim Abott, have you broken through?”
On the head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, enveloped in a murky light orb in a state of bloodline purification, the Silver Giant Dragon is also awakened.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon’s mouth opens slightly, emitting a scorching red light, its deep and sonorous voice shakes Space-Time: “Not completely through yet, but I’m planning to change a place to sleep.”
At this moment, the Primordial True Body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon has already completed transformation, and the second Lifeline Talent has also finished framework restructuring, having passed the most dangerous period.
Therefore, it doesn’t matter whether it stays in the Mythical World or not.
The most important thing is that the matter on Jack Clark’s side is significant, and he is determined to obtain the Origins contained in that world.
So, he plans to let the real body of the Emperor Dragon tear through Space-Time to go there. If normal means are insufficient, then he will directly use absolute strength to tear apart the entire world, Devouring everything.
The temptation to break through the Primordial Triplex Heaven in one go is so great that even Jack Clark himself is driven crazy by it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1843: 679: The Endless Great War, The Sealed Existence
chapters.content:
Chapter 1843: Chapter 679: The Endless Great War, The Sealed Existence
The Black-red Colossal Beast, measuring ten thousand kilometers long and surrounded by a spectrum of radiant lights, soared into the sky, causing a powerful fluctuation of strength. In an instant, the Heavenly Energy within a radius of several billion kilometers erupted.
From afar, it resembled a multicolored star traversing the horizon, its dazzling brilliance and terrifying aura causing countless beasts to tremble on their limbs and kneel to the ground.
At this moment, aside from a few True Spirit Level beasts and different races’ strong men, all living beings were unable to lift their heads or gaze directly under the imposing pressure of that Primordial ascension.
“That Primordial Beast has finally left.”
“What a terrifying aura, is this the power of the Primordial…”
Under the illumination of starlight, a few beasts and different races, radiating the air of the Primordial, watched with solemn expressions and horror as the multicolored star flew higher and higher.
Meanwhile, in the Void Heaven Dragon Race’s world, located between the mythical world’s Boundary Wall and the Chaos, the Purple Proliferation Dragon, as large as a Star System, slightly bowed its head, its enormous vertical pupils revealing a faint astonishment.
It seemed that the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s speed of breaking through the Primordial was a bit too fast.
It truly was its descendant. Mistakingly believing that the Terminal Emperor Dragon was a descendant of the mythical world, the Silver Divine Dragon felt emotions stirring within.
Just as the Terminal Emperor Dragon ascended millions of kilometers in the blink of an eye, about to tear through the mythical world’s Firmament into the Chaos Outside Heaven,
Boom!
The will of the Terminal Emperor Dragon shook tremendously, and a terrifying will from the depths of the mythical world appeared, a mere wisp of it making the dragon feel it could not bear it.
Amidst the vague will, the Terminal Emperor Dragon faintly saw a giant shadow of a Black Colossus, too vast to describe, slightly opening its mouth towards it.
Instantly, the will of the Terminal Emperor Dragon shook again, and a tremendous influx of information entered its mind, transforming into a directional map of the Chaos Void.
The map radiated out in a fan-shaped pattern deep into the Chao Sea, centered around the flickering node of the mythical world.
There was also a will carrying a faint warmth, instructing the Terminal Emperor Dragon to collect ‘its’ fragments in that area and bring them back for a substantial reward of Eternal Air.
Besides, tearing and slaying those Primordial subordinates under the Abyssal Chaos King would also yield rewards from ‘it’.
This is an eternal war that has continued for a million years, and this war is still not over.
When the mythical world ‘awakens’ or when the Abyssal Chaos King returns, both sides will again ignite the eternal war, never ceasing until one side is utterly fallen.
Once that vague will receded, the gaze of the Terminal Emperor Dragon also returned to clarity, its eyes flickering with black and blood-colored lightning, revealing a faint surprise.
“There’s actually a map.”
But this is normal, the Chaos Void is so vast, without a map, how would those Primordial Beasts locate and find those World Fragments shattered in the eternal war?
Also, within that information, the Terminal Emperor Dragon saw the true ‘purpose’ of the Eternal Air, which is an indestructible will.
When life breaks through to the Seventh Primal Heaven Realm, the True Body will exist eternally, undying even if the Soul Will is worn down, shining gloriously forever.
And reaching the Eighth Primal Heaven Realm means an immortal will, an endless cycle of rebirth.
At this state, it’s practically immortal; even a presence from the Ninth Primal Heaven Realm cannot annihilate it, only suppress and seal it.
Even for those at the Eternal Level, to erase a Primordial Beast from the Eighth Heaven Realm would take a monumental price, completely obliterating mutually synchronized Eternal Will.
Including that eternally existing True Body, it too would require the consumption of an equivalent Eternal Origin to erode it.
As long as the eternal True Body exists, after hundreds of millions of years, the Primordial Beast might suddenly return and resurrect.
This is also why creatures like the Purple Glow Divine Dragon value the Eternal Air so much.
It not only enhances cultivation and strength, but most importantly, it allows the will to be tainted with the undying trait so that there is hope for resurrection even if slain by a True Emperor Level Ferocious Beast.
Of course, if unlucky enough to encounter an Undying Giant Beast from the Seventh Heaven Realm, one would still die.
Although the temptation of Eternal Air is great, for the Terminal Emperor Dragon at present, those batches of World Origin are more important.
Roar!
The Terminal Emperor Dragon, spanning ten thousand kilometers, tears through the Boundary Wall, howls to the sky, and turns to look at the Silver Divine Dragon encircling the Void Heavenly Dragon World, letting out a low growl.
“Purple Proliferation Supreme, I entrust Miss Joseline to your care, as I have matters that require my departure.”
…The Silver Divine Dragon pauses and then slowly nods, watching as the grim and vast Black-red Colossal Beast rips through space-time and disappears.
And just as the Terminal Emperor Dragon follows the connection with Jack Clark, tearing through space-time, rushing towards the coordinates of the Chaos in Cecil’s Great World—
In the Evil God Palace underneath the ninety-ninth level labyrinth of Cecil’s Great World, Boroedo sits high on his rugged throne, looking at the uninvited guests below.
In the palace, surrounded by dense Black Demonic Qi, with bat wings sprouting from his back, the demon respectfully speaks: “Selos, meeting the two revered Hell Envoys.”
Boroedo slightly bows his head, cold gaze in his three pairs of narrow white eyes: “An Abyssal creature dares to appear before us, aren’t you afraid of death?”
“Or do you think we can’t see that your true body is an Abyssal Great Demon?”
Only the early-Myth Abyssal Demon smiles slightly, appearing somewhat fierce and eerie.
“Naturally, I fear death, but currently, all of us are suppressed by this world; shouldn’t we cooperate to find a way to escape first?”
“Cooperate? Do you have a way to leave here?” In the dark corner, merged with the shadows, Mpolak’s voice is deep.
The Abyssal Demon’s tone is calm: “I have been suppressed in this world for tens of thousands of years, invaded the surface three times, killed countless Valkyries and warriors, and was called the Ancient Demon by people of the surface world.”
“By raiding the surface and plundering books and documents, I finally figured out the truth of this world.”
“Invading the surface and leaving through the Boundary Wall outside the surface is actually a deception; the real way out is deep in the world, right under our feet.”
“Under our feet, are you sure you’re not mistaken?” Boroedo narrows his three pairs of narrow eyes slightly.
The demon nods affirmatively: “Indeed, beneath our feet.”
“As suppressed Evil Gods, the deeper we go underground, into the depths of this world, the stronger the suppressive force we encounter, and the faster our strength dissipates.”
“The reason is that there’s an incredibly powerful ancient being suppressed in the depths of this world.”
“The will of this world does not want us to approach there, yet wants to extract our power, utilizing our ability to absorb power from the Supreme Plane to suppress that ancient being.”
“Unfortunately, when I discovered this secret, it was too late, only one-tenth of my power remained, making it impossible for me to reach the deepest part of the world and break the seal.”
“Therefore, I have been waiting for an opportunity to break the seal. By then, not only can we escape, but we might even completely destroy this world and plunder a great amount of World Origin.”
“How about it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1844: 680: The Taste of Childhood, What Is This Operation
chapters.content:
Chapter 1844: Chapter 680: The Taste of Childhood, What Is This Operation
On the rough throne, the massive Mountain Giant bowed its head, its eyes flickering as it looked down at the Abyssal Demon below, its voice deep and ice-cold.
“Our alliance is not urgent. Next time you come, we can talk again after you show some sincerity.”
Bang! With a squeeze in the virtual Void, the true body of that Abyssal Demon exploded instantly, turning into scattered flesh and blood raining down.
As the true body of the Abyssal Demon shattered, a terrifying will imbued with darkness and evil soared into the sky, disappearing into the depths of the Void in an instant.
Once that parasitic will dissipated, Boroedo looked at the wriggling flesh on the ground and turned his head toward the dark area.
“Mpolak, why did you have me kill ‘it’?”
The shadow writhed, coalescing into a towering, ferocious figure over two hundred meters tall that walked out slowly from the deep darkness of the Dungeon, its voice cold as ice: “Naturally, to probe its true nature.”
“After all, no matter if it’s the most ancient demon or the strong entity sealed deep in the world, it’s only based on its one-sided claims.”
Speaking of this, the pair of pitch-black empty pupils in Mpolak’s eyes slowly disappeared: “Did you notice just now? The will that escaped had a strange aura.”
“Although it definitely had the pressure of a True Spirit Level and reeked of the darkness and evil belonging to Abyssal Demons, the feeling it gave me was rather peculiar.”
“The abyssal aura on it, it’s too pure.”
“Had you not mentioned it, I wouldn’t have noticed this detail.”
Boroedo paused, thoughtfully: “The will did contain an intensely pure abyssal aura, like that of a true Abyssal Demon.”
As representatives of the abyssal will, it’s abnormal for an Abyssal Great Demon to contain such a pure dark demon air.
Just like these Hell Messengers, while these Abyssal Great Demons can harness the power of the Supreme Plane to invade and tear apart other world planes, they are not creatures of the Abyss themselves.
This means that the ‘fellow’ known as Selos is not an Abyssal Great Demon at all, but a true Abyssal Demon.
It might even be the sealed entity itself, attempting to lure them deeper underground with the plight of being ‘Evil Gods’ themselves to disrupt the Seal.
“Figure out a way to send a message to Darren Callum, who has already infiltrated, and see if he can dig up any information on the most ancient demons or Selos; probe the situation.”
Boroedo slowly nodded.
Although they had noticed something amiss with that Abyssal Demon, that it was hiding something, trying to scheme against them.
If Darren Callum were also to fail and get pinned down, unable to extricate himself, aligning with this sealed Abyssal Demon would become a fallback option.
While the two Evil Gods were in the depths of the Dungeon sending a message to Jack Clark, Jack Clark had already reached the ninetieth floor of the underground Labyrinth.
This place was entirely another plane, the sky gray and bleak with death, the ground parched and dotted with sinister white bones, devoid of any signs of life.
The clothing of Jack Clark and Amitya flapped and rustled in the fierce winds at the edge of the towering ten-thousand-meter clifftops.
Because the departure was hasty, Amitya was wearing a red and white long dress, which clung tightly to her body in the raging wind, revealing a charming figure with pronounced curves.
In addition, her serene demeanor and delicate features oddly filled with temptation amidst the oppressive darkness of this World.
There is a kind of ‘beauty’ that makes one want to tear it apart and trample it fiercely. The eyes of the demons hovering over the mountain peak castle more than ten kilometers away are ablaze with passion.
This is a dark lord towering a hundred meters high, with curved horns, cloven hooves, a tail, and a pair of tattered wings behind him. He is the ruler of this layer of the labyrinth.
Every ten levels, the underground labyrinth has a boss, and the deeper one goes, the stronger they become.
For example, this demon king, evolved from the labyrinth demons, exudes a pressure comparable to the early stages of mythical power. Every breath he takes is in harmony with the power of this dungeon, filled with a sense of oppression.
Looking at Jack Clark and his companion delving deep into the earth, the Ram-Horned Demon King reveals a ferocious smile: “After so many years, finally, adventurers have reached this place again.”
“Come on, human warriors, please your king with your weak and amusing attacks.”
“You have only one chance to strike, and after that, my counters will rip your limbs and twist your heads off, then hang them on the wall to dry for a thousand years.”
Just as the demon king finished speaking, Jack Clark keenly felt a force enveloping them and the demon king.
Once they take the first strike and fail to kill this demon king, they will be hit by a backlash from this ‘word spirit’-like power, resulting in the outcome described by the demon king.
Limbs torn apart, heads twisted off.
This ability is very bizarre and powerful, normally, warriors of the same rank or even Valkyries who can transform cannot withstand this attack.
No wonder it has been many years since anyone has ventured deep into the labyrinth.
Jack Clark, deep in thought, clenches his right fist and rotates his wrist, immediately causing a surge of Qi Blood that shakes the world to spread through his body. The invisible dissemination of power causes the entire layer of this world to wobble involently.
Boom boom boom!! Mountains around crumble thunderously, and the earth within a radius of hundreds to thousands of kilometers undulates like the sea surface, kicking up billowing smoke and dust.
The earth-shattering might instantly startles the Ram-Horned Demon King.
Boom!
Jack Clark throws a punch, shattering the space in front of him. The Unrivaled Domineering Power obliterates everything, forming a pitch-black pathway a thousand kilometers long and tens of kilometers wide.
The powerful shockwave creates a white wave, generating a hurricane that sweeps across Heaven and Earth with a tremendous roar, shaking mountains and seas.
As for the Ram-Horned Demon King, along with its castle and mountain peak, everything is reduced to dust and vanishes.
Even though Amitya has witnessed such scenes many times along the way, she still watches with tremoring heart and excited eyes at the towering figure before her.
So strong, so powerful!
The demon king, comparable to a newly transformed Valkyrie, is utterly obliterated by a single punch, leaving no bones or traces.
Experiencing the power of a God Demon for the first time, the purple-haired girl feels her legs going weak.
Jack Clark looks back at the excited Amitya and can’t help shaking his head. It’s just a labyrinth demon of the Legendary Realm, no need to get excited.
If it wasn’t for the world rules that sealed him, and the contract that restricted him to use only the ‘strength’ of a flesh and blood body within the Legendary Realm, not to mention the labyrinth, that punch just now could have even pierced through the World Crystal Wall.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s gaze shifts slightly, they’re coming.
