Phew! Jack Clark and the purple-haired girl found God-given powers appearing out of nowhere above their heads, continuously streaming into their bodies.
This power, after merging into Amitya’s body, gathered in a certain place as potential for further Evolution, somewhat similar to the Life Energy accumulated by the Terminal Emperor Dragon in its previous Evolutions.
But as soon as these energies entered Jack’s body, they instantly disappeared, transformed into stored Origin Points.
Looking at the attribute page, the Origin Points increased from 9784 to 10248, Jack revealed a faint smile on his face, the gains were about what he had expected.
The reward for slaying a mythical creature is roughly between thirty and forty Origin Points, dozens of times more than a normal Plane war.
Today, he just fought straight through the ninety floors of the dungeon, killing all the Labyrinth Demons he encountered, accumulating over ten thousand Origin Points, equating to one-fortieth of the Primal First Layer of Heavenly Realm.
And these Demons were just a very small part of the underground dungeon.
“Let’s go, Amitya, it’s time for us to head back.”
“…Jack, we’re not continuing further?” Amitya was taken aback, somewhat surprised.
Jack looked back and spoke lightly: “Let’s improve your strength when we get back. Your weakness is limiting the display of my power; I’m not confident I could crush the Demons on the ninety-ninth floor, let alone the stronger Evil Gods below.”
Amitya was Jack Clark’s Contractor, allowing him to anchor within the world, preventing his True Body from being suppressed and rejected by the rules due to its excessive strength.
Too weak, blame her. Amitya stuck out her tongue.
Of course, there is another reason Jack felt the gains weren’t substantial enough.
Through today’s test, Jack had not only confirmed God-given power as Origin but also keenly noticed loopholes in the power structure of this world.
In the judgment of World Rules, Jack is considered Amitya’s Contractor.
Therefore, the Demons he kills are all counted on her, and when rewards are distributed, the ‘loophole’ appears above her head, with God-given powers branching out a portion to Jack.
After hundreds of tests, Jack found this reward system to be very mechanical, lacking autonomous judgement functions.
Otherwise, it would have detected his anomalies at the first instance, realizing that with Amitya, a Three-Star Valkyrie’s power, it is impossible to kill Labyrinth Demon Kings of nine stars and above.
So Jack wanted to try something.
When Amitya awakens her Valkyrie Power, he would release a bit of his Seal power, tamper with the contract to switch their roles, placing himself in the lead.
Besides, he would adjust the proportion of distribution between them, like Jack taking ninety-nine percent, and Amitya getting one percent. That way, he would gain even more Origin, while Amitya wouldn’t lose out.
After all, without Jack power-leveling with her, there’s no way she could have made it to the depths of the dungeon by herself, just standing aside and shouting ‘666’ to earn a massive amount of God-given power.
…
By the time Jack Clark and Amitya stepped out from the Stone Gate, the sky had already darkened.
But the area around the World Tree was even more bustling, with plenty of vendors set up on both sides of the square shouting and selling various snacks, barbecue, and beer from all corners.
The heroes returning from their adventures set down their weapons and sat in groups, devouring meat and chugging beer enthusiastically.
Excitedly talking about how many Demons they’d chopped down today, what materials they got, energy crystals, and who was unlucky enough to get their chest ripped open by the leg-stabbing spider, drained of all their blood.
In the crowd, Amitya, with greasy hands holding green grilled skewers, said vaguely: “Jack, isn’t this stall’s rice fruit skewers delicious? ”
“Not bad.” Jack nodded, devouring the two green, succulent skewers in his hand.
Truth be told, this barbecue that looked like dark cuisine was indeed not bad, spicy and savory with the fragrance of dozens of fruits, more tempting than Jack’s stone slab barbecue.
At that moment, Amitya pointed towards a distant fire where a seven-meter long whole cow was being roasted: “The rice fruit skewers are just average here in the food square, but that place’s barbecue rainbow milk cow is really aromatic.”
As she spoke, the purple-haired girl couldn’t help licking her lips: “The meat of the rainbow milk cow is tender, and with the owner’s secret recipe, the moment you eat it, your taste buds instantly explode.”
“Plus, there’s that distinctive milky fragrance of the rainbow milk cow, which instantly transports one back to lying quietly in their mother’s arms as an infant, a sense of warmth and fulfillment.”
…What kind of flavor is that? Even Jack is a bit dumbfounded this time.
Forget the fruit barbecue from a moment ago, the one in front is still acceptable, but what is that milk-flavored barbecue beef?
And, just below their feet is a dungeon swarming with Demons, don’t the heroes who skirmish by day find it discordant to frolic here at night?
That’s when cheers came from afar, and the girl with shining eyes urged: “Jack, the rainbow milk cow is about ready, we should rush over, or there’ll be none left.”
“Alright, let’s have a taste.” Jack agreed nonchalantly.
Seems like ever since he took Sherry Williams to see Doris Clark, Jack hadn’t really eaten anything, either cultivating or undergoing Closed-door Cultivation.
Today could be seen as an indulgence for the palate, a chance to sample the cuisine of another world.
Of course, Jack would not admit he was a bit curious about the scent of that rainbow milk cow, one bite to recall the milky taste of childhood, yeah right…
About five hours later, after being led by the purple-haired girl around the square sampling the delicacies, Jack had nearly tried everything tasty there was.
Leaving from the other end, Amitya’s stomach was noticeably larger, appearing like a pregnant woman two months along, her face filled with contentment.
But this was just a brief moment of relaxation, as after eating their fill, they moved onto more serious matters.
Soon, Jack and the purple-haired girl returned to the Valkyrie Cadet campus.
Because the academy occupies a vast space, every Valkyrie student’s dwelling is an individual two-story small building, with a touch of Western Medieval villa architecture and decor.
“Jack, I will need your help later.”
Inside the room, Amitya said to Jack: “Us students of the Phantom God Series need to merge with a part of the Phantom Beast’s power at the Three-Star awakening in order to enter the Valkyrie form.”
“No problem.” Jack nodded.
Perfect timing: once Amitya merges with a ‘bit’ of his power, it will be easier for Jack to proceed with his plans.
As soon as Jack finished speaking, the purple-haired girl slipped off her dress, revealing her smooth, fair back…

chapters.title: Chapter 1845: 681: The Second Destruction of Heavenly Realm, Valkyrie Armament
chapters.content:
Chapter 1845: Chapter 681: The Second Destruction of Heavenly Realm, Valkyrie Armament
In the room, Amitya took off her long dress, revealing a fair and smooth back that seemed ideal for cupping therapy.
Of course, the relationship between the two was not that intimate yet, so the purple-haired girl still wore a white corset and sports shorts underneath.
The reason for taking off her outerwear was that behind Amitya, a palm-sized, wing-like golden light screen slowly emerged.
Within the light screen, golden runes circled like a complex Runes Array mixed with an assembly of electric circuits.
These golden runes resembled the text of Ancient Civilization, and Jack Clark recognized some of them.
Some runes represented “Light” and “Space,” while others represented special powers such as “Distortion,” “Summoning,” “Void,” “Fire,” “Thunder,” and so forth.
Amitya turned her head, her eyes clear and piercing like sapphires, filled with anticipation: “Jack, I need your help.”
Jack Clark nodded, placing his hand on her solidified golden wings, which were a manifestation of her talent.
Hum!
The little golden wings vibrated slightly, emitting a strong suction force, beginning to absorb energy from Jack Clark’s body without him refusing.
Even a mere wisp of the energy contained within Jack Clark was enough to instantly burst the golden wings.
Boom!
A myriad of golden lightning exploded, like a rapidly expanding net of light, destroying everything in the room with the overbearing power of golden thunder.
Then the entire building crumbled under the rampaging, leaping lightning.
Raging winds howled, and amidst rolling air currents, the golden wings expanded to ten meters, unfolding behind Amitya, making her look like a golden angel.
At that moment, the powerful golden wings fiercely folded, enveloping Amitya completely, resembling a glowing cocoon emitting a dazzling halo.
Inside the cocoon, those circuit-like runes began to evolve and combine, about to form a Valkyrie armor tailored for Amitya.
Just then, a pair of black gold vertical pupils slowly emerged in Jack Clark’s eyes, with streaks of purple-gray lightning leaping, emanating terrifying fluctuations of will.
At the same time, around Jack Clark and Amitya, the vague projection of a bronze bell appeared, forming its own world, isolating space-time.
Time was running short. A frightening gleam flickered in Jack Clark’s eyes, his right hand reaching out, wrapped in solid black willpower electric arcs imprinting on the cocoon.
Instantly, Jack Clark’s consciousness vibrated slightly, as countless pieces of information flooded into his mind.
With the moment Amitya awakened the Valkyrie Power, Jack Clark touched the power structure of this world—complex, mysterious, like a net covering the entire world.
But soon, Jack Clark disregarded external distractions and focused on the cocoon enveloping Amitya.
In just an instant, Jack Clark discerned the basic structure contained within the cocoon; from his palm as the center, streaks of black light penetrated deeply into the cocoon.
These black lights, condensed by Jack Clark’s will, formed millions of runes creating multiple Rune Sequence Chains, integrating into the cocoon, forming six circular black patterns.
Each pattern represented different powers.
Reversing the main and subordinate ‘identities’, adjusting the distribution ratio of talent power obtained from slaughtering demons, and incidentally improving the module combination of the Valkyrie armor for the purple-haired girl.
With Jack Clark’s current realm and understanding of rules, a simple adjustment was enough to increase the impending might of Amitya’s Valkyrie armor by dozens of times.
All this happened in an instant.
At that moment, Jack Clark’s gaze shifted; the Firmament above changed rapidly, and the space silently shattered to form a ten-thousand-meter long crack, resembling an Eye of Heavenly Path.
The instant that crack appeared, a force imbued with terrifying heavenly might descended from its depths.
“It’s here.”
Jack Clark’s eyes hardened, the phantom of the Chaotic Bronze Bell around him suddenly shrank, disappearing inside him, and the black gold vertical pupils also vanished from sight.
Boom boom boom!!
The pressure of Heavenly Dao descended, causing all the strong men of Valkyrie Academy with nine stars and above to have their will shaken, their bodies sank, and their faces drastically changed as they looked towards the sky.
“What’s happening!”
“Why has the world’s will suddenly descended!?”
Amidst Fiorina and others’ astonishment, that world’s will swept across this area, including the cocoon where Amitya was awakening the Valkyrie Power and Jack Clark aside.
But under the self-seal and suppression of the Chaotic Bronze Bell, this instinctive reaction of the world detected nothing.
Eventually, with lingering doubt, that will receded, along with the crack in the Firmament silently disappearing as if it had never appeared.
Watching the disappearing crack in the sky, Jack Clark’s face revealed a faint smile.
The Chaotic Supreme Treasure, a Bronze Bell containing one of the branches of the Quake Rules’ suppressive power, not only has formidable offensive power but also holds a degree of suppressive force.
Suppressing the enemy’s might might be somewhat lacking, but sealing and suppressing oneself proved quite effective.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!! Under the night, sounds of breaking the air arose from all directions.
The nearest, including Isabel and other students, arrived first, followed by massive Phantom Beasts, then Fiorina and a group of women in their thirties and forties.
After these people appeared, they spread out and all looked towards Amitya enveloped by the cocoon.
“It’s Amitya, she is awakening the Valkyrie Power.” Several students who had just summoned Phantom Beasts immediately showed envy in their eyes.
At the same time, a blue-haired woman radiating a strong aura, her eyes serious, focused on the golden cocoon: “Was the anomaly just now caused by her?”
Fiorina shook her head: “It shouldn’t be, the awakening of a Valkyrie is indeed spectacular, but it shouldn’t be enough to provoke a response from the world’s will.” As she spoke, she subconsciously glanced at the black-haired young man next to the cocoon.

chapters.title: Chapter 1846: 681: The Second Destruction of Heavenly Realm, Valkyrie Armament_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1846: Chapter 681: The Second Destruction of Heavenly Realm, Valkyrie Armament_2
The only person she couldn’t see through was this one.
However, since the ‘King of Phantasmal Beasts’ was able to make a pact and descend from the Outer Illusion Beast Realm, logically speaking, there should be no problem.
Lost in thought, Fiorina looked towards the students who were arriving one after another: “Those who are not from the Phantom God series, disperse and don’t disturb Amitya as she constructs the Valkyrie armament.”
“Let’s go, there’s nothing interesting to see.”
“The commotion just now was so loud, I thought someone had broken through to a Nine-Star Valkyrie.”
“Indeed.”
Amidst whispered conversations, the students attracted by the noise of the collapsing buildings dispersed.
Soon everyone dispersed, leaving only Fiorina and the people from Phantom God series like Isabel, with Jack Clark also quietly standing aside, though his attention was no longer here.
Boom boom boom!!
In the dimensional folding light tunnel, a ten-thousand-kilometer-long ferocious behemoth roared, its massive body colliding with the surrounding chaotic flows capable of shredding True Spirits, emitting earth-shattering booms.
Thanks to Jack Clark as a positioning anchor, the coordinates were precise, thus the Terminal Emperor Dragon moved quickly through the light tunnel, crossing a great distance in a short time.
However, though traveling through the deeper layers of the dimension was fast, the energy consumption was also terrifyingly huge, and even the Terminal Emperor Dragon felt a bit depleted internally and needed ‘food’.
Thinking this, the Terminal Emperor Dragon looked around, its eyes cold gold vertical pupils devoid of any emotion.
Around it, blurry shadows occasionally flashed by, each representing a vast world.
Although these worlds flashing by seemed close, they were in fact very distant, and the Terminal Emperor Dragon might need to fly a few more hours after leaving the light tunnel.
Thus, the Terminal Emperor Dragon only looked but didn’t strike.
Separated by space-time, it couldn’t discern the strengths of those fleeting worlds; picking a world governed by a Primordial True Emperor would be troublesome.
It was a waste of time, and no gains to be had.
As the Terminal Emperor Dragon crossed through the dimensional space-time in the light tunnel and sped forward, the invisible strong forces it released shook the space-time, alarming many powerful beings of various worlds.
In a blue world composed entirely of oceans filled with endless seawater, a majestic and profound Dragon Roar exploded.
Countless marine creatures looked up towards the sky, where the projection of a black-red ferocious giant beast tens of millions of kilometers in length appeared, its double wings unfolded, darkening the skies.
Even separated by a world, the invisible pressure and filled destructive aura emanating from the black-red giant beast left the mythic beings of this world shocked.
Boom! The ocean exploded, an enormous figure emerged reaching from the heavens to the earth, revealing a grave look in its eyes: “Such a strong destructive aura.”
Fortunately, that horrific creature was merely passing by, and soon the power projection disappeared.
And this scene occurred in many worlds.
That day, many powerful beings in various worlds saw a black-red giant beast flying by with wings that covered the skies, emitting a terrifying aura that seemed to devour the heavens and earth.
Above the huge head of the black-red giant beast, the strength of the Silver Giant Dragon, over seven thousand meters long, somewhat puzzled: “Roar! Tim Abott, how much longer must we fly?”
The Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly roared, its voice vibrating through space-time: “Soon, we’re almost there.”
As it spoke, chaotic light burst forth from the Terminal Emperor Dragon, its wings shook, and the space-time in front of it instantly collapsed, forming a hollow that penetrated the material universe and the imaginary.
Boom! The Chaotic Sea roiled, amidst roaring muddy waves the massive black-red giant beast appeared.
In front of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, not far away, a seemingly ordinary black world emerged amidst the endless chaotic currents, floating like a galaxy.
Just as it appeared, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes lit up, its wings spread wide, and the surrounding frost converged into a raging ice and snow tornado.
“Roar! Tim Abott, the Great Scythia feels there are good things inside that world, many good things.”
The corners of the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s mouth curled up slightly, revealing a ferocious smile: “Scythia, your senses are correct, that world indeed contains good things.”
Immediately the Silver Giant Dragon excitedly waved its claws: “Roar! Tim Abott, quick, let’s go in and slaughter them creating rivers of blood, kill them all, loot them all, devour them all.”
The massive black-red giant beast slowly shook its head: “No rush, I have not completed my breakthrough, let’s wait till I fully advance to the Primordial level.”
Looking at the black world ahead floating in the chaos, the Terminal Emperor Dragon’s golden vertical pupils showed a trace of solemnity, as it sensed a faint danger emanating from within.
Unlike Jack Clark, whose strength was comparable to the Primordial but was only at the Late Stage of True Spirit, the Terminal Emperor Dragon was now a genuine Primordial Life, its intuition keener.
That world, there must be some secrets hidden.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon gazed deeply at the distant black world, then closed its eyes, its wings folded as it re-entered hibernation, the transformation within its body that had momentarily paused now resuming.
Boom!
Centered on the ten-thousand-kilometer-long black-red giant beast, a layer of murky light unfolded, covering billions of kilometers, akin to a Boundary Wall.
This was the Primordial Heavenly Realm ‘Chaos’ condensed by the Terminal Emperor Dragon during its breakthrough to the Primordial level.
The so-called Primordial Heavenly Realm is a layer of Primordial ‘world’ evolved from the rule domain mastered by the giant beast, similar to the Great Thousand Worlds, but only containing ‘Heaven’.
Standing in this layer containing endless space, a Primordial Beast was not only invincible in defense, but also immune to damage from non-Primordial level powers, and closer to the Chaotic Sea.
This feeling was akin to the difference between ordinary life and Innate Life; in the Chaotic Sea, they could mobilize even more powerful forces with their movements.

chapters.title: Chapter 1847: 681: The Second Destruction of Heavenly Realm, Valkyrie Armament_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1847: Chapter 681: The Second Destruction of Heavenly Realm, Valkyrie Armament_3
And the First Layer of Heavenly Realm of the Terminal Emperor Dragon is built around the most Supreme Chaos Rule, condensing the Chaotic Heavens.
It possesses the attribute of containing all things, accommodating everything.
Furthermore, due to it harboring not one but two Supreme Rules, theoretically, the Terminal Emperor Dragon could carry both the First and Second Layers of Heavenly Realm upon piercing the Primordial, provided there is enough energy for Creation and Primordial Force.
This is no longer a challenge for the current Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Just as the murky light film envelops countless miles, terrifying black lightning erupts across the body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, and a layer of even mightier Black Light Curtain slowly unfolds.
Inside the Terminal Emperor Dragon, streams of pure Origin surge in through the Soul Channel.
The moment this energy appears within the body of Terminal Emperor Dragon, it transforms into the force for condensing the Second Layer of the realm of destruction, the Creation and Primordial Force.
This is the ‘power’ of the Origin Points, able to transform into whatever strength Jack Clark requires.
As long as there are sufficient Origin Points and the fundamental conditions are met, both Jack Clark and the Terminal Emperor Dragon can directly forge the Second Layer, or even the Third Layer of the Heavenly Realm.
But…
“Six hundred thousand Origin Points are required to condense the realm of destruction, the Giant Beast Body; current Origin Points are insufficient, please replenish promptly, otherwise, the condensing process will be interrupted…”
At Valkyrie Academy, Jack Clark watches the transparent page rapidly consuming two thousand Origin Points, his eyes narrow slightly at the remark that follows.
Given this rate of consumption, ten thousand Origin Points should last about five hours.
And with a demand of six hundred thousand, that’s two hundred thousand more than what was needed to congeal the First Layer of Heavenly Realm.
However, it matters not, for the Origin reserves of this world are ample enough for him and the Terminal Emperor Dragon to use; all that remains is to delve deeper into the labyrinth to harvest the Origin after Amitya’s awakening is complete.
Under the watchful eyes of Jack Clark, Fiorina, and the others, roughly two hours later, a powerful Power Explosion erupts from within Amitya’s light cocoon.
Boom! The cocoon shatters, golden light spreading in all directions, casting the dormitory area within a thousand-meter radius into a golden realm.
Within the golden glow, Amitya stands on the Void, hovering a few meters above ground; her originally waist-long purple hair has grown down to her heels, its edges emanating golden light.
And it’s not just her hair that has lengthened; the girl who was initially in a white tube top and fitness shorts is now cloaked in a magnificent garment with black as the base and adorned with golden armor.
The style resembles a fitted low-cut bodysuit, revealing half of her fair and round bosom, with the neck area wrapped by a black bow with golden edges, looking fashionable and beautiful.
At her waist, a skirt made of Black Gold Dragon Scales hangs on either side, revealing her fair thighs beneath, while from the knees downward, she’s wrapped in something akin to black stockings made of thin armor.
And at the very bottom, heavy black metal high-heeled battle boots give the 1.75-meter-tall girl an even taller and more slender appearance with straight legs.
Her unfurling black cloak behind her, three meters in length on either side, shimmers like three pairs of narrow golden light wings, giving her an air of both handsomeness and sexiness.
Add to this the black spear in her hand, three meters in length and twisted with Golden Dragon Scale Patterns, as though a real goddess has descended.
Mighty, beautiful, magnificent – this is the origin of the Valkyrie.
“Four stars? No, Amitya’s level has already made a breakthrough to five stars,” Isabel, who had not yet awakened the power of a Valkyrie, is somewhat shocked by the dazzling figure in the sky.
“Five stars? How deep is Amitya’s reservoir of God-given power?” The other students all express disbelief on their faces.
Fiorina also shows shock on her face: “Not just in level, the Valkyrie armor she’s awakened is so strong; the fluctuation of energy it emits is already no less than that of a Nine-Star Valkyrie.”
Awakening Valkyrie Power, her level leaps directly to five stars.
And the Valkyrie armor she has congealed far surpasses the armor awakened by others, her strength boosting instantly by more than a hundredfold, so powerful it exceeds the norm.
“Five stars? How deep is Amitya’s reservoir of God-given power?” The other students all express disbelief on their faces.
Fiorina also shows shock on her face: “Not just in level, the Valkyrie armor she’s awakened is so strong; the fluctuation of energy it emits is already no less than that of a Nine-Star Valkyrie.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1848: 682: The Young Man, The Seal Loosens
chapters.content:
Chapter 1848: Chapter 682: The Young Man, The Seal Loosens
Above the collapsing ruins of the buildings, surrounded by golden light, the purple-haired girl with her hair dancing in the wind softly murmured to herself, feeling the strength inside her body that had increased a thousandfold.
“So, this is the power of my Valkyrie armor.”
As Amitya was looking around, her eyes carried a faint authority, giving others the feeling that she had aged several years in an instant.
In Amitya’s eyes, those high-level senior sisters with gigantic Phantom Beasts behind them, which used to oppress her severely, now seemed so weak.
As if she could kill them with a single shot from her hand.
And this was not an illusion, for at this moment, she was truly that powerful.
While Amitya was lost in the euphoria of her newfound power, Jack Clark also slightly lifted his head, evaluating his ‘masterpiece’.
The Valkyrie form of the purple-haired girl looked even more mature, glamorous, and sexy, with a beauty comparable to Crystal Lewis but with the fuller figure characteristic of Westerners, curvaceous in all the right places.
However, this is just a change in appearance. Jack Clark’s attention was mainly on the Valkyrie armor she was wearing.
In Jack Clark’s eyes, that sexy and glamorous armor was not a mere piece of clothing, but a complex energy matrix, similar to an exoskeleton ‘armor’.
This was also the reason for the great enhancement in Amitya’s Valkyrie form.
Because the source of the power all comes from the Valkyrie armor, she is just a carrier.
After all, even with Jack Clark’s full strength at the Fifth Layer Heaven, he was barely comparable to the Seventh Layer, but Amitya, who had just awakened and broken through to the five stars, saw her power surge to the Ninth Heavens.
However, this Valkyrie system seems powerful but actually has a very low limit.
When the power all comes from the Valkyrie armor, the bodies, wills, and souls of these Valkyrie Warriors are not tempered at all.
Not to mention every breakthrough in realm means a transformation and evolution of their life level.
This is also why in this world, the lifespan of warriors and Valkyries isn’t much longer than ordinary people’s; essentially, they are still just ordinary Transcendents.
At this moment, Dean Fiorina of the Divine Phantasm Faculty showed a smile on her face: “Amitya, congratulations on awakening your armor and becoming a true Valkyrie Warrior.”
“However, a surge in power is often accompanied by a loss of control. Next, I will teach you a practical combat lesson to help you get familiar with your strength.”
As she spoke, Fiorina looked towards Isabel and the other students: “You also should go to the training square and see the difference between a Valkyrie armor integrated with divine power and your own armors.”
Amitya’s powerful Valkyrie form was all credited to Jack Clark by Fiorina, who believed that it was his power that influenced the Valkyrie armor.
And this time, her guess was accurate.
With this suggestion, Amitya, whose strength had greatly increased, naturally would not refuse. But at that moment, Jack Clark suddenly spoke: “Amitya, I need to verify something and won’t be watching the battle.”
These ‘child’s play’ comparisons naturally did not interest Jack Clark, as he had more important things to do.
“…Clark, where are you going?” the purple-haired girl asked, startled.
“The underground labyrinth,” Jack Clark replied as he burst forth with power from underneath his feet.
Boom!
The earth shook for tens of kilometers around, and the ground was instantly collapsing beneath Jack Clark, countless fragments of rock and dirt skyrocketing into the air, creating a violent wind wave that swept across Heaven and Earth.
The sudden aberration elicited exclaims of astonishment from the students.
“Be careful.”
Roar! The Phantom Beasts behind the girls roared, their bodies erupting in a myriad of colors, blocking the stones that rained down like cannonballs.
When the smoke and dust settled, the crowd opened their eyes to look into the distance.
There where Amitya had been standing, the ruins had vanished, replaced by a pitch-black hole a hundred meters in diameter and bottomless, with cracks spreading around it like a spider web.
There was no choice, the power of Divine Power and Rule self-concealed, Jack Clark could only rely on his physical strength.
However, he had focused all his strength under his foot with this kick, minimizing the damage to the surroundings; otherwise, even with his power contained, he was enough to shatter a thousand-kilometer radius.
A hundred kilometers away from the Valkyrie Campus, an explosion occurred at World Tree Plaza. Amongst the billowing smoke and dust, a shadow darted past and rushed into the Dungeon Stone Gate.
The ground of the underground labyrinth on the Thirteenth Floor began to collapse with a thunderous crash.
Roar roar!!
Three Tauren, over ten meters tall with dark red skin and wielding broken stone axes, growled ominously, their blood-red eyes steadfastly watching the young man with black hair looming within the dust.
But before the three five-star Labyrinth Demons could react, an invisible Overbearing force descended from above.
Boom! The three demons exploded on the spot, leaving behind a giant palm imprint a hundred meters in diameter, plunging a kilometer downwards through that floor of the labyrinth.
And just as the three demons were being wiped out, Jack Clark keenly sensed the fluctuations of invisible rules above him, and three ‘God-given powers’ appeared out of thin air.
This power disappeared by one percent instantly after it appeared, with the rest surging into Jack Clark’s body.
The World Origin harvested from the three five-star demons couldn’t transform even a single Origin Point, but Jack Clark’s face broke into a radiant smile.
“Now, it’s time for slaughter.”
Boom!
A sonic boom sounded as Jack Clark burst forth at hundreds of times the speed of sound. The friction between his body and the air created a layer of scorching blue-red plasma light trail around him.
This time, Jack Clark didn’t directly crush through the labyrinth to the next floor but instead rammed into the tunnel walls, collapsing them one by one.
Under the powerful impacts, layers of rock and stone, dozens to hundreds of meters thick, instantaneously crumbled and melted into Scorching Magma, transforming this floor of the labyrinth into a sea of fire.
Roar roar roar!!
All the monsters within the labyrinth let out enraged roars, but before they had time to respond, they were reduced to ashes under the passing red glow.
As Jack Clark swept through floor after floor of the labyrinth, slaughtering all the demons within, multiples of the previously acquired Origin Points continued to pour in and then transformed into Origin Points.
Soon, the Origin Points on the attribute page exceeded ten thousand, twenty thousand…
These Origin Points, still warm, flowed into the being of the Terminal Emperor Dragon within Jack Clark’s realm of thought via the Soul Channel, transforming into the required Primordial Force and World Creation Force.
Roar!
In the Chaotic Sea, a majestic and fierce roar sounded, and the Black-red Colossal Beast, which had swelled to a size of 13,000 kilometers, was surrounded by a Black Light Curtain that expanded at an astonishing speed.
In an instant, the aura of the Terminal Emperor Dragon surged, vaguely surpassing the level of the Primordial Stars.
Above the head of the Black-red Colossal Beast, even the Silver Giant Dragon, accustomed to its heaven-defying talent, widened its eyes in shock upon sensing the endless surge of power from the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
As Giant Beasts approach the latter stages of cultivation, their rate of progression slows down, with a single minor breakthrough in the Ancient Realm taking thousands to tens of thousands of years.
However, the case with the Terminal Emperor Dragon was the complete opposite; the stronger its strength, the faster its rate of progression.
Even if it reached the Primordial Realm, the pace of its advancement was unaffected – in fact, it accelerated even more.
“Roar! Tim Abott is becoming even more monstrous!” The Silver Giant Dragon exhaled a breath of icy blue chill from its nostrils, its tail quivering with excitement, for the stronger the Terminal Emperor Dragon grew, the sturdier the ‘leg’ it clung to became.
…
Boom, boom, boom!! In Jack Clark’s relentless destruction, deep within the Earth and in a different layer of space, the labyrinth began to collapse, layer by layer.
No matter what stood before Jack Clark, all was obliterated under his Unrivaled Domination of fists – exploded, shattered, utterly unstoppable.
The invisible spread of power fluctuations caused the entire underground labyrinth to shake and sway.
All pathways of the twentieth floor of the labyrinth collapsed, forming a parallel cavern with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers.
The twenty-first floor of the labyrinth collapsed, creating a planar fault strewn with rubble and ruins that spanned twenty thousand kilometers, with individual pathways of several to tens of kilometers long connecting to the levels below.
Since his target was to annihilate all the demons without exception, even if Jack Clark cleared a level himself, it still took time.
As Jack Clark pierced through the labyrinth, one level after the other, the immense disturbances he caused left many of the warriors who ventured deep into the dungeon and had not left panicking, unaware of what was happening above them.
It felt like the entire labyrinth was about to collapse.
On the fifty-fourth floor of the labyrinth, in another direction from where Jack Clark penetrated the lower level during the day, a seven-person team rested with their backs against the forest.
A campfire burned in front of them as they prepared for the evening meal.
But just then, a woman with long blue hair dressed in black and white Valkyrie armor suddenly stood up, looking towards the cavern ceiling ten thousand meters above.
“Everyone, be careful.”
The other six quickly stood up, including a burly man emanating the aura of a Nine-Star Valkyrie looking towards the blue-haired woman: “What’s wrong, Estelle Your Highness?”
Estelle’s brows furrowed slightly: “Did you hear something? Sounds coming from above.”
“Sounds.” The others exchanged glances.
Another youth also emanating the pressure of the Ninth Heavens, with green hair, hesitated: “Your Highness, we didn’t hear anything.”
“Nothing?”
Estelle’s brows furrowed again, but her expression suddenly changed as the invisible vibrations from above grew even more intense, she declared decisively.
“Something must have happened above, and it’s serious. We need to leave immediately.”
“Leave? But Your Highness, we’re about to explore the fifty-fifth floor soon.”
“Yes, it seems a pity to leave now?” Immediately, the other warriors hesitated.
Summoned by the strongest warrior of the Valkyrie Academy’s Divine Martial Faculty, and at the same time the most powerful Nine-Star Valkyrie of the current generation, these Nine-Star warriors had come together.
Their goal was to delve deep into the Dungeon, at least to levels below ninety, or even to explore the Evil God’s Dungeon beneath, to investigate the situation.
Success would have catapulted them all to fame, turning them into legends within the adventuring circles.
Just as they hesitated, the ground beneath, even the entire labyrinth, trembled slightly, and then the shaking grew stronger and stronger, to the point where even the ‘sky’ above was swaying.
The thick rock cavern ceiling, whose breadth was seemingly endless, began to develop cracks that spread with Crackle Crackle, and soon many fragments fell with a loud crash.
All at once, the entire level of the labyrinth was thrown into turmoil, with many demons hidden in the dark issuing restless hisses and roars.
“This is bad, what’s happening!”
“Quick, pack up, be ready to evacuate at any moment.” The six who had hesitated were all startled.
Yet the tremors came not just from above, but covered all directions, leaving everyone clueless about where to flee to, looking to Estelle for direction.
“We can’t go down.” Estelle, with a stern face and a beautiful, aloof visage, shook her head with gravity.
“These tremors are coming from the entire upper labyrinth. Without knowing exactly what has happened, blindly descending to the fifty-sixth floor could be even more dangerous.”
“As for going up, it’s too late now, the pathway to the fifty-third floor is far from here,”
“Ades, deploy your Light Defense Formation, be prepared for any danger that may arise, Thor, you head to that mountain top to keep watch.”
“If this disturbance is caused by the appearance of a Demon King, we will take a stand here and strike it down.”
“Okay.”
“No problem.” Following that, the group positioned themselves around Estelle, defenses at the ready, charged and prepared for any danger that might emerge.
But as time went on, the shaking of the ‘world’ above and the entire ‘world’ itself grew even more violent, to the point where it no longer seemed like the anomaly caused by the appearance of a Demon King.
Boom, boom, boom!!
The ‘sky’ shattered in the distance, with countless pieces of rubble falling from above, striking the Earth, causing it to tremble; billowing smoke and raging wind enveloped this underground plain.
Within the dust, the green-haired youth’s complexion changed drastically, retreating as he shouted, “Be careful, a powerful entity has appeared on that side, it’s very strong… damn it, it’s moving towards us.”
“Attack.” Estelle shouted, her body bursting with dazzling icy blue radiance.
Boom, boom, boom!!
In front of them, the ground shattered, and ice walls tens of meters thick and hundreds of meters high emerged abruptly, forming layers of Ice Crystal City Walls before them.
Simultaneously, a woman cloaked in a black cloak pressed her hands to the ground, as a thick white light barrier arose around them.
However, the anticipated attack did not happen. As they braced for the worst, the dust slowly cleared, revealing a vague silhouette on the outermost ice wall.
[A bit more polishing needed, please wait]

chapters.title: Chapter 1849: 683: The Chive Farm, The Secret of the World
chapters.content:
Chapter 1849: Chapter 683: The Chive Farm, The Secret of the World
The disturbance in the underground labyrinth soon alarmed the entire City of Braves.
Even the World Tree, towering tens of thousands of meters high and formed by the Rule, emitted white light, its tremendous strength shaking and illuminating the entire night sky.
Suddenly, beams of light flashed from all directions, shooting into the sky.
Especially at the Valkyrie Academy, there erupted auras that rivaled myths, two akin to Titans, and one comparable to the Ancient God-King.
The relationship between the World Tree and the underground labyrinth is significant; it’s not just the foundation of transcendent power on this continent but also relates to the safety of this world.
If the labyrinth collapses, countless monsters will surge out from underground like a tide, contaminating Heaven and Earth, and everyone will perish.
At the roots of the World Tree, around the shaking Stone Gate, appeared an imposing figure clad in Red Battle Armor, standing 3 meters tall, which instantly boosted the spirits of the chaotic warriors around.
“It’s the City Lord.”
“Wagtall City Lord has come.”
“Greetings to the City Lord.”
The helmet’s red demon-like horns extended at the sides, and under the faceplate, a pair of dignified dark-red eyes conveyed solemnity: “Kuwas, do you know what’s happening below?”
The middle-aged man in black armor respectfully replied, “City Lord, according to the warriors who escaped from the labyrinth, the anomaly started an hour ago.”
“At that time, the 19th level of the labyrinth suddenly collapsed on a large scale, the mountain wall broke apart, and it rapidly spread below to the 20th level.”
“Since the collapse began on the 19th level, the disturbance wasn’t ‘very loud’ at first, and only now is there a slight tremor on the surface.”
“Currently, the collapse has likely reached below the 50th level, because it has been half an hour since the eight-star warrior Kual left the 40th level to return to the surface.”
“Kual.”
Wagtall looked at the middle-aged man carrying a Battle Axe and armored with a rough appearance: “You’re the strongest among the returned warriors, did you see what caused the labyrinth to collapse?”
The middle-aged man hesitated a little, then bitterly smiled: “I’m afraid you might not believe me if I tell you, because I’m not entirely sure myself.”
Wagtall said gravely: “Whether we believe it or not, we’ll decide for ourselves. The collapse of the labyrinth is a major concern, and we must determine the cause and the anticipated consequences.”
Kual nodded, speaking gravely, “It was a person. I saw a person standing amidst the Magma Flames, transforming into a beam of light piercing Heaven and Earth.”
“Wherever they passed, the thick pathways and mountain walls instantly shattered, the Earth broke apart, with a power beyond description.”
“At that moment, the eight-star BOSS monster on the 40th level was instantly obliterated by that person’s punch, which broke the Earth and created a magma pathway hundreds of kilometers wide and several kilometers deep leading to the 41st level.”
Hiss!
All the warriors around took a cold breath, their faces showing disbelief.
An eight-star BOSS monster requires nine-star warriors to unite to defeat, not to mention creating a hollow hundreds of kilometers wide and several kilometers deep with a single punch in the labyrinth.
The rocks that make up the labyrinth are ten times harder than those on the surface, akin to steel; even a Valkyrie in her third form might not be able to achieve such destructive power.
Not to mention carving a path of destruction from the 19th level downward, destroying every single level, isn’t he tired?!
While everyone was astonished, the powerful women from the Valkyrie Academy shortly arrived, with gorgeously armored and attractive women descending from the sky.
The weakest of these Valkyries arriving first all exuded the aura of nine-stars, among them was Amitya, who had just been training with Fiorina.
These Valkyries were led by the strongest among them, the Valkyrie Dean.
Though called a dean and sporting white hair, Carmen Lindon looked to be only in her thirties, with a beautiful face and dignified charm, radiating a mature and enchanting aura.
Combined with those attractive teachers in Valkyrie form, the least good-looking scored above ninety, and with ravishing bodies.
Add to that Amitya, whose three pairs of light wings unfurled and clad in splendid armor, everyone felt dazzled by their beauty.
However, despite being pleasing to the eye, these Valkyries naturally instilled reverence in onlookers, who did not dare look directly at them.
Upon their arrival, Carmen Lindon immediately looked up towards the glowing World Tree, her eyes also emanating white light, as a grand and sacred breath spread from her.
Her white hair swayed behind her, surrounded by light, like a goddess descending upon them.
Watching the authoritative presence of Carmen Lindon, Wagtall respectfully said, “Dean Lindon, from what we know, an unknown strong being below is causing widespread destruction.”
“Although we don’t know why he’s doing this, the World Tree and the labyrinth are related to the safety of the surface, and I think we need to go down and stop him immediately.”
“City Lord Wagtall and everyone else, don’t panic, the situation is not that grave,” Carmen Lindon withdrew her gaze from the World Tree and slowly shook her head.
“Although the World Tree is shaking violently, it just told me that the roots entwined with the world below are stable, and that person has not shaken the foundation of the labyrinth.”
“Just, I don’t know why he is doing this?” Saying this, Lindon’s eyes showed puzzlement.
As the Valkyrie Dean of this continent, the current strongest Valkyrie, and with the ability to ‘communicate’ with the World Tree, Carmen Lindon saw the image of Jack Clark sweeping through the labyrinth, annihilating all monsters.
But what puzzled Carmen Lindon was why Jack Clark would do such a thing.
As a ‘Divine Position Phantom Beast’ summoned through a contract, without the Contractor entering the labyrinth, for what reason would he voluntarily slaughter those monsters?

chapters.title: Chapter 1850: 683: The Chive Farm, The Secret of the World_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1850: Chapter 683: The Chive Farm, The Secret of the World_2
Valkyrie Warriors slay those demons to hone their combat techniques and accumulate God-given power to advance in rank, so they would actively venture deep into the labyrinth.
However, if a Phantom Beast has no Contractor, slaying those demons yields nothing more than a burst of equipment materials and no other additional benefits.
This was the reason for Carmen Lindon’s bewilderment.
At this moment, Amitya spoke up from behind, softly saying: “Dean, Jack once said he detests those dark demons.”
“Is that so.”
Carmen Lindon pondered thoughtfully: “That’s to say, due to the opposition of life forms, upon entering the Primary Material World he ventured on his own into the underground dungeon.”
Next to him, Fiorina nodded: “I think that must be the case, Dean.”
This reason did align well with Jack Clark’s actions and regardless, he truly had been slaughtering the labyrinth demons in large numbers, weakening the powers of the Evil God, easing Carmen Lindon’s concerns little by little.
Still, she always felt this Divine Position Phantom Beast carried a certain mystery.
At this time, figures of Estelle and her group appeared somewhat distressed from deep within the Stone Gate, bringing back news of their encounter with Jack Clark.
However, the strong men on the outside already knew the situation below, and because the labyrinth space stabilized by the entangling roots of the World Tree, these people did not go down immediately.
They wanted to see if that terrifying Divine Position creature, after breaking through the ninety-nine layers of the labyrinth, would directly invade the Evil God Palace and suppress the Evil Gods beneath.
While those above waited, Jack Clark with his unmatched strength blasted through everything, quickly reaching below the ninetieth layer.
Here, the space of the maze was even more stable, the pathways were wide, and the mountain walls between them spanned like ranges of mountains, with the weakest of the monsters born here being eight-star.
More powerful nine-star demons were abundant, each layer’s guardian possessed the strength of a demon king level.
Of course, such power was still no match for Jack Clark, who easily descended to the deepest part of the ninety-ninth layer of the labyrinth.
In the pitch-black world where all life is dead and silent, the sky suddenly collapsed, and a sky full of Magma Flames fell, bringing a glimmer of light to this world.
But this layer had no demons, only a demon king with a terrifying aura.
“After more than a hundred years, finally another warrior has made it here.” A deep voice laden with horror and evil slowly resounded between heaven and earth.
“Unfortunately, your adventure ends here at my hands.”
“For I am the darkness. One day, I will be the Dark Lord that engulfs the lands.”
In the center of this world, nine towering black peaks thousands of meters high converge, like nine sharp Demon Horns crossing to form a massive throne.
In the middle of the throne, a demon king several hundred meters tall, covered in ferocious black armor, lifts his head and looks at Jack Clark, descending amidst the torrential Magma Flames with cold, cruel eyes.
On this demon king, there emanates an oppressive aura that rivalled that of a Heavenly King, coupled with the surrounding sky-obscuring swirls of Dark Demon Air and his blood-red eyes, his presence was formidable.
Fitting for the Great Demon King that suppresses the deepest part of the labyrinth.
Yet no sooner had this Great Demon King finished speaking than Jack Clark, who had descended from the sky and stood unwavering amidst the sea of fire, clenched his fist slightly towards it.
Boom! Heaven and Earth shook, the air exploded.
Above that Great Demon King’s head, a horrifying force converged to form a transparent handspan covering a thousand-kilometer range, and then it pressed down.
And the moment Jack Clark acted, the Great Demon King, sensing the terrifying force of eternal suppression above his head, wore a look of horror instantly.
“Your strength, how is it possible!”
Boom! The throne of fanged teeth formed by the nine mountain peaks instantly turned to dust, the earth shattered, and innumerable chunks of rocks and dirt soared into the sky, thrown tens of thousands of meters high.
Boom Boom Boom!! Those gigantic rocks crashed onto the cavern ceiling like missiles, setting off violent explosions, flames burning, smoke and dust billowing.
In this moment, the most dangerous ninety-ninth layer of the underground labyrinth, as legend has it, seemed as if Doomsday had arrived.
As for that self-proclaimed Dark Lord who would engulf everything, Jack Clark’s single palm strike reduced him to ash, erasing his will, his True Body dissipating.
When power reaches its extreme limit, the so-called undying bodies of beings beyond myth lose all meaning.
And with the fall of that demon king, a more grand and mighty God-given power emerged out of nowhere above Jack Clark’s head, pouring into his body in torrents.
In this world, this power in the hands of humans is merely used for advancing but in Jack Clark’s hands, it can be reverted to its primal form, becoming World Origin, and then transformed into Origin Points energy exclusive to him.
The attribute page showed that the original 4,570 Origin Points surged in an instant by 15,244, an increase of over ten thousand, equivalent to the harvest of slaying a True Spirit on the Plane Battlefield.
After tampering with the contract and changing the ‘share’ ratio with Amitya, the already many times more profitable Origin from the Plane Battlefield directly skyrocketed to a hundredfold.
Looking at the exploding Origin Points on the page, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but feel a tinge of red in his eyes, his murderous intent growing even stronger as he looked downward.
In the cavern below, wrought by his hand through the Earth, a thousand kilometers wide and a hundred kilometers deep, endless darkness spread with a dungeon floating inside, vast as a plane.
That is the Evil God Palace, the place where two Hell Messengers of Boroedo are oppressed and trapped.
Killing them here, the Origin harvested should be enough for the Terminal Emperor Dragon to solidify its Third Layer of the Heavenly Realm and directly become a Primordial Monarch-level Giant Beast.
But then Jack Clark exhaled, suppressing the murderous intent in his heart.
At this point, today should come to an end.
Today, by slaughtering through the entire underground dungeon and all its demons, he collected over five hundred thousand Origin Points, enough for the Terminal Emperor Dragon to solidify its Second Layer of Heaven.
But this amount of Origin is still not enough for Jack Clark; he wants more.
The nature of the underground dungeon is that it will automatically restore its ‘buildings’, and given some time, the slaughtered demons will re-emerge soon after.
Of course, the lower-level demon kings, the BOSS elite demons of each layer, cannot make an appearance again so soon.
These demons, born from the slaughter amongst countless demons, including devouring the flesh and blood of human warriors, need time to accumulate.
Even so, Jack Clark estimates that each subsequent clearing of the dungeon will net him two to three hundred thousand Origin Points.
Therefore, there is no need to take the eggs and decimate the nest. Leaving the roots of the demonic source, and reaping batches of crops later is the real deal.
With that thought, a faint smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
Even if he were to descend, he would wait until those two were nearly drained before doing so.
As for whether to kill them and harvest their Origin, or, considering everyone hails from Hell and they were the ones who led Jack Clark here, give them some leeway, that would depend on the circumstances.
Such as, by that time, Jack Clark had accumulated enough Origin Points.
But just as Jack Clark’s gaze deeply penetrated the Evil God Palace below, preparing to turn and leave, the Hell Roulette sub-disk kept within his Storage Space trembled slightly.
Those two guys, with a slight movement of Jack Clark’s eyes, his Spirit Power probed into the Storage Space, and suddenly the intermittent thoughts within the roulette came through.
“Darren Callum brother… be careful.”
“This world is very dangerous…”
“Deeper within the Evil God Palace… there’s an even more powerful existence sealed…”
“The oldest demon… Selos…”
This information coming from the two Hell Messengers weighed heavily on Jack Clark, hinting at a powerful presence suppressed deep within this world.
Perhaps the force suppressing all Evil Gods in this world, including Primordial Second and Third Heavenly Realm beings, is actually aimed at sealing that very existence.
That being could very well be the Primordial Fourth Heavenly Realm True Emperor, or even a more formidable oldest demon.
“So, is this the true secret of this world?” Jack Clark slowly lifted his head, gazed at the hollow running through the ninety-nine layers above, and with a tremendous crumbling of space beneath his feet, his figure vanished in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 1851: 684: The Change of Eras, Lord of Darkness
chapters.content:
Chapter 1851: Chapter 684: The Change of Eras, Lord of Darkness
Watching the black-haired young man slowly walk out of the labyrinth’s stone gate, astonishment was written on everyone’s faces.
Under the fearsome Blood Qi that seemed to shake the ages, the air itself was compressed into tangible white waves, causing everyone to retreat as if hit by a tsunami.
In just a blink of an eye, the space by the entrance became empty as people retreated for kilometers.
Even the most powerful presence there, Carmen Lindon, whose strength in the third Valkyrie form could be compared to an Ancient God King, instinctively retreated under the Aura imbued with Dragon Might.
Due to her extraordinary strength, her senses were extremely sharp, and looking at the black-haired young man emerging felt like beholding a colossal Destruction Beast; a shiver emerged from the depths of her soul.
Such terrifying Qi Blood, such fearsome Dragon Might, truly worthy of the strongest Divine King in the legends of the Phantom Beast World!!
Shock appeared in Carmen Lindon’s eyes. If this Divine King before her could exert his full power, she might not be able to withstand a single hit.
Thump thump thump!! Many warriors collapsed onto their knees, instinctively ‘paying their highest respects’ to the young man emerging from the stone gate of the labyrinth.
Though this action was not of their own volition.
Jack Clark released a bit of Qi Blood, naturally to intimidate.
After getting the intel that deep within the world, a presence that might Suppress even a Primordial True Emperor had started to break free from its Seal and was reaching out with tentacles to make contact with two of Boroedo’s ‘Evil Gods’, even he couldn’t help but feel the gravity of the situation.
The relatively relaxed attitude he had been holding was let go, turning to seriousness; he no longer had any interest in ‘playing house’ with these people.
Jack Clark’s indifferent gaze swept across the crowd, eventually looking towards the elites of Valkyrie Academy; after giving a slight nod to Amitya within the crowd, his gaze settled on Carmen Lindon.
Jack Clark calmly said, “This should be our first meeting, hello, Madam Dean of Valkyrie Academy.”
Carmen Lindon replied neither humbly nor arrogantly, “Hello, Mr. Callum, I am Carmen Lindon. I didn’t expect our first meeting to be under such circumstances.”
“Mr. Callum made a powerful move, breaking through the multiple layers of the maze and killing demons, may I ask what the situation is like underneath the labyrinth at the moment?”
Jack Clark calmly said, “The situation is alright, all the Labyrinth Demons below the nineteenth level have been killed by me, including the Great Demon King that resided in the ninety-ninth level.”
“However, after breaching the ninety-ninth level, I did not proceed further because, due to the contract, my current ‘strength’ is still insufficient to Suppress the Evil Gods below.”
Hiss Hiss!! Suddenly, a series of gasps could be heard all around.
All of the warriors, including Fiorina and other Valkyries, were somewhat startled, unable to believe that Jack Clark had managed to eradicate the entire underground labyrinth in such a short time.
When he said all the demons were killed, it wasn’t just a straight dive to the ninety-ninth level, but a thorough sweep through a Dungeon vastly larger than the surface.
This feat was even more shocking than killing the ninety-ninth level’s Great Demon King.
Carmen Lindon solemnly said, “Mr. Callum’s caution is correct, the Evil God Palace below the labyrinth has only been gathering for less than three years, and their strength is at its peak.”
“Especially since two Evil Gods are lurking in the depths of that Evil God Palace, their combined strength is even stronger, an adversary not to be challenged by force.”
“Now that all the demons in the labyrinth have been killed and the mountain wall shattered, it will probably take a week or so to return to its original state.”
“As for those common Labyrinth Demons, it is estimated it will take half a month to fully regenerate, and that is with the two Evil Gods below emitting strength that accelerates the birth rate of the demons.”
“However, even so, it is predicted that it will take half a year to a year for those elite demons, and the demon kings stationed every ten levels after the seventieth level, to be born; this gives us time to purge the labyrinth of demons.”
“In the upcoming period, as long as it is well-managed and every time an elite demon is born, we shall kill it, we can expect that for the next few decades to centuries, no demon king will appear.”
Having said this, Carmen Lindon deeply bowed to Jack Clark, “Carmen Lindon here wishes to represent all humanity from the surface to thank Mr. Callum for his contribution to this world.”
Her strength was indeed great, but that was when entering the third Valkyrie form, normally she was merely a Nine-Star Valkyrie.
And Valkyrie forms were a Burst state; the stronger the form, the shorter the duration it could be maintained, which is why Carmen Lindon usually refrains from acting rashly.
Let alone slaughtering her way through the entire underground labyrinth.
Her duty was to oversee the surface, to prevent any potential surge of demons; every time countless demons in the labyrinth began to stir, she would dive into the depths of the underground to kill the leading demon king.
This was the ‘way of life’ of human warriors and Labyrinth Demons of this world.
And Evil Gods were being Suppressed at the very bottom of the Dungeon, serving as the source of power for the birth of those demons until finally being drained dry by this world.
Over the hundreds of thousands of years of human history, the World Tree roots-wrapped labyrinth has worn away over a hundred otherworldly Evil Gods.
Jack Clark indifferently said, “Madam Dean Carmen Lindon is too polite; I did all this simply because I despise those demons. However…”
Carmen Lindon subconsciously asked, “Mr. Callum, however what?”
Jack Clark slowly said, “When I was eradicating the ninety-ninth-level Great Demon King, I also obliterated its Demon King Castle, and then a fragmented stele appeared beneath its foundation.”
“Most of the content on the stele was damaged, only the title of the Ancient Evils remained, along with a part of the description about someone named Selos left by the ‘person’ who placed the stele.”
“From the content, one can feel ‘his’ fear of that most ancient evil, seemingly an existence more terrifying than an Evil God, which once it emerges, it will destroy the world.”
“So, I wanted to ask if you had any information on the most ancient evil, or this Selos?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1852: 684: The Change of an Era, Lord of Darkness_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1852: Chapter 684: The Change of an Era, Lord of Darkness_2
The news about the most ancient demon came from the Underworld Evil God; Jack Clark had no good explanation, so he simply made up an excuse, which no one present doubted.
However, when they heard the names of the most ancient demon and Selos, everyone showed a look of confusion and perplexity.
Including Carmen Lindon who Jack Clark thought was well-informed, even she, as the Valkyrie Dean for a hundred years, was hearing these names for the first time.
After pondering, Carmen Lindon still shook her head: “Sorry, Mr. Callum, I have never heard of the most ancient demon or the name Selos.”
“You haven’t?” Jack Clark frowned slightly.
This world’s civilization has gone through seven destructions, past eight eras of civilization, and many secrets have vanished amidst history and the chaos of wars, so it was normal for Carmen Lindon not to know.
At the same time, everyone else didn’t pay it much attention, thinking that this so-called most ancient demon might be some Evil God that dissipated who knows how many years ago.
But at this moment, Estelle from the crowd in the academy spoke hesitantly: “I, I seem to know a little bit, but I’m not sure if it pertains to the most ancient demon.”
“You know?” Jack Clark was somewhat surprised.
Carmen Lindon, Fiorina, and others also turned their gaze to Estelle.
Estelle nodded: “I once saw a fragment of a stele in the Imperial Treasury, which contained some information from the earliest era.”
“The description on it tells of a time before humans came into existence, the era when boundless darkness enveloped and devoured the world.”
“It was then that the Eternal God descended, Opening the Heavens and Earth, tearing through the darkness, Suppressing the Lord of Darkness who was devouring the world, and afterward created human civilization.”
“But for some reason unknown, the Eternal God did not slay the Lord of Darkness, only Sealing him beneath the Earth.”
“And when the Eternal God disappeared, he left behind a World Tree to suppress the darkness forever.”
“Of course, that World Tree isn’t the one before us; the very first World Tree has long since vanished.”
“However, the stele referred to the ‘Lord of Darkness,’ not the most ancient demon or Selos, so I’m somewhat uncertain.”
Having said this, Estelle hesitated: “Including the information recorded on the stele, I’m not sure of its authenticity.”
“Over hundreds of thousands of years, civilizations have risen and fallen, and too many Mythical Legends have emerged among the people of countless empires and kingdoms, many more exaggerated than this.”
Jack Clark slowly nodded, showing understanding, but also somewhat surprised.
He hadn’t expected that a casually mentioned broken stele would actually correspond to a real artifact.
The Lord of Darkness Sealed by the Eternal God, and the title of the most ancient demon could be marginally related, especially the part about being Sealed by ‘Henry.’
So Jack Clark felt there was a high chance that this Lord of Darkness was the same as the most ancient demon described by Boroedo.
But it was unknown how strong the Lord of Darkness was and how much strength remained after being Sealed for hundreds of thousands of years?
As Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly, Fiorina, who stood behind Carmen Lindon, suddenly spoke.
“Mr. Callum, Estelle is the Imperial Princess of the Kamor Empire, and as I know, the Imperial Treasury of the Kamor Empire houses many artifacts from the Ancient Civilizations.”
“Many of these artifacts contain ancient powers. Since you are interested in the news of the most ancient demon, Mr. Callum, you might want to go see for yourself.”
Without waiting for Jack Clark to respond, Estelle’s eyes lit up: “Mr. Callum, I can lead the way. I know exactly which corner that fragmentary stele is in.”
“…Then I would be troubled.” Jack Clark paused only briefly before nodding in agreement.
As Fiorina said, a stele that has been handed down from the previous civilization, or even an older civilization, should be extraordinary.
Perhaps the inscriptions on the stele contain the imprinted thoughts of their creator, providing a better understanding of the information regarding the Lord of Darkness.
Moreover, the underground labyrinth will need a week to recover; it will be ten to fifteen days before hordes of monsters are spawned. This gives Jack Clark some free time.
The most important thing is that he is not short of time.
According to the timeline when Henry appeared, and calculations based on Boroedo and other Underworld Evil Gods having been consolidating for two to three years, the flow of time here is dozens of times faster than in the mythical world.
A year here is but a few days to a fortnight in the mythical world.
…
Roar! Over the skies of the Brave City, a Giant Dragon over three hundred meters long, covered in Blue Scales, let out a roaring cry, its double wings stirring up a raging wind.
Perched atop this two-legged blue Flying Dragon was a dainty and luxurious white castle that spread over a hundred meters.
At this moment, within the castle’s rooftop garden, two girls respectfully arranged snacks and proceeded to pour a cup of aromatic black tea for Jack Clark and Estelle, as well as for Amitya.
Once the girls stood aside, Estelle, who had changed into a blue and white princess lace dress and tied her blue hair back, revealing her slender neck, began to speak with a smile, politely saying,
“Mr. Callum, this is our Kamor’s famous Snow Night Black Tea. See if it suits your palate.”
Tasting the tea.
Looking at the beautiful girl in front of him, smiling warmly with tea and snacks on the table, Jack Clark who just slaughtered tens of millions of monsters, felt somewhat out of place.
At this moment, Amitya with her purple hair draped over her back and no longer in Valkyrie form, gently lifted the black tea and quietly praised,
“I had heard that the snacks and black tea made by Princess Estelle’s servants are unparalleled in the imperial city. I didn’t expect to have the honor of tasting them here.”
As she spoke, Amitya smiled at Jack Clark, “Jack, give it a try; the flavor surely won’t disappoint you.”
Well, if the scene is weird, let it be weird. Jack Clark shook his head, lifted the cup emitting a rich floral fragrance, and took a small sip.
Immediately, over a dozen unfamiliar floral scents filled Jack Clark’s mouth, a delicate blend of light and rich, sweet, warm, and fruity, each distinct from the others.
This craftsmanship of blending various flowers with the tea, fully releasing the fragrance without any interference, evoked Jack Clark’s admiration.
“The taste is indeed good, it’s lingering and refreshing, making one feel as if they’re amidst a blossoming garden,” he commented.
Estelle’s smile brightened even more: “I’m glad you’re satisfied, Mr. Callum. Tatiana, don’t forget to thank Mr. Callum for his compliment.”
“Thank you, sir,” said Tatiana.
Tatiana, the pretty servant girl who appeared to be in her early twenties and was respectfully bowing, made the mountain peaks half-covered by her chest seem even more voluptuous and fair.
Of course, such ‘beauty’ could not tempt Jack Clark; it simply reflected the ‘class hierarchy’ inherent in this world.
Estelle, an Imperial Princess, and Amitya, a daughter of a different kingdom and Estelle’s cousin, were polite in the presence of Jack Clark because of his strength.
But in front of ordinary people, they were princesses exalted high above.
However, these were trivial matters. What came next was a chat about tea among the three, while the colossal Blue Scales Flying Dragon cut through Carney Turner, flying over mountain ranges.
In just three hours, the Flying Dragon traversed over ten thousand kilometers to hover over a bustling, medieval-style city.
[]

chapters.title: Chapter 1853: 685 Henry, The Eternal Henry, The Ruin of The Human Race Across The Heavens
chapters.content:
Chapter 1853: Chapter 685 Henry, The Eternal Henry, The Ruin of The Human Race Across The Heavens
Spanning several kilometers, outside the black diamond-built Imperial Treasury.
As a blue Flying Dragon, hundreds of meters in length, thunderously descended, a raging wind swept up smoke and dust across the square, prompting the soldiers guarding the treasury to instinctively close their eyes.
Leading them, the chief bent down to pay his respects, greeting the one atop the dragon: “Greetings, Princess Estelle.”
However, before Princess Estelle could speak, Jack Clark, who stood between the two women, made his move. In an instant, the blue Flying Dragon let out a mournful scream as its massive body crashed to the ground.
At that moment, Jack Clark had already instantaneously appeared at the treasury entrance, feeling the oscillations of the Primordial Genesis Rules within him growing more intense.
At the same time, Jack Clark could sense that a power within the treasury was awakening, causing all of Heaven and Earth to tremble beneath this dreadful might.
Crack! Under the astonished gazes of the guards and people like Estelle, the formidable and strict treasury crumbled silently into nothingness.
And it wasn’t just the crumbling; including countless resources and items stored within the Kamor Empire, as well as the very space of that area, all turned into nothingness.
In the center of that pitch-black void stood a towering, thirty-meter high, twenty-meter wide, severely damaged black stele with obvious signs of fracture at the top.
“It’s that stele!” Estelle exclaimed in surprise.
However, unlike five years ago, the once indestructible and dimly lit stele was now emitting a Seven-Colored Glow, with each of its ancient inscriptions lighting up one by one.
Suddenly, a supreme power that transcended all Rules permeated the air.
Beneath the rippling effect, like that on the surface of a lake, Space-Time twisted and transformed, making all of Heaven and Earth ephemeral, as a multi-colored river enveloped the Firmament.
Boom! The terrifying power of Time washed over everything, warping all existence.
Within the Seven-Colored Glow, as Space-Time interwove, Estelle, Amitya, the soldiers, and even the entire city, including its surroundings, disappeared from Jack Clark’s sight.
Or rather, Jack Clark had been pulled into the depths of this multi-colored river that contained time and towered above Space-Time.
Around Jack Clark, time reversed at an alarming speed, forming a radiant tunnel swirling with multi-colors – in the blink of an eye, tens of thousands, a hundred thousand years passed…
Facing such immense Time Power and control over Space-Time, even Jack Clark couldn’t help but be astonished.
Primordial True Emperor!
No, even a Primordial True Emperor could not reverse tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years within a Great Thousand Worlds. This power was no longer that of the fourth, fifth, or sixth layer of the Heavenly Boundary.
Indeed, it was him!
Whoosh! Jack Clark took a deep breath, suppressing the slight excitement in his heart.
After all, this was the former leader who led the Ancient Human Race to tear through Space-Time and embark on expeditions to other worlds, the chief among the seven great Ancient Civilization Emperors, “Henry”.
Even when entering the Ancient Battlefield and entering the mythical world, under his leadership, the Ancient Human Race still dominated unchallenged.
He even ventured alone into the depths of the Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon of a hostile peak civilization and suppressed a True Emperor-level strong man from different races bearing the name “Henry”.
With me, invincible, looking down upon all beings.
This was Jack Clark’s first impression of the Ancient Emperor Henry when he first investigated his background.
Under Jack Clark’s solemn gaze, the reversing Time Power around him gradually subsided, and beneath his feet, the roaring, colorful river surged mightily, covering the entire world.
A towering figure, millions of kilometers tall, emerged above the river, transitioning from a blur to a clear figure, as if walking from the past through Space-Time.
Immediately, an indescribable aura of nobility spread throughout.
Upon seeing the middle-aged figure with an ancient countenance, Jack Clark seemed to witness the eternal singularity, everlasting life, and even as the cosmos faded, he still existed eternally across countless visions.
Facing the towering figure on the other end of the colorful river, Jack Clark courteously said, “Jack Clark of the Human Race, greets the Ancient Emperor, Henry!”
The middle-aged man, dressed in a white Imperial Robe and standing with his hands behind his back, slowly began to speak. His voice was grandiose, resonating with a gentle ancientness over the River of Destiny.
But his words were somewhat startling to Jack Clark.
“Jack Clark, you have finally arrived.”
Jack Clark thoughtfully gazed at the middle-aged man at the other end of the river: “Senior, did you leave that stele tens of thousands of years ago waiting for me?”
The Primordial True Emperor truly began to master Space-Time, capable of reversing time within a certain area and resurrecting those who had fallen.
Of course, this mastery applied within their own Divine Realm or the Great Thousand Worlds’ Time River they manifested, with their power influencing a certain surrounding area, not the Endless Chaotic Sea.
This was why the Primordial True Emperor was much more powerful than a Monarch of the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary, and all other lesser primordial beings.
And this Emperor, who had presumably made a breakthrough to the Eternal Immortal Realm of the Seventh Heaven, could foresee that he would appear today – it seems natural.
Monarch Heng slowly nodded, “Indeed, I have been waiting for you and have left behind a legacy here sufficient for your breakthrough to the primordial, even to ascend to the Seventh Heaven Realm.”
“An opportunity of the Seventh Heaven Realm!”
Jack Clark’s expression changed subtly, feeling not so much elated by the news but instead overwhelmed by a great wave in his heart.
Henry had left the stele here tens of thousands of years ago, anticipating Jack Clark’s arrival, knowing that one day in the future he would come to this world.
Then, was the Emperor Inheritance at the end of the Road to Becoming a God on the Continent of Void Heritage in Blue Star, also deliberately left for him?
With this thought, Jack Clark felt his destiny had been prearranged, his efforts thus far negated, along with the discomfort that all his secrets lay exposed under the spotlight.

chapters.title: Chapter 1854: 685 Henry, The Eternity of Henry, The Destruction of the Human Race Across the Heavens_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1854: Chapter 685 Henry, The Eternity of Henry, The Destruction of the Human Race Across the Heavens_2
Is the opportunity in the Primal Seventh Heaven great? Indeed, it is.
But for Jack Clark, as long as he is given a bit of time, he can easily transcend the Primal Seventh Heaven, the Eighth, the Ninth, and even stepping into Eternity is not impossible.
Thus, he spoke with a somewhat cold tone: “So, at the end of the path of inheritance on the Blue Star Void Continent, you, Senior, purposely left that rudimentary Rule for me?”
Pay attention to the change in Jack Clark’s tone, Monarch Heng revealed a faint smile on his face, his voice gentle.
“Rest assured, I did not scheme against you. The inheritance of your race is simply a choice of Destiny, a power beyond my control even as I tread upon Eternity.”
“…Wait, what did you say, Senior? You have already entered Eternity!!”
Jack Clark reacted instantly, his face showing shock: “Didn’t Blazing Heaven Senior and the others say that you had departed to breakthrough the Seventh Heaven?”
“That was merely a trace of me in this Chaos Cosmos.”
Monarch Heng’s voice was grand and resounded through the River of Fate: “My path is the Eternal Path, my True Body transcends the endless Chaos, my strength omnipresent.”
“This Chao Sea, the Civilization Emperor Heng from the universe you once belonged to, was but a manifestation of a Will Projection of mine.”
“Leading the ‘Human Race’ to rise toward a mythical and eternal civilization is part of my path, not limited to the ‘humans’ of this particular universe.”
“The destined trajectory of ‘my’ existence in this Chao Sea would have seen me successfully breakthrough the Seventh Heaven, return to the Ancient Battlefield to suppress various races, and lead the Human Race to even greater heights.”
“But, at the moment of ‘my’ breakthrough to the Seventh Heaven, destinies converged, and I saw ‘you’.”
“Me.” Jack Clark was stunned.
Monarch Heng nodded: “Indeed, from the depths of the River of Fate, I saw a day (in mythical world time) tens of thousands of years later when you would appear on the battlefield where I (True Body) and another Eternal struggle.”
“So, my Will descended, the traces united to deduce the past and future, and I saw that ‘tens of thousands of years later’, you and your Giant Beast Body would appear here.”
“Yet, the Destiny within you is obscure; I cannot see your past or future.”
“I do not know how, at this time, being only at the Late Stage of True Spirit, and just after your breakthrough with the Giant Beast Body, you could step into Eternity and intervene in the battlefield between me and another Eternal within such a short period.”
“Therefore, I have come here, to the place of your emergence.”
“This is a world transformed by the True Body of an Abyss Lord who is half-step into Eternity, on the verge of breaking through the Seventh Heaven…”
As ‘Monarch’ Heng spoke, the River of Destiny trembled, an Invisible Power permeated downwards, projecting scenes of the past before Jack Clark’s eyes.
