Tens of thousands of years ago, a battle involving the Seventh Heaven, ancient and immortal, erupted here, and the outcome was self-evident.
Faced with the descent of an eternal Will, the Monarch Heng who had already broken through the Seventh Heaven Realm, naturally, the Abyss Lord was no match and was quickly defeated, sustaining heavy injuries.
But Heng did not slay it; instead, he nearly erased its Will, severing and suppressing it deep within the world from the Immortal Demon Body.
And Heng also severed its immortal True Body, merging it with this world and eternally suppressing the Abyss Lord, preventing it from breaking free while it continuously grew and perfected the Immortal Demon Body.
As for the unique Rule of this world, it includes the World Origin accumulated over tens of thousands of years.
A small part of it comes from those invading Evil Gods and forces of the Supreme Plane, but the majority is derived from the suppressed Divine Soul Intent of the Abyss Lord.
The reason for doing this was that he intended to help Jack Clark and his Giant Beast Body together breakthrough the Seventh Heaven.
To hasten his steps toward breaking through to Eternity and stepping onto the battlefield where he and another Eternal are engaged in battle in the not-so-distant future.
Although he did not understand, unable to fathom how, within the predestined trajectory of fate, Jack Clark could step into Eternity so swiftly without his assistance.
And even with his intervention, aiding Jack Clark in quickly accumulating the power needed for a breakthrough to the ‘pseudo’ Seventh Heaven Realm, Henry still couldn’t foresee how Jack would step into eternity in such a short amount of time.
Or perhaps the destiny he witnessed through this trace was actually deceiving ‘him’.
A deception from destiny.
But no matter what the future holds, Henry still casually left behind this ‘opportunity’.
To someone who has stepped into eternity like himself, it’s insignificant whether he has a Seventh Heaven Realm body derived from traces of other spaces and times, other chaotic universes.
Of course, even if Jack Clark uses the vast origin energy left by him, and successfully ‘fuses’ and ‘devours’ the two immortal true bodies with the help of the galaxy array that covers the entire world, it’s still only a ‘pseudo’ Seventh Heaven Realm.
By the time everything was said, Jack Clark’s heart was already engulfed in surging waves and shock.
Awe-struck by the strength of an eternal-level existence.
Countless spaces, countless worlds, everywhere, truly reflecting the heavens—Is this the power of an eternal existence?
This is a power and a path different from the ‘Giant Beasts’ of the mythical world, as well as the Chaotic Nightmare Master Giant Beast that was heavily injured.
But at the same time, Jack Clark also dimly realized that eternity seems not to be the ultimate limit of power.
Otherwise, why would these Eternal Behemoths, eternal strong men fight and even burst into battles to the death?
As Jack Clark was emotionally impacted, Henry standing at the other end of the River of Destiny slightly smiled: “Go for it, Jack Clark; I am looking forward to the day when you will appear before me.”
“Also, I am the origin of the ‘Human Race’, if I fail and cannot defeat those two eternals, all of the Human Race across the endless worlds will be affected.”
“Even completely erased from existence.”
“This is not a threat, it’s stating a fact. I hope that you will do everything possible to make an early breakthrough into eternity, for you, for everything you wish to protect.”
“I, actually, don’t know how much longer I can hold on…”
In the voice tinged with faint emotion, the majestic figure at the end of the River of Destiny slowly dissipated, and at the same time, a terrifying power of Time Power erupted from the end of the river.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s consciousness was shaken, and time around him advanced at a terrifying speed; countless visions flashed by him, seas changed into mulberry fields, millennia passed in the blink of an eye.
When the scene around Jack Clark restored, the colorful river that covered the world had already disappeared.
Simultaneously, Amitya and the others who had disappeared appeared again, including the guards; everything was as it was tens of thousands of years ago before his arrival, unchanged.
The only difference was that the broken stele had now become complete, standing a kilometer tall at the center of the shattered Void.
The stele was engraved with celestial stars and countless complex rule runes, shrouded in a seven-colored glow, forming a colossal and vast galaxy vision in its surroundings.
Looking at the glinting stele, everyone felt an intense desire in their hearts, as if by mastering the stele, one could master the entire world.
But as they looked at the figure of the young man standing at the edge of the Dark Void with his hands behind his back, everyone felt their legs tremble, not daring to make a move.
Within that black-haired young man, it seemed as if a terrifying power was awakening, a Supreme Power that towered above the countless beings.
At this moment, only Amitya, who was a Contractor, felt the least pressure, showing some hesitation: “…Jack, what just happened?”
[]

chapters.title: Chapter 1855: 686: Breakthrough Primordial, Peak Civilization Unite
chapters.content:
Chapter 1855: Chapter 686: Breakthrough Primordial, Peak Civilization Unite
The moment Jack Clark touched the stele, the entire world lit up with a white glow, turning night into day.
In the light, a colossal white divine tree phantom appeared, covering the whole world. Its branches reached into the starry sky beyond, stretching infinitely with galaxies hanging from its twigs.
At the base of the white divine tree phantom, its roots extended deep into the Earth, spreading endlessly downward, enveloping a huge Demonic body that only Jack Clark could ‘see’—the Abyss Lord.
This tree was the very same World Tree left behind when Henry disappeared. It never perished, simply transformed into rules and merged with the world, linking stellar formations and suppressing the entire world.
At the same time, it constructed the special power system network of this world.
Just then, a cold, emotionless voice sounded slowly between heaven and earth from within the stele.
“Identity authentication in progress…”
“Current life form, Human Race, first command confirmed.”
“Fate aura detection…”
“Fate mark confirmed, identity confirmed, commencing authority inheritance…”
Hum!
The luxuriant World Tree phantom shone brightly as a vast and boundless Rule Force descended, squeezing and bursting the space around Jack Clark, robustly merging into his body.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Due to the overwhelming influx of Rule Force, a roaring tsunami ensued.
Synchronized with identity ‘authentication’, Jack Clark no longer needed to seal himself. A deep and resonant bell sound slowly rose from within his body, dong!
Boom! An Aura, at the Late Stage of True Spirit level but rivaling Primordial in majesty, burst forth from Jack Clark and soared into the sky.
The terrifying Aura caused the whole imperial city, the entire Kamor Empire, and even the continent and this world to shake. Heavenly Energy ran wild, and the cosmos trembled.
The sudden anomaly shocked countless people across the world, who watched in astonishment the white divine tree phantom covering the heavens and earth, as well as the supreme pressure overpowering the rules.
Including the demonic entities from the other two torn continents, all shivered under that Primordial Aura cloaking the world.
Meanwhile, in the depths of the Evil God Palace underground, Boroedo and Mpolak, who were consolidating their power to prevent accelerated loss, suddenly opened their eyes.
Feeling the faint world fluctuations transmitted from the surface and the terrifying pressure piercing through space-time, Boroedo spoke with some gravity, “This presence, seems like Brother Darren Callum has revealed himself?”
“It’s him.”
Shrouded in shadow, Mpolak looked somewhat surprised, “But it seems like he hasn’t triggered the World Rules, and there are no signs of him being suppressed into the Earth?”
Boroedo also realized this and his face immediately broke into a smile, admiringly saying, “Worthy of coming from the Eternal World, his ways are indeed stronger than ours.”
“Brother Callum must have discovered something; that’s why he burst forth all his power. It won’t be long before he can free us.”
Enveloped in black armor, Mpolak nodded, a faint, fiendish smile appeared on his face.
And while those two Hell Messengers were awaiting Jack Clark to rescue them, to the eyes of Amitya and the others, Jack Clark’s figure was already slowly fading and vanishing.
Gone with him were the black stele and the phantom of the World Tree.
Soon the world returned to calm, the sky-covering divine tree phantom, and the Primordial Aura that made the whole world tremble, all disappeared as if everything that had happened was an illusion.
Of course, these people knew it was not an illusion.
But at this moment, no one knew what changes the strange events would bring to this world, including Estelle lying on the ground and Amitya barely standing.
The purple-haired girl was especially lost in thought.
She hadn’t expected Jack Clark to be not some Divine Position Phantom Beast taking human form, the King of Phantasmal Beasts, but rather an unfathomably powerful ‘human strong man’.
No wonder, he once said he was not a phantom beast.
…
So much Origin.
In the depths of the rule-transformed white World Tree, Jack Clark was somewhat shocked as he looked at the white energy materializing all around him, Origin, all of it was Origin.
Suppressing and dissolving the Divine Soul Intent of an Abyss Lord just half a step from the Seventh Heaven Realm, returning to the original and converting into World Origin.
Plus the continuous invasion of this realm by true spirits and even half-step Primordials, draining everything dry, coupled with power from the agents of Supreme Planes looted from their bodies.
After tens of thousands of years of accumulation, the Origin within this World Tree had become so abundant that it formed an ocean.
If these Origins were converted into Origin Points, and then into Creation Force, Primordial Air, they would be sufficient for Jack Clark and the Terminal Emperor Dragon to condense a Fourth Layer.
Of course, only Jack Clark could directly use the World Origin to upgrade his Primordial Realm.
The existence of Origin Points was even more astonishing than the Lifeline Talent and exceeding god-given talents Jack Clark had condensed; though not directly enhancing his strength, their supportive function had reached its limit.
Without hesitation, and already possessing partial ‘Heavenly Dao’ privileges, Jack Clark started to ‘consume’ immediately.
Boom!
World Origin around him erupted, flowing ceaselessly towards Jack Clark, who, transformed into a Black Hole, continuously devoured them, transforming them into his unique ‘Origin Points’.
Instantly, the Origin Points on the attribute page jumped at a terrifying rate, breaking through one hundred thousand, two hundred thousand, five hundred thousand…
Boom! Jack Clark’s True Body suddenly expanded, revealing a Primordial Demon God True Body that was four hundred thousand meters tall, with three faces and ten arms, wearing an Imperial Robe and an Imperial Crown.
Having enough Origin Points did not mean Jack Clark’s realm could instantly improve; he still needed to cultivate.
Growth in his True Body to reach the Primordial on the life plane, Divine Power, talent, and Supreme Rule all needed evolution to ultimately become the Primordial Rule, Superior Divine Power.

chapters.title: Chapter 1856: 686: Breakthrough Primordial, Peak Civilization Alliance_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1856: Chapter 686: Breakthrough Primordial, Peak Civilization Alliance_2
Meanwhile, Jack Clark’s mental voice echoed in his mind: “Burn all Attribute points, enter the epiphany state.”
Whoosh! Over twenty million Points Attribute ignited, emitting dazzling light, transforming into a layer of white flame that was distinct from the World Origin and enveloped Jack Clark.
However, that was still not enough, and Jack Clark’s voice continued in his mind: “Convert five hundred thousand Origin Points into Primordial Air, and five hundred thousand Origin Points into Creation Force.”
“Transform one million points of Primordial and Creation Force within the body of the Giant Beast…”
Roar!
In the Chaotic Sea outside the Black World, the Black-red Colossal Beast, whose size had grown to over sixty thousand kilometers, roared, and an even more powerful aura Burst forth from its body.
The endlessly escalating terror and pressure made the Silver Giant Dragon perched upon the Beast’s head tremble and stare blankly.
Tim Abott was too strong, too monstrous.
But the Silver Giant Dragon soon showed a human-like expression of schadenfreude on its face, for the Purple little dragon was not there.
Every time the Terminal Emperor Dragon made a breakthrough, the breakthrough and life essences it released would promote the bloodline and even the realm progression of the Purple little dragon that lay on its head.
But this time, the Terminal Emperor Dragon was not just making a breakthrough in the Primordial, it was even on the verge of breaking through to the second day of the Primordial Boundary.
If the Purple little dragon was here, absorbing the massive life essence released by the Terminal Emperor Dragon, perhaps it could take advantage of this opportunity to leap to become a True Spirit Beast.
This time, it seemed that only the Great Sethia alone would enjoy this opportunity.
The Silver Giant Dragon’s face revealed a happy (fierce) smile, cozily lying down, its will guiding the bloodline strength within its body, transforming into an ice-cold, twisted space vortex to absorb the pervasive Primordial energy around it.
This was the energy released by the body of the Terminal Emperor Dragon as it made its realm breakthrough, similar to the heat discharged by a burning fireball.
This Qi Blood would dissipate back into the Heaven and Earth even if the Silver Giant Dragon didn’t absorb it.
Of course, under normal conditions, when a Primordial Beast breaks through, an area of billions of kilometers around it becomes a forbidden zone, with no other Giant Beast or living creature able to step into the range of the Primordial Heavenly Realm.
The Silver Giant Dragon could be here because it was protected by the rules of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
As it devoured the pure energy from the Primordial breakthrough, the Silver Giant Dragon that had just broken through to the True Spirit Realm not long ago experienced a surge in internal strength, growing at a rate visible to the naked eye.
In the process of Evolution and growth, the image of the Silver Giant Dragon increasingly resembled that of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Of course, the ever more massive and fierce Silver Giant Dragon’s scale armor remained silver.
As Jack Clark devoured and absorbed a large amount of the Origin, serving as the foundation of the laws that suppress the Black World, the forces that originally restrained the Evil God and the deeper Abyss Lord became even more apparent.
In the deep darkness, those eyes covered in Black Flames and peering into the Dark Void opened once again, revealing a touch of excitement this time.
For tens of thousands of years, tens of thousands of years, the Seal had finally begun to loosen.
Once it got out, it would retrieve its True Body and demon body to become one, restoring its peak strength; it would definitely kill all the humans of this world, and those from other Space-Times as vengeance.
Meanwhile, while Jack Clark was in Closed-door Cultivation and making a breakthrough.
Chaos Emperor City
A burly man with full golden facial hair, exuding the aura of one at the Peak of the Ancient, quickly flew across high altitude, occasionally twisting his neck as if he was not quite accustomed to this body.
Soon, this imposing man arrived at the central city within the Imperial City, landing and entering like a normal human.
Reflected in the mirror hanging at the city gate, the man with golden facial hair was shown as a standard human, showing no reaction.
On the bustling and lively street, the man with golden facial hair looked around and then found a corner to sit down cross-legged, tossing out a piece of gray rag in front of him, scattering upon it some Heaven and Earth Treasure suitable for those at the Ancient God King Realm.
After disguising himself a bit, the man with golden facial hair ‘boredly’ looked up at the splendid palaces standing above the Firmament, his gaze flickering with light.
“There, is that where the human is in a retreat for Closed-door Cultivation?”
“A half-step into the Primordial, comparable to the strength of a stronger Primordial Star, it’s actually worth for those higher-ups to offer two Chaotic Supreme Treasures as a bounty.”
“In such a case, either this human’s strength is more formidable than what the information suggests, or his strength level has stepped into that of a Primordial Overlord.”
“Either this peak civilization known as the Human Race is harboring a frightening hidden strength, so terrifying that even those offering rewards dare not provoke them openly.”
With this thought, the golden-whiskered strong man revealed a cold smile in his eyes, because to him, either possibility was of no consequence.
With his strength at the pinnacle of the Primordial Third Heaven’s Peak, capable of retreating unscathed even when facing a True Emperor, he could easily suppress and kill even if this human possessed a monstrous power on par with a Primordial Overlord.
If it’s the latter, there’s even less reason to care.
For a wanderer like him, killing a person and then simply leaving—how could the terrifying hidden powers of the Human Race find him once he’s left this cluster of civilizations?
All he needed to do was wait for this human to come out of Closed-door Cultivation, then his true body would find a way to make some noise outside and lure him away from the bounds of the Imperial City.
Then, his death hour would strike.
Looking up at the glittering palaces in the sky, the golden-whiskered strong man’s eyes revealed a faint, cold smile.
As a strong entity of a different race, at the pinnacle of Primordial Monarch lurked into the Chaos Emperor City, a piece of news spread astonishingly fast among the other peak civilizations surrounding the Human Race.
The current guardian of the Chaos Emperor City, Jack Clark, also known as Darren Callum.
This man, a few Sun Wheels ago, was but at the Titan Peak and slew a genius from the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe with bloodline of the Eternal Heavenly God at the same realm.
Then, after a single Sun Wheel, he soared to the Peak of the Ancient and in the depths of the Ancient Dueling Arena, killed a monstrous Ancient Overlord from the Gloomy Heaven Clan with Primordial Bloodline.
Now, after three Sun Wheels, this human has broken through to half a step into Primordial, possessing the strength of Primordial Stars to guard an Imperial City.
Not long ago, during the emergence event of a Chaotic Supreme Treasure, he ambushed and killed the Guardians from the Golden Eternity Race, Youtian War God Clan, and Silver-Winged Sky Ant Clan.
Such a fearsome growth rate and defiance of the heavens in combat power instantly sent shockwaves through the nine great peak civilizations and several top-tier civilizations.
Many ‘people’ felt the truth of the news might be overstated, too exaggerated to believe.
Under normal conditions, if an individual was supported by the full force and resources of a peak civilization, it was indeed possible to achieve such a growth spurt.
But along with the advancement in realm, the Divine Powers, combat strength, one’s personal battle armor and weapons, as well as the understanding of rules, would also grow in sync, rather than merely increasing in realm which would be quite unbelievable.
How could anyone possibly defy the heavens to this extent?
While those of the Ancient level and the True Spirit level scoffed at this news, the strong beings above the True Emperor rank among these peak civilizations began to receive a ‘delivery’ through various channels.
Contained within was only a Divine Object imprinted with information, which shocked all of these powerful beings.
Soon, within the nine great peak civilizations, several civilizations began to stir internally, eventually gathering in an unknown Void.
In the raging Chaotic Air Waves of the Void, six towering figures shrouded in hazy light, indiscernible in appearance and aura and thus unidentifiable as to which race they belonged, stood firmly.
One of the vague figures trembled slightly as a deep, indifferent voice echoed through the Chao Sea.
“Six out of the nine great peak civilizations have sent messengers here, it seems everyone has long held dissatisfaction towards this new and Overbearing race of the Human Race.”
No sooner had the towering figure finished speaking than a hoarse voice answered from the opposite side.
“Enough talk, by coming here we’ve already shown our stance. But before that, we need you to show us evidence credible enough to believe.”
“Such as revealing your identity as belonging to the Youtian Clan or the King Roar Clan.”
“Moreover, confirm whether Darren Callum’s identity is as you’ve claimed, truly the person who returned after breaking through the Seventh Heaven Realm and is currently in a special state of re-cultivation.”
“Only then will we consider joining forces to pinpoint his ‘location’ and strangle him.”
“Indeed.”
“I concur.”
The other three towering figures nodded slightly.
In an instant, the figure who first spoke narrowed his eyes; it was apparent that these beings also did not want to wage full-scale war against the Human Race but were prepared to unite to suppress and kill Darren Callum instead.
This did not match the internal agreement of their tribes to seize this opportunity to obliterate the Human Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 1857: 687: Three True Names, A Blink of a Century
chapters.content:
Chapter 1857: Chapter 687: Three True Names, A Blink of a Century
In the Chaos Sea, six figures exuding the oppressive aura of the Primary Fourth Heavenly Realm stood towering.
Enveloped by hazy strength concealing the secrets of heaven around them, they restrained their aura, making it impossible for anyone to see clearly who the other was or which race they came from.
At this moment, the atmosphere among the six was somewhat tense, with five figures watching silently the one who had first spoken.
Hahahahaha… Suddenly, one of the five figures burst into laughter, and then the white light covering him dissipated, revealing a figure towering a hundred thousand kilometers tall.
Like an Obsidian-cast figure, it stretched across like a Divine Mountain, and in its cheeks, black flames danced within four pairs of slender white eyes.
Under the gaze of those four pairs of eyes burning with flames, one of the strongmen from the different races spoke, his voice tinged with surprise.
“Alquest, it’s actually you.”
The other three different races’ strongmen were also somewhat surprised.
Unexpectedly, the first to openly show hostility towards the Human Race was not the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan, which had the most significant conflict with the Human Race. This means…
Under the gaze of the four different races’ strongmen, the first who spoke let his gaze turn cold, as the black mist shrouding him gradually dispersed.
He and Alquest were of the same party, revealing his identity naturally as the concealment dissipated.
But what once again silenced the four strongmen of the different races was that this strongman was not the anticipated Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon, bearing a grudge against the Human Race, but the ‘neutral’ Eternal Heavenly God of the Golden Clan.
Atop his true body measuring a hundred and fifty thousand kilometers, golden flames leaped, burning through Chaos, their light dispelling the chaotic airflow of countless kilometers around, forming a pure golden world.
Standing within the eternal golden world, the Seventh Eternal Heavenly God, Siegmund, slowly spoke, his voice cold: “My lords, Alquest and I have already revealed our true bodies, isn’t it about time you show yours?”
“Being here implies that you’ve already communicated through the will within your clans, there’s no need to continue hiding.”
Upon hearing this, one of the different races’ strongmen spoke, his voice hoarse and deep.
“Siegmund, you are right, but unless it’s certain that Darren Callum is ‘Henry’, and before we suppress him, none of us will show our faces.”
The other three strongmen of the different races nodded slightly; while they didn’t say anything, their stance was clear.
Suddenly, silence descended upon the scene again.
Siegmund and Alquest exchanged glances, their brows slightly furrowed, as they didn’t expect these few beings and their respective peak civilizations to be so careful.
What these different races actually feared was not Human retaliation or misidentifying Darren Callum as Henry and mistakenly killing him.
What they truly feared was that Darren Callum was indeed Henry.
The very first Human Race strongman who disappeared for ten thousand years, who faced the Sixth Heavenly Realm with just his True Emperor realm strength, and who, upon entering the Sixth Heavenly Realm, slew a Primordial being of the same realm.
If that human was Henry who has broken through to the Seventh Heaven Realm and returned, and they fail to annihilate him during his ‘recovery period’, then they would face a horrific retaliation.
Given that human’s terrifying combat strength, he could extinguish a peak civilization all by himself once he returns to his peak.
If that happens, only if the surrounding peak races join forces could anyone stand against him.
The reason why these civilizations are willing to take the risk against Henry who is so powerful is because no one desires the emergence of an invincible king in the Ancient Battlefield, eternally submissive to the Human Race.
After a moment of silence, the Golden Dragon Man within the golden radiance spoke once again, his voice detached: “This is the sincerity you demanded, to prove that particular human is ‘Henry’.”
As he spoke, Siegmund spread his hand, several thousand kilometers wide, and a golden world slowly opened within his palm.
A flow of time within the golden world mirrored, reflecting an imposing grey Arena, with two figures emanating the aura of Titan Peak standing in it.
They were none other than Jack Clark’s battle against Nashigyas of the Golden Clan.
And behind Jack Clark, who showed his Three-faced, Eight-armed Demon God True Body, layers of Space-Time shattered, like transparent glass fragments frozen in the air.
Each of these fragments revealed an incomplete image, some of Jack Clark’s military campaigns against the Purgatory Demon Race, some with him standing with hands behind his back, overlooking the Earth from the sky.
These fragments eventually formed a circle, with a quietly spinning grey light orb at its center.
This light orb was the blank embryonic Primordial Rule that Jack Clark had obtained at the end of the Road to Becoming a God, the legacy left by Henry.
Behind the light orb, a faintly discernible towering figure stood, left hand held behind, right hand forming a seal.
Although it was only a shadow, the moment they saw that blurred figure, the four strongmen of the different races felt an invisible, domineering, and invincible pressure that reigned over Heaven and Earth.
Instantly, the few different races’ strongmen cried out.
“Henry!”
“It really is him!”
“He didn’t perish in that forbidden land, he truly broke through and returned!!”
Shocked beyond measure, the surrounding mist enveloping these strongmen trembled slightly, and the imposing aura on their bodies flashed momentarily.
“My fellows, now it is certain without a doubt,” Siegmund said with a faint smile on his face.
He had risked injury to invade the Ancient Dueling Arena, not only to peek at Jack Clark’s moment in time but also to snatch a thread of his aura from that time.
With the aid of this once-present aura of Jack Clark, the Golden Clan had spent a tremendous amount of resources painful even for True Emperors to conjure, secretly enlisting a strong man to retrospect the past.
This retrospection involved not just time but also a touch of Destiny, revealing many traces of Jack Clark’s past presence.
Most importantly, it confirmed the traces of ‘Henry’ on him, which shocked the other Eternal Heavenly Gods since Siegmund was proven right.
Only then was there the secret collaboration with the Youtian Clan and the spreading of the message to neighboring civilizations, including the plot to convey news about ‘Henry’ by using spies within other peak civilizations to the primordial beings and arranging this meeting.
The Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon Clan’s unexpected refusal to form an alliance and their absence here took the Golden Clan and the Gloomy Heaven Clan by surprise.
Previously, Alquest and another Eternal Heavenly God had visited the Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon Clan but returned empty-handed as well.
As for the cosmic bounty placed in that distant Great Thousand Worlds, it originated from the Gloomy Heaven Clan and the Golden Clan.
A different race’s strong man slowly exhaled, setting off a world-ending hurricane, his voice laced with a trace of dread and murderous intent: “This Darren Callum must die.”
Another different race’s entity, surrounded by swirling black mist, nodded: “According to the fragments of destiny, he seems to be in some sort of reincarnation state, or perhaps a coordinate that leads his True Body back.”
“As long as we eradicate him, even if we cannot fully cause Henry to fall, it will be enough to prevent his return from that hopeless place.”
Speaking of which, the different race’s strong man looked towards the giant that resembled the Obsidian Mountain Range: “Speak, Alquest, what is your plan?”
Flames burned in Alquest’s eyes, cold light flickering in his cross pupils: “It’s simple, first lure that human out of the First Layer of the Chaos Cosmos.”
“The plan to lure the snake out of its hole is already underway, and as soon as the time is right, we can draw Darren Callum out.”
“By then, every race needs to deploy a True Emperor, or even stronger warriors, to descend at the same time and strike with the force of Thunder, giving the Human Race no time to react.”
“Furthermore, should the assault be exposed, warriors from each race must intervene to obstruct the six Human True Emperors and deny them any chance of rescue.”
This plan is indeed straightforward, but executing it is extremely challenging.
For example, how to draw Jack Clark out from his ‘Closed-door Cultivation in the Chaos Emperor City’ and from that layer of the Chaos Cosmos?
Moreover, the True Emperor-level strong men of the neighboring Peak Civilizations have specific numbers, and most of them are engaged in standoffs deep in the Ancient Battlefield.
Thus, the moment the six True Bodies of the True Emperors move and converge in a direction, they will instantly alert the Human Race, possibly even revealing their assassination plan for Darren Callum.
In that event, other strong men from their races interfering with the Human True Emperors would immediately become exposed.
As a consequence, all of their efforts to conceal their auras now seem laughable, prompting a moment of doubt in the eyes of several different race strong men.
This is a conspiracy without a solution.
“Why wait until Darren Callum leaves the Chaos Emperor City? Why can’t we curse assassinate him now?” one different race strong man questioned.
“I recall that the first Domain Lord of the Gloomy Heaven Clan is proficient in nightmarish curses and causality. With his peerless cultivation reached the Sixth Heavenly Realm a thousand years ago, cursing Darren Callum who is merely a half step into the Primordial would not be a problem, right?”
“Of course, given Darren Callum’s background as Henry, the curse assassination will require significant expenditure. We will not be stingy with this, willing to share the cost.”
“This suggestion is good, safe, and efficient, and the Human Race can’t defend against it.”
“It just so happens that our clan’s treasure vault has recently acquired a Chaotic Supreme Treasure, containing power that can enhance the effectiveness of the curse assassination side’s strength. We’re willing to take it out.”
Obviously, even now, these different race strong men still do not wish to expose themselves or their backing clans.
Black Flames danced in Alquest’s eyes, his voice indifferent: “We’ve already considered this point and have attempted it, but unfortunately, it failed.”
This issue was already contemplated by the strong men of the Golden Clan and the Gloomy Heaven Clan the moment they confirmed Jack Clark’s identity.
At that time, the first domain lord of the Gloomy Heaven Clan made his move, using the Ziqi Liuli Mirror, which had been refined for hundreds of thousands of years, to shine across Heaven and Earth, penetrating Space-Time in an effort to lock onto Jack Clark’s true name.
However, the Sixth Heavenly Realm strong man, despite suffering tremendous loss to break through the obfuscating power of the Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor, discovered yet another hazy force concealing Jack Clark.
In this situation, a Fourth Heavenly Realm and a Fifth Heavenly Realm strong man from the Gloomy Heaven Clan joined forces, burning a source of Chaos that pained even an original True Emperor, and finally shattered that layer of obscurity.
To their shock, they found the Ziqi Liuli Mirror reflected three true names.
Despite repeated verifications by the Ziqi Liuli Mirror, the three names ‘Cang,’ ‘Tian,’ and ‘Di’ all appeared incredibly authentic, and even after burning another artifact comparable to a Chaotic Supreme Treasure, they could not discern which was real.
Unable to determine which of the three true names was real, the Ziqi Liuli Mirror could not lock onto the ‘essential’ existence of Jack Clark, preventing the power of the nightmare curse from assassinating him.
Confronted with this outcome, the two exhausted clans were naturally not reconciled. The strongest being of the Gloomy Heaven Clan attempted to curse assassinate the true name Cang.
And the result was a heavy injury, as a terrifying force from the depths of the mythical world, across the invisible remote Space-Time, rebounded and inflicted a heavy wound.
Clearly, this was Henry’s contingency for himself, a precaution against being assassinated by illusory forces.
Faced with this result, the two clans ultimately had no choice but to revert to their initial plan—to wait for the bait from the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary that took the bounty in the Chaos Emperor City to act and lure Jack Clark out of that layer of Chaos Cosmos.
And then, to rally the forces of all the races for a direct suppression.
After Alquest finished explaining, the strong men of the different races appeared somewhat solemn, finding it unexpectedly logical for someone of that man’s strength to be well-prepared for a return in such a manner.
“It seems we can only wait, though there are still some details to discuss…”
Following this, several towering figures discussed with Alquest and his companion for a while before dispersing silently under their watchful eyes.
Those who descended here were projections of their will embedded within their Rule bodies, seemingly matching the Primordial in surface power but dissolving upon touch, leaving no trace behind.
Despite their caution, they ultimately stepped right into their own elaborate scheming.
Thinking of this, Alquest and Siegmund exchanged a glance, both revealing a faint satisfaction in their eyes.
Under the pressure from Henry, the initial alliance among the Peak Civilizations has begun to take shape. What follows is to promote the conflict between the alliance and the Human Race, ultimately bringing those beings down completely.
By then, the joint force of the six Peak Civilizations will be powerful enough to inflict serious damage on the Human Race in the Ancient Battlefield, perhaps even to obliterate the six Human Divine Domains.
And even if they fail to kill Darren Callum this time, and Henry ultimately revives and returns, the combined forces of the six peak races will still be able to contend face-to-face, without being oppressed by the Human Race.
[There is still some finishing up to do, refresh in ten minutes]

chapters.title: Chapter 1858: 688: True. Star Level Giant Beast, Primordial Monarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 1858: Chapter 688: True. Star Level Giant Beast, Primordial Monarch
In the now-empty White Rules World Tree, Jack Clark sits cross-legged in Void, adorned in a Dark Dragon-Emperor Robe and crowned with twenty-four Black All-Heaven Emperor Crowns.
At this moment, Jack Clark’s True Body stands at 300,000 kilometers tall, akin to a colossal planetary celestial body, exuding an overwhelming sense of mass and oppression.
As Jack Clark opens his eyes, the entire Void trembles with a boom, as if a peerless deity has awakened, with the World Rules responding like a tidal wave.
Simultaneously, soft light waves of gold, white, and purple radiate from Jack Clark as the center, enveloping a hundred billion kilometers in the blink of an eye.
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s figure becomes blurred, as if sinking into a deeper world, yet emanating an impression of sublime grandeur, supremacy, akin to the highest sovereign of the Heavenly Dao.
This ‘light’ represents the heavenly brilliance Jack Clark has condensed, with the three layers symbolizing the Monarch Realm of the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary.
These are the rewards of Jack Clark’s ‘century’ of cultivation.
The reason it took a century is because the difficulty in progressing after reaching Primordial is even more exaggerated than Jack Clark had imagined, with normal conditions requiring ten years to barely make any progress.
In the Primordial Realm, even those with exceptional talent among the Human Race would take hundreds or thousands of years to advance a single step.
For instance, the six Civilizational Emperors of ancient times, each a monstrous talent that dominated an era, took over thirty thousand years in the mythical world, with an indeterminable number of real-time years, to only breakthrough the Fourth and Fifth Heavenly Realms.
Therefore, even Jack Clark, who could transform World Origin into any form of strength, still spent thirty years and more than sixty years to condense the latter two layers of Heavenly Realm.
That’s because the Heavenly Realm condensation is only one of the signs of the Primordial Realm; Jack Clark’s Primordial Demon God True Body and Divine Soul Intent also needed to undergo a transformation to keep up with the realm.
At this moment, Jack Clark feels immensely powerful, his will ruling supreme above the Heavenly Dao, and reaches out with a slight grab forward.
Boom! The remarkably solid space shatters, forming a black hole with a diameter of ten million kilometers.
And this black hole, unlike the past where space shatters into wild Space Turbulence, under the cover of the three-layered Heavenly Realm power, manifests in a multi-layered fashion.
In total, three layers, each separated by a dimensional boundary.
And when a Primordial Powerhouse stands across these dimensional boundaries, their strength is magnified tenfold in reverse from the material Chaos Sea, layered on top of one another.
This magnification is in terms of range, but the extension of range also contributes to the increase of strength.
Because a greater range is being controlled.
This is also the reason why during the Purple Glow Divine Dragon and Nightmare Fiend Beast’s ferocious battle, they entered another ‘world,’ where they could unleash their peak powers in the depths of dimensional boundaries.
At this moment, blood-red, silver-white, and black-gold tri-layer vertical pupils emerge in Jack Clark’s pitch-black eyes.
In the hundred years of breaking through Primordial, Jack Clark has not only advanced to the Third Heavenly Realm but also evolved all his strengths and paths to become even more formidable.
For example, the once three-faced ten-armed True Demon God Body has evolved into a sixteen-armed figure, increasing the number of arms, but the formerly intangible demonic and divine faces have now merged into one.
From afar, it appears as a seated multi-armed Demon God, with arms united in front at the abdomen, one hand lifting the heavens and the other forming a seal, with fourteen arms spread out in the back.
And as Jack Clark’s three faces merged, the three pairs of eyes that contained divine powers and Deification Talent were also united into one, their combined might formidable.
The instant the quadruple pupils appear in Jack Clark’s eyes, a terrifying gaze bursts forth, piercing through nothingness and reality, traversing the dimensional boundaries of the Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Heavenly Realms.
Starting from the Fourth Heavenly Realm, the dimensional boundaries are no longer filled with invisible tearing forces of the Void but also grey energies that make even Jack Clark’s scalp tingle with alarm.
These grey energies, akin to Chaos Energy streams in the Chaos Sea, emanate terrifying connotations of contamination, warping, madness, and absurdity.
The Void!
Below the third dimension lies the Void.
Yet the Void Energy contained within deeper dimensional boundaries is exponentially more dangerous than the simple rending of space that reveals the Dark Void.
“Unexpectedly, the deep dimensions within the Primordial, which can be entered at will, are related to the Void,” Jack Clark murmurs to himself, looking at the hazy images in the deeper dimensions, his eyes slowly retracting their triple pupils, reflecting contemplation.
The two Eternal Behemoths battled, rupturing the Chaos Sea and connecting to the supreme Chaos, whereas the path of cultivation for Primordial beings involves continuously unlocking Heavenly Realms and delving into the depths of multi-layered dimensions.
As their power expands, utilizing the forces of dimensions and boundaries, the existences of the Eighth and Ninth Primordial Realms can reflect the heavens and project upon the Endless World.
After feeling his newly acquired immense strength, Jack Clark prepares to summon the attribute page to assess the detailed changes post-breakthrough.
But immediately, his gaze shifts subtly, as another ‘vision’ appears in his eyes.
The Terminal Emperor Dragon has awakened.
As a ‘human,’ Jack Clark spent a lengthy period breaking through the Second and Third Primordial Heavens, and naturally, the hibernation of the colossal Terminal Emperor Dragon is also exceedingly prolonged.
After a century-long hibernation and ingesting a massive amount of Chaos Energy, the Terminal Emperor Dragon finally completes the evolution of a Monarch-level Giant Beast Body.
In the roaring chaos of murky air currents, the colossal Black-red Colossal Beast slowly opened its eyes.
Around those planet-sized golden vertical pupils, four rings of mysterious rune sequence chains in black, red, gold, and purple, slowly rotated, invisibly emanating a terrifying oppressive force.
Each of these rune sequence chains represented the Lifeline Talent projections of the Terminal Emperor Dragon.
Roar!
The evolved Black-red Colossal Beast couldn’t help but lift its head and bellow, its roar infused with terror and pressure, shaking the endless space-time, and the sound waves triggering explosions in the chaotic air currents for billions of kilometers.
The roar even penetrated the world’s crystal barrier, reverberating throughout the entire Black World.
Beneath that terrible ferocious and majestic roar, everyone shivered, their faces pale, an indescribable fear arising from deep within their souls.
Including the two Evil Gods who had been ‘suppressed’ under the Earth for a hundred years, who couldn’t help but turn pale.
Inside the towering palace, Boroedo looked up at the ‘Firmament’ above his head with some solemnity: “Mpolak, Mpolak, did you hear that roar just now?”
“Stop shouting, I heard it. I’m not that weak yet.”
Speaking, a figure clad in black armor, over two hundred meters tall, slowly walked out of the darkness.
Only now, this Hell Messenger appeared extremely gaunt, akin to a famine-stricken refugee who hadn’t eaten for several years, reduced to skin and bones.
Moving, his skeletal frame collided with his armor, producing a hollow clicking sound.
Even Boroedo, originally a towering figure as if carved from rock, because of the ‘material’ he was made of, was not as thin as a dried corpse; however, his rocky body had turned ashen-white, riddled with cracks and tiny holes.
Like a rock weathered for eons, giving off the fragile sense that it might crumble at a touch.
What’s more, the two Evil Gods emitted an extremely weak aura, so weak that their realms had already fallen from the True Spirit Level to the ancient times.
And the ancient oppressive force emanating from their withered True Bodies was so feeble, they seemed as if they could expire at any moment.
A hundred years had passed, and the two Evil Gods, suppressed by the World Rules and continuously drained of energy every moment, had reached a state of utter exhaustion.
And the long-awaited rescue had yet to arrive.
At this thought, Boroedo’s face showed a glimmer of hope: “Mpolak, do you think this Primordial Beast will enter our world?”
Mpolak shook his head slowly, weakly saying, “It depends on what kind of Primordial Beast this wanderer of the chaos is.”
“If it belongs to the devouring type, when it invades the world, we might still have hope to escape by unleashing our last bit of strength.”
“If it’s just passing by, then we should prepare our last words.”
With these words, the faces of the two Evil Gods showed bitterness and unwillingness.
As overlords who once dominated a world, as Hell Messengers who brought catastrophe and destruction to other worlds, their original path should have been triumphant and disdainful of all life.
Yet, who would have thought that one day they would silently fall in a seemingly ordinary, yet terrifying world.
As for Darren Callum, there was no hope of counting on him any longer.
A hundred years ago, he suddenly erupted with strength, and then his presence disappeared; he must have been suppressed by this world too, possibly as feeble and powerless as they were now.
Regarding the possibility of Darren Callum having fled, the two Evil Gods felt little hope.
Because if that ‘brother’ had escaped, he would have already led the Lord of Hell to descend and tear apart this world, rich with the voluminous World Origin.
Meanwhile, in the depths of this world, the will of the Abyss Lord sealed for hundreds of thousands of years was also disturbed.
Yet sensing the ‘World Rules’ that had loosened for a hundred years but were still strong and intact, this Abyss Lord’s will could not help but let out an angry roar.
“Henry, I will definitely kill you, wipe out every single one of the Human Race.”
“Wipe out all humans.”
Hearing these words, Jack Clark sitting inside the World Tree and sensing the transformation of the Emperor Dragon, stirred slightly, withdrawing part of his consciousness, his gaze piercing through the Void.
In the eyes of Jack Clark, who had seized the authority of the Heavenly Dao of this world, between two vast and unending structures like galaxies of indestructible ‘corpses,’ a series of white roots intertwined to form a giant cage.
Enclosed within the cage was a colossal black shadow.
Only this Abyss Lord, who had once nearly made a breakthrough to the Seventh Heavenly Realm, now had a will so utterly weak and transparent that only a few ‘lines’ constituted its figure.
“Next, it’s time to deal with this fellow.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1859: 689: King of the Ten Wheels Annihilation, Demigod Deification Fusion
chapters.content:
Chapter 1859: Chapter 689: King of the Ten Wheels Annihilation, Demigod Deification Fusion
As Jack Clark’s attention was drawn by the Abyss Lord, from atop the tens of thousands of kilometers large head of the Terminal Emperor Dragon in the Chaos Sea, an excited dragon roar was heard.
“Tim Abott, you’re awake.”
The silver giant dragon, over 900,000 kilometers in length and with wings crystallized like magnificent crystals, flew in the ‘air’, looking at the gigantic vertical pupil unfolding before its eyes, spanning ten thousand kilometers, extremely thrilled.
A hundred years have passed, under the thick chaos energy imbued with primordial aura in its surroundings, the silver giant dragon also achieved a breakthrough to the late stage of True Spirit, becoming a supreme colossal beast.
And it was not just growth in realm, its bloodline also purified under the influence of the Terminal Emperor Dragon, reaching a senior monarch level, possessing the potential to break through the Primordial.
Built on the foundation of a titan dragon descendant, growing to this extent over just a hundred years, it could be said that the silver giant dragon was truly the ‘Child of Destiny’.
Seeing the ‘ant’-like tiny silver giant dragon before it, the Terminal Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, its breath emitting a deep and heavy growl resonating with chaos.
“Mmm, I’m awake.” Having said that, the Terminal Emperor Dragon looked around, the confusion of a hundred years’ slumber gradually fading from its eyes.
A hundred years, to it/him, was too long; so long that many memories were drowned out by the infinite rules information, needing to be ‘found out’ from the depths of the soul.
Slightly distracted, the Terminal Emperor Dragon then focused its attention upon itself.
In a hundred years’ growth, its size surged directly from tens of thousands of kilometers to over 1.5 million kilometers, and its overall form underwent many changes as well.
For instance, the three rows of sharp-as-mountain-peak dorsal fins on its back became a bit shorter, among the denser and more slender mane along the spine, they appeared like rugged mountain peaks stretching thousands of kilometers high, extending for over 700,000 kilometers.
Followed by an even more slender tail extending 800,000 kilometers, the back becoming thicker with each sharp and pointed blackthorn resembling saw teeth.
The tip of the tail was exceptionally sharp, emitting a faintly discernible Dark Red Glow, spreading a terrifying aura of annihilating everything.
The body became more robust, four claws long and fierce, resembling a pure killing machine.
The dragon head also changed massively, behind the two pairs of fierce dragon horns that extended backwards, thirty-six sharp and somewhat shorter black-purple Scale Horns protruded, forming a magnificent crown.
Surrounded by dense, slender black mane, fluttering about making the Terminal Emperor Dragon appear even more majestic and imposing at this moment.
The signature three pairs of Crystal Red feather horns on both sides of the dragon head shrank to a scale of thousands of kilometers, like three actual red feather wings inserted slantingly among ribbon-like black mane, adding more mystery.
At the same time, the full-body scales armor became thicker, more protruding like spikes, and even deeper in color than before, resembling the light emitted when a black hole devours surrounding energy explosively.
Between those scales, the crimson light that was emitted had now turned into tangible down, moving without wind like a layer of burning blood flames, evoking an indescribable sense of dread and unease.
The first impression of this form of the Terminal Emperor Dragon was majesty, dominance, grandeur, and ferocity.
And these were just external changes; this breakthrough transformed the power of both Jack Clark and the Terminal Emperor Dragon tremendously.
Thinking of this, a transparent page simultaneously appeared in the eyes of both the Terminal Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark.
Realm: Primordial Monarch [Holder of Heaven, Monarch, and dual true names at the Third Layer of the Heavenly Realm]
Primordial Physique: 847 [1 point equals the strength of the same realm Primordial God Demon True Body, base strength, base defense, base capacity for Primordial Rules]
Primordial Soul: 451 [1 point equals the thickness of the Primordial Demon God’s Soul Source in the same realm]
Dark Star Demon God True Body: [Based on the two Primordial Rules ‘strength’ and ‘Primordial Genesis’, forged by the force of three-dimensional dimensions, a Demon God’s Body that supersedes Heaven and Earth, a chaotic being.
The chaos within itself, endless strength never exhausting, disregards any ultimate laws restricting heavenly abilities.
Dark Star Demon God. Ten Wheels Annihilation True King form.
Fused with the Five Great Demon God Seals, Ten Overwhelming Worlds-ending Combat Techniques, Demon God Emperor Dragon Bloodline Power, Creation Force/Supreme True Strength (two Supreme Rules broken through elemental Primordial condensed mystique), Eight Desolations Heaven-Opening World-Destroying Halberd, Despair Demon God Armor, Chaotic Bronze Bell, the ultimate form.
Under the form of Annihilation True King, the base strength, defense, and authority of the rules increase 356 times.]
Granted Primordial Flame, Primordial Thunder, Primordial Death, Primordial Soul, Primordial Void, Primordial Great Void, Primordial Nothingness, Primordial Beginnings. Halberd, Primordial Shaking Death Bell, Primordial Despair. Armor, enveloped by Ten Heavy Chaos Light Wheels.
Each Chaos Light Wheel contains one type of Primordial Rule’s power, with differing strengths and attributes.]
Holder of the four Supreme Divine Powers, Vacuum Devouring, Eternal Force Field, Heaven-walking Divine Steps, Time Reincarnation (Primordial version of Time Reincarnation Divine Power)]
Hint one: Because the true body is too powerful, in ordinary human form, it needs to compress the surrounding space-time at the Third Layer of the Heavenly Realm, thus only able to exert 30% power.]
Hint two: When the true body is unfolded, the expanding space tides will destroy everything within a range of ten million kilometers, affecting up to a billion kilometers, please be cautious about the unfolding circumstances]
Deification Talent: Soul Split [Deification: 1/2]
Special Trace: Ancient Duel Mark, Hell’s Eye [Contains the seed of Supreme Hell within]
Origin Points: 0 [Special energy transformed from the World Origin, can be used as Creation Force and Primordial Air, including strengthening the Giant Beast Body]
Avatar Body: Chaos. Heavenly Sky. Terminal Emperor Dragon
Level: Primordial Monarch [Body length 1,530,000 kilometers, growth period of a Heavenly Tier Colossus]
Bloodline: Heavenly Tier Emperor Dragon. King [Further enhanced Heavenly Tier bloodline through Primordial Transformation, bloodline level equivalent to the eighth day of the Primordial Immortal Realm]

chapters.content:
Chapter 1860: Chapter 689: King of the Ten Wheels Annihilation, Demigod Deification Fusion_2
Body of The End [Forged by the Supreme Chaos and Supreme Destruction, two Primordial Rules, after undergoing 1,202,357 regular Evolutions, its strength is 1558 times that of a Primordial Beast at the same realm.]
Top Ten Deification Talents fused
Chaos Double Wings, Destruction Claw, Vajra Tyrant Body, Radiant Annihilation Blade, Undying Blood, Supernova Breath, Thunder Magnetic Waveform, Doomsday Gigantification, Chaos Hole Domain, Black Hole Devouring.
Transcendent Talent: Terminal Force [Body length increases fiftyfold, and both base strength and defense surge synchronously, shattering anything with absolute power.]
Reminder, this talent belongs to the Active Burst type and has immense consumption; use with caution.]
Black Hole Tyrant Body [By assimilating the Domain to merge all Origin energies of Primordial Level, Golden Flame, and Thunder, with the Chaos Hole Domain into the scale armor, forming a visage of eternal darkness that devours and annihilates everything.]
Devours all forms of energy attacks and twists and crushes all physical attacks, defense is invincible.]
Reminder, this talent belongs to the Active Burst type and has immense consumption; use with caution.]
Extermination True Blade [Using a tail blade manifesting from speed as its core, forged with despairing corrosion and the lethal power of thunder magnetism, its speed defies time and causality, striking with certainty.]
Beneath the blade, bodies are severed in twain, divine souls extinguished.]
Reminder, this talent belongs to the Active Burst type and has immense consumption; use with caution.]
Infinite Evolution [A passive talent: Innately hidden, centers around the Evolution Talent which evolves and grows in sync with strength advancement, fused from the energies of the Four Great Deification Talents.]
Able to ingest all tangible and intangible matter and energy for growth, purifying bloodlines, endless.]
This talent belongs to the passive category, with no need for activation.]
◇◇◇◇
Upon Jack Clark’s breakthrough to the Primordial Level, soul resonates, expanding the pathway of the Soul Origin, allowing for free circulation and sharing of part of True Bodies’ powers.]
Shared Power: Integration [In the ultimate form of the human body, one may stack and integrate one Transcendent Talent of the Giant Beast Body to sublime pinnacle, pushing across everything.
The Giant Beast Body, in its Transcendent Talent form, can stack and unlock parts of the Ten Wheels True King form, attaining invincibility upon reaching sublime pinnacle.]
After the breakthrough to Primordial, as Cultivation Methods, Divine Powers, and Talents fuse, the data for Jack Clark and Doomsday Emperor Dragon becomes immensely concise.]
Simultaneously, the data experiences huge changes, for instance, the physique ratio has shrunk from over twelve hundred times that of a True Spirit at the same realm to over eight hundred times.]
Of course, this is just surface data. It seems like Jack Clark’s True Body Strength has weakened a lot, but in fact it is far more terrifying than when it was at the same tier as the True Spirit.]
After all, a Primordial Level existence has reached the end of the path, powerful beyond compare.]
In such a case, for Jack Clark’s True Body to still reach over eight hundred times the same tier truly illustrates its terror, nearly with the capability to clash head-on with a True Emperor.]
And the reason why Jack Clark’s True Body could grow so powerful after the Primordial breakthrough is due to the shared energies from the two True Bodies after Primordial.]
Under the various Superior Powers and Deification Talents of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, the strength and potential of the True Body are further expanded and tempered.]
Similarly, for the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s Giant Beast Body to become so powerful at present, over fifteen hundred times compared to Giant Beasts of the same level, is also due to power sharing.]
Under the counter-nourishment of Jack Clark’s two Supreme Rules and various forces, it broke through the 999-fold Chaotic Shackles of Primordial Creatures, becoming a defying existence.]
However, upon this foundation, the trajectory of power for Jack Clark’s human body and the Giant Beast Body are completely separate paths.]
For instance, in Jack Clark’s form as the King of the Ten Wheels Annihilation, the base strength and defense increased more than three hundredfold, with the might of rules and Divine Powers also surging.]
Whereas the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s Transcendent Talent, Terminal Force, can only increase the base strength and defense of the Giant Beast Body.]
Moreover, after this breakthrough, the strength of Jack Clark and the Giant Beast Body have become more concise, all abilities unified, the norm is the peak, with only one Burst form.]
Jack Clark was already aware of these changes, merely not certain of the detailed data, hence when his eyes passed over it, he felt no surprise.]
The disappearance of the Attribute points function from the attribute page was also expected.]
As the realm and cultivation advanced to Primordial, the essence of the Extraordinary Giant Beasts’ life converted into attribute points was of a too disparate energy level, now useless to him.]
However, what made Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon take a deep breath was the new content separated by ◇◇◇◇ underneath the attribute page.]
Integration
The human body and the Giant Beast Body can share and synchronize each other’s strongest power, reaching a demigod state of integration when Jack Clark space-time summoned and merged with the projected energy of the Thunderflame Beheamoth.]
Only now, with both parties’ realms elevated, the demigod state will become more powerful and fearsome.]
Despite Jack Clark having an inkling of this when Doomsday Emperor Dragon broke through to Primordial, he still felt some excitement, with a smile emerging on his face.]
This, is the true trump card.]
At the Primordial Realm, each Primordial Powerhouse and Primordial Beast has its own Lifeline Talent and Primordial Rule Mystery, on top of tens of thousands to millions of years of accumulation.]
The number of rules, Divine Powers, and Primordial Level Secret Skills far exceed those of Jack Clark, many True Bodies are likewise condensed to ten to dozens of times of the same realm.]
With the accumulation of Chaotic Supreme Treasures and Creation Level Divine Weapons, Jack Clark’s real advantage lies only in a formidable True Body and some additional Primordial Level powers, Superior Divine Powers.]
As per Jack Clark’s estimate, under the norm, he and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon at Third Heaven Invincible, with True Bodies over eight hundred to a thousand times stronger, could even break the boundaries of space-time and ascend to the True Emperor Level.]
Once entering the form of King of the Ten Wheels Annihilation or the Terminal Black Hole form, even a Primordial True Emperor could be suppressed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1861: 689: King of the Ten Wheels Annihilation, Demigod Deification Fusion_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1861: Chapter 689: King of the Ten Wheels Annihilation, Demigod Deification Fusion_3
But it was only suppression.
Between the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary and the Fourth Heavenly Boundary exists a vast chasm, the disparity akin to that between the Primordial Stars and the True Spirits, where a True Emperor could suppress a Primordial Monarch with a mere flip of his hand.
Similarly, with thorough control over ‘world’ time and space within the same realm, it is nearly impossible for True Emperors of the Primordial level to eliminate each other.
However, with added fusion power, both Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, possessing the Primordial Monarch Realm, possess terrifying power capable of slaying True Emperors or even stronger beings.
At the Primordial level, one can even battle across Major Realms, and such power is truly considered a trump card.
And this is just the beginning, as long as Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon can differentiate and refine, ‘devouring’ the immortality left by Henry, seal the Immortal Demon Body.
The cultivation realm will rapidly break through to the Sixth Heavenly Realm, closely approaching the Pseudo-Immortal Realm of the Seventh Heaven.
By then, Jack Clark will leap to become a hegemon of the Chaos Sea, possessing the terrifying power to push through the Endless Worlds and suppress all heavens.
Whew! At this moment, Jack Clark couldn’t help but take a deep breath, calming his somewhat overflowing emotions.
This gift from a prime Eternal-level Powerhouse was so substantial that Jack Clark still felt somewhat bewildered.
Even though the cost of this gift is his involvement in a major battle between three Eternals after his breakthrough to eternity.
A battle capable of causing the fall of eternals, but Jack Clark felt it was worth it.
Henry’s help allowed him to quickly pass through the ‘Primordial weakness phase’, avoiding dangers from True Emperors and even Immortal-level dangers during the initial stages of the Third Heavenly Realm.
And as the original source of ‘humans’, Henry can’t afford accidents, at least not before the emergence of a second source of ‘human’ race.
Although Jack Clark is confident that even if Henry falls, it would no longer impact him, or those who have become True Emperors of Divine Domain, Law True Spirits.
But below the realm of Law, countless worlds and universes, inhabitants of other space-time and dimensions will be affected.
Erased by powers from the Eternal level, including friends and family of Jack Clark from the Solar System, although not all will die, many might vanish.
It’s like Thanos snapping his fingers, but the covered area is many times that of Thanos.
Furthermore, the ‘Luck’ of humanity will be severed in the future, making cultivation arduous.
Under such circumstances, unless a defiance of heavens occurs who opens a new path for humans, stepping into eternity once more to lead the entire Human Race to a leap forward.
Thinking this, Jack Clark’s eyes gradually became colder: “Next, it’s time to handle real business.”
Saying this, Jack Clark looked towards the depths of the Black World, his massive True Body slowly stood up, causing the entire Black World’s space to tremble slightly.
The shaking prompted massive planets from the external Void to sway, continental blocks within the world and mountain ranges to collapse, earthquakes across the Earth, and the sea surface to rise creating kilometer-high tsunamis, resembling the arrival of doomsday.
The sudden change once again plunged countless people intimidated by the Emperor Dragon’s roar into terror.
Boom! The shaking of Heaven and Earth in the Black World intensified significantly.
In the Warrior City, Amitya, who had become the most powerful Valkyrie, stood above the Valkyrie Academy; surrounded by powerful old teachers, all of them were stunned looking towards the sky.
There, the real shadow of the World Tree which appeared a century ago reappeared.
A white world enveloped the entire world, with the trunk reaching beyond the sky and branches extending hanging galaxy clusters, creating a magnificent and intimidating scene.
What truly shocked Amitya and others, was the trunk of the World Tree’s projection slit open slowly, forming a black crack millions of kilometers high and tens of thousands of kilometers wide.
The crack looked like another world on the opposite side, silently stood a towering figure with thirty thousand kilometers in height, wearing an Imperial Crown and Imperial Robe with sixteen arms.
Thud thud thud!!
At the moment that towering figure appeared, a palpable oppressive force swept across the entire world, overwhelming everyone’s consciousness, causing their eyes to turn white and faint.
Even Amitya, comparable to an Ancient God King in Valkyrie’s third form, was not qualified to directly gaze at Jack Clark’s Dark Star Demon God True Body and crackled down from the sky.
Jack Clark slowly lowered his head, his gaze indifferent swept over the ‘continent’ below with little change, slowly stretched out both hands, reaching into the Earth.
Boom! On the other end of the Black World’s ocean, another continental block occupied by numerous demons crumbled.
Boom boom boom!!
The entire world’s surface slightly torn by Jack Clark, ripping out a world crack tens of thousands of kilometers long, spanning several times the width of ‘planets’.
The edges of the crack probed into the Void, stretched millions and billions of kilometers with white transparent roots sprawling, sealing the terrifying dark powers below.
On one corner of the left side of the crack floated three dilapidated palaces with only ruins remaining, and on the right side stretched a greyish black palace spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
At this moment in the Evil God Palace, resembling a One-side World, Boroedo and Mpolak looked up in shock, unbelieving as they recognized the familiar towering figure in the sky.
Imperial Robe style and the indifferent face under the twenty-four All-Heaven Imperial Crown, they recognized it, their ‘good brother’ who had vanished for a century.
Darren Callum.
A century later, the transformation in their brother’s true form was somewhat immense, but what was this terrifying pressure even more dreadful than a Primordial Monarch?
At this moment, the two Hell Messengers felt somewhat stupefied, dumbfounded.
But at this time, Jack Clark’s attention had already fallen to the deep darkness, where a fearsome figure entwined by thin, transparent roots emitted a terrifying roar.
“Humans, I can sense the scent of humanity from you.”
“Damn it, all of you should die, I will kill you all.”
Jack Clark lowered his head, his gaze coldly watching the Divine Soul phantom below, still emitting the majesty of a True Emperor and slowly spoke, his voice low.
“Afraid you won’t have that chance.”
As he spoke, the ‘sky’ of the Black World silently shattered, a ferocious massive dragon head slowly emerged, its ‘radiance’ obscuring the entire world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1862: 690: Reincarnation Unity, Light-year Corpse
chapters.content:
Chapter 1862: Chapter 690: Reincarnation Unity, Light-year Corpse
Roar! A ferocious bellow filled with terrifying suppressive power shook the world.
In the eyes of two Hell Messengers from Boroedo, full of horror, a black-red Colossal Beast with a length of over a million kilometers and a fearsomely ferocious appearance thrust its double claws into the crystal wall and tore it fiercely.
Boom!
The solid and thick World Crystal Wall, materialized and condensed by layers of Space-Time Power, shattered, forming a dark Hollow of billions of kilometers across the starry sky.
In the thunderous roar that shook heaven and earth, the black-red Colossal Beast flapped its double wings, sweeping chaotic air currents of destruction upon the starry sky, suddenly unleashing a suppressive force comparable to that of a Primordial True Emperor.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Under the invisible suppressive force turned into rules, the starry sky which Jack Clark had once crossed, trembled, with massive planets and even Stars shaking.
But the Cecilus Great World, cleaved in two by Jack Clark like two hemispheres each a million kilometers in diameter, remained towering and stable.
It appears rather small under the double wings spreading over three million kilometers, sweeping destructive Chaotic waves.
However, a clear barrier on the torn world’s surface protects against the terrifying suppressive force and Chaotic waves emanating from the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Otherwise, with the current might of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, its mere arrival would be enough to shatter the Cecilus planet the size of a Star and eradicate all life.
But the two Hell Messengers within the labyrinth beneath the World Rift were not so fortunate.
Bang Bang!!
The already weakened and heavily injured duo of Boroedo messengers collapsed to their knees, their internal power frozen, unable to mobilize even a bit under the Emperor Dragon’s might.
The arrival of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon also caught the focused attention of the Abyss Lord in the depths of the cracks.
If it were at its prime, two Colossal Beasts and a human with suppressive forces on par with a Primordial True Emperor would not be even worth noting, it could suppress and shred them effortlessly.
But after tens of thousands of years of sealing, its Divine Soul Intent continually eroding, it had weakened to only barely maintaining strength at the Fourth Heavenly Realm.
Yet with strength also at the Fourth Heavenly Realm, it still had the confidence to suppress the human and the Beast.
This is the disparity in the realm of strength perception and mastery.
A deep voice filled with terrifying malice rang out from the dark depths, vibrating the world: “Human, even with this Giant Beast’s aid today, you cannot change your doomed fate.”
“Today, the great Selos will show you, even among the Primordial True Emperor and Primordial True Emperor Level forces, there exists a gap.”
Boom!
In the depths of the crack, the horror of power explodes in a shadowy figure reduced to just a few lines, breaking every thin tree root on its body.
As Jack Clark tore apart the Earth and the Seal dissolved, the roots of a mere Primordial Level World Tree no longer suppressed the Abyss Lord.
Instantly, with Selos at the center breaking free from the Seal, a boundless and darker than dark power flooded in, submerging everything around like a tide.
The intangible emission of terrifying Dark intent shocked the senses of Boroedo, snapping them back to reality with horror on their faces.
“Abyss Demonic Aura!”
“Darren Callum, be careful, this is an Abyss Lord, and moreover, it’s as powerful as the Lord of Hell, Alvaron, capable of transforming the surroundings into the Abyss Plane.”
Just as Boroedo cried out, a Demon God tens of millions of kilometers tall, condensed from Abyss Demonic Aura and bearing broken double wings, emerged from the dark Abyss.
Boom! An even more terrifying Dark suppressive force burst from Selos, piercing the Cloud Sky, causing star systems beyond to tremble.
“Human, face death.”
The murder-filled roar echoed in the depths of the cracks, a towering Abyssal Overlord surrounded by darkness, soaring into the sky, shattering the thick tree roots surrounding the cracks.
Watching this scene, Jack Clark under the Imperial Crown wore a cold expression, his eyes sparking with rainbow-colored ripples, his voice deep: “True Emperor, are you strong enough?”
As he spoke, layers of red, blue, purple, black, and other Chaotic divine patterns circles unfolded behind Jack Clark, forming a terrifying Chaos Halo covering billions of kilometers of the starry sky.
In it, the dark-red Halo suddenly brightened, and in an instant, a Qi Blood burst from Jack Clark, more fearsome than that of a True Emperor Giant Beast.
Roar!
A heaven-shattering Dragon Roar exploded through the Void, Jack Clark clasped his hands together, as if holding the sky, dragging the dark-red Chaos Halo behind him to smash down.
Boom!
The staggering eruption of Qi Blood shocking the Great Thousand Worlds, transformed into an imprint coming from the dimensional depths, covering a billion kilometers, resembling but not resembling a dark-red imperial dragon print.
Beneath the Dragon Print, the Void collapsed, compressing Space-Time, with countless rule chains emerging and shattering, radiating a dazzling and intoxicating halo of rules.
Such might made even the Demon Power-filled Selos focus intensely, seriousness visible in its eyes.
It realized this human seemed somewhat strong.
But even if strong, was it strong as much as it, stepping halfway into the seventh undying Heavenly Realm?
In an almost time-stilled dimension, Selos’s arms transformed into claws, instantly causing the surrounding Abyss Plane to surge, endless Dark Demon Air converging into a dark War spear tens of millions of kilometers long.
Suddenly, Selos’s aura soared once more, unleashing a terror that pierced through the Great Thousand Universe.
Like Jack Clark, Selos’s Divine Weapon, too, had long merged with its rules, commanding its assembly and dispersal at will, thus enabling the summoning of its lifebound Divine Weapon from the Dark Rules following the liberation of its Divine Soul.
“Demon Peng Zhitian, desolate all eight wastes!”
Selos roared, its black tremendous Spawn Roc double wings covering the sky, as it swung its War spear towards the falling imperial dragon print from above.
Boom!
The two forces collided, instantly releasing a powerful impact force, shattering the surrounding rules and sweeping across hundreds of billions of kilometers at an indescribable speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1863: 690: Reincarnation Unity, Light-year Corpse_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1863: Chapter 690: Reincarnation Unity, Light-year Corpse_2
The immense strength even erased the surrounding time, leaving only the Chaos Halo flashing behind, like Jack Clark, a god surpassing both ancient and modern times, and the Abyss Demon God of World-Destroying holding a war spear in the endless darkness.
And that blow just now, both sides were ‘equally matched’.
Selos’s eyes burned with black flames, radiating an even more intense killing intent.
This human is very strong, surprisingly fighting to a draw with it despite being of the same realm but a higher level. He must not be spared, this monstrous human must die, they all must die.
“All humans must die.”
A terrifying roar filled with murderous intent shook the heavens, and from behind Selos, a demon claw that covered the sky reached out from the depths of the Abyss, overshadowing heaven and earth, covering the past, present, and future.
Simultaneously, Selos swung his war spear, and in an instant, the power of the Great Dark Heaven burst forth, engulfing the entire black world, including the cosmic starry sky, in darkness.
In the darkness, streams of ‘light’ spread like billions of meteors, inundating the starry heavens.
Each stream of light contained terrifying might capable of shattering primordial rules, breaking through space-time, and piercing through dimensional voids; worlds of tens to hundreds of thousands of kilometers in diameter shattered and exploded under this light.
As planets were destroyed and star systems collapsed, Roger was filled with endless destructive dark forces, and influenced by that sky-covering demon claw, it seemed like an obliterated Great Thousand Universe crashing down on Jack Clark.
The power of this strike even touched the Fifth Heavenly Realm, a blow to obliterate the Great Thousand.
At that moment, appearing in Jack Clark’s hand was a war halberd millions of kilometers long, with red shards wrapped around it.
Within each red shard were scenes of world destruction, universe collapse, and the apocalyptic rending of starry spaces.
Boom!
A halberd skill stretching a billion kilometers surged into the sky, containing the ultimate power of destruction but slicing through the darkness with purple-red light, splitting the dark cosmos in two.
“No matter how legendary your demon power was, no matter your command over the Abyss, eternal through the ages, today you will still fall under my war halberd.”
In the midst of that split darkness, Jack Clark, whose true body had swelled to a million kilometers, stood holding the halberd, with fourteen arms spread out behind him, supported by multiple halos as if a god carving out the chaos.
Jack Clark’s words, still with their tone, instantly infuriated Selos, who had been sealed and suppressed for hundreds of thousands of years.
“Human, if my true body were here, I would not allow you such insolence today.”
“But even without my true body, today just with the body of will alone, I can slay you.”
Boom!
Behind Selos, the dark Abyss roared to life, with condensed figures of dark demon gas, rising up to a million kilometers, appearing like a sea of giants throughout the Abyss.
“All demons obliterate the world, kill.”
As Selos roared, countless giants with the ‘True Spirit’ aura started moving, crushing worlds and lunging at Jack Clark.
Surrounded by millions of abyss giants, Selos’s presence became more monumental and mighty, enveloped by a terrifying power capable of suppressing everything.
