Under the power resonated by those millions of abyss giants, the rules of this world, the stagnant time, space, everything froze.
Even a True Emperor here would find movement difficult, and even the strongest control over time would be unable to mobilize, unable to enter another time dimension to dodge and attack.
In this moment, one could only directly face the onslaught of millions of abyss giants infused with ‘its’ power, whose attacks reached near the primordial step.
And just as Selos spread his wings wide behind him, surrounded by countless giants lunging at Jack Clark, ready to exhaust and suppress him with endless Abyssal Power, what met him was a towering bronze bell.
Gathered from the Chaos Halo, the silhouette of a chaos bronze bell stretching up to ten million kilometers trembled slightly.
Dong!
The deep bell chimes echoed throughout the Great Thousand Universe, instantly solidifying time and space. Following that, countless abyss giants, centered around Jack Clark, shattered like grains of sand, dispersing into the sky as ash.
Even Selos, under the strike of the Chaotic Supreme Treasure fused with Jack Clark, trembled and his consciousness shook, form disintegrating.
Its true body was merely condensed from Abyssal rules, not the immortal Demon Body lasting through the ages.
Just as the demon gas in the dark Abyss converged and reformed into a colossal Abyss Demon God’s Body spanning millions of kilometers, nine pairs of silver light wings unfolded layer by layer in Jack Clark’s eyes.
In an instant, a terrifyingly profound ‘Time Power’ descended.
Behind Jack Clark, eight shadows dressed in Imperial Robes, each holding a War Halberd, emerged, every one of them exuding a powerful pressure comparable to that of the Primordial True Emperor.
Nine Jack Clarks from the past appeared simultaneously, the Power Pressure they emitted was so immense that it even caused the Abyss Plane to show signs of fracturing.
“You, too, shall face one of my primordial arcane Divine Powers.”
An indifferent and deep voice resounded through the Void, and the eight shadows behind Jack Clark suddenly lunged towards him, instantly bursting forth with a terrifyingly indescribable Power Explosion.
Boom!
A ten-billion-kilometer long War Halberd, gleaming with bright light, formed from the pure purple-red ‘strength’ of light, spanned the Void, illuminating the entire dark starry sky.
Under the Halberd’s skill, the Abyss Plane shattered, demon gas dispersed, and even the newly reformed Abyssal Body of Selos burst apart, creating a void of trillions of kilometers in the cosmic starry sky.
Because a Time Mark had merged into the Solar System and became part of the Heavenly Dao of the Solar System’s Divine Realm, Jack Clark’s Time Reincarnation Divine Power was incomplete and could not exert its strongest force.
Even the complete Time Reincarnation Divine Power would require a daunting amount of Time Power to condense nine Time True Bodies comparable to the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary, an amount that made Jack Clark’s scalp tingle.
Even for a True Emperor who has mastered time, it is estimated to take thousands of years just to condense a single Primordial Monarch Time True Body.
Therefore, over a hundred years, upon breakthrough, Jack Clark revolutionized his Time Reincarnation Divine Power with his lifetime of Martial Arts cultivation and realm, using the present as coordinates to Summon the eight-second Time Marks of the past.
Nine become one, instantly fusing and bursting forth with a strike as powerful as the complete opening of the Dark Star’s Tenfold Heavenly Gate.
With such formidable power, the True Emperor Level strength of Selos was directly shattered, and even its already frail Divine Soul was dispersed, unable to recondense immediately.
But at that moment, the black-red Colossal Beast that had been looming overhead ever since its descent, suddenly moved.
Instantly, the Silver Giant Dragon with two-thousand-kilometer wingspan on the head of the black-red Colossal Beast roared excitedly: “Roar! Charge at them, Tim Abbott, make them bleed rivers!”
“Stop fooling around.”
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon growled lowly, an Invisible Power pulled the Silver Giant Dragon down, pressing it onto its shoulder to keep it from running amok and avoid being obliterated by the aftermath of the battle.
Yet, its target was not Selos, who was regathering its form.
A mere Divine Soul with only the strength of a True Emperor was not qualified to face the joint force of Jack Clark and the Giant Beast Body. The target of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was the deep world itself.
There lied a colossal ‘corpse’ as vast as a star system, stretching over a light-year.
At this moment, driven by the force of Selos’ drawing of the Abyssal Descent and continuous Power Bursts, this corpse, silent for hundreds of thousands of years, was trembling slightly.
And Selos’ seemingly reckless, impotent roars of fury, in fact, all had a purpose.
[Just a bit more to wrap things up, please wait ten minutes]

chapters.title: Chapter 1864: 691 The Great Sun Perishes Together, Devouring the Seventh Day
chapters.content:
Chapter 1864: Chapter 691 The Great Sun Perishes Together, Devouring the Seventh Day
The colossal ‘corpse’ hand, measured in light-years, drooped down, collapsing layer upon layer of space-time as it passed, before finally landing gently on a slightly smaller corpse below ‘it’.
Whoosh! A pure black tide radiated out from the center of Henry’s palm, piercing through the Void, ripping apart dimensions, affecting a span of several light-years.
This is the terror of the Seventh Heaven Realm, where merely the collision of two ‘corpses’ could unleash an impact so powerful that it exceeds the strength level of a True Emperor.
It instantly annihilated everything around it, including the Abyssal Power that Selos had secretly released imbued with the fluctuations of his will.
Without the call of a soul and showing signs of struggle, the Abyss Demon God once again reverted to calmness, serenely sprawling and floating in the depths of the pitch-black Void.
Phew, thankfully, it’s been suppressed.
On the edge of the middle finger of a hand as massive as tens of trillions of kilometers… atop the fingerprint mountain ranges towering tens of thousands of kilometers high, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon let out a sigh of relief.
Standing on the finger pressing into the chest of the Abyss Demon Body, and because of the perspective, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s field of vision was occupied by the corpse below that spanned a light-year.
To keep the ‘material’ intact and reach the Seventh Heavenly Undying Realm, Henry didn’t completely annihilate Selos when suppressing the Abyss Lord back in the day.
Instead, he stripped away the Divine Soul Intent, sealing it atop the ‘Abyssal Corpse’, keeping it in an ‘alive’ state.
In doing so, the Abyssal Corpse would instinctively breathe in Chaos Energy to perfect itself, ultimately stepping into the undying realm of eternity in the Seventh Heaven.
When Jack Clark appeared, he would be able to obtain two undying ‘materials’.
The human form and the Giant Beast Body could both use this to prematurely touch the power of the Seventh Heaven Realm.
However, before this, Jack Clark needed to deal with the weakened Divine Soul Intent of Selos to prevent it from reuniting with his real body.
If he was careless and let Selos’s Divine Soul Intent escape and re-merge with the demon body across ‘Henry’s corpse’, then it would be Jack Clark’s turn to take the beating.
Although not explicitly stated, Jack Clark had a vague feeling that this was probably a ‘test’ from Henry to him.
Watching Jack Clark, who has rapidly advanced in strength by leveraging the World Origin and refined a tremendous amount of it, stepping into a higher plane of primordial realm with both his True Bodies cooperating, whether he could handle Selos’s Divine Soul.
However, this test seemed a bit contemptuous.
A mere Lord of the Abyss, weak enough to barely maintain the Fourth Heavenly Realm, had no right to require the cooperation of Jack Clark’s two True Bodies, especially since this Lord of the Abyss was incomplete.
Without a true body, no matter how strong Selos’s Divine Soul is, it could only wield and mobilize the rules of the Abyss Plane with his will.
Unable to use his True Body as a foundation to take in the power of the Supreme Abyss Plane into his body to confront Jack Clark’s True Body head on, and to shatter everything with the Supreme Plane’s power.
However, at this moment, overlooking the boundless Giant Demon Body below, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was still somewhat shaken.
Only by close contact could one feel the horror of these undying existences’ True Bodies, massive beyond imagination.
Such a colossal body didn’t even need to employ any force beyond the Primordial Rules; the mere physical body alone was enough to shatter all celestial bodies in the cosmic starry sky.
A casual gesture could crush whole galaxies, grasp black holes, and suppress everything.
Yet before these two massive undying corpses, the current clan leader of the Void Heaven Divine Dragon, the Silver Divine Dragon who had just broken through the Sixth Heaven, seemed not as impressive.
Even though the Purple Proliferation Dragon’s dragon head alone was several million kilometers.
“Roar! Tim Abott, what… what is this!!”
On the shoulder of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon, having witnessed the terrifying scene just now, trembled on all fours, displaying a look of shock, panic, and a bit of excitement in its eyes.
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon exhaled a wave of destructive breath through its nostrils, slightly opened its mouth, and let out a sonorous roar that shook the Void: “This is an eternal undying corpse.”
“Next, I plan to devour it.” As it spoke, without waiting for the Silver Giant Dragon to ask, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s double wings had already flapped.
Boom!
With the double wings steering Chaos, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon turned into a ray of light and shot out, its speed surpassing that of light in a blink, and it rapidly flew towards the head of the Immortal Demon Body.
The mountain ranges tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of kilometers tall retreated below as it sped by, those were ridges and gullies on the dark demonic armor of the Immortal Demon Body.
As space-time didn’t exist in this area, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon couldn’t fold space to teleport; it had no choice but to fly.
It took about half an hour to fly from the chest of the Immortal Demon Body to the vicinity of the huge head.
At the forehead of the brutish head of the Demon Body, there was a massive white divine rune, which was the last resort left by Henry for the Doomsday Emperor Dragon to refine the Immortal Demon Body.
Starting from the Fourth Heavenly Realm, one could control all the time and space within the domain of Divine Realm or Heavenly Realm, retroactively conquering the past and gradually becoming the sole existence.
Once a cultivator or a Giant Beast breaks through to the Seventh Heaven, they are fundamentally considered an embryonic form of Eternity.
Space-time integrated, the only one through eternity.
Even if the current undying body is shattered, its past existence can instantly reappear and remain there.
This is also why the Primal Seventh Heavens is known as the undying realm — because it has already acquired some attributes of eternity and possesses the foundation of eternity.
Next step is to break through the Eighth Heavenly Realm, reflecting all heavens, extending one’s power invisibly, covering the Chao Sea and the Endless World with ‘oneself’.
Just like those three suns hanging above the mythical world, along with the two moons.
Therefore, what the Doomsday Emperor Dragon needs to do is to merge with this Immortal Demon Body with the help of the power left by Henry and occupy the existence of Selos for himself.
Directly becoming a pseudo-seventh Heavenly Undying Supreme Expert,

chapters.title: Chapter 1865: 691 The Great Sun Perishes Together, Devouring the Seventh Day_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1865: Chapter 691 The Great Sun Perishes Together, Devouring the Seventh Day_2
And when the day comes that the Doomsday Emperor Dragon fully becomes the ‘Doomsday Emperor Dragon’ by completing the transformation of the Immortal Demon Body, it will thoroughly become an undying existence of the Seventh Heaven.
For countless Primordial Powerhouses, this is a step straight to heaven.
But this is the path of others, not that of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
The difficulty of taking another step forward after becoming an eternal undying being is a hundred or even a thousand times greater than that of its own cultivation; it might even be trapped in the Seventh Heaven forever, unable to advance an inch.
Roar!
Standing on the white runes that seemed substantive and stretched for hundreds of millions of kilometers, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon roared fiercely towards the heavens, its terrifying roar shaking space-time.
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon spread its wings in anger, with circles of black halos emanating blood-colored light spreading from behind, covering tens of billions of kilometers, hundreds of billions of kilometers in the blink of an eye…
Soon, a gigantic black hole of dozens of trillions of kilometers in size appeared above the Immortal Demon Body’s head, and at the same time, a gravitational force far exceeding black holes burst forth.
Boom! The demon body trembled slightly.
Then, it began to move toward the black hole at a slow speed, ‘little by little’.
Roar!
Atop the white eternal runes, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon let out another fierce roar, its full-body scales continually shattering, with dark golden blood gushing out incessantly.
The burden brought about by forcefully Devouring an Undying Body to stimulate the transformation through Deification Talent has already exceeded the limits of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
If not for its powerful and unparalleled Body of The End, it would have shattered and sustained heavy injuries on the spot.
Roar Roar Roar!!
As the Doomsday Emperor Dragon roared again, its scales and flesh and blood continued to crumble and heal, its entire body dyed red with the gushing and retracting blood, making it look incredibly fierce and savage.
Under the desperate eruption of power from the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, the colossal Immortal Demon Body’s head has slowly begun to merge into the black hole.
Instantly, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s figure sank, a crack tens of thousands of kilometers long tore through its abdomen, nearly splitting it open, creating a bloody and terrifying scene.
It seemed as though it would explode the next moment.
It can be said that since stepping onto the path of evolution, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon has never suffered such a serious injury.
Even when facing enemies two Major Realms higher in strength, it was able to retreat with only light injuries.
But the recovery ability of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was equally terrifying; under the Undying Blood, all of its wounds healed in the blink of an eye, only for more wounds to burst forth again.
“Stop, what do you think you are doing!!”
Just when the Doomsday Emperor Dragon had not chosen to merge but instead forcefully Devoured the Undying Body, preparing to transform it into sustenance for growth, Selos, who was being suppressed by Jack Clark, immediately sensed it.
And let out an enraged roar right away.
However, being blocked by Henry’s Undying corpse and weakened, Selos was unable to cross that heavenly chasm, let alone being suppressed by Jack Clark.
“Your era has already passed.”
Beyond the endlessly churning Abyss of darkness, donning an Imperial Crown and with Ten Heavy Chaos Light Wheels unfurled behind him, Jack Clark, with sixteen arms, simultaneously formed seals, releasing endless light from his body in an instant.
In that moment, the entire cosmic starry sky was filled with an intensely tyrannical and grandly scorching power.
Within the starry sky, a fiery sovereign of ten billion kilometers tall, with three heads and sixteen arms, appeared, seated cross-legged, each half-body facing in three directions, holding up stars with their hands.
Under the three golden Imperial Crowns ablaze with flames, Jack Clark’s eyes were half open, his expression cold and detached, as if an exalted Supreme Deity was looking down upon all living beings.
“Great Sun, annihilate everything.”
The hands of the fiery sovereign sparkled with light, sixteen golden stars of millions of kilometers in diameter, burning with intense flames, slashing through space-time and crashing into the reconstituted Abyss Plane.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Sixteen dazzling lights exploded in the starry sky, like the detonation of sixteen super-giant stars, emitting endless might of Primordial True Emperor Level flames, burning everything.
Under that wildly destructive and scorching power, the entire layer of the Abyss Plane began to collapse from its fundamental structure, and Selos’ just reformed True Body was instantly annihilated once again.
Moreover, this strike contained the Superior Divine Power of the True Vacuum Annihilation force, with might comparable to an extraordinary divine talent.
Scorching four dimensions and burning the destructive power of the past and future, one-tenth of Selos’ Divine Soul Source was obliterated by this strike.
Suddenly, a scream of misery and fury echoed through the starry sky.
In the midst of the scorching flames, a massive, distorted face formed from black flames leaped in the depths of the fifth-dimensional fabric, staring intently at the seated Fiery Sovereign in the ‘outside’ vacuum.
“How can your power possibly harm my Divine Soul Source?”
At this moment, the last bit of pride held by Selos as a ruler of the Supreme Plane’s first layer was shattered, facing this ‘low-level’ human, a retreat commenced.
The Human Race was too terrifying; previously, an Immortal of a slightly higher Realm easily obliterated and suppressed it with overwhelming force.
Now, tens of thousands of years later, just as it had escaped the seal, it encountered another human, one with a Third Heavenly Realm breath but whose Power Explosion threshold even touched the strength of the fifth dimension layer – a monstrous being.
And the power it wielded was tyrannical and terrifying, able to harm its Will, even penetrating the Will’s True Body and eroding its Soul Source.
Over tens of thousands of years, its Soul had already been heavily injured, weakened to the verge of collapse by the loss of its Origin.
Each loss brought it closer to danger.
Leave!
Just in that instant, Selos made a resolute decision, with a decisive look in its eyes.
Without the Immortal Demon Body, it might suffer serious injuries and foundational damage, but if it could arrange for the Divine Soul Intent to be reborn and repair the shattered Soul later on, there would still be hope for its return.
However, if the Divine Soul Intent were obliterated here and the Demon Body also Devoured, it would be utterly destroyed.
But whether it chose to leave now or not, was no longer up to Selos to decide.

chapters.title: Chapter 1866: 691 The Great Sun Perishes Together, Devouring the Seventh Day_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1866: Chapter 691 The Great Sun Perishes Together, Devouring the Seventh Day_3
The Void churned with flames coalescing into a figure, whose sixteen arms suddenly merged into one, and in an instant, the entire universe was lit up.
A gigantic Light sphere emerged.
This Light sphere, composed of fire and light released from the exploding supernova, covered hundreds of billions of kilometers, engulfing the shattered Abyss of Selos.
What horrified Selos was the endless fire runes that appeared within the Light sphere, burning and penetrating through space-time, forming a super destructive Star with a diameter of hundreds of billions of kilometers.
“Great Sun, Annihilation!”
A cold and deep voice echoed through space-time.
Boom!
In an instant, even more terrifying destructive power Burst, the massive super Star suddenly collapsed, emitting an indescribable destructive gravity, shattering space-time within its range.
As the edge collapse accelerated, the inward collapsing destructive gravity’s might exploded geometrically, even shattering and piercing through layers upon layers of dimensions.
And all this happened in a blink of an eye, so fast that Selos didn’t have time to re-gather his Divine Soul Intent and True Body.
He could only watch helplessly as the dark destructive power shattered the First Layer, the Second Layer, and the Third Layer of dimensions, followed by the Fourth Layer, and even the Fifth Layer dimension where he burned his Origin to enter.
“Humans!”
Boom!
In the end, the super-giant Star collapsed to the size of ten thousand kilometers, like a destructive black hole substance spanning the Void.
An intangible force emanated from around it, a collapse gravity so strong that it was indescribable, warping and tearing everything around it, even tearing a hole of tens of millions of kilometers in the World Crystal Wall of the Black World.
This Hollow was not a crack opened with the authority of the Heavenly Dao by Jack Clark, but one that was forcibly pierced through by this strike.
From the roaring Hollow of the Chaos crystalline wall, a Demon God of a million kilometers in height appeared, extending his right hand, slowly dragging the black hole that sealed the Remnant Soul of Selos.
Boom!
Jack Clark’s arms trembled slightly, then with an indifferent expression, he dragged the black hole, his long black hair dancing like a mad cascade behind him, his Aura grand and sacred, his majesty unbearable to behold.
This was the strength Jack Clark possessed now, easily Suppressing a rather powerful, incomplete True Emperor.
However, as the realm of this Abyss Lord had reached half-step into the seventh heaven, with Jack Clark’s current strength, killing him thoroughly was still a bit troublesome and would require some time.
For example, after erasing his Divine Soul bit by bit, he would also have to erase the traces of his rules extended across various space-times.
Only by doing so could he be completely eradicated, preventing the possibility of a Will suddenly resurrecting one day to disturb the Devouring and refining process of the Immortal Demon Body by the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Very soon, the cosmos, which had just been the site of a Destroy Heaven and Earth battle, returned to calm.
Among the nearly shattered countless galaxies and planets, Cecil’s Great World, torn in half, floated, its inhabitants awakening to the first shock of the world’s change.
Shocked that the world had split in two, gazing across the pitch-black Void.
Meanwhile, on a night that once had countless stars twinkling, it is now pitch-black, with all the stars gone, leaving only the Golden Sun and the silver moon that rise as usual from who knows where.
But regardless of the great changes in the world, ordinary people still need to live on.
Soon, just two months passed, and order was restored in Cecilus World.
But beneath the Void that lies between the two halves of the world, within the floating black Evil God Palace, the two Evil Gods from Boroedo remained in a state of constant anxiety.
Only they knew the terrifying scale of the battle that erupted two months ago.
But since their strength was vastly inferior, they could not directly witness the battlefield, and thus did not know the outcome of that battle, nor whether the fearsome Darren Callum ‘brother’ was alive or dead.
Besides, there was also the terrifying Black-red Colossal Beast that suddenly appeared and then disappeared, baffling everyone.
Inside the Dungeon, Boroedo, who had been sitting on the throne for more than two months, could no longer hold back and turned to look at the black figure lying on the ground, about to speak.
But just then, darkness fell from above, and a gigantic hand emerged from the depths of the Void, catching the Evil God Palace with a bang.
Then, a familiar voice with a tinge of indifference resounded.
“Almost forgot about you guys.”
“Let’s send you out first, I still have some matters to attend to, so I won’t catch up with you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1867: 692: Bloodline Retracing, Occupying the Past
chapters.content:
Chapter 1867: Chapter 692: Bloodline Retracing, Occupying the Past
Before they could react, Boroedo and another appeared in the Chaos Sea.
In that tumultuous stream filled with destruction and dissolution, reducing all matter and energy back to their primordial state, the unfortified Evil God Palace crumbled layer by layer.
Within the world of the palace, as Boroedo and his companion watched the shattered sky and earth, their faces suddenly changed.
This was not the benign Chaos Void where Mythical Powerhouses from around the mythical world could wander, but the far more dangerous Chaos Sea, where even True Spirit Level strong men could barely survive.
If their cultivation was at its peak, it might not matter, but now their strength had fallen to the True Spirit level, barely maintaining the peak of ancient times.
Just as the two Hell Messengers were ready to burn their souls to resist for a while, looking for a way to summon the strength of Supreme Hell to escape, the surrounding space-time suddenly solidified.
A golden-white light screen emerged around them, forming a dome with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, keeping the world-destroying murky streams outside.
Meanwhile, in the turbulent turmoil of the murky stream in the distance, a colossal figure turned its head to give them one glance, and then slowly disappeared.
Although Jack Clark’s arrival here was well within Henry’s expectations, without Boroedo providing the coordinates, telling him that there were many sources here, Jack Clark would not have come.
Therefore, Jack Clark did not skimp on lending a hand, casually saving them from the peril.
After sending away the two Evil Gods, standing in the cosmic void filled with destruction that had already begun to collapse, Jack Clark looked towards the Cecilus World floating in the starry sky.
Boom!
The space-time shook, and beneath the world torn into two halves, a vast golden palm slowly emerged from the depths of the Dark Starry Sky, holding up one of the halves.
Of course, “holding” is merely a description.
Between that gigantic palm and the broken planet, the substantial silver Space Power filled the space, forming multiple layers of subspace as shock absorbers.
Meanwhile, on that half planet, the empires and kingdoms built around the sapling of the World Tree and countless people looked up at the mighty figure reaching out from outside their world to hold it up.
Due to the disparity in the level of strength, these people could not clearly see the figure that held their world.
They could only vaguely see that it was a Divine Entity of incomparable grandeur wearing an Imperial Crown and a dark, magnificent Imperial Robe, with ten layers of colorful coronas unfurled behind, covering the entire Heaven and Earth.
And beneath the World Tree sapling, Principal Aemidia and Vice Principal Estelle, who had just flown back above the Valkyrie Academy, faintly realized who the majestic figure was.
Recalling the scenes from a century ago, everybody felt somewhat dreamy.
Although the contact was brief, that young man named “Clark” had been like a Great Sun in the sky from his arrival, dazzling and stunning everyone time and time again.
Boom! A purple-black Halberd Skill that spanned billions of kilometers tore through the Chaos, forming a cut spanning billions of kilometers across.
The Chaos streams filled with the intent of destruction roared, yet unable to close, as the halberd passed and divided Heaven and Earth, and the elements of Earth, Fire, Wind, and Thunder began to emerge.
Gradually, a nascent world was born.
Once a cultivator achieves a breakthrough to the Primordial level, they possess the great power to Open Heaven and Earth in the Chaos Sea and forge a complete Great Era world. If condensed into a Divine Realm, it would further evolve into the Great Thousand Worlds.
And with Jack Clark’s current cultivation level, creating a Great Era world was naturally effortless.
Just as this nascent world gradually stabilized and the Earth began to coalesce, space-time shattered, and a half-planet with a diameter of one million kilometers appeared from outside the sky.
The sky-covering golden palm gently placed the planet above, like a Divine Realm floating above the Firmament.
After dealing with this world as well, Jack Clark finally returned to the Black World, where the cosmic starry sky had completely shattered, revealing the true face of this world.
It was the immense, boundless corpse of Monarch Henry, and beneath it, the Immortal Demon Body that had already been swallowed up by a black hole.
Just like the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark arrived on the head of the corpse as vast as a Star System, where there also lay the eternal mark left by Henry.
However, unlike the Immortal Demon Body which carried the personal mark of the Abyssal Overlord, Henry had completely erased his personal traces when he left.
Thus, what lay before Jack Clark was like a pure experience packet, an Origin of Primordial essence encompassing past, future, and present.
Above the runes with a diameter of hundreds of millions of kilometers, Jack Clark, in his restored True Body standing fifteen thousand kilometers tall, merged silently into them like an imperceptible speck of dust.
Boom!
The white runes vibrated, emitting rings of white ripples, and wherever they passed, the Monarch’s corpse melted away like a candle in flames.
Soon, a white light orb about 1.5 light-years in diameter emerged in the Chaos.
There were no earth-shattering rule fluctuations, no impacts that could shatter space-time and tear dimensions, the orb’s light was dim, slowly rotating and floating.
If it weren’t for the massive demon body half-swallowed by the black hole below, this would seem like a typical world commonly seen in the Chaos Sea.
The Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Heavenly Realms of Primordial actually correspond to cultivation in Space-Time.
The Fourth Heavenly Realm revisits the past, the Fifth Heavenly Realm occupies the future, and the Sixth Heavenly Realm stands firm in the present, merging the past and the future into an eternal singularity.
Therefore, as Jack Clark was enveloped by the Space-Time Origin that could be directly absorbed and refined into his True Body, his mind trembled, and countless images reflected around him.
Among them were images of Jack Clark wearing a school uniform, walking with Glenn Clark on the way to school.
There were also scenes of Jack Clark wearing Dark Red Armor, sitting on a transport leaving the airport, feeling a bit nervous yet excited about the impending attack from the Evil God Sect Cultist.

chapters.title: Chapter 1868: 692: Bloodline Retrogression, Occupying the Past_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1868: Chapter 692: Bloodline Retrogression, Occupying the Past_2
There were also images of dominating the Southern Battlefield overnight, slaying through dozens of Martial Arts School’s peers, and ascending to the top as the number one young successor in the South.
There was also a global live broadcast of the battle against the Blood God on the outskirts of the city, entering the mythical world to counter-kill two demon kings, and clashing with a Demon God at the Mid-Mythical Stage.
There were even images of Jack Clark in his previous life wearing a suit, sitting in the office, and seriously reviewing documents.
All were reflected during the retracing within the Space-Time Origin.
At this moment, the closest to the present time, the image of Jack Clark’s arrival in Cecil’s Great World a hundred years ago, was slowly being rendered into a golden-white color by a powerful force.
Meanwhile, as Jack Clark began his breakthrough into the Primordial True Emperor, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon below, completely soaked in blood, roared once more, its body engulfed in blood-colored flames.
Boom! In an instant, a terrifying burst of Qi Blood erupted, and under the burning of Essence Blood, the aura of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon surged by dozens of times.
The chaos-spanning Black Hole rings trembled, and their sucking force increased several-fold, devouring the Immortal Demon Body at an even faster speed.
Simultaneously, the increased pressure caused the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s body to continuously shatter, cracking open deep, bone-deep wounds, as blood gushed out like oceans.
Roar, roar, roar!! The Silver Giant Dragon, flapping its double wings, circled over the head of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, issuing worried Dragon Roars.
Because it was a future seen tens of thousands of years ago, even Henry did not know that Jack Clark was actually the Giant Beast, and the Giant Beast Body was him.
Therefore, when leaving a contingency plan, he simply treated the Giant Beast Body as an external embodiment of himself, not ‘caring’ as well for the Demon Body left behind.
However, this issue was still within the tolerable range for the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Under the worried gaze of the Silver Giant Dragon, the body of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon kept fragmenting, healing, and at its worst, it almost shattered to pieces.
But no matter how severe the injuries, under the power of the immortal blood, they instantly healed, consuming only a bit of Vitality.
Time passed, and after roughly more than a month, the Black Hole that shrouded chaos finally devoured the Immortal Demon Body completely.
Roar!
With a roar that was fierce and brutal, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon cried out with a hint of relief—it had finally devoured the indestructible corpse, and next was digestion.
“Telsafi, I’m going to hibernate and enter Closed-door Cultivation, don’t go wandering around,” said Jack Clark.
Instantly, the Silver Giant Dragon’s eyes lit up, somewhat excited: “Roar! No problem, Tim Abott, you sleep with ease, the Great Telsafi won’t go anywhere.”
The implications of realm breakthrough emanating invisibly from the Doomsday Emperor Dragon during its hibernation, as well as the escaping Vitality, were all greatly beneficial to it.
Perhaps the Great Telsafi could soon step into the Pinnacle of True Spirit and then break through the Primordial!
Thinking of this, the corners of the Silver Giant Dragon’s mouth almost split with joy. When it breaks through the Primordial, it will definitely go back and show off to its mother and Telsafi.
Let them stop always saying it’s dumb.
They definitely couldn’t imagine, the Great Telsafi was actually the smartest one. From the first glance, it noticed Tim Abott’s extraordinariness and built the Dragon Palace Giant Beast Empire together with him.
Ever since following Tim Abott, the strength of the Great Telsafi has been skyrocketing, advancing all the way to the present.
Haha… Surely the Great Telsafi is the smartest.
While the Silver Giant Dragon was joyfully imagining a beautiful future, an explosion erupted inside the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, as the Space-Time Origin, infused with darkness, evil, and destruction, erupted.
Boom!! The robust and unparalleled body of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon suddenly exploded, turning into sky-filled fragments of flesh and blood.
Where the Doomsday Emperor Dragon collapsed, a substantive black-hole sphere appeared and expanded at a terrifying rate, reaching tens of millions, billions of kilometers in the blink of an eye.
Eventually, a black hole not inferior to the white light orb appeared in chaos, silent as a black celestial body with a diameter of one light-year hanging still.
Meanwhile, the flesh and blood of the shattered True Body of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was devoured and absorbed within the first instant of the black hole’s expansion, leaving only the Silver Giant Dragon dazedly lying on the black ‘planet.’
What about Tim Abott?
No one knew that Jack Clark had already broken through the Primordial and was in the process of breaking through the Primordial True Emperor realm.
As he was in Closed-door Cultivation, time rapidly slipped by, with decades flashing by in a blink of an eye.
In the Chaos Emperor City, although the Divine Martial Emperor Jack Clark had been in Closed-door Cultivation for three years, this bustling city was not affected at all.
For these cultivators, the weakest of whom were above the Mythical Stage, three years was merely the time for a trip, a mindful rest for recuperation.
Therefore, not only were these Imperial City cultivators unconcerned, but the golden-bearded burly man who had been mingling here for a long time didn’t care either.
Those peak civilization strong men behind it were also silently watching this side, waiting for the moment to launch a thunderous strike.
Everything was operating in an orderly manner, and all the Human Federation cultivators who ventured into the Flame Wheel Divine Domain years ago had reaped significant benefits over the past three years.
Among them, within the Heavenly King Realm, the already peak-level Mysterious Martial Sky King, Denny Kaye Sky King, and the so-called strongest Heavenly King, Mad Wheeler, all made breakthroughs to ancient gods after absorbing the essence of Divine Domain cultivation.
Primordial True Emperor, as well as Sky-based God King who was also in the ancient mid-period, had already made breakthroughs to the ancient late period.
However, the one whose strength improved the most was the True Martial King, whose strength subsequently overshadowed others after gaining opportunities while traveling through Xuanhuang Continent, managing to break through to the peak of the ancient period.
As for those people, Mathilda Ward, who has the ‘deepest’ relationship with Jack Clark, followed Sherry Williams to the world beyond three years ago and successfully condensed the Chaos Supreme Dragon King Body.
As she swallows and extracts the power of Chaos, taking in the rule factors it contains, her strength becomes terrifying.
Because she belongs to Chaos ‘creatures,’ her cultivation realm is different from the mythical world system. Based on strength, she would be roughly at the early stage of ancient times.
Not inferior to her father, the Mysterious Martial Sky King.
This result made the Mysterious Martial Sky King feel greatly gratified and a bit baffled at the same time.
But these peoples’ changes were nothing compared to another person.
Human Federation, Solar Divine Domain.
The territory linked between the Blue Star World and the mythical world had expanded a thousandfold over three years, with cities that combine civilization technology and the transcendental dotting the space between heaven and earth.
Above the entrance number one logistics city from years ago, ten thousand kilometers above, a cluster of gold palaces stretching for tens of thousands of kilometers floated in the air.
At this time, in the most majestic divine temple of the palace cluster, a tall and burly young man in Golden Armor, standing ten meters tall, sat on the throne.
His presence was overbearing and fierce, invisibly radiating dazzling golden light that penetrated the divine temple, heaven and earth, enveloping the entire human territory.
The invisible divine pressure caused all Mythical Kings, Heavenly Kings, Main Gods of the Heavenly Feather Clan, Immortal Monarchs of the Immortal Spirit Clan, and others to be shocked and look up.
Besides them, two unfamiliar races have also integrated into the Human Alliance, with a comprehensive strength not inferior to the Heavenly Feather Clan.
And these people, looking up at the divine temple suspended high in the firmament, were all a bit shocked, and some even incredulously exclaimed.
“True, the pinnacle of True Spirit!”
“How is this possible, the cultivation of the Eternal God King has improved again!”
“Yes, didn’t he just break through the late stage of True Spirit last month? And now he seems to have made another breakthrough.”
“Terrifying, truly worthy of being that person’s brother, whose talent as a freak is even not below his.”
“Yeah, it seemed like when that person left, he had just broken through… Eh, what realm was the Divine Martial King when he left?”
“Eh… now that you mention it, I realize I don’t seem to remember either.”
“Just knew he was very strong, very strong, one of the peak strong men of the Human Race at the time.”
At this moment, Glenn Clark, who sat high in the divine temple on the throne, was like the king of kings, revered and gazed up at by all the strong men.
While the human experts were exhilarated, and the strong men of different races were deterred, the space in the Golden Divine Temple shattered silently, forming a pitch-black void leading to the depths of the Void.
A somewhat ferocious silhouette stood in the depths of the Void, emitting a powerful aura comparable to that of a True Spirit.
Then, a hoarse voice, inexplicably carrying a terrifying aura, pierced through the void and slowly resounded in the Golden Divine Temple: “Has your cultivation soared again?”
On the throne, Glenn Clark slowly nodded, his voice low and authoritative: “Mmm, it has indeed improved a bit, and it’s the fifth time in these years.”
From the depths of the Void, another somewhat hoarse voice came out, the tone carrying a bit of gravity.
“Destiny never gives feedback for no reason. Every gift has been priced in advance. This kind of strength that suddenly increases without a source might not be a good sign.”
“For example, the origin of the power you inherited, could it be that the ancient being has not completely fallen?”
Adam Garcetti’s words caused Glenn Clark to pause slightly, then he shook his head affirmatively: “It shouldn’t be, my Divine Power surges without having sensed any bad premonitions.”
“And also, I probably know the source of this power.”
“Where from?”
“My brother.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1869: 693: The New School Year Begins, He's Back
chapters.content:
Chapter 1869: Chapter 693: The New School Year Begins, He’s Back
Within the Golden Divine Temple, Glenn Clark was like a golden sun, his body emitting a golden divine light that illuminated billions of kilometers of heaven and earth, exuding an incomparably sacred and majestic presence.
And when Glenn Clark revealed that his strength had surged multiple times, supposedly stemming from his brother Jack Clark, the Great Hall fell silent.
In the depths of the Void, the fearsome visage resembling a monster lurking in the darkness, Adam Garcetti paused for a moment before his face gradually showed a look of shock.
“When Jack Clark left back then, his realm was already at the mid-stage of True Spirit.”
“And with your cultivation three years ago, the only way to significantly increase your strength through bloodline reversion is if he entered the Primordial, becoming a lifeform of Chaos.”
“This emergence happened five times in succession, does it not imply that he has consecutively broken through four major realms after that… the True Emperor!!”
At this point, even Adam Garcetti, who had grown accustomed to Jack Clark’s extraordinary talents, could not help but feel somewhat shaken.
Three years, to break through from the mid-stage of True Spirit to the Primordial True Emperor in just three years, could the resources and opportunities on the side of the Divine Realm truly be that exaggerated?
No, that’s not right.
Adam Garcetti took a deep breath, suppressing the shock in his heart, and discarded this speculation.
Years have passed, and although those who left back then have not yet returned, the Federal Top Level and the Heavenly Feather Clan’s Sky-based God Kings among others have already established contact.
Therefore, they know a bit about that realm, that the cultivation of several people had only recently broken through True Spirit, and even the last True Martial King had only reached the late stage of True Spirit.
That wasn’t as significant as the gains he made staying behind in the Federation to study the depths of the Void.
Also, because of the information exchange, and Jack Clark’s status on that side, people like the True Martial King also learned many things that were pervasive amongst the upper echelons.
For example, the division of realms after Primordial, knowing that after the first, second, and third layer of Primordial realms comes the True Emperor who masters space-time.
Adam Garcetti shook his head and sighed, “Truly worthy to be your brother, with a talent so formidable that it’s no longer appropriate to describe it as having no equal before or after but rather unique and unparalleled through the ages.”
In response to Adam Garcetti’s exclamation, Glenn Clark’s solemn and resolute face couldn’t help but show a smile, brimming with arrogant pride: “My brother has always been the strongest, both in talent and strength.”
“I have a premonition that the next time we hear from my brother, he will shock the entire mythical world,” he said.
“There’s no doubt about that,” replied Adam Garcetti with a smile emerging on his face covered with black scales, then he turned solemn again.
“Glenn Clark, there has been movement in that piece of ancient shattered bone recently. I sense that in the farthest depths of the absurd and twisted Void, another Golden Eternal Divine Temple might be about to open.”
Boom!
Glenn Clark suddenly sat upright, his aura vibrantly pulsating with unparalleled domineering power, his tone slightly agitated: “Is it finally going to open there.”
“Senior, we must go down immediately.”
As Glenn Clark stood up, the entire Golden Divine Temple, the palace complex, and even this realm of heaven and earth shook subtly with him.
It was as if it wasn’t a towering young man who stood up, but a terrifying Giant Beast that filled heaven and earth, his imposing might bearing some resemblance to the previous might of Jack Clark.
And as Glenn Clark’s footsteps moved, the golden light underfoot spread, transforming into a golden rainbow bridge that plunged deep into the Void.
In just the blink of an eye, Glenn Clark had disappeared into the endless depths of the Void with Adam Garcetti, and the black hole that broke through the Void within the Golden Divine Temple also slowly faded away.
“Jim’s presence has vanished.”
In another world separated by distance, within the depths of the stars of the Solar Divine Domain, a pair of brilliant platinum eyes slowly opened.
Standing tall amidst the searing liquid flames, reaching a thousand kilometers high, was a platinum figure with a Divine Wheel the diameter of several hundred kilometers, spinning slowly like white metal crafted behind it.
This lofty figure exuded a profoundly paradoxical sensation.
From afar, it seemed like a magnificently slender super Mecha, but up close it appeared as a beautifully adorned woman in a luxurious platinum divine gown, elegant and distinguished with a noble aura.
Freya Louise looked up, gazing towards an unknown place overhead, and spoke softly: “Jack Clark, Jim has ‘left’ the mythical world.”
Freya Louise’s voice, containing a faint Heavenly Dao authority, pierced through space-time, echoing to the deepest reaches of the Solar Divine Domain, instantly alerting a fearsome existence.
Outside the sun, a colossal shadowy figure, hundreds of times larger than the sun and outlined by a few thin lines, slowly emerged.
At once, the cosmic starry sky trembled, with heavenly energy from billions of kilometers around going berserk, converging, and forming a sky full of golden petals as if to welcome the descent of the supreme Heavenly Dao.
However, this vision could only be seen by Freya Louise, who had a certain level of Heavenly Dao authority.
After the sketchy figure appeared, its gaze penetrated the World Crystal Wall and landed on the Golden Divine Temple, while the nine silver rings of light in its eyes formed a counterclockwise-spinning vortex.
Suddenly, time and space within the Golden Divine Temple came to a halt, rewound, and reflected the recent conversation between Glenn Clark and Adam Garcetti.
After witnessing the dialogue between the two, the shadowy figure wearing an Imperial Crown’s eyes shattered the spinning silver light rings, with every fragment racing past as an image.
In each image, either Glenn Clark or Adam Garcetti’s figure appeared.
Traversing the past, glimpsing the future!!
Only after all the silver fragments in the eyes dissipated did the sketched figure slowly turn back, its gaze falling on the magnificent figure in the depths of the star, its voice incredibly slow.
“It’s nothing, no need to concern ourselves with them.”
With that said, the Heavenly Dao’s will left by Jack Clark began to dissipate.
But just then, Freya Louise suddenly asked, “Jack Clark, three years have passed; you’ve broken through the Primordial stage, haven’t you? What realm are you at now?”
The will that Jack Clark had left merged with heaven and earth, becoming the Heavenly Dao.
Unless it related to the destruction of the world or his family, it would not usually converge and descend, let alone to respond to Freya Louise’s question and engage in conversation with her.
However, in the recent half-year, Freya Louise had keenly felt subtle changes in this world.
The world seemed to have come alive, or rather the operation of the Heavenly Earth Rules became more vigorous, and the source was the mark of Jack Clark, who dominated the Heavenly Dao.
Facing Freya Louise’s inquiry, the dotted line figure standing in the starry sky paused for a moment and, after a long while, showed a response with a lively smile emerging on their face as they turned to look at Freya Louise.
“True Emperor, and, above.” As soon as the phantom finished speaking, an invisible and terrifying force appeared out of nowhere, sweeping across the figure of the Heavenly Dao.
Pfft! Under the influence of that terrifying force, the figure made up of several lines suddenly collapsed, turning into specks of light that dissipated and merged back into the Heavenly Dao.
Under the impact of that unexpected terrifying force, the ‘Heavenly Dao’ of the Solar Divine Domain collapsed without resistance.
Watching this scene, Freya Louise was somewhat astonished, but not excessively worried.
What mattered more to her was that Jack Clark had indeed returned, or rather, he had returned half a year ago, in some special form of existence.
With this thought, Freya Louise’s gaze shifted subtly, and her True Body, which had been silent for years, slowly stood up.
Boom! Deep within the sun, a powerful force erupted, causing the entire star to quiver and destabilize, while its surface formed streams of flames tens of thousands of kilometers long.
Merging an ownerless layer of the Primitive Azure Sky, along with the body of an ancient creature revived at the threshold of the Late Stage of True Spirit and the Origin force of the Solar System.
In unity, although Freya Louise was inconspicuous, her cultivation had silently grown to a breathtakingly powerful extent.
Chirp! On the sun, amidst the erupting solar corona, the cry of a mythical bird resounded throughout the world. A Three-legged Golden Crow, composed entirely of flames, with a wingspan of a hundred thousand kilometers, appeared and soared around the sun.
This spectacle immediately attracted the attention of countless people on Blue Star.
“Look, the Golden Crow has appeared.”
Blue Star, Mist River City.
Watching the firebird that appeared around the rising sun at dawn, only one-tenth the size of the sun itself, many people on the street excitedly looked up.
Since entering the New Age, the world had become increasingly filled with fantasy.
Immortals, angels, and humans coexisted, and various Unique Beasts and legendary creatures from the tales of the Classic of Mountains and Seas continuously emerged; Flood Dragons roared in the sea, and Kirin tread upon the mountains.
Including the Golden Crow born from the sun, which had also appeared over two years ago.
At the beginning of each month, with the rise of the great sun, the Three-legged Golden Crow would dance with the sun, also marking the arrival of a new month.
At this moment, not far from the street near South Sky Martial Height, one middle-aged person suddenly remembered something.
“Right, today is the opening ceremony of South Sky Martial Height. I heard that this time there are descendants of seven King-level powerhouses enrolling and they are all direct descendants within four generations.”
A few meters away, a young man with a briefcase, preparing to hail a cab for work, paused momentarily and turned his head: “It’s not just King-level. I heard on the internet that the third-generation grandchildren of four Main Gods from the Heavenly Feather Clan are also among this batch of freshmen.”
“The Main Gods of the Heavenly Feather Clan?” More than a dozen people around all paused, then started to gossip.
“Given their age, wouldn’t their third-generation grandchildren be over a thousand years old? With formidable strength, why would they come to South Sky Martial Arts School?”
“This I do know.” In the crowd, a beautiful girl dressed in a white dress and wearing a white bow on her head took over the conversation excitedly.
“Because of the Civilization Great War that broke out with the Purgatory Demon Race, many of the Heavenly Feather Clan’s talented prodigies were sealed by the upper echelons soon as they began to show their talent.”
“Firstly, to avoid being assassinated by the Purgatory Demon Race, and secondly, if the Heavenly Feather Clan were to be defeated, these sealed and taken away talents would be the hope for the Heavenly Feather Clan’s future rise.”
“Therefore, considering that, these prodigies are not very old, and their strength is only high-order, meeting the entrance requirements of South Sky Martial Height.”
Immediately, everyone turned their attention to the white-dressed girl, and someone exclaimed: “Beauty, how do you know all this? I haven’t even heard about it on the internet?”
“Indeed, I’ve also never heard of this secret of the Heavenly Feather Clan.”
Faced with the curious gazes of the crowd, the girl just smiled and did not respond: “Alright, you gentlemen are busy, I’m going to check out South Sky Martial Height.”
With that, the girl waved to the crowd, turned, and left with a light step.
Walking through the somewhat familiar streets, looking at the vehicles floating half a meter above the ground speeding by, Freya Louise, who hadn’t been in the mindset of an ordinary person for a long time, found everything interesting.
Soon after, Freya Louise arrived at South Sky Martial Height.
Compared to a few years back, South Sky Martial Height, famous within the Human Federation, had been expanded several times by the hands of Heavenly King Level powerhouses, with a campus area that was tens of thousands of times larger than before.
Moreover, because the expansion involved opening up inner spaces, it did not cause much disruption to the surrounding area.
The gate remained the same, but once inside, people would discover that the interior was vast, with towering kilometer-high academic buildings and ancient trees reaching up to the sky.
The flow of people within the school was also frighteningly large.
With annual enrollment increases, tens of millions apply each year, and of those, only a portion is accepted; currently, the resident population of the campus has reached over two hundred thousand.
Most of these are students with no weak cultivation, and the aura of high-order strength flickers from time to time.
Because she appeared to be only eighteen or nineteen years old, Freya Louise easily walked into the school and followed the flow of people to the open-air Sports Center.
By that time, fifty thousand freshmen had already assembled, forming hundreds of person squares standing below.
On the surrounding stands sat second and third grade seniors who came to watch the excitement, and sitting in the front seats were teachers and some young faces.
These young individuals all exuded strong auras, with the weakest among them radiating Eight Layer Heaven.
The strongest batch had all reached the late period and peak of the Ninth Heavens, with two even touching upon the Legendary Realm.
Standing on the edge of the crowd, Freya Louise curiously surveyed her surroundings, her gaze sweeping through the crowd in search of something.
“Classmate, are you looking for something?”
[Just a bit more editing]

chapters.title: Chapter 1870: 694 Everything Will Disappear, Jumping Out of the Three Boundaries
chapters.content:
Chapter 1870: Chapter 694 Everything Will Disappear, Jumping Out of the Three Boundaries
The other layer of space unreachable by ordinary people, Freya Louise, dressed in a white dress, stood with a gentle smile alongside the faint silhouette of Jack Clark.
Jack’s return made Freya feel a little happy.
Although it was just a will projection, at Jack’s level, there was barely any difference between a will projection and his true self.
Under the ‘human’ personality, Freya acted like a normal girl, curiously asking, “Jack, you’ve been in the Ancient Divine Domain for a few years. How are things over there?”
Sitting in the Solar Divine Domain, in a state of ‘indifference’ as she refined the Primitive Azure Sky, Freya was indifferent to everything except matters concerning Jack and her family.
Including news about the Divine Realm.
As for her asking now, it was naturally to find something to talk about.
Jack smiled slightly, “The situation over there is a bit complicated. Peak civilizations are abundant, and as a newly-rising race, the Human Race has made quite a few enemies.”
In the following moments, Jack briefly elaborated on the situation in the Six Great Divine Domains for Freya.
At this moment, the 2057 South Sky Martial freshman orientation officially began. A tall, beautiful girl wearing a red off-the-shoulder dress stepped onto the stage.
“Hello, everyone. I am Teresa Wilson from Senior Class 1, one of the hosts of this year’s opening ceremony.”
“First, let me welcome all junior students to the Federation Cultivation Hall, South Sky Martial School.”
“Modern schools are not merely places of knowledge but also cradles nurturing peak powerhouses, refining willpower, and jointly safeguarding humanity’s future and glory.”
“Next, let’s invite our school principal, Mr. Laurant Harris, to the stage to deliver his speech.”
As the girl in the red dress turned with a smile to look at the teachers and principal on the dais, her bright gaze exuded confidence and poise.
When Laurant Harris, the former head instructor, stepped onto the stage, the ‘nonexistent’ Freya in the crowd looked at the girl in the dress, somewhat surprised: “Isn’t that Marcus Lindsay’s sister?”
“Yes, that’s her,” Jack nodded.
“I remember she went to the same school as your brother Glenn Clark. In the blink of an eye, they’ve all grown up so much. Time really flies by,” Freya sighed.
Speaking of this, even Jack, who had been in closed-door cultivation for ‘over two centuries,’ also felt emotional, “Indeed, time passes so quickly.”
At that moment, Freya shifted the topic and suddenly said, “Jack, you must have a reason for coming back this time. Otherwise, you wouldn’t suddenly descend with your will projection.”
Regarding this, Jack did not hide it, nodding slightly, “This time, besides seeing you all, I came back to erase certain things.”
“Certain traces of my existence in the past.”
“…Erase the traces of your past existence!?” Freya was stunned.
“When breaking through from the fourth layer of the Primordial Heavenly Realm to the Fifth Heavenly Realm post-Primordial, one must claim the past and condense the traces imprinted on time and space.”
“And this place is where I embarked on the transcendent path. Reclaiming my past will start here as well.”
Thus, this was why Jack appeared at the opening ceremony. Everything began at South Sky Martial School, from the day the semester ended and his cultivation journey formally began.
Before transcending, ordinary people are unqualified to leave traces of existence in Heaven and Earth.
Therefore, there is no need to reclaim anything.
“I see,” Freya nodded.
As the two conversed among the crowd, an invisible force involving time began spreading outward from Jack’s projection, causing a series of changes in many places.
In the old Building B, a janitor was organizing some activity equipment on the fifth floor.
With the school’s expansion and the development of technology and transcendent civilization, this ordinary teaching building had been turned into a student activity center, doubling as a storage area for some equipment.
Just then, a few fragmented impressions flashed through the classroom, startling the janitor.
Haunted!
But after rubbing their eyes in shock and looking around again, the janitor found nothing. The fleeting shadows seemed like an illusion.
This scene wasn’t limited to this location. On the top floor of Building C, in the library by the window, a series of residual shadows momentarily appeared and disappeared…
……
“Marcus Lindsay, it’s a pity he didn’t come back this time. He missed the moment when his sister became the host,” remarked Zac Maben, whose hardened features now carried an air of maturity as he gazed at the girl in the dress standing with the principal on stage.
Whit Veil beside him shook his head, “That guy wanted to return, but he stumbled upon a relic that could help him break through to the Mythical level, so he didn’t come back.”
“A relic that helps break through Mythical!” Zac’s eyes widened, “Damn, that guy’s going to surpass us and become king-level first.”
Whit shrugged, “No need to be so shocked. It’s just breaking through to the Mythical level, and he’s not the first. No big deal.”
“Sure, but it’s still frustrating,” Zac pouted, “Among our group, Howard Lambert had the best talent, followed by Justin Welan with his ridiculous luck, and then us lot.”
“Howard and the others probably don’t need mentioning. They’ve been in the Ancient Divine Domain for years and are likely already kings, with the potential to become Heavenly Kings.”
“But Marcus, that guy. His talent and progress in cultivation were on par with ours. We all broke through to the Ninth Heaven Peak just six months ago.”
“And now you’re telling me he’s about to break through to the Mythical? This isn’t fair.”
Whit froze for a moment before realizing, “Damn it, now that you mention it, it really is frustrating. Getting surpassed by Howard and the others is fine, but now even Marcus is outpacing us.”
“Had I known, I wouldn’t have come back for this useless opening ceremony. It’s a total waste of time. I’d rather stay in the mythical world in closed-door cultivation and look for a breakthrough opportunity.”
“Don’t blame me for this. You wanted to show off by coming here,” Zac replied, flipping him the middle finger.
Their banter and uncouth behavior were entirely unbefitting of Ninth Heaven Peak cultivators, leaving Sawyer Levin and a few others nearby speechless and increasingly dumbfounded.
“Can you two stop already? We all know you’ve reached the Ninth Heaven Peak. You might even break through to king-level any day now.”
“Oh? You already knew, huh.” Zac and Whit were a bit surprised.
Former cultivation committee member Matt Watkins shook his head, “Your names and states are listed on the School’s Outstanding Individuals Board. You’re ranked over fifty, with your realms clearly indicated.”
“Hahaha… so that’s how you knew.”
Zac and Whit laughed awkwardly, brushing it off. Then they changed the subject, “By the way, Matt, it’s been a while. What’s your current realm?”
Matt replied calmly, “A bit behind you two, just broke through to the Ninth Heaven last month.”
“Not bad, not bad. Reaching the Ninth Heaven at your age is already impressive. You’ll likely step into the Mythical within ten years,” Whit said, patting his shoulder encouragingly.
In the current era, Mythical was no longer an untouchable realm.
No one knew when it began, but the Federation’s cultivators had started finding cultivation increasingly easy. Bottlenecks that would have taken decades to overcome were suddenly bypassed.
Coupled with sufficient resources, Mythical powerhouses in the Federation had been emerging rapidly over the past few years, like mushrooms after the rain.
“By the way, who’s ranked first on that Outstanding Individuals Board? Wait.” Whit suddenly paused, forgetting what he was about to say.
“Strange, I feel like I’ve forgotten something.”
Whit furrowed his brow, “I was trying to ask if the person ranked first was someone I knew, but now I can’t recall their name.”
“No, it’s not just their name. I can’t even remember who they are or what they look like.”
As Whit spoke, his expression grew increasingly grave. He turned to Matt and the others, “Matt, do you know who the person ranked first is?”
Matt nodded, “I do. I read through the names and notes of all 100 people on the list. The first is… wait, who is it?”
At that moment, Matt also realized he couldn’t recall who was ranked first, even though he had looked at it this morning.
For a Ninth Heaven cultivator’s physique, eidetic memory was basic. Forgetting something was impossible.
Realizing this, Matt frowned deeply.
At this moment, Sawyer Levin shrugged, “Stop fooling around, the list is right there on the announcement screen. The first is Howard Lambert, who has already reached the early Heavenly King stage in the Divine Realm.”
“The second is Justin Welan, who has become a personal disciple of an ancient powerhouse in the Divine Realm and is currently in closed-door cultivation to break through to the Heavenly King stage. Over the past two years, he’s contributed significant knowledge to the Federation.”
“The third and fourth positions belong to Crystal Lewis and Mandy Lewis. Both have become disciples of the ancient powerhouse Empress of Mysterious Flame and have reached Mythical Peak.”
“As for you two, there’s no need to explain. Matt is ranked 82nd and is one of the outstanding representatives this time.”
After saying this, Sawyer seemed exasperated, “You guys really make me repeat this every time just to let you bask in your glory. What’s so fun about showing off like this?”
However, it was clear that Sawyer misunderstood. Whit and Zac truly hadn’t looked at the announcement and weren’t in the loop.
When Sawyer finished, Zac expressed his astonishment, “Howard really is a monster. He’s already reached the Heavenly King stage. And Justin, too.”
“Wait, why is Howard ranked first?”
Realizing something, Zac’s tone grew puzzled, “Back then, Jane Aiken’s talent was unparalleled among her peers. She was an outstanding figure in the entire Human Federation. Why isn’t she ranked first?”
“Jane has been missing for years. She disappeared on the battlefield where she went to aid the Heavenly Feather Clan. There has been no news of her since then, and she’s most likely perished.”
Sawyer explained, “You’ve all been training in the depths of the mythical world these past years and aren’t up to date.”
“That’s how it is. That explains it,” Whit nodded with a hint of regret in his tone.
“What a pity. With talent surpassing Howard Lambert’s, if Jane were still alive, she might already be in the late or even peak Heavenly King stage.”
“Indeed.”
Zac nodded in agreement, lamenting, “Jane’s enlightenment was unparalleled, and her cultivation talent was terrifying. Back then, only one other person was comparable to her…”
“Someone else!” Zac’s expression grew solemn, and the same realization dawned on Matt. It felt as if they had truly forgotten something important.
Exchanging a glance, their figures flickered and vanished from the guest seating area in quick succession.
“I’ll head to the archive room.”
“I’ll check the school intelligence core.”
“I’ll go find Professor Peng…”
The sudden departure of several transcendent powerhouses caused a stir among the guests, who were baffled by what had happened to warrant such urgency.
Amidst the crowd below, Freya also noticed the abnormality in Zac and others, a faint smile gracing her face.
“Their reactions aren’t too slow, but it’s all already gone.”
As she spoke, the smile on Freya’s face gradually vanished, and she fell into silence.
Years ago, when a powerhouse from an ancient civilization appeared, Jack’s traces had been erased once before.
Written records, online information, images, videos—everything had been wiped clean by an invisible force.
At that time, when Jack left, the entire Federation and Solar System were blanketed by an immense force. Many had their memories of Jack altered directly.
However, back then, it was merely an alteration. Some traces still remained in the school’s archives and the Federation’s most secure think tank.
This time, Jack’s return marked the complete obliteration of his past traces.
Under the temporal power touching the Primordial Fifth Heavenly Realm, Jack’s past was vanishing. The changes it brought included the memories of people like Zac regarding him being erased, rather than altered.
This was an irreversible change.
Because Jack’s past no longer existed, it had been claimed by an even stronger force.
“Jack, tell me, will I forget you too?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1871: 695: Condensing an Era, Galactic Giant Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 1871: Chapter 695: Condensing an Era, Galactic Giant Beast
Here is the translated text:
The universe, burning with red flames, held at its center a majestic figure seated wearing the Golden Twenty-Four Heavens Crown and adorned in a magnificent Imperial Robe.
Behind her, dazzling light swirled and formed a radiant star, illuminating space and time.
Yet, within the endless flames, at one single node, time twisted and reversed, reflecting a fragmented shadow of a black-haired young man.
This universe was the manifestation of the power of Sparkling Heaven True Emperor, where even the slightest change could not escape her perception; thus, she immediately opened her eyes, showing an expression of astonishment.
“How is this possible? You’ve actually already broken through to the realm of True Emperor.”
“No, according to the trajectory of your rise, you’re about to complete the path of the past and touch the Fifth Heavenly Realm of the future!”
By the time she finished speaking, even Sparkling Heaven True Emperor’s face revealed a rare trace of shock.
Three years ago, when Jack Clark came to meet her, his true realm had only reached the Late Stage of True Spirit—even though the pressure he exuded had already rivaled the Primordial Stars, that was merely his strength, not his realm.
To her surprise, after three years of closed-door cultivation in the Chaos Emperor City, Jack Clark’s realm had quietly broken through to True Emperor.
If she hadn’t witnessed it with her own eyes and directly experienced the process of occupying the past, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor could never have imagined Jack Clark’s power reaching this level.
As Sparkling Heaven True Emperor grappled with incredulity, the fleeting shadow of Jack Clark suddenly turned back to smile just before disappearing, his lips slightly parting.
Instantly, within the fiery universe, faint traces of Jack Clark’s gentle voice echoed.
“I was fortunate to encounter an opportunity that allowed me to break through. Senior, no need to be overly surprised.”
No need to be overly surprised! Gazing at the restored tranquility of the flame-lit starry sky, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor found herself momentarily speechless, standing silently in the Void.
How could she not be surprised?
In ancient times, she had taken a full millennium to cross from Primordial Monarch to True Emperor, eventually occupying all traces of the past.
This breakthrough speed was considered one of the faster ones among the True Emperor strong men of surrounding peak civilizations.
Yet how much time had Jack Clark taken? Moreover, he had leaped directly from the Late Stage of True Spirit to Primordial, then to True Emperor in one sweep. Could such an incomprehensible leap be attributed merely to “finding an opportunity”?
After a brief pause, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor slowly raised her right hand and tore forward into space. Instantly, a crack stretching tens of thousands of kilometers appeared.
Within the crack floated a polygonal altar, forged from golden crystal and spanning a diameter of a million kilometers, radiating splendid brilliance and an overwhelming energy pulse.
From afar, it resembled a star.
Surrounding the altar were six planets each ten thousand kilometers in diameter, orbiting it, emanating colors of red, gold, black, and three others, forming a celestial array.
At the center of the altar lay a shattered white planet, seemingly foretelling something ominous.
Suddenly, one of the golden planets shone intensely, sending a Light Beam bursting forth, crashing into the center of the altar.
Boom!
The altar quaked as eight towering statues of divine beasts standing at its eight edges began glowing one by one, roaring towards the heavens as if alive, yet emitting no sound.
Bzzz! Bzzz! Bzzz!!
The other five planets trembled in turn as powerful wills awakened from their depths.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
In an instant, the terrifying aura of three beings at the Primordial Fifth Heavenly Realm and two at the Sixth Heavenly Realm exploded forth, causing the flame universe to tremble slightly, as though it could barely bear their presence.
Beneath those dreadful wills, the five planets transformed, materializing as five towering figures descending upon the scene.
Among them, a burly young man wearing blood-red battle armor surrounded by thirty-six blood-colored chains covered in barbed spikes began to speak, his voice low and imbued with chilling Killing Intent.
“Sparkling Heaven, you’ve drained the Space-Time Origin to summon us. What catastrophe has occurred?”
Upon hearing this, the other figures turned their gaze toward the imposing figure standing at the flame universe’s center, their resplendent eyes carrying a powerful pressure but also a hint of inquiry.
Though the six True Emperors of the Human Race were able to communicate with one another, such cross-dimensional contact spanning vast distances consumed unimaginable amounts of power—only matters of racial survival warranted such measures.
Sparkling Heaven True Emperor nodded, her voice resounding majestically across the universe: “The reason I’ve contacted you this time pertains to Jack Clark. Something has changed on his end.”
“Just moments ago, I discovered his realm had already crossed into True Emperor and has reached the very edge of the Fourth Heavenly Realm.”
“Therefore, I believe it’s necessary to make adjustments to our planned operation for the six peak civilizations to join forces and execute the ambush against Jack Clark.”
Though Sparkling Heaven True Emperor spoke lightly, the moment her words echoed through the universe, dead silence followed.
Among the five True Emperors who had descended, a white-robed young man surrounded by towering sword illusions spoke softly: “I must confirm I didn’t hear wrong—Jack Clark’s realm has already stepped into True Emperor?”
Another figure, appearing as a shadow of the Void, spoke slowly, its voice seeming to emanate from the depths of endless nothingness with an eerie, hollow chill.
“If we’re not seeing illusions, Sword Ancestor, then you did not hear wrong.”
At this, Sword Ancestor True Emperor sighed exasperatedly: “Void, are you certain the words you speak aren’t simply nonsense?”
“Interesting.”
Among the five figures, a graceful young man radiating Silver Brilliance, with flowing time-like rivers solidified into transparent streams around him, chuckled lightly: “Sparkling Heaven, your news does carry an element of surprise.”
“Three years of closed-door cultivation in Chaos Emperor City, while everyone assumed he was breaking through to Primordial, who could have imagined he had silently entered the realm of True Emperor with no breakthrough phenomena.”
“Or perhaps, he wasn’t in Chaos Emperor City at all but somewhere else in unexplored Chaos making his breakthrough.”
“The time flow of that place must differ from ours; otherwise, in just three years, it would’ve been impossible for him to complete the accumulation of ‘energy’ and the forging of his True Body.”
As beings standing at the pinnacle of the ancient Human Race, the few True Emperors were naturally not foolish; they immediately deduced that Jack Clark had long departed Chaos Emperor City.

chapters.title: Chapter 1872: 695: Condensing an Era, Galactic Giant Beast_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1872: Chapter 695: Condensing an Era, Galactic Giant Beast_2
No one doubted the authenticity of the news.
Among the five, the burly man carrying nine colossal divine weapons on his back exclaimed: “To leap across four layers of the Primordial Major Realm within three years, even if the time flow there is reversed by a hundred-fold or thousand-fold, it’s still terrifying.”
“And before that, it only took him two years to rise from obscurity and step into True Spirit.”
At this point, the Eternal True Emperor looked at the others, his tone revealing a hint of excitement: “Everyone, this kind of astonishing speed of ascent—doesn’t it feel familiar to you?”
The Sword Ancestor True Emperor hesitated: “Eternal, are you suggesting he might truly be…”
Before the Sword Ancestor True Emperor could finish, the Blazing Heaven True Emperor interrupted: “I know what you’re implying, but Jack Clark is not him. This, I can confirm.”
The white-clad young man surrounded by the flow of time shook his head slightly: “I can also confirm—he is indeed not Henry.”
With that, the Reincarnation True Emperor looked toward the broken white star on the altar: “Henry’s Fate Star shattered ten thousand years ago. You all should know what that means.”
The Eternal True Emperor shook his head: “Reincarnation, you don’t need to explain further. Although Henry’s Fate Star shattered and vanished ten thousand years ago, I believe he definitely hasn’t perished.”
“Of course, I know he hasn’t perished.”
The Reincarnation True Emperor spoke calmly: “What I’m saying is, if Jack Clark were Henry reincarnated, when he came to see Blazing Heaven, the Fate Star would’ve already shown a reaction.”
“Besides, among us, Blazing Heaven has known Henry the longest and understands him the best.”
“Since Blazing Heaven is certain Jack Clark is not Henry, then it is absolutely so.”
Whew! The Slaughter Heaven True Emperor exhaled deeply, the fearsome killing intent surrounding him suddenly causing the flames dancing across the universe to dim in light.
“…Unexpectedly, in the Endless World of myriad races, apart from Henry, there exists someone with such terrifying talent—and he’s from our Human Race.”
Hearing this, the others revealed faint expressions of sentiment on their faces.
Among the Seven Ancient Monarchs, whether in the past or present, Henry was unanimously acknowledged as the strongest.
To be precise, all Six Great True Emperors were essentially unacknowledged disciples of Henry. They bore witness to and participated in the Human Race’s glorious rise led by Henry, from nonexistence to magnificence.
That era was incomparably resplendent.
And their ability to become Ancient Monarchs, and to move forward so swiftly upon entering the Vast World, owed much to a Supreme Secret Skill Henry imparted back then.
At that time, each of them refined the luck of an era, a Human Race epoch, the entirety of a civilization’s destiny.
