The Six Civilizational Emperors represented six eras of civilization. Each era’s cultivation methodology and power systems originated from Henry, driven by that greatest of beings.
However, aside from the exalted Six Civilizational Emperors, no one knows of this now.
The consequence of them refining the destiny of an entire epoch was that, apart from themselves, the Human Race could not break the barrier of their ‘existence.’
When they were Ancient Monarchs, no one could surpass Monarch-level.
After they entered the Vast World, spending thirty thousand years in the Ancient Battlefield, the Six Great Divine Domains saw only nine monsters break through to the Primordial Realm.
Among them, the one with the greatest talent has been trapped in the Primordial Monarch Realm for ten thousand years.
These Primordial-level powerhouses were each peerless monsters, emerging once in millennia from the Six Great Divine Domains, their talent unparalleled. Under normal conditions, being stuck for thousands of years without progress was inconceivable.
The reason was their existence had severed the Human Race’s path; no one could reach the end to stand beside them.
This was when the Slaughter Heaven True Emperor spoke slowly: “Now that Jack Clark’s cultivation has not only broken through the Primordial level but also stepped into True Emperor, it seems we need to revise our plans.”
“What do you all think about slaying a few True Emperors this time?”
Instantly, an even more terrifying killing intent emanated from the Slaughter Heaven True Emperor, freezing flames in his surroundings into solid blue ice flames suspended in the Void.
The Sword Ancestor True Emperor and Eternal True Emperor appeared somewhat tempted.
However, after a brief contemplation, the Reincarnation True Emperor shook his head to dismiss the idea: “There’s no need. Even if we purposely slay two or three peak-civilization True Emperors, it won’t significantly impact the current situation.”
“Not only would it bring no benefits, but it might also expose our true strength.”
“If that happens, sensing the threat we pose, those peak civilizations might truly decide to form a complete alliance, creating unnecessary trouble.”
“After all, for now, we lack the absolute power to suppress the Ancient Battlefield and sweep through the Nine Peak Civilizations, so full-scale war is inadvisable.”
“Alright, Reincarnation, you’ve made a fair point,” Slaughter Heaven True Emperor nodded.
Since the chaotic conflict ignited by Henry in the Ancient Battlefield ten thousand years ago, the Human Race’s Six True Emperors had all made breakthroughs, their powers continually growing more formidable.
Among them, the Reincarnation True Emperor—who commanded the laws of chaotic time and chaotic space—was the strongest.
Next came the most enigmatic Void True Emperor, whose exact strength remained unclear even to beings such as the Blazing Heaven True Emperor; all they knew was he possessed an Avatar from the Soul Devouring Mayfly Race.
He had completely taken over and refined a Primordial True Emperor-level powerhouse from the Soul Devouring Mayfly Race without alerting other Mayfly experts.
This alone revealed the terrifying extent of his strength.
At the same time, it was through this Soul Devouring Mayfly Avatar that Blazing Heaven and the others first learned of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, Gloomy Heaven War God Clan, and several other civilizations’ ambush plans targeting Jack Clark.
But to avoid provoking these peak civilizations into feeling immediate and formidable danger, leading to their union, the earlier preparations were merely aimed to repel their assault and protect Jack Clark, without revealing that Reincarnation and Void had already stepped into the Sixth Heavenly Realm.
While the Human Race’s True Emperors reevaluated strategies amid their shock over Jack Clark’s rise in strength…
In the distant Chaos Sea, a white sphere of light, reduced by one-tenth in size, revealed Jack Clark, whose body had grown to a million kilometers, lying across the Void.
Surrounding him, the tangible currents of chaotic space-time Origin flowed; laws and ultimate truths encircled him like a god of creation.
On his brow, a silver eye as colossal as a planet burned with white flames, its gaze flashing with countless fragmented images.
Every fragment represented a possible future for Jack Clark.
Having claimed the past, the next step was to consolidate the future, using chaotic space-time Origin—a fuel exclusive to Primordial True Emperors—to extract a strand of future aura and refine his future self.
The Fifth Heavenly Realm’s future self differed from the Abyss Demon God Brudos’s temporary summoning of a future self through bloodline power.
Not only was it stronger, but once condensed, it would remain permanently in the present.
Moreover, the power of this future self directly influenced a Primordial powerhouse’s strength during their breakthrough to the Sixth Heavenly Supreme Realm. Thus, Primordial Great Emperor-level beings continuously probed the future, seeking the mightiest future self.
Yet the deeper one delved into the future, the more chaotic space-time Origin consumed, and if the extracted future faced eventual death, the retrieved aura might prove defective.
At that moment, the Primordial Great Emperor would suffer instant heavy injury.
This made the Primordial Fifth Heavenly Realm a profoundly perilous state, one long plagued by the exhaustion of space-time Origin.
However, these concerns posed no problems for Jack Clark.
With a Seventh Heavenly Indestructible Origin as his fuel, Jack Clark could continuously push deeper into the future, without fear of depleting space-time Origin or of extracting an aura of future ‘death.’
Jack Clark was confident his future self would undoubtedly step into Eternity, invincible across the heavens.
Thus, his only worry was whether the future aura he retrieved would be strong enough.
If he grasped the aura representing a self who had already broken through Primordial Ninth, or even stepped into Eternity, his power upon merging with his future self in the Sixth Heavenly Supreme Realm would be unimaginably terrifying.
While Jack Clark silently fished for the future, beneath him, over a century, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon had grown incomparably massive.
Unlike Jack Clark’s path, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon followed the Road of Invincibility, unifying countless forces to forge an Eternal Behemoth Body.
In the Chaos Sea, the black light sphere had disappeared, replaced by a Black-red Colossal Beast as vast as a galaxy, stretching over ten million kilometers.
Around the beast, Chaos shattered, forming a Destruction Black Hole encompassing a trillion kilometers, devouring endless turbid currents in all directions.
Swallowing Chaos, digesting the indestructible—every moment, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s aura surged with terrifying speed, growing ever more formidable.

chapters.title: Chapter 1873: 696
chapters.content:
Chapter 1873: Chapter 696
Chapter 696 The Future of the Fault, Chaos Emperor City Riot
When Jack Clark first entered the Martial Arts School, he spent half a month completing the Foundation Establishment in order to learn True Martial arts, choosing the intermediate cultivation methods: Dragon Elephant Power and Mind’s Eye Bright Knife.
The Mind’s Eye Bright Knife was particularly special.
The sword skill’s power was only average among intermediate cultivation methods, but once the Heart’s Eye was cultivated, its power surpassed even senior sword skills.
With the help of the Heart’s Eye, Jack Clark, who was only at the Second Layer Heaven level, could traverse the battlefield under the senior cultivators of Koroya.
Ambush attacks and covert sniper threats were all predicted by him in advance, and he hunted down Evil God Sect Cultists with precision, completing the first wave of resource accumulation.
Later, the Mind’s Eye Bright Knife, under the enhancement of attribute points, reached its peak, separating the Heart’s Eye from the sword skill and transforming it into the Blade of Void Cutting Rune.
And with Jack Clark undergoing numerous strength breakthroughs and transformations, it became a special Divine Power, able to perceive all sights, intuitively foreseeing danger, and ultimately even peering into the past.
Now, as Jack Clark stepped into the Primordial stage, crossing into Fifth Heavenly Realm and mastering the Source of Space-Time, his heart’s eye also grew stronger under the enhancement of time and space.
Using himself as the coordinate, the silver-white eye on Jack Clark’s forehead radiated dazzling light, countless images about ‘his’ own self flashed past his eyes.
The future, always lies in the future.
Every person’s next second, the future can undergo multiple changes due to a sudden thought, and the next second continues these extensions, endlessly.
This aligns with the Blue Star Taoist theory of one generating two, two generating three, and three generating ten thousand things.
Thus, even eternal beings that transcend chaos and time-space cannot grasp their own future, as their potential futures change even more in every moment.
And because of ‘transcendence’, time and space leave no mark, so they cannot see themselves either.
Back then, Henry could see a fleeting flash of Jack Clark in a segment of future, visualizing Jack Clark’s participation in his battle with two other eternal Earth beings, because of their bond.
An ancient civilization and the Human Federation, the inheritance Jack Clark obtained on the Void Relic Continent.
Therefore, to avoid interfering with the future and creating unpredictable variables, Henry did not reach out to Jack Clark in advance.
The hidden means to help Jack Clark enhance his power were placed here, unimaginably far from the mythical world, tens of thousands of years ago, to minimize impact on Jack Clark’s early growth.
After merely sitting in the Chaos Sea for ten years, a subtle solemnity crept into Jack Clark’s previously dignified, detached face.
In ten years, he saw countless future fragments concerning himself, as numerous as the sands of the Ganges, but all his futures ended 150 years later.
Adjusting for the time flow in the mythical world, it’s roughly three years.
This made Jack Clark slightly solemn, stopping his future 150 years later, stemming from a potential result among more than 18 million possible futures 150 years later.
No matter which future, they all break off 150 years later.
This suggests either he completely perished, leaving no trace, naturally leading to no future in such a case.
Or he had already become eternal, transcending endless time and space, leaving no mark, thus Jack Clark could no longer see.
“It seems, the future self can only be constrained within 150 years.” Jack Clark’s gaze turned slightly focused, the eye on his forehead suddenly bursting with dazzling light.
Boom! Within the radiant tunnel composed of countless future fragments, a beam of light resembling a silver eye flashed by, stretching toward the future.
In a future fragment within the radiant tunnel, in the scene, a terrifying black-red giant beast standing in the cosmic void suddenly raised its head, roaring at the sky.
Roar!
A terrifying roar pierced through space-time, containing indescribably potent dark power, smashing Jack Clark’s vision into the future in an instant.
Immediately, Jack Clark’s silver eye on his forehead shut abruptly, his aura fluctuated, that roar from ‘himself’ destroying the Heart’s Eye light, depleting him significantly.
This is one of the resistances in grasping the future.
The future ‘him’ held far greater strength, and when sensing a vague observing, instinctively reacted.
“Again.”
Jack Clark’s gaze remained calm, the silver eye on his forehead opened again, emitting an even more dazzling silver light under the burning of the Origin of Space-Time…
As Jack Clark repeatedly tested reaching for the future, time passed at an astonishing speed, and decades seemed almost to pass in a flash.
During this time, the transformation of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon became more significant, its body length remained at a billion kilometers, but the surrounding Black Hole’s scope surged to a trillion kilometers.
Moreover, the shape was not circular but an enlarged version of a Dark Emperor Dragon resembling the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
A dark destruction beast with a body length of a trillion kilometers.
…
Chaos Emperor City.
During Jack Clark’s sixth year of closed-door cultivation, this vast mythical city remained as prosperous as ever, to these cultivators, six years elapsed almost like a blink of an eye.
But the golden-bearded man, who had been setting up a stall in the Imperial City for six years, grew increasingly fraught.
Looking up to the golden palace complexes seated in the sky, the golden-bearded man showed a solemn expression, unsure why recently, he always felt an inexplicable unease as if his mind were restless.
As a Primordial Monarch-level existence, such hunches wouldn’t be baseless.
Clearly, some change he wasn’t aware of occurred, likely related to his current mission; otherwise, his foreboding premonition wouldn’t have warned him.
“No way, I must draw that human out; delay will breed change.” With that thought, Bakibelens slowly stood up and looked outward to the sky.
There, a red light point faintly appeared, rapidly becoming brilliant and dazzling.
Boom!
Above Chaos Emperor City, a blood-colored star with a diameter of ten million kilometers descended, shaking the surrounding space and time, shattering the void, emitting a terrifying fluctuate with the power to Destroy Heaven and Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1874: 696
chapters.content:
Chapter 1874: Chapter 696
The sudden anomaly startled everyone in the Imperial City.
Under the oppressive force of the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary Monarch, everyone felt their bodies burning, their internal power frozen and unable to mobilize, forced to watch helplessly as the World-Destroying Light Sphere descended from the heavens.
At that moment, a long howl echoed from deep within the Chaos Emperor City, resonating through Heaven and Earth.
“The Primordial is invading. Everyone, join forces with this Lord of the Palace and activate the city to block it.”
Chaotic Emperor City, situated along Chaos Continent, began to tremble as one True Spirit-level powerful aura after another surged to the heavens.
Of course, these True Spirit powerhouses were not targeting the descending World-Destroying Great Sun—that power was beyond their ability to resist. Their goals were the control nodes of Chaos Emperor City.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Thousands of massive golden energy columns shot into the sky from all directions of the Chaos Emperor City, forming an immense and boundless light screen that enveloped and integrated with the Earth below.
Simultaneously, the million-kilometer-long city walls of Chaos Emperor City began to glow, illuminating even the internal structures with radiant brilliance.
It all happened in an instant.
The moment Chaos Emperor City activated, the scarlet Great Sun fell from the sky, engulfing this ancient, immense city.
Boom!
An explosion of terrifying energy, potent enough to shake the Heavenly Earth Rules, burst forth. The destructive force released by the red sun submerged the entire world, shaking Heaven and Earth, splitting skies and land apart.
The catastrophic explosion that seemed capable of Destroying Heaven and Earth penetrated layers of space-time, obliterating everything in its path. Amidst the chaos, the faint image of a colossal figure, fifty thousand kilometers tall and resembling a thousand-armed deity, emerged.
Half an hour later, as the radiance of the explosion gradually faded, the shattered Chaos Continent lay revealed, spanning billions of kilometers, and Chaos Emperor City, its brilliance dimmed significantly, appeared intact.
Above the city, Sara Williams held a top-tier Divine Sword in her left hand while her right hand cradled a golden decree.
The decree bore an engraved character, “Sparkling,” radiating an intimidating energy that linked seamlessly with the Chaos Emperor City below her.
Looking down at the city, where only ordinary buildings and mountain ranges had collapsed, Bakibelens furrowed his brow in the void above.
After all, the strike he had unleashed just now could, under normal conditions, severely wound an “ordinary” Primordial Monarch, its might peaking at the Third Heavenly Boundary of Primordial.
However, such an overwhelmingly powerful attack had failed to destroy an Imperial City, which was said to have only the “strength” of the Second Layer Heaven within the Primordial domain.
The reason was the golden decree in the hands of the woman exuding a pinnacle True Spirit aura.
Sara Williams stood in the Void, fortified by the True Emperor’s Edict, presiding over the city. Her gaze was piercing as she looked at the towering figure beyond the skies. “You are not a powerhouse from the surrounding civilizations. Who are you?”
“Who I am is irrelevant,” Bakibelens revealed his True Body, his gaze icy as he inspected the fractured Chaos Earth below. His cold, grim voice echoed throughout the vastness. “What matters is that you summon your Divine Martial City Master.”
“I’ve heard rumors that your Divine Martial City Master recently acquired a Chaos Supreme Treasure.”
“As the saying goes, Heaven and Earth Treasure belongs to the virtuous. Coincidentally, this Chaos Supreme Treasure is destined to be mine.”
“Now, I give you three breaths’ time. Have that so-called Divine Martial human surrender the Chaos Supreme Treasure immediately, or I will reduce this city to complete ruin.”
As he spoke, an even more terrifying aura erupted from Bakibelens, shaking the confines of space-time. Crimson blood light radiated from his body, his overwhelming aura dominating both Heaven and Earth.
Bakibelens’ words caused Sara Williams’ eyes to turn cold. “Attacking the Imperial City of the Human Race and coveting our Supreme Treasure—do you understand the consequences of such actions, foreign adversary?”
Bakibelens sneered, his gaze freezing. “Do you think I care about consequences once I’ve chosen to act?”
“Enough nonsense. If Divine Martial refuses to appear and surrender the treasure, then I shall slaughter you first and flatten this city to dust.”
Boom!
As his words fell, crimson light converged around Bakibelens, forming two blood-red dragons, each stretching millions of kilometers, roaring into the heavens as they charged towards the city below.
Roar! Roar!!
The two Apocalypse Blood Dragons descended from the heavens, emanating energy waves so terrifying that even Sara Williams’ pupils contracted slightly.
“Heart of the Imperial City, unleash the full might of the city’s power and cooperate with me!”
Sara Williams let out a long roar, the golden decree in her hand inscribed with the “Sparkling” character flashing brilliantly, summoning a new surge of immense power.
Bzzzzz!
Faced with impending destruction, the city, already imbued with an Artifact Spirit, radiated glow from its walls. Deep within, a force comparable to the power of Second Layer Primordial burst forth.
Boom!
A blinding white energy column, ten thousand kilometers in diameter, erupted into the sky, permeated with boundless Origin Energy fluctuations. It instantly enveloped Sara Williams, who absorbed it into the decree in her hand.
The energy column pierced through Heaven and Earth. Amidst the torrent of Origin Energy, Sara Williams’ long hair danced wildly as she raised the decree high.
“True Emperor’s Decree, unparalleled through the ages—Sparkling Heaven Sevenfold Star Slayer!”
Boom!
With a surge of Origin Energy rivaling a Primordial Second Layer Heaven master, the golden decree expanded, transforming into a colossal stele that stretched across the cosmos and stood resolutely against Heaven and Earth.
Boom! Boom!!
The two Blood Dragons, each possessing the destructive power to annihilate an entire Star System, collided with the stele.
The inhuman force struck the stele. The “Sparkling” character engraved on it gleamed fiercely, unleashing a terrifying counterforce that shattered the True Bodies of both Blood Dragons.
Bang! Bang!!
As the Blood Dragons disintegrated, a downpour of blood rain blanketed everything, washing over the land.
In the blink of an eye, the surroundings of Chaos Emperor City, spanning a million kilometers, were submerged in endless seas of blood—a scene akin to Blood Sea Hell.
“Let me see how many strikes you can withstand.”
Bakibelens roared in the Chaos Starry Sky, his thousand arms merging into one. A turbulent aura erupted from his body, reaching the extreme limits of the Primordial Third Heavenly Boundary, overpowering Heaven and Earth.
Boom! Waves of blood light burst forth from his consolidated palms, saturating the cosmos and consuming all in their path.
Under the assault of the terrifying blood light, the Heavenly Earth Rules disintegrated, space-time collapsed, and all things perished. The unparalleled aura of destruction rippled across dimensions, causing countless worlds to collapse into nothingness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1875: 697
chapters.content:
Chapter 1875: Chapter 697
Chapter 697: Jack Clark Returns
This time, the sudden attack by the Chaos Hunters triggered an explosive momentum that caught everyone by surprise.
Originally, based on the calculations of the powerhouses from the six Peak Civilizations, Jack Clark’s closed-door breakthrough into the Primordial realm was expected to take decades.
And even before breaking through to the Primordial level, Jack Clark’s combat power had already exceeded the limits of the Invincible Primordial Stars Realm, with strength nearly reaching the Second Heavenly Realm.
Once he steps into the Primordial realm, his actual combat strength might rival that of a Third Heavenly Realm Monarch. Even if Bakibelens is stronger, at most, he could suppress him.
As for killing him? Practically impossible.
Once the Human True Emperor reacts and immediately manifests outside the cosmos to deter, Bakibelens would have no choice but to retreat.
And afterward, it would face relentless pursuit from the Human Race.
Their plan, therefore, was to wait for Jack Clark’s “breakthrough” and emergence, for Bakibelens to feign weakness and lure him out of the Chaos Cosmos, where they’d obliterate him with the crushing force of thunder.
Four Fourth Heavenly Realm True Emperors and two Fifth Heavenly Realm Great Emperors joining forces for an ambush—such an attack would seriously injure even a Fifth Heavenly Realm Great Emperor.
But unexpected changes disrupted the plan; Bakibelens did not act according to the outlined strategy after taking on the mission.
Thus, Alquest and the others had no choice but to issue orders to their civilization’s powerhouses within the cosmos, immediately descending upon Chaos Emperor City to force Jack Clark out.
Even if they couldn’t kill Jack Clark this time, they had to interrupt his breakthrough process.
In the instant the order was given, Siegmund of the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe erupted with a terrifying aura, sending endless dazzling golden flames spewing across the surroundings of the Chaos Sea.
“Everyone, combine efforts to seal off space-time and disrupt the rules of Chaos. We cannot allow the Human Race to instantly receive word and react.”
“Take action!”
Boom!
Alquest let out a long howl, and his massive Obsidian True Body, stretching tens of thousands of kilometers high, emerged in the Chaos Cosmos, with layers of skies spreading outward to cover billions of kilometers.
Before the other four strong men of different races could act, a golden-red Great Sun suddenly descended.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Red flames capable of burning the heavens and boiling the seas erupted, scorching everything. Even the blend-all Chaos Qi currents burned fiercely under the flames, making the fire grow ever more vigorous and intense.
Looking at the red star system with a diameter of over one billion kilometers and surrounded by nine rings of red fire spanning hundreds of billions of kilometers, all six different race powerhouses’ expressions tightened.
Alquest’s voice turned heavy: “Blazing Heaven True Emperor, why aren’t you guarding Azure Sycamore Imperial City? Why are you here?”
“Here? Obviously, to stop you all from surrounding and killing our Human Race powerhouse.”
A cold and authoritative voice echoed throughout the Chaos region, as the terrifyingly vast blazing flames twisted and formed a colossal Fire Lotus Stand.
At the center of the searing sea of flames, the majestic figure of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor emerged, clad in radiant regal robes, crowned with the Imperial Crown, and holding the Great Sun in his hand.
Instantly, a pressure of a Fifth Heavenly Realm Primordial Great Emperor spread across, compressing the surrounding space-time into roaring tides and forcing apart the boiling, turbulent chaotic air waves, forming a “vacuum” of hundreds of billions of kilometers.
Though Alquest and Siegmund were also Primordial Great Emperors, their expressions grew increasingly grave.
For they had both been defeated by this Human Race Great Emperor before. Despite being equals in the realm, the opponent’s strength was on an entirely different tier.
This time, even those monitoring secretly, including Blazing Heaven and his peers, hadn’t expected the different races to launch an attack on Chaos Emperor City without waiting for Jack Clark to emerge.
As a result, Blazing Heaven had no choice but to descend directly to avoid revealing the fact that Jack Clark was not present in the Chaos Cosmos.
With the obstruction of the Chaos Cosmos, experts above the Primordial Monarch realm could not descend, largely cutting off the possibility of these foreign races’ strongest combatants intervening.
But if the races found out Jack Clark wasn’t in the Chaos Emperor City, wasn’t in this layer of the Chaos Cosmos, their strongest fighters would undoubtedly take direct action.
Given the deep foundation of these Peak Civilizations, they would certainly find a way to locate Jack Clark, even at great cost.
Among these methods, one is a forbidden blood ritual known to all civilizations from the Ancient Battlefield.
The blood ritual sacrifices a strong civilization’s race. Using the energy of an entire culture’s fate, the blood of powerhouses, and countless souls, the ritual can pinpoint enemies across far-off dimensions of space-time.
Once Jack Clark’s true name and true body are locked, even Blazing Heaven True Emperor and his peers might not be able to intercept quickly.
After all, they don’t even know where Jack Clark is currently.
Fixing his cold gaze on Siegmund, who stood in the midst of the golden world, Blazing Heaven True Emperor spoke indifferently:
“Lord Siegmund, hasn’t your Golden Tribe always declared neutrality? So, are you prepared to involve yourself in the Human Race and Gloomy Heaven Clan’s struggle, fighting to the bitter end?”
With these words, Blazing Heaven True Emperor turned his gaze toward another patch of Chaos Void, his eyes piercing dimensions to land upon the four concealed foreign race powerhouses.
“And as for you all, are you here intending to join forces with them and assault our Human Race strong man? Or did you merely happen to pass by?”
At this moment, Blazing Heaven True Emperor remained calm and refrained from taking immediate action.
His words also excluded the four hidden foreign race combatants from hostility, and even the Golden Eternal Divine Tribe, who had shown explicit animosity, were not directly labeled enemies.
Jack Clark’s talent was simply too exceptional, so overwhelming that Blazing Heaven and the others believed it wouldn’t be long before the Human Race produced a second Seventh Heavenly Undying powerhouse.
Time, therefore, was on their side.
As for the first one, that was naturally Henry, who vanished a million years ago.
Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s words instantly cast hesitation into the eyes of the concealed foreign combatants hiding within dimensions deep.
But at that moment, Alquest of the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan sneered: “Blazing Heaven, aren’t today’s events clear enough for you yet? Obviously, our six tribes have already formed an alliance, united to confront your Human Race.”
“Ever since your Human Race appeared in the Ancient Battlefield, you disrupted the balance maintained among the tribes for hundreds of thousands of years.”
“Under your ruthlessly aggressive invasions, the boundaries of influence in the Ancient Battlefield were redefined, triggering frequent wars among the tribes. These past years have seen incredible losses.”
“But as long as your Human Race is driven out of the Ancient Battlefield—out of this Chaos space-time—the Ancient Battlefield will return to its former tranquility.”
Just as Alquest finished speaking, a more overwhelming aura subtly emerged from the depths of the Chaos Void. Everyone suddenly felt a “darkness” descend over their sight, as though falling into the warped abyss of the Void.
“The Void!”
At that instant, the foreign race powerhouses’ expressions all changed dramatically, showing intense fear. One dark-breathing figure coughed lightly:
“Ahem, Lord Alquest, please don’t speak recklessly. We never said anything about alliances or partnerships, nor can we represent the tribes behind us.”
“Our presence here is purely accidental—a coincidence, merely passing through.”
With someone taking the lead, another foreign race powerhouse nodded promptly: “Indeed, we are simply passing through, passing through. We have no intention of opposing the Human Race.”
“Lord Alquest, you can joke about anything except such matters.”
Faced with the potential hidden threat of the Void True Emperor, the four foreign race powerhouses decisively switched sides, hastily distancing themselves from the Gloomy Heaven Clan.
With Blazing Heaven’s arrival and the Void’s watchful gaze, the plan to ambush Darren Callum had already failed.
Now Blazing Heaven offered them a way out, and their identities hadn’t yet been exposed—common sense dictated their next move.
The reason these experts from foreign races feared the Human Race so much was due to Reincarnation and the Void.
Among the Ancient Battlefield’s nine Peak Civilizations, each civilization possessed a strongest combatant at the Sixth Heavenly Realm. However, unlike tribes such as the Gloomy Heaven Clan and Golden Tribe, the Human Race had two.
Only two Peak Civilizations possessed two Sixth Heavenly Realm Primordial Supremes—one being the Human Race, and the other the Heavenly Punishment Clan.
But unlike the aggressive Human Race, the Heavenly Punishment Clan was territorial and reclusive: as long as other civilizations didn’t provoke them, they rarely left their domains.
This made the Human Race the dominant force in the Ancient Battlefield. That additional Sixth Heavenly Realm Supreme was enough to tip the balance between civilizations.
This supremacy was countered only by the Gloomy Heaven Clan and the Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon tribe, who formed a mutually reinforcing alliance.
“You!” Watching the four foreign race powerhouses suddenly switch sides, Alquest’s gaze turned icy.
At that moment, Siegmund of the Golden Tribe also spoke leisurely: “Blazing Heaven True Emperor, you have misunderstood us. Our Golden Tribe has always been, and will always be, friends to the Human Race.”
“My appearance here tonight was purely coincidental. I happened to encounter Lord Alquest and was preparing for a friendly sparring match.”
“Imagine my surprise when you arrived before we’d even begun our duel.”
Siegmund’s words caused Alquest’s gaze to turn frostier, as he stood silently in the void, seemingly unwilling to respond further.
Watching this scene, the four foreign race combatants’ eyes flickered.
A bizarre stillness descended over the Chaos Sea—a fragile alliance formed to oppose Jack Clark seemed to crumble before it ever began.
At that moment, Blazing Heaven True Emperor radiated cold and terrifying killing intent. His voice, icy yet authoritative, echoed across the Chaos: “Since this is all a misunderstanding, then I won’t entertain you all as guests today.”
“Alquest, today, as a Great Emperor, you dared to break the rules, attempting a covert assault on our Human Race experts below the Primordial level.”
“From now on, the Human Race and the Gloomy Heaven Clan’s civilizations are at war. Whether in the Ancient Battlefield or Chaos Void, Human Race experts and the Gloomy Heaven Clan will battle without rest or reconciliation.”
Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s voice transcended space and dimensions, resonating within Human Race territories. Instantly, wars between the Human Race and the Gloomy Heaven Clan erupted across countless realms.
Boom!
Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s true form expanded, transforming into a towering figure millions of kilometers high. Holding a star in his hand, he created a vast Flame Universe that radiated horrifying power capable of crushing heavens and shaking eternity.
“Blazing Heaven, don’t think for a moment that I fear you!”
Alquest roared furiously, surrounded by layers of dark worlds where endless black flames converged, transforming into a colossal, boundless Beast Head.
Roar! A bloodthirsty, ferocious roar shook the Chaos.
In an instant, primal chaos…
[]

chapters.title: Chapter 1876: 698: The Invincible Giant Beast, Devouring the Supreme Hell
chapters.content:
Chapter 1876: Chapter 698: The Invincible Giant Beast, Devouring the Supreme Hell
On the eve of Chaos Emperor City’s eruption, Jack Clark, having completed the forging of his Undying Body in the distant Chaos Sea with his cultivation soaring, stood side by side with the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Compared to the earth-shaking commotion during their breakthrough, the pair—man and beast—appeared much more ‘ordinary’ now.
Jack Clark’s true body stood at a height of one million kilometers. He wore the black Twenty-Four All-Heaven Emperor Crown on his head, and behind him floated a white halo with a diameter of ten thousand kilometers, radiating a divine and majestic aura of immense power.
It was as if he were the Supreme God from Blue Star’s mythical legends.
As for the beast, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s true body was even larger. Even in its standard form, its size reached an unfathomable fifteen million kilometers, a magnitude beyond comprehension.
One thick scale on its body was as immense as Jupiter, while even the thinnest belly scale measured ten thousand kilometers in thickness. Behind it stretched three rows of peaks, each spanning a million kilometers, extending tens of millions of kilometers endlessly.
Such a colossal beast was overwhelming in presence merely by existing there.
Though Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon didn’t seem to emit an air of annihilation or destruction, the Silver Giant Dragon perched on the Black-red Colossal Beast’s head dared not move recklessly.
In the Silver Giant Dragon’s perception, the space-time within tens of thousands of kilometers around the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s body was compressed layer by layer, distorted to a point where all laws were pulverized into terrifying chaos.
“Roar! Tim Abott and that human are so powerful, so terrifying now.”
The Silver Giant Dragon was both nervous and exhilarated. Feeling the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s terrifying aura, its four claws trembled with excitement, and its tail lifted involuntarily.
Over the course of nearly three hundred years of closed-door cultivation, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon had continuously achieved breakthroughs in power.
The transcendent boundary concepts unleashed during its breakthroughs, coupled with the Origin Energy radiating from its body, brought great gains to the Silver Giant Dragon as well.
Its physical size had grown to one million meters in length, and its realm had advanced to the half-step Primordial stage, nearing the level where its body could begin condensing and generating Primordial Air.
In terms of overall form, it now resembled the Doomsday Emperor Dragon even more—such as its dorsal fins that stretched backward like three rows of peaks, and its tail, which was unusually long compared to other dragons.
Add to that the flowing silver mane around its dragon head, and upon first glance, one could mistake it as the ‘daughter’ of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Over the hundreds of years, it had progressed from the True Spirit Initial Stage to the half-step Primordial stage. Compared to the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s accomplishment of advancing from the pinnacle of True Spirit to the extreme limits of the Sixth Heavenly Realm, it seemed an immense gap.
Yet, in comparison to other Giant Beasts of the mythical world, the growth speed of the Silver Giant Dragon was terrifying enough to stun even dragons.
Most notably, the Silver Giant Dragon’s bloodline continued to evolve under the influence of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s Heavenly Tier bloodline, advancing from the Senior Monarch level to the Pseudo-Heaven Tier.
As long as it did not perish along the way, the bloodline potential of the Silver Giant Dragon was sufficient for it to grow to the True Emperor level in the future.
Standing in the chaos, Jack Clark’s eyes revealed a trace of regret, for both he and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon had stopped just one step shy of the extreme limits of the Sixth Heavenly Realm.
The Primordial Nine-layered Heavens could be divided into three major tiers, each tier marked by distinct differences.
The core of the fourth, fifth, and sixth layers of the Heavenly Realm lies in the Chaos Space-Time Source—past, future, and present merging in a unified perfection to ascend to the Seventh Heaven.
Jack Clark had already grasped the past, condensed the future, and completed the step of unification, reaching the peak perfection of his current realm.
But due to insufficient Undying Power, he was unable to achieve the True Body Transformation.
Regrettably, the foundational strength of both his and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s true bodies was far too robust—a double-edged sword that granted them terrifying combat strength surpassing the boundary of a major realm.
Yet, when attempting to break through realms, this advantage turned into a constraint, as their ‘energy’ requirements far exceeded the standard—more than a hundred times the norm for those within the same realm.
Therefore, even though Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon each forged an ancient Undying Body, the contained Undying Power was still insufficient for their breakthroughs.
Especially for the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, whose even more formidable true body had only managed to achieve less than one-tenth of its transformation.
Let alone reaching the level of ancient undying, let alone ascending further to eternal and undying will.
Under normal conditions, even for Jack Clark, it would take thousands or tens of thousands of years to cross this threshold.
The source of Undying Power lies in Chaos Qi, which must be absorbed in vast quantities, refined into Chaos Origin, and then tempered through a cultivator’s will and vitality to transform into Undying Power.
This process of refinement and transformation is painstakingly intricate, with time costs typically measured in millennia or tens of thousands of years.
That is why strong men within the Chaos Sea above the Seventh Heavenly Realm are rare—they’re all busy in closed-door cultivation, absorbing chaos energy and refining undying strength, rather than wasting time fighting life-or-death battles.
Of course, having enough Eternal Air would be ideal—it is an energy superior to chaos and reigns above it.
This was also the reason why Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon were able to forge an Undying Body.
If not for the lingering Eternal Power left behind by Henry aiding them, even Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon—and let alone an eighth-level Heavenly Realm cultivator—wouldn’t have been able to refine the corpse of a seventh-degree Heavenly Realm strong man.
Ancient undying is no mere phrase to be taken lightly.
“Origin, I require more Origin. Anything that can be converted into Origin Energy will suffice.” At this moment, a fierce longing for World Origin surfaced in Jack Clark’s heart.
But he immediately exhaled, gently dispelling the trace of restlessness that had risen within him, as a faint smile emerged on his face.
Humans must not be too greedy. The leap from Primordial Initial Stage to the Sixth Heavenly Realm has already yielded abundant rewards.
And this was only in realm advancements—the transformations and expansions in other aspects were even more terrifying. For instance, the ten Chaos Halos behind Jack Clark had increased to thirteen.
Each Chaos Halo symbolized a power equivalent to a lifeline talent or supreme rule.
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon had experienced similarly terrifying transformations, solidifying three lifeline talents based on its core three deification talents.
At this moment, Jack Clark could not even fathom its strength—no comparisons, no benchmarks.

chapters.title: Chapter 1877: 698: The Invincible Giant Beast, Devouring the Supreme Hell_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1877: Chapter 698: The Invincible Giant Beast, Devouring the Supreme Hell_2
“Time to head back. Just as well, the Ancient Battlefield is a good testing ground. Haven’t they been persistently seeking me?” Jack Clark muttered, his blood-red eyes slowly opening at the center of his brow.
Within the blood-red eyes, a sinister disc emerged, surrounded by torrential blood light, hinting at ominous signs.
The strongest warrior of the Gloomy Heaven Clan shattered the protective force of the Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor, along with the double concealment of the Hidden Deity’s shrouding technique, instantly sensing Jack Clark’s true name upon uncovering it.
The strange phenomenon of Black Flames veiling layer after layer of Space-Time and engulfing endless dimensions assured Jack Clark at first glance that the prying force originated from the You Tian War God Clan.
There was no mistaking it; the energy signature of this clan was far too distinct.
Moreover, surrounding that manifestation of boundless Black Flames, faint traces of pure golden light permeated, clearly indicating assistance from other Supreme Experts.
In the end, however, the prying force was dispersed by the roar of a Giant Beast, preventing it from locking onto Jack Clark’s location or determining his Space-Time coordinates.
But this ‘grudge’ was not something Jack Clark would simply let go.
Using Great Divine Power to lock onto one’s true name and search for coordinates inherently entails a vow of life or death. It’s a method reserved for deep-seated hatred.
Boom!
Bloodstains stretching across billions of kilometers descended, unleashing torrents of blood light that transformed into a Sea of Blood, submerging Jack Clark and disappearing deep into dimensional space amidst intense Space-Time ripples.
Watching the red glow disappear like a fleeting mirage, along with that terrifying human figure, the Silver Giant Dragon finally exhaled in relief.
“Roar! Tim Abott, that human has left.”
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon slowly nodded, releasing a low growl from its nostrils that reverberated through the chaos with undaunted majesty: “Yes, he’s gone.”
Now that Jack Clark, whose presence had exerted immense pressure on them, had departed, the Silver Giant Dragon’s mood lightened considerably. It roared inquisitively: “Tim Abott, where are we going now?”
“Should we go back to find May, or do we dive straight into the depths of chaos to hunt for some Primordial Beasts to ‘eat’?”
At the mention of hunting Primordial Beasts for consumption, the Silver Giant Dragon’s tone grew excited, revealing the brutal savagery of a beast.
Of course, the feast of Primordial Beasts was reserved for the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
The Silver Giant Dragon didn’t possess the stomach to digest the flesh and blood of creatures a Major Realm higher than itself, let alone convert it into energy for rapid Evolution.
Under the Silver Giant Dragon’s expectant gaze, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon subtly shook its colossal, ferocious dragon head, causing the surrounding Chaos Sea to quake with its overwhelming power.
“No rush. There’s one more battle to fight. Once it’s over, we’ll venture into the depths of the Chaos Void.”
“Roar! Fighting! Great Sethia loves fighting most of all. Great Sethia demands rivers of blood!” the Silver Giant Dragon cheered.
…
Under the power of the Supreme Hell Plane, Jack Clark shattered dimensions instantly, leaping toward the Chaos Emperor City.
However, within the brief moment of borrowing the Hell Plane’s energy for the leap, Jack Clark’s inner energy depleted at a terrifying rate, instantly consuming one-tenth of it.
No choice—while the Supreme Hell Plane could support the dimensional leap of a being at the Sixth Heavenly Realm Perfection stage, it wasn’t without considerable strain.
Thus, the cost had to be borne by Jack Clark, who was utilizing its power.
While immersed in the depths of dimensional space, surrounded by speeding streams of light, a sudden wave of immense power surged, accompanied by an unexpected summons. Jack Clark’s brows furrowed slightly.
“Alvaron? What could it want with me?”
Sensing the familiar fluctuations embedded in the call, Jack Clark didn’t reject it. Instantly, the surrounding aura of blood light distorted.
In a world bathed entirely in blood, where the sky, the Earth, even the ‘air and energy’ turned crimson, Jack Clark’s towering figure—standing a million kilometers tall—descended.
A horrifying pressure unique to the Sixth Heavenly Realm exploded from Jack Clark’s body.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
A mere trace of Jack Clark’s aura caused this blood-drenched world to quake, its rules to collapse layer by layer, and billions of kilometers of Earth to crumble and disintegrate.
Such fearsome might left the towering figure at the edge of the world—cloaked in a blood-red robe, crowned with a sinister crown, and standing a million kilometers tall—momentarily stunned.
Soon after, shock flashed through the eyes of this Lord of Hell, his voice trembling as he exclaimed: “Impossible! Darren Callum, your cultivation has reached the Sixth Heavenly Realm!!”
Amid the chaotic currents, Jack Clark, whose aura rivaled Alvaron’s, revealed a faint smile: “It’s been a long time, Lord of Alvaron.”
“You aren’t mistaken. Through a twist of fate, my cultivation has managed to step into the Sixth Heavenly Realm.”
Damn! Even Alvaron’s steadfast composure couldn’t suppress an expletive deep within his heart.
Earlier, sensing the fluctuations of Hell’s power, Alvaron had detected Jack Clark’s familiar aura, realizing it had reached Primordial Level. This in itself was somewhat surprising.
This prompted him to instinctively intervene and pull Jack Clark into his domain.
Alvaron had always held Jack Clark, this ‘monster’ from the Eternal Great World, in high regard, closely observing his growth.
Jack Clark’s recent breakthrough into ‘Primordial Level’ met the minimum threshold for establishing a layer of Hell, prompting Alvaron to see whether Jack Clark sought his assistance.
But to his utter disbelief, Jack Clark hadn’t merely broken through to Primordial Level—he had reached the same Sixth Heavenly Realm Perfection stage as him.
How was that possible!? Alvaron momentarily wondered if he was experiencing an illusion.
Only ten years had passed since the conclusion of the last Plane war—what miraculous opportunities could let a True Spirit Powerhouse navigate the six Major Realm levels of Primordial so rapidly?
Watching the baffled Alvaron, Jack Clark calmly spoke: “Lord of Alvaron, you abruptly summoned me here. What is the matter?”
“Hah! There is indeed a matter.” Alvaron exhaled deeply, suppressing his inner shock as his tone turned solemn.
“Originally, I believed that even with Darren’s unparalleled talent, reaching this stage would demand at least ten millennia. It seems I underestimated your gift.”
“Still, this is good; the plan can now proceed ahead of schedule.”
Jack Clark’s eyes flickered slightly: “What plan?”
Alvaron did not hold back and divulged directly: “To slay a seventh-heaven-realm Lord of Hell and divide the Hell layer controlled by said lord.”
“This plan has long been in preparation. The question is, Darren, do you dare to join me?”
Between the two figures, a ribbon-like strand of blood light emerged, seemingly containing a dreadful power, floating toward Jack Clark.
After a brief moment of contemplation, Jack Clark extended his right hand to seize the strand of blood.
Boom!
Suddenly, Jack Clark’s consciousness trembled slightly as a force imbued with eternal essence, capable of obliterating the Soul Will of a Pinnacle True Spirit, surged into his body.
This information unraveled in Jack Clark’s Sea of Consciousness, materializing as a fragmented blood-red ‘universe.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1878: 699
chapters.content:
Chapter 1878: Chapter 699
Chapter 699: The Heavenly Dao’s Oppression, The Devouring Beast
Chaos Emperor City
The tangible force of space-time imbued with Great Sun rules materialized, turning into a golden light curtain that enveloped the Chaos Emperor City.
Within the city’s borders, hundreds of millions of cultivators gazed solemnly at the Chaos Outside Heaven, where an immense black fortress emitting dazzling radiance was shattering chaos, hurtling toward them at incredible speed.
Outside the imperial city, a colossal figure towering fifty thousand kilometers high stood firm, spreading a thousand arms as nine blood dragons, each stretching tens of millions of kilometers, roared around it with an awe-inspiring might.
Each time the blood dragons struck the imperial city’s curtain of light, earth-shattering vibrations and deafening booms erupted.
The invisible omnipresent force of rules shattered space-time, generating rings of blood-red shockwaves that swept through billions of kilometers, covering the heavens and engulfing chaos in destruction.
Despite approaching a True Emperor’s level of dreadful power, this force failed to intimidate the Human Race.
Within the imperial city, three million figures clad in ferocious black battle armor were dispersed in units of ten thousand, merging into the layers of defensive arrays fortified by the imperial city’s celestial walls.
Standing within the massive array, Curt Walters who presided over the Godslaying Formation let out a thunderous roar: “Hall Lord Williams, hold off that Primordial Monarch; leave the Gloomy Heaven Main City to us.”
“Nine turns to the heavens, slay gods and demons—kill!”
Nine True Spirit-level experts commanding the army, along with dozens of ancient-level and hundreds of Titan-level powerhouses, acted as nodes, channeling the imperial city’s core strength into the Godslaying Formation.
Boom!
An endless surge of dark crimson blood light shot skyward, converging the combined power of millions of mighty cultivators, forming a Black Armored Demon God towering over hundreds of thousands of kilometers, surrounded by dark crimson flames.
Instantly, a force comparable to the third Primordial Tier Overlord level permeated the space.
Since most of this power resonated with the Chaos Emperor City, the golden sky curtain ignored the Demon God, allowing part of its enormous form to ‘slowly’ extend beyond the city borders.
In its hand, a massive black Demon Blade spanning over two hundred thousand kilometers ignited in flames, cleaving through the void toward the rapidly approaching Gloomy Heaven Main City.
The power of the third Primordial Heaven Tier could not challenge Bakibelens, nor could it endure the crushing strength of this expert approaching True Emperor-level capabilities.
However, it was sufficient to momentarily block the Gloomy Heaven Main City, preventing its collision with the Chaos Emperor City from triggering a catastrophic explosion.
Watching the Black Armored Demon God ’emerging’ from another direction of the Chaos Emperor City, Bakibelens’ gaze grew icy: “You dare to act as though my majesty is irrelevant.”
With those words, the eighteen arms behind Bakibelens reached into the Void, tearing ferociously toward the Black Armored Demon God located tens of millions of kilometers away.
Boom! Chaos detonated, and a massive black crack stretched across tens of millions of kilometers, its unmatched might tearing the Black Armored Demon God into two, obliterating it effortlessly.
The Demon God condensed from the Godslaying Array was annihilated by Bakibelens, and the backlash of power caused Curt Walters and others to spew blood instantly, sustaining heavy injuries.
The disparity in power was simply too vast.
And due to Bakibelens’ obstruction, the guardian of the Gloomy Heaven Clan had already maneuvered the main city to hover above the Chaos Emperor City.
Spanning a diameter of a million kilometers, the ominous black main city forged from a dead celestial body was now entirely engulfed in black flames, its interior surging with an explosive energy terrifying enough to alarm even Primordial Monarchs.
“Human Race, prepare to die!”
A black Obsidian Giant towering tens of thousands of kilometers beneath the main city roared, exuding a recklessly maddened aura.
Should this strike descend, the ensuing explosion would exhaust the remaining energy in the Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s Edict held by Sara Williams, already diminished by Bakibelens’ attacks.
Moreover, the destructive force would shatter the edict entirely, erasing divine souls and obliterating intent.
As for the members of the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan and other vassal alien race experts within the Gloomy Heaven Main City, they had long since been consumed as fuel in its fiery descent.
Inside the golden light curtain, as the black ‘star’ from outside the heavens hurtled toward them, and the thousand-armed alien stood ready to strike, Sara Williams’ expression remained serenely calm.
For in her possession were not only the Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s Edict but also one from the Void True Emperor.
In preparation for Jack Clark’s closed-door cultivation, the Human Race’s experts had provided Sara Williams with numerous trump cards, anticipating a scenario just like this.
Yet none of the others were aware of this; at this moment, countless cultivators within the Chaos Emperor City stared nervously and intently toward the heavens above.
“It must hold… we must hold!”
But just as tension gripped every heart, as Sara Williams prepared to unleash another hidden card to buy more time, scarlet blood light erupted from the depths of the Chaos Emperor City like a sea of blood overflowing.
The blood light spread at a speed transcending light, transcending time itself, blanketing this part of the Chaos Cosmos.
Boom!
From within the blood light, an unimaginable supreme figure descended, its presence surrounded by apocalyptic manifestations of seas of blood, its aura shaking the Chaos Cosmos to its core.
Under this force that surpassed space-time, the entire world froze completely.
Be it the overwhelming might of Bakibelens or the impending collision of the Gloomy Heaven Main City with the Chaos Emperor City, even thought and consciousness—all was suspended in stagnation.
At this moment, only True Spirit-level experts could barely retain the ability to process thought.
Among them, Sara Williams, Curt Walters, Bakibelens, and others all gazed in shock at the figure clad in a Mysterious Colored Imperial Robe.
Though he appeared as an ordinary person, the immense presence he exuded engulfed the cosmos entirely.
Especially for Bakibelens, the instant it laid eyes on Jack Clark’s return, the faint unease it had felt earlier intensified exponentially.
From the depths of its soul came an overwhelming shuddering fear; a terror born from its racial talent—an innate premonition sharper than the sixth sense.
Since stepping onto the Transcendent Path, Bakibelens had never felt such spine-chilling dread.

chapters.title: Chapter 1879: 699
chapters.content:
Chapter 1879: Chapter 699
Even the life-and-death dangers it encountered more than ten times before, the fear it felt then was not even one percent of what it felt now, so intense that it made it despair.
Going to die, going to die!!
Run, move quickly, move!!
Bakibelens roared crazily in its heart, its powerful monarch will burst out, trying to break through the terrifying pressure that suppressed Heaven and Earth, suppressing its strength.
But with the difference of several major realms, Bakibelens’ struggle was futile.
This kind of despair was almost the same as when it wandered in the Chaos Sea in the past, when those True Spirit Emperors of different races encountered it.
Unresistable, uncontradictable.
But before Jack Clark could do anything, a repulsive force from across the Chaos Cosmos, even penetrating the ancient battlefield of the Supreme Chaos, came through.
Boom!
Under that counter-shock force containing the supreme chaos power, the pressure covering this universe by Jack Clark began to shatter, forming a rolling tide of rules rushing towards him from all directions of the Chaos Cosmos.
At the same time, an invisible supreme force descended, swirling around Jack Clark, transmitting some vague information.
If you don’t leave, you’ll be suppressed.
This was the instinctive warning from the ancient battlefield.
This layer of the Chaos Cosmos does not allow life forms above the True Emperor level, otherwise, the invisible emanating space-time tide will destroy the fundamental structure of this layer of the Chaos Cosmos.
Thereby affecting the ancient battlefield.
This is also the reason why Sparkling Heaven and others have not stepped into this Chaos Cosmos, and why Siegmund and other strong men of different races have not personally entered to attack the Chaos Emperor City.
They did not want to be suppressed beneath the ancient battlefield.
In the face of the origin will’s warning of this Chaos Cosmos, Jack Clark looked indifferent, and his voice rang through this Heaven and Earth: “Whether I leave or not depends on my will.”
With that said, Jack Clark ignored the universe will warning, reached out his right hand, and grabbed Bakibelens and You Tian Main City, frozen by the blood light.
Boom!
In Jack Clark’s hand, space-time cut through, and space within a billion kilometers collapsed with a rumble, forming a blood-red light sphere caught in his hand in the blink of an eye.
And Jack Clark’s disregard for the warning instantly enraged the origin will of the Chaos Cosmos.
Crackle! Above Chaos Emperor City, a gray crack appeared, stretching for billions of kilometers, like a giant Eye of Heavenly Path.
Instantly, a powerful Heavenly Path pressure descended.
In the depths of that massive gray pupil, purple-black thunder emerged, and the destructive aura it invisibly emanated made this Chaos Cosmos begin to crumble.
Looking at the heavenly punishment about to descend, Jack Clark slowly raised his head, eyes cold: “Do you want to face-off with pupil-type divine power.”
With that said, a pair of black golden vertical pupils also appeared in Jack Clark’s eyes.
At the same time, beneath the suspended Chaos Emperor City, where only the city remained after the continent shattered, a pair of black golden vertical pupils covering the starry skies appeared, eyes filled with endless darkness.
As if from another plane, covering all heavens and realms, the Dark Void, deep, terrifying.
Feeling the terrifying power capable of destroying the universe contained in those black golden vertical pupils, a rare hint of hesitation appeared in the descending Heavenly Path eye, and the destructive thunder penalty that had gathered in its pupils did not fall.
Only the fear of the Void Death Pupil’s power by this universe’s Heavenly Path, without expulsion, but the ‘world’ around Jack Clark began to crumble little by little because it couldn’t bear his existence.
This crumbling belonged to the breakdown of fundamental rules, as if a black hole devouring the cosmic starry sky began to spread centered on Jack Clark.
“You are too fragile.”
With that, Jack Clark stepped forward along the black hole of the world’s crumbling into the depths of the universe, directly breaking the universe’s crystal walls to leave.
As Jack Clark left, the supreme pressure that suppressed the entire universe also disappeared, and Curt Walters and others instantly regained control of their bodies.
Only now, shock and disbelief appeared on the faces of these True Spirit level leaders.
The figure just now with a might more terrifying than a True Emperor seemed like the Divine Martial City Master! But how is this possible, before the City Master went into closed-door cultivation, he was only in the True Spirit Realm?
Even if his talent was strong, after several years of closed-door cultivation, at most he could have broken through to Primal Hegemon.
But what was that just now, the pressure even repelled the heavenly will of this Chaos Cosmos, casually suppressing that primal monarch strong man who was overwhelming!!
Too, too terrifying.
At this moment, not only the Human Experts of Chaos Emperor City, but also those Alien True Emperors watching the battle between Sparkling Heaven and Alquest on the periphery of the Chaos Cosmos, also felt that powerful pressure belonging to the Primordial Supreme when Jack Clark arrived.
Especially the Heavenly God strongman Siegmund of the Golden Eternity Race.
The first moment they recognized the figure surrounded by blood light as Jack Clark, that very likely Darren Callum of the reincarnation of Heng.
Wrong, he is indeed the reincarnation of the ancient emperor Heng, as expected, all these years of closed-door cultivation were not about breakthroughs, but about restoring past cultivation.
But it’s too late, everything is too late!!
From Jack Clark’s return until now, everything happened in an instant, and those Alien True Emperors had not reacted yet when the Chaos Sea was stained red by endless blood light.
Boom! Chaos roared, heaven and earth trembled.
Under Jack Clark’s nearly comparable to the seventh sky eternal, terrifying pressure, chaos qi within several light-years rioted, forming a tsunami engulfing everything.
And Siegmund and others were even sinking in body shape, the Primordial Celestial Domain around them shaking, constantly compressing.
Including the Blazing Heaven True Emperor deep in the time-space dimensional battle, the Gloomy Heaven Domain Lord Alquest, also subconsciously burst out their power to shake off their opponents, looking in horror at the center of the blood light.
There, Blood Sea Hell rolled, forming a majestic figure as high as a million kilometers, wearing an Imperial Crown.
In one arm of that supreme figure, it was holding a one-side world, inside which You Tian Main City exploded like fireworks, and Bakibelens’ true body of the Primal Monarch had been crushed.
And around the shattered true body of Bakibelens, time and space constantly warped and overlapped.
Those warped time-spaces continuously displayed various images, each featuring Bakibelens’ figure, which under invisible power, kept dissipating and vanishing.
This scene made Alquest and others’ complexions slightly change.
Across chaos space-time, erasing past and future.
When all the images of Bakibelens in those time-spaces disappeared, it would also represent the complete fall of this immensely powerful, undying Primal Monarch.
At this time, a somewhat astonished voice broke the heavy atmosphere.
“Jack Clark, you’ve already broken through the Sixth Heavenly Realm!!” Those Alien experts were in disbelief, and so was the Blazing Heaven True Emperor.
Although they had known two years ago that Jack Clark had broken through the Primordial True Emperor, reached the fourth Heavenly Realm’s limit, and completed the final past occupation.
But two years later, the result of Jack Clark’s cultivation reaching across the Fifth Heavenly Realm and achieving Primordial Supreme still made her feel a bit surreal, and unreal.
Jack Clark slowly nodded: “Yes, Blazing Heaven Senior, because of some opportunities, my cultivation passed smoothly into the Sixth Heavenly Realm.”
“However, now is not the time for reminiscing, let’s settle these guys first.”
Saying so, Jack Clark glanced over at the Gloomy Heaven Domain Lord Alquest and then at the other four Alien experts, finally falling on Siegmund billions of kilometers away.
Instantly, Siegmund, standing at the center of the golden world, had a slight change in expression: “Supreme Divine Martial, our Golden Eternity Race has always been neutral, with no enmity towards the Human Race, and we are only passing by today.”
“If the Supreme is displeased, I will leave immediately.”
With that, Siegmund prepared to turn and leave, not daring to stay here any longer.
The other few Alien experts also had thoughts of retreat, the Human Race was too terrifying, that Darren Callum was indeed the reincarnation of Heng, fortunately, they hadn’t revealed their identities and acted.
Boom! Space-time around Siegmund trembled, forming black golden chains encircling billions of kilometers, sealing and cutting dimensions.
Jack Clark silently appeared in front of Siegmund, looking at it indifferently, and a deep, majestic voice resonated through chaos: “Do you think I would believe your words.”
“Or do you think you did not detect when you Golden Tribe expended greatly, joined forces with the Gloomy Heaven Clan to search for my true name all over?”
With that, behind Jack Clark, the chaos roared, space-time twisted, and a gloomy blue altar covering billions of kilometers emerged.
Above the altar, space-time twisted, dimensions intertwined, forming a giant black-blue vortex, a gigantic and fierce dragon head slowly probing out from the vortex depths.
Roar! A fierce roar reverberated through chaos.
“From now on, the Golden Eternity Race and the Youtian War God Clan will all become past!”

chapters.title: Chapter 1880: 700 Eternal Darkness Devouring, Assault on Ancient Times
chapters.content:
Chapter 1880: Chapter 700 Eternal Darkness Devouring, Assault on Ancient Times
Chapter 700: Eternal Darkness Devouring, Entering the Ancient Era
Roar! The ferocious howl of the mighty beast reverberated through the chaos.
Amidst the horrified gazes of all True Emperors and Great Emperor-level strong men, a colossal black-red beast spanning 150 million kilometers, resembling a star system, crossed spacetime and descended.
What caused the hearts of these True Emperors to tremble was the aura emanating from this ferocious behemoth.
Savage, majestic, and supremely divine.
Looking at the black-red beast towering in the Void, those alien strong men felt as if they were gazing upon primordial stars in the ancient universe, stars that had existed for billions of years, undying through eternity.
Eternal!
Unlike Jack Clark, who had restrained his power upon his return, due to descending by tearing through dimensional coordinates using the Time-Space Summoning Altar, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon released its full strength.
In this state, neither its realm nor its aura could be concealed, causing all strong men, including the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, to reveal expressions of astonishment.
It was a seventh-layer Eternal Undying Realm beast, although the aura it exuded at the moment seemed only at the level of a sixth-layer Heavenly Realm. Its terrifying power, however, was clearly at the seventh-layer level.
This level of power had not appeared on the Ancient Battlefield for a million years, belonging to the absolute invincible tier.
Run!
Without a second thought, Siegmund immediately sought to escape.
Boom!
The golden world, spanning billions of kilometers around Siegmund, collapsed like an infinitely contracting singularity, leaving behind a golden dot less than one hundred meters in the Boundless Chaotic Sea.
In the perception of Blazing Heaven and others, Siegmund’s aura disappeared instantly.
Within several light years, his presence was undetectable; Siegmund had vanished from spacetime, disappearing from this moment in time.
Such divine power, capable of erasing all traces of oneself instantly, surprised everyone. Indeed, it was worthy of a fifth-layer Heavenly Realm Primordial Great Emperor-level strong man.
But today, Siegmund faced Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Standing amidst the Blood Sea Hell, gazing at the fading golden light, Jack Clark’s eyes remained indifferent as he spoke slowly, “Can you escape?”
As he spoke, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon towering behind him moved thunderously, its wings covering the sky and earth as they unfurled, its colossal mouth opened wide, revealing a black hole within.
Boom!
Centered on Siegmund’s disappearance point, the chaotic qi spanning hundreds of billions of kilometers erupted, forming a chaos-consuming vortex that swallowed heaven and earth.
Within the vortex, resembling the event horizon of a black hole, layers of spacetime folded, twisted, and then shattered.
In one fragment of shattered spacetime, a Golden Dragon Man towering a million kilometers high stood at the center of a world, staring in shock at the apocalyptic black hole devouring everything beyond the heavens.
Around the black hole, layers of collapsing spacetime condensed into tangible black destruction waves that layered atop one another, enveloping this world.
As he stared at the world-engulfing apocalyptic black hole, Siegmund felt an inexplicable surge of strong deathly dread.
Boom!
The two golden dragon horns atop Siegmund’s head shattered, releasing infinite golden light that condensed into a primordial rune resembling a ferocious dragon head appearing behind him.
The primordial rune represented Siegmund’s innate divine power and, amplified by primordial supreme talent, surged exponentially in power.
As the primordial rune enveloped Siegmund, an overwhelming burst of power erupted from his body, causing his true self to expand massively and transform into a Golden Dragon Man spanning tens of millions of kilometers.
The colossal true form brought absolute power.
Siegmund, now towering tens of millions of kilometers high, stood firmly upon the earth, causing the Great Thousand World to tremble. The vast continent shattered piece by piece like a broken mosaic of heaven and earth.
Time compressed and burst within the ten-billion-kilometer radius surrounding him, and space annihilated, forming an Absolute Domain governed solely by Siegmund.
“Golden Power, Eternal Burial of Heaven!” Siegmund shouted as he raised his hands high, roaring skyward. Between his arms, a tangible golden world emerged.
Within the golden world, heaven and earth combusted into obliteration, emitting dimensional-shattering waves of terrifying energy.
The power was so overwhelming that its invisible remnants disturbed the spacetime around him, forming the spectacle of dozens of world projections wherein Golden Dragon Men held collapsing worlds aloft.
With these otherworldly projections enhancing him, Siegmund’s aura skyrocketed over tenfold, resembling a golden sun ascending fearlessly to the heavens.
Among Primordial Rune holders who mastered the powers of chaotic spacetime in the Fourth Heavenly Realm, every motion carried the weight and influence of spacetime itself.
Any attack below their level could never reach them, vanishing instantly upon nearing the infinite spacetime folds and interlayers surrounding them.
Just as Siegmund detonated his innate divine rune, attempting to shatter the consuming black hole and pierce the locked spacetime horizon,
Beneath Siegmund’s tail that stretched across several million kilometers, a Golden Dragon Man with faint and concealed aura appeared, radiating a powerful spacetime force.
It slightly raised its head, regarding Siegmund coldly as he tore upward toward the heavens.
Once Siegmund managed to break open the spacetime horizon of the black hole and create a tear in the sealed spacetime, this future incarnation of Siegmund that had yet to merge would escape instantly.
Following the path of the governing rules, vanishing into an unpredictable and inaccessible future.
Even if the present Siegmund were obliterated and suppressed, the future incarnation already condensed would persist, carrying the hope of resurrection.
A future reality reappearing to recreate the present and the past.
Facing the indomitable Doomsday Emperor Dragon with seventh-layer Eternal Undying Realm power, Siegmund harbored no illusions of resistance, only the singular hope of escape. There was no choice—the disparity was insurmountable.
A fifth-layer Heavenly Realm Great Emperor before an Eternal Undying creature was utterly powerless.
Within the spacetime frozen by distortion, a golden Eternal World with billions of kilometers in diameter rushed through the atmosphere at mind-bending speeds beyond the grasp of conscious perception.
Boom! The golden Eternal World instantly collided with the all-consuming darkness, releasing dazzling golden radiance.
No earth-shattering explosion occurred; only brilliant golden fireworks emerged, scattering across a portion of the black hole’s horizon before being absorbed into the darkness.
The layer upon layer of spacetime twisted, devastated, and forged into the boundary wall with supreme Divine Might.
Unyielding, immovable.
“Impossible!” Golden scales covering Siegmund’s face contorted into an expression of shock.
The gap between Primordial Great Emperor and Eternal Undying Realm wasn’t supposed to be so vast that his entire effort, detonating his innate divine rune with full force, couldn’t even make a dent.
“I refuse to believe it.”
Siegmund bellowed again; flames burned away his golden hair, turning it black.
Even his true body, once as if forged from gold, became jet-black, erupting in a surge of savage and sinister energy.
Black Siegmund unleashed black-purple energy waves that surged outward, colliding against the consuming ‘darkness.’
From the shattering void in spacetime beyond the heavens, Siegmund grasped his millions-of-kilometer-long chaotic supreme treasure spear, delivering a mighty blow upon the encroaching dark tides ahead.
Boom! The collision of blackened light erupted with a surge that shook heaven and earth.
Yet, the layer upon layer of obliterating darkness within the consuming spacetime horizon remained unmoving, devouring the entire world, including Siegmund, in one gulp.
All of this transpired in mere moments.
Boom!
The chaotic sea’s murky currents surged, forming an immense black void spanning hundreds of billion kilometers, erasing all within its scope, leaving an unhealing scar upon the chaos.
Viewed from afar, the void resembled a black stain seared upon the Chaotic Sea.
At the edge of this black stain stood the colossal black-red beast, over a hundred million kilometers tall, emanating an aura so terrifying that Alquest felt chills throughout his body.
Because, in just that moment, Siegmund, who seemingly had already escaped, was devoured whole by this monstrous beast, separated by another spacetime.
Even the Great Thousand World Siegmund had descended upon was consumed.
The act of consumption included all traces of Siegmund’s existence, even the Primordial Rule he represented—all swallowed whole by this terrifying beast.
One strike, annihilating a Primordial Great Emperor!
Such devastating power made Alquest’s scalp tingle with sheer dread.
At this moment, not only Alquest but the four alien True Emperors observing the battlefield felt their bodies go limp, overwhelmed by an intense fear of death.
Since breaking through to become spacetime-manipulating True Emperors, their senses of true danger within the Boundless Chaotic Sea had dulled in the tens of thousands of years.
But today, before this horrifying beast, no matter if they were eternal beings, wielding immense power capable of ruling eternity, none of it mattered.
One bite—gone, simply gone.
Escape, escape!
Alquest roared; his Obsidian true form, over a million kilometers tall, released boundless black flames, unleashing a terrifying power that even the Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s expression shifted.
“You’ve gone mad.”
Blazing Heaven shouted in shock; flames erupted from his body as five golden ‘sky realms,’ resembling five stars, spread outward centered upon him, spanning billions of kilometers.
Just as Blazing Heaven expanded his Heavenly Realm, forming five layers of spacetime dimensions in defense, a chaos-shaking eruption ignited.
Boom!
Infinite black flames burst out and incinerated all it touched, forming layers of black and white waves that spread in all directions, sweeping across thousands of billions of kilometers.
Wherever the black and white waves passed, murky currents dissipated, spacetime emerged, dimensions shattered—all succumbed to the black and white flames.
Even the stellar skies surrounding Blazing Heaven True Emperor disintegrated layer by layer. Four out of five were destroyed before the final layer persisted against the waves’ fury.
Such was the power unleashed by a Primordial Great Emperor detonating his true body, terrifyingly enough to leave all who bore witness trembling.
Alquest’s ruthless decisiveness took everyone by surprise.
No one had anticipated such resolve—that the moment he’d witnessed Siegmund’s devouring, Alquest would explode his true self to annihilate everything around, including entire spacetime dimensions.
Under these circumstances, even the black-red beast’s terrifying power could not pursue Alquest’s Divine Soul Intent retreating instantly to the Silent Heavenly Divine Domain, enabled by his ancestral bloodline divine power.
Though this left Alquest mortally wounded, requiring hundreds of thousands of years to reforge his true body and refine his bloodline,
Compared to total annihilation and being devoured by this monstrous beast, this outcome was acceptable.
It was then that a cold voice reverberated through the oscillating chaos.
“Can you escape?”
Standing as the Blood Sea’s master, summoner of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark remained unfazed as the black and white flames neared the Blood Sea only to twist and vanish under the suppression of an invisible force.
Bathed in blood-red light, Jack Clark’s gaze was serene. His eyes revealed three sets of blood-red, silvery-white, and black-gold vertical pupils layered upon each other.
Combined with his jet-black irises, the layered effect was utterly terrifying, making even Blazing Heaven in the Stellar Sky tremble inexplicably.
Boom!
From the center of Alquest’s self-detonation, darkness collapsed into itself, and an invisible Void spread outward, coalescing into a cycle of reincarnation shaped like a colossal silver clock dial spanning billions of kilometers.
As the cycle manifested, terrifying Time Power permeated the surroundings.
The previously shattered and burning spacetime began reconstructing, reversing—everything rewound, including Alquest’s Divine Soul Intent retreating to the Silent Heavenly Divine Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1881: 701
chapters.content:
Chapter 1881: Chapter 701
Chapter 701: Eternal Pressure, Chaos-Level Civilization
The crumbling Chaotic Void Blood Sea churned, resembling light belts stretching tens of billions of kilometers. They coiled around the ten-million-kilometer-wide red Great Sun that was “rising.”
In merely a blink, the Hell Sea of Blood and the Great Sun disappeared, entering the “upper” ancient battlefield of the Chaos Cosmos.
Instantly, this segment of chaos descended into absolute silence.
