Observing the roaring murky currents around them and the two black holes—one large, one small—that practically obstructed their view, one of the Alien True Emperors spoke solemnly.
“The heavens… are about to change.”
The other three Alien True Emperors slightly nodded, their faces, shrouded in the mists of space-time, filled with grave expressions.
At this moment, whether Darren Callum—the enigmatic figure possibly Human—was the long-lost Henry, no longer mattered. What mattered was the power Darren Callum wielded had entirely transcended into the Seventh Heavenly Realm.
Beyond that, the black-red Colossal Beast Darren Callum had summoned displayed an unfathomably terrifying devouring talent. With a single gulp, it had consumed a Primordial Emperor.
Not merely in the present, but across the past and future, erasing all traces of existence—including the Primordial Rules mastered by the Emperor.
And this was what filled them with the deepest dread.
Primordial-level beings rarely died, let alone once ascending to the rank of Primordial True Emperor, where they could occupy the past, gather the future, and resurrect even if their True Body was obliterated.
Yet, all of this crumbled before the terrifying beast’s monumental appetite.
As long as one couldn’t escape the black hole’s devouring talent or evade the lock of space-time, even a Primordial Supreme of the Sixth Heavenly Realm could end up devoured and suppressed.
Followed by being slowly ground into oblivion and refined amidst despair.
This black-red Colossal Beast’s existence represented an existential threat to all beings at the Primordial Level.
Under normal conditions, if any beast with such talent broke through to the Primordial level and appeared nearby the ancient battlefield, all the Primordial-level powerhouses of various civilizations would join forces to annihilate it at all costs.
However, such thoughts now only lingered as fleeting hopes buried deep in their hearts.
In mere seconds, it had domineeringly suppressed and devoured two Primordial Emperors with such frightening strength that even if the top powerhouses from the nine Peak Civilizations on the ancient battlefield united, it would at most result in mutual destruction.
Let alone now, when one of those nine Peak Civilizations—the Human Race—seemed allied with this terrifying beast.
“Honorable ones, let us part ways here. Farewell.” The four Alien True Emperors bowed to each other and then vanished in four separate directions.
They sought “quiet” places to employ their tribal Secret Skills, sending news back to their clans about Darren Callum’s transcending to the Sixth Heavenly Realm and about the beast.
At the same time, they warned their powerhouses against intervening in the incoming Civilization Great War between the Human Race and the Golden Eternity Race as well as the Youtian War God Clan.
For over 30,000 years, after the Human Race infiltrated the ancient battlefield, chaos engulfed the realm for millennia until Henry disappeared and the Humans retreated into dormancy, barely maintaining a fragile balance among the clans.
Now, amidst this fragile equilibrium, the Humans reignited a Civilization War, their strength unprecedentedly powerful after Darren Callum’s exit from closed-door cultivation.
Should other Peak Civilizations—for example, their tribe’s Supreme—attempt to bolster the weaker side like the Golden Tribe against the Humans for balance, disastrous consequences would follow.
That human and beast are too frightful, nearly invincible across the ancient battlefield.
This time, if other Peak Civilizations dared meddle, they would instantly become targets of war.
……
The Chaos Cosmos where Chaos Emperor City resided was said to be the lowest layer of the ancient battlefield, yet it lay “immeasurably distant” from the true ancient battlefield.
The true ancient battlefield was a realm where only beings of ancient grades could survive, True Spirit-level beings barely counted as experts, and Primordial-level powerhouses could dominate regions.
Here, even Chaos Seas fragmented into countless pieces, Chaos Rules descended into disarray, and the environment teemed with various zones of death.
Before Jack Clark’s return, following the Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s orders, the Civilization Great War between the Humans and the Youtian War God Clan suddenly broke out, shaking every civilization.
As the Peak Civilizations’ and Top-tier Civilizations’ powerhouses were alarmed, gazing across vast spans of space-time toward the two clashing tribes.
At one of the Human Territory zones within the ancient battlefield, the Tian Hong Emperor City—under the command of the Reincarnation True Emperor—rested upon an expansive continent stretching tens of millions of kilometers, encircled by raging waves of chaotic air currents.
From a distance, it resembled a murky ocean, or perhaps it was an ocean made of liquefied Chaos Qi.
Boundless and limitless, this zone brimmed with astonishingly abundant resources, cultivating a vast array of God-level and Rule-level Heaven and Earth Treasures.
Thus, it also marked one of the supreme Chaos Energy “leakage points,” with the Reincarnation True Emperor stationed there to refine the supreme Chaos Energy within the liquefied Chaos Qi.
The core battleground among Peak and Top-tier Civilizations on the ancient battlefield revolved around these supreme Chaos Nodes.
Supreme Chaos Energy resembled Eternal Qi—yet one was innate, the other acquired—and it greatly accelerated a Primordial-level powerhouse’s cultivation, aiding them in consolidating their Space-Time True Body and Indestructible True Body.
At this moment, thousands of Ancient-grade beings and hundreds of True Spirit-level powerhouses stood tall at Tian Hong Emperor City, their expressions all terrified as their gazes fixed upon the heavens.
Three towering figures stood aloft—two of them immense, and particularly, the black-red Colossal Beast emitted an aura so horrifying that its mere arrival had shaken the entire ancient battlefield.
The shadow of its immense body cast darkness over Tian Hong Emperor City and the surrounding continent.
Meanwhile, before Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon arrived at the ancient battlefield, a colossal Reincarnation light wheel, formed from intertwining silver and black hues, suspended across the void, with a diameter of a million kilometers.
In the center of the upright Reincarnation light wheel, a youth, wearing a white Imperial Crown and draped in an ornate silver Imperial Robe, stood with his hands behind his back. His face bore a faintly awestruck look as he gazed at Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
The Reincarnation True Emperor softly murmured, “If I hadn’t witnessed it myself, even I would struggle to imagine our Human Race could produce a God-level prodigy as monstrous as you.”
Because Jack Clark returned so swiftly, subduing Siegmund’s two Emperors with unstoppable force.
Thus, the Human Divine Realm powerhouses in Tian Hong Emperor City hadn’t yet had time to assemble—let alone venture to the Chaos boundaries to attack the Youtian War God Clan’s “territory.”
Jack Clark shook his head lightly, his tone polite: “You overestimate me, Senior. The only reason my cultivation advanced so greatly this time is due to the gifts left behind by Senior Henry.”
“Otherwise, even with dedicated closed-door cultivation, I could at best achieve a breakthrough to the Primordial level this time.”
Though Jack Clark’s cultivation now surpassed these Senior Human powerhouses, he still maintained an attitude of deep respect.
For instance, even though he had never met the Reincarnation True Emperor before, Jack Clark had benefited from his gifts, including the Space-Time Reincarnation Divine Power inherited from him.
However, neither the Reincarnation True Emperor nor Blazing Heaven True Emperor took Jack Clark’s humility seriously.
They understood well that ascending from the late stages of the True Spirit Level to the Sixth Heavenly Realm of Primordial in “six years” defied common reason—a feat unachievable merely by resources.
Otherwise, with the nine Peak Civilizations and thirty-six Top-tier Civilizations on the ancient battlefield, only twelve Sixth Heavenly Realm powerhouses had emerged over the course of a million years.
The Reincarnation True Emperor’s gaze then shifted to the colossal Doomsday Emperor Dragon, his tone solemn: “As for you, Dragon Palace King, I deeply appreciate your assistance.”
“Regardless of the result of today’s battle, you are an eternal ally of our Human Race. Should you ever need assistance in the future, do not hesitate to ask.”
The massive black-red Colossal Beast slowly opened its mouth, revealing rows of sharp, menacingly enormous teeth. A deep and majestic growl echoed across the heavens and earth.
“Reincarnation Master, there’s no need for courtesy. I intervened this time solely due to a promise made with Jack Clark in the past.”
During the brief journey toward the ancient battlefield, Jack Clark and the Blazing Heaven True Emperor had provided explanations for his breakthrough and his “relationship” with the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
The excuses were consistent with those given to the Primordial True Emperors and others following the decisive battle with the Purgatory Demon Clan.
Meanwhile, atop the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, a silver Giant Dragon—spanning a million meters—stood beneath a massive dragon horn, its expression filled with excitement as it looked around.
The scene of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon devouring two Primordial Emperors with a mere gulp left the Silver Giant Dragon’s blood boiling, its spirit still in an exhilarated state.
Tim Abott was unmatched in strength!
As the conversation unfolded over several brief moments, an aura began descending from beyond space-time.
Far in the distance, billions of kilometers away, a pitch-black fissure—stretching a million kilometers—manifested, as if the heavens and earth were severed by a sharp sword, leaving behind a smooth, clean cut.
From the rift strode forth a youth clad in white, surrounded by an incredibly sharp Sword Intent. The Sword Intent projected towering illusions, penetrating the heavens and earth.
Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s expression softened into a faint smile: “Ancestor Sword, you’ve arrived.”
“Upon receiving your message, I came immediately.” The white-clad youth turned to look at Jack Clark, his face betraying an involuntary sense of awe.
“So this is the most dazzling genius of our lineage, God-level prodigy. Truly a hero among youths, gifted beyond measure.”
The expressions of Blazing Heaven True Emperor and Reincarnation True Emperor twitched involuntarily. Hero among youths? Gifted beyond measure? These were words used to describe a Primordial Supreme?
In that moment, a deep voice resonated from the outer heavens.
“Ancestor Sword, if you don’t know how to praise others, then refrain from trying—otherwise, you’ll expose your rough warrior persona.”
From millions of kilometers away, the space shattered as a colossal figure measuring over a million kilometers tall appeared, carrying nine enormous Divine Weapons upon its back.
Instantly, a bursting, overbearing, and ferocious aura pervaded the heavens, causing the Ancient-grade and True Spirit powerhouses below to gasp for breath.
As the towering figure’s stride moved forward, the surrounding space-time trembled layer by layer, emanating rings of white ripples that spread to all sides, seemingly unable to endure his existence.
“Eternal, you’ve come as well.”
Observing the descending Eternal True Emperor, the Reincarnation True Emperor’s expression turned serious: “Time is of the essence. Next, we will split into two forces—you, Eternal, and Ancestor Sword will engage the Golden Tribe’s Eternal Heavenly Gods.”
“God Martial, Blazing Heaven, as well as you, Dragon Palace King—the Youtian Clan’s Domain Lords will be your battlefield.”
“Remember, our top priority is eliminating True Emperor-level entities and then Primordial-level powerhouses; anything below that—civilizations or clans—if feasible to destroy, do so swiftly, but avoid wasting time.”
“As for Lu Tian and Xu Tian, they have already led other Emperor City powerhouses back to the Divine Realm, stationed around the periphery, preparing for contingencies.”
“Their focus is to guard against desperate counterattacks from both clans or interference from other Peak Civilizations, disrupting our Human Race’s path to ascension.”
The contingent’s expressions grew somber as they nodded their agreement.
In civilizations at war, if the factions maintained an equilibrium of power, the battles would appear orderly—king against king, general against general—it could span thousands, even tens of thousands of years.
But when high-tier forces became imbalanced, as in this incidence, the war grew exceptionally brutal.
Should the Human Race annihilate all Primordial-level fighters or higher within the two clans, the remaining “ordinary” tribes and civilizations would also face total obliteration.
Billions of beings from both clans would be exterminated, forming seas of blood as far as the eye could see.
Conversely, if desperation overtook the Youtian War God Clan or Golden Eternity Race, their elite fighters could launch frenzied offensives against the Human Race’s rear territories, causing catastrophic casualties.
A True Emperor-level powerhouse’s single strike could obliterate an Emperor City lacking a similar-grade guardian.
If they ripped apart the Divine Realm, the ensuing destruction would potentially kill billions of Humans inside. Such outcomes were scenarios the Reincarnation True Emperor and his allies wished to avoid.
Thus, when Blazing Heaven True Emperor had conveyed Jack Clark’s “plans,” precautions had been established without delay.
“Hahahaha! Finally, I can let loose again!” The Eternal True Emperor laughed wildly, and the nine Creation Divine Weapons on his back quivered, emitting bloodthirsty hums of longing.
Ancestor Sword True Emperor’s body radiated an intense murderous aura that nearly condensed into tangible form. His pupils transformed into the shapes of swords, his gaze sharp enough to pierce through everything.
“Those Eternal Heavenly Gods of the Golden Tribe, scheming to assassinate God Martial behind the scenes—today, let us settle this score with them.”
Boom!
The Reincarnation True Emperor’s light wheel began spinning behind him. A burst of Time Power exploded, forming a massive silver vortex that fractured space-time, creating a silver Hollow.
On the other side of the space-time Hollow was an infinite murky ocean, within which a radiant golden Star was suspended.
Sensitive to the might of Reincarnation True Emperor and his allies, the Star—spanning a diameter of ten million kilometers—quivered, and beams of golden light unleashing True Spirit and three Primordial-level auras shot skyward.
While Reincarnation True Emperor carved open the Space-Time Channel toward the Golden Eternity Empire City.
Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, guided by Blazing Heaven True Emperor, descended into the Youtian Dark Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1882: 702: The Final Heavenly Gate, Invincible Power
chapters.content:
Chapter 1882: Chapter 702: The Final Heavenly Gate, Invincible Power
Chapter 702: The Final Heavenly Gate, The Power of Invincibility
The structure of the ancient battlefield resembles a nine-layered pyramid. Beyond the lowest layer of the Chaos Cosmos, the suppression from the Supreme Chaos grows stronger the higher one ascends.
Moreover, the upper ‘eight layers’ exist in a shattered state, composed of countless fragments of Chaos.
Currently, the nine peak civilizations, including the Human Race, are active below the Seventh Layer of the ancient battlefield. The core dark domain of the Gloomy Heaven Clan occupies the Fifth Layer.
This dark domain environment is especially suitable for the Gloomy Heaven Clan’s habitation and serves as a major nexus rich in Supreme Chaos energy.
But today, this dark domain, crucial to the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan, has been destroyed by ‘someone.’ Thousands of ancient-level beings and dozens of True Spirit-level clan powerhouses were reduced to ashes in an instant by a terrifying strike.
The breath unleashed carried an extreme, overwhelming destructive power, reaching a level of annihilation at its very root.
It fundamentally erased the rules of True Spirit belonging to the Gloomy Heaven clan, obliterated the essence of life, and pierced through the Fifth, Sixth, and Seventh layers of the ancient battlefield in a single blow.
The ensuing power waves shook the entire ancient battlefield.
And just then, the furious roar of the Golden First Order Eternal God reverberated through Chaos: “Reincarnation, do you really think your Human Race has become invincible in the ancient battlefield?”
Boom! Boom! Boom! The Supreme-level power belonging to the Sixth Heavenly Realm erupted, piercing through space-time and shaking dimensional borders.
At the same time, bursts of Primordial True Emperor-level and Primordial Great Emperor-level power erupted in several locations, throwing the entire ancient battlefield into chaos and startling all the strong beings.
Boom!
A silver galaxy spun, a silver palace the size of a colossal star trembled, and amidst the twisting silver light of space-time, an enormous Silver-winged Heavenly Ant, towering at a height of a million kilometers, slowly emerged.
Standing upright, the Heavenly Ant’s entire body was encased in heavy armor, its surface covered with majestic Dragon Scales. Its head was grotesque, resembling a peerless Ferocious Beast.
Gazing at the Fifth Layer battlefield, where fearsome energy waves were still spreading, the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant wore a solemn expression: “Such powerful strength, it feels like it has shattered the Supreme Realm.”
“Could it be one of the Eternal Strong Ones from the Seventh Heaven Realm, or has the legacy of the Human Race truly returned with Henry?”
At this moment, one True Emperor-level aura after another, along with Great Emperor-level presence, burst forth from various corners of the battlefield. Surging space-time energy roared skyward, stirring Chaos, overwhelming in majesty.
Some of these figures emanating immense auras appeared as shapeless gray fogs, enveloping billions of kilometers.
Some took the form of purple beasts, spanning tens of millions of kilometers, rivaling colossal superstars.
Others were strong beings from the Sixth Heavenly Realm, walking out of the ‘moon’ formed in the Sea of Blood, heads slightly lowered, their gaze firmly locked on the Fifth Layer battlefield where the Gloomy Heaven clan resided.
But the most imposing presence came from the Skyflame Divine Race, whose clan had taken control of half of the ancient battlefield’s Fourth Layer, transforming half the cosmos into a sea of fire.
Millions of fragments of Chaos, Void Continents, were ignited by white flames, resembling massive stars emitting scorching light and heat.
Amidst the boiling sea of fire, dozens of giants, towering ten thousand to hundreds of thousands of kilometers high, appeared, encircling an apocalyptic flaming giant that stood countless millions of kilometers tall.
In an instant, a burst of Primordial Supreme-level presence, two Great Emperor-level forces, two True Emperor-level beings, along with twelve other Primordial-level entities, erupted, sparking a sky filled with fire that scorched Chaos.
The giant seated atop the throne of flames slightly raised its head, its fiery gaze piercing the battlefield as its voice, deep and commanding, vibrated across space-time.
“This power, so formidable, so unfamiliar. Guta, an Eternal Strong One has invaded the battlefield.”
Under the call of the Skyflame Supreme, an ethereal voice slowly resonated throughout the fiery sea, and echoed across various places in the ancient battlefield: “That beast indeed seems unfamiliar, it does not belong to the ancient battlefield.”
“However, it is allied with the Human Race’s faction, and thus does not qualify as an invader.”
“Due to that individual’s actions, the Human Race has already declared war on the Golden Tribe and the Gloomy Heaven Clan for secretly assassinating Darren Callum.”
“This matter falls under internal disputes of the ancient battlefield, and we have no reason to intervene.”
Instantly, the expressions of countless Primordial-level powerhouses turned heavy or visibly shocked, as they directed their gaze towards a new eruption of Supreme-level power pressure.
Jack Clark and the Blazing Heaven True Emperor entered the battlefield at an astonishing speed, catching various peak civilizations unawares of the emergence of an Eternal Strong One from the Human Race.
This included four peak tribe factions of different races.
Earlier, the declaration of war made by the Blazing Heaven True Emperor reverberated across the Human Race’s domain as a vow of warfare against the Gloomy Heaven Clan. This news incited ripples among the various clans.
Wars among peak civilizations used to erupt once every few hundred or thousand years, rendering these beings accustomed to such occurrences.
Due to the comparable high-tier forces of both sides—along with the balancing acts of other peak civilizations—these wars typically involved powerhouses ranked below True Emperor, engaging in battle, and generally subsiding after decades or centuries without decisive outcomes.
But unexpectedly, this time, the Human Race not only declared simultaneous war against two peak civilizations, but immediately initiated the final decisive battle, deploying all powerhouses ranked True Emperor and above.
“It’s actually reinforcements from the Human Race! The Human Race has allied with a Seventh Heavenly Entity-level beast!” exclaimed the Skyflame Supreme, with a hint of heaviness in her expression, sensing trouble ahead.
The Skyflame Supreme was well aware of the covert assassination attempt orchestrated against the possibly returning Darren Callum by peak civilizations hostile to the Human Race.
Although the Skyflame Clan had not dispatched messengers to partake in the scheme, there were only two peak civilizations in the ancient battlefield that held serious grudges against the Human Race.
Excluding the Purple Mane King Wolf Dragon, which had been intimidated to the core by Henry in past events, it was obvious who the remaining culprit was. However, the realization that the Golden Tribe was also involved, and even served as the mastermind, was unexpected.
What troubled the Skyflame Supreme and other powerhouses was the Seventh Heaven Realm beast.
This level of strength could only be countered by the collective effort of all strong beings within the ancient battlefield. An individual peak civilization alone stood no chance against an Eternal-level existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1883: 702: The Final Heavenly Gate, Invincible Power_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1883: Chapter 702: The Final Heavenly Gate, Invincible Power_2
Only the most mysterious Heavenly Punishment different races have the qualification to fight.
However, the Heavenly Punishment Clan never intervene in matters of the ancient battlefield unless there is an invasion by external enemies, in which case they will appear to lead the civilizations of this chaotic sea to unite against them.
Now, the Heavenly Punishment Clan is unwilling to take action, waiting for the Human Race to defeat and suppress the two golden tribes, and with the might of the Eternal Ancient Beast, to completely dominate the ancient battlefield.
By then, will these peak civilizations submit or withdraw from the ancient battlefield?
Or perhaps they will disregard the rules and unite with the golden and Gloomy Heaven clans to jointly resist the Human Race? For a moment, the supreme beings of several peak civilizations had flickering eyes.
And just when all the primordial powerhouses were observing the top strong men of the three tribes in battle with various divine secret skills.
At the place closest to the seventh level on the ancient battlefield, white thunder danced, radiating the sacred overbearing intent of shattering chaos and judging the heavens.
Within the ocean of the Thunder Pool, there was a simple palace built of black stones.
Inside, a ‘human’ with white hair over the shoulders, eyes like thunder, sat cross-legged, a white thunder pattern flickering on his forehead, exuding the mysterious majesty of primordial chaos.
Facing this white-haired young man exuding terrifying Heavenly Punishment pressure, a twisted void shadow condensed into a human form emanated a kind of terrifying and twisted obscure aura.
Looking at the void projection before him, Heavenly Punishment Supreme Guta said indifferently: “Void, remember what you said.”
The Void True Emperor slowly spoke, his voice seeming to come from the depths of the void: “Rest assured, my Human Race always keeps our promises, this much you should know well, Guta.”
“After this battle, my Human Race will only occupy the nodes belonging to the Gloomy Heaven tribe, as for the territories of the Golden Tribe, whoever is interested can have them.”
“As for that Dragon Palace King, it does not belong here, after helping my Human Race obliterate the two great civilizations it will naturally leave, and will not affect others.”
After speaking, the Void True Emperor ‘smiled slightly’ and silently dissipated.
After the Void True Emperor left, another figure with white hair draping over his shoulders, with a chaos thunder pattern imprinted on the forehead, appeared in the empty black stone palace and spoke calmly.
“Guta, do you believe his words?”
“What if I don’t believe, can you deal with that Human Race who has just entered the Sixth Heavenly Realm?” The white-haired Guta asked indifferently in return.
Immediately, the atmosphere in the palace quieted down.
Underneath the two figures, the surface of the black stone was like a lake, rippling in circles, becoming gradually transparent, revealing a magnificent and grand scene of destruction.
There a towering figure surrounded by a sea of blood, with sixteen arms virtually grasping, walked through the chaos, destroying master cities wherever it passed, reducing numerous Gloomy Heaven War God clan strong men to ashes.
Those primordial powerhouses of the Gloomy Heaven clan all proved no match before this Human Race.
Great Sun nuclear explosion capable of destroying heaven and earth, a grey millstone obliterating vitality, with a lift of finger countless primordial overlords, primordial monarch powerhouses’ true bodies were shredded to pieces, reduced to dust.
Including the combined might of three True Emperor powerhouses, they too were blown apart by a halberd skill extending billions of kilometers long.
Such might saw those two Heavenly Punishment Supremes observing the ancient battlefield with serious gazes, all of which happened within an extremely short duration.
As Jack Clark irresistibly suppressed the Gloomy Heaven War God Clan and slew those strong men, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon quietly watched the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme who rushed out of the breath explosion range.
That icy gaze, seeing food, made the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme’s scalp tingle as he couldn’t help but roar angrily: “Who are you, my Youtian Clan has no grievances or enmity with you, why destroy my main city.”
To the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme’s furious roar, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon disdainfully did not respond, nor was it interested in speaking.
Only to see the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s double wings expand behind it, the chaos within a trillion kilometers instantly stirred into violent motion, the endless turbid airflow converging into a destruction tsunami engulfing heaven and earth.
Bang bang bang!! The vortex formed by the chaos qi blocked out the sun and moon, stirring all directions, destroying everything.
“Don’t think that only your strength is powerful!” The Ethereal Heavenly Supreme roared to the sky, as a heavy dark sky curtain unfolded centered around him, delving into dimensional levels.
Bang! Upon entering the sixth dimensional plane, the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme’s aura multiplied ‘ten thousand times’ instantly.
Every time a sky is condensed in the primordial realm, one can delve into a dimensional plane, and each delving into a dimensional plane, the power coverage range of the primordial powerhouse gains a hundredfold expansion.
With six multiplications of ten, the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme’s power nearly covered several light-years in deep dimensional levels.
The spread of rules brought a compound increase in powers, not so exaggerated as a power increase to the sixth power, but the power of heaven and earth over several light-years was nearly amplified ‘ten thousand times’ in ‘energy’.
Of course, it was merely energy, not the powers of primordial rules.
But even so, it allowed the primordial supreme’s strength to swell to an unprecedentedly formidable level, its true body swelling to a billion kilometers, immensely vast.
Bang!
With its primordial supreme arms spread out, hands spanning millions of kilometers shattered the chaos vortexes, carrying mountain and sea-shaking energy waves ‘slowly’ reaching towards the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Around those massive obsidian hands, space-time shattered, rules dissolved, forming a pitch-black destruction domain, with imposing momentum that shook the heavens and earth.
“Roar! You damned fools, just having a big body isn’t impressive, Tim Abott is invincible.”
Atop the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s head, a Silver Giant Dragon stretching a million meters roared with excitement and enthusiasm, looking at the expansive hand without a trace of fear.
And its confidence lay in the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
“Dare to compete with me in size.”
With double wings raising a chaotic destructive storm, the mouth of the Black-red Colossal Beast expanding slightly, breath blowing destructive aura, a tremendous strength burst.
Bang bang bang!!
Behind the Black-red Colossal Beast, ten golden heavenly gates appeared, each encircled by a dragon-shaped dark golden chain exuding a terrifying aura.
As if something horrific were sealed within, which once descended would destroy the world.
Simultaneously, on the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, blood red lightning, black lightning exploded, its form swelling, its scale armor raised, infinite darkness centered around the Black-red Colossal Beast burst.
As the darkness burst, there was also the shattering of chain sounds breaking.
In an instant, an aura almost causing the entire ancient battlefield to tremble burst out, plunging the entire ancient battlefield into ‘darkness’, pitch-black belonging to concepts.
Even the most radiant light dimmed under that pitch-black power.
What terrified all beings was that at the moment darkness descended, the horrific aura that appeared simultaneously, its formlessly emanated bloodline pressure made even the primordial supreme’s soul tremble.
Including the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme prepared to fight to death by burning the space-time origin, mobilizing power of six-dimensional levels, who also looked ahead in horror.
In the darkness, a colossal beast a trillion kilometers long slowly emerged, its whole body radiating purple-black brilliance, illuminating the ancient battlefield shrouded in darkness.
At this moment, everyone ‘saw’ that terrifying Giant Beast, as if it had stood in heaven and earth since ancient times.
This time, just standing there, with formlessly emanated power twisting space-time, it shattered all chaotic fragments on the fifth level of the ancient battlefield, tearing apart the boundary walls of the sixth and fourth levels.
The highest bloodline pressure it emanated even made countless souls tremble, instinctively kneeling on the ground, not daring to face its form directly.
But not everyone ‘was’ intimidated by that heavenly tier bloodline, some self-assured strong different race True Spirit powerhouses, with pride to their bones, unconsciously burst out aura wanting to resist kneeling down.
Bang bang bang!!
In an instant, the true bodies of these different race strong men burst into bloodlines, consciousness collapsing.
Entering the terminal form and opening the Dark Star’s tenfold heavenly gates, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was powerful beyond description, its power level faintly hints of surpassing the limits of the Seventh Heaven Realm.
In the blink of an eye, an aura almost making the entire ancient battlefield tremble burst forth, plunging the entire ancient battlefield into ‘darkness’, pitch-black belonging to concepts.
Even the most radiant light dimmed under that pitch-black power.
What terrified all beings was that at the moment darkness descended, the horrific aura that appeared simultaneously, its formlessly emanated bloodline pressure made even the primordial supreme’s soul tremble.
Including the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme prepared to fight to death by burning the space-time origin, mobilizing power of six-dimensional levels, who also looked ahead in horror.
In the darkness, a colossal beast a trillion kilometers long slowly emerged, its whole body radiating purple-black brilliance, illuminating the ancient battlefield shrouded in darkness.
This time, just standing there, with formlessly emanated power twisting space-time, it shattered all chaotic fragments on the fifth level of the ancient battlefield, tearing apart the boundary walls of the sixth and fourth levels.
The highest bloodline pressure it emanated even made countless souls tremble, instinctively kneeling on the ground, not daring to face its form directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1884: 703: Terrifying Truth, Nine Nether Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 1884: Chapter 703: Terrifying Truth, Nine Nether Monster
No one expected that the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, which had already demonstrated the ability to sweep through the Ancient Battlefield, would decisively enter its strongest form when facing the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme, who was much weaker.
With a single strike, it penetrated the Ancient Battlefield, and a crack was torn open in the mysterious Seventh Layer.
Inside the black stone palace, the two white-haired youths suddenly raised their heads.
Gazing at the multicolored glow descending from the Seventh Layer of the Ancient Battlefield and the voice resonating with excitement in an unknown language of some civilization, the faces of the two youths immediately changed drastically.
“No, it must not be allowed to descend.”
“Celestial Punishment Clan members above Primal level, immediately act with me to stop the Nine Nether Monster from descending upon the Ancient Battlefield.”
Boom!
The two white-haired youths stood up tall, transforming into a brilliant white thunderbolt traversing Heaven and Earth.
Behind them, seventeen auras emanated from the Primordial Stars, Primal Hegemon, and Monarch; three Primordial True Emperors, and the explosive aura of one Fifth Heaven Realm Emperor Level being.
In an instant, the white thunderbolt, embodying the utmost power of pure yang and grand supremacy, shattered the darkness, surging towards the multicolored Hollow billions of miles away.
Yet this scene was unseen, shrouded by the ‘darkness’ emitted by the Final Dark Star Dragon.
In the darkness enveloping the Ancient Battlefield, only the purple-black light from the Final Dark Star Dragon and the multicolored glow from the Seventh Layer Ancient Battlefield’s Hollow were present.
Especially in the hollow penetrating the Seventh Layer Battlefield, a colossal and ferocious head strained to squeeze down.
Because it was so immense, its size filled the hollow torn by the Final Dark Star Dragon only with its part above the eyes.
At the moment the gigantic head appeared, a truly ancient and mighty pressure reaching the Seventh Heaven Realm enveloped the Ancient Battlefield.
Boom, boom, boom!! The sky collapsed, the earth caved, and all things shattered.
Under the terrifying pressure surpassing the Primordial Rule, the Sixth and Fifth Layer Ancient Battlefields shook violently, and fragments of chaos like small worlds exploded one after another.
Coupled with the ‘darkness’ permeating the entire Ancient Battlefield, at this moment all the strong ones from various civilizations and races felt an illusion of doomsday descending.
But just as the gigantic head was squeezing down, it suddenly jerked to a stop, gazing solemnly at the ferocious behemoth standing in the center of the darkness in the distance.
The destructive aura emanating from this terrifying Giant Beast posed a strong threat even to it.
Unexpectedly, after millions of years, such a powerful creature appeared in the Ancient Battlefield.
But soon, this eternal strong one’s expression slightly changed, a trace of panic appearing in its eyes, as it roared in rage and fury: “Get out, get out!”
Boom!
The gigantic head struggled, crazily trying to squeeze down from above, the explosive shockwaves causing even more intense tremors throughout the Ancient Battlefield.
The crack torn by the Final Dark Star Dragon also expanded bit by bit with its struggle.
But at this moment, a power resembling black-gray tentacles emerged from the surrounding shattered glow, crawling along the giant head’s face at an astonishing speed.
“Get out, get out!!”
The appearance of the black power made the eternal strong one even more frantic and terrified, struggling more violently, as most of the gigantic head squeezed down.
Yet the spreading black-gray power was faster, covering the area squeezed down by the gigantic head within an instant.
The areas covered by the black-gray power turned to void from the perspective of the Final Dark Star Dragon.
But from the overall perspective, the gigantic head remained, the surrounding black-gray power displaying a three-dimensional structure, appearing very eerie.
“Get out!”
The gigantic head roared, eyes showing madness and determination, as a crack formed in its brow, extending billions of kilometers.
Silver-blue substance gushed out like a galaxy from the crack, forming a dazzling band streaming into the Sixth Layer Ancient Battlefield.
The moment the silver-blue band surged out, the gigantic head was completely covered by the black-gray power, pulled back above the Seventh Layer Battlefield.
All this happened in the blink of an eye.
Because the nature of that black-gray power was unclear, the Final Dark Star Dragon merely watched quietly, not taking action.
However, while the Final Dark Star Dragon did not act, those mighty ones from the Celestial Punishment Clan, traversing the cosmos, did not hesitate. The surrounding dazzling white lightning converged, forming a Heavenly Punishment Sword Light.
The sword light, extending billions of kilometers, swept across Heaven and Earth, containing endless mysterious transformations, appearing behind the silver-blue band in an instant.
“You think you can stop me, get lost!” An enraged roar shook Heaven and Earth.
The silver-blue band of light, penetrating the Hollow and appearing in the ‘universe’ of the Fifth Layer Battlefield, blazed brightly, transforming into an imposing figure towering billions of kilometers.
This Divine Soul Intent Projection wore blue battle armor, its head ferocious like a demon, covered in fine silver scales all over.
Seven tangible, Primordial Rule light belts, each emitting silver, blue, and purple light, circled around it, appearing incomparably sacred and grand.
Under the glow’s cover, its large hand swung towards the Heavenly Punishment Sword Light in a flick.
The palm, encompassing past, present, and future, released an eternal aura, shaking chaos, with even the surroundings manifesting phenomena of transforming heavens, suppressing the void.
This eternal Will Projection was different from the Abyss Lord whom Jack Clark had previously annihilated.
Though it only retained the Divine Soul Intent as well, its strength remained at its peak state, enabling it to briefly possess the might of the Eternity Realm at full strength.
But at the moment of contact, the sword light, condensed from white thunder, split in two, and two powerful Sixth Heaven Realm auras exploded.
Boom!!
A ring of white light exploded in the darkness, lightning crackling, yet unable to dispel the darkness.

chapters.title: Chapter 1885: 703: Terrifying Truth, Nine Nether Monster_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1885: Chapter 703: Terrifying Truth, Nine Nether Monster_2
With a single strike, the sword’s brilliance shattered, and two Primordial Supremes from the Celestial Punishment Clan spat blood, transforming into two cascading bolts of thunder stretching across billions of miles, before reuniting with the strong men from their clan behind them.
“Clan Leader.”
“Grand Elder, are you both alright?”
Several Primordial Powerhouses surrounded by celestial thunder rings appeared beside Gu Duo and the others, their expressions grave as they questioned.
“We’re fine, it’s just a light injury.” Gu Duo, his white hair flowing across his shoulders, spoke while looking solemnly at the silver-blue figure standing tall in the Fifth-level battlefield.
“As expected of an Eternal Strong One who achieved enlightenment a million years ago; even though only a remnant soul remains, its power remains formidable.”
“But you have already been tainted with the Nine Nether Aura. If it leaks out, it will inevitably lead to catastrophic disaster. For the sake of the billions of living beings in the Ancient Battlefield, I ask you to return to the Seventh Layer and above.”
“Return? Return merely to face death?”
The silver-blue figure’s eyes were cold, filled with killing intent toward the clan preventing its descent, as it spoke in a low voice: “And who do you think you are? What qualifications do you have to make decisions for me?”
“Simply based on your obstruction just now, I already have enough reason to completely annihilate your clan.”
The silver-blue figure then glared towards the massive black-purple beast standing in the darkness’ center and cast a second wary glance at the slowly healing seven-colored Hollow, a flicker of apprehension flashing in its eyes.
“Hmph! Today, I’ll let you go for now, but if you dare to obstruct me again, I will send your clan into the deepest Void Abyss where you’d never know peace for eternity.”
After issuing this threat, the silver-blue figure prepared to tear through the Boundary Wall and leave the Ancient Battlefield.
Boom, boom, boom!!
An even greater burst of power erupted from Gu Duo and the others, white thunder roared and enveloped the Void, accompanied by an unparalleled sharp, chaos-tearing Sword Intent of terrifying magnitude.
Streams of blinding white thunder filled with an unfathomable force radiated, dispersing in all directions to target the silver-blue figure at the center.
Gu Duo, towering millions of miles high, entirely constructed of white lightning, gripped a thunder long sword as his stern gaze locked onto the silver-blue figure. His voice reverberated like thunder across the entirety of the Ancient Battlefield.
“You are tainted with Nine Nether, you cannot leave!”
“Courting death!” Already twice interrupted, the Eternal Strong One was completely enraged, and the seven Primordial Light Bands surrounding it instantly detonated.
The dazzling brilliance immediately illuminated the darkness as a seven-colored vortex emerged, spanning a trillion miles, magnificent and laden with supreme power.
Within the vortex’s range, space-time froze, penetrating into dimensional layers. In mere moments, the true forms of over a dozen Celestial Punishment Primordial Powerhouses were ground to pieces, followed by three True Emperors and one Great Emperor.
Under the wear of the Eternal indestructible will enclosed within the vortex, the aura and traces of existence of those Primordial Powerhouses swiftly dissipated.
Evidently, the obstruction of the Celestial Punishment Clan had inflamed an unyielding killing intent within this powerhouse, willing to sacrifice Divine Soul Intent to obliterate them entirely and showcase the might of eternity.
Such destruction was also meant to instill fear into other alien powerhouses within the Ancient Battlefield.
Especially that black-purple beast which caused its trepidation.
“Gu Duo.”
Gu Duo and Gu Yuan’s eyes turned blood-red, brimming with frenzied killing intent as they howled: “Our clan has upheld the Celestial Punishment decree, guarding the Sixth Layer battlefield for a million years.”
“Even if the entirety of our clan must perish today, we will not allow a Nine Nether-tainted entity like you to leave!”
“Azure Extermination Lightning Devours All, annihilation eternal!”
Boom!
The sword light and true form in Gu Duo’s hands shattered simultaneously, morphing into a pale lightning dragon spanning tens of billions of miles, roaring and hurtling toward the silver-blue figure.
The other white-haired young man fell into complete frenzy as well: “For the honor of the Celestial Punishment Clan, kill!”
Bang! The Primordial Supreme exploded his true form, releasing an equally terrifying force that transformed into another pale lightning dragon stretching tens of billions of miles.
Two lightning dragons intertwined, roaring in unison, unleashing almost invincible Sixth Heavenly Realm power, morphing into two streams of white light that shattered the surrounding seven-colored vortex.
In just an instant, the two pale lightning dragons appeared before the silver-blue figure, their dragon claws raised high, roaring in ferocious cries.
“No matter your Eternal indestructibility or invincibility across epochs, today, we will suppress you.”
Boom, boom!!
Blinding pale lightning erupted, pulverizing the entire seven-colored vortex, immediately triggering an explosion of radiant silver-blue brilliance, accompanied by an enraged, furious howl.
“Your power, all of you deserve to die!”
Boom! The horrifying shockwaves of earth-shattering explosions reverberated throughout the Ancient Battlefield.
Amid the upheaval, the forceful tremors shaking all of heaven and earth rendered even the mightiest tribes below the Seventh Layer mortified and bewildered.
The day’s events had overwhelmed everyone.
First, the Human Race and the You Tian War God Clan declared war, then the Humans voiced their dominion by simultaneously waging battles against the Golden War God Tribe and the You Tian Clan.
Before the various civilizations could fully react, the Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor and two True Emperors moved to stop the Golden Eternal Clan’s powerhouses.
Meanwhile, led by Darren Callum and the terrifying beast, the Human Race swiftly swept through the You Tian War God Clan with overwhelming triumph.
Particularly the terrifying beast, whose unleashed power surpassed even “ordinary” Eternal Strong Ones, invincible within the era.
Yet before civilizations’ powerhouses could recover from their astonishment, an anomaly erupted in the Seventh Layer of the Ancient Battlefield; an Eternal Strong One from a million years ago appeared.
Disregarding everything, the entity abandoned its true form and descended, seemingly fleeing from some monstrous threat above.
The mysterious Celestial Punishment Clan, typically detached and uninvolved in affairs, suddenly acted to intercept the descending Eternal Strong One.
The abrupt upheaval diverted the focus of all alien powerhouses.
Even the awe-inspiring Final Dark Star Dragon momentarily lost its spotlight in the face of the life-risking battle between the Celestial Punishment Clan and the Eternal Strong One.
Yet not all “individuals” possessed the ability to battle across realms.
Beyond the Primordial True Emperor Realm, the chasm between each major realm becomes exceptionally vast, even for the likes of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon and Jack Clark, whose terrifying intrinsic strength barely breached the boundaries of major realm limits.
Of course, this calculation excludes the stacking effects of shared Lifeline Talents.
Thus, as the annihilation-level explosion subsided, revealing layer upon layer of destroyed Chaos Void, there stood the silver-blue figure at the very heart of the Chaos Void.
At this moment, the brilliance of the Eternal Strong One’s Divine Soul projection dimmed slightly, indicating significant consumption from the earlier strike.
In stark contrast to this Eternal Strong One, Gu Duo and Gu Yuan were in much worse shape, their true forms shattered in large parts as they stood billions of miles away, their will dim in their eyes.
Under the silver-blue figure’s wrathful counterattack, the two Celestial Punishment Supremes who burned their internal power were severely injured.
The consumption of Divine Soul Intent fueled the anger of the Eternal Strong One further, its aura emitting bone-chilling killing intent that froze the Void as its frosty gaze pinned down Gu Duo and Gu Yuan.
“You deserve to die. No wonder you’re willing to stop me at all costs.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1886: 704
chapters.content:
Chapter 1886: Chapter 704
The shattered Chaotic Zone: a towering silver-blue figure emanating a weak Divine Soul Intent, weakened by twenty percent, stood tall, its body exuding turbulent emotions of intense anger and fear.
In the distance lay the two figures of the ancient tower, their auras even more feeble.
The dialogue among these three directly caused the strong ones of various peak civilizations in the ancient battlefield to feel heavy-hearted, astonished, not knowing whom to trust.
The Heavenly Punishment Clan, as the strongest civilization of the ancient battlefield’s past, had guarded the zone closest to the Seventh Layer for millions of years, refraining from meddling in Outer World affairs.
Only when provoked would the strong ones of the Heavenly Punishment Clan act, delivering devastating blows.
Logically, everyone should believe the words of the two figures from the ancient tower, after all, they ‘had been known’ for so many years.
But that Eternal Strong One who descended from the Seventh Layer, forsaking its immortal True Body just to escape—the weight of its words seemed far more credible in this scenario.
The “Denny Kaye” they mentioned, recorded in the annals of nine peak civilizations, including the Human Race.
Millions of years ago, two Eternal Behemoths engaged in a battle that ended in mutual destruction, unleashing terrifying power bursts that pierced the Supreme Chaos, thus forming the ancient battlefield.
As the two Eternal Behemoths fell into hibernation, the site of their battle attracted numerous powerful different races and Chaotic Ferocious Beasts.
The location held remnants from the bodies of the two fallen beasts, dissipating Eternal Air, and the pure energies leaking from Supreme Chaos.
These scraps, deemed worthless garbage by Eternal-level entities, were considered priceless treasures to Primordial Powerhouses, even marginal remnants.
Yet unexpectedly, when the civilization strong ones, alongside the gathered Primordial Fierce Beasts, assembled, the all-consuming and destructive Nine Nether Great Calamity broke out.
The so-called “Denny Kaye” is akin to a Supreme Plane but far more terrifying and brutal in nature, residing in a layer deep within the endless Void where every single entity is immensely powerful.
The most horrifying element of these Nine Nether creatures is their Netherworld Qi.
Surpassing Void Energy pollution, it is a force of death that corrupts and erodes all life, distorting it into twisted monsters caught between life and death.
As such, the Nine Nether Calamity of the past nearly devoured all life in the ancient battlefield.
Whether True Spirit Powerhouses, Primordials, True Emperors, or even Eternal-level entities—only a few, positioned outside the range of the Nine Nether burst, survived.
Survivors bore witness to everything, spreading the news far and wide.
Given the overwhelming Nine Nether threat, it took tens of thousands of years for the dissipating Nine Nether power to recede from the ancient battlefield before some bold strong ones dared re-enter for exploration.
Through the cycles of replacements, nearly a million years passed, and Denny Kaye became a legend.
The original civilizations that dared to venture in had largely perished—some due to Civilization Wars, others due to internal conflict, and still others inexplicably vanishing.
The only civilization to endure for nearly a million years was none other than the Heavenly Punishment Clan!!
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!!
In the Chaos Void, figures imbued with the aura of Primordial True Emperors, Primordial Great Emperors, and the Sixth Heavenly Supreme began to manifest incessantly, surrounding the ancient tower and the towering silver-blue figure.
Excluding the Eternal Heavenly God of the Golden Tribe, battling the Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor and others, as well as the Nine Nether different races suppressed by Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon—the other five peak civilization strong ones had all arrived.
This included thirty-six Primordial Monarch powerhouses from top-tier civilizations.
Given the involvement of Denny Kaye and secrets concerning the battlefield above the Seventh Layer, it was impossible for them to remain uninvolved—they had to ascertain the truth.
The converging aura of five Primordial Supremes, seven Great Emperors, nearly twenty True Emperors, and countless Primordial Powerhouses weighed heavily—even causing that Eternal Strong One’s expression to subtly intensify in seriousness.
If this conglomerated force were to wage an all-out battle, with its heavily injured state, it wouldn’t be able to withstand the assault.
At that moment, a frigid, detached voice leisurely emanated by everyone’s ears, bursting with intangible, terrifying pressure: “How can you prove that the other party is lying.”
With the voice’s emergence, the distorted space-time in the distance rippled, revealing the figures of Jack Clark and the Sparkling Heaven True Emperor.
Instantly, the air grew stifling, accompanied by a palpable heaviness that everyone seemed to feel. Even the silver-blue figure’s eyes betrayed a weight of guarded foreboding, bordering on fear.
From the imposing presence of this ‘different race’ wearing a black Imperial Crown, halo rotations bursting brilliantly behind them—the pressure felt was no less than what it had experienced at its peak.
How was this possible!
The aura emanating from him clearly belonged to the Sixth Heavenly Realm. Even at Sixth Heavenly Realm Perfection, it shouldn’t be this overwhelming!
So strong!
Feeling the intangible yet terrifying pressure radiating from Jack Clark up close, even the Skyflame Supreme and other top-tier strong ones were visibly shaken, as if facing an Eternal Strong One.
Could he truly be Henry!?
No, his aura is different from Henry. That guy from back then had an oppressive presence that was far more overbearing and aggressive!
For a moment, the peak civilization strong ones’ gazes wavered with hesitation, thrown into chaos by the series of eruptions and conflicts unfolding today.
Even the two figures from the ancient tower displayed a fleeting solemnity in their eyes.
Observing Jack Clark’s domination of the Youtian Clan through distant Divine Secret Skills versus experiencing firsthand the danger and oppression he exuded were entirely different concepts.
Such strength was enough to suppress them.
Instantly, countless thoughts raced through the ancient tower’s mind, its resolute face darkening, its voice grave as it declared: “We all know that the deepest recesses of the ancient battlefield connect to the Supreme Chaos.”
“And the Nine Nether Calamity from back then was triggered by the encroaching power of the Supreme Chaos, drawing forth a terrifying Nine Nether Monster.”
“However, Denny Kaye does not integrate with the world. Each emergence provokes the Origin Will of the Chaos Sea to intervene and suppress it. Thus, the Nine Nether Monster was quickly banished back then.”
“But that monster was far too powerful, leaving residual strength throughout the battlefield above the Seventh Layer.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1887: 704_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1887: Chapter 704_2
“Years ago, an immortal supremacist of the Eighth Heavenly Realm ventured deep into the battlefield and, upon their departure, left a seal in the Seventh Layer, entrusting us, who were only at the Primordial Stars Realm at the time, to guard it.”
“That immortal stated that Denny Kaye was far too dangerous—unless forged into an eternal undying body, touching it meant certain death and would ignite a Great Calamity.”
“Our mission has always been to block all creatures carrying the Netherworld Qi from descending, even those eternal strong ones who come to explore.”
“To this end, that supreme being bestowed upon us two powerful Decrees, enough to withstand eternity.”
“Alas, so many years have passed, and the power of those two Decrees has been mostly consumed—they can no longer traverse realms.” At this point, Gu Tower spoke with a faint trace of regret in his tone.
Then Gu Tower solemnly turned to Jack Clark: “The proof you seek is simple—did it not claim we are Denny Kaye’s tentacles? Then let it and I simultaneously reveal our Soul Source forms.”
“Having been tainted with Netherworld Qi, its essence of life has already been twisted—impossible to conceal.”
Immediately, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor and others glanced slightly, nodding subtly in agreement with this proposition.
Regardless of whether it is a transcendent strong man, a mythical divine object, or a primordial being, strength, aura, appearance, and soul can all be altered—yet the Soul Source alone cannot be hidden.
It is the truest essence of a life, representing everything, including its concealed true name.
Thus, Jack Clark did not speak but simply stood silently, gazing at the silver-blue figure. Seeing this, the eternal strong one sneered coldly.
“The burst of that powerful force earlier, although well disguised, I still sensed traces of Denny Kaye’s presence above.”
“Since you are not afraid to reveal your original forms, do you think I would hesitate?”
The eternal strong one acted decisively—faced with Jack Clark, whose power rivaled its prime, and seeing no easy escape, it revealed its Soul Source without hesitation.
The towering projection, tens of millions of kilometers tall, crumbled at the chest, forming a colossal hollow measuring hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Within the hollow, blue starlight rotated like a nebula, encapsulating an icy-blue figure, tens of thousands of kilometers tall, somewhat resembling the eternal strong one.
Upon beholding the icy-blue figure, all present subconsciously had a name surface in their minds.
“Luo Jia,” the true name of this eternal strong one.
However, half of its essence was submerged in black-gray power, with its face horrifically twisted, sprouting countless black, hair-like tentacles writhing incessantly.
As for its body, the lower half was chaotic—legs extended up to its shoulders, split into a bizarre eight-petal chrysanthemum formation, revealing sharp teeth buried in the blackened flesh.
The torso, exposed ribs, was overtaken by flesh splitting into countless blood worms, crawling along bones or weaving through energy-transformed organs.
At the bottom, claws turned into warped hands—in both forward and reversed directions, small faces contorted in agony, writhing and hollow-eyed, evoking a deep sense of dread in onlookers.
Such a grotesque scene left many of the different races shocked and their scalps numb with terror.
The Netherworld Qi was utterly dreadful—even eternal strong ones could not resist its erosion, corrupting their lives and twisting their souls.
Sparkling Heaven True Emperor’s expression grew solemn; in a low voice, he murmured to Jack Clark, “This is indeed Netherworld Qi—troublesome. If its corruption completes, it will become dominated by Denny Kaye’s power.”
“Should it summon Denny Kaye’s descent or even awaken one of those terrifying Nine Nether Monsters, every surrounding civilization will be within its grasp.”
Luo Jia’s icy gaze locked upon Gu Tower and another figure, his voice deep and resonating across the Void: “Weren’t you seeking to prove your innocence? I’ve displayed my essence—now it’s your turn.”
“What’s there to fear?”
Gu Tower’s calm eyes met Gu Duo’s shattered silhouette, and they exchanged a slight nod.
Suddenly!
Their chests exploded, creating similarly colossal hollows, surrounded by white blood mist winding around spectral white projections.
Their essence forms bore little resemblance to the current white-haired, white-clothed “Human Race” appearances.
Humanoid forms sat cross-legged, heads morphing into white dragon heads—hornless, yet crowned with flowing white manes that moved unnaturally, appearing peculiar.
As these forms materialized, names surfaced in everyone’s consciousness.
“Cloud, Teng!”
Unlike Luo Jia’s polluted essence, Gu Tower and Gu Duo’s forms appeared translucent due to severe injuries yet entirely untainted.
“Impossible!!” Luo Jia screamed in disbelief, staring wide-eyed at the pure essence forms of the two, utterly stunned.
At its lofty cultivation and realm, detecting wrongly was unthinkable—earlier, the duo’s deadly strike injured its Divine Soul Intent, surging with Denny Kaye’s power.
How could their sixth Heavenly Realm powers obliterate twenty percent of its Divine Soul Intent otherwise?
Yet their Soul Sources remained untouched by the corrupted forces of Denny Kaye—or rather, any essence-defying pollution.
“Everyone, does this not affirm the truth I have spoken?” Gu Tower’s gaze swept over the crowd.
A massive figure composed of red primordial flames nodded slowly: “I trust Gu Tower’s words—this eternal strong one has succumbed to Denny Kaye’s corruption. It cannot be permitted to leave today.”
Silver-winged Heavenly Ant Supreme spoke gravely: “The spread of Netherworld Qi cannot be allowed.”
Strongmen of various races nodded in agreement, forming an intangible yet formidable encirclement surrounding the towering silver-blue presence, preparing collective suppression.
Displaying both Soul Sources had confirmed much of Gu Tower’s claims among the witnesses.
Yet the Netherworld Qi remained problematic. Only Jack Clark and the fearsome Doomsday Emperor Dragon could truly resist and potentially resolve it, drawing everyone’s subconscious focus upon the Human Race’s position.
Jack Clark’s towering figure stood unwavering, instead deep in contemplation while observing the black-gray energy infecting Luo Jia’s essence form.
This power inspired dread, capable even of eroding eternal beings—but to Jack Clark, its threat was bearable.
Its nature, at its core, aligned with the Void.
With the awakening of the Void Double Pupils talent, mastery of Void Rules, and countless evolutionary transformations, Jack Clark’s True Body had already partially merged with the Void.
Thus, Jack Clark’s concern did not lie with the Netherworld Qi—it lay with what lay above.
Amidst numerous scrutinizing gazes, Jack Clark finally spoke, his voice steady: “What lies above?”
Above.
The silver-blue figure froze momentarily, casting wary glances at the hostile surrounding strongmen before letting traces of fear escape into its tone.
“Above lies the graveyard—a burial site for over a dozen eternal strong ones.”
“When we ascended, the Nine Nether Monster entrenched above subdued us, devouring our true forms as nutrients for its growth—all buried within the black burial soil.”
“And I wasn’t lying—the link above leads not to supreme chaos but to Denny Kaye—there is no legendary eighth or ninth level.”
“Or perhaps once, the cracks in the supreme chaos were breached—but now repaired, leaving only a massive Denny Kaye crack and the monstrosity lurking above that…”
Luo Jia’s words were abruptly interrupted as Gu Tower hurriedly interjected: “Supreme Divine Martial, do not trust its words—its mind is already corrupted by Denny Kaye…”
Before Gu Tower could finish, Jack Clark raised an eyebrow, clenching his right fist.
Boom!
Under Jack Clark’s single punch, chaos erupted—heaven and earth ruptured, leaving Gu Tower and Gu Duo’s positions engulfed in a colossal vacuum hollow spanning millions of kilometers.
Under the unstoppable force of Supreme Divine Power’s Vacuum Annihilation, the two heavily wounded supreme beings shattered instantly, obliterated.
[]

chapters.title: Chapter 1888: 705
chapters.content:
Chapter 1888: Chapter 705
The ferocious Chaos Void, where supreme beings of different races and True Emperor powerhouses treated the scene as if facing a dire enemy, all gazed warily at the black-haired young man standing in the Void.
Skyflame Supreme glanced at the increasingly weakened ancient towers duo and slowly said: “Supreme Divine Martial, is there some misunderstanding in all this?”
“Just earlier, we all saw it clearly—those ancient towers have nothing to do with Denny Kaye; the issue lies with this ancient remnant soul.”
“When the Human Race fought against the Gloomy Heaven Clan and the Golden Tribe earlier, the ancient towers even warned us against taking action, advising that this was a grievance between the Human Race and the two clans, and other civilizations should not interfere lightly.”
“Indeed.” The Silver-winged Heavenly Ant Supreme, along with the Purple Mane King Behemoth Supreme and other strong men, nodded lightly, expressing their agreement with the ancient towers duo.
For a million years, the Heavenly Punishment Clan had earned high prestige in the Ancient Battlefield. If Jack Clark failed to produce ‘evidence’ proving that these two posed a problem, attempting to suppress them forcefully could incite public anger.
It might even awaken the spirit of rebellion among these beings.
If that were to happen—uniting those Peak Civilization powerhouses, who already feared the Human Race’s tremendous power—what then?
As Jack Clark, with an indifferent gaze, was about to speak, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor whispered: “Jack, how about we wait for Reincarnation and Void to arrive?”
“Unnecessary.” Jack Clark shook his head faintly.
He understood Sparkling Heaven True Emperor’s intent. If he intended to ‘begin the battle’ with every race in the Ancient Battlefield, then it would be wise to wait—to summon Reincarnation and Void True Emperor and others.
The Human Race boasted two supreme beings and four Great Emperors, each one exceptionally powerful among their ranks.
Especially Reincarnation and Void among the Six Great True Emperors; their rapid ascension to the Supreme realm revealed an unfathomable strength and heaven-defying combat power.
This much was evident from the Mark of Time Divine Power.
Unlike Jack Clark, due to the complete Mark of Time, Reincarnation True Emperor’s breakthrough during Primordial transformation led this Divine Power to evolve into Temporal Cycles, becoming further intricate.
Thus, waiting for Reincarnation and the others to arrive might ease Jack Clark’s confrontation, allowing him to deal with suppressing the ancient towers duo more comfortably.
But Sparkling Heaven True Emperor wasn’t remotely aware of Jack Clark’s current might.
His Sixth Heavenly Realm Perfection state combined with the terrifying strength of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was enough to suppress eternal existences, not to mention the partial convergence of their powers.
Together, even against the immortal existences of the Eighth Heaven, they could stand toe-to-toe.
“Have you all forgotten something?”
A voice, imbued with detached indifference, slowly echoed across the Void as layer upon layer of Chaos Halos unfolded behind Jack Clark, resembling thirteen radiant arrays blanketing a billion kilometers.
Instantly, an overwhelming aura strong enough to shake the heavens spread outward, as if an unparalleled deity proving themselves through power had descended.
The intangible, pure force emanating from him filled the entire Ancient Battlefield, compressing the rules, making all the Primordial powerhouses present feel uneasy.
A sensation akin to entering another Great Thousand World, being suppressed by the Great Thousand Universe’s laws.
Because this ‘strength’ was so overpowering, the entire Void trembled with fissures forming—billions upon billions of souls murmured in hymn-like reverence to the force.
“Impossible! Your strength!!”
Skyflame Supreme gasped, staring in disbelief at Jack Clark, whose fully released aura radiated power far surpassing eternal, indestructible beings.
For a moment, powerhouses from other civilizations fell silent, and the ancient towers duo’s faces turned ashen.
Previously, even when Jack Clark crushed the Primordial Great Emperors and obliterated Primordial True Emperors from the Gloomy Heaven Clan, his strength—though overwhelming—still barely stayed within the Sixth Heavenly Realm.
He was invincible as a Supreme, yes.
But now…
Roar!
Just as everyone reeled in shock from Jack Clark’s terrifying aura, the entire Ancient Battlefield shook within layered ‘universes,’ casting his massive shadow.
The Giant Beast, emitting a purple-black radiance, revealed only part of its head—a colossal form spanning nearly a trillion kilometers.
Under the icy gaze of its golden vertical pupils ignited by purple-black flames, strong men like the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant Supreme couldn’t lift a finger, frozen in trepidation.
Distracted by the series of incidents involving Denny Kaye and the Remnant Soul, these beings had forgotten about this monstrous entity.
They forgot its earlier acts—devouring the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme in one bite and tearing apart the entire Ancient Battlefield with an unparalleled force more terrifying than the seemingly ‘ordinary’ Jack Clark.
Boom!
Pale lightning streaked through the darkness, leaving lingering trails etched into the Void, twisting and intersecting, disappearing into the depths of layer upon layer of Space-Time.
Sensing Jack Clark’s unwavering killing intent and aware they could not stop Luo Jia’s escape today—or avoid their own impending demise—the ancient towers duo swiftly fled.
They fled in opposite directions, using Heavenly Punishment Divine Thunder to escape.
Under some formidable transcendent talent, their aura simultaneously appeared across dozens of different Space-Time locations, making it impossible for anyone to discern what was real and false.
Even Jack Clark couldn’t differentiate.
But there was no need for him to.
Buzz!
A Chaos Halo behind Jack Clark trembled, promptly collapsing and condensing into a Bronze Bell adorned with golden patterns spanning five billion kilometers.
Dong!
The Bronze Bell in Jack Clark’s hand emitted a deep resonance, and the Ancient Battlefield’s seven ‘universes’ were instantly filled with its profound sound.
Boom! Under the terrifying Shock Power, Space-Time obliterated, transparent cracks spread in all directions from Jack Clark’s center, suppressing Space-Time itself.
Bang, bang, bang!!
The traces of the ancient towers duo dispersed across dozens of Space-Time dimensions exploded one after another. Their True Bodies hiding light-years away, embedded in another timeline, were forcibly shattered.
They were jolted out of an alternate parallel Space-Time.
Boom, boom!!
Massive fragments of planetary size materialized, resembling Black Holes while radiating terrifying energy and white Thunder that shredded every surrounding substance and energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1889: 705_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1889: Chapter 705_2
Roar! Before the true forms of Gu Duo and the ancient tower could converge, a terrifying roar shook the heavens, rendering the Skyflame Supreme and others deaf.
Unable to perceive, unable to see, they could only sense an extremely terrifying force of destruction erupting, like a black hole devouring the universe descending upon them.
When the darkness faded from before the eyes of the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant Supreme and others, restoring vision and perception, the auras belonging to the ancient tower and Gu Duo had already vanished.
At the distant edge of the battlefield, a hole with a diameter of trillions of kilometers had appeared, as if a piece of the universe had been gouged out, unable to be repaired for a long time.
This scene was very familiar; previously, the Ethereal Heavenly Supreme had also fallen to this tactic.
Although powerful in the Supreme realm, even that Giant Beast could only devour in one gulp, suppressing within its “body,” unable to annihilate instantly.
But next, unless they break the devouring confinement, what awaits them will be gradual annihilation.
This power almost perfectly counters the “undying, immortal” Primordial; at this moment, not only the likes of Skyflame, but even the long-silent Luo Jia showed deep apprehension in their eyes.
The devouring power mastered by this Giant Beast is even more terrifying than the Nine Nether Monster that erodes and refines them.
Amidst the apprehensive gazes of the crowd, the chaotic Bronze Bell in Jack Clark’s hand dissipated, transforming back into a complex and large Halo Grand Formation behind him, slowly rotating.
Jack Clark’s gaze swept over the strong men of the different races, then settled on the increasingly transparent silver-blue figure, his voice indifferent.
“The Heavenly Punishment Clan, who cooperated with Denny Kaye to harvest countless lives on the battlefield, has already been slain by me. Next, we will discuss your matter.”
The silver-blue figure’s gaze was solemn, and it slowly said: “How do you want to talk?”
In front of this supremely powerful “different race” strong man, even though its cultivation realm was higher, Luo Jia had a feeling of looking up at a Mythical Life from when it was weak.
This had nothing to do with its only remaining broken Divine Soul Intent projection, but stemmed from a difference in the level of life.
This human, though his realm was only the Sixth Heavenly Realm, his essence of life was even higher than its own. This guess left Luo Jia a bit bewildered, pondering when the “below” grew so terrifying?
Or perhaps the era has changed.
As countless thoughts flashed through Luo Jia’s mind, Jack Clark casually said, “Tell me the true situation above, and I can consider helping you deal with the Nine Nether power within you.”
“What, you can suppress the Netherworld Qi that has already eroded my Soul Source!!” Luo Jia was stunned, somewhat incredulous.
Jack Clark said calmly, “That’s right, although the Netherworld Qi within you is troublesome, it’s not unmanageable.”
“I can take action to sever the part of your Soul Source that has been eroded, along with the Netherworld Qi, thus preventing you from ultimately losing control and triggering a Great Calamity.”
“…I feel I might still be salvageable.” Jack Clark’s suggestion left the silver-blue figure somewhat hesitant.
Or perhaps resistant.
Having been suppressed and refined by the Nine Nether Monster for so many years, it had completely abandoned its True Body to escape, and its Divine Soul Intent was left broken and weak by the ancient tower’s desperate efforts.
In such a condition, if its Soul Source were to be further severed by half, even if it survived, it would fall in realm and be unable to progress further in the future.
Let alone find a way to recover to the Everlasting Realm and reforge its True Body.
“I have a way to temporarily seal the Netherworld Qi within it.”
As the silver-blue figure hesitated over Jack Clark’s suggestion, a twisted voice faintly echoed from the depth of the Void, then a figure appeared silently as darkness split open.
“Void, why are you here?”
Looking at the figure like a mass of twisted shadows, the Blazing Heaven True Emperor was somewhat surprised.
However, this shadow was a Power Projection of the Void True Emperor. Since the breakthrough to the True Emperor Realm over ten thousand years ago, the Void True Emperor has delved deep into the Void, never revealing his True Body.
Therefore, even the likes of Blazing Heaven and others did not know what the True Body of the Void True Emperor looked like.
“Are you sure you can seal the Netherworld Qi within me?” The silver-blue figure glanced at the Void projection, then looked towards Jack Clark.
Here, only this human and that Giant Beast caused it apprehension, and at the same time, only this human’s words could decide everything.
Jack Clark slowly began, “This is a Senior strong man of the Human Race; since he has spoken, there is certainly confidence in sealing the Netherworld Qi within you.”
“The next problem is telling me the information I want to know.”
“Otherwise, to me, obliterating you is easier than helping you seal the Netherworld Qi.”
The Void True Emperor has spent his life researching the Void, cultivating Void Rules. As a Senior strong man of human civilization, since he has spoken, there is certainly confidence.
As for why he appeared at this time, clearly, this Void strong man is also interested in the Netherworld Qi, preparing to study it.
“I understand your meaning.” Facing Jack Clark’s “threat,” the silver-blue figure slowly nodded.
Concerning the true information above the Seventh Layer, relative to protection fees, the price of buying life.
Puff!
Under the watchful gazes of strong men from all races, the silver-blue figure extended its hand into its body, tearing out a massive fragment of its soul, resembling a transparent blue crystal flying towards Jack Clark.
The primordial life’s power is immense; even if it’s just a figure, it encompasses endless mysteries. Ordinary life, at just a glance, would have their souls exploded under the barrage of endless information.
Therefore, as Jack Clark grasped that soul fragment, countless pieces of information exploded in his Sea of Consciousness, transforming into a bizarre and terrifying image.
In a pitch-black, icy world where there was no sky, no earth, only dead black burial grounds.
Each burial ground was like a Chaos Continent spanning dozens of light-years, shrouded in black-gray mist and towering with a massive tombstone.
These black-gray mists swirled around the tombstone, forming a sky-reaching whirlpool, at the center of which a hideous great mouth faintly revealed, devouring and absorbing the “strength” below.
And such graveyards numbered nine in total, each representing an Everlasting Ancient Corpse buried underneath.
Among them, two graveyards were cracked, the burial grounds shattered, exposing some remaining petrified remnants below, indicating that the Everlasting Ancient Corpse had already been digested.
[]
Some have already been dissolved and digested.
Back then, when it saw that Nine Nether Monster, the other party was also fleeing, somewhat panicked.
In a heavily injured state, during these years, unbeknownst to peak civilization, it subsequently lured and killed four Everlasting Strong Ones exploring the Ancient Battlefield.
Extremely powerful, the heavily injured Eighth Heavenly Realm, back then it directly suppressed three Everlasting ones, and over the years, it has successively lured and killed four, absorbing their everlasting bodies, its injuries almost fully recovered.
Some have already been dissolved and digested.

chapters.title: Chapter 1890: 706
chapters.content:
Chapter 1890: Chapter 706
Chapter 706: The True Void Creature, Suppressing the Nine Nether
The shattered Chaos Void was swept by waves of powerful primordial pressure, shaking space-time.
Invisible primordial radiance spread across the battlefield, dazzlingly brilliant and multicolored, yet unable to pierce the ‘darkness’ that engulfed the entire battlefield—like a magnificent painting imprinted upon the starry sky.
Under the watchful gaze of the Five Peak Civilizations and thirty-six Top-tier Civilizations’ strongest individuals:
