Jack Clark, with his black hair flowing behind him like a galaxy and the All-Heaven Emperor Crown atop his head, slowly opened his eyes. Beneath the colossal black-and-white pupils emerged triple irises shimmering with cosmic depth.
Suddenly, a terrifying pressure swept outwards, forcing all present to lower their gazes, unable to meet his gaze.
Even the silver-blue figure of Eternal Immortal Realm instinctively looked away—a reflex buried deep within its soul.
At this moment, Jack Clark resembled an ancient and unparalleled Great Emperor, commanding the battlefield’s civilizations and surveying the heavens.
Only the Void True Emperor and Blazing Heaven True Emperor remained undeterred, gazing at Jack as the latter softly asked: “Jack Clark, what do you think?”
Jack Clark nodded slowly: “The fragments of the Divine Soul cannot lie; above the Seventh Layer indeed lurks a Nine Nether Monster—a wounded, hibernating Undying.”
Hiss! Hiss!!
Gasping sounds instantly echoed across the void.
Earlier, when the silver-blue figure and the Heavenly Punishment Clan argued, everyone subconsciously leaned towards assuming Luo Jia was lying, claiming there was no Undying Monster above.
Because the very idea was too horrifying.
Nine Nether itself was synonymous with ‘terror,’ let alone an existence of the Immortal Realm.
The Eighth Primordial Heavenly Realm, with will that cycles eternally and power projecting across heavens.
Such beings are terrifyingly powerful, evidenced by the utter devastation of Luo Jia and other ancient strong entities.
Ancient entities of Eternal Undying Realm, who once stood at the pinnacle of the Ancient Battlefield, were crushed and used as nourishment, suppressed within burial grounds, being refined bit by bit.
A monster like this, entrenched on the Ancient Battlefield, is akin to a world-ending sword poised to strike at any moment.
The day this Nine Nether Monster awakens is when all civilizations on the Ancient Battlefield face annihilation, with all life consumed in an instant.
The Silver-winged Heavenly Ant Supreme cast a solemn gaze across the group and said gravely: “Everyone, we cannot remain here; we must leave immediately.”
“Now that the Seventh Layer’s seal has shattered, that Undying Monster may already be roused—delay further, and none shall escape.”
“What the Sky Ant Supreme says holds truth, but…” At this, a flicker of hesitation appeared in Skyflame Supreme’s eyes.
Other strong individuals from different races shared similar sentiments, struggling with the notion of abandoning battlefield footholds cultivated for tens or even hundreds of thousands of years.
The Ancient Battlefield is of incomparable importance to these civilizations, whether they are primordial powerhouses, True Emperors, or strong individuals at the level of True Spirit and below.
The Battlefield yields rare Chaotic Supreme Treasures from the Chaos Sea, supreme Chaotic Sources, countless Heaven and Earth Treasures, and the residual Eternal Air dissipated in battles involving Eternal Behemoths.
With these resources, these civilizations grew rapidly at astonishing rates.
In the Endless World, a single Primordial Stars powerhouse is enough to dominate an era and suppress an entire realm to become a Dao Ancestor.
For the civilizations of the Endless World, primordial beings are akin to Creator Gods who opened the heavens to establish existence, transcending eons without decay or death.
But within the Ancient Battlefield, a single Top-tier Civilization could station three to five primordial powerhouses.
Peak Civilizations, boasting over a dozen primordial entities, were brimming with True Emperors and Great Emperors, each overseen by supreme individuals.
Thirty-plus Top-tier Civilizations and nine Peak Civilizations clustered here, vying for those ‘resources.’
Civilizations long obliterated by history also fought and bled indiscriminately—for the chance to claim nodes capable of consolidating Eternal Air and infusing supreme chaotic power.
Even the Ancient Human Race’s rapid development was closely tied to the resources of the Ancient Battlefield.
Otherwise, despite the monstrous talents of figures like the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, they could never leap from True Spirit Level upon entering to primordial strength, let alone ascending to become a Great Emperor Supreme.
Amid the Chaos Void, the blood-light figure condensed into a Blood Moon hesitated and asked: “Is there truly no way to deal with that Nine Nether Monster?”
“Isn’t it wounded and in a hibernating state?”
As the Blood Moon Supreme turned, it gazed at Jack Clark, standing a hundred billion kilometers away, beside his massive, void-spanning purple-black Giant Beast stretching trillions of kilometers.
Prompted by this, Skyflame Supreme and others glanced at Jack Clark from afar.
With the terrifying strength Jack displayed, combined with the even more formidable power of his Giant Beast, the possibility of addressing the injured Undying seemed plausible.
But to face an Undying creature, especially a Nine Nether Monster.
Under normal conditions, no one willingly confronts such abominations; even an Undying being of the same realm would avoid combat with an Immortal Nine Nether Monster.
A single misstep—injury, or damage to one’s foundation—would incur immense losses.
Not to mention, Jack Clark’s true realm was merely the Sixth Heavenly Realm.
Thus, for Skyflame Supreme and others, the notion was dismissed as impossible—the Human Race could never assume such tremendous risk to face the Nine Nether Monster.
Perceiving the chilling intent in Skyflame Supreme and others’ gazes, the Blazing Heaven True Emperor’s expression turned sharp.
But before the Blazing Heaven True Emperor could speak, Jack Clark calmly stated: “Nine Nether beings are the mortal enemies of all primary material life; their entire existence is nothing but destruction and corruption.”
“For this Nine Nether Monster, we have but two options: either battle to suppress and seal it within the battlefield—or abandon the Ancient Battlefield entirely.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1891: 706_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1891: Chapter 706_2
“And the entire tribe must migrate away from this chaotic region, leaving the vast world.”
Half of the civilizations in the ancient battlefield originated from the mythical world ‘nearby,’ where they established divine realms, dominating vassal races across all directions with their presence.
However, primordial powerhouses cannot enter the mythical world, and thus, once they choose to leave the ancient battlefield, all civilizations must relocate their tribes.
Of course, these primordial powerhouses could also choose to abandon their tribes, letting the transcendent lives of their races remain in the divine realm of the mythical world, roaming the chaos together.
But in doing so, no one could guarantee what might happen in the future.
Without a primordial powerhouse holding the fort for the different races’ civilizations, there might come a day when their tribes are suddenly annihilated by an emerging new civilization.
Just like the Purgatory Demon Race, which ruled the forbidden area surroundings for a hundred thousand years, only to be crushed by the rising Blue Star Federation, leading to the annihilation of their tribe.
Abandoning the ancient battlefield rich with primordial resources, forsaking the eternal-level vast world abundant in extraordinary resources, even these primordial powerhouses now feel their hearts bleeding.
But with the current situation, it is the only choice.
Even Sparkling Heaven and Void show some solemnity, though only a trace, because the Human Race is different from these civilizations of other races—human potential is boundless.
Vanished for ten thousand years, Henry, whose talent amazed ancient times.
Jack Clark, who had already broken through the Sixth Heavenly Realm thousands of years ago, with his exact cultivation known only to himself and Void.
And a talent no lesser than Henry, perhaps even more shocking: Jack Clark.
Especially Jack Clark—given his rate of cultivation progress, Sparkling Heaven predicts it may take less than ten years for him to fully step into the Everlasting Realm.
And being even bolder, Jack Clark might have the potential to break through into Eternity within ten thousand years and become the supreme legend.
By then, the Human Race is destined to rise as an Eternal Divine Clan, standing unrivaled in the Endless World, where every newborn is born into myth.
Upon such thoughts, even Sparkling Heaven’s emotions ripple, filled with hope for the future.
But as the Blazing Heaven True Emperor is brimming with hope for the future, while other civilization powerhouses wryly prepare to accept this decision, Jack Clark speaks again.
“The ancient battlefield is of utmost importance to all of you and to my Human Race—thus, I have decided to enter the Seventh Layer Battlefield to suppress that Nine Nether Monster.”
“What!”
“Supreme Divine Martial, are you saying you want to suppress that Nine Nether Monster!?”
Skyflame Supreme and the others were all stunned. With their cultivation levels, they even doubted their hearing, and the silver-blue figure was equally astonished.
But Sparkling Heaven and Void True Emperor’s faces instantly changed: “No! It’s too dangerous, Jack Clark—that is an immortal-level Nine Nether Monster.”
Faced with the urgent looks from Sparkling Heaven and Void True Emperor, Jack Clark’s gaze remained calm: “Don’t worry, Seniors—I wouldn’t dare go unless I felt confident in my chances.”
“With both my strength and Thunderflame’s, even if we cannot suppress it, we can ensure a safe retreat.”
“However, if that’s the case, everyone will still have to withdraw from the ancient battlefield, leaving this chaotic region, to avoid being polluted by the awakened Nine Nether Monster.”
Feeling the unwavering determination radiating from Jack Clark, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor struggled to find words to dissuade him.
At this moment, Void True Emperor, silent with his will until now, showed a trace of awe on his face: “Facing an immortal with the cultivation level of Primordial Supreme—a display of courage and strength that’s exceptional.”
“But neither you, Jack Clark, nor any of us, have experience fighting immortals—we know nothing of how powerful they are, or what divine powers and talents they possess.”
“Thus, I feel it’s better to act cautiously. Before entering the Seventh Layer Battlefield, we should prepare—perhaps by first crafting an avatar to enter.”
As soon as Void True Emperor finished speaking, the silver-blue figure standing within the Void had a sudden change in expression: “It’s too late.”
Noticing the silver-blue figure’s expression shift, everyone was seized by a foreboding sense of unease, and Sparkling Heaven True Emperor gravely asked: “What… do you mean?”
“It has already awakened.”
As the silver-blue figure spoke, he raised his head towards the darkness-enveloped ‘sky,’ a faint trace of panic flashing in his eyes.
Because Luo Jia, whose soul origin was also eroded by the Nine Nether Aura, was exceptionally attuned to the power of the Nine Nether.
Just moments ago, he keenly sensed the Nine Nether Aura corroding souls begin to stir—awakening, growing more alive, and accelerating its pollution.
Crackle Crackle!!
The ‘sky’ of the Sixth Layer Battlefield shook as the Doomsday Emperor Dragon bit through the multicolored curtain of light, unveiling numerous black cracks, forming the shape of a massive black eye.
As if a terrifying monster was now watching those below.
Instantly, everyone felt a chill run through them—a visceral, soul-deep fear and trembling surged forth, leaving their faces marked with horror.
That Nine Nether Monster was more dreadful than they had ever imagined.
Just a strand of its will’s gaze filled them with fear like this—should its True Body descend, perhaps no action would be needed—just a look might distort and disrupt their consciousness.
It was too terrifying—run, escape immediately!!
At this moment, the entire Sixth Layer of the ancient battlefield, relative to the cosmos of the Sixth Layer Universe, felt like countless lives facing their mortal enemy—a primal terror of being preyed upon.
Even Jack Clark, under the immortal will’s strand of attention, felt a strong sense of oppression and danger.
For an instant, Jack Clark’s entire bloodstream boiled, and an intense Battle Intent surged within him, as the ginormous purple-black colossus behind him suddenly raised its head.
Roar! A deafening roar erupted, shaking space-time to its core.
Within this roar reverberated the Heavenly Tier’s imposing pressure, colliding with the aura of the Nine Nether will—instantly causing Skyflame Supreme and others’ consciousness to hum with deafening impact, their minds flooded with chaos.
Jack Clark shouted with determination: “Blazing Heaven Senior—the Golden Tribe’s affairs are entrusted to you. Thunderflame and I will ascend to intercept it and prevent it from descending.”
“Luo Jia, I hope you honor your promise—else bear the consequences.”
Saying so, and without waiting for everyone’s response, a terrifying power surged within Jack Clark’s body, radiating blinding golden-white light.
Amidst the brilliance, an awe-inspiring figure emerged—entirely cloaked in golden-purple battle armor, enveloped by golden-white flames, standing at an unimaginable height of ten billion kilometers with three heads and eighteen limbs.
Behind this colossal figure unfolded nineteen layers of multicolored Chaos Halos, stretching across a range of trillions of kilometers.
Instantly, an aura no less imposing than the Terminal Form of the purple-black colossus, who had unlocked the Dark Star Tenfold Heavenly Gate, descended on all.
Boom Boom Boom!!
Under the extremity of this Rule of Power’s aura—the heavens reversed, all creation disintegrated, and intangible vibrations caused the entire ancient battlefield to tremble madly.
Even the ruinous shockwaves sweeping forth from this overwhelming might flung everyone away uncontrollably.
Even the silver-blue figure, capable of temporarily bursting into Half-Step Everlasting Realm combat power, was hurled billions of kilometers away before he could maintain balance before this iteration of Jack Clark’s form.
When the crowd, recovering from the chaos, looked towards the golden-white light that had chased away the shadows, they couldn’t help but reveal astonishment.
At this moment, just Jack Clark standing there evoked instinctive dread within them—a deep, inexplicable fear and reverence etched into their bones.
“How is this possible!!”
Even Blazing Heaven True Emperor couldn’t help but gape in astonishment, staring in disbelief at the colossal being obscuring the heavens and blotting out the sky.
Dark Star Demon God, Thirteenth Wheel World-Ending True King in Apocalypse Form, enhanced by the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s unparalleled talent—the Black Hole Tyrant Body—had pushed Jack Clark’s ‘Rule of Power’ to unimaginable heights.
The form of his True Body transformed—now three-headed and eighteen-armed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1892: 707: Light-year Creature, Single-handedly Suppressing Demons
chapters.content:
Chapter 1892: Chapter 707: Light-year Creature, Single-handedly Suppressing Demons
As Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon departed, entering the Seventh Layer Battlefield, the overbearing, unparalleled, and terrifying pressure that filled the cosmos also dissipated.
Along with it faded the darkness that enveloped six layers of the ‘universe,’ and Heaven and Earth regained their radiance.
For an instant, everyone felt as though Doomsday had passed, subconsciously exhaling a sigh of relief, their minds and bodies never feeling as unburdened as they did now.
But only the likes of the Skyflame Supreme and others knew that the true Great Calamity was just beginning.
Far away, gazing at the pathway piercing through layers of universes and the seven-colored light screen with a diameter exceeding ten trillion kilometers at the end of the pathway, everyone’s expressions were filled with solemnity and awe.
Their solemnity stemmed from the fact that the Immortal-level Nine Nether Monster had indeed been awakened.
And their awe was directed at Jack Clark, who, with just his Sixth Heavenly Realm cultivation, truly ascended above, joining forces with that terrifying Giant Beast to face the Nine Nether Monster.
This selfless ‘heroic sacrifice’ astonished these powerful beings from various civilizations.
Though it was related to Jack Clark’s celestial combat strength, if placed in their shoes, they would have chosen to lead their races away from the Ancient Battlefield rather than venture into danger.
There was simply no other choice—the gap between the Sixth Heavenly Realm and the Immortal Realm was too vast.
Every breakthrough of a Primordial Creature into the Seventh Heavenly Realm was marked by a qualitative leap in power, and even though Jack Clark and that Giant Beast radiated an aura stronger than many Eternal Undying entities, it still felt insufficient to suppress.
Not even against the injured state of the Nine Nether Monster.
And battles at this level, once locked in stalemate, where neither side could dominate the other, could possibly drag on for hundreds, even thousands of years.
With this realization, the Blood Moon Supreme solemnly turned toward the two figures of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor, their towering forms stooping low in a deeply respectful bow. “The heroic spirit of the Supreme Divine Martial is beyond our reach.”
“I believe that with the combined might of the Supreme Divine Martial and that Primordial Beast, they will undoubtedly be able to hold back that Nine Nether Monster.”
“…Let us hope so.” Blazing Heaven True Emperor lifted her gaze, staring at the glowing, colored light screen above the ‘Firmament,’ her expression grave, her eyes tinged with faint puzzlement.
She did not understand why Jack Clark chose to take such a risk.
If the Nine Nether Monster were to invade below, let it. At worst, the Human Race could evacuate the Ancient Battlefield, and all of the strong men from Chaos Outside Heaven could retreat far from this Chaos Sea.
With Jack Clark’s unparalleled talent, time was on his side.
He merely needed to wait a few centuries, perhaps a few millennia, until his realm reached the Immortal Realm, or until he crossed into the Ninth Heavenly Realm, transforming into a Great Sun of Eternity illuminating all worlds across the heavens.
At that time, he could return alone, and with but a hand, suppress the Nine Nether Monster.
It was at this moment that the Void True Emperor, resembling a shapeless shadow of abstraction, slowly spoke, “Blazing Heaven, do not overthink it. Jack Clark naturally has his reasons for making this choice.”
“Yet, as he entered the Seventh Layer Battlefield, from his back… I ‘saw’ urgency.”
Pausing briefly, the Void True Emperor continued.
“Urgency.”
Blazing Heaven was taken aback. “With his growth—less than ten years to leap from being an ordinary lifeform to transcendent, to surpassing myth, and becoming the Primordial Supreme.”
“And even after reaching Primordial Supreme, he still can cross realms to fight with that defiant strength.”
“All things considered, I cannot fathom what could make him feel urgent. Is it lifespan? An existential enemy? Or does he feel he’s still not strong enough?”
The shadow lightly shook its head. “Do not ask me, for I do not know. Perhaps I was mistaken in my perception.”
Yet could a Primordial Supreme deeply versed in the Void truly mistake their perception?
…
The Ancient Battlefield does not have nine layers—or rather, under the self-healing of supreme chaos, the entire Ancient Battlefield is merging, eventually reforming into ‘shards’ for repair.
Thus, the Seventh Layer Battlefield, already fused into one entity, was incomparably vast, resembling a cosmic expanse devoid of sky, Earth, or light—a dark, icy universe.
Moreover, its capacity was unimaginably immense, sufficient to sustain Immortal-level beings, even those of Great Sun Eternity levels.
But today, the usually silent and pitch-dark Seventh Layer Universe had become bustling, while golden-white radiance of breathtaking brilliance permeated space-time, illuminating the starry void.
The power-pressure-laden golden-white light spread in all directions, clashing against the pervasive black-gray mist filling the dead starry void.
BOOM BOOM BOOM!!
In the instant these two forces made contact, it was akin to two universes colliding, unleashing earth-shattering rumbles that reverberated across hundreds of light-years, with dazzling light quaking throughout.
The golden-white radiance, embodying true, actualized Rule of Power, extended for a light-year, at the center of its luminous brilliance stood Jack Clark’s three-headed, eighteen-armed figure.
In his hands was a 30-billion-kilometer-long purple-golden War Halberd, coiled with dragon patterns, and emanating an imperceptible weight that resembled a colossal black hole, distorting all around it.
Yet at this moment, with his overwhelming aura akin to an absolute Monarch descending, Jack Clark’s expression was grim, his eyes locked forward.
Tens of light-years away, amidst the churning black-gray mist, an enormous terror, so vast it made one’s scalp tingle, faintly emerged, its diameter exceeding five light-years.
To put it into perspective, the distance across the Solar System, from its furthest boundary at Pluto, measures less than six billion kilometers.
One could only imagine the sheer immensity of this Nine Nether Monster.
And this enormity was not mere hollow scale—it was accompanied by ‘substance’ of equal magnitude. Simply coiling there, it radiated an invisible power that compressed space-time.
Crushing everything, squeezing dimension after dimension into collapse, forming a domain of invincibility spanning tens of light-years around its surroundings.
Without the strength of the Eternal Undying Realm, one wouldn’t even qualify to penetrate that domain—let alone attack, let alone face that terrifying Nine Nether Monster directly.
At this level, notions of tactics such as massive groups fell away entirely.
Even if ten thousand Primordial Stars strong men joined forces, the power they generated would merely be akin to a mantis trying to stop a chariot, incapable of disturbing even a strand of its being.
Small wonder those who had broken into the Seventh and Eighth Heavenly Realm, some of them Primordial Beings, remained elusive across millennia—the two sides were simply not on the same plane.

chapters.title: Chapter 1893: 707: Light-Year Creature, Solo Suppressing Demons_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1893: Chapter 707: Light-Year Creature, Solo Suppressing Demons_2
Below is the translated text:
Just at this moment, amidst the rolling black-gray fog of darkness, nine circular blood-colored lights emerged, shining like nine star systems, their gaze filled with incomparable malice enveloping Jack Clark.
BOOM BOOM BOOM!!
Under that terrifying gaze, a golden-white light spanning a light-year suddenly trembled, forming nine massive hollows each ten trillion kilometers deep.
Following this, a crazed, twisted icy-blue horizontal sound slowly echoed across the cosmic starry sky.
“Are… you… here… to… die?”
As the voice spoke, the black-gray fog surrounding the terrifying monster dissipated, revealing a twisted true form.
A grotesque figure cobbled together from countless colossal life forms, fused into one insane entity.
This Nine Nether Monster’s body was bloated, resembling a spider with dozens of arms and tentacles, and twenty pairs of mismatched legs, entirely covered in black scales.
On its broad shoulders grew nine heads, one of which belonged to Luo Jia.
Previously, it had unleashed a fragmented Divine Soul Intent, attempting to flee the Seventh Layer battlefield with its incomplete upper body, but was ultimately dragged back by the Nine Nether Monster.
With the last remnants of its will extinguished, Luo Jia’s True Body was wholly absorbed by the monster.
Gazing upon the massive and chaotic monster, Jack Clark’s eyes burned with heightened Battle Intent.
Because he realized that the monster’s injuries had not yet healed.
A million years ago, this monster had encountered an unknown adversary so powerful that its Undying Body was shattered, leaving only its reincarnating immortal will to “escape” and linger on the Ancient Battlefield.
Even with just an immortal will, the monster’s power remained terrifying.
Adding the Netherworld Qi’s life-eradicating effect, it had suppressed countless Eternal Strong Ones, polluting and assimilating their Divine Souls with its Nine Nether Demonic Qi, gradually transforming their bodies into parts of itself.
This was the method by which the Nine Nether Monster refined these Undying Bodies.
Without Eternal Level strength, the monster could not forcibly dissolve the Eternal Bodies, resorting to this piecemeal fusion process.
However, the integration was crude, and these Eternal Undying Bodies largely retained their original shapes.
Even after millions of years, only two Undying Bodies had been fully absorbed, while the other seven “corpses” remained partially torn apart, the slow progress agonizingly apparent.
Without wasting words, as the Nine Nether Monster revealed its true form, the Chaos Halo behind Jack Clark shuddered, and an even more colossal purple-black shadow emerged.
A purple-black Giant Beast, stretching ten trillion kilometers, descended as if from another dimension, its double wings flapping to engulf the Dark Chaos, consuming the entire starry sky.
ROAR! A ferocious bellow shook the entire battlefield.
Under the terrifying roar, the floating fragments within the black-gray mist, each hundreds to thousands of billions of kilometers wide, exploded one after another.
The roar shook the heavens, its sound shattering stars.
This overwhelming force made even the previously “carefree” Nine Nether Monster suddenly narrow its eyes in focus.
BOOM!
The Eternal Darkness Dragon moved like a black Light Beam piercing the cosmos, traversing dozens of light-years instantaneously at a speed transcending the concept of time.
When its massive body collided with the black-gray fog, it was akin to traveling at ten thousand times the speed of sound within the atmosphere, emitting an exceptionally dazzling White Light that illuminated Heaven and Earth.
Due to its sheer velocity, the impact’s sound had no time to catch up.
ROAR!
The purple-black Giant Beast at the edge of the invincible domain let out another roar, twisting its body as a blade light stretching hundreds of trillions of kilometers shot skyward.
The moment the purple-red blade light emerged, the Nine Nether Monster’s nine heads all roared in unison.
Among them, a colossal dark-red claw tens of thousands of kilometers long extended outward, covered in densely packed black runes that shimmered.
BOOM! Heaven and Earth trembled.
Under the purple-red blade light, the invincible domain spanning ten light-years was torn apart, creating a massive rift.
Its blade edge was indestructible, flickering millions of times within layers of Space-Time in an instant, resembling a Blade God who had ascended to the peak realm.
Ultimately, the blade struck the overwhelming dark-red beast claw that spanned Space-Time and engulfed everything beneath its shadow.
BOOM!
At the moment of collision between blade and beast claw, a brilliant explosion of purple-red light erupted, its unleashed power shaking the entire Seventh Layer Universe into chaotic tremors.
Faintly, a seven-colored river flashed across the cosmic sky, roaring as if cleaved in two.
BOOM BOOM BOOM!!
Amid the world-shattering impact, the beast claw’s surface—covered in star-like scales—fractured and shattered, with huge cracks spreading across its surface.
This was the Lifeline Talent of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon: the Extermination True Blade.
A strike severing forms, extinguishing Divine Souls.
With the enhanced power of the Final Darkness Star Form, even an Immortal Realm existence could not fully withstand this cutting force—defense breached in one strike.
However, this minor “injury” was almost negligible to the colossal monster.
ROAR!
The monster’s nine heads unleashed chaotic roars, with endless black-gray mist erupting from its enormous beast claw, instantly triggering a terrifying Power Explosion.
BOOM! The Eternal Darkness Dragon instantly vanished, leaving behind a hollow spanning hundreds of billions of kilometers.
Meanwhile, hundreds of light-years away, a black burial land floating in the pitch-black Cosmic Void, with a diameter of tens of thousands of light-years, exploded and disintegrated.
The trillion-kilometer-long Eternal Darkness Dragon, in comparison to the five-light-year, nearly five quadrillion-kilometer-long Nine Nether Monster, looked like a mere ant.
But vast size brought with it absolute strength.
Still, at this level, strength was no longer merely determined by size.
BOOM!
The Cosmic Void quaked as nineteen layers of Chaos Halos radiated and merged, gradually forming a golden-white figure towering a trillion kilometers high, with three heads and eighteen arms.
Among the eighteen arms, one holding a bronze giant bell trembled slightly.
Silence became sound.
In complete silence, the domain surrounding the Nine Nether Monster shattered entirely, unleashing compressed Space-Time dimensional power that exploded into a radiant tide of destruction sweeping in all directions.
Simultaneously, within the dark starry sky, two massive black-gold vertical pupils emerged, connecting to the infinite Void, instantly unleashing an overwhelming eye force.
BOOM BOOM BOOM!!
Centered around the Nine Nether Monster, the surrounding space spanning dozens of light-years disintegrated, akin to a shattered mirror, obliterating everything.
[]
ROAR!
Movements stirred Heaven and Earth. The front-line power of the Eternal Darkness Dragon matched the monster’s equally, while Jack Clark played an assisting role, wielding the War Halberd with Chaos Halo amplification to shatter True Forms.
Their combined forces held their ground against the Nine Nether Monster without faltering.
With the fusion of past, present, and future forming a perfect unity, their Limit Breakthrough state, though hugely draining, brought an equally terrifying recovery rate, allowing prolonged sustenance.
The battle raged on for a full year until both Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon began losing steam.
Unable to maintain their footing, they activated the second state: merging soul breath and entering Demigod fusion, instantly unleashing a torrential surge across the Chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 1894: 708: Fate Reincarnation, Devouring Heaven and Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 1894: Chapter 708: Fate Reincarnation, Devouring Heaven and Earth
When Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon joined forces and confronted the Nine Nether Monster in the Seventh Layer battlefield, the war below between the Human Race and the Nine Nether Golden Tribe was also drawing to a close.
“Skyflame, why!”
A voice tinged with grief and anger reverberated across the battlefield.
Above the ruins that had nearly shattered the Fifth Layer battlefield stood the Eternal Heavenly God Supreme, resembling a Golden Dragon Man. His golden flames flickered in his eyes as he looked upward in rage.
Above the crumbling firmament, six towering figures exuding the oppressive aura of the Primordial Supreme stood tall.
Among them, the Reincarnation True Emperor, whose Wheel of Samsara rotated behind him, had the strongest presence, followed by the Silver-winged Heavenly Ant Supreme that resembled a colossal silver beast.
At the same time, the Skyflame Supreme, Blood Moon Supreme, Purple Mane King Behemoth Supreme, and Soul-Devouring Ant Supreme spread out to block all directions.
In response to the Golden Supreme’s question, the gaze of Skyflame Supreme was icy-cold as he replied indifferently: “The Supreme Divine Martial single-handedly suppressed the Nine Nether, bestowing immense grace upon all civilizations in the Ancient Battlefield.”
“This mutation has allowed us to see ourselves more clearly and understand our position better.”
“Compared to the vastness of the Boundless Chaotic Sea, our civilizations are but insignificant ants. Continuing to fight each other for resources is neither beneficial nor wise.”
“After our deliberations, the six Peak Civilizations and thirty-two Top-tier Civilizations have formed the Ancient Alliance to maintain stability in the Ancient Battlefield.”
“The first act of the Alliance is to purge the forces causing instability within the Ancient Battlefield.”
“For instance, the Heavenly Punishment Clan, which has served as the Nine Nether’s tentacles for millions of years; the Youtian Clan, which often instigates racial wars; and finally, your Golden Tribe that has been secretly sowing discord among the factions.”
Striding along the River of Time and wielding the power of time, the Reincarnation True Emperor spoke slowly: “Skyflame, don’t waste words on it. Take action.”
“Attack.”
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!!
The six Supremes struck simultaneously, assailing the Golden Supreme. Their terrifying power instantly obliterated the chaotic fragments in their vicinity, shaking the cosmos.
And not just here—the war engulfed all six layers of the Ancient Battlefield’s cosmos. Strong men from different races launched an all-out siege against the three tribes, fighting so fiercely that heaven and earth grew dim, and rivers of blood flowed.
This was the change brought by Jack Clark.
Years ago, when he returned from the Kelaya Battlefield, as the first freshman of South Sky Martial Height breaking through the Fourth Layer Heaven, he had already sensed the shift in reality.
When you grow strong, the villains around you naturally disappear.
Likewise, the true core of the so-called Ancient Alliance’s formation was Jack Clark’s invincible power upon entering the Eternal Undying Realm, which subdued the five Peak Civilizations.
As for the supposed noble act of single-handedly suppressing the Nine Nether, it was merely a convenient pretext.
As the chaos in the Ancient Battlefield grew increasingly intense, a Silver Giant Dragon, spanning a million meters, coiled languidly beneath the colorful Sky Curtain and let out a feeble roar: “So boring, Tim Abbott isn’t here.”
The Silver Giant Dragon’s mood was somewhat gloomy, taking no interest in the blood-soaked battlefield below.
Ever since it encountered the Thunderflame Behemoth, the Silver Giant Dragon had followed in its wake—fighting, brawling, and raiding empire after empire of Giant Beasts, using its Level 9 Giant Beast Body to confront Mythical Giant Beasts.
Later, when the Doomsday Emperor Dragon entered hibernation for several centuries, the Silver Giant Dragon had also kept it company, sleeping alongside it—it had long grown accustomed to the Emperor Beast’s presence.
Now, suddenly abandoned by the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, the Silver Giant Dragon found itself at a loss.
Its only hope now was that the Doomsday Emperor Dragon would quickly destroy the Nine Nether Monster and return, so they could resume their rampage through the chaos together.
…
ROAR!
A ferocious, earth-shattering roar shook the Cosmic Void as a massive purple-black beast, stretching a trillion kilometers, bellowed. From its monstrously savage maw, dazzling light began to gather.
BANG!
A purple-white light beam, hundreds of billions of kilometers thick, erupted forth, piercing through space-time dimensions, crossing over ten light-years in an instant, and striking the boundless body of the Nine Nether Monster.
The radiant, dazzling light immediately illuminated the entire Cosmic Void, its brilliance spanning past and future, annihilating everything.
Mixed within were the furious roars of the Nine Nether Monster’s nine heads. Amidst the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s Breath, its scale armor shattered, and vast swaths of black flesh and blood exploded.
But the Nine Nether Monster’s speed of reaction was terrifyingly fast.
As soon as the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s Breath surged, its massive tail, spanning two light-years, swept across space-time, collapsing all eras in its wake.
This strike’s speed defied physical laws, arriving instantaneously at the head of the Eternal Darkness Dragon spewing its Breath.
BANG! The Breath dissipated, and a dark shadow flashed through the cosmos, followed by the shattering and explosion of a black burial ground a thousand light-years away.
Meanwhile, as the tail sent the Eternal Darkness Dragon flying, a black claw emerged from the Nine Nether Monster’s side, stretching across the heavens to envelop the halberd-wielding Jack Clark.
“Sky-Stepping Execution Blade, Eight Desolates Godslayer!”
Millions of purple-golden halberd radiances, each tens of trillions of kilometers long, soared into the sky, forming a destructive halberd peak that spanned one light-year.
The strike carried a power and sharpness that shattered heaven and earth, obliterating all timelines.
The moment it collided with the Nine Serenities Demon Claw, the halberd radiance bloomed like a lotus flower.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!!
The earth-shaking explosions reverberated once more, dazzling and eternal. The aftermath detonated hundreds of black continents within a radius of light-years.
ROAR! As Jack Clark entangled the Nine Nether Monster, the Eternal Darkness Dragon reappeared, its aura even more savage.
On its colossal body, fissures spanning tens of thousands of kilometers began to mend, and its shattered dorsal fins restored themselves in the blink of an eye.
But this time, the Eternal Darkness Dragon did not pounce on the Nine Nether Monster. Its gaze turned icy-cold, scanning the surroundings.
The battle had already raged for half a month, with evenly-matched exchanges. As Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon familiarized themselves with the surging powers, they also began to uncover the Monster’s weaknesses.

chapters.title: Chapter 1895: 708: Fate Reincarnation, Devouring Heaven and Earth_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1895: Chapter 708: Fate Reincarnation, Devouring Heaven and Earth_2
The opponent’s undying body was partially composed of nine Eternal Ancient Corpses.
Due to the incomplete refinement, the body appeared vast and overwhelming, full of oppression, but the cost was ‘slow’ movement, lacking coordination and flexibility when mobilizing immortal-level strength.
Even so, Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon could only face it head-on; suppressing the opponent was not possible.
The strength possessed by this Nine Nether Monster was far greater than Jack Clark anticipated; its full power during its prime ranked among the strongest in immortality, akin to the difference between the early period and late period.
Without the ability to suppress and defeat this opponent, Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s defeat was only a matter of time.
Unlike the Nine Nether Monster, which had recovered half of its strength, Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon were both in a state of limit breakthrough.
Although the past, future, and present had merged, allowing them to reach the Primordial Supreme Completion Realm, the outburst of dual super talents could be sustained for a long time, lasting for ten years without issue.
But ten years was merely the blink of an eye for immortal-level beings.
Once a battle of this level descended into stalemate, fighting for hundreds or thousands of years was commonplace, as both sides had endless energy and terrifying regenerative capabilities.
Thus, a solution to break the deadlock was imperative.
For instance, achieving a breakthrough during combat.
At this thought, the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s gaze turned toward the Cosmic Void behind the Nine Nether Monster, where black burial grounds floated.
On each of the immense black burial grounds, spanning dozens of light-years, stood towering steles beneath which lay shattered Eternal Ancient Corpses.
As Luo Jia’s body was completely devoured, only six of these Eternal Undying Corpses remained.
By devouring all six incomplete undying bodies, the undying power contained within them should enable the Eternal Darkness Dragon to complete its own undying body transformation, truly becoming an Eternal Ancient Beast.
Buzz! A lightning bolt entwined with fire exploded in the Void, flashing with indescribable speed.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Seeing the purple-black Colossus charging once again, seemingly as indestructible as a cockroach, the Nine Nether Monster let out chaotic roars, its nine pairs of eyes seething with terrifying killing intent.
This time, however, the lightning curve merely weaved around the Nine Nether Monster, tracing an arc toward the black burial grounds a hundred light-years away.
Meanwhile, behind Jack Clark, who stood holding a halberd, sixteen arms spread out, with a cosmic annihilation domain, spanning billions of kilometers, brimming with devastation, emerging above his head and radiating an aura of destroying Heaven and Earth.
Especially within the fragmented domain, the reflection of a massive, sinister ghostly face caused the Nine Nether Monster to flinch slightly.
Boom!
At full burst within the Apocalypse Form of the True King of Darkness, Jack Clark engaged the Nine Nether Monster in relentless combat. The purple-black Colossus then descended from the sky, shattering the vast black continent spanning dozens of light-years with a single strike.
Amid the earth-shaking explosions, an incomplete, half-body measuring a light-year emerged.
Above the massive corpse stood a stele towering trillions of kilometers high, condensed with black and gray mist, suppressing the power contained within the ‘corpse’ below.
Roar! A purple-red blade light, spanning hundreds of billions of kilometers, swept horizontally, annihilating all directions, destroying the World Suppressing Demon Stele with a single strike.
Suddenly, the Nine Nether Monster, who had been relentlessly suppressing Jack Clark, jerked its head around to glower at the purple-black Colossus destroying its burial grounds, its nine heads unleashing furious roars.
Yet soon after, the immense creature’s expression morphed to one of shock and anger.
Boom!
The Eternal Darkness Dragon’s enormous jaws opened in enraged fury as a world-devouring black hole emerged behind it, spanning several light-years in diameter, emitting horrifying devouring energy that engulfed the fragmented corpse below.
With its cultivation improving, the powers of the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s various lifeline talents simultaneously soared.
Whereas it took half a month to devour an undying corpse during its Primordial Monarch Realm with Henry’s assistance, now it consumed half a corpse in the blink of an eye.
This scene left the Nine Nether Monster furious beyond measure.
“Put, down, my, food!”
Boom!
The colossal body of the Nine Nether Monster pivoted, causing the Seventh Layer of the universe to tremble with unseen ripples. The shockwaves, akin to mountains quaking and seas roaring, extended across dozens of light-years.
Meanwhile, its tail, spanning two light-years long and resembling a colossal serpent clad in black scales, swept out to block the halberd skill opening the Heavens behind it.
But as the creature wrapped itself in billowing black-and-gray netherworld qi in an attempt to stop the Eternal Darkness Dragon, the fragmented corpse had already vanished into the black hole.
Unrelenting, the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s gaze shifted to another immense burial ground floating over fifty light-years away.
Boom, boom, boom!
At that moment, the black-and-gray mist permeating the universe boiled over, transforming into colossal black tentacles that wriggled in pursuit of the Eternal Darkness Dragon.
Roar! The giant beast roared, its double claws shimmering with black radiance, tearing apart the writhing tentacles of the nether.
“Your opponent is me.”
Jack Clark let out a thunderous cry, his body exploding into a chaotic halo spanning ten light-years in radius.
Nineteen layers of chaos halos interlaced together, forming a three-dimensional divine formation that imprisoned the Nine Nether Monster within.
Each of the nineteen layers of chaos halos embodied a power akin to the Primordial Rule, and under the Rule of Power’s dominance, the energy contained within left the Nine Nether Monster’s form visibly weighed down.
“Get, out, of, my, way!”
Expanding its form to five light-years, the Nine Nether Monster roared, unleashing an endless spray of black-gray mist from within its body, shattering all the chaos halos with explosive force.
Yet due to Jack Clark’s relentless and self-sacrificial entanglement, the Eternal Darkness Dragon had already reached another burial ground.
Boom!
An apocalyptic breath pierced through Heaven and Earth, blasting the enormous burial ground into fragments, as innumerable star-sized debris erupted skyward, radiating in all directions under the brilliance of a ‘nuclear explosion.’
Such immense power distorted space-time, causing many black burial fragments to pierce dimensions and vanish across countless spacetime matrices.
Among them, one black burial fragment drifted across tens of thousands of years of the past, piercing spacetime to emerge somewhere within the mythical world, resembling a burning meteor descending from the heavens and shrinking down to merely a few kilometers.
Boom! Upon impact, the black fragment shattered vast stretches of land spanning tens of thousands of kilometers.
The tremendous commotion startled a nearby emerging civilization of different races, drawing their attention.
This black burial fragment was merely an insignificant piece among the shattered burial ground, yet as it disappeared across spacetime, the Eternal Darkness Dragon instinctively glanced at it.
In the depths of warped spacetime, the Eternal Darkness Dragon vaguely discerned a familiar image.
In the depths of pitch-black void, a floating black land, merely the size of a hundred meters, hovered.
Amidst the black land rested a silver hibernation pod, five meters long, three meters wide, and bearing an integrated modeling brimming with science-fiction aesthetics.
Through the faintly opaque lid of the hibernation pod, a sleeping girl could be seen, lying silently within.
Though the vision flashed by in an instant, the Eternal Darkness Dragon immediately recognized the scene as the burial ground Mathilda Ward had entered to transcend death and enter hibernation.
The burial ground Mathilda Ward had hibernated on originated from here.
Although it was merely an insignificant fragment of the grounds housing Eternal Ancient Corpses, under the influence of Netherworld Qi and undying aura, it still carried a certain divinity.
This enabled Mathilda Ward to successfully transcend life and death and reconstruct her body.
Moreover, the burial ground’s aura imbued Mathilda Ward with a life essence that surpassed that of myths; though her strength grew daily, she still could not break through to the Legendary Realm.
For in essence, she already belonged to chaos life.
At that moment, the Eternal Darkness Dragon faintly sensed a mysterious cycle of fate.
Yet it quickly steeled its gaze, its jaws once again opened wide, as the world-devouring black hole behind it reappeared, emitting horrifying gravitational force to engulf the fragmentary undying corpse below.
Boom!
“Put, down, my, food!”
The Nine Nether Monster erupted into an even greater fury.
[]

chapters.title: Chapter 1896: 709
chapters.content:
Chapter 1896: Chapter 709
Chapter 709
Boom!
A purple-black dragon claw, spanning one light-year and as massive in diameter as a formation of stars a hundred million times the size of the sun, descended, instantly burying and shattering the burial ground of an Undying Body.
Continental blocks spanning over a dozen light-years were obliterated, and the destructive aftershocks shook the cosmos, resonating through time immemorial.
Even the ancient battlefield below suffered collateral damage, as one by one, primordial and higher beings among the different races raised their heads, gazing gravely toward the unattainable Seventh Layer of the universe.
The battle there was unbelievably fierce.
Roar!
Just as the Eternal Darkness Dragon shattered the third burial ground, a tentacle spanning the Void suddenly swept toward it. Formed by hundreds of strands of black-gray mist, the appendage stretched over a dozen light-years.
The massive tentacle, large enough to shroud tens of star systems, radiated an immortal aura so destructive that it tore through layers of space-time dimensions along its path.
Because of a momentary pause while destroying the burial ground, the Eternal Darkness Dragon was unable to evade.
Boom!
Under a terrifying strike spanning dozens of light-years, expanses of blackened land, ranging from the size of small planets to colossal millions of kilometers, were utterly annihilated, dissipating entirely into energy.
Amid the violent waves of destruction stood a behemoth wreathed in purple-black flames of light. Black flames leapt across its surface, unshaken and monumental.
In its golden vertical pupils, blazing with purple-black lightning, a gaze of cold cruelty flickered as its claws gripped a fragment of Undying Remains, its aura bloodthirsty and overwhelming.
If the true body of the Nine Nether Monster had personally attacked, even the Eternal Darkness Dragon would have exercised some caution.
But this tentacle, merely infused with an immortal rule condensed from the Netherworld Qi, was not enough to breach the defenses of the Eternal Darkness Dragon.
The innate Lifeline Talent of the Black Hole Tyrant Body had elevated the defense of the Eternal Darkness Dragon to a peerless level within the same rank, capable of contending with opponents a full major realm above.
The Lifeline Talent itself was a powerful, explosive trump card that allowed temporary battles beyond its level.
Under normal conditions, a Primordial Beast can only develop one Lifeline Talent, as evolving it to the Deification Realm is exceptionally difficult—even for a Primordial being.
It’s only after breaking through to the True Emperor level and surpassing ancient eras that one could form additional talents, one at a time.
However, for the Eternal Darkness Dragon, Lifeline Talents were so numerous that they drove other behemoths of the same rank to madness. As long as its realm reached the threshold and Creation Force sufficed, it could form one new talent per minor realm.
Stacking these talents, its combat strength reached heaven-defying levels.
Roar! Roar! Roar!!
The “gaze” of the Eternal Darkness Dragon provoked the Nine Nether Monster into an even deeper fury despite being over a hundred light-years away. Its nine heads let out disordered, chaotic roars.
Unfolding its twisted true form, stretching five full light-years in length, and augmented further by massive tentacles of black-gray mist, the Nine Nether Monster presented a form of terrifyingly colossal proportions.
Its tentacles whipped the fabric of space, causing the entire cosmic starlit canopy to tremble violently.
Though it purposely allowed the behemoth to devour those contaminated remains, that didn’t mean that creature could challenge its supremacy.
Just as the monstrous entity geared to strike, golden-white light coalesced before it, revealing the towering figure of Jack Clark, standing resolutely with a halberd. His form spanned trillions of kilometers.
Assuming the apocalyptic True King of Annihilation form, Jack Clark appeared supremely majestic and sacred.
Yet compared to the gargantuan true form of the Nine Nether Monster, he appeared insignificant. Even stars in Jack Clark’s hands seemed no more than the size of ants.
Blocking the Nine Nether Monster, Jack Clark refrained from attacking immediately. His gaze locked onto the monstrosity shrouding the starry sky, and he opened his mouth slowly.
“I’m quite curious—who injured you millions of years ago, given your strength?”
“Was it the Three Great Suns hanging above the Vast World, or another supreme existence from the Ninth Heavenly Realm deep within the Chaos Sea?”
The kind of power that could obliterate the full, undying true form of this Nine Nether Monster could only belong to an entity stronger, one dwelling in the Ninth Heavenly Realm.
Beings of such caliber were exceedingly rare, even amidst the Endless Chaotic Sea.
Even at the peak of the mythical world of Eternal Behemoths, it had commanded only two behemoths of such magnitude.
As for the crimson sun suspended beyond the heavens, it sought to corrode the mythical world but was ultimately suppressed by a certain Eternal Behemoth within the crimson “Supreme Plane” beyond the heavens.
Of course, despite his curiosity, Jack Clark was really aiming to buy himself time to recover.
The pressure of facing this giant creature alone was immense. Under the raging, relentless assaults of the Immortal Monster, even his defensive true body had fractured multiple times.
While he could restore himself to peak condition in the blink of an eye, the toll on his Origin was considerable.
“You… want… to stall.”
The response to Jack Clark was two enormous pale claws, shaped like hybrids of blades and hooks, with sharp bone spurs rising from their surfaces. They exuded a terrifying aura that plunged all living creatures into despair.
Boom! A fierce battle erupted again.
While Jack Clark engaged the Nine Nether Monster, the Eternal Darkness Dragon swallowed the third fragment of the shattered Undying Body, feeling an overwhelming sensation of fullness.
Though the Eternal Darkness Dragon had devoured the remnants of the Undying Body, they were merely stored in its “stomach.”
Unlike its previous ability to devour the flesh and blood of behemoths and instantly refine them into biological energy required by its body, this time was different.
However, unlike the Nine Nether Monster, the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s digestive space housed a massive rotating white Divine Script, emanating mysterious radiance.
This rune was the Eternal Divine Script left behind by Henry long ago, serving to suppress the Undying Demon Body while aiding the Doomsday Emperor Dragon in refining it.
Now, under the luminous radiance of this Eternal Divine Script, the first devoured fragment of the Undying Remains began to “melt,” transforming into the purest immortal Origin.
Boom!
An unending torrent of energy surged throughout its body. The Eternal Darkness Dragon’s flesh, cells, and bones expanded at an alarming speed, its scale armor stretching wide.
Crackle crackle! The colossal body of the Eternal Darkness Dragon began to grow and swell with incredible rapidity.

chapters.title: Chapter 1897: 709_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1897: Chapter 709_2
Especially the indestructible force contained within this energy caused the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s body to rapidly transform into an Undying Body. Its aura surged instantly, becoming even more ferocious.
However, amidst the energy fueling the transformation into an Undying Body, strands of black energy were intertwined.
These threads of Netherworld Qi, containing the indomitable will of the Nine Nether Monster, were intensely overbearing, filled with corrosive and polluting characteristics, eroding the Emperor Dragon’s flesh and blood as they merged.
Squish, squish!!
Under the influence of the Netherworld energy, robust muscle fibers dissolved and disintegrated into richer black energy, spreading into the surroundings.
Just as the Netherworld energy began to diffuse, the compressed cells, shining like stars, erupted with brilliant light, releasing a dense black-red energy.
From deep within these cells, majestic and ferocious dragon roars resounded.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Shadows of black-red colossal beasts bellowed and burst forth from the depths of these cells, rushing at the black-gray energy spreading in all directions.
These shadows of black-red colossal beasts embodied the bloodline power containing the will of the Eternal Darkness Dragon.
Hiss, hiss!!
From the black energy came eerie, cold hissing sounds, and vaguely, a grotesque and distorted monster resembling countless coiled black serpents appeared.
In an instant, the black-red energy collided with the black energy, engaging in a fierce clash between the bloodline power and the indestructible will within.
No earth-shaking shockwaves emerged—only the brutal annihilation and mutual consumption of energies.
Under the assault of the dark red bloodline energy, the black energy dissipated continuously. At the same time, as it extinguished the Netherworld energy and indestructible will, the bloodline power also consumed some energy in the process.
Yet this negligible consumption meant nothing to the Eternal Darkness Dragon, whose recovery ability was terrifying.
As the corrosive Netherworld energy was one by one annihilated, the Nine Nether Monster, under Jack Clark’s “restraint,” immediately sensed a shift.
The Netherworld energy infused with its indestructible will inside its broken Undying Body was vanishing!!
How could this be!
Suddenly, astonishment surfaced in the eyes of all nine heads of the Nine Nether Monster, for this defied its expectations.
That monstrous beast with transcendent combat power, yet only at the realm of Primordial Supreme Perfection, was actually capable of resisting the corruption and pollution of its Netherworld energy that carried its indestructible will.
Not only that, its bloodline embodying supremacy could even obliterate its will.
Even when merging with the power of rules, exerting corrosive dominance over spirit power frameworks typically required an equivalent strength for mutual destruction.
In other words, the bloodline of this monstrous beast had minimally reached the high tier of Heavenly Tier, with a life essence foundation equal to, or perhaps exceeding, its own.
It might even possess a bloodline at the pinnacle of Heavenly Tier, comparable to the Ninth Heavenly Realm… As this realization dawned, madness flared within the Nine Nether Monster’s eyes.
Jealousy, murderous intent, and greed filled all nine pairs of pupils.
Roar, roar, roar!!
Devour—it decided to devour the monstrous beast, absorb its flesh and blood, seize its pinnacle bloodline potentially comparable to the Ninth Heavenly Realm, and harness the potential to step into the Eternal Great Sun.
Boom!!
The massive body of the Nine Nether Monster expanded again, now encased in blood-red sharp spikes entwined with black smoke, making it appear incredibly grotesque.
With the eruption of its Eternal Origin, the Nine Nether Monster’s aura surged, suppressing universal laws and asserting dominance over all.
Its incomprehensible strength created horrific visions within the surrounding black-gray mist—endless creatures’ despair, lamentations, and apocalyptic destruction across worlds.
Boom!
In the shadow of claws cloaked in blood-red spikes spanning a light-year’s breadth, the universe fissured. Jack Clark’s diamond-shaped protective light shattered under the Nine Nether Monster’s strike, sending him flying with tremendous impact.
Roar! At that precise moment, a more ferocious roar detonated like thunder.
A colossal purple-black beast expanded from ten trillion kilometers to fifteen trillion kilometers in moments, its menacing double wings obscuring the skies as it promptly appeared above the Nine Nether Monster.
The Eternal Darkness Dragon clasped its double claws high in the sky, each movement akin to the grip of a grandmaster performing a ritual hand sign.
Within its claws, boundless strength converged, forming a dazzling purple-black hole radiating waves of energy that even the Nine Nether Monster instinctively feared, crashing down mercilessly.
Boom!
The black “forcefield” surrounding the Nine Nether Monster shattered. Half of its head’s scale armor exploded, its colossal body staggering under the sheer impact, retreating a step backward.
With the infusion of indestructible remnants, and under the abundant indestructible force and energy, the Eternal Darkness Dragon completed twenty percent of its transformation into an Undying Body.
The exponential growth of its form enhanced its strength to even greater heights.
In the synergy of its Terminal Form and Dark Star Heavenly Gate, the tremendous amplifications of power incrementally multiplied geometrically, barely enabling it to confront the Nine Nether Monster head-on.
This outcome only fueled the Nine Nether Monster’s fury.
Earlier, it had refrained from fully blocking the monstrous beast, permitting it to devour those eternal corpses, intending to use the Netherworld Qi fused within the corpses to corrupt it.
The ultimate goal was to consume this combat-monster of unparalleled strength.
Following that, it planned to target the equally monstrous alien strong man, integrating them both into its being.
But what it never expected was that the Doomsday Emperor Dragon possessed two lifeline talents—Devouring and Evolution. Furthermore, as its bloodline ascended through levels of the Primordial Realm, it continuously refined, reaching the epitome of Heavenly Tier.
Rather than succumbing to the contamination of the Netherworld Qi, the Eternal Darkness Dragon utilized its digestion of the indestructible remnants for rapid growth, skyrocketing in power.
Boom, boom, boom!!
Under the joint assault of the Eternal Darkness Dragon and Jack Clark, the battle intensified, with waves of indestructible energy reverberations shaking the entire Ancient Battlefield.
Within the Sixth Level of the battlefield, figures radiating True Emperor-level pressures emerged beneath the colorful curtain of light.

chapters.title: Chapter 1898: 709_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1898: Chapter 709_3
Sparkling Heaven, Reincarnation, and Skyflame Supreme all raised their heads solemnly, gazing at the violently shaking multicolored radiance. Even they seemed a little tense.
Because the outcome of the battle above determined the survival or annihilation of every civilization in the Ancient Battlefield.
At this moment, Sparkling Heaven, who had already suppressed Denny Kaye and the strong men of the Golden Tribe, suddenly spoke: “Reincarnation, do you think we should go up and provide support?”
The words of the Blazing Heaven True Emperor immediately silenced the atmosphere.
The Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor slowly shook his head: “The corruptive power of that Nine Nether Monster is too overwhelming. If we go up, we’d only be a hindrance. Waiting here is the best option.”
“Alright,” Sparkling Heaven True Emperor nodded, realizing this suggestion might have been presumptuous.
Even strong men like Luo Jia from the Everlasting Realm had been polluted, let alone them. If they went up, they might be eroded by the monster’s power, which would distract Jack Clark instead.
However, the waiting period that followed turned out to be rather prolonged.
Amid the tremors that caused waves across the layered cosmos of the Ancient Battlefield, time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, ten years had passed.
Such an extended interval surprised the Reincarnation True Emperor and the others guarding the entrance to the Seventh Layer while also causing them to let out a small sigh of relief.
If the battle had been at a stalemate for this long, it meant that Jack Clark and the Giant Beast, even if falling behind, weren’t far apart.
Under such circumstances, even if things couldn’t hold out, they could retreat unscathed.
Later, with Jack Clark leading, uniting the strength of all Peak Civilization warriors would be enough to seal the entrance, preventing the Nine Nether Monster from descending.
With this thought, Skyflame Supreme and the others exchanged glances, a faint smile of relief appearing on their faces.
Meanwhile, as the warriors below assumed Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon were barely holding back that monster, the situation above told a very different story.
In the violently chaotic black Void, a Black-red Colossal Beast—its body expanded to a length of one light-year—roared, its every movement releasing transcendental force that shook the heavens.
With each claw strike, it would obliterate either the paw or part of the body of the even larger Nine Nether Monster.
With every blade light from its ten-light-year-long black-red Tail Blade, it would tear through space-time, splitting the Nine Nether Monster’s body with a massive crack while simultaneously forming a black abyss, spanning dozens of light-years in the Cosmic Void and lingering long after.
Over these ten years, using warfare to nurture growth, and continuously devouring and digesting seven shattered Everlasting Corpses, the Eternal Darkness Dragon had fully ascended into the Seventh Heaven Realm.
The Major Realm breakthrough brought with it an immense surge in strength, its body becoming even colossal, enabling the Eternal Darkness Dragon to suppress the Nine Nether Monster outright.
This outcome enraged and maddened the Nine Nether Monster further.
However, despite the breakthrough into the Seventh Heaven Realm, the Eternal Darkness Dragon, against this monster that still possessed Immortal strength, could only suppress—it couldn’t yet deliver the ultimate blow.
Reaching this caliber of existence, the difficulty of suppressing, defeating, or exterminating grew exponentially.
At the edge of the battlefield between the immense beast and monster, Jack Clark, whose true body had shrunk to a mere three trillion kilometers, sat cross-legged, his aura now several times stronger.
Behind him, twenty Chaos Halos unfurled, spanning billions of kilometers, appearing unimaginably vast and sacred.
The feedback from the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s ascension into the Seventh Heaven Realm—its evolutionary growth—had also made Jack Clark’s true body even more powerful. However, the lack of Immortal strength prevented him from breaking through as well.
Watching the monster viciously raging and battling against the Eternal Darkness Dragon, Jack Clark’s eyes narrowed slightly: “It seems I’ll need to take some risks.”
This Nine Nether Monster, which had reconstituted its fragmented true body and reached the Immortal realm, was essentially prime prey for the newly ascended Eternal Darkness Dragon.
If it could be suppressed and devoured…
The Immortal force it harbored, along with the Chaos Energy it had accumulated over a million years at the Seventh Layer Battlefield, might very well propel the Eternal Darkness Dragon to the peak of the Seventh Heaven Realm.
With this thought, Jack Clark let out a deep breath, gradually standing up.
To suppress this Immortal monster, besides resorting to Deification Unity—momentarily achieving ten-thousandfold invincible strength—there was one other method.
That was to use Soul Force as a medium to unify the strength of his human true body and the Giant Beast Body of the Eternal Darkness Dragon.
Jack Clark had used this move once before during his first encounter at the Frontline Battlefield, the Heavenly Abyss Battlefield, against the Purgatory Great Demon Kings.
Back then, Jack Clark, who was only at the Ninth Heavens Realm, had fused with a Power Projection of the Thunderflame Behemoth he summoned—its strength only one-tenth of a true Great Demon King.
In an instant, their combined strength skyrocketed to rival a Great Demon King.
But after using this technique once, Jack Clark had never employed it again.
As Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s strength increased, an invisible pull between the man and beast subtly grew stronger.
This pull originated from the natural yearning of the Soul Source for completeness. Though faint and suppressible, it still made Jack Clark uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1899: 710: Suppressing and Devouring, the Great Calamity Descends
chapters.content:
Chapter 1899: Chapter 710: Suppressing and Devouring, the Great Calamity Descends
As Jack Clark stood up, the overwhelming aura he unleashed caused the surrounding cosmos to tremble, like an unfathomable Giant Beast on par with the Eternal Darkness Dragon.
Roar! At this moment, massive black fanged teeth emerged from the Void, hundreds of light-years away, sealing all directions.
From afar, it appeared as though the monstrous head of a creature spanning tens of light-years was emerging from the darkness, devouring the enormous Eternal Darkness Dragon along with the surrounding space-time in a single bite.
Boom!
A ring of purple-black lightning exploded, shattering the dark maw along with those black fanged teeth. The dazzling light emanating from it illuminated the Seventh Layer battlefield almost completely.
At the center of the purple-black lightning, brimming with an aura of ultimate annihilation, a colossal beast-dragon of purple-black color, stretching trillions of kilometers tall, stood upright, roaring toward the heavens.
Roar!
The Eternal Darkness Dragon roared skyward, its double claws clenching in mid-air, suffused with the indomitable Rule of Power ‘Strength’ that spread across a radius of hundreds of light-years.
The overlapping Rule of Power amplified the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s strength to a terrifying extent, even causing the Nine Nether Monster’s massive form to momentarily freeze.
Just then, the Eternal Darkness Dragon suddenly ripped with its double claws.
Slash!! A massive crack tore open the ‘cosmos’ spanning a hundred light-years, forming a gigantic black fissure.
Under this world-shattering power, the Nine Nether Monster roared, its external body torn apart, revealing a colossal wound stretching tens of trillions of kilometers—an opening beneath its scale armor exposing its flesh and blood.
However, referring to it as flesh and blood would be inaccurate; it more resembled chains of rules glimmering faintly with black lights.
Whoosh! Gray-black mist squirmed, and the enormous wound instantly healed as if it had never existed.
Just as the enraged Nine Nether Monster prepared to mobilize its power for vengeance, its colossal body suddenly paused. Its nine heads turned solemnly toward the crown of the Eternal Darkness Dragon.
There, Jack Clark had inexplicably appeared.
To this human, who had previously joined forces with the Giant Beast to contend against it, the Nine Nether Monster naturally was no stranger.
Though sharing the same Sixth Heavenly Realm Perfection level, his astonishing combat prowess rivaled the Seventh Heaven Ancient Extreme level. His mastery of absolute power allowed him to barely hold his own against the Nine Nether Monster.
However, after the Giant Beast had devoured countless ancient remains and experienced a dramatic surge in power, this human had retreated from the battlefield.
At this moment, as sensed by the Nine Nether Monster, Jack Clark’s aura had become exponentially stronger than it was a decade ago, his body now exuding an undying essence almost indistinguishable from the Everlasting Realm.
This is troublesome.
In this instant, even the Nine Nether Monster, with its monstrous power and terrifying demonic aura, revealed an unusual heaviness in the nine frenzied and distorted eyes.
Facing the massively overpowered Giant Beast, it had to exert all its strength merely to avoid being overwhelmed; now, this human, whose strength had grown further, had joined the fray!
Should it retreat? The thought of withdrawal instinctively surfaced in the Nine Nether Monster’s mind.
But the very next moment, that thought was ruthlessly extinguished.
As the Immortal King of the Ninth Abyss, having consumed endless worlds and corrupted billions of lives, how could it possibly be driven away by a human who had just broken through to the Everlasting, along with a Primordial Supreme? How could it abandon its lair of millions of years?
The battlefield, forged from the clash of two Eternal Behemoths piercing through supreme chaos, was, to the Nine Nether Monster, a natural place for healing.
Here, the dissipated eternal essence far exceeded that below, and the endlessly absorbed supreme chaos energy could repair its wounded Divine Soul and accelerate the reshaping of its True Body.
For a million years, it had nearly transformed the Seventh Layer battlefield into a ‘greenhouse,’ with the entire layer of the cosmos saturated with rich, pure supreme chaos energy.
Saturated with the rules and elements of supreme chaos.
Thus, whether for the Immortal King’s dignity or this healing ‘greenhouse,’ it had no choice but to expel these two intruders.
Initially, the beast’s plan was to wear down Jack Clark and the Eternal Darkness Dragon, devouring and merging them in the end, but this idea had been crushed by the rapidly-strengthening Eternal Darkness Dragon.
While the Nine Nether Monster’s mind flashed through countless notions in an instant, an overwhelming force appeared before it, terrifying enough to make it tremble.
Atop the head of the Eternal Darkness Dragon, Jack Clark stood, with a colossal projection emerging behind him—a figure donning an Imperial Robe and wielding an Emperor Seal, emitting a devastating wave of soul energy.
The sheer magnitude of this soul energy was so profound that even the Nine Nether Monster seemed startled.
And from deep within the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s body, another equally potent soul energy was drawn forth, manifesting as a black gold claw-tip searing with white flames, slowly extending outward.
Simultaneously, the one-light-year-tall soul projection behind Jack Clark slightly bowed its head, lightly touching the claw-tip in that realm where consciousness and time approached stillness.
At the moment their two souls touched, an indescribable sense of fulfillment arose.
Accompanying it was a deeper impulse to merge—to become a more complete, more terrifying life form, surpassing the billions of heavens, transcending chaos itself.
Whoosh! Jack Clark exhaled deeply, forcibly suppressing the intense urge to fuse, instead controlling the two souls to harmonize in resonance.
Boom!
From the depths of the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s body erupted radiant blood-red light, seeping across space-time, dyeing the gray and black mist and even the Seventh Layer cosmos crimson.
The gathering blood light faintly materialized into the shadow of a ferocious beast, spanning tens of thousands of light-years.
As the shadow of the monstrosity formed from the Dragon of the End’s bloodline appeared, a Heavenly Tier pressure far above the Immortal Boundary exploded forth.
At the same time, the beast shadow lunged toward the Eternal Darkness Dragon, merging back into its body.
Roar! In an instant, a terrifyingly boundless aura shot through the Cloud Sky, trembling the heavens, shaking innumerable worlds.
The formidable force pierced through the Seventh Layer cosmos, radiating across the Ancient Battlefield, even spreading to the surrounding Chaos Sea, causing nearby worlds to quake incessantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1900: 710: Suppressing and Devouring, the Great Calamity Descends_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1900: Chapter 710: Suppressing and Devouring, the Great Calamity Descends_2
Even the distant mythical world trembled slightly, and the three golden, red, and blue stars hanging above the firmament burst into dazzling brilliance.
Faint roars of three terrifying giant beasts echoed.
Roar! Roar!! Day suddenly turned to the dark night in the mythical world, and under the night sky, a moon and a Blood Moon simultaneously appeared, radiating an oppressive terror.
At the same time, in the Chaos Void outside the mythical world, countless stars suddenly began to shimmer.
Each star represented a primordial-level giant beast. Their eyes, filled with shock and solemnity, were fixated in the direction of the Ancient Battlefield.
Even in the Xutian Divine Dragon Clan Territory, the silver Divine Dragon circling their world growled gravely: “A giant beast has stepped into the Reincarnation Immortal Realm. Who could it be?”
In its low growl, the Purple Proliferation Dragon displayed a trace of doubt in its gaze.
It couldn’t shake the faint sense of familiarity about the terrifying destructive aura rippling through the nearby Chaos Sea.
Above the skies of the Xu Tian Divine Dragon world, deep within a radiant purple-gold energy cocoon, a Purple Divine Dragon with a gargantuan body spanning a million meters slowly opened its eyes, letting out a dazed cooing sound.
“It’s my brother’s aura.”
“Roar! How… how could it be… How could it be… You, you are actually one!”
The Ancient Battlefield bathed in crimson was dominated by a monstrous black-gray tentacled being that spanned over tens of light-years. Its enraged roar vibrated across dimensions.
In its extreme shock, even its previously slow speech—the result of a perpetual stutter—was miraculously cured. Its nine eyes, brimming with crazed killing intent, locked onto a distant figure.
There, amidst the blood-red glow, stood a giant beast towering three light-years tall, its entire body jet-black and engraved with intricate patterns of blood-red lightning.
What terrified the Nine Nether Monster most was the realization that the Eternal Darkness Dragon and that human were, in essence, one entity.
At this moment, the two’s Soul Resonance and the fusion of the Life Origin within their True Bodies caused their realms to surge instantly to the Everlasting Realm’s upper limit, nearly touching immortality.
The crimson-purple lightning that coiled around the Eternal Darkness Dragon’s body made even the Nine Nether Monster’s scalp tingle.
This crimson-purple lightning represented the Supreme Rules of Chaos and Destruction mastered by the Eternal Darkness Dragon, fused with the Rule of Power and Primordial Genesis Rules wielded by Jack Clark, producing an extraordinary phenomenon.
The four Supreme Primordial Rules—each sufficient to cultivate to the Ninth Heavenly Realm Limit—merged terrifyingly in this moment.
The presence of the End-Dark World-Destroying Emperor Dragon alone exuded such annihilative power that the very universe, infused with the highest Chaotic Rules, began to collapse.
This revealed the terrifying essence of Jack Clark’s original Soul Talent, the divine power born when honed to its ultimate peak.
The higher Jack Clark’s cultivation realm grew, the more fearsome his divine-empowered fusion became. Back in the Ancient Realm, when Jack Clark merged with the Thunderflame Emperor Dragon, his realm had instantly surged to the borderline of the True Spirit Limit and Primordial.
Now, even with only Soul Resonance, the merging of his Life Essence and the rules he commanded caused his strength to ascend to near-invincibility in an instant.
“It’s a lie, all of it’s a lie!”
The colossal Nine Nether Monster roared, its massive form splitting at its center, revealing a pale-white serpentine eye spanning an entire light-year beneath.
BOOM! In an instant, an unstoppable immortal aura burst forth.
This pale-white serpent eye was the monster’s true form—a vital fragment of its essence preserved after its True Body was destroyed under grievous injury eons ago.
WHOOSH!
From the serpent eye came a transparent beam of shocking light, tens of trillions of kilometers in diameter. Under the pale glow, the entire universe began to fade, its rules disintegrating.
In its wake, space and matter collapsed, compressing infinitely. From afar, it resembled the terrifying activation of a two-dimensional plane.
Yet, after this dimensional-degrading attack powerful enough to collapse the universe, the massive pale serpent eye dimmed, its Divine Soul Intent weakened by fifty percent, reflecting the move’s enormous consumption.
