Facing the overpoweringly ascended Eternal Darkness Dragon, the Nine Nether Monster—despite initially scheming to wear it down—was now fighting for its life.
However…
ROAR!
The ferocious behemoth shrouded in crimson-purple lightning roared. Behind it, a blazing streak of blood-red light sliced forward, instantly splitting the pale beam of light in two.
A fan-shaped black void hundreds of light-years wide was slashed into existence, bisecting the enormous Nine Nether Monster horizontally.
BOOM!
In the very moment the dimension-slashing attack of the Nine Nether Monster was annihilated, a pair of massive claws wreathed in crimson-purple lightning descended from the heavens, bypassing all constraints of space-time to land right above its head.
THUD! THUD! THUD!!
Under those claws imbued with supreme power, the nine conjoined heads of the Nine Nether Monster exploded one by one.
Instantly, a horrific wail resounded across the entire Ancient Battlefield.
ROAR!
The Eternal Darkness Dragon bellowed, its muscles bulging as it flexed its arms. With an explosion of invincible force, it savagely tore apart the Nine Nether Monster’s already bisected body, shredding it into four pieces in an instant.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!!
Chunks of the monster’s dismembered True Body were surrounded by crackling crimson-purple lightning, which sparked and exploded, leaving the flesh and blood mangled and seeping black smoke.
The black smoke emerged from the annihilation of the monster’s will contained in its flesh and blood.
Facing the Seventh-Heaven-Limit-bound Eternal Darkness Dragon—whose combat strength surpassed even immortality—the Nine Nether Monster, already weakened to a mere fraction of its former might, was utterly crushed.
ROAR!
Standing in the center of a sea of crimson-purple lightning, the domineering Eternal Darkness Dragon gripped a chunk of flesh spanning billions of kilometers, biting into it directly.
BOOM! Its blood-streaked maw caused the flesh to explode, spreading shreds across the battlefield.
A more piercing, agonized scream echoed through the Void.
Revealing its second trait, the Eternal Darkness Dragon—should its opponent fall beneath its overwhelming might—would unleash its barbaric, devouring nature through its innate Devouring Talent.
At this moment, the outcome of this battle was clear.
However, those such as Sparkling Heaven below remained unaware of the unfolding conclusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 1901: 710: Suppressing and Devouring, the Great Calamity Descends_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1901: Chapter 710: Suppressing and Devouring, the Great Calamity Descends_3
Looking up at the violently trembling seven-colored light screen overhead, which dyed layer upon layer of worlds with blood-red light, and hearing the anguished howls echoing across the battlefield, all the strong men of civilization wore grave expressions.
This anomaly persisted for nearly half a year before finally subsiding.
Even the blood light that enveloped the Seventh Layer of the universe began to fade, rendering the entire world eerily silent, as though nothing had ever occurred.
“Has the great war… ended?” Skyflame Supreme muttered uncertainly.
“Unclear.” Others subtly shook their heads, their faces still clouded, as they continued to stare up at the seven-colored light screen.
Even though the intense battle waves that had raged for over a decade on the Seventh Layer battlefield had disappeared, an inexplicable oppression lingered over everyone.
It felt as if a far more terrifying being was lurking above them, trapped in some state of hibernation and transformation, growing stronger by the moment.
The entity had become so powerful that its intangible emanations, even after piercing through a layer of the Boundary Wall of the universe, made their legs tremble and weaken, evoking an irresistible urge to kneel and worship.
Did Jack Clark and the Giant Beast emerge victorious, or was it the Nine Nether Monster that triumphed?
Just as Silver Wing Supreme and others hesitated over whether to dare to release an avatar and venture into the Seventh Layer battlefield for reconnaissance, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor’s expression suddenly shifted slightly.
Buzz! In Sparkling Heaven True Emperor’s hand, a thousand-meter golden mirror floated into view.
Inside the mirror appeared the figure of Sara Williams, but her expression now was overwhelmingly heavy as she gazed across at Sparkling Heaven True Emperor: “Master, something has gone awry in the Divine Realm.”
“What happened?” Sparkling Heaven True Emperor’s brow furrowed, and even the nearby Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor glanced over.
With a solemn face, Sara Williams explained, “Starting one month ago, many beings in the Divine Realm underwent sudden, grotesque mutations, swelling in size and transforming into bloodthirsty monsters that frantically devoured all surrounding life.”
“In addition, entire towns across many states vanished overnight—cities with populations of tens of thousands to millions disappeared into thin air.”
“Curiously, everything else—buildings, objects—remained intact, as though those people had never existed or were erased by some incomprehensibly powerful force.”
“Initially, these phenomena weren’t severe, but they still garnered the attention of disciples and Flame Wheel Great Emperor, prompting an investigation.”
“But the results yielded absolutely nothing—no origins, no traces—even heavenly mysteries, destiny, and foresight-based divine powers failed to perceive any signs.”
“As time moved on, these occurrences grew increasingly frequent, spreading across the Six Great Divine Domains.”
“Within one month, over a billion people have vanished and hundreds of millions have mutated into monsters, and due to the inability to uncover any useful information, I had no choice but to disturb you, Master.”
Sara Williams’ words caused Sparkling Heaven True Emperor and Reincarnation Divine Domain True Emperor’s faces to turn solemn.
And this terrifying anomaly wasn’t limited to the Six Great Divine Domains—the Human Federation’s Solar Divine Domain had also been afflicted, with millions disappearing in just one month.
Moreover, over a million individuals had suddenly mutated into bloodthirsty monsters, causing tens of millions of casualties, which instantaneously plunged the Federation into widespread panic.
Even Jack Clark, Glenn Clark, Adam Garcetti, and other king-level figures who had achieved breakthroughs over the past decade joined forces to investigate, yet still found no traces of answers.
Even Freya Louise, who managed portions of the Heavenly Dao’s power while stationed in the Solar Divine Domain, couldn’t “see” a single clue.
Standing atop the Sun’s expanded and searing surface, now swollen nearly tenfold to a diameter of tens of millions of kilometers, a colossal, platinum figure taller than a million meters gazed toward Blue Star’s direction.
“No matter what, Aunt cannot come to harm.” With those words, Freya Louise’s figure vanished into thin air.
This time, the mutation descended like a sudden Great Calamity, engulfing the Human Race, leaving countless people gripped by unease.

chapters.title: Chapter 1902: Emperor 711: Annihilate the Human Race, The Power of Eternity
chapters.content:
Chapter 1902: Emperor Chapter 711: Annihilate the Human Race, The Power of Eternity
Solar Divine Domain
The towering trunk of the Golden Divine Tree, stretching over a hundred thousand kilometers, unfolds its vast canopy, covering over two hundred thousand kilometers. Branches hundreds of kilometers thick spread out like planetary orbits.
Every single leaf on it is comparable to a city, several kilometers thick, with crisscrossing textures resembling mountain ranges, emitting a faint golden light that illuminates millions of kilometers in all directions.
In this place, there is no dark night, only eternal daylight, like the sacred realms depicted in Western mythical legends.
After over a decade of development, relying on the Eternal Golden Divine Tree to gather billions of the Human Race, Heavenly Feather Clan, Immortal Spirit Clan, and the Divine Gods Alliance of different races, the place has thrived immensely.
But today, this holy city is shrouded in oppressive silence.
Suddenly, a commotion erupts in the leaf-city located at the end of a golden branch.
Amid the panicked expressions of Heavenly Feather and Immortal Spirit Clan members in hotels and pavilions, dozens of humans on the streets below suddenly explode, their bodies swelling into towering bloodthirsty monsters over ten meters tall.
These monsters are completely covered in blood-red scales. Before their mutations, they only possessed the power of Seventh Layer Heaven or Eight Layer Heaven, but their auras surged by tens or even hundreds of times upon transforming.
Splurt!! Several Heavenly Feather Clan members and humans didn’t react in time and were torn into dozens of pieces by the claws of one monster, their blood spraying everywhere.
“Run! Another human has turned into a monster!”
“Quick, call the enforcement army! Another mutation occurred here!”
At the very instant those humans mutated, the Alliance people scattered from the surrounding streets and buildings, followed by an oppressive kingly aura descending upon the scene.
Boom! Under the tangible pressure of the laws, the air trembled, and the dozens of bloodthirsty monsters instantly staggered.
The rocks under these monsters shattered, fractures forming intricate spiderweb cracks extending hundreds of meters. From the cracks, golden light poured out, enveloping and suppressing them.
Roar!! The blood-red scaled monsters trapped in golden light howled at the heavens, their eyes insane and bloodthirsty, glaring desperately towards the sky.
In that space, distorted by immense power, the silhouettes of four formidable beings materialized. Among them stood a deity from the Heavenly Feather Clan, a general from the Immortal Spirit Clan, and Glenn Clark of the Human Race.
The three individuals stood respectfully behind a tall, broad-shouldered young man with black flowing hair, clad in Golden Armor, his expression solemn.
Gazing at the blood-red monsters below as they roared and struggled, Glenn Clark’s expression was grave: “These monsters are appearing more frequently, and as always, without any prior signs.”
The Heavenly Feather deity looked equally grave: “Recently, frequent mutations among humanity have caused significant casualties, plunging the Alliance into a state of panic.”
“We need to find countermeasures urgently, or the consequences will only grow more severe.”
The Immortal Spirit general nodded, respectfully turning to the broad-shouldered young man with draped black hair: “Your Majesty, what should we do next?”
Glenn Clark withdrew his gaze from the blood-red monsters below and slowly spoke, his voice deep and authoritative: “I will take these individuals with me to be dealt with later.”
“You all must stick to the plan, continue monitoring your assigned areas, and suppress any mutated monsters immediately upon appearance. Isolate the injured populace.”
“Understood.” The Heavenly Feather deity and Immortal Spirit general bowed their heads in deference.
Facing Glenn Clark, the true spirit powerhouse and the Human Race’s ‘first strong man’ and Eternal Monarch for over ten years, these mythical powerhouses of the Alliance dared not display the slightest negligence.
Boom! The space around the blood-red monsters ripped open, and Glenn Clark and Marcellus Larry vanished along with dozens of monsters.
Deep within the shadowy Void, black light ribbons covered in barbs were drawn out from the thousands of blood-red monsters, ultimately converging in Adam Garcetti’s hand, standing tall amidst the darkness.
Adam Garcetti turned towards Glenn Clark and Marcellus Larry, who were surrounded by golden radiance, his voice cold and tinged with gravity: “The force responsible for their mutations is growing stronger.”
Marcellus Larry’s expression darkened: “Mr. Garcetti, are we still unable to trace the source of this force?”
In the depths of darkness, Adam Garcetti, looking somewhat grim, shook his head solemnly: “Not only can we not trace the source, but we can’t even sense a single remnant trail from it.”
“This force has clearly surpassed conventional primordial levels; the entity behind it is likely of a True Emperor level.”
“Only beings that have already mastered Space-Time at the True Emperor level can silently achieve such feats, obscuring all fluctuations of the Primordial Rule from our perception.”
Recently, they had been researching the reasons behind humanity’s mutations. Though they had failed to locate the source, they uncovered the ruthlessness of the culprits.
Under the influence of the force that suddenly appeared, large numbers of humans were either annihilated out of thin air or instantly transformed into an entirely different species.
However, unlike the energy corruption from the mythical world in the past, these mutations appeared to create a seemingly stronger life form, yet their genes and even Life Origin were irreparably damaged.
Based on the rate of genetic sequence decay, these monsters could only persist for an hour before collapsing into pools of blood and dying completely.
Still, within their mutated genetic sequence, there was a complete predatory chain. As long as they devoured the flesh and blood of their kind, they could replenish energy and delay their decline.
This predatory trait was the reason they frantically slaughtered the surrounding Human Race.
But this consumption merely delayed their decay—their collapse into rotten flesh was inevitable within a month. It seemed impossible for them to develop into stronger lifeforms or form another monstrous civilization.
The decay of their genes, Life Origin, and Soul Source was so severe that even Glenn Clark and Adam Garcetti, who had stepped into True Spirit realms, were powerless to address it.
It was blatantly apparent that the ‘individual’ orchestrating these events aimed solely for the complete extinction of the Human Race.
Golden Divine Light flickered in Glenn Clark’s eyes, exuding an aura of authority: “Is it an unknown True Emperor powerhouse from the Gloomy Heaven Clan? Or a surviving member of the Golden Tribe’s primordial? Or perhaps a hidden figure from the Heavenly Punishment?”
“Only entities like these harbor such hatred for the Human Race.”

chapters.title: Chapter 1903: Emperor 711: Annihilate the Human Race, The Power of Eternity_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1903: Emperor Chapter 711: Annihilate the Human Race, The Power of Eternity_2
It has been twelve years since Jack Clark charged into the Ancient Battlefield. Eleven years ago, the clans of Denny Kaye, Gold, and Heavenly Punishment were utterly annihilated by the Human Race and the alliance of civilizations within the Ancient Battlefield.
Through True Martial Heavenly King and others from the Six Great Divine Domains, Glenn Clark and the others learned some details about the other side.
Meanwhile, over the span of ten years, due to Jack Clark’s influence, the Six Great Divine Domains provided massive support to the Human Alliance, including infrastructure development, cultural exchanges, resource allocations, and more.
Marcellus Larry’s expression was dark: “This incident is already beyond what we can handle. I propose activating the Primordial Heavenly Altar to seek help from the Divine Realm.”
“We do indeed need to contact the other side,” Glenn Clark nodded slowly.
At the peak of the Eternal Divine Tree, an altar constructed from gray boulders soared tens of thousands of meters high.
The altar was shaped like the Eight Diagrams, covered in ancient runes, and bore some resemblance to the one Sherry Williams used to contact Sara Williams in the past.
But this altar was far larger, surrounded by seven towering black steles, each standing a hundred thousand meters tall and inscribed with a character representing one of the Seven Great Emperors of ancient times.
Around the altar, aside from Glenn Clark and a few powerful figures from the alliance who remained nearby, dozens of Heavenly Feather Main Gods, deities, and Immortal Monarchs and Generals of the Immortal Spirit Clan had gathered.
Under the gaze of these figures, Glenn Clark formed a divine seal with his hand and pressed his palm down onto the altar.
Boom! The clouds trembled, and a golden rune, hundreds of meters in size, descended from the heavens, landing atop the altar.
Buzz!
The altar vibrated, resonating with the seven steles inscribed with the true names of the ancient emperors. In an instant, an invisible ripple shot into the sky, piercing through the Firmament of the mythical world.
Suddenly, in the distant Flame Wheel Divine Domain, another power was triggered, crossing space-time to descend.
Boom! The altar quaked, and the runes engraved on its surface lit up one by one, painting this World in a crimson, fiery starry sky.
Amidst the starry sky, blazing flames leapt together, forming an imposing throne. Upon the throne stood a middle-aged man clad in an Imperial Robe, radiating primordial-level pressure.
“Greetings, Flame Wheel Great Emperor!”
Except for Glenn Clark, all the Heavenly Feather Clan, Immortal Spirit Clan, and Human Experts present bowed respectfully.
Due to the Flame Wheel Great Emperor’s attention to the Blue Star Federation, he had been sporadically contacting the two realms for the past decade since breaking through to the primordial level.
Thus, figures like Marcellus Larry were familiar with such a primordial powerhouse.
Glenn Clark said seriously: “Forgive the intrusion, Your Majesty Flame Wheel.”
“No harm done.”
Seated high atop the fiery throne, the Flame Wheel Great Emperor slowly shook his head, his tone gentle: “With your character, you wouldn’t contact the Divine Realm unless it was a matter of great importance.”
“I suppose it’s due to the recent disappearances of many humans and the phenomenon of mutated bloodthirsty monsters.”
“…Your Majesty Flame Wheel, you already know,” the Flame Wheel Great Emperor’s words caused Glenn Clark and the others to pause.
The Flame Wheel Great Emperor spoke softly: “This Great Calamity involves all Humans—not just your side. The Six Great Divine Domains are experiencing this as well, and to a far worse degree.”
“Just yesterday, five Mythical Kings and one Titan Heavenly King of the Sword Ancient Divine Domain suddenly turned to ash, completely destroyed.”
“In the Slaughter Divine Domain, an Ancient Powerhouse mutated into a bloodthirsty monster, slaughtering three main cities and an entire continent, causing billions of deaths and injuries before being erased across dimensions by the True Emperor of the Divine Realm.”
“But even Sparkling Heaven True Emperor and the others couldn’t locate the origin of this power.”
Hiss!! Suddenly, gasps echoed around the altar. Even Glenn Clark’s face showed a trace of horror.
This crisis had already spread to the Mythical-level and beyond.
The bizarre power enveloping Humanity was undetectable even to True Emperor-level beings. Could the enemy be an existence stronger than the True Emperor, a primordial supreme being?
As the Human Alliance was gripped with unease due to the Flame Wheel Great Emperor’s revelations, an immense sight appeared in the shattered Seventh Layer of the Ancient Battlefield universe.
In the vast void lay a Black-red Colossal Beast, so massive that its true body spanned three light-years.
The surface of this colossal beast churned with black-gray mist, emitting terrifying roars that could make the scalp of even primordial powerhouses tingle.
As the Black-red Colossal Beast inhaled, the entire Seventh Layer universe responded, endlessly feeding it supreme, pure Chaos Energy that permeated the cosmos.
With its Infinite Evolution Talent, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon could grow limitlessly as long as energy was sufficient, until it reached the bottleneck of its current realm.
Thus, by devouring the true body of the Nine Nether Monster and transforming supreme Chaos Energy accumulated over millions of years, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon had grown to the limits of the Seventh Heavenly Realm.
It was now in the process of pillaging the immortal force of the Nine Nether Monster, aiming to undergo the metamorphosis into Immortal Boundary and enter the Eighth Heavenly Realm.
However, despite the power of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon and the monster’s current state—having only its Divine Soul Intent remaining—the immortal force it contained was far from sufficient for the Dragon to break through to the Immortal Boundary.
Moreover, due to the “reincarnation indestructible” characteristic of the Nine Nether Monster, even the Doomsday Emperor Dragon could not completely annihilate it.
Rather than “refining,” it would be more accurate to describe the current process as devouring its “energy” while suppressing the monster’s indestructible intent within countless cells deep inside its own body.
The Dragon planned to fully obliterate it after it eventually stepped into Immortal Boundary or even the Ninth Heavenly Realm.
Atop the head of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, Jack Clark sat cross-legged in his ordinary human form, his aura obscure yet powerful, only a small step away from attaining the Seventh Heavenly Realm.
The battle in the Ancient Battlefield had yielded tremendous gains for both Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon.
Once they finished digesting this harvest, the Dragon, comparable to an immortal being, would head to the edge of the Chaos Void to hunt True Emperor-level and above Chaotic Nightmare Ferocious Beasts to “exchange” for Eternal Air.
It was estimated that it wouldn’t take long before breaking through to Immortal Boundary completely.
Simultaneously, Jack Clark prepared to honor his agreement with Alvaron to hunt down the heavily injured Lord of Hell, splitting the supreme Hell Plane to convert it into Origin.
By then, his power would skyrocket further.
He planned to use the supreme plane’s forces to invade and plunder other Great Thousand Universes, rapidly accumulating enough Origin to break through to the Immortal Boundary.
Thinking about this, a faint smile appeared on Jack Clark’s face.
But just as Jack Clark mapped out his cultivation path, he suddenly looked ahead.
Even the Doomsday Emperor Dragon below him stirred from its hibernating “cultivation,” its colossal golden vertical pupils resembling star systems, projecting a terrifying gaze.
Without a sound, a power beyond time and dimensions, carrying annihilation intent, descended in an attempt to erase Jack Clark’s existence.
Boom!
The power clashed with the Eternal Force Field around Jack Clark, creating a strong impact that caused several black hairs atop the Doomsday Emperor Dragon’s head to sway slightly.
“Who is it?” Jack Clark narrowed his eyes.
The intensity of this power was comparable to a Primordial Overlord-level being, yet its arrival was so elusive that Jack Clark couldn’t perceive its origin.
Only as the power manifested “before him” did he become aware of it.
Could such a power come from an existence at the Immortal or even Ninth Heavenly Realm targeting him?
At the thought, Jack Clark’s blood-red pupils, silver pupils, and black-gold vertical pupils appeared simultaneously. The three powerful sight forces merged, instantly unleashing a terrifying vision across time and space.
Boom! The horrifying vision pierced dimensions, reversing time-space.
Using the mystical intuition provided by Heart’s Eye power, Jack Clark followed the faint sensation of danger, witnessing a terrifying image for an instant.
In the image, a black figure stood towering with its back to Jack Clark, its presence immensely majestic, situated at the ultimate “other shore.”
Opposing the black figure, Henry—once briefly encountered by Jack Clark—stood alongside a red figure engaged in a fierce battle.
Bang Bang!!
Within the fleeting instant of witnessing the image, Jack Clark groaned as his fourfold pupils shattered, blood pouring like a galaxy cascading freely, unable to be contained.
Despite the relentless streams of blood from his eyes, Jack Clark’s expression was extremely grave at this moment.
Henry, battling against two Eternal Powerhouses, had fallen into a disadvantage and was beginning to sustain injuries—origin injuries, no less.
As Humanity’s sole Eternal Source, Henry’s origin being harmed was equivalent to Humanity being harmed, affecting countless worlds and countless timelines of humans instantly.
Such was the terror of Eternal-level beings; they had transcended time-space, standing above Chaos and Reincarnation.
As they struck down Henry, the power imbued with their supreme wills extended through Henry’s “existence,” with each blow erasing Humans from countless worlds.

chapters.title: Chapter 1904: 712: Deification, Illuminating the Heavens, The True Star Giant Beast (Finale)
chapters.content:
Chapter 1904: Chapter 712: Deification, Illuminating the Heavens, The True Star Giant Beast (Finale)
Blue Star
Mist River City, the office of the board chairman at Myth Development Metal Refining Group, Doris Clark was flipping through documents.
Suddenly, a faint commotion came from far outside the building. Doris Clark involuntarily looked up, furrowing her brows slightly: “Someone mutated again. Xiao Qian, go check out the situation over there. Do they need help?”
“Yes, Chairman.”
Outside the office, a crisp, uniformed female secretary picked up the phone.
Soon, the secretary named Xiao Qian walked back in: “Chairman, in a neighborhood south of the city, more than ten people suddenly turned into bloodthirsty monsters.”
“But the Federation Law Enforcement Team was prepared. Those monsters didn’t have time to cause much harm before the teachers from South Sky Martial Height arrived.”
“Professor Lori Parma from Martial Height asked me to inform you that there’s no need to trouble you, Chairman. They can handle this incident.”
Doris Clark nodded slowly: “As long as it can be handled. Xiao Qian, you can get back to your tasks.”
“Understood, Chairman.” The female secretary left a bit nervously.
More than a decade has passed, and not only Glenn Clark, but even Doris Clark, an ordinary person, evolved into a Mythical Powerhouse through repeated breakthroughs of Major Realm by Jack Clark, coupled with the bloodline feedback from her family lineage.
With both of her sons becoming top-tier strong men, Doris Clark found herself bored and decided to seek something to do.
She then became the chairman of her former state-owned Metal Company and consolidated it, forming an international group to develop resources from the mythical world.
Having spent long years in a ‘high position,’ Doris Clark gradually gained an aura of authority belonging to higher-ups.
It was hard to imagine that more than ten years ago, Doris Clark was just an ordinary female employee trying her best to raise her two sons, working overtime every week.
Meanwhile, in a space interlayer high above Blue Star’s firmament, Freya Louise stood, her white dress swaying.
Although Jack Clark had occupied the past, erasing all traces and memories associated with him, Freya Louise instinctively watched over this place after the mutation outbreak.
Her father and aunt were also within her scope of observation.
Through long periods of blending her thoughts with the Heavenly Dao, Freya Louise’s mindset grew increasingly indifferent. In the vast Solar Divine Domain, the people and matters she cared about grew ever fewer.
Meanwhile, outside the company building, on the edge of the street, a burly man was roasting sweet potatoes, seeming somewhat diligent.
Still, in this era, it was strange to see someone selling sweet potatoes.
According to Jack Clark’s three-year agreement and the disappearing traces following the closure of the past, this Violent Dragon King had long ceased needing to guard Doris Clark.
Yet an instinctive awareness from the Mythical Powerhouse still told Kavadola it needed to protect this human.
Even when faced with enemies it couldn’t resist, retreat was not an option.
Though Kavadola didn’t understand why it had this thought, some mismatched, peculiar memories in its mind made it trust its intuition.
As Freya Louise stood above Blue Star, gazing down like the Heavenly Dao overlooking the world,
suddenly her expression changed dramatically. An incomprehensibly vast force of the Heavenly Dao descended, surging overwhelmingly into her body. Her aura escalated madly in an instant.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
The entire Blue Star’s atmosphere, and even the nearby outer space, were engulfed by the spontaneously appearing purple lightning, roaring and exploding, shaking heaven and earth.
“What is happening?”
“What’s going on? Could this be the end of the world?!”
Countless people looked up in horror, staring at the dazzling purple lightning enveloping the skies.
Especially the cultivators—those with stronger power felt the greater pressure. Mythical-level beings like Kavadola had already been reduced to trembling legs in fright.
In its Divine Soul Thought perception, the sprawling purple lightning above could effortlessly obliterate it with just a single strike.
Under the gaze of the Heavenly Feather Clan and Immortal Spirit Clan powerhouses on Blue Star and the neighboring Mars and Saturn, amidst the endless purple lightning, a platinum figure towering tens of thousands of kilometers emerged.
Behind this figure, resembling both a woman and a colossal mecha, a complex and resplendent white light wheel slowly formed.
The moment everyone saw the emerging white light wheel, they felt as though facing the Heavenly Dao directly. Instantly, an inescapable pressure descended.
Boom! Boom! Boom!!
Billions of humans on Blue Star, the Heavenly Feather Clan and Immortal Spirit Clan on Mars and Saturn—whether ordinary people, transcendents, mythics, or even Main God-level beings—
all instinctively knelt before the platinum figure.
At this moment, apart from Doris Clark, who did not sense the pressure of the Heavenly Dao, even Emma Louise and others bowed before the newly appointed Heavenly Dao.
The mutation in the Solar Divine Domain also alarmed individuals like Glenn Clark on the opposite side of the mythical world. All of them looked up at the Void above the Golden Divine Tree.
Glenn Clark was notably stunned: “Sister Freya Louise, her aura!!”
“How is this possible?!” In the depths of the Void, Adam Garcetti’s eyes revealed a moment of astonishment.
Due to Jack Clark’s repeated ascensions, the Solar Divine Domain had continuously expanded, becoming comparable to the Flame Wheel Divine Domain in size within just over a decade.
Though slower energy circulation caused the energy density of Heavenly Energy in this Divine Realm’s starspace to be significantly lower,
the Solar Divine Domain’s positional pattern had already grown equal to that of the True Emperor Divine Realm.
Moreover, with Freya Louise’s ancient half-step True Spirit physique, the remnants of the unknown Primordial Powerhouse’s Primitive Azure Sky, and over a decade’s accumulation of Heavenly Dao tempered intrinsic resources,
as Freya Louise wholly merged with the ‘Heavenly Dao’ at this moment, her realm naturally advanced into Primordial.
This progression also left Adam Garcetti slightly dazed.
He hadn’t expected that, out of the vast Human Federation, apart from Jack Clark, the first to step into Primordial wouldn’t be Glenn Clark or the Child of Destiny from the previous era—himself,
but rather Freya Louise, who once piloted Number One.

chapters.title: Chapter 1905: 712: Deification, Illuminating the Heavens, The True Star Giant Beast (Finale) _2
chapters.content:
Chapter 1905: Chapter 712: Deification, Illuminating the Heavens, The True Star Giant Beast (Finale) _2
At this moment, Freya Louise, who had become the Heavenly Dao of the Solar Divine Domain and reached a realm comparable to Primordial, did not feel the slightest joy.
In the space-time dimension visible only to her, a figure adorned in a white, ornate imperial robe and crowned with an imperial crown silently gazed at her, speaking without sound.
“Take care of our family.”
As the figure turned to leave after speaking, Freya Louise, who had fully regained her memories, called out anxiously, “Jack Clark, where are you going?”
The figure turned back, a faint smile on his face. “I am going to fight a battle. Someone there needs help.”
With those words, the figure vanished without a trace.
…
The Seventh Layer of the Ancient Battlefield Universe.
Amid the turbulent Void, a figure dressed in a white imperial robe appeared out of nowhere, smiling gently at Jack Clark, who was seated atop the head of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon. The figure turned into a radiant beam and merged into Jack Clark’s body.
Instantly, an aura of harmonious energy emanated from Jack Clark’s being.
With the Heavenly Dao fragment, which had been split off in the past as a resurrection mechanism, now returning to his divine soul, both Jack Clark and the Doomsday Emperor Dragon beneath him adopted a solemn expression.
Henry’s situation had already posed a significant threat to the existence of the Human Race; there was no time left for Jack Clark to continue his cultivation.
Although, with his current realm, even if Henry were killed by those two eternal beings and countless humans across dimensions and universes disappeared, it would not affect him.
However, the path he followed was not one of extinguishing emotions and desires.
In this world, there were many people he cared about and things he wished to protect.
Therefore, this battle was inevitable, and he had to join it as quickly as possible.
Yet, at the Eternal Battlefield, neither he—who was just one step away from entering the ancient realm—nor the half-immortal Giant Beast Body, capable of touching the will of immortality, could intervene unless the fusion of Deification Unity was achieved.
Moreover, this time, the fusion would be beast-dominant, with the “human” aspect disappearing completely.
There was no alternative.
The Doomsday Emperor Dragon had an unparalleled foundation, including half-step immortality, Primordial Rules of Chaos and Destruction, ten Deification Talents, eight Lifeline Talents, and the Body of The End.
By then, it would combine with Jack Clark’s equally powerful Destroyer Wheel King True Body, along with the Primordial Rules of Force and Genesis, sixteen Chaos Halos representing the sources of rules,
And four Superior Divine Powers, the Talent of Peerless Eyes—under comprehensive fusion, their realm could at least advance to the Ninth Heavenly Realm.
At that point, with the terrifying foundation of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon, even an Eternal existence could be confronted head-on in battle.
If he could cooperate with Henry and leverage the battle to grow stronger, gradually tearing and devouring the Eternal body of the opponent, perhaps, when the battle concluded, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon itself might ascend to Eternity.
And this was Jack Clark’s confidence.
Eternity is not an unkillable state! Thinking of this, Jack Clark lowered his gaze and murmured in the realm of thought.
“Deification, Unite!”
Boom!
The soul energy erupted with such immense power that the entirety of the Seventh Layer Universe quaked madly, radiating dazzling golden-white brilliance that illuminated all seven layers of the Ancient Battlefield.
Amid the Soul Light, Jack Clark’s true body scattered into countless luminous particles, enveloping and merging with the black-red Colossal Beast spanning three light years.
Roar! A wildly ferocious and commanding roar reverberated through the heavens, shaking countless worlds.
Under the shocked gaze of innumerable living beings, Heaven and Earth were engulfed by blinding black-red radiance, as a black-red “Sun” emerged from nothingness.
Illuminating the heavens, it existed for eternity.
This was the characteristic of the Ancient Ninth Heavenly Realm Everlasting Blaze, signifying true indomitability, an immortal will, and light that illuminated the heavens, a name worthy of Henry.
At this point, the Primordial path had reached its ultimate destination; advancing further would lead to complete transcendence and eternal permanence.
At this moment, across countless worlds in the Chaos Sea and even in other dimensional universes and space-times, countless beings witnessed the emergence of that black-red Sun.
Within the Sun appearing above their worlds out of nowhere, an incomparably majestic and ferocious behemoth stood faintly visible.
Or rather, the essence of the Sun itself was that colossal behemoth, overshadowing endless space-time and dimensions, descending as a projection in the form of a Sun.
Simultaneously, as many humans faintly discerned the outline of the giant beast, its form began to change.
It transformed into a lifeform no one had ever seen before—crowned with a black-red Imperial Crown, donned in a Mysterious Colored Imperial Robe, surrounded by thirty-six multicolored Chaos Halos.
This scene was also witnessed by everyone in the Six Great Divine Domains and the Blue Star Human Federation.
Especially the people of the Blue Star Federation, who had just experienced Freya Louise transcending the Primordial with her breakthrough as Heavenly Dao, now found their world blanketed by another earth-shaking phenomenon.
Moreover, with the appearance of the black-red Great Sun, standing alongside the golden, red, and gloomy blue suns over the Firmament of the mythical world, all humans’ blood boiled, their genes trembled.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Countless cultivators’ auras skyrocketed as they frantically absorbed the surging Heavenly Energy in their surroundings.
Among them, Glenn Clark benefited the most—as he had just entered half-step Primordial, his entire body erupted with dazzling golden light, enveloping the Human Territory spanning billions of kilometers.
The golden light in the sky surged like a sea of boiling clouds, converging into strands of rule-based chains, exuding an immensely overbearing and majestic aura.
In the depths of the Void, Adam Garcetti suddenly froze, startled: “Primordial!!”
“Damn, that giant beast looks familiar. Don’t tell me it’s that Thunderflame beast.”
Summer Welan from the Flame Wheel Divine Domain was utterly dumbfounded, staring at the heavens where the colossal beast projection resembling the Great Sun loomed over them. Sensing the supreme and unparalleled terror radiating from it, he could not help but swear aloud.
And it wasn’t just Summer Welan—Crystal Lewis, Mandy Lewis, and even Howard Lambert, who was battling against a bleeding giant beast, were equally astounded.
Of course, they recognized that colossal beast—the iconic three feathered horns and monstrous visage unmistakably belonging to the terrifying beast that had emerged from the Blue Star.
Mandy Lewis’s voice was trembling with disbelief: “Sis, do you feel that when looking up at that giant beast, there’s a sense of seeing Jack Clark in it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 1906: 712: Deification, Illuminating the Heavens, The True Star Giant Beast (Finale) _3
chapters.content:
Chapter 1906: Chapter 712: Deification, Illuminating the Heavens, The True Star Giant Beast (Finale) _3
“…Do you feel the same way?” Crystal Lewis was stunned.
As Jack Clark broke through, the aura triggered traces of the past that had been erased, including memories that resurfaced in the minds of known individuals.
From converging and occupying the past and future, erasing all traces, to illuminating the heavens, the marks engraved upon infinite spacetime and deep within the souls of countless living beings.
It was like a cycle—this was the path to eternity.
“The Eternal Blazing Sun… No, this aura of eternity, he/it has already touched eternity!”
Still stationed at the ancient battlefield, Sparkling Heaven True Emperor and the others looked up in horror, gazing at the dark red sun reflecting on all cosmic realms above them in disbelief.
The Skyflame Supreme and others were similarly petrified, momentarily dazed on the spot.
More than a decade ago, when Jack Clark and the Giant Beast faced off against the Nine Nether Monster, his realm was still perfected at the Sixth Heavenly Realm. Even then, his achievements left countless people shocked.
Now, eleven years later, Jack Clark—or rather, the Giant Beast—had suddenly stepped into the Ninth Heavenly Realm, even a half-step into eternity.
This… Could it be possible!?
“Welcome the arrival of eternity!”
Under the increasingly powerful aura of supreme eternity, billions of mythological entities and beings from different races on the ancient battlefield all knelt, welcoming the supreme and unmatched arrival of eternity.
Countless living beings from other worlds similarly instinctively knelt toward the sun in the heavens.
Within the Solar Divine Domain, Sky Path Freya Louise stood in outer space, her gaze hazy as she looked at the flashing dark red sun beyond infinite spacetime.
“Jack Clark!”
“That giant beast… Is my brother!?” At the center of the golden ocean, Glenn Clark, whose strength had skyrocketed into the primordial realm, raised his head, stunned, looking at the flashing dark red sun above.
Observing the sun that seemed both like a giant beast and Jack Clark, coupled with the terrifying, overflowing strength resonating within his body, Glenn Clark was momentarily dazed.
In his subconscious mind, a vision emerged: the small room where Jack Clark once kept a Six-legged Salamander.
That palm-sized Six-legged Salamander, under the influence of heavenly energy, mutated, grew larger as it fed, and one day, Jack Clark released it back into the wild.
It turned out, it wasn’t released into the wild—it was Jack Clark himself who was the giant beast, or perhaps, the beast was his Avatar.
No wonder the giant beast had repeatedly aided the Human Race, even leading the Beast Empire army across vast distances to support during the decisive battle against the Purgatory Demon Race.
At this moment, Glenn Clark comprehended everything.
And it wasn’t just Glenn Clark—in Mist River City.
Standing atop the sea of clouds, surrounded by a radiance of rules, Doris Clark—who had broken through from the Mythical Peak straight to Titan level, becoming an ancient Supreme—was also dazed.
Looking at the glowing dark red sun in the sky, she inexplicably felt an immense sense of intimacy, as though it was her son.
Roar! Roar! Roar!!
In the mythical world, as the dark red sun emerged, golden, red, and gloomy blue sunlight surged forth, a series of dignified roars from giant beasts thundered across infinite spacetime.
Meanwhile, amid the daylight, the silver moon and the Blood Moon appeared out of thin air, emitting brilliant radiance in collaboration.
It seemed as if they were celebrating the birth of the dark red sun.
On the mythical world’s earth, billions of mythical giant beasts raised their heads and roared toward the newly born King of the Beasts in the sky.
Within the Chaotic Turbulent Region, seawater detonated in the ocean as the Deep Sea Dragon Turtle, Nine-headed Flood Dragon, Single-horned Spawn Roc, and other beasts all soared with excitement, gazing toward the heavens.
Roar! “Kidora, Candle Dragon, look quickly—it’s Thunderflame! Thunderflame has turned into the sun in the sky!” The Deep Sea Dragon Turtle trembled with excitement.
Roar! Roar! Roar!! “We see it; you don’t have to tell us!” Kidora’s nine dragon heads twisted wildly, shaking the surrounding space into reverberating waves.
Even as a Titan-level beast, the Nine-headed Flood Dragon Kidora still maintained its chaotic habits of flailing its heads and entwining its tail during moments of heightened excitement.
Woo! The Single-horned Spawn Roc uttered a melodious cry, looking at the floating black Spawn Whale beside it.
“Darling, did you see? Thunderflame has turned into the sun—it feels overwhelmingly strong!”
The female Spawn Whale offered a soft, humming reply, gazing up into the sky: “Strong is an understatement—this is a power far beyond our comprehension.”
Blub! Blub!! “Amazing! Invincible! King is incredible! Hoo-ah, hoo-ah!!”
On the sea surface, the Blue Giant Crab spewed bubbles wildly, leading tens of thousands of crab-beast creatures behind it in unison to wave their claws—a spectacular scene.
Within these beasts, the more time-imbued Red Beast remained comparatively calm, letting out a subtle growl: “Indeed, King is magnificent, invincible.”
Due to their ignorance of realms exceeding primordial levels, these beasts couldn’t fathom the current stage of the Doomsday Emperor Dragon or how strong it had become.
But it didn’t matter—their King had always been terrifyingly powerful.
In their understanding, the Doomsday Emperor Dragon was either on the path of becoming stronger or already in a state of unparalleled strength. The intensity of its current aura simply agitated them.
Only awe remained—long accustomed to this.
Compared to beasts like the Single-horned Spawn Roc, the ancient Dragon Kings within the Dragon Palace reacted more dramatically.
“Darling, are we hallucinating? Is that giant beast King?”
The Time Dragon stared blankly at the sky, dazed, as if caught in a dream: after merely a dozen years away, how had that giant beast become a celestial sun hanging in the firmament?
“It’s him. There’s no mistake.” The Blue-White Giant Dragon nodded dazedly.
That indigenous beast, not even a year old yet already a mythical giant, had terrifying potential. Within the span of what seemed like slumber, it had grown so immensely.
One could only wonder what became of Scythia, who had left alongside it.
“You’ve gone so far, haven’t you?” The golden-blue giant dragon stood atop a mountain peak spanning thousands of kilometers, gazing upward at the glowing dark red sun, awe in its eyes.
“If only we knew how Scythia, that fool, was faring now.”
Under the watchful eyes of countless familiar and unfamiliar individuals, known and unknown beasts alike, a pair of enormous black golden vertical pupils slowly opened within the dark red glow.
Within those pupils, cosmoses rose and fell, and the birth and death of all existence unfolded in grandiose visuals.
Meanwhile, a vast transparent seven-colored river appeared before the Doomsday Celestial Emperor Dragon’s gaze, spanning across the heavens and realms, interweaving the destinies of all living beings.
“So, this is the River of Destiny.”
This complete deification transformation and elevation was more exaggerated than Jack Clark had anticipated, directly leaping beyond the Ninth Heavenly Realm to reach the half-step Eternal Realm.
Feeling the nearly invincible power within himself, Jack Clark’s eyes brimmed with fierce Battle Intent as he slightly raised his gaze toward the ancient battlefield above.
There, the battlefield connected to the supreme chaos, where Henry and two other eternal existences were locked in combat, deep within the supreme chaotic domain.
Boom!

The end, scatter the flowers!!
